verses.hindi: देवर्षि नारदने मुझसे यही प्रश्‍न पूछा था। उस  कुरु, कनखल, भद्राश्व, सगर, अश्वयूप, नचिकेता, समय मैंने प्रयत्नपूर्वक जो कुछ उनसे कहा था,  वृषाकपि तथा अरिन्दम आदि मानवोंद्वारा निर्मित वही तुम्हें भी बतलाता हूँ। तीर्थ मानुष कहलाते हैं। ये सब यश तथा उत्तम नारदजीने पूछा जगत्पते ! स्वर्गलोक, मर्त्यलोक  फलकी सिद्धिके लिये निर्मित हुए हैं। तीनों
verses.translation: if you give me the command, this rite of performance is to be done." Thus Shankara, god of gods, lord of the world, said to me:
verses.explanation: देवर्षि नारदने मुझसे यही प्रश्‍न पूछा था। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: देवर्षि नारदने मुझसे यही प्रश्‍न पूछा था। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यद् उद्दिष्टं सुरेशान तत् कुरुष्व यथेप्सितम् कर्तास्मि वचनं सर्वं ब्रह्मंस् तव जगद्विभो
verses.transliteration: yad uddiṣṭaṃ sureśāna tat kuruṣva yathepsitam kartāsmi vacanaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṃs tava jagadvibho
verses.hindi: और रसातलमें कुल कितने तीर्थ हैं तथा सब  लोकोंमें कहीं भी जो स्वतः प्रकट हुए हैव तीर्थ तीरथाँमें सदा कौन सबसे बढ़कर है? हैं, उन्हें पुण्यतीर्थ कहा गया है। इस प्रकार मैंने ब्रह्माजी बोले देवर्षे! स्वर्गलोक, मर्त्यलोक तीर्थ-भेद बतलाये हैं । और रसातलमें चार प्रकारके तीर्थ हैं-हैव, आसुर,  महाहैत्य राजा बलि देवताओंके अजेय शत्रु
verses.translation: "Do, lord of gods, as indicated, as you wish. I shall do all your word, Brahma, all-pervading lord of the world."
verses.explanation: और रसातलमें कुल कितने तीर्थ हैं तथा सब लोकोंमें कहीं भी जो स्वतः प्रकट हुए हैव तीर्थ तीरथाँमें सदा कौन सबसे बढ़कर है? हैं, उन्हें पुण्यतीर्थ कहा गया है। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: और रसातलमें कुल कितने तीर्थ हैं तथा सब लोकोंमें कहीं भी जो स्वतः प्रकट हुए हैव तीर्थ तीरथाँमें सदा कौन सबसे बढ़कर है? हैं, उन्हें पुण्यतीर्थ कहा गया है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चाहं प्रहृष्टात्मा कुशान् आदाय सत्वरम् हस्तं देवस्य देव्याश् च योगबन्धेन युक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tataś cāhaṃ prahṛṣṭātmā kuśān ādāya satvaram hastaṃ devasya devyāś ca yogabandhena yuktavān
verses.hindi: आर्ष और मानुष। ये तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात हैं ।  हुए; उन्होंने धर्म, यश, प्रजापालन, गुरुभक्ति, जम्बूद्वीपमें भारतवर्ष तीर्थभूमि है। वह तीनों लोकोंमें  सत्यभाषण, बल, पराक्रम, त्याग और क्षमाके
verses.translation: Then I, with glad heart, quickly took kusha grass and joined the god's and the goddess's hands with the yoga-bond.
verses.explanation: आर्ष और मानुष। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: आर्ष और मानुष। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलनश् च स्वयं तत्र कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः श्रुतिगीतैर् महामन्त्रैर् मूर्तिमद्भिर् उपस्थितैः
verses.transliteration: jvalanaś ca svayaṃ tatra kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ śrutigītair mahāmantrair mūrtimadbhir upasthitaiḥ
verses.hindi: द्वारा वह सम्मान प्राप्त किया, जिसकी तीनों  शस्त्र धारण करते हैं। आप-जैसे स्वामीके होते लोकोंमें कहीं उपमा नहीं है। उनकी बढ़ती हुई  हुए हमपर ऐसा दुःख आ पड़ा है। हमारी जो समृद्धि देखकर देवताओंको बड़ी चिन्ता हुई। वे  वाणी आपको प्रणाम करती थी, वही एक हैत्यको आपसमें सलाह करने लगे कि हम बलिको कैसे  कैसे नमस्कार करेगी। सुरेश्वर! आपके ऐश्वर्यसे
verses.translation: Agni himself stood there with joined palms, attended by the great mantras sung in the Shruti, embodied,
verses.explanation: द्वारा वह सम्मान प्राप्त किया, जिसकी तीनों शस्त्र धारण करते हैं। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: द्वारा वह सम्मान प्राप्त किया, जिसकी तीनों शस्त्र धारण करते हैं। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तविधिना हुत्वा सर्पिस् तद् अमृतं हविः ततस् तं ज्वलनं सर्वं कारयित्वा प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: yathoktavidhinā hutvā sarpis tad amṛtaṃ haviḥ tatas taṃ jvalanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam
verses.hindi: जीतें। राजा बलिके शासनकालमें तीनों लोक  पुष्ट हो अपने ही पराक्रमसे तीनों लोकोंको जीतकर
verses.translation: having offered as prescribed ghee, that immortal oblation, and then having made them circumambulate that whole fire,
verses.explanation: जीतें। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: जीतें। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्त्वा हस्तसमायोगं सहितः सर्वदैवतैः पुत्रैश् च मानसैः सिद्धैः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: muktvā hastasamāyogaṃ sahitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ putraiś ca mānasaiḥ siddhaiḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
verses.hindi: शत्रुओंको बाधा नहीं थी। अनावृष्टि और अधर्मका तो नाम भी नहीं था। स्वप्रमें भी किसीको दुष्ट पुरुषका दर्शन नहीं होता था। देवताओंको उनको उन्नति बाणको तरह चुभती थी। बलिको कोीर्तिरूपी
verses.translation: releasing the joining of hands, together with all the deities, with mind-born sons and Siddhas, with a delighted inner self,
verses.explanation: शत्रुओंको बाधा नहीं थी। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: शत्रुओंको बाधा नहीं थी। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वृत्त उद्वाहकाले तु प्रणम्य च वृषध्वजम् योगेनैव तयोर् विप्रास् तद् उमापरमेशयोः
verses.transliteration: vṛtta udvāhakāle tu praṇamya ca vṛṣadhvajam yogenaiva tayor viprās tad umāparameśayoḥ
verses.hindi: तलवारसे वे टुकड़े-टुकड़े हुए जाते थे तथा उनके शासनरूपी शक्तिसे देवताओंके समस्त अङ्ग विदीर्ण हो रहे थे। अतः उन्हें कभी शान्ति नहीं मिलती थी। देवता उनसे द्वेष करने लगे। उनके
verses.translation: at the time of the wedding rite, having bowed to the bull-bannered Lord, by yoga alone, Brahmins, of those two, Uma and the Supreme Lord —
verses.explanation: तलवारसे वे टुकड़े-टुकड़े हुए जाते थे तथा उनके शासनरूपी शक्तिसे देवताओंके समस्त अङ्ग विदीर्ण हो रहे थे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: तलवारसे वे टुकड़े-टुकड़े हुए जाते थे तथा उनके शासनरूपी शक्तिसे देवताओंके समस्त अङ्ग विदीर्ण हो रहे थे। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहः स परो वृत्तो यं देवा न विदुः क्वचित् इति वः सर्वम् आख्यातं स्वयंवरम् इदं शुभम् उद्वाहश् चैव देवस्य शृणुध्वं परमाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: udvāhaḥ sa paro vṛtto yaṃ devā na viduḥ kvacit iti vaḥ sarvam ākhyātaṃ svayaṃvaram idaṃ śubham udvāhaś caiva devasya śṛṇudhvaṃ paramādbhutam
verses.hindi: यशरूपी अग्निसे जलने लगे। अतः वे व्याकुल होकर भगवान् विष्णुकी शरणमे गये
verses.translation: that supreme wedding took place, which the gods nowhere know. Thus all this auspicious svayamvara has been told to you; hear also the supremely wondrous wedding of the god.
verses.explanation: यशरूपी अग्निसे जलने लगे। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: यशरूपी अग्निसे जलने लगे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ वृत्ते विवाहे तु भवस्यामिततेजसः प्रहर्षम् अतुलं गत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः तुष्टुवुर् वाग्भिर् आद्याभिः प्रणेमुस् ते महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: atha vṛtte vivāhe tu bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ praharṣam atulaṃ gatvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir ādyābhiḥ praṇemus te maheśvaram
verses.translation: When the marital ceremony of lord Siva of unmeasured splendour was performed Indra and other Devas were highly pleased. They eulogised the lord in glorious words and paid obeisance in reverence in the following way.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले जगन्नाथ! हम पीडित हैं। हमारी सत्ता
verses.commentary: Sense: When the marital ceremony of lord Siva of unmeasured splendour was performed Indra and other Devas were highly pleased. They eulogised the lord in glorious words and paid obeisance in reverence in the following way.
verses.science: करनेवाले जगन्नाथ! हम पीडित हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमः पर्वतलिङ्गाय पर्वतेशाय वै नमः नमः पवनवेगाय विरूपायाजिताय च नमः क्लेशविनाशाय दात्रे च शुभसंपदाम्
verses.transliteration: namaḥ parvataliṅgāya parvateśāya vai namaḥ namaḥ pavanavegāya virūpāyājitāya ca namaḥ kleśavināśāya dātre ca śubhasaṃpadām
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord who has the blue tuft. Obeisance to the lord, husband of Uma. Obeisance to the lord in the form of the wind. Obeisance to the lord of one hundred forms.
verses.hindi: छिन गयी है। आप हमारी ही रक्षाके लिये अस्त्र-
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord who has the blue tuft. Obeisance to the lord, husband of Uma. Obeisance to the lord in the form of the wind. Obeisance to the lord of one hundred forms.
verses.science: छिन गयी है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमो नीलशिखण्डाय अम्बिकापतये नमः नमः पवनरूपाय शतरूपाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya ambikāpataye namaḥ namaḥ pavanarūpāya śatarūpāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity of terrible form, of deformed eyes, one thousand eyes and one thousand feet.*
verses.hindi: हम स्थिर होंगे। हैत्यको कैसे नमस्कार करें।
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity of terrible form, of deformed eyes, one thousand eyes and one thousand feet.*
verses.science: हम स्थिर होंगे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नमो भैरवरूपाय विरूपनयनाय च नमः सहस्रनेत्राय सहस्रचरणाय च
verses.transliteration: namo bhairavarūpāya virūpanayanāya ca namaḥ sahasranetrāya sahasracaraṇāya ca

verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the overlord of mobile and immobile beings; obeisance, obeisance to one who suppresses sinners. Obeisance to the deity whose symbol is a water reservoir; obeisance, obeisance to one who annihilates the Yugas.
verses.science: श्रीभगवान् बोले-देवताओ! बलि मेरा भक्त है, उसे देवता और असुर कोई भी नहीं मार सकते जैसे तुमलोग मेरे द्वारा पालन-पोषणके योग्य हो, वैसे बलि भी है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तम् अनाचारसंयुक्तं दुरात्मानं कुलाधमम् लोकान् सर्वान् पीडयन्तं सर्वाङ्गावरणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tam anācārasaṃyuktaṃ durātmānaṃ kulādhamam lokān sarvān pīḍayantaṃ sarvāṅgāvaraṇātmakam
verses.translation: On being burned he became distressed and lamented piteously and out of tune. Propitiating that lord he fell down on the ground.
verses.hindi: तथा अविनाशी यश आदि प्रदान किये। इस प्रकार हैत्यराज बलिको यह सब कुछ देकर भगवानूने उन्हें पुत्र और पल्रीसहित रसातलमें भेज दिया और इन्द्रको देवताओंका राज्य अर्पित किया।
verses.commentary: Sense: On being burned he became distressed and lamented piteously and out of tune. Propitiating that lord he fell down on the ground.
verses.science: तथा अविनाशी यश आदि प्रदान किये। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां विघ्नकर्तारं नियमानां व्रतैः सह चक्राह्वयस्य रूपेण रत्या सह समागतम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ vighnakartāraṃ niyamānāṃ vrataiḥ saha cakrāhvayasya rūpeṇa ratyā saha samāgatam
verses.translation: With his limbs encompassed by fire the cupid, the scorcher of the world fell down into a swoon instantaneously.
verses.hindi: इसी बीचमें उनका जो दूसरा पग मेरे लोकमें पहुँचा था, उसे देखकर मैंने सोचा, “यह मेरे
verses.commentary: Sense: With his limbs encompassed by fire the cupid, the scorcher of the world fell down into a swoon instantaneously.
verses.science: इसी बीचमें उनका जो दूसरा पग मेरे लोकमें पहुँचा था, उसे देखकर मैंने सोचा, “यह मेरे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथाततायिनं विप्रा वेद्धुकामं सुरेश्वरः नयनेन तृतीयेन सावज्ञं समवैक्षत
verses.transliteration: athātatāyinaṃ viprā veddhukāmaṃ sureśvaraḥ nayanena tṛtīyena sāvajñaṃ samavaikṣata
verses.translation: His excessively distressed wife lamented piteously. In great agony she ruefully requested the lord and the goddess for mercy.
verses.hindi: है, जो सौभाग्यवश
verses.commentary: Sense: His excessively distressed wife lamented piteously. In great agony she ruefully requested the lord and the goddess for mercy.
verses.science: है, जो सौभाग्यवश। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्य नेत्रजो वह्निर् ज्वालामालासहस्रवान् सहसा रतिभर्तारम् अदहत् सपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'sya netrajo vahnir jvālāmālāsahasravān sahasā ratibhartāram adahat saparicchadam
verses.translation: Realizing her pathetic plight, the sympathetic lord and the lady Uma glanced at the desolate Rati consolingly and said.
verses.hindi: मेरे घरपर आ पहुँचा है। इसके लिये मैं क्या करूँ, जिससे मेरा कल्याण हो ? मेरे पास जो यह श्रेष्ठ कमण्डलु है, इसमें भगवान् शंकरका दिया पर्वके समय शुभोदय करनेवाला है। उसके हुआ पवित्र जल है। यह जल उत्तम, वरदायक,  प्रभावका स्मरण करनेसे समस्त अभिलषित
verses.commentary: Sense: Realizing her pathetic plight, the sympathetic lord and the lady Uma glanced at the desolate Rati consolingly and said.
verses.science: मेरे घरपर आ पहुँचा है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: स दह्यमानः करुणम् आर्तो ऽक्रोशत विस्वरम् प्रसादयंश् च तं देवं पपात धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: sa dahyamānaḥ karuṇam ārto 'krośata visvaram prasādayaṃś ca taṃ devaṃ papāta dharaṇītale
verses.translation: Indeed, O gentle lady, he has been burned up. His resuscitation here, is not desired. Bodiless though he be, O gentle lady, he will carry out your tasks.
verses.hindi: शान्तिकारक, शुभद, भोग और मोक्षका दाता, विश्वके  वस्तुओंकी प्रापि होती है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, O gentle lady, he has been burned up. His resuscitation here, is not desired. Bodiless though he be, O gentle lady, he will carry out your tasks.
verses.science: शान्तिकारक, शुभद, भोग और मोक्षका दाता, विश्वके वस्तुओंकी प्रापि होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ सो ऽग्निपरीताङ्गो मन्मथो लोकतापनः पपात सहसा मूर्छां क्षणेन समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: atha so 'gniparītāṅgo manmatho lokatāpanaḥ papāta sahasā mūrchāṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata
verses.translation: After securing that boon, the fair*faeed wife of Kama

verses.commentary: Sense: After securing that boon, the fair*faeed wife of Kama
verses.science: पूज्य, ज्येष्ठ, श्रेष्ठ, गुणमय तथा स्मरणमात्रसे लोकोंको पवित्र करनेवाला है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पत्नी तु करुणं तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता देवीं देवं च दुःखार्ता अयाचत् करुणावती
verses.transliteration: patnī tu karuṇaṃ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā devīṃ devaṃ ca duḥkhārtā ayācat karuṇāvatī

verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, after burning up Kama the delighted bulUbannered lord sported about on the Himalaya mountain Jn the company of Uma«
verses.science: दिया। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश् च करुणां ज्ञात्वा देवौ तौ करुणात्मकौ ऊचतुस् तां समालोक्य समाश्वास्य च दुःखिताम्

verses.translation: Surrounded by Devas led by Indra, sages, Yakyas, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Vidyadharas, leading Daityas and others of various sorts, the couple derived great pleasure on that mountain.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरने जटाओंमें रख लिया। पश्चिममें जो जल गिरा, वह फिर कमण्डलुमें ही चला आया। उत्तरमें गिरे हुए जलको भगवान् विष्णुने ग्रहण किया तथा पूर्वमें जो जल गिरा, उसे देवताओं,
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded by Devas led by Indra, sages, Yakyas, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Vidyadharas, leading Daityas and others of various sorts, the couple derived great pleasure on that mountain.
verses.science: भगवान् शंकरने जटाओंमें रख लिया। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध एव ध्रुवं भद्रे नास्योत्पत्तिर् इहेष्यते अशरीरो ऽपि ते भद्रे कार्यं सर्वं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: dagdha eva dhruvaṃ bhadre nāsyotpattir iheṣyate aśarīro 'pi te bhadre kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: There the celestial damsels and the leading Devas •danced; the delighted Gandharvas sai; the brahmins medita¬ ted; some hurriedly played on the musical instruments and some eultised the excellent qualities of the lord.

verses.commentary: Sense: There the celestial damsels and the leading Devas •danced; the delighted Gandharvas sai; the brahmins medita¬ ted; some hurriedly played on the musical instruments and some eultised the excellent qualities of the lord.
verses.science: पितरों और लोकपालोंने ग्रहण किया; अतः वह जल अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ कहा जाता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु विष्णुर् भगवान् वसुदेवसुतः शुभे तदा तस्य सुतो यश् च पतिस् ते संभविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yadā tu viṣṇur bhagavān vasudevasutaḥ śubhe tadā tasya suto yaś ca patis te saṃbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The noble lord, who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga, who was accompanied by hii powerful attendants comparable to Indra, Yama and fire-god, did not leave off that mountain just for pleasing the goddess.

verses.commentary: Sense: The noble lord, who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga, who was accompanied by hii powerful attendants comparable to Indra, Yama and fire-god, did not leave off that mountain just for pleasing the goddess.
verses.science: गौतमके द्वारा भगवान् शंकरकी स्तुति, शिवका गौतमको जटासहित गङ्ाका अर्पण तथा गोतमी गङ्गाका माहात्म्य ब्रह्माजी कहते हैं-महामते! भगवान् शंकरको पालन करते हुए तपस्…। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā tu varaṃ labdhvā kāmapatnī śubhānanā jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ prītiyuktā gataklamā
verses.translation: What did the great lord the destroyer of Kama do, 'Staying there accompanied by Uma? We wish to know this.
verses.hindi: जटामें जो दिव्य जल आकर स्थित हुआ, उसके  आराधना करनी पड़ी थी। इस प्रकार एक ही दो भेद हुए; क्योंकि उसे पृथ्वीपर उतारनेवाले  गङ्गाके दो स्वरूप हो गये।
verses.commentary: Sense: What did the great lord the destroyer of Kama do, 'Staying there accompanied by Uma? We wish to know this.
verses.science: जटामें जो दिव्य जल आकर स्थित हुआ, उसके आराधना करनी पड़ी थी। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.transliteration: dagdhvā kāmaṃ tato viprāḥ sa tu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ reme tatromayā sārdhaṃ prahṛṣṭas tu himācale
verses.translation: On being bluntly told thus by her mother Um& was not pleased. Endowed with enormous patience she did not say anything to her mother. Dbmissed by her mother she went straight to her lord and said:

verses.sanskrit: कन्दरेषु च रम्येषु पद्मिनीषु गुहासु च निर्झरेषु च रम्येषु कर्णिकारवनेषु च
verses.transliteration: kandareṣu ca ramyeṣu padminīṣu guhāsu ca nirjhareṣu ca ramyeṣu karṇikāravaneṣu ca
verses.translation: O lord of the chiefs of Devas I will not stay on this mountain. O lord of massive splendour, make another residence for me in any of the three worlds.
verses.hindi: दूसरा भाग बलवान् क्षत्रिय राजा भगीरथने इस पुथ्वीपर उतारा। इसके लिये उन्हें नियमोंका
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the chiefs of Devas I will not stay on this mountain. O lord of massive splendour, make another residence for me in any of the three worlds.
verses.science: दूसरा भाग बलवान् क्षत्रिय राजा भगीरथने इस पुथ्वीपर उतारा। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: नदीतीरेषु कान्तेषु किंनराचरितेषु च शृङ्गेषु शैलराजस्य तडागेषु सरःसु च

verses.explanation: एक समयकी बात है, महर्षि गौतम कैलासपर्वतपर गये और मौनभावसे कुशा बिछाकर उसपर बैठे; फिर पवित्र होकर इस स्तोत्रका गान। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: वनराजिषु रम्यासु नानापक्षिरुतेषु च तीर्थेषु पुण्यतोयेषु मुनीनाम् आश्रमेषु च
verses.transliteration: vanarājiṣu ramyāsu nānāpakṣiruteṣu ca tīrtheṣu puṇyatoyeṣu munīnām āśrameṣu ca
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.translation: in lovely lines of forests, with the cries of many birds, in holy places with sacred waters and in the hermitages of sages.
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.transliteration: eteṣu puṇyeṣu manohareṣu deśeṣu vidyādharabhūṣiteṣu gandharvayakṣāmaraseviteṣu reme sa devyā sahitas trinetraḥ
verses.translation: In these holy and charming regions, adorned with Vidyadharas and frequented by Gandharvas, Yakshas and immortals, the three-eyed god sported with the Goddess.

verses.sanskrit: देवैः सहेन्द्रैर् मुनियक्षसिद्धैर् गन्धर्वविद्याधरदैत्यमुख्यैः अन्यैश् च सर्वैर् विविधैर् वृतो ऽसौ तस्मिन् नगे हर्षम् अवाप शंभुः
verses.transliteration: devaiḥ sahendrair muniyakṣasiddhair gandharvavidyādharadaityamukhyaiḥ anyaiś ca sarvair vividhair vṛto 'sau tasmin nage harṣam avāpa śaṃbhuḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by the gods with Indra, by sages, Yakshas and Siddhas, by Gandharvas, Vidyadharas and chief Daityas and all others of various kinds, Shambhu found joy on that mountain.

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्ति तत्राप्सरसः सुरेशा गायन्ति गन्धर्वगणाः प्रहृष्टाः दिव्यानि वाद्यान्य् अथ वादयन्ति केचिद् द्रुतं देववरं स्तुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: nṛtyanti tatrāpsarasaḥ sureśā gāyanti gandharvagaṇāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ divyāni vādyāny atha vādayanti kecid drutaṃ devavaraṃ stuvanti
verses.translation: There the Apsarases dance for the lord of the gods, the hosts of Gandharvas sing with delight, and some play divine instruments while others quickly praise the best of gods.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स देवः स्वगणैर् उपेतो महाबलैः शक्रयमाग्नितुल्यैः देव्याः प्रियार्थं भगनेत्रहन्ता गिरिं न तत्याज तदा महात्मा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa devaḥ svagaṇair upeto mahābalaiḥ śakrayamāgnitulyaiḥ devyāḥ priyārthaṃ bhaganetrahantā giriṃ na tatyāja tadā mahātmā
verses.translation: Thus that great-souled god, the slayer of Bhaga's eyes, accompanied by his own mighty hosts equal to Shakra, Yama and Agni, did not leave the mountain, for the Goddess's pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: देव्याः समं तु भगवांस् तिष्ठंस् तत्र स कामहा अकरोत् किं महादेव एतद् इच्छाम वेदितुम्
verses.transliteration: devyāḥ samaṃ tu bhagavāṃs tiṣṭhaṃs tatra sa kāmahā akarot kiṃ mahādeva etad icchāma veditum
verses.translation: While the Lord, the destroyer of Kama, stayed there with the Goddess, what did Mahadeva do? We wish to know this.

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् हिमवच्छृङ्गे स हि देव्याः प्रियेच्छया गणेशैर् विविधाकारैर् हासं संजनयन् मुहुः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān himavacchṛṅge sa hi devyāḥ priyecchayā gaṇeśair vividhākārair hāsaṃ saṃjanayan muhuḥ
verses.translation: On the peak of the Himalaya, the Lord, wishing to please the Goddess, again and again made her laugh with his Ganas of various shapes.

verses.sanskrit: देवीं बालेन्दुतिलको रमयंश् च रराम च महानुभावैः सर्वज्ञैः कामरूपधरैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: devīṃ bālendutilako ramayaṃś ca rarāma ca mahānubhāvaiḥ sarvajñaiḥ kāmarūpadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: The one marked with the crescent moon delighted the Goddess and sported with the glorious, omniscient, auspicious ones able to take any form.

verses.transliteration: atha devy āsasādaikā mātaraṃ parameśvarī āsīnāṃ kāñcane śubhra āsane paramādbhute
verses.translation: Then the supreme Goddess went alone to her mother, who was seated on a bright, wondrous golden seat.

verses.sanskrit: अथ दृष्ट्वा सतीं देवीम् आगतां सुररूपिणीम् आसनेन महार्हेण शंपादयद् अनिन्दिताम् आसीनां ताम् अथोवाच मेना हिमवतः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā satīṃ devīm āgatāṃ surarūpiṇīm āsanena mahārheṇa śaṃpādayad aninditām āsīnāṃ tām athovāca menā himavataḥ priyā
verses.translation: Seeing the virtuous Goddess arrive in divine form, Mena, beloved of Himavan, honoured the blameless one with a costly seat, and when she was seated, said to her:

verses.sanskrit: चिरस्यागमनं ते ऽद्य वद पुत्रि शुभेक्षणे दरिद्रा क्रीडनैस् त्वं हि भर्त्रा क्रीडसि संगता
verses.transliteration: cirasyāgamanaṃ te 'dya vada putri śubhekṣaṇe daridrā krīḍanais tvaṃ hi bhartrā krīḍasi saṃgatā
verses.translation: "Tell me, daughter of lovely eyes, why you have come after so long. You play, united with your husband, with poor amusements.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये दरिद्रा भवन्ति स्म तथैव च निराश्रयाः उमे त एवं क्रीडन्ति यथा तव पतिः शुभे
verses.transliteration: ye daridrā bhavanti sma tathaiva ca nirāśrayāḥ ume ta evaṃ krīḍanti yathā tava patiḥ śubhe
verses.translation: Those who are poor and without shelter, Uma, play just as your husband does, dear one."

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu viprarṣiḥ punar dakṣam abhāṣata
verses.translation: Having said this, the brahmin sage spoke again to Daksha:

verses.transliteration: pūjyaṃ ca paśubhartāraṃ kasmān nārcayase prabhum
verses.translation: "Why do you not worship the Lord, the master of creatures, who is worthy of worship?"

verses.transliteration: santi me bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ ekādaśasthānagatā nānyaṃ vidmo maheśvaram
verses.translation: "I have many Rudras, bearing tridents and with matted hair, stationed in eleven places; we know no other Maheshvara."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एकमन्त्रो ऽयं ममेशो न निमन्त्रितः यथाहं शंकराद् ऊर्ध्वं नान्यं पश्यामि दैवतम् तथा दक्षस्य विपुलो यज्ञो ऽयं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām ekamantro 'yaṃ mameśo na nimantritaḥ yathāhaṃ śaṃkarād ūrdhvaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi daivatam tathā dakṣasya vipulo yajño 'yaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "This one mantra is for all, yet my Lord has not been invited. As I see no deity higher than Shankara, so this vast sacrifice of Daksha will not come to be."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोश् च भागा विविधाः प्रदत्तास् तथा च रुद्रेभ्य उत प्रदत्ताः अन्ये ऽपि देवा निजभागयुक्ता ददामि भागं न तु शंकराय
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoś ca bhāgā vividhāḥ pradattās tathā ca rudrebhya uta pradattāḥ anye 'pi devā nijabhāgayuktā dadāmi bhāgaṃ na tu śaṃkarāya
verses.translation: "Various shares have been given to Vishnu, and shares given to the Rudras; the other gods too have their own shares; but I give no share to Shankara."

verses.sanskrit: गतास् तु देवता ज्ञात्वा शैलराजसुता तदा उवाच वचनं शर्वं देवं पशुपतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: gatās tu devatā jñātvā śailarājasutā tadā uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim
verses.translation: Knowing that the deities had gone, the daughter of the king of mountains then spoke to Sharva, the god, the lord of creatures, her husband:

verses.transliteration: bhagavan kutra yānty ete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahān ayam
verses.translation: "O Lord, where are these gods led by Shakra going? Tell me truly, O knower of truth; this is my great doubt."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patir uttamaḥ hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: "O illustrious one, Daksha, the excellent lord of creatures, is performing a horse sacrifice; the heaven-dwellers are going there."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञम् एतं महाभाग किमर्थं नानुगच्छसि केन वा प्रतिषेधेन गमनं ते न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: yajñam etaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nānugacchasi kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate
verses.translation: "O illustrious one, why do you not go to this sacrifice? By what prohibition is your going ruled out?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरैर् एव महाभागे सर्वम् एतद् अनुष्ठितम् यज्ञेषु मम सर्वेषु न भाग उपकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: surair eva mahābhāge sarvam etad anuṣṭhitam yajñeṣu mama sarveṣu na bhāga upakalpitaḥ
verses.translation: "O illustrious one, the gods themselves have arranged all this: in all their sacrifices no share has been assigned to me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वागतेन गन्तव्यं मार्गेण वरवर्णिनि न मे सुराः प्रयच्छन्ति भागं यज्ञस्य धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: pūrvāgatena gantavyaṃ mārgeṇa varavarṇini na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ
verses.translation: O fair one, one must go by the path followed of old; the gods do not give me a share of the sacrifice according to dharma."

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् सर्वदेवेषु प्रभावाभ्यधिको गुणैः अजेयश् चाप्य् अधृष्यश् च तेजसा यशसा श्रिया
verses.transliteration: bhagavan sarvadeveṣu prabhāvābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ ajeyaś cāpy adhṛṣyaś ca tejasā yaśasā śriyā
verses.translation: "O Lord, among all the gods you are superior in power and virtues, unconquerable and unassailable in splendour, fame and glory.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनेन तु महाभाग प्रतिषेधेन भागतः अतीव दुःखम् आपन्ना वेपथुश् च महान् अयम्
verses.transliteration: anena tu mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ atīva duḥkham āpannā vepathuś ca mahān ayam
verses.translation: But through this exclusion from the share, O illustrious one, I have fallen into great sorrow, and I tremble greatly.

verses.transliteration: kiṃ nāma dānaṃ niyamaṃ tapo vā kuryām ahaṃ yena patir mamādya labheta bhāgaṃ bhagavān acintyo yajñasya cendrādyamarair vicitram
verses.translation: What gift, observance or austerity should I perform so that my husband, the inconceivable Lord, may today obtain a share in the sacrifice made splendid by Indra and the other immortals?"

verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ bhagavān vicintya patnīṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ kṣubhitām uvāca na vetsi māṃ devi kṛśodarāṅgi kiṃ nāma yuktaṃ vacanaṃ tavedam
verses.translation: As she spoke thus, the Lord reflected and, delighted, said to his agitated wife: "You do not know me, O Goddess of slender waist; what kind of speech is this of yours?

verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vijānāmi viśālanetre dhyānena sarve ca vidanti santaḥ tavādya mohena sahendradevā lokatrayaṃ sarvam atho vinaṣṭam
verses.translation: I know, O wide-eyed one, and all the good know through meditation: today through your delusion the gods with Indra and all the three worlds are ruined.

verses.transliteration: mām adhvareśaṃ nitarāṃ stuvanti rathaṃtaraṃ sāma gāyanti mahyam māṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantrair yajanti mamādhvaryavaḥ kalpayante ca bhāgam
verses.translation: They praise me constantly as lord of the sacrifice; they sing the Rathantara Saman for me; brahmins worship me with Vedic mantras; my Adhvaryu priests assign me a share."

verses.transliteration: vikatthase prākṛtavat sarvastrījanasaṃsadi stauṣi garvāyase cāpi svam ātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "You boast like an ordinary man in an assembly of women; you praise yourself and are proud of yourself, no doubt."

verses.transliteration: nātmānaṃ staumi deveśi yathā tvam anugacchasi saṃsrakṣyāmi varārohe bhāgārthe varavarṇini
verses.translation: "I do not praise myself, O Queen of gods; as you follow along, I will create one for the sake of the share, O lovely one of fine hips."

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā bhagavān patnīm umāṃ prāṇair api priyām so 'sṛjad bhagavān vaktrād bhūtaṃ krodhāgnisaṃbhavam
verses.translation: Having said this to his wife Uma, dearer to him than life, the Lord created from his mouth a being born of the fire of wrath,

verses.transliteration: tam uvāca makhaṃ gaccha dakṣasya tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ nāśayāśu kratuṃ tasya dakṣasya madanujñayā
verses.translation: and said to him, "Go to Daksha's sacrifice, O great lord; destroy Daksha's rite quickly with my permission."

verses.transliteration: tato rudraprayuktena siṃhaveṣeṇa līlayā devyā manyukṛtaṃ jñātvā hato dakṣasya sa kratuḥ
verses.translation: Then, sent by Rudra, in the guise of a lion, playfully, knowing it was caused by the Goddess's wrath, he destroyed Daksha's sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: manyunā ca mahābhīmā bhadrakālī maheśvarī ātmanaḥ karmasākṣitve tena sārdhaṃ sahānugā
verses.translation: And through her wrath the very terrible Bhadrakali, the great Goddess, went with him and his followers as witness of her own act.

verses.transliteration: sa eṣa bhagavān krodhaḥ pretāvāsakṛtālayaḥ vīrabhadreti vikhyāto devyā manyupramārjakaḥ
verses.translation: He is that Lord Wrath, who makes his abode among the dead, famed as Virabhadra, who wiped away the Goddess's anger.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद् रोमकूपेभ्य आत्मनैव गणेश्वरान् रुद्रानुगान् गणान् रौद्रान् रुद्रवीर्यपराक्रमान्
verses.transliteration: so 'sṛjad romakūpebhya ātmanaiva gaṇeśvarān rudrānugān gaṇān raudrān rudravīryaparākramān
verses.translation: From the pores of his own body he created lords of hosts, followers of Rudra, fierce hosts with Rudra's might and valour.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्यानुचराः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रपराक्रमाः ते निपेतुस् ततस् तूर्णं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: rudrasyānucarāḥ sarve sarve rudraparākramāḥ te nipetus tatas tūrṇaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: All were Rudra's attendants, all of Rudra's valour; they rushed down swiftly in hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाशं पूरयन्न् इव समभूत् सुमहान् विप्राः सर्वरुद्रगणैः कृतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kilakilāśabda ākāśaṃ pūrayann iva samabhūt sumahān viprāḥ sarvarudragaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, a very great "kilikila" sound, made by all the hosts of Rudra, arose as if filling the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन महता त्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः पर्वताश् च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुंधरा
verses.transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta cakampe ca vasuṃdharā
verses.translation: By that great sound all the heaven-dwellers were terrified; the mountains crumbled and the earth trembled.

verses.sanskrit: मरुतश् च ववुः क्रूराश् चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः अग्नयो वै न दीप्यन्ते न चादीप्यत भास्करः
verses.transliteration: marutaś ca vavuḥ krūrāś cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ agnayo vai na dīpyante na cādīpyata bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Fierce winds blew and the ocean was agitated; the fires did not blaze and the sun did not shine.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहा नैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि न तारकाः ऋषयो न प्रभासन्ते न देवा न च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: grahā naiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na tārakāḥ ṛṣayo na prabhāsante na devā na ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: The planets did not shine, nor the constellations nor the stars; the sages did not shine, nor the gods, nor the Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि तिमिरीभूते निर्दहन्ति गणेश्वराः प्रभञ्जन्त्य् अपरे यूपान् घोरान् उत्पाटयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi timirībhūte nirdahanti gaṇeśvarāḥ prabhañjanty apare yūpān ghorān utpāṭayanti ca
verses.translation: When all had thus become dark, the lords of the hosts burned everything; others broke the sacrificial posts and tore them up terribly.

verses.transliteration: praṇadanti tathā cānye vikurvanti tathā pare tvaritaṃ vai pradhāvanti vāyuvegā manojavāḥ
verses.translation: Some roared, others made strange forms, and others ran swiftly, fast as the wind and quick as thought.

verses.transliteration: cūrṇyante yajñapātrāṇi yajñasyāyatanāni ca śīryamāṇāny adṛśyanta tārā iva nabhastalāt
verses.translation: The sacrificial vessels and the halls of sacrifice were smashed; being shattered, they looked like stars falling from the sky.

verses.transliteration: divyānnapānabhakṣyāṇāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ kṣīranadyas tathā cānyā ghṛtapāyasakardamāḥ
verses.translation: There were heaps of divine food, drink and eatables like mountains, rivers of milk, and others with mud of ghee and milk-rice,

verses.sanskrit: मधुमण्डोदका दिव्याः खण्डशर्करवालुकाः षड्रसान् निवहन्त्य् अन्या गुडकुल्या मनोरमाः
verses.transliteration: madhumaṇḍodakā divyāḥ khaṇḍaśarkaravālukāḥ ṣaḍrasān nivahanty anyā guḍakulyā manoramāḥ
verses.translation: divine rivers with water of honey-cream, with sands of candied sugar, others carrying the six tastes, and lovely streams of molasses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च यानि कानि च दिव्यानि लेह्यचोष्याणि यानि च
verses.transliteration: uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca yāni kāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca
verses.translation: Meats of every kind, various eatables, and whatever divine things there were to lick and suck,

verses.sanskrit: भुञ्जन्ति विविधैर् वक्त्रैर् विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च रुद्रकोपा महाकोपाः कालाग्निसदृशोपमाः
verses.transliteration: bhuñjanti vividhair vaktrair vilumpanti kṣipanti ca rudrakopā mahākopāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ
verses.translation: the fierce ones born of Rudra's wrath, like the fire of doom, devoured with their various mouths, plundered and threw about.

verses.translation: Devouring, huge as mountains, terrifying everyone on all sides, those of various shapes sported and carried off the women of the gods.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ gaṇāś ca tair yukto vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān rudrakopaprayuktaś ca sarvadevaiḥ surakṣitam
verses.translation: Thus the valiant Virabhadra, joined with those hosts and impelled by Rudra's wrath, the sacrifice that had been well protected by all the gods —

verses.transliteration: taṃ yajñam adahac chīghraṃ bhadrakālyāḥ samīpataḥ cakrur anye tathā nādān sarvabhūtabhayaṃkarān
verses.translation: he quickly burned that sacrifice in the presence of Bhadrakali; others raised cries terrifying to all beings.

verses.transliteration: chittvā śiro 'nye yajñasya vyanadanta bhayaṃkaram tataḥ śakrādayo devā dakṣaś caiva prajāpatiḥ ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kathyatāṃ ko bhavān iti
verses.translation: Others cut off the head of the Sacrifice and roared terribly. Then the gods led by Shakra, and Daksha the lord of creatures, joined their palms and said, "Tell us, who are you?"

verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ devo na daityo vā na ca bhoktum ihāgataḥ naiva draṣṭuṃ ca devendrā na ca kautūhalānvitāḥ
verses.translation: "I am not a god nor a Daitya, nor have I come here to eat, nor to see, O lords of gods, nor out of curiosity.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षयज्ञविनाशार्थं संप्राप्तो ऽहं सुरोत्तमाः वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो रुद्रकोपाद् विनिःसृतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñavināśārthaṃ saṃprāpto 'haṃ surottamāḥ vīrabhadreti vikhyāto rudrakopād viniḥsṛtaḥ
verses.translation: I have come to destroy Daksha's sacrifice, O best of gods. I am known as Virabhadra, born from the wrath of Rudra.

verses.transliteration: bhadrakālī ca vikhyātā devyāḥ krodhād vinirgatā preṣitā devadevena yajñāntikam upāgatā
verses.translation: And this is the famous Bhadrakali, who came forth from the Goddess's anger; sent by the god of gods, she has come to the sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: śaraṇaṃ gaccha rājendra devadevam umāpatim varaṃ krodho 'pi devasya na varaḥ paricārakaiḥ
verses.translation: O king of kings, take refuge in the god of gods, the husband of Uma; even the god's anger is better than a boon from his attendants."

verses.transliteration: nikhātotpāṭitair yūpair apaviddhais tatas tataḥ utpatadbhiḥ patadbhiś ca gṛdhrair āmiṣagṛdhnubhiḥ
verses.translation: With sacrificial posts dug up and torn out and thrown here and there, with vultures greedy for flesh flying up and swooping down,

verses.transliteration: pakṣavātavinirdhūtaiḥ śivārutavināditaiḥ sa tasya yajño nṛpater bādhyamānas tadā gaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: scattered by the wind of their wings, resounding with the howls of jackals, that king's sacrifice, oppressed then by the hosts,

verses.transliteration: āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai kham evābhyapatat tadā taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantam upalabhya saḥ
verses.translation: took the form of a deer and flew up into the sky. Perceiving that sacrifice going away in that form,

verses.transliteration: dhanur ādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadartham agamat prabhuḥ tatas tasya gaṇeśasya krodhād amitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: the Lord took up his bow and arrow and went after it. Then from the forehead of that lord of hosts, of boundless splendour, in his anger,

verses.translation: Daksha too took refuge in his mind in the god Bhava. Restraining his in-breath and out-breath with effort at the place of the eyes,

verses.transliteration: vidhārya sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ bahudṛṣṭir amitrajit smitaṃ kṛtvābravīd vākyaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
verses.translation: holding his gaze in all directions, the many-eyed conqueror of foes smiled and said, "Tell me, what shall I do for you?"

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान् यदि वाहं तव प्रियः यदि चाहम् अनुग्राह्यो यदि देयो वरो मम
verses.transliteration: yadi prasanno bhagavān yadi vāhaṃ tava priyaḥ yadi cāham anugrāhyo yadi deyo varo mama
verses.translation: "If the Lord is pleased, if I am dear to you, if I am worthy of favour, and if a boon is to be given me —

verses.transliteration: yad bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣitaṃ pītaṃ trāsitaṃ yac ca nāśitam cūrṇīkṛtāpaviddhaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhāram īdṛśam
verses.translation: whatever of the sacrificial materials has been eaten, drunk, scattered, destroyed, crushed and thrown away,

verses.transliteration: dīrghakālena mahatā prayatnena ca saṃcitam na ca mithyā bhaven mahyaṃ tvatprasādān maheśvara
verses.translation: gathered over a long time and with great effort — let it not be in vain for me, by your grace, O Maheshvara."

verses.translation: kneeling on the ground, having obtained the boon from Bhava, Daksha praised the bull-bannered god with a thousand and eight names.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā dakṣaḥ śaṃbhor vīryaṃ dvijottamāḥ prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā saṃstotum upacakrame
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the virility of Siva hus, Dakfa joined his palms in reverence and bowed down. Then he began to eulogise.

verses.transliteration: namas te devadeveśa namas te 'ndhakasūdana devendra tvaṃ balaśreṣṭha devadānavapūjita
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O lord of the chiefs of Devas, Obei¬ sance to you, O slayer of Bala, O lord of Devas, you are the most excellent one in strength, you are worshipped by Devas and Danavas.

verses.transliteration: sahasrākṣa virūpākṣa tryakṣa yakṣādhipapriya sarvataḥpāṇipādas tvaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ
verses.translation: Devas are procreated by Sv&has and Svadhau. To those who attain death Svfthas and Svadhas are offered. Svahi, Svadhit and Ahar eulogise you.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतःश्रुतिमांल् लोके सर्वम् आवृत्य तिष्ठसि शङ्कुकर्णो महाकर्णः कुम्भकर्णो ऽर्णवालयः
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥśrutimāṃl loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhasi śaṅkukarṇo mahākarṇaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'rṇavālayaḥ
verses.translation: You are identical with all. You are the omnipresent lord, the lord of all living beings, and the immanent soul in all living beings. Hence you have not been invited.

verses.transliteration: gajendrakarṇo gokarṇaḥ śatakarṇo namo 'stu te śatodaraḥ śatāvartaḥ śatajihvaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: O lordi you alone are worshipped in sacrifices with:.yanou8 lortt gifts. You aiooe are the doer of everything. Hence you have not been invited.

verses.translation: O lord of Devas, be pleased with me. You alone are my refuge. You are the goal and the foundation. It is my opinion that no one else is so.

verses.translation: After eulogising the great lord thus the highly intelli- gent Dak 9 a stopped. The delighted lord spoke to Daksa once again.

verses.translation: O Dakfa of good holy rites, I am delighted with this hymn of yours. Of what avail is much talk? You will come to my presence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dakfa of good holy rites, I am delighted with this hymn of yours. Of what avail is much talk? You will come to my presence.

verses.translation: After uttering the words of consolation the omniscient lord of the three worlds spoke the following words succinctly put in good sentences.
verses.commentary: Sense: After uttering the words of consolation the omniscient lord of the three worlds spoke the following words succinctly put in good sentences.

verses.transliteration: trijaṭāya triśīrṣāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe tryambakāya trinetrāya tripuraghnāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O Dakya, you should not feel sad by this destruction of sacrifice. O sinless one, I am the destroyer of sacrifice and this has been seen by you formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Dakya, you should not feel sad by this destruction of sacrifice. O sinless one, I am the destroyer of sacrifice and this has been seen by you formerly.

verses.transliteration: namaś caṇḍāya muṇḍāya viśvacaṇḍadharāya ca daṇḍine śaṅkukarṇāya daṇḍidaṇḍāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O one of Good holy rites, accept this boon from me. Wear a happy and pleasant face and listen to me attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: O one of Good holy rites, accept this boon from me. Wear a happy and pleasant face and listen to me attentively.

verses.transliteration: namo 'rdhadaṇḍikeśāya śuṣkāya vikṛtāya ca vilohitāya dhūmrāya nīlagrīvāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O Patriarch, by virtue of my favour, you will derive the fruit of a thousand hone and a hundred Vajapeya sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Patriarch, by virtue of my favour, you will derive the fruit of a thousand hone and a hundred Vajapeya sacrifices.

verses.translation: O sages who are conversant with holy rites, after acquiring his share as mentioned before, the lord classified (ail* ments, fever etc.) in to various divisions, in the company of Uma.

verses.translation: O sages conversant with virtue, such are the fevers among living beings. It occurs at the time of birth, death and in the intervening period.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages conversant with virtue, such are the fevers among living beings. It occurs at the time of birth, death and in the intervening period.

verses.translation: From the supreme lord he derives happiness and with this body itself he becomes the lord of Gaas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the supreme lord he derives happiness and with this body itself he becomes the lord of Gaas.

verses.transliteration: namo jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya balapramathanāya ca ugrāya ca namo nityaṃ namaś ca daśabāhave
verses.translation: The holy rites of that person who listens to this or narrates this frequently, shall fructify without any hindrance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy rites of that person who listens to this or narrates this frequently, shall fructify without any hindrance.

verses.transliteration: namaḥ kapālahastāya sitabhasmapriyāya ca vibhīṣaṇāya bhīmāya bhīṣmavratadharāya ca
verses.translation: By repeating this hymn, whatever one desires mentally or utters orally shall be realised.

verses.translation: To the one of various distorted faces, with a tongue like a sword and fierce fangs, whose portions are fortnights, months and moments, who loves the gourd-lute;

verses.translation: to the one of forms both gentle and terrible, more terrible than the terrible; salutation to Shiva, the tranquil; salutation to the most tranquil;

verses.transliteration: namo buddhāya śuddhāya saṃvibhāgapriyāya ca pavanāya pataṃgāya namaḥ sāṃkhyaparāya ca
verses.translation: salutation to the awakened, the pure, who loves sharing; to the wind, to the bird; salutation to the one devoted to Sankhya;

verses.transliteration: namaś caṇḍaikaghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭājalpāya ghaṇṭine sahasraśataghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāmālāpriyāya ca
verses.translation: salutation to the one with a single fierce bell, who speaks with bells, who bears a bell, who has a hundred thousand bells, who loves garlands of bells;

verses.transliteration: prāṇadaṇḍāya nityāya namas te lohitāya ca hūṃhūṃkārāya rudrāya bhagākārapriyāya ca
verses.translation: to the staff of life, the eternal; salutation to you, the red one; to Rudra who utters "hum hum," who loves the form of the yoni;

verses.transliteration: namo 'pāravate nityaṃ girivṛkṣapriyāya ca namo yajñādhipataye bhūtāya prasutāya ca
verses.translation: salutation ever to the boundless, who loves mountains and trees; salutation to the lord of sacrifice, to the being, to the one who is born;

verses.transliteration: yajñavāhāya dāntāya tapyāya ca bhagāya ca namas taṭāya taṭyāya taṭinīpataye namaḥ
verses.translation: to the bearer of sacrifice, the self-controlled, the one to be worshipped with austerity, and to Bhaga; salutation to the bank, to the one of the bank, salutation to the lord of rivers;

verses.transliteration: annadāyānnapataye namas tv annabhujāya ca namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya sahasracaraṇāya ca
verses.translation: to the giver of food, the lord of food; salutation to the eater of food; salutation to the thousand-headed, the thousand-footed,

verses.transliteration: sahasroddhataśūlāya sahasranayanāya ca namo bālārkavarṇāya bālarūpadharāya ca
verses.translation: the one with a thousand raised tridents, the thousand-eyed; salutation to the one coloured like the morning sun, who bears the form of a child,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: namo bālārkarūpāya bālakrīḍanakāya ca namaḥ śuddhāya buddhāya kṣobhaṇāya kṣayāya ca
verses.translation: salutation to the one in the form of the morning sun, who plays like a child; salutation to the pure, the awakened, the agitator and destroyer,

verses.sanskrit: तरंगाङ्कितकेशाय मुक्तकेशाय वै नमः नमः षट्कर्मनिष्ठाय त्रिकर्मनियताय च
verses.transliteration: taraṃgāṅkitakeśāya muktakeśāya vai namaḥ namaḥ ṣaṭkarmaniṣṭhāya trikarmaniyatāya ca
verses.translation: whose hair is marked with waves, salutation to the one with loosened hair; salutation to the one devoted to the six duties and bound by the three duties,

verses.translation: who duly establishes the separate dharmas of the classes and stages of life; salutation to the best, the eldest; salutation to the tumultuous,

verses.translation: with white and tawny eyes, with black and red eyes; to dharma, desire, wealth and liberation; to the slayer and the destroyer;

verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyāya sāṃkhyamukhyāya yogādhipataye namaḥ namo rathyādhirathyāya catuṣpathapathāya ca
verses.translation: to Sankhya, the chief of Sankhya, the lord of yoga, salutation; salutation to the lord of streets and highways, to the path of the crossroads;

verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine īśāna rudrasaṃghāta harikeśa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: with a black antelope skin as upper garment and a serpent as sacred thread; O Ishana, host of Rudras, Harikesha, salutation to you!

verses.transliteration: tryambakāyāmbikānātha vyaktāvyakta namo 'stu te kālakāmadakāmaghna duṣṭodvṛttaniṣūdana
verses.translation: O three-eyed one, lord of Ambika, manifest and unmanifest, salutation to you; O Kala, giver of desires and destroyer of desire, slayer of the wicked and unruly,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगर्हित सर्वघ्न सद्योजात नमो ऽस्तु ते उन्मादन शतावर्तगङ्गातोयार्द्रमूर्धज
verses.transliteration: sarvagarhita sarvaghna sadyojāta namo 'stu te unmādana śatāvartagaṅgātoyārdramūrdhaja
verses.translation: censured by all, destroyer of all, Sadyojata, salutation to you; O maddener, whose hair is wet with the water of the hundred-whirled Ganga,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रार्धसंयुगावर्त मेघावर्त नमो ऽस्तु ते नमो ऽन्नदानकर्त्रे च अन्नदप्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: candrārdhasaṃyugāvarta meghāvarta namo 'stu te namo 'nnadānakartre ca annadaprabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: whirl joined with the crescent moon, whirl of clouds, salutation to you; salutation to the maker of gifts of food, salutation to the source of food-givers;

verses.transliteration: annabhoktre ca goptre ca tvam eva pralayānala jarāyujāṇḍajāś caiva svedajodbhijja eva ca
verses.translation: you are the eater of food and the protector, and the fire of dissolution. The womb-born, the egg-born, the sweat-born and the sprout-born —

verses.transliteration: tvam eva devadeveśa bhūtagrāmaś caturvidhaḥ carācarasya sraṣṭā tvaṃ pratihartā tvam eva ca
verses.translation: you alone, lord of the gods, are the fourfold host of beings; you are the creator of the moving and unmoving, and you alone are the withdrawer.

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् एव ब्रह्मा विश्वेश अप्सु ब्रह्म वदन्ति ते सर्वस्य परमा योनिः सुधांशो ज्योतिषां निधिः
verses.transliteration: tvam eva brahmā viśveśa apsu brahma vadanti te sarvasya paramā yoniḥ sudhāṃśo jyotiṣāṃ nidhiḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Brahma, lord of the universe; they call you Brahman in the waters; you are the supreme source of all, the nectar-rayed one, the treasury of lights.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्सामानि तथौंकारम् आहुस् त्वां ब्रह्मवादिनः हायि हायि हरे हायि हुवाहावेति वासकृत्
verses.transliteration: ṛksāmāni tathauṃkāram āhus tvāṃ brahmavādinaḥ hāyi hāyi hare hāyi huvāhāveti vāsakṛt
verses.translation: The expounders of Brahman call you the Rik and Saman and the syllable Om; "haayi haayi hare haayi huvaahaava" —
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वां सुरश्रेष्ठाः सामगा ब्रह्मवादिनः यजुर्मय ऋङ्मयश् च सामाथर्वयुतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: gāyanti tvāṃ suraśreṣṭhāḥ sāmagā brahmavādinaḥ yajurmaya ṛṅmayaś ca sāmātharvayutas tathā
verses.translation: so the best of gods, the Saman-singers and expounders of Brahman, sing to you; you consist of the Yajus and the Rik, joined with the Saman and the Atharvan;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: you alone are the assemblies of the stages of life, the lightning and the thunder; you are the year, the seasons, the months and the half-months,

verses.sanskrit: सिंहो मृगाणां पतयस् तक्षकानन्तभोगिनाम् क्षीरोदो ह्य् उदधीनां च मन्त्राणां प्रणवस् तथा

verses.transliteration: vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyam eva ca tvam evecchā ca dveṣaś ca rāgo mohaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā
verses.translation: the thunderbolt among weapons and truth among vows; you alone are desire and hatred, passion, delusion, calm and forbearance,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्यवसायो धृतिर् लोभः कामक्रोधौ जयाजयौ त्वं गदी त्वं शरी चापी खट्वाङ्गी मुद्गरी तथा

verses.translation: resolution, steadfastness, greed, desire and anger, victory and defeat; you bear the mace, the arrow, the bow, the khatvanga and the mallet;

verses.translation: you are the cutter, the piercer, the striker, the leader and the thinker, in our view; dharma with its ten marks, wealth and desire,

verses.transliteration: dravyakarmaguṇārambhaḥ kālapuṣpaphalapradaḥ ādiś cāntaś ca madhyaś ca gāyatry oṃkāra eva ca
verses.translation: the beginning of substance, action and quality, the giver of flowers and fruits in season, the beginning, end and middle, the Gayatri and the syllable Om;

verses.transliteration: harito lohitaḥ kṛṣṇo nīlaḥ pītas tathā kṣaṇaḥ kadruś ca kapilo babhruḥ kapoto macchakas tathā
verses.translation: green, red, black, blue and yellow, the moment, tawny, brown, dove-coloured and the macchaka;

verses.transliteration: suvarṇaretā vikhyātaḥ suvarṇaś cāpy atho mataḥ suvarṇanāmā ca tathā suvarṇapriya eva ca
verses.translation: famed as having golden seed, considered golden, named golden and fond of gold;

verses.transliteration: tvam indraś ca yamaś caiva varuṇo dhanado 'nalaḥ utphullaś citrabhānuś ca svarbhānur bhānur eva ca
verses.translation: you are Indra and Yama, Varuna, the giver of wealth and fire; the blooming one, the bright-rayed, Svarbhanu and the sun;

verses.translation: whose limbs are song, instrument and dance, fond of song and music; the fish, the net, the water, the invincible, the water-serpent, the hut-dweller;

verses.translation: the untimely, the good time, the bad time, the destroyer of time; death, the imperishable, the end, the maker of forbearance and illusion;

verses.translation: Samvarta and Vartaka, the Samvartaka and the cloud; the one with bells, the bell-bearer, the crested one, the salt ocean;

verses.translation: leader of the four stages of life and maker of the four classes; perishable and imperishable, beloved, rogue, counted by hosts, lord of hosts;

verses.translation: wearing red garlands and garments, lord of the mountain, beloved of the mountain's daughter, lord of artisans, best of artisans, originator of all crafts;

verses.transliteration: gūḍhavrataś ca gūḍhaś ca gūḍhavrataniṣevitaḥ taraṇas tāraṇaś caiva sarvabhūteṣu tāraṇaḥ
verses.translation: Of hidden vows, hidden, served by those of hidden vows; the crosser, the one who carries across, the saviour among all beings;

verses.translation: mental and bodily ailments, the destroyer and lord of disease; the bearable, the hunter of the sacrificial deer, the mine of diseases and not their mine;

verses.translation: crested, the lotus, lotus-eyed; bearer of the staff and discus-staff, destroyer of the fierce share;

verses.transliteration: candrādityau cakṣuṣī te hṛdayaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ agniṣṭomas tathā deho dharmakarmaprasādhitaḥ
verses.translation: the moon and sun are your eyes and the Grandsire your heart; the Agnishtoma is your body, adorned by dharma and ritual.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रह्मा न च गोविन्दः पुराण-ऋषयो न च माहात्म्यं वेदितुं शक्ता याथातथ्येन ते शिव
verses.transliteration: na brahmā na ca govindaḥ purāṇa-ṛṣayo na ca māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yāthātathyena te śiva
verses.translation: Neither Brahma, nor Govinda, nor the ancient sages can truly know your greatness, O Shiva.

verses.transliteration: śivā yā mūrtayaḥ sūkṣmās te mahyaṃ yāntu darśanam tābhir māṃ sarvato rakṣa pitā putram ivaurasam
verses.translation: May your auspicious, subtle forms come into my sight; protect me with them on all sides, as a father protects his own son.

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष मां रक्षणीयो ऽहं तवानघ नमो ऽस्तु ते भक्तानुकम्पी भगवान् भक्तश् चाहं सदा त्वयि
verses.transliteration: rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo 'haṃ tavānagha namo 'stu te bhaktānukampī bhagavān bhaktaś cāhaṃ sadā tvayi
verses.translation: Protect me — I am to be protected by you, O sinless one; salutation to you. You are the Lord compassionate to devotees, and I am ever devoted to you.

verses.transliteration: yaḥ sahasrāṇy anekāni puṃsām āvṛtya durdṛśām tiṣṭhaty ekaḥ samudrānte sa me goptāstu nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: He who, covering many thousands of men hard to see, stands alone at the ocean's end — may he always be my protector.

verses.sanskrit: यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शिनः ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास् तस्मै योगात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānās tasmai yogātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: To him whom yogins, sleepless, breath controlled, established in sattva, seeing all equally, behold as light, to him whose self is yoga, salutation.

verses.sanskrit: संभक्ष्य सर्वभूतानि युगान्ते समुपस्थिते यः शेते जलमध्यस्थस् तं प्रपद्ये ऽम्बुशायिनम्
verses.transliteration: saṃbhakṣya sarvabhūtāni yugānte samupasthite yaḥ śete jalamadhyasthas taṃ prapadye 'mbuśāyinam
verses.translation: I take refuge in the one who lies on the waters, who, having devoured all beings when the end of the age comes, sleeps in the midst of the waters.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य वदनं राहोर् यः सोमं पिबते निशि ग्रसत्य् अर्कं च स्वर्भानुर् भूत्वा सोमाग्निर् एव च
verses.transliteration: praviśya vadanaṃ rāhor yaḥ somaṃ pibate niśi grasaty arkaṃ ca svarbhānur bhūtvā somāgnir eva ca
verses.translation: He who, entering the mouth of Rahu, drinks the moon at night and, becoming Svarbhanu, swallows the sun, and is the fire of Soma —

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमात्राः पुरुषा देहस्थाः सर्वदेहिनाम् रक्षन्तु ते च मां नित्यं नित्यं चाप्याययन्तु माम्
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhamātrāḥ puruṣā dehasthāḥ sarvadehinām rakṣantu te ca māṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ cāpyāyayantu mām
verses.translation: may those thumb-sized persons who dwell in the bodies of all embodied beings always protect me and always nourish me.

verses.sanskrit: येनाप्य् उत्पादिता गर्भा अपो भागगताश् च ये तेषां स्वाहा स्वधा चैव आप्नुवन्ति स्वदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: yenāpy utpāditā garbhā apo bhāgagatāś ca ye teṣāṃ svāhā svadhā caiva āpnuvanti svadanti ca
verses.translation: Those by whom embryos are produced and the waters that have their share — through them Svaha and Svadha reach and are relished.

verses.transliteration: yena rohanti dehasthāḥ prāṇino rodayanti ca harṣayanti na kṛṣyanti namas tebhyas tu nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Those by whom living beings in the body grow and weep, rejoice and are not drawn away — salutation to them always.

verses.sanskrit: ये समुद्रे नदीदुर्गे पर्वतेषु गुहासु च वृक्षमूलेषु गोष्ठेषु कान्तारगहनेषु च
verses.transliteration: ye samudre nadīdurge parvateṣu guhāsu ca vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣṭheṣu kāntāragahaneṣu ca
verses.translation: Those in the ocean, in river fastnesses, on mountains and in caves, at the roots of trees, in cow-pens, in wildernesses and thickets,

verses.translation: at crossroads, in streets, in squares and in assembly halls, in stables of elephants, horses and chariots, in old gardens and houses,

verses.sanskrit: येषु पञ्चसु भूतेषु दिशासु विदिशासु च इन्द्रार्कयोर् मध्यगता ये च चन्द्रार्करश्मिषु
verses.transliteration: yeṣu pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca indrārkayor madhyagatā ye ca candrārkaraśmiṣu
verses.translation: in the five elements, in the directions and intermediate directions, those between Indra and the sun, and those in the rays of the moon and sun,

verses.sanskrit: रसातलगता ये च ये च तस्मात् परं गताः नमस् तेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यस् तु सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmāt paraṃ gatāḥ namas tebhyo namas tebhyo namas tebhyas tu sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: those who have gone to Rasatala and those who have gone beyond it — salutation to them, salutation to them, salutation to them in every way.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस् त्वं सर्वगो देवः सर्वभूतपतिर् भवः सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा च तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: sarvas tvaṃ sarvago devaḥ sarvabhūtapatir bhavaḥ sarvabhūtāntarātmā ca tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ
verses.translation: You are all, the all-pervading god, Bhava, lord of all beings, the inner self of all beings; that is why you were not invited.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् एव चेज्यसे देव यज्ञैर् विविधदक्षिणैः त्वम् एव कर्ता सर्वस्य तेन त्वं न निमन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: tvam eva cejyase deva yajñair vividhadakṣiṇaiḥ tvam eva kartā sarvasya tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are worshipped, O god, with sacrifices of various fees; you alone are the maker of all; that is why you were not invited.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथवा मायया देव मोहितः सूक्ष्मया तव तस्मात् तु कारणाद् वापि त्वं मया न निमन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: athavā māyayā deva mohitaḥ sūkṣmayā tava tasmāt tu kāraṇād vāpi tvaṃ mayā na nimantritaḥ
verses.translation: Or else, O god, I was deluded by your subtle maya; for that reason too you were not invited by me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद मम देवेश त्वम् एव शरणं मम त्वं गतिस् त्वं प्रतिष्ठा च न चान्यो ऽस्तीति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration: prasīda mama deveśa tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mama tvaṃ gatis tvaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca na cānyo 'stīti me matiḥ
verses.translation: Be gracious to me, O lord of the gods; you alone are my refuge; you are my goal and my foundation, and there is no other — this is my conviction.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वैवं स महादेवं विरराम महामतिः भगवान् अपि सुप्रीतः पुनर् दक्षम् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: stutvaivaṃ sa mahādevaṃ virarāma mahāmatiḥ bhagavān api suprītaḥ punar dakṣam abhāṣata
verses.translation: Having praised Mahadeva thus, the great-minded one fell silent; and the Lord, well pleased, spoke again to Daksha:

verses.sanskrit: परितुष्टो ऽस्मि ते दक्ष स्तवेनानेन सुव्रत बहुना तु किम् उक्तेन मत्समीपं गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: parituṣṭo 'smi te dakṣa stavenānena suvrata bahunā tu kim uktena matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: "I am well satisfied with you, Daksha, by this hymn, O one of good vows; what need to say more? You will come near me."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैवम् अब्रवीद् वाक्यं त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर् भवः कृत्वाश्वासकरं वाक्यं सर्वज्ञो वाक्यसंहितम्
verses.transliteration: tathaivam abravīd vākyaṃ trailokyādhipatir bhavaḥ kṛtvāśvāsakaraṃ vākyaṃ sarvajño vākyasaṃhitam
verses.translation: Then Bhava, lord of the three worlds, the omniscient, spoke these reassuring words:

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष दुःखं न कर्तव्यं यज्ञविध्वंसनं प्रति अहं यज्ञहनस् तुभ्यं दृष्टम् एतत् पुरानघ
verses.transliteration: dakṣa duḥkhaṃ na kartavyaṃ yajñavidhvaṃsanaṃ prati ahaṃ yajñahanas tubhyaṃ dṛṣṭam etat purānagha
verses.translation: "Daksha, do not grieve over the destruction of the sacrifice. I am the destroyer of sacrifice for you; this was seen long ago, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: भूयश् च त्वं वरम् इमं मत्तो गृह्णीष्व सुव्रत प्रसन्नसुमुखो भूत्वा ममैकाग्रमनाः शृणु
verses.transliteration: bhūyaś ca tvaṃ varam imaṃ matto gṛhṇīṣva suvrata prasannasumukho bhūtvā mamaikāgramanāḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Take from me this further boon, O one of good vows; be glad and pleasant of face, and listen to me with a concentrated mind.

verses.transliteration: aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya vai prajāpate matprasādāt phalabhāgī bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: By my grace, O lord of creatures, you will share in the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices and a hundred Vajapeya sacrifices.

verses.transliteration: vedān ṣaḍaṅgān budhyasva sāṃkhyayogāṃś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ tapaś ca vipulaṃ taptvā duścaraṃ devadānavaiḥ
verses.translation: Understand the Vedas with their six limbs and Sankhya and Yoga completely, and practise vast austerity, hard even for gods and Danavas.

verses.translation: Joined with twelve years, secret, blamed by the ignorant, practised in some places according to the dharmas of classes and stages of life and not in others,

verses.sanskrit: उत्पादितं दक्ष शुभं सर्वपापविमोचनम् अस्य चीर्णस्य यत् सम्यक् फलं भवति पुष्कलम् तच् चास्तु सुमहाभाग मानसस् त्यज्यतां ज्वरः
verses.transliteration: utpāditaṃ dakṣa śubhaṃ sarvapāpavimocanam asya cīrṇasya yat samyak phalaṃ bhavati puṣkalam tac cāstu sumahābhāga mānasas tyajyatāṃ jvaraḥ
verses.translation: has been produced by me, Daksha — auspicious and releasing from all sins. Whatever abundant fruit comes from its proper observance, may that be yours, O illustrious one; let the fever of your mind be cast off."

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu deveśaḥ sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ adarśanam anuprāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, the lord of the gods, with his wife and followers, vanished from the sight of Daksha of boundless splendour.

verses.transliteration: avāpya ca tathā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ comayā bhavaḥ jvaraṃ ca sarvadharmajño bahudhā vyabhajat tadā
verses.translation: Having obtained his share as Uma had said, Bhava, knower of all dharma, then divided the fever in many ways

verses.translation: for the peace of all beings — hear now, O twice-born: heat of the head for elephants, bitumen for mountains,

verses.transliteration: apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ vidyān nirmoko bhujageṣu ca khorakaḥ saurabheyāṇām ūkharaḥ pṛthivītale
verses.translation: know it as moss for waters, the sloughed skin for serpents, foot-disease for cattle, and salinity on the earth's surface;

verses.transliteration: śunām api ca dharmajñā dṛṣṭipratyavarodhanam randhrāgatam athāśvānāṃ śikhodbhedaś ca barhiṇām
verses.translation: for dogs, O knowers of dharma, the obstruction of sight; for horses, the disease of the nostrils; for peacocks, the bursting of the crest;

verses.transliteration: netrarāgaḥ kokilānāṃ dveṣaḥ prokto mahātmanām janānām api bhedaś ca sarveṣām iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: redness of eyes for cuckoos; for the great souls it is declared to be hatred; for all people, dissension — so we have heard;

verses.transliteration: śukānām api sarveṣāṃ hikkikā procyate jvaraḥ śārdūleṣv atha vai viprāḥ śramo jvara ihocyate
verses.translation: for all parrots the fever is said to be hiccup; for tigers, O brahmins, fever here is called exhaustion;

verses.transliteration: mānuṣeṣu ca sarvajñā jvaro nāmaiṣa kīrtitaḥ maraṇe janmani tathā madhye cāpi niveśitaḥ
verses.translation: and among humans, O all-knowing ones, it is called fever; it is placed at death, at birth and in between.

verses.sanskrit: एतन् माहेश्वरं तेजो ज्वरो नाम सुदारुणः नमस्यश् चैव मान्यश् च सर्वप्राणिभिर् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: etan māheśvaraṃ tejo jvaro nāma sudāruṇaḥ namasyaś caiva mānyaś ca sarvaprāṇibhir īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: This is Maheshvara's very terrible splendour called fever; the Lord is to be saluted and honoured by all living beings.

verses.transliteration: imāṃ jvarotpattim adīnamānasaḥ paṭhet sadā yaḥ susamāhito naraḥ vimuktarogaḥ sa naro mudāyuto labheta kāmāṃś ca yathāmanīṣitān
verses.translation: The man who, with an undismayed mind and well composed, always reads this origin of fever, becomes free from disease, joyful, and obtains his desires as he wishes.

verses.transliteration: dakṣaproktaṃ stavaṃ cāpi kīrtayed yaḥ śṛṇoti vā nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyāt kiṃcid dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Whoever recites or hears the hymn spoken by Daksha meets with no misfortune and obtains long life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वेषु देवेषु वरिष्ठो भगवान् भवः तथा स्तवो वरिष्ठो ऽयं स्तवानां दक्षनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: yathā sarveṣu deveṣu variṣṭho bhagavān bhavaḥ tathā stavo variṣṭho 'yaṃ stavānāṃ dakṣanirmitaḥ
verses.translation: As the Lord Bhava is foremost among all the gods, so this hymn composed by Daksha is foremost among hymns.

verses.sanskrit: यशःस्वर्गसुरैश्वर्यवित्तादिजयकाङ्क्षिभिः स्तोतव्यो भक्तिम् आस्थाय विद्याकामैश् च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: yaśaḥsvargasuraiśvaryavittādijayakāṅkṣibhiḥ stotavyo bhaktim āsthāya vidyākāmaiś ca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: It should be recited with devotion and care by those who desire fame, heaven, divine lordship, wealth and victory, and by those who desire knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: व्याधितो दुःखितो दीनो नरो ग्रस्तो भयादिभिः राजकार्यनियुक्तो वा मुच्यते महतो भयात्
verses.transliteration: vyādhito duḥkhito dīno naro grasto bhayādibhiḥ rājakāryaniyukto vā mucyate mahato bhayāt
verses.translation: A man who is ill, sorrowful, wretched, seized by fear and the like, or engaged in the king's service, is freed from great fear.

verses.transliteration: anenaiva ca dehena gaṇānāṃ ca maheśvarāt iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya gaṇarāḍ upajāyate
verses.translation: In this very body he obtains happiness in this world from Maheshvara and becomes a king of the hosts.

verses.sanskrit: न यक्षा न पिशाचा वा न नागा न विनायकाः कुर्युर् विघ्नं गृहे तस्य यत्र संस्तूयते भवः
verses.transliteration: na yakṣā na piśācā vā na nāgā na vināyakāḥ kuryur vighnaṃ gṛhe tasya yatra saṃstūyate bhavaḥ
verses.translation: Neither Yakshas nor Pishachas, nor Nagas nor Vinayakas can cause obstacles in the house where Bhava is praised.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुयाद् वा इदं नारी भक्त्याथ भवभाविता पितृपक्षे भर्तृपक्षे पूज्या भवति चैव ह
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuyād vā idaṃ nārī bhaktyātha bhavabhāvitā pitṛpakṣe bhartṛpakṣe pūjyā bhavati caiva ha
verses.translation: A woman devoted to Bhava who hears this with devotion becomes honoured in her father's family and in her husband's.

verses.transliteration: śṛṇuyād vā idaṃ sarvaṃ kīrtayed vāpy abhīkṣṇaśaḥ tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ gacchanty avighnataḥ
verses.translation: Whoever hears all this or recites it often — all his undertakings succeed without obstacle.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा चिन्तितं यच् च यच् च वाचाप्य् उदाहृतम् सर्वं संपद्यते तस्य स्तवस्यास्यानुकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: manasā cintitaṃ yac ca yac ca vācāpy udāhṛtam sarvaṃ saṃpadyate tasya stavasyāsyānukīrtanāt
verses.translation: Whatever is thought in the mind and whatever is spoken in words — all is accomplished for him by the recitation of this hymn.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prayukto gṛhṇīyān nāmāny āśu yathākramam īpsitāṃl labhate 'py arthān kāmān bhogāṃś ca mānavaḥ
verses.translation: thereafter, engaged, he should quickly take up the names in due order; the man obtains the wealth, desires and enjoyments he seeks.

verses.transliteration: mṛtaś ca svargam āpnoti strīsahasrasamāvṛtaḥ sarvakāmasuyukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: When he dies he attains heaven, surrounded by a thousand women; whether endowed with all desires or burdened with all sins,

verses.transliteration: paṭhan dakṣakṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate mṛtaś ca gaṇasāyujyaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: reciting the hymn made by Daksha he is freed from all sins; and when he dies, honoured by gods and Asuras, he attains union with the hosts.

verses.transliteration: vṛṣeṇa viniyuktena vimānena virājate ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī rudrasyānucaro bhavet
verses.translation: He shines in a celestial car yoked with a bull, and becomes a follower of Rudra until the dissolution of beings.

verses.transliteration: ity āha bhagavān vyāsaḥ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ naitad vedayate kaścin naitac chrāvyaṃ ca kasyacit
verses.translation: So said the Lord Vyasa, son of Parashara. No one knows this, and it should not be recited to just anyone.

verses.transliteration: śrutvemaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ vaiśyāḥ striyaś ca śūdrāś ca rudralokam avāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Having heard this supreme secret, even those of sinful birth — vaishyas, women and shudras — would attain the world of Rudra.

verses.transliteration: śrāvayed yaś ca viprebhyaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu rudralokam avāpnoti dvijo vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born who always recites it to brahmins on every festival day attains the world of Rudra; there is no doubt.

verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ vai muniśreṣṭhāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm rudrakrodhodbhavāṃ puṇyāṃ vyāsasya vadato dvijāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the story mentioned by Brahmi, the leading sages were delighted. Their hairs stood on ends. They praised the lord.

verses.transliteration: pārvatyāś ca tathā roṣaṃ krodhaṃ śaṃbhoś ca duḥsaham utpattiṃ vīrabhadrasya bhadrakālyāś ca saṃbhavam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the fburiaced lord of worlds recounted that holy centre of lord 3iva which yields worldly pleasures and salvation on this voy earth itself.

verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñavināśaṃ ca vīryaṃ śaṃbhos tathādbhutam punaḥ prasādaṃ devasya dakṣasya sumahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, in the previous Kalpa, there was a single Mango tree there by which name, the holy centre came to be known as Ekamra.

verses.transliteration: yajñabhāgaṃ ca rudrasya dakṣasya ca phalaṃ kratoḥ hṛṣṭā babhūvuḥ saṃprītā vismitāś ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: It contained massive doorways arranged in groups of three. A white outer wall enhanced its beauty. It was well guarded by weapons and beautified by moats and trenches.

verses.transliteration: papracchuś ca punar vyāsaṃ kathāśeṣaṃ tathā dvijāḥ pṛṣṭaḥ provāca tān vyāsaḥ kṣetram ekāmrakaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The people were gay and joyous in perpetual festivities with various kinds of musical instruments such as Che lute, Sute and drums. The area was adorned with slings fcM* hurling missiles.

verses.translation: There were many temples of gods embellished by outer walls and gardens. The ways of worship therein were wonder¬ ful and they enhanced the beauty of the holy centre.

verses.transliteration: aho devasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā śaṃbhoḥ prakīrtitam dakṣasya ca suraśreṣṭha yajñavidhvaṃsanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The men too were richly endowed with their noble traits and bedecked in all ornaments. They appeared to be haughty by virtue of their youth and handsome features.

verses.transliteration: ekāmrakaṃ kṣetravaraṃ vaktum arhasi sāṃpratam śrotum icchāmahe brahman paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, they were brahmins, Ktriyas, Vaijyas and 8udras. Those who lived there were very virtuous and engaged in their respective profession.

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā lokanāthaś caturmukhaḥ provāca śaṃbhos tat kṣetraṃ bhūtale duṣkṛtacchadam
verses.translation: These beautiful women, pleasing to behold were experts in conversation and side-glancing at people. None of them was bereft of beauty, none harassed others, none could be called wicked or evil in their activities.

verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: The intelligent people who visit the lord at any time, are liberated from their sins. They go to the world of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent people who visit the lord at any time, are liberated from their sins. They go to the world of lord Siva.

verses.translation: The holy centre extending to two and a half Yojanas to the West, East, North and South of the lord is an area that yields worldly pleasures and salvation.

verses.translation: Even a woman, O leadii brahmins, attains the benefit if she worships in due faith. No doubt need be entertain¬ ed in this respect.

verses.translation: Excepting lord diva, O excellent sages, who can re¬ count the good qualities of that excellent holy centre?

verses.transliteration: devatāyatanair divyaiḥ prākārodyānamaṇḍitaiḥ pūjāvicitraracitaiḥ sarvatra samalaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: adorned everywhere with divine temples set with ramparts and gardens and with variously arranged worship.

verses.sanskrit: पीनोन्नतकुचाः श्यामाः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः स्थिरालकाः सुकपोलाः काञ्चीनूपुरनादिताः
verses.transliteration: pīnonnatakucāḥ śyāmāḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ sthirālakāḥ sukapolāḥ kāñcīnūpuranāditāḥ
verses.translation: with full, raised breasts, youthful, with faces like the full moon, with steady locks and fine cheeks, sounding with girdles and anklets,

verses.transliteration: sukeśyaś cārujaghanāḥ karṇāntāyatalocanāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवस्त्रधराः शुभ्राः काश्चित् काञ्चनसंनिभाः हंसवारणगामिन्यः कुचभारावनामिताः
verses.transliteration: divyavastradharāḥ śubhrāḥ kāścit kāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ haṃsavāraṇagāminyaḥ kucabhārāvanāmitāḥ
verses.translation: wearing divine garments, fair, some like gold, walking like swans and elephants, bent with the weight of their breasts,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यगन्धानुलिप्ताङ्गाः कर्णाभरणभूषिताः मदालसाश् च सुश्रोण्यो नित्यं प्रहसिताननाः
verses.transliteration: divyagandhānuliptāṅgāḥ karṇābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ madālasāś ca suśroṇyo nityaṃ prahasitānanāḥ
verses.translation: their limbs anointed with divine perfumes, adorned with ear-ornaments, languid with intoxication, with lovely hips and ever-smiling faces,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
