verses.sanskrit: ईषद्विस्पष्टदशना बिम्बौष्ठा मधुरस्वराः ताम्बूलरञ्जितमुखा विदग्धाः प्रियदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: īṣadvispaṣṭadaśanā bimbauṣṭhā madhurasvarāḥ tāmbūlarañjitamukhā vidagdhāḥ priyadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: their teeth slightly showing, lips like bimba fruit, sweet-voiced, their mouths reddened with betel, clever and pleasing to see,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: fortunate, sweet-spoken, ever proud of their youth, all wearing divine garments and always adorned with good conduct.

verses.transliteration: krīḍanti tāḥ sadā tatra striyaś cāpsarasopamāḥ sve sve gṛhe pramuditā divā rātrau varānanāḥ
verses.translation: Those women, like Apsarases, always sport there, joyful in their own homes day and night, with lovely faces.

verses.translation: Men are seen there, proud of beauty and youth, endowed with every good mark, with polished jewelled earrings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś ca munisattamāḥ svadharmaniratās tatra nivasanti sudhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: Brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras, O best of sages, very righteous and devoted to their own dharma, dwell there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: anyāś ca tatra tiṣṭhanti vāramukhyāḥ sulocanāḥ ghṛtācīmenakātulyās tathā samatilottamāḥ
verses.translation: Other chief courtesans dwell there too, with lovely eyes, equal to Ghritachi and Menaka and equal to Tilottama,

verses.transliteration: urvaśīsadṛśāś caiva vipracittinibhās tathā viśvācīsahajanyābhāḥ pramlocāsadṛśās tathā
verses.translation: like Urvashi and like Viprachitti, resembling Vishvachi and Sahajanya, and like Pramlocha.

verses.transliteration: sarvās tāḥ priyavādinyaḥ sarvā vihasitānanāḥ kalākauśalasaṃyuktāḥ sarvās tā guṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: All of them are sweet-spoken and all smiling, all skilled in the arts and all endowed with virtues.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पण्यस्त्रियस् तत्र नृत्यगीतविशारदाः निवसन्ति मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वस्त्रीगुणगर्विताः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ paṇyastriyas tatra nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ nivasanti muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvastrīguṇagarvitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus courtesans skilled in dance and song dwell there, O best of sages, proud of all feminine accomplishments,

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्षणालापकुशलाः सुन्दर्यः प्रियदर्शनाः न रूपहीना दुर्वृत्ता न परद्रोहकारिकाः
verses.transliteration: prekṣaṇālāpakuśalāḥ sundaryaḥ priyadarśanāḥ na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakārikāḥ
verses.translation: skilled in glances and conversation, beautiful and pleasing to see — not lacking beauty, not of bad conduct, not doing harm to others,

verses.sanskrit: यासां कटाक्षपातेन मोहं गच्छन्ति मानवाः न तत्र निर्धनाः सन्ति न मूर्खा न परद्विषः
verses.transliteration: yāsāṃ kaṭākṣapātena mohaṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ na tatra nirdhanāḥ santi na mūrkhā na paradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: at the fall of whose sidelong glances men are bewitched. There are no poor there, no fools, no haters of others,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न रोगिणो न मलिना न कदर्या न मायिनः न रूपहीना दुर्वृत्ता न परद्रोहकारिणः
verses.transliteration: na rogiṇo na malinā na kadaryā na māyinaḥ na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: no sick, no unclean, no misers, no deceivers, none lacking beauty, none of bad conduct, none who harm others.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ति मानवास् तत्र क्षेत्रे जगति विश्रुते सर्वत्र सुखसंचारं सर्वसत्त्वसुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhanti mānavās tatra kṣetre jagati viśrute sarvatra sukhasaṃcāraṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham
verses.translation: Such men dwell in that region famed in the world, where movement is pleasant everywhere and brings happiness to all beings,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानाजनसमाकीर्णं सर्वसस्यसमन्वितम् कर्णिकारैश् च पनसैश् चम्पकैर् नागकेसरैः

verses.translation: crowded with various peoples and rich in all crops, with karnikaras, jackfruits, champakas and nagakesaras,

verses.transliteration: pāṭalāśokabakulaiḥ kapitthair bahulair dhavaiḥ cūtanimbakadambaiś ca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ
verses.translation: patalas, ashokas, bakulas, many kapitthas and dhavas, mangoes, nimbas and kadambas, and other kinds of flowers,

verses.transliteration: nīpakair dhavakhadirair latābhiś ca virājitam śālais tālais tamālaiś ca nārikelaiḥ śubhāñjanaiḥ
verses.translation: shining with nipas, dhavas, khadiras and creepers, with shalas, palmyras, tamalas, coconuts and shubhanjanas,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: arjunaiḥ samaparṇaiś ca kovidāraiḥ sapippalaiḥ lakucaiḥ saralair lodhrair hintālair devadārubhiḥ
verses.translation: with arjunas, saptaparnas, kovidaras and pippalas, lakuchas, saralas, lodhras, hintalas and devadarus,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पलाशैर् मुचुकुन्दैश् च पारिजातैः सकुब्जकैः कदलीवनखण्डैश् च जम्बूपूगफलैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: palāśair mucukundaiś ca pārijātaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ kadalīvanakhaṇḍaiś ca jambūpūgaphalais tathā
verses.translation: with palashas, muchukundas, parijatas and kubjakas, groves of plantains, jambus and areca palms,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केतकीकरवीरैश् च अतिमुक्तैश् च किंशुकैः मन्दारकुन्दपुष्पैश् च तथान्यैः पुष्पजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: ketakīkaravīraiś ca atimuktaiś ca kiṃśukaiḥ mandārakundapuṣpaiś ca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ
verses.translation: with ketakis, karaviras, atimuktas and kimshukas, mandara and kunda flowers, and other kinds of flowers,

verses.translation: with chakoras, shatapatras, bhringarajas and cuckoos, sparrows, peacocks, priyaputras and parrots,

verses.sanskrit: जीवंजीवकहारीतैश् चातकैर् वनवेष्टितैः नानापक्षिगणैश् चान्यैः कूजद्भिर् मधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: jīvaṃjīvakahārītaiś cātakair vanaveṣṭitaiḥ nānāpakṣigaṇaiś cānyaiḥ kūjadbhir madhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: jivanjivakas, haritas and chatakas dwelling in the woods, and other flocks of birds singing with sweet voices,

verses.transliteration: dīrghikābhis taḍāgaiś ca puṣkariṇībhiś ca vāpibhiḥ nānājalāśayaiś cānyaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ
verses.translation: with long ponds, tanks, lotus pools and step-wells, and other various reservoirs adorned with clusters of lotuses,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश् च तथा नीलोत्पलैः शुभैः कादम्बैश् चक्रवाकैश् च तथैव जलकुक्कुटैः
verses.transliteration: kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ kādambaiś cakravākaiś ca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ
verses.translation: with water-lilies, white lotuses and lovely blue lotuses, with kadambas, chakravakas and water-fowl,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कारण्डवैः प्लवैर् हंसैस् तथान्यैर् जलचारिभिः एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैर् नानाविधैर् वरैः
verses.transliteration: kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavair haṃsais tathānyair jalacāribhiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpair nānāvidhair varaiḥ
verses.translation: karandavas, plavas, swans and other water-birds. Thus with trees of various kinds and excellent flowers of various kinds,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानाजलाशयैः पुण्यैः शोभितं तत् समन्ततः आस्ते तत्र स्वयं देवः कृत्तिवासा वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ śobhitaṃ tat samantataḥ āste tatra svayaṃ devaḥ kṛttivāsā vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: and with various holy reservoirs, it is beautiful all around. There dwells the god himself, clad in hide, bull-bannered,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिताय सर्वलोकस्य भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदः शिवः पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: hitāya sarvalokasya bhuktimuktipradaḥ śivaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: Shiva, giver of enjoyment and liberation, for the good of all the world. The holy places on earth, the rivers and lakes,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करिण्यस् तडागानि वाप्यः कूपाश् च सागराः तेभ्यः पूर्वं समाहृत्य जलबिन्दून् पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: puṣkariṇyas taḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpāś ca sāgarāḥ tebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ samāhṛtya jalabindūn pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: lotus pools, tanks, wells, springs and seas — having first gathered drops of water from each of them separately,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकहितार्थाय रुद्रः सर्वसुरैः सह तीर्थं बिन्दुसरो नाम तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sarvalokahitārthāya rudraḥ sarvasuraiḥ saha tīrthaṃ bindusaro nāma tasmin kṣetre dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: for the good of all the worlds, Rudra, with all the gods, made in that region, O best of brahmins, a holy place named Bindusaras,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: cakāra ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tena bindusaraḥ smṛtam aṣṭamyāṃ bahule pakṣe mārgaśīrṣe dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: together with the sages; therefore it is remembered as Bindusaras. On the eighth day of the dark fortnight of Margashirsha, O best of brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् तत्र यात्रां कुरुते विषुवे विजितेन्द्रियः विधिवद् बिन्दुसरसि स्नात्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: yas tatra yātrāṃ kurute viṣuve vijitendriyaḥ vidhivad bindusarasi snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: whoever makes a pilgrimage there at the equinox, with senses controlled, bathing duly in Bindusaras with faith,

verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝn saṃtarpya vāgyataḥ tilodakena vidhinā nāmagotravidhānavit

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वैवं विधिवत् तत्र सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ग्रहोपरागे विषुवे संक्रान्त्याम् अयने तथा
verses.transliteration: snātvaivaṃ vidhivat tatra so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet grahoparāge viṣuve saṃkrāntyām ayane tathā
verses.translation: having bathed there duly, obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. At an eclipse, the equinox, the solar transit and the solstice,

verses.sanskrit: युगादिषु षडशीत्यां तथान्यत्र शुभे तिथौ ये तत्र दानं विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति धनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ tathānyatra śubhe tithau ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti dhanādikam
verses.translation: at the beginnings of the ages, at the shadashiti and on other auspicious days, those who give wealth and the like to brahmins there

verses.sanskrit: अन्यतीर्थाच् छतगुणं फलं ते प्राप्नुवन्ति वै पिण्डं ये संप्रयच्छन्ति पितृभ्यः सरसस् तटे
verses.transliteration: anyatīrthāc chataguṇaṃ phalaṃ te prāpnuvanti vai piṇḍaṃ ye saṃprayacchanti pitṛbhyaḥ sarasas taṭe
verses.translation: obtain a hundredfold the fruit of other holy places. Those who offer rice-balls to the ancestors on the bank of the lake
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणाम् अक्षयां तृप्तिं ते कुर्वन्ति न संशयः ततः शंभोर् गृहं गत्वा वाग्यतः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇām akṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ te kurvanti na saṃśayaḥ tataḥ śaṃbhor gṛhaṃ gatvā vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: bring imperishable satisfaction to the ancestors, without doubt. Then, going to Shambhu's temple, silent and with senses controlled,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य पूजयेच् छर्वं कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् घृतक्षीरादिभिः स्नानं कारयित्वा भवं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: praviśya pūjayec charvaṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam ghṛtakṣīrādibhiḥ snānaṃ kārayitvā bhavaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: entering, one should worship Sharva after circumambulating him three times; having bathed Bhava with ghee, milk and the like, being pure,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चन्दनेन सुगन्धेन विलिप्य कुङ्कुमेन च ततः संपूजयेद् देवं चन्द्रमौलिम् उमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: candanena sugandhena vilipya kuṅkumena ca tataḥ saṃpūjayed devaṃ candramaulim umāpatim
verses.translation: anointing him with fragrant sandal and saffron, one should then worship the god, the moon-crested husband of Uma,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैर् नानाविधैर् मेध्यैर् बिल्वार्ककमलादिभिः आगमोक्तेन मन्त्रेण वेदोक्तेन च शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: puṣpair nānāvidhair medhyair bilvārkakamalādibhiḥ āgamoktena mantreṇa vedoktena ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: with various pure flowers — bilva, arka, lotus and others — worshipping Shankara with the mantra stated in the Agamas and that stated in the Veda.

verses.sanskrit: अदीक्षितस् तु नाम्नैव मूलमन्त्रेण चार्चयेत् एवं संपूज्य तं देवं गन्धपुष्पानुरागिभिः
verses.transliteration: adīkṣitas tu nāmnaiva mūlamantreṇa cārcayet evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpānurāgibhiḥ
verses.translation: One who is not initiated should worship with the name alone and with the root mantra. Having worshipped the god thus with perfumes and flowers he loves,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धूपदीपैश् च नैवेद्यैर् उपहारैस् तथा स्तवैः दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश् च गीतैर् वाद्यैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: dhūpadīpaiś ca naivedyair upahārais tathā stavaiḥ daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca gītair vādyair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: with incense, lamps, food offerings, presents and hymns, with prostrations like a staff and with charming songs and music,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: nṛtyajapyanamaskārair jayaśabdaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad devadevam umāpatim
verses.translation: with dances, recitations, salutations, cries of victory and circumambulations — having worshipped the god of gods, the husband of Uma, duly in this way,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रूपयौवनगर्वितः कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य दिव्याभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: freed from all sins, proud of beauty and youth, having raised twenty-one generations of his family, adorned with divine ornaments,

verses.transliteration: sauvarṇena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā upagīyamāno gandharvair apsarobhir alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: in a golden celestial car hung with networks of bells, sung to by Gandharvas and adorned with Apsarases,

verses.sanskrit: उद्द्योतयन् दिशः सर्वाः शिवलोकं स गच्छति भुक्त्वा तत्र सुखं विप्रा मनसः प्रीतिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: uddyotayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati bhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ viprā manasaḥ prītidāyakam
verses.translation: illuminating all the directions, he goes to Shiva's world. Having enjoyed there, O brahmins, happiness that delights the mind,

verses.sanskrit: तल्लोकवासिभिः सार्धं यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् ततस् तस्माद् इहायातः पृथिव्यां पुण्यसंक्षये
verses.transliteration: tallokavāsibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam tatas tasmād ihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puṇyasaṃkṣaye
verses.translation: with the dwellers of that world until the dissolution of beings, he then comes back here to earth when his merit is exhausted,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जायते योगिनां गेहे चतुर्वेदी द्विजोत्तमाः योगं पाशुपतं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: jāyate yogināṃ gehe caturvedī dvijottamāḥ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: and is born in the house of yogins, a knower of the four Vedas, O best of brahmins; having attained the Pashupata yoga, he then attains liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शयनोत्थापने चैव संक्रान्त्याम् अयने तथा अशोकाख्यां तथाष्टम्यां पवित्रारोपणे तथा
verses.transliteration: śayanotthāpane caiva saṃkrāntyām ayane tathā aśokākhyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pavitrāropaṇe tathā
verses.translation: At the god's lying down and rising, at the solar transit and solstice, on the Ashoka eighth and at the Pavitraropana festival,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये च पश्यन्ति तं देवं कृत्तिवाससम् उत्तमम् विमानेनार्कवर्णेन शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ye ca paśyanti taṃ devaṃ kṛttivāsasam uttamam vimānenārkavarṇena śivalokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: those who see that supreme god clad in hide go to Shiva's world in a celestial car coloured like the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकाले ऽपि तं देवं ये पश्यन्ति सुमेधसः ते ऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्ताः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: sarvakāle 'pi taṃ devaṃ ye paśyanti sumedhasaḥ te 'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti vai
verses.translation: The wise who see that god at any time are also freed from sin and go to Shiva's world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवस्य पश्चिमे पूर्वे दक्षिणे चोत्तरे तथा योजनद्वितयं सार्धं क्षेत्रं तद् भुक्तिमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: devasya paścime pūrve dakṣiṇe cottare tathā yojanadvitayaṃ sārdhaṃ kṣetraṃ tad bhuktimuktidam
verses.translation: To the west, east, south and north of the god, for two and a half yojanas, is that region granting enjoyment and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे लिङ्गं भास्करेश्वरसंज्ञितम् पश्यन्ति ये तु तं देवं स्नात्वा कुण्डे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare liṅgaṃ bhāskareśvarasaṃjñitam paśyanti ye tu taṃ devaṃ snātvā kuṇḍe maheśvaram
verses.translation: In that excellent region is a linga called Bhaskareshvara; those who, having bathed in the pool, see that god Maheshvara,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्येनार्चितं पूर्वं देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ता विमानवरम् आस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ādityenārcitaṃ pūrvaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānavaram āsthitāḥ
verses.translation: the three-eyed god of gods worshipped long ago by the Sun, freed from all sins and mounted on excellent celestial cars,

verses.sanskrit: उपगीयमाना गन्धर्वैः शिवलोकं व्रजन्ति ते तिष्ठन्ति तत्र मुदिताः कल्पम् एकं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: upagīyamānā gandharvaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te tiṣṭhanti tatra muditāḥ kalpam ekaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: sung to by Gandharvas, go to Shiva's world; they stay there joyfully for a whole kalpa, O best of brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगाञ् शिवलोके मनोरमान् पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायाता जायन्ते प्रवरे कुले
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāñ śivaloke manoramān puṇyakṣayād ihāyātā jāyante pravare kule
verses.translation: Having enjoyed abundant charming pleasures in Shiva's world, when their merit is exhausted they come here and are born in an excellent family,

verses.translation: or in the house of yogins, masters of the Vedas and their limbs; they are born as excellent brahmins devoted to the welfare of all beings,

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षशास्त्रार्थकुशलाः सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः योगं शंभोर् वरं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: mokṣaśāstrārthakuśalāḥ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ yogaṃ śaṃbhor varaṃ prāpya tato mokṣaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: skilled in the meaning of the scriptures of liberation, even-minded everywhere; having attained the excellent yoga of Shambhu, they then go to liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये लिङ्गं यद् दृश्यते द्विजाः पूज्यापूज्यं च सर्वत्र वने रथ्यान्तरे ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye liṅgaṃ yad dṛśyate dvijāḥ pūjyāpūjyaṃ ca sarvatra vane rathyāntare 'pi vā
verses.translation: In that holy, excellent region, O brahmins, whatever linga is seen, whether it is worshipped or not, anywhere — in a forest or amid streets,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्पथे श्मशाने वा यत्र कुत्र च तिष्ठति दृष्ट्वा तल् लिङ्गम् अव्यग्रः श्रद्धया सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: catuṣpathe śmaśāne vā yatra kutra ca tiṣṭhati dṛṣṭvā tal liṅgam avyagraḥ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: at a crossroads or in a cremation ground, wherever it stands — seeing that linga, calm and composed with faith,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा तु तं भक्त्या गन्धैः पुष्पैर् मनोहरैः धूपैर् दीपैः सनैवेद्यैर् नमस्कारैस् तथा स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: snāpayitvā tu taṃ bhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpair manoharaiḥ dhūpair dīpaiḥ sanaivedyair namaskārais tathā stavaiḥ
verses.translation: bathing it with devotion and worshipping it with charming perfumes and flowers, with incense, lamps, food offerings, salutations and hymns,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश् च नृत्यगीतादिभिस् तथा संपूज्यैवं विधानेन शिवलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca nṛtyagītādibhis tathā saṃpūjyaivaṃ vidhānena śivalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: with prostrations like a staff, and with dance, song and the like — having worshipped thus by rule, a man goes to Shiva's world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारी वा द्विजशार्दूलाः संपूज्य श्रद्धयान्विता पूर्वोक्तं फलम् आप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: nārī vā dvijaśārdūlāḥ saṃpūjya śraddhayānvitā pūrvoktaṃ phalam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Or a woman, O tigers among brahmins, who worships with faith obtains the fruit told before; there is no need for deliberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं समग्रान् मुनिसत्तमाः तस्य क्षेत्रवरस्याथ ऋते देवान् महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samagrān munisattamāḥ tasya kṣetravarasyātha ṛte devān maheśvarāt
verses.translation: Who, O best of sages, can tell all the virtues of that excellent region, except the god Maheshvara?

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रोत्तमे गत्वा श्रद्धयाश्रद्धयापि वा माधवादिषु मासेषु नरो वा यदि वाङ्गना
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetrottame gatvā śraddhayāśraddhayāpi vā mādhavādiṣu māseṣu naro vā yadi vāṅganā
verses.translation: Going to that best of regions, with faith or even without faith, in the months beginning with Madhava, whether man or woman,

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् यस्मिंस् तिथौ विप्राः स्नात्वा बिन्दुसरोम्भसि पश्येद् देवं विरूपाक्षं देवीं च वरदां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: yasmin yasmiṃs tithau viprāḥ snātvā bindusarombhasi paśyed devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ devīṃ ca varadāṃ śivām
verses.translation: on whatever day, O brahmins, having bathed in the water of Bindusaras, whoever sees the god Virupaksha and the boon-giving Goddess Shiva,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गणं चण्डं कार्त्तिकेयं गणेशं वृषभं तथा कल्पद्रुमं च सावित्रीं शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: gaṇaṃ caṇḍaṃ kārttikeyaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā kalpadrumaṃ ca sāvitrīṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: the Gana Chanda, Karttikeya, Ganesha, the bull, the wish-fulfilling tree and Savitri, goes to Shiva's world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा च कापिले तीर्थे विधिवत् पापनाशने प्राप्नोत्य् अभिमतान् कामाञ् शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: snātvā ca kāpile tīrthe vidhivat pāpanāśane prāpnoty abhimatān kāmāñ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Having bathed duly in the Kapila holy place, destroyer of sin, one obtains one's desired wishes and goes to Shiva's world.

verses.transliteration: yaḥ stambhyaṃ tatra vidhivat karoti niyatendriyaḥ kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Whoever, with senses controlled, duly performs the stambhya rite there raises twenty-one generations of his family and goes to Shiva's world.

verses.sanskrit: एकाम्रके शिवक्षेत्रे वाराणसीसमे शुभे स्नानं करोति यस् तत्र मोक्षं स लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ekāmrake śivakṣetre vārāṇasīsame śubhe snānaṃ karoti yas tatra mokṣaṃ sa labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: In the auspicious Shiva-region of Ekamraka, equal to Varanasi, whoever bathes there surely obtains liberation.

verses.transliteration: viraje virajā mātā brahmāṇī saṃpratiṣṭhitā yasyāḥ saṃdarśanān martyaḥ punāty āsaptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: By visiting that goddess even for once and by worshipp¬ ing and bowing to her with devotion a man redeems hii family and goes to my world.

verses.sanskrit: सकृद् दृष्ट्वा तु तां देवीं भक्त्यापूज्य प्रणम्य च नरः स्ववंशम् उद्धृत्य मम लोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ devīṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca naraḥ svavaṃśam uddhṛtya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The other mothers of the world who stand in Viraja are goddesses who dispel sins and bestow boons. They are &vour- ably disposed to the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other mothers of the world who stand in Viraja are goddesses who dispel sins and bestow boons. They are &vour- ably disposed to the devotees.

verses.transliteration: anyāś ca tatra tiṣṭhanti viraje lokamātaraḥ sarvapāpaharā devyo varadā bhaktivatsalāḥ
verses.translation: The self*bom lord Vi|iu stays there in the form of a Boar. By visiting him and bowing to him with devotim man goes to Vifnu's abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: The self*bom lord Vi|iu stays there in the form of a Boar. By visiting him and bowing to him with devotim man goes to Vifnu's abode.

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते वैतरणी तत्र सर्वपापहरा नदी यस्यां स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: āste vaitaraṇī tatra sarvapāpaharā nadī yasyāṃ snātvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: He who offers balls of rice in Viraja* my holy centre* shall undoubtedly accord ever-lasting satisfaction to the manes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who offers balls of rice in Viraja* my holy centre* shall undoubtedly accord ever-lasting satisfaction to the manes.

verses.transliteration: āste svayaṃbhūs tatraiva kroḍarūpī hariḥ svayam dṛṣṭvā praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: O excellent ses* men who cast off their body in Viraja my holy centre* do attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ses* men who cast off their body in Viraja my holy centre* do attain salvation.

verses.transliteration: kāpile gograhe some tīrthe cālābusaṃjñite mṛtyuṃjaye kroḍatīrthe vāsuke siddhakeśvare
verses.translation: O excellent sages* there are many holy sites and shrines. They should be known as equal to that (Vir&).

verses.transliteration: tīrtheṣv eteṣu matimān viraje saṃyatendriyaḥ gatvāṣṭatīrthaṃ vidhivat snātvā devān praṇamya ca
verses.translation: The wise man with senses controlled, going to these holy places in Viraja and to the Ashtatirtha, bathing duly and bowing to the gods,

verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto vimānavaram āsthitaḥ upagīyamāno gandharvair mama loke mahīyate
verses.translation: freed from all sins, mounted on an excellent celestial car and sung to by Gandharvas, is honoured in my world.

verses.transliteration: viraje yo mama kṣetre piṇḍadānaṃ karoti vai sa karoty akṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Whoever offers rice-balls in my region Viraja brings imperishable satisfaction to the ancestors; there is no doubt.

verses.transliteration: mama kṣetre muniśreṣṭhā viraje ye kalevaram parityajanti puruṣās te mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai
verses.translation: Those men who give up their bodies in my region Viraja, O best of sages, attain liberation.

verses.transliteration: snātvā yaḥ sāgare martyo dṛṣṭvā ca kapilaṃ harim paśyed devīṃ ca vārāhīṃ sa yāti tridaśālayam
verses.translation: The mortal who bathes in the ocean, sees Kapila Hari and sees the goddess Varahi goes to the abode of the gods.

verses.translation: with sounds from the mouths of birds, pleasant to the ear, very sweet, intoxicating in strength, giving joy to the mind,

verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpaiś cānyair manoharaiḥ latāvitānagulmaiś ca vividhaiś ca jalāśayaiḥ

verses.translation: long ponds, tanks, lotus pools and step-wells, various holy reservoirs adorned with clusters of lotuses,

verses.transliteration: sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasannasalilāni ca kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiś ca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ

verses.transliteration: etaiś cānyaiś ca kūjadbhiḥ samantāj jalacāribhiḥ khagair jalacaraiś cānyaiḥ kusumaiś ca jalodbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: with these and other water-creatures calling all around, with birds and aquatic creatures and flowers born in water.

verses.sanskrit: एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैः स्थलजलोद्भवैः ब्रह्मचारिगृहस्थैश् च वानप्रस्थैश् च भिक्षुभिः

verses.translation: Thus with various trees and flowers born on land and in water, with celibate students, householders, forest-dwellers and mendicants,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतैर् वर्णैस् तथान्यैः समलंकृतम् हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं नरनारीसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: svadharmaniratair varṇais tathānyaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamākulam
verses.translation: adorned with the classes devoted to their own dharma and with others, crowded with happy, well-fed people, full of men and women,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: the abode of all knowledge, the mine of all dharma and virtue — thus endowed with every good quality is that most rare region.

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते तत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठा विख्यातः पुरुषोत्तमः यावद् उत्कलमर्यादा दिक् क्रमेण प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: āste tatra muniśreṣṭhā vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ yāvad utkalamaryādā dik krameṇa prakīrtitā
verses.translation: There dwells, O best of sages, the renowned Purushottama; as far as the boundary of Utkala extends, as declared in the order of the directions,

verses.transliteration: tāvat kṛṣṇaprasādena deśaḥ puṇyatamo hi saḥ yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā deśe sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: so far, by the grace of Krishna, is that land most holy, the land where Purushottama, the soul of the universe, abides.

verses.transliteration: jagadvyāpī jagannāthas tatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ahaṃ rudraś ca śakraś ca devāś cāgnipurogamāḥ
verses.translation: Jagannatha, pervading the world — there everything is established. I, Rudra, Shakra and the gods led by Agni

verses.sanskrit: निवसामो मुनिश्रेष्ठास् तस्मिन् देशे सदा वयम् गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्वाः पितरो देवमानुषाः
verses.transliteration: nivasāmo muniśreṣṭhās tasmin deśe sadā vayam gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ pitaro devamānuṣāḥ
verses.translation: always dwell in that land, O best of sages; all the Gandharvas and Apsarases, the ancestors, gods and men,

verses.sanskrit: यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धा मुनयः संशितव्रताः ऋषयो वालखिल्याश् च कश्यपाद्याः प्रजेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ṛṣayo vālakhilyāś ca kaśyapādyāḥ prajeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Yakshas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, sages of strict vows, the Valakhilya seers, and the lords of creatures led by Kashyapa,

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णाः किंनरा नागास् तथान्ये स्वर्गवासिनः साङ्गाश् च चतुरो वेदाः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: suparṇāḥ kiṃnarā nāgās tathānye svargavāsinaḥ sāṅgāś ca caturo vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Suparnas, Kinnaras, Nagas and other heaven-dwellers, the four Vedas with their limbs and various scriptures,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि यज्ञाश् च वरदक्षिणाः नद्यश् च विविधाः पुण्यास् तीर्थान्य् आयतनानि च
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇāni yajñāś ca varadakṣiṇāḥ nadyaś ca vividhāḥ puṇyās tīrthāny āyatanāni ca
verses.translation: the Itihasas and Puranas, sacrifices with excellent fees, various holy rivers, holy places and shrines,

verses.transliteration: sāgarāś ca tathā śailās tasmin deśe vyavasthitāḥ evaṃ puṇyatame deśe devarṣipitṛsevite
verses.translation: the oceans and the mountains — all are established in that land. In so holy a land, served by gods, sages and ancestors,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपभोगसहिते वासः कस्य न रोचते श्रेष्ठत्वं कस्य देशस्य किं चान्यद् अधिकं ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvopabhogasahite vāsaḥ kasya na rocate śreṣṭhatvaṃ kasya deśasya kiṃ cānyad adhikaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: endowed with every enjoyment, who would not like to dwell? What land is superior, and what could be greater than that,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते यत्र स्वयं देवो मुक्तिदः पुरुषोत्तमः धन्यास् ते विबुधप्रख्या ये वसन्त्य् उत्कले नराः
verses.transliteration: āste yatra svayaṃ devo muktidaḥ puruṣottamaḥ dhanyās te vibudhaprakhyā ye vasanty utkale narāḥ
verses.translation: where the god Purushottama himself, the giver of liberation, dwells? Blessed are those men, like gods, who dwell in Utkala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थराजजले स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् स्वर्गे वसन्ति ते मर्त्या न ते यान्ति यमालये
verses.transliteration: tīrtharājajale snātvā paśyanti puruṣottamam svarge vasanti te martyā na te yānti yamālaye
verses.translation: who bathe in the water of the king of holy places and see Purushottama; those mortals dwell in heaven and do not go to Yama's abode.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: ye vasanty utkale kṣetre puṇye śrīpuruṣottame saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣām utkalānāṃ sumedhasām
verses.translation: Those who dwell in the holy region of Utkala at Shri Purushottama — fruitful is the life of those wise people of Utkala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये पश्यन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं प्रसन्नायतलोचनम् चारुभ्रूकेशमुकुटं चारुकर्णावतंसकम्
verses.transliteration: ye paśyanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ prasannāyatalocanam cārubhrūkeśamukuṭaṃ cārukarṇāvataṃsakam
verses.translation: who see the best of gods, with gracious long eyes, lovely brows, hair and crown, lovely ear-ornaments,

verses.translation: a lovely smile, lovely teeth, adorned with lovely earrings, with a fine nose, fine cheeks, fine forehead and fine marks —

verses.transliteration: trailokyānandajananaṃ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṅkajam
verses.translation: the lotus face of Krishna, which gives joy to the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे विप्राः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः बभूव नृपतिः श्रीमान् इन्द्रद्युम्न इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ babhūva nṛpatiḥ śrīmān indradyumna iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, formerly, in the Krtayuga there was a glorious king who was known as Indradyumna. He was as valor¬ ous asIndra.

verses.transliteration: satyavādī śucir dakṣaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro dātā bhoktā priyaṃvadaḥ
verses.translation: While that king, the repository of good qualities, ruled over the Earth he thought of propitiating Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: While that king, the repository of good qualities, ruled over the Earth he thought of propitiating Visnu.

verses.transliteration: yaṣṭā samastayajñānāṃ brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ dhanurvede ca vede ca śāstre ca nipuṇaḥ kṛtī
verses.translation: "How shall I propitiate Visjriu, the lord ofDevas? In which holy centre or sacred spot or the river bank or hermitage shall it be?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "How shall I propitiate Visjriu, the lord ofDevas? In which holy centre or sacred spot or the river bank or hermitage shall it be?"

verses.sanskrit: वल्लभो नरनारीणां पौर्णमास्यां यथा शशी आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः शत्रुसंघभयंकरः
verses.transliteration: vallabho naranārīṇāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ śatrusaṃghabhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: The king went there accompanied by his flourishing army and vehicles. He duly performed a horse sacrifice where much wealth was distributed as gift.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king went there accompanied by his flourishing army and vehicles. He duly performed a horse sacrifice where much wealth was distributed as gift.

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवः सत्त्वसंपन्नो जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः अध्येता योगसांख्यानां मुमुक्षुर् धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavaḥ sattvasaṃpanno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ adhyetā yogasāṃkhyānāṃ mumukṣur dharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: The city of Avanti 1 in Malava, known as the most excellent one over the earth, was the capital of that monarch.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Avanti 1 in Malava, known as the most excellent one over the earth, was the capital of that monarch.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स पालयन् पृथ्वीं राजा सर्वगुणाकरः तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना हरेर् आराधनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa pālayan pṛthvīṃ rājā sarvaguṇākaraḥ tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā harer ārādhanaṃ prati
verses.translation: They were liberal donors of jewels and the enjoyers of riches. O excellent sages, charming women were seen in that splendid land.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were liberal donors of jewels and the enjoyers of riches. O excellent sages, charming women were seen in that splendid land.

verses.sanskrit: कथम् आराधयिष्यामि देवदेवं जनार्दनम् कस्मिन् क्षेत्रे ऽथवा तीर्थे नदीतीरे तथाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: katham ārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ janārdanam kasmin kṣetre 'thavā tīrthe nadītīre tathāśrame
verses.translation: Their tresses were glossy and beautiful. Their cheeks were fine and their forelocks steady. Their teeth were like the clearly \ Isible lightning streaks. Their faces were like the full moon. They bent their necks in exhibiting their emotions with gesticulation and charming twists; their ears were adorned with ornaments.
verses.wordMeaning: Their tresses were glossy and beautiful. Their cheeks were fine and their forelocks steady. Their teeth were like the clearly \ Isible lightning streaks. Their faces were like the full moon.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं चिन्तापरः सो ऽथ निरीक्ष्य मनसा महीम् आलोक्य सर्वतीर्थानि क्षेत्राण्य् अथ पुराण्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ cintāparaḥ so 'tha nirīkṣya manasā mahīm ālokya sarvatīrthāni kṣetrāṇy atha purāṇy api
verses.translation: Their lips were red like Bimba fruits. They shone with their mouths coloured by chewing betal leaves. They were bedecked in golden ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their lips were red like Bimba fruits. They shone with their mouths coloured by chewing betal leaves. They were bedecked in golden ornaments.

verses.transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi saṃtyajya jagāmāyatanaṃ punaḥ vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Some were dark-complexioned, some were fair-comple- xioned; they had fine buttocks, their girdles and armlets produc¬ ed charming sounds-. They wore divine garlands and garments; they applied divine scents and unguents over their bodies.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा तत् क्षेत्रवरं समृद्धबलवाहनः अयजच् चाश्वमेधेन विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā tat kṣetravaraṃ samṛddhabalavāhanaḥ ayajac cāśvamedhena vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The women were clever and competent. They were lovely with attractive faces and charming limbs. They were pleasing to look at. They were endowed with beauty and good colour and form. They had smiling faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: The women were clever and competent. They were lovely with attractive faces and charming limbs. They were pleasing to look at. They were endowed with beauty and good colour and form. They had smiling faces.

verses.transliteration: kārayitvā mahotsedhaṃ prāsādaṃ caiva viśrutam tatra saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ sthāpya vīryavān
verses.translation: Mad and intoxicated they sported about in assemblies and quadrangular court-yards. They delighted others by songs, instrumental music and spicy conversation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mad and intoxicated they sported about in assemblies and quadrangular court-yards. They delighted others by songs, instrumental music and spicy conversation.

verses.transliteration: pañcatīrthaṃ ca vidhivat kṛtvā tatra mahīpatiḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ devatāprekṣaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The chiefs of harlots, experts in dancing and singing could also be found there. They were experts in the art of con¬ versation, scanning and scrutiny. They were endued with femi¬ nine charms and fine qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chiefs of harlots, experts in dancing and singing could also be found there. They were experts in the art of con¬ versation, scanning and scrutiny. They were endued with femi¬ nine charms and fine qualities.

verses.sanskrit: गृहगोपुरसंबाधा वीथीभिः समलंकृता राजहंसनिभैः शुभ्रैश् चित्रग्रीवैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: gṛhagopurasaṃbādhā vīthībhiḥ samalaṃkṛtā rājahaṃsanibhaiḥ śubhraiś citragrīvair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: crowded with houses and gate-towers, adorned with lanes, with white, charming mansions like royal swans with variegated necks,

verses.sanskrit: अनेकशतसाहस्रैः प्रासादैः समलंकृता यज्ञोत्सवप्रमुदिता गीतवादित्रनिस्वना
verses.transliteration: anekaśatasāhasraiḥ prāsādaiḥ samalaṃkṛtā yajñotsavapramuditā gītavāditranisvanā
verses.translation: adorned with many hundreds of thousands of mansions, joyful with sacrifices and festivals, resounding with song and music,

verses.transliteration: nānāvarṇapatākābhir dhvajaiś ca samalaṃkṛtā hastyaśvarathasaṃkīrṇā padātigaṇasaṃkulā
verses.translation: adorned with banners and flags of various colours, crowded with elephants, horses and chariots and thronged with foot soldiers,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानायोधसमाकीर्णा नानाजनपदैर् युता ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर् वैश्यैः शूद्रैश् चैव द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: nānāyodhasamākīrṇā nānājanapadair yutā brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś caiva dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: full of various warriors and joined with various provinces, with brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: समृद्धा सा मुनिश्रेष्ठा विद्वद्भिः समलंकृता न तत्र मलिनाः सन्ति न मूर्खा नापि निर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: samṛddhā sā muniśreṣṭhā vidvadbhiḥ samalaṃkṛtā na tatra malināḥ santi na mūrkhā nāpi nirdhanāḥ
verses.translation: prosperous, O best of sages, and adorned with learned men. There were no unclean people there, no fools and no poor,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न रोगिणो न हीनाङ्गा न द्यूतव्यसनान्विताः सदा हृष्टाः सुमनसो दृश्यन्ते पुरुषाः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: na rogiṇo na hīnāṅgā na dyūtavyasanānvitāḥ sadā hṛṣṭāḥ sumanaso dṛśyante puruṣāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: no sick, no maimed, none addicted to gambling; men and women are always seen happy and cheerful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्ति स्म दिवा रात्रौ हृष्टास् तत्र पृथक् पृथक् सुवेषाः पुरुषास् तत्र दृश्यन्ते मृष्टकुण्डलाः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanti sma divā rātrau hṛṣṭās tatra pṛthak pṛthak suveṣāḥ puruṣās tatra dṛśyante mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ
verses.translation: They played there happily day and night, each in their own way; well-dressed men are seen there with polished earrings,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपाः सुगुणाश् चैव दिव्यालंकारभूषिताः कामदेवप्रतीकाशाः सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: surūpāḥ suguṇāś caiva divyālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ kāmadevapratīkāśāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ
verses.translation: handsome and virtuous, adorned with divine ornaments, like Kamadeva, marked with every good sign,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुकेशाः सुकपोलाश् च सुमुखाः श्मश्रुधारिणः ज्ञातारः सर्वशास्त्राणां भेत्तारः शत्रुवाहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: sukeśāḥ sukapolāś ca sumukhāḥ śmaśrudhāriṇaḥ jñātāraḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ bhettāraḥ śatruvāhinīm
verses.translation: with fine hair, fine cheeks and fine faces, bearded, knowers of all the scriptures, breakers of enemy armies,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दातारः सर्वरत्नानां भोक्तारः सर्वसंपदाम् स्त्रियस् तत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठा दृश्यन्ते सुमनोहराः
verses.transliteration: dātāraḥ sarvaratnānāṃ bhoktāraḥ sarvasaṃpadām striyas tatra muniśreṣṭhā dṛśyante sumanoharāḥ
verses.translation: givers of all jewels and enjoyers of all riches. The women seen there, O best of sages, are very charming,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हंसवारणगामिन्यः प्रफुल्लाम्भोजलोचनाः सुमध्यमाः सुजघनाः पीनोन्नतपयोधराः
verses.transliteration: haṃsavāraṇagāminyaḥ praphullāmbhojalocanāḥ sumadhyamāḥ sujaghanāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ
verses.translation: walking like swans and elephants, with eyes like blooming lotuses, slender-waisted, with fine hips and full, raised breasts,

verses.transliteration: bimbauṣṭhyo rañjitamukhās tāmbūlena virājitāḥ suvarṇābharaṇopetāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: with lips like bimba fruit, their mouths reddened and shining with betel, wearing gold ornaments and adorned with every decoration,

verses.transliteration: śyāmāvadātāḥ suśroṇyaḥ kāñcīnūpuranāditāḥ divyamālyāmbaradharā divyagandhānulepanāḥ
verses.translation: youthful and fair, with lovely hips, sounding with girdles and anklets, wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine perfumes,

verses.transliteration: vidagdhāḥ subhagāḥ kāntāś cārvaṅgyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktāḥ sarvāḥ prahasitānanāḥ
verses.translation: clever, fortunate, lovely, graceful in limb and pleasing to see, endowed with beauty and charm, all with smiling faces.

verses.transliteration: krīḍantyaś ca madonmattāḥ sabhāsu catvareṣu ca gītavādyakathālāpai ramayantyaś ca tāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: Playing, intoxicated with delight, in halls and squares, those women give pleasure with song, music, stories and conversation.

verses.transliteration: vāramukhyāś ca dṛśyante nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ prekṣaṇālāpakuśalāḥ sarvayoṣidguṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Chief courtesans are seen, skilled in dance and song, clever in glances and talk, endowed with all feminine accomplishments.

verses.transliteration: anyāś ca tatra dṛśyante guṇācāryāḥ kulastriyaḥ pativratāś ca subhagā guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Other women are seen there too — noble ladies who are teachers of virtue, devoted to their husbands, fortunate and adorned with every virtue.

verses.transliteration: vanaiś copavanaiḥ puṇyair udyānaiś ca manoramaiḥ devatāyatanair divyair nānākusumaśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: With holy woods and groves, charming gardens and divine temples beautiful with various flowers,

verses.transliteration: śālais tālais tamālaiś ca bakulair nāgakesaraiḥ pippalaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca candanāgurucampakaiḥ
verses.translation: with shalas, palmyras, tamalas, bakulas, nagakesaras, pippalas, karnikaras, sandal, aloe and champakas,

verses.transliteration: puṃnāgair nārikeraiś ca panasaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ nāraṅgair lakucair lodhraiḥ saptaparṇaiḥ śubhāñjanaiḥ
verses.translation: punnagas, coconuts, jackfruits, sarala trees, oranges, lakuchas, lodhras, saptaparnas and shubhanjanas,

verses.transliteration: cūtabilvakadambaiś ca śiṃśapair dhavakhādiraiḥ pāṭalāśokatagaraiḥ karavīraiḥ sitetaraiḥ
verses.translation: mangoes, bilvas, kadambas, shimshapas, dhavas, khadiras, patalas, ashokas, tagaras and karaviras red and white,

verses.sanskrit: पीतार्जुनकभल्लातैः सिद्धैर् आम्रातकैस् तथा न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थकाश्मर्यैः पलाशैर् देवदारुभिः
verses.transliteration: pītārjunakabhallātaiḥ siddhair āmrātakais tathā nyagrodhāśvatthakāśmaryaiḥ palāśair devadārubhiḥ
verses.translation: yellow arjunas, bhallatakas, siddhas and amratakas, banyans, ashvatthas, kashmaryas, palashas and devadarus,

verses.translation: with creepers, shrubs and canopies, gardens like Nandana, always rich with the scent of flowers and always bent with loads of fruit,

verses.translation: and other birds of many kinds, pleasant to the ear and charming; rivers, lotus pools and very many lakes,

verses.transliteration: anyair jalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ kumudotpalamaṇḍitaiḥ padmaiḥ sitetaraiḥ śubhraiḥ kahlāraiś ca sugandhibhiḥ
verses.translation: and other holy reservoirs adorned with water-lilies and lotuses, red and white lotuses and fragrant kahlaras,

verses.translation: and other various very charming water-born flowers, divine, spreading fragrance, bright with the blossoms of every season,

verses.translation: crowded with swans and karandavas, beautiful with chakravakas, with cranes, herons, tortoises, fish and crocodiles,

verses.translation: with jalapadas, kadambas, plavas and water-fowl, and other birds and aquatic creatures adorned with various cries,

verses.sanskrit: नानावर्णैः सदा हृष्टैर् अञ्चितानि समन्ततः एवं नानाविधैः पुष्पैर् विविधैश् च जलाशयैः
verses.transliteration: nānāvarṇaiḥ sadā hṛṣṭair añcitāni samantataḥ evaṃ nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpair vividhaiś ca jalāśayaiḥ
verses.translation: of various colours and always joyful, filling it all around. Thus with various flowers and various reservoirs,

verses.sanskrit: विविधैः पादपैः पुण्यैर् उद्यानैर् विविधैस् तथा जलस्थलचरैश् चैव विहगैश् चार्वधिष्ठितैः
verses.transliteration: vividhaiḥ pādapaiḥ puṇyair udyānair vividhais tathā jalasthalacaraiś caiva vihagaiś cārvadhiṣṭhitaiḥ
verses.translation: with various holy trees and various gardens, with creatures of water and land and birds dwelling in lovely places,

verses.sanskrit: देवतायतनैर् दिव्यैः शोभिता सा महापुरी तत्रास्ते भगवान् देवस् त्रिपुरारिस् त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: devatāyatanair divyaiḥ śobhitā sā mahāpurī tatrāste bhagavān devas tripurāris trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: and with divine temples, that great city was beautiful. There dwells the Lord, the god, the three-eyed enemy of Tripura,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाकालेति विख्यातः सर्वकामप्रदः शिवः शिवकुण्डे नरः स्नात्वा विधिवत् पापनाशने
verses.transliteration: mahākāleti vikhyātaḥ sarvakāmapradaḥ śivaḥ śivakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā vidhivat pāpanāśane
verses.translation: famed as Mahakala, Shiva who grants all desires. A man who bathes duly in the Shivakunda, destroyer of sin,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवान् पितॄन् ऋषींश् चैव संतर्प्य विधिवद् बुधः गत्वा शिवालयं पश्चात् कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: devān pitṝn ṛṣīṃś caiva saṃtarpya vidhivad budhaḥ gatvā śivālayaṃ paścāt kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: the wise one, having duly satisfied the gods, ancestors and sages, then goes to Shiva's temple and circumambulates it three times;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य संयतो भूत्वा धौतवासा जितेन्द्रियः स्नानैः पुष्पैस् तथा गन्धैर् धूपैर् दीपैश् च भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: praviśya saṃyato bhūtvā dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ snānaiḥ puṣpais tathā gandhair dhūpair dīpaiś ca bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: entering, self-restrained, in washed garments and with senses controlled, with baths, flowers, perfumes, incense and lamps, with devotion,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवेद्यैर् उपहारैश् च गीतवाद्यैः प्रदक्षिणैः दण्डवत्प्रणिपातैश् च नृत्यैः स्तोत्रैश् च शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: naivedyair upahāraiś ca gītavādyaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiś ca nṛtyaiḥ stotraiś ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: with food offerings and presents, with song, music and circumambulation, with prostrations like a staff, dances and hymns to Shankara —
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य विधिवद् भक्त्या महाकालं सकृच् छिवम् अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya vidhivad bhaktyā mahākālaṃ sakṛc chivam aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: having worshipped Mahakala Shiva duly with devotion even once, a man obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापैः सर्वैर् विनिर्मुक्तो विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः आरुह्य त्रिदिवं याति यत्र शंभोर् निकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: pāpaiḥ sarvair vinirmukto vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ āruhya tridivaṃ yāti yatra śaṃbhor niketanam
verses.translation: Freed from all sins, mounting celestial cars that fulfil every wish, he goes to heaven where Shambhu's abode is.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यरूपधरः श्रीमान् दिव्यालंकारभूषितः भुङ्क्ते तत्र वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ bhuṅkte tatra varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: Bearing a divine form, glorious, adorned with divine ornaments, he enjoys excellent pleasures there until the dissolution of beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवलोके मुनिश्रेष्ठा जरामरणवर्जितः पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः प्रवरे ब्राह्मणे कुले
verses.transliteration: śivaloke muniśreṣṭhā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ pravare brāhmaṇe kule
verses.translation: In Shiva's world, O best of sages, free from old age and death; when his merit is exhausted he comes here and is born in an excellent brahmin family,

verses.transliteration: caturvedī bhaved vipraḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: a brahmin learned in the four Vedas and skilled in all scriptures; having attained the Pashupata yoga, he then attains liberation.

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते तत्र नदी पुण्या शिप्रा नामेति विश्रुता तस्यां स्नातस् तु विधिवत् संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: āste tatra nadī puṇyā śiprā nāmeti viśrutā tasyāṃ snātas tu vidhivat saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: There flows the holy river famed by the name Shipra; bathing in it duly and satisfying the ancestors and deities,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विमानवरम् आस्थितः भुङ्क्ते बहुविधान् भोगान् स्वर्गलोके नरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto vimānavaram āsthitaḥ bhuṅkte bahuvidhān bhogān svargaloke narottamaḥ
verses.translation: freed from all sins and mounted on an excellent celestial car, the best of men enjoys many kinds of pleasures in the world of heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्ते तत्रैव भगवान् देवदेवो जनार्दनः गोविन्दस्वामिनामासौ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदो हरिः
verses.transliteration: āste tatraiva bhagavān devadevo janārdanaḥ govindasvāmināmāsau bhuktimuktiprado hariḥ
verses.translation: There too dwells the Lord Janardana, god of gods, named Govindasvamin — Hari, giver of enjoyment and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मुक्तिम् आप्नोति त्रिसप्तकुलसंयुतः विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā muktim āpnoti trisaptakulasaṃyutaḥ vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā
verses.translation: Seeing him, one attains liberation together with twenty-one generations; in a celestial car coloured like the sun, hung with networks of bells,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेन कामगेनास्थिरेण च उपगीयमानो गन्धर्वैर् विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagenāsthireṇa ca upagīyamāno gandharvair viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: rich in every desire, moving at will and restless, sung to by Gandharvas, he is honoured in Vishnu's world,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुङ्क्ते च विविधान् कामान् निरातङ्को गतज्वरः आभूतसंप्लवं यावत् सुरूपः सुभगः सुखी
verses.transliteration: bhuṅkte ca vividhān kāmān nirātaṅko gatajvaraḥ ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvat surūpaḥ subhagaḥ sukhī
verses.translation: and enjoys various desires, free from fear and fever, until the dissolution of beings, handsome, fortunate and happy.

verses.sanskrit: कालेनागत्य मतिमान् ब्राह्मणः स्यान् महीतले प्रवरे योगिनां गेहे वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: kālenāgatya matimān brāhmaṇaḥ syān mahītale pravare yogināṃ gehe vedaśāstrārthatattvavit
verses.translation: In due time returning, the wise one becomes a brahmin on earth in an excellent house of yogins, knowing the truth of the Vedas and scriptures,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात् विक्रमस्वामिनामानं विष्णुं तत्रैव भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt vikramasvāmināmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ tatraiva bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: and having taken up the yoga of Vishnu, he then attains liberation. Seeing Vishnu named Vikramasvamin there, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नरो वा नारी वा फलं पूर्वोदितं लभेत् अन्ये ऽपि तत्र तिष्ठन्ति देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā naro vā nārī vā phalaṃ pūrvoditaṃ labhet anye 'pi tatra tiṣṭhanti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: man or woman obtains the fruit described before. Other gods led by Shakra dwell there too,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मातरश् च मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वकामफलप्रदाः दृष्ट्वा तान् विधिवद् भक्त्या संपूज्य प्रणिपत्य च
verses.transliteration: mātaraś ca muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ dṛṣṭvā tān vidhivad bhaktyā saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca
verses.translation: and the Mothers, O best of sages, granting the fruit of every desire; seeing them, worshipping them duly with devotion and bowing,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो नरो याति त्रिविष्टपम् एवं सा नगरी रम्या राजसिंहेन पालिता
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti triviṣṭapam evaṃ sā nagarī ramyā rājasiṃhena pālitā
verses.translation: a man freed from all sins goes to heaven. Thus that delightful city was protected by the lion among kings,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: nityotsavapramuditā yathendrasyāmarāvatī purāṣṭādaśasaṃyuktā suvistīrṇacatuṣpathā
verses.translation: joyful with constant festivals like Indra's Amaravati, joined with eighteen suburbs, with very broad crossroads,

verses.transliteration: dhanurjyāghoṣaninadā siddhasaṃgamabhūṣitā vidyāvadgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā vedanirghoṣanāditā
verses.translation: resounding with the twang of bowstrings, adorned with gatherings of Siddhas, abounding in groups of learned men, resounding with the recitation of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि शास्त्राणि विविधानि च काव्यालापकथाश् चैव श्रूयन्ते ऽहर्निशं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca kāvyālāpakathāś caiva śrūyante 'harniśaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Itihasas, Puranas, various scriptures, poetry, conversations and stories are heard there day and night, O brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मया गुणाढ्या सा तदुयिनी?? समुदाहृता यस्यां राजाभवत् पूर्वम् इन्द्रद्युम्नो महामतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mayā guṇāḍhyā sā taduyinī?? samudāhṛtā yasyāṃ rājābhavat pūrvam indradyumno mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Thus I have described that city rich in virtues, in which formerly lived the great-minded King Indradyumna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां स नृपतिः पूर्वं कुर्वन् राज्यम् अनुत्तमम् पालयाम् आस मतिमान् प्रजाः पुत्रान् इवौरसान्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ kurvan rājyam anuttamam pālayām āsa matimān prajāḥ putrān ivaurasān
verses.translation: Administering the excellent country formerly, from that city, that king of great intellect, protected his subjects like his own bosom-born sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Administering the excellent country formerly, from that city, that king of great intellect, protected his subjects like his own bosom-born sons.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवादी महाप्राज्ञः शूरः सर्वगुणाकरः मतिमान् धर्मसंपन्नः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः
verses.transliteration: satyavādī mahāprājñaḥ śūraḥ sarvaguṇākaraḥ matimān dharmasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Thus endowed with riches and adorned by good qualities the king administered the excellent kingdom with his mind assured of realizing all cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus endowed with riches and adorned by good qualities the king administered the excellent kingdom with his mind assured of realizing all cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: satyavāñ śīlavān dāntaḥ śrīmān parapuraṃjayaḥ āditya iva tejobhī rūpair āśvinayor iva
verses.translation: Once he pondered over this, in mind—"How shall I propitiate Visnu, the lord of all Yogas? How shall I propitiate lord who bestows worldly pleasures and salvation?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Once he pondered over this, in mind—"How shall I propitiate Visnu, the lord of all Yogas? How shall I propitiate lord who bestows worldly pleasures and salvation?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमानसुराश्चर्यः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः शारदेन्दुर् इवाभाति लक्षणैः समलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: vardhamānasurāścaryaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ śāradendur ivābhāti lakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After realising the greatest entity, the unchanging lord Vasudeva, he passed beyond all illusory knowledge. 1 Restraining his sense-organs, he became a seeker of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After realising the greatest entity, the unchanging lord Vasudeva, he passed beyond all illusory knowledge. 1 Restraining his sense-organs, he became a seeker of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: आहर्ता सर्वयज्ञानां हयमेधादिकृत् तथा दानैर् यज्ञैस् तपोभिश् च तत्तुल्यो नास्ति भूपतिः
verses.transliteration: āhartā sarvayajñānāṃ hayamedhādikṛt tathā dānair yajñais tapobhiś ca tattulyo nāsti bhūpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Charioteer-soldiers followed him in chariots resem¬ bling aerial vehicles. They were decorated with flag-staffs and fanners. The soldiers carried weapons in their arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Charioteer-soldiers followed him in chariots resem¬ bling aerial vehicles. They were decorated with flag-staffs and fanners. The soldiers carried weapons in their arms.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तानां गजाश्वानां च भूपतिः प्रददौ विप्रमुख्येभ्यो यागे यागे महाधनम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇamaṇimuktānāṃ gajāśvānāṃ ca bhūpatiḥ pradadau vipramukhyebhyo yāge yāge mahādhanam
verses.translation: bhr&nti-jfl&na —illusory knowledge, such as the knowledge of "snake in rope or of silver in a shell". This is known as the pratibhisika jnana.
verses.commentary: Sense: bhr&nti-jfl&na —illusory knowledge, such as the knowledge of "snake in rope or of silver in a shell". This is known as the pratibhisika jnana.

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथमुख्यानां कम्बलाजिनवाससाम् रत्नानां धनधान्यानाम् अन्तस् तस्य न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathamukhyānāṃ kambalājinavāsasām ratnānāṃ dhanadhānyānām antas tasya na vidyate
verses.translation: The cavalry men followed the king with horses on a par with the wind. They carried javelins and iron clubs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cavalry men followed the king with horses on a par with the wind. They carried javelins and iron clubs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वधनैर् युक्तो गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा कुर्वन् राज्यम् अकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvadhanair yukto guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā kurvan rājyam akaṇṭakam
verses.translation: There were people who sold missiles, those who sustain¬ ed themselves by trading in betal leaves, the sellers of grass, the sellers of fuel.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were people who sold missiles, those who sustain¬ ed themselves by trading in betal leaves, the sellers of grass, the sellers of fuel.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्येयं मतिर् उत्पन्ना सर्वयोगेश्वरं हरिम् कथम् आराधयिष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tasyeyaṃ matir utpannā sarvayogeśvaraṃ harim katham ārādhayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: All those who sustained themselves by the stage, those who sold meat, oil-mongers and cloth merchants followed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those who sustained themselves by the stage, those who sold meat, oil-mongers and cloth merchants followed him.

verses.sanskrit: विचार्य सर्वशास्त्राणि तन्त्राण्य् आगमविस्तरम् इतिहासपुराणानि वेदाङ्गानि च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: vicārya sarvaśāstrāṇi tantrāṇy āgamavistaram itihāsapurāṇāni vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Sellers of fruits, those who sold leaves, those who tiansported grass and fodder and thousands of washermen (followed him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sellers of fruits, those who sold leaves, those who tiansported grass and fodder and thousands of washermen (followed him).

verses.translation: There were cowherds, barbers, tailors, shepherds, goat¬ herds and those who tended deer and swans.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were cowherds, barbers, tailors, shepherds, goat¬ herds and those who tended deer and swans.

verses.transliteration: guruṃ saṃsevya yatnena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān ādhāya paramāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'bhavat tadā
verses.translation: There were people who sold foodgrains, powdered fried grains, gaggery and salt.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were people who sold foodgrains, powdered fried grains, gaggery and salt.

verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya paramaṃ tattvaṃ vāsudevākhyam avyayam bhrāntijñānād atītas tu mumukṣuḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: There were musicians, dancers, bards, actors, story-tellers and those who are experts in Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were musicians, dancers, bards, actors, story-tellers and those who are experts in Puranas.

verses.transliteration: katham ārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ sanātanam pītavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: There were poets, versifiers, composers of poems, experts in different poems, followers of Garutfa who dispel poison and those who test different jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were poets, versifiers, composers of poems, experts in different poems, followers of Garutfa who dispel poison and those who test different jewels.

verses.sanskrit: वनमालावृतोरस्कं पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम् श्रीवत्सोरःसमायुक्तं मुकुटाङ्गदशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: vanamālāvṛtoraskaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam śrīvatsoraḥsamāyuktaṃ mukuṭāṅgadaśobhitam
verses.translation: There were blacksmiths, coppersmiths, those who work in bellmctal, Ruthakas?, those who make scabbards, painters, turners and Pavakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were blacksmiths, coppersmiths, those who work in bellmctal, Ruthakas?, those who make scabbards, painters, turners and Pavakas.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपुरात् स तु निष्क्रान्त उज्जयिन्याः प्रजापतिः बलेन महता युक्तः सभृत्यः सपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: svapurāt sa tu niṣkrānta ujjayinyāḥ prajāpatiḥ balena mahatā yuktaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ sapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: There 'were makers of sticks and batons, those who make swords, those who maintain by selling ale or gambling;
verses.commentary: Sense: There 'were makers of sticks and batons, those who make swords, those who maintain by selling ale or gambling;

verses.sanskrit: अनुजग्मुस् तु तं सर्वे रथिनः शस्त्रपाणयः रथैर् विमानसंकाशैः पताकाध्वजसेवितैः
verses.transliteration: anujagmus tu taṃ sarve rathinaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ rathair vimānasaṃkāśaiḥ patākādhvajasevitaiḥ
verses.translation: All these citizens and those who have not yet been mentioned followed him. The entire residents of the city followed him too.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these citizens and those who have not yet been mentioned followed him. The entire residents of the city followed him too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सादिनश् च तथा सर्वे प्रासतोमरपाणयः अश्वैः पवनसंकाशैर् अनुजग्मुस् तु तं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: sādinaś ca tathā sarve prāsatomarapāṇayaḥ aśvaiḥ pavanasaṃkāśair anujagmus tu taṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: Just as the sons eager to sec other villages follow their father who proceeds ahead so also those citizens followed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the sons eager to sec other villages follow their father who proceeds ahead so also those citizens followed him.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्संभवैर् मत्तैर् वारणैः पर्वतोपमैः ईषादन्तैः सदा मत्तैः प्रचण्डैः षष्टिहायनैः
verses.transliteration: himavatsaṃbhavair mattair vāraṇaiḥ parvatopamaiḥ īṣādantaiḥ sadā mattaiḥ pracaṇḍaiḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the glorious king surrounded by a great concourse of people as well as (the four divisions of the army viz the ele¬ phants, horses, chariots and infantry, proceeded slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the glorious king surrounded by a great concourse of people as well as (the four divisions of the army viz the ele¬ phants, horses, chariots and infantry, proceeded slowly.

verses.sanskrit: हेमकक्षैः सपताकैर् घण्टारवविभूषितैः अनुजग्मुश् च तं सर्वे गजयुद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: hemakakṣaiḥ sapatākair ghaṇṭāravavibhūṣitaiḥ anujagmuś ca taṃ sarve gajayuddhaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: Going ahead thus, followed by the armies the king reached the shore of the Southern sea after a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Going ahead thus, followed by the armies the king reached the shore of the Southern sea after a long time.

verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyeyāś ca pādātā dhanuṣprāsāsipāṇayaḥ divyamālyāmbaradharā divyagandhānulepanāḥ
verses.translation: After reaching the sea-shore the king encamped there in a beautiful holy land endowed with the qualities of a good land.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the sea-shore the king encamped there in a beautiful holy land endowed with the qualities of a good land.

verses.sanskrit: अनुजग्मुश् च तं सर्वे युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः शूराः सदा संग्रामलालसाः
verses.transliteration: anujagmuś ca taṃ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ sarvāstrakuśalāḥ śūrāḥ sadā saṃgrāmalālasāḥ
verses.translation: Listen you all. I shall succinctly mention the story of some past incidents. It is a story that destroys sins: Formerly, Lord Visnu was asked by Laksmx.

verses.transliteration: antaḥpuranivāsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ bimbauṣṭhacārudaśanāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: On the wonder-inspiring golden peak of Sumeru, the lotus-born goddess bowed to the unchanging creator of all worlds, named Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the wonder-inspiring golden peak of Sumeru, the lotus-born goddess bowed to the unchanging creator of all worlds, named Vasudeva.

verses.transliteration: divyavastradharāḥ sarvā divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ divyagandhānuliptāṅgāḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ
verses.translation: Balakhilyas or Vdlakhilyas —Sixty thousand hermits bom to Kratu, a hermit, by his wife Santati. Everyone of them was of the size of half a thumb, but they were as bright as the blazing sun and had attained control over their senses.

verses.transliteration: sumadhyamāś cāruveṣāś cārukarṇālakāñcitāḥ tāmbūlarañjitamukhā rakṣibhiś ca surakṣitāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of his consort, Visnu the lord of Devas spoke with pleasure. What he said was nectarlike. It was the great essence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of his consort, Visnu the lord of Devas spoke with pleasure. What he said was nectarlike. It was the great essence.

verses.transliteration: yānair uccāvacaiḥ śubhrair maṇikāñcanabhūṣitaiḥ upagīyamānās tāḥ sarvā gāyanaiḥ stutipāṭhakaiḥ
verses.translation: At the conclusion of his Yogic slumber he created
verses.commentary: Sense: At the conclusion of his Yogic slumber he created

verses.translation: On the shore of the Southern ocean a place extending to ten Yojanas all round the place where there stands a holy big tree, is the rarest of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the shore of the Southern ocean a place extending to ten Yojanas all round the place where there stands a holy big tree, is the rarest of all holy centres.

verses.transliteration: vaṇiggrāmagaṇāḥ sarve nānāpuranivāsinaḥ dhanai ratnaiḥ suvarṇaiś ca sadārāḥ saparicchadāḥ
verses.translation: This holy fig tree does not perish when the Kalpa comes to a close and the dissolution of all the worlds starts. It remains there as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: This holy fig tree does not perish when the Kalpa comes to a close and the dissolution of all the worlds starts. It remains there as before.

verses.translation: All those creatures who circumambulate and make obeisance, shake oft their sins and go to the abode of lord Visnu.

verses.transliteration: raṅgopajīvinaḥ sarve māṃsavikrayiṇas tathā tailavikrayakāś caiva vastravikrayakās tathā
verses.translation: O my beloved, on seeing men (and women devotees) going thus, (God of death) came near me once, bowed to me with the bent head, and said thus:—

verses.transliteration: phalavikrayiṇaś caiva pattravikrayiṇas tathā tathā javasahārāś ca rajakāś ca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: $a —Adisesa, Chief of the Nagas, is the reposing bed of Visu. But he is also represented as supporting the earth at the behest of Brahma. According to a myth, Balabhadra Rama, the elder brother of Srikr§na was born from a portion of Sesa.

verses.transliteration: gopālā nāpitāś caiva tathānye vastrasūcakāḥ meṣapālāś cājapālā mṛgapālāś ca haṃsakāḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed lady, on seeing him standing outside with palms joined in reverence, I asked the (God of Death) about the purpose for which I had been eulogised.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed lady, on seeing him standing outside with palms joined in reverence, I asked the (God of Death) about the purpose for which I had been eulogised.

verses.transliteration: dhānyavikrayiṇaś caiva saktuvikrayiṇaś ca ye guḍavikrayikāś caiva tathā lavaṇajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: O Vaivasvata of long brawny arms, indeed, you arc the most excellent of all Devas. Why did you eulogise me? Tell me all in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vaivasvata of long brawny arms, indeed, you arc the most excellent of all Devas. Why did you eulogise me? Tell me all in brief.

verses.transliteration: gāyanā nartakāś caiva tathā maṅgalapāṭhakāḥ śailūṣāḥ kathakāś caiva purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: In this meritorious shrine known as Purusottama, there is an excellent idol made of sapphire. It bestows all cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this meritorious shrine known as Purusottama, there is an excellent idol made of sapphire. It bestows all cherished desires.

verses.transliteration: kavayaḥ kāvyakartāro nānākāvyaviśāradāḥ viṣaghnā gāruḍāś caiva nānāratnaparīkṣakāḥ
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed lord, by visiting it with emotional fervour and faith, even men devoid of desires go to the abode called Sveta. 1

verses.transliteration: vyokārās tāmrakārāś ca kāṃsyakārāś ca rūṭhakāḥ kauṣakārāś citrakārāḥ kundakārāś ca pāvakāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O slayer of enemies I am notable to carry on my activities. O great lord, be pleased. O lord, withdraw the idol.

verses.transliteration: daṇḍakārāś cāsikārāḥ surādhūtopajīvinaḥ mallā dūtāś ca kāyasthā ye cānye karmakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Yama I spoke to him: O Yama, I shall conceal it with sands all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Yama I spoke to him: O Yama, I shall conceal it with sands all round.

verses.transliteration: tantuvāyā rūpakārā vārtikās tailapāṭhakāḥ lāvajīvās taittirikā mṛgapakṣyupajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: Suela or Svetadvlpa —Colonel Wilford identifies it with Britain— J. Dowson. Hindu Mythology and Religion

verses.transliteration: ete nāgarakāḥ sarve ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ anujagmus tu rājānaṃ samastapuravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: all these citizens, and others not mentioned, all the inhabitants of the city followed the king,

verses.transliteration: yathā vrajantaṃ pitaraṃ grāmāntaraṃ samutsukāḥ anuyānti yathā putrās tathā taṃ te 'pi nāgarāḥ
verses.translation: as eager sons follow their father when he goes to another village, so those citizens followed him.

verses.translation: Thus that glorious king, surrounded by all the great people, with elephants, horses, chariots and foot soldiers, went slowly on.

verses.translation: Having thus gone, followed by all those forces for a long time, the lord king reached the shore of the southern ocean.

verses.transliteration: dadarśa sāgaraṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyantam iva ca sthitam anekaśatasāhasrair ūrmibhiś ca samākulam
verses.translation: He saw the delightful ocean, standing as if dancing, crowded with many hundreds of thousands of waves,

verses.translation: deep with many whirlpools, refuge of the Danavas, the divine churning-source of nectar, source of the gods, lord of waters,

verses.sanskrit: केतकीवनखण्डैश् च सदा पुष्पधरैः सितैः मल्लिकाकुन्दकुसुमैर् यूथिकातगरैस् तथा

verses.transliteration: tathānyaiḥ kṛṣṇasārādyair mṛgaiḥ sarvatra śobhitaiḥ śārdūlair dīptamātaṅgais tathānyair vanacāribhiḥ
verses.translation: and other deer such as black bucks, beautiful everywhere, with tigers, blazing elephants and other forest-dwellers.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣair udyānair nandanopamaiḥ latāgulmavitānaiś ca vividhaiś ca jalāśayaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus with various trees and gardens like Nandana, canopies of creepers and shrubs and various reservoirs,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ kādambaiś ca plavair haṃsaiś cakravākopaśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: crowded with swans and karandavas, adorned with clusters of lotuses, with kadambas, plavas and swans, beautiful with chakravakas,

verses.translation: with lotuses, hundred-petalled lotuses, kahlaras, water-lilies and blue lotuses, birds, aquatic creatures and flowers born of water,

verses.transliteration: parvatair dīptaśikharaiś cārukandaramaṇḍitaiḥ nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇair nānādhātuvibhūṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: with mountains with blazing peaks, adorned with lovely caves, covered with various trees and adorned with various minerals,
