verses.translation: with peaks full of every wonder, auspicious abodes of all beings, rich in all herbs, with vast and variegated slopes —

verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditaiḥ śobhitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ dadarśa sa mahīpālaḥ sthānaṃ trailokyapūjitam
verses.translation: thus that king saw a place adorned with all these charming things together, worshipped by the three worlds,

verses.transliteration: daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ pañcayojanam āyatam nānāścaryasamāyuktaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: ten yojanas wide and five yojanas long, filled with various wonders, a most rare region.

verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vaiṣṇave puruṣottame kiṃ tatra pratimā pūrvaṃ na sthitā vaiṣṇavī prabho
verses.translation: (All round the sacrificial chamber) hundreds of palaces were built. They were beautiful and they resembled the abode of Indra. They were bedecked in gold and jewels. Excellent gems enhanced their beauty.

verses.transliteration: yenāsau nṛpatis tatra gatvā sabalavāhanaḥ sthāpayām āsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ śubhapradām
verses.translation: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.
verses.commentary: Sense: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.

verses.transliteration: saṃśayo no mahān atra vismayaś ca jagatpate śrotum icchāmahe sarvaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ ca naḥ
verses.translation: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their
verses.commentary: Sense: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their

verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ pūrvasaṃvṛttāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm pravakṣyāmi samāsena śriyā pṛṣṭaḥ purā hariḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.

verses.transliteration: sumeroḥ kāñcane śṛṅge sarvāścaryasamanvite siddhavidyādharair yakṣaiḥ kiṃnarair upaśobhite
verses.translation: Paflcar&tra —a system of spiritual doctrines, by following which one attains, the position of Uparicara.

verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvair nāgair apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ munibhir guhyakaiḥ siddhaiḥ sauparṇaiḥ samarudgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: O great Boar 1 just as the earth had been formerly lifted up by you by your curved fangs, from the nether worlds so also save me from the ocean of misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great Boar 1 just as the earth had been formerly lifted up by you by your curved fangs, from the nether worlds so also save me from the ocean of misery.

verses.transliteration: anyair devālayaiḥ sādhyaiḥ kaśyapādyaiḥ prajeśvaraiḥ vālakhilyādibhiś caiva śobhite sumanohare
verses.translation: O lord Krsna, these idols of yours, the bestowers of boons, have been eulogised by me. You, Baladeva and others, are stationed in separate forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Krsna, these idols of yours, the bestowers of boons, have been eulogised by me. You, Baladeva and others, are stationed in separate forms.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकारवनैर् दिव्यैः सर्वर्तुकुसुमोत्करैः जातरूपप्रतीकाशैर् भूषिते सूर्यसंनिभैः
verses.transliteration: karṇikāravanair divyaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ jātarūpapratīkāśair bhūṣite sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ
verses.translation: This refers to the Boar incarnation of VisijLU. The boar entered the sea and found out the earth that had sunk. The boar lifted the earth at his tusks, came out of the ocean and set the earth firm over the water. On the way, the fierce and wicked Hiranyaksa hindered him. The Boar killed Hirayaksa and disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च बहुभिर् वृक्षैः शालतालादिभिर् वनैः पुंनागाशोकसरलन्यग्रोधाम्रातकार्जुनैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca bahubhir vṛkṣaiḥ śālatālādibhir vanaiḥ puṃnāgāśokasaralanyagrodhāmrātakārjunaiḥ
verses.translation: Guardians of quarters —lokapalas. They are sometimes regarded as the guardian deities of different orders of beings, but more commonly of the four cardinal and four intermediate points of the world. They are 1 Indra, of East; 2 Agni of South-east; 3 Yama of South; 4 Surya of South¬ west; 5 Varuna of West; 6 Vayu of North-west; 7 Kubera of North; 8 liana of North-east. Others substitute Nirfti for Surya and Iiani or Pfthivi for liana. According to Dharraa-saiigraha, the Buddhists enumerate 14 lokapalas.

verses.transliteration: pārijātāmrakhadiranīpabilvakadambakaiḥ dhavakhādirapālāśaśīrṣāmalakatindukaiḥ
verses.translation: Hara, Sankarsana and others who have been glorified as your variant forms, have been evolved for your worship. They are dependent on you, they resort to you for support.

verses.sanskrit: नारिङ्गकोलबकुललोध्रदाडिमदारुकैः सर्जैश् च कर्णैस् तगरैः शिशिभूर्जवनिम्बकैः
verses.transliteration: nāriṅgakolabakulalodhradāḍimadārukaiḥ sarjaiś ca karṇais tagaraiḥ śiśibhūrjavanimbakaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च काञ्चनैश् चैव फलभारैश् च नामितैः नानाकुसुमगन्धाढ्यैर् भूषिते पुष्पपादपैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca kāñcanaiś caiva phalabhāraiś ca nāmitaiḥ nānākusumagandhāḍhyair bhūṣite puṣpapādapaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one. You are all-pervading Consciousness by nature and you are unsullied.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one. You are all-pervading Consciousness by nature and you are unsullied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मालतीयूथिकामल्लीकुन्दबाणकुरुण्टकैः पाटलागस्त्यकुटजमन्दारकुसुमादिभिः
verses.transliteration: mālatīyūthikāmallīkundabāṇakuruṇṭakaiḥ pāṭalāgastyakuṭajamandārakusumādibhiḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, most excellent one among Devas, O bestower of freedom from fear on devotees, O deity with eyes like the petals of lotus, save me. I am immersed in the ocean of sexual objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, most excellent one among Devas, O bestower of freedom from fear on devotees, O deity with eyes like the petals of lotus, save me. I am immersed in the ocean of sexual objects.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च विविधैः पुष्पैर् मनसः प्रीतिदायकैः नानाविहगसंघैश् च कूजद्भिर् मधुरस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhaiḥ puṣpair manasaḥ prītidāyakaiḥ nānāvihagasaṃghaiś ca kūjadbhir madhurasvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, O lord of worlds, O husband of Lak§ml, I do not see any one in whom I can seek refuge. O slayer of Madhu, 1 be pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, O lord of worlds, O husband of Lak§ml, I do not see any one in whom I can seek refuge. O slayer of Madhu, 1 be pleased.

verses.sanskrit: पुंस्कोकिलरुतैर् दिव्यैर् मत्तबर्हिणनादितैः एवं नानाविधैर् वृक्षैः पुष्पैर् नानाविधैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: puṃskokilarutair divyair mattabarhiṇanāditaiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhair vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpair nānāvidhais tathā
verses.translation: O slayer of Madhu. Madhu and Kaifabha sprang from the ears of Visnu. They were about to kill Brahma who was lying on the lotus sprin¬ ging from Visnu's navel. Visnu killed them and obtained the names: Kaitabhari and Madhusudana.
verses.commentary: Sense: O slayer of Madhu. Madhu and Kaifabha sprang from the ears of Visnu. They were about to kill Brahma who was lying on the lotus sprin¬ ging from Visnu's navel. Visnu killed them and obtained the names: Kaitabhari and Madhusudana.

verses.sanskrit: खगैर् नानाविधैश् चैव शोभिते सुरसेविते तत्र स्थितं जगन्नाथं जगत्स्रष्टारम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: khagair nānāvidhaiś caiva śobhite surasevite tatra sthitaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagatsraṣṭāram avyayam
verses.translation: O lord, I have passed through births, thousands and ten thousands of them of diverse kinds, in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I have passed through births, thousands and ten thousands of them of diverse kinds, in this world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकविधातारं वासुदेवाख्यम् अव्ययम् प्रणम्य शिरसा देवी लोकानां हितकाम्यया पप्रच्छेमं महाप्रश्नं पद्मजा तम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvalokavidhātāraṃ vāsudevākhyam avyayam praṇamya śirasā devī lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā papracchemaṃ mahāpraśnaṃ padmajā tam anuttamam
verses.translation: Separations from and union with wives, enemies, friends and kinsmen have been faced by me. Many and many kinds of fathers have been seen by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Separations from and union with wives, enemies, friends and kinsmen have been faced by me. Many and many kinds of fathers have been seen by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि त्वं सर्वलोकेश संशयं मे हृदि स्थितम् मर्त्यलोके महाश्चर्ये कर्मभूमौ सुदुर्लभे
verses.transliteration: brūhi tvaṃ sarvalokeśa saṃśayaṃ me hṛdi sthitam martyaloke mahāścarye karmabhūmau sudurlabhe
verses.translation: Many miseries have been experienced by me. Many miseries have been misunderstood and enjoyed as pleasures by me. I have had cousins and kinsmen, sons and brothers, in plenty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many miseries have been experienced by me. Many miseries have been misunderstood and enjoyed as pleasures by me. I have had cousins and kinsmen, sons and brothers, in plenty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोभमोहग्रहग्रस्ते कामक्रोधमहार्णवे येन मुच्येत देवेश अस्मात् संसारसागरात्
verses.transliteration: lobhamohagrahagraste kāmakrodhamahārṇave yena mucyeta deveśa asmāt saṃsārasāgarāt
verses.translation: I have lived within the belly of women that abounds in urine and floating masses of faeces. O lord, great misery has been experienced by me while staying in womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have lived within the belly of women that abounds in urine and floating masses of faeces. O lord, great misery has been experienced by me while staying in womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचक्ष्व सर्वदेवेश प्रणतां यदि मन्यसे त्वदृते नास्ति लोके ऽस्मिन् वक्ता संशयनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: ācakṣva sarvadeveśa praṇatāṃ yadi manyase tvadṛte nāsti loke 'smin vaktā saṃśayanirṇaye
verses.translation: O lord, all those miseries that are usual in childhood, youth and old age have been suffered by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, all those miseries that are usual in childhood, youth and old age have been suffered by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैवं वचनं तस्या देवदेवो जनार्दनः प्रोवाच परया प्रीत्या परं सारामृतोपमम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyā devadevo janārdanaḥ provāca parayā prītyā paraṃ sārāmṛtopamam
verses.translation: The miseries at death, in the path and the abode of Yama as also the tortures in hell have been experienced by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The miseries at death, in the path and the abode of Yama as also the tortures in hell have been experienced by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुखोपास्यः सुसाध्यश् च ऽभिरामश् च सुसत्फलः आस्ते तीर्थवरे देवि विख्यातः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sukhopāsyaḥ susādhyaś ca 'bhirāmaś ca susatphalaḥ āste tīrthavare devi vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, many times I have been the slave of glorious prosperous men. From the impoverished state I had attained the state of a lord and master.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, many times I have been the slave of glorious prosperous men. From the impoverished state I had attained the state of a lord and master.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तेन सदृशः कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते कीर्तनाद् यस्य देवेशि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate kīrtanād yasya deveśi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Many were killed by me. I have been killed by many. I have caused death to many and my death has been caused by many. Much had been given to me by others and many times gifts have been distributed by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many were killed by me. I have been killed by many. I have caused death to many and my death has been caused by many. Much had been given to me by others and many times gifts have been distributed by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न विज्ञातो ऽमरैः सर्वैर् न दैत्यैर् न च दानवैः मरीच्याद्यैर् मुनिवरैर् गोपितं मे वरानने
verses.transliteration: na vijñāto 'maraiḥ sarvair na daityair na ca dānavaiḥ marīcyādyair munivarair gopitaṃ me varānane
verses.translation: A fugitive (terrified of life) attacked by grief and greed I have become senseless. Now, O lord, utterly helpless and confused, I seek refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: A fugitive (terrified of life) attacked by grief and greed I have become senseless. Now, O lord, utterly helpless and confused, I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् ते ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि तीर्थराजं च सांप्रतम् भावेनैकेन सुश्रोणि शृणुष्व वरवर्णिनि
verses.transliteration: tat te 'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrtharājaṃ ca sāṃpratam bhāvenaikena suśroṇi śṛṇuṣva varavarṇini
verses.translation: O lord, save me who have become miserable and immersed in the ocean of worldly existence. O lord of the uni¬ verse, if you consider me your devotee have pity on me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, save me who have become miserable and immersed in the ocean of worldly existence. O lord of the uni¬ verse, if you consider me your devotee have pity on me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: āsīt kalpe samutpanne naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame pralīnā devagandharvadaityavidyādharoragāḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तमोभूतम् इदं सर्वं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन तस्मिञ् जागर्ति भूतात्मा परमात्मा जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tamobhūtam idaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana tasmiñ jāgarti bhūtātmā paramātmā jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: All this was darkness, and nothing could be discerned. In it keeps watch the Self of beings, the Supreme Self, the teacher of the world,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमांस् त्रिमूर्तिकृद् देवो जगत्कर्ता महेश्वरः वासुदेवेति विख्यातो योगात्मा हरिर् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śrīmāṃs trimūrtikṛd devo jagatkartā maheśvaraḥ vāsudeveti vikhyāto yogātmā harir īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: the glorious god who makes the three forms, maker of the world, the great Lord, famed as Vasudeva, whose self is yoga, Hari the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद् योगनिद्रान्ते नाभ्यम्भोरुहमध्यगम् पद्मकेशरसंकाशं ब्रह्माणं भूतम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: so 'sṛjad yoganidrānte nābhyambhoruhamadhyagam padmakeśarasaṃkāśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhūtam avyayam
verses.translation: At the end of his yogic sleep he created, seated in the middle of the lotus of his navel, Brahma, like the filaments of a lotus, the imperishable being.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तादृग्भूतस् ततो ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः पञ्चभूतसमायुक्तं सृजते च शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: tādṛgbhūtas tato brahmā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ pañcabhūtasamāyuktaṃ sṛjate ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma, great lord of all the worlds, being thus, slowly creates what is joined with the five elements —

verses.sanskrit: मात्रायोनीनि भूतानि स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि यानि च चतुर्विधानि सर्वाणि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: mātrāyonīni bhūtāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi yāni ca caturvidhāni sarvāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
verses.translation: beings arising from the subtle elements, gross and subtle, all four kinds, unmoving and moving.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajāpatir brahmā cakre sarvaṃ carācaram saṃcintya manasātmānaṃ sasarja vividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma, lord of creatures, made all the moving and unmoving; reflecting on himself with his mind, he created various creatures:

verses.transliteration: marīcyādīn munīn sarvān devāsurapitṝn api yakṣavidyādharāṃś cānyān gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā
verses.translation: all the sages led by Marichi, gods, Asuras and ancestors, Yakshas, Vidyadharas and others, and the rivers beginning with the Ganga,

verses.transliteration: naravānarasiṃhāṃś ca vividhāṃś ca vihaṃgamān jarāyūn aṇḍajān devi svedajodbhedajāṃs tathā
verses.translation: men, monkeys and lions and various birds, the womb-born, the egg-born, O Goddess, the sweat-born and the sprout-born,

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं तथा वैश्यं शूद्रं चैव चतुष्टयम् अन्त्यजातांश् च म्लेच्छांश् च ससर्ज विविधान् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: brahma kṣatraṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva catuṣṭayam antyajātāṃś ca mlecchāṃś ca sasarja vividhān pṛthak
verses.translation: the fourfold brahmin, kshatriya, vaishya and shudra, and the lowest castes and barbarians — he created them separately in their variety.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञं तु तृणगुल्मपिपीलिकम् ब्रह्मा भूत्वा जगत् सर्वं निर्ममे स चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñaṃ tu tṛṇagulmapipīlikam brahmā bhūtvā jagat sarvaṃ nirmame sa carācaram
verses.translation: Whatever is called a living being, down to grass, shrubs and ants — becoming Brahma, he fashioned the whole world, moving and unmoving.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाङ्गे तथात्मानं संचिन्त्य पुरुषं स्वयम् वामे चैव तु नारीं स द्विधा भूतम् अकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāṅge tathātmānaṃ saṃcintya puruṣaṃ svayam vāme caiva tu nārīṃ sa dvidhā bhūtam akalpayat
verses.translation: Contemplating himself as a man on the right side and a woman on the left, he made himself twofold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: From it arose the eternal king of holy places, the famed supreme region, frequented in all four ages.

verses.translation: Of all the gods, sages and celibates, Daityas, Danavas and Siddhas, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakshasas,

verses.sanskrit: नागविद्याधराणां च स्थावरस्य चरस्य च उत्तमः पुरुषो यस्मात् तस्मात् स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nāgavidyādharāṇāṃ ca sthāvarasya carasya ca uttamaḥ puruṣo yasmāt tasmāt sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Nagas and Vidyadharas, the unmoving and the moving — because he is the supreme Person, therefore he is Purushottama.

verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre nyagrodho yatra tiṣṭhati daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham
verses.translation: On the shore of the southern ocean, where the banyan tree stands, is a most rare region ten yojanas wide.

verses.transliteration: yas tu kalpe samutpanne mahadulkānibarhaṇe vināśaṃ naivam abhyeti svayaṃ tatraivam āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: When a kalpa arises with the destruction of great meteors, it does not perish, for I myself abide there thus.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टमात्रे वटे तस्मिंश् छायाम् आक्रम्य चासकृत् ब्रह्महत्यात् प्रमुच्येत पापेष्व् अन्येषु का कथा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭamātre vaṭe tasmiṃś chāyām ākramya cāsakṛt brahmahatyāt pramucyeta pāpeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā
verses.translation: By merely seeing that banyan and stepping into its shade repeatedly, one is freed from the sin of brahmin-slaying — what then of other sins?

verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇā kṛtā yais tu namaskāraś ca jantubhiḥ sarve vidhūtapāpmānas te gatāḥ keśavālayam
verses.translation: Those creatures who circumambulate it and bow to it are all freed from sin and go to the abode of Keshava.

verses.transliteration: nyagrodhasyottare kiṃcid dakṣiṇe keśavasya tu prāsādas tatra tiṣṭhet tu padaṃ dharmamayaṃ hi tat
verses.translation: A little to the north of the banyan and to the south of Keshava stands a temple there; that is a place made of dharma.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिमां तत्र वै दृष्ट्वा स्वयं देवेन निर्मिताम् अनायासेन वै यान्ति भुवनं मे ततो नराः
verses.transliteration: pratimāṃ tatra vai dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ devena nirmitām anāyāsena vai yānti bhuvanaṃ me tato narāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the image there, made by the god himself, men then go effortlessly to my world."

verses.transliteration: gacchamānāṃs tu tān prekṣya ekadā dharmarāṭ priye madantikam anuprāpya praṇamya śirasābravīt
verses.translation: Seeing them going, my dear, one day the king of dharma came near me, bowed his head and said:

verses.transliteration: namas te bhagavan deva lokanātha jagatpate kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devaṃ śeṣabhogānuśāyinam
verses.translation: "Salutation to you, O Lord, god, lord of the worlds, master of the universe, the god who dwells in the milk ocean and lies on the coils of Shesha,

verses.transliteration: varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ kartāram akṛtaṃ prabhum viśveśvaram ajaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvajñam aparājitam
verses.translation: the best, the most excellent, the giver of boons, the maker, the unmade, the Lord, master of the universe, unborn Vishnu, all-knowing and unconquered,

verses.translation: free from being and non-being, all-pervading, beyond Prakriti — I bow to the Lord of the world, the Lord who grants happiness, the Master."

verses.translation: Thus long ago the king of dharma, near the banyan, praised him with various hymns and then bowed.

verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahābhāge praṇataṃ prāñjalisthitam stotrasya kāraṇaṃ devi pṛṣṭavān aham antakam
verses.translation: Seeing him bowing with joined palms, O illustrious Goddess, I asked the Ender the reason for his hymn:

verses.transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho sarvadevottamo hy asi kimarthaṃ stutavān māṃ tvaṃ saṃkṣepāt tad bravīhi me
verses.translation: "O mighty-armed son of Vivasvan, you are foremost among all the gods; why did you praise me? Tell me that briefly."

verses.transliteration: asminn āyatane puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame indranīlamayī śreṣṭhā pratimā sārvakāmikī
verses.translation: "In this holy shrine, the famed Purushottama, there is an excellent image made of sapphire that fulfils every desire.

verses.translation: Seeing it with single-minded devotion and faith, O lotus-eyed one, even men without desires go to the abode called Shveta.

verses.transliteration: ataḥ kartuṃ na śaknomi vyāpāram arisūdana prasīda sumahādeva saṃhara pratimāṃ vibho
verses.translation: Therefore I cannot carry out my work, O slayer of foes. Be gracious, great god, and withdraw the image, O Lord."

verses.transliteration: śrutvā vaivasvatasyaitad vākyam etad uvāca ha yama tāṃ gopayiṣyāmi sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing these words of the son of Vivasvan, he said this: "Yama, I will hide it all around with sand."

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा प्रतिमा देवि वल्लिभिर् गोपिता मया यथा तत्र न पश्यन्ति मनुजाः स्वर्गकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā pratimā devi vallibhir gopitā mayā yathā tatra na paśyanti manujāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O Goddess, that image was hidden by me with creepers, so that men seeking heaven do not see it there.

verses.sanskrit: प्रच्छाद्य वल्लिकैर् देवि जातरूपपरिच्छदैः यमं प्रस्थापयाम् आस स्वां पुरीं दक्षिणां दिशम्
verses.transliteration: pracchādya vallikair devi jātarūpaparicchadaiḥ yamaṃ prasthāpayām āsa svāṃ purīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
verses.translation: Having covered it, O Goddess, with creepers and golden coverings, I sent Yama back to his own city in the southern direction.

verses.sanskrit: लुप्तायां प्रतिमायां तु इन्द्रनीलस्य भो द्विजाः तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये विख्याते पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: luptāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ tu indranīlasya bho dvijāḥ tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame
verses.translation: When the sapphire image had vanished, O brahmins, in that holy excellent region, the famed Purushottama,

verses.sanskrit: यो भूतस् तत्र वृत्तान्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः तं सर्वं कथयाम् आस स तस्यै भगवान् पुरा
verses.transliteration: yo bhūtas tatra vṛttānto devadevo janārdanaḥ taṃ sarvaṃ kathayām āsa sa tasyai bhagavān purā
verses.translation: whatever events took place there, Janardana, god of gods, the Lord, told her all of it long ago:

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य गमनं क्षेत्रसंदर्शनं तथा क्षेत्रस्य वर्णनं चैव प्रासादकरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: indradyumnasya gamanaṃ kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ tathā kṣetrasya varṇanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: the coming of Indradyumna, his seeing of the region, the description of the region, and the building of the temple,

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधस्य यजनं स्वप्नदर्शनम् एव च लवणस्योदधेस् तीरे काष्ठस्य दर्शनं तथा
verses.transliteration: hayamedhasya yajanaṃ svapnadarśanam eva ca lavaṇasyodadhes tīre kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: the performance of the horse sacrifice, the seeing of the dream, the finding of the log on the shore of the salt ocean,

verses.transliteration: darśanaṃ vāsudevasya śilpirājasya ca dvijāḥ nirmāṇaṃ pratimāyās tu yathāvarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: the appearance of Vasudeva and the king of craftsmen, O brahmins, and the fashioning of the images, each according to its colour,

verses.sanskrit: स्थापनं चैव सर्वेषां प्रासादे भुवनोत्तमे यात्राकाले च विप्रेन्द्राः कल्पसंकीर्तनं तथा
verses.transliteration: sthāpanaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ prāsāde bhuvanottame yātrākāle ca viprendrāḥ kalpasaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: the installation of all of them in the finest temple in the world, and at the time of the festival, O best of brahmins, the recounting of the kalpa,

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयस्य चरितं स्थापनं शंकरस्य च पञ्चतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं दर्शनं शूलपाणिनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyasya caritaṃ sthāpanaṃ śaṃkarasya ca pañcatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ darśanaṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ
verses.translation: the story of Markandeya and the installation of Shankara, the greatness of the Panchatirtha and the seeing of the trident-bearer,

verses.sanskrit: वटस्य दर्शनं चैव व्युष्टिं तस्य च भो द्विजाः दर्शनं बलदेवस्य कृष्णस्य च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: vaṭasya darśanaṃ caiva vyuṣṭiṃ tasya ca bho dvijāḥ darśanaṃ baladevasya kṛṣṇasya ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: the seeing of the banyan and its glory, O brahmins, and especially the seeing of Baladeva and Krishna,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुभद्रायाश् च तत्रैव माहात्म्यं चैव सर्वशः दर्शनं नरसिंहस्य व्युष्टिसंकीर्तनं तथा
verses.transliteration: subhadrāyāś ca tatraiva māhātmyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ darśanaṃ narasiṃhasya vyuṣṭisaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: and of Subhadra there and her greatness in full, the seeing of Narasimha and the recounting of his glory,

verses.transliteration: udadher darśanaṃ caiva snānaṃ tarpaṇam eva ca samudrasnānamāhātmyam indradyumnasya ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: the seeing of the ocean, bathing and libations, the greatness of bathing in the sea and of Indradyumna, O brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चतीर्थफलं चैव महाज्येष्ठं तथैव च स्थानं कृष्णस्य हलिनः पर्वयात्राफलं तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcatīrthaphalaṃ caiva mahājyeṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca sthānaṃ kṛṣṇasya halinaḥ parvayātrāphalaṃ tathā
verses.translation: the fruit of the Panchatirtha and of the Mahajyeshtha, the abode of Krishna and the plough-bearer, and the fruit of festival pilgrimages,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वर्णनं विष्णुलोकस्य क्षेत्रस्य च पुनः पुनः पूर्वं कथितवान् सर्वं तस्यै स पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: varṇanaṃ viṣṇulokasya kṣetrasya ca punaḥ punaḥ pūrvaṃ kathitavān sarvaṃ tasyai sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: the description of Vishnu's world and of the region again and again — all this Purushottama told her long ago.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे देव कथाशेषं महीपतेः तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे गत्वा किं चकार नराधिपः
verses.transliteration: śrotum icchāmahe deva kathāśeṣaṃ mahīpateḥ tasmin kṣetravare gatvā kiṃ cakāra narādhipaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, we wish to hear the rest of the story of the king. After going to that excellent holy centre what did the lord of men do?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः क्षेत्रसंदर्शनं चैव कृत्यं तस्य च भूपतेः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ caiva kṛtyaṃ tasya ca bhūpateḥ
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, I shall mention briefly the vision of the holy centre that the king had and his activities thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O leading sages, I shall mention briefly the vision of the holy centre that the king had and his activities thereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र महीपालः क्षेत्रे त्रैलोक्यविश्रुते ददर्श रमणीयानि स्थानानि सरितस् तथा
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra mahīpālaḥ kṣetre trailokyaviśrute dadarśa ramaṇīyāni sthānāni saritas tathā
verses.translation: O leading sages, these villages are full of well grown plants. They are very charming and thronged by delighted and well nourished people. They are finely dressed and bedecked in ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, these villages are full of well grown plants. They are very charming and thronged by delighted and well nourished people. They are finely dressed and bedecked in ornaments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नदी तत्र महापुण्या विन्ध्यपादविनिर्गता स्वित्त्रोपलेति विख्याता सर्वपापहरा शिवा
verses.transliteration: nadī tatra mahāpuṇyā vindhyapādavinirgatā svittropaleti vikhyātā sarvapāpaharā śivā
verses.translation: The Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are lound there engaged in their duties. They are splendid in their traits and very peaceful.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are lound there engaged in their duties. They are splendid in their traits and very peaceful.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातुल्या महास्रोता दक्षिणार्णवगामिनी महानदीति नाम्ना सा पुण्यतोया सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātulyā mahāsrotā dakṣiṇārṇavagāminī mahānadīti nāmnā sā puṇyatoyā saridvarā
verses.translation: Mah&nadl —a river celebrated in the Puranas and flowing through the region of Utkala (Orissa).

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्योदधेर् गर्भं गतावर्तातिशोभिता उभयोस् तटयोर् यस्या ग्रामाश् च नगराणि च
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadher garbhaṃ gatāvartātiśobhitā ubhayos taṭayor yasyā grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca
verses.translation: going into the womb of the southern ocean, very beautiful with its whirlpools, on both of whose banks villages and towns

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते मुनिशार्दूलाः सुसस्याः सुमनोहराः हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा वस्त्रालंकारभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante muniśārdūlāḥ susasyāḥ sumanoharāḥ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: are seen, O tigers among sages, rich in crops and very charming, crowded with happy, well-fed people adorned with clothes and ornaments.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrās tatra pṛthak pṛthak svadharmaniratāḥ śāntā dṛśyante śubhalakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras are seen there, each devoted to his own dharma, peaceful and with auspicious marks.

verses.sanskrit: ताम्बूलपूर्णवदना मालादामविभूषिताः वेदपूर्णमुखा विप्राः सषडङ्गपदक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: tāmbūlapūrṇavadanā mālādāmavibhūṣitāḥ vedapūrṇamukhā viprāḥ saṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ
verses.translation: Their mouths full of betel, adorned with garlands; the brahmins' mouths full of the Vedas with the six limbs and the pada and krama recitations,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: some devoted to the Agnihotra, some to domestic fire rites, skilled in the meaning of all scriptures, sacrificers with abundant fees.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारे राजमार्गेषु वनेषूपवनेषु च सभामण्डलहर्म्येषु देवतायतनेषु च

verses.translation: the Itihasas and Puranas, the Vedas with their limbs well recited, poetry, scriptures and stories are heard there among the great people.

verses.translation: The women dwelling in that land are proud of beauty and youth, endowed with every good mark, with broad hips,

verses.sanskrit: सरोरुहमुखाः श्यामाः शरच्चन्द्रनिभाननाः पीनोन्नतस्तनाः सर्वाः समृद्ध्या चारुदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: saroruhamukhāḥ śyāmāḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ pīnonnatastanāḥ sarvāḥ samṛddhyā cārudarśanāḥ

verses.translation: with lips like bimba fruit, lovely, with eyes reaching to their ears, fair-faced and with lovely hair, bent with grace and coquetry.

verses.transliteration: kuṭilālakasaṃyuktāḥ sīmantena virājitāḥ grīvābharaṇasaṃyuktā mālyadāmavibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: with curling locks, shining with the parting of their hair, wearing neck ornaments and adorned with garlands,

verses.transliteration: kuṇḍalai ratnasaṃyuktaiḥ karṇapūrair manoharaiḥ devayoṣitpratīkāśā dṛśyante śubhalakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: with jewelled earrings and charming ear-ornaments, like the women of the gods — women with auspicious marks are seen.

verses.translation: with the sounds of conches and kettledrums and various charming instruments; those playful women always play happily with one another.

verses.translation: Thus, skilled in many songs and instruments, the lovely women, intoxicated with love, are engaged day and night.

verses.translation: It is frequented by mendicants, Vaikhanasas, Siddhas, graduates and celibate students, and by those perfected in mantra, austerity and sacrifice.

verses.translation: Thus the king saw that supremely beautiful region: "Right here I shall worship the eternal Lord,

verses.translation: the teacher of the world, the supreme god, the supreme shore, the supreme state, Vishnu, lord of the lords of all, endless and unconquered.

verses.translation: This is that holy place of the mind, known to me as Purushottama, where the huge wish-fulfilling banyan tree stands.

verses.transliteration: pratimā cendranīlākhyā svayaṃ devena gopitā na cātra dṛśyate cānyā pratimā vaiṣṇavī śubhā
verses.translation: The sapphire image has been hidden by the god himself, and no other auspicious image of Vishnu is seen here.

verses.translation: So I shall strive so that the god, lord of the world, Vishnu of true valour, comes before my eyes.

verses.translation: With sacrifices, gifts, austerities, fire offerings, meditations, worship and fasts, I shall duly observe the supreme vow.

verses.translation: With a single mind, absorbed in him and thinking of nothing else, I shall begin the construction of a temple of Vishnu."

verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after thinking like this the king made the preliminary arrangements for the propitiation of Visnu.

verses.translation: After duly offering libation, the king Indradyumna called the heroic rulers of Kalihga, Utkala and Kosala and said:

verses.translation: After commanding them to proceed, Indradyumna spoke to the ministers and priests.

verses.translation: Thus the messengers who were commanded by the noble king went to different kings and proclaimed the words of that monarch to them.

verses.translation: On hearing the words of messengers the kings came there in a hurry accompanied by their armies.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of messengers the kings came there in a hurry accompanied by their armies.

verses.transliteration: puṣpalājākṣatair gandhaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ dadāv arghyaṃ tato rājā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: On observing that the various kings had arrived with their ministers and priests, the delighted king announced the weighty task on hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing that the various kings had arrived with their ministers and priests, the delighted king announced the weighty task on hand.

verses.transliteration: dattvaivam arghyaṃ vidhivad ānāyya sa mahīpatiḥ kaliṅgādhipatiṃ śūram utkalādhipatiṃ tathā kośalādhipatiṃ caiva tān uvāca tadā nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Let learned brahmins who have mastered the Vedas go about and find out a place worthy of being used for success¬ fully concluding the horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let learned brahmins who have mastered the Vedas go about and find out a place worthy of being used for success¬ fully concluding the horse-sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: gacchadhvaṃ sahitāḥ sarve śilārthe susamāhitāḥ gṛhītvā śilpimukhyāṃś ca śilākarmaviśāradān
verses.translation: (All round the sacrificial chamber) hundreds of palaces were built. They were beautiful and they resembled the abode of Indra. They were bedecked in gold and jewels. Excellent gems enhanced their beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: (All round the sacrificial chamber) hundreds of palaces were built. They were beautiful and they resembled the abode of Indra. They were bedecked in gold and jewels. Excellent gems enhanced their beauty.

verses.transliteration: vindhyācalaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ bahukandaraśobhitam nirūpya sarvasānūni cchedayitvā śilāḥ śubhāḥ saṃvāhyantāṃ ca śakaṭair naukābhir mā vilambatha
verses.translation: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.
verses.commentary: Sense: He got constructed many comfortable houses and residences for the Brahmins and VaiSyas who had come there from different lands.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ gantuṃ samādiśya tān nṛpān sa mahīpatiḥ punar evābravīd vākyaṃ sāmātyān sapurohitān
verses.translation: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their
verses.commentary: Sense: As those noble persons enjoyed themselves in their

verses.transliteration: gacchantu dūtāḥ sarvatra mamājñāṃ pravadantu vai yatra tiṣṭhanti rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tān suśīghragāḥ
verses.translation: Delicious foodstuffs of various kinds prepared with rice, sugarcane, barley milk and milk products were served to guests. The excellent king himself approached them and ordered for the immediate supply of things they wanted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: "With elephants, horses, chariots and foot soldiers, with ministers and family priests, come all together at the command of Indradyumna."

verses.translation: Thus instructed by that great-souled king, the messengers went and told the kings the words of that ruler.

verses.translation: Hearing the words of the messengers, all those kings came quickly, surrounded by their own armies —

verses.transliteration: ye nṛpāḥ sarvadigbhāge ye ca dakṣiṇataḥ sthitāḥ paścimāyāṃ sthitā ye ca uttarāpathasaṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: kings from every quarter, those in the south, those in the west and those in the northern lands,

verses.transliteration: pratyantavāsino ye 'pi ye ca saṃnidhivāsinaḥ pārvatīyāś ca ye kecit tathā dvīpanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: those dwelling on the borders and those dwelling near, those of the mountains and those dwelling on islands —

verses.translation: with chariots, elephants, foot soldiers, horses and abundant wealth, many arrived, O brahmins, having heard Indradyumna's command.

verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṃś caiva maharṣīṃś ca devarṣīṃś caiva tāpasān brahmacārigṛhasthāṃś ca vānaprasthān yatīṃs tathā
verses.translation: the seers, great seers, divine seers and ascetics, celibates, householders, forest-dwellers and renunciants,

verses.sanskrit: स्नातकान् ब्राह्मणांश् चान्यान् अग्निहोत्रे सदा स्थितान् आचार्योपाध्यायवरान् स्वाध्यायतपसान्वितान्
verses.transliteration: snātakān brāhmaṇāṃś cānyān agnihotre sadā sthitān ācāryopādhyāyavarān svādhyāyatapasānvitān
verses.translation: graduates and other brahmins ever engaged in the Agnihotra, excellent teachers and preceptors endowed with study and austerity,

verses.sanskrit: सदस्याञ् शास्त्रकुशलांस् तथान्यान् पावकान् बहून् दृष्ट्वा तान् नृपतिः श्रीमान् उवाच स्वं पुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: sadasyāñ śāstrakuśalāṃs tathānyān pāvakān bahūn dṛṣṭvā tān nṛpatiḥ śrīmān uvāca svaṃ purohitam
verses.translation: members of the assembly skilled in the scriptures and many other purifiers — seeing them, the glorious king said to his family priest:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रयान्तु विद्वांसो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः वाजिमेधार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं देशं पश्यन्तु यज्ञियम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prayāntu vidvāṃso brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ vājimedhārthasiddhyarthaṃ deśaṃ paśyantu yajñiyam
verses.translation: "Let the learned brahmins, masters of the Veda, go forth and find a place fit for sacrifice, to accomplish the horse sacrifice."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तः स तथा चक्रे वचनं तस्य भूपतेः हृष्टः स मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं तदा राजपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: ity uktaḥ sa tathā cakre vacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ hṛṣṭaḥ sa mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ tadā rājapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the royal priest, glad, did as the king said, together with the ministers.

verses.transliteration: tato yayau purodhāś ca prājñaḥ sthapatibhiḥ saha brāhmaṇān agrataḥ kṛtvā kuśalān yajñakarmaṇi
verses.translation: Then the wise priest went with the architects, placing in front the brahmins skilled in the rites of sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: taṃ deśaṃ dhīvaragrāmaṃ sapratoliviṭaṅkinam kārayām āsa vipro 'sau yajñavāṭaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: In that place, the fishermen's village with its lanes and towers, the brahmin had the sacrificial enclosure made according to rule,

verses.sanskrit: प्रासादशतसंबाधं मणिप्रवरशोभितम् इन्द्रसद्मनिभं रम्यं हेमरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: prāsādaśatasaṃbādhaṃ maṇipravaraśobhitam indrasadmanibhaṃ ramyaṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: crowded with hundreds of mansions, beautiful with excellent gems, delightful like Indra's palace, adorned with gold and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: स्तम्भान् कनकचित्रांश् च तोरणानि बृहन्ति च यज्ञायतनदेशेषु दत्त्वा शुद्धं च काञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: stambhān kanakacitrāṃś ca toraṇāni bṛhanti ca yajñāyatanadeśeṣu dattvā śuddhaṃ ca kāñcanam
verses.translation: Placing pillars painted with gold and great archways in the areas of the sacrificial halls, and pure gold,

verses.transliteration: antaḥpurāṇi rājñāṃ ca nānādeśanivāsinām kārayām āsa dharmātmā tatra tatra yathāvidhi
verses.translation: the righteous one had inner apartments made for the kings dwelling in various lands, here and there according to rule.

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiśyānāṃ nānādeśasamīyuṣām kārayām āsa vidhivac chālās tatrāpy anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: For the brahmins and vaishyas who had come from various lands he had many halls made there according to rule.

verses.translation: To please that king, the best of kings came, bringing many gems, and women came to the festival.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां निर्विशतां स्वेषु शिबिरेषु महात्मनाम् नदतः सागरस्येव दिविस्पृग् अभवद् ध्वनिः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nirviśatāṃ sveṣu śibireṣu mahātmanām nadataḥ sāgarasyeva divispṛg abhavad dhvaniḥ
verses.translation: As those great souls entered their own camps, a sound touching the sky arose, like the roaring of the ocean.

verses.transliteration: teṣām abhyāgatānāṃ ca sa rājā munisattamāḥ vyādideśāyatanāni śayyāś cāpy upacārataḥ
verses.translation: To those who had come, O best of sages, the king assigned dwellings and beds with due courtesy.

verses.transliteration: bhojanāni vicitrāṇi śālīkṣuyavagorasaiḥ upetya nṛpatiśreṣṭho vyādideśa svayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: The best of kings himself approached and assigned various foods of shali rice, sugarcane, barley and milk products.

verses.transliteration: tathā tasmin mahāyajñe bahavo brahmavādinaḥ ye ca dvijātipravarās tatrāsan dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Likewise, at that great sacrifice, many expounders of Brahman and the foremost of the twice-born, O best of brahmins, who were there

verses.transliteration: samājagmuḥ saśiṣyās tān pratijagrāha pārthivaḥ sarvāṃś ca tān anuyayau yāvad āvasathān iti
verses.translation: came with their disciples; the king received them and accompanied them all as far as their lodgings,

verses.transliteration: svayam eva mahātejā dambhaṃ tyaktvā nṛpottamaḥ tataḥ kṛtvā svaśilpaṃ ca śilpino 'nye ca ye tadā
verses.translation: the mighty best of kings himself, casting off pride. Then the craftsmen and others, having done their own work,

verses.transliteration: kṛtsnaṃ yajñavidhiṃ rājñe tadā tasmai nyavedayan tataḥ śrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ sarvam atandritaḥ hṛṣṭaromābhavad rājā saha mantribhir acyutaḥ
verses.translation: reported to the king the entire arrangement of the sacrifice. Hearing that all had been done, the tireless best of kings, Achyuta's devotee, thrilled with joy together with his ministers.

verses.transliteration: tasmin yajñe pravṛtte tu vāgmino hetuvādibhiḥ hetuvādān bahūn āhuḥ parasparajigīṣavaḥ
verses.translation: When that sacrifice began, eloquent debaters, desiring victory over one another, advanced many arguments.

verses.transliteration: devendrasyeva vihitaṃ rājasiṃhena bho dvijāḥ dadṛśus toraṇāny atra śātakumbhamayāni ca
verses.translation: It was arranged by that lion among kings like that of the lord of the gods, O brahmins; they saw archways made of gold,

verses.transliteration: śayyāsanavikārāṃś ca subahūn ratnasaṃcayān ghaṭapātrīkaṭāhāni kalaśān vardhamānakān
verses.translation: many kinds of beds and seats, heaps of gems, pots, vessels, cauldrons, jars and vardhamanakas.

verses.transliteration: nahi kaścid asauvarṇam apaśyad vasudhādhipaḥ yūpāṃś ca śāstrapaṭhitān dāravān hemabhūṣitān
verses.translation: No king saw anything there that was not of gold. The sacrificial posts prescribed in the scriptures, of wood adorned with gold,

verses.transliteration: upakṣiptān yathākālaṃ vidhivad bhūrivarcasaḥ sthalajā jalajā ye ca paśavaḥ kecana dvijāḥ
verses.translation: set up duly at the proper time, of great splendour; and all the animals, of land and water, O brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् एव समानीतान् अपश्यंस् तत्र ते नृपाः गाश् चैव महिषीश् चैव तथा वृद्धस्त्रियो ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: sarvān eva samānītān apaśyaṃs tatra te nṛpāḥ gāś caiva mahiṣīś caiva tathā vṛddhastriyo 'pi ca
verses.translation: the kings saw brought there — cows, buffaloes and even old women,

verses.sanskrit: औदकानि च सत्त्वानि श्वापदानि वयांसि च जरायुजाण्डजातानि स्वेदजान्य् उद्भिदानि च
verses.transliteration: audakāni ca sattvāni śvāpadāni vayāṃsi ca jarāyujāṇḍajātāni svedajāny udbhidāni ca
verses.translation: aquatic creatures, beasts of prey and birds, the womb-born, egg-born, sweat-born and sprout-born,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतान्य् उपधान्यानि भूतानि ददृशुश् च ते एवं प्रमुदितं सर्वं पशुतो धनधान्यतः
verses.transliteration: parvatāny upadhānyāni bhūtāni dadṛśuś ca te evaṃ pramuditaṃ sarvaṃ paśuto dhanadhānyataḥ
verses.translation: and beings of the mountains and grain-fields — they saw them all. Thus, seeing everything delightful in animals, wealth and grain,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञवाटं नृपा दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गताः ब्राह्मणानां विशां चैव बहुमिष्टान्नम् ऋद्धिमत्
verses.transliteration: yajñavāṭaṃ nṛpā dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumiṣṭānnam ṛddhimat
verses.translation: the kings who saw the sacrificial enclosure were filled with supreme wonder; for the brahmins and people there was much sweet food and abundance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु विप्राणां तत्र भुञ्जताम् दुन्दुभिर् मेघनिर्घोषान् मुहुर्मुहुर् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe śatasahasre tu viprāṇāṃ tatra bhuñjatām dundubhir meghanirghoṣān muhurmuhur athākarot
verses.translation: When a full hundred thousand brahmins had eaten there, a drum resounded again and again like the roar of clouds,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विननादासकृच् चापि दिवसे दिवसे गते एवं स ववृधे यज्ञस् तस्य राज्ञस् तु धीमतः
verses.transliteration: vinanādāsakṛc cāpi divase divase gate evaṃ sa vavṛdhe yajñas tasya rājñas tu dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: and it sounded repeatedly day after day. Thus the sacrifice of that wise king grew.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नस्य सुबहून् विप्रा उत्सर्गान् निर्गतोपमान् दधिकुल्याश् च ददृशुः पयसश् च ह्रदांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: annasya subahūn viprā utsargān nirgatopamān dadhikulyāś ca dadṛśuḥ payasaś ca hradāṃs tathā
verses.translation: The brahmins saw very many heaps of food like mountains, streams of curd and lakes of milk.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपो हि सकलो नानाजनपदैर् युतः द्विजाश् च तत्र दृश्यन्ते राज्ञस् तस्य महामखे
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpo hi sakalo nānājanapadair yutaḥ dvijāś ca tatra dṛśyante rājñas tasya mahāmakhe
verses.translation: The whole of Jambudvipa with its various countries, and brahmins too, were seen at that king's great sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यानि सहस्राणि पुरुषाणां ततस् ततः गृहीत्वा भाजनं जग्मुर् बहूनि द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tatra yāni sahasrāṇi puruṣāṇāṃ tatas tataḥ gṛhītvā bhājanaṃ jagmur bahūni dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: There thousands of men from here and there took vessels and went, many of them, O best of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: श्राविणश् चापि ते सर्वे सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः पर्यवेषयन् द्विजातीञ् शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: śrāviṇaś cāpi te sarve sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ paryaveṣayan dvijātīñ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: And all the attendants, wearing polished jewelled earrings, served the twice-born by hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विविधान्य् अनुपानानि पुरुषा ये ऽनुयायिनः ते वै नृपोपभोज्यानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददुः सह
verses.transliteration: vividhāny anupānāni puruṣā ye 'nuyāyinaḥ te vai nṛpopabhojyāni brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ saha
verses.translation: The men who followed gave to the brahmins various drinks and foods fit for kings.

verses.transliteration: digdeśād āgatān rājño mahāsaṃgrāmaśālinaḥ naṭanartakakādīṃś ca gītastutiviśāradān
verses.translation: the kings from all directions and lands, great in battle, actors, dancers and others skilled in song and praise.

verses.transliteration: patnyo manoramās tasya pīnonnatapayodharāḥ indīvarapalāśākṣyaḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ
verses.translation: His charming wives, with full, raised breasts, eyes like blue lotus petals and faces like the autumn moon,

verses.transliteration: kulaśīlaguṇopetāḥ sahasraikaṃ śatādhikam evaṃ tadbhūpaparamapatnīgaṇasamanvitam
verses.translation: endowed with lineage, character and virtue, numbered a thousand and one hundred. Thus, accompanied by that king's host of chief wives,

verses.sanskrit: रत्नमालाकुलं दिव्यं पताकाध्वजसेवितम् रत्नहारयुतं रम्यं चन्द्रकान्तिसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: ratnamālākulaṃ divyaṃ patākādhvajasevitam ratnahārayutaṃ ramyaṃ candrakāntisamaprabham
verses.translation: divine, full of jewelled garlands, served by banners and flags, delightful with jewelled necklaces, radiant like moonlight,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: करिणः पर्वताकारान् मदसिक्तान् महाबलान् शतशः कोटिसंघातैर् दन्तिभिर् दन्तभूषणैः

verses.translation: with mountain-like elephants, sprinkled with ichor, very mighty, in hundreds and crores, tuskers adorned with tusk-ornaments,

verses.translation: with horses swift as the wind, born in Sindhu, very beautiful, white horses with dark ears, in many crores, full of speed,

verses.translation: thus the king saw the vast array of the sacrifice's provisions. Then the king was filled with joy and, delighted, said:

verses.transliteration: ānayadhvaṃ hayaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam cārayadhvaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai rājaputrāḥ susaṃyatāḥ
verses.translation: "Bring the best horse, marked with every good sign, and let the well-disciplined princes let it roam over the earth.

verses.sanskrit: विद्वद्भिर् धर्मविद्भिश् च अत्र होमो विधीयताम् कृष्णच्छागं च महिषं कृष्णसारमृगं द्विजान्

verses.translation: Let the fire offering be performed here by the learned and those who know dharma. Bring a black goat, a buffalo and a black buck, O twice-born,

verses.transliteration: anaḍvāhaṃ ca gāś caiva sarvāṃś ca paśupālakān iṣṭayaś ca pravartantāṃ prāsādaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: and an ox, cows and all the herdsmen. Let the sacrificial rites proceed, and then the temple of Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: samyak samṛddhabhūmyaś ca viṣayāś caivam arthinām anyāni dravyajātāni manojñāni bahūni ca
verses.translation: well-endowed lands and territories for those who seek them, and many other charming kinds of goods.

verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ yācamānānāṃ nāsti hy etan na bhāṣayet tāvat pravartatāṃ yajño yāvad devaḥ purā tv iha pratyakṣaṃ mama cābhyeti yajñasyāsya samīpataḥ
verses.translation: To all who ask, let 'there is none' never be said. Let the sacrifice go on until the god himself comes before my eyes here near this sacrifice."

verses.translation: and various jewels he gave at the great sacrifice,

verses.translation: slender-waisted, with lovely hips and eyes long as lotus petals, their necks graceful with coquetry, many adorned with bracelets,

verses.translation: wearing anklets and garments of silk; one by one he gave many desirable, loving women

verses.translation: sweet fried cakes, well-cooked and tasty food; food was given again and again for the pleasure of all beings.

verses.translation: There was no end to the wealth given and being given. Seeing thus the great sacrifice, gods and Daityas with the Charanas,

verses.translation: Gandharvas and Apsarases, Siddhas, sages and lords of creatures were filled with supreme wonder at the sight of that excellent, auspicious rite.

verses.transliteration: na vopasargo na glānir nādhayo vyādhayas tathā nākālamaraṇaṃ tatra na daṃśo na grahā viṣam
verses.translation: no calamity, no weariness, no mental or bodily ailment; there was no untimely death, no biting insect, no evil planet, no poison.

verses.translation: All the people were happy and well-fed at that king's great festival; and the sages perfected by austerity and long-lived who were there

verses.transliteration: na jātaṃ tādṛśaṃ yajñaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam evaṃ sa rājā vidhivad vājimedhaṃ dvijottamāḥ kratuṃ samāpayām āsa prāsādaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā
verses.translation: said that no such sacrifice rich in wealth and grain had ever taken place. Thus, O best of brahmins, the king duly completed the horse sacrifice and likewise the temple of Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: brūhi no devadeveśa yat pṛcchāmaḥ purātanam yathā tāḥ pratimāḥ pūrvam indradyumnena nirmitāḥ
verses.translation: Paflcar&tra —a system of spiritual doctrines, by following which one attains, the position of Uparicara. O great Boar 1 just as the earth had been formerly lifted up by you by your curved fangs, from the nether worlds so also save me from the ocean of misery. O lord Krsna, these idols of yours, the bestowers of boons, have been eulogised by me. You, Baladeva and others, are stationed in separate forms.

verses.transliteration: kena caiva prakāreṇa tuṣṭas tasmai sa mādhavaḥ tat sarvaṃ vada cāsmākaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: This refers to the Boar incarnation of VisijLU. The boar entered the sea and found out the earth that had sunk. The boar lifted the earth at his tusks, came out of the ocean and set the earth firm over the water. On the way, the fierce and wicked Hiranyaksa hindered him. The Boar killed Hirayaksa and disappeared. Guardians of quarters —lokapalas. They are sometimes regarded as the guardian deities of different orders of beings, but more commonly of the four cardinal and four intermediate points of the world. They are 1 Indra, of East; 2 Agni of South-east; 3 Yama of South; 4 Surya of South¬ west; 5 Varuna of West; 6 Vayu of North-west; 7 Kubera of North; 8 liana of North-east. Others substitute Nirfti for Surya and Iiani or Pfthivi for liana. According to Dharraa-saiigraha, the Buddhists enumerate 14 lokapalas. Hara, Sankarsana and others who have been glorified as your variant forms, have been evolved for your worship. They are dependent on you, they resort to you for support.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः पुराणं वेदसंमितम् कथयामि पुरा वृत्तं प्रतिमानां च संभवम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam kathayāmi purā vṛttaṃ pratimānāṃ ca saṃbhavam
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees. O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one. You are all-pervading Consciousness by nature and you are unsullied. O lord of Devas, most excellent one among Devas, O bestower of freedom from fear on devotees, O deity with eyes like the petals of lotus, save me. I am immersed in the ocean of sexual objects.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees. O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, in fact, you have no other form separate from you. The various forms of yours are only for your worship by the devotees. O lord, how can man mention you as twofold, you who are one and only one.…
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्ते च महायज्ञे प्रासादे चैव निर्मिते चिन्ता तस्य बभूवाथ प्रतिमार्थम् अहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: pravṛtte ca mahāyajñe prāsāde caiva nirmite cintā tasya babhūvātha pratimārtham aharniśam
verses.translation: Excepting you, O lord of worlds, O husband of Lak§ml, I do not see any one in whom I can seek refuge. O slayer of Madhu, 1 be pleased. O slayer of Madhu. Madhu and Kaifabha sprang from the ears of Visnu. They were about to kill Brahma who was lying on the lotus sprin¬ ging from Visnu's navel. Visnu killed them and obtained the names: Kaitabhari and Madhusudana. O lord, I have passed through births, thousands and ten thousands of them of diverse kinds, in this world.
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, O lord of worlds, O husband of Lak§ml, I do not see any one in whom I can seek refuge. O slayer of Madhu, 1 be pleased. O slayer of Madhu. Madhu and Kaifabha sprang from the ears of Visnu.…

verses.sanskrit: न वेद्मि केन देवेशं सर्वेशं लोकपावनम् सर्गस्थित्यन्तकर्तारं पश्यामि पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: na vedmi kena deveśaṃ sarveśaṃ lokapāvanam sargasthityantakartāraṃ paśyāmi puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Separations from and union with wives, enemies, friends and kinsmen have been faced by me. Many and many kinds of fathers have been seen by me. Many miseries have been experienced by me. Many miseries have been misunderstood and enjoyed as pleasures by me. I have had cousins and kinsmen, sons and brothers, in plenty. I have lived within the belly of women that abounds in urine and floating masses of faeces. O lord, great misery has been experienced by me while staying in womb.
verses.wordMeaning: Separations from and union with wives, enemies, friends and kinsmen have been faced by me. Many and many kinds of fathers have been seen by me. Many miseries have been experienced by me. Many miseries have been misunderstood and enjoyed as pleasures by me.…

verses.sanskrit: चिन्ताविष्टस् त्व् अभूद् राजा शेते रात्रौ दिवापि न न भुङ्क्ते विविधान् भोगान् न च स्नानं प्रसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: cintāviṣṭas tv abhūd rājā śete rātrau divāpi na na bhuṅkte vividhān bhogān na ca snānaṃ prasādhanam
verses.translation: O lord, all those miseries that are usual in childhood, youth and old age have been suffered by me. The miseries at death, in the path and the abode of Yama as also the tortures in hell have been experienced by me. O lord, many times I have been the slave of glorious prosperous men. From the impoverished state I had attained the state of a lord and master.
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, all those miseries that are usual in childhood, youth and old age have been suffered by me. The miseries at death, in the path and the abode of Yama as also the tortures in hell have been experienced by me. O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: नैव वाद्येन गन्धेन गायनैर् वर्णकैर् अपि न गजैर् मदयुक्तैश् च न चानेकैर् हयान्वितैः
verses.transliteration: naiva vādyena gandhena gāyanair varṇakair api na gajair madayuktaiś ca na cānekair hayānvitaiḥ
verses.translation: Many were killed by me. I have been killed by many. I have caused death to many and my death has been caused by many. Much had been given to me by others and many times gifts have been distributed by me. A fugitive (terrified of life) attacked by grief and greed I have become senseless. Now, O lord, utterly helpless and confused, I seek refuge in you.
verses.wordMeaning: Many were killed by me. I have been killed by many. I have caused death to many and my death has been caused by many. Much had been given to me by others and many times gifts have been distributed by me.…

verses.sanskrit: नेन्द्रनीलैर् महानीलैः पद्मरागमयैर् न च सुवर्णरजताद्यैश् च वज्रस्फटिकसंयुतैः
verses.transliteration: nendranīlair mahānīlaiḥ padmarāgamayair na ca suvarṇarajatādyaiś ca vajrasphaṭikasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord, save me who have become miserable and immersed in the ocean of worldly existence. O lord of the uni¬ verse, if you consider me your devotee have pity on me. Excepting you I have no other kinsmen who may have some consideration for me. O lord, after resorting to you, my lord, I cease to have any fear from any quarter or direction. The idea often occurs in Sanskrit poetry.

verses.transliteration: bahurāgārthakāmair vā na vanyair antarikṣagaiḥ babhūva tasya nṛpater manasas tuṣṭivardhanam
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the Garuda-cmblemed deity who was eulogised thus by him became pleased with him and granted him the boon of his choice. He who worships the lord of the universe every day and eulogises him by this hymn, shall become intelligent. He shall certainly obtain liberation.
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, the Garuda-cmblemed deity who was eulogised thus by him became pleased with him and granted him the boon of his choice. He who worships the lord of the universe every day and eulogises him by this hymn, shall become intelligent.…

verses.transliteration: śailamṛddārujāteṣu praśastaṃ kiṃ mahītale viṣṇupratimāyogyaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam
verses.translation: The pure man who repeats this excellent hymn during the three Sandhyas every day shall attain virtue, wealth, love and liberation. He shall surely become a scholar. He who reads, listens to and narrates this with great concentration shall shake off his sins and obtain the divine world. It should not be imparted to an atheist, a fool, an un¬ grateful person, an arrogant or to one of wicked intellect. It should never be handed over to a knave.

verses.transliteration: etair eva trayāṇāṃ tu dayitaṃ syāt surārcitam sthāpite prītim abhyeti iti cintāparo 'bhavat
verses.translation: It should be imparted to one endowed with devotion, good qualities and good conduct, to a devotee of Visnu, to a calm person habituated to perform his duty with faith. This hymn Karunyastava (a hymn of mercy) causes destruction of sins. It bestows happiness and salvation, and grants desires. This hymn of the lord mentioned by me is the most excellent of all.

verses.transliteration: pañcarātravidhānena saṃpūjya puruṣottamam cintāviṣṭo mahīpālaḥ saṃstotum upacakrame
verses.translation: Those pure men who meditate continuously on the slayer of Mura, 1 the subtle deity, the ancient Purusa attain liberation and enter Visnu as do the butter-offering consigned to the fire of sacrifice by. reciting the Mantras. He who has devotion to the deity known as the best of all Purusas is the most blessed in the world. He is*pure. He is a The slayer of Mura: Lord Krsga slew the two powerful asuras: Mura and Naraka when he attacked Pragjyoti?a, the capital city of Naraka,

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेव नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते मोक्षकारण त्राहि मां सर्वलोकेश जन्मसंसारसागरात्
verses.transliteration: vāsudeva namas te 'stu namas te mokṣakāraṇa trāhi māṃ sarvalokeśa janmasaṃsārasāgarāt
verses.translation: At the time of going to bed his thought was—"How does Vasudeva, the lord of Devas become visible? How is that lord going to dispel my agony?

verses.sanskrit: निर्मलाम्बरसंकाश नमस् ते पुरुषोत्तम संकर्षण नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्राहि मां धरणीधर
verses.transliteration: nirmalāmbarasaṃkāśa namas te puruṣottama saṃkarṣaṇa namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ dharaṇīdhara
verses.translation: Vasudeva, the preceptor of the universe revealed himself to the sleeping king as one who held conch, discus and iron club.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasudeva, the preceptor of the universe revealed himself to the sleeping king as one who held conch, discus and iron club.

verses.transliteration: namas te hemagarbhābha namas te makaradhvaja ratikānta namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ saṃvarāntaka
verses.translation: O king, go there alone in a sportful mood. Take an axe
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, go there alone in a sportful mood. Take an axe

verses.transliteration: namas te 'ñjanasaṃkāśa namas te bhaktavatsala aniruddha namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ varado bhava
verses.translation: After saying this, Lord Visnu, the highly blessed deity, vanished from sight. On account of this vision in his dream the king was extremely surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, Lord Visnu, the highly blessed deity, vanished from sight. On account of this vision in his dream the king was extremely surprised.

verses.transliteration: namas te vibudhāvāsa namas te vibudhapriya nārāyaṇa namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam
verses.translation: The king spent that night eagerly expecting (what had been foretold). His mind dwelt on it alone. He repeated the Mantras and hymns pertaining to Visnu.

verses.transliteration: namas te balināṃ śreṣṭha namas te lāṅgalāyudha caturmukha jagaddhāma trāhi māṃ prapitāmaha
verses.translation: Neither a chariot nor a charioteer, neither an elephant nor a foot-soldier accompanied him. The highly intelligent king entered the great shore alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither a chariot nor a charioteer, neither an elephant nor a foot-soldier accompanied him. The highly intelligent king entered the great shore alone.

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते नीलमेघाभ नमस् ते त्रिदशार्चित त्राहि विष्णो जगन्नाथ मग्नं मां भवसागरे
verses.transliteration: namas te nīlameghābha namas te tridaśārcita trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha magnaṃ māṃ bhavasāgare
verses.translation: In the course of a dream I have been directed by the lord of Devas the noblest and the greatest Soul. It has thus been narrated to you two.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of a dream I have been directed by the lord of Devas the noblest and the greatest Soul. It has thus been narrated to you two.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलयानलसंकाश नमस् ते दितिजान्तक नरसिंह महावीर्य त्राहि मां दीप्तलोचन
verses.transliteration: pralayānalasaṃkāśa namas te ditijāntaka narasiṃha mahāvīrya trāhi māṃ dīptalocana
verses.translation: Viivakarmd, the architect of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viivakarmd, the architect of gods.

verses.sanskrit: यथा रसातलाद् उर्वी त्वया दंष्ट्रोद्धृता पुरा तथा महावराहस् त्वं त्राहि मां दुःखसागरात्
verses.transliteration: yathā rasātalād urvī tvayā daṃṣṭroddhṛtā purā tathā mahāvarāhas tvaṃ trāhi māṃ duḥkhasāgarāt
verses.translation: Kaustubha: —a celebrated jewel, obtained with thirteen precious things at the churning of milky ocean and suspended on the breast of Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kaustubha: —a celebrated jewel, obtained with thirteen precious things at the churning of milky ocean and suspended on the breast of Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: तवैता मूर्तयः कृष्ण वरदाः संस्तुता मया तवेमे बलदेवाद्याः पृथग्रूपेण संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tavaitā mūrtayaḥ kṛṣṇa varadāḥ saṃstutā mayā taveme baladevādyāḥ pṛthagrūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Sudariana: —The discus of lord Krsna which he received from the fire-god to fight with Indra when the latter showered rain to protect the forest Khan<Java from burning. According to another version, Visvakarma, the divine architect put the sun in a turning machine, turned him and decreased his radiance. Out of the dust of the sun, produced by this pro¬ cess, Visvakarma made the discus-weapon, the aerial chariot, Puspaka, the Trident of Siva and the Sakti (lance) of Subrahmapya. Of these weapons, the discus Sudarsana was given to Mahavisnu.
verses.wordMeaning: Sudariana: —The discus of lord Krsna which he received from the fire-god to fight with Indra when the latter showered rain to protect the forest Khan<Java from burning. According to another version, Visvakarma, the divine architect put the sun in a turning machine,…

verses.transliteration: aṅgāni tava deveśa garutmādyās tathā prabho dikpālāḥ sāyudhāś caiva keśavādyās tathācyuta
verses.translation: Ananta, the Naga chief Sesa. Balarama, the eldest brother of Srikisna is said to be part incarnation (am$avatara)of Sesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ananta, the Naga chief Sesa. Balarama, the eldest brother of Srikisna is said to be part incarnation (am$avatara)of Sesa.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये तव देवेश भेदाः प्रोक्ता मनीषिभिः ते ऽपि सर्वे जगन्नाथ प्रसन्नायतलोचन
verses.transliteration: ye cānye tava deveśa bhedāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ te 'pi sarve jagannātha prasannāyatalocana
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Visvakarma did all efficiently, instantaneously. He made the idols of auspicious traits.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Visvakarma did all efficiently, instantaneously. He made the idols of auspicious traits.

verses.sanskrit: मयार्चिताः स्तुताः सर्वे तथा यूयं नमस्कृताः प्रयच्छत वरं मह्यं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: mayārcitāḥ stutāḥ sarve tathā yūyaṃ namaskṛtāḥ prayacchata varaṃ mahyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam
verses.translation: The car-rings were of wonderful design and shone in the ears. The hands were kept on the discus and ploughshare, Krsna holding the discus and Balarama the ploughshare. The idols were approved of by the pious people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: bhedās te kīrtitā ye tu hare saṃkarṣaṇādayaḥ tava pūjārthasaṃbhūtās tatas tvayi samāśritāḥ
verses.translation: The divisions called Sankarshana and the others, O Hari, have been told; they arose for your worship and therefore rest in you.

verses.sanskrit: न भेदस् तव देवेश विद्यते परमार्थतः विविधं तव यद् रूपम् उक्तं तद् उपचारतः
verses.transliteration: na bhedas tava deveśa vidyate paramārthataḥ vividhaṃ tava yad rūpam uktaṃ tad upacārataḥ
verses.translation: In ultimate truth there is no division in you, O lord of gods; whatever various forms of yours are spoken of are figurative.

verses.transliteration: advaitaṃ tvāṃ kathaṃ dvaitaṃ vaktuṃ śaknoti mānavaḥ ekas tvaṃ hi hare vyāpī citsvabhāvo nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: How can a man speak of you, the non-dual, as dual? You alone, O Hari, are all-pervading, of the nature of consciousness, stainless.

verses.sanskrit: परमं तव यद् रूपं भावाभावविवर्जितम् निर्लेपं निर्गुणं श्रेष्ठं कूटस्थम् अचलं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: paramaṃ tava yad rūpaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kūṭastham acalaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: Your supreme form is free of being and non-being, untainted, without qualities, the best, unchanging, immovable and fixed,

verses.transliteration: sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ sattāmātravyavasthitam tad devāś ca na jānanti kathaṃ jānāmy ahaṃ prabho
verses.translation: free of all limiting adjuncts, established as pure existence; even the gods do not know it — how can I, O Lord?

verses.transliteration: aparaṃ tava yad rūpaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇimukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam
verses.translation: Your other form, clad in yellow, four-armed, holding conch, discus and mace, wearing crown and armlets,

verses.sanskrit: श्रीवत्सोरस्कसंयुक्तं वनमालाविभूषितम् तद् अर्चयन्ति विबुधा ये चान्ये तव संश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: śrīvatsoraskasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam tad arcayanti vibudhā ye cānye tava saṃśrayāḥ
verses.translation: marked with the Shrivatsa on the chest and adorned with the forest garland — that the gods worship, and others who take refuge in you.

verses.transliteration: devadeva suraśreṣṭha bhaktānām abhayaprada trāhi māṃ padmapattrākṣa magnaṃ viṣayasāgare
verses.translation: O god of gods, best of the gods, giver of fearlessness to devotees, protect me, O lotus-eyed one, sunk in the ocean of sense-objects.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यं पश्यामि लोकेश यस्याहं शरणं व्रजे त्वाम् ऋते कमलाकान्त प्रसीद मधुसूदन
verses.transliteration: nānyaṃ paśyāmi lokeśa yasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje tvām ṛte kamalākānta prasīda madhusūdana
verses.translation: I see no other, O lord of the world, in whom I can take refuge, except you, O beloved of Kamala; be gracious, O Madhusudana.

verses.sanskrit: जराव्याधिशतैर् युक्तो नानादुःखैर् निपीडितः हर्षशोकान्वितो मूढः कर्मपाशैः सुयन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: jarāvyādhiśatair yukto nānāduḥkhair nipīḍitaḥ harṣaśokānvito mūḍhaḥ karmapāśaiḥ suyantritaḥ
verses.translation: Joined with hundreds of old age and diseases, oppressed by various sorrows, deluded by joy and grief, tightly bound by the fetters of karma,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पतितो ऽहं महारौद्रे घोरे संसारसागरे विषमोदकदुष्पारे रागद्वेषझषाकुले
verses.transliteration: patito 'haṃ mahāraudre ghore saṃsārasāgare viṣamodakaduṣpāre rāgadveṣajhaṣākule
verses.translation: I have fallen into the very fierce, terrible ocean of worldly existence, hard to cross with its bitter waters, full of the fish of attraction and aversion,

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियावर्तगम्भीरे तृष्णाशोकोर्मिसंकुले निराश्रये निरालम्बे निःसारे ऽत्यन्तचञ्चले
verses.transliteration: indriyāvartagambhīre tṛṣṇāśokormisaṃkule nirāśraye nirālambe niḥsāre 'tyantacañcale
verses.translation: deep with the whirlpools of the senses, crowded with waves of craving and sorrow, without shelter, without support, without substance and exceedingly unstable.

verses.sanskrit: मायया मोहितस् तत्र भ्रमामि सुचिरं प्रभो नानाजातिसहस्रेषु जायमानः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: māyayā mohitas tatra bhramāmi suciraṃ prabho nānājātisahasreṣu jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Deluded by maya there, I have wandered a very long time, O Lord, born again and again in thousands of various species.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया जन्मान्य् अनेकानि सहस्राण्य् अयुतानि च विविधान्य् अनुभूतानि संसारे ऽस्मिञ् जनार्दन
verses.transliteration: mayā janmāny anekāni sahasrāṇy ayutāni ca vividhāny anubhūtāni saṃsāre 'smiñ janārdana
verses.translation: I have experienced many births, thousands and tens of thousands, of various kinds in this worldly existence, O Janardana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदाः साङ्गा मयाधीताः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च इतिहासपुराणानि तथा शिल्पान्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: vedāḥ sāṅgā mayādhītāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca itihāsapurāṇāni tathā śilpāny anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: I have studied the Vedas with their limbs and various scriptures, the Itihasas and Puranas and many crafts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: असंतोषाश् च संतोषाः संचयापचया व्ययाः मया प्राप्ता जगन्नाथ क्षयवृद्ध्यक्षयेतराः
verses.transliteration: asaṃtoṣāś ca saṃtoṣāḥ saṃcayāpacayā vyayāḥ mayā prāptā jagannātha kṣayavṛddhyakṣayetarāḥ
verses.translation: Discontents and contentments, gains, losses and expenses, O lord of the world, decay, growth and their opposites I have obtained.

verses.transliteration: bhāryārimitrabandhūnāṃ viyogāḥ saṃgamās tathā pitaro vividhā dṛṣṭā mātaraś ca tathā mayā
verses.translation: Separations and unions with wife, enemies, friends and kinsmen; various fathers and mothers have been seen by me.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखानि चानुभूतानि यानि सौख्यान्य् अनेकशः प्राप्ताश् च बान्धवाः पुत्रा भ्रातरो ज्ञातयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: duḥkhāni cānubhūtāni yāni saukhyāny anekaśaḥ prāptāś ca bāndhavāḥ putrā bhrātaro jñātayas tathā
verses.translation: Sorrows have been experienced, and pleasures many times; kinsmen, sons, brothers and relatives have been obtained.

verses.sanskrit: मयोषितं तथा स्त्रीणां कोष्ठे विण्मूत्रपिच्छले गर्भवासे महादुःखम् अनुभूतं तथा प्रभो
verses.transliteration: mayoṣitaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ koṣṭhe viṇmūtrapicchale garbhavāse mahāduḥkham anubhūtaṃ tathā prabho
verses.translation: I have dwelt in women's wombs slimy with excrement and urine, and experienced the great sorrow of dwelling in the womb, O Lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दुःखानि यान्य् अनेकानि बाल्ययौवनगोचरे वार्धके च हृषीकेश तानि प्राप्तानि वै मया
verses.transliteration: duḥkhāni yāny anekāni bālyayauvanagocare vārdhake ca hṛṣīkeśa tāni prāptāni vai mayā
verses.translation: The many sorrows that belong to childhood, youth and old age, O Hrishikesha, have been obtained by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरणे यानि दुःखानि यममार्गे यमालये मया तान्य् अनुभूतानि नरके यातनास् तथा
verses.transliteration: maraṇe yāni duḥkhāni yamamārge yamālaye mayā tāny anubhūtāni narake yātanās tathā
verses.translation: The sorrows at death, on Yama's road and in Yama's abode, and the torments in hell, have been experienced by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृमिकीटद्रुमाणां च हस्त्यश्वमृगपक्षिणाम् महिषोष्ट्रगवां चैव तथान्येषां वनौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: kṛmikīṭadrumāṇāṃ ca hastyaśvamṛgapakṣiṇām mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ caiva tathānyeṣāṃ vanaukasām
verses.translation: In the wombs of worms, insects and trees, elephants, horses, deer and birds, buffaloes, camels, cows and other forest-dwellers,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातीनां च सर्वेषां शूद्राणां चैव योनिषु धनिनां क्षत्रियाणां च दरिद्राणां तपस्विनाम्

verses.translation: of all the twice-born and of shudras, of the rich, of kshatriyas, of the poor and of ascetics,

verses.sanskrit: नृपाणां नृपभृत्यानां तथान्येषां च देहिनाम् गृहेषु तेषाम् उत्पन्नो देव चाहं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpabhṛtyānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ca dehinām gṛheṣu teṣām utpanno deva cāhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: of kings, of kings' servants and of other embodied beings — in their houses I have been born again and again, O god.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
