verses.sanskrit: गतो ऽस्मि दासतां नाथ भृत्यानां बहुशो नृणाम् दरिद्रत्वं चेश्वरत्वं स्वामित्वं च तथा गतः
verses.transliteration: gato 'smi dāsatāṃ nātha bhṛtyānāṃ bahuśo nṛṇām daridratvaṃ ceśvaratvaṃ svāmitvaṃ ca tathā gataḥ
verses.translation: I have often gone into servitude to the servants of men, O Lord; I have gone to poverty, to lordship and to mastership.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हतो मया हताश् चान्ये घातितो घातितास् तथा दत्तं ममान्यैर् अन्येभ्यो मया दत्तम् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: hato mayā hatāś cānye ghātito ghātitās tathā dattaṃ mamānyair anyebhyo mayā dattam anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: I have been killed and I have killed others; I have been slain and others slain; others have given to me, and I have given to others many times.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृमातृसुहृद्भ्रातृकलत्राणां कृतेन च धनिनां श्रोत्रियाणां च दरिद्राणां तपस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛmātṛsuhṛdbhrātṛkalatrāṇāṃ kṛtena ca dhanināṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ tapasvinām
verses.translation: For the sake of father, mother, friends, brothers and wife, to the rich, the learned, the poor and the ascetics,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उक्तं दैन्यं च विविधं त्यक्त्वा लज्जां जनार्दन देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्येषु स्थावरेषु चरेषु च
verses.transliteration: uktaṃ dainyaṃ ca vividhaṃ tyaktvā lajjāṃ janārdana devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca
verses.translation: I have spoken words of wretchedness of many kinds, abandoning shame, O Janardana. Among gods, animals and men, the unmoving and the moving,

verses.transliteration: na vidyate tathā sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ na gataḥ prabho kadā me narake vāsaḥ kadā svarge jagatpate
verses.translation: there is no place where I have not gone, O Lord. Now I dwell in hell, now in heaven, O lord of the world,

verses.sanskrit: कदा मनुष्यलोकेषु कदा तिर्यग्गतेषु च जलयन्त्रे यथा चक्रे घटी रज्जुनिबन्धना
verses.transliteration: kadā manuṣyalokeṣu kadā tiryaggateṣu ca jalayantre yathā cakre ghaṭī rajjunibandhanā
verses.translation: now in the worlds of men, now among animals. As a pot bound by a rope on the wheel of a water-lift

verses.transliteration: yāti cordhvam adhaś caiva kadā madhye ca tiṣṭhati tathā cāhaṃ suraśreṣṭha karmarajjusamāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: goes up and down and sometimes stays in the middle, so I, O best of gods, covered by the rope of karma,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: adhaś cordhvaṃ tathā madhye bhraman gacchāmi yogataḥ evaṃ saṃsāracakre 'smin bhairave romaharṣaṇe
verses.translation: wander down, up and in the middle as it happens. Thus in this terrible, hair-raising wheel of worldly existence

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमामि सुचिरं कालं नान्तं पश्यामि कर्हिचित् न जाने किं करोम्य् अद्य हरे व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: bhramāmi suciraṃ kālaṃ nāntaṃ paśyāmi karhicit na jāne kiṃ karomy adya hare vyākulitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: I have wandered a very long time and never see an end. I do not know what to do today, O Hari, my senses in confusion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शोकतृष्णाभिभूतो ऽहं कांदिशीको विचेतनः इदानीं त्वाम् अहं देव विह्वलः शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: śokatṛṣṇābhibhūto 'haṃ kāṃdiśīko vicetanaḥ idānīṃ tvām ahaṃ deva vihvalaḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Overcome by grief and craving, bewildered and senseless, I now, O god, in distress, have come to you for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्राहि मां दुःखितं कृष्ण मग्नं संसारसागरे कृपां कुरु जगन्नाथ भक्तं मां यदि मन्यसे
verses.transliteration: trāhi māṃ duḥkhitaṃ kṛṣṇa magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare kṛpāṃ kuru jagannātha bhaktaṃ māṃ yadi manyase
verses.translation: Save me, O Krishna, sorrowful and sunk in the ocean of worldly existence; show compassion, O lord of the world, if you regard me as your devotee.

verses.transliteration: tvadṛte nāsti me bandhur yo 'sau cintāṃ kariṣyati deva tvāṃ nātham āsādya na bhayaṃ me 'sti kutracit
verses.translation: Apart from you I have no kinsman who will care for me; having found you as my lord, O god, I have no fear anywhere,

verses.sanskrit: जीविते मरणे चैव योगक्षेमे ऽथवा प्रभो ये तु त्वां विधिवद् देव नार्चयन्ति नराधमाः
verses.transliteration: jīvite maraṇe caiva yogakṣeme 'thavā prabho ye tu tvāṃ vidhivad deva nārcayanti narādhamāḥ
verses.translation: in life or in death, in acquiring or keeping, O Lord. But those vilest of men who do not duly worship you, O god —

verses.sanskrit: सुगतिस् तु कथं तेषां भवेत् संसारबन्धनात् किं तेषां कुलशीलेन विद्यया जीवितेन च
verses.transliteration: sugatis tu kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhavet saṃsārabandhanāt kiṃ teṣāṃ kulaśīlena vidyayā jīvitena ca
verses.translation: how can there be a good destiny for them, bound by worldly existence? What use to them is family, character, learning or life,

verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ na jāyate bhaktir jagaddhātari keśave prakṛtiṃ tv āsurīṃ prāpya ye tvāṃ nindanti mohitāḥ
verses.translation: if devotion does not arise in them for Keshava, the sustainer of the world? Those who, having taken on a demonic nature, revile you in delusion,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पतन्ति नरके घोरे जायमानाः पुनः पुनः न तेषां निष्कृतिस् तस्माद् विद्यते नरकार्णवात्
verses.transliteration: patanti narake ghore jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ na teṣāṃ niṣkṛtis tasmād vidyate narakārṇavāt
verses.translation: fall into terrible hell, born again and again; there is no deliverance for them from that ocean of hell —

verses.transliteration: ye dūṣayanti durvṛttās tvāṃ deva puruṣādhamāḥ yatra yatra bhavej janma mama karmanibandhanāt
verses.translation: those evil, vile men who defame you, O god. Wherever I may be born through the bondage of my karma,

verses.transliteration: tatra tatra hare bhaktis tvayi cāstu dṛḍhā sadā ārādhya tvāṃ surā daityā narāś cānye 'pi saṃyatāḥ
verses.translation: there, O Hari, may my devotion to you always be firm. Having worshipped you, gods, Daityas, men and others who are self-controlled

verses.transliteration: avāpuḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kas tvāṃ deva na pūjayet na śaknuvanti brahmādyāḥ stotuṃ tvāṃ tridaśā hare
verses.translation: have attained the supreme perfection — who would not worship you, O god? Brahma and the gods cannot praise you, O Hari;

verses.transliteration: kathaṃ mānuṣabuddhyāhaṃ staumi tvāṃ prakṛteḥ param tathā cājñānabhāvena saṃstuto 'si mayā prabho
verses.translation: how can I, with a human mind, praise you who are beyond Prakriti? You have been praised by me in ignorance, O Lord;

verses.sanskrit: तत् क्षमस्वापराधं मे यदि ते ऽस्ति दया मयि कृतापराधे ऽपि हरे क्षमां कुर्वन्ति साधवः
verses.transliteration: tat kṣamasvāparādhaṃ me yadi te 'sti dayā mayi kṛtāparādhe 'pi hare kṣamāṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ
verses.translation: so forgive my offence, if you have compassion for me; the good forgive even one who has offended, O Hari.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् प्रसीद देवेश भक्तस्नेहं समाश्रितः स्तुतो ऽसि यन् मया देव भक्तिभावेन चेतसा साङ्गं भवतु तत् सर्वं वासुदेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tasmāt prasīda deveśa bhaktasnehaṃ samāśritaḥ stuto 'si yan mayā deva bhaktibhāvena cetasā sāṅgaṃ bhavatu tat sarvaṃ vāsudeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Therefore be gracious, O lord of the gods, resting in your love for devotees. Whatever praise I have offered you, O god, with a devoted heart, may it all be complete — salutation to you, Vasudeva.

verses.transliteration: itthaṃ stutas tadā tena prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ dadau tasmai muniśreṣṭhāḥ sakalaṃ manasepsitam
verses.translation: Praised thus by him, the Garuda-bannered god, pleased, granted him, O best of sages, all that his mind desired.

verses.sanskrit: यः संपूज्य जगन्नाथं प्रत्यहं स्तौति मानवः स्तोत्रेणानेन मतिमान् स मोक्षं लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ saṃpūjya jagannāthaṃ pratyahaṃ stauti mānavaḥ stotreṇānena matimān sa mokṣaṃ labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: The wise man who worships the lord of the world and praises him daily with this hymn surely attains liberation.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिसंध्यं यो जपेद् विद्वान् इदं स्तोत्रवरं शुचिः धर्मं चार्थं च कामं च मोक्षं च लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: trisaṃdhyaṃ yo japed vidvān idaṃ stotravaraṃ śuciḥ dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥ
verses.translation: The learned man who, pure, recites this excellent hymn at the three junctions of the day obtains dharma, wealth, desire and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच् छृणुयाद् वापि श्रावयेद् वा समाहितः स लोकं शाश्वतं विष्णोर् याति निर्धूतकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi śrāvayed vā samāhitaḥ sa lokaṃ śāśvataṃ viṣṇor yāti nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: Whoever reads it, hears it or recites it to others with a composed mind goes, his impurities shaken off, to the eternal world of Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: dhanyaṃ pāpaharaṃ cedaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śivam guhyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ puṇyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit
verses.translation: This is blessed, removes sin, grants enjoyment and liberation, and is auspicious; it is secret, very rare and holy, and should not be given to just anyone —

verses.sanskrit: न नास्तिकाय मूर्खाय न कृतघ्नाय मानिने न दुष्टमतये दद्यान् नाभक्ताय कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na nāstikāya mūrkhāya na kṛtaghnāya mānine na duṣṭamataye dadyān nābhaktāya kadācana
verses.translation: not to an atheist, a fool, an ungrateful or proud man, not to the evil-minded, and never to one without devotion.

verses.transliteration: dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya guṇaśīlānvitāya ca viṣṇubhaktāya śāntāya śraddhānuṣṭhānaśāline
verses.translation: It should be given to one filled with devotion, endowed with virtue and good character, a devotee of Vishnu, tranquil, and rich in faith and practice.

verses.transliteration: idaṃ samastāghavināśahetuḥ kāruṇyasaṃjñaṃ sukhamokṣadaṃ ca aśeṣavāñchāphaladaṃ variṣṭhaṃ stotraṃ mayoktaṃ puruṣottamasya
verses.translation: This excellent hymn to Purushottama, called Karunya, which I have told, is the cause of the destruction of all sins, grants happiness and liberation, and yields the fruit of every wish.

verses.sanskrit: ये तं सुसूक्ष्मं विमला मुरारिं ध्यायन्ति नित्यं पुरुषं पुराणम् ते मुक्तिभाजः प्रविशन्ति विष्णुं मन्त्रैर् यथाज्यं हुतम् अध्वराग्नौ
verses.transliteration: ye taṃ susūkṣmaṃ vimalā murāriṃ dhyāyanti nityaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam te muktibhājaḥ praviśanti viṣṇuṃ mantrair yathājyaṃ hutam adhvarāgnau
verses.translation: Those pure ones who always meditate on Murari, that very subtle, ancient Person, become partakers of liberation and enter Vishnu, as ghee offered with mantras enters the sacrificial fire.

verses.sanskrit: एकः स देवो भवदुःखहन्ता परः परेषां न ततो ऽस्ति चान्यत् द्रष्टा स पाता स तु नाशकर्ता विष्णुः समस्ताखिलसारभूतः
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ sa devo bhavaduḥkhahantā paraḥ pareṣāṃ na tato 'sti cānyat draṣṭā sa pātā sa tu nāśakartā viṣṇuḥ samastākhilasārabhūtaḥ
verses.translation: He alone is the god who destroys the sorrow of existence, higher than the highest; there is nothing other than him. He is the seer, the protector and the destroyer — Vishnu, the essence of all that exists.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं विद्यया किं स्वगुणैश् च तेषां यज्ञैश् च दानैश् च तपोभिर् उग्रैः येषां न भक्तिर् भवतीह कृष्णे जगद्गुरौ मोक्षसुखप्रदे च
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vidyayā kiṃ svaguṇaiś ca teṣāṃ yajñaiś ca dānaiś ca tapobhir ugraiḥ yeṣāṃ na bhaktir bhavatīha kṛṣṇe jagadgurau mokṣasukhaprade ca
verses.translation: What use is learning, or their own virtues, sacrifices, gifts and fierce austerities, for those who have no devotion here to Krishna, the teacher of the world, giver of the bliss of liberation?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोके स धन्यः स शुचिः स विद्वान् मखैस् तपोभिः स गुणैर् वरिष्ठः ज्ञाता स दाता स तु सत्यवक्ता यस्यास्ति भक्तिः पुरुषोत्तमाख्ये
verses.transliteration: loke sa dhanyaḥ sa śuciḥ sa vidvān makhais tapobhiḥ sa guṇair variṣṭhaḥ jñātā sa dātā sa tu satyavaktā yasyāsti bhaktiḥ puruṣottamākhye
verses.translation: In the world he is blessed, he is pure, he is learned, he is foremost in sacrifices, austerities and virtues; he is the knower, the giver, the speaker of truth — he who has devotion to the one called Purushottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वैवं मुनिशार्दूलाः प्रणम्य च सनातनम् वासुदेवं जगन्नाथं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: stutvaivaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ praṇamya ca sanātanam vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: The deity whom the Yogins call Vasudeva can be com¬ prehended only through perfect knowledge. It is mentioned in all scriptures. The lord is mentioned (as Brahma) in Vedanta texts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चिन्ताविष्टो महीपालः कुशान् आस्तीर्य भूतले वस्त्रं च तन्मना भूत्वा सुष्वाप धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: cintāviṣṭo mahīpālaḥ kuśān āstīrya bhūtale vastraṃ ca tanmanā bhūtvā suṣvāpa dharaṇītale
verses.translation: I am Brahma, Visnu and Siva. I am Indra, the king of Devas. I am Yama who restrains the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am Brahma, Visnu and Siva. I am Indra, the king of Devas. I am Yama who restrains the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कथं प्रत्यक्षम् अभ्येति देवदेवो जनार्दनः मम चार्तिहरो देवस् तदासाव् इति चिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ pratyakṣam abhyeti devadevo janārdanaḥ mama cārtiharo devas tadāsāv iti cintayan
verses.translation: I am the earth and other elements. I am the three¬ fold sacrificial fire. 1 O king, I am also the firegod swallowing what is consigned into him. I am Varuna, lord of Waters. I am earth and the supporter of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the earth and other elements. I am the three¬ fold sacrificial fire. 1 O king, I am also the firegod swallowing what is consigned into him. I am Varuna, lord of Waters. I am earth and the supporter of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्तस्य तस्य नृपतेर् वासुदेवो जगद्गुरुः आत्मानं दर्शयाम् आस शङ्खचक्रगदाभृतम्
verses.transliteration: suptasya tasya nṛpater vāsudevo jagadguruḥ ātmānaṃ darśayām āsa śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtam
verses.translation: Three fires —Garhapatya, Ahavaniya and Daksina.
verses.commentary: Sense: Three fires —Garhapatya, Ahavaniya and Daksina.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श तु सप्रेम देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम् शङ्खचक्रधरं देवं गदाचक्रोग्रपाणिनम्
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa tu saprema devadevaṃ jagadgurum śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ gadācakrograpāṇinam
verses.translation: O excellent king of good holy rites! I am pleased with you. Choose any boon that you wish. Whatever is desired by you, whatever is cherished in the heart by you, I shall give you immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king of good holy rites! I am pleased with you. Choose any boon that you wish. Whatever is desired by you, whatever is cherished in the heart by you, I shall give you immediately.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शार्ङ्गबाणधरं देवं ज्वलत्तेजोतिमण्डलम् युगान्तादित्यवर्णाभं नीलवैदूर्यसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: śārṅgabāṇadharaṃ devaṃ jvalattejotimaṇḍalam yugāntādityavarṇābhaṃ nīlavaidūryasaṃnibham
verses.translation: Persons without merit do not have my vision even in a dream. Due to your steadfast devotion you have seen me directly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons without merit do not have my vision even in a dream. Due to your steadfast devotion you have seen me directly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णांसे तम् आसीनं षोडशार्धभुजं शुभम् स चास्मै प्राब्रवीद् धीराः साधु राजन् महामते
verses.transliteration: suparṇāṃse tam āsīnaṃ ṣoḍaśārdhabhujaṃ śubham sa cāsmai prābravīd dhīrāḥ sādhu rājan mahāmate
verses.translation: O brahmins, on hearing these words of Vasudeva the king experienced horripilation all over his body and he recited the following prayer:
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on hearing these words of Vasudeva the king experienced horripilation all over his body and he recited the following prayer:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुनानेन दिव्येन तथा भक्त्या च श्रद्धया तुष्टो ऽस्मि ते महीपाल वृथा किम् अनुशोचसि
verses.transliteration: kratunānena divyena tathā bhaktyā ca śraddhayā tuṣṭo 'smi te mahīpāla vṛthā kim anuśocasi
verses.translation: After eulogising thus, he bowed to the lord with palms joined m reverence. After bowing down and falling down on the ground he said.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising thus, he bowed to the lord with palms joined m reverence. After bowing down and falling down on the ground he said.

verses.sanskrit: यद् अत्र प्रतिमा राजञ् जगत्पूज्या सनातनी यथा सा प्राप्यते भूप तदुपायं ब्रवीमि ते
verses.transliteration: yad atra pratimā rājañ jagatpūjyā sanātanī yathā sā prāpyate bhūpa tadupāyaṃ bravīmi te
verses.translation: May everything be to your welfare. Obtain everything desired by you. Everything will happen as you wish by my favour. There is no doubt about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: May everything be to your welfare. Obtain everything desired by you. Everything will happen as you wish by my favour. There is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit: गतायाम् अद्य शर्वर्यां निर्मले भास्करोदिते सागरस्य जलस्यान्ते नानाद्रुमविभूषिते
verses.transliteration: gatāyām adya śarvaryāṃ nirmale bhāskarodite sāgarasya jalasyānte nānādrumavibhūṣite
verses.translation: O excellent king, rule over the great kingdom conti¬ nuously for ten thousand nine hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent king, rule over the great kingdom conti¬ nuously for ten thousand nine hundred years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जलं तथैव वेलायां दृश्यते तत्र वै महत् लवणस्योदधे राजंस् तरङ्गैः समभिप्लुतम्
verses.transliteration: jalaṃ tathaiva velāyāṃ dṛśyate tatra vai mahat lavaṇasyodadhe rājaṃs taraṅgaiḥ samabhiplutam
verses.translation: This sacred water-reservoir named Indradyumna- saras is born as a part of sacrifice. By taking bath in it even for once, people attain the world of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sacred water-reservoir named Indradyumna- saras is born as a part of sacrifice. By taking bath in it even for once, people attain the world of Indra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कूलान्ते हि महावृक्षः स्थितः स्थलजलेषु च वेलाभिर् हन्यमानश् च न चासौ कम्पते द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: kūlānte hi mahāvṛkṣaḥ sthitaḥ sthalajaleṣu ca velābhir hanyamānaś ca na cāsau kampate drumaḥ
verses.translation: He who offers rice balls on the splendid bank of the lake shall redeem twentyone generations and go to the world of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who offers rice balls on the splendid bank of the lake shall redeem twentyone generations and go to the world of Indra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: परशुम् आदाय हस्तेन ऊर्मेर् अन्तस् ततो व्रज एकाकी विहरन् राजन् स त्वं पश्यसि पादपम्
verses.transliteration: paraśum ādāya hastena ūrmer antas tato vraja ekākī viharan rājan sa tvaṃ paśyasi pādapam
verses.translation: He will go there in aerial chariot honoured by celes¬ tial damsels and the divine musicians singing in loud voice. He shall stay therefor the duration of fourteen Indras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will go there in aerial chariot honoured by celes¬ tial damsels and the divine musicians singing in loud voice. He shall stay therefor the duration of fourteen Indras.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृक् चिह्नं समालोक्य छेदय त्वम् अशङ्कितः छेद्यमानं तु तं वृक्षं प्रातर् अद्भुतदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: īdṛk cihnaṃ samālokya chedaya tvam aśaṅkitaḥ chedyamānaṃ tu taṃ vṛkṣaṃ prātar adbhutadarśanam
verses.translation: By eulogising, visiting and devoutly bowing to the idols men shall stay in the prosperous city of Hari for ten thousand years in accordance with the divine reckoning.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तेनैव संचिन्त्य ततो भूपाल दर्शनात् कुरु तां प्रतिमां दिव्यां जहि चिन्तां विमोहिनीम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tenaiva saṃcintya tato bhūpāla darśanāt kuru tāṃ pratimāṃ divyāṃ jahi cintāṃ vimohinīm
verses.translation: "Having seen it and reflected with it, then, O king, by that sight make that divine image; cast off your bewildering anxiety."

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महाभागो जगामादर्शनं हरिः स चापि स्वप्नम् आलोक्य परं विस्मयम् आगतः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā mahābhāgo jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ sa cāpi svapnam ālokya paraṃ vismayam āgataḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, the illustrious Hari vanished; and he, having seen the dream, was filled with great wonder.

verses.sanskrit: तां निशां स समुद्वीक्ष्य स्थितस् तद्गतमानसः व्याहरन् वैष्णवान् मन्त्रान् सूक्तं चैव तदात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ niśāṃ sa samudvīkṣya sthitas tadgatamānasaḥ vyāharan vaiṣṇavān mantrān sūktaṃ caiva tadātmakam
verses.translation: He stayed awake through that night, his mind absorbed in him, reciting the mantras of Vishnu and the hymn whose essence is him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगतायां रजन्यां तु उत्थितो नान्यमानसः स स्नात्वा सागरे सम्यग् यथावद् विधिना ततः
verses.transliteration: pragatāyāṃ rajanyāṃ tu utthito nānyamānasaḥ sa snātvā sāgare samyag yathāvad vidhinā tataḥ
verses.translation: When the night had passed he rose, thinking of nothing else, and bathed properly in the ocean according to rule.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानं च विप्रेभ्यो ग्रामांश् च नगराणि च कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं कर्म जगाम स नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo grāmāṃś ca nagarāṇi ca kṛtvā paurvāhṇikaṃ karma jagāma sa nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: Having given gifts to brahmins, villages and towns, and performed his morning rites, that best of kings went forth.

verses.sanskrit: न चाश्वो न पदातिश् च न गजो न च सारथिः एकाकी स महावेलां प्रविवेश महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: na cāśvo na padātiś ca na gajo na ca sārathiḥ ekākī sa mahāvelāṃ praviveśa mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: With no horse, no foot soldier, no elephant and no charioteer, the king entered the great shore alone.

verses.sanskrit: तं ददर्श महावृक्षं तेजस्वन्तं महाद्रुमम् महातिगमहारोहं पुण्यं विपुलम् एव च
verses.transliteration: taṃ dadarśa mahāvṛkṣaṃ tejasvantaṃ mahādrumam mahātigamahārohaṃ puṇyaṃ vipulam eva ca
verses.translation: He saw that great tree, radiant, a mighty tree, very tall and high, holy and vast,

verses.translation: The friend of Indra was about to split it in two; as he examined the wood, a wondrous sight appeared.

verses.translation: Seeing those two brahmins there, like the moon and sun come down, he bowed to the two lords of the world and stood with downcast face.

verses.translation: "I intend to make an image in order to worship the god of gods, without beginning or end, endless, lord of the worlds.

verses.translation: like a rain-cloud, devoted to the welfare of cows and brahmins, protector of all, all-pervading, sustainer of all beings.

verses.translation: I bow to the god bearing conch and discus, mace and pestle, the boon-giving god with the lustre of a blue lotus petal.

verses.translation: I bow to Hrishikesha, lying on the serpent couch in the milk ocean, Hari who removes all sins.

verses.translation: Again I bow to you, lord of the gods, boon-giving and all-pervading, lord of all worlds, Vishnu, imperishable cause of liberation."

verses.translation: Having thus praised that god and bowed with joined palms, he prostrated himself on the ground and, bowing, said:

verses.translation: that state, without qualities, pure and tranquil, which the wise behold — I wish to reach it by your grace, though it is very hard to attain."

verses.translation: "May all be well with you; may you obtain everything you desire. It will be as you wish by my grace; there is no doubt.

verses.translation: For ten thousand nine hundred years, O best of kings, rule your great kingdom without interruption.

verses.sanskrit: परात् परतरं सूक्ष्मं निर्लेपं निष्कलं ध्रुवम् चिन्ताशोकविनिर्मुक्तं क्रियाकारणवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: parāt parataraṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirlepaṃ niṣkalaṃ dhruvam cintāśokavinirmuktaṃ kriyākāraṇavarjitam
verses.translation: higher than the highest, subtle, untainted, partless and fixed, free from anxiety and grief, devoid of action and cause.

verses.sanskrit: तद् अहं दर्शयिष्यामि ज्ञेयाख्यं परमं पदम् यं प्राप्य परमानन्दं प्राप्स्यसि परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tad ahaṃ darśayiṣyāmi jñeyākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam yaṃ prāpya paramānandaṃ prāpsyasi paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: I will show you that supreme state called the knowable; attaining it you will reach supreme bliss and the highest goal.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तिश् च तव राजेन्द्र भवत्य् अत्र महीतले यावद् घना नभो यावद् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: kīrtiś ca tava rājendra bhavaty atra mahītale yāvad ghanā nabho yāvad yāvac candrārkatārakam
verses.translation: And your fame, O king of kings, will last here on earth as long as there are clouds and sky, as long as moon, sun and stars,

verses.sanskrit: यावत् समुद्राः सप्तैव यावन् मेर्वादिपर्वताः तिष्ठन्ति दिवि देवाश् च तावत् सर्वत्र चाव्यया
verses.transliteration: yāvat samudrāḥ saptaiva yāvan mervādiparvatāḥ tiṣṭhanti divi devāś ca tāvat sarvatra cāvyayā
verses.translation: as long as the seven oceans and the mountains beginning with Meru remain and the gods dwell in heaven — so long, everywhere, imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नसरो नाम तीर्थं यज्ञाङ्गसंभवम् यत्र स्नात्वा सकृल् लोकः शक्रलोकम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: indradyumnasaro nāma tīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam yatra snātvā sakṛl lokaḥ śakralokam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The holy place named Indradyumna Lake, born from the parts of the sacrifice — bathing there even once, people attain the world of Shakra.

verses.sanskrit: दापयिष्यति यः पिण्डांस् तटे ऽस्मिन् सरसः शुभे कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य शक्रलोकं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: dāpayiṣyati yaḥ piṇḍāṃs taṭe 'smin sarasaḥ śubhe kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya śakralokaṃ gamiṣyati
verses.translation: Whoever has rice-balls offered on the bank of this auspicious lake will raise twenty-one generations of his family and go to the world of Shakra,

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यमानो ऽप्सरोभिश् च गन्धर्वैर् गीतनिस्वनैः विमानेन वसेत् तत्र यावद् इन्द्राश् चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: pūjyamāno 'psarobhiś ca gandharvair gītanisvanaiḥ vimānena vaset tatra yāvad indrāś caturdaśa
verses.translation: honoured by Apsarases and by Gandharvas with the sound of song, dwelling there in a celestial car for the reigns of fourteen Indras.

verses.sanskrit: सरसो दक्षिणे भागे नैरृत्यां तु समाश्रिते न्यग्रोधस् तिष्ठते तत्र तत्समीपे तु मण्डपः
verses.transliteration: saraso dakṣiṇe bhāge nairṛtyāṃ tu samāśrite nyagrodhas tiṣṭhate tatra tatsamīpe tu maṇḍapaḥ
verses.translation: In the southern part of the lake, toward the south-west, stands a banyan, and near it a pavilion,

verses.transliteration: ketakīvanasaṃchanno nānāpādapasaṃkulaḥ nārikelair asaṃkhyeyaiś campakair bakulāvṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: covered with ketaki groves and full of various trees, with countless coconuts, champakas surrounded by bakulas,

verses.transliteration: aśokaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca puṃnāgair nāgakesaraiḥ pāṭalāmrātasaralaiś candanair devadārubhiḥ
verses.translation: ashokas, karnikaras, punnagas, nagakesaras, patalas, amratakas, saralas, sandal and devadarus,

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थखदिरैः पारिजातैः सहार्जुनैः हिन्तालैश् चैव तालैश् च शिंशपैर् बदरैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: nyagrodhāśvatthakhadiraiḥ pārijātaiḥ sahārjunaiḥ hintālaiś caiva tālaiś ca śiṃśapair badarais tathā
verses.translation: banyans, ashvatthas, khadiras, parijatas and arjunas, hintalas, palmyras, shimshapas and badaras,

verses.transliteration: āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ pitṛdaivate ṛkṣe neṣyanti nas tatra nītvā sapta dināni vai
verses.translation: In the bright fortnight of Ashadha, on the fifth day, under the asterism of the ancestors, they will bring us there and for seven days

verses.transliteration: maṇḍape sthāpayiṣyanti suveśyābhiḥ suśobhanaiḥ krīḍāviśeṣabahulair nṛtyagītamanoharaiḥ
verses.translation: will install us in the pavilion with beautiful courtesans, charming with dance and song and rich in special entertainments.

verses.transliteration: cāmaraiḥ svarṇadaṇḍaiś ca vyajanai ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ vījayantas tathāsmabhyaṃ sthāpayiṣyanti maṅgalāḥ
verses.translation: Fanning us with chowries with golden handles and fans adorned with jewels, auspicious women will install us.

verses.transliteration: brahmacārī yatiś caiva snātakāś ca dvijottamāḥ vānaprasthā gṛhasthāś ca siddhāś cānye ca brāhmaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Celibate students, ascetics, graduates, the best of brahmins, forest-dwellers, householders, Siddhas and other brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: नानावर्णपदैः स्तोत्रैर् ऋग्यजुःसामनिस्वनैः करिष्यन्ति स्तुतिं राजन् रामकेशवयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nānāvarṇapadaiḥ stotrair ṛgyajuḥsāmanisvanaiḥ kariṣyanti stutiṃ rājan rāmakeśavayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: with hymns of various words and letters, and the sounds of Rig, Yajus and Saman, will praise Rama and Keshava again, O king.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ stutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca saṃpraṇamya ca bhaktitaḥ naro varṣāyutaṃ divyaṃ śrīmaddharipure vaset
verses.translation: Then, having praised, seen and bowed with devotion, a man will dwell for ten thousand divine years in the glorious city of Hari,

verses.transliteration: pūjyamāno 'psarobhiś ca gandharvair gītanisvanaiḥ harer anucaras tatra krīḍate keśavena vai
verses.translation: honoured by Apsarases and by Gandharvas with the sound of song; as Hari's attendant he sports there with Keshava,

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन रत्नहारेण भ्राजता सर्वकामैर् महाभोगैस् तिष्ठते भुवनोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena ratnahāreṇa bhrājatā sarvakāmair mahābhogais tiṣṭhate bhuvanottame
verses.translation: in a celestial car coloured like the sun, shining with jewelled necklaces, with all desires and great enjoyments he stays in the best of worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तपःक्षयादिहागत्य मनुष्यो ब्राह्मणो भवेत् कोटीधनपतिः श्रीमांश् चतुर्वेदी भवेद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: tapaḥkṣayādihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet koṭīdhanapatiḥ śrīmāṃś caturvedī bhaved dhruvam
verses.translation: When his austerity is exhausted, coming here, he becomes a brahmin, lord of crores of wealth, glorious, surely a knower of the four Vedas."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā kṛtvā ca samayaṃ hariḥ jagāmādarśanaṃ viprāḥ sahito viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: Having thus given him the boon and made the covenant, Hari vanished, O brahmins, together with Vishvakarman.

verses.sanskrit: स तु राजा तदा हृष्टो रोमाञ्चिततनूरुहः कृतकृत्यम् इवात्मानं मेने संदर्शनाद् धरेः
verses.transliteration: sa tu rājā tadā hṛṣṭo romāñcitatanūruhaḥ kṛtakṛtyam ivātmānaṃ mene saṃdarśanād dhareḥ
verses.translation: The king, then delighted, his hair standing on end, felt that he had fulfilled his purpose through the sight of Hari.

verses.translation: Then Krishna, Rama and Subhadra, the giver of boons, on chariots like celestial cars, painted with gems and gold,

verses.transliteration: saṃvāhya tās tadā rājā mahāmaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ānayām āsa matimān sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: the wise king, with his ministers and family priest, had carried there with the sounds of great auspicious music,

verses.sanskrit: नानावादित्रनिर्घोषैर् नानावेदस्वनैः शुभैः संस्थाप्य च शुभे देशे पवित्रे सुमनोहरे
verses.transliteration: nānāvāditranirghoṣair nānāvedasvanaiḥ śubhaiḥ saṃsthāpya ca śubhe deśe pavitre sumanohare
verses.translation: with the sounds of various instruments and auspicious Vedic recitation, and placed them in an auspicious, holy, very charming spot.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ śubhatithau kāle nakṣatre śubhalakṣaṇe pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayām āsa sumuhūrte dvijaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Then, at an auspicious time, on an auspicious day under a constellation of good omen, at a favourable moment, he had the consecration performed with the brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तेन विधानेन विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा आचार्यानुमतेनैव सर्वं कृत्वा महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: yathoktena vidhānena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ācāryānumatenaiva sarvaṃ kṛtvā mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: by the prescribed method and the rites seen in the injunctions; the king, having done everything with the approval of the preceptor,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचार्याय तदा दत्त्वा दक्षिणां विधिवत् प्रभुः ऋत्विग्भ्यश् च विधानेन तथान्येभ्यो धनं ददौ
verses.transliteration: ācāryāya tadā dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivat prabhuḥ ṛtvigbhyaś ca vidhānena tathānyebhyo dhanaṃ dadau
verses.translation: then gave the preceptor the fee according to rule, and gave wealth to the officiating priests and to others as prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठां विधिवत् प्रासादे भवनोत्तमे स्थापयाम् आस तान् सर्वान् विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivat prāsāde bhavanottame sthāpayām āsa tān sarvān vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: Having duly performed the consecration in the temple, the best of dwellings, he installed them all by the rites seen in the injunctions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā nānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ suvarṇamaṇimuktādyair nānāvastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Then, having worshipped duly with various fragrant flowers, with gold, gems, pearls and beautiful garments of many kinds,

verses.sanskrit: रत्नैश् च विविधैर् दिव्यैर् आसनैर् ग्रामपत्तनैः ददौ चान्यान् स विषयान् पुराणि नगराणि च
verses.transliteration: ratnaiś ca vividhair divyair āsanair grāmapattanaiḥ dadau cānyān sa viṣayān purāṇi nagarāṇi ca
verses.translation: with various divine jewels, seats, villages and towns, he gave other territories, cities and towns as well.

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं दत्त्वा राज्यं कृत्वा यथोचितम् इष्ट्वा च विविधैर् यज्ञैर् दत्त्वा दानान्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dattvā rājyaṃ kṛtvā yathocitam iṣṭvā ca vividhair yajñair dattvā dānāny anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: Having thus given in many ways, ruled the kingdom fittingly, performed various sacrifices and given many gifts,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यस् ततो राजा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः जगाम परमं स्थानं तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtakṛtyas tato rājā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: the king, his purpose fulfilled, having given up all possessions, went to the supreme abode, the supreme state of Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: एवं मया मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कथितो वो नृपोत्तमः क्षेत्रस्य चैव माहात्म्यं किम् अन्यच् छ्रोतुम् इच्छथ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kathito vo nṛpottamaḥ kṣetrasya caiva māhātmyaṃ kim anyac chrotum icchatha
verses.translation: Thus, O best of sages, I have told you of the best of kings and the greatness of the region. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.transliteration: āsīt kalpe muniśreṣṭhāḥ saṃpravṛtte mahākṣaye naṣṭe 'rkacandre pavane naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
verses.translation: Then great clouds rose up in the sky presenting a wonderful sight. They were like herds of elephants bedecked in necklaces of lightning streaks.

verses.transliteration: udite pralayāditye pracaṇḍe ghanagarjite vidyudutpātasaṃghātaiḥ saṃbhagne taruparvate
verses.translation: O brahmins, on hearing his words, the sage was extre¬ mely infuriated and surprised too. He said.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on hearing his words, the sage was extre¬ mely infuriated and surprised too. He said.

verses.transliteration: loke ca saṃhṛte sarve mahadulkānibarhaṇe śuṣkeṣu sarvatoyeṣu saraḥsu ca saritsu ca
verses.translation: The sage then sought refuge in Visnu. His mind solely dwelt on him alone. Once again he looked at the Banyan tree towering above the water.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃvartako vahnir vāyunā saha bho dvijāḥ lokaṃ tu prāviśat sarvam ādityair upaśobhitam
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, the Samvartaka fire together with the wind entered the whole world, lit by the suns.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् स पृथिवीं भित्त्वा प्रविश्य च रसातलम् देवदानवयक्षाणां भयं जनयते महत्
verses.transliteration: paścāt sa pṛthivīṃ bhittvā praviśya ca rasātalam devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ bhayaṃ janayate mahat
verses.translation: Afterwards, piercing the earth and entering Rasatala, it creates great fear for gods, Danavas and Yakshas.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दहन् नागलोकं च यच् च किंचित् क्षिताव् इह अधस्तान् मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वं नाशयते क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: nirdahan nāgalokaṃ ca yac ca kiṃcit kṣitāv iha adhastān muniśārdūlāḥ sarvaṃ nāśayate kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Burning the world of the Nagas and whatever is on the earth here and below, O tigers among sages, it destroys everything in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: ततो योजनविंशानां सहस्राणि शतानि च निर्दहत्य् आशुगो वायुः स च संवर्तको ऽनलः
verses.transliteration: tato yojanaviṃśānāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca nirdahaty āśugo vāyuḥ sa ca saṃvartako 'nalaḥ
verses.translation: Then for thousands and hundreds of twenty yojanas the swift wind and that Samvartaka fire burn all.

verses.transliteration: sadevāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam tato dahati saṃdīptaḥ sarvam eva jagat prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Then, blazing, that lord burns the entire world with its gods, Asuras and Gandharvas, Yakshas, serpents and Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीप्तो ऽसौ महारौद्रः कल्पाग्निर् इति संश्रुतः महाज्वालो महार्चिष्मान् संप्रदीप्तमहास्वनः
verses.transliteration: pradīpto 'sau mahāraudraḥ kalpāgnir iti saṃśrutaḥ mahājvālo mahārciṣmān saṃpradīptamahāsvanaḥ
verses.translation: That very fierce blazing one is known as the fire of the kalpa, with great flames, great rays and a great roaring blaze,

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशो ज्वलन्न् इव स तेजसा त्रैलोक्यं चादहत् तूर्णं ससुरासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭipratīkāśo jvalann iva sa tejasā trailokyaṃ cādahat tūrṇaṃ sasurāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: like a crore of suns, blazing with its splendour, it quickly burned the three worlds with gods, Asuras and men.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधे महाघोरे महाप्रलयदारुणे ऋषिः परमधर्मात्मा ध्यानयोगपरो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhe mahāghore mahāpralayadāruṇe ṛṣiḥ paramadharmātmā dhyānayogaparo 'bhavat
verses.translation: In such a very terrible, dreadful great dissolution, a sage of supreme righteousness was absorbed in the yoga of meditation.

verses.sanskrit: एकः संतिष्ठते विप्रा मार्कण्डेयेति विश्रुतः मोहपाशैर् निबद्धो ऽसौ क्षुत्तृष्णाकुलितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate viprā mārkaṇḍeyeti viśrutaḥ mohapāśair nibaddho 'sau kṣuttṛṣṇākulitendriyāḥ
verses.translation: He remained alone, O brahmins, famed as Markandeya; bound by the fetters of delusion, his senses tormented by hunger and thirst,

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा तं महावह्निं शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकः तृष्णार्तः प्रस्खलन् विप्रास् तदासौ भयविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā taṃ mahāvahniṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ tṛṣṇārtaḥ praskhalan viprās tadāsau bhayavihvalaḥ
verses.translation: seeing that great fire, his throat, lips and palate dry, tormented by thirst and stumbling, he was then overcome with fear, O brahmins.

verses.translation: He wandered over the whole earth, bewildered and senseless; finding no protector, he ran here and there.

verses.transliteration: na lebhe ca tadā śarma yatra viśrāmyatā dvijāḥ karomi kiṃ na jānāmi yasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje
verses.translation: He found no place of rest where he might repose, O brahmins. "What shall I do? I do not know in whom to take refuge.

verses.translation: he reached that divine place, the cause of the great dissolution, the eternal king of banyans, famed as Purushesha.

verses.transliteration: tvarāyukto muniś cāsau nyagrodhasyāntikaṃ yayau āsādya taṃ muniśreṣṭhās tasya mūle samāviśat
verses.translation: The sage hastened to the banyan; reaching it, O best of sages, he entered at its root.

verses.transliteration: na kālāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāṅgārapravarṣaṇam na saṃvartāgamas tatra na ca vajrāśanis tathā
verses.translation: There was no fear of the fire of doom, no rain of embers, no coming of the Samvartaka, nor thunderbolt.

verses.translation: After entering the belly of the boy the sage saw the entire earth consisting of different realms and countries.

verses.translation: He saw four castes, 2 first to last in his belly. He saw deer, monkeys, lions, boars, Srmara variety of deer, rabbits, elephants and other animals.

verses.translation: Their bodies wrapped in garlands of lightning, great clouds arose, terrible in form, mighty, resounding with dreadful roars.

verses.translation: Then all the clouds covered the vault of the sky; by them this whole earth with its mountains, forests and mines,

verses.transliteration: āpūritā diśaḥ sarvāḥ salilaughapariplutāḥ tatas te jaladā ghorā vāriṇā munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: and all the directions, were filled and flooded with masses of water. Then those terrible clouds, O best of sages,

verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ plāvayām āsuś coditāḥ parameṣṭhinā varṣamāṇā mahātoyaṃ pūrayanto vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: impelled by the Supreme One, flooded everything with water, raining great waters and filling the earth,

verses.sanskrit: सुघोरम् अशिवं रौद्रं नाशयन्ति स्म पावकम् ततो द्वादश वर्षाणि पयोदाः समुपप्लवे
verses.transliteration: sughoram aśivaṃ raudraṃ nāśayanti sma pāvakam tato dvādaśa varṣāṇi payodāḥ samupaplave
verses.translation: and they destroyed the very terrible, inauspicious, fierce fire. Then for twelve years the clouds, in the deluge,

verses.sanskrit: धाराभिः पूरयन्तो वै चोद्यमाना महात्मना ततः समुद्राः स्वां वेलाम् अतिक्रामन्ति भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: dhārābhiḥ pūrayanto vai codyamānā mahātmanā tataḥ samudrāḥ svāṃ velām atikrāmanti bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: filled everything with torrents, impelled by the great soul. Then the oceans overflowed their shores, O brahmins;

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताश् च व्यशीर्यन्त मही चाप्सु निमज्जति सर्वतः सुमहाभ्रान्तास् ते पयोदा नभस्तलम्
verses.transliteration: parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta mahī cāpsu nimajjati sarvataḥ sumahābhrāntās te payodā nabhastalam
verses.translation: the mountains crumbled and the earth sank in the waters. On all sides those clouds, greatly whirling, the vault of the sky

verses.sanskrit: संवेष्टयित्वा नश्यन्ति वायुवेगसमाहताः ततस् तं मारुतं घोरं स विष्णुर् मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: saṃveṣṭayitvā naśyanti vāyuvegasamāhatāḥ tatas taṃ mārutaṃ ghoraṃ sa viṣṇur munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: having covered, perished, struck by the force of the wind. Then that terrible wind, O best of sages, Vishnu,

verses.sanskrit: आदिपद्मालयो देवः पीत्वा स्वपिति भो द्विजाः तस्मिन्न् एकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: ādipadmālayo devaḥ pītvā svapiti bho dvijāḥ tasminn ekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
verses.translation: the god who dwells in the primal lotus, drinks up and sleeps, O brahmins. In that terrible single ocean, when moving and unmoving had perished,

verses.transliteration: naṣṭe devāsuranare yakṣarākṣasavarjite tato muniḥ sa viśrānto dhyātvā ca puruṣottamam
verses.translation: when gods, Asuras and men had perished and there were no Yakshas or Rakshasas, then the sage, resting and meditating on Purushottama,

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श चक्षुर् उन्मील्य जलपूर्णां वसुंधराम् नापश्यत् तं वटं नोर्वीं न दिगादि न भास्करम्
verses.transliteration: dadarśa cakṣur unmīlya jalapūrṇāṃ vasuṃdharām nāpaśyat taṃ vaṭaṃ norvīṃ na digādi na bhāskaram
verses.translation: opened his eyes and saw the earth full of water; he did not see that banyan, nor the earth, nor the directions, nor the sun,

verses.sanskrit: न चन्द्रार्काग्निपवनं न देवासुरपन्नगम् तस्मिन्न् एकार्णवे घोरे तमोभूते निराश्रये
verses.transliteration: na candrārkāgnipavanaṃ na devāsurapannagam tasminn ekārṇave ghore tamobhūte nirāśraye
verses.translation: nor moon, sun, fire and wind, nor gods, Asuras and serpents. In that terrible single ocean, dark and without support,

verses.sanskrit: निमज्जन् स तदा विप्राः संतर्तुम् उपचक्रमे बभ्रामासौ मुनिश् चार्त इतश् चेतश् च संप्लवन्
verses.transliteration: nimajjan sa tadā viprāḥ saṃtartum upacakrame babhrāmāsau muniś cārta itaś cetaś ca saṃplavan
verses.translation: sinking, O brahmins, he began to swim; the distressed sage wandered, floating here and there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निममज्ज तदा विप्रास् त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति एवं तं विह्वलं दृष्ट्वा कृपया पुरुषोत्तमः प्रोवाच मुनिशार्दूलास् तदा ध्यानेन तोषितः
verses.transliteration: nimamajja tadā viprās trātāraṃ nādhigacchati evaṃ taṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā puruṣottamaḥ provāca muniśārdūlās tadā dhyānena toṣitaḥ
verses.translation: He sank, O brahmins, finding no protector. Seeing him thus distressed, Purushottama, pleased by his meditation, spoke to him out of compassion, O tigers among sages:

verses.sanskrit: वत्स श्रान्तो ऽसि बालस् त्वं भक्तत्र मम सुव्रत आगच्छागच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं मार्कण्डेय ममान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: vatsa śrānto 'si bālas tvaṃ bhaktatra mama suvrata āgacchāgaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ mārkaṇḍeya mamāntikam
verses.translation: "Child, you are weary; you are a boy, my devotee of good vows. Come, come quickly to me, Markandeya.

verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā muniḥ paramakopitaḥ uvāca sa tadā viprā vismitaś cābhavan muhuḥ

verses.translation: "Who is this who calls me by name, as if slighting my austerity, as if insulting my body that has lived many thousands of years?

verses.transliteration: na hy eṣa samudācāro deveṣv api samāhitaḥ māṃ brahmā sa ca deveśo dīrghāyur iti bhāṣate
verses.translation: Such conduct is not practised even among the gods; Brahma, the lord of the gods, calls me 'the long-lived one.'

verses.translation: Who, careless of his life, addressing me — whose austerity is terrible — as 'Markandeya,' wishes here to meet his death at my hands?"

verses.translation: Having said this, O brahmins, the sage became anxious: "Is this a dream I have seen, or has this delusion come upon me?"

verses.translation: As he reflected thus, a thought arose that removes sorrow: "I will go for refuge with devotion to the god Purushottama."

verses.translation: Taking refuge in the god, his mind absorbed in him, the sage again saw that vast banyan above the water.

verses.translation: On a broad branch of it was a very wonderful golden, lovely divine couch fashioned by Vishvakarman,

verses.translation: his chest covered with the forest garland, wearing divine earrings, his neck laden with necklaces and adorned with divine jewels.

verses.translation: Seeing the god, the sage, his eyes wide with wonder and his body thrilling, bowed to the god and said this:

verses.transliteration: aho caikārṇave ghore vinaṣṭe sacarācare katham eko hy ayaṃ bālas tiṣṭhaty atra sunirbhayaḥ
verses.translation: "Ah! In this terrible single ocean, when all moving and unmoving has perished, how does this one child stay here so fearless?"

verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca jānann api mahāmuniḥ na bubodha tadā devaṃ māyayā tasya mohitaḥ yadā na bubudhe cainaṃ tadā khedād uvāca ha

verses.transliteration: vṛthā me tapaso vīryaṃ vṛthā jñānaṃ vṛthā kriyā vṛthā me jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ vṛthā mānuṣyam eva ca
verses.translation: "Vain is the power of my austerity, vain my knowledge, vain my rites, vain my long life and vain my humanity,

verses.transliteration: yo 'haṃ suptaṃ na jānāmi paryaṅke divyabālakam
verses.translation: since I do not know the divine child sleeping on the couch."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃcintayan vipraḥ plavamāno vicetanaḥ trāṇārthaṃ vihvalaś cāsau nirvedaṃ gatavāṃs tadā
verses.translation: Reflecting thus, floating and senseless, distressed and seeking protection, the brahmin fell into despair.

verses.transliteration: tato bālārkasaṃkāśaṃ svamahimnā vyavasthitam sarvatejomayaṃ viprā na śaśākābhivīkṣitum
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, he could not look at him, standing in his own greatness, like the morning sun, made of all splendour.

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ munim āyāntaṃ sa bālaḥ prahasann iva provāca muniśārdūlās tadā meghaughanisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the sage approaching, the child, as if laughing, spoke then with a voice like the rumble of clouds, O tigers among sages:

verses.transliteration: vatsa jānāmi śrāntaṃ tvāṃ trāṇārthaṃ mām upasthitam śarīraṃ viśa me kṣipraṃ viśrāmas te mayoditaḥ
verses.translation: "Child, I know you are weary and have come to me for protection. Enter my body quickly; rest has been ordained for you by me."

verses.transliteration: śrutvā sa vacanaṃ tasya kiṃcin novāca mohitaḥ viveśa vadanaṃ tasya vivṛtaṃ cāvaśo muniḥ
verses.translation: Hearing his words, the bewildered sage said nothing and, helpless, entered his open mouth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स प्रविश्योदरे तस्य बालस्य मुनिसत्तमः ददर्श पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां नानाजनपदैर् वृताम्
verses.transliteration: sa praviśyodare tasya bālasya munisattamaḥ dadarśa pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ nānājanapadair vṛtām
verses.translation: O excellent sages, after coming out of the belly of that boy, he once again saw the earth turned into a vast sheet of water. It was devoid of people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, after coming out of the belly of that boy, he once again saw the earth turned into a vast sheet of water. It was devoid of people.

verses.sanskrit: लवणेक्षुसुरासर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलोदधीन् ददर्श तान् समुद्रांश् च जम्बु प्लक्षं च शाल्मलम्
verses.transliteration: lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalodadhīn dadarśa tān samudrāṃś ca jambu plakṣaṃ ca śālmalam
verses.translation: He saw that same lord in the form of the infant boy whom he had seen before. He was stationed on the branch of banyan tree in a palanquin.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw that same lord in the form of the infant boy whom he had seen before. He was stationed on the branch of banyan tree in a palanquin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशं क्रौञ्चं च शाकं च पुष्करं च ददर्श सः भारतादीनि वर्षाणि तथा सर्वांश् च पर्वतान्
verses.transliteration: kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ ca śākaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ ca dadarśa saḥ bhāratādīni varṣāṇi tathā sarvāṃś ca parvatān
verses.translation: That lord had the scar Srlvatsa on his chest. He was clad in yellow robes and had four arms. His wide eyes resembl¬ ed the large petals of the lotus and he stayed there taking up the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord had the scar Srlvatsa on his chest. He was clad in yellow robes and had four arms. His wide eyes resembl¬ ed the large petals of the lotus and he stayed there taking up the universe.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुं च सर्वरत्नाढ्यं अपश्यत् कनकाचलम् नानारत्नान्वितैः शृङ्गैर् भूषितं बहुकन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: meruṃ ca sarvaratnāḍhyaṃ apaśyat kanakācalam nānāratnānvitaiḥ śṛṅgair bhūṣitaṃ bahukandaram
verses.translation: On seeing the sage floating and swimming like a sense¬ less person and approaching him after coming out of his mouth, the lord spoke with laugh.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the sage floating and swimming like a sense¬ less person and approaching him after coming out of his mouth, the lord spoke with laugh.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नानामुनिजनाकीर्णं नानावृक्षवनाकुलम् नानासत्त्वसमायुक्तं नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: nānāmunijanākīrṇaṃ nānāvṛkṣavanākulam nānāsattvasamāyuktaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam
verses.translation: O dear one, I hope you stayed in my belly comfort¬ ably and have had your rest. While wandering about what wonderful thing did you observe there?
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, I hope you stayed in my belly comfort¬ ably and have had your rest. While wandering about what wonderful thing did you observe there?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रैः सिंहैर् वराहैश् च चामरैर् महिषैर् गजैः मृगैः शाखामृगैश् चान्यैर् भूषितं सुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: vyāghraiḥ siṃhair varāhaiś ca cāmarair mahiṣair gajaiḥ mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgaiś cānyair bhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, you are my devotee and have resorted completely to me. But you are tired. Hence, to help you I speak to you. See me again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, you are my devotee and have resorted completely to me. But you are tired. Hence, to help you I speak to you. See me again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शक्राद्यैर् विविधैर् देवैः सिद्धचारणपन्नगैः मुनियक्षाप्सरोभिश् च वृतैश् चान्यैः सुरालयैः
verses.transliteration: śakrādyair vividhair devaiḥ siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ muniyakṣāpsarobhiś ca vṛtaiś cānyaiḥ surālayaiḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, O lord of Universe, you have assumed the form of a boy by your Maya, O beautiful lotus¬ eyed one, save me, I am miserable and I have sought refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, O lord of Universe, you have assumed the form of a boy by your Maya, O beautiful lotus¬ eyed one, save me, I am miserable and I have sought refuge in you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सुमेरुं श्रीमन्तम् अपश्यन् मुनिसत्तमः पर्यटन् स तदा विप्रस् तस्य बालस्य चोदरे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sumeruṃ śrīmantam apaśyan munisattamaḥ paryaṭan sa tadā vipras tasya bālasya codare
verses.translation: Omost excellent one among Devas, I am scorched by the fire called Samvarta. O lord, save me. I am afraid of the rising of sparks pf fire in flames.
verses.commentary: Sense: Omost excellent one among Devas, I am scorched by the fire called Samvarta. O lord, save me. I am afraid of the rising of sparks pf fire in flames.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिमवन्तं हेमकूटं निषधं गन्धमादनम् श्वेतं च दुर्धरं नीलं कैलासं मन्दरं गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: himavantaṃ hemakūṭaṃ niṣadhaṃ gandhamādanam śvetaṃ ca durdharaṃ nīlaṃ kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ girim
verses.translation: Scoiched by theAdityas, Pralayavartaka and others, I do not derive peace. Save me, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Scoiched by theAdityas, Pralayavartaka and others, I do not derive peace. Save me, O lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रं मलयं विन्ध्यं पारियात्रं तथार्बुदम् सह्यं च शुक्तिमन्तं च मैनाकं वक्रपर्वतम्
verses.transliteration: mahendraṃ malayaṃ vindhyaṃ pāriyātraṃ tathārbudam sahyaṃ ca śuktimantaṃ ca mainākaṃ vakraparvatam
verses.translation: am thirsty and afflicted by hunger. O lord of uni¬ verse, I am miserable too. I do not see any saviour. Save me, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: am thirsty and afflicted by hunger. O lord of uni¬ verse, I am miserable too. I do not see any saviour. Save me, O lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एताश् चान्याश् च बहवो यावन्तः पृथिवीधराः ततस् तांस् तु मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सो ऽपश्यद् रत्नभूषितान्
verses.transliteration: etāś cānyāś ca bahavo yāvantaḥ pṛthivīdharāḥ tatas tāṃs tu muniśreṣṭhāḥ so 'paśyad ratnabhūṣitān
verses.translation: In this terrible vast sheet of water, as the mobile and immobile beings have perished I do find no resort, save me, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this terrible vast sheet of water, as the mobile and immobile beings have perished I do find no resort, save me, O lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं च पाञ्चालान् मत्स्यान् मद्रान् सकेकयान् बाह्लीकान् शूरसेनांश् च काश्मीरांस् तङ्गणान् खसान्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ ca pāñcālān matsyān madrān sakekayān bāhlīkān śūrasenāṃś ca kāśmīrāṃs taṅgaṇān khasān
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, the mobile and immobile beings were seen by me in your belly. I am surprised and bewildered. Save me, O lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, the mobile and immobile beings were seen by me in your belly. I am surprised and bewildered. Save me, O lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पार्वतीयान् किरातांश् च कर्णप्रावरणान् मरून् अन्त्यजान् अन्त्यजातींश् च सो ऽपश्यत् तस्य चोदरे
verses.transliteration: pārvatīyān kirātāṃś ca karṇaprāvaraṇān marūn antyajān antyajātīṃś ca so 'paśyat tasya codare
verses.translation: In this worldly existence that has no basic support, be pleased O Lord, O most excellent one among Devas, be pleased. O deity fond of the learned and Devas, be pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this worldly existence that has no basic support, be pleased O Lord, O most excellent one among Devas, be pleased. O deity fond of the learned and Devas, be pleased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगाञ् शाखामृगान् सिंहान् वराहान् सृमराञ् शशान् गजांश् चान्यांस् तथा सत्त्वान् सो ऽपश्यत् तस्य चोदरे
verses.transliteration: mṛgāñ śākhāmṛgān siṃhān varāhān sṛmarāñ śaśān gajāṃś cānyāṃs tathā sattvān so 'paśyat tasya codare
verses.translation: Be pleased, O Lord of the learned. Be pleased, O support of the learned. Be pleased, O lord of the worlds, O cause of the cause of the Universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O Lord of the learned. Be pleased, O support of the learned. Be pleased, O lord of the worlds, O cause of the cause of the Universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि ग्रामाश् च नगराणि च कृषिगोरक्षवाणिज्यं क्रयविक्रयणं तथा
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni grāmāś ca nagarāṇi ca kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyaṃ krayavikrayaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lord of Devas. Be pleased with me, O deity that bear the burden of the earth. Be pleased, O deity residing in waters. Be pleased, O slayer of Madhu demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O lord of Devas. Be pleased with me, O deity that bear the burden of the earth. Be pleased, O deity residing in waters. Be pleased, O slayer of Madhu demon.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्रादीन् विबुधाञ् श्रेष्ठांस् तथान्यांश् च दिवौकसः गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षान् ऋषींश् चैव सनातनान्
verses.transliteration: śakrādīn vibudhāñ śreṣṭhāṃs tathānyāṃś ca divaukasaḥ gandharvāpsaraso yakṣān ṛṣīṃś caiva sanātanān
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lover of Laksml, be pleased, O lord of Devas. Be pleased, O slayer of Kamsa and Kesin. Be pleased O destroyer of Arista. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O lover of Laksml, be pleased, O lord of Devas. Be pleased, O slayer of Kamsa and Kesin. Be pleased O destroyer of Arista. 1
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यदानवसंघांश् च नागांश् च मुनिसत्तमाः सिंहिकातनयांश् चैव ये चान्ये सुरशत्रवः
verses.transliteration: daityadānavasaṃghāṃś ca nāgāṃś ca munisattamāḥ siṃhikātanayāṃś caiva ye cānye suraśatravaḥ
verses.translation: Be pleased, O Kjrsna, O destroyer of* Daityas. Be pleased, O slayer of Danu's sons. Be pleased, O resident of Mathura. Be pleased, O scion of the family of Yadus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O Kjrsna, O destroyer of* Daityas. Be pleased, O slayer of Danu's sons. Be pleased, O resident of Mathura. Be pleased, O scion of the family of Yadus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत् किंचित् तेन लोके ऽस्मिन् दृष्टपूर्वं चराचरम् अपश्यत् स तदा सर्वं तस्य कुक्षौ द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yat kiṃcit tena loke 'smin dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ carācaram apaśyat sa tadā sarvaṃ tasya kukṣau dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Arista,: An asura, a servant of Kamsa. Once, at the instance of Kamsa he went to Gokula disguised as an ox to kill Srikrsna. The ox instilled terror in people by crushing hills and mountains, with its horns and bellowing like a bull. But Srikrsna faced the beast with courage and rained blows on him so that it was thrown hundred yojanas away and it cried. At the time of death it regained its former form and was recognized
verses.wordMeaning: Arista,: An asura, a servant of Kamsa. Once, at the instance of Kamsa he went to Gokula disguised as an ox to kill Srikrsna. The ox instilled terror in people by crushing hills and mountains, with its horns and bellowing like a bull.…

verses.sanskrit: अथवा किं बहूक्तेन कीर्तितेन पुनः पुनः ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं यत् किंचित् सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: athavā kiṃ bahūktena kīrtitena punaḥ punaḥ brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yat kiṃcit sacarācaram
verses.translation: You are the Purusa, the seed of the Universe. You are more excellent than others. You arc the sense-organs. O lord, you are the objects, and subtle primary elements.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the Purusa, the seed of the Universe. You are more excellent than others. You arc the sense-organs. O lord, you are the objects, and subtle primary elements.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं च द्विजोत्तमाः महर् जनस् तपः सत्यम् अतलं वितलं तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ mahar janas tapaḥ satyam atalaṃ vitalaṃ tathā
verses.translation: You arc the guardian of the quarters. You are Devas, Yajfias and sacrificial gifts. You are Indra, Siva, offer¬ ing and the sacrificial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc the guardian of the quarters. You are Devas, Yajfias and sacrificial gifts. You are Indra, Siva, offer¬ ing and the sacrificial fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पातालं सुतलं चैव वितलं च रसातलम् महातलं च ब्रह्माण्डम् अपश्यत् तस्य चोदरे
verses.transliteration: pātālaṃ sutalaṃ caiva vitalaṃ ca rasātalam mahātalaṃ ca brahmāṇḍam apaśyat tasya codare
verses.translation: You are Yama, the lord of manes; O lord, you are the lord of Raksasas (Nirrti) himself. You are Varuna, lord of waters; you are wind and the lord of wealth (Kubera).
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Yama, the lord of manes; O lord, you are the lord of Raksasas (Nirrti) himself. You are Varuna, lord of waters; you are wind and the lord of wealth (Kubera).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अव्याहता गतिस् तस्य तदाभूद् द्विजसत्तमाः प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य स्मृतिलोपश् च नाभवत्
verses.transliteration: avyāhatā gatis tasya tadābhūd dvijasattamāḥ prasādāt tasya devasya smṛtilopaś ca nābhavat
verses.translation: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भ्रममाणस् तदा कुक्षौ कृत्स्नं जगद् इदं द्विजाः नान्तं जगाम देहस्य तस्य विष्णोः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: bhramamāṇas tadā kukṣau kṛtsnaṃ jagad idaṃ dvijāḥ nāntaṃ jagāma dehasya tasya viṣṇoḥ kadācana
verses.translation: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).

verses.sanskrit: यदासौ नागतश् चान्तं तस्य देहस्य भो द्विजाः तदा तं वरदं देवं शरणं गतवान् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: yadāsau nāgataś cāntaṃ tasya dehasya bho dvijāḥ tadā taṃ varadaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatavān muniḥ
verses.translation: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसौ सहसा विप्रा वायुवेगेन निःसृतः महात्मनो मुखात् तस्य विवृतात् पुरुषस्य सः
verses.transliteration: tato 'sau sahasā viprā vāyuvegena niḥsṛtaḥ mahātmano mukhāt tasya vivṛtāt puruṣasya saḥ
verses.translation: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc Isana, Ananta, Ganesa, Sanmukha, Vasus, Rudras, Adilyas and Khecaras (Planets).

verses.sanskrit: स निष्क्रम्योदरात् तस्य बालस्य मुनिसत्तमाः पुनश् चैकार्णवाम् उर्वीम् अपश्यज् जनवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: sa niṣkramyodarāt tasya bālasya munisattamāḥ punaś caikārṇavām urvīm apaśyaj janavarjitām
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Markaneya, O brahmins, the lord became pleased. He said in a voice as majestic as the rumbling sound of clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वदृष्टं च तं देवं ददर्श शिशुरूपिणम् शाखायां वटवृक्षस्य पर्यङ्कोपरि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ ca taṃ devaṃ dadarśa śiśurūpiṇam śākhāyāṃ vaṭavṛkṣasya paryaṅkopari saṃsthitam
verses.translation: O excellent sage, tell me freely what you have in your mind. O brahmanical sage, I shall give you everything, what¬ ever you may desire from me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, tell me freely what you have in your mind. O brahmanical sage, I shall give you everything, what¬ ever you may desire from me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं पीतवस्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् जगद् आदाय तिष्ठन्तं पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam jagad ādāya tiṣṭhantaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam
verses.translation: O lord, 1 wish to know you. O bestower of salvation, I wish to'*know your Maya (Illusion). O lord of Devas, by your favour, my power of memory is not impaired.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, 1 wish to know you. O bestower of salvation, I wish to'*know your Maya (Illusion). O lord of Devas, by your favour, my power of memory is not impaired.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तं मुनिम् आयान्तं प्लवमानम् अचेतनम् दृष्ट्वा मुखाद् विनिष्क्रान्तं प्रोवाच प्रहसन्न् इव
verses.transliteration: so 'pi taṃ munim āyāntaṃ plavamānam acetanam dṛṣṭvā mukhād viniṣkrāntaṃ provāca prahasann iva
verses.translation: I have hurriedly wandered through your body. O lord, I entered your body through your mouth. O lord, I saw all worlds in your belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have hurriedly wandered through your body. O lord, I entered your body through your mouth. O lord, I saw all worlds in your belly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कच्चित् त्वयोषितं वत्स विश्रान्तं च ममोदरे भ्रममाणश् च किं तत्र आश्चर्यं दृष्टवान् असि
verses.transliteration: kaccit tvayoṣitaṃ vatsa viśrāntaṃ ca mamodare bhramamāṇaś ca kiṃ tatra āścaryaṃ dṛṣṭavān asi
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed one, I wish to know you, the unchanging one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed one, I wish to know you, the unchanging one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्तो ऽसि मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ श्रान्तो ऽसि च ममाश्रितः तेन त्वाम् उपकाराय संभाषे पश्य माम् इह
verses.transliteration: bhakto 'si me muniśreṣṭha śrānto 'si ca mamāśritaḥ tena tvām upakārāya saṃbhāṣe paśya mām iha
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed one, I wish to hear everything in detail and in the precise manner. O lord, what I have seen is immense and inconceivable.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed one, I wish to hear everything in detail and in the precise manner. O lord, what I have seen is immense and inconceivable.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा स वचनं तस्य संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः ददर्श तं सुदुष्प्रेक्षं रत्नैर् दिव्यैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sa vacanaṃ tasya saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ dadarśa taṃ suduṣprekṣaṃ ratnair divyair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Thus requested by him, the lord of Devas of great refulgence, the foremost among the eloquent ones spoke the following words to Markanqleya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by him, the lord of Devas of great refulgence, the foremost among the eloquent ones spoke the following words to Markanqleya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना निर्मला दृष्टिर् मुहूर्तात् तस्य भो द्विजाः प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य प्रादुर्भूता पुनर् नवा
verses.transliteration: prasannā nirmalā dṛṣṭir muhūrtāt tasya bho dvijāḥ prasādāt tasya devasya prādurbhūtā punar navā
verses.translation: Admittedly, O brahmin, Devas do not know me in reality. Out of affection for you I shall tell you how I create this universe and discharge it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Admittedly, O brahmin, Devas do not know me in reality. Out of affection for you I shall tell you how I create this universe and discharge it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताङ्गुलितलौ पादौ ततस् तस्य सुरार्चितौ प्रणम्य शिरसा विप्रा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: raktāṅgulitalau pādau tatas tasya surārcitau praṇamya śirasā viprā harṣagadgadayā girā
verses.translation: O brahminical sage, you are one with great filial affec¬ tion. You have sought refuge in me alone. Your celebacy is great. Hence, I have seen directly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahminical sage, you are one with great filial affec¬ tion. You have sought refuge in me alone. Your celebacy is great. Hence, I have seen directly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिस् तदा हृष्टो विस्मितश् च पुनः पुनः दृष्ट्वा तं परमात्मानं संस्तोतुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalis tadā hṛṣṭo vismitaś ca punaḥ punaḥ dṛṣṭvā taṃ paramātmānaṃ saṃstotum upacakrame
verses.translation: I am Narayana; I am the permanent unchanging, source of origin, the dispenser of destiny and the annihilator of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am Narayana; I am the permanent unchanging, source of origin, the dispenser of destiny and the annihilator of all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव जगन्नाथ मायाबालवपुर्धर त्राहि मां चारुपद्माक्ष दुःखितं शरणागतम्
verses.transliteration: devadeva jagannātha māyābālavapurdhara trāhi māṃ cārupadmākṣa duḥkhitaṃ śaraṇāgatam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, I am Visnu, I am Brahma, I am Indra too. T am king VaiSravana 1 and Yama the Lord of ghosts.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, I am Visnu, I am Brahma, I am Indra too. T am king VaiSravana 1 and Yama the Lord of ghosts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संतप्तो ऽस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ संवर्ताख्येन वह्निना अङ्गारवर्षभीतं च त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: saṃtapto 'smi suraśreṣṭha saṃvartākhyena vahninā aṅgāravarṣabhītaṃ ca trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: O excellent brahmin, I am Siva, Soma and patriarch Kasyapa. I am creator and dispenser of destiny and I am sacrifice too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmin, I am Siva, Soma and patriarch Kasyapa. I am creator and dispenser of destiny and I am sacrifice too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शोषितश् च प्रचण्डेन वायुना जगदायुना विह्वलो ऽहं तथा श्रान्तस् त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: śoṣitaś ca pracaṇḍena vāyunā jagadāyunā vihvalo 'haṃ tathā śrāntas trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: Vaxiraoaria: Kubera, king ofYaksas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaxiraoaria: Kubera, king ofYaksas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तापितश् च तशामात्यैः प्रलयावर्तकादिभिः न शान्तिम् अधिगच्छामि त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tāpitaś ca taśāmātyaiḥ pralayāvartakādibhiḥ na śāntim adhigacchāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: Badava: the fire of sage Aurva's penance which started to burn the world but which, at the request of pitrs he threw down into the sea where it took the shape of a horse-head and living beneath the sea continued vomiting heat at all times.
verses.commentary: Sense: Badava: the fire of sage Aurva's penance which started to burn the world but which, at the request of pitrs he threw down into the sea where it took the shape of a horse-head and living beneath the sea continued vomiting heat at all times.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तृषितश् च क्षुधाविष्टो दुःखितश् च जगत्पते त्रातारं नात्र पश्यामि त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tṛṣitaś ca kṣudhāviṣṭo duḥkhitaś ca jagatpate trātāraṃ nātra paśyāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: Thus, O excellent sage, for the duration of the period till Brahma rises up I remain in the form of an infant though. I am not an infant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O excellent sage, for the duration of the period till Brahma rises up I remain in the form of an infant though. I am not an infant.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्न् एकार्णवे घोरे विनष्टे सचराचरे न चान्तम् अधिगच्छामि त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: asminn ekārṇave ghore vinaṣṭe sacarācare na cāntam adhigacchāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, honoured and worshipped by brahminical sages, boon has been granted to you by. me in the form of Brahma. I have been propitiated many times.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, honoured and worshipped by brahminical sages, boon has been granted to you by. me in the form of Brahma. I have been propitiated many times.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तवोदरे च देवेश मया दृष्टं चराचरम् विस्मितो ऽहं विषण्णश् च त्राहि मां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tavodare ca deveśa mayā dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram vismito 'haṃ viṣaṇṇaś ca trāhi māṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: When the mobile and immobile beings had perished you set out. Seeing everything in a vast sheet of water you were bewildered. It was observed by me and hence you were shown the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the mobile and immobile beings had perished you set out. Seeing everything in a vast sheet of water you were bewildered. It was observed by me and hence you were shown the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: संसारे ऽस्मिन् निरालम्बे प्रसीद पुरुषोत्तम प्रसीद विबुधश्रेष्ठ प्रसीद विबुधप्रिय
verses.transliteration: saṃsāre 'smin nirālambe prasīda puruṣottama prasīda vibudhaśreṣṭha prasīda vibudhapriya
verses.translation: O brahmins, after saying this, when the period of a thousand sets of four Yugas was completed the lord again spoke to him in a voice as majestic as the sound of rumbling cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, after saying this, when the period of a thousand sets of four Yugas was completed the lord again spoke to him in a voice as majestic as the sound of rumbling cloud.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद विबुधां नाथ प्रसीद विबुधालय प्रसीद सर्वलोकेश जगत्कारणकारण
verses.transliteration: prasīda vibudhāṃ nātha prasīda vibudhālaya prasīda sarvalokeśa jagatkāraṇakāraṇa
verses.translation: On hearing that splendid speech of the lord and glanc¬ ing at him, the sage bent down his head, made obeisance and spoke thus again:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that splendid speech of the lord and glanc¬ ing at him, the sage bent down his head, made obeisance and spoke thus again:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: prasīda sarvakṛd deva prasīda mama bhūdhara prasīda salilāvāsa prasīda madhusūdana
verses.translation: Thereby the people in the world will know Lord Vi?nu and Lord Siva as the same form.

verses.transliteration: prasīda kamalākānta prasīda tridaśeśvara prasīda kaṃsakeśīghna prasīdāriṣṭanāśana
verses.translation: Be gracious, beloved of Kamala; be gracious, lord of the thirty gods; be gracious, slayer of Kamsa and Keshin; be gracious, destroyer of Arishta.
