verses.transliteration: prasīda kṛṣṇa daityaghna prasīda danujāntaka prasīda mathurāvāsa prasīda yadunandana
verses.translation: Be gracious, Krishna, slayer of Daityas; be gracious, ender of the Danavas; be gracious, dweller in Mathura; be gracious, joy of the Yadus.

verses.transliteration: prasīda śakrāvaraja prasīda varadāvyaya tvaṃ mahī tvaṃ jalaṃ deva tvam agnis tvaṃ samīraṇaḥ
verses.translation: Be gracious, younger brother of Shakra; be gracious, imperishable giver of boons. You are earth, you are water, O god, you are fire, you are wind,

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नभस् त्वं मनश् चैव त्वम् अहंकार एव च त्वं बुद्धिः प्रकृतिश् चैव सत्त्वाद्यास् त्वं जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ nabhas tvaṃ manaś caiva tvam ahaṃkāra eva ca tvaṃ buddhiḥ prakṛtiś caiva sattvādyās tvaṃ jagatpate
verses.translation: you are space and you are mind, you are egoity; you are intellect and Prakriti, and the qualities beginning with sattva, O lord of the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषस् त्वं जगद्व्यापी पुरुषाद् अपि चोत्तमः त्वम् इन्द्रियाणि सर्वाणि शब्दाद्या विषयाः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: puruṣas tvaṃ jagadvyāpī puruṣād api cottamaḥ tvam indriyāṇi sarvāṇi śabdādyā viṣayāḥ prabho
verses.translation: You are the Person pervading the world, and higher than the Person; you are all the senses and their objects beginning with sound, O Lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दिक्पालाश् च धर्माश् च वेदा यज्ञाः सदक्षिणाः त्वम् इन्द्रस् त्वं शिवो देवस् त्वं हविस् त्वं हुताशनः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ dikpālāś ca dharmāś ca vedā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ tvam indras tvaṃ śivo devas tvaṃ havis tvaṃ hutāśanaḥ
verses.translation: You are the guardians of the directions and the dharmas, the Vedas and sacrifices with their fees; you are Indra, you are the god Shiva, you are the oblation and the fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यमः पितृराट् देव त्वं रक्षोधिपतिः स्वयम् वरुणस् त्वम् अपां नाथ त्वं वायुस् त्वं धनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yamaḥ pitṛrāṭ deva tvaṃ rakṣodhipatiḥ svayam varuṇas tvam apāṃ nātha tvaṃ vāyus tvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ
verses.translation: You are Yama, king of the ancestors, O god; you yourself are the lord of the Rakshasas; you are Varuna, lord of waters; you are Vayu and the lord of wealth.

verses.transliteration: tvam īśānas tvam anantas tvaṃ gaṇeśaś ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ vasavas tvaṃ tathā rudrās tvam ādityāś ca khecarāḥ
verses.translation: You are Ishana, you are Ananta, you are Ganesha and the six-faced one; you are the Vasus, the Rudras, the Adityas and the sky-rovers.

verses.sanskrit: दानवास् त्वं तथा यक्षास् त्वं दैत्याः समरुद्गणाः सिद्धाश् चाप्सरसो नागा गन्धर्वास् त्वं सचारणाः
verses.transliteration: dānavās tvaṃ tathā yakṣās tvaṃ daityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ siddhāś cāpsaraso nāgā gandharvās tvaṃ sacāraṇāḥ
verses.translation: You are the Danavas and Yakshas, the Daityas with the hosts of Maruts, the Siddhas, Apsarases, Nagas, Gandharvas and Charanas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितरो वालखिल्याश् च प्रजानां पतयो ऽच्युत मुनयस् त्वम् ऋषिगणास् त्वम् अश्विनौ निशाचराः
verses.transliteration: pitaro vālakhilyāś ca prajānāṃ patayo 'cyuta munayas tvam ṛṣigaṇās tvam aśvinau niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: You are the ancestors, the Valakhilyas and the lords of creatures, O Achyuta; you are the sages and the hosts of seers, the Ashvins and the night-rovers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश् च जातयस् त्वं हि यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञितम् किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बगोचरम्
verses.transliteration: anyāś ca jātayas tvaṃ hi yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñitam kiṃ cātra bahunoktena brahmādistambagocaram
verses.translation: You are the other species too, whatever is called a living being. What need to say more? Whatever lies between Brahma and a blade of grass,

verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tvaṃ jagat sacarācaram yat te rūpaṃ paraṃ deva kūṭastham acalaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: past, present and future — you are the world, moving and unmoving. Your supreme form, O god, unchanging, immovable and fixed,

verses.transliteration: brahmādyās tan na jānanti katham anye 'lpamedhasaḥ deva śuddhasvabhāvo 'si nityas tvaṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: even Brahma and the others do not know; how then others of little intelligence? O god, you are pure in nature, eternal, beyond Prakriti,

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तः शाश्वतो ऽनन्तः सर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः त्वम् आकाशः परः शान्तो अजस् त्वं विभुर् अव्ययः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaḥ śāśvato 'nantaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ tvam ākāśaḥ paraḥ śānto ajas tvaṃ vibhur avyayaḥ
verses.translation: unmanifest, eternal, endless, all-pervading, the great Lord; you are space, supreme and tranquil, unborn, all-pervading and imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: एवं त्वां निर्गुणं स्तोतुं कः शक्नोति निरञ्जनम् स्तुतो ऽसि यन् मया देव विकलेनाल्पचेतसा तत् सर्वं देवदेवेश क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि चाव्यय
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tvāṃ nirguṇaṃ stotuṃ kaḥ śaknoti nirañjanam stuto 'si yan mayā deva vikalenālpacetasā tat sarvaṃ devadeveśa kṣantum arhasi cāvyaya
verses.translation: Who can praise you thus, without qualities and stainless? Whatever praise I have offered you, O god, confused and of little mind, forgive it all, O imperishable lord of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स्तुतस् तदा तेन मार्कण्डेयेन भो द्विजाः प्रीतः प्रोवाच भगवान् मेघगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ stutas tadā tena mārkaṇḍeyena bho dvijāḥ prītaḥ provāca bhagavān meghagambhīrayā girā
verses.translation: O brahmins, henceforth, I shall recount the mode of visiting the five Tlrthas (holy centres) and the benefit derived from holy dips,.charitable gifts and visits to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि कामं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत् ते मनसि वर्तते ददामि सर्वं विप्रर्षे मत्तो यद् अभिवाञ्छसि
verses.transliteration: brūhi kāmaṃ muniśreṣṭha yat te manasi vartate dadāmi sarvaṃ viprarṣe matto yad abhivāñchasi
verses.translation: The pure man should go to the eddy called Markandeya Hrada and dive therein facing the north. He should take the holy dips thrice and repeat this Mantra,
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure man should go to the eddy called Markandeya Hrada and dive therein facing the north. He should take the holy dips thrice and repeat this Mantra,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा स वचनं विप्राः शिशोस् तस्य महात्मनः उवाच परमप्रीतो मुनिस् तद्गतमानसः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sa vacanaṃ viprāḥ śiśos tasya mahātmanaḥ uvāca paramaprīto munis tadgatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: After taking the holy dip in the water of depth upto the umbilicus, the intelligent devotee should duly perform Tarpana of Devas, sages, manes, and others by means of water mixed with gingelly seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking the holy dip in the water of depth upto the umbilicus, the intelligent devotee should duly perform Tarpana of Devas, sages, manes, and others by means of water mixed with gingelly seeds.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातुम् इच्छामि देव त्वां मायां वै तव चोत्तमाम् त्वत्प्रसादाच् च देवेश स्मृतिर् न परिहीयते
verses.transliteration: jñātum icchāmi deva tvāṃ māyāṃ vai tava cottamām tvatprasādāc ca deveśa smṛtir na parihīyate
verses.translation: By taking the holy dip in the eddy of Markanqleya Hrada, thus, and by visiting Sankara, the man obtains the benefit of ten horse-sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking the holy dip in the eddy of Markanqleya Hrada, thus, and by visiting Sankara, the man obtains the benefit of ten horse-sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुतम् अन्तः शरीरेण सततं पर्यवर्तितम् इच्छामि पुण्डरीकाक्ष ज्ञातुं त्वाम् अहम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: drutam antaḥ śarīreṇa satataṃ paryavartitam icchāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa jñātuṃ tvām aham avyayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the devotee should go to the holy fig tree on a par with the Kalpa tree, circumambulate it thrice and worship the banyan tree with great devotion, repeating the following Mantra:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the devotee should go to the holy fig tree on a par with the Kalpa tree, circumambulate it thrice and worship the banyan tree with great devotion, repeating the following Mantra:—

verses.sanskrit: इह भूत्वा शिशुः साक्षात् किं भवान् अवतिष्ठते पीत्वा जगद् इदं सर्वम् एतद् आख्यातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: iha bhūtvā śiśuḥ sākṣāt kiṃ bhavān avatiṣṭhate pītvā jagad idaṃ sarvam etad ākhyātum arhasi
verses.translation: By devoutly circumambulating and bowing down to the Banyan tree resembling the Kalpa tree the man is imme¬ diately liberated from sins like the serpent that is rid of its old and decaying slough.
verses.commentary: Sense: By devoutly circumambulating and bowing down to the Banyan tree resembling the Kalpa tree the man is imme¬ diately liberated from sins like the serpent that is rid of its old and decaying slough.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं च जगत् सर्वं शरीरस्थं तवानघ कियन्तं च त्वया कालम् इह स्थेयम् अरिंदम
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ ca jagat sarvaṃ śarīrasthaṃ tavānagha kiyantaṃ ca tvayā kālam iha stheyam ariṃdama
verses.translation: O brahmins, even by passing through the shadow of this Kalpa tree, a man eschews the sin of brahmin slaughter. What doubt is there in regard to other sins?
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, even by passing through the shadow of this Kalpa tree, a man eschews the sin of brahmin slaughter. What doubt is there in regard to other sins?

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातुम् इच्छामि देवेश ब्रूहि सर्वम् अशेषतः त्वत्तः कमलपत्त्राक्ष विस्तरेण यथातथम् महद् एतद् अचिन्त्यं च यद् अहं दृष्टवान् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: jñātum icchāmi deveśa brūhi sarvam aśeṣataḥ tvattaḥ kamalapattrākṣa vistareṇa yathātatham mahad etad acintyaṃ ca yad ahaṃ dṛṣṭavān prabho
verses.translation: By making obeisance to Vainateya, Garuda son of Vinata who is stationed in front of Krsna, the devotee shall be¬ come, liberated from all sins. He shall then go to the city of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making obeisance to Vainateya, Garuda son of Vinata who is stationed in front of Krsna, the devotee shall be¬ come, liberated from all sins. He shall then go to the city of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्तः स तदा तेन देवदेवो महाद्युतिः सान्त्वयन् स तदा वाक्यम् उवाच वदतां वरः
verses.transliteration: ity uktaḥ sa tadā tena devadevo mahādyutiḥ sāntvayan sa tadā vākyam uvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Purusottama, Samkarsana and Su- bhadra after visiting the banyan tree and Vainateya, attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Purusottama, Samkarsana and Su- bhadra after visiting the banyan tree and Vainateya, attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामं देवाश् च मां विप्र नहि जानन्ति तत्त्वतः तव प्रीत्या प्रवक्ष्यामि यथेदं विसृजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ devāś ca māṃ vipra nahi jānanti tattvataḥ tava prītyā pravakṣyāmi yathedaṃ visṛjāmy aham
verses.translation: After entering the shrine of Visnu and circumambu¬ lating the lord thrice he should worship and propitiate San- karsana and Subliadra, repeating their own Mantra:—
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the shrine of Visnu and circumambu¬ lating the lord thrice he should worship and propitiate San- karsana and Subliadra, repeating their own Mantra:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृभक्तो ऽसि विप्रर्षे माम् एव शरणं गतः ततो दृष्टो ऽस्मि ते साक्षाद् ब्रह्मचर्यं च ते महत्
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhakto 'si viprarṣe mām eva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ tato dṛṣṭo 'smi te sākṣād brahmacaryaṃ ca te mahat
verses.translation: After worshipping the ploughshare-bearing lord thus, the clever devotee shall worship Krsna with great concentra¬ tion uttering the twelve-syllabled Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the ploughshare-bearing lord thus, the clever devotee shall worship Krsna with great concentra¬ tion uttering the twelve-syllabled Mantra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति पुरा संज्ञाकर्म कृतं मया तेन नारायणो ऽस्म्य् उक्तो मम तास् त्व् अयनं सदा
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti purā saṃjñākarma kṛtaṃ mayā tena nārāyaṇo 'smy ukto mama tās tv ayanaṃ sadā
verses.translation: The self-possessed bold persons who devoutly worship Purusottama by reciting the twelve-syllabled Mantra attain Salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-possessed bold persons who devoutly worship Purusottama by reciting the twelve-syllabled Mantra attain Salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं नारायणो नाम प्रभवः शाश्वतो ऽव्ययः विधाता सर्वभूतानां संहर्ता च द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ nārāyaṇo nāma prabhavaḥ śāśvato 'vyayaḥ vidhātā sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃhartā ca dvijottama
verses.translation: O brahmins, neither Devas nor Yogins, nor the Chanters of Saman hymns attain that goal which those who are devoted to the twelve-syllabled Mantra attain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, neither Devas nor Yogins, nor the Chanters of Saman hymns attain that goal which those who are devoted to the twelve-syllabled Mantra attain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं विष्णुर् अहं ब्रह्मा शक्रश् चापि सुराधिपः अहं वैश्रवणो राजा यमः प्रेताधिपस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ viṣṇur ahaṃ brahmā śakraś cāpi surādhipaḥ ahaṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaḥ pretādhipas tathā
verses.translation: Hence, one should devoutly worship Krsna, the pre¬ ceptor of the universe, by reciting that Mantra alone. After worshipping with scents, fragrant flowers, etc. he should bow to the deity and propitiate him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should devoutly worship Krsna, the pre¬ ceptor of the universe, by reciting that Mantra alone. After worshipping with scents, fragrant flowers, etc. he should bow to the deity and propitiate him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहं शिवश् च सोमश् च कश्यपश् च प्रजापतिः अहं धाता विधाता च यज्ञश् चाहं द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ śivaś ca somaś ca kaśyapaś ca prajāpatiḥ ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca yajñaś cāhaṃ dvijottama
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna the man obtains that benefit which has been glorified as the result of holy dip and charitable gifts in the holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna the man obtains that benefit which has been glorified as the result of holy dip and charitable gifts in the holy centres.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् आस्यं क्षितिः पादौ चन्द्रादित्यौ च लोचने द्यौर् मूर्धा खं दिशः श्रोत्रे तथापः स्वेदसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: agnir āsyaṃ kṣitiḥ pādau candrādityau ca locane dyaur mūrdhā khaṃ diśaḥ śrotre tathāpaḥ svedasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which results from a sacrifice where much gold is distri¬ buted together with precious stones and other valuables.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which results from a sacrifice where much gold is distri¬ buted together with precious stones and other valuables.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सदिशं च नभः कायो वायुर् मनसि मे स्थितः मया क्रतुशतैर् इष्टं बहुभिश् चाप्तदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: sadiśaṃ ca nabhaḥ kāyo vāyur manasi me sthitaḥ mayā kratuśatair iṣṭaṃ bahubhiś cāptadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: By making obeisance to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which has been glorified as the result of sacrifices and the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making obeisance to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which has been glorified as the result of sacrifices and the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते वेदविदुषो मां देवयजने स्थितम् पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियेन्द्राश् च पार्थिवाः स्वर्गकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: yajante vedaviduṣo māṃ devayajane sthitam pṛthivyāṃ kṣatriyendrāś ca pārthivāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which is attained by all charitable gifts, holy rites and observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which is attained by all charitable gifts, holy rites and observances.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते मां तथा वैश्याः स्वर्गलोकजिगीषवः चतुःसमुद्रपर्यन्तां मेरुमन्दरभूषणाम्
verses.transliteration: yajante māṃ tathā vaiśyāḥ svargalokajigīṣavaḥ catuḥsamudraparyantāṃ merumandarabhūṣaṇām
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which has been cited as the benefit accruing from diffe¬ rent sorts of severe austerities.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which has been cited as the benefit accruing from diffe¬ rent sorts of severe austerities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शेषो भूत्वाहम् एको हि धारयामि वसुंधराम् वाराहं रूपम् आस्थाय ममेयं जगती पुरा
verses.transliteration: śeṣo bhūtvāham eko hi dhārayāmi vasuṃdharām vārāhaṃ rūpam āsthāya mameyaṃ jagatī purā
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which is glorified as the result of the vow of celibacy perfectly practised.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains that benefit which is glorified as the result of the vow of celibacy perfectly practised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मज्जमाना जले विप्र वीर्येणास्मि समुद्धृता अग्निश् च वाडवो विप्र भूत्वाहं द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: majjamānā jale vipra vīryeṇāsmi samuddhṛtā agniś ca vāḍavo vipra bhūtvāhaṃ dvijasattama
verses.translation: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains the benefit of a householder who strictly adheres to the disciplined conduct of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting and bowing to Krsna a man obtains the benefit of a householder who strictly adheres to the disciplined conduct of life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिबाम्य् अपः समाविष्टस् ताश् चैव विसृजाम्य् अहम् ब्रह्म वक्त्रं भुजौ क्षत्रम् ऊरू मे संश्रिता विशः
verses.transliteration: pibāmy apaḥ samāviṣṭas tāś caiva visṛjāmy aham brahma vaktraṃ bhujau kṣatram ūrū me saṃśritā viśaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पादौ शूद्रा भवन्तीमे विक्रमेण क्रमेण च ऋग्वेदः सामवेदश् च यजुर्वेदस् त्व् अथर्वणः
verses.transliteration: pādau śūdrā bhavantīme vikrameṇa krameṇa ca ṛgvedaḥ sāmavedaś ca yajurvedas tv atharvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He will be engaged in the performance of his own duty. He will be quietly controlling his sense organs. He will be engaged in the welfare of all living beings. Attaining per¬ fect knowledge pertaining to Visnu, he will attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will be engaged in the performance of his own duty. He will be quietly controlling his sense organs. He will be engaged in the welfare of all living beings. Attaining per¬ fect knowledge pertaining to Visnu, he will attain salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मत्तः प्रादुर्भवन्त्य् एते माम् एव प्रविशन्ति च यतयः शान्तिपरमा यतात्मानो बुभुत्सवः
verses.transliteration: mattaḥ prādurbhavanty ete mām eva praviśanti ca yatayaḥ śāntiparamā yatātmāno bubhutsavaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O brahmin, he shall worship Subhadra, favourably disposed towards her devotees by reciting the requisite Mantra. He shall then propitiate her by bowing to her with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O brahmin, he shall worship Subhadra, favourably disposed towards her devotees by reciting the requisite Mantra. He shall then propitiate her by bowing to her with palms joined in reverence.

verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhadveṣamuktā niḥsaṅgā vītakalmaṣāḥ sattvasthā nirahaṃkārā nityam adhyātmakovidāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you O omnipresent Goddess. Obeisance to you the bestower of auspicious happiness. Save me, O God¬ dess with eyes like the petals of a lotus. O KatyayanI, obeis¬ ance be to you, Subhadra.

verses.translation: "The brahmins worship me alone, constantly meditating on me. I am the Samvartaka light, I am the Samvartaka fire,

verses.transliteration: ahaṃ saṃvartakaḥ sūryas tv ahaṃ saṃvartako 'nilaḥ tārārūpāṇi dṛśyante yāny etāni nabhastale
verses.translation: I am the Samvartaka sun, I am the Samvartaka wind. These forms of stars that are seen in the vault of the sky —

verses.transliteration: mama vai romakūpāṇi viddhi tvaṃ dvijasattama ratnākarāḥ samudrāś ca sarva eva caturdiśaḥ
verses.translation: know them to be the pores of my skin, O best of brahmins. The oceans, mines of jewels, all in the four directions —

verses.transliteration: vasanaṃ śayanaṃ caiva nilayaṃ caiva viddhi me kāmaḥ krodhaś ca harṣaś ca bhayaṃ mohas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: know them to be my garment, my bed and my dwelling. Desire, anger, joy, fear and delusion —

verses.sanskrit: ममैव विद्धि रूपाणि सर्वाण्य् एतानि सत्तम प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा विप्र यत् कृत्वा कर्म शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: mamaiva viddhi rūpāṇi sarvāṇy etāni sattama prāpnuvanti narā vipra yat kṛtvā karma śobhanam
verses.translation: know all these to be my forms, O excellent one. That which men obtain by doing good works, O brahmin —

verses.transliteration: satyaṃ dānaṃ tapaś cogram ahiṃsāṃ sarvajantuṣu madvidhānena vihitā mama dehavicāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: truth, charity, fierce austerity and non-violence to all creatures — is ordained by me; they move within my body.

verses.transliteration: mayābhibhūtavijñānāś ceṣṭayanti na kāmataḥ samyag vedam adhīyānā yajanto vividhair makhaiḥ
verses.translation: Their understanding overpowered by me, they act, not by their own will. Studying the Veda properly and sacrificing with various rites,

verses.transliteration: śāntātmāno jitakrodhāḥ prāpnuvanti dvijātayaḥ prāptuṃ śakyo na caivāhaṃ narair duṣkṛtakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: the twice-born, tranquil in mind and with anger conquered, attain me. I cannot be attained by men of evil deeds,

verses.transliteration: lobhābhibhūtaiḥ kṛpaṇair anāryair akṛtātmabhiḥ tan māṃ mahāphalaṃ viddhi narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: overcome by greed, miserly, ignoble and undisciplined. Know me as the great fruit for men of cultivated minds,

verses.transliteration: suduṣprāpaṃ vimūḍhānāṃ māṃ kuyoganiṣeviṇām yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati sattama
verses.translation: very hard to reach for the deluded who follow wrong disciplines. Whenever there is a decline of dharma, O excellent one,

verses.transliteration: abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmy aham daityā hiṃsānuraktāś ca avadhyāḥ surasattamaiḥ
verses.translation: and a rise of adharma, then I bring myself forth. When Daityas devoted to violence, who cannot be slain by the best of gods,

verses.translation: and fearsome Rakshasas arise in this world, then I am born in the houses of those of holy deeds;

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टो मानुषं देहं सर्वं प्रशमयाम्य् अहम् सृष्ट्वा देवमनुष्यांश् च गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭo mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ sarvaṃ praśamayāmy aham sṛṣṭvā devamanuṣyāṃś ca gandharvoragarākṣasān
verses.translation: entering a human body, I pacify everything. Having created gods and men, Gandharvas, serpents and Rakshasas,

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराणि च भूतानि संहराम्य् आत्ममायया कर्मकाले पुनर् देहम् अनुचिन्त्य सृजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃharāmy ātmamāyayā karmakāle punar deham anucintya sṛjāmy aham
verses.translation: and the unmoving beings, I withdraw them through my own maya; at the time of action I reflect again on the body and create.

verses.sanskrit: आविश्य मानुषं देहं मर्यादाबन्धकारणात् श्वेतः कृतयुगे धर्मः श्यामस् त्रेतायुगे मम
verses.transliteration: āviśya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ maryādābandhakāraṇāt śvetaḥ kṛtayuge dharmaḥ śyāmas tretāyuge mama
verses.translation: I enter a human body for the sake of binding the bounds of right order. My dharma is white in the Krita age and dark in the Treta;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्तो द्वापरम् आसाद्य कृष्णः कलियुगे तथा त्रयो भागा ह्य् अधर्मस्य तस्मिन् काले भवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: rakto dvāparam āsādya kṛṣṇaḥ kaliyuge tathā trayo bhāgā hy adharmasya tasmin kāle bhavanti ca
verses.translation: on reaching the Dvapara it is red, and in the Kali age black; at that time three parts are adharma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकाले च संप्राप्ते कालो भूत्वातिदारुणः त्रैलोक्यं नाशयाम्य् एकः सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: antakāle ca saṃprāpte kālo bhūtvātidāruṇaḥ trailokyaṃ nāśayāmy ekaḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: And when the time of the end arrives, becoming Time, exceedingly fierce, I alone destroy the three worlds, all that is unmoving and moving.

verses.sanskrit: अहं त्रिधर्मा विश्वात्मा सर्वलोकसुखावहः अभिन्नः सर्वगो ऽनन्तो हृषीकेश उरुक्रमः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tridharmā viśvātmā sarvalokasukhāvahaḥ abhinnaḥ sarvago 'nanto hṛṣīkeśa urukramaḥ
verses.translation: I am of three dharmas, the soul of the universe, bringer of happiness to all worlds, undivided, all-pervading, endless, Hrishikesha, the wide-striding one.

verses.sanskrit: कालचक्रं नयाम्य् एको ब्रह्मरूपं ममैव तत् शमनं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतकृतोद्यमम्
verses.transliteration: kālacakraṃ nayāmy eko brahmarūpaṃ mamaiva tat śamanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtakṛtodyamam
verses.translation: I alone turn the wheel of time; that form of Brahman is mine alone — the stilling of all beings and the effort made by all beings.

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रणिहितः सम्यङ् ममात्मा मुनिसत्तम सर्वभूतेषु विप्रेन्द्र न च मां वेत्ति कश्चन
verses.transliteration: evaṃ praṇihitaḥ samyaṅ mamātmā munisattama sarvabhūteṣu viprendra na ca māṃ vetti kaścana
verses.translation: Thus my self is well placed in all beings, O best of sages, O best of brahmins, yet no one knows me.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोके च मां भक्ताः पूजयन्ति च सर्वशः यच् च किंचित् त्वया प्राप्तं मयि क्लेशात्मकं द्विज
verses.transliteration: sarvaloke ca māṃ bhaktāḥ pūjayanti ca sarvaśaḥ yac ca kiṃcit tvayā prāptaṃ mayi kleśātmakaṃ dvija
verses.translation: In all the world my devotees worship me in every way. Whatever painful experience you have had in me, O brahmin,

verses.sanskrit: सुखोदयाय तत् सर्वं श्रेयसे च तवानघ यच् च किंचित् त्वया लोके दृष्टं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: sukhodayāya tat sarvaṃ śreyase ca tavānagha yac ca kiṃcit tvayā loke dṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: all of it is for the arising of your happiness and for your good, O sinless one. Whatever unmoving and moving you have seen in the world,

verses.sanskrit: विहितः सर्व एवासौ मयात्मा भूतभावनः अहं नारायणो नाम शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.transliteration: vihitaḥ sarva evāsau mayātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ahaṃ nārāyaṇo nāma śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
verses.translation: all of it is ordained by me, the self who brings beings into existence. I am named Narayana, bearing conch, discus and mace.

verses.transliteration: yāvad yugānāṃ viprarṣe sahasraṃ parivartate tāvat svapimi viśvātmā sarvaviśvāni mohayan
verses.translation: As long as a thousand ages revolve, O brahmin sage, so long I, the soul of the universe, sleep, bewildering all the worlds.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvam ahaṃ kālam ihāse munisattama aśiśuḥ śiśurūpeṇa yāvad brahmā na budhyate
verses.translation: Thus I remain here all this time, O best of sages, not a child yet in the form of a child, until Brahma awakens.

verses.sanskrit: मया च दत्तो विप्रेन्द्र वरस् ते ब्रह्मरूपिणा असकृत् परितुष्टेन विप्रर्षिगणपूजित
verses.transliteration: mayā ca datto viprendra varas te brahmarūpiṇā asakṛt parituṣṭena viprarṣigaṇapūjita
verses.translation: And a boon was given to you by me in the form of Brahma, O best of brahmins, being pleased again and again, O one honoured by hosts of brahmin sages.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वम् एकार्णवं कृत्वा नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे निर्गतो ऽसि मयाज्ञातस् ततस् ते दर्शितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sarvam ekārṇavaṃ kṛtvā naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame nirgato 'si mayājñātas tatas te darśitaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Having made all one ocean, when moving and unmoving had perished, you came forth unknown to me; then the world was shown to you.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यन्तरं शरीरस्य प्रविष्टो ऽसि यदा मम दृष्ट्वा लोकं समस्तं हि विस्मितो नावबुध्यसे
verses.transliteration: abhyantaraṃ śarīrasya praviṣṭo 'si yadā mama dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ samastaṃ hi vismito nāvabudhyase
verses.translation: When you entered the inside of my body and saw the whole world, you were astonished and did not understand.

verses.transliteration: tato 'si vaktrād viprarṣe drutaṃ niḥsārito mayā ākhyātas te mayā cātmā durjñeyo hi surāsuraiḥ
verses.translation: Then, O brahmin sage, you were quickly expelled by me from my mouth, and my self, hard for gods and Asuras to know, has been declared to you.

verses.transliteration: yāvat sa bhagavān brahmā na budhyeta mahātapāḥ tāvat tvam iha viprarṣe viśrabdhaś cara vai sukham
verses.translation: Until that Lord Brahma of great austerity awakens, so long, O brahmin sage, move about here happily and without fear.

verses.transliteration: tato vibuddhe tasmiṃs tu sarvalokapitāmahe eko bhūtāni srakṣyāmi śarīrāṇi dvijottama
verses.translation: Then, when that grandsire of all worlds has awakened, I alone will create beings and bodies, O best of brahmins —

verses.sanskrit: आकाशं पृथिवीं ज्योतिर् वायुः सलिलम् एव च लोके यच् च भवेत् किंचिद् इह स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ jyotir vāyuḥ salilam eva ca loke yac ca bhavet kiṃcid iha sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: space, earth, light, wind and water, and whatever unmoving and moving there may be here in the world."

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tadā viprāḥ punas taṃ prāha mādhavaḥ pūrṇe yugasahasre tu meghagambhīranisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, O brahmins, Madhava spoke to him again when a full thousand ages had passed, with a voice deep as a cloud:

verses.sanskrit: मुने ब्रूहि यदर्थं मां स्तुतवान् परमार्थतः वरं वृणीष्व यच् छ्रेष्ठं ददामि नचिराद् अहम्
verses.transliteration: mune brūhi yadarthaṃ māṃ stutavān paramārthataḥ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yac chreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi nacirād aham
verses.translation: "O sage, tell me truly for what purpose you praised me. Choose the best boon; I will give it without delay.

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्मान् असि देवानां मद्भक्तो ऽसि दृढव्रतः तेन त्वम् असि विप्रेन्द्र पुनर् दीर्घायुर् आप्नुहि
verses.transliteration: āyuṣmān asi devānāṃ madbhakto 'si dṛḍhavrataḥ tena tvam asi viprendra punar dīrghāyur āpnuhi
verses.translation: You are long-lived among the gods, my devotee of firm vows; therefore, O best of brahmins, obtain long life again."

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃ hi deveśa tava rūpaṃ dvijottama moho 'yaṃ vigataḥ satyaṃ tvayi dṛṣṭe tu me hare
verses.translation: "I have seen your supreme form, O lord of the gods; truly this delusion of mine has gone now that I have seen you, O Hari.

verses.transliteration: śaivabhāgavatānāṃ ca vādārthapratiṣedhakam asmin kṣetravare puṇye nirmale puruṣottame
verses.translation: a refutation of the arguments of the Shaivas and Bhagavatas: in this excellent, holy, pure region of Purushottama

verses.transliteration: śivasyāyatanaṃ deva karomi paramaṃ mahat pratiṣṭheya tathā tatra tava sthāne ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: I shall build a supreme and great temple of Shiva, O god, and install Shankara there in your place.

verses.translation: Then people in this world will know that Hari and Ishvara are of one form." The lord of the world answered that great sage again:

verses.translation: at my command, O best of brahmins, quickly build a temple of Shiva; by its power you will dwell imperishably in Shiva's world.

verses.sanskrit: शिवे संस्थापिते विप्र मम संस्थापनं भवेत् नावयोर् अन्तरं किंचिद् एकभावौ द्विधा कृतौ
verses.transliteration: śive saṃsthāpite vipra mama saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet nāvayor antaraṃ kiṃcid ekabhāvau dvidhā kṛtau
verses.translation: When Shiva is installed, O brahmin, I shall be installed; there is no difference between us, one nature made twofold.

verses.transliteration: yo rudraḥ sa svayaṃ viṣṇur yo viṣṇuḥ sa maheśvaraḥ ubhayor antaraṃ nāsti pavanākāśayor iva
verses.translation: He who is Rudra is Vishnu himself, and he who is Vishnu is Maheshvara; there is no difference between the two, as between wind and space.

verses.transliteration: mohito nābhijānāti ya eva garuḍadhvajaḥ vṛṣadhvajaḥ sa eveti tripuraghnaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: The deluded one does not know that he who is Garuda-bannered is himself the bull-bannered one, the three-eyed destroyer of Tripura.

verses.transliteration: tava nāmāṅkitaṃ tasmāt kuru vipra śivālayam uttare devadevasya kuru tīrthaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Therefore, O brahmin, build a temple of Shiva marked with your name, and to the north of the god of gods make a very beautiful holy place;

verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahrado nāma naralokeṣu viśrutaḥ bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ
verses.translation: it will be famed in the world of men as Markandeya's Pool, O best of brahmins, destroying all sins."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा स तदा देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत मार्कण्डेयं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्वव्यापी जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa tadā devas tatraivāntaradhīyata mārkaṇḍeyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvavyāpī janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, O best of sages, the god, the all-pervading Janardana, vanished right there before Markandeya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पञ्चतीर्थविधिं द्विजाः यत् फलं स्नानदानेन देवताप्रेक्षणेन च
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcatīrthavidhiṃ dvijāḥ yat phalaṃ snānadānena devatāprekṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: By thus visiting and bowing to Bala, Krsna and Su- bhadra, the devotee obtains virtue, wealth, love and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: By thus visiting and bowing to Bala, Krsna and Su- bhadra, the devotee obtains virtue, wealth, love and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदं गत्वा नरश् चोदङ्मुखः शुचिः निमज्जेत् तत्र वारांस् त्रीन् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahradaṃ gatvā naraś codaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ nimajjet tatra vārāṃs trīn imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: He returns to his abode where lord Visnu's idol, made of lapis lazuli, is covered up by sands. By bowing to the lord who vanished there he enters the city of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He returns to his abode where lord Visnu's idol, made of lapis lazuli, is covered up by sands. By bowing to the lord who vanished there he enters the city of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संसारसागरे मग्नं पापग्रस्तम् अचेतनम् त्राहि मां भगनेत्रघ्न त्रिपुरारे नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastam acetanam trāhi māṃ bhaganetraghna tripurāre namo 'stu te
verses.translation: By devoutly visiting Narasimha lord, and by bowing to him one is liberated from all sins. There is no doubt in this.
verses.commentary: Sense: By devoutly visiting Narasimha lord, and by bowing to him one is liberated from all sins. There is no doubt in this.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय सर्वपापहराय च स्नानं करोमि देवेश मम नश्यतु पातकम्
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca snānaṃ karomi deveśa mama naśyatu pātakam
verses.translation: Hence, by all means one shall resort to Narasimha since he bestows the benefit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by all means one shall resort to Narasimha since he bestows the benefit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाभिमात्रे जले स्नात्वा विधिवद् देवता ऋषीन् तिलोदकेन मतिमान् पितॄंश् चान्यांश् च तर्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: nābhimātre jale snātvā vidhivad devatā ṛṣīn tilodakena matimān pitṝṃś cānyāṃś ca tarpayet
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, we wish to hear the power of that lord in detail. Our eagerness is very great.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the universe, we wish to hear the power of that lord in detail. Our eagerness is very great.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तथैव चाचम्य ततो गच्छेच् छिवालयम् प्रविश्य देवतागारं कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tathaiva cācamya tato gacchec chivālayam praviśya devatāgāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: O lord, obeisance be to you. For rendering help to devotees, tell us how Narasimha, the lord of great strength becomes pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, obeisance be to you. For rendering help to devotees, tell us how Narasimha, the lord of great strength becomes pleased.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मूलमन्त्रेण संपूज्य मार्कण्डेयस्य चेश्वरम् अघोरेण च भो विप्राः प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: mūlamantreṇa saṃpūjya mārkaṇḍeyasya ceśvaram aghoreṇa ca bho viprāḥ praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: We hear many human and divine accomplishments which are undoubtedly realized by the favour of that lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: We hear many human and divine accomplishments which are undoubtedly realized by the favour of that lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिलोचन नमस् ते ऽस्तु नमस् ते शशिभूषण त्राहि मां त्वं विरूपाक्ष महादेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: trilocana namas te 'stu namas te śaśibhūṣaṇa trāhi māṃ tvaṃ virūpākṣa mahādeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Due to the favour of that lord, one's movement be¬ comes unimpeded in the mortal world, heaven, netherworlds, quarters, water, city as well as mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the favour of that lord, one's movement be¬ comes unimpeded in the mortal world, heaven, netherworlds, quarters, water, city as well as mountain.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयह्रदे त्व् एवं स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा च शंकरम् दशानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyahrade tv evaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkaram daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: In this world including the mobile and immobile beings O brahmins, there is nothing impossible to achieve for lord Narasimha who is always sympathetic to his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world including the mobile and immobile beings O brahmins, there is nothing impossible to achieve for lord Narasimha who is always sympathetic to his devotees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापैः सर्वैर् विनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोकं स गच्छति तत्र भुक्त्वा वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: pāpaiḥ sarvair vinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: I shall mention the mode of procedure for the worship of the lord. This is helpful to his devotees. I shall mention what it is whereby the deity with half the body of a lion is propitiated.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the mode of procedure for the worship of the lord. This is helpful to his devotees. I shall mention what it is whereby the deity with half the body of a lion is propitiated.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इहलोकं समासाद्य भवेद् विप्रो बहुश्रुतः शांकरं योगम् आसाद्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ihalokaṃ samāsādya bhaved vipro bahuśrutaḥ śāṃkaraṃ yogam āsādya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen to the eternal Kalparaja (Royal ritual), the real principle of Narasimha which has not been understood by Devas and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, listen to the eternal Kalparaja (Royal ritual), the real principle of Narasimha which has not been understood by Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पवृक्षं ततो गत्वा कृत्वा तं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या मन्त्रेणानेन तं वटम्
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam pūjayet parayā bhaktyā mantreṇānena taṃ vaṭam
verses.translation: O brahmins, the leading aspirant devotee should subsist on a diet of milk accompanied by greens, roots, barley food, fruits, fried grain powder and oil cake.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the leading aspirant devotee should subsist on a diet of milk accompanied by greens, roots, barley food, fruits, fried grain powder and oil cake.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो व्यक्तरूपाय महाप्रलयकारिणे महद्रसोपविष्टाय न्यग्रोधाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo vyaktarūpāya mahāpralayakāriṇe mahadrasopaviṣṭāya nyagrodhāya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: It should also protect from all those enemies such as Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Nagas, goblins, demons as well as similar antagonists.
verses.commentary: Sense: It should also protect from all those enemies such as Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Nagas, goblins, demons as well as similar antagonists.

verses.transliteration: amaras tvaṃ sadā kalpe hareś cāyatanaṃ vaṭa nyagrodha hara me pāpaṃ kalpavṛkṣa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The learned aspirant shall unhesitatingly enter the Crevasse with the coat of mail on, as he goes ahead, his diffi¬ culty, darkness and delusion perish.

verses.transliteration: bhaktyā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā natvā kalpavaṭaṃ naraḥ sahasā mucyate pāpāj jīrṇatvaca ivoragaḥ
verses.translation: A wide royal road beautified by humming bees becomes visible. O brahmins, remembering Narasimha he enters the nether worlds.

verses.translation: The amulet (inspired with Narasimha Mantra)' tied round the neck of children affords a permanent protection: It destroys tumour, pustule, boils, as well as spider poison.

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ brahmatejomayaṃ param nyagrodhākṛtikaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇipatya ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: If afflicted by ailments, the devotee should perform a sacrifice with sacrificial twigs, ghee and milk, thrice a day during the junctions (i.e. dawn, midday and dusk). If this is continued for a month it will dispel all ailments.

verses.sanskrit: राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति चाधिकम् तथा स्ववंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam tathā svavaṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Hence, O leading sages, the devotee should always worship the lord of beasts, of great power, the bestower of all desires.

verses.transliteration: vainateyaṃ namaskṛtya kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitam sarvapāpavinirmuktas tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Bowing to Vainateya standing before Krishna, one is freed from all sins and then goes to Vishnu's city.

verses.translation: Whoever, having seen the banyan and Vainateya, sees Purushottama, Sankarshana and Subhadra, goes to the supreme goal.

verses.translation: Entering Vishnu's temple and circumambulating it three times, one should worship Sankarshana with devotion using his own mantra and propitiate him:

verses.transliteration: namas te balināṃ śreṣṭha namas te dharaṇīdhara pralambāre namas te 'stu trāhi māṃ kṛṣṇapūrvaja
verses.translation: salutation to you, best of the strong; salutation to you, upholder of the earth; enemy of Pralamba, salutation to you; protect me, elder brother of Krishna."

verses.translation: Having thus propitiated Ananta, the invincible, worshipped by the gods, shaped like the peak of Kailasa, with a face lovelier than the moon,

verses.translation: the god clad in blue, his head fearsome with hoods, the mighty plough-bearer adorned with a single earring,

verses.transliteration: rauhiṇeyaṃ naro bhaktyā labhed abhimataṃ phalam sarvapāpair vinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: the son of Rohini, a man obtains with devotion the fruit he desires; freed from all sins, he goes to Vishnu's world.

verses.translation: becoming the foremost of brahmins, master of the meaning of all scriptures, he attains knowledge there and reaches rare liberation.

verses.transliteration: dviṣaṭkavarṇamantreṇa bhaktyā ye puruṣottamam pūjayanti sadā dhīrās te mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai
verses.translation: The steadfast who always worship Purushottama with devotion using the twelve-syllable mantra surely attain liberation.

verses.transliteration: na tāṃ gatiṃ surā yānti yogino naiva somapāḥ yāṃ gatiṃ yānti bho viprā dvādaśākṣaratatparāḥ
verses.translation: Neither gods, nor yogins, nor Soma-drinkers reach the goal that those devoted to the twelve-syllable mantra reach, O brahmins.

verses.translation: victory, lotus-eyed one; victory, bearer of discus and mace; victory, dark as a blue cloud; victory, giver of all happiness;

verses.translation: victory, god worshipped by the world; victory, destroyer of worldly existence; victory, lord of the worlds, master; victory, giver of the fruit of wishes.

verses.translation: muddy with the waves of various diseases, very hard to cross with whirlpools of delusion — I am sunk, O best of gods; save me, Purushottama."

verses.translation: Whatever fruit is declared for bathing and giving at all holy places, a man obtains that fruit by seeing Krishna and bowing.

verses.translation: Whatever fruit belongs to a householder who follows the prescribed conduct, a man obtains that fruit by seeing Krishna and bowing.

verses.transliteration: kiṃ cātra bahunoktena māhātmye tasya bho dvijāḥ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham
verses.translation: What need to say more about his greatness, O brahmins? Seeing Krishna with devotion, a man attains rare liberation.

verses.transliteration: pāpair vimuktaḥ śuddhātmā kalpakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Freed from sins arising over crores of kalpas, pure in heart, endowed with supreme glory and all virtues,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामसमृद्धेन विमानेन सुवर्चसा त्रिसप्तकुलम् उद्धृत्य नरो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānena suvarcasā trisaptakulam uddhṛtya naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: in a radiant celestial car rich in every desire, raising twenty-one generations, a man goes to Vishnu's city.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कल्पशतं यावद् भुक्त्वा भोगान् मनोरमान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसैः सार्धं यथा विष्णुश् चतुर्भुजः
verses.transliteration: tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvad bhuktvā bhogān manoramān gandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā viṣṇuś caturbhujaḥ
verses.translation: Enjoying charming pleasures there for a hundred kalpas with Gandharvas and Apsarases, like four-armed Vishnu,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: च्युतस् तस्माद् इहायातो विप्राणां प्रवरे कुले सर्वज्ञः सर्ववेदी च जायते गतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: cyutas tasmād ihāyāto viprāṇāṃ pravare kule sarvajñaḥ sarvavedī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: falling from there and coming here, he is born in an excellent family of brahmins, all-knowing, versed in all the Vedas and free from envy,

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतः शान्तो दाता भूतहिते रतः आसाद्य वैष्णवं ज्ञानं ततो मुक्तिम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: svadharmanirataḥ śānto dātā bhūtahite rataḥ āsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ tato muktim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: devoted to his own dharma, tranquil, generous and devoted to the welfare of beings; attaining the knowledge of Vishnu, he then attains liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः संपूज्य मन्त्रेण सुभद्रां भक्तवत्सलाम् प्रसादयेत् ततो विप्राः प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃpūjya mantreṇa subhadrāṃ bhaktavatsalām prasādayet tato viprāḥ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Then, having worshipped Subhadra, loving to her devotees, with her mantra, one should propitiate her, O brahmins, bowing with joined palms:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमस् ते सर्वगे देवि नमस् ते शुभसौख्यदे त्राहि मां पद्मपत्त्राक्षि कात्यायनि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namas te sarvage devi namas te śubhasaukhyade trāhi māṃ padmapattrākṣi kātyāyani namo 'stu te
verses.translation: "Salutation to you, all-pervading Goddess; salutation to you, giver of auspicious happiness; protect me, lotus-eyed one; Katyayani, salutation to you."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रसाद्य तां देवीं जगद्धात्रीं जगद्धिताम् बलदेवस्य भगिनीं सुभद्रां वरदां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prasādya tāṃ devīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ jagaddhitām baladevasya bhaginīṃ subhadrāṃ varadāṃ śivām
verses.translation: Having thus propitiated that Goddess, sustainer and benefactor of the world, Subhadra, sister of Baladeva, the boon-giving auspicious one,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कामगेन विमानेन नरो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् आभूतसंप्लवं यावत् क्रीडित्वा तत्र देववत्
verses.transliteration: kāmagena vimānena naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvat krīḍitvā tatra devavat
verses.translation: a man goes to Vishnu's city in a celestial car that moves at will; having sported there like a god until the dissolution of beings,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इह मानुषतां प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणो वेदविद् भवेत् प्राप्य योगं हरेस् तत्र मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: iha mānuṣatāṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vedavid bhavet prāpya yogaṃ hares tatra mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: on attaining human birth here he becomes a brahmin learned in the Veda, and attaining the yoga of Hari there, he surely obtains liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्ट्वा बलं कृष्णं सुभद्रां प्रणिपत्य च धर्मं चार्थं च कामं च मोक्षं च लभते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ praṇipatya ca dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: He has been propitiated by me and thereafter by Indra, Vibhlsana 1 and Rama. Who does not wish to be propitiated?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: He has been propitiated by me and thereafter by Indra, Vibhlsana 1 and Rama. Who does not wish to be propitiated?

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रम्य देवतागारात् कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः प्रणम्यायतनं पश्चाद् व्रजेत् तत्र समाहितः
verses.transliteration: niṣkramya devatāgārāt kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ praṇamyāyatanaṃ paścād vrajet tatra samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The man who takes holy dip in the Svetaganga and visits Svetamadhava as well as Matsya Madhava (Lord Visnu in the form of a fish) goes to Svetadvlpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who takes holy dip in the Svetaganga and visits Svetamadhava as well as Matsya Madhava (Lord Visnu in the form of a fish) goes to Svetadvlpa.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रनीलमयो विष्णुर् यत्रास्ते वालुकावृतः अन्तर्धानगतं नत्वा ततो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: indranīlamayo viṣṇur yatrāste vālukāvṛtaḥ antardhānagataṃ natvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: In his kingdom, men used to live upto ten thousand years without sickness. No body perished or was despondant in that kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his kingdom, men used to live upto ten thousand years without sickness. No body perished or was despondant in that kingdom.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवमयो यो ऽसौ हतवान् असुरोत्तमम् स आस्ते तत्र भो विप्राः सिंहार्धकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: sarvadevamayo yo 'sau hatavān asurottamam sa āste tatra bho viprāḥ siṃhārdhakṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the surpassing devotion of the king, the Lord of the universe came there together with Yama and said C T am delighted and satisfied".
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the surpassing devotion of the king, the Lord of the universe came there together with Yama and said C T am delighted and satisfied".

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या दृष्ट्वा तु तं देवं प्रणम्य नरकेसरीम् मुच्यते पातकैर् मर्त्यः समस्तैर् नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ praṇamya narakesarīm mucyate pātakair martyaḥ samastair nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Sveta, lord Mahesvara be¬ came joyous. He called the God of death who is terrible to all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Sveta, lord Mahesvara be¬ came joyous. He called the God of death who is terrible to all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरसिंहस्य ये भक्ता भवन्ति भुवि मानवाः न तेषां दुष्कृतं किंचित् फलं स्याद् यद् यद् ईप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: narasiṃhasya ye bhaktā bhavanti bhuvi mānavāḥ na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcit phalaṃ syād yad yad īpsitam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, he restrained the unthwartable Kala, the
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmins, he restrained the unthwartable Kala, the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन नरसिंहं समाश्रयेत् धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां फलं यस्मात् प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena narasiṃhaṃ samāśrayet dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalaṃ yasmāt prayacchati
verses.translation: O Lord of Devas, O Lord of the Universe, O unchang¬ ing source of origin of the three worlds, tell us now the greatest fact of the deity named Sveta.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of Devas, O Lord of the Universe, O unchang¬ ing source of origin of the three worlds, tell us now the greatest fact of the deity named Sveta.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: माहात्म्यं नरसिंहस्य सुखदं भुवि दुर्लभम् यथा कथयसे देव तेन नो विस्मयो महान्
verses.transliteration: māhātmyaṃ narasiṃhasya sukhadaṃ bhuvi durlabham yathā kathayase deva tena no vismayo mahān
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, O sinless ones, for the welfare of all living beings I shall mention factually what you ask of me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O leading sages, O sinless ones, for the welfare of all living beings I shall mention factually what you ask of me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावं तस्य देवस्य विस्तरेण जगत्पते श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: prabhāvaṃ tasya devasya vistareṇa jagatpate śrotum icchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, I have heard his anecdote formerly from the sages, the divine story of the deity called Madhava. Listen to that story which dispels fear, grief and agony.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, I have heard his anecdote formerly from the sages, the divine story of the deity called Madhava. Listen to that story which dispels fear, grief and agony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रसीदेद् देवो ऽसौ नरसिंहो महाबलः भक्तानाम् उपकाराय ब्रूहि देव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: yathā prasīded devo 'sau narasiṃho mahābalaḥ bhaktānām upakārāya brūhi deva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Vasudeva, obeisance to Samkarsana, obeisance to Pradyumna, Aniruddha, obeisance to Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to Vasudeva, obeisance to Samkarsana, obeisance to Pradyumna, Aniruddha, obeisance to Narayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादान् नरसिंहस्य या भवन्त्य् अत्र सिद्धयः ब्रूहि ताः कुरु चास्माकं प्रसादं प्रपितामह
verses.transliteration: prasādān narasiṃhasya yā bhavanty atra siddhayaḥ brūhi tāḥ kuru cāsmākaṃ prasādaṃ prapitāmaha
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the deity with the umbilical lotus, to the source of origin of the lotus-born lord; to the lotus-coloured one, to you with the lotus in hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to the deity with the umbilical lotus, to the source of origin of the lotus-born lord; to the lotus-coloured one, to you with the lotus in hand.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ tasya bho viprāḥ prabhāvaṃ gadato mama ajitasyāprameyasya bhuktimuktipradasya ca
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the lotus-eyed bountiful lord with a thousand eyes i obeisance to the thousand-footed, thousand¬ armed and thousand-furied lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to the lotus-eyed bountiful lord with a thousand eyes i obeisance to the thousand-footed, thousand¬ armed and thousand-furied lord.

verses.sanskrit: कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं समस्तांस् तस्य भो द्विजाः सिंहार्धकृतदेहस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samastāṃs tasya bho dvijāḥ siṃhārdhakṛtadehasya pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Varaha (Boar), the bestower of boons, the most excellent, the most praise-worthy deity of good intellect, Acyuta of gold complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to Varaha (Boar), the bestower of boons, the most excellent, the most praise-worthy deity of good intellect, Acyuta of gold complexion.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याः काश्चित् सिद्धयश् चात्र श्रूयन्ते दैवमानुषाः प्रसादात् तस्य ताः सर्वाः सिध्यन्ति नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yāḥ kāścit siddhayaś cātra śrūyante daivamānuṣāḥ prasādāt tasya tāḥ sarvāḥ sidhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the lord in the form of a boy, obe¬ isance to the deity with the lustre of a tender lotus, obeisance to the deity with the rising sun and the moon for the eyes, obeisance to the lord with the tresses resembling Munja grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to the lord in the form of a boy, obe¬ isance to the deity with the lustre of a tender lotus, obeisance to the deity with the rising sun and the moon for the eyes, obeisance to the lord with the tresses resembling Munja grass.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च पाताले दिक्षु तोये पुरे नगे प्रसादात् तस्य देवस्य भवत्य् अव्याहता गतिः
verses.transliteration: svarge martye ca pātāle dikṣu toye pure nage prasādāt tasya devasya bhavaty avyāhatā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Kesava, obeisance to Narayana. Obeisance to Madhava, obeisance to Govinda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Kesava, obeisance to Narayana. Obeisance to Madhava, obeisance to Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: असाध्यं तस्य देवस्य नास्त्य् अत्र सचराचरे नरसिंहस्य भो विप्राः सदा भक्तानुकम्पिनः
verses.transliteration: asādhyaṃ tasya devasya nāsty atra sacarācare narasiṃhasya bho viprāḥ sadā bhaktānukampinaḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Visnu, obeisance to the lord endowed with wealth and strength; obeisance to the slayer of Madhu, to one who holds pure rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to Visnu, obeisance to the lord endowed with wealth and strength; obeisance to the slayer of Madhu, to one who holds pure rays.

verses.transliteration: ūṣare siddhakṣetre ca narasiṃhāśrame tathā pratiṣṭhāpya svayaṃ vāpi pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ

verses.translation: Obeisance to Hrslkesa 1 of brightly illuminated form. Obeisance to you, lord Vasudeva. Obeisance to you Narayana.

verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity conducive to the welfare of the. world. Om obeisance to the destroyer of delusion. Obeisance to one who breaks existence.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिर्जप्तं कवचं दिव्यम् अभेद्यं च सुरासुरैः द्वादशाभ्यन्तरे चैव योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: trirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyam abhedyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ dvādaśābhyantare caiva yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Yogins; obeisance to Rama who redeems all; obeisance to happiness; obeisance to the happy-eyed; obeisance to the upholder of merits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Yogins; obeisance to Rama who redeems all; obeisance to happiness; obeisance to the happy-eyed; obeisance to the upholder of merits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रक्षते भगवान् देवो नरसिंहो महाबलः ततो गत्वा बिलद्वारम् उपोष्य रजनीत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣate bhagavān devo narasiṃho mahābalaḥ tato gatvā biladvāram upoṣya rajanītrayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to Vasudeva worthy of being saluted; obeisance to Vamadeva; obeisance to one who creates bodies for the embodied souls; obeisance to the breaker of difference.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Vasudeva worthy of being saluted; obeisance to Vamadeva; obeisance to one who creates bodies for the embodied souls; obeisance to the breaker of difference.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पलाशकाष्ठैः प्रज्वाल्य भगवन्तं हुताशनम् पलाशसमिधस् तत्र जुहुयात् त्रिमधुप्लुताः
verses.transliteration: palāśakāṣṭhaiḥ prajvālya bhagavantaṃ hutāśanam palāśasamidhas tatra juhuyāt trimadhuplutāḥ
verses.translation: Om obeisance to the maker of riches; obeisance to one who bestows riches and residence; obeisance to the deity of the form of sacrifice; obeisance to the lord of sacrifices; obeisance to the Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to the maker of riches; obeisance to one who bestows riches and residence; obeisance to the deity of the form of sacrifice; obeisance to the lord of sacrifices; obeisance to the Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे शते द्विजशार्दूला वषट्कारेण साधकः ततो विवरद्वारं तु प्रकटं जायते क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: dve śate dvijaśārdūlā vaṣaṭkāreṇa sādhakaḥ tato vivaradvāraṃ tu prakaṭaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of ascetics who preach Yoga. Obeisance to one who holds a discus; obeisance to Samkarsana; obeisance to one who slew Pralamba. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of ascetics who preach Yoga. Obeisance to one who holds a discus; obeisance to Samkarsana; obeisance to one who slew Pralamba. 2

verses.sanskrit: ततो विशेत् तु निःशङ्कं कवची विवरं बुधः गच्छतः संकटं तस्य तमोमोहश् च नश्यति
verses.transliteration: tato viśet tu niḥśaṅkaṃ kavacī vivaraṃ budhaḥ gacchataḥ saṃkaṭaṃ tasya tamomohaś ca naśyati
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holder of ploughshare whose velocity is great and whose sound resembles the sound of clouds. Obeisance to you a perfect knowledge of the wise, O Narayana the ultimate resort of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the holder of ploughshare whose velocity is great and whose sound resembles the sound of clouds. Obeisance to you a perfect knowledge of the wise, O Narayana the ultimate resort of all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजमार्गः सुविस्तीर्णो दृश्यते भ्रमराजितः नरसिंहं स्मरंस् तत्र पातालं विशते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: rājamārgaḥ suvistīrṇo dṛśyate bhramarājitaḥ narasiṃhaṃ smaraṃs tatra pātālaṃ viśate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord excepting you, I haye no other kinsmen or guide for redeeming me from hell. Hence, O deity favourably disposed towards those who bow down, I bow to you with emotional fervour.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord excepting you, I haye no other kinsmen or guide for redeeming me from hell. Hence, O deity favourably disposed towards those who bow down, I bow to you with emotional fervour.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र जपेत् तत्त्वं नरसिंहाख्यम् अव्ययम् ततः स्त्रीणां सहस्राणि वीणावादनकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra japet tattvaṃ narasiṃhākhyam avyayam tataḥ strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi vīṇāvādanakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Hr$\kefa: One who has controlled the sense-organs that is a yogin. Krsna is said to be yogesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hr$\kefa: One who has controlled the sense-organs that is a yogin. Krsna is said to be yogesvara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निर्गच्छन्ति पुरो विप्राः स्वागतं ता वदन्ति च प्रवेशयन्ति ता हस्ते गृहीत्वा साधकेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nirgacchanti puro viprāḥ svāgataṃ tā vadanti ca praveśayanti tā haste gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaram
verses.translation: Pralamba: an asura who attacked Srikrsna and Balarama but was killed by the latter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pralamba: an asura who attacked Srikrsna and Balarama but was killed by the latter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो रसायनं दिव्यं पाययन्ति द्विजोत्तमाः पीतमात्रे दिव्यदेहो जायते सुमहाबलः
verses.transliteration: tato rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ pāyayanti dvijottamāḥ pītamātre divyadeho jāyate sumahābalaḥ
verses.translation: I have approached you after eschewing all sorts of contacts and unions. O Kesava, may my contact remain with you for attaining self-realization.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have approached you after eschewing all sorts of contacts and unions. O Kesava, may my contact remain with you for attaining self-realization.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडते सह कन्याभिर् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम् भिन्नदेहो वासुदेवे लीयते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: krīḍate saha kanyābhir yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam bhinnadeho vāsudeve līyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Kesava, I know that this worldly existence is full of pain. It is impossible to cross it during adversities. I am afflicted by my threefold searching tortures. Hence, I seek refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kesava, I know that this worldly existence is full of pain. It is impossible to cross it during adversities. I am afflicted by my threefold searching tortures. Hence, I seek refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: यदा न रोचते वासस् तस्मान् निर्गच्छते पुनः पट्टं शूलं च खड्गं च रोचनां च मणिं तथा
verses.transliteration: yadā na rocate vāsas tasmān nirgacchate punaḥ paṭṭaṃ śūlaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca rocanāṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā
verses.translation: On hearing these nectar-like words of the Lord of Devas, Sveta bent down his head with devotion and said with his mind concentrating on the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these nectar-like words of the Lord of Devas, Sveta bent down his head with devotion and said with his mind concentrating on the lord.

verses.sanskrit: रसं रसायनं चैव पादुकाञ्जनम् एव च कृष्णाजिनं मुनिश्रेष्ठा गुटिकां च मनोहराम्
verses.transliteration: rasaṃ rasāyanaṃ caiva pādukāñjanam eva ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ muniśreṣṭhā guṭikāṃ ca manoharām
verses.translation: O leading king, your glory will spread throughout the world. I will always be present here.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुं चाक्षसूत्रं यष्टिं संजीवनीं तथा सिद्धविद्यां च शास्त्राणि गृहीत्वा साधकेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍaluṃ cākṣasūtraṃ yaṣṭiṃ saṃjīvanīṃ tathā siddhavidyāṃ ca śāstrāṇi gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Taking a water-pot, a rosary, a staff, the life-restoring herb, the perfected knowledge and the scriptures, the lord of practitioners,

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलद्वह्निस्फुलिङ्गोर्मिवेष्टितं त्रिशिखं हृदि सकृन् न्यस्तं दहेत् सर्वं वृजिनं जन्मकोटिजम्
verses.transliteration: jvaladvahnisphuliṅgormiveṣṭitaṃ triśikhaṃ hṛdi sakṛn nyastaṃ dahet sarvaṃ vṛjinaṃ janmakoṭijam
verses.translation: placing once in the heart the three-pointed form encircled by waves of blazing sparks of fire, burns up all sin born over crores of births.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विषे न्यस्तं विषं हन्यात् कुष्ठं हन्यात् तनौ स्थितम् स्वदेहे भ्रूणहत्यादि कृत्वा दिव्येन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: viṣe nyastaṃ viṣaṃ hanyāt kuṣṭhaṃ hanyāt tanau sthitam svadehe bhrūṇahatyādi kṛtvā divyena śudhyati
verses.translation: Placed on poison, it destroys poison; placed on the body, it destroys leprosy; one who has committed the killing of an embryo and the like is purified in his own body by this divine means.

verses.transliteration: mahāgrahagṛhīteṣu jvalamānaṃ vicintayet hṛdante vai tataḥ śīghraṃ naśyeyur dāruṇā grahāḥ
verses.translation: For those seized by great planetary spirits, one should contemplate it blazing within the heart; then the fierce spirits quickly perish.

verses.transliteration: bālānāṃ kaṇṭhake baddhaṃ rakṣā bhavati nityaśaḥ gaṇḍapiṇḍakalūtānāṃ nāśanaṃ kurute dhruvam
verses.translation: Tied on the necks of children it is a constant protection; it surely destroys boils, lumps and spider-poison.

verses.transliteration: vyādhijāte samidbhiś ca ghṛtakṣīreṇa homayet trisaṃdhyaṃ māsam ekaṃ tu sarvarogān vināśayet
verses.translation: When disease arises, one should offer fuel-sticks with ghee and milk; doing so at the three junctions for a month destroys all diseases.

verses.transliteration: asādhyaṃ tu na paśyāmi trailokye sacarācare yāṃ yāṃ kāmayate siddhiṃ tāṃ tāṃ prāpnoti sa dhruvam
verses.translation: I see nothing impossible in the three worlds, moving and unmoving; whatever perfection he desires, that he surely obtains.

verses.transliteration: aṣṭottaraśataṃ tv eke pūjayitvā mṛgādhipam mṛttikāḥ sapta valmīke śmaśāne ca catuṣpathe
verses.translation: Some, having worshipped the lord of beasts a hundred and eight times, take seven kinds of earth from an anthill, a cremation ground and a crossroads,

verses.transliteration: raktacandanasaṃmiśrā gavāṃ kṣīreṇa loḍayet siṃhasya pratimāṃ kṛtvā pramāṇena ṣaḍaṅgulām
verses.translation: mix them with red sandal and knead them with cow's milk, and make an image of the lion six finger-breadths in size;

verses.transliteration: limpet tathā bhūrjapattre rocanayā samālikhet narasiṃhasya kaṇṭhe tu baddhvā caiva hi mantravit
verses.translation: one should anoint it and write on birch-bark with gorochana; and the knower of mantras, tying it to Narasimha's neck,

verses.transliteration: japet saṃkhyāvihīnaṃ tu pūjayitvā jalāśaye yāvat saptāhamātraṃ tu japet saṃyamitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: should recite without count after worshipping it in a reservoir; he should recite for a week with senses controlled.

verses.translation: Within a moment the whole earth becomes covered with water. Or one should worship Narasimha on the top of a dry tree,

verses.transliteration: japtvā cāṣṭaśataṃ tattvaṃ varṣantaṃ vinivārayet tam evaṃ piñjake baddhvā bhrāmayet sādhakottamaḥ
verses.translation: and reciting the essence a hundred and eight times, one can stop rain. Tying it in a cage, the best practitioner should whirl it;

verses.transliteration: mahāvāto muhūrtena āgacchen nātra saṃśayaḥ punaś ca dhārayet kṣipraṃ saptasaptena vāriṇā
verses.translation: a great wind will come within a moment, without doubt; and he should quickly hold it again with water seven times seven.

verses.transliteration: atha tāṃ pratimāṃ dvāri nikhaned yasya sādhakaḥ gotrotsādo bhavet tasya uddhṛte caiva śāntidaḥ
verses.translation: If the practitioner buries that image at someone's door, that person's family will be destroyed; when it is dug up, it brings peace.

verses.transliteration: tasmāt taṃ muniśārdūlā bhaktyā saṃpūjayet sadā mṛgarājaṃ mahāvīryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Therefore, O tigers among sages, one should always worship with devotion that very mighty king of beasts, who grants the fruit of every desire.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्रान्त्यजातयः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātayaḥ
verses.translation: Freed from all sins, he goes to Vishnu's world. Brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas, women, shudras and the lowest castes,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य तं सुरश्रेष्ठं भक्त्या सिंहवपुर्धरम् मुच्यन्ते चाशुभैर् दुःखैर् जन्मकोटिसमुद्भवैः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam mucyante cāśubhair duḥkhair janmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: having worshipped with devotion that best of gods who bears the form of a lion, are freed from evils and sorrows arising over crores of births.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य तं सुरश्रेष्ठं प्राप्नुवन्त्य् अभिवाञ्छितम् देवत्वम् अमरेशत्वं गन्धर्वत्वं च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ prāpnuvanty abhivāñchitam devatvam amareśatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Having worshipped that best of gods they obtain what they desire — godhood, lordship over the immortals and the state of a Gandharva, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षविद्याधरत्वं च तथान्यच् चाभिवाञ्छितम् दृष्ट्वा स्तुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा संपूज्य नरकेसरीम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣavidyādharatvaṃ ca tathānyac cābhivāñchitam dṛṣṭvā stutvā namaskṛtvā saṃpūjya narakesarīm
verses.translation: the state of a Yaksha or Vidyadhara, and whatever else they wish. Having seen, praised, bowed to and worshipped the Man-Lion,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा राज्यं स्वर्गं मोक्षं च दुर्लभम् नरसिंहं नरो दृष्ट्वा लभेद् अभिमतं फलम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnuvanti narā rājyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca durlabham narasiṃhaṃ naro dṛṣṭvā labhed abhimataṃ phalam
verses.translation: men obtain kingship, heaven and rare liberation. A man who sees Narasimha obtains the fruit he desires;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निर्मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति सकृद् दृष्ट्वा तु तं देवं भक्त्या सिंहवपुर्धरम्
verses.transliteration: nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati sakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam
verses.translation: freed from all sins, he goes to Vishnu's world. Having seen once with devotion that god in lion form,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यते चाशुभैर् दुःखैर् जन्मकोटिसमुद्भवैः संग्रामे संकटे दुर्गे चोरव्याघ्रादिपीडिते
verses.transliteration: mucyate cāśubhair duḥkhair janmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe durge coravyāghrādipīḍite
verses.translation: one is freed from evils and sorrows arising over crores of births. In battle, in distress, in a fortress, when oppressed by thieves, tigers and the like,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्तारे प्राणसंदेहे विषवह्निजलेषु च राजादिभ्यः समुद्रेभ्यो ग्रहरोगादिपीडिते
verses.transliteration: kāntāre prāṇasaṃdehe viṣavahnijaleṣu ca rājādibhyaḥ samudrebhyo graharogādipīḍite
verses.translation: in a wilderness, when life is in doubt, amid poison, fire and water, from kings and oceans, and when afflicted by planets, diseases and the like,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मृत्वा तं पुरुषः सर्वै राजग्रामैर् विमुच्यते सूर्योदये यथा नाशं तमो ऽभ्येति महत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā taṃ puruṣaḥ sarvai rājagrāmair vimucyate sūryodaye yathā nāśaṃ tamo 'bhyeti mahattaram
verses.translation: a man who remembers him is freed from all such troubles. As great darkness perishes when the sun rises,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा संदर्शने तस्य विनाशं यान्त्य् उपद्रवाः गुटिकाञ्जनपातालपादुके च रसायनम्
verses.transliteration: tathā saṃdarśane tasya vināśaṃ yānty upadravāḥ guṭikāñjanapātālapāduke ca rasāyanam
verses.translation: so at the sight of him calamities perish. Magic pills, collyrium, sandals for the netherworld and elixirs,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नरसिंहे प्रसन्ने तु प्राप्नोत्य् अन्यांश् च वाञ्छितान् यान् यान् कामान् अभिध्यायन् भजते नरकेसरीम्
verses.transliteration: narasiṃhe prasanne tu prāpnoty anyāṃś ca vāñchitān yān yān kāmān abhidhyāyan bhajate narakesarīm
verses.translation: and other things desired, one obtains when Narasimha is pleased. Whatever desires a man meditates on while worshipping the Man-Lion,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
