verses.transliteration: tāṃs tān kāmān avāpnoti naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca
verses.translation: those desires he obtains; there is no doubt. Having seen that lord of the gods, worshipped him with devotion and bowed,

verses.transliteration: daśānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet pāpaiḥ sarvair vinirmukto guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: one obtains tenfold the fruit of ten horse sacrifices; freed from all sins and adorned with all virtues,

verses.translation: rich in every desire, free from old age and death, in a golden celestial car hung with networks of bells,

verses.transliteration: sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagena suvarcasā taruṇādityavarṇena muktāhārāvalambinā
verses.translation: rich in every desire, moving at will, radiant, coloured like the young sun, hung with pearl necklaces,

verses.transliteration: divyastrīśatayuktena divyagandharvanādinā kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya devavan muditaḥ sukhī
verses.translation: accompanied by a hundred divine women and resounding with divine Gandharvas, raising twenty-one generations, joyful and happy like a god,

verses.transliteration: stūyamāno 'psarobhiś ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān viṣṇuloke dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: praised by Apsarases, the man goes to Vishnu's world. Having enjoyed excellent pleasures there in Vishnu's world, O best of brahmins,

verses.transliteration: gandharvair apsarair yuktaḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam manohlādakaraṃ saukhyaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: accompanied by Gandharvas and Apsarases, taking a four-armed form, happiness that delights the mind until the dissolution of beings,

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः प्रवरे योगिनां कुले चतुर्वेदी भवेद् विप्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ pravare yogināṃ kule caturvedī bhaved vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: when his merit is exhausted he comes here and in an excellent family of yogins becomes a brahmin versed in the four Vedas, master of the Vedas and their limbs; taking up the yoga of Vishnu, he then attains liberation.

verses.transliteration: anantākhyaṃ vāsudevaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā praṇamya ca sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti paraṃ padam
verses.translation: He goes to the greatest abode where Hari himself is present. Returning to this placc(eartli)in due course of time he shall become a king on the earth,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मया चाराधितश् चासौ शक्रेण तदनन्तरम् विभीषणेन रामेण कस् तं नाराधयेत् पुमान्
verses.transliteration: mayā cārādhitaś cāsau śakreṇa tadanantaram vibhīṣaṇena rāmeṇa kas taṃ nārādhayet pumān
verses.translation: By resorting to Matsyamadhava a man becomes un- thwartable. He shall be a donor, enjoyer of pleasures, a wor¬ shipper, a devotee of Visnu and truthful in speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to Matsyamadhava a man becomes un- thwartable. He shall be a donor, enjoyer of pleasures, a wor¬ shipper, a devotee of Visnu and truthful in speech.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतगङ्गां नरः स्नात्वा यः पश्येच् छ्वेतमाधवम् मत्स्याख्यं माधवं चैव श्वेतद्वीपं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śvetagaṅgāṃ naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyec chvetamādhavam matsyākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ caiva śvetadvīpaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Afterwards he attains Yoga pertaining to Hari and gains salvation. O leading sages, the greatness of Matsyama¬ dhava has been recounted by me. By visiting him the devotee will obtain all cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards he attains Yoga pertaining to Hari and gains salvation. O leading sages, the greatness of Matsyama¬ dhava has been recounted by me. By visiting him the devotee will obtain all cherished desires.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतमाधवमाहात्म्यं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः विस्तरेण जगन्नाथ प्रतिमां तस्य वै हरेः
verses.transliteration: śvetamādhavamāhātmyaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ vistareṇa jagannātha pratimāṃ tasya vai hareḥ
verses.translation: O Lord, we wish to hear further. The rites of wiping off,
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, we wish to hear further. The rites of wiping off,

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे पुण्ये विख्याते जगतीतले श्वेताख्यं माधवं देवं कस् तं स्थापितवान् पुरा
verses.transliteration: tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte jagatītale śvetākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ devaṃ kas taṃ sthāpitavān purā
verses.translation: The Pancatlrthi (a set of five holy centres and sacred waters) is as follows:—The eddy named after Markandeya, the holy banyan tree, the shrine of Kfsna, the shrine of Bala- rama and the great Indradyumnasaras (Lake of Indra- dyumna).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pancatlrthi (a set of five holy centres and sacred waters) is as follows:—The eddy named after Markandeya, the holy banyan tree, the shrine of Kfsna, the shrine of Bala- rama and the great Indradyumnasaras (Lake of Indra- dyumna).

verses.transliteration: abhūt kṛtayuge viprāḥ śveto nāma nṛpo balī matimān dharmavic chūraḥ satyasaṃdho dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: One should visit the Tlrtfiaraja (king of holy centres, the holy Banyan tree) on the full moon day in the month of Jyestha. If the constellation Jyestha coincides with it, it is especially auspicious.

verses.translation: The waters are glorified as Naras because they are the sons ofNara (human beings). At the outset the waters had been the abode of Visnu. Hence, he is known as Narayana (having Nara (waters) for abode.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा क्षेमं जगत् सर्वं मुनेः पुत्रं स तं द्विजाः देव्या सहोमया देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kṣemaṃ jagat sarvaṃ muneḥ putraṃ sa taṃ dvijāḥ devyā sahomayā devas tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: The brahmin shall be authorized in the Tarpana rite
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin shall be authorized in the Tarpana rite
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं संजीवयाम् आस मुनेः पुत्रं नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃjīvayām āsa muneḥ putraṃ nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: At the time ofSraddha, when the ball office is offered, the devotee shall offer it with a single hand. When performing the rite of Tarpana he shall use both hands. This is the pro¬ cedure to be followed always.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time ofSraddha, when the ball office is offered, the devotee shall offer it with a single hand. When performing the rite of Tarpana he shall use both hands. This is the pro¬ cedure to be followed always.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव जगन्नाथ त्रैलोक्यप्रभवाव्यय ब्रूहि नः परमं तथ्यं श्वेताख्यस्य च सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: devadeva jagannātha trailokyaprabhavāvyaya brūhi naḥ paramaṃ tathyaṃ śvetākhyasya ca sāṃpratam
verses.translation: After repeating the name and Gotra (Spiritual line¬ age) he shall say 'Trpyatam' (may be pleased). Otherwise he should not utter anything. The left-hand should be joined to the right hand (and thus the libation should be offered.
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating the name and Gotra (Spiritual line¬ age) he shall say 'Trpyatam' (may be pleased). Otherwise he should not utter anything. The left-hand should be joined to the right hand (and thus the libation should be offered.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वसत्त्वहितावहम् प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथ्यं यत् पृच्छथ ममानघाः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ sarvasattvahitāvaham pravakṣyāmi yathātathyaṃ yat pṛcchatha mamānaghāḥ
verses.translation: If out of delusion the devotee performs the rite of Tar¬ pana with the gingclly seeds kept on any of his limbs, it would be as though he had performed the rites of Tarpana to the forefathers by means of skin, flesh, blood and bone.
verses.commentary: Sense: If out of delusion the devotee performs the rite of Tar¬ pana with the gingclly seeds kept on any of his limbs, it would be as though he had performed the rites of Tarpana to the forefathers by means of skin, flesh, blood and bone.

verses.sanskrit: माधवस्य च माहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् यच् छ्रुत्वाभिमतान् कामान् ध्रुवं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: mādhavasya ca māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam yac chrutvābhimatān kāmān dhruvaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: One should notperform the rite of Tarpana to the deities and Pitrs with the gingclly seeds kept on any of the limbs. That water will turn into blood and he who offers it shall be sinful.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should notperform the rite of Tarpana to the deities and Pitrs with the gingclly seeds kept on any of the limbs. That water will turn into blood and he who offers it shall be sinful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतवान् ऋषिभिः पूर्वं माधवाख्यस्य भो द्विजाः शृणुध्वं तां कथां दिव्यां भयशोकार्तिनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: śrutavān ṛṣibhiḥ pūrvaṃ mādhavākhyasya bho dvijāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ bhayaśokārtināśinīm
verses.translation: O leading sages, if the person who offers libation stands in water and if the libation is offered on the dry ground, that offering is made futile. It does not benefit anyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, if the person who offers libation stands in water and if the libation is offered on the dry ground, that offering is made futile. It does not benefit anyone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा राज्यम् एकाग्र्यं वर्षाणां च सहस्रशः विचार्य लौकिकान् धर्मान् वैदिकान् नियमांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā rājyam ekāgryaṃ varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ vicārya laukikān dharmān vaidikān niyamāṃs tathā
verses.translation: If the man stands on the ground and offers libation into the water, that water libation does not approach the manes. It turns futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the man stands on the ground and offers libation into the water, that water libation does not approach the manes. It turns futile.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केशवाराधने विप्रा निश्चितं व्रतम् आस्थितः स गत्वा परमं क्षेत्रं सागरं दक्षिणाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: keśavārādhane viprā niścitaṃ vratam āsthitaḥ sa gatvā paramaṃ kṣetraṃ sāgaraṃ dakṣiṇāśrayam
verses.translation: One should not stand in water and offer water libation to the manes. He should come out and perform water libation on a pure spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तटे तस्मिञ् शुभे रम्ये देशे कृष्णस्य चान्तिके श्वेतो ऽथ कारयाम् आस प्रासादं शुभलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: taṭe tasmiñ śubhe ramye deśe kṛṣṇasya cāntike śveto 'tha kārayām āsa prāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: On that auspicious, delightful shore, near Krishna, Shveta then had a temple built with auspicious features,

verses.sanskrit: धन्वन्तरशतं चैकं देवदेवस्य दक्षिणे ततः श्वेतेन विप्रेन्द्राः श्वेतशैलमयेन च
verses.transliteration: dhanvantaraśataṃ caikaṃ devadevasya dakṣiṇe tataḥ śvetena viprendrāḥ śvetaśailamayena ca
verses.translation: a hundred and one bow-lengths to the south of the god of gods. Then, O best of brahmins, by Shveta, of white stone,

verses.sanskrit: कृतः स भगवाञ् श्वेतो माधवश् चन्द्रसंनिभः प्रतिष्ठां विधिवच् चक्रे यथोद्दिष्टां स्वयं तु सः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaḥ sa bhagavāñ śveto mādhavaś candrasaṃnibhaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivac cakre yathoddiṣṭāṃ svayaṃ tu saḥ
verses.translation: that Lord Shveta Madhava, like the moon, was made; and he himself performed the consecration duly as prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानं द्विजातिभ्यो दीनानाथतपस्विनाम् अथानन्तरतो राजा माधवस्य च संनिधौ
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo dīnānāthatapasvinām athānantarato rājā mādhavasya ca saṃnidhau
verses.translation: Having given gifts to the twice-born, the poor, the helpless and ascetics, the king then, in the presence of Madhava,

verses.sanskrit: महीं निपत्य सहसा ॐकारं द्वादशाक्षरम् जपन् स मौनम् आस्थाय मासम् एकं समाधिना
verses.transliteration: mahīṃ nipatya sahasā oṃkāraṃ dvādaśākṣaram japan sa maunam āsthāya māsam ekaṃ samādhinā
verses.translation: suddenly fell to the ground, and reciting Om and the twelve-syllable mantra, keeping silence, for one month in samadhi,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निराहारो महाभागः सम्यग् विष्णुपदे स्थितः जपान्ते स तु देवेशं संस्तोतुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nirāhāro mahābhāgaḥ samyag viṣṇupade sthitaḥ japānte sa tu deveśaṃ saṃstotum upacakrame
verses.translation: fasting, the illustrious one remained fixed in Vishnu's state. At the end of the recitation he began to praise the lord of gods:

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the lotus-naveled, the source of the one born from the lotus; salutation to the lotus-coloured one, salutation to you with a lotus in hand.

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the lotus-eyed, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful; salutation to the thousand-footed, whose arms and wrath are a thousand.

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the Boar, the giver of boons, the wise, the most excellent, the adorable, the refuge, Achyuta.

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the one in child's form, radiant like a young lotus, whose eyes are the morning sun and moon, with hair like munja grass, the wise one.

verses.translation: Salutation ever to Keshava, and salutation to Narayana; to Madhava, the most excellent; to Govinda, salutation again and again.

verses.translation: Om, salutation ever to Vishnu, the god whose seed is wealth; salutation to Madhusudana, the pure one who bears the rays.

verses.translation: Salutation to Ananta, the subtle; salutation to the bearer of the Shrivatsa; salutation to Trivikrama, and to the one wearing divine yellow garments.

verses.translation: Salutation to you, creator; salutation again and again to the protector and sustainer; salutation to the one who is the qualities, and again and again to the one beyond qualities.

verses.transliteration: namo vāmanarūpāya namo vāmanakarmaṇe namo vāmananetrāya namo vāmanavāhine
verses.translation: Salutation to the one in dwarf form, to the one of the dwarf's deeds, to the one with the dwarf's eyes, to the one borne by the dwarf.

verses.translation: Salutation to the delightful, the adorable; salutation to the one of unmanifest form, beyond reasoning, the pure, and the remover of fear.

verses.transliteration: bhavabhaṅgakṛte caiva bhavabhogapradāya ca bhavasaṃghātarūpāya bhavasṛṣṭikṛte namaḥ
verses.translation: to the one who breaks existence and grants the enjoyments of existence, to the one whose form is the aggregate of existence, the maker of the creation of existence, salutation.

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the one of divine form, whose breath is Soma and fire, whose hair is the rays of moon and sun, beneficial to cows and brahmins.

verses.transliteration: oṃ nama ṛksvarūpāya padakramasvarūpiṇe ṛkstutāya namas tubhyaṃ nama ṛksādhanāya ca
verses.translation: Om, salutation to the one whose form is the Rik, whose form is the pada and krama recitations; salutation to you praised by the Rik, salutation to the means of the Rik.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो यजुषां धात्रे यजूरूपधराय च यजुर्याज्याय जुष्टाय यजुषां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo yajuṣāṃ dhātre yajūrūpadharāya ca yajuryājyāya juṣṭāya yajuṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Om, salutation to the sustainer of the Yajus, bearing the form of the Yajus, to be worshipped by the Yajus, delighted in, the lord of the Yajus.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमः श्रीपते देव श्रीधराय वराय च श्रियः कान्ताय दान्ताय योगिचिन्त्याय योगिने
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaḥ śrīpate deva śrīdharāya varāya ca śriyaḥ kāntāya dāntāya yogicintyāya yogine
verses.translation: Om, salutation, O lord of Shri, O god, bearer of Shri, the excellent, beloved of Shri, the self-controlled, to be meditated on by yogins, the yogin.

verses.translation: Om, salutation to the one whose form is the Saman, excellent in the sound of the Saman; Om, salutation to the gentle one of the Saman, the knower of the yoga of the Saman.

verses.transliteration: sāmne ca sāmagītāya oṃ namaḥ sāmadhāriṇe sāmayajñavide caiva namaḥ sāmakarāya ca
verses.translation: To the Saman, the one sung in the Saman; Om, salutation to the bearer of the Saman, the knower of Saman sacrifices, salutation to the maker of the Saman.

verses.transliteration: namas tv atharvaśirase namo 'tharvasvarūpiṇe namo 'stv atharvapādāya namo 'tharvakarāya ca
verses.translation: Salutation to the one whose head is the Atharvan, whose form is the Atharvan; salutation to the one whose feet are the Atharvan, salutation to the maker of the Atharvan.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो वज्रशीर्षाय मधुकैटभघातिने महोदधिजलस्थाय वेदाहरणकारिणे
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo vajraśīrṣāya madhukaiṭabhaghātine mahodadhijalasthāya vedāharaṇakāriṇe
verses.translation: Om, salutation to the one with a diamond head, slayer of Madhu and Kaitabha, dwelling in the waters of the great ocean, the recoverer of the Vedas.

verses.transliteration: namo dīptasvarūpāya hṛṣīkeśāya vai namaḥ namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Salutation to the one of blazing form, salutation to Hrishikesha; salutation to you, the Lord, salutation to you, Vasudeva.

verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇa namas tubhyaṃ namo lokahitāya ca oṃ namo mohanāśāya bhavabhaṅgakarāya ca
verses.translation: Narayana, salutation to you, salutation to the benefactor of the world; Om, salutation to the destroyer of delusion and the breaker of existence,

verses.sanskrit: गतिप्रदाय च नमो नमो बन्धहराय च त्रैलोक्यतेजसां कर्त्रे नमस् तेजःस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: gatipradāya ca namo namo bandhaharāya ca trailokyatejasāṃ kartre namas tejaḥsvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: salutation to the giver of the goal, salutation to the remover of bonds; salutation to the maker of the splendours of the three worlds, whose form is splendour,

verses.transliteration: yogīśvarāya śuddhāya rāmāyottaraṇāya ca sukhāya sukhanetrāya namaḥ sukṛtadhāriṇe
verses.translation: to the lord of yogins, the pure, to Rama, to the one who carries across, to happiness, to the one with happy eyes, salutation to the bearer of good deeds,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेवाय वन्द्याय वामदेवाय वै नमः देहिनां देहकर्त्रे च भेदभङ्गकराय च
verses.transliteration: vāsudevāya vandyāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ dehināṃ dehakartre ca bhedabhaṅgakarāya ca
verses.translation: to Vasudeva, the adorable, salutation to Vamadeva, to the maker of the bodies of the embodied and the breaker of divisions,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवैर् वन्दितदेहाय नमस् ते दिव्यमौलिने नमो वासनिवासाय वासव्यवहराय च
verses.transliteration: devair vanditadehāya namas te divyamauline namo vāsanivāsāya vāsavyavaharāya ca
verses.translation: whose body is adored by the gods, salutation to you with divine crown; salutation to the dwelling of dwellings, who conducts the affairs of dwelling.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो वसुकर्त्रे च वसुवासप्रदाय च नमो यज्ञस्वरूपाय यज्ञेशाय च योगिने
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo vasukartre ca vasuvāsapradāya ca namo yajñasvarūpāya yajñeśāya ca yogine
verses.translation: Om, salutation to the maker of wealth and giver of wealth and dwelling; salutation to the one whose form is sacrifice, the lord of sacrifice, the yogin,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यतियोगकरेशाय नमो यज्ञाङ्गधारिणे संकर्षणाय च नमः प्रलम्बमथनाय च
verses.transliteration: yatiyogakareśāya namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe saṃkarṣaṇāya ca namaḥ pralambamathanāya ca
verses.translation: the lord who makes the yoga of ascetics, salutation to the bearer of the limbs of sacrifice; salutation to Sankarshana, and to the crusher of Pralamba,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मेघघोषस्वनोत्तीर्णवेगलाङ्गलधारिणे नमो ऽस्तु ज्ञानिनां ज्ञान नारायणपरायण
verses.transliteration: meghaghoṣasvanottīrṇavegalāṅgaladhāriṇe namo 'stu jñānināṃ jñāna nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa
verses.translation: bearing the plough, whose speed surpasses the roar of clouds; salutation to the knowledge of the knowers, O you devoted to Narayana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मे ऽस्ति त्वाम् ऋते बन्धुर् नरकोत्तारणे प्रभो अतस् त्वां सर्वभावेन प्रणतो नतवत्सल
verses.transliteration: na me 'sti tvām ṛte bandhur narakottāraṇe prabho atas tvāṃ sarvabhāvena praṇato natavatsala
verses.translation: I have no kinsman but you to carry me across hell, O Lord; therefore I bow to you with all my being, O you who love the humble.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मलं यत् कायजं वापि मानसं चैव केशव न तस्यान्यो ऽस्ति देवेश क्षालकस् त्वाम् ऋते ऽच्युत
verses.transliteration: malaṃ yat kāyajaṃ vāpi mānasaṃ caiva keśava na tasyānyo 'sti deveśa kṣālakas tvām ṛte 'cyuta
verses.translation: Whatever impurity there is, of body or of mind, O Keshava, there is no other who can wash it away but you, O Achyuta, lord of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: संसर्गाणि समस्तानि विहाय त्वाम् उपस्थितः सङ्गो मे ऽस्तु त्वया सार्धम् आत्मलाभाय केशव
verses.transliteration: saṃsargāṇi samastāni vihāya tvām upasthitaḥ saṅgo me 'stu tvayā sārdham ātmalābhāya keśava
verses.translation: Abandoning all associations I have come to you; may my association be with you for the attainment of the Self, O Keshava.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कष्टम् आपत् सुदुष्पारं संसारं वेद्मि केशव तापत्रयपरिक्लिष्टस् तेन त्वां शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: kaṣṭam āpat suduṣpāraṃ saṃsāraṃ vedmi keśava tāpatrayaparikliṣṭas tena tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: I know worldly existence, O Keshava, to be a painful calamity very hard to cross; afflicted by the threefold suffering, I have therefore come to you for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एषणाभिर् जगत् सर्वं मोहितं मायया तव आकर्षितं च लोभाद्यैर् अतस् त्वाम् अहम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: eṣaṇābhir jagat sarvaṃ mohitaṃ māyayā tava ākarṣitaṃ ca lobhādyair atas tvām aham āśritaḥ
verses.translation: The whole world is deluded by your maya through its desires and drawn away by greed and the rest; therefore I have taken refuge in you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति किंचित् सुखं विष्णो संसारस्थस्य देहिनः यथा यथा हि यज्ञेश त्वयि चेतः प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: nāsti kiṃcit sukhaṃ viṣṇo saṃsārasthasya dehinaḥ yathā yathā hi yajñeśa tvayi cetaḥ pravartate
verses.translation: There is no happiness at all, O Vishnu, for an embodied being in worldly existence; but as the mind turns toward you, O lord of sacrifice,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tathā phalavihīnaṃ tu sukham ātyantikaṃ labhet naṣṭo vivekaśūnyo 'smi dṛśyate jagad āturam
verses.translation: so one gains absolute happiness free from fruits. I am lost, devoid of discrimination; the world appears afflicted.

verses.sanskrit: गोविन्द त्राहि संसारान् माम् उद्धर्तुं त्वम् अर्हसि मग्नस्य मोहसलिले निरुत्तारे भवार्णवे उद्धर्ता पुण्डरीकाक्ष त्वाम् ऋते ऽन्यो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: govinda trāhi saṃsārān mām uddhartuṃ tvam arhasi magnasya mohasalile niruttāre bhavārṇave uddhartā puṇḍarīkākṣa tvām ṛte 'nyo na vidyate
verses.translation: O Govinda, save me from worldly existence; you must lift me out. For one sunk in the waters of delusion in the uncrossable ocean of existence, there is no rescuer but you, O lotus-eyed one."

verses.transliteration: itthaṃ stutas tatas tena rājñā śvetena bho dvijāḥ tasmin kṣetravare divye vikhyāte puruṣottame
verses.translation: Thus praised by King Shveta, O brahmins, in that divine, excellent region famed as Purushottama,

verses.transliteration: bhaktiṃ tasya tu saṃcintya devadevo jagadguruḥ ājagāma nṛpasyāgre sarvair devair vṛto hariḥ
verses.translation: considering his devotion, the god of gods, teacher of the world, Hari, came before the king surrounded by all the gods,

verses.translation: like a dark cloud, with eyes long as lotus petals, the wise one holding Sudarshana, a blazing disc, at the tip of his hand;

verses.translation: in his left hand shone the very radiant Panchajanya, like the waters of the milk ocean, spotless and like the moon.

verses.transliteration: pakṣirājadhvajaḥ śrīmān gadāśārṅgāsidhṛk prabhuḥ uvāca sādhu bho rājan yasya te matir uttamā yad iṣṭaṃ vara bhadraṃ te prasanno 'smi tavānagha
verses.translation: The glorious Lord, whose banner is the king of birds, bearing mace, Sharnga and sword, said: "Well done, O king, whose mind is excellent. Choose what you desire; blessings on you; I am pleased with you, O sinless one."

verses.transliteration: śrutvaivaṃ devadevasya vākyaṃ tat paramāmṛtam praṇamya śirasovāca śvetas tadgatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing that supreme nectar-like speech of the god of gods, Shveta, his mind absorbed in him, bowed his head and said:

verses.translation: "If I am your devotee, O Lord, grant me the highest boon: the imperishable state of Vishnu beyond the abode of Brahma,

verses.transliteration: vimalaṃ virajaṃ śuddhaṃ saṃsārāsaṅgavarjitam tat padaṃ gantum icchāmi tvatprasādāj jagatpate
verses.translation: spotless, free of passion, pure, devoid of attachment to worldly existence — I wish to go to that state by your grace, O lord of the world,

verses.transliteration: yat padaṃ vibudhāḥ sarve munayaḥ siddhayoginaḥ nābhigacchanti yad ramyaṃ paraṃ padam anāmayam
verses.translation: that delightful, supreme, faultless state which all the gods, sages and perfected yogins do not reach."

verses.sanskrit: यास्यसि परमं स्थानं राज्यामृतम् उपास्य च सर्वांल् लोकान् अतिक्रम्य मम लोकं गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: yāsyasi paramaṃ sthānaṃ rājyāmṛtam upāsya ca sarvāṃl lokān atikramya mama lokaṃ gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: "You will go to the supreme abode after enjoying the nectar of kingship; passing beyond all worlds, you will go to my world.

verses.transliteration: kīrtis tavātra rājendra trīṃl lokāṃś ca gamiṣyati sāṃnidhyaṃ mama caivātra sarvadaiva bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Your fame here, O king of kings, will go to the three worlds, and my presence will always be here.

verses.translation: All the gods and Danavas will sing of the 'Shveta Ganga'; and even touching the water of the Shveta Ganga with the tip of a kusha blade, O king of kings,

verses.translation: my devotees who are composed will go to heaven. Whoever goes to this image named Madhava, radiant as the moon,

verses.transliteration: śaṅkhagokṣīrasaṃkāśām aśeṣāghavināśinīm tāṃ praṇamya sakṛd bhaktyā puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇām
verses.translation: like conch and cow's milk, destroyer of all sins, and bows once with devotion to her with eyes like white lotuses,

verses.transliteration: vihāya sarvalokān vai mama loke mahīyate manvantarāṇi tatraiva devakanyābhir āvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: leaving all worlds, is honoured in my world; there, for Manu-periods, surrounded by divine maidens,

verses.transliteration: gīyamānaś ca madhuraṃ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ bhunakti vipulān bhogān yatheṣṭaṃ māmakaiḥ saha
verses.translation: sweetly sung to and attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas, he enjoys abundant pleasures as he wishes with my own people.

verses.transliteration: cyutas tasmād ihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet vedavedāṅgavic chrīmān bhogavāṃś cirajīvitaḥ
verses.translation: Falling from there and coming here, he becomes a human brahmin, knower of the Vedas and their limbs, glorious, rich in enjoyments and long-lived,

verses.transliteration: gajāśvarathayānāḍhyo dhanadhānyāvṛtaḥ śuciḥ rūpavān bahubhāgyaś ca putrapautrasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: rich in elephants, horses, chariots and vehicles, surrounded by wealth and grain, pure, handsome, very fortunate and blessed with sons and grandsons.

verses.transliteration: puruṣottamaṃ punaḥ prāpya vaṭamūle 'tha sāgare tyaktvā dehaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā tataḥ śāntapadaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Reaching Purushottama again, at the root of the banyan or in the ocean, giving up his body while remembering Hari, he then goes to the state of peace."

verses.transliteration: śvetamādhavam ālokya samīpe matsyamādhavam ekārṇavajale pūrvaṃ rohitaṃ rūpam āsthitam
verses.translation: After drawing the mystic diagram O brahmins, the devotee should worship Narayana, the unborn lord by means of injunctions in regard to the eight syllabled Mantra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: vedānāṃ haraṇārthāya rasātalatale sthitam cintayitvā kṣitiṃ samyak tasmin sthāne pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Then he should perform the Nyasa rite with the eight- syllabled Mantra. He shall begin with the left foot and fix in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he should perform the Nyasa rite with the eight- syllabled Mantra. He shall begin with the left foot and fix in due order.

verses.transliteration: ādyāvataraṇaṃ rūpaṃ mādhavaṃ matsyarūpiṇam praṇamya praṇato bhūtvā sarvaduḥkhād vimucyate
verses.translation: The aspirant should perform the following rites with the basic Mantra viz. the five limbs belonging to lord Visnu;
verses.commentary: Sense: The aspirant should perform the following rites with the basic Mantra viz. the five limbs belonging to lord Visnu;

verses.sanskrit: प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् काले पुनर् इहायातो राजा स्यात् पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam kāle punar ihāyāto rājā syāt pṛthivītale
verses.translation: Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the head. Om obeisance tojvalana (the fiery blaze)—thus the tuft. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the coat of mail. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the throbbing for the binding of quarters. Om Hum phat—thus the miraculous weapon. Om Vasudeva is white—in the head thus. Om Am Sarikarsana is red—in the forehead. Garuda is the fire, the luminary sun thus. Aril Pradyumna is yellow—in the neck. He is the wind and cloud. Orh ArhAniruddha is black—in the heart. He is endowed with all power. Thus protected by four arrays the devotee shall start reciting Kavaca.
verses.wordMeaning: Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the head. Om obeisance tojvalana (the fiery blaze)—thus the tuft. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the coat of mail. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the throbbing for the binding of quarters. Om Hum phat—thus the miraculous weapon.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the head. Om obeisance tojvalana (the fiery blaze)—thus the tuft. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the coat of mail. Om obeisance to Visnu—thus the throbbing for the binding of quarters. Om Hum phat—thus the miraculous weapon.…

verses.transliteration: vatsamādhavam āsādya durādharṣo bhaven naraḥ dātā bhoktā bhaved yajvā vaiṣṇavaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ
verses.translation: He should perform the worship of eternal lord by the twelve-syllabled Mantra; thereafter he should fix it up in the pericarp, at the outside, after retaining it in the heart.

verses.transliteration: yogaṃ prāpya hareḥ paścāt tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt matsyamādhavamāhātmyaṃ mayā saṃparikīrtitam yaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśārdūlāḥ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He should meditate upon the eternal lord with four arms and possessed of great strength. He should think upon the lord with lustre of a crore suns. He should invoke the lord after duly thinking about him in his mind.

verses.translation: His name with Orhkara at the beginning and Namah at the end is called the Mantra of all Principles.

verses.translation: having bathed at the delightful wish-fulfilling banyan, one should circumambulate Janardana three times with great composure.

verses.transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpāt saptajanmasamudbhavāt puṇyaṃ cāpnoti vipulaṃ gatim iṣṭāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By seeing it one is freed from sin arising over seven births and obtains abundant merit and the desired goal, O brahmins.

verses.translation: I shall tell its names and its measure in each age, O brahmins, in order, beginning with the Krita age.

verses.translation: Vata, Vateshvara, Krishna and Puranapurusha, O brahmins — these are declared the names of the banyan in the Krita and following ages.

verses.transliteration: yojanaṃ pādahīnaṃ ca yojanārdhaṃ tadardhakam pramāṇaṃ kalpavṛkṣasya kṛtādau parikīrtitam
verses.translation: A yojana, three-quarters of a yojana, half a yojana and half of that — this is declared the measure of the wish-fulfilling tree beginning with the Krita age.

verses.sanskrit: यथोक्तेन तु मन्त्रेण नमस्कृत्वा तु तं वटम् दक्षिणाभिमुखो गच्छेद् धन्वन्तरशतत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: yathoktena tu mantreṇa namaskṛtvā tu taṃ vaṭam dakṣiṇābhimukho gacched dhanvantaraśatatrayam
verses.translation: Having bowed to that banyan with the prescribed mantra, one should go facing south three hundred bow-lengths,

verses.sanskrit: यत्रासौ दृश्यते विष्णुः स्वर्गद्वारं मनोरमम् सागराम्भःसमाकृष्टं काष्ठं सर्वगुणान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: yatrāsau dṛśyate viṣṇuḥ svargadvāraṃ manoramam sāgarāmbhaḥsamākṛṣṭaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam
verses.translation: to where Vishnu is seen at the charming gate of heaven — the log drawn up from the waters of the ocean, endowed with every virtue.

verses.transliteration: praṇipatya tatas taṃ bhoḥ paripūjya tataḥ punaḥ mucyate sarvarogādyais tathā pāpair grahādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Having bowed to it and then worshipped it fully, one is freed from all diseases and the like, and from sins, planets and so on.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रसेनं पुरा दृष्ट्वा स्वर्गद्वारेण सागरम् गत्वाचम्य शुचिस् तत्र ध्यात्वा नारायणं परम्
verses.transliteration: ugrasenaṃ purā dṛṣṭvā svargadvāreṇa sāgaram gatvācamya śucis tatra dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ param
verses.translation: Having first seen Ugrasena, going to the ocean by the gate of heaven, sipping water and being pure there, meditating on the supreme Narayana,

verses.sanskrit: न्यसेद् अष्टाक्षरं मन्त्रं पश्चाद् धस्तशरीरयोः ॐ नमो नारायणायेति यं वदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: nyased aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ paścād dhastaśarīrayoḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti yaṃ vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: one should then place the eight-syllable mantra on the hands and body — "Om namo narayanaya," which the wise recite.

verses.sanskrit: किं कार्यं बहुभिर् मन्त्रैर् मनोविभ्रमकारकैः ॐ नमो नारायणायेति मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ bahubhir mantrair manovibhramakārakaiḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
verses.translation: What need of many mantras that bewilder the mind? The mantra "Om namo narayanaya" accomplishes every aim.

verses.transliteration: āpo narasya sūnutvān nārā itīha kīrtitāḥ viṣṇos tās tv ayanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The waters are called 'nara' because they are the offspring of Nara; since they were formerly Vishnu's abode (ayana), he is remembered as Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरा वेदा नारायणपरा द्विजाः नारायणपरा यज्ञा नारायणपराः क्रियाः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā dvijāḥ nārāyaṇaparā yajñā nārāyaṇaparāḥ kriyāḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas are devoted to Narayana, the twice-born are devoted to Narayana, sacrifices are devoted to Narayana, rites are devoted to Narayana;

verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparā pṛthvī nārāyaṇaparaṃ jalam nārāyaṇaparo vahnir nārāyaṇaparaṃ nabhaḥ
verses.translation: the earth is devoted to Narayana, water is devoted to Narayana, fire is devoted to Narayana, the sky is devoted to Narayana;

verses.sanskrit: नारायणपरो वायुर् नारायणपरं मनः अहंकारश् च बुद्धिश् च उभे नारायणात्मके
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaparo vāyur nārāyaṇaparaṃ manaḥ ahaṃkāraś ca buddhiś ca ubhe nārāyaṇātmake
verses.translation: the wind is devoted to Narayana, the mind is devoted to Narayana; egoity and intellect both have Narayana as their self.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च यत् किंचिज् जीवसंज्ञितम् स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चैव सर्वं नारायणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yat kiṃcij jīvasaṃjñitam sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam
verses.translation: Past, present and future, whatever is called a living being, gross, subtle and supreme — all has Narayana as its self.

verses.transliteration: śabdādyā viṣayāḥ sarve śrotrādīnīndriyāṇi ca prakṛtiḥ puruṣaś caiva sarve nārāyaṇātmakāḥ
verses.translation: All objects beginning with sound, the senses beginning with the ear, Prakriti and Purusha — all have Narayana as their self.

verses.sanskrit: जले स्थले च पाताले स्वर्गलोके ऽम्बरे नगे अवष्टभ्य इदं सर्वम् आस्ते नारायणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: jale sthale ca pātāle svargaloke 'mbare nage avaṣṭabhya idaṃ sarvam āste nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: In water, on land, in the netherworld, in heaven, in the sky and on the mountains, the Lord Narayana abides supporting all this.

verses.sanskrit: किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन जगद् एतच् चराचरम् ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं नारायणात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cātra bahunoktena jagad etac carācaram brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam
verses.translation: What need to say more? This world of moving and unmoving, from Brahma down to a blade of grass, all has Narayana as its self.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नारायणात् परं किंचिन् नेह पश्यामि भो द्विजाः तेन व्याप्तम् इदं सर्वं दृश्यादृश्यं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāt paraṃ kiṃcin neha paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ tena vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: I see nothing here higher than Narayana, O brahmins; by him all this, seen and unseen, moving and unmoving, is pervaded.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ह्य् आयतनं विष्णोः स च एवाम्भसां पतिः तस्माद् अप्सु स्मरेन् नित्यं नारायणम् अघापहम्
verses.transliteration: āpo hy āyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa ca evāmbhasāṃ patiḥ tasmād apsu smaren nityaṃ nārāyaṇam aghāpaham
verses.translation: The waters are Vishnu's abode, and he is the lord of the waters; therefore one should always remember Narayana, remover of sin, in the waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानकाले विशेषेण चोपस्थाय जले शुचिः स्मरेन् नारायणं ध्यायेद् धस्ते काये च विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: snānakāle viśeṣeṇa copasthāya jale śuciḥ smaren nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyed dhaste kāye ca vinyaset
verses.translation: Especially at the time of bathing, standing pure in the water, one should remember Narayana, meditate on him and place the mantra on the hands and body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारं च नकारं च अङ्गुष्ठे हस्तयोर् न्यसेत् शेषैर् हस्ततलं यावत् तर्जन्यादिषु विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: oṃkāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca aṅguṣṭhe hastayor nyaset śeṣair hastatalaṃ yāvat tarjanyādiṣu vinyaset
verses.translation: One should place Om and Na on the thumbs of both hands, and the rest on the forefingers and others up to the palm.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारं वामपादे तु नकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् मोकारं वामकट्यां तु नाकारं दक्षिणे न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: oṃkāraṃ vāmapāde tu nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ tu nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset
verses.translation: One should place Om on the left foot and Na on the right; Mo on the left hip and Na on the right;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राकारं नाभिदेशे तु यकारं वामबाहुके णाकारं दक्षिणे न्यस्य यकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: rākāraṃ nābhideśe tu yakāraṃ vāmabāhuke ṇākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyaset
verses.translation: Ra on the navel, Ya on the left arm, Na on the right, and Ya on the head.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अधश् चोर्ध्वं च हृदये पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतो ऽग्रतः ध्यात्वा नारायणं पश्चाद् आरभेत् कवचं बुधः
verses.transliteration: adhaś cordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'grataḥ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ paścād ārabhet kavacaṃ budhaḥ
verses.translation: Below, above, in the heart, at the sides, behind and in front, having meditated on Narayana, the wise one should then begin the armour:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे मां पातु गोविन्दो दक्षिणे मधुसूदनः पश्चिमे श्रीधरो देवः केशवस् तु तथोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: pūrve māṃ pātu govindo dakṣiṇe madhusūdanaḥ paścime śrīdharo devaḥ keśavas tu tathottare
verses.translation: "May Govinda protect me in the east, Madhusudana in the south, the god Shridhara in the west and Keshava in the north;

verses.sanskrit: पातु विष्णुस् तथाग्नेये नैरृते माधवो ऽव्ययः वायव्ये तु हृषीकेशस् तथेशाने च वामनः
verses.transliteration: pātu viṣṇus tathāgneye nairṛte mādhavo 'vyayaḥ vāyavye tu hṛṣīkeśas tatheśāne ca vāmanaḥ
verses.translation: may Vishnu protect me in the south-east, the imperishable Madhava in the south-west, Hrishikesha in the north-west and Vamana in the north-east;

verses.translation: "I am the god Narayana, bearing conch, discus and mace." Having meditated thus on oneself, one should utter this mantra:

verses.transliteration: tvam agnir dvipadāṃ nātha retodhāḥ kāmadīpanaḥ pradhānaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ prabhur avyayaḥ
verses.translation: "You are fire, lord of the two-footed, bearer of seed, kindler of desire, chief of all beings, imperishable lord of living creatures.

verses.transliteration: amṛtasyāraṇis tvaṃ hi devayonir apāṃ pate vṛjinaṃ hara me sarvaṃ tīrtharāja namo 'stu te
verses.translation: You are the churning-source of nectar, source of the gods, lord of waters; take away all my sin, O king of holy places; salutation to you."

verses.transliteration: evam uccārya vidhivat tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret anyathā bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snānaṃ tatra na śasyate
verses.translation: Having uttered this duly, one should then bathe; otherwise, O best of brahmins, bathing there is not commended.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु वैदिकैर् मन्त्रैर् अभिषेकं च मार्जनम् अन्तर् जले जपेत् पश्चात् त्रिर् आवृत्त्याघमर्षणम्

verses.translation: Having performed the sprinkling and cleansing with Vedic mantras, one should then recite the Aghamarshana three times under the water.

verses.transliteration: hayamedho yathā viprāḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ kratuḥ tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cātra sūktaṃ sarvāghanāśanam
verses.translation: As the horse sacrifice, O brahmins, is the rite that removes all sins, so the Aghamarshana hymn here destroys all sins.

verses.translation: Coming out and putting on two clean washed garments, restraining the breath, sipping water and performing the twilight worship of the sun,

verses.transliteration: upatiṣṭhet tataś cordhvaṃ kṣiptvā puṣpajalāñjalim upasthāyordhvabāhuś ca talliṅgair bhāskaraṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: one should then stand, casting upward a handful of flowers and water, and worship the sun with raised arms, with the verses marked by him.

verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam anyāṃś ca sauramantrāṃś ca japtvā tiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: One should recite the purifying goddess Gayatri a hundred and eight times, and other solar mantras, standing composed.

verses.translation: Having circumambulated the sun, bowed and sat down facing east, having done one's Vedic study, one should offer libations to the deities and sages,

verses.transliteration: manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝṃś cānyān nāmagotreṇa mantravit toyena tilamiśreṇa vidhivat susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: to men, the ancestors and others, with their names and lineages, knowing the mantras, with water mixed with sesame, duly and with composure.

verses.transliteration: tarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūrvaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ adhikārī bhavet paścāt pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe dvijaḥ
verses.translation: Having first performed the libations to the deities with composure, the twice-born then becomes qualified for the libations to the ancestors.

verses.transliteration: śrāddhe havanakāle ca pāṇinaikena nirvapet tarpaṇe tūbhayaṃ kuryād eṣa eva vidhiḥ sadā
verses.translation: At a shraddha and at the time of fire offering one should offer with one hand; at libations one should use both — this is always the rule.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वारब्धेन सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु तृप्यताम् इति सिञ्चेत् तु नामगोत्रेण वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu tṛpyatām iti siñcet tu nāmagotreṇa vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: With the right hand supported by the left, one should pour, saying "May he be satisfied," with name and lineage, keeping silence.

verses.sanskrit: कायस्थैर् यस् तिलैर् मोहात् करोति पितृतर्पणम् तर्पितास् तेन पितरस् त्वङ्मांसरुधिरास्थिभिः
verses.transliteration: kāyasthair yas tilair mohāt karoti pitṛtarpaṇam tarpitās tena pitaras tvaṅmāṃsarudhirāsthibhiḥ
verses.translation: One who out of delusion offers libations to the ancestors with sesame taken from his body satisfies the ancestors with skin, flesh, blood and bones.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गस्थैर् न तिलैः कुर्याद् देवतापितृतर्पणम् रुधिरं तद् भवेत् तोयं प्रदाता किल्बिषी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅgasthair na tilaiḥ kuryād devatāpitṛtarpaṇam rudhiraṃ tad bhavet toyaṃ pradātā kilbiṣī bhavet
verses.translation: One should not offer libations to the gods and ancestors with sesame from the limbs; that water becomes blood and the giver becomes sinful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूम्यां यद् दीयते तोयं दाता चैव जले स्थितः वृथा तन् मुनिशार्दूला नोपतिष्ठति कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: bhūmyāṃ yad dīyate toyaṃ dātā caiva jale sthitaḥ vṛthā tan muniśārdūlā nopatiṣṭhati kasyacit
verses.translation: Water given onto the ground while the giver stands in the water is in vain, O tigers among sages; it reaches no one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्थले स्थित्वा जले यस् तु प्रयच्छेद् उदकं नरः पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठेत सलिलं तन् निरर्थकम्
verses.transliteration: sthale sthitvā jale yas tu prayacched udakaṃ naraḥ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭheta salilaṃ tan nirarthakam
verses.translation: The man who stands on land and gives water into the water — that water does not reach the ancestors and is useless.

verses.sanskrit: उदके नोदकं कुर्यात् पितृभ्यश् च कदाचन उत्तीर्य तु शुचौ देशे कुर्याद् उदकतर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: udake nodakaṃ kuryāt pitṛbhyaś ca kadācana uttīrya tu śucau deśe kuryād udakatarpaṇam
verses.translation: One should never offer water to the ancestors into water; coming out, one should perform the water libation on a clean spot.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नोदकेषु न पात्रेषु न क्रुद्धो नैकपाणिना नोपतिष्ठति तत् तोयं यद् भूम्यां न प्रदीयते
verses.transliteration: nodakeṣu na pātreṣu na kruddho naikapāṇinā nopatiṣṭhati tat toyaṃ yad bhūmyāṃ na pradīyate
verses.translation: Not into water, not into vessels, not in anger, not with one hand; water not given onto the ground does not reach them.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणाम् अक्षयं स्थानं मही दत्ता मया द्विजाः तस्मात् तत्रैव दातव्यं पितॄणां प्रीतिम् इच्छता
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇām akṣayaṃ sthānaṃ mahī dattā mayā dvijāḥ tasmāt tatraiva dātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītim icchatā
verses.translation: The earth has been given by me as the imperishable place of the ancestors, O brahmins; therefore it should be given there by one who desires the ancestors' pleasure.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूमिपृष्ठे समुत्पन्ना भूम्यां चैव च संस्थिताः भूम्यां चैव लयं याता भूमौ दद्यात् ततो जलम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmipṛṣṭhe samutpannā bhūmyāṃ caiva ca saṃsthitāḥ bhūmyāṃ caiva layaṃ yātā bhūmau dadyāt tato jalam
verses.translation: They were born on the surface of the earth, they rest on the earth, and they dissolve into the earth; therefore one should give water on the earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आस्तीर्य च कुशान् साग्रांस् तान् आवाह्य स्वमन्त्रतः प्राचीनाग्रेषु वै देवान् याम्याग्रेषु तथा पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: āstīrya ca kuśān sāgrāṃs tān āvāhya svamantrataḥ prācīnāgreṣu vai devān yāmyāgreṣu tathā pitṝn
verses.translation: Spreading kusha grass with its tips intact and invoking them with their own mantras — the gods on eastward-pointing tips and the ancestors on southward-pointing ones —

verses.transliteration: devān pitṝṃs tathā cānyān saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ hastamātraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: After duly and devoutly worshipping the lord thus, the devotee should bend his head thereafter and propitiate the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: पुरं विलिख्य भो विप्रास् तीरे तस्य महोदधेः मध्ये तत्र लिखेत् पद्मम् अष्टपत्त्रं सकर्णिकम्
verses.transliteration: puraṃ vilikhya bho viprās tīre tasya mahodadheḥ madhye tatra likhet padmam aṣṭapattraṃ sakarṇikam
verses.translation: O Lord of streams you arc the vital breath and source of origin of all living beings. O king of sacred waters fond of Lord Visnu, obeisance be to you. Save me.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ maṇḍalam ālikhya pūjayet tatra bho dvijāḥ aṣṭākṣaravidhānena nārāyaṇam ajaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: Having drawn the mandala thus, O brahmins, one should worship there the unborn, all-pervading Narayana by the rite of the eight syllables.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कायशोधनम् उत्तमम् अकारं हृदये ध्यात्वा चक्ररेखासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāyaśodhanam uttamam akāraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā cakrarekhāsamanvitam
verses.translation: Next I shall tell the excellent purification of the body. Meditating on the syllable A in the heart, joined with the lines of a discus,

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलन्तं त्रिशिखं चैव दहन्तं पापनाशनम् चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यस्थं राकारं मूर्ध्नि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: jvalantaṃ triśikhaṃ caiva dahantaṃ pāpanāśanam candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rākāraṃ mūrdhni cintayet
verses.translation: blazing with three flames, burning, destroying sin; one should contemplate the syllable Ra on the head, in the middle of the orb of the moon,

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लवर्णं प्रवर्षन्तम् अमृतं प्लावयन् महीम् एवं निर्धूतपापस् तु दिव्यदेहस् ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śuklavarṇaṃ pravarṣantam amṛtaṃ plāvayan mahīm evaṃ nirdhūtapāpas tu divyadehas tato bhavet
verses.translation: white in colour, raining nectar and flooding the earth; thus, with sins shaken off, one then becomes of divine body.

verses.transliteration: aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ nyased evātmano budhaḥ vāmapādaṃ samārabhya kramaśaś caiva vinyaset
verses.translation: The wise one should then place the eight-syllable mantra on himself, beginning with the left foot and placing in order.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाङ्गं वैष्णवं चैव चतुर्व्यूहं तथैव च करशुद्धिं प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण साधकः
verses.transliteration: pañcāṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva caturvyūhaṃ tathaiva ca karaśuddhiṃ prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ
verses.translation: The practitioner should perform the fivefold limb-placement of Vishnu and the fourfold manifestation, and purify the hands with the root mantra,

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं चैव वर्णं तु अङ्गुलीषु पृथक् पृथक् ॐकारं पृथिवीं शुक्लां वामपादे तु विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ caiva varṇaṃ tu aṅgulīṣu pṛthak pṛthak oṃkāraṃ pṛthivīṃ śuklāṃ vāmapāde tu vinyaset
verses.translation: placing each letter separately on the fingers. One should place Om, the white earth, on the left foot;

verses.transliteration: nakāraḥ śāṃbhavaḥ śyāmo dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitaḥ mokāraṃ kālam evāhur vāmakaṭyāṃ nidhāpayet
verses.translation: Na, belonging to Shambhu, dark, is placed on the right; Mo they call time — one should place it on the left hip;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाकारः सर्वबीजं तु दक्षिणस्यां व्यवस्थितः राकारस् तेज इत्य् आहुर् नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: nākāraḥ sarvabījaṃ tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ rākāras teja ity āhur nābhideśe vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Na, the seed of all, is placed on the right; Ra they call fire — it is placed at the navel;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वायव्यो ऽयं यकारस् तु वामस्कन्धे समाश्रितः णाकारः सर्वगो ज्ञेयो दक्षिणांसे व्यवस्थितः यकारो ऽयं शिरस्थश् च यत्र लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: vāyavyo 'yaṃ yakāras tu vāmaskandhe samāśritaḥ ṇākāraḥ sarvago jñeyo dakṣiṇāṃse vyavasthitaḥ yakāro 'yaṃ śirasthaś ca yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: this Ya, belonging to the wind, rests on the left shoulder; Na should be known as all-pervading, placed on the right shoulder; and this Ya is on the head, where the worlds are established.

verses.transliteration: oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ śiraḥ oṃ jvalanāya namaḥ śikhā | oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ kavacam oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ sphuraṇaṃ diśobandhāya | oṃ huṃphaḍastram oṃ śirasi śuklo vāsudeva iti | oṃ āṃ lalāṭe raktaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo garutmān vahnis teja āditya iti | oṃ āṃ grīvāyāṃ pītaḥ pradyumno vāyumegha iti | oṃ āṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo 'niruddhaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvita iti | evaṃ caturvyūham ātmānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma samācaret
verses.translation: "Om, salutation to Vishnu" — the head; "Om, salutation to the blazing one" — the crest; "Om, salutation to Vishnu" — the armour; "Om, salutation to Vishnu" — the flashing, for binding the directions; "Om hum phat" — the weapon; "Om, on the head, the white Vasudeva"; "Om Am, on the forehead, the red Sankarshana, Garuda, fire, splendour, the sun"; "Om Am, on the neck, the yellow Pradyumna, wind and cloud"; "Om Am, on the heart, the dark Aniruddha, endowed with all powers." Having thus made oneself the fourfold manifestation, one should then perform the rite.

verses.transliteration: mamāgre 'vasthito viṣṇuḥ pṛṣṭhataś cāpi keśavaḥ govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme tu madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: "Vishnu stands before me, Keshava behind, Govinda on the right side and Madhusudana on the left,

verses.translation: Vaikuntha above, Varaha on the surface of the earth, and in all the intermediate directions Madhava.

verses.transliteration: gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato 'pi vā narasiṃhakṛtā guptir vāsudevamayo hy aham
verses.translation: Whether going or standing, waking or sleeping, my protection is made by Narasimha; I am made of Vasudeva."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet yathā dehe tathā deve sarvatattvāni yojayet
verses.translation: Having thus become made of Vishnu, one should then begin the rite; as in the body, so in the deity one should place all the principles.

verses.translation: Then one should perform the sprinkling with the pranava, ending with "phat," declared to remove all obstacles and auspicious.

verses.transliteration: tatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayet padmamadhye nyased viṣṇuṃ pavanasyāmbarasya ca
verses.translation: There one should contemplate the orbs of the sun, moon and fire, and in the middle of the lotus place Vishnu, of wind and of space.

verses.translation: Then contemplating in the heart the syllable Om whose form is light, seated on the pericarp, the eternal form of light,

verses.transliteration: aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ vinyasec ca yathākramam tena vyastasamastena pūjanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: one should place the eight-syllable mantra in order; worship with it, separately and together, is remembered as supreme.

verses.translation: contemplating the four-armed, mighty one, radiant as a crore of suns, the great yogin, the eternal form of light; then, contemplating in the mind, one should invoke him with the mantra in order.

verses.transliteration: āvāhanamantraḥ: mīnarūpo varāhaś ca narasiṃho 'tha vāmanaḥ | āyātu devo varado mama nārāyaṇo 'grataḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The invocation mantra: "Fish in form, Boar, Man-Lion and Dwarf — may the boon-giving god Narayana come before me. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: sthāpanamantraḥ: karṇikāyāṃ supīṭhe 'tra padmakalpitam āsanam sarvasattvahitārthāya tiṣṭha tvaṃ madhusūdana oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The installation mantra: "Here on the pericarp, on this fine seat, is a seat made of lotus; for the good of all beings, stay, O Madhusudana. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: arghamantraḥ: oṃ trailokyapatīnāṃ pataye devadevāya hṛṣīkeśāya viṣṇave namaḥ | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The offering mantra: "Om, salutation to the lord of the lords of the three worlds, the god of gods, Hrishikesha, Vishnu. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: pādyamantraḥ: oṃ pādyaṃ pādayor deva padmanābha sanātana viṣṇo kamalapattrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdana oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The foot-water mantra: "Om, O god, eternal Padmanabha, Vishnu, lotus-eyed Madhusudana, accept this water for the feet. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: madhuparkamantraḥ: madhuparkaṃ mahādeva brahmādyaiḥ kalpitaṃ tava mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottama oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: The madhuparka mantra: "O great god, the madhuparka prepared for you by Brahma and the others, offered by me with devotion — accept it, O Purushottama. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिन्याः सितं वारि सर्वपापहरं शिवम् गृहाणाचमनीयं त्वं मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: mandākinyāḥ sitaṃ vāri sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "The pure white water of the Mandakini, removing all sins — accept this water for sipping, offered by me with devotion. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: tvam āpaḥ pṛthivī caiva jyotis tvaṃ vāyur eva ca lokeśa vṛttimātreṇa vāriṇā snāpayāmy aham oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "You are water and earth, you are light and wind; O lord of the world, merely as a gesture I bathe you with water. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: devatattvasamāyukta yajñavarṇasamanvita svarṇavarṇaprabhe deva vāsasī tava keśava oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "O you endowed with the divine principle, joined with the colour of sacrifice, these two garments of golden radiance are yours, O Keshava. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ caiva ca keśava mayā nivedito gandhaḥ pratigṛhya vilipyatām oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "I do not know your body or your movements, O Keshava; accept the perfume offered by me and let it be applied. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रेण त्रिवृतं पद्मयोनिना सावित्रीग्रन्थिसंयुक्तम् उपवीतं तवार्पये ॐ नमो नारायणाय नमः
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmamantreṇa trivṛtaṃ padmayoninā sāvitrīgranthisaṃyuktam upavītaṃ tavārpaye oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "I offer you a sacred thread, threefold by the one born of the lotus through the mantras of Rig, Yajus and Saman, joined with the knot of Savitri. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: divyaratnasamāyukta vahnibhānusamaprabha gātrāṇi tava śobhantu sālaṃkārāṇi mādhava oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ
verses.translation: "O you endowed with divine jewels, radiant as fire and sun, may your limbs shine with ornaments, O Madhava. Om, salutation to Narayana, salutation."

verses.transliteration: oṃ nama iti pratyakṣaraṃ samastena mūlamantreṇa vā pūjayet ||
verses.translation: One should worship either syllable by syllable with 'Om Namah' or entirely with the primary root mantra (Mulamantra).

verses.science:

verses.commentary: Prescription of systematic mantra worship and japa in Brahma Purana ch 61, emphasizing focused consciousness during sacred recitation.
verses.lifeLesson: Focus your mind with simplicity. A single sincere word or sacred syllable spoken with total presence has tremendous power.

verses.translation: Vayu, the lord of wealth, Ishana and Ananta with Brahma one should worship with Tantric mantras, below and above likewise.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam labhed abhimatān kāmān naro nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Having thus worshipped the lord of gods Janardana in the mandala, a man obtains the desires he wishes; there is no doubt.

verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam pūjitaṃ yaḥ saṃpaśyeta sa viśed viṣṇum avyayam
verses.translation: Whoever sees Janardana in the mandala worshipped by this very rite enters the imperishable Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: सकृद् अप्य् अर्चितो येन विधिनानेन केशवः जन्ममृत्युजरां तीर्त्वा स विष्णोः पदम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sakṛd apy arcito yena vidhinānena keśavaḥ janmamṛtyujarāṃ tīrtvā sa viṣṇoḥ padam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: One by whom Keshava has been worshipped even once by this rite crosses birth, death and old age and attains the state of Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्मरेत् सततं भक्त्या नारायणम् अतन्द्रितः अन्वहं तस्य वासाय श्वेतद्वीपः प्रकल्पितः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ smaret satataṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇam atandritaḥ anvahaṃ tasya vāsāya śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥ
verses.translation: For one who tirelessly remembers Narayana with devotion constantly, day after day, Shvetadvipa is prepared as his dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारादिसमायुक्तं नमःकारान्तदीपितम् तन्नाम सर्वतत्त्वानां मन्त्र इत्य् अभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: oṃkārādisamāyuktaṃ namaḥkārāntadīpitam tannāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ity abhidhīyate
verses.translation: Joined with Om at the beginning and brightened by "namah" at the end, that name of all the principles is called a mantra.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधानेन गन्धपुष्पं निवेदयेत् एकैकस्य प्रकुर्वीत यथोद्दिष्टं क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhānena gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet ekaikasya prakurvīta yathoddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa tu
verses.translation: By this same method one should offer perfume and flowers, performing it for each one in order as prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: मुद्रास् ततो निबध्नीयाद् यथोक्तक्रमचोदिताः जपं चैव प्रकुर्वीत मूलमन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्

verses.translation: Then one should form the mudras as prompted in the prescribed order, and the knower of mantras should perform recitation with the root mantra —

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाविंशतिम् अष्टौ वा शतम् अष्टोत्तरं तथा कामेषु च यथाप्रोक्तं यथाशक्ति समाहितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāviṃśatim aṣṭau vā śatam aṣṭottaraṃ tathā kāmeṣu ca yathāproktaṃ yathāśakti samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: twenty-eight, or eight, or a hundred and eight times, and for desired ends as prescribed, according to one's ability, with composure.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मं शङ्खश् च श्रीवत्सो गदा गरुड एव च चक्रं खड्गश् च शार्ङ्गं च अष्टौ मुद्राः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: padmaṃ śaṅkhaś ca śrīvatso gadā garuḍa eva ca cakraṃ khaḍgaś ca śārṅgaṃ ca aṣṭau mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Lotus, conch, Shrivatsa, mace, Garuda, discus, sword and Sharnga — eight mudras are declared.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ गच्छ परं स्थानं पुराणपुरुषोत्तम यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा विन्दन्ति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama yatra brahmādayo devā vindanti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: "Go, go to the supreme abode, O ancient Purushottama, where the gods beginning with Brahma find the supreme state."

verses.sanskrit: अर्चनं ये न जानन्ति हरेर् मन्त्रैर् यथोदितम् ते तत्र मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयन्त्व् अच्युतं सदा
verses.transliteration: arcanaṃ ye na jānanti harer mantrair yathoditam te tatra mūlamantreṇa pūjayantv acyutaṃ sadā
verses.translation: Those who do not know the worship of Hari with the mantras as told should always worship Achyuta there with the root mantra.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्य विधिवद् भक्त्या तं पुरुषोत्तमम् प्रणम्य शिरसा पश्चात् सागरं च प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad bhaktyā taṃ puruṣottamam praṇamya śirasā paścāt sāgaraṃ ca prasādayet
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmins, thence the devotee should go to the holy spot of sacrifices where the splendid and sacred lake Indradyumna is situated.;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmins, thence the devotee should go to the holy spot of sacrifices where the splendid and sacred lake Indradyumna is situated.;
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस् त्वं सर्वभूतानां योनिश् च सरितां पते तीर्थराज नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्राहि माम् अच्युतप्रिय
verses.transliteration: prāṇas tvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniś ca saritāṃ pate tīrtharāja namas te 'stu trāhi mām acyutapriya
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee should go there with pure mind and body, and meditate mentally on lord Hari, approach the sacred waters, perform the Acamana rite and repeat this Mantra:—
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent devotee should go there with pure mind and body, and meditate mentally on lord Hari, approach the sacred waters, perform the Acamana rite and repeat this Mantra:—

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वैवं सागरे सम्यक् तस्मिन् क्षेत्रवरे द्विजाः तीरे चाभ्यर्च्य विधिवन् नारायणम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: snātvaivaṃ sāgare samyak tasmin kṣetravare dvijāḥ tīre cābhyarcya vidhivan nārāyaṇam anāmayam
verses.translation: "O holy spot that is sanctified by the performance of horse sacrifice, and which destroys sins, I am taking a holy dip in you. Remove my sin. Obeisance be to you".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy spot that is sanctified by the performance of horse sacrifice, and which destroys sins, I am taking a holy dip in you. Remove my sin. Obeisance be to you".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामं कृष्णं सुभद्रां च प्रणिपत्य च सागरम् शतानाम् अश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca praṇipatya ca sāgaram śatānām aśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: He redeems seven former generations and seven sub¬ sequent generations of his family. Like a God he goes to the world of Visnu on an aerial chariot that can go in all directions.
verses.commentary: Sense: He redeems seven former generations and seven sub¬ sequent generations of his family. Like a God he goes to the world of Visnu on an aerial chariot that can go in all directions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः वृन्दारक इव श्रीमान् रूपयौवनगर्वितः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ vṛndāraka iva śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ
verses.translation: He can enjoy pleasures and happiness there, as long as the moon, sun and stars last. Falling off* from that world he returns to the earth and attains salvation thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He can enjoy pleasures and happiness there, as long as the moon, sun and stars last. Falling off* from that world he returns to the earth and attains salvation thereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन दिव्यगन्धर्वनादिना कुलैकविंशम् उद्धृत्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena divyagandharvanādinā kulaikaviṃśam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: O lord, great-grandfather, why do you praise the month of Jyestha in preference to Magha and other months. Kindly tell us the reason thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, great-grandfather, why do you praise the month of Jyestha in preference to Magha and other months. Kindly tell us the reason thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् क्रीडित्वा चाप्सरैः सह मन्वन्तरशतं साग्रं जरामृत्युविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍitvā cāpsaraiḥ saha manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen, I shall briefly mention why I praise the month of Jyestha. in preference to other months.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, listen, I shall briefly mention why I praise the month of Jyestha. in preference to other months.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षयाद् इहायातः कुले सर्वगुणान्विते रूपवान् सुभगः श्रीमान् सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣayād ihāyātaḥ kule sarvaguṇānvite rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān satyavādī jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the tenth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha removes ten sins. Hence it is called 'Dasahara'.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the tenth day in the bright half of the month of Jyestha removes ten sins. Hence it is called 'Dasahara'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रार्थविद् विप्रो भवेद् यज्वा तु वैष्णवः योगं च वैष्णवं प्राप्य ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrārthavid vipro bhaved yajvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ yogaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ prāpya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The man who visits Balarama, Krsna, and Subhadra meditates upon them with concentration and mental purity will get rid of all sins and go to the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who visits Balarama, Krsna, and Subhadra meditates upon them with concentration and mental purity will get rid of all sins and go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहोपरागे संक्रान्त्याम् अयने विषुवे तथा युगादिषु षडशीत्यां व्यतीपाते दिनक्षये
verses.transliteration: grahoparāge saṃkrāntyām ayane viṣuve tathā yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatīpāte dinakṣaye
verses.translation: O Brahmins, by visiting Purusottama, Rama and Subhadra during the first day of the northern and southern solar transits the man goes to the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmins, by visiting Purusottama, Rama and Subhadra during the first day of the northern and southern solar transits the man goes to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आषाढ्यां चैव कार्त्तिक्यां माघ्यां वान्ये शुभे तिथौ ये तत्र दानं विप्रेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्ति सुमेधसः
verses.transliteration: āṣāḍhyāṃ caiva kārttikyāṃ māghyāṃ vānye śubhe tithau ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti sumedhasaḥ
verses.translation: By visiting Govinda, the most excellent of all Gods, seated on the swing, on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna the devotee of great self-restraint shall go to the city of Govinda.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: फलं सहस्रगुणितम् अन्यतीर्थाल् लभन्ति ते पितॄणां ये प्रयच्छन्ति पिण्डं तत्र विधानतः
verses.transliteration: phalaṃ sahasraguṇitam anyatīrthāl labhanti te pitṝṇāṃ ye prayacchanti piṇḍaṃ tatra vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: They obtain a thousandfold the fruit of other holy places, those who offer rice-balls to the ancestors there according to rule;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयां पितरस् तेषां तृप्तिं संप्राप्नुवन्ति वै एवं स्नानफलं सम्यक् सागरस्य मयोदितम्
verses.transliteration: akṣayāṃ pitaras teṣāṃ tṛptiṃ saṃprāpnuvanti vai evaṃ snānaphalaṃ samyak sāgarasya mayoditam
verses.translation: their ancestors obtain imperishable satisfaction. Thus I have properly told the fruit of bathing in the ocean,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दानस्य च फलं विप्राः पिण्डदानस्य चैव हि धर्मार्थमोक्षफलदम् आयुष्कीर्तियशस्करम्
verses.transliteration: dānasya ca phalaṃ viprāḥ piṇḍadānasya caiva hi dharmārthamokṣaphaladam āyuṣkīrtiyaśaskaram
verses.translation: and the fruit of giving, O brahmins, and of offering rice-balls — it gives the fruits of dharma, wealth and liberation, and brings long life, fame and glory,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिमुक्तिफलं नॄणां धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: yields enjoyment and liberation to men, is blessed, destroys bad dreams, removes all sins, is holy and grants the fruit of every desire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ tāvad garjanti tīrthāni māhātmyaiḥ svaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: This Purana should not be told to an atheist, O best of brahmins. The holy places roar each with its own greatness

verses.sanskrit: यावन् न तीर्थराजस्य माहात्म्यं वर्ण्यते द्विजाः पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि प्रयच्छन्ति स्वकं फलम्
verses.transliteration: yāvan na tīrtharājasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate dvijāḥ puṣkarādīni tīrthāni prayacchanti svakaṃ phalam
verses.translation: only until the greatness of the king of holy places is described, O brahmins. Pushkara and the other holy places give their own fruit,

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थराजस् तु स पुनः सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदः भूतले यानि तीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च
verses.transliteration: tīrtharājas tu sa punaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ bhūtale yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca
verses.translation: but the king of holy places gives the fruit of all holy places. Whatever holy places, rivers and lakes there are on earth

verses.sanskrit: विशन्ति सागरे तानि तेनासौ श्रेष्ठतां गतः राजा समस्ततीर्थानां सागरः सरितां पतिः
verses.transliteration: viśanti sāgare tāni tenāsau śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ rājā samastatīrthānāṃ sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: enter the ocean; therefore it has attained pre-eminence. The ocean, lord of rivers, is the king of all holy places;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् समस्ततीर्थेभ्यः श्रेष्ठो ऽसौ सर्वकामदः तमो नाशं यथाभ्येति भास्करे ऽभ्युदिते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt samastatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho 'sau sarvakāmadaḥ tamo nāśaṃ yathābhyeti bhāskare 'bhyudite dvijāḥ
verses.translation: therefore it is superior to all holy places and grants every desire. As darkness perishes when the sun has risen, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानेन तीर्थराजस्य तथा पापस्य संक्षयः तीर्थराजसमं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: snānena tīrtharājasya tathā pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ tīrtharājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: so by bathing in the king of holy places sin is destroyed. There has not been and will not be a holy place equal to the king of holy places,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं यदा यत्र प्रभोर् नारायणस्य वै कः शक्नोति गुणान् वक्तुं तीर्थराजस्य भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhānaṃ yadā yatra prabhor nārāyaṇasya vai kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tīrtharājasya bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: where the Lord Narayana has his abode. Who can tell the virtues of the king of holy places, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कोट्यो नवनवत्यस् तु यत्र तीर्थानि सन्ति वै तस्मात् स्नानं च दानं च होमं जप्यं सुरार्चनम् यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र चाक्षयं क्रियते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: koṭyo navanavatyas tu yatra tīrthāni santi vai tasmāt snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca homaṃ japyaṃ surārcanam yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra cākṣayaṃ kriyate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: where there are ninety-nine crores of holy places? Therefore whatever is done there — bathing, giving, fire offering, recitation, worship of the gods — becomes imperishable, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेद् द्विजश्रेष्ठास् तीर्थं यज्ञाङ्गसंभवम् इन्द्रद्युम्नसरो नाम यत्रास्ते पावनं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tato gacched dvijaśreṣṭhās tīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam indradyumnasaro nāma yatrāste pāvanaṃ śubham
verses.translation: When the Mahajyesthi occurs due to the contact of a zodiac and a constellation he should go to the holy place called Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा तत्र शुचिर् धीमान् आचम्य मनसा हरिम् ध्यात्वोपस्थाय च जलम् इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: gatvā tatra śucir dhīmān ācamya manasā harim dhyātvopasthāya ca jalam imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: O brahmins, by visiting Krsna, Rama and Subhadra on the Mahajyesthi day, the visitor obtains more benefit than that of twelve pilgrimages.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, by visiting Krsna, Rama and Subhadra on the Mahajyesthi day, the visitor obtains more benefit than that of twelve pilgrimages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधाङ्गसंभूत तीर्थ सर्वाघनाशन स्नानं त्वयि करोम्य् अद्य पापं हर नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhāṅgasaṃbhūta tīrtha sarvāghanāśana snānaṃ tvayi karomy adya pāpaṃ hara namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, those who are desirous of attaining their longed-for benefit, will assiduously go to Purusottama on the MahajycsthI day.

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उच्चार्य विधिवत् स्नात्वा देवान् ऋषीन् पितॄन् तिलोदकेन चान्यांश् च संतर्प्याचम्य वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: evam uccārya vidhivat snātvā devān ṛṣīn pitṝn tilodakena cānyāṃś ca saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: Having uttered this duly, bathed, satisfied the gods, sages, ancestors and others with sesame water, sipped water and kept silence,

verses.transliteration: saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya devavat kāmagena vimānena viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Raising seven generations below and seven above, like a god, he goes to Vishnu's world in a celestial car that moves at will.

verses.transliteration: bhuktvā tatra sukhān bhogān yāvac candrārkatārakam cyutas tasmād ihāyāto mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam
verses.translation: Having enjoyed pleasant enjoyments there as long as the moon, sun and stars endure, falling from there and coming here, he surely obtains liberation.

verses.transliteration: sa pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ prāpya krīḍitvā vācyutālaye prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: obtaining the fruit described before and sporting in Achyuta's abode, goes to the supreme place from which there is no return.
