verses.transliteration: māsān anyān parityajya māghādīn prapitāmaha praśaṃsasi kathaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ prabho
verses.translation: "Leaving aside other months beginning with Magha, O great grandsire, why do you praise Jyeshtha? Tell us the reason, O Lord."

verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ māsaṃ yathā tebhyaḥ praśaṃsāmi punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: "Listen, O tigers among sages; I shall tell briefly why I praise the month of Jyeshtha again and again above them.

verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca puṣkariṇyas taḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpās tathā hradāḥ
verses.translation: The holy places on earth, the rivers and lakes, lotus pools, tanks, step-wells, wells and pools,

verses.transliteration: nānānadyaḥ samudrāś ca saptāhaṃ puruṣottame jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyādi pratyakṣaṃ yānti sarvadā
verses.translation: the various rivers and the oceans always come in person to Purushottama for seven days beginning from the bright tenth of Jyeshtha.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानदानादिकं तस्माद् देवताप्रेक्षणं द्विजाः यत् किंचित् क्रियते तत्र तस्मिन् काले ऽक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: snānadānādikaṃ tasmād devatāprekṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥ yat kiṃcit kriyate tatra tasmin kāle 'kṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Therefore whatever bathing, giving and seeing of the deity is done there at that time becomes imperishable, O brahmins.

verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣasya daśamī jyeṣṭhe māsi dvijottamāḥ harate daśa pāpāni tasmād daśaharā smṛtā
verses.translation: The tenth of the bright fortnight in the month of Jyeshtha, O best of brahmins, takes away ten sins; therefore it is remembered as Dashahara.

verses.sanskrit: यस् तस्यां हलिनं कृष्णं पश्येद् भद्रां सुसंयतः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: yas tasyāṃ halinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyed bhadrāṃ susaṃyataḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: The man who, well controlled, sees the plough-bearer, Krishna and Bhadra on that day is freed from all sins and goes to Vishnu's world.

verses.translation: The man who, being devout, sees Govinda Purushottama on the swing on the Phalguni full moon goes to Govinda's city.

verses.translation: When the equinox arrives, having performed the Panchatirtha according to rule and seen Sankarshana, Krishna and Bhadra, O brahmins,

verses.translation: a man obtains the rare fruit of all sacrifices; freed from all sins, he goes to Vishnu's world.

verses.translation: Whoever sees Krishna anointed with sandal on the third of the dark fortnight of Vaishakha goes to Achyuta's temple.

verses.translation: Whoever sees Purushottama on the full moon of Jyeshtha joined with the Jyeshtha asterism raises twenty-one generations and goes to Vishnu's world."

verses.transliteration: yadā bhaven mahājyaiṣṭhī rāśinakṣatrayogataḥ prayatnena tadā martyair gantavyaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: O sages, even as I recount, listen to the rules of holy ablution (in propitiation) of Krsna, Rama and Subhadra. It is meritorious and destroyer of all sins. O brahmins if, in the month of Jyestha the constella- ation Margasiras coincides with the full moon, that is the auspicious time for the ablution of Hari.

verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, all the holy sacred waters mentioned above bathe the deities separately with their waters moved with flowers. "Obeisance to you, O Lord of the chiefs of Devas, O ancient Purusottama, O lord, the cause of creation, sustenance and annihilation, O lord of the world, O lord of the Universe.

verses.transliteration: prayāge ca kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare gaye gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
verses.translation: Devoutly we bow to the lord holding the three worlds, who is favourably disposed to the brahmins, who is the cause of liberation and who bestows all desired benefits. O excellent sages, Devas eulogised Krsna, Balarama of great strength and Subhadra and remained in the sky itself.

verses.transliteration: kokāmukhe śūkare ca mathurāyāṃ marusthale śālagrāme vāyutīrthe mandare sindhusāgare
verses.translation: Together with Gandharvas they sang auspicious songs while the celestial damsels danced, the divine musical instru¬ ments were played and the cool gentle winds blew. The clouds gathered in the sky, showered water and strewed flowers. The sages, Siddhas and Caranas shouted cries of victory.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मनिरतः शान्तः कृष्णभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: svadharmanirataḥ śāntaḥ kṛṣṇabhakto jitendriyaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is the result of holy bath accompanied by charit¬ able gifts in Kuruksetra at the time of solar eclipse.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting Krsna facing the south a man obtains the benefit which is the result of holy bath accompanied by charit¬ able gifts in Kuruksetra at the time of solar eclipse.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्मिन् काले भवेत् स्नानं कृष्णस्य कमलोद्भव विधिना केन तद् ब्रूहि ततो विधिविदां वर
verses.transliteration: kasmin kāle bhavet snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya kamalodbhava vidhinā kena tad brūhi tato vidhividāṃ vara
verses.translation: Those who observe Kr?na, Balarama and Subhadra seated in a chariot and going in a procession to the Mandapa called Gundika go to the abode of lord Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनयः स्नानं कृष्णस्य वदतो मम रामस्य च सुभद्रायाः पुण्यं सर्वाघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vadato mama rāmasya ca subhadrāyāḥ puṇyaṃ sarvāghanāśanam
verses.translation: Those who visit Krsna, Balarama and Subhadra occu¬ pying the Mandapa for seven days, go to the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who visit Krsna, Balarama and Subhadra occu¬ pying the Mandapa for seven days, go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मासि ज्येष्ठे च संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे चन्द्रदैवते पौर्णमास्यां तदा स्नानं सर्वकालं हरेर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: māsi jyeṣṭhe ca saṃprāpte nakṣatre candradaivate paurṇamāsyāṃ tadā snānaṃ sarvakālaṃ harer dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Who initiated the procession to the auspicious Gundika Mandapa? What is the benefit of witnessing this procession?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who initiated the procession to the auspicious Gundika Mandapa? What is the benefit of witnessing this procession?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतीर्थमयः कूपस् तत्रास्ते निर्मलः शुचिः तदा भोगवती तत्र प्रत्यक्षा भवति द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sarvatīrthamayaḥ kūpas tatrāste nirmalaḥ śuciḥ tadā bhogavatī tatra pratyakṣā bhavati dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O king, there shall be a procession for seven days on the banks of your lake. It will be called Gundika. It will bestow all desired benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, there shall be a procession for seven days on the banks of your lake. It will be called Gundika. It will bestow all desired benefits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यां समुद्धृत्य हैमाढ्यैः कलशैर् जलम् कृष्णरामाभिषेकार्थं सुभद्रायाश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyāṃ samuddhṛtya haimāḍhyaiḥ kalaśair jalam kṛṣṇarāmābhiṣekārthaṃ subhadrāyāś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this to him the lord vanished there itself. That glorious and excellent king was fully satisfied.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to him the lord vanished there itself. That glorious and excellent king was fully satisfied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा सुशोभनं मञ्चं पताकाभिर् अलंकृतम् सुदृढं सुखसंचारं वस्त्रैः पुष्पैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā suśobhanaṃ mañcaṃ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam sudṛḍhaṃ sukhasaṃcāraṃ vastraiḥ puṣpair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one shall by all means visit lord Visnu, the bestower of all desires, at Gundika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one shall by all means visit lord Visnu, the bestower of all desires, at Gundika.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्णं धूपितं धूपैः स्नानार्थं रामकृष्णयोः सितवस्त्रपरिच्छन्नं मुक्ताहारावलम्बितम्
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇaṃ dhūpitaṃ dhūpaiḥ snānārthaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ sitavastraparicchannaṃ muktāhārāvalambitam
verses.translation: A man if he has no son, obtains sons, if poor, gets riches, if sick, is liberated from ailments. A virgin will get a good husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man if he has no son, obtains sons, if poor, gets riches, if sick, is liberated from ailments. A virgin will get a good husband.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नानाविधैर् वाद्यैः कृष्णं नीलाम्बरं द्विजाः मध्ये सुभद्रां चास्थाप्य जयमङ्गलनिस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: tatra nānāvidhair vādyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ dvijāḥ madhye subhadrāṃ cāsthāpya jayamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ
verses.translation: The man derives longevity, glory, fame, intelligence, strength, learning, courage and obtains cattle, progeny and the wealth of handsome features and blooming youth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man derives longevity, glory, fame, intelligence, strength, learning, courage and obtains cattle, progeny and the wealth of handsome features and blooming youth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर् वैश्यैः शूद्रैश् चान्यैश् च जातिभिः अनेकशतसाहस्रैर् वृतं स्त्रीपुरुषैर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś cānyaiś ca jātibhiḥ anekaśatasāhasrair vṛtaṃ strīpuruṣair dvijāḥ
verses.translation: By visiting lord Visnu a man or woman devotee attains whatever pleasure he or she wishes for.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थाः स्नातकाश् चैव यतयो ब्रह्मचारिणः स्नापयन्ति तदा कृष्णं मञ्चस्थं सहलायुधम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthāḥ snātakāś caiva yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ snāpayanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ mañcasthaṃ sahalāyudham
verses.translation: Householders, graduates, ascetics and celibate students then bathe Krishna, seated on the platform with the plough-armed one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा समस्ततीर्थानि पूर्वोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमाः स्वोदकैः पुष्पमिश्रैश् च स्नापयन्ति पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tathā samastatīrthāni pūrvoktāni dvijottamāḥ svodakaiḥ puṣpamiśraiś ca snāpayanti pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Likewise all the holy places mentioned before, O best of brahmins, bathe them separately with their own waters mixed with flowers.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चात् पटहशङ्खाद्यैर् भेरीमुरजनिस्वनैः काहलैस् तालशब्दैश् च मृदङ्गैर् झर्झरैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: paścāt paṭahaśaṅkhādyair bherīmurajanisvanaiḥ kāhalais tālaśabdaiś ca mṛdaṅgair jharjharais tathā
verses.translation: Then with kettledrums, conches and the like, with the sounds of drums and tabors, with horns, cymbals, mridangas and jharjharas,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वाद्यैर् घण्टास्वनविभूषितैः स्त्रीणां मङ्गलशब्दैश् च स्तुतिशब्दैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: anyaiś ca vividhair vādyair ghaṇṭāsvanavibhūṣitaiḥ strīṇāṃ maṅgalaśabdaiś ca stutiśabdair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: and other various instruments adorned with the sound of bells, with women's auspicious cries and charming sounds of praise,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: with cries of victory, hymns and the sounds of lute and flute, a very great sound is heard, like the roaring ocean.

verses.transliteration: yatibhiḥ snātakaiś caiva gṛhasthair brahmacāribhiḥ snānakāle suraśreṣṭha stuvanti parayā mudā
verses.translation: ascetics, graduates, householders and celibate students praise him with supreme joy at the time of bathing, O best of gods.

verses.translation: By youthful courtesans bent with the weight of their breasts, in yellow and red garments, bent with garlands,

verses.transliteration: namas te devadeveśa purāṇa puruṣottama sargasthityantakṛd deva lokanātha jagatpate
verses.translation: "Salutation to you, lord of the god of gods, ancient Purushottama, god who makes creation, sustenance and end, lord of the worlds, master of the universe.

verses.translation: We bow with devotion to the god who upholds the three worlds, friendly to brahmins, the cause of liberation, granting the fruit of every desire."

verses.translation: Having thus praised Krishna, the mighty Rama and Subhadra, the gods, O best of sages, stood in the sky.

verses.translation: The divine Gandharvas sing, the Apsarases dance, the instruments of the gods are played, and very cool winds blow.

verses.translation: Then the clouds moving in the sky rain flowers mixed with water, and sages, Siddhas and Charanas raise cries of victory,

verses.translation: surrounded by all holy Vidyadharas and those perfected in yoga; the Grandsire, Pulastya, Pulaha of great austerity,

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिराः कश्यपो ऽत्रिश् च मरीचिर् भृगुर् एव च क्रतुर् हरः प्रचेताश् च मनुर् दक्षस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: aṅgirāḥ kaśyapo 'triś ca marīcir bhṛgur eva ca kratur haraḥ pracetāś ca manur dakṣas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Angiras, Kashyapa, Atri, Marichi and Bhrigu, Kratu, Hara, Prachetas, Manu and Daksha,

verses.transliteration: ṛtavaś ca grahāś caiva jyotīṃṣi ca dvijottamāḥ mūrtimatyaś ca sarito devāś caiva sanātanāḥ
verses.translation: the seasons, planets and luminaries, O best of brahmins, the embodied rivers and the eternal gods,

verses.transliteration: samudrāś ca hradāś caiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca pṛthivī dyaur diśaś caiva pādapāś ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: oceans, pools and various holy places, earth, heaven, the directions and the trees, O best of brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर् देवमाता च ह्रीः श्रीः स्वाहा सरस्वती उमा शची सिनीवाली तथा चानुमतिः कुहूः
verses.transliteration: aditir devamātā ca hrīḥ śrīḥ svāhā sarasvatī umā śacī sinīvālī tathā cānumatiḥ kuhūḥ
verses.translation: Aditi mother of the gods, Hri, Shri, Svaha, Sarasvati, Uma, Shachi, Sinivali, Anumati and Kuhu,

verses.transliteration: rākā ca dhiṣaṇā caiva patnyaś cānyā divaukasām himavāṃś caiva vindhyaś ca meruś cānekaśṛṅgavān

verses.transliteration: airāvataḥ sānucaraḥ kalākāṣṭhās tathaiva ca māsārdhaṃ māsa-ṛtavas tathā rātryahanī samāḥ
verses.translation: Airavata with his followers, kalas and kashthas, half-months, months and seasons, nights, days and years,

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवा हयश्रेष्ठो नागराजश् च वामनः अरुणो गरुडश् चैव वृक्षाश् चौषधिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭho nāgarājaś ca vāmanaḥ aruṇo garuḍaś caiva vṛkṣāś cauṣadhibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Uchchaihshravas the best of horses, the king of Nagas and Vamana, Aruna and Garuda, trees with herbs,

verses.transliteration: dharmaś ca bhagavān devaḥ samājagmur hi saṃgatāḥ kālo yamaś ca mṛtyuś ca yamasyānucarāś ca ye
verses.translation: and the Lord Dharma came together; Time, Yama, Death and Yama's followers,

verses.sanskrit: बहुलत्वाच् च नोक्ता ये विविधा देवतागणाः ते देवस्याभिषेकार्थं समायान्ति ततस् ततः
verses.transliteration: bahulatvāc ca noktā ye vividhā devatāgaṇāḥ te devasyābhiṣekārthaṃ samāyānti tatas tataḥ
verses.translation: and the various hosts of gods not named because of their multitude — they come from here and there for the god's consecration.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा ते तदा विप्राः सर्वे देवा दिवौकसः आभिषेचनिकं द्रव्यं मङ्गलानि च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā te tadā viprāḥ sarve devā divaukasaḥ ābhiṣecanikaṃ dravyaṃ maṅgalāni ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, all the gods, dwellers of heaven, taking the materials of consecration and all auspicious things,

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यसंभारसंयुक्तैः कलशैः काञ्चनैर् द्विजाः सारस्वतीभिः पुण्याभिर् दिव्यतोयाभिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: divyasaṃbhārasaṃyuktaiḥ kalaśaiḥ kāñcanair dvijāḥ sārasvatībhiḥ puṇyābhir divyatoyābhir eva ca
verses.translation: with golden pitchers joined with divine provisions, with holy waters of the Sarasvati and divine waters,

verses.sanskrit: तोयेनाकाशगङ्गायाः कृष्णं रामेण संगतम् सपुष्पैः काञ्चनैः कुम्भैः स्नापयन्त्य् अवनिस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: toyenākāśagaṅgāyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam sapuṣpaiḥ kāñcanaiḥ kumbhaiḥ snāpayanty avanisthitāḥ
verses.translation: with water of the heavenly Ganga, standing on the earth, they bathe Krishna together with Rama with golden pots containing flowers.

verses.sanskrit: संचरन्ति विमानानि देवानाम् अम्बरे तथा उच्चावचानि दिव्यानि कामगानि स्थिराणि च
verses.transliteration: saṃcaranti vimānāni devānām ambare tathā uccāvacāni divyāni kāmagāni sthirāṇi ca
verses.translation: The celestial cars of the gods move in the sky, high and low, divine, moving at will and steady,

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यरत्नविचित्राणि सेवितान्य् अप्सरोगणैः गीतैर् वाद्यैः पताकाभिः शोभितानि समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: divyaratnavicitrāṇi sevitāny apsarogaṇaiḥ gītair vādyaiḥ patākābhiḥ śobhitāni samantataḥ
verses.translation: variegated with divine jewels, attended by hosts of Apsarases, adorned all around with songs, music and banners.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तदा मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कृष्णं रामेण संगतम् स्नापयित्वा सुभद्रां च संस्तुवन्ति मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tadā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam snāpayitvā subhadrāṃ ca saṃstuvanti mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O best of sages, having bathed Krishna together with Rama and Subhadra, they joyfully praise them:

verses.transliteration: jaya jaya lokapāla bhaktarakṣaka jaya jaya praṇatavatsala jaya jaya bhūtacaraṇa jaya jayādideva bahukāraṇa jaya jaya vāsudeva jaya jayāsurasaṃharaṇa jaya jaya divyamīna jaya jaya tridaśavara jaya jaya jaladhiśayana | 1 | jaya jaya yogivara jaya jaya sūryanetra jaya jaya devarāja jaya jaya kaiṭabhāre jaya jaya vedavara jaya jaya kūrmarūpa jaya jaya yajñavara jaya jaya kamalanābha jaya jaya śailacara | 2 | jaya jaya yogaśāyiñ jaya jaya vegadhara jaya jaya viśvamūrte jaya jaya cakradhara jaya jaya bhūtanātha jaya jaya dharaṇīdhara jaya jaya śeṣaśāyiñ jaya jaya pītavāso jaya jaya somakānta | 3 | jaya jaya yogavāsa jaya jaya dahanavaktra jaya jaya dharmavāsa jaya jaya guṇanidhāna jaya jaya śrīnivāsa jaya jaya garuḍagamana jaya jaya sukhanivāsa jaya jaya dharmaketo jaya jaya mahīnivāsa | 4 | jaya jaya gahanacaritra jaya jaya yogigamya jaya jaya makhanivāsa jaya jaya vedavedya jaya śāntikara jaya jaya yogicintya jaya jaya puṣṭikara jaya jaya jñānamūrte jaya jaya kamalākara | 5 | jaya jaya bhāvavedya jaya jaya muktikara jaya jaya vimaladeha jaya jaya sattvanilaya jaya jaya guṇasamṛddha jaya jaya yajñakara jaya jaya guṇavihīna jaya jaya mokṣakara jaya jaya bhūśaraṇya | 6 | jaya jaya kāntiyuta jaya jaya lokaśaraṇa jaya jaya lakṣmīyuta jaya jaya paṅkajākṣa jaya jaya sṛṣṭikara jaya jaya yogayuta jaya jayātasīkusumaśyāmadeha jaya jaya samudrāviṣṭadeha jaya jaya lakṣmīpaṅkajaṣaṭcaraṇa | 7 | jaya jaya bhaktavaśa jaya jaya lokakānta jaya jaya paramaśānta jaya jaya paramasāra jaya jaya cakradhara jaya jaya bhogiyuta jaya jaya nīlāmbara jaya jaya śāntikara jaya jaya mokṣakara jaya jaya kaluṣahara |

Victory, victory, full of radiance; victory, victory, refuge of the worlds; victory, victory, joined with Lakshmi; victory, victory, lotus-eyed; victory, victory, maker of creation; victory, victory, joined with yoga; victory, victory, whose body is dark as the atasi flower; victory, victory, whose body is pervaded by the ocean; victory, victory, bee at the lotus of Lakshmi. Victory, victory, subject to devotees; victory, victory, beloved of the world; victory, victory, supremely tranquil; victory, victory, supreme essence; victory, victory, discus-bearer; victory, victory, joined with the serpent; victory, victory, clad in blue; victory, victory, giver of peace; victory, victory, giver of liberation; victory, victory, remover of impurity.

verses.translation: Having seen, praised and bowed to Krishna, Rama and Subhadra, those dwellers of heaven go each to their own abode.

verses.sanskrit: अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः तस्य देवस्य माहात्म्यं मञ्चस्थस्य द्विजोत्तमाः

verses.translation: What need to say more, repeating it again and again, about the greatness of that god on the platform, O best of brahmins?

verses.translation: The fruit declared for vows and gifts at all holy places, the doer of good obtains by seeing Krishna on the platform with the plough-armed one

verses.transliteration: subhadrāṃ ca muniśreṣṭhāḥ prāpnoti śubhakṛn naraḥ tasmān naro 'thavā nārī paśyet taṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: and Subhadra, O best of sages. Therefore man or woman should see that Purushottama;

verses.transliteration: tataḥ samastatīrthānāṃ labhet snānādikaṃ phalam snānaśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇasya toyenātmābhiṣicyate
verses.translation: then one obtains the fruit of bathing and the rest at all holy places. With the water remaining from Krishna's bath one anoints oneself.

verses.sanskrit: वन्ध्या मृतप्रजा या तु दुर्भगा ग्रहपीडिता राक्षसाद्यैर् गृहीता वा तथा रोगैश् च संहताः
verses.transliteration: vandhyā mṛtaprajā yā tu durbhagā grahapīḍitā rākṣasādyair gṛhītā vā tathā rogaiś ca saṃhatāḥ
verses.translation: A barren woman, one whose children have died, the unfortunate, one afflicted by planets, one seized by Rakshasas and the like, or those beset by diseases —

verses.transliteration: sadyas tāḥ snānaśeṣeṇa udakenābhiṣecitāḥ prāpnuvantīpsitān kāmān yān yān vāñchanti cepsitān
verses.translation: anointed at once with the water remaining from the bath, they obtain whatever desires they wish.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थिनी लभेत् पुत्रान् सौभाग्यं च सुखार्थिनी रोगार्ता मुच्यते रोगाद् धनं च धनकाङ्क्षिणी
verses.transliteration: putrārthinī labhet putrān saubhāgyaṃ ca sukhārthinī rogārtā mucyate rogād dhanaṃ ca dhanakāṅkṣiṇī
verses.translation: One seeking a son obtains sons, one seeking happiness obtains good fortune, the sick is freed from disease, and one wanting wealth obtains wealth.

verses.translation: All the holy waters that exist on the earth are not worth a sixteenth part of the water remaining from the bath.

verses.translation: Therefore, O brahmins, one should anoint one's limbs with the water remaining from Krishna's bath, for it grants every desire.

verses.translation: Those who see Krishna, after his bath, going toward the south are freed from sins such as brahmin-slaying; there is no doubt.

verses.translation: The fruit of bathing and giving at Kurukshetra during a solar eclipse, a man obtains by seeing Krishna facing south.

verses.translation: the fruit declared for bathing and giving duly, a man obtains by seeing Krishna facing south.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करे चाथ तीर्थेषु गये चामरकण्टके नैमिषादिषु तीर्थेषु क्षेत्रेष्व् आयतनेषु च
verses.transliteration: puṣkare cātha tīrtheṣu gaye cāmarakaṇṭake naimiṣādiṣu tīrtheṣu kṣetreṣv āyataneṣu ca
verses.translation: At Pushkara and other holy places, at Gaya and Amarakantaka, at Naimisha and other holy places, regions and shrines,

verses.sanskrit: यत् फलं स्नानदानेन राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे दृष्ट्वा नरो लभेत् कृष्णं तत् फलं दक्षिणामुखम्

verses.translation: the fruit of bathing and giving when the sun is seized by Rahu, a man obtains by seeing Krishna facing south.

verses.sanskrit: अथ किं पुनर् उक्तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः यत् किंचित् कथितं चात्र फलं पुण्यस्य कर्मणः
verses.transliteration: atha kiṃ punar uktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ yat kiṃcit kathitaṃ cātra phalaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: What need to say it again and again? Whatever fruit of meritorious action has been told here,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रे पुराणे च भारते च द्विजोत्तमाः धर्मशास्त्रेषु सर्वेषु तथान्यत्र मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstre purāṇe ca bhārate ca dvijottamāḥ dharmaśāstreṣu sarveṣu tathānyatra manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: in the Vedas and scriptures, in the Puranas and the Bharata, O best of brahmins, in all the law books and elsewhere by the wise,

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नरो लभेत् कृष्णं तत् फलं सहलायुधम् सकलं भद्रया सार्धं व्रजन्तं दक्षिणामुखम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā naro labhet kṛṣṇaṃ tat phalaṃ sahalāyudham sakalaṃ bhadrayā sārdhaṃ vrajantaṃ dakṣiṇāmukham
verses.translation: a man obtains all that fruit by seeing Krishna with the plough-armed one and Bhadra, going toward the south.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गुडिवामण्डपं यान्तं ये पश्यन्ति रथे स्थितम् कृष्णं बलं सुभद्रां च ते यान्ति भवनं हरेः
verses.transliteration: guḍivāmaṇḍapaṃ yāntaṃ ye paśyanti rathe sthitam kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ subhadrāṃ ca te yānti bhavanaṃ hareḥ
verses.translation: Mention separately the benefit which a man or a woman with perfect self-control acquires by making holy pilgrimage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये पश्यन्ति तदा कृष्णं सप्ताहं मण्डपे स्थितम् हलिनं च सुभद्रां च विष्णुलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: ye paśyanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ saptāhaṃ maṇḍape sthitam halinaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: O brahmins, even as I recount, listen to the benefit of holy pilgrimage severally, that a man acquires after under¬ taking the pilgrimage to that holy centre with great restraint.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, even as I recount, listen to the benefit of holy pilgrimage severally, that a man acquires after under¬ taking the pilgrimage to that holy centre with great restraint.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केन सा निर्मिता यात्रा दक्षिणस्यां जगत्पते यात्राफलं च किं तत्र प्राप्यते ब्रूहि मानवैः
verses.transliteration: kena sā nirmitā yātrā dakṣiṇasyāṃ jagatpate yātrāphalaṃ ca kiṃ tatra prāpyate brūhi mānavaiḥ
verses.translation: A man undoubtedly enjoys pleasures for as many Kalpas as the number of times he undertakes pilgrimages in the month of Jyestha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man undoubtedly enjoys pleasures for as many Kalpas as the number of times he undertakes pilgrimages in the month of Jyestha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं सरसस् तीरे राज्ञस् तस्य जगत्पते पवित्रे विजने देशे गत्वा तत्र च मण्डपे
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ sarasas tīre rājñas tasya jagatpate pavitre vijane deśe gatvā tatra ca maṇḍape
verses.translation: O Lord, we wish to hear, even as you recount, the installation and worship of the lord of the universe and the mode of these rites as well as charitable gifts and the fruits thereof. O leading sages, listen to the installation of idols urged by Brahma. By devoutly performing this, the man or the woman acquires the benefit.
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, we wish to hear, even as you recount, the installation and worship of the lord of the universe and the mode of these rites as well as charitable gifts and the fruits thereof. O leading sages, listen to the installation of idols urged by Brahma.…

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णः संकर्षणश् चैव सुभद्रा च रथेन ते स्वस्थानं संपरित्यज्य सप्तरात्रं वसन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaś caiva subhadrā ca rathena te svasthānaṃ saṃparityajya saptarātraṃ vasanti vai
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, when the twelve pilgrimages are completed, the devotee should carry out the installation that destroy sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, when the twelve pilgrimages are completed, the devotee should carry out the installation that destroy sin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नेन भो विप्राः पुरा वै प्रार्थितो हरिः सप्ताहं सरसस् तीरे मम यात्रा भवत्व् इति
verses.transliteration: indradyumnena bho viprāḥ purā vai prārthito hariḥ saptāhaṃ sarasas tīre mama yātrā bhavatv iti
verses.translation: The rite of holy bath should be performed in accord¬ ance with the injunctions prescribed by the sages in regard to him. After taking holy bath perfectly in accordance with the injunction (the devotee) who is conversant with the names, Gotras (spiritual lines) and the procedure, should perform Tarpana rite to Devas, sages and manes as well as others.
verses.wordMeaning: The rite of holy bath should be performed in accord¬ ance with the injunctions prescribed by the sages in regard to him. After taking holy bath perfectly in accordance with the injunction (the devotee) who is conversant with the names,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of holy bath should be performed in accord¬ ance with the injunctions prescribed by the sages in regard to him. After taking holy bath perfectly in accordance with the injunction (the devotee) who is conversant with the names,…

verses.transliteration: guḍivā nāma deveśa bhuktimuktiphalapradā tasmai kila varaṃ cāsau dadau sa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: He should repeat other holy passages and Mantras pertaining to the sun with faith and concentration. After making three circumambulations he should bow down to the Sungod.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should repeat other holy passages and Mantras pertaining to the sun with faith and concentration. After making three circumambulations he should bow down to the Sungod.

verses.sanskrit: सप्ताहं सरसस् तीरे तव राजन् भविष्यति गुडिवा नाम यात्रा मे सर्वकामफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: saptāhaṃ sarasas tīre tava rājan bhaviṣyati guḍivā nāma yātrā me sarvakāmaphalapradā
verses.translation: In regard to the people of the first three castes the rite of holy bath and the repetition of Mantras is in the manner mentioned in the Vedas. The utterance of the Vedic passage is to be avoided by women as well as Sudras. With great devotion he shall worship Lord Visnu offering lotuses and other flowers pertaining to Visnu (like jasmine etc.).
verses.wordMeaning: In regard to the people of the first three castes the rite of holy bath and the repetition of Mantras is in the manner mentioned in the Vedas. The utterance of the Vedic passage is to be avoided by women as well as Sudras.…

verses.transliteration: ye māṃ tatrārcayiṣyanti śraddhayā maṇḍape sthitam saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca vidhivat susamāhitāḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping the lord the ruler of the universe, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation, in this manner, he shall burn incense along with agallochum in front of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the lord the ruler of the universe, the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation, in this manner, he shall burn incense along with agallochum in front of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्रियः शूद्राश् च वै नृप पुष्पैर् गन्धैस् तथा धूपैर् दीपैर् नैवेद्यकैर् वरैः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāś ca vai nṛpa puṣpair gandhais tathā dhūpair dīpair naivedyakair varaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he shall burn aromatic resin too along with scents. He shall light a lamp with devotion using ghee (instead of oil) according to the means. With concentration he shall offer twelve other lamps, O excellent sages, he shall burn it with ghee or gingelly oil.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, he shall burn aromatic resin too along with scents. He shall light a lamp with devotion using ghee (instead of oil) according to the means. With concentration he shall offer twelve other lamps, O excellent sages, he shall burn it with ghee or gingelly oil.

verses.sanskrit: उपहारैर् बहुविधैः प्रणिपातैः प्रदक्षिणैः जयशब्दैस् तथा स्तोत्रैर् गीतैर् वाद्यैर् मनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: upahārair bahuvidhaiḥ praṇipātaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ jayaśabdais tathā stotrair gītair vādyair manoharaiḥ
verses.translation: By way of Naivedya (food offering) he shall dedicate milk pudding, sweet Saskulis, Vatakas (special kinds of baked or fried cakes) sweets, a little quantity of molasses and fruits too.
verses.commentary: Sense: By way of Naivedya (food offering) he shall dedicate milk pudding, sweet Saskulis, Vatakas (special kinds of baked or fried cakes) sweets, a little quantity of molasses and fruits too.

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचित् फलं यस्य यद् ईप्सितम् भविष्यति नृपश्रेष्ठ मत्प्रसादाद् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcit phalaṃ yasya yad īpsitam bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha matprasādād asaṃśayam
verses.translation: After worshipping Purusottama with five items of service (i.e. bathing, offering cloths, worshipping with flowers, showing lamps and incense and food offerings) the devotee shall repeat "Om obeisance to Purusottama" a hundred and eight times. With faith and concentration, O excellent sages, the devotee shall make a flowery bowerlike Mantfapa over the lord.
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping Purusottama with five items of service (i.e. bathing, offering cloths, worshipping with flowers, showing lamps and incense and food offerings) the devotee shall repeat "Om obeisance to Purusottama" a hundred and eight times. With faith and concentration,…

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु तं देवस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत स तु राजवरः श्रीमान् कृतकृत्यो ऽभवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu taṃ devas tatraivāntaradhīyata sa tu rājavaraḥ śrīmān kṛtakṛtyo 'bhavat tadā
verses.translation: Thereafter, he shall resolve to keep awake at night. For this purpose he shall arrange for the discourses on the divine story of Vasudeva or devotional songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he shall resolve to keep awake at night. For this purpose he shall arrange for the discourses on the divine story of Vasudeva or devotional songs.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन गुडिवायां द्विजोत्तमाः सर्वकामप्रदं देवं पश्येत् तं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena guḍivāyāṃ dvijottamāḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ paśyet taṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: After taking bath perfectly in accordance with the in¬ junctions, the devotee shall control his sense organs and put on washed (and dried) clothes. Thereafter, he shall bathe lord Visnu with devotion as before. Thereafter, he should give the preceptor a cow, cloth, gold, umbrella, pair of sandals, foodgrain and bellmetal vessel with devotion.
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath perfectly in accordance with the in¬ junctions, the devotee shall control his sense organs and put on washed (and dried) clothes. Thereafter, he shall bathe lord Visnu with devotion as before. Thereafter, he should give the preceptor a cow, cloth, gold,…

verses.sanskrit: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रान् निर्धनो लभते धनम् रोगाच् च मुच्यते रोगी कन्या प्राप्नोति सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: aputro labhate putrān nirdhano labhate dhanam rogāc ca mucyate rogī kanyā prāpnoti satpatim
verses.translation: He should feed brahmins. The food served should begin with milk pudding. There should be sweet cooked rice and various kinds of edibles prepared in jaggery and ghee.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should feed brahmins. The food served should begin with milk pudding. There should be sweet cooked rice and various kinds of edibles prepared in jaggery and ghee.

verses.sanskrit: आयुः कीर्तिं यशो मेधां बलं विद्यां धृतिं पशून् नरः संततिम् आप्नोति रूपयौवनसंपदम्
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ kīrtiṃ yaśo medhāṃ balaṃ vidyāṃ dhṛtiṃ paśūn naraḥ saṃtatim āpnoti rūpayauvanasaṃpadam
verses.translation: After the brahmins have been fed to their satisfaction and their minds are at rest, he should give them twelve water pots together with sweets. Devoid of revelry he should give them monetary gifts according to his capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the brahmins have been fed to their satisfaction and their minds are at rest, he should give them twelve water pots together with sweets. Devoid of revelry he should give them monetary gifts according to his capacity.

verses.sanskrit: यान् यान् समीहते भोगान् दृष्ट्वा तं पुरुषोत्तमम् नरो वाप्य् अथवा नारी तांस् तान् प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: yān yān samīhate bhogān dṛṣṭvā taṃ puruṣottamam naro vāpy athavā nārī tāṃs tān prāpnoty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after worshipping those brah¬ mins, he should devotedly worship his preceptor who is the bestower of perfect knowledge and who is on a par with Visnu
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, after worshipping those brah¬ mins, he should devotedly worship his preceptor who is the bestower of perfect knowledge and who is on a par with Visnu

verses.sanskrit: यात्रां कृत्वा गुडिवाख्यां विधिवत् सुसमाहितः आषाढस्य सिते पक्षे नरो योषिद् अथापि वा
verses.transliteration: yātrāṃ kṛtvā guḍivākhyāṃ vidhivat susamāhitaḥ āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe naro yoṣid athāpi vā
verses.translation: The learned devotee should honour him with gold cloth, cow, foodgrains and other articles. Thereafter, he should repeat this mantra. "May Lord Purusottama who has neither beginning nor end, who holds conch, discus and iron club and who is the omnipresent lord of the Universe be pleased with this.
verses.wordMeaning: The learned devotee should honour him with gold cloth, cow, foodgrains and other articles. Thereafter, he should repeat this mantra. "May Lord Purusottama who has neither beginning nor end, who holds conch,…

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ daśapañcāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam
verses.translation: After uttering this mantra he should circumambulate brahmins thrice. He should bid farewell to the preceptor by bending his head with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After uttering this mantra he should circumambulate brahmins thrice. He should bid farewell to the preceptor by bending his head with devotion.

verses.transliteration: saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśān uddhṛtya cātmanaḥ kāmagena vimānena sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should follow those brahmins with devo¬ tion to the boundary of the village. Thus following them he should pay homage and bid them farewell. Accompanied by kinsmen and relatives he should take

verses.transliteration: gandharvair apsarobhiś ca sevyamāno yathottaraiḥ rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: By performing this rite perfectly well, the devotee whether a man or a woman should derive the benefit of thou¬ sands of horse-sacrifices and a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing this rite perfectly well, the devotee whether a man or a woman should derive the benefit of thou¬ sands of horse-sacrifices and a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices.

verses.translation: For a period of thirty Kalpas he enjoys excellent plea¬ sures there as he wishes. From there, O excellent brahmins he comes to the world of the moon. O excellent brahmins, after enjoying splendid pleasures there for a period of ten Kalpas he comes to the world of Gan- dharvas which is most difficult of access.

verses.translation: After enjoying various pleasures to the fullest satisfac¬ tion for the period of a Kalpa, he comes to the earth and be¬ comes a virtuous king.

verses.translation: As long as the heaven stands alongwith the moon and stars, they dally with the celestial nymphs. They resemble heated gold. They are devoid of old age and death.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे त्व् एकादश्यां समाहितः गत्वा जलाशयं पुण्यम् आचम्य प्रयतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe tv ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ gatvā jalāśayaṃ puṇyam ācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: All these are established in the abode of Vasudeva. Of what avail is much talk? Everything is established there.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are established in the abode of Vasudeva. Of what avail is much talk? Everything is established there.

verses.sanskrit: आवाह्य सर्वतीर्थानि ध्यात्वा नारायणं तथा ततः स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत विधिवत् सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: āvāhya sarvatīrthāni dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tathā tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta vidhivat susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, 1 do not behold any other world better than the world of Visnu. It is the cause of bliss and it bestows the desired benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, 1 do not behold any other world better than the world of Visnu. It is the cause of bliss and it bestows the desired benefits.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यो विधिर् उद्दिष्ट ऋषिभिः स्नानकर्मणि तेनैव तु विधानेन स्नानं तस्य विधीयते
verses.transliteration: yasya yo vidhir uddiṣṭa ṛṣibhiḥ snānakarmaṇi tenaiva tu vidhānena snānaṃ tasya vidhīyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, all those worlds which we hear as the worlds in the heavenly sphere, all those who perform meritorious rites, do not merit even a sixteenth part of the world of lord Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, all those worlds which we hear as the worlds in the heavenly sphere, all those who perform meritorious rites, do not merit even a sixteenth part of the world of lord Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा सम्यग् विधानेन ततो देवान् ऋषीन् पितॄन् संतर्पयेत् तथान्यांश् च नामगोत्रविधानवित्
verses.transliteration: snātvā samyag vidhānena tato devān ṛṣīn pitṝn saṃtarpayet tathānyāṃś ca nāmagotravidhānavit
verses.translation: Atheists and profligates do not go there. Nor do the following go there viz.—the ungrateful and those who are of uncontrollable sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atheists and profligates do not go there. Nor do the following go there viz.—the ungrateful and those who are of uncontrollable sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तीर्य वाससी धौते निर्मले परिधाय वै उपस्पृश्य विधानेन भास्कराभिमुखस् ततः
verses.transliteration: uttīrya vāsasī dhaute nirmale paridhāya vai upaspṛśya vidhānena bhāskarābhimukhas tataḥ
verses.translation: The devotees of Visnu who worship Vasudeva the preceptor of the universe with devotion, go to the world of Vi§nu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं पावनीं देवीं मनसा वेदमातरम् सर्वपापहरां पुण्यां जपेद् अष्टोत्तरं शतम्
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ manasā vedamātaram sarvapāpaharāṃ puṇyāṃ japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam
verses.translation: One should mentally recite a hundred and eight times the purifying goddess Gayatri, mother of the Vedas, holy and removing all sins,

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यांश् च सौरमन्त्रांश् च श्रद्धया सुसमाहितः त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य भास्करं प्रणमेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: puṇyāṃś ca sauramantrāṃś ca śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ triḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya bhāskaraṃ praṇamet tataḥ
verses.translation: and the holy solar mantras, with faith and composure; then, having circumambulated three times, one should bow to the sun.

verses.transliteration: vedoktaṃ triṣu varṇeṣu snānaṃ jāpyam udāhṛtam strīśūdrayoḥ snānajāpyaṃ vedoktavidhivarjitam
verses.translation: Bathing and recitation according to the Veda are prescribed for the three classes; for women and shudras, bathing and recitation without the Vedic procedure.

verses.transliteration: tato gacched gṛhaṃ maunī pūjayet puruṣottamam prakṣālya hastau pādau ca upaspṛśya yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Then, silent, one should go home and worship Purushottama, having washed hands and feet and sipped water according to rule.

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन स्नापयेद् देवं क्षीरेण तदनन्तरम् मधुगन्धोदकेनैव तीर्थचन्दनवारिणा
verses.transliteration: ghṛtena snāpayed devaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaram madhugandhodakenaiva tīrthacandanavāriṇā
verses.translation: One should bathe the god with ghee, then with milk, with honey and fragrant water, and with sacred water and sandal-water.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वस्त्रयुगं श्रेष्ठं भक्त्या तं परिधापयेत् चन्दनागरुकर्पूरैः कुङ्कुमेन विलेपयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato vastrayugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā taṃ paridhāpayet candanāgarukarpūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet
verses.translation: Then one should devotedly clothe him in an excellent pair of garments and anoint him with sandal, aloe, camphor and saffron.

verses.transliteration: pūjayet parayā bhaktyā padmaiś ca puruṣottamam anyaiś ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ puṣpair arcayen mallikādibhiḥ
verses.translation: One should worship Purushottama with supreme devotion with lotuses, and with other Vaishnava flowers such as mallika.

verses.transliteration: saṃpūjyaivaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim dhūpaṃ cāgurusaṃyuktaṃ dahed devasya cāgrataḥ
verses.translation: Having thus worshipped Hari, lord of the world, giver of enjoyment and liberation, one should burn incense with aloe before the god,

verses.translation: Having made the dedication, one should then hold a vigil at night and have the story of Vasudeva and songs performed.

verses.transliteration: snātvā samyag vidhānena dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ snāpayet pūrvavat tatra pūjayet puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Having bathed properly by rule, in washed garments and with senses controlled, one should bathe the god as before and worship Purushottama there,

verses.sanskrit: गन्धैः पुष्पैर् उपहारैर् नैवेद्यैर् दीपकैस् तथा उपचारैर् बहुविधैः प्रणिपातैः प्रदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: gandhaiḥ puṣpair upahārair naivedyair dīpakais tathā upacārair bahuvidhaiḥ praṇipātaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: with perfumes, flowers, presents, food offerings and lamps, with services of many kinds, prostrations and circumambulations,

verses.sanskrit: जाप्यैः स्तुतिनमस्कारैर् गीतवाद्यैर् मनोहरैः संपूज्यैवं जगन्नाथं ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: jāpyaiḥ stutinamaskārair gītavādyair manoharaiḥ saṃpūjyaivaṃ jagannāthaṃ brāhmaṇān pūjayet tataḥ
verses.translation: with recitations, hymns, salutations and charming songs and music; having thus worshipped the lord of the world, one should then honour the brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशैव तु गास् तेभ्यो दत्त्वा कनकम् एव च छत्त्रोपानद्युगं चैव श्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśaiva tu gās tebhyo dattvā kanakam eva ca chattropānadyugaṃ caiva śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Having given them twelve cows and gold, an umbrella and a pair of sandals, with faith and devotion,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या तु सधनं तेभ्यो दद्याद् वस्त्रादिकं द्विजाः सद्भावेन तु गोविन्दस् तोष्यते पूजितो यतः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā tu sadhanaṃ tebhyo dadyād vastrādikaṃ dvijāḥ sadbhāvena tu govindas toṣyate pūjito yataḥ
verses.translation: one should devotedly give them garments and the like along with wealth, O brahmins, for Govinda is pleased when worshipped with sincerity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आचार्याय ततो दद्याद् गोवस्त्रं कनकं तथा छत्त्रोपानद्युगं चान्यत् कांस्यपात्रं च भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ācāryāya tato dadyād govastraṃ kanakaṃ tathā chattropānadyugaṃ cānyat kāṃsyapātraṃ ca bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: Then one should devotedly give the teacher a cow, garments and gold, an umbrella, a pair of sandals and a bronze vessel.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तान् भोजयेद् विप्रान् भोज्यं पायसपूर्वकम् पक्वान्नं भक्ष्यभोज्यं च गुडसर्पिःसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tatas tān bhojayed viprān bhojyaṃ pāyasapūrvakam pakvānnaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca guḍasarpiḥsamanvitam
verses.translation: Then one should feed those brahmins with food beginning with milk-rice, cooked food, foods to chew and eat, with molasses and ghee.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tatas tān annatṛptāṃś ca brāhmaṇān svasthamānasān dvādaśaivodakumbhāṃś ca dadyāt tebhyaḥ samodakān
verses.translation: Then, when the brahmins are satisfied with food and content in mind, one should give them twelve water-jars with sweets,

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणां च यथाशक्त्या दद्यात् तेभ्यो विमत्सरः कुम्भं च दक्षिणां चैव आचार्याय निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā dadyāt tebhyo vimatsaraḥ kumbhaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ caiva ācāryāya nivedayet
verses.translation: and without envy give them a fee according to one's ability; one should present a jar and a fee to the teacher.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्य तान् विप्रान् गुरुं ज्ञानप्रदायकम् पूजयेत् परया भक्त्या विष्णुतुल्यं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya tān viprān guruṃ jñānapradāyakam pūjayet parayā bhaktyā viṣṇutulyaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Having thus honoured those brahmins, one should worship with supreme devotion the teacher who imparts knowledge, as equal to Vishnu, O best of brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णवस्त्रगोधान्यैर् द्रव्यैश् चान्यैर् वरैर् बुधः संपूज्य तं नमस्कृत्य इमं मन्त्रम् उदीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇavastragodhānyair dravyaiś cānyair varair budhaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ namaskṛtya imaṃ mantram udīrayet
verses.translation: The wise one, having worshipped him with gold, garments, cows, grain and other excellent things and bowed to him, should utter this mantra:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वव्यापी जगन्नाथः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः अनादिनिधनो देवः प्रीयतां पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sarvavyāpī jagannāthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ anādinidhano devaḥ prīyatāṃ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: "May the all-pervading lord of the world, bearer of conch, discus and mace, the god without beginning or end, Purushottama, be pleased."

verses.transliteration: ity uccārya tato viprāṃs triḥ kṛtvā ca pradakṣiṇām praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā ācāryaṃ tu visarjayet
verses.translation: Having uttered this and circumambulated the brahmins three times, bowing the head with devotion, one should dismiss the teacher.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तान् ब्राह्मणान् भक्त्या चासीमान्तम् अनुव्रजेत् अनुव्रज्य तु तान् सर्वान् नमस्कृत्य निवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatas tān brāhmaṇān bhaktyā cāsīmāntam anuvrajet anuvrajya tu tān sarvān namaskṛtya nivartayet
verses.translation: Then one should devotedly follow those brahmins up to the boundary; having followed them all, one should bow and return.

verses.sanskrit: बान्धवैः स्वजनैर् युक्तस् ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः अन्यैश् चोपासकैर् दीनैर् भिक्षुकैश् चान्नकाङ्क्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: bāndhavaiḥ svajanair yuktas tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ anyaiś copāsakair dīnair bhikṣukaiś cānnakāṅkṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Then, with kinsmen and one's own people, one should eat in silence, along with other worshippers, the poor, mendicants and those seeking food.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा नरः सम्यङ् नारी वा लभते फलम् अश्वमेधसहस्राणां राजसूयशतस्य च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyaṅ nārī vā labhate phalam aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ rājasūyaśatasya ca
verses.translation: Having done this properly, a man or woman obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices and a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतं शतम् आदाय पुरुषाणां नरोत्तमाः भविष्यं च शतं विप्राः स्वर्गत्या दिव्यरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: atītaṃ śatam ādāya puruṣāṇāṃ narottamāḥ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śataṃ viprāḥ svargatyā divyarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: Taking with him a hundred past generations and a hundred future ones, O best of men, O brahmins, by going to heaven he bears a divine form,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नः सर्वालंकारभूषितः सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा देववद् विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā devavad vigatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: endowed with every good mark, adorned with every ornament, rich in every desire, free of fever like a god,

verses.sanskrit: रूपयौवनसंपन्नो गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः स्तूयमानो ऽप्सरोभिश् च गन्धर्वैः समलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: rūpayauvanasaṃpanno guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ stūyamāno 'psarobhiś ca gandharvaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: endowed with beauty and youth, adorned with all virtues, praised by Apsarases and adorned by Gandharvas,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विमानेनार्कवर्णेन कामगेन स्थिरेण च पताकाध्वजयुक्तेन सर्वरत्नैर् अलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: vimānenārkavarṇena kāmagena sthireṇa ca patākādhvajayuktena sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: in a celestial car coloured like the sun, moving at will and steady, with flags and banners, adorned with all jewels,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उद्योतयन् दिशः सर्वा आकाशे विगतक्लमः युवा महाबलो धीमान् विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: udyotayan diśaḥ sarvā ākāśe vigataklamaḥ yuvā mahābalo dhīmān viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: illuminating all directions in the sky, free from weariness, young, mighty and wise, he goes to Vishnu's world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कल्पशतं यावद् भुङ्क्ते भोगान् यथेप्सितान् सिद्धाप्सरोभिर् गन्धर्वैः सुरविद्याधरोरगैः
verses.transliteration: tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvad bhuṅkte bhogān yathepsitān siddhāpsarobhir gandharvaiḥ suravidyādharoragaiḥ
verses.translation: There for a hundred kalpas he enjoys pleasures as he wishes, praised by Siddhas, Apsarases, Gandharvas, gods, Vidyadharas and serpents,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तूयमानो मुनिवरैस् तिष्ठते विगतज्वरः यथा देवो जगन्नाथः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.transliteration: stūyamāno munivarais tiṣṭhate vigatajvaraḥ yathā devo jagannāthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
verses.translation: and by the best of sages he remains free of fever. As the god, lord of the world, bearing conch, discus and mace,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथासौ मुदितो विप्राः कृत्वा रूपं चतुर्भुजम् भुक्त्वा तत्र वरान् भोगान् क्रीडां कृत्वा सुरैः सह
verses.transliteration: tathāsau mudito viprāḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍāṃ kṛtvā suraiḥ saha
verses.translation: so he, joyful, O brahmins, takes a four-armed form; having enjoyed excellent pleasures there and sported with the gods,

verses.transliteration: tadante brahmasadanam āyāti sarvakāmadam siddhavidyādharaiś cāpi śobhitaṃ surakiṃnaraiḥ
verses.translation: at its end he comes to the abode of Brahma, which grants every desire, beautiful with Siddhas, Vidyadharas, gods and Kinnaras.

verses.sanskrit: कालं नवतिकल्पं तु तत्र भुक्त्वा सुखं नरः तस्माद् आयाति विप्रेन्द्राः सर्वकामफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: kālaṃ navatikalpaṃ tu tatra bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ tasmād āyāti viprendrāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam
verses.translation: Having enjoyed happiness there for ninety kalpas, from there, O best of brahmins, he comes to the world that grants the fruit of every desire,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकं सुरगणैः सेवितं सुखमोक्षदम् अनेकशतसाहस्रैर् विमानैः समलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: rudralokaṃ suragaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ sukhamokṣadam anekaśatasāhasrair vimānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: the world of Rudra, frequented by hosts of gods, giving happiness and liberation, adorned with many hundreds of thousands of celestial cars,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धविद्याधरैर् यक्षैर् भूषितं दैत्यदानवैः अशीतिकल्पकालं तु तत्र भुक्त्वा सुखं नरः
verses.transliteration: siddhavidyādharair yakṣair bhūṣitaṃ daityadānavaiḥ aśītikalpakālaṃ tu tatra bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: adorned with Siddhas, Vidyadharas, Yakshas, Daityas and Danavas; having enjoyed happiness there for eighty kalpas,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदन्ते याति गोलोकं सर्वभोगसमन्वितम् सुरसिद्धाप्सरोभिश् च शोभितं सुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: tadante yāti golokaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam surasiddhāpsarobhiś ca śobhitaṃ sumanoharam
verses.translation: at its end he goes to Goloka, endowed with every enjoyment, beautiful and charming with gods, Siddhas and Apsarases.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सप्ततिकल्पांस् तु भुक्त्वा भोगम् अनुत्तमम् दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु स्वस्थचित्तो यथामरः
verses.transliteration: tatra saptatikalpāṃs tu bhuktvā bhogam anuttamam durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu svasthacitto yathāmaraḥ
verses.translation: Having enjoyed there for seventy kalpas unsurpassed enjoyment, rare in the three worlds, content in mind like an immortal,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् आगच्छते लोकं प्राजापत्यम् अनुत्तमम् गन्धर्वाप्सरसैः सिद्धैर् मुनिविद्याधरैर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: tasmād āgacchate lokaṃ prājāpatyam anuttamam gandharvāpsarasaiḥ siddhair munividyādharair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: from there he comes to the unsurpassed world of Prajapati, surrounded by Gandharvas, Apsarases, Siddhas, sages and Vidyadharas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिकल्पान् सुखं तत्र भुक्त्वा नानाविधं मुदा तदन्ते शक्रभवनं नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭikalpān sukhaṃ tatra bhuktvā nānāvidhaṃ mudā tadante śakrabhavanaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam
verses.translation: Having joyfully enjoyed various happiness there for sixty kalpas, at its end he comes to the abode of Shakra, full of various wonders,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैः किंनरैः सिद्धैः सुरविद्याधरोरगैः गुह्यकाप्सरसैः साध्यैर् वृतैश् चान्यैः सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: gandharvaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ siddhaiḥ suravidyādharoragaiḥ guhyakāpsarasaiḥ sādhyair vṛtaiś cānyaiḥ surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: with Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Siddhas, gods, Vidyadharas and serpents, Guhyakas, Apsarases, Sadhyas and other excellent gods.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य तत्र पञ्चाशत् कल्पान् भुक्त्वा सुखं नरः सुरलोकं ततो गत्वा विमानैः समलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: āgatya tatra pañcāśat kalpān bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ suralokaṃ tato gatvā vimānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Coming there, the man enjoys happiness for fifty kalpas; then going to the world of the gods, adorned with celestial cars,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत् तु कल्पांस् तु भुक्त्वा भोगान् सुदुर्लभान् आगच्छते ततो लोकं नक्षत्राख्यं सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśat tu kalpāṃs tu bhuktvā bhogān sudurlabhān āgacchate tato lokaṃ nakṣatrākhyaṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: having enjoyed very rare pleasures for forty kalpas, he then comes to the very rare world called that of the stars.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो भोगान् वरान् भुङ्क्ते त्रिंशत् कल्पान् यथेप्सितान् तस्माद् आगच्छते लोकं शशाङ्कस्य द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tato bhogān varān bhuṅkte triṃśat kalpān yathepsitān tasmād āgacchate lokaṃ śaśāṅkasya dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: There he enjoys excellent pleasures for thirty kalpas as he wishes; from there he comes to the world of the moon, O best of brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रासौ तिष्ठते सोमः सर्वैर् देवैर् अलंकृतः तत्र विंशतिकल्पांस् तु भुक्त्वा भोगं सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: yatrāsau tiṣṭhate somaḥ sarvair devair alaṃkṛtaḥ tatra viṃśatikalpāṃs tu bhuktvā bhogaṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: where Soma dwells, adorned by all the gods; having enjoyed very rare pleasure there for twenty kalpas,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य ततो लोकम् आयाति सुरपूजितम् नानाश्चर्यमयं पुण्यं गन्धर्वाप्सरःसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: ādityasya tato lokam āyāti surapūjitam nānāścaryamayaṃ puṇyaṃ gandharvāpsaraḥsevitam
verses.translation: he then comes to the world of the sun, worshipped by the gods, full of various wonders, holy, frequented by Gandharvas and Apsarases.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा शुभान् भोगान् दश कल्पान् द्विजोत्तमाः तस्माद् आयाति भुवनं गन्धर्वाणां सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā śubhān bhogān daśa kalpān dvijottamāḥ tasmād āyāti bhuvanaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: Having enjoyed auspicious pleasures there for ten kalpas, O best of brahmins, from there he comes to the very rare world of the Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भोगान् समस्तांश् च कल्पम् एकं यथासुखम् भुक्त्वा चायाति मेदिन्यां राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhogān samastāṃś ca kalpam ekaṃ yathāsukham bhuktvā cāyāti medinyāṃ rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: Having enjoyed all pleasures there as he likes for one kalpa, he comes to the earth and becomes a righteous king,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवर्ती महावीर्यो गुणैः सर्वैर् अलंकृतः कृत्वा राज्यं स्वधर्मेण यज्ञैर् इष्ट्वा सुदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: cakravartī mahāvīryo guṇaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtaḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ svadharmeṇa yajñair iṣṭvā sudakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: a universal emperor of great valour, adorned with all virtues; having ruled according to his dharma and performed sacrifices with good fees,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदन्ते योगिनां लोकं गत्वा मोक्षप्रदं शिवम् तत्र भुक्त्वा वरान् भोगान् यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tadante yogināṃ lokaṃ gatvā mokṣapradaṃ śivam tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: at its end he goes to the auspicious world of yogins that grants liberation; having enjoyed excellent pleasures there until the dissolution of beings,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् आगच्छते चात्र जायते योगिनां कुले प्रवरे वैष्णवे विप्रा दुर्लभे साधुसंमते
verses.transliteration: tasmād āgacchate cātra jāyate yogināṃ kule pravare vaiṣṇave viprā durlabhe sādhusaṃmate
verses.translation: he comes from there and is born here in a family of yogins, an excellent Vaishnava family, O brahmins, rare and esteemed by the good,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वेदी विप्रवरो यज्ञैर् इष्ट्वाप्तदक्षिणैः वैष्णवं योगम् आस्थाय ततो मोक्षम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: caturvedī vipravaro yajñair iṣṭvāptadakṣiṇaiḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ yogam āsthāya tato mokṣam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: a foremost brahmin learned in the four Vedas; having performed sacrifices with proper fees and taking up the yoga of Vishnu, he then attains liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं यात्राफलं विप्रा मया सम्यग् उदाहृतम् भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नॄणां किम् अन्यच् छ्रोतुम् इच्छथ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yātrāphalaṃ viprā mayā samyag udāhṛtam bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ kim anyac chrotum icchatha
verses.translation: Thus, O brahmins, I have properly described the fruit of pilgrimage, which grants enjoyment and liberation to men. What else do you wish to hear?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे देव विष्णुलोकम् अनामयम् लोकानन्दकरं कान्तं सर्वाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: śrotum icchāmahe deva viṣṇulokam anāmayam lokānandakaraṃ kāntaṃ sarvāścaryasamanvitam
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the truth, the very truth has been cited by us on all. There is no other holy centre on Earth that is equal to Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the truth, the very truth has been cited by us on all. There is no other holy centre on Earth that is equal to Purusottama.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाणं तस्य लोकस्य भोगं कान्तिं बलं प्रभो कर्मणा केन गच्छन्ति तत्र धर्मपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: pramāṇaṃ tasya lokasya bhogaṃ kāntiṃ balaṃ prabho karmaṇā kena gacchanti tatra dharmaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All those holy centres and shrines do not deserve even a sixteenth part of Purusottama.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those holy centres and shrines do not deserve even a sixteenth part of Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनाद् वापि तीर्थस्नानादिनापि वा विस्तराद् ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन परं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: darśanāt sparśanād vāpi tīrthasnānādināpi vā vistarād brūhi tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: Just as Visnu has been cited as the most excellent one among the sons of Aditi so also Purusottama is the most ex¬ cellent one among the holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as Visnu has been cited as the most excellent one among the sons of Aditi so also Purusottama is the most ex¬ cellent one among the holy centres.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनयः सर्वे यत् परं परमं पदम् भक्तानाम् ईहितं धन्यं पुण्यं संसारनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yat paraṃ paramaṃ padam bhaktānām īhitaṃ dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃsāranāśanam
verses.translation: Just as the moon among the stars and ocean among lakes so also the holy centre of Purusottama is the most excellent among the holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the moon among the stars and ocean among lakes so also the holy centre of Purusottama is the most excellent among the holy centres.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.translation: Like (fire).among the Vasus and Sankara among the Rudras, so also Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like (fire).among the Vasus and Sankara among the Rudras, so also Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: अशोकैः पारिजातैश् च मन्दारैश् चम्पकद्रुमैः मालतीमल्लिकाकुन्दैर् बकुलैर् नागकेसरैः
verses.transliteration: aśokaiḥ pārijātaiś ca mandāraiś campakadrumaiḥ mālatīmallikākundair bakulair nāgakesaraiḥ
verses.translation: Like brahmins among the four castes and Garuda among the birds, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like brahmins among the four castes and Garuda among the birds, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: पुंनागैर् अतिमुक्तैश् च प्रियङ्गुतगरार्जुनैः पाटलाचूतखदिरैः कर्णिकारवनोज्ज्वलैः
verses.transliteration: puṃnāgair atimuktaiś ca priyaṅgutagarārjunaiḥ pāṭalācūtakhadiraiḥ karṇikāravanojjvalaiḥ
verses.translation: Like LaksmI among young women and Gariga among the rivers Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like LaksmI among young women and Gariga among the rivers Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: नारङ्गैः पनसैर् लोध्रैर् निम्बदाडिमसर्जकैः द्राक्षालकुचखर्जूरैर् मधुकेन्द्रफलैर् द्रुमैः
verses.transliteration: nāraṅgaiḥ panasair lodhrair nimbadāḍimasarjakaiḥ drākṣālakucakharjūrair madhukendraphalair drumaiḥ
verses.translation: Like Uccaissravas among the horses, like Usanas among the poets, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like Uccaissravas among the horses, like Usanas among the poets, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: कपित्थैर् नारिकेरैश् च तालैः श्रीफलसंभवैः कल्पवृक्षैर् असंख्यैश् च वन्यैर् अन्यैः सुशोभनैः
verses.transliteration: kapitthair nārikeraiś ca tālaiḥ śrīphalasaṃbhavaiḥ kalpavṛkṣair asaṃkhyaiś ca vanyair anyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Like Vyasa among the sages, like Kubera among \ aksas and (like Vibhisana among) Raksasas, Purusottama is the excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like Vyasa among the sages, like Kubera among \ aksas and (like Vibhisana among) Raksasas, Purusottama is the excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: सरलैश् चन्दनैर् नीपैर् देवदारुशुभाञ्जनैः जातीलवङ्गकङ्कोलैः कर्पूरामोदवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: saralaiś candanair nīpair devadāruśubhāñjanaiḥ jātīlavaṅgakaṅkolaiḥ karpūrāmodavāsibhiḥ
verses.translation: Like mind among the organs of sense, like earth among the elements, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like mind among the organs of sense, like earth among the elements, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताम्बूलपत्त्रनिचयैस् तथा पूगीफलद्रुमैः अन्यैश् च विविधैर् वृक्षैः सर्वर्तुफलशोभितैः
verses.transliteration: tāmbūlapattranicayais tathā pūgīphaladrumaiḥ anyaiś ca vividhair vṛkṣaiḥ sarvartuphalaśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: Like the holy big tree among all trees, like wind among those who float and spread, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the holy big tree among all trees, like wind among those who float and spread, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैर् नानाविधैश् चैव लतागुच्छसमुद्भवैः नानाजलाशयैः पुण्यैर् नानापक्षिरुतैर् वरैः

verses.translation: Like Citraratha among the Gandharvas, like Kulisa among weapons, Purusottama is the most excellent among all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like Citraratha among the Gandharvas, like Kulisa among weapons, Purusottama is the most excellent among all holy centres.

verses.transliteration: dīrghikāśatasaṃghātais toyapūrṇair manoharaiḥ kumudaiḥ śatapattraiś ca puṣpaiḥ kokanadair varaiḥ
verses.translation: Like the letter A among all syllables, like Gayatrl among all vedic mantras, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the letter A among all syllables, like Gayatrl among all vedic mantras, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.translation: Like the king among men, like the Divine cow among cows, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the king among men, like the Divine cow among cows, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.transliteration: haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiś cakravākopaśobhitaiḥ koyaṣṭikaiś ca dātyūhaiḥ kāraṇḍavaravākulaiḥ
verses.translation: Like a piece of gold among jewels, like Vasuki among serpents, Purusottama is the most excellent among holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a piece of gold among jewels, like Vasuki among serpents, Purusottama is the most excellent among holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: चातकैः प्रियपुत्रैश् च जीवंजीवकजातिभिः अन्यैर् दिव्यैर् जलचरैर् विहारमधुरस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: cātakaiḥ priyaputraiś ca jīvaṃjīvakajātibhiḥ anyair divyair jalacarair vihāramadhurasvanaiḥ
verses.translation: Like Prahlada among all Daityas, like Rama among
verses.commentary: Sense: Like Prahlada among all Daityas, like Rama among

verses.sanskrit: एवं नानाविधैर् दिव्यैर् नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितैः वृक्षैर् जलाशयैः पुण्यैर् भूषितं सुमनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nānāvidhair divyair nānāścaryasamanvitaiḥ vṛkṣair jalāśayaiḥ puṇyair bhūṣitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ
verses.translation: Like the shark among fishes, like lion among violent animals, Purusottama is the most excellent among all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the shark among fishes, like lion among violent animals, Purusottama is the most excellent among all holy centres.

verses.translation: Like gold among metals, like the gift of coins among all sacred gifts, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.translation: Like Daksa among Prajapatis, like Kasyapa among sages, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like Daksa among Prajapatis, like Kasyapa among sages, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.transliteration: khecaraiḥ sapatākaiś ca muktāhārāvalambibhiḥ nānāvarṇair asaṃkhyātair jātarūpaparicchadaiḥ
verses.translation: Like the Sun among planets, like Pranava among Mantras, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the Sun among planets, like Pranava among Mantras, Purusottama is the most excellent of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: नानाकुसुमगन्धाढ्यैश् चन्दनागुरुभूषितैः सुखप्रचारबहुलैर् नानावादित्रनिःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: nānākusumagandhāḍhyaiś candanāgurubhūṣitaiḥ sukhapracārabahulair nānāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ
verses.translation: Just as the holy rite of all sacred places is the means of redemption from worldly existence so also Purusottama is excellent of all holy centres.

verses.transliteration: manomārutatulyaiś ca kiṅkiṇīstabakākulaiḥ viharanti pure tasmin vaiṣṇave lokapūjite
verses.translation: With cars swift as mind and wind, crowded with clusters of bells, they roam in that city of Vishnu worshipped by the world,

verses.sanskrit: नानाङ्गनाभिः सततं गन्धर्वाप्सरसादिभिः चन्द्राननाभिः कान्ताभिर् योषिद्भिः सुमनोहरैः
verses.transliteration: nānāṅganābhiḥ satataṃ gandharvāpsarasādibhiḥ candrānanābhiḥ kāntābhir yoṣidbhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ
verses.translation: constantly with various women, Gandharvas, Apsarases and others, with lovely moon-faced women, very charming,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पीनोन्नतकुचाग्राभिः सुमध्याभिः समन्ततः श्यामावदातवर्णाभिर् मत्तमातङ्गगामिभिः
verses.transliteration: pīnonnatakucāgrābhiḥ sumadhyābhiḥ samantataḥ śyāmāvadātavarṇābhir mattamātaṅgagāmibhiḥ
verses.translation: with full, raised breasts and fine waists all around, youthful and fair, walking like intoxicated elephants;

verses.sanskrit: परिवार्य नरश्रेष्ठं वीजयन्ति स्म ताः स्त्रियः चामरै रुक्मदण्डैश् च नानारत्नविभूषितैः
verses.transliteration: parivārya naraśreṣṭhaṃ vījayanti sma tāḥ striyaḥ cāmarai rukmadaṇḍaiś ca nānāratnavibhūṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: surrounding the best of men, those women fanned him with chowries with golden handles adorned with various jewels,

verses.sanskrit: गीतनृत्यैस् तथा वाद्यैर् मोदमानैर् मदालसैः यक्षविद्याधरैः सिद्धैर् गन्धर्वैर् अप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: gītanṛtyais tathā vādyair modamānair madālasaiḥ yakṣavidyādharaiḥ siddhair gandharvair apsarogaṇaiḥ

verses.sanskrit: सुरसंघैश् च ऋषिभिः शुशुभे भुवनोत्तमम् तत्र प्राप्य महाभोगान् प्राप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: surasaṃghaiś ca ṛṣibhiḥ śuśubhe bhuvanottamam tatra prāpya mahābhogān prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: hosts of gods and sages, the best of worlds shone. Reaching there, the wise obtain great enjoyments —

verses.sanskrit: वटराजसमीपे तु दक्षिणस्योदधेस् तटे दृष्टो यैर् भगवान् कृष्णः पुष्कराक्षो जगत्पतिः
verses.transliteration: vaṭarājasamīpe tu dakṣiṇasyodadhes taṭe dṛṣṭo yair bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ puṣkarākṣo jagatpatiḥ
verses.translation: those by whom the Lord Krishna, lotus-eyed lord of the world, was seen near the king of banyans on the shore of the southern ocean.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडन्त्य् अप्सरसैः सार्धं यावद् द्यौश् चन्द्रतारकम् प्रतप्तहेमसंकाशा जरामरणवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: krīḍanty apsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvad dyauś candratārakam prataptahemasaṃkāśā jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: They sport with Apsarases as long as heaven, moon and stars endure, like molten gold, free from old age and death,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदुःखविहीनाश् च तृष्णाग्लानिविवर्जिताः चतुर्भुजा महावीर्या वनमालाविभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvaduḥkhavihīnāś ca tṛṣṇāglānivivarjitāḥ caturbhujā mahāvīryā vanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: free from all sorrow, free from craving and weariness, four-armed, very mighty, adorned with forest garlands,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रीवत्सलाञ्छनैर् युक्ताः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः केचिन् नीलोत्पलश्यामाः केचित् काञ्चनसंनिभाः
verses.transliteration: śrīvatsalāñchanair yuktāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ kecin nīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecit kāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.translation: marked with the Shrivatsa, bearing conch, discus and mace; some dark as blue lotuses, some like gold,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केचिन् मरकतप्रख्याः केचिद् वैदूर्यसंनिभाः श्यामवर्णाः कुण्डलिनस् तथान्ये वज्रसंनिभाः
verses.transliteration: kecin marakataprakhyāḥ kecid vaidūryasaṃnibhāḥ śyāmavarṇāḥ kuṇḍalinas tathānye vajrasaṃnibhāḥ
verses.translation: some like emerald, some like beryl, some dark and wearing earrings, and others like diamond.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तादृक् सर्वदेवानां भान्ति लोका द्विजोत्तमाः यादृग् भाति हरेर् लोकः सर्वाश्चर्यसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: na tādṛk sarvadevānāṃ bhānti lokā dvijottamāḥ yādṛg bhāti harer lokaḥ sarvāścaryasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The worlds of all the gods do not shine as the world of Hari shines, full of all wonders, O best of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र पुनरावृत्तिर् गमनाज् जायते द्विजाः प्रभावात् तस्य देवस्य यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: na tatra punarāvṛttir gamanāj jāyate dvijāḥ prabhāvāt tasya devasya yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: There is no return from going there, O brahmins; by the power of that god, until the dissolution of beings,

verses.sanskrit: विचरन्ति पुरे दिव्ये रूपयौवनगर्विताः कृष्णं रामं सुभद्रां च पश्यन्ति पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: vicaranti pure divye rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca paśyanti puruṣottame
verses.translation: they roam in the divine city, proud of beauty and youth, and see Krishna, Rama and Subhadra at Purushottama.

verses.transliteration: prataptahemasaṃkāśaṃ taruṇādityasaṃnibham puramadhye harer bhāti mandiraṃ ratnabhūṣitam
verses.translation: In the middle of the city shines Hari's temple, like molten gold, like the young sun, adorned with jewels,

verses.sanskrit: अनेकशतसाहस्रैः पताकैः समलंकृतम् योजनायुतविस्तीर्णं हेमप्राकारवेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: anekaśatasāhasraiḥ patākaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam yojanāyutavistīrṇaṃ hemaprākāraveṣṭitam
verses.translation: adorned with many hundreds of thousands of banners, ten thousand yojanas wide and surrounded by a golden rampart,

verses.sanskrit: नानावर्णैर् ध्वजैश् चित्रैः कल्पितैः सुमनोहरैः विभाति शारदो यद्वन् नक्षत्रैः सह चन्द्रमाः

verses.translation: with variegated flags of various colours, very charming, it shines like the autumn moon with the stars.
