verses.transliteration: caturdvāraṃ suvistīrṇaṃ kañcukibhiḥ surakṣitam purasaptakasaṃyuktaṃ mahotsekaṃ manoharam
verses.translation: With four gates, very broad, well guarded by chamberlains, joined with seven enclosures, very lofty and charming —

verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ kāñcanaṃ tatra dvitīyaṃ marakatair yutam indranīlaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu mahānīlaṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: the first of gold, the second set with emeralds, the third of sapphire, and after that of great sapphire,

verses.sanskrit: पुरं तु पञ्चमं दीप्तं पद्मरागमयं पुरम् षष्ठं वज्रमयं विप्रा वैदूर्यं सप्तमं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: puraṃ tu pañcamaṃ dīptaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ puram ṣaṣṭhaṃ vajramayaṃ viprā vaidūryaṃ saptamaṃ puram
verses.translation: the fifth enclosure blazing and made of rubies, the sixth of diamond, O brahmins, and the seventh of beryl.

verses.sanskrit: नानारत्नमयैर् हेमप्रवालाङ्कुरभूषितैः स्तम्भैर् अद्भुतसंकाशैर् भाति तद् भवनं महत्
verses.transliteration: nānāratnamayair hemapravālāṅkurabhūṣitaiḥ stambhair adbhutasaṃkāśair bhāti tad bhavanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: That great mansion shines with wondrous pillars made of various gems and adorned with gold and coral shoots.

verses.transliteration: dṛśyante tatra siddhāś ca bhāsayanti diśo daśa paurṇamāsyāṃ sanakṣatro yathā bhāti niśākaraḥ
verses.translation: Siddhas are seen there illuminating the ten directions, as the moon shines with the stars on the full-moon night.

verses.sanskrit: आरूढस् तत्र भगवान् सलक्ष्मीको जनार्दनः पीताम्बरधरः श्यामः श्रीवत्सलक्ष्मसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: ārūḍhas tatra bhagavān salakṣmīko janārdanaḥ pītāmbaradharaḥ śyāmaḥ śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: Seated there is the Lord Janardana with Lakshmi, clad in yellow, dark, marked with the Shrivatsa.

verses.translation: Hari held in his right hand the blazing, terrible Sudarshana discus, chief of all weapons, made of all splendour.

verses.sanskrit: कुन्देन्दुरजतप्रख्यं हारगोक्षीरसंनिभम् आदाय तं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सव्यहस्तेन केशवः
verses.transliteration: kundendurajataprakhyaṃ hāragokṣīrasaṃnibham ādāya taṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ savyahastena keśavaḥ
verses.translation: Taking in his left hand, O best of sages, the conch like jasmine, the moon and silver, like a necklace and cow's milk,

verses.sanskrit: यस्य शब्देन सकलं संक्षोभं जायते जगत् विश्रुतं पाञ्चजन्येति सहस्रावर्तभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: yasya śabdena sakalaṃ saṃkṣobhaṃ jāyate jagat viśrutaṃ pāñcajanyeti sahasrāvartabhūṣitam
verses.translation: at whose sound the whole world is shaken, famed as Panchajanya, adorned with a thousand spirals,

verses.transliteration: duṣkṛtāntakarīṃ raudrāṃ daityadānavanāśinīm jvaladvahniśikhākārāṃ duḥsahāṃ tridaśair api
verses.translation: and the fierce mace Kaumodaki, ender of evil-doers, destroyer of Daityas and Danavas, like a blazing flame of fire, unbearable even to the gods,

verses.sanskrit: कौमोदकीं गदां चासौ धृतवान् दक्षिणे करे वामे विस्फुरति ह्य् अस्य शार्ङ्गं सूर्यसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: kaumodakīṃ gadāṃ cāsau dhṛtavān dakṣiṇe kare vāme visphurati hy asya śārṅgaṃ sūryasamaprabham
verses.translation: he held in his right hand; in his left flashes his Sharnga bow, radiant as the sun,

verses.sanskrit: शरैर् आदित्यसंकाशैर् ज्वालामालाकुलैर् वरैः यो ऽसौ संहरते देवस् त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: śarair ādityasaṃkāśair jvālāmālākulair varaiḥ yo 'sau saṃharate devas trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: with which, with excellent arrows like the sun wreathed in flames, that god destroys the three worlds with all that moves and does not move.

verses.transliteration: sarvānandakaraḥ śrīmān sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ sarvalokagurur devaḥ sarvair devair namaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious one who gives all bliss, skilled in all scriptures, the god who is teacher of all worlds, saluted by all the gods,

verses.translation: the thousand-headed lord of the gods, with a thousand feet and eyes, a thousand names, a thousand limbs, the Lord with a thousand arms,

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनगतो देवः पद्मपत्त्रायतेक्षणः विद्युद्विस्पष्टसंकाशो जगन्नाथो जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanagato devaḥ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇaḥ vidyudvispaṣṭasaṃkāśo jagannātho jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: the god seated on the throne, with eyes long as lotus petals, clear as lightning, lord of the world, teacher of the world,

verses.transliteration: parītaḥ surasiddhaiś ca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ yakṣavidyādharair nāgair munisiddhaiḥ sacāraṇaiḥ
verses.translation: surrounded by gods and Siddhas, hosts of Gandharvas and Apsarases, Yakshas, Vidyadharas, Nagas, sages, Siddhas and Charanas,

verses.transliteration: suparṇair dānavair daityai rākṣasair guhyakiṃnaraiḥ anyair devagaṇair divyaiḥ stūyamāno virājate
verses.translation: Suparnas, Danavas, Daityas, Rakshasas, Guhyakas, Kinnaras and other divine hosts of gods — praised by them, he shines.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रस्था सततं कीर्तिः प्रज्ञा मेधा सरस्वती बुद्धिर् मतिस् तथा क्षान्तिः सिद्धिमूर्तिस् तथा द्युतिः
verses.transliteration: tatrasthā satataṃ kīrtiḥ prajñā medhā sarasvatī buddhir matis tathā kṣāntiḥ siddhimūrtis tathā dyutiḥ
verses.translation: There always dwell Kirti, Prajna, Medha, Sarasvati, Buddhi, Mati, Kshanti, Siddhimurti and Dyuti,

verses.translation: all of them are established in Vasudeva's abode. What need to say more? Everything is established there.

verses.transliteration: mandodarī ca subhagā viśvācī vipulānanā bhadrāṅgī citrasenā ca pramlocā sumanoharā
verses.translation: Mandodari, Subhaga, Vishvachi, Vipulanana, Bhadrangi, Chitrasena and the very charming Pramlocha,

verses.translation: Paravati, Maharupa, Shashilekha, Shubhanana, following the gait of swans and walking like intoxicated elephants,

verses.sanskrit: बिम्बौष्ठी नवगर्भा च विख्याताः सुरयोषितः एताश् चान्या अप्सरसो रूपयौवनगर्विताः
verses.transliteration: bimbauṣṭhī navagarbhā ca vikhyātāḥ surayoṣitaḥ etāś cānyā apsaraso rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ
verses.translation: Bimbaushthi and Navagarbha — famed women of the gods; these and other Apsarases, proud of beauty and youth,

verses.transliteration: sumadhyāś cāruvadanāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ gītamādhuryasaṃyuktāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: slender-waisted, lovely-faced, adorned with every ornament, with sweet song, endowed with every good mark,

verses.transliteration: gītavādye ca kuśalāḥ suragandharvayoṣitaḥ nṛtyanty anudinaṃ tatra yatrāsau puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: skilled in song and music, women of gods and Gandharvas, dance daily there where Purushottama is.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र रोगो नो ग्लानिर् न मृत्युर् न हिमातपौ न क्षुत् पिपासा न जरा न वैरूप्यं न चासुखम्
verses.transliteration: na tatra rogo no glānir na mṛtyur na himātapau na kṣut pipāsā na jarā na vairūpyaṃ na cāsukham
verses.translation: There is no disease there, no weariness, no death, no cold or heat, no hunger or thirst, no old age, no ugliness and no unhappiness.

verses.transliteration: paramānandajananaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam viṣṇulokāt paraṃ lokaṃ nātra paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: I see no world here higher than the world of Vishnu, which produces supreme bliss and grants the fruit of every desire, O brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: ये लोकाः स्वर्गलोके तु श्रूयन्ते पुण्यकर्मणाम् विष्णुलोकस्य ते विप्राः कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: ye lokāḥ svargaloke tu śrūyante puṇyakarmaṇām viṣṇulokasya te viprāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: The worlds of those of meritorious deeds heard of in heaven are not worth a sixteenth part of the world of Vishnu, O brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हरेः पुरस्थानं सर्वभोगगुणान्वितम् सर्वसौख्यकरं पुण्यं सर्वाश्चर्यमयं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hareḥ purasthānaṃ sarvabhogaguṇānvitam sarvasaukhyakaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Thus is Hari's city, endowed with all enjoyments and virtues, bringing all happiness, holy, full of every wonder, O brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र नास्तिका यान्ति पुरुषा विषयात्मकाः न कृतघ्ना न पिशुना नो स्तेना नाजितेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: na tatra nāstikā yānti puruṣā viṣayātmakāḥ na kṛtaghnā na piśunā no stenā nājitendriyāḥ
verses.translation: Atheists do not go there, nor men absorbed in sense-objects, nor the ungrateful, the slanderous, thieves or those with senses uncontrolled.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽर्चयन्ति सदा भक्त्या वासुदेवं जगद्गुरुम् ते तत्र वैष्णवा यान्ति विष्णुलोकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: ye 'rcayanti sadā bhaktyā vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum te tatra vaiṣṇavā yānti viṣṇulokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Those Vaishnavas who always worship Vasudeva, teacher of the world, with devotion, go there to Vishnu's world; there is no doubt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्योदधेस् तीरे क्षेत्रे परमदुर्लभे दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं च रामं च सुभद्रां च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre kṣetre paramadurlabhe dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Having seen Krishna, Rama and Subhadra in the most rare region on the shore of the southern ocean, O best of brahmins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पवृक्षसमीपे तु ये त्यजन्ति कलेवरम् ते तत्र मनुजा यान्ति मृता ये पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: kalpavṛkṣasamīpe tu ye tyajanti kalevaram te tatra manujā yānti mṛtā ye puruṣottame
verses.translation: those men who give up their bodies near the wish-fulfilling tree, who die at Purushottama, go there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वटसागरयोर् मध्ये यः स्मरेत् पुरुषोत्तमम् ते ऽपि तत्र नरा यान्ति ये मृताः पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: vaṭasāgarayor madhye yaḥ smaret puruṣottamam te 'pi tatra narā yānti ye mṛtāḥ puruṣottame
verses.translation: Those who remember Purushottama between the banyan and the ocean, those men who die at Purushottama, also go there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि तत्र परं स्थानं यान्ति नास्त्य् अत्र संशयः एवं मया मुनिश्रेष्ठा विष्णुलोकः सनातनः सर्वानन्दकरः प्रोक्तो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: te 'pi tatra paraṃ sthānaṃ yānti nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā viṣṇulokaḥ sanātanaḥ sarvānandakaraḥ prokto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: They too go to that supreme abode; there is no doubt. Thus, O best of sages, I have told you of the eternal world of Vishnu, which gives all bliss and grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बह्वाश्चर्यस् त्वया प्रोक्तो विष्णुलोको जगत्पते नित्यानन्दकरः श्रीमान् भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: bahvāścaryas tvayā prokto viṣṇuloko jagatpate nityānandakaraḥ śrīmān bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: We are not satiated by listening to the story of the lord. It behoves you to relate once again the great secret doctrine.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रं च दुर्लभं लोके कीर्तितं पुरुषोत्तमम् त्यक्त्वा यत्र नरो देहं याति सालोक्यतां हरेः
verses.transliteration: kṣetraṃ ca durlabhaṃ loke kīrtitaṃ puruṣottamam tyaktvā yatra naro dehaṃ yāti sālokyatāṃ hareḥ
verses.translation: The details of Vasudeva the infinite deity have not been explained perfectly by you. O lord, wc wish to hear. Kindly mention it in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: The details of Vasudeva the infinite deity have not been explained perfectly by you. O lord, wc wish to hear. Kindly mention it in detail.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं त्वया सम्यक् प्रकीर्तितम् यत्र स्वदेहसंत्यागाद् विष्णुलोकं व्रजेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: samyak kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā samyak prakīrtitam yatra svadehasaṃtyāgād viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, I shall mention the greatest essence, the greatness of the infinite deity Vasudeva, the rarest in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, I shall mention the greatest essence, the greatness of the infinite deity Vasudeva, the rarest in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहो मोक्षस्य मार्गो ऽयं देहत्यागस् त्वयोदितः नराणाम् उपकाराय पुरुषाख्ये न संशयः
verses.transliteration: aho mokṣasya mārgo 'yaṃ dehatyāgas tvayoditaḥ narāṇām upakārāya puruṣākhye na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, in the Adikalpa (first of the Kalpas), O brahmins, I was born of the unmanifest. Visvakarman spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the Adikalpa (first of the Kalpas), O brahmins, I was born of the unmanifest. Visvakarman spoke these words.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: anāyāsena deveśa dehaṃ tyaktvā narottamāḥ tasmin kṣetre paraṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yānti nirāmayam
verses.translation: The glorious and righteous Vibhlsana, the younger brother and minister of Ravana was a devotee of Narayana. He was entrusted with the administration of the capital Lanka.

verses.transliteration: śrutvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vismayo no mahān abhūt prayāgapuṣkarādīni kṣetrāṇy āyatanāni ca
verses.translation: O king, it behoves you to favour me with this idol. O lord of the worlds, I shall propitiate it irnd cross the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थानि सरितश् च सरांसि च न तथा तानि सर्वाणि प्रशंससि सुरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni saritaś ca sarāṃsi ca na tathā tāni sarvāṇi praśaṃsasi surottama
verses.translation: Those who devoutly resort to the infinite lord of all, mentally, verbally and physically attain the highest region.

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रशंससि क्षेत्रं पुरुषाख्यं पुनः पुनः ज्ञातो ऽस्माभिर् अभिप्रायस् तवेदानीं पितामह
verses.transliteration: yathā praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ puruṣākhyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ jñāto 'smābhir abhiprāyas tavedānīṃ pitāmaha
verses.translation: By visiting Ananta (infinite) even for once and by devoutly worshipping and bowing to him, the devotee derives ten.times more than the benefit of Rajasuya and Asvamedha sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting Ananta (infinite) even for once and by devoutly worshipping and bowing to him, the devotee derives ten.times more than the benefit of Rajasuya and Asvamedha sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: येन प्रशंससि क्षेत्रं मुक्तिदं पुरुषोत्तमम् पुरुषाख्यसमं नूनं क्षेत्रं नास्ति महीतले तेन त्वं विबुधश्रेष्ठ प्रशंससि पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: yena praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam puruṣākhyasamaṃ nūnaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsti mahītale tena tvaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭha praśaṃsasi punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Divine Ordeal (divya-pariksa). Yajnavalkya prescribes ten ordeals viz tula, agni, jala, visa, kos'a, tandula, tapta-masa, phala, dharma, tulasi.

verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ muniśreṣṭhā bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtam puruṣākhyasamaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsty atra pṛthivītale
verses.translation: True, true, O best of sages, is what you have declared: there is no region on the earth equal to the one called Purusha.

verses.transliteration: santi yāni tu tīrthāni puṇyāny āyatanāni ca tāni śrīpuruṣākhyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: The holy places and sacred shrines that exist are not worth a sixteenth part of the one called Shri Purusha.

verses.translation: As Vishnu, lord of all, is the highest of all worlds, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As Vishnu is declared the best among the Adityas, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.transliteration: nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā somaḥ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: As the moon among the stars and the ocean among lakes, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As fire among the Vasus and Shankara among the Rudras, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As the brahmin among the classes and Vainateya among birds, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As the makara among fishes and the lion among beasts, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्राणां यथा श्रेष्ठः क्षीरोदः सरितां पतिः तथा समस्ततीर्थानां वरिष्ठं पुरुषोत्तमम्

verses.translation: As the milk ocean is the best of oceans, lord of rivers, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As Narada is the best of divine sages, O best of sages, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As gold among metals and the sacrificial fee among purifiers, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As Daksha among lords of creatures and Kashyapa among seers, so Purushottama is the best of all holy places.

verses.translation: As the horse sacrifice is declared the best of sacrifices, so is that region among all holy places, O best of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीनां यथा धान्यं तृणेषु तृणराड् यथा तथा समस्ततीर्थानाम् उत्तमं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīnāṃ yathā dhānyaṃ tṛṇeṣu tṛṇarāḍ yathā tathā samastatīrthānām uttamaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: As grain among plants and the king of grasses among grasses, so Purushottama is the highest of all holy places.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा समस्ततीर्थानां धर्मः संसारतारकः तथा समस्ततीर्थानां श्रेष्ठं तत् पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yathā samastatīrthānāṃ dharmaḥ saṃsāratārakaḥ tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tat puruṣottamam
verses.translation: As dharma, which carries one across worldly existence, is best among all holy things, so is that Purushottama the best of all holy places.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां चैव तीर्थानां क्षेत्राणां च द्विजोत्तमाः जपहोमव्रतानां च तपोदानफलानि च
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ japahomavratānāṃ ca tapodānaphalāni ca
verses.translation: Thus, the glory of (Infinite deity) and the holy shrine of Purusottama that yields worldly pleasures and liberation unto men has been recounted by me. It is very difficult of access.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न तत् पश्यामि भो विप्रा यत् तेन सदृशं भुवि किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन भाषितेन पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: na tat paśyāmi bho viprā yat tena sadṛśaṃ bhuvi kiṃ cātra bahunoktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: KtSin: a follower of Kaiiisa who at the instruction of Kamsa went to Gokula, in the form of a horse, to kill Srikrs*a. But Snkrsna killed him and got the name Kesava.
verses.commentary: Sense: KtSin: a follower of Kaiiisa who at the instruction of Kamsa went to Gokula, in the form of a horse, to kill Srikrs*a. But Snkrsna killed him and got the name Kesava.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं क्षेत्रं तत् परमं महत् पुरुषाख्यं सकृद् दृष्ट्वा सागराम्भःसमाप्लुतम्
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tat paramaṃ mahat puruṣākhyaṃ sakṛd dṛṣṭvā sāgarāmbhaḥsamāplutam
verses.translation: Those who meditate upon Krsna the overlord of the three worlds', the bestower of all desired benefits, are liberated souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who meditate upon Krsna the overlord of the three worlds', the bestower of all desired benefits, are liberated souls.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविद्यां सकृज् ज्ञात्वा गर्भवासो न विद्यते हरेः संनिहिते स्थान उत्तमे पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: brahmavidyāṃ sakṛj jñātvā garbhavāso na vidyate hareḥ saṃnihite sthāna uttame puruṣottame
verses.translation: Those who are devoted to Krsna, those who remember Krsna at night (when they go to bed) and again when they get up enter Krsna when their bodies are consumed on death like the ghee offering consigned to fire with due repetitions of Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are devoted to Krsna, those who remember Krsna at night (when they go to bed) and again when they get up enter Krsna when their bodies are consumed on death like the ghee offering consigned to fire with due repetitions of Mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरम् उपासीत मासमात्रम् अथापि वा तेन जप्तं हुतं तेन तेन तप्तं तपो महत्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaram upāsīta māsamātram athāpi vā tena japtaṃ hutaṃ tena tena taptaṃ tapo mahat
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent sages, the lotus-eyed deity Krsna should be assiduously visited in that holy centre by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent sages, the lotus-eyed deity Krsna should be assiduously visited in that holy centre by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र योगेश्वरो हरिः भुक्त्वा भोगान् विचित्रांश् च देवयोषित्समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ bhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃś ca devayoṣitsamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: The lofty-minded persons who visit Krsna, (Balarama) and Subhadra at the time when the deities are laid to rest go to the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lofty-minded persons who visit Krsna, (Balarama) and Subhadra at the time when the deities are laid to rest go to the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कल्पान्ते पुनर् आगत्य मर्त्यलोके नरोत्तमः जायते योगिनां विप्रा ज्ञानज्ञेयोद्यतो गृहे
verses.transliteration: kalpānte punar āgatya martyaloke narottamaḥ jāyate yogināṃ viprā jñānajñeyodyato gṛhe
verses.translation: Those who devoutly visit Purusottama, Balarama and Subhadra at any time, go to the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who devoutly visit Purusottama, Balarama and Subhadra at any time, go to the world of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य वैष्णवं योगं हरेः स्वच्छन्दतां व्रजेत् कल्पवृक्षस्य रामस्य कृष्णस्य भद्रया सह
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ hareḥ svacchandatāṃ vrajet kalpavṛkṣasya rāmasya kṛṣṇasya bhadrayā saha
verses.translation: He who stays in the holy centres of Purusottama for the four months of rainy season derives more benefit than the benefit accruing from the holy pilgrimage to the other centres of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who stays in the holy centres of Purusottama for the four months of rainy season derives more benefit than the benefit accruing from the holy pilgrimage to the other centres of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयेन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यं माधवस्य च स्वर्गद्वारस्य माहात्म्यं सागरस्य विधिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyendradyumnasya māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya ca svargadvārasya māhātmyaṃ sāgarasya vidhiḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Those lofty persons who reside there itself during the seasons, after conquering sense-organs and controlling anger, derive the benefit of a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those lofty persons who reside there itself during the seasons, after conquering sense-organs and controlling anger, derive the benefit of a penance.

verses.sanskrit: मार्जनस्य यथाकाले भागीरथ्याः समागमम् सर्वम् एतन् मया ख्यातं यत् परं श्रोतुम् इच्छथ
verses.transliteration: mārjanasya yathākāle bhāgīrathyāḥ samāgamam sarvam etan mayā khyātaṃ yat paraṃ śrotum icchatha
verses.translation: Within a month a man obtains at Purusottama their benefit which others obtain after performing penance in other holy centres for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within a month a man obtains at Purusottama their benefit which others obtain after performing penance in other holy centres for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माहात्म्यम् एतच् च कथितं मया सर्वाश्चर्यं समाख्यातं रहस्यं पुरुषोत्तमम् पुराणं परमं गुह्यं धन्यं संसारमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: indradyumnasya māhātmyam etac ca kathitaṃ mayā sarvāścaryaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ puruṣottamam purāṇaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāramocanam
verses.translation: Everyday, the pure person derives that benefit which is mentioned as the result of perfectly performed pilgrimage, holy rites and observances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everyday, the pure person derives that benefit which is mentioned as the result of perfectly performed pilgrimage, holy rites and observances.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नहि नस् तृप्तिर् अस्तीह शृण्वतां तीर्थविस्तरम् पुनर् एव परं गुह्यं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः परं तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nahi nas tṛptir astīha śṛṇvatāṃ tīrthavistaram punar eva paraṃ guhyaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ paraṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam
verses.translation: A man of perfectly restrained sense-organs obtains everyday the same benefit as one obtains (on other holy centres) after performing different rites of sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man of perfectly restrained sense-organs obtains everyday the same benefit as one obtains (on other holy centres) after performing different rites of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इमम् एव पुरा प्रश्नं पृष्टो ऽस्मि द्विजसत्तमाः नारदेन प्रयत्नेन तदा तं प्रोक्तवान् अहम्
verses.transliteration: imam eva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo 'smi dvijasattamāḥ nāradena prayatnena tadā taṃ proktavān aham
verses.translation: Those who abandon their bodies anywhere between the baniyan tree and the Ocean obtain* the greatest liberation which is very difficult to get.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who abandon their bodies anywhere between the baniyan tree and the Ocean obtain* the greatest liberation which is very difficult to get.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसो यज्ञदानानां तीर्थानां पावनं स्मृतम् सर्वं श्रुतं मया त्वत्तो जगद्योने जगत्पते
verses.transliteration: tapaso yajñadānānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tvatto jagadyone jagatpate
verses.translation: Even the animals of low strata of species such as germs, worms, moths etc., attain the greatest salvation by abandon¬ ing their bodies there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the animals of low strata of species such as germs, worms, moths etc., attain the greatest salvation by abandon¬ ing their bodies there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कियन्ति सन्ति तीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले सर्वेषाम् एव तीर्थानां सर्वदा किं विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: kiyanti santi tīrthāni svargamartyarasātale sarveṣām eva tīrthānāṃ sarvadā kiṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, see the illusion of the world in regard to other holy centres. The fruits of all other holy centres are derived from the only holy centre Purusottama.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, see the illusion of the world in regard to other holy centres. The fruits of all other holy centres are derived from the only holy centre Purusottama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधानि तीर्थानि स्वर्गे मर्त्ये रसातले दैवानि मुनिशार्दूल आसुराण्य् आरुषाणि च
verses.transliteration: caturvidhāni tīrthāni svarge martye rasātale daivāni muniśārdūla āsurāṇy āruṣāṇi ca
verses.translation: The man who faithfully visits Purusottama for once will become the most excellent man among thousands of men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who faithfully visits Purusottama for once will become the most excellent man among thousands of men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानुषाणि त्रिलोकेषु विख्यातानि सुरादिभिः मानुषेभ्यश् च तीर्थेभ्य आर्षं तीर्थम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāṇi trilokeṣu vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ mānuṣebhyaś ca tīrthebhya ārṣaṃ tīrtham anuttamam
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one who gives up his body in this holy centre will achieve liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent brahmins, one who gives up his body in this holy centre will achieve liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आर्षेभ्यश् चैव तीर्थेभ्य आसुरं बहुपुण्यदम् आसुरेभ्यस् तथा पुण्यं दैवं तत् सार्वकामिकम्
verses.transliteration: ārṣebhyaś caiva tīrthebhya āsuraṃ bahupuṇyadam āsurebhyas tathā puṇyaṃ daivaṃ tat sārvakāmikam
verses.translation: Who can adequately mention the glory of Puru¬ sottama? Just by visiting the baniyan tree there a man dispels the sin of brahmin slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who can adequately mention the glory of Puru¬ sottama? Just by visiting the baniyan tree there a man dispels the sin of brahmin slaughter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवैश् चैव निर्मितं दैवम् उच्यते त्रिभ्यो यद् एकं जायेत तस्मान् नातः परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇuśivaiś caiva nirmitaṃ daivam ucyate tribhyo yad ekaṃ jāyeta tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, if you seek for perpetual salvation,
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, if you seek for perpetual salvation,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानां तीर्थं मेध्यम् उदाहृतम् तत्रापि जाम्बवं द्वीपं तीर्थं बहुगुणोदयम्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānāṃ tīrthaṃ medhyam udāhṛtam tatrāpi jāmbavaṃ dvīpaṃ tīrthaṃ bahuguṇodayam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma born of the unmani¬ fest one, sages resided there and attained the highest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma born of the unmani¬ fest one, sages resided there and attained the highest region.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाम्बवे भारतं वर्षं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् कर्मभूमिर् यतः पुत्र तस्मात् तीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: jāmbave bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam karmabhūmir yataḥ putra tasmāt tīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, you too stay in this holy centre—Purusottama, if you seek for perfect creation here¬ after.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tatraiva yāni tīrthāni yāny uktāni mayā tava himavadvindhyayor madhye ṣaṇnadyo devasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: There are the holy places I have told you of: between the Himalaya and the Vindhya there are six rivers of divine origin,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथैव देवजा ब्रह्मन् दक्षिणार्णवविन्ध्ययोः एता द्वादश नद्यस् तु प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva devajā brahman dakṣiṇārṇavavindhyayoḥ etā dvādaśa nadyas tu prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: and likewise, O Brahman, divine ones between the southern ocean and the Vindhya; these twelve rivers are declared as the principal ones.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभिसंपूजितं यस्माद् भारतं बहुपुण्यदम् कर्मभूमिर् अतो देवैर् वर्षं तस्मात् प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: abhisaṃpūjitaṃ yasmād bhārataṃ bahupuṇyadam karmabhūmir ato devair varṣaṃ tasmāt prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Because Bharata, bestowing much merit, is worshipped by the gods as the land of action, it is therefore declared a varsha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्षाणि चैव तीर्थानि देवजानि क्वचित् क्वचित् आसुरैर् आवृतान्य् आसंस् तद् एवासुरम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ārṣāṇi caiva tīrthāni devajāni kvacit kvacit āsurair āvṛtāny āsaṃs tad evāsuram ucyate
verses.translation: The holy places of the sages and those of the gods were in places covered by Asuras; hence those are called Asuric.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैवेष्व् एव प्रदेशेषु तपस् तप्त्वा महर्षयः दैवप्रभावात् तपस आर्षाण्य् अपि च तान्य् अपि
verses.transliteration: daiveṣv eva pradeśeṣu tapas taptvā maharṣayaḥ daivaprabhāvāt tapasa ārṣāṇy api ca tāny api
verses.translation: In the divine regions the great sages practised austerity; by the power of the gods and of austerity, those too became holy places of the sages.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषैः कारितान्य् आहुर् मानुषाणीति नारद एवं चतुर्विधो भेदस् तीर्थानां मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaiḥ kāritāny āhur mānuṣāṇīti nārada evaṃ caturvidho bhedas tīrthānāṃ munisattama
verses.translation: those made by men are called human, O Narada. Thus there are four kinds of holy places, O best of sages.

verses.sanskrit: भेदं न कश्चिज् जानाति श्रोतुं युक्तो ऽसि नारद बहवः पण्डितंमन्याः शृण्वन्ति कथयन्ति च सुकृती को ऽपि जानाति वक्तुं श्रोतुं निजैर् गुणैः
verses.transliteration: bhedaṃ na kaścij jānāti śrotuṃ yukto 'si nārada bahavaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca sukṛtī ko 'pi jānāti vaktuṃ śrotuṃ nijair guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: No one knows the distinction; you are fit to hear it, O Narada. Many who think themselves learned hear and speak, but only some rare virtuous person knows how to tell and hear it by his own merits.

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ bhedaṃ ca śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ yac chrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "I wish to hear truly their nature and distinctions, hearing which one is freed from all sins; there is no doubt.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन् कृतयुगादौ तु उपायो ऽन्यो न विद्यते तीर्थसेवां विना स्वल्पायासेनाभीष्टदायिनीम्
verses.transliteration: brahman kṛtayugādau tu upāyo 'nyo na vidyate tīrthasevāṃ vinā svalpāyāsenābhīṣṭadāyinīm
verses.translation: O Brahman, from the beginning of the Krita age there is no other means, apart from resorting to holy places, that grants one's desire with little effort.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वया सदृशो धातर् वक्ता ज्ञाताथवा क्वचित् त्वं नाभिकमले विष्णोः संजातो ऽखिलपूर्वजः
verses.transliteration: na tvayā sadṛśo dhātar vaktā jñātāthavā kvacit tvaṃ nābhikamale viṣṇoḥ saṃjāto 'khilapūrvajaḥ
verses.translation: O Creator, there is no speaker or knower anywhere like you; you were born in the navel-lotus of Vishnu, the forefather of all."

verses.transliteration: godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca veṇikā tāpī payouṣṇī vindhyasya dakṣiṇe tu prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The Godavari, Bhimarathi, Tungabhadra, Venika, Tapi and Payoshni are declared to the south of the Vindhya;

verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathī narmadā tu yamunā ca sarasvatī viśokā ca vitastā ca himavatparvatāśritāḥ
verses.translation: the Bhagirathi, Narmada, Yamuna, Sarasvati, Vishoka and Vitasta rest on the Himalaya mountains.

verses.transliteration: etā nadyaḥ puṇyatamā devatīrthāny udāhṛtāḥ gayaḥ kollāsuro vṛtras tripuro hy andhakas tathā
verses.translation: These most holy rivers are declared divine holy places. Gaya, Kollasura, Vritra, Tripura and Andhaka,

verses.transliteration: hayamūrdhā ca lavaṇo namuciḥ śṛṅgakas tathā yamaḥ pātālaketuś ca mayaḥ puṣkara eva ca
verses.translation: Hayamurdha, Lavana, Namuchi, Shringaka, Yama, Patalaketu, Maya and Pushkara —

verses.translation: holy places covered by these are Asuric, yet auspicious. Prabhasa, Bhargava, Agasti, Nara and Narayana,

verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaś ca bharadvājo gotamaḥ kaśyapo manuḥ ityādimunijuṣṭāni ṛṣitīrthāni nārada
verses.translation: Vasishtha, Bharadvaja, Gotama, Kashyapa, Manu — those frequented by such sages are the holy places of the sages, O Narada.

verses.transliteration: ambarīṣo hariścandro māndhātā manur eva ca kuruḥ kanakhalaś caiva bhadrāśvaḥ sagaras tathā

verses.transliteration: aśvayūpo nāciketā vṛṣākapir ariṃdamaḥ ityādimānuṣair vipra nirmitāni śubhāni ca
verses.translation: Ashvayupa, Nachiketas, Vrishakapi and Arindama — by such men, O brahmin, auspicious ones were made,

verses.sanskrit: यशसः फलभूत्यर्थं निर्मितानीह नारद स्वतोउद्भूतानि दैवानि यत्र क्वापि जगत्त्रये पुण्यतीर्थानि तान्य् आहुस् तीर्थभेदो मयोदितः
verses.transliteration: yaśasaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ nirmitānīha nārada svatoudbhūtāni daivāni yatra kvāpi jagattraye puṇyatīrthāni tāny āhus tīrthabhedo mayoditaḥ
verses.translation: made here for the sake of fame, fruit and prosperity, O Narada. The divine ones arose of themselves anywhere in the three worlds; they are called holy places of merit. Thus I have told the distinction of holy places.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदैवत्यं तु यत् तीर्थं सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् उक्तम् उत्तमम् तस्य स्वरूपभेदं च विस्तरेण ब्रवीतु मे
verses.transliteration: tridaivatyaṃ tu yat tīrthaṃ sarvebhyo hy uktam uttamam tasya svarūpabhedaṃ ca vistareṇa bravītu me
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen to his interesting story. I shall mention in brief the activities of that sage. During the summer he practised fivefold penance with four fires on the four sides and the sun overhead; during the rainy season he slept on the bare ground; during winter he stood in neck-deep water—thus he performed a great penance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् अन्यानि तीर्थानि तावत् ताः पुण्यभूमयः तावद् यज्ञादयो यावत् त्रिदैवत्यं न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tāvad anyāni tīrthāni tāvat tāḥ puṇyabhūmayaḥ tāvad yajñādayo yāvat tridaivatyaṃ na dṛśyate
verses.translation: On seeing the power of penance of that sage, Devas, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Vidyadharas were struck with wonder. O excellent sages, with the force of his strength Kandu scorched the three worlds, Earth, firmament and heaven. On seeing him engaged in penance Devas said thus:— cc Wonderful is his great courage! Wonderful is his great penance!'
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the power of penance of that sage, Devas, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Vidyadharas were struck with wonder. O excellent sages, with the force of his strength Kandu scorched the three worlds, Earth, firmament and heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गेयं सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वकामप्रदायिनी त्रिदैवत्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ तदुत्पत्तिम् अतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: gaṅgeyaṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvakāmapradāyinī tridaivatyā muniśreṣṭha tadutpattim ataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Without excitement they consulted one another. Inclu¬ ding Indra they were bewildered and frightened. Hence, they wanted an obstacle to be putin the way of his penance. O Pramloca, go quickly to the place where this sage is performing penance. O splendid lady, in order to impede his penance make his mind agitated.
verses.wordMeaning: Without excitement they consulted one another. Inclu¬ ding Indra they were bewildered and frightened. Hence, they wanted an obstacle to be putin the way of his penance. O Pramloca, go quickly to the place where this sage is performing penance. O splendid lady,…

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणाम् अयुतात् पूर्वं देवकार्य उपस्थिते तारको बलवान् आसीन् मद्वराद् अतिगर्वितः
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇām ayutāt pūrvaṃ devakārya upasthite tārako balavān āsīn madvarād atigarvitaḥ
verses.translation: O most excellent Deva, O my lord, I always carry out your behests. But in this matter, I have some doubts. My lif e has to be risked. When he comes to know that I have approached him to create impediment in his penance, sage Kandu of excessive splendour will curse me angrily. It will be unbearable. On hearing her words the consort of SacI said again;— Let others stay by. O splendid lady, you are very clever in this affair.

verses.sanskrit: देवानां परमैश्वर्यं हृतं तेन बलीयसा ततस् ते शरणं जग्मुर् देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ paramaiśvaryaṃ hṛtaṃ tena balīyasā tatas te śaraṇaṃ jagmur devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: O lady of fine buttocks, I shall send Kama, Vasanta (Spring) and the gentle breeze to assist you. Go with them to the place where this great sage lives. On hearing the words of Indra that excellent lady of attractive eyes went with them by the aerial path.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of fine buttocks, I shall send Kama, Vasanta (Spring) and the gentle breeze to assist you. Go with them to the place where this great sage lives. On hearing the words of Indra that excellent lady of attractive eyes went with them by the aerial path.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदशायिनं देवं जगतां प्रपितामहम् कृताञ्जलिपुटा देवा विष्णुम् ऊचुर् अनन्यगाः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ devaṃ jagatāṃ prapitāmaham kṛtāñjalipuṭā devā viṣṇum ūcur ananyagāḥ
verses.translation: After going there she saw the excellent and charming forest. She saw the pious sage, seated in the hermitage perform¬ ing his brilliant penance. Along with them, she surveyed the beautiful forest comparable to the Nandana forest. It contained excellent flowers of all seasons. It was agitated by groups of monkeys. Standing on the banks of the river, only a very short distance from him, that excellqnt celestial damsel with the sweetness of the cuckoo in her voice began to sing songs merrily.
verses.wordMeaning: After going there she saw the excellent and charming forest. She saw the pious sage, seated in the hermitage perform¬ ing his brilliant penance. Along with them, she surveyed the beautiful forest comparable to the Nandana forest. It contained excellent flowers of all seasons.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वं त्राता जगतां नाथ देवानां कीर्तिवर्धन सर्वेश्वर जगद्योने त्रयीमूर्ते नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ trātā jagatāṃ nātha devānāṃ kīrtivardhana sarveśvara jagadyone trayīmūrte namo 'stu te
verses.translation: An untimely but sweet and charming note of the cuckoo was heard and Vasanta exerted his full force. A gentle breeze withhis abode in the Malaya mountain blew there making the excellent flowers fall down gently into small or big heaps.
verses.commentary: Sense: An untimely but sweet and charming note of the cuckoo was heard and Vasanta exerted his full force. A gentle breeze withhis abode in the Malaya mountain blew there making the excellent flowers fall down gently into small or big heaps.

verses.sanskrit: लोकस्रष्टासुरान् हन्ता त्वम् एव जगतां पतिः स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशानां कारणं त्वं जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: lokasraṣṭāsurān hantā tvam eva jagatāṃ patiḥ sthityutpattivināśānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ jaganmaya
verses.translation: Holding the flowery arrows, Kama went near that sage and made his mind agitated. On hearing the sweet sound of the song the sage was surprised and his mind was afflicted by the arrows of Kama. He went to the place where the lady of beautiful eyebrows was standing. O lady of good buttocks, who are you? Whom do you belong to? O fortunate blessed lady of atrractive smiles, you have captivated my mind. O lady of fine eyebrows and slender waist, tell me the truth.
verses.wordMeaning: Holding the flowery arrows, Kama went near that sage and made his mind agitated. On hearing the sweet sound of the song the sage was surprised and his mind was afflicted by the arrows of Kama. He went to the place where the lady of beautiful eyebrows was standing.…

verses.sanskrit: त्राता न कोप्य् अस्ति जगत्त्रये ऽपि शरीरिणां सर्वविपद्गतानाम् त्वया विना वारिजपत्त्रनेत्र तापत्रयाणां शरणं न चान्यत्
verses.transliteration: trātā na kopy asti jagattraye 'pi śarīriṇāṃ sarvavipadgatānām tvayā vinā vārijapattranetra tāpatrayāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ na cānyat
verses.translation: I have come here to collect flowers. I am your servant- maid. Command me quickly? What shall I do at your bidding? On hearing her words the sage lost his courage. He

verses.transliteration: evaṃ tv anekadhā loke yā sthitā lokapāvanī devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yuvayor garbham āviśat
verses.translation: Trees took up that foetus and unified it in a body. One can befriend a person by seven steps together: She became the lovely-eyed daughter of trees, Marisa by name. O brahmins, it was she who became the wife of Prace- tas and the mother of Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trees took up that foetus and unified it in a body. One can befriend a person by seven steps together: She became the lovely-eyed daughter of trees, Marisa by name. O brahmins, it was she who became the wife of Prace- tas and the mother of Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: समुत्पन्ना जगन्माता शंभोः पत्नी भविष्यति अस्माकं भवतां चापि पालनी च भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: samutpannā jaganmātā śaṃbhoḥ patnī bhaviṣyati asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ cāpi pālanī ca bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: As soon as he saw the holy centre and lord Purusot¬ tama, the excellent sage considered himself contented as one who had fulfilled his duties. There he sat with fully concentrated mind and pro¬ pitiated Hari. The excellent sage, a great Yogin stood with his arms lifted up. With a singlcminded attention he performed Japa (repetition of holy names) of Brahmapara (Brahman the great redeemer).
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as he saw the holy centre and lord Purusot¬ tama, the excellent sage considered himself contented as one who had fulfilled his duties. There he sat with fully concentrated mind and pro¬ pitiated Hari. The excellent sage, a great Yogin stood with his arms lifted up.…

verses.transliteration: himavān api tad vākyaṃ surāṇām abhinandya ca menā cāpi mahotsāhā astv ity evaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: O sage, we wish to hear about the excellent and great Brahmapara whereby lord Kesava was propitiated by Kandu who performed this Japa. O sage, mention to me the greatest task that is thought of by you in your mind. I have come to you as the bestower of boons. O sage of good holy rites, choose the boon. O Narayana, O Hari O Krsna, O lord of the universe with the Srlvatsa scar, O seed of the universe, O abode of the universe, O witness of the universe, obeisance be to you.
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, we wish to hear about the excellent and great Brahmapara whereby lord Kesava was propitiated by Kandu who performed this Japa. O sage, mention to me the greatest task that is thought of by you in your mind. I have come to you as the bestower of boons.…

verses.transliteration: tadotpannā jagaddhātrī gaurī himavato gṛhe śivadhyānaratā nityaṃ tanniṣṭhā tanmanogatā
verses.translation: O unmanifest one, O victorious one, O source of origin, O chief Purusottama, O lotus-eyed one, O Govinda, O lord of the worlds, obeisance be to you. O golden-wombed one, O abode of Sri, O deity wit the umbilical lotus, O eternal one, O deity with the Earth in the womb, O steadfast one, O Isana, O Hrsikesa, obeisance be to

verses.transliteration: tāṃ vai procuḥ suragaṇā īśārthe tapa āviśa tathā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe gaurī tepe tapo mahat
verses.translation: O deity without beginning and end, O immortal and O deity with the Yogic Atman, O incomprehensi e O excellent one, O bestower of boons, O infinite one O source of origin of Brahma, O mine of good qualities, O lord of dissolution, origin and contact, O Vasudeva, obeisance be to

verses.transliteration: punaḥ saṃmantrayām āsur īśo dhyāyati tāṃ śivām ātmānaṃ vā tathānyad vā na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ bhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Parjanya (Lord of Rain), O maker of holy rites, OBhutapa (lord of Elements), O unmanifest one, O deity not agitated by the elements and principles, O abode of living beings, O soul of living beings. O deity containing living beings in the womb, obeisance be to you.

verses.transliteration: menakāyāḥ sutāyāṃ tu cittaṃ dadhyāt sureśvaraḥ tatra nītir vidhātavyā tataḥ śraiṣṭhyam avāpsyatha tataḥ prāha mahābuddhir vācaspatir udāradhīḥ
verses.translation: O performer of Yajhas, O upholder of Yajnas, O crea¬ tor ofYajnas; O bestower of fearlessness; O deity with the Yajna in the womb (?), O golden-limbcd one, O deity born of Devaki, obeisance be to you. You are the knower of Ksetra (Physical form, holy centre) you are the holder Ksetra; you possess Ksetra; you are the destroyer of Ksetra; you arc the maker of Ksetra; you have selfcontrol; O soul of Ksetra, O deity devoid of Ksetra, obei¬ sance be to you, the creator of Ksetra. O abode of good qualities, O receptacle of good quali¬ ties, O support of good qualities; O deity who are conducive to good qualities; O enjoyer of good qualities; O garden of good qualities; O deity who abandon good qualities (i.e. attributes), obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अयं मदनो धीमान् कन्दर्पः पुष्पचापधृक् स विध्यतु शिवं शान्तं बाणैः पुष्पमयैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: yas tv ayaṃ madano dhīmān kandarpaḥ puṣpacāpadhṛk sa vidhyatu śivaṃ śāntaṃ bāṇaiḥ puṣpamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: You are Visnu; you are Hari; you are the discus¬ bearing lord; you areJisnu (victorious); you are Janardana; you are the Element; and the Vasatkara; you are the future one, the lord of the present one. You are the creator of the Bhutas (living beings); you are the unmanifest one; You are Bhava (source of origin); you are the holder of Bhutas. You are lord conceiver and creator of Bhutas. They call you the unborn overlord.
verses.wordMeaning: You are Visnu; you are Hari; you are the discus¬ bearing lord; you areJisnu (victorious); you are Janardana; you are the Element; and the Vasatkara; you are the future one, the lord of the present one. You are the creator of the Bhutas (living beings);…

verses.sanskrit: तेन विद्धस् त्रिनेत्रो ऽपि ईशायां बुद्धिम् आदधेत् परिणेष्यत्य् असौ नूनं तदा तां गिरिजां हरः
verses.transliteration: tena viddhas trinetro 'pi īśāyāṃ buddhim ādadhet pariṇeṣyaty asau nūnaṃ tadā tāṃ girijāṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: You arc the sun; you are the Omkara, you are the vital breath; you are the dispeller of darkness; you are Parjanya (god of Rain); you are well reputed; you arc Brahma; you are Indra, lord of Devas. You are Rk. Yajus and Saman; you are Atman; you arc the honoured and approved one, you are fire and wind; you are Kubera; you arc Havis (ghee offering). You are the creator; you are the enjoyer; you are the Hotf (one who performs Homa offerings), you are Havis (obla¬ tion) Kratu (sacrifice); you are the poet, you are Hari; you are the most excellent lord of worlds; you are Acyuta.
verses.wordMeaning: You arc the sun; you are the Omkara, you are the vital breath; you are the dispeller of darkness; you are Parjanya (god of Rain); you are well reputed; you arc Brahma; you are Indra, lord of Devas. You are Rk. Yajus and Saman; you are Atman;…

verses.sanskrit: जयिनः पञ्चबाणस्य न बाणाः क्वापि कुण्ठिताः तथोढायां जगद्धात्र्यां शंभोः पुत्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: jayinaḥ pañcabāṇasya na bāṇāḥ kvāpi kuṇṭhitāḥ tathoḍhāyāṃ jagaddhātryāṃ śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: You are the glorious deity with the vision of every¬ thing; you are the destroyer of enemies suppressing everyone; you are the day; similarly, you are the night; learned men call you Vatsara (year). You are the units of time such as Kala; Kastha, Muhurta, Ksana and Lava; you are a boy; you are an old man; you are man, woman and eunuch.

verses.transliteration: jātaḥ putras trinetrasya tārakaṃ sa haniṣyati vasantaṃ ca sahāyārthaṃ śobhiṣṭhaṃ kusumākaram
verses.translation: You arc Atman the support of all (?) You are not per¬ ceptible to sense-organs. You are Agranl (leader); you are Gramani (leader of groups); you are Suparna (Garuda); you are one without a beginning, you are the collection; you are very great, you are one who held the Atman; you are Acyuta (unswerving). You are Yama; (Restraint); you are Niyama (observ¬ ance of regulations); you are lofty; you are four-armed; you alone are the cooked rice and the immanent soul; you are men¬ tioned as the greatest Atman.

verses.sanskrit: आह्लादनं च मनसा कामायैनं प्रयच्छथ
verses.transliteration: āhlādanaṃ ca manasā kāmāyainaṃ prayacchatha
verses.translation: You are the preceptor and the weighty one; you are the weightier being; you are the left one (adverse one); you are the right one (the favourable one, clever one); you are Pippala (a variety of medicinal plant), you are one who do not go, you are the manifest one; you are the Prajapati (patriarch). You arc one with golden umbilicus; you are the lord; you are the moon; you are one whose physical form cannot be specifically pointed out; you are Yama; you are the destroyer of the enemies ofDcvas.
verses.wordMeaning: You are the preceptor and the weighty one; you are the weightier being; you are the left one (adverse one); you are the right one (the favourable one, clever one); you are Pippala (a variety of medicinal plant), you are one who do not go, you are the manifest one;…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the preceptor and the weighty one; you are the weightier being; you are the left one (adverse one); you are the right one (the favourable one, clever one); you are Pippala (a variety of medicinal plant), you are one who do not go, you are the manifest one;…

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणा मदनं कुसुमाकरम् प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अव्यग्राः शिवान्तिकम् अरिंदमाः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇā madanaṃ kusumākaram preṣayām āsur avyagrāḥ śivāntikam ariṃdamāḥ
verses.translation: You are lord Samkarsana; you are the eternal maker; you are Vasudeva of unmeasurable soul; you alone are one devoid of attributes. You are the eldest; you are the most excellent; you are one who endure; you are Madhava; you are thousand-headed lord; you are unmanifcst one with thousand Visions. You are the thousand-footed lord, you are Virat (Immense Being); you are the lord ofDevas; O lord of Dcvas; you alone stand ten Angulas beyond all.

verses.sanskrit: स जगाम त्वरा कामो धृतचापो समाधवः रत्या च सहितः कामः कर्तुं कर्म सुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: sa jagāma tvarā kāmo dhṛtacāpo samādhavaḥ ratyā ca sahitaḥ kāmaḥ kartuṃ karma suduṣkaram
verses.translation: A fourth part of yours constitutes the Universe; your nine parts are immortal in heaven; nine parts are stationed in the firmament; this part is the eternal manly being. Two of your parts are stationed on the Earth; four parts were also here. (?) Yajnas originate from you, the cause of rain in the world.
verses.wordMeaning: A fourth part of yours constitutes the Universe; your nine parts are immortal in heaven; nine parts are stationed in the firmament; this part is the eternal manly being. Two of your parts are stationed on the Earth; four parts were also here. (?) Yajnas originate from you,…

verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpam idaṃ tasya mano 'bhavat mayā vedhyas tv avedhyo vai śaṃbhur lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The Virat (Immense Being) originated from you; it is the Man who is in the heart of the universe; he excelled the elements by splendour, fam e and glory. You are devoted to what should be meditated upon and the meditation; you created the medicinal herbs. O lord of Dcvas, having seven faces you are named Kala; you have an illuminated physical form. verses.transliteration: trailokyajayino bāṇāḥ śaṃbhau me kiṃ dṛḍhā na vā tenāsau cāgninetreṇa bhasmaśeṣas tadā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed deity, save me 0 Narayana, obeisance to you. O Puru?ottama, obeisance to you. Obeisance to you, O lord of worlds, obeisance to you the abode of LaksmI; obeisance to you, O abode of attributes; obeisance be to you; O mine of good qualities.

verses.transliteration: tad eva karma sudṛḍham īkṣituṃ surasattamāḥ ājagmus tatra yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu vismayakārakam

O lord of the universe, O source of origin of the uni¬

verses.transliteration: tārakād bhayam āpannaṃ kuru patnīṃ gireḥ sutām
verses.translation: O Horse-headed deity of great snout, O deity, having the great manly frame, O Horse-faced deity, obeisance to you the annihilator of Madhu and Kaitabha. Obeisance to you, to the great tortoise, to the deity with the great body of a tortoise, to the deity who lifted up e Earth, to that form that held the mountain aloft. Obeisance to the great Varaha (Boar), to (the deity)

verses.sanskrit: विद्धचित्तो हरो ऽप्य् आशु मेने वाक्यं सुरोदितम् अरुन्धतीं वसिष्ठं च मां तु चक्रधरं तथा
verses.transliteration: viddhacitto haro 'py āśu mene vākyaṃ suroditam arundhatīṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca māṃ tu cakradharaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the infinite one, to the subtle one, chief one, to the most excellent one. Obeisance to you of the form of the atom, to one comprehensible to the yogins. Obeisance to the greatest cause of causes; to the abode of the circle of leading Yogins; to the being very difficult to be known. Obeisance to you who lie down on the couch of the great serpent stationed in the milky ocean; obeisance to the deity with fine ear rings made of gold and studded with jewels.
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the infinite one, to the subtle one, chief one, to the most excellent one. Obeisance to you of the form of the atom, to one comprehensible to the yogins. Obeisance to the greatest cause of causes; to the abode of the circle of leading Yogins;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयाम् आसुर् अमरा विवाहाय परस्परम् संबन्धो ऽपि तथाप्य् आसीद् धिमवल्लोकनाथयोः
verses.transliteration: preṣayām āsur amarā vivāhāya parasparam saṃbandho 'pi tathāpy āsīd dhimavallokanāthayoḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, after saying thus to him, Visnu the lord After he had gone, O excellent sages, Kandu eschew¬ ed all lustful desires. He became delighted in his mind and he attained a proper mental quietude. He who reads or listens to the story of the noble Kandu shall be liberated from sins. He goes to the heavenly world.
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, after saying thus to him, Visnu the lord After he had gone, O excellent sages, Kandu eschew¬ ed all lustful desires. He became delighted in his mind and he attained a proper mental quietude.…

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वते श्रेष्ठे नानारत्नविचित्रिते नानावृक्षलताकीर्णे नानाद्विजनिषेविते
verses.transliteration: himavatparvate śreṣṭhe nānāratnavicitrite nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānādvijaniṣevite
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vyasa, the sages of restrained sense-organs became satisfied, delighted and struck with wonder again and again.

verses.transliteration: nadīnadasaraḥkūpataḍāgādibhir āvṛte devagandharvayakṣādisiddhacāraṇasevite
verses.translation: Wonderful indeed are the attributes of the sub continent Bharata mentioned by you. So also of the shrine named Sri- purusa in the holy centre Purusottama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wonderful indeed are the attributes of the sub continent Bharata mentioned by you. So also of the shrine named Sri- purusa in the holy centre Purusottama.

verses.transliteration: śubhamārutasaṃpanne harṣotkarṣaikakāraṇe merumandarakailāsamainākādinagair vṛte
verses.translation: ' O sage, the most excellent among eloquent ones, who will not be delighted and surprised on hearing about the excellent greatness of the shrine named Purusa?

verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhāgastyapaulastyalomaśādibhir āvṛte mahotsave vartamāne vivāhaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: Why were the heroic Krsna and Sankarsana (Balarama) born in the house of Vasudeva? Why was she too born in that house there, O sage?
verses.commentary: Sense: Why were the heroic Krsna and Sankarsana (Balarama) born in the house of Vasudeva? Why was she too born in that house there, O sage?

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वेदी रत्नमयी शोभिता स्वर्णभूषिता वज्रमाणिक्यवैदूर्यतन्मयस्तम्भशोभिता
verses.transliteration: tatra vedī ratnamayī śobhitā svarṇabhūṣitā vajramāṇikyavaidūryatanmayastambhaśobhitā
verses.translation: O sage, the most excellent among the eloquent ones, recount to us in detail the activities that they pursued on being born on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the most excellent among the eloquent ones, recount to us in detail the activities that they pursued on being born on the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: जयालक्ष्मीशुभाक्षान्तिकीर्तिपुष्ट्यादिसंवृता मेरुमन्दरकैलासरैवतैः परिशोभितैः
verses.transliteration: jayālakṣmīśubhākṣāntikīrtipuṣṭyādisaṃvṛtā merumandarakailāsaraivataiḥ pariśobhitaiḥ
verses.translation: Tarakamaya: a war which arose in consequence of Soma (Moon) havin carried ofFTara, the wife of Brhaspati.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितो लोकनाथेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना मैनाकः पर्वतश्रेष्ठो रेजे ऽतीव हिरण्मयः
verses.transliteration: pūjito lokanāthena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā mainākaḥ parvataśreṣṭho reje 'tīva hiraṇmayaḥ
verses.translation: Worshipped by the lord of the world, the mighty Vishnu, Mainaka, the best of mountains, shone exceedingly golden.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो लोकपालाश् च आदित्याः समरुद्गणाः विवाहे वेदिकां चक्रुर् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo lokapālāś ca ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ vivāhe vedikāṃ cakrur devadevasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: The sages, the guardians of the worlds, the Adityas and the hosts of Maruts made the altar for the wedding of the trident-bearing god of gods.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा स्वयं त्वष्टा वेदीं चक्रे सतोरणाम् सुरभी नन्दिनी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदोहिनी
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā svayaṃ tvaṣṭā vedīṃ cakre satoraṇām surabhī nandinī nandā sunandā kāmadohinī
verses.translation: Vishvakarman, Tvashtri himself, made the altar with archways. Surabhi, Nandini, Nanda, Sunanda and Kamadohini —

verses.transliteration: ābhis tu śobhiteśānyā vivāhaḥ samajāyata samudrāḥ sarito nāgā oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ
verses.translation: adorned by these, the wedding of Ishani took place. The oceans, rivers, Nagas, plants and mothers of the world,

verses.transliteration: savanaspatibījāś ca sarve tatra samāyayuḥ bhuvaḥ karma ilā cakre oṣadhyas tv annakarma ca
verses.translation: with trees and seeds, all came there. Ila did the work of the earth, the plants the work of food,

verses.sanskrit: वरुणः पानकर्माणि दानकर्म धनाधिपः अग्निश् चकार तत्रान्नं यच् चेष्टं लोकनाथयोः
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ pānakarmāṇi dānakarma dhanādhipaḥ agniś cakāra tatrānnaṃ yac ceṣṭaṃ lokanāthayoḥ
verses.translation: Varuna the work of drinks, and the lord of wealth the work of gifts; Agni prepared there the food that the lords of the world liked.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र पृथक् पूजां चक्रे विष्णुः सनातनः वेदाश् च सरहस्या वै गायन्ति च हसन्ति च
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra pṛthak pūjāṃ cakre viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ vedāś ca sarahasyā vai gāyanti ca hasanti ca
verses.translation: The eternal Vishnu performed separate worship here and there; and the Vedas with their secrets sang and laughed.

verses.transliteration: nṛtyanty apsarasaḥ sarvā jagur gandharvakiṃnarāḥ lājādhṛk cāpi maināko babhūva munisattama
verses.translation: All the Apsarases danced, the Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang, and Mainaka held the parched grain, O best of sages.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्याहवाचनं वृत्तम् अन्तर्वेश्मनि नारद वेदिकायाम् उपाविष्टौ दंपती सुरसत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: puṇyāhavācanaṃ vṛttam antarveśmani nārada vedikāyām upāviṣṭau daṃpatī surasattamau
verses.translation: The recitation of auspicious-day blessings took place in the inner apartment, O Narada; the divine couple, best of gods, sat on the altar.

verses.translation: Having duly established the fire and the stone, my son, and offered parched grain duly, he then performed the circumambulation.

verses.translation: For the touching of the stone, prompted by Vishnu, Shambhu took in his hand the big toe of the Goddess's right foot.

verses.transliteration: tām adarśam ahaṃ tatra homaṃ kurvan harāntike dṛṣṭe 'ṅguṣṭhe duṣṭabuddhyā vīryaṃ susrāva me tadā
verses.translation: I saw it there while performing the fire offering near Hara; seeing the toe with a wicked mind, my seed then flowed.

verses.transliteration: lajjayā kaluṣībhūtaḥ skannaṃ vīryam acūrṇayam madvīryāc cūrṇitāt sūkṣmād vālakhilyās tu jajñire
verses.translation: Stained with shame, I crushed the fallen seed; from my fine crushed seed the Valakhilyas were born.

verses.transliteration: tato mahān abhūt tatra hāhākāraḥ suroditaḥ lajjayā paribhūto 'haṃ nirgatas tu tadāsanāt
verses.translation: Then a great cry of dismay arose there from the gods; overcome with shame, I left my seat.

verses.transliteration: brahmāṇam āhvayasveha gatapāpaṃ karomy aham kṛtāparādhe 'pi jane santaḥ sakṛpamānasāḥ mohayanty api vidvāṃsaṃ viṣayāṇām iyaṃ sthitiḥ
verses.translation: "Call Brahma here; I will free him from sin. The good are compassionate even to one who has offended; such is the nature of sense-objects that they bewilder even the learned."

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā sa bhagavān umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ mamānukampayā caiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Having said this, that Lord Shiva with Uma, out of compassion for me and wishing the good of the worlds,

verses.sanskrit: एतच् चकार लोकेशः शृणु नारद यत्नतः पापिनां पापमोक्षाय भूमिर् आपो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: etac cakāra lokeśaḥ śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ pāpināṃ pāpamokṣāya bhūmir āpo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: the lord of the world did this — hear it carefully, O Narada: "Earth and water will be for the release of sinners from sin.

verses.transliteration: tayoś ca sārasarvasvam āhariṣyāmi pāvanam evaṃ niścitya bhagavāṃs tayoḥ sāraṃ samāharat
verses.translation: I will take the purifying essence of both." Having resolved thus, the Lord gathered their essence.

verses.transliteration: trijagatpāvanīṃ śaktiṃ tatra sasmāra pāpahā mām uvāca sa lokeśo gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum
verses.translation: the destroyer of sin remembered there the power that purifies the three worlds. The lord of the world said to me, "Take this water-pot.

verses.transliteration: āpo vai mātaro devyo bhūmir mātā tathāparā sthityutpattivināśānāṃ hetutvam ubhayoḥ sthitam
verses.translation: The waters are divine mothers, and the earth is another mother; the causes of sustenance, origin and destruction rest in both.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो ह्य् अत्र यज्ञः सनातनः अत्र भुक्तिश् च मुक्तिश् च स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा
verses.transliteration: atra pratiṣṭhito dharmo hy atra yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ atra bhuktiś ca muktiś ca sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Here dharma is established, here the eternal sacrifice, here enjoyment and liberation, the unmoving and the moving.

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणान् मानसं पापं वचनाद् वाचिकं तथा स्नानपानाभिषेकाच् च प्रणश्यत्य् अपि कायिकम्
verses.transliteration: smaraṇān mānasaṃ pāpaṃ vacanād vācikaṃ tathā snānapānābhiṣekāc ca praṇaśyaty api kāyikam
verses.translation: By remembrance mental sin is destroyed, by speech verbal sin, and by bathing, drinking and sprinkling even bodily sin.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एवामृतं लोके नैतस्मात् पावनं परम् मयाभिमन्त्रितं ब्रह्मन् गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: etad evāmṛtaṃ loke naitasmāt pāvanaṃ param mayābhimantritaṃ brahman gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum
verses.translation: This alone is nectar in the world; there is nothing more purifying than it. Consecrated by me, O Brahman, take this water-pot.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रत्यं वारि यः कश्चित् स्मरेद् अपि पठेद् अपि स सर्वकामान् आप्नोति गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: atratyaṃ vāri yaḥ kaścit smared api paṭhed api sa sarvakāmān āpnoti gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum
verses.translation: Whoever even remembers or recites the water in it obtains all desires; take this water-pot.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेभ्यश् चापि पञ्चभ्य आपो भूतं महोदितम् तासाम् उत्कृष्टम् एतस्माद् गृहाणेमं कमण्डलुम्

verses.translation: Of the five elements, water is declared the great element; this is the most excellent of waters; take this water-pot.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र यद् वारि शोभिष्ठं पुण्यं पावनम् एव च स्पृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च ब्रह्मन् पापाद् विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: atra yad vāri śobhiṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanam eva ca spṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahman pāpād vimokṣyase
verses.translation: By touching, remembering and seeing the most beautiful, holy and purifying water in it, O Brahman, you will be freed from sin."

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवः प्रादान् मम कमण्डलुम् ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे भक्त्या प्रोचुः सुरेश्वरम् आह्लादश् च महांस् तत्र जयशब्दो व्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā mahādevaḥ prādān mama kamaṇḍalum tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve bhaktyā procuḥ sureśvaram āhlādaś ca mahāṃs tatra jayaśabdo vyavartata
verses.translation: Having said this, Mahadeva gave me the water-pot. Then all the hosts of gods praised the lord of gods with devotion; great joy arose there and the cry of victory went forth.

verses.sanskrit: देवोत्सवे मातुर् अजः पदाग्रं समीक्ष्य पापात् पतितत्वम् आप प्रादात् कृपालुः स्मरणात् पवित्रां गङ्गां पिता पुण्यकमण्डलुस्थाम्
verses.transliteration: devotsave mātur ajaḥ padāgraṃ samīkṣya pāpāt patitatvam āpa prādāt kṛpāluḥ smaraṇāt pavitrāṃ gaṅgāṃ pitā puṇyakamaṇḍalusthām
verses.translation: At the festival of the gods the unborn one, having looked at the tip of the mother's foot, fell into sin; the compassionate father gave him the Ganga, purifying by mere remembrance, held in the holy water-pot.

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुस्थिता देवी तव पुण्यविवर्धिनी यथा मर्त्यं गता नाथ तन् मे विस्तरतो वद
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalusthitā devī tava puṇyavivardhinī yathā martyaṃ gatā nātha tan me vistarato vada
verses.translation: Immediately after entering the hermitage sage Kandu assumed a very beautiful form like that of a Cupid.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बलिर् नाम महादैत्यो देवारिर् अपराजितः धर्मेण यशसा चैव प्रजासंरक्षणेन च
verses.transliteration: balir nāma mahādaityo devārir aparājitaḥ dharmeṇa yaśasā caiva prajāsaṃrakṣaṇena ca
verses.translation: Suddenly, due to the power of his penance he assumed a form clad in divine garments, and beautified with divine garlands and unguents. It was lovely and capable of enjoying all pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suddenly, due to the power of his penance he assumed a form clad in divine garments, and beautified with divine garlands and unguents. It was lovely and capable of enjoying all pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुभक्त्या च सत्येन वीर्येण च बलेन च त्यागेन क्षमया चैव त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते
verses.transliteration: gurubhaktyā ca satyena vīryeṇa ca balena ca tyāgena kṣamayā caiva trailokye nopamīyate
verses.translation: The sage Kandu engaged himself in vulgar sexual intercourse with her. Many hundreds of years he stayed with her in the valley of the Mandara mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage Kandu engaged himself in vulgar sexual intercourse with her. Many hundreds of years he stayed with her in the valley of the Mandara mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यर्द्धिम् उन्नतां दृष्ट्वा देवाश् चिन्तापरायणाः मिथः समूचुर् अमरा जेष्यामो वै कथं बलिम्
verses.transliteration: tasyarddhim unnatāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāś cintāparāyaṇāḥ mithaḥ samūcur amarā jeṣyāmo vai kathaṃ balim

verses.translation: When urged by her thus, the sage said to that lady of large eyes—"O lady of beautiful eyebrows, stay with me for a long time more: you will go later to heaven."
verses.commentary: Sense: When urged by her thus, the sage said to that lady of large eyes—"O lady of beautiful eyebrows, stay with me for a long time more: you will go later to heaven."

verses.translation: Frightened of being cursed by that sage, the lady of fine buttocks stayed with him for a further period of slightly less than two hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Frightened of being cursed by that sage, the lady of fine buttocks stayed with him for a further period of slightly less than two hundred years.

verses.translation: The great sage sported and diverted himself with her, day and night, with his mind overwhelmed by cupid. The more he indulged himself the fresher became the ways of expressing his affection.

verses.translation: When asked by her thus he said— cc O auspicious lady, the day is coming to a close. I shall say my prayers for the dusk. Otherwise, it will be a great omission of my holy rites."

verses.translation: The delighted lady then laughed and said to the sage— "is it only now; O sage conversant with all holy rites, that the day is coming to a close? Has it not passed of many times before?"

verses.translation: "O brahmin, this is true that I came here in a morning. It is not false. But hundreds of years have passed by, since I came to you."

verses.translation: Thereupon, the brahmin asked the lady of large eyes in great perturbation—"O timid lady, even as I was engaged in dalliance with you, what period of time did pass by?"

verses.translation: "Nine hundred, seven years, six months and three days have passed ofF till date."

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो ऽसौ बलिर् दैत्यो ह्य् अवध्यो ऽसौ सुरासुरैः यथा भवन्तो मत्पोष्यास् तथा पोष्यो बलिर् मम
verses.transliteration: madbhakto 'sau balir daityo hy avadhyo 'sau surāsuraiḥ yathā bhavanto matpoṣyās tathā poṣyo balir mama
verses.translation: "O timid lady, arc you telling me the truth or are you jesting with me? I think I have stayed here with you only for a day."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O timid lady, arc you telling me the truth or are you jesting with me? I think I have stayed here with you only for a day."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना तु संगरं देवा हत्वा राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे बलिं निबध्य मन्त्रोक्त्या राज्यं वः प्रददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: vinā tu saṃgaraṃ devā hatvā rājyaṃ triviṣṭape baliṃ nibadhya mantroktyā rājyaṃ vaḥ pradadāmy aham
verses.translation: "O brahmin, how will I utter a lie in your presence? Particularly when asked by you as you proceed ahead along your path?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः संजग्मुर् दिवम् एव हि भगवान् अपि देवेशो ह्य् अदित्या गर्भम् आविशत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ saṃjagmur divam eva hi bhagavān api deveśo hy adityā garbham āviśat
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," the hosts of gods went to heaven, and the Lord, the lord of gods, entered Aditi's womb.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् उत्पद्यमाने तु उत्सवाश् च बभूविरे जातो ऽसौ वामनो ब्रह्मन् यज्ञेशो यज्ञपूरुषः
verses.transliteration: tasminn utpadyamāne tu utsavāś ca babhūvire jāto 'sau vāmano brahman yajñeśo yajñapūruṣaḥ
verses.translation: When he was being born, festivals took place; that Vamana was born, O Brahman, lord of sacrifice, the Person of sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: etasminn antare brahman hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ balir balavatāṃ śreṣṭha ṛṣimukhyaiḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Meanwhile, O Brahman, Bali, best of the mighty, was consecrated for a horse sacrifice, attended by the chief sages,

verses.transliteration: purodhasā ca śukreṇa vedavedāṅgavedinā makhe tasmin vartamāne yajamāne balau tathā
verses.translation: with Shukra as priest, knower of the Vedas and their limbs. As that sacrifice proceeded, with Bali as sacrificer,

verses.sanskrit: आर्त्विज्य ऋषिमुख्ये तु शुक्रे तत्र पुरोधसि हविर्भागार्थम् आसन्नदेवगन्धर्वपन्नगे
verses.transliteration: ārtvijya ṛṣimukhye tu śukre tatra purodhasi havirbhāgārtham āsannadevagandharvapannage
verses.translation: with the chief sages as officiants and Shukra as priest, and gods, Gandharvas and serpents present for their share of oblations,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीयतां भुज्यतां पूजा क्रियतां च पृथक् पृथक् परिपूर्णं पुनः पूर्णम् एवं वाक्ये प्रवर्तति
verses.transliteration: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ pūjā kriyatāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak paripūrṇaṃ punaḥ pūrṇam evaṃ vākye pravartati
verses.translation: while the words "Let it be given, let it be eaten, let worship be done separately; it is complete, again complete" went on,

verses.transliteration: śanais taddeśam abhyāgād vāmanaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ yajñavāṭam anuprāpto vāmanaś citrakuṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: slowly Vamana came to that place, singing the Saman; Vamana with bright earrings reached the sacrificial enclosure,

verses.sanskrit: प्रशंसमानस् तं यज्ञं वामनं प्रेक्ष्य भार्गवः ब्रह्मरूपधरं देवं वामनं दैत्यसूदनम्
verses.transliteration: praśaṃsamānas taṃ yajñaṃ vāmanaṃ prekṣya bhārgavaḥ brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ vāmanaṃ daityasūdanam
verses.translation: praising that sacrifice. Seeing Vamana, the Bhargava — the god in the form of a brahmin, Vamana, slayer of Daityas,

verses.sanskrit: दातारं यज्ञतपसां फलं हन्तारं रक्षसाम् ज्ञात्वा त्वरन्न् अथोवाच राजानं भूरितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: dātāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ phalaṃ hantāraṃ rakṣasām jñātvā tvarann athovāca rājānaṃ bhūritejasam
verses.translation: giver of the fruit of sacrifices and austerities, slayer of Rakshasas — recognising him, hastily spoke to the king of great splendour,

verses.sanskrit: जेतारं क्षत्रधर्मेण दातारं भक्तितो धनम् बलिं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं सभार्यं दीक्षितं मखे
verses.transliteration: jetāraṃ kṣatradharmeṇa dātāraṃ bhaktito dhanam baliṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāryaṃ dīkṣitaṃ makhe
verses.translation: conqueror by the kshatriya dharma, giver of wealth with devotion, Bali, best of the mighty, consecrated for the sacrifice with his wife,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्तं यज्ञपुरुषम् उत्सृजन्तं हविः पृथक् तम् आह भृगुशार्दूलः शुक्रः परमबुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyantaṃ yajñapuruṣam utsṛjantaṃ haviḥ pṛthak tam āha bhṛguśārdūlaḥ śukraḥ paramabuddhimān
verses.translation: meditating on the Person of sacrifice and offering oblations separately; to him spoke Shukra, tiger of the Bhrigus, of supreme intelligence:

verses.translation: "The brahmin in the form of a dwarf who has come to your sacrifice is truly not a brahmin, O Bali; he is the lord of sacrifice, the bearer of sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: śiśus tvāṃ yācituṃ prāpto nūnaṃ devahitāya hi mayā ca saha saṃmantrya paścād deyaṃ tvayā prabho
verses.translation: This child has surely come to beg from you for the good of the gods. Only after consulting with me should you give, O lord."

verses.transliteration: balis tu bhārgavaṃ prāha purodhasam ariṃdamaḥ
verses.translation: But Bali, subduer of foes, said to the Bhargava, his priest:

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽहं मम यज्ञेशो गृहम् आयाति मूर्तिमान् आगत्य याचते किंचित् किं मन्त्र्यम् अवशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'haṃ mama yajñeśo gṛham āyāti mūrtimān āgatya yācate kiṃcit kiṃ mantryam avaśiṣyate
verses.translation: "I am blessed that the lord of sacrifice comes in embodied form to my house. Having come, he asks for something — what remains to consult about?"

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा सभार्यो ऽसौ शुक्रेण च पुरोधसा जगाम यत्र विप्रेन्द्रो वामनो ऽदितिनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā sabhāryo 'sau śukreṇa ca purodhasā jagāma yatra viprendro vāmano 'ditinandanaḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, with his wife and the priest Shukra, he went where the best of brahmins, Vamana, son of Aditi, was.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा केनार्थित्वं तद् उच्यताम् वामनो ऽपि तदा प्राह पदत्रयमितां भुवम्

verses.translation: With joined palms he said, "Tell me what you seek." Then Vamana said, "Land measured by three steps —
