verses.transliteration: dehi rājendra nānyena kāryam asti dhanena kim tathety uktvā tu kalaśān nānāratnavibhūṣitāt
verses.translation: give me that, O king of kings; I have no need of any other wealth." Saying "So be it," from pitchers adorned with various gems,

verses.translation: pouring a stream of water, he gave the land to Vamana, while the chief sages and the priest Shukra looked on;

verses.transliteration: paśyatsu lokanātheṣu vāmanāya bhuvaṃ dadau paśyatsu daityasaṃgheṣu jayaśabde pravartati
verses.translation: while the lords of the worlds looked on, he gave the land to Vamana; while the hosts of Daityas looked on, the cry of victory arose.

verses.transliteration: śanais tu vāmanaḥ prāha svasti rājan sukhī bhava dehi me saṃmitāṃ bhūmiṃ tripadām āśu gamyate
verses.translation: Slowly Vamana said, "Hail, O king, be happy; give me the measured land of three steps; it is to be traversed at once."

verses.transliteration: tathety uvāca daityeśo yāvat paśyati vāmanam yajñeśo yajñapuruṣaś candrādityau stanāntare
verses.translation: "So be it," said the lord of the Daityas; as he looked at Vamana, the lord of sacrifice, the Person of sacrifice, so that the moon and sun were at his breast

verses.translation: and the gods at his head, grew into the striding form; the endless, imperishable god, the strider of the striding form. Seeing him, the king of Daityas with his wife said humbly:

verses.transliteration: kramasva viṣṇo lokeśa yāvacchaktyā jaganmaya jitaṃ mayā sureśāna sarvabhāvena viśvakṛt
verses.translation: "Stride, O Vishnu, lord of the world, as far as your power goes, O you who are the universe; I have been conquered wholly, O lord of the gods, maker of the universe."

verses.transliteration: tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu viṣṇuḥ prāha mahākratuḥ
verses.translation: At the very moment of his words, Vishnu, the great sacrifice, said:

verses.transliteration: daityeśvara mahābāho kramiṣye paśya daityarāṭ
verses.translation: "O mighty-armed lord of the Daityas, I will stride; watch, O king of the Daityas."

verses.sanskrit: एवं वदन्तं स प्राह क्रम विष्णो पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vadantaṃ sa prāha krama viṣṇo punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: As he spoke thus, the other said, "Stride, Vishnu," again and again.

verses.sanskrit: कूर्मपृष्ठे पदं न्यस्य बलियज्ञे पदं न्यसत् द्वितीयं तु पदं प्राप ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: kūrmapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyasya baliyajñe padaṃ nyasat dvitīyaṃ tu padaṃ prāpa brahmalokaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Placing his foot on the tortoise's back, he placed a step at Bali's sacrifice; the second step reached the eternal world of Brahma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयस्य पदस्यात्र स्थानं नास्त्य् असुरेश्वर क्व क्रमिष्ये भुवं देहि बलिं तं हरिर् अब्रवीत् विहस्य बलिर् अप्य् आह सभार्यः स कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyasya padasyātra sthānaṃ nāsty asureśvara kva kramiṣye bhuvaṃ dehi baliṃ taṃ harir abravīt vihasya balir apy āha sabhāryaḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: "There is no place here for the third step, O lord of the Asuras; where shall I stride? Give me land," said Hari to Bali. Bali, with his wife, joined his palms and, smiling, said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सृष्टं जगत् सर्वं न स्रष्टाहं सुरेश्वर त्वद्दोषाद् अल्पम् अभवत् किं करोमि जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ na sraṣṭāhaṃ sureśvara tvaddoṣād alpam abhavat kiṃ karomi jaganmaya
verses.translation: "The whole world was created by you; I am not its creator, O lord of the gods. By your fault it has become small; what can I do, O you who are the universe?

verses.sanskrit: तथापि नानृतपूर्वं कदाचिद् वच्मि केशव सत्यवाक्यं च मां कुर्वन् मत्पृष्ठे हि पदं न्यस
verses.transliteration: tathāpi nānṛtapūrvaṃ kadācid vacmi keśava satyavākyaṃ ca māṃ kurvan matpṛṣṭhe hi padaṃ nyasa
verses.translation: Yet I have never before spoken falsely, O Keshava; making my word true, place your step on my back."

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃs trayīmūrtiḥ surārcitaḥ
verses.translation: Then the Lord, whose form is the three Vedas, worshipped by the gods, was pleased:

verses.sanskrit: वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते भक्त्या प्रीतो ऽस्मि दैत्यराट्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te bhaktyā prīto 'smi daityarāṭ
verses.translation: "Choose a boon, blessings on you; I am pleased with your devotion, O king of the Daityas."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स तु प्राह जगन्नाथं न याचे त्वां त्रिविक्रमम् स तु प्रादात् स्वयं विष्णुः प्रीतः सन् मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu prāha jagannāthaṃ na yāce tvāṃ trivikramam sa tu prādāt svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ prītaḥ san manasepsitam
verses.translation: He said to the lord of the world, "I ask nothing of you, O Trivikrama." But Vishnu himself, pleased, gave him what his heart desired:

verses.sanskrit: रसातलपतित्वं च भावि चेन्द्रपदं पुनः आत्माधिपत्यं च हरिर् अविनाशि यशो विभुः
verses.transliteration: rasātalapatitvaṃ ca bhāvi cendrapadaṃ punaḥ ātmādhipatyaṃ ca harir avināśi yaśo vibhuḥ
verses.translation: lordship of Rasatala and the future position of Indra again, mastery of himself and imperishable fame, the all-pervading Hari gave.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं दत्त्वा बलेः सर्वं ससुतं भार्ययान्वितम् रसातले हरिः स्थाप्य बलिं त्व् अमरवैरिणम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dattvā baleḥ sarvaṃ sasutaṃ bhāryayānvitam rasātale hariḥ sthāpya baliṃ tv amaravairiṇam
verses.translation: Having thus given everything to Bali and established Bali, enemy of the immortals, with his sons and wife in Rasatala,

verses.transliteration: śatakratos tathā prādāt surarājyaṃ yathābhavam etasminn antare tatra padaṃ prāgāt surārcitam

verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ tat padaṃ viṣṇoḥ pitur mama mahāmate yat padaṃ samanuprāptaṃ gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvāpy acintayam
verses.translation: that second step of Vishnu, my father, O wise one; seeing the step reach my house, I reflected:

verses.transliteration: kiṃ kṛtyaṃ yac chubhaṃ me syāt pade viṣṇoḥ samāgate sarvasvaṃ ca samālokya śreṣṭho me syāt kamaṇḍaluḥ
verses.translation: "What should be done that would be auspicious for me, now that Vishnu's foot has come? Surveying all my possessions, the best for me is my water-pot,

verses.transliteration: tad vāri yat puṇyatamaṃ dattaṃ ca tripurāriṇā varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varaṃ śāntikaraṃ param
verses.translation: the water which is most holy, given by the enemy of Tripura — excellent, most adorable, boon-giving, supreme, bringing peace,

verses.translation: auspicious and ever bestowing auspiciousness, granting enjoyment and liberation, the mother of the worlds in form, nectar, medicine, pure,

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रं पावनं पूज्यं ज्येष्ठं श्रेष्ठं गुणान्वितम् स्मरणाद् एव लोकानां पावनं किं नु दर्शनात्

verses.translation: holy, purifying, worshipful, eldest, best and full of virtues — purifying people merely by remembrance, how much more by sight?

verses.translation: Being pure, I will prepare such water as an offering to my father." Having reflected thus, he took that water and prepared it as an offering.

verses.translation: The offering-water, well consecrated, fell on Vishnu's foot; that water fell on Meru and went to the earth in four directions,

verses.transliteration: pūrve tu dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā dakṣiṇe yat tu patitaṃ jaṭābhiḥ śaṃkaro mune
verses.translation: east, south, west and north. What fell in the south, O sage, Shankara received in his matted locks;

verses.transliteration: jagrāha paścime yat tu punaḥ prāyāt kamaṇḍalum uttare patitaṃ yat tu viṣṇur jagrāha taj jalam
verses.translation: what fell in the west went back into the water-pot; the water that fell in the north Vishnu received;

verses.transliteration: pūrvasminn ṛṣayo devā pitaro lokapālakāḥ jagṛhuḥ śubhadaṃ vāri tasmāc chreṣṭhaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: in the east the sages, gods, ancestors and guardians of the worlds received the auspicious water; therefore it is called the best.

verses.sanskrit: या दक्षिणां दिशं प्राप्ता आपो वै लोकमातरः विष्णुपादप्रसूतास् ता ब्रह्मण्या लोकमातरः
verses.transliteration: yā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ prāptā āpo vai lokamātaraḥ viṣṇupādaprasūtās tā brahmaṇyā lokamātaraḥ
verses.translation: The waters, mothers of the world, that reached the southern direction, born from Vishnu's foot, friendly to brahmins, mothers of the world,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsaṃsthāḥ parvajātaśubhodayāḥ tāsāṃ prabhāvasmaraṇāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: resting in Maheshvara's matted locks, arising auspiciously at festivals — by remembering their power one attains all desires.

verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalusthitā devī maheśvarajaṭāgatā śrutā deva yathā martyam āgatā tad bravītu me
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, I shall recount to you briefly the incarnations which Hari took up in order to remove the burden of the Earth.

verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā āpo devyo mahāmate tāsāṃ ca dvividho bheda āhartur dvayakāraṇāt
verses.translation: Now, Daityas, the followers of Kalanemi have come to the mortal world. Day and night they harass the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, Daityas, the followers of Kalanemi have come to the mortal world. Day and night they harass the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: एकांशो ब्राह्मणेनात्र व्रतदानसमाधिना गोतमेन शिवं पूज्य आहृतो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ekāṃśo brāhmaṇenātra vratadānasamādhinā gotamena śivaṃ pūjya āhṛto lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: • That Asura Kalancmi who was slain by all powerful Visnu is now born as Karhsa the great Asura and a son of Ugrasena.
verses.commentary: Sense: • That Asura Kalancmi who was slain by all powerful Visnu is now born as Karhsa the great Asura and a son of Ugrasena.

verses.sanskrit: अपरस् तु महाप्राज्ञ क्षत्रियेण बलीयसा आराध्य शंकरं देवं तपोभिर् नियमैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: aparas tu mahāprājña kṣatriyeṇa balīyasā ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ tapobhir niyamais tathā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the Earth Brahma was requested by Devas to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the Earth Brahma was requested by Devas to remove the burden of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथेन भूपेन आहृतो ऽंशो ऽपरस् तथा एवं द्वैरूप्यम् अभवद् गङ्गाया मुनिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathena bhūpena āhṛto 'ṃśo 'paras tathā evaṃ dvairūpyam abhavad gaṅgāyā munisattama
verses.translation: After saying thus Brahma went along with Devas. With full concentration, he eulogised the Garua-emblemed deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus Brahma went along with Devas. With full concentration, he eulogised the Garua-emblemed deity.

verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā hetunā kena gautamaḥ āhartā kṣatriyeṇāpi āhṛtā kena tad vada
verses.translation: O lord with thousand forms, obeisance, obeisance be to you; O thousand-armed one, O many-armed and many- footcd one, obeisance, obeisance to you, O lord engaged in creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe, O incomprehensible one.

verses.sanskrit: यथानीता पुरा वत्स ब्राह्मणेनेतरेण वा तत् सर्वं विस्तरेणाहं वदिष्ये प्रीतये तव
verses.transliteration: yathānītā purā vatsa brāhmaṇenetareṇa vā tat sarvaṃ vistareṇāhaṃ vadiṣye prītaye tava
verses.translation: You are the subtlest of all subtle beings; you have a great magnitude, O lord, you are weightier than the weightiest. O lord, possessed of Pradhana, cosmic intellect and sense- organs, O lord identical with the chief worlds, be pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the subtlest of all subtle beings; you have a great magnitude, O lord, you are weightier than the weightiest. O lord, possessed of Pradhana, cosmic intellect and sense- organs, O lord identical with the chief worlds, be pleased.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् काले सुरेशस्य उमा पत्न्य् अभवत् प्रिया तस्मिन्न् एवाभवद् गङ्गा प्रिया शंभोर् महामते
verses.transliteration: yasmin kāle sureśasya umā patny abhavat priyā tasminn evābhavad gaṅgā priyā śaṃbhor mahāmate
verses.translation: On account of the mighty Asuras born on the Earth, O lord, this Earth is extremely afflicted. She is pained under the heavy weight of suffering. In order to get the burden re¬ moved she has approached you the ultimate resort of worlds, the redeemer without any other greater being.
verses.wordMeaning: On account of the mighty Asuras born on the Earth, O lord, this Earth is extremely afflicted. She is pained under the heavy weight of suffering. In order to get the burden re¬ moved she has approached you the ultimate resort of worlds,…

verses.sanskrit: मम दोषापनोदाय चिन्तयानः शिवस् तदा उमया सहितः श्रीमान् देवीं प्रेक्ष्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: mama doṣāpanodāya cintayānaḥ śivas tadā umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān devīṃ prekṣya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: May all Devas incarnate on the Earth. Let them fight with the mighty proud Asuras who are already born before.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all Devas incarnate on the Earth. Let them fight with the mighty proud Asuras who are already born before.

verses.transliteration: rasavṛttau sthito yasmān nirmame rasam uttamam rasikatvāt priyatvāc ca straiṇatvāt pāvanatvataḥ
verses.translation: O immortal ones, this hair of mine will be born as the eighth child in the womb of DevakI, the wife of Vasudeva who is comparable to a goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O immortal ones, this hair of mine will be born as the eighth child in the womb of DevakI, the wife of Vasudeva who is comparable to a goddess.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभ्यो ह्य् अधिकप्रीतिर् गङ्गाभूद् द्विजसत्तम सैवोद्भूता जटामार्गात् कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे स तु संगोपयाम् आस गङ्गां शंभुर् जटागताम्
verses.transliteration: sarvābhyo hy adhikaprītir gaṅgābhūd dvijasattama saivodbhūtā jaṭāmārgāt kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare sa tu saṃgopayām āsa gaṅgāṃ śaṃbhur jaṭāgatām
verses.translation: After birth on the Earth it will kill Kamsa bom of Kalancmi. AJter saying this, Hari vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After birth on the Earth it will kill Kamsa bom of Kalancmi. AJter saying this, Hari vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: शिरसा च धृतां ज्ञात्वा न शशाक उमा तदा सोढुं ब्रह्मञ् जटाजूटे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: śirasā ca dhṛtāṃ jñātvā na śaśāka umā tadā soḍhuṃ brahmañ jaṭājūṭe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Those Devas then bowed down to the noble lord who became invisible, went to the top of Meru and then descended on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Devas then bowed down to the noble lord who became invisible, went to the top of Meru and then descended on the Earth.

verses.transliteration: amarṣeṇa bhavaṃ gorī prerayasvety abhāṣata naivāsau prairayac chaṃbhū rasiko rasam uttamam
verses.translation: The holy sage Narada said thus to Kamsa—"The eighth child in the womb of DevakI born in the Earth will kill you".
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy sage Narada said thus to Kamsa—"The eighth child in the womb of DevakI born in the Earth will kill you".

verses.sanskrit: जटास्व् एव तदा देवीं गोपायन्तं विमृश्य सा विनायकं जयां स्कन्दं रहो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: jaṭāsv eva tadā devīṃ gopāyantaṃ vimṛśya sā vināyakaṃ jayāṃ skandaṃ raho vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: On hearing it from Narada, Kamsa became infuriated. He kept DevakI and Vasudeva as prisoners in their own house and guarded them well.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it from Narada, Kamsa became infuriated. He kept DevakI and Vasudeva as prisoners in their own house and guarded them well.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवायं त्रिदशेशानो गङ्गां त्यजति कामुकः सापि प्रिया शिवस्याद्य कथं त्यजति तां प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: naivāyaṃ tridaśeśāno gaṅgāṃ tyajati kāmukaḥ sāpi priyā śivasyādya kathaṃ tyajati tāṃ priyām
verses.translation: The sons of Hiranyakasipu became well known as these six children in the womb. Urged by Visnu, his (Yogic) slumber joined them gradually to the womb of DevakI.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Hiranyakasipu became well known as these six children in the womb. Urged by Visnu, his (Yogic) slumber joined them gradually to the womb of DevakI.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं विमृश्य बहुशो गौरी चाह विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vimṛśya bahuśo gaurī cāha vināyakam
verses.translation: O slumber, go hence. One by one take these children (of Hiranyakasipu) who are in the nether worlds now to the belly of DevakI at my behest.
verses.commentary: Sense: O slumber, go hence. One by one take these children (of Hiranyakasipu) who are in the nether worlds now to the belly of DevakI at my behest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न देवैर् नासुरैर् यक्षैर् न सिद्धैर् भवतापि च न राजभिर् अथान्यैर् वा न गङ्गां त्यजति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: na devair nāsurair yakṣair na siddhair bhavatāpi ca na rājabhir athānyair vā na gaṅgāṃ tyajati prabhuḥ
verses.translation: When they have been killed by Kamsa, my sinless part named Sesa will become the seventh child in the womb of DevakI by means of a small part.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they have been killed by Kamsa, my sinless part named Sesa will become the seventh child in the womb of DevakI by means of a small part.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुनस् तप्स्यामि वा गत्वा हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम् अथवा ब्राह्मणैः पुण्यैस् तपोभिर् हतकल्मषैः
verses.transliteration: punas tapsyāmi vā gatvā himavantaṃ nagottamam athavā brāhmaṇaiḥ puṇyais tapobhir hatakalmaṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Since the child in the womb has been dragged away, the heroic boy comparable to the peak of Meru, Sankarsana will be born in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the child in the womb has been dragged away, the heroic boy comparable to the peak of Meru, Sankarsana will be born in the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तैर् वा जटास्थिता गङ्गा प्रार्थिता भुवम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tair vā jaṭāsthitā gaṅgā prārthitā bhuvam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Then, I shall be born in the auspicious womb of DevakI. You should also go to the womb of Yasoda without delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, I shall be born in the auspicious womb of DevakI. You should also go to the womb of Yasoda without delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा मातृवाक्यं मातरं प्राह विघ्नराट् भ्रात्रा स्कन्देन जयया संमन्त्र्येह च युज्यते
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā mātṛvākyaṃ mātaraṃ prāha vighnarāṭ bhrātrā skandena jayayā saṃmantryeha ca yujyate
verses.translation: I shall be born at night on the eighth day in the dark half of the mouth of Sravana during the rainy season. You will be born on the ninth day.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall be born at night on the eighth day in the dark half of the mouth of Sravana during the rainy season. You will be born on the ninth day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत् कुर्मो मस्तकाद् गङ्गां यथा त्यजति मे पिता एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे ब्रह्मन्न् अनावृष्टिर् अजायत
verses.transliteration: tat kurmo mastakād gaṅgāṃ yathā tyajati me pitā etasminn antare brahmann anāvṛṣṭir ajāyata
verses.translation: O uncensured lady, urged by my Sakti, Vasudeva will take me to the bed ofYasoda and you to that of Devaki.
verses.commentary: Sense: O uncensured lady, urged by my Sakti, Vasudeva will take me to the bed ofYasoda and you to that of Devaki.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विर् द्वादश समा मर्त्ये सर्वप्राणिभयावहा ततो विनष्टम् अभवज् जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: dvir dvādaśa samā martye sarvaprāṇibhayāvahā tato vinaṣṭam abhavaj jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, Kamsa will seize you and hurl you against a rocky slab. Thereafter, you will attain an abode in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, Kamsa will seize you and hurl you against a rocky slab. Thereafter, you will attain an abode in the firmament.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना तु गौतमं पुण्यम् आश्रमं सर्वकामदम् स्रष्टुकामः पुरा पुत्र स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा
verses.transliteration: vinā tu gautamaṃ puṇyam āśramaṃ sarvakāmadam sraṣṭukāmaḥ purā putra sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: With due deference to me, Indra will bow down to you a hundred times; with his head bent down in obeisance he will accept you as his sister.
verses.commentary: Sense: With due deference to me, Indra will bow down to you a hundred times; with his head bent down in obeisance he will accept you as his sister.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतो यज्ञो मया पूर्वं स देवयजनो गिरिः मन्नामा तत्र विख्यातस् ततो ब्रह्मगिरिः सदा
verses.transliteration: kṛto yajño mayā pūrvaṃ sa devayajano giriḥ mannāmā tatra vikhyātas tato brahmagiriḥ sadā
verses.translation: Thereafter, you will kill thousands of Daityas. With various abodes (i.e. shrines) you will adorn the entire Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, you will kill thousands of Daityas. With various abodes (i.e. shrines) you will adorn the entire Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आश्रित्य नगश्रेष्ठं सर्वदास्ते स गौतमः तस्याश्रमे महापुण्ये श्रेष्ठे ब्रह्मगिरौ शुभे
verses.transliteration: tam āśritya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvadāste sa gautamaḥ tasyāśrame mahāpuṇye śreṣṭhe brahmagirau śubhe
verses.translation: You are identical with the following deities:—Bhuti (Existence), Sannati (Obeisance), Klrti (Renown), Kanti (Splendour), PrthivI (Earth), Dhrti (Courage), Lajja (Bashfulness), Pu?ti (Nourishment), Uma and other goddesses whoever they may be.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are identical with the following deities:—Bhuti (Existence), Sannati (Obeisance), Klrti (Renown), Kanti (Splendour), PrthivI (Earth), Dhrti (Courage), Lajja (Bashfulness), Pu?ti (Nourishment), Uma and other goddesses whoever they may be.

verses.sanskrit: आधयो व्याधयो वापि दुर्भिक्षं वाप्य् अवर्षणम् भयशोकौ च दारिद्र्यं न श्रूयन्ते कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ādhayo vyādhayo vāpi durbhikṣaṃ vāpy avarṣaṇam bhayaśokau ca dāridryaṃ na śrūyante kadācana
verses.translation: Worshipped by means of wine, meat and other pre¬ sents and various items of foodstuffs you will become de¬ lighted and fulfil all desires of men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worshipped by means of wine, meat and other pre¬ sents and various items of foodstuffs you will become de¬ lighted and fulfil all desires of men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तदाश्रमं विनान्यत्र हव्यं वा कव्यम् एव च नास्ति पुत्र तथा दाता होता यष्टा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tadāśramaṃ vinānyatra havyaṃ vā kavyam eva ca nāsti putra tathā dātā hotā yaṣṭā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, all of them will have welfare always due to my favour. It need not be suspected at all. O gentle lady, go, in the manner mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदैव गौतमो विप्रो ददाति च जुहोति च तदैवाप्य् अयनं स्वर्गे सुराणाम् अपि नान्यतः
verses.transliteration: yadaiva gautamo vipro dadāti ca juhoti ca tadaivāpy ayanaṃ svarge surāṇām api nānyataḥ
verses.translation: Only when the brahmin Gautama gives and offers oblations is there sustenance in heaven, even for the gods, and not otherwise.

verses.transliteration: devaloke 'pi martye vā śrūyate gautamo muniḥ hotā dātā ca bhoktā ca sa eveti janā viduḥ
verses.translation: In the world of the gods and among mortals the sage Gautama is spoken of; people know that he alone is the offerer, the giver and the enjoyer.

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे नानाश्रमनिवासिनः गौतमाश्रमम् आपृच्छन्न् आगच्छन्तस् तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā munayaḥ sarve nānāśramanivāsinaḥ gautamāśramam āpṛcchann āgacchantas tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing that, all the sages dwelling in various hermitages, ascetics, came asking for Gautama's hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मुनीनां सर्वेषाम् आगतानां स गौतमः शिष्यवत् पुत्रवद् भक्त्या पितृवत् पोषको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ munīnāṃ sarveṣām āgatānāṃ sa gautamaḥ śiṣyavat putravad bhaktyā pitṛvat poṣako 'bhavat
verses.translation: To all those sages who came, that Gautama became a nourisher with devotion, like a disciple, like a son, like a father.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यथेप्सितं कामं यथायोग्यं यथाक्रमम् यथानुरूपं सर्वेषां शुश्रूषाम् अकरोन् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: yasya yathepsitaṃ kāmaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam yathānurūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ śuśrūṣām akaron muniḥ
verses.translation: The sage served all of them according to each one's desire, as fitting, in due order and as suitable.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञया गौतमस्यासन्न् ओषध्यो लोकमातरः आराधिताः पुनस् तेन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ājñayā gautamasyāsann oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ ārādhitāḥ punas tena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: At Gautama's command the plants, mothers of the world, were there, and Brahma, Vishnu and Maheshvara were worshipped by him again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जायन्ते च तदौषध्यो लूयन्ते च तदैव हि संपत्स्यन्ते तदोप्यन्ते गौतमस्य तपोबलात्
verses.transliteration: jāyante ca tadauṣadhyo lūyante ca tadaiva hi saṃpatsyante tadopyante gautamasya tapobalāt
verses.translation: The plants were born then and reaped then; they were sown then and ripened, by the power of Gautama's austerity.

verses.transliteration: sarvāḥ samṛddhayas tasya saṃsidhyante manogatāḥ pratyahaṃ vakti vinayād gautamas tv āgatān munīn
verses.translation: All prosperities that he wished for in his mind were accomplished. Every day Gautama humbly said to the sages who had come:

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रवच् छिष्यवच् चैव प्रेष्यवत् करवाणि किम् पितृवत् पोषयाम् आस संवत्सरगणान् बहून्
verses.transliteration: putravac chiṣyavac caiva preṣyavat karavāṇi kim pitṛvat poṣayām āsa saṃvatsaragaṇān bahūn
verses.translation: "Like a son, like a disciple, like a servant — what shall I do?" He nourished them like a father for many years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं वसत्सु मुनिषु त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातिर् आश्रयात् ततो विनायकः प्राह मातरं भ्रातरं जयाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vasatsu muniṣu trailokye khyātir āśrayāt tato vināyakaḥ prāha mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ jayām
verses.translation: While the sages dwelt there thus, the hermitage gained fame in the three worlds. Then Vinayaka spoke to his mother, his brother and Jaya:

verses.sanskrit: देवानां सदने मातर् गीयते गौतमो द्विजः यन् न साध्यं सुरगणैर् गौतमः कृतवान् इति
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ sadane mātar gīyate gautamo dvijaḥ yan na sādhyaṃ suragaṇair gautamaḥ kṛtavān iti
verses.translation: "Mother, in the abode of the gods the brahmin Gautama is sung of: 'Gautama has done what the hosts of gods could not accomplish.'

verses.transliteration: evaṃ śrutaṃ mayā devi brāhmaṇasya tapobalam sa vipraś cālayed enāṃ mātar gaṅgāṃ jaṭāgatām
verses.translation: Thus I have heard, O Goddess, of that brahmin's power of austerity. That brahmin could bring down this Ganga who dwells in the matted locks, Mother.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा वान्यतो वापि पूजयित्वा त्रिलोचनम् स एव च्यावयेद् एनां जटास्थां मे पितृप्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā vānyato vāpi pūjayitvā trilocanam sa eva cyāvayed enāṃ jaṭāsthāṃ me pitṛpriyām
verses.translation: By austerity or otherwise, having worshipped the three-eyed god, he alone could bring down this one in the locks, dear to my father.

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śreyo yat syāt tathā kuru brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā mene vākyaṃ gaṇādhipaḥ
verses.translation: do whatever would be for the good of all brahmins." Hearing the brahmins' words, the lord of the Ganas accepted their word:

verses.sanskrit: क्रियते गुणरूपं यद् गौतमस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kriyate guṇarūpaṃ yad gautamasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "What is done will be of virtue, especially for Gautama."

verses.sanskrit: अनुमान्य द्विजान् सर्वान् पुनः पुनर् उदारधीः स्वयं च ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा प्रणम्य ब्राह्मणान् पुनः मातुर् मते स्थितो विद्वाञ् जयां प्राह गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anumānya dvijān sarvān punaḥ punar udāradhīḥ svayaṃ ca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā praṇamya brāhmaṇān punaḥ mātur mate sthito vidvāñ jayāṃ prāha gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Having gained the consent of all the brahmins again and again, the noble-minded one himself became a brahmin and bowed again to the brahmins; abiding by his mother's wish, the wise lord of the Ganas said to Jaya:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथा नान्यो विजानीते तथा कुरु शुभानने गोरूपधारिणी गच्छ गौतमो यत्र तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yathā nānyo vijānīte tathā kuru śubhānane gorūpadhāriṇī gaccha gautamo yatra tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: "Act so that no one else knows, O fair-faced one. Taking the form of a cow, go where Gautama is.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शालीन् खाद विनाश्याथ विकारं कुरु भामिनि कृते प्रहारे हुंकारे प्रेक्षिते चापि किंचन पत दीनं स्वनं कृत्वा न म्रियस्व न जीव च
verses.transliteration: śālīn khāda vināśyātha vikāraṃ kuru bhāmini kṛte prahāre huṃkāre prekṣite cāpi kiṃcana pata dīnaṃ svanaṃ kṛtvā na mriyasva na jīva ca
verses.translation: Eat and destroy the rice, and behave strangely, O lovely one. When struck, or at a 'hum' or even a glance, fall down with a pitiful cry, neither dying nor living."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा चकार विजया विघ्नेश्वरमते स्थिता यत्रासीद् गौतमो विप्रो जया गोरूपधारिणी
verses.transliteration: tathā cakāra vijayā vighneśvaramate sthitā yatrāsīd gautamo vipro jayā gorūpadhāriṇī
verses.translation: Vijaya did so, abiding by the will of the lord of obstacles; where the brahmin Gautama was, Jaya, in the form of a cow,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जगाम शालीन् खादन्ती तां ददर्श स गौतमः गां दृष्ट्वा विकृतां विप्रस् तां तृणेन न्यवारयत्
verses.transliteration: jagāma śālīn khādantī tāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ gāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ vipras tāṃ tṛṇena nyavārayat
verses.translation: went, eating the rice. Gautama saw her; seeing the strange cow, the brahmin warded her off with a blade of grass.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निवार्यमाणा सा तेन स्वनं कृत्वा पपात गौः तस्यां तु पतितायां च हाहाकारो महान् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: nivāryamāṇā sā tena svanaṃ kṛtvā papāta gauḥ tasyāṃ tu patitāyāṃ ca hāhākāro mahān abhūt
verses.translation: Being warded off by him, the cow cried out and fell; when she fell, a great cry of dismay arose.

verses.sanskrit: स्वनं श्रुत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च गौतमस्य विचेष्टितम् व्यथिता ब्राह्मणाः प्राहुर् विघ्नराजपुरस्कृताः
verses.transliteration: svanaṃ śrutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca gautamasya viceṣṭitam vyathitā brāhmaṇāḥ prāhur vighnarājapuraskṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the cry and seeing Gautama's action, the distressed brahmins, led by the king of obstacles, said:

verses.sanskrit: इतो गच्छामहे सर्वे न स्थातव्यं तवाश्रमे पुत्रवत् पोषिताः सर्वे पृष्टो ऽसि मुनिपुंगव
verses.transliteration: ito gacchāmahe sarve na sthātavyaṃ tavāśrame putravat poṣitāḥ sarve pṛṣṭo 'si munipuṃgava
verses.translation: "We are all leaving here; we should not stay in your hermitage. We were all nourished like sons; we take leave of you, O bull among sages."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा मुनिर् वाक्यं विप्राणां गच्छतां तदा वज्राहत इवासीत् स विप्राणां पुरतो ऽपतत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā munir vākyaṃ viprāṇāṃ gacchatāṃ tadā vajrāhata ivāsīt sa viprāṇāṃ purato 'patat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of the departing brahmins, the sage was as if struck by a thunderbolt and fell before the brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् ऊचुर् ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे पश्येमां पतितां भुवि रुद्राणां मातरं देवीं जगतां पावनीं प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: tam ūcur brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paśyemāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi rudrāṇāṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ jagatāṃ pāvanīṃ priyām
verses.translation: All the brahmins said to him: "See this one fallen on the ground, the goddess, mother of the Rudras, purifier of the worlds, beloved.

verses.translation: Now that this cow, the embodiment of the gods of the holy places, has fallen by the force of fate, O best of sages, it remains for us to go.

verses.transliteration: cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ kṣayaṃ yāti yathā vāsas tvadāśrame vayaṃ nānyadhanā brahman kevalaṃ tu tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: The vows we practised would perish by staying in your hermitage; we have no other wealth, O Brahman, but austerity alone."

verses.translation: Standing before the brahmins, Gautama humbly said:

verses.transliteration: bhavanta eva śaraṇaṃ pūtaṃ māṃ kartum arhatha
verses.translation: "You alone are my refuge; you should make me pure."

verses.translation: Then the Lord, the king of obstacles, surrounded by the brahmins, spoke:

verses.sanskrit: नैवेयं म्रियते तत्र नैव जीवति तत्र किम् वदामो ऽस्मिन् सुसंदिग्धे निष्कृतिं गतिम् एव वा
verses.transliteration: naiveyaṃ mriyate tatra naiva jīvati tatra kim vadāmo 'smin susaṃdigdhe niṣkṛtiṃ gatim eva vā
verses.translation: "She neither dies there nor lives; what shall we say, in this doubtful case, about expiation or its course?"

verses.transliteration: katham utthāsyatīyaṃ gaur atha cāsmiṃś ca niṣkṛtim vaktum arhatha tat sarvaṃ kariṣye 'ham asaṃśayam
verses.translation: "How will this cow rise, and what is the expiation for this? Please tell me all that; I will do it without doubt."

verses.translation: "This wise one will speak with the agreement of all; his word will be our authority for you, Gautama."

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ preryamāṇo 'sau gautamena balīyasā vighnakṛd brahmavapuṣā prāha sarvān idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Urged by the brahmins and by the mighty Gautama, the creator of obstacles in a brahmin's form spoke these words to all:

verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ ca matenāhaṃ vadiṣyāmi yathārthavat anumanyantu munayo madvākyaṃ gautamo 'pi ca
verses.translation: "With the agreement of all I will speak truthfully; let the sages and Gautama too assent to my words.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटाजूटे ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः कमण्डलुस्थितं वारि तिष्ठतीति हि शुश्रुम
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭājūṭe brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ kamaṇḍalusthitaṃ vāri tiṣṭhatīti hi śuśruma
verses.translation: We have heard that in the matted locks of Maheshvara stays the water that was in the water-pot of Brahma, born of the unmanifest.

verses.sanskrit: तद् आनयस्व तरसा तपसा नियमेन च तेनाभिषिञ्च गाम् एतां भगवन् भुवम् आश्रिताम् ततो वत्स्यामहे सर्वे पूर्ववत् तव वेश्मनि
verses.transliteration: tad ānayasva tarasā tapasā niyamena ca tenābhiṣiñca gām etāṃ bhagavan bhuvam āśritām tato vatsyāmahe sarve pūrvavat tava veśmani
verses.translation: Bring it quickly through austerity and discipline, and with it sprinkle this cow lying on the ground, O Lord; then we shall all dwell in your house as before."

verses.transliteration: ity uktavati viprendre brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi tatrāpatat puṣpavṛṣṭir jayaśabdo vyavardhata tataḥ kṛtāñjalir namro gautamo vākyam abravīt

verses.transliteration: tapasāgniprasādena devabrahmaprasādataḥ bhavatāṃ ca prasādena matsaṃkalpo 'nusidhyatām
verses.translation: "By austerity, by the grace of fire, by the grace of gods and Brahman, and by your grace, may my resolve be accomplished."

verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ viprā āpṛcchan munipuṃgavam svāni sthānāni te jagmuḥ samṛddhāny annavāribhiḥ
verses.translation: "So be it," said the brahmins; taking leave of that bull among sages, they went to their own places, rich in food and water.

verses.transliteration: yāteṣu teṣu vipreṣu bhrātrā saha gaṇeśvaraḥ jayayā saha suprītaḥ kṛtakṛtyo nyavartata
verses.translation: When those brahmins had gone, the lord of the Ganas, with his brother and Jaya, well pleased and his purpose achieved, returned.

verses.transliteration: gateṣu brahmavṛndeṣu gaṇeśe ca gate tathā gautamo 'pi muniśreṣṭhas tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: When the groups of brahmins had gone, and Ganesha too, Gautama, the best of sages, his impurity destroyed by austerity,

verses.transliteration: dhyāyaṃs tadarthaṃ sa muniḥ kim idaṃ mama saṃsthitam ity evaṃ bahuśo dhyāyañ jñānena jñātavān dvija
verses.translation: meditated on the matter: "What is this that has happened to me?" Meditating thus many times, the sage came to know through wisdom, O brahmin.

verses.translation: He understood it as for the purpose of the gods, the course of his own fault, the benefit of the worlds and the pleasing of Shambhu,

verses.transliteration: umāyāḥ prīṇanaṃ cāpi gaṅgānayanam eva ca sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ manye mayi naiva ca kilbiṣam
verses.translation: the pleasing of Uma and the bringing of the Ganga: "I consider everything conducive to good, and there is no fault in me."

verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ manasā dhyāyan suprīto 'bhūd dvijottamaḥ ārādhya jagatām īśaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Reflecting thus in his mind, the best of brahmins became well pleased: "Having worshipped the three-eyed, bull-bannered lord of the worlds,

verses.sanskrit: आनयिष्ये सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां प्रीता ऽस्तु गिरिजा मम सपत्नी जगदम्बाया महेश्वरजटास्थिता
verses.transliteration: ānayiṣye saricchreṣṭhāṃ prītā 'stu girijā mama sapatnī jagadambāyā maheśvarajaṭāsthitā
verses.translation: I will bring the best of rivers; may Girija be pleased with me, the co-wife of the Mother of the world who dwells in Maheshvara's matted locks."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi saṃkalpya munipravīraḥ sa gautamo brahmagirer jagāma kailāsam ādhiṣṭhitam ugradhanvanā surārcitaṃ priyayā brahmavṛndaiḥ
verses.translation: Having resolved thus, that foremost of sages, Gautama, went from Brahmagiri to Kailasa, ruled by the fierce-bowed god, worshipped by the gods with his beloved and the hosts of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरं गत्वा गौतमो भगवान् ऋषिः किं चकार तपो वापि कां चक्रे स्तुतिम् उत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsaśikharaṃ gatvā gautamo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ kiṃ cakāra tapo vāpi kāṃ cakre stutim uttamām
verses.translation: On the same day the Yogic slumber took birth in the belly of Yasoda in accordance with what was mentioned by Brahma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: On the same day the Yogic slumber took birth in the belly of Yasoda in accordance with what was mentioned by Brahma.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गिरिं गत्वा ततो वत्स वाचं संयम्य गौतमः आस्तीर्य स कुशान् प्राज्ञः कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: giriṃ gatvā tato vatsa vācaṃ saṃyamya gautamaḥ āstīrya sa kuśān prājñaḥ kailāse parvatottame
verses.translation: O brahmins, when the part of Visnu entered the Earth the seasons became auspicious. The planets in the sky moved perfectly (and favourably).
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, when the part of Visnu entered the Earth the seasons became auspicious. The planets in the sky moved perfectly (and favourably).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपविश्य शुचिर् भूत्वा स्तोत्रं चेदं ततो जगौ अपतत् पुष्पवृष्टिश् च स्तूयमाने महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: upaviśya śucir bhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato jagau apatat puṣpavṛṣṭiś ca stūyamāne maheśvare
verses.translation: No one dared to look at Devaki due to her excessive refulgence. On seeing her blazing splendidly, the minds of onlookers became excited.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one dared to look at Devaki due to her excessive refulgence. On seeing her blazing splendidly, the minds of onlookers became excited.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोगार्थिनां भोगम् अभीप्सितं च दातुं महान्त्य् अष्टवपूंषि धत्ते सोमो जनानां गुणवन्ति नित्यं देवं महादेवम् इति स्तुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: bhogārthināṃ bhogam abhīpsitaṃ ca dātuṃ mahānty aṣṭavapūṃṣi dhatte somo janānāṃ guṇavanti nityaṃ devaṃ mahādevam iti stuvanti
verses.translation: Day and night the deities eulogised Devaki who held Visnu in her womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: Day and night the deities eulogised Devaki who held Visnu in her womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्तुं स्वकीयैर् विषयैः सुखानि भर्तुं समस्तं सचराचरं च संपत्तये ह्य् अस्य विवृद्धये च महीमयं रूपम् इतीश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: kartuṃ svakīyair viṣayaiḥ sukhāni bhartuṃ samastaṃ sacarācaraṃ ca saṃpattaye hy asya vivṛddhaye ca mahīmayaṃ rūpam itīśvarasya
verses.translation: You are Svaha, you are Svadha, you are Vidya, you are Sudha (Nectar), you are splendour. For the protection of worlds, you have incarnated on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Svaha, you are Svadha, you are Vidya, you are Sudha (Nectar), you are splendour. For the protection of worlds, you have incarnated on the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टेः स्थितेः संहरणाय भूमेर् आधारम् आधातुम् अपां स्वरूपम् भेजे शिवः शान्ततनुर् जनानां सुखाय धर्माय जगत् प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃharaṇāya bhūmer ādhāram ādhātum apāṃ svarūpam bheje śivaḥ śāntatanur janānāṃ sukhāya dharmāya jagat pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Devas, she conceived the lord in her womb, the lotus-eyed lord, the cause of safety and security of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised by Devas, she conceived the lord in her womb, the lotus-eyed lord, the cause of safety and security of the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालव्यवस्थाम् अमृतस्रवं च जीवस्थितिं सृष्टिम् अथो विनाशनम् मुदं प्रजानां सुखम् उन्नतिं च चक्रे ऽर्कचन्द्राग्निमयं शरीरम्
verses.transliteration: kālavyavasthām amṛtasravaṃ ca jīvasthitiṃ sṛṣṭim atho vināśanam mudaṃ prajānāṃ sukham unnatiṃ ca cakre 'rkacandrāgnimayaṃ śarīram
verses.translation: When at midnight, Janardana the support of all, was
verses.commentary: Sense: When at midnight, Janardana the support of all, was
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिं गतिं शक्तिम् अथाक्षराणि जीवव्यवस्थां मुदम् अप्य् अनेकाम् स्रष्टुं कृतं वायुर् इतीशरूपं त्वं वेत्सि नूनं भगवन् भवन्तम्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhiṃ gatiṃ śaktim athākṣarāṇi jīvavyavasthāṃ mudam apy anekām sraṣṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vāyur itīśarūpaṃ tvaṃ vetsi nūnaṃ bhagavan bhavantam
verses.translation: May that lord ofDevas be pleased, the lord of Devas who has now revealed an infant's form by means of his own Maya, whose form is endless, whose form is this entire universe and who bears the world in his womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: May that lord ofDevas be pleased, the lord of Devas who has now revealed an infant's form by means of his own Maya, whose form is endless, whose form is this entire universe and who bears the world in his womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भेदैर् विना नैव कृतिर् न धर्मो नात्मीयम् अन्यन् न दिशो ऽन्तरिक्षम् द्यावापृथिव्यौ न च भुक्तिमुक्ती तस्माद् इदं व्योमवपुस् तवेश
verses.transliteration: bhedair vinā naiva kṛtir na dharmo nātmīyam anyan na diśo 'ntarikṣam dyāvāpṛthivyau na ca bhuktimuktī tasmād idaṃ vyomavapus taveśa
verses.translation: O lord, the Atman of ail, withdraw this four-armed form. O destroyer of Asuras, sons of Diti, let not Karhsa know about your incarnation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the Atman of ail, withdraw this four-armed form. O destroyer of Asuras, sons of Diti, let not Karhsa know about your incarnation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं व्यवस्थापयितुं व्यवस्य ऋक्सामशास्त्राणि यजुश् च शाखाः लोके च गाथाः स्मृतयः पुराणम् इत्यादिशब्दात्मकताम् उपैति
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ vyavasya ṛksāmaśāstrāṇi yajuś ca śākhāḥ loke ca gāthāḥ smṛtayaḥ purāṇam ityādiśabdātmakatām upaiti
verses.translation: Formerly, O gentle lady, I had been eulogised by you, desirous of a son. Since I am now born of your womb, your prayer has become fruitful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, O gentle lady, I had been eulogised by you, desirous of a son. Since I am now born of your womb, your prayer has become fruitful.

verses.transliteration: yaṣṭā kratur yāny api sādhanāni ṛtvikpradeśaṃ phaladeśakālāḥ tvam eva śaṃbho paramārthatattvaṃ vadanti yajñāṅgamayaṃ vapus te
verses.translation: O excellent sages, after saying thus, the lord became silent. During the night itself Vasudeva took him and went out.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, after saying thus, the lord became silent. During the night itself Vasudeva took him and went out.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कर्ता प्रदाता प्रतिभूः प्रदानं सर्वज्ञसाक्षी पुरुषः परश् च प्रत्यात्मभूतः परमार्थरूपस् त्वम् एव सर्वं किम् उ वाग्विलासैः
verses.transliteration: kartā pradātā pratibhūḥ pradānaṃ sarvajñasākṣī puruṣaḥ paraś ca pratyātmabhūtaḥ paramārtharūpas tvam eva sarvaṃ kim u vāgvilāsaiḥ
verses.translation: When Vasudeva set out, the watchmen became deluded. The porters and watchmen of the city of Mathura were enchanted and deluded by the Yogic slumber.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Vasudeva set out, the watchmen became deluded. The porters and watchmen of the city of Mathura were enchanted and deluded by the Yogic slumber.

verses.sanskrit: न वेदशास्त्रैर् गुरुभिः प्रदिष्टो न नासि बुद्ध्यादिभिर् अप्रधृष्यः अजो ऽप्रमेयः शिवशब्दवाच्यस् त्वम् अस्ति सत्यं भगवन् नमस् ते
verses.transliteration: na vedaśāstrair gurubhiḥ pradiṣṭo na nāsi buddhyādibhir apradhṛṣyaḥ ajo 'prameyaḥ śivaśabdavācyas tvam asti satyaṃ bhagavan namas te
verses.translation: When the clouds discharged a heavy and fierce down¬ pour during that night, Sesa shielded Vasudeva by means of
verses.commentary: Sense: When the clouds discharged a heavy and fierce down¬ pour during that night, Sesa shielded Vasudeva by means of

verses.sanskrit: आत्मैकतां स्वप्रकृतिं कदाचिद् ऐक्षच् छिवः संपद् इयं ममेति पृथक् तदैवाभवद् अप्रतर्क्य अचिन्त्यप्रभावो बहुविश्वमूर्तिः
verses.transliteration: ātmaikatāṃ svaprakṛtiṃ kadācid aikṣac chivaḥ saṃpad iyaṃ mameti pṛthak tadaivābhavad apratarkya acintyaprabhāvo bahuviśvamūrtiḥ
verses.translation: Bearing Visnu, Vasudeva waded through Yamuna with
verses.commentary: Sense: Bearing Visnu, Vasudeva waded through Yamuna with

verses.sanskrit: भावे ऽभिवृद्धा च भवे भवे च स्वकारणं कारणम् आस्थिता च नित्या शिवा सर्वसुलक्षणा वा विलक्षणा विश्वकरस्य शक्तिः
verses.transliteration: bhāve 'bhivṛddhā ca bhave bhave ca svakāraṇaṃ kāraṇam āsthitā ca nityā śivā sarvasulakṣaṇā vā vilakṣaṇā viśvakarasya śaktiḥ
verses.translation: On the bank of Yamuna he saw Nanda and other elderly cowherds who carried revenue to be paid to Karhsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the bank of Yamuna he saw Nanda and other elderly cowherds who carried revenue to be paid to Karhsa.

verses.transliteration: utpādanaṃ saṃsthitir annavṛddhi layāḥ satāṃ yatra sanātanās te ekaiva mūrtir na samasti kiṃcid asādhyam asyā dayitā harasya
verses.translation: On waking up, Yasoda saw her new-born son, dark in complexion like the petals of a blue lotus. Thereat she re¬ joiced very much.
verses.commentary: Sense: On waking up, Yasoda saw her new-born son, dark in complexion like the petals of a blue lotus. Thereat she re¬ joiced very much.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थम् अन्नानि धनानि जीवा यच्छन्ति कुर्वन्ति तपांसि धर्मान् सापीयम् अम्बा जगतो जनित्री प्रिया तु सोमस्य महासुकीर्तिः
verses.transliteration: yadartham annāni dhanāni jīvā yacchanti kurvanti tapāṃsi dharmān sāpīyam ambā jagato janitrī priyā tu somasya mahāsukīrtiḥ
verses.translation: Taking the baby girl back to his abode, Vasudeva placed her on the bed of Devakl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the baby girl back to his abode, Vasudeva placed her on the bed of Devakl.

verses.sanskrit: यद् ईक्षितं काङ्क्षति वासवो ऽपि यन्नामतो मङ्गलम् आप्नुयाच् च या व्याप्य विश्वं विमलीकरोति सोमा सदा सोमसमानरूपा
verses.transliteration: yad īkṣitaṃ kāṅkṣati vāsavo 'pi yannāmato maṅgalam āpnuyāc ca yā vyāpya viśvaṃ vimalīkaroti somā sadā somasamānarūpā
verses.translation: O brahmins, thereafter the watchmen heard the crying sound of the infant and got up suddenly. They intimated to Kamsa about the birth of a child to Devakl.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, thereafter the watchmen heard the crying sound of the infant and got up suddenly. They intimated to Kamsa about the birth of a child to Devakl.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिजीवस्य चराचरस्य बुद्ध्यक्षिचैतन्यमनःसुखानि यस्याः प्रसादात् फलवन्ति नित्यं वागीश्वरी लोकगुरोः सुरम्या
verses.transliteration: brahmādijīvasya carācarasya buddhyakṣicaitanyamanaḥsukhāni yasyāḥ prasādāt phalavanti nityaṃ vāgīśvarī lokaguroḥ suramyā
verses.translation: Kamsa rushed to Devakl and seized the baby girl from her even as Devakl tried to prevent him crying aloud "Leave off, leave off" till her throat ached.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kamsa rushed to Devakl and seized the baby girl from her even as Devakl tried to prevent him crying aloud "Leave off, leave off" till her throat ached.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखस्यापि मनो मलीनं किम् अन्यजन्तोर् इति चिन्त्य माता गङ्गावतारं विविधैर् उपायैः सर्वं जगत् पावयितुं चकार
verses.transliteration: caturmukhasyāpi mano malīnaṃ kim anyajantor iti cintya mātā gaṅgāvatāraṃ vividhair upāyaiḥ sarvaṃ jagat pāvayituṃ cakāra
verses.translation: He hurled her on the top of a rocky slab. On being hurled thus she flew up and took up a position in the sky. She assumed a formidable form with eight large hands armed with weapons. She laughed aloud (in derision) and furiously spoke to Kamsa thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतीः समालक्ष्य हरप्रभुत्वं विश्वस्य लोकः सकलैः प्रमाणैः कृत्वा च धर्मान् बुभुजे च भोगान् विभूतिर् एषा तु सदाशिवस्य
verses.transliteration: śrutīḥ samālakṣya haraprabhutvaṃ viśvasya lokaḥ sakalaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ kṛtvā ca dharmān bubhuje ca bhogān vibhūtir eṣā tu sadāśivasya
verses.translation: Having observed the Shrutis and Hara's lordship over the universe by all means of knowledge, people perform their dharmas and enjoy pleasures; this is the glory of Sadashiva.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यक्रियाकारकसाधनानां वेदोदितानाम् अथ लौकिकानाम् यत् साध्यम् उत्कृष्टतमं प्रियं च प्रोक्ता च सा सिद्धिर् अनादिकर्तुः
verses.transliteration: kāryakriyākārakasādhanānāṃ vedoditānām atha laukikānām yat sādhyam utkṛṣṭatamaṃ priyaṃ ca proktā ca sā siddhir anādikartuḥ
verses.translation: Whatever is to be accomplished — most excellent and dear — through the effects, actions, agents and means taught in the Veda and in the world, that is declared the perfection of the beginningless maker.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: dhyātvā varaṃ brahma paraṃ pradhānaṃ yat sārabhūtaṃ yad upāsitavyam yat prāpya muktā na punar bhavanti sadyogino muktir umāpatiḥ saḥ
verses.translation: Having meditated on the excellent supreme Brahman, the chief, which is the essence and is to be worshipped, attaining which the liberated are not born again — the liberation of true yogins is that husband of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा शंभुर् अमेयमाया रूपाणि धत्ते जगतो हिताय तद्योगयोग्यानि तथैव धत्से पतिव्रतात्वं त्वयि मातर् एवम्
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā śaṃbhur ameyamāyā rūpāṇi dhatte jagato hitāya tadyogayogyāni tathaiva dhatse pativratātvaṃ tvayi mātar evam
verses.translation: As Shambhu of immeasurable maya takes forms for the good of the world, so you take forms fit for union with them; thus, O Mother, is fidelity to one's husband in you.

verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ stuvatas tasya purastād vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān gaṇeśādigaṇair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: As he praised thus, the bull-bannered god appeared before him, glorious, with Uma, surrounded by Ganesha and the other hosts.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षाद् आगत्य तं शंभुः प्रसन्नो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sākṣād āgatya taṃ śaṃbhuḥ prasanno vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Shambhu came in person and, pleased, spoke to him:

verses.sanskrit: किं ते गौतम दास्यामि भक्तिस्तोत्रव्रतैः शुभैः परितुष्टो ऽस्मि याचस्व देवानाम् अपि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ te gautama dāsyāmi bhaktistotravrataiḥ śubhaiḥ parituṣṭo 'smi yācasva devānām api duṣkaram
verses.translation: "What shall I give you, Gautama? I am pleased by your auspicious devotion, hymn and vows; ask for something even the gods find hard to obtain."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा जगन्मूर्तेर् वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः हर्षबाष्पपरीताङ्गो गौतमः पर्यचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā jaganmūrter vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ harṣabāṣpaparītāṅgo gautamaḥ paryacintayat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of the one whose form is the world, Gautama, skilled in speech, his body covered with tears of joy, reflected:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: aho daivam aho dharmo hy aho vai viprapūjanam aho lokagatiś citrā aho dhātar namo 'stu te
verses.translation: "Ah, fate! Ah, dharma! Ah, the worship of brahmins! Ah, how strange the ways of the world! Ah, Creator, salutation to you!"

verses.transliteration: jaṭāsthitāṃ śubhāṃ gaṅgāṃ dehi me tridaśārcita yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa trayīdhāma namo 'stu te
verses.translation: "Give me the auspicious Ganga who dwells in your locks, O one worshipped by the gods, if you are pleased, O lord of gods; salutation to you, abode of the three Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् उपकारार्थं लोकानां याचितं त्वया आत्मनस् तूपकाराय तद् याचस्वाकुतोभयः
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām upakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitaṃ tvayā ātmanas tūpakārāya tad yācasvākutobhayaḥ
verses.translation: "You have asked for the benefit of the three worlds; now ask without fear for your own benefit."

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्तास् त्वां च देवीं स्तुवन्ति वै सर्वकामसमृद्धाः स्युर् एतद् धि वरयाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: stotreṇānena ye bhaktās tvāṃ ca devīṃ stuvanti vai sarvakāmasamṛddhāḥ syur etad dhi varayāmy aham
verses.translation: "May the devotees who praise you and the Goddess with this hymn be rich in all desires — this I choose."

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्त्व् इति देवेशः परितुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् वचः अन्यान् अपि वरान् मत्तो याचस्व विगतज्वरः
verses.transliteration: evam astv iti deveśaḥ parituṣṭo 'bravīd vacaḥ anyān api varān matto yācasva vigatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: "So be it," said the lord of gods, well pleased; "ask other boons of me too, free from anxiety."

verses.transliteration: evam uktas tu harṣeṇa gautamaḥ prāha śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Thus addressed, Gautama joyfully said to Shankara:

verses.sanskrit: इमां देवीं जटासंस्थां पावनीं लोकपावनीम् तव प्रियां जगन्नाथ उत्सृज ब्रह्मणो गिरौ
verses.transliteration: imāṃ devīṃ jaṭāsaṃsthāṃ pāvanīṃ lokapāvanīm tava priyāṃ jagannātha utsṛja brahmaṇo girau
verses.translation: "Release this goddess dwelling in your locks, purifying, purifier of the world, your beloved, O lord of the world, on Brahma's mountain.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासां तीर्थभूता तु यावद् गच्छति सागरम् ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि मनोवाक्कायिकानि च
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāṃ tīrthabhūtā tu yāvad gacchati sāgaram brahmahatyādipāpāni manovākkāyikāni ca
verses.translation: May she be the holy place of all, as far as she goes to the ocean; may all sins such as brahmin-slaying, of mind, speech and body,

verses.sanskrit: स्नानमात्रेण सर्वाणि विलयं यान्तु शंकर चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे च अयने विषुवे तथा
verses.transliteration: snānamātreṇa sarvāṇi vilayaṃ yāntu śaṃkara candrasūryoparāge ca ayane viṣuve tathā
verses.translation: be dissolved by merely bathing in her, O Shankara. Whatever fruit there is at eclipses of moon and sun, at the solstices and equinoxes,

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्तौ वैधृतौ पुण्यतीर्थेष्व् अन्येषु यत् फलम् अस्यास् तु स्मरणाद् एव तत् पुण्यं जायतां हर
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau puṇyatīrtheṣv anyeṣu yat phalam asyās tu smaraṇād eva tat puṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara
verses.translation: at the solar transits, at vaidhriti, and at other holy places — may that merit arise from merely remembering her, O Hara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्लाघ्यं कृते तपः प्रोक्तं त्रेतायां यज्ञकर्म च द्वापरे यज्ञदाने च दानम् एव कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: ślāghyaṃ kṛte tapaḥ proktaṃ tretāyāṃ yajñakarma ca dvāpare yajñadāne ca dānam eva kalau yuge
verses.translation: Austerity is declared praiseworthy in the Krita age, the work of sacrifice in the Treta, sacrifice and gift in the Dvapara, and gift alone in the Kali age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युगधर्माश् च ये सर्वे देशधर्मास् तथैव च देशकालादिसंयोगे यो धर्मो यत्र शस्यते
verses.transliteration: yugadharmāś ca ye sarve deśadharmās tathaiva ca deśakālādisaṃyoge yo dharmo yatra śasyate
verses.translation: The dharmas of the ages and the dharmas of lands, whatever dharma is commended where according to place and time,

verses.transliteration: yad anyatra kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānādisaṃyamaiḥ asyās tu smaraṇād eva tat puṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara
verses.translation: whatever merit is gained elsewhere through bathing, giving and restraint — may that merit arise from merely remembering her, O Hara.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र त्व् इयं याति यावत् सागरगामिनी तत्र तत्र त्वया भाव्यम् एष चास्तु वरो वरः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra tv iyaṃ yāti yāvat sāgaragāminī tatra tatra tvayā bhāvyam eṣa cāstu varo varaḥ
verses.translation: Wherever she goes, as far as she flows to the sea, there you should be present — let this be the excellent boon.

verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ tūpari tu daśa yāvac ca saṃkhyayā tadantarapraviṣṭānāṃ mahāpātakinām api
verses.translation: For ten yojanas beyond by count, even great sinners who enter within that area,

verses.transliteration: tat pitṝṇāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca snānāyāgacchatāṃ śiva snāne cāpy antare mṛtyor muktibhājo bhavantu vai
verses.translation: and their ancestors, and those coming to bathe, O Shiva, and those who die while bathing or in between, may they partake of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: एकतः सर्वतीर्थानि स्वर्गमर्त्यरसातले एषा तेभ्यो विशिष्टा तु अलं शंभो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni svargamartyarasātale eṣā tebhyo viśiṣṭā tu alaṃ śaṃbho namo 'stu te
verses.translation: On one side all the holy places in heaven, the mortal world and Rasatala; this one is superior to them. Enough, Shambhu; salutation to you."

verses.sanskrit: तद् गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा तथास्त्व् इत्य् अब्रवीच् छिवः अस्याः परतरं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā tathāstv ity abravīc chivaḥ asyāḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Hearing Gautama's words, Shiva said, "So be it; there has not been and will not be a holy place higher than this.

verses.transliteration: satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vede ca pariniṣṭhitam sarveṣāṃ gautamī puṇyā ity uktvāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: True, true, again true, and established in the Veda: the Gautami is the holiest of all." Having said this, he vanished.

verses.transliteration: tato gate bhagavati lokapūjite tadājñayā pūrṇabalaḥ sa gautamaḥ jaṭāṃ samādāya saridvarāṃ tāṃ surair vṛto brahmagiriṃ viveśa
verses.translation: When the Lord worshipped by the world had gone, Gautama, full of strength by his command, taking the lock with that best of rivers, entered Brahmagiri surrounded by the gods.

verses.transliteration: tatas tu gautame prāpte jaṭām ādāya nārada puṣpavṛṣṭir abhūt tatra samājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ
verses.translation: When Gautama arrived with the lock, O Narada, a shower of flowers fell there and the lords of the gods assembled,

verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaś ca mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyās tathā jayaśabdena taṃ vipraṃ pūjayanto mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: and the illustrious sages, brahmins and kshatriyas, joyfully honouring that brahmin with cries of victory.

verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭājuṭād gaṅgām ādāya gautamaḥ āgatya brahmaṇaḥ puṇye tataḥ kim akarod girau
verses.translation: Distressed in mind (due to this) Kamsa called all Asuras, Pralamba, Kesin and others and spoke to them thus:

verses.sanskrit: आदाय गौतमो गङ्गां शुचिः प्रयतमानसः पूजितो देवगन्धर्वैस् तथा गिरिनिवासिभिः
verses.transliteration: ādāya gautamo gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ pūjito devagandharvais tathā girinivāsibhiḥ
verses.translation: O Pralamba of great arms, O Kesin, O Dhenuka, O Putana, may my words be heard by Arista and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pralamba of great arms, O Kesin, O Dhenuka, O Putana, may my words be heard by Arista and others.

verses.transliteration: girer mūrdhni jaṭāṃ sthāpya smaran devaṃ trilocanam uvāca prāñjalir bhūtvā gaṅgāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ
verses.translation: Still O leading Asuras I have to exert myself to harm those wicked ones, more than what those evil ones may do.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still O leading Asuras I have to exert myself to harm those wicked ones, more than what those evil ones may do.

verses.transliteration: trilocanajaṭodbhūte sarvakāmapradāyini kṣamasva mātaḥ śāntāsi sukhaṃ yāhi hitaṃ kuru
verses.translation: "The lord of the past, present and future is born to bring about my death", So says the girl born of the womb of Devakl.

verses.transliteration: gaccheyaṃ devasadanam athavāpi kamaṇḍalum rasātalaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ jātas tvaṃ satyavāg asi
verses.translation: Hence grieve not for what has happened. Who is not

verses.transliteration: trayāṇām upakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitā mayā śaṃbhunā ca tathā dattā devi tan nānyathā bhavet
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, after consoling them thus, Kamsa delighted them by releasing them. Thereupon, he entered his inner apartment.

verses.transliteration: tad gautamavacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgā mene dvijeritam tredhātmānaṃ vibhajyātha svargamartyarasātale
verses.translation: Hearing Gautama's words, the Ganga accepted what the brahmin said and divided herself into three, in heaven, the mortal world and Rasatala.

verses.transliteration: svarge caturdhā vyagamat saptadhā martyamaṇḍale rasātale caturdhaiva saivaṃ pañcadaśākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: In heaven she went in four streams, in the mortal world in seven, in Rasatala in four; thus she has fifteen forms.

verses.transliteration: sarvatra sarvabhūtaiva sarvapāpavināśinī sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ saiva vede pragīyate
verses.translation: Everywhere she is all beings, destroyer of all sins, ever granting all desires; she alone is sung in the Veda.

verses.transliteration: martyā martyagatām eva paśyanti na talaṃ gatām naiva svargagatāṃ martyāḥ paśyanty ajñānabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: Mortals see only the one gone to the mortal world, not the one gone below; nor do mortals of ignorant mind see the one gone to heaven.

verses.transliteration: yāvat sāgaragā devī tāvad devamayī smṛtā utsṛṣṭā gautamenaiva prāyāt pūrvārṇavaṃ prati
verses.translation: As far as the goddess goes to the ocean, so far she is remembered as full of the gods; released by Gautama, she went toward the eastern ocean.

verses.transliteration: tato devarṣibhir juṣṭāṃ mātaraṃ jagataḥ śubhām gautamo muniśārdūlaḥ pradakṣiṇam athākarot
verses.translation: Then Gautama, tiger among sages, circumambulated the auspicious mother of the world, frequented by gods and sages.

verses.transliteration: trilocanaṃ sureśānaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya gautamaḥ ubhayos tīrayoḥ snānaṃ karomīti dadhe matim
verses.translation: Having first worshipped the three-eyed lord of the gods, Gautama resolved, "I will bathe on both banks."

verses.transliteration: smṛtamātras tadā tatrāvirāsīt karuṇārṇavaḥ tatra snānaṃ kathaṃ sidhyed ity evaṃ śarvam abravīt
verses.translation: As soon as he was remembered, the ocean of compassion appeared there; Gautama asked Sharva how the bathing there should be accomplished,

verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ sarvadā tīrthaṃ gautamī nātra saṃśayaḥ tisraḥ koṭyo 'rdhakoṭī ca yojanānāṃ śatadvaye
verses.translation: Krsna seized her breasts and pressed them forcibly with both of his hands. He sucked the breast furiously and drank up even her vital breath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna seized her breasts and pressed them forcibly with both of his hands. He sucked the breast furiously and drank up even her vital breath.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि मुनिशार्दूल संभविष्यन्ति गौतम इयं माहेश्वरी गङ्गा गौतमी वैष्णवीति च
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni muniśārdūla saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā gautamī vaiṣṇavīti ca
verses.translation: The terrible Putana groaned loudly as she died with the nervous cards snapping one by one. She fell on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: The terrible Putana groaned loudly as she died with the nervous cards snapping one by one. She fell on the ground.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मी गोदावरी नन्दा सुनन्दा कामदायिनी ब्रह्मतेजःसमानीता सर्वपापप्रणाशनी
verses.transliteration: brāhmī godāvarī nandā sunandā kāmadāyinī brahmatejaḥsamānītā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī
verses.translation: Frightened on hearing her loud cry the residents of the cowherds' colony woke up and saw Putana lying dead and Krsna was in her lap.
verses.commentary: Sense: Frightened on hearing her loud cry the residents of the cowherds' colony woke up and saw Putana lying dead and Krsna was in her lap.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणाद् एव पापौघहन्त्री मम सदा प्रिया पञ्चानाम् अपि भूतानाम् आपः श्रेष्ठत्वम् आगताः
verses.transliteration: smaraṇād eva pāpaughahantrī mama sadā priyā pañcānām api bhūtānām āpaḥ śreṣṭhatvam āgatāḥ
verses.translation: Nanda the cowherd took some cow-dung and smeared Krsna's forehead with it, according him protection thereby. Even as he did so he uttered these Mantras:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Nanda the cowherd took some cow-dung and smeared Krsna's forehead with it, according him protection thereby. Even as he did so he uttered these Mantras:—

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि तीर्थभूतास् तु तस्माद् आपः पराः स्मृताः तासां भागीरथी श्रेष्ठा ताभ्यो ऽपि गौतमी तथा
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi tīrthabhūtās tu tasmād āpaḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥ tāsāṃ bhāgīrathī śreṣṭhā tābhyo 'pi gautamī tathā
verses.translation: The boy for whom the benedictory rites were performed
verses.commentary: Sense: The boy for whom the benedictory rites were performed
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनीता सजटा गङ्गा अस्या नान्यच् छुभावहम् स्वर्गे भुवि तले वापि तीर्थं सर्वार्थदं मुने
verses.transliteration: ānītā sajaṭā gaṅgā asyā nānyac chubhāvaham svarge bhuvi tale vāpi tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ mune
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतत् कथितं पुत्र गौतमाय महात्मने साक्षाद् धरेण तुष्टेन मया तव निवेदितम्
verses.transliteration: ity etat kathitaṃ putra gautamāya mahātmane sākṣād dhareṇa tuṣṭena mayā tava niveditam
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं सा गौतमी गङ्गा सर्वेभ्यो ऽप्य् अधिका मता तत्स्वरूपं च कथितं कुतो ऽन्या श्रवणस्पृहा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sā gautamī gaṅgā sarvebhyo 'py adhikā matā tatsvarūpaṃ ca kathitaṃ kuto 'nyā śravaṇaspṛhā
verses.translation: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the huge body of the dead ogress Putana, the cowherds were frightened and surprised.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधा सैव गदिता एकापि सुरसत्तम एको भेदस् तु कथितो ब्राह्मणेनाहृतो यतः
verses.transliteration: dvividhā saiva gaditā ekāpi surasattama eko bhedas tu kathito brāhmaṇenāhṛto yataḥ
verses.translation: Thus urged by Vjisudeva, Garga went to the Cowherds' colony disguised and unknown to the cowherds. He performed the postnatal ceremonies and rites for the two boys,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियेणापरो ऽप्य् अंशो जटास्व् एव व्यवस्थितः भवस्य देवदेवस्य आहृतस् तद् वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyeṇāparo 'py aṃśo jaṭāsv eva vyavasthitaḥ bhavasya devadevasya āhṛtas tad vadasva me
verses.translation: O brahmins, in a short while the two boys became well known as very powerful. They began to crawl on their knees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in a short while the two boys became well known as very powerful. They began to crawl on their knees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्वये जात इक्ष्वाकुकुलसंभवः पुरा वै सगरो नाम राजासीद् अतिधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānvaye jāta ikṣvākukulasaṃbhavaḥ purā vai sagaro nāma rājāsīd atidhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: With their bodies smeared with the ashes of cowdung cakes they roamed about here and there. Neither Yasoda nor Rohini was inclined to stop them.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their bodies smeared with the ashes of cowdung cakes they roamed about here and there. Neither Yasoda nor Rohini was inclined to stop them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्वा दानपरो नित्यं धर्माचारविचारवान् तस्य भार्याद्वयं चासीत् पतिभक्तिपरायणम्
verses.transliteration: yajvā dānaparo nityaṃ dharmācāravicāravān tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsīt patibhaktiparāyaṇam
verses.translation: They played about in the middle of the kine-enclosure. Then they stepped into the folds of calves. They were eager to pull the tail of the new-born calf.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tasya vai saṃtatir nābhūd iti cintāparo 'bhavat vasiṣṭhaṃ gṛham āhūya saṃpūjya vidhivat tataḥ
verses.translation: He had no offspring, and so he became anxious; having summoned Vasishtha to his house and duly worshipped him,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: uvāca vacanaṃ rājā saṃtateḥ kāraṇaṃ prati iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā rājānam abravīt
verses.translation: the king spoke about the cause of offspring. Hearing these words, he meditated and said to the king:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सपत्नीकः सदा राजन्न् ऋषिपूजापरो भव
verses.transliteration: sapatnīkaḥ sadā rājann ṛṣipūjāparo bhava
verses.translation: "O king, with your wife, always be devoted to the worship of sages."

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa munir vipra yathāsthānaṃ jagāma ha ekadā tasya rājarṣer gṛham āgāt taponidhiḥ
verses.translation: Having said this, the sage went to his own place, O brahmin. One day a treasury of austerity came to the house of that royal sage.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यर्षेः पूजनं चक्रे स संतुष्टो ऽब्रवीद् वचम् वरं ब्रूहि महाभागेत्य् उक्ते पुत्रान् स चावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: tasyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sa saṃtuṣṭo 'bravīd vacam varaṃ brūhi mahābhāgety ukte putrān sa cāvṛṇot
verses.translation: He worshipped that sage, and the sage, pleased, said, "Name a boon, O illustrious one." When this was said, he chose sons.

verses.sanskrit: स मुनिः प्राह राजानम् एकस्यां वंशधारकः पुत्रो भूयात् तथान्यस्यां षष्टिसाहस्रकं सुताः
verses.transliteration: sa muniḥ prāha rājānam ekasyāṃ vaṃśadhārakaḥ putro bhūyāt tathānyasyāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrakaṃ sutāḥ
verses.translation: The sage said to the king: "From one wife let there be a son who continues the line, and from the other sixty thousand sons."

verses.sanskrit: वरं दत्त्वा मुनौ याते पुत्रा जाताः सहस्रशः स यज्ञान् सुबहूंश् चक्रे हयमेधान् सुदक्षिणान्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ dattvā munau yāte putrā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ sa yajñān subahūṃś cakre hayamedhān sudakṣiṇān
verses.translation: When the sage had given the boon and gone, thousands of sons were born. He performed very many sacrifices, horse sacrifices with good fees.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन् हयमेधे वै दीक्षितो विधिवन् नृपः पुत्रान् न्ययोजयद् राजा ससैन्यान् हयरक्षणे
verses.transliteration: ekasmin hayamedhe vai dīkṣito vidhivan nṛpaḥ putrān nyayojayad rājā sasainyān hayarakṣaṇe
verses.translation: In one horse sacrifice, duly consecrated, the king appointed his sons with armies to guard the horse.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद् अन्तरम् आसाद्य हयं जह्रे शतक्रतुः मार्गमाणाश् च ते पुत्रा नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: kvacid antaram āsādya hayaṃ jahre śatakratuḥ mārgamāṇāś ca te putrā naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Finding an opportunity somewhere, Shatakratu stole the horse; searching, those sons did not see the horse then.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणां तथा षष्टिर् नानायुद्धविशारदाः तेषु पश्यत्सु रक्षांसि पुत्रेषु सगरस्य हि
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭir nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ teṣu paśyatsu rakṣāṃsi putreṣu sagarasya hi
verses.translation: Sixty thousand of them, skilled in various kinds of fighting — while Sagara's sons looked on, the Rakshasas

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षितं तद् धयं नीत्वा ते रसातलम् आगमन् राक्षसान् मायया युक्तान् नैवापश्यन्त सागराः
verses.transliteration: prokṣitaṃ tad dhayaṃ nītvā te rasātalam āgaman rākṣasān māyayā yuktān naivāpaśyanta sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: took that consecrated horse and went to Rasatala; the sons of Sagara did not see the Rakshasas, who were possessed of illusion.

verses.sanskrit: न दृष्ट्वा ते हयं पुत्राः सगरस्य बलीयसः इतश् चेतश् चरन्तस् ते नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: na dṛṣṭvā te hayaṃ putrāḥ sagarasya balīyasaḥ itaś cetaś carantas te naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Not seeing the horse, the sons of mighty Sagara wandered here and there and still did not see the horse.

verses.sanskrit: देवलोकं तदा जग्मुः पर्वतांश् च सरांसि च वनानि च विचिन्वन्तो नैवापश्यन् हयं तदा
verses.transliteration: devalokaṃ tadā jagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca sarāṃsi ca vanāni ca vicinvanto naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā
verses.translation: Then they went to the world of the gods, searching mountains, lakes and forests, and did not see the horse.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्वस्त्ययनो राजा ऋत्विग्भिः कृतमङ्गलः अदृष्ट्वा तु पशुं रम्यं राजा चिन्ताम् उपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: kṛtasvastyayano rājā ṛtvigbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalaḥ adṛṣṭvā tu paśuṃ ramyaṃ rājā cintām upeyivān
verses.translation: The king, for whom blessings had been recited and auspicious rites performed by the priests, not seeing the lovely animal, fell into anxiety.

verses.sanskrit: अटन्तः सागराः सर्वे देवलोकम् उपागमन् हयं तम् अनुचिन्वन्तस् तत्रापि न हयो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: aṭantaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve devalokam upāgaman hayaṃ tam anucinvantas tatrāpi na hayo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Wandering, all the sons of Sagara came to the world of the gods, searching for the horse, but the horse was not there either.

verses.transliteration: tato mahīṃ samājagmuḥ parvatāṃś ca vanāni ca tatrāpi ca hayaṃ naiva dṛṣṭavanto nṛpātmajāḥ
verses.translation: Then they came to the earth, the mountains and forests; there too the princes did not see the horse.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र दैवी वाग् अभवत् तदा रसातले हयो बद्ध आस्ते नान्यत्र सागराः
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra daivī vāg abhavat tadā rasātale hayo baddha āste nānyatra sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: Meanwhile a divine voice arose there: "The horse is tied in Rasatala and nowhere else, O sons of Sagara."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा ततो वाक्यं गन्तुकामा रसातलम् अखनन् पृथिवीं सर्वां परितः सागरास् ततः
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ gantukāmā rasātalam akhanan pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ paritaḥ sāgarās tataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words and wishing to go to Rasatala, the sons of Sagara dug up the whole earth all around.

verses.sanskrit: ते क्षुधार्ता मृदं शुष्कां भक्षयन्तस् त्व् अहर्निशम् न्यखनंश् चापि जग्मुश् च सत्वरास् ते रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: te kṣudhārtā mṛdaṃ śuṣkāṃ bhakṣayantas tv aharniśam nyakhanaṃś cāpi jagmuś ca satvarās te rasātalam
verses.translation: Tormented by hunger, eating dry earth day and night, they dug and quickly went to Rasatala.

verses.sanskrit: तान् आगतान् भूपसुतान् सागरान् बलिनः कृतीन् श्रुत्वा रक्षांसि संत्रस्ता व्यगमन् कपिलान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: tān āgatān bhūpasutān sāgarān balinaḥ kṛtīn śrutvā rakṣāṃsi saṃtrastā vyagaman kapilāntikam
verses.translation: Hearing that those mighty, skilful sons of the king had come, the Rakshasas, terrified, went near Kapila.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कपिलो ऽपि महाप्राज्ञस् तत्र शेते रसातले पुरा च साधितं तेन देवानां कार्यम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kapilo 'pi mahāprājñas tatra śete rasātale purā ca sādhitaṃ tena devānāṃ kāryam uttamam
verses.translation: The very wise Kapila lay there in Rasatala; formerly he had accomplished an excellent task for the gods.
