verses.sanskrit: विनिद्रेण ततः श्रान्तः सिद्धे कार्ये सुरान् प्रति अब्रवीत् कपिलः श्रीमान् निद्रास्थानं प्रयच्छथ
verses.transliteration: vinidreṇa tataḥ śrāntaḥ siddhe kārye surān prati abravīt kapilaḥ śrīmān nidrāsthānaṃ prayacchatha
verses.translation: Weary from sleeplessness when the task had been accomplished, the glorious Kapila said to the gods, "Give me a place to sleep."

verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ dadus tasmai punar āha surān muniḥ yo mām utthāpayen mando bhasmī bhūyāc ca satvaram
verses.translation: They gave him Rasatala; the sage said again to the gods, "Whatever fool wakes me will quickly become ashes.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शये तलगतो नो चेन् न स्वप्न एव हि तथेत्य् उक्तः सुरगणैस् तत्र शेते रसातले
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaye talagato no cen na svapna eva hi tathety uktaḥ suragaṇais tatra śete rasātale
verses.translation: Then I will lie below; otherwise there is no sleep." The hosts of gods said, "So be it," and he lies in Rasatala.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभावं ते ज्ञात्वा राक्षसा मायया युताः सागराणां च सर्वेषां वधोपायं प्रचक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāvaṃ te jñātvā rākṣasā māyayā yutāḥ sāgarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vadhopāyaṃ pracakrire
verses.translation: Knowing his power, the Rakshasas, possessed of illusion, devised a means to kill all the sons of Sagara.

verses.transliteration: vinā yuddhena te bhītā rākṣasāḥ satvarās tadā āgatya yatra sa muniḥ kapilaḥ kopano mahān
verses.translation: Afraid of fighting, the Rakshasas quickly came to where that very irascible sage Kapila was,

verses.sanskrit: शिरोदेशे हयं ते वै बद्ध्वाथ त्वरयान्विताः दूरे स्थित्वा मौनिनश् च प्रेक्षन्तः किं भवेद् इति
verses.transliteration: śirodeśe hayaṃ te vai baddhvātha tvarayānvitāḥ dūre sthitvā mauninaś ca prekṣantaḥ kiṃ bhaved iti
verses.translation: and hastily tying the horse near his head, stood far off in silence, watching to see what would happen.

verses.transliteration: sāgarā brahmaśāpena naṣṭāḥ sarve rasātale eko 'pi ca vanaṃ prāpta idānīṃ kā gatir mama
verses.translation: "The sons of Sagara have all perished in Rasatala by a brahmin's curse, and the one has gone to the forest; now what is my course?"

verses.translation: The son of Asamanjas was known as Amshuman; the king had the boy brought and told him the task.

verses.transliteration: kapilaṃ ca samārādhya aṃśumān api bālakaḥ sagarāya hayaṃ prādāt tataḥ pūrṇo 'bhavat kratuḥ
verses.translation: Having propitiated Kapila, the boy Amshuman gave the horse to Sagara, and then the sacrifice was completed.

verses.transliteration: tasyāpi putras tejasvī dilīpa iti dhārmikaḥ tasyāpi putro matimān bhagīratha iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: His son was the radiant and righteous Dilipa; his son was known as the wise Bhagiratha.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहानां सर्वेषां गतिं श्रुत्वा सुदुःखितः सगरं नृपशार्दूलं पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ gatiṃ śrutvā suduḥkhitaḥ sagaraṃ nṛpaśārdūlaṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing of the fate of all his grandfathers, greatly grieved, he humbly asked Sagara, tiger among kings:

verses.sanskrit: सागराणां तु सर्वेषां निष्कृतिस् तु कथं भवेत् भगीरथं नृपः प्राह कपिलो वेत्ति पुत्रक
verses.transliteration: sāgarāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niṣkṛtis tu kathaṃ bhavet bhagīrathaṃ nṛpaḥ prāha kapilo vetti putraka
verses.translation: "How can there be deliverance for all the sons of Sagara?" The king said to Bhagiratha, "Kapila knows, my son."

verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bālaḥ prāyād rasātalam kapilaṃ ca namaskṛtvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat
verses.translation: Hearing his words, the boy went to Rasatala, bowed to Kapila and told him everything.

verses.transliteration: sa munis tu ciraṃ dhyātvā tapasārādhya śaṃkaram jaṭājalena svapitṝn āplāvya nṛpasattama
verses.translation: The sage meditated long and said, "Having propitiated Shankara with austerity, flood your ancestors with the water of his locks, O best of kings;

verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtārtho bhavitā tvaṃ ca te pitaras tathā tathā karomīti muniṃ praṇamya punar abravīt
verses.translation: then you and your ancestors will be fulfilled." Saying "I will do so," he bowed to the sage and said again:

verses.transliteration: kva gacche 'haṃ muniśreṣṭha kartavyaṃ cāpi tad vada
verses.translation: "Where should I go, best of sages, and what must I do? Tell me that."

verses.sanskrit: कैलासं तं नरश्रेष्ठ गत्वा स्तुहि महेश्वरम् तपः कुरु यथाशक्ति ततश् चेप्सितम् आप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: kailāsaṃ taṃ naraśreṣṭha gatvā stuhi maheśvaram tapaḥ kuru yathāśakti tataś cepsitam āpsyasi
verses.translation: "Go to Kailasa, best of men, and praise Maheshvara; practise austerity as you are able, and then you will obtain what you desire."

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा स मुनेर् वाक्यं मुनिं नत्वा त्व् अगान् नगम् कैलासं स शुचिर् भूत्वा बालो बालक्रियान्वितः तपसे निश्चयं कृत्वा उवाच स भगीरथः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā sa muner vākyaṃ muniṃ natvā tv agān nagam kailāsaṃ sa śucir bhūtvā bālo bālakriyānvitaḥ tapase niścayaṃ kṛtvā uvāca sa bhagīrathaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the sage's words, he bowed to him and went to the mountain Kailasa; becoming pure, the boy, with a boy's ways, resolved on austerity, and Bhagiratha said:

verses.sanskrit: बालो ऽहं बालबुद्धिश् च बालचन्द्रधर प्रभो नाहं किमपि जानामि ततः प्रीतो भव प्रभो
verses.transliteration: bālo 'haṃ bālabuddhiś ca bālacandradhara prabho nāhaṃ kimapi jānāmi tataḥ prīto bhava prabho
verses.translation: "I am a child with a child's mind, O Lord who bears the young moon; I know nothing; therefore be pleased, O Lord.

verses.transliteration: vāgbhir manobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye tebhyo hitārthaṃ tv iha cāmareśa somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam
verses.translation: To those who, devoted to my good, sometimes help me by words, thoughts and deeds — for their good, O lord of the immortals, I bow here to Soma, worshipped by the gods and others.

verses.translation: May Shiva fulfil the wishes of those by whom I was begotten and raised, of the same lineage and the same dharma; I ever bow to the one crowned with the young moon."

verses.translation: As he spoke thus, Shiva appeared before him and, offering a boon, said to Bhagiratha:

verses.sanskrit: यन् न साध्यं सुरगणैर् देयं तत् ते मया ध्रुवम् वदस्व निर्भयो भूत्वा भगीरथ महामते
verses.transliteration: yan na sādhyaṃ suragaṇair deyaṃ tat te mayā dhruvam vadasva nirbhayo bhūtvā bhagīratha mahāmate
verses.translation: "What cannot be accomplished by the hosts of gods I will surely give you; speak without fear, O wise Bhagiratha."

verses.translation: Bhagiratha, bowing to the Lord, joyfully said to Shankara:

verses.transliteration: jaṭāsthitāṃ pitṝṇāṃ me pāvanāya saridvarām tām eva dehi deveśa sarvam āptaṃ tato bhavet
verses.translation: "Give me the best of rivers who dwells in your locks, to purify my ancestors, O lord of gods; then all will be attained."

verses.translation: Maheshvara laughed and said to Bhagiratha:

verses.transliteration: dattā mayeyaṃ te putra punas tāṃ stuhi suvrata
verses.translation: "She is given to you by me, my son; now praise her, O one of good vows."

verses.transliteration: tad devavacanaṃ śrutvā tadarthaṃ tu tapo mahat stutiṃ cakāra gaṅgāyā bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the god's words, for that purpose he performed great austerity and praised the Ganga with devotion and a disciplined mind.

verses.translation: Obtaining her grace too, the boy, not like a boy, took the Ganga received from Maheshvara and went to Rasatala.

verses.translation: He told the great-souled sage Kapila, and having carefully established the Ganga in the manner described,

verses.translation: he circumambulated and, with joined palms, said:

verses.sanskrit: देवि मे पितरः शापात् कपिलस्य महामुनेः प्राप्तास् ते विगतिं मातस् तस्मात् तान् पातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: devi me pitaraḥ śāpāt kapilasya mahāmuneḥ prāptās te vigatiṃ mātas tasmāt tān pātum arhasi
verses.translation: "O Goddess, my ancestors, through the curse of the great sage Kapila, have gone to a bad fate, Mother; therefore you should save them."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suranadī sarveṣām upakārikā lokānām upakārārthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ pāvanāya ca
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," the river of the gods, benefactor of all, for the benefit of the worlds and to purify the ancestors,

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यपीतस्याम्भोधेः पूरणाय विशेषतः स्मरणाद् एव पापानां नाशाय सुरनिम्नगा
verses.transliteration: agastyapītasyāmbhodheḥ pūraṇāya viśeṣataḥ smaraṇād eva pāpānāṃ nāśāya suranimnagā
verses.translation: and especially to fill the ocean drunk by Agastya, the river of the gods, who destroys sins by mere remembrance,

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथोदितं चक्रे रसातलतले स्थितान् भस्मीभूतान् नृपसुतान् सागरांश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathoditaṃ cakre rasātalatale sthitān bhasmībhūtān nṛpasutān sāgarāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: did as Bhagiratha asked: the princes, sons of Sagara, lying burned to ashes at the bottom of Rasatala,

verses.sanskrit: विनिर्दग्धान् अथाप्लाव्य खातपूरम् अथाकरोत् ततो मेरुं समाप्लाव्य स्थितां बालो ऽब्रवीन् नृपः
verses.transliteration: vinirdagdhān athāplāvya khātapūram athākarot tato meruṃ samāplāvya sthitāṃ bālo 'bravīn nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: she flooded, and then filled up the excavation. Then, having flooded Meru, as she stood there, the boy king said:

verses.sanskrit: कर्मभूमौ त्वया भाव्यं तथेत्य् आगाद् धिमालयम् हिमवत्पर्वतात् पुण्याद् भारतं वर्षम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: karmabhūmau tvayā bhāvyaṃ tathety āgād dhimālayam himavatparvatāt puṇyād bhārataṃ varṣam abhyagāt
verses.translation: "You must be in the land of action." Saying "So be it," she came to the Himalaya; from the holy Himalaya mountain she came to the land of Bharata.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्यतः पुण्यनदी प्रायात् पूर्वार्णवं प्रति एवम् एषापि ते प्रोक्ता गङ्गा क्षात्रा महामुने
verses.transliteration: tanmadhyataḥ puṇyanadī prāyāt pūrvārṇavaṃ prati evam eṣāpi te proktā gaṅgā kṣātrā mahāmune
verses.translation: Through its midst the holy river went toward the eastern ocean. Thus this Ganga too has been told to you, the kshatriya one, O great sage.

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरी वैष्णवी च सैव ब्राह्मी च पावनी भागीरथी देवनदी हिमवच्छिखराश्रया
verses.transliteration: māheśvarī vaiṣṇavī ca saiva brāhmī ca pāvanī bhāgīrathī devanadī himavacchikharāśrayā
verses.translation: She is of Maheshvara, of Vishnu and of Brahma, and purifying; the Bhagirathi, the river of the gods, resting on the peaks of the Himalaya.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरजटावारि एवं द्वैविध्यम् आगतम् विन्ध्यस्य दक्षिणे गङ्गा गौतमी सा निगद्यते उत्तरे सापि विन्ध्यस्य भागीरथ्य् अभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: maheśvarajaṭāvāri evaṃ dvaividhyam āgatam vindhyasya dakṣiṇe gaṅgā gautamī sā nigadyate uttare sāpi vindhyasya bhāgīrathy abhidhīyate
verses.translation: Thus the water of Maheshvara's locks became twofold: south of the Vindhya the Ganga is called the Gautami; north of the Vindhya she is called the Bhagirathi.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मनस् तृप्तिम् आधत्ते कथाः शृण्वत् त्वयेरिताः पृथक् तीर्थफलं श्रोतुं प्रवृत्तं मम मानसम्
verses.transliteration: na manas tṛptim ādhatte kathāḥ śṛṇvat tvayeritāḥ pṛthak tīrthaphalaṃ śrotuṃ pravṛttaṃ mama mānasam
verses.translation: He went to the river Kalindl that had gently moving ripples and waves and that appeared to be smiling all round by the clusters of foams sticking to the banks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रमशो ब्राह्मणानीतां गङ्गां मे प्रथमं वद पृथक् तीर्थफलं पुण्यं सेतिहासं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kramaśo brāhmaṇānītāṃ gaṅgāṃ me prathamaṃ vada pṛthak tīrthaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ setihāsaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: There he saw a hideous and extremely terrible whirl¬ pool of serpent Kaliya, which had been defiled by sparks of poisonous fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw a hideous and extremely terrible whirl¬ pool of serpent Kaliya, which had been defiled by sparks of poisonous fire.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानां च पृथग् भावं फलं माहात्म्यम् एव च सर्वं वक्तुं न शक्नोमि न च त्वं श्रवणे क्षमः
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāṃ ca pṛthag bhāvaṃ phalaṃ māhātmyam eva ca sarvaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknomi na ca tvaṃ śravaṇe kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: As the fire of poison spread, the great trees that grew on its banks were burnt. Even the birds (that flew over it) had been burnt when they came into contact with its watery spray as the wind wafted it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the fire of poison spread, the great trees that grew on its banks were burnt. Even the birds (that flew over it) had been burnt when they came into contact with its watery spray as the wind wafted it up.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि किंचिद् वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद यत्नतः यान्य् उक्तानि च तीर्थानि श्रुतिवाक्यानि यानि च
verses.transliteration: tathāpi kiṃcid vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ yāny uktāni ca tīrthāni śrutivākyāni yāni ca
verses.translation: On seeing that highly terrible serpent which was like another jaw of Death lord Krsna thought thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that highly terrible serpent which was like another jaw of Death lord Krsna thought thus:

verses.sanskrit: तानि वक्ष्यामि संक्षेपान् नमस्कृत्वा त्रिलोचनम् यत्रासौ भगवान् आसीत् प्रत्यक्षस् त्र्यम्बको मुने
verses.transliteration: tāni vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepān namaskṛtvā trilocanam yatrāsau bhagavān āsīt pratyakṣas tryambako mune
verses.translation: Therefore, I shall climb this great tree of Kadamba which is not very far off from it, I shall jump into the eddy of the serpent that causes destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, I shall climb this great tree of Kadamba which is not very far off from it, I shall jump into the eddy of the serpent that causes destruction.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकं नाम तत् तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् वाराहम् अपरं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tryambakaṃ nāma tat tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam vārāham aparaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Those trees that were sprinkled with the hot water heated by the flames of the defiled person of the serpent blazed suddenly. The flames then spread over all the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those trees that were sprinkled with the hot water heated by the flames of the defiled person of the serpent blazed suddenly. The flames then spread over all the quarters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि नाम विष्णोर् यथाभवत् पुरा देवान् पराभूय यज्ञम् आदाय राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi nāma viṣṇor yathābhavat purā devān parābhūya yajñam ādāya rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Krsna clapped and dashed against the whirlpool with his arms. On hearing that sound the king of serpents approached him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Krsna clapped and dashed against the whirlpool with his arms. On hearing that sound the king of serpents approached him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रसातलम् अनुप्राप्तः सिन्धुसेन इति श्रुतः यज्ञे तलम् अनुप्राप्ते निर्यज्ञा ह्य् अभवन् मही
verses.transliteration: rasātalam anuprāptaḥ sindhusena iti śrutaḥ yajñe talam anuprāpte niryajñā hy abhavan mahī
verses.translation: His eyes turned red due to wrath; his hoods became agitated through poisonous flames. He was surrounded by pink-coloured serpents of great poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: His eyes turned red due to wrath; his hoods became agitated through poisonous flames. He was surrounded by pink-coloured serpents of great poison.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नायं लोको ऽस्ति न परो यज्ञे नष्ट इतीत्वराः सुरास् तम् एव विविशू रसातलम् अनुद्विषम्
verses.transliteration: nāyaṃ loko 'sti na paro yajñe naṣṭa itītvarāḥ surās tam eva viviśū rasātalam anudviṣam
verses.translation: There were hundreds of wives of the serpent. They appeared splendid by their attractive necklaces. Their earrings sparkled as they moved along with their jerking trembling bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were hundreds of wives of the serpent. They appeared splendid by their attractive necklaces. Their earrings sparkled as they moved along with their jerking trembling bodies.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नाशक्नुवंस् तु तं जेतुं देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः विष्णुं पुराणपुरुषं गत्वा तस्मै न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: nāśaknuvaṃs tu taṃ jetuṃ devā indrapurogamāḥ viṣṇuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ gatvā tasmai nyavedayan
verses.translation: On seeing him fallen there afflicted by the bodies of serpents, the cowherd lads went back to Vraja (the colony of cowherds) and lamented in their excessive grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him fallen there afflicted by the bodies of serpents, the cowherd lads went back to Vraja (the colony of cowherds) and lamented in their excessive grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसस्य तु तत् कर्म यज्ञभ्रंशम् अशेषतः ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् वाराहं वपुर् आस्थितः
verses.transliteration: rākṣasasya tu tat karma yajñabhraṃśam aśeṣataḥ tataḥ provāca bhagavān vārāhaṃ vapur āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: In his. delusion Krsna went into the eddy of Kaliya. He has sunk into it. He is being bitten by the king of serpents. Hence, all of you come. Do not delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his. delusion Krsna went into the eddy of Kaliya. He has sunk into it. He is being bitten by the king of serpents. Hence, all of you come. Do not delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिर् गत्वा चैव रसातलम् आनयिष्ये मखं पुण्यं हत्वा राक्षसपुंगवान्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇir gatvā caiva rasātalam ānayiṣye makhaṃ puṇyaṃ hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavān
verses.translation: On hearing these words comparable to the stunning blow of the thunderbolt, the cowherds and the cowherdesses, Yosoda and others, hastened to the eddy.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words comparable to the stunning blow of the thunderbolt, the cowherds and the cowherdesses, Yosoda and others, hastened to the eddy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वः प्रयान्तु सुराः सर्वे व्येतु वो मानसो ज्वरः येन गङ्गा तलं प्राप्ता पथा तेनैव चक्रधृक्
verses.transliteration: svaḥ prayāntu surāḥ sarve vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ yena gaṅgā talaṃ prāptā pathā tenaiva cakradhṛk
verses.translation: Rama of wonderful exploits, Nandagopa and other cowherds hastened to Yamuna, desirous of seeing Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama of wonderful exploits, Nandagopa and other cowherds hastened to Yamuna, desirous of seeing Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जगाम तरसा पुत्र भुवं भित्त्वा रसातलम् स वराहवपुः श्रीमान् रसातलनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: jagāma tarasā putra bhuvaṃ bhittvā rasātalam sa varāhavapuḥ śrīmān rasātalanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, staring anxiously at the face of his son, Nandagopa stood motionless. The highly blessed Yosoda was also like that.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, staring anxiously at the face of his son, Nandagopa stood motionless. The highly blessed Yosoda was also like that.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसान् दानवान् हत्वा मुखे धृत्वा महाध्वरम् वाराहरूपी भगवान् मखम् आदाय यज्ञभुक्
verses.transliteration: rākṣasān dānavān hatvā mukhe dhṛtvā mahādhvaram vārāharūpī bhagavān makham ādāya yajñabhuk
verses.translation: The cowherdesses and others looked on helplessly. In their extreme distress and grief they wept continuously owing to their love for Kcs'ava. Those ladies said in the frightened timidity of their minds: Ail of us shall now enter this great eddy of the king of serpents alongwith Yasoda. It is not proper on our part to go back to our colony.
verses.wordMeaning: The cowherdesses and others looked on helplessly. In their extreme distress and grief they wept continuously owing to their love for Kcs'ava.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The cowherdesses and others looked on helplessly. In their extreme distress and grief they wept continuously owing to their love for Kcs'ava.…
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येन प्राप तलं विष्णुः पथा तेनैव शत्रुजित् मुखे न्यस्य महायज्ञं निश्चक्राम रसातलात्
verses.transliteration: yena prāpa talaṃ viṣṇuḥ pathā tenaiva śatrujit mukhe nyasya mahāyajñaṃ niścakrāma rasātalāt
verses.translation: Vyasa said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मगिरौ देवाः प्रतीक्षां चक्रिरे हरेः पथस् तस्माद् विनिःसृत्य गङ्गास्रवणम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmagirau devāḥ pratīkṣāṃ cakrire hareḥ pathas tasmād viniḥsṛtya gaṅgāsravaṇam abhyagāt
verses.translation: He saw Nanda extremely distressed with his eyes fixed to his face. He saw Yasoda perturbed and faintingwithout being fully aware of his greatness. With both of his hands he made the middle hood bend down. As the head of the serpent king became bent he rode and danced on it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw Nanda extremely distressed with his eyes fixed to his face. He saw Yasoda perturbed and faintingwithout being fully aware of his greatness. With both of his hands he made the middle hood bend down. As the head of the serpent king became bent he rode and danced on it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्षालयच् च स्वाङ्गानि असृग्लिप्तानि नारद गङ्गाम्भसा तत्र कुण्डं वाराहम् अभवत् ततः
verses.transliteration: prākṣālayac ca svāṅgāni asṛgliptāni nārada gaṅgāmbhasā tatra kuṇḍaṃ vārāham abhavat tataḥ
verses.translation: The hood of the serpent became wounded due to the kicks from the feet of Kr§na whenever the hood was raised. After the kick his head bent low.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hood of the serpent became wounded due to the kicks from the feet of Kr§na whenever the hood was raised. After the kick his head bent low.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखे न्यस्तं महायज्ञं देवानां पुरतो हरिः दत्तवांस् त्रिदशश्रेष्ठो मुखाद् यज्ञो ऽभ्यजायत
verses.transliteration: mukhe nyastaṃ mahāyajñaṃ devānāṃ purato hariḥ dattavāṃs tridaśaśreṣṭho mukhād yajño 'bhyajāyata
verses.translation: By frequent hits and blows from Krsna the serpent became unconscious and deluded. Due to the fierce kickings he vomited blood. On seeing that serpent had been compelled to bend his head and neck to shed blood from his mouth the wives of the serpent lord sought shelter in Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: By frequent hits and blows from Krsna the serpent became unconscious and deluded. Due to the fierce kickings he vomited blood. On seeing that serpent had been compelled to bend his head and neck to shed blood from his mouth the wives of the serpent lord sought shelter in Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति यज्ञाङ्गं प्रधानं स्रुव उच्यते वाराहरूपम् अभवद् एवं वै कारणान्तरात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti yajñāṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ sruva ucyate vārāharūpam abhavad evaṃ vai kāraṇāntarāt
verses.translation: O serpent, you must not stay any longer in the waters of Yamuna, go to the waters of the ocean along with your sons and attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: O serpent, you must not stay any longer in the waters of Yamuna, go to the waters of the ocean along with your sons and attendants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुण्यतमं तीर्थं वाराहं सर्वकामदम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ sarvakāmadam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: O serpent, when he sees the imprints of my feet on your head during your stay in the ocean, Garuqla the enemy of serpents will not strike you. After saying this lordHari released the king of serpents. The serpent lord bowed down to Krsna and went to the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O serpent, when he sees the imprints of my feet on your head during your stay in the ocean, Garuqla the enemy of serpents will not strike you. After saying this lordHari released the king of serpents. The serpent lord bowed down to Krsna and went to the ocean.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितो ऽपि यः कश्चित् पितॄन् स्मरति पुण्यकृत् विमुक्ताः सर्वपापेभ्यः पितरः स्वर्गम् आप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: tatra sthito 'pi yaḥ kaścit pitṝn smarati puṇyakṛt vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ pitaraḥ svargam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Even as all the living beings stood watching, the serpent king abandoned his white eddy and went away along with servants, children and kinsmen accompanied by all his wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as all the living beings stood watching, the serpent king abandoned his white eddy and went away along with servants, children and kinsmen accompanied by all his wives.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशावर्तस्य माहात्म्यम् अहं वक्तुं न ते क्षमः तस्य स्मरणमात्रेण कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: kuśāvartasya māhātmyam ahaṃ vaktuṃ na te kṣamaḥ tasya smaraṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: Once again, Bala and Keava started tending the cows together. Wandering along the forest they came to the beautiful grove of palmyre trees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Once again, Bala and Keava started tending the cows together. Wandering along the forest they came to the beautiful grove of palmyre trees.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुशावर्तम् इति ख्यातं नराणां सर्वकामदम् कुशेनावर्तितं यत्र गौतमेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: kuśāvartam iti khyātaṃ narāṇāṃ sarvakāmadam kuśenāvartitaṃ yatra gautamena mahātmanā
verses.translation: The Asura Dhenuka occupied that palmyra grove after assuming the form of a donkey. Human flesh and beef consti¬ tuted his diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asura Dhenuka occupied that palmyra grove after assuming the form of a donkey. Human flesh and beef consti¬ tuted his diet.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कुशेनावर्तयित्वा तु आनयाम् आस तां मुनिः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पितॄणां तृप्तिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: kuśenāvartayitvā tu ānayām āsa tāṃ muniḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam
verses.translation: On seeing the beautiful palm grove richlyendowed with plenty of fruits, the cowherds became desirous of plucking those fruits. They said thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the beautiful palm grove richlyendowed with plenty of fruits, the cowherds became desirous of plucking those fruits. They said thus:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नीलगङ्गा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा निःसृता नीलपर्वतात् तत्र स्नानादि यत् किंचित् करोति प्रयतो नरः
verses.transliteration: nīlagaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā niḥsṛtā nīlaparvatāt tatra snānādi yat kiṃcit karoti prayato naraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the cowherd lads, Sariikar- sana and Krsna knocked clown the palm fruits to the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the cowherd lads, Sariikar- sana and Krsna knocked clown the palm fruits to the ground.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् पितॄणां तृप्तिदायकम् विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु कपोतं तीर्थम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kapotaṃ tīrtham uttamam
verses.translation: On hearing the sound of the falling palmyra fruits the evil-minded king of Asuras, a son of Diti who had assumed the form of a donkey came there in great fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the sound of the falling palmyra fruits the evil-minded king of Asuras, a son of Diti who had assumed the form of a donkey came there in great fury.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रूपं च वक्ष्यामि मुने शृणु महाफलम् तत्र ब्रह्मगिरौ कश्चिद् व्याधः परमदारुणः
verses.transliteration: tasya rūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi mune śṛṇu mahāphalam tatra brahmagirau kaścid vyādhaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: As he fell down from the top of the palm tree the dead donkey brought with him many fruits on the Earth like a gust of wind bringing down clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he fell down from the top of the palm tree the dead donkey brought with him many fruits on the Earth like a gust of wind bringing down clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हिनस्ति ब्राह्मणान् साधून् यतीन् गोपक्षिणो मृगान् एवंभूतः स पापात्मा क्रोधनो ऽनृतभाषणः
verses.transliteration: hinasti brāhmaṇān sādhūn yatīn gopakṣiṇo mṛgān evaṃbhūtaḥ sa pāpātmā krodhano 'nṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna and Balabhadra playfully seized other asuras too in the form of donkeys—this asura's kinsmen came there
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna and Balabhadra playfully seized other asuras too in the form of donkeys—this asura's kinsmen came there
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भीषणाकृतिर् अत्युग्रो नीलाक्षो ह्रस्वबाहुकः दन्तुरो नष्टनासाक्षो ह्रस्वपात् पृथुकुक्षिकः
verses.transliteration: bhīṣaṇākṛtir atyugro nīlākṣo hrasvabāhukaḥ danturo naṣṭanāsākṣo hrasvapāt pṛthukukṣikaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, thereafter without any obstruction the cows comfortably grazed fresh shoots of grass inthatpalmgrove where they had not been grazing before.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, thereafter without any obstruction the cows comfortably grazed fresh shoots of grass inthatpalmgrove where they had not been grazing before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वोदरो ह्रस्वभुजो विकृतो गर्दभस्वनः पाशहस्तः पापचित्तः पापिष्ठः सधनुः सदा
verses.transliteration: hrasvodaro hrasvabhujo vikṛto gardabhasvanaḥ pāśahastaḥ pāpacittaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ sadhanuḥ sadā
verses.translation: Then those two sons of Vasudeva much delighted after killing asura Dhenuka, went to the Bhandlra forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then those two sons of Vasudeva much delighted after killing asura Dhenuka, went to the Bhandlra forest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या तथाभूता अपत्यान्य् अपि नारद तया तु प्रेर्यमाणो ऽसौ विवेश गहनं वनम्
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā apatyāny api nārada tayā tu preryamāṇo 'sau viveśa gahanaṃ vanam
verses.translation: Jesting and shouting, singing and collecting the fruits of the trees those two noble boys shone splendidly like two bulls with tiny horns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jesting and shouting, singing and collecting the fruits of the trees those two noble boys shone splendidly like two bulls with tiny horns.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स जघान मृगान् पापः पक्षिणो बहुरूपिणः पञ्जरे प्राक्षिपत् कांश्चिज् जीवमानांस् तथेतरान्
verses.transliteration: sa jaghāna mṛgān pāpaḥ pakṣiṇo bahurūpiṇaḥ pañjare prākṣipat kāṃścij jīvamānāṃs tathetarān
verses.translation: An Asura named Pralamba, desirous of catching them, came there, even as both of them were sporting about thus. He was disguised as an ordinary cowherd.
verses.commentary: Sense: An Asura named Pralamba, desirous of catching them, came there, even as both of them were sporting about thus. He was disguised as an ordinary cowherd.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधया परितप्ताङ्गो विह्वलस् तृषया तथा भ्रान्तदेशो बहुतरं न्यवर्तत गृहं प्रति
verses.transliteration: kṣudhayā paritaptāṅgo vihvalas tṛṣayā tathā bhrāntadeśo bahutaraṃ nyavartata gṛhaṃ prati
verses.translation: He considered ways and means to find about a vulnerable point in them very quickly. He desired to kill Krsna and Balarama.
verses.commentary: Sense: He considered ways and means to find about a vulnerable point in them very quickly. He desired to kill Krsna and Balarama.

verses.transliteration: tato 'parāhṇe saṃprāpte nivṛtte madhumādhave kṣaṇāt taḍid garjitaṃ ca sābhraṃ caivābhavat tadā
verses.translation: The Danava carried Samkarsana on his shoulders and walked quickly. He did not stop (at the stipulated plaee). He appeared like the cloud carrying the moon.

verses.translation: Unable to bear the weight of Rauhneya the excellent asura increased in size with his body like a cloud in the rainy season.

verses.translation: Then the sinner, exhausted, could not make out water, land, pit, path or directions, nor any refuge.

verses.transliteration: kva gacchāmi kva tiṣṭheyaṃ kiṃ karomīty acintayat sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇān āhartāhaṃ yathāntakaḥ
verses.translation: "Where shall I go? Where shall I stay? What shall I do?" he thought. "I take the lives of all living beings, like Death.

verses.transliteration: mamāpy antakaraṃ bhūtaṃ saṃprāptaṃ cāśmavarṣaṇam trātāraṃ naiva paśyāmi śilāṃ vā vṛkṣam antike
verses.translation: Now a hailstorm has come, a thing that brings my end. I see no protector, no rock or tree nearby."

verses.translation: Thinking thus in many ways, the hunter saw near him in the forest a tree, like the lord of trees, as the moon is among stars,

verses.translation: an excellent, bright tree adorned with branches and shoots. Taking shelter under it, the hunter sat down in wet clothes,

verses.transliteration: smaran bhāryām apatyāni jīveyur athavā na vā etasminn antare tatra cāstaṃ prāpto divākaraḥ
verses.translation: remembering his wife and children — whether they lived or not. Meanwhile the sun set there.

verses.translation: On that same tree a pigeon lived with his wife, surrounded by sons and grandsons, in that excellent tree,

verses.transliteration: sukhena nirbhayo bhūtvā sutṛptaḥ prīta eva ca bahavo vatsarā yātā vasatas tasya pakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: happy and fearless, well satisfied and content; many years had passed as that bird dwelt there.

verses.translation: His wife was devoted to him, and he well pleased with her; in a hollow of that excellent tree, free from water, wind and fire,

verses.transliteration: atrāham asmi baddhaiva vivaśāsmi khagottama ānītāhaṃ lubdhakena baddhā pāśair mahāmate
verses.translation: "I am here, bound and helpless, O best of birds; I have been brought by the hunter and bound with nooses, O wise one.

verses.transliteration: dhanyāsmy anugṛhītāsmi patir vakti guṇān mama sato vāpy asato vāpi kṛtārthāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: I am blessed and favoured that my husband speaks of my virtues, whether present or not; I am fulfilled, without doubt.

verses.transliteration: tuṣṭe bhartari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ viparyaye tu nārīṇām avaśyaṃ nāśam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: When the husband is pleased, all the deities are pleased with women; in the opposite case women surely meet destruction.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दैवं त्वं प्रभुर् मह्यं त्वं सुहृत् त्वं परायणम् त्वं व्रतं त्वं परं ब्रह्म स्वर्गो मोक्षस् त्वम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ daivaṃ tvaṃ prabhur mahyaṃ tvaṃ suhṛt tvaṃ parāyaṇam tvaṃ vrataṃ tvaṃ paraṃ brahma svargo mokṣas tvam eva ca
verses.translation: You are my god, my lord, my friend, my refuge; you are my vow, the supreme Brahman, heaven and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: मा चिन्तां कुरु कल्याण धर्मे बुद्धिं स्थिरां कुरु त्वत्प्रसादाच् च भुक्ता हि भोगाश् च विविधा मया अलं खेदेन मज्जेन धर्मे बुद्धिं कुरु स्थिराम्
verses.transliteration: mā cintāṃ kuru kalyāṇa dharme buddhiṃ sthirāṃ kuru tvatprasādāc ca bhuktā hi bhogāś ca vividhā mayā alaṃ khedena majjena dharme buddhiṃ kuru sthirām
verses.translation: Do not grieve, auspicious one; make your mind firm in dharma. By your grace I have enjoyed various pleasures. Enough of grief; do not sink; make your mind firm in dharma."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा प्रियावाक्यम् उत्ततार नगोत्तमात् यत्र सा पञ्जरस्था तु कपोती वर्तते त्वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā priyāvākyam uttatāra nagottamāt yatra sā pañjarasthā tu kapotī vartate tvaram
verses.translation: Hearing his beloved's words, he quickly came down from the excellent tree to where the pigeon hen was in the cage.

verses.transliteration: tām āgatya priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtavac cāpi lubdhakam mocayāmīti tām āha niśceṣṭo lubdhako 'dhunā
verses.translation: Coming to her, seeing his beloved and the hunter lying as if dead, he said to her, "I will free you; the hunter is now motionless."

verses.transliteration: mā muñcasva mahābhāga jñātvā saṃbandham asthiram lubdhānāṃ khecarā hy annaṃ jīvo jīvasya cāśanam
verses.translation: "Do not free me, illustrious one, knowing that relationships are impermanent; birds are food for hunters, and life is the food of life.

verses.transliteration: nāparādhaṃ smarāmy asya dharmabuddhiṃ sthirāṃ kuru gurur agnir dvijātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ
verses.translation: I do not remember his offence; make your mind firm in dharma. Fire is the teacher of the twice-born, and the brahmin the teacher of the classes;

verses.transliteration: patir eva guruḥ strīṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ abhyāgatam anuprāptaṃ vacanais toṣayanti ye
verses.translation: the husband alone is the teacher of women, and the guest is the teacher of all. Those who please a guest who has come with their words —

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ vāgīśvarī devī tṛptā bhavati niścitam tasyānnasya pradānena śakras tṛptim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: the goddess of speech is surely satisfied with them; by giving him food, Shakra is satisfied;

verses.sanskrit: पितरः पादशौचेन अन्नाद्येन प्रजापतिः तस्योपचाराद् वै लक्ष्मीर् विष्णुना प्रीतिम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pitaraḥ pādaśaucena annādyena prajāpatiḥ tasyopacārād vai lakṣmīr viṣṇunā prītim āpnuyāt
verses.translation: by washing his feet the ancestors, by food and the like Prajapati; by serving him Lakshmi with Vishnu is pleased;

verses.transliteration: śayane sarvadevās tu tasmāt pūjyatamo 'tithiḥ abhyāgatam anuśrāntaṃ sūryoḍhaṃ gṛham āgatam taṃ vidyād devarūpeṇa sarvakratuphalo hy asau

verses.transliteration: abhyāgataṃ śrāntam anuvrajanti devāś ca sarve pitaro 'gnayaś ca tasmin hi tṛpte mudam āpnuvanti gate nirāśe 'pi ca te nirāśāḥ
verses.translation: All the gods, ancestors and fires follow a weary guest; when he is satisfied they rejoice, and when he goes away disappointed, they too are disappointed.

verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvātmanā kānta duḥkhaṃ tyaktvā śamaṃ vraja kṛtvā tiṣṭha śubhāṃ buddhiṃ dharmakṛtyaṃ samācara
verses.translation: Therefore, beloved, with all your being give up grief and become calm; keep a good mind and do the work of dharma.

verses.transliteration: upakāro 'pakāraś ca pravarāv iti saṃmatau upakāriṣu sarvo 'pi karoty upakṛtiṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Help and harm are both considered excellent; everyone helps those who help them in return,

verses.transliteration: apakāriṣu yaḥ sādhuḥ puṇyabhāk sa udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: but the good man who helps those who harm him is declared to partake of merit."

verses.transliteration: āvayor anurūpaṃ ca tvayoktaṃ sādhu manyase kiṃtu vaktavyam apy asti tac chṛṇuṣva varānane
verses.translation: "What you have said befits us both, and you think rightly; but there is something to be said too — hear it, fair-faced one.

verses.translation: Someone supports a thousand, another a hundred, another ten, another himself in comfort; we fill our bellies with difficulty.

verses.transliteration: gartadhānyadhanāḥ kecit kuśūladhanino 'pare ghaṭakṣiptadhanāḥ kecic cañcukṣiptadhanā vayam
verses.translation: Some have wealth of grain in pits, others wealth in granaries, some wealth stored in jars; our wealth is what we carry in our beaks.

verses.transliteration: pūjayāmi kathaṃ śrāntam abhyāgatam imaṃ śubhe
verses.translation: How can I honour this weary guest, dear one?"

verses.transliteration: agnir āpaḥ śubhā vāṇī tṛṇakāṣṭhādikaṃ ca yat etad apy arthine deyaṃ śītārto lubdhakas tv ayam
verses.translation: "Fire, water, kind words, and whatever grass and wood there is — these too should be given to one in need; and this hunter is tormented by cold."

verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā priyāvākyaṃ vṛkṣam āruhya pakṣirāṭ ālokayām āsa tadā vahniṃ dūraṃ dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Hearing his beloved's words, the king of birds climbed the tree and looked about; then he saw a fire far away.

verses.transliteration: sa tu gatvā vahnideśaṃ cañcunolmukam āharat puro 'gniṃ jvālayām āsa lubdhakasya kapotakaḥ
verses.translation: Going to the place of the fire, he brought a firebrand in his beak, and the pigeon lit a fire before the hunter.

verses.transliteration: strīṇām ayaṃ paro dharmo yad bhartur anuveśanam vede ca vihito mārgaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: "This is the highest dharma of women, that they follow their husband; it is the path prescribed in the Veda and honoured in all worlds.

verses.transliteration: vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ bilād uddharate balāt evaṃ tv anugatā nārī saha bhartrā divaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: As a snake-catcher forcibly draws a snake from its hole, so a woman who follows her husband goes with him to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रः कोट्यो ऽर्धकोटी च यानि रोमाणि मानुषे तावत्कालं वसेत् स्वर्गे भर्तारं यानुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: tisraḥ koṭyo 'rdhakoṭī ca yāni romāṇi mānuṣe tāvatkālaṃ vaset svarge bhartāraṃ yānugacchati
verses.translation: She who follows her husband dwells in heaven as long as there are hairs on a human body — three and a half crores."

verses.transliteration: namaskṛtvā bhuvaṃ devān gaṅgāṃ cāpi vanaspatīn āśvāsya tāny apatyāni lubdhakaṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Having bowed to the earth, the gods, the Ganga and the trees, and comforted her children, she said to the hunter:

verses.transliteration: tvatprasādān mahābhāga upapannaṃ mamedṛśam apatyānāṃ kṣamasveha bhartrā yāmi triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: "By your grace, illustrious one, this has come about for me; forgive my children here; I go with my husband to heaven."

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā pakṣiṇī sādhvī praviveśa hutāśanam praviṣṭāyāṃ hutavahe jayaśabdo nyavartata
verses.translation: Having said this, the virtuous bird entered the fire; when she entered the fire, cries of victory arose.

verses.transliteration: gagane sūryasaṃkāśaṃ vimānam atiśobhanam tadārūḍhau suranibhau daṃpatī dadṛśe tataḥ
verses.translation: Then in the sky was seen a very beautiful celestial car like the sun, and the couple seated in it, resembling gods.

verses.translation: Both joyfully spoke to the astonished hunter:

verses.transliteration: gacchāvas tridaśasthānam āpṛṣṭo 'si mahāmate āvayoḥ svargasopānam atithis tvaṃ namo 'stu te
verses.translation: "We are going to the abode of the gods; we take leave of you, O wise one. You, our guest, are our stairway to heaven; salutation to you."

verses.sanskrit: विमानवरम् आरूढौ तौ दृष्ट्वा लुब्धको ऽपि सः सधनुः पञ्जरं त्यक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिर् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: vimānavaram ārūḍhau tau dṛṣṭvā lubdhako 'pi saḥ sadhanuḥ pañjaraṃ tyaktvā kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata
verses.translation: Seeing them mounted on the excellent car, the hunter too, casting away his bow and cage, spoke with joined palms:

verses.transliteration: na tyaktavyo mahābhāgau deyaṃ kiṃcid ajānate aham atrātithir mānyo niṣkṛtiṃ vaktum arhathaḥ
verses.translation: "I should not be abandoned, illustrious ones; something must be given to the ignorant. I, your guest here, am to be honoured; please tell me an expiation."

verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te tasyāḥ pāpaṃ nivedaya tatraivāplavanāt pakṣaṃ sarvapāpair vimokṣyase
verses.translation: "Go to the Gautami, blessings on you; confess your sin to her; by bathing there for a fortnight you will be freed from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तपापः पुनस् तत्र गङ्गायाम् अवगाहने अश्वमेधफलं पुण्यं प्राप्य पुण्यो भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: muktapāpaḥ punas tatra gaṅgāyām avagāhane aśvamedhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpya puṇyo bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Freed from sin, by bathing again in the Ganga there, you will obtain the merit of a horse sacrifice and become holy.

verses.transliteration: saridvarāyāṃ gautamyāṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśasaṃbhuvi punar āplavanād eva tyaktvā dehaṃ malīmasam
verses.translation: In the Gautami, best of rivers, born of Brahma, Vishnu and Ishvara, by bathing again, casting off your impure body,

verses.transliteration: vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ svargaṃ gantāsy asaṃśayam
verses.translation: you will mount an excellent celestial car and go to heaven without doubt."

verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ tābhyāṃ tathā cakre sa lubdhakaḥ vimānavaram ārūḍho divyarūpadharo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Hearing their words, the hunter did so; mounting an excellent celestial car, he took on a divine form,

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरः पूज्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः कपोतश् च कपोती च तृतीयो लुब्धकस् तथा गङ्गायाश् च प्रभावेण सर्वे वै दिवम् आक्रमन्
verses.transliteration: divyamālyāmbaradharaḥ pūjyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ kapotaś ca kapotī ca tṛtīyo lubdhakas tathā gaṅgāyāś ca prabhāveṇa sarve vai divam ākraman
verses.translation: wearing divine garlands and garments, honoured by hosts of Apsarases; the pigeon, the pigeon hen and the hunter as the third — all went to heaven by the power of the Ganga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं कापोतम् इति विश्रुतम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पितृपूजनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kāpotam iti viśrutam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṛpūjanam eva ca
verses.translation: From then on that holy place has been famed as Kapota; bathing, giving and worship of the ancestors there,

verses.sanskrit: जपयज्ञादिकं कर्म तद् आनन्त्याय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: japayajñādikaṃ karma tad ānantyāya kalpate
verses.translation: and rites such as recitation and sacrifice, lead to endless merit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कार्त्तिकेयं परं तीर्थं कौमारम् इति विश्रुतम् यन्नामश्रवणाद् एव कुलवान् रूपवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kārttikeyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kaumāram iti viśrutam yannāmaśravaṇād eva kulavān rūpavān bhavet
verses.translation: Even as Rama and Kesava sported about thus, the rainy season passed off and the season of Autumn set in when lotuses blossomed forth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निहते तारके दैत्ये स्वस्थे जाते त्रिविष्टपे कार्त्तिकेयं सुतं ज्येष्ठं प्रीत्या प्रोवाच पार्वती
verses.transliteration: nihate tārake daitye svasthe jāte triviṣṭape kārttikeyaṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ prītyā provāca pārvatī
verses.translation: On seeing the cowherds enthusiastic and desirous of celebrating the festival the highly intelligent Krsna spoke to the elders out of curiosity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the cowherds enthusiastic and desirous of celebrating the festival the highly intelligent Krsna spoke to the elders out of curiosity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यथासुखं भुङ्क्ष्व भोगांस् त्रैलोक्ये मनसः प्रियान् ममाज्ञया प्रीतमनाः पितुश् चैव प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: yathāsukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃs trailokye manasaḥ priyān mamājñayā prītamanāḥ pituś caiva prasādataḥ
verses.translation: "What is this festival of Indra wherein you are so very delighted?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is this festival of Indra wherein you are so very delighted?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः स वै मात्रा विशाखो देवतास्त्रियः यथासुखं बलाद् रेमे देवपत्न्यो ऽपि रेमिरे
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ sa vai mātrā viśākho devatāstriyaḥ yathāsukhaṃ balād reme devapatnyo 'pi remire
verses.translation: Plants and foodgrains are produced by that rain. We and other embodied beings sustain ourselves by eating them. So we propitiate the Deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Plants and foodgrains are produced by that rain. We and other embodied beings sustain ourselves by eating them. So we propitiate the Deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः संभुज्यमानासु देवपत्नीषु नारद नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं कार्त्तिकेयं दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃbhujyamānāsu devapatnīṣu nārada nāśaknuvan vārayituṃ kārttikeyaṃ divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The land without plants and grass and people afflicted by hunger are not seen in the places where rain-bearing clouds are seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The land without plants and grass and people afflicted by hunger are not seen in the places where rain-bearing clouds are seen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवेदयाम् आसुः पार्वत्यै पुत्रकर्म तत् असकृद् वार्यमाणो ऽपि मात्रा देवैः स शक्तिधृक्
verses.transliteration: tato nivedayām āsuḥ pārvatyai putrakarma tat asakṛd vāryamāṇo 'pi mātrā devaiḥ sa śaktidhṛk
verses.translation: The cloud squeezes the terrestrial water through the rays of the sun. Parjanya, lord of the cloud, showers it on the Earth for Existence and growth of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cloud squeezes the terrestrial water through the rays of the sun. Parjanya, lord of the cloud, showers it on the Earth for Existence and growth of the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नैवासाव् अकरोद् वाक्यं स्त्रीष्व् आसक्तस् तु षण्मुखः अभिशापभयाद् भीता पार्वती पर्यचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: naivāsāv akarod vākyaṃ strīṣv āsaktas tu ṣaṇmukhaḥ abhiśāpabhayād bhītā pārvatī paryacintayat
verses.translation: Hence, during the rainy season, the joyous kings, we and other embodied beings, worship Indra the lord of Devas in the festival.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, during the rainy season, the joyous kings, we and other embodied beings, worship Indra the lord of Devas in the festival.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्नेहात् तथैवेशा देवानां कार्यसिद्धये देवपत्न्यश् चिरं रक्ष्या इति मत्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: putrasnehāt tathaiveśā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye devapatnyaś ciraṃ rakṣyā iti matvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Nandagopa in regard to the worship of Indra, Kfsna spoke thus, in order to rouse the anger of the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Nandagopa in regard to the worship of Indra, Kfsna spoke thus, in order to rouse the anger of the lord of Devas.

verses.transliteration: sa tu mātṛkṛtaṃ jñātvā pravṛttasya nivartanam nivāryaś ced ahaṃ bhogāt kiṃtu pūrvaṃ pravartitaḥ

verses.translation: O brahmins, on hearing these words of his, Nanda and other residents of the colony became delighted with their faces beaming with pleasure. They said "Well said, well said, my boy."

verses.transliteration: yat khyātaṃ kṛttikātīrthaṃ kārttikeyād anantaram tasya śravaṇamātreṇa somapānaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: O brahmins, on being commended thus by the lord of Devas, those clouds let down a terrible gust of wind and downpour for the annihilation of cows. Then, O brahmins, Ear.h, sky and quarters became one as it were, due to the great showers that filled them all.

verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on being commended thus by the lord of Devas, those clouds let down a terrible gust of wind and downpour for the annihilation of cows. Then, O brahmins, Ear.h, sky and quarters became one as it were, due to the great showers that filled them all.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुरा तारकनाशाय भवरेतो ऽपिबत् कविः रेतोगर्भं कविं दृष्ट्वा ऋषिपत्न्यो ऽस्पृहन् मुने
verses.transliteration: purā tārakanāśāya bhavareto 'pibat kaviḥ retogarbhaṃ kaviṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣipatnyo 'spṛhan mune
verses.translation: The cows began to tremble as the winds blew and the showers fell. They gave, up their lives and fell down with their heads and faces directed sideways.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cows began to tremble as the winds blew and the showers fell. They gave, up their lives and fell down with their heads and faces directed sideways.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सप्तर्षीणाम् ऋतुस्नातां वर्जयित्वा त्व् अरुन्धतीम् तासु गर्भः समभवत् षट्सु स्त्रीषु तदाग्नितः
verses.transliteration: saptarṣīṇām ṛtusnātāṃ varjayitvā tv arundhatīm tāsu garbhaḥ samabhavat ṣaṭsu strīṣu tadāgnitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, other cows stood over their calves covering them with their laps. Still other cows were deprived of their calves by the heavy downpour of water. The distressed calves exhibited their wretched faces. The chill wind made their necks shiver. They seemed to tell Krsna cf O save us, O save us" by uttering few feeble words.
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, other cows stood over their calves covering them with their laps. Still other cows were deprived of their calves by the heavy downpour of water. The distressed calves exhibited their wretched faces. The chill wind made their necks shiver.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, other cows stood over their calves covering them with their laps. Still other cows were deprived of their calves by the heavy downpour of water. The distressed calves exhibited their wretched faces. The chill wind made their necks shiver.…

verses.sanskrit: तप्यमानास् तु शोभिष्ठा ऋतुस्नातास् तु ता मुने किं कुर्मः क्व नु गच्छामः किं कृत्वा सुकृतं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tapyamānās tu śobhiṣṭhā ṛtusnātās tu tā mune kiṃ kurmaḥ kva nu gacchāmaḥ kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: On seeing the entire cowherds' colony bewildered with the cows, cowherds and cowherdesses in utter confusion, Hari thought of the means of saving them. He said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the entire cowherds' colony bewildered with the cows, cowherds and cowherdesses in utter confusion, Hari thought of the means of saving them. He said.

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा ता मिथो गङ्गां व्यग्रा गत्वा व्यपीडयन् ताभ्यस् ते निःसृता गर्भाः फेनरूपास् तदाम्भसि
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā tā mitho gaṅgāṃ vyagrā gatvā vyapīḍayan tābhyas te niḥsṛtā garbhāḥ phenarūpās tadāmbhasi
verses.translation: After thinking thus, Kr?na uprooted the Govardhana mountain and playfully held it aloft with a single hand. On being advised thus by him the cowherds and the cowherdesscs who had been afflicted by the heavy downpour, entered the sheltered spot along with their cattle wealth. They kept their utensils and belongings loaded in carts.
verses.wordMeaning: After thinking thus, Kr?na uprooted the Govardhana mountain and playfully held it aloft with a single hand. On being advised thus by him the cowherds and the cowherdesscs who had been afflicted by the heavy downpour, entered the sheltered spot along with their cattle wealth.…

verses.sanskrit: अम्भसा त्व् एकतां प्राप्ता वायुना सर्व एव हि एकरूपस् तदा ताभ्यः षण्मुखः समजायत
verses.transliteration: ambhasā tv ekatāṃ prāptā vāyunā sarva eva hi ekarūpas tadā tābhyaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ samajāyata
verses.translation: Krsna then released the great mountain Govardhana and replaced it in its spot, closely watched by the residents of Vraja with wonderment evident in their faces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna then released the great mountain Govardhana and replaced it in its spot, closely watched by the residents of Vraja with wonderment evident in their faces.

verses.sanskrit: स्रावयित्वा तु तान् गर्भान् ऋषिपत्न्यो गृहान् ययुः तासां विकृतरूपाणि दृष्ट्वा ते ऋषयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: srāvayitvā tu tān garbhān ṛṣipatnyo gṛhān yayuḥ tāsāṃ vikṛtarūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā te ṛṣayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: The lord of Devas, the conqueror of enemies rode on O Kfsna, O Krsna of mighty great arms, listen, why I have come near you. This should not be misunderstood (and thought otherwise) by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Devas, the conqueror of enemies rode on O Kfsna, O Krsna of mighty great arms, listen, why I have come near you. This should not be misunderstood (and thought otherwise) by you.

verses.sanskrit: गम्यतां गम्यतां शीघ्रं स्वैरी वृत्तिर् न युज्यते स्त्रीणाम् इति ततो वत्स निरस्ताः पतिभिस् तु ताः
verses.transliteration: gamyatāṃ gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ svairī vṛttir na yujyate strīṇām iti tato vatsa nirastāḥ patibhis tu tāḥ
verses.translation: You are indeed the great lord, the support of every¬ thing. You have incarnated on the surface of the Earth in order to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are indeed the great lord, the support of every¬ thing. You have incarnated on the surface of the Earth in order to remove the burden of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुःखं समाविष्टास् त्यक्ताः स्वपतिभिश् च षट् ता दृष्ट्वा नारदः प्राह कार्त्तिकेयो हरोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tato duḥkhaṃ samāviṣṭās tyaktāḥ svapatibhiś ca ṣaṭ tā dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha kārttikeyo harodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The cows were saved by you by uprooting the great mountain. O heroic one, I am delighted by this extremely wonderful feat of yours. Q Krsna, I think, the purpose of Devas has been served today. This excellent mountain has been held aloft with a single hand by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cows were saved by you by uprooting the great mountain. O heroic one, I am delighted by this extremely wonderful feat of yours. Q Krsna, I think, the purpose of Devas has been served today. This excellent mountain has been held aloft with a single hand by you.

verses.sanskrit: गाङ्गेयो ऽग्निभवश् चेति विख्यातस् तारकान्तकः तं यान्तु न चिराद् एव प्रीतो भोगं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: gāṅgeyo 'gnibhavaś ceti vikhyātas tārakāntakaḥ taṃ yāntu na cirād eva prīto bhogaṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: Moreover, O Krsna, I have come near you, after being prompted by the cows saved by you. It is very much for your sake also, you are the cause of causes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, O Krsna, I have come near you, after being prompted by the cows saved by you. It is very much for your sake also, you are the cause of causes.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षेर् वचनाद् एव समभ्येत्य च षण्मुखम् कृत्तिकाः स्वयम् एवैतद् यथावृत्तं न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: devarṣer vacanād eva samabhyetya ca ṣaṇmukham kṛttikāḥ svayam evaitad yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: Urged by the words of cows, I shall crown you as Upendra (younger brother of Indra). You shall become Govinda, the lord of cows. Then he brought the bell from his vehicle, Airavata. Filling it with sacred waters he performed the rite of coro¬ nation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by the words of cows, I shall crown you as Upendra (younger brother of Indra). You shall become Govinda, the lord of cows. Then he brought the bell from his vehicle, Airavata. Filling it with sacred waters he performed the rite of coro¬ nation.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यो वाक्यं कृत्तिकाभ्यः कार्त्तिकेयो ऽनुमन्य च गौतमीं यान्तु सर्वाश् च स्नात्वापूज्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tābhyo vākyaṃ kṛttikābhyaḥ kārttikeyo 'numanya ca gautamīṃ yāntu sarvāś ca snātvāpūjya maheśvaram
verses.translation: After crowning Sri Krsna at the instance of cows, the husband of SacI, Devendra spoke to Krsna again humbly and lovingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: After crowning Sri Krsna at the instance of cows, the husband of SacI, Devendra spoke to Krsna again humbly and lovingly.

verses.sanskrit: एष्यामि चाहं तत्रैव यास्यामि सुरमन्दिरम् तथेत्य् उक्त्वा कृत्तिकाश् च स्नात्वा गङ्गां च गौतमीम्
verses.transliteration: eṣyāmi cāhaṃ tatraiva yāsyāmi suramandiram tathety uktvā kṛttikāś ca snātvā gaṅgāṃ ca gautamīm
verses.translation: I know Partha born into the Bharata family from a part of yours. As long as I continue to live on the surface of the Earth, I shall protect him. O Indra, lordofDevas, O suppressor of foes, as long as I stay on the Earth, no one will conquer Arjuna, in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know Partha born into the Bharata family from a part of yours. As long as I continue to live on the surface of the Earth, I shall protect him. O Indra, lordofDevas, O suppressor of foes, as long as I stay on the Earth, no one will conquer Arjuna, in battle.

verses.sanskrit: देवेश्वरं च संपूज्य कार्त्तिकेयानुशासनात् देवेश्वरप्रसादेन प्रययुः सुरमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: deveśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya kārttikeyānuśāsanāt deveśvaraprasādena prayayuḥ suramandiram
verses.translation: • Go, it does not behove you to be sad and anxious for the sake of your son. No enemy of Arjuna, howsoever great, will be too powerful in my presence.
verses.commentary: Sense: • Go, it does not behove you to be sad and anxious for the sake of your son. No enemy of Arjuna, howsoever great, will be too powerful in my presence.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं कृत्तिकातीर्थम् उच्यते कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे तत्र यः स्नानम् आचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ kṛttikātīrtham ucyate kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatra yaḥ snānam ācaret
verses.translation: For the sake of Arjuna I shall protect Yudhisthira and others also. When the Bharata battle is concluded I shall hand over toKunti all these persons led by Yudhisthira, (safe and) unwounded. On being assured thus the king of Devas embraced Kfsna and mounted on his elephant Airavata went back to heaven once again.
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of Arjuna I shall protect Yudhisthira and others also. When the Bharata battle is concluded I shall hand over toKunti all these persons led by Yudhisthira, (safe and) unwounded.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of Arjuna I shall protect Yudhisthira and others also. When the Bharata battle is concluded I shall hand over toKunti all these persons led by Yudhisthira, (safe and) unwounded.…
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वक्रतुफलं प्राप्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः तत्तीर्थस्मरणं वापि यः करोति शृणोति च सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ tattīrthasmaraṇaṃ vāpi yaḥ karoti śṛṇoti ca sarvapāpavinirmukto dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Accompanied by* cowherds and cows Krsna returned to the Vraja along the path sanctified by the loving glances of cowherd lasses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by* cowherds and cows Krsna returned to the Vraja along the path sanctified by the loving glances of cowherd lasses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं तच् छृणुष्व महामुने यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण हयमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva mahāmune yasya śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: When Iridra went away, the cowherds who had wit¬ nessed Krsna of unimpaired activities holding aloft the moun¬ tain Govardhana said to him lovingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: When Iridra went away, the cowherds who had wit¬ nessed Krsna of unimpaired activities holding aloft the moun¬ tain Govardhana said to him lovingly.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मसुतः श्रीमान् विश्वरूपो महाबलः तस्यापि प्रथमः पुत्रस् तत्पुत्रो भौवनो विभुः
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmasutaḥ śrīmān viśvarūpo mahābalaḥ tasyāpi prathamaḥ putras tatputro bhauvano vibhuḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, from this great danger all of us and the cows have been protected by you through this activity of holding up the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed one, from this great danger all of us and the cows have been protected by you through this activity of holding up the mountain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधाः कश्यपस् तस्य सर्वज्ञानविशारदः तम् अपृच्छन् महाबाहुर् भौवनः सार्वभौवनः
verses.transliteration: purodhāḥ kaśyapas tasya sarvajñānaviśāradaḥ tam apṛcchan mahābāhur bhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ
verses.translation: (If this is only)a childish play, it is (really) unrivalled. O dear one, tending of the cows is a profession viewed at with abhorrence. But your activities are divine. How is this? May it be explained to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: (If this is only)a childish play, it is (really) unrivalled. O dear one, tending of the cows is a profession viewed at with abhorrence. But your activities are divine. How is this? May it be explained to us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्ष्ये ऽहं हयमेधैश् च युगपद् दशभिर् मुने इत्य् अपृच्छद् गुरुं विप्रं क्व यक्ष्यामि सुरान् इति
verses.transliteration: yakṣye 'haṃ hayamedhaiś ca yugapad daśabhir mune ity apṛcchad guruṃ vipraṃ kva yakṣyāmi surān iti
verses.translation: Whether you are a Deva or a Danava, whether you are a Yaksa or a Gandharva—You are our kinsman in our consideration. Obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether you are a Deva or a Danava, whether you are a Yaksa or a Gandharva—You are our kinsman in our consideration. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽवदद् देवयजनं तत्र तत्र नृपोत्तम यत्र यत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रावर्तन्त महाक्रतून्
verses.transliteration: so 'vadad devayajanaṃ tatra tatra nṛpottama yatra yatra dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāvartanta mahākratūn
verses.translation: O Kesava, the love of the entire cowherds' colony in¬ cluding women and children is heaped on you. This feat is impossible to Devas too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kesava, the love of the entire cowherds' colony in¬ cluding women and children is heaped on you. This feat is impossible to Devas too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्राभवन्न् ऋषिगणा आर्त्विज्ये मखमण्डले युगपद् दशमेधानि प्रवृत्तानि पुरोधसा
verses.transliteration: tatrābhavann ṛṣigaṇā ārtvijye makhamaṇḍale yugapad daśamedhāni pravṛttāni purodhasā
verses.translation: Your boyhood and this excessive valour, your birth amidst us, not very splendid in itself—all this, on being considered, O Krsna of immeasurable Soul, produces suspicion in us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your boyhood and this excessive valour, your birth amidst us, not very splendid in itself—all this, on being considered, O Krsna of immeasurable Soul, produces suspicion in us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतां नाययुस् तानि दृष्ट्वा चिन्तापरो नृपः विहाय देवयजनं पुनर् अन्यत्र तान् क्रतून्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatāṃ nāyayus tāni dṛṣṭvā cintāparo nṛpaḥ vihāya devayajanaṃ punar anyatra tān kratūn
verses.translation: On being addressed thus by the cowherds, O excellent brahmins, Krsna remained silent for a while with feigned anger (in spite of his) love and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus by the cowherds, O excellent brahmins, Krsna remained silent for a while with feigned anger (in spite of his) love and said.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपाक्रामत् तथा तत्र विघ्नदोषास् तम् आययुः दृष्ट्वापूर्णांस् ततो यज्ञान् राजा गुरुम् अभाषत
verses.transliteration: upākrāmat tathā tatra vighnadoṣās tam āyayuḥ dṛṣṭvāpūrṇāṃs tato yajñān rājā gurum abhāṣata
verses.translation: o cowherds, if due to your relationship with me you
verses.commentary: Sense: o cowherds, if due to your relationship with me you
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देशदोषात् कालदोषान् मम दोषात् तवापि वा पूर्णतां नाप्नुवन्ति स्म दशमेधानि वाजिनः
verses.transliteration: deśadoṣāt kāladoṣān mama doṣāt tavāpi vā pūrṇatāṃ nāpnuvanti sma daśamedhāni vājinaḥ
verses.translation: I am neither a Deva nor a Gandharva, neither a Yaksa nor a Danava. I have become your kinsman. Hence, nothing other than this should be thought of me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am neither a Deva nor a Gandharva, neither a Yaksa nor a Danava. I have become your kinsman. Hence, nothing other than this should be thought of me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च दुःखितो राजा कश्यपेन पुरोधसा गीष्पतेर् भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं गत्वा संवर्तम् ऊचतुः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca duḥkhito rājā kaśyapena purodhasā gīṣpater bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ gatvā saṃvartam ūcatuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Hari and realizing that he had feigned anger due to love, the highly blessed cowherds kept quiet. They gained in strength thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Hari and realizing that he had feigned anger due to love, the highly blessed cowherds kept quiet. They gained in strength thereby.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् युगपत् कार्याण्य् अश्वमेधानि मानद दश संपूर्णतां यान्ति तं देशं तं गुरुं वद
verses.transliteration: bhagavan yugapat kāryāṇy aśvamedhāni mānada daśa saṃpūrṇatāṃ yānti taṃ deśaṃ taṃ guruṃ vada
verses.translation: The lotus-footed lord sang sweet songs in the company of Rama, pleasing to the womenfolk. He feigned that he was observing holy rites there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lotus-footed lord sang sweet songs in the company of Rama, pleasing to the womenfolk. He feigned that he was observing holy rites there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यात्वा ऋषिश्रेष्ठः संवर्तो भौवनं तदा अब्रवीद् गच्छ ब्रह्माणं गुरुं देशं वदिष्यति
verses.transliteration: tato dhyātvā ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ saṃvarto bhauvanaṃ tadā abravīd gaccha brahmāṇaṃ guruṃ deśaṃ vadiṣyati
verses.translation: On hearing the sweet and charming sound of the songs, the cowherd lasses left ofT their abodes and hurriedly came to the place where Krsna stood.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the sweet and charming sound of the songs, the cowherd lasses left ofT their abodes and hurriedly came to the place where Krsna stood.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भौवनो ऽपि महाप्राज्ञः कश्यपेन महात्मना आगत्य माम् अब्रवीच् च गुरुं देशादिकं च यत्
verses.transliteration: bhauvano 'pi mahāprājñaḥ kaśyapena mahātmanā āgatya mām abravīc ca guruṃ deśādikaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: A certain cowherd lass followed his footsteps and sang slowly. Another one listened to it attentively and mentally remembered him.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain cowherd lass followed his footsteps and sang slowly. Another one listened to it attentively and mentally remembered him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहम् अब्रवं पुत्र भौवनं कश्यपं तथा गौतमीं गच्छ राजेन्द्र स देशः क्रतुपुण्यवान्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ham abravaṃ putra bhauvanaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā gautamīṃ gaccha rājendra sa deśaḥ kratupuṇyavān
verses.translation: A certain lass uttered "O Krsna O Krsna 5 ' and be¬ came bashful. A certain lass who was blindly in love with him went near him without shame.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain lass uttered "O Krsna O Krsna 5 ' and be¬ came bashful. A certain lass who was blindly in love with him went near him without shame.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अयम् एव गुरुः श्रेष्ठः कश्यपो वेदपारगः गुरोर् अस्य प्रसादेन गौतम्याश् च प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: ayam eva guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo vedapāragaḥ guror asya prasādena gautamyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by the cowherd lasses and eager to begin the charming dance of Rasa, Govinda approved of the night, charming with the autumnal moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded by the cowherd lasses and eager to begin the charming dance of Rasa, Govinda approved of the night, charming with the autumnal moon.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकेन हयमेधेन तत्र स्नानेन वा पुनः सेत्स्यन्ति तत्र यज्ञाश् च दशमेधानि वाजिनः
verses.transliteration: ekena hayamedhena tatra snānena vā punaḥ setsyanti tatra yajñāś ca daśamedhāni vājinaḥ
verses.translation: The cowherdesses were fully engrossed in the activities of Krsna. When Krsna went to a different spot those lasses walked about in the forests of Vrndavana in groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cowherdesses were fully engrossed in the activities of Krsna. When Krsna went to a different spot those lasses walked about in the forests of Vrndavana in groups.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा भौवनो राजा गौतमीतीरम् अभ्यगात् कश्यपेन सहायेन हयमेधाय दीक्षितः
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā bhauvano rājā gautamītīram abhyagāt kaśyapena sahāyena hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Eager to see Krsna, the cowherdesses wandered here and there, O brahmins, on seeing the footprint of Krsna during that night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eager to see Krsna, the cowherdesses wandered here and there, O brahmins, on seeing the footprint of Krsna during that night.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवृत्ते यज्ञेशे हयमेधे महाक्रतौ संपूर्णे तु तदा राजा पृथिवीं दातुम् उद्यतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravṛtte yajñeśe hayamedhe mahākratau saṃpūrṇe tu tadā rājā pṛthivīṃ dātum udyataḥ
verses.translation: Thus in the course of different types of activities and sports of Krsna, the cowherd lasses became agitated simultane¬ ously and roamed about in the beautiful forest of Vrndavana. From there the cowherd lasses losing their hopes of seeing Krsna, came back to the banks of Yamuna and sang about his conduct.
verses.wordMeaning: Thus in the course of different types of activities and sports of Krsna, the cowherd lasses became agitated simultane¬ ously and roamed about in the beautiful forest of Vrndavana. From there the cowherd lasses losing their hopes of seeing Krsna,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्तरिक्षे वाग् उच्चैर् उवाच नृपसत्तमम् पूजयित्वा स्थितं विप्रान् ऋत्विजो ऽथ सदस्पतीन्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ntarikṣe vāg uccair uvāca nṛpasattamam pūjayitvā sthitaṃ viprān ṛtvijo 'tha sadaspatīn
verses.translation: Thereupon, the cowherdesses saw Krsna of unimpaired activities, the saviour of the three worlds coming to them with his face beaming like a full-blown lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the cowherdesses saw Krsna of unimpaired activities, the saviour of the three worlds coming to them with his face beaming like a full-blown lotus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
