verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन मुने गौतम सुव्रत तुष्टो ऽहं तव धैर्येण ज्ञानेन तपसा तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mune gautama suvrata tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava dhairyeṇa jñānena tapasā tathā
verses.translation: The ladies of the royal harem and the ordinary ladies
verses.commentary: Sense: The ladies of the royal harem and the ordinary ladies
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दत्तेयम् ऋषिशार्दूल कन्या लोकवरा मया इत्य् उक्त्वाहं गौतमाय अहल्याम् अददां मुने
verses.transliteration: datteyam ṛṣiśārdūla kanyā lokavarā mayā ity uktvāhaṃ gautamāya ahalyām adadāṃ mune
verses.translation: Krsna of unmeasured valour fought with Canura. Mustika the asura who was an expert in wrestling, fought with Balarama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna of unmeasured valour fought with Canura. Mustika the asura who was an expert in wrestling, fought with Balarama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जाते विवाहे ते देवाः कृत्वेलायाः प्रदक्षिणम् शनैः शनैर् अथागत्य ददृशुः सर्व एव ते
verses.transliteration: jāte vivāhe te devāḥ kṛtvelāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam śanaiḥ śanair athāgatya dadṛśuḥ sarva eva te
verses.translation: They dragged other cowherds of the same age to them¬ selves in their delight. With his eyes turned red Kamsa spoke to his men who had gathered in large.
verses.commentary: Sense: They dragged other cowherds of the same age to them¬ selves in their delight. With his eyes turned red Kamsa spoke to his men who had gathered in large.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं गौतमम् अहल्यां च दांपत्यं प्रीतिवर्धनम् ते चागत्याथ पश्यन्तो विस्मिताश् चाभवन् सुराः
verses.transliteration: taṃ gautamam ahalyāṃ ca dāṃpatyaṃ prītivardhanam te cāgatyātha paśyanto vismitāś cābhavan surāḥ
verses.translation: Let these two cowherds be forcibly removed from the the assembled group. Let the sinful Nanda be seized and bound with fetters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let these two cowherds be forcibly removed from the the assembled group. Let the sinful Nanda be seized and bound with fetters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्रान्ते विवाहे तु सुराः सर्वे दिवं ययुः समत्सरः शचीभर्ता ताम् ईक्ष्य च दिवं ययौ
verses.transliteration: atikrānte vivāhe tu surāḥ sarve divaṃ yayuḥ samatsaraḥ śacībhartā tām īkṣya ca divaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Let Vasudeva also be punished in the same manner as one not old. Let all these cowherds too who vaunt and swagger along with Krsna, be punished suitably.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Vasudeva also be punished in the same manner as one not old. Let all these cowherds too who vaunt and swagger along with Krsna, be punished suitably.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतमनास् तस्मै गौतमाय महात्मने प्रादां ब्रह्मगिरिं पुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prītamanās tasmai gautamāya mahātmane prādāṃ brahmagiriṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lord of Devas, O most excellent one, O lord, O Kesava, favouring us you have lifted us up.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O lord of Devas, O most excellent one, O lord, O Kesava, favouring us you have lifted us up.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यायां मुनिश्रेष्ठो रेमे तत्र स गौतमः गौतमस्य कथां पुण्यां श्रुत्वा शक्रस् त्रिविष्टपे
verses.transliteration: ahalyāyāṃ muniśreṣṭho reme tatra sa gautamaḥ gautamasya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā śakras triviṣṭape
verses.translation: Since after being propitiated by me the lord has incar¬ nated in my house for destroying the wicked ones, thereby our race is sanctified.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since after being propitiated by me the lord has incar¬ nated in my house for destroying the wicked ones, thereby our race is sanctified.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तम् आश्रमं तं च मुनिं तस्य भार्याम् अनिन्दिताम् भूत्वा ब्राह्मणवेषेण द्रष्टुम् आगाच् छतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: tam āśramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tasya bhāryām aninditām bhūtvā brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa draṣṭum āgāc chatakratuḥ
verses.translation: You remain within living beings. You are stationed within living beings, O soul of everyone, it is from you that the past and future function, invariably.
verses.commentary: Sense: You remain within living beings. You are stationed within living beings, O soul of everyone, it is from you that the past and future function, invariably.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा भवनं तस्य भार्यां च विभवं तथा पापीयसीं मतिं कृत्वा अहल्यां समुदैक्षत
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā bhavanaṃ tasya bhāryāṃ ca vibhavaṃ tathā pāpīyasīṃ matiṃ kṛtvā ahalyāṃ samudaikṣata
verses.translation: O Acyuta, identical with Devas, O incomprehensible and unimaginable one, you are worshipped in the course of a Yajna. O lord of Yajnas, you are the Yajna and the performer of Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Acyuta, identical with Devas, O incomprehensible and unimaginable one, you are worshipped in the course of a Yajna. O lord of Yajnas, you are the Yajna and the performer of Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: नात्मानं न परं देशं कालं शापाद् ऋषेर् भयम् न बुबोध तदा वत्स कामाकृष्टः शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: nātmānaṃ na paraṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ śāpād ṛṣer bhayam na bubodha tadā vatsa kāmākṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: O son ofDevakl, the fact that out of affection, my mind is full of vague notions in respect of you is great decep¬ tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son ofDevakl, the fact that out of affection, my mind is full of vague notions in respect of you is great decep¬ tion.

verses.sanskrit: तद्ध्यानपरमो नित्यं सुरराज्येन गर्वितः संतप्ताङ्गः कथं कुर्यां प्रवेशो मे कथं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: taddhyānaparamo nityaṃ surarājyena garvitaḥ saṃtaptāṅgaḥ kathaṃ kuryāṃ praveśo me kathaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: You are the maker of all living beings. You have neither beginning nor end. Where is the tongue pertaining to me, a mere human being, which says— c O son'.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the maker of all living beings. You have neither beginning nor end. Where is the tongue pertaining to me, a mere human being, which says— c O son'.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं वसन् विप्ररूपो नान्तरं त्व् अध्यगच्छत स कदाचिन् महाप्राज्ञः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकीं क्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vasan viprarūpo nāntaraṃ tv adhyagacchata sa kadācin mahāprājñaḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām
verses.translation: By what expedient, excepting Maya, will that person be born of us, O lord of the Universe, that person from whom all this universe has evolved?
verses.commentary: Sense: By what expedient, excepting Maya, will that person be born of us, O lord of the Universe, that person from whom all this universe has evolved?

verses.sanskrit: सहितो गौतमः शिष्यैर् निर्गतश् चाश्रमाद् बहिः आश्रमं गौतमीं विप्रान् धान्यानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: sahito gautamaḥ śiṣyair nirgataś cāśramād bahiḥ āśramaṃ gautamīṃ viprān dhānyāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: How can that lord be borne by a female human being, that lord in whom the entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings lias been established? How can he be made to lie down in the womb or in the lap?
verses.commentary: Sense: How can that lord be borne by a female human being, that lord in whom the entire universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings lias been established? How can he be made to lie down in the womb or in the lap?

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुं गतो मुनिवर इन्द्रस् तं समुदैक्षत इदम् अन्तरम् इत्य् उक्त्वा चक्रे कार्यं मनःप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: draṣṭuṃ gato munivara indras taṃ samudaikṣata idam antaram ity uktvā cakre kāryaṃ manaḥpriyam
verses.translation: O great lord, be pleased. Protect the universe. Since you are having the partial incarnation you are not my son, O soul of the great lord, O lord of the universe, why do you delude the mind of every one from Brahman to an ordinary tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great lord, be pleased. Protect the universe. Since you are having the partial incarnation you are not my son, O soul of the great lord, O lord of the universe, why do you delude the mind of every one from Brahman to an ordinary tree.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रूपं कृत्वा गौतमस्य प्रियेप्सुः स शतक्रतुः तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीम् अहल्यां वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ kṛtvā gautamasya priyepsuḥ sa śatakratuḥ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīm ahalyāṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: My eyes had been deluded by Maya. I had the feeling "Here is my son." Much afraid of Kamsaat that time, you were taken to the cowherds' colony. O lord of cows, you entered then my intellect, even as I was afraid and agitated due to the enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: My eyes had been deluded by Maya. I had the feeling "Here is my son." Much afraid of Kamsaat that time, you were taken to the cowherds' colony. O lord of cows, you entered then my intellect, even as I was afraid and agitated due to the enemies.

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्टो ऽहं तव गुणै रूपं स्मृत्वा स्खलत्पदः इति ब्रुवन् हसन् हस्तम् आदायान्तः समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣṭo 'haṃ tava guṇai rūpaṃ smṛtvā skhalatpadaḥ iti bruvan hasan hastam ādāyāntaḥ samāviśat
verses.translation: You are Visnu, O lord, you have attained what cannot be attained by Rudras, Maruts, Asvins and Indra for rendering help to the worlds. Our great delusion had surrounded us hitherto.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न बुबोध त्व् अहल्या तं जारं मेने तु गौतमम् रममाणा यथासौख्यं प्रागाच् छिष्यैः स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: na bubodha tv ahalyā taṃ jāraṃ mene tu gautamam ramamāṇā yathāsaukhyaṃ prāgāc chiṣyaiḥ sa gautamaḥ
verses.translation: Ahalya did not recognise him; she took the lover to be Gautama. As she enjoyed herself at will, Gautama came with his disciples.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छन्तं नित्यम् एव अहल्या प्रियवादिनी प्रतियाति प्रियं वक्ति तोषयन्ती च तं गुणैः
verses.transliteration: āgacchantaṃ nityam eva ahalyā priyavādinī pratiyāti priyaṃ vakti toṣayantī ca taṃ guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Every day, when he came, the sweet-spoken Ahalya would come out to meet him, speak lovingly and please him with her virtues.

verses.sanskrit: ताम् अदृष्ट्वा महाप्राज्ञो मेने तन् महद् अद्भुतम् द्वारस्थितं मुनिश्रेष्ठं सर्वे पश्यन्ति नारद
verses.transliteration: tām adṛṣṭvā mahāprājño mene tan mahad adbhutam dvārasthitaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ sarve paśyanti nārada
verses.translation: Not seeing her, the very wise one considered it a great wonder; all saw the best of sages standing at the door, O Narada.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रस्य शालाया रक्षिणो गृहकर्मिणः ऊचुर् मुनिवरं भीता गौतमं विस्मयान्विताः
verses.transliteration: agnihotrasya śālāyā rakṣiṇo gṛhakarmiṇaḥ ūcur munivaraṃ bhītā gautamaṃ vismayānvitāḥ
verses.translation: The guardians of the Agnihotra hall and the household servants, astonished and afraid, said to the excellent sage Gautama:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् किम् इदं चित्रं बहिर् अन्तश् च दृश्यसे प्रिययान्तः प्रविष्टो ऽसि तथैव च बहिर् भवान् अहो तपःप्रभावो ऽयं नानारूपधरो भवान्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan kim idaṃ citraṃ bahir antaś ca dṛśyase priyayāntaḥ praviṣṭo 'si tathaiva ca bahir bhavān aho tapaḥprabhāvo 'yaṃ nānārūpadharo bhavān
verses.translation: "O Lord, what is this wonder? You are seen outside and inside; you have entered within with your beloved, and you are also outside. Ah, this is the power of austerity — you bear many forms."

verses.translation: "Who are you, who in the form of the sage have committed sin?" Saying this, she quickly rose from the bed in fear.

verses.translation: Searching for the lover, the sage saw the cat and said to him, "Who are you? If you lie, I will burn you to ashes."

verses.translation: This sin has come upon me; I have told the truth, O sinless one. I have done a greatly blameworthy deed, O sage.

verses.translation: What will those whose hearts are pierced by the arrows of Love not do? O Brahman, forgive me, great sinner that I am, O treasury of compassion.

verses.transliteration: bhūtvā prasanno bhagavann avadhāraya madvacaḥ tava rūpeṇa cāgatya mām agāt sākṣiṇas tv ime
verses.translation: Be gracious, O Lord, and consider my words: he came to me in your form; these are witnesses."

verses.transliteration: tatheti rakṣiṇaḥ procur ahalyā satyavādinī dhyānenāpi munir jñātvā śāntaḥ prāha pativratām
verses.translation: "It is so," said the guards; "Ahalya speaks the truth." The sage, knowing it through meditation too, became calm and said to the faithful wife:

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु संगता भद्रे गौतम्या सरिदीशया नदी भूत्वा पुना रूपं प्राप्स्यसे प्रियकृन् मम
verses.transliteration: yadā tu saṃgatā bhadre gautamyā saridīśayā nadī bhūtvā punā rūpaṃ prāpsyase priyakṛn mama
verses.translation: "When, dear one, you meet the Gautami, queen of rivers, having become a river, you will regain your form and do what pleases me."

verses.transliteration: ity ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā cakre pativratā tayā tu saṃgatā devyā ahalyā gautamapriyā
verses.translation: Hearing the sage's words, the faithful wife did so; united with that goddess, Ahalya, beloved of Gautama,

verses.sanskrit: पुनस् तद् रूपम् अभवद् यन् मया निर्मितं पुरा ततः कृताञ्जलिपुटः सुरराट् प्राह गौतमम्
verses.transliteration: punas tad rūpam abhavad yan mayā nirmitaṃ purā tataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ surarāṭ prāha gautamam
verses.translation: again had the form that I had fashioned long ago. Then the king of the gods, with joined palms, said to Gautama:

verses.sanskrit: मां पाहि मुनिशार्दूल पापिष्ठं गृहम् आगतम् पादयोः पतितं दृष्ट्वा कृपया प्राह गौतमः
verses.transliteration: māṃ pāhi muniśārdūla pāpiṣṭhaṃ gṛham āgatam pādayoḥ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā prāha gautamaḥ
verses.translation: "Protect me, tiger among sages, a great sinner who has come to your house." Seeing him fallen at his feet, Gautama said with compassion:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ भद्रं ते स्नानं कुरु पुरंदर क्षणान् निर्धूतपापस् त्वं सहस्राक्षो भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te snānaṃ kuru puraṃdara kṣaṇān nirdhūtapāpas tvaṃ sahasrākṣo bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "Go to the Gautami, blessings on you; bathe there, Purandara; in a moment, your sin shaken off, you will become thousand-eyed."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभयं विस्मयकरं दृष्टवान् अस्मि नारद अहल्यायाः पुनर्भावं शचीभर्ता सहस्रदृक्
verses.transliteration: ubhayaṃ vismayakaraṃ dṛṣṭavān asmi nārada ahalyāyāḥ punarbhāvaṃ śacībhartā sahasradṛk
verses.translation: I saw both wonders, O Narada: Ahalya's restoration and the husband of Shachi becoming thousand-eyed.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ahalyāsaṃgamaṃ śubham indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: From then on that auspicious holy place has been famed as the confluence of Ahalya and as Indratirtha, granting all desires to men.

verses.transliteration: tasmād apy aparaṃ tīrthaṃ janasthānam iti śrutam caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ smaraṇān muktidaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: After saying this, both of them bowed down to the
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्वये जातो राजाभूज् जनकः पुरा सो ऽपांपतेस् तु तनुजाम् उपयेमे गुणार्णवाम्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānvaye jāto rājābhūj janakaḥ purā so 'pāṃpates tu tanujām upayeme guṇārṇavām
verses.translation: Then Karhsa's wives surrounded the dead body of Kamsa and lamented. His mothers too were fully overwhelmed by sorrow and misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Karhsa's wives surrounded the dead body of Kamsa and lamented. His mothers too were fully overwhelmed by sorrow and misery.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां जनकां जनको नृपः अनुरूपगुणत्वाच् च तस्य भार्या गुणार्णवा
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ janakāṃ janako nṛpaḥ anurūpaguṇatvāc ca tasya bhāryā guṇārṇavā
verses.translation: They were upset in various ways. They were agitated due to repentance. Krsna consoled them. His own eyes became turbid due to tears.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were upset in various ways. They were agitated due to repentance. Krsna consoled them. His own eyes became turbid due to tears.

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्यश् च विप्रेन्द्रस् तस्य राज्ञः पुरोहितः तम् अपृच्छन् नृपश्रेष्ठो याज्ञवल्क्यं पुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkyaś ca viprendras tasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ tam apṛcchan nṛpaśreṣṭho yājñavalkyaṃ purohitam
verses.translation: He then released Ugrasena from prison. He crowned Ugrasena whose son had been killed. He crowned him in his own kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: He then released Ugrasena from prison. He crowned Ugrasena whose son had been killed. He crowned him in his own kingdom.

verses.translation: After being crowned in the kingdom he, the lion among the descendants of Yadu clan, performed the obsequies of his son as well as of others who were killed there.

verses.translation: Thus urged, the wind god went to Indra and spoke everything to him. Indra gave the assembly hall Sudharma to Vayu.

verses.translation: All those leading Yadus, having Krsna's arms for support enjoyed that divine assembly hall decorated with jewels and brought over there by Vayu.

verses.translation: They accepted his discipleship. They were duly en¬ gaged in serving the preceptor. To all the people they thus practically demonstrated their proper conduct.

verses.translation: Within sixtyfour days and nights they learned the science of Archery alongwith its secrets and digests. O brah¬ mins, it was miraculous indeed.

verses.translation: Considering their super-human activity that could not at all have been imagined (in persons of their age) Sandipani thought that the moon and the sun had come to him.

verses.translation: The moment they were uttered, (the two brothers) learned the Mantras of all miraculous missiles. They said— "What monetary gift should be paid as the preceptor's fees? That may be mentioned."

verses.translation: Observing their ability to act beyond the pale of sense-organs the highly intelligent preceptor requested (the resuscitation) of his son who was dead in the holy centre of Prabhasa on the shore of the briny sea.

verses.translation: Equipped with their arms they went to the briny ocean. They said to the sea—"May the son of our preceptor be restored".

verses.translation: On being told thus, Kr§na went inside the water, killed Paficajana and took the excellent conch originating from his bones.

verses.translation: Of the four stages of life, the householder's is remembered as the giver of merit; from it come enjoyment and liberation — that is my view.

verses.translation: Hearing this, Janaka and the wise Yajnavalkya worshipped Varuna and spoke again:

verses.translation: "What land and what holy place would grant enjoyment and liberation? Tell us that, best of gods; you are all-knowing; salutation to you."

verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ daṇḍakaṃ tatra puṇyadam tasmin kṣetre kṛtaṃ karma bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām

verses.translation: Yajnavalkya and Janaka, having heard the words of the lord of waters and taking leave of Varuna, then went to their own city.

verses.translation: King Janaka performed rites such as the horse sacrifice, and the best of brahmins Yajnavalkya officiated for that king.

verses.translation: The place of sacrifice of the Janakas is declared Janasthana, four yojanas wide, removing all sins by remembrance.

verses.translation: one obtains all desires and also attains liberation.

verses.translation: The lord of Magadha attacked the vicinity of Mathura. He was accompanied by twenty three Aksauhinls 1 of the army.

verses.translation: Surrounded by only a limited number of soldiers, the powerful Balarama and Krsna came out of their city and fought with the strong soldiers.

verses.transliteration: trailokyacakṣus tīkṣṇāṃśuḥ saptāśvo lokapūjitaḥ tasya patnī uṣā khyātā tvāṣṭrī trailokyasundarī
verses.translation: Thereafter, O excellent sages, Balarama and Krsna of great strength thought of taking up their ancient weapons.

verses.translation: An army consisting of 21,870 elephants, 21,870 chariots, 65,610 horses, 109,350 feet is called Ak?auhini.

verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, although Jarasandha of evil design was conquered, Krsna did not consider him defeated because he returned alive.

verses.transliteration: sākarod ātmanaś chāyām ātmarūpeṇa yatnataḥ tām abravīt tataś coṣā tvaṃ ca matsadṛśī bhava
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, Jarasandha came again accom¬ panied by his huge army. He was conquered by Balarama and Krsna. He fled from the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, Jarasandha came again accom¬ panied by his huge army. He was conquered by Balarama and Krsna. He fled from the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं त्वम् अपत्यानि पालयस्व ममाज्ञया यावद् आगमनं मे स्यात् पत्युस् तावत् प्रिया भव
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ tvam apatyāni pālayasva mamājñayā yāvad āgamanaṃ me syāt patyus tāvat priyā bhava
verses.translation: Thus, the arrogant king of Magadha fought eighteen battles with the descendants ofYadu led by Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the arrogant king of Magadha fought eighteen battles with the descendants ofYadu led by Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: नाख्यातव्यं त्वया क्वापि अपत्यानां तथा प्रिये तथेत्य् आह च सा छाया निर्जगाम गृहाद् उषा
verses.transliteration: nākhyātavyaṃ tvayā kvāpi apatyānāṃ tathā priye tathety āha ca sā chāyā nirjagāma gṛhād uṣā
verses.translation: The fact that the army ofYadavas won all times indi¬ cates the greatness of discus-bearing Visnu (i.e. Krsna)
verses.commentary: Sense: The fact that the army ofYadavas won all times indi¬ cates the greatness of discus-bearing Visnu (i.e. Krsna)

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा सा जगामाशु शान्तं रूपम् अभीप्सती सा गत्वोषा गृहं त्वष्टुः पित्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् त्वष्टापि चकितः प्राह तां सुतां सुतवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sā jagāmāśu śāntaṃ rūpam abhīpsatī sā gatvoṣā gṛhaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat tvaṣṭāpi cakitaḥ prāha tāṃ sutāṃ sutavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: In fact with his mere mental thought he can create and annihilate the universe. What detailed attempt need he make in destroying the enemy's sides?
verses.commentary: Sense: In fact with his mere mental thought he can create and annihilate the universe. What detailed attempt need he make in destroying the enemy's sides?

verses.sanskrit: नैतद् युक्तं भर्तृमत्या यत् स्वैरेण प्रवर्तनम् अपत्यानां कथं वृत्तिर् भर्तुर् वा सवितुस् तव बिभेमि भद्रे शिष्टो ऽहं भर्तुर् गेहं पुनर् व्रज
verses.transliteration: naitad yuktaṃ bhartṛmatyā yat svaireṇa pravartanam apatyānāṃ kathaṃ vṛttir bhartur vā savitus tava bibhemi bhadre śiṣṭo 'haṃ bhartur gehaṃ punar vraja
verses.translation: Still the lord follows the activities of human beings. Allying himself with the strong persons he fights with the weaker ones.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु पित्रा सा नेत्य् उक्त्वा वै पुनः पुनः उत्तरं च कुरोर् देशं जगाम तपसे त्वरा
verses.transliteration: evam uktā tu pitrā sā nety uktvā vai punaḥ punaḥ uttaraṃ ca kuror deśaṃ jagāma tapase tvarā
verses.translation: Thus addressed by her father, she said "No" again and again and quickly went to the land of the Northern Kurus for austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तेपे तपस् तीव्रं वडवारूपधारिणी दुष्प्रेक्षं तं स्वकं कान्तं ध्यायन्ती निश्चला उषा
verses.transliteration: tatra tepe tapas tīvraṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī duṣprekṣaṃ taṃ svakaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyantī niścalā uṣā
verses.translation: There Usha practised fierce austerity in the form of a mare, motionless, meditating on her own husband, so hard to look upon.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तात छाया चोषास्वरूपिणी पत्यौ सा वर्तयाम् आस अपत्यान्य् अथ जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tāta chāyā coṣāsvarūpiṇī patyau sā vartayām āsa apatyāny atha jajñire
verses.translation: Meanwhile, my dear, Chhaya in the form of Usha lived with the husband, and children were born:

verses.transliteration: sāvarṇiś ca śaniś caiva viṣṭir yā duṣṭakanyakā sā chāyā vartayām āsa vaiṣamyeṇaiva nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Savarni, Shani, and Vishti, the wicked daughter. That Chhaya always behaved with partiality

verses.sanskrit: स्वेष्व् अपत्येषु चोषाया यमस् तत्र चुकोप ह वैषम्येणाथ वर्तन्तीं छायां तां मातरं तदा
verses.transliteration: sveṣv apatyeṣu coṣāyā yamas tatra cukopa ha vaiṣamyeṇātha vartantīṃ chāyāṃ tāṃ mātaraṃ tadā
verses.translation: toward her own children and Usha's; Yama became angry at this, at his mother Chhaya behaving with partiality,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tāḍayām āsa pādena dakṣiṇāśāpatir yamaḥ putradaurjanyasaṃkṣobhāc chāyā vaivasvataṃ yamam
verses.translation: and Yama, lord of the southern quarter, struck her with his foot. Agitated by her son's misconduct, Chhaya cursed Yama, son of Vivasvan:

verses.sanskrit: शशाप पाप ते पादो विशीर्यतु ममाज्ञया विशीर्णचरणो दुःखाद् रुदन् पितरम् अभ्यगात् सवित्रे तं तु वृत्तान्तं न्यवेदयद् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śaśāpa pāpa te pādo viśīryatu mamājñayā viśīrṇacaraṇo duḥkhād rudan pitaram abhyagāt savitre taṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ nyavedayad aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "Sinner, let your foot rot away at my command." His foot rotting, weeping with pain, he went to his father and told Savitri the whole affair:

verses.sanskrit: नेयं माता सुरश्रेष्ठ यया शप्तो ऽहम् ईदृशः अपत्येषु विरुद्धेषु जननी नैव कुप्यते
verses.transliteration: neyaṃ mātā suraśreṣṭha yayā śapto 'ham īdṛśaḥ apatyeṣu viruddheṣu jananī naiva kupyate
verses.translation: "This is not my mother, O best of gods, by whom I have been cursed like this; a mother is never angry even with wayward children.

verses.transliteration: trātāraḥ santi munayo janasthāna iti śrutam ṛṣīṇām āśramaṃ sāśvā praviṣṭā gautamīṃ tathā
verses.translation: "There are sages at Janasthana who will protect me," she had heard; the mare entered the hermitage of the sages and the Gautami.

verses.transliteration: anuprāptas tathā cāśvo bhānus tadrūpavāṃs tataḥ aśvaṃ nivārayām āsur janasthā munidārakāḥ tataḥ kopād ṛṣīṃs tāṃś ca śaśāpoṣāpatiḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The Sun in the form of a horse followed her there; the sages' sons dwelling at Janasthana stopped the horse. Then the lord, husband of Usha, cursed those sages in anger:

verses.transliteration: nivārayatha māṃ yasmād vaṭā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha
verses.translation: "Since you hold me back, you will become banyan trees."

verses.transliteration: jñānadṛṣṭyā tu munayo menire 'śvam uṣāpatim stuvanto devadeveśaṃ bhānuṃ taṃ munayo mudā
verses.translation: Through the eye of wisdom the sages knew the horse to be Usha's husband; the sages joyfully praised that Sun, lord of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: स्तूयमानो मुनिगणैर् अश्वां भानुर् अथागमत् वडवाया मुखे लग्नं मुखं चाश्वस्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: stūyamāno munigaṇair aśvāṃ bhānur athāgamat vaḍavāyā mukhe lagnaṃ mukhaṃ cāśvasvarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Praised by the hosts of sages, the Sun then approached the mare; his face in the form of a horse touched the mare's face.

verses.transliteration: jñātvā tvāṣṭrī ca bhartāraṃ mukhād vīryaṃ prasusruve tayor vīryeṇa gaṅgāyām aśvinau samajāyatām
verses.translation: Recognising her husband, the daughter of Tvashtri released seed from her mouth; from the seed of the two, the Ashvins were born in the Ganga.

verses.transliteration: tatrāgacchan suragaṇāḥ siddhāś ca munayas tathā nadyo gāvas tathauṣadhyo devā jyotirgaṇās tathā
verses.translation: There came the hosts of gods, the Siddhas and sages, the rivers, cows, plants, gods and hosts of luminaries,

verses.transliteration: saptāśvaś ca rathaḥ puṇyo hy aruṇo bhānusārathiḥ yamo manuś ca varuṇaḥ śanir vaivasvatas tathā
verses.translation: the holy chariot with seven horses, Aruna the Sun's charioteer, Yama, Manu, Varuna and Shani, son of Vivasvan,

verses.transliteration: yamunā ca nadī puṇyā tāpī caiva mahānadī tattadrūpaṃ samāsthāya nadyas tā vismayān mune
verses.translation: the holy river Yamuna and the great river Tapi; taking their respective forms, those rivers, O sage, in wonder

verses.transliteration: draṣṭuṃ te vismayāviṣṭā ājagmuḥ śvaśuras tathā abhiprāyaṃ viditvā tu śvaśuraṃ bhānur abravīt
verses.translation: came to see, filled with astonishment, and the father-in-law too. Knowing his intention, the Sun said to his father-in-law:

verses.sanskrit: उषायाः प्रीतये त्वष्टः कुर्वत्यास् तप उत्तमम् यन्त्रारूढं च मां कृत्वा छिन्धि तेजांस्य् अनेकशः यावत् सौख्यं भवेद् अस्यास् तावच् छिन्धि प्रजापते
verses.transliteration: uṣāyāḥ prītaye tvaṣṭaḥ kurvatyās tapa uttamam yantrārūḍhaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā chindhi tejāṃsy anekaśaḥ yāvat saukhyaṃ bhaved asyās tāvac chindhi prajāpate
verses.translation: "O Tvashtri, for the pleasure of Usha, who is performing supreme austerity, mount me on the lathe and cut away my splendour many times; cut as much as will bring her comfort, O lord of creatures."

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा ततस् त्वष्टा सोमनाथस्य संनिधौ तेजसां छेदनं चक्रे प्रभासं तु ततो विदुः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā tatas tvaṣṭā somanāthasya saṃnidhau tejasāṃ chedanaṃ cakre prabhāsaṃ tu tato viduḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," Tvashtri then cut away his splendour in the presence of Somanatha; hence they know it as Prabhasa.

verses.transliteration: bhartrā ca saṃgatā yatra gautamyām aśvarūpiṇī aśvinor yatra cotpattir aśvatīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Where she in the form of a mare was united with her husband in the Gautami, and where the Ashvins were born, that is called Ashvatirtha.

verses.transliteration: bhānutīrthaṃ tad ākhyātaṃ tathā pañcavaṭāśramaḥ tāpī ca yamunā caiva pitaraṃ draṣṭum āgate
verses.translation: It is also known as Bhanutirtha and as the Panchavata hermitage; the Tapi and the Yamuna came to see their father.

verses.transliteration: aruṇāvaruṇānadyor gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ devānāṃ tatra tīrthānām āgatānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: The confluence of the rivers Aruna and Varuna with the Ganga is auspicious; of the holy places of the gods who came there separately,

verses.transliteration: nava trīṇi sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvam akṣayapuṇyadam
verses.translation: there are twelve thousand virtuous holy places; bathing and giving there all grant imperishable merit.

verses.transliteration: smaraṇāt paṭhanād vāpi śravaṇād api nārada sarvapāpavinirmukto dharmavān sa sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: By remembering, reading or hearing it, O Narada, one becomes freed from all sins, righteous and happy.

verses.transliteration: gāruḍaṃ nāma yat tīrthaṃ sarvavighnapraśāntidam tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, Syala called a brahmin of the cowherds colony (named) Gargya by the (ignoble remark) Sandha

verses.transliteration: maṇināga iti tv āsīc cheṣaputro mahābalaḥ garuḍasya bhayād bhaktyā toṣayām āsa śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Thereupon, the infuriated brahmin went to Southern territory and performed a penance. He was desirous of a son who would be a terror to the Yadavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the infuriated brahmin went to Southern territory and performed a penance. He was desirous of a son who would be a terror to the Yadavas.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān parameṣṭhī maheśvaraḥ tam uvāca mahānāgaṃ varaṃ varaya pannaga
verses.translation: The \ avanesa (a Greek King) who had no son honour¬ ed him. As a result of sexual intercourse withhis wife a son of fiery splendour was born to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The \ avanesa (a Greek King) who had no son honour¬ ed him. As a result of sexual intercourse withhis wife a son of fiery splendour was born to him.

verses.sanskrit: नागः प्राह प्रभो मह्यं देहि मे गरुडाभयम् तथेत्य् आह च तं शंभुर् गरुडाद् अभयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nāgaḥ prāha prabho mahyaṃ dehi me garuḍābhayam tathety āha ca taṃ śaṃbhur garuḍād abhayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Proud and arrogant by virtue of his prowess, he asked about the powerful kings on the Earth. Narada told him about the Yadavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Proud and arrogant by virtue of his prowess, he asked about the powerful kings on the Earth. Narada told him about the Yadavas.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गतो निर्भयो नागो गरुडाद् अरुणानुजात् क्षीरोदशायी यत्रास्ते क्षीरार्णवसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: nirgato nirbhayo nāgo garuḍād aruṇānujāt kṣīrodaśāyī yatrāste kṣīrārṇavasamīpataḥ
verses.translation: After thinking thus Kjrsna begged of the great ocean a piece twelve Yojana. He created the city of Dvaraka there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus Kjrsna begged of the great ocean a piece twelve Yojana. He created the city of Dvaraka there.

verses.sanskrit: इतश् चेतश् च चरति नागो ऽसौ सुखशीतले गरुडो ऽपि च यत्रास्ते तं देशम् अपि यात्य् असौ
verses.transliteration: itaś cetaś ca carati nāgo 'sau sukhaśītale garuḍo 'pi ca yatrāste taṃ deśam api yāty asau
verses.translation: When the army (of Kalayavana) encamped outside Mathura, he came out without any weapon and the Yavana saw him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the army (of Kalayavana) encamped outside Mathura, he came out without any weapon and the Yavana saw him.

verses.transliteration: garuḍaḥ pannagaṃ dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ nirbhayena tu taṃ gṛhītvā mahānāgaṃ prākṣipat svasya veśmani
verses.translation: The Yavana also entered the cave. He saw a man lying on a bed. Thinking him to be Krsna, the wicked Yavana kicked him with his foot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yavana also entered the cave. He saw a man lying on a bed. Thinking him to be Krsna, the wicked Yavana kicked him with his foot.

verses.sanskrit: तं बद्ध्वा गारुडैः पाशैर् गरुडो नागसत्तमम् एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे नन्दी प्रोवाचेशं जगत्प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ baddhvā gāruḍaiḥ pāśair garuḍo nāgasattamam etasminn antare nandī provāceśaṃ jagatprabhum
verses.translation: That king had taken part in the battle between Devas and Asuras and defeated Asuras. He had to remain for many nights without sleep and so was distressed. He requested Suras for the boon of slumber.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king had taken part in the battle between Devas and Asuras and defeated Asuras. He had to remain for many nights without sleep and so was distressed. He requested Suras for the boon of slumber.

verses.sanskrit: नूनं नागो न चायाति भक्षितो बद्ध एव वा गरुडेन सुरेशान जीवन् नागो न संव्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: nūnaṃ nāgo na cāyāti bhakṣito baddha eva vā garuḍena sureśāna jīvan nāgo na saṃvrajet
verses.translation: After reducing that sinner he looked at Krsna and said—"Who are you?" Krsna said: "I am born of the lunar race.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reducing that sinner he looked at Krsna and said—"Who are you?" Krsna said: "I am born of the lunar race.

verses.transliteration: nandino vacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā śaṃbhur athābravīt
verses.translation: You are everything viz-oceans, mountains, rivers, forests, Earth, sky, wind, water, fire, you are the highest being.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are everything viz-oceans, mountains, rivers, forests, Earth, sky, wind, water, fire, you are the highest being.

verses.sanskrit: गरुडस्य गृहे नागो बद्धस् तिष्ठति सत्वरम् गत्वा तं जगताम् ईशं विष्णुं स्तुहि जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: garuḍasya gṛhe nāgo baddhas tiṣṭhati satvaram gatvā taṃ jagatām īśaṃ viṣṇuṃ stuhi janārdanam
verses.translation: O lord, miseries alone were taken up by me as pleasures, like the mirages that are understood as water-reser¬ voirs. They were conducive to my agony alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, miseries alone were taken up by me as pleasures, like the mirages that are understood as water-reser¬ voirs. They were conducive to my agony alone.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धं नागं काश्यपेन मद्वाक्याद् आनय स्वयम् तत् प्रभोर् वचनं श्रुत्वा नन्दी गत्वा श्रियः पतिम्
verses.transliteration: baddhaṃ nāgaṃ kāśyapena madvākyād ānaya svayam tat prabhor vacanaṃ śrutvā nandī gatvā śriyaḥ patim
verses.translation: O lord, even Devas attaining the goal of the common world became desirous of help from me. Where is permanent happiness (available)?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, even Devas attaining the goal of the common world became desirous of help from me. Where is permanent happiness (available)?

verses.sanskrit: व्यज्ञापयत् स्वयं वाक्यं विष्णुं लोकपरायणम् नारायणः प्रीतमना गरुडं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vyajñāpayat svayaṃ vākyaṃ viṣṇuṃ lokaparāyaṇam nārāyaṇaḥ prītamanā garuḍaṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Without propitiating you, the basis and source of origin of all the worlds, by whom is permanent happiness attained?
verses.commentary: Sense: Without propitiating you, the basis and source of origin of all the worlds, by whom is permanent happiness attained?

verses.sanskrit: विनतात्मज मे वाक्यान् नन्दिने देहि पन्नगम् कम्पमानस् तद् आकर्ण्य नेत्य् उवाच विहंगमः विष्णुम् अप्य् अब्रवीत् कोपात् सुपर्णो नन्दिनो ऽन्तिके
verses.transliteration: vinatātmaja me vākyān nandine dehi pannagam kampamānas tad ākarṇya nety uvāca vihaṃgamaḥ viṣṇum apy abravīt kopāt suparṇo nandino 'ntike
verses.translation: People whose minds are deluded try your Maya attain

verses.sanskrit: यद् यत् प्रियतमं किंचिद् भृत्येभ्यः प्रभविष्णवः दास्यन्त्य् अन्ये भवान् नैव मयानीतं हरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yad yat priyatamaṃ kiṃcid bhṛtyebhyaḥ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ dāsyanty anye bhavān naiva mayānītaṃ hariṣyati
verses.translation: "Whatever is dearest, powerful masters give to their servants; others give, but you will take away what I have brought.

verses.sanskrit: पश्य देवं त्रिनयनं नागं मोक्ष्यति नन्दिना मयोपपादितं नागं त्वं तु दास्यसि नन्दिने
verses.transliteration: paśya devaṃ trinayanaṃ nāgaṃ mokṣyati nandinā mayopapāditaṃ nāgaṃ tvaṃ tu dāsyasi nandine
verses.translation: Look, the three-eyed god will release the serpent through Nandin; you will give Nandin the serpent I obtained.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां वहामि सदा स्वामिन् मम देयं सदा त्वया मयोपपादितं नागं वक्तुं देहीति नोचितम्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ vahāmi sadā svāmin mama deyaṃ sadā tvayā mayopapāditaṃ nāgaṃ vaktuṃ dehīti nocitam
verses.translation: I always carry you, master; you should always give to me. It is not fitting to say 'give' about the serpent I obtained.

verses.transliteration: satāṃ prabhūṇāṃ neyaṃ syād vṛttiḥ sadvṛttikāriṇām santo dāsyanti bhṛtyebhyo madupāttaharo bhavān
verses.translation: This is not the conduct of good masters who act rightly; the good give to their servants, but you take what I have gained.

verses.transliteration: daityāñ jayasi saṃgrāme madbalenaiva keśava ahaṃ mahābalīty evaṃ mudhaiva ślāghate bhavān
verses.translation: You conquer the Daityas in battle only by my strength, O Keshava, yet you vainly boast, 'I am very mighty.'"

verses.transliteration: garuḍasyeti tad vākyaṃ śrutvā cakragadādharaḥ vihasya nandinaḥ pārśve paśyadbhir lokapālakaiḥ
verses.translation: Hearing these words of Garuda, the bearer of discus and mace laughed and, near Nandin, as the guardians of the worlds looked on,

verses.transliteration: idam āha mahābuddhir māṃ samuhya kṛśo bhavān tvadbalād asurān sarvāñ jeṣye 'haṃ khagasattama
verses.translation: the wise one said: "Carrying me you have become lean, O best of birds; by your strength I shall conquer all the Asuras."

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā śrīpatir brahmañ śāntakopo 'bravīd idam vahāṅguliṃ karasyāśu kaniṣṭhāṃ nandino 'ntike
verses.translation: Having said this, O Brahman, the lord of Shri, his anger calmed, said: "Carry just the little finger of my hand, near Nandin."

verses.sanskrit: गरुडस्य ततो मूर्ध्नि न्यस्येदं पुनर् अब्रवीत् सत्यं मां वहसे नित्यं पश्य धर्मं विहंगम
verses.transliteration: garuḍasya tato mūrdhni nyasyedaṃ punar abravīt satyaṃ māṃ vahase nityaṃ paśya dharmaṃ vihaṃgama
verses.translation: Then, placing it on Garuda's head, he said again: "If you truly carry me always, see what is right, O bird."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यस्तायां च ततो ऽङ्गुल्यां शिरः कुक्षौ समाविशत् कुक्षिश् च चरणस्यान्तः प्राविशच् चूर्णितो ऽभवत् ततः कृताञ्जलिर् दीनो व्यथितो लज्जयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: nyastāyāṃ ca tato 'ṅgulyāṃ śiraḥ kukṣau samāviśat kukṣiś ca caraṇasyāntaḥ prāviśac cūrṇito 'bhavat tataḥ kṛtāñjalir dīno vyathito lajjayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: When the finger was placed, his head sank into his belly, and his belly sank between his feet, and he was crushed. Then, wretched, pained and ashamed, with joined palms:

verses.sanskrit: त्राहि त्राहि जगन्नाथ भृत्यं माम् अपराधिनम् त्वं प्रभुः सर्वलोकानां धर्ता धार्यस् त्वम् एव च
verses.transliteration: trāhi trāhi jagannātha bhṛtyaṃ mām aparādhinam tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ dhartā dhāryas tvam eva ca
verses.translation: "Save me, save me, lord of the world, your offending servant; you are the lord of all worlds, the upholder and the one to be upheld.

verses.sanskrit: अपराधसहस्राणि क्षमन्ते प्रभविष्णवः कृतापराधे ऽपि जने महती यस्य वै कृपा
verses.transliteration: aparādhasahasrāṇi kṣamante prabhaviṣṇavaḥ kṛtāparādhe 'pi jane mahatī yasya vai kṛpā
verses.translation: The mighty forgive thousands of offences; great is the compassion of one who shows it even to an offender.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदन्ति मुनयः सर्वे त्वाम् एव करुणाकरम् रक्षस्वार्तं जगन्मातर् माम् अम्बुजनिवासिनि कमले बालकं दीनम् आर्तं तनयवत्सले
verses.transliteration: vadanti munayaḥ sarve tvām eva karuṇākaram rakṣasvārtaṃ jaganmātar mām ambujanivāsini kamale bālakaṃ dīnam ārtaṃ tanayavatsale
verses.translation: All the sages call you alone the mine of compassion. Protect me, distressed, Mother of the world who dwells in the lotus; O Kamala, protect this wretched, suffering child, you who love your children."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛpānvitā devī śrīr apy āha janārdanam
verses.translation: Then the goddess Shri, full of compassion, also said to Janardana:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष नाथ स्वकं भृत्यं गरुडं विपदं गतम् जनार्दन उवाचेदं नन्दिनं शंभुवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣa nātha svakaṃ bhṛtyaṃ garuḍaṃ vipadaṃ gatam janārdana uvācedaṃ nandinaṃ śaṃbhuvāhanam
verses.translation: "Protect, Lord, your own servant Garuda who has fallen into distress." Janardana said this to Nandin, Shambhu's mount:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नय नागं सगरुडं शंभोर् अन्तिकम् एव च तत्प्रसादाच् च गरुडो महेश्वरनिरीक्षितः आत्मीयं च पुना रूपं गरुडः समवाप्स्यति
verses.transliteration: naya nāgaṃ sagaruḍaṃ śaṃbhor antikam eva ca tatprasādāc ca garuḍo maheśvaranirīkṣitaḥ ātmīyaṃ ca punā rūpaṃ garuḍaḥ samavāpsyati
verses.translation: "Take the serpent together with Garuda to Shambhu. By his grace, when Garuda is looked upon by Maheshvara, Garuda will regain his own form."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा च वृषभो नागेन गरुडेन च शनैः स शंकरं गत्वा सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् शंकरो ऽपि गरुत्मन्तं प्रोवाच शशिशेखरः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā ca vṛṣabho nāgena garuḍena ca śanaiḥ sa śaṃkaraṃ gatvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat śaṃkaro 'pi garutmantaṃ provāca śaśiśekharaḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," the bull went slowly with the serpent and Garuda to Shankara and told him everything. Shankara, the moon-crested, said to Garutman:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याहि गङ्गां महाबाहो गौतमीं लोकपावनीम् सर्वकामप्रदां शान्तां ताम् आप्लुत्य पुनर् वपुः
verses.transliteration: yāhi gaṅgāṃ mahābāho gautamīṃ lokapāvanīm sarvakāmapradāṃ śāntāṃ tām āplutya punar vapuḥ
verses.translation: "Go, mighty-armed one, to the Ganga, the Gautami, purifier of the world, granting all desires and peaceful; bathing in her, you will regain your body

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्स्यसे सर्वकामांश् च शतधाथ सहस्रधा सर्वपापोपतप्ता ये दुर्दैवोन्मूलितोद्यमाः प्राणिनो ऽभीष्टदा तेषां शरणं खग गौतमी
verses.transliteration: prāpsyase sarvakāmāṃś ca śatadhātha sahasradhā sarvapāpopataptā ye durdaivonmūlitodyamāḥ prāṇino 'bhīṣṭadā teṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ khaga gautamī
verses.translation: and obtain all desires a hundredfold and a thousandfold. For living beings tormented by all sins, whose efforts have been uprooted by ill fortune, the Gautami is the refuge that grants their wishes, O bird."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यं प्रणतो भूत्वा श्रुत्वा तु गरुडो ऽभ्यगात् गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य गरुडः शिवं विष्णुं ननाम सः
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṃ praṇato bhūtvā śrutvā tu garuḍo 'bhyagāt gaṅgām āplutya garuḍaḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ nanāma saḥ
verses.translation: Hearing his words, bowing, Garuda went; having bathed in the Ganga, Garuda bowed to Shiva and Vishnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्णमयः पक्षी वज्रदेहो महाबलः वेगी भवन् मुनिश्रेष्ठ पुनर् विष्णुम् इयात् सुधीः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svarṇamayaḥ pakṣī vajradeho mahābalaḥ vegī bhavan muniśreṣṭha punar viṣṇum iyāt sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Then the bird became golden, with a body of diamond, mighty and swift, O best of sages, and the wise one returned to Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं गारुडं सर्वकामदम् तत्र स्नानादि यत् किंचित् करोति प्रयतो नरः सर्वं तद् अक्षयं वत्स शिवविष्णुप्रियावहम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ gāruḍaṃ sarvakāmadam tatra snānādi yat kiṃcit karoti prayato naraḥ sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vatsa śivaviṣṇupriyāvaham
verses.translation: From then on that holy place is called Garuda, granting all desires; whatever bathing and the like a disciplined man does there is all imperishable, my child, and brings the love of Shiva and Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गोवर्धनं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् पितॄणां पुण्यजननं स्मरणाद् अपि पापनुत्
verses.transliteration: tato govardhanaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam pitṝṇāṃ puṇyajananaṃ smaraṇād api pāpanut
verses.translation: Eulogised thus by that intelligent Mucukunda, the lord of all living beings, the lord who has no beginning or death spoke thus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभाव एष स्यान् मया दृष्टस् तु नारद ब्राह्मणः कर्षकः कश्चिज् जाबालिर् इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāva eṣa syān mayā dṛṣṭas tu nārada brāhmaṇaḥ karṣakaḥ kaścij jābālir iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of men, go to divine worlds as desired by you. You will be strengthened by my grace and your prosperity and prowess will be unimpeded.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of men, go to divine worlds as desired by you. You will be strengthened by my grace and your prosperity and prowess will be unimpeded.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न विमुञ्चत्य् अनड्वाहौ मध्यं याते ऽपि भास्करे प्रतोदेन प्रतुदति पृष्ठतो ऽपि च पार्श्वयोः
verses.transliteration: na vimuñcaty anaḍvāhau madhyaṃ yāte 'pi bhāskare pratodena pratudati pṛṣṭhato 'pi ca pārśvayoḥ
verses.translation: After enjoying the great divine pleasures, you will be born in a great family. By my favour you will be able to remem¬ ber your previous births. Thereafter, you will attain salvation. Thus blessed by the lord the king bowed to Acyuta; the lord of the worlds came out of the cave. Then' he saw short- statured men;
verses.wordMeaning: After enjoying the great divine pleasures, you will be born in a great family. By my favour you will be able to remem¬ ber your previous births. Thereafter, you will attain salvation. Thus blessed by the lord the king bowed to Acyuta;…
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying the great divine pleasures, you will be born in a great family. By my favour you will be able to remem¬ ber your previous births. Thereafter, you will attain salvation. Thus blessed by the lord the king bowed to Acyuta;…

verses.sanskrit: तौ गावाव् अश्रुपूर्णाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा गौः कामदोहिनी सुरभिर् जगतां माता नन्दिने सर्वम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tau gāvāv aśrupūrṇākṣau dṛṣṭvā gauḥ kāmadohinī surabhir jagatāṃ mātā nandine sarvam abravīt
verses.translation: The king understood that the Kaliyuga had arrived. He went to the abode of Nara and Narayana in order to perform penance (on the mountain) Gandhamidana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king understood that the Kaliyuga had arrived. He went to the abode of Nara and Narayana in order to perform penance (on the mountain) Gandhamidana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स चापि व्यथितो भूत्वा शंभवे तन् न्यवेदयत् शंभुश् च वृषभं प्राह सर्वं सिध्यतु ते वचः
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi vyathito bhūtvā śaṃbhave tan nyavedayat śaṃbhuś ca vṛṣabhaṃ prāha sarvaṃ sidhyatu te vacaḥ
verses.translation: Slaying the enemy by means of a stratagem, Krsna captured his army shining with horses, elephants and chariots After bringing it to Dvaravatihe offered it toUgrasena. (Thereby) the army of the Yadus had no fear of the onslaught of enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slaying the enemy by means of a stratagem, Krsna captured his army shining with horses, elephants and chariots After bringing it to Dvaravatihe offered it toUgrasena. (Thereby) the army of the Yadus had no fear of the onslaught of enemies.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाज्ञासहितो नन्दी गोजातं सर्वम् आहरत् नष्टेषु गोषु सर्वेषु स्वर्गे मर्त्ये ततस् त्वरा
verses.transliteration: śivājñāsahito nandī gojātaṃ sarvam āharat naṣṭeṣu goṣu sarveṣu svarge martye tatas tvarā
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, having subdued all quarrels Bala- deva became eager to see his kinsmen and so went to the cow¬ herds' colony of Nanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, having subdued all quarrels Bala- deva became eager to see his kinsmen and so went to the cow¬ herds' colony of Nanda.

verses.sanskrit: माम् अवोचन् सुरगणा विना गोभिर् न जीव्यते तान् अवोचं सुरान् सर्वाञ् शंकरं यात याचत
verses.transliteration: mām avocan suragaṇā vinā gobhir na jīvyate tān avocaṃ surān sarvāñ śaṃkaraṃ yāta yācata
verses.translation: As before, the conqueror of enemies spoke to the cowherds and cowherdlasses with affection and respect. The cowherds spoke many pleasing words to Balarama. Some cowherdesses spoke joyously in their love and others spoke with malice.
verses.commentary: Sense: As before, the conqueror of enemies spoke to the cowherds and cowherdlasses with affection and respect. The cowherds spoke many pleasing words to Balarama. Some cowherdesses spoke joyously in their love and others spoke with malice.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवेशं तु ते सर्वे स्तुत्वा कार्यं न्यवेदयन् ईशो ऽपि विबुधान् आह जानाति वृषभो मम
verses.transliteration: tathaiveśaṃ tu te sarve stutvā kāryaṃ nyavedayan īśo 'pi vibudhān āha jānāti vṛṣabho mama
verses.translation: Other cowherdesses asked thus "Is Krsna the lover of womenfolk of the city happy? Is he agitated by stirring emotions of love.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other cowherdesses asked thus "Is Krsna the lover of womenfolk of the city happy? Is he agitated by stirring emotions of love.

verses.sanskrit: ते वृषं प्रोचुर् अमरा देहि गा उपकारिणः वृषो ऽपि विबुधान् आह गोसवः क्रियतां क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: te vṛṣaṃ procur amarā dehi gā upakāriṇaḥ vṛṣo 'pi vibudhān āha gosavaḥ kriyatāṃ kratuḥ
verses.translation: Does Krsna ever remember our following him and singing alongwith him? Will he come here at least once to see his mother? Father, mother, brother, husband and kinsmen who is not abandoned by us for his sake. (But) he load been un¬ grateful.
verses.commentary: Sense: Does Krsna ever remember our following him and singing alongwith him? Will he come here at least once to see his mother? Father, mother, brother, husband and kinsmen who is not abandoned by us for his sake. (But) he load been un¬ grateful.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राप्स्यथ गाः सर्वा या दिव्या याश् च मानुषाः ततः प्रवर्तते यज्ञो गोसवो देवनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāpsyatha gāḥ sarvā yā divyā yāś ca mānuṣāḥ tataḥ pravartate yajño gosavo devanirmitaḥ
verses.translation: Still, does Krsna ever (mention) anything about his coming here? Nectar-like words must be uttered by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, does Krsna ever (mention) anything about his coming here? Nectar-like words must be uttered by you.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्याश् च शुभे पार्श्वे गावो ववृधिरे ततः गोवर्धनं तु तत् तीर्थं देवानां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: gautamyāś ca śubhe pārśve gāvo vavṛdhire tataḥ govardhanaṃ tu tat tīrthaṃ devānāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: He appears to be devoid of love towards us because his rnindis attached to the ladies of the city. It seems it will be difficult to sec him." The cowherdlasses were consoled by Rama through gentle and sweet messages of Krsna couched in loving emo¬ tions and devoid of arrogance. The notes were as sweet as honey.

The cowherdlasses were consoled by Rama through gentle and sweet messages of Krsna couched in loving emo¬ tions and devoid of arrogance.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं मुनिश्रेष्ठ गोसहस्रफलप्रदम् किंचिद् दानादिना यत् स्यात् फलं तत् तु न विद्महे
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ muniśreṣṭha gosahasraphalapradam kiṃcid dānādinā yat syāt phalaṃ tat tu na vidmahe
verses.translation: As before Balarama continued funny stories and jokes with the cowherds whose minds were attracted by Krsna, the cowherds who were the residents of Vraja.
verses.commentary: Sense: As before Balarama continued funny stories and jokes with the cowherds whose minds were attracted by Krsna, the cowherds who were the residents of Vraja.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पापप्रणाशनं नाम तीर्थं पापभयापहम् नामधेयं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: pāpapraṇāśanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ pāpabhayāpaham nāmadheyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ
verses.translation: O wine, you have always been liked by (Balarama) of great prowess, O auspicious one, go now for his joy and enjoyment of pleasures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O wine, you have always been liked by (Balarama) of great prowess, O auspicious one, go now for his joy and enjoyment of pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: धृतव्रत इति ख्यातो ब्राह्मणो लोकविश्रुतः तस्य भार्या मही नाम तरुणी लोकसुन्दरी
verses.transliteration: dhṛtavrata iti khyāto brāhmaṇo lokaviśrutaḥ tasya bhāryā mahī nāma taruṇī lokasundarī
verses.translation: Thus advised by him Varuni (wine) stationed herself in the hollow of a Kadamba tree growing on-the banks of Yamuna in Vrndavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus advised by him Varuni (wine) stationed herself in the hollow of a Kadamba tree growing on-the banks of Yamuna in Vrndavana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रः सूर्यनिभः सनाज्जात इति श्रुतः धृतव्रतं तथाकर्षन् मृत्युः कालेरितो मुने
verses.transliteration: tasya putraḥ sūryanibhaḥ sanājjāta iti śrutaḥ dhṛtavrataṃ tathākarṣan mṛtyuḥ kālerito mune
verses.translation: Roaming about that spot Balarama inhaled the inten- sive odour of wine. After smelling it he experienced the delight that he previously used to have in wine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Roaming about that spot Balarama inhaled the inten- sive odour of wine. After smelling it he experienced the delight that he previously used to have in wine.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा बालविधवा बालपुत्रा सुरूपिणी त्रातारं नैव पश्यन्ती गालवाश्रमम् अभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā bālavidhavā bālaputrā surūpiṇī trātāraṃ naiva paśyantī gālavāśramam abhyagāt
verses.translation: O sages, thereafter, Balarama saw a current of liquor suddenly falling from Kadamba. He derived great joy there¬ from.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, thereafter, Balarama saw a current of liquor suddenly falling from Kadamba. He derived great joy there¬ from.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै पुत्रं निवेद्याथ स्वैरिणी पापमोहिता सा बभ्राम बहून् देशान् पुंस्कामा कामचारिणी
verses.transliteration: tasmai putraṃ nivedyātha svairiṇī pāpamohitā sā babhrāma bahūn deśān puṃskāmā kāmacāriṇī
verses.translation: He drank it joyously in the company of cowherds and cowlici desses while experts in songs and instrumental music sang elegantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He drank it joyously in the company of cowherds and cowlici desses while experts in songs and instrumental music sang elegantly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पुत्रो गालवगृहे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः जातो ऽपि मातृदोषेण वेश्येरितमतिस् त्व् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: tatputro gālavagṛhe vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ jāto 'pi mātṛdoṣeṇa veśyeritamatis tv abhūt
verses.translation: Shining with the pearl-like drops of sweat due to excessive heat and fatigue he became agitated and said -;t O Yamuna, come hither. I wish to take my bath".
verses.commentary: Sense: Shining with the pearl-like drops of sweat due to excessive heat and fatigue he became agitated and said -;t O Yamuna, come hither. I wish to take my bath".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जनस्थानम् इति ख्यातं नानाजातिसमावृतम् तत्रासौ पण्यवेषेण अध्यास्ते च मही तथा
verses.transliteration: janasthānam iti khyātaṃ nānājātisamāvṛtam tatrāsau paṇyaveṣeṇa adhyāste ca mahī tathā
verses.translation: The river disregarded those words of inebriated person. She did not approach him. The infuriated Balarama (there¬ upon) seized his ploughshare.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river disregarded those words of inebriated person. She did not approach him. The infuriated Balarama (there¬ upon) seized his ploughshare.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्सुतो ऽपि बहून् देशान् परिबभ्राम कामुकः सो ऽपि कालवशात् तत्र जनस्थाने ऽवसत् तदा
verses.transliteration: tatsuto 'pi bahūn deśān paribabhrāma kāmukaḥ so 'pi kālavaśāt tatra janasthāne 'vasat tadā
verses.translation: Agitated due to inebriation he caught hold of her by the tip of his ploughshare - "O evil-minded one, won't you come, won't you come? Then go elsewhere as you please".
verses.commentary: Sense: Agitated due to inebriation he caught hold of her by the tip of his ploughshare - "O evil-minded one, won't you come, won't you come? Then go elsewhere as you please".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियम् आकाङ्क्षते वेश्यां धृतव्रतसुतो द्विजः मही चापि धनं दातॄन् पुरुषान् समपेक्षते
verses.transliteration: striyam ākāṅkṣate veśyāṃ dhṛtavratasuto dvijaḥ mahī cāpi dhanaṃ dātṝn puruṣān samapekṣate
verses.translation: Dragged by him suddenly the river left her usual path and flooded the forest where Balarama was present.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dragged by him suddenly the river left her usual path and flooded the forest where Balarama was present.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मेने न पुत्रम् आत्मीयं स चापि न तु मातरम् तयोः समागमश् चासीद् विधिना मातृपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: mene na putram ātmīyaṃ sa cāpi na tu mātaram tayoḥ samāgamaś cāsīd vidhinā mātṛputrayoḥ
verses.translation: She approached him in an embodied form. Due to fear her eyes were agitated. She said to him "O you having lionclub as your weapon, be pleased, leave me off".
verses.commentary: Sense: She approached him in an embodied form. Due to fear her eyes were agitated. She said to him "O you having lionclub as your weapon, be pleased, leave me off".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले पुत्रे मातरि गच्छति तयोः परस्परं ज्ञानं नैवासीन् मातृपुत्रयोः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahutithe kāle putre mātari gacchati tayoḥ parasparaṃ jñānaṃ naivāsīn mātṛputrayoḥ
verses.translation: He said "If you disregard me in spite of my heroism and strength I shall split you into a thousand bits with the blows of my ploughshare".
verses.commentary: Sense: He said "If you disregard me in spite of my heroism and strength I shall split you into a thousand bits with the blows of my ploughshare".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तमानस्य पितृधर्मेण सन्मतिः आसीत् तस्याप्य् असद्वृत्तेः शृणु नारद चित्रवत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravartamānasya pitṛdharmeṇa sanmatiḥ āsīt tasyāpy asadvṛtteḥ śṛṇu nārada citravat
verses.translation: Having aborned himself with the blue lotus, embelli¬ shing himself with the beautiful ear-ring and clad in blue garments, the glorious one shone with splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having aborned himself with the blue lotus, embelli¬ shing himself with the beautiful ear-ring and clad in blue garments, the glorious one shone with splendour.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वैरस्थित्या वर्तमानो नेदं स परिहातवान् ब्राह्मीं संध्याम् अनुष्ठाय तद् ऊर्ध्वं तु धनार्जनम्
verses.transliteration: svairasthityā vartamāno nedaṃ sa parihātavān brāhmīṃ saṃdhyām anuṣṭhāya tad ūrdhvaṃ tu dhanārjanam
verses.translation: Thus embellished, Rama sported there in the cow¬ herds' colony. After two months he went to Dvaraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus embellished, Rama sported there in the cow¬ herds' colony. After two months he went to Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याबलेन वित्तानि बहून्य् आर्ज्य ददात्य् असौ तथा स प्रातर् उत्थाय गङ्गां गत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: vidyābalena vittāni bahūny ārjya dadāty asau tathā sa prātar utthāya gaṅgāṃ gatvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Balarama married Revatl the daughter of king Raivata. Two sons, Nisatha and Ulumuka were born of her.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: śaucādi snānasaṃdhyādi sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yathākramam kṛtvā tu brāhmaṇān natvā tato 'bhyeti svakarmasu
verses.translation: Having done cleansing and the rest, bathing, twilight worship and all else in due order, and having bowed to the brahmins, he then goes about his own work.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रातःकाले गौतमीं तु यदा याति विरूपवान् कुष्ठसर्वाङ्गशिथिलः पूयशोणितनिःस्रवः
verses.transliteration: prātaḥkāle gautamīṃ tu yadā yāti virūpavān kuṣṭhasarvāṅgaśithilaḥ pūyaśoṇitaniḥsravaḥ
verses.translation: In the morning, when he goes to the Gautami, he is ugly, all his limbs loose with leprosy, oozing pus and blood;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तु गौतमीं गङ्गां यदा याति सुरूपधृक् शान्तः सूर्याग्निसदृशो मूर्तिमान् इव भास्करः
verses.transliteration: snātvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ yadā yāti surūpadhṛk śāntaḥ sūryāgnisadṛśo mūrtimān iva bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: when, having bathed in the Gautami Ganga, he returns, he bears a beautiful form, calm, like the sun and fire, like the sun embodied.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् रूपद्वयं स्वस्य नैव पश्यति स द्विजः गालवो यत्र भगवांस् तपोज्ञानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: etad rūpadvayaṃ svasya naiva paśyati sa dvijaḥ gālavo yatra bhagavāṃs tapojñānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The brahmin himself never sees these two forms of his. Where the Lord Galava, devoted to austerity and knowledge,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आश्रित्य गौतमीं देवीं आस्ते च मुनिभिर् वृतः ब्राह्मणो ऽपि च तत्रैव नित्यं तीर्थं समेत्य च
verses.transliteration: āśritya gautamīṃ devīṃ āste ca munibhir vṛtaḥ brāhmaṇo 'pi ca tatraiva nityaṃ tīrthaṃ sametya ca
verses.translation: resorting to the goddess Gautami, stays surrounded by sages, the brahmin too comes daily to that holy place,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गालवं च नमस्याथ ततो याति स्वमन्दिरम् गङ्गायाः सेवनात् पूर्वं सनाज्जातस्य यद् वपुः
verses.transliteration: gālavaṃ ca namasyātha tato yāti svamandiram gaṅgāyāḥ sevanāt pūrvaṃ sanājjātasya yad vapuḥ
verses.translation: and bowing to Galava, then goes to his own house. The body the one born of Sana had before resorting to the Ganga,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानसंध्योत्तरे काले पुनर् यद् अपि तद् द्विजे उभयं तस्य तद् रूपं गालवो नित्यम् एव च
verses.transliteration: snānasaṃdhyottare kāle punar yad api tad dvije ubhayaṃ tasya tad rūpaṃ gālavo nityam eva ca
verses.translation: and the one he had again after bathing and the twilight worship — both forms of that brahmin Galava saw every day.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सविस्मयो मेने किंचिद् अस्त्य् अत्र कारणम् एवं सविस्मयो भूत्वा गालवः प्राह तं द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā savismayo mene kiṃcid asty atra kāraṇam evaṃ savismayo bhūtvā gālavaḥ prāha taṃ dvijam
verses.translation: Seeing it, astonished, he thought, "There must be some reason for this." Thus astonished, Galava said to that brahmin,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तं तु नमस्याथ सनाज्जातं गुरुर् गृहम् आहूय यत्नतो धीमान् कृपया विस्मयेन च
verses.transliteration: gacchantaṃ tu namasyātha sanājjātaṃ gurur gṛham āhūya yatnato dhīmān kṛpayā vismayena ca
verses.translation: when the one born of Sana bowed and was going home; the wise teacher carefully called him, with compassion and wonder:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: को भवान् क्व च गन्तासि किं करोषि क्व भोक्ष्यसि किंनामा त्वं क्व शय्या ते का ते भार्या वदस्व मे
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān kva ca gantāsi kiṃ karoṣi kva bhokṣyasi kiṃnāmā tvaṃ kva śayyā te kā te bhāryā vadasva me
verses.translation: "Who are you, where will you go, what do you do, where will you eat, what is your name, where is your bed, who is your wife? Tell me."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: gālavasya vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇo 'py āha taṃ munim
verses.translation: Hearing Galava's words, the brahmin said to the sage:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: श्वः कथ्यते मया सर्वं ज्ञात्वा कार्यविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: śvaḥ kathyate mayā sarvaṃ jñātvā kāryavinirṇayam
verses.translation: "Tomorrow I will tell you everything, having determined what is to be done."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tad vipravacanaṃ śrutvā gālavaḥ prāha mā śucaḥ tavedaṃ dvividhaṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ paśyāmy apūrvavat
verses.translation: Hearing the brahmin's words, Galava said, "Do not grieve. I see this twofold form of yours daily, as never before.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पृष्टो ऽसि वृत्तान्तं श्रुतं ज्ञातं मया यथा यत् कृत्यं तव तत् सर्वं गङ्गायां प्रत्यगात् क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pṛṣṭo 'si vṛttāntaṃ śrutaṃ jñātaṃ mayā yathā yat kṛtyaṃ tava tat sarvaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ pratyagāt kṣayam
verses.translation: That is why I asked you the story; I have heard and understood it. Whatever you did has been destroyed in the Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद् अस्या देव्याः प्रसादतः पूतो ऽसि प्रत्यहं वत्स नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: asya tīrthasya māhātmyād asyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ pūto 'si pratyahaṃ vatsa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: By the greatness of this holy place and the grace of this goddess you are purified daily, my child; there is no need to deliberate.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाते तव रूपाणि सपापानि त्व् अहर्निशम् पश्ये ऽहं पुनर् अप्य् एव रूपं तव गुणोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prabhāte tava rūpāṇi sapāpāni tv aharniśam paśye 'haṃ punar apy eva rūpaṃ tava guṇottamam
verses.translation: In the morning I see your forms sinful day and night, and again I see your form excellent in virtue.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छन्तं त्व् आगोयुक्तं गच्छन्तं त्वाम् अनागसम् पश्यामि नित्यं तस्मात् त्वं पूतो देव्या कृतो ऽधुना
verses.transliteration: āgacchantaṃ tv āgoyuktaṃ gacchantaṃ tvām anāgasam paśyāmi nityaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ pūto devyā kṛto 'dhunā
verses.translation: I always see you coming burdened with sin and going sinless; therefore you have now been purified by the goddess.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान् न कार्यं ते किंचिद् अवशिष्टं भविष्यति इयं च माता ते विप्र ज्ञाता या चैव बन्धकी
verses.transliteration: tasmān na kāryaṃ te kiṃcid avaśiṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati iyaṃ ca mātā te vipra jñātā yā caiva bandhakī
verses.translation: So nothing remains for you to do. And this is your mother, O brahmin, known to be a courtesan;

verses.transliteration: paścāttāpaṃ gatātyantaṃ nivṛttā tv atha pātakāt bhūtānāṃ viṣaye prītir vatsa svābhāvikī yataḥ
verses.translation: she has repented greatly and turned away from sin. Attachment to sense-objects is natural to beings, my child;

verses.sanskrit: सत्सङ्गतो महापुण्यान् निवृत्तिर् दैवतो भवेत् अत्यर्थम् अनुतप्तेयं प्रागाचरितपुण्यतः
verses.transliteration: satsaṅgato mahāpuṇyān nivṛttir daivato bhavet atyartham anutapteyaṃ prāgācaritapuṇyataḥ
verses.translation: through the company of the good and great merit, turning away comes by divine grace. She has repented exceedingly through merit done before.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं कृत्वा चात्र तीर्थे ततः पूता भविष्यति तथा तौ चक्रतुर् उभौ मातापुत्रौ च नारद
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ kṛtvā cātra tīrthe tataḥ pūtā bhaviṣyati tathā tau cakratur ubhau mātāputrau ca nārada
verses.translation: Bathing at this holy place she will then be purified." And so, O Narada, mother and son both did so,

verses.sanskrit: स्नानाद् बभूवतुर् उभौ गतपापाव् असंशयम् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं धौतपापं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: snānād babhūvatur ubhau gatapāpāv asaṃśayam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ dhautapāpaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: and by bathing both became free of sin, without doubt. From then on that holy place is called Dhautapapa,

verses.sanskrit: पापप्रणाशनं नाम गालवं चेति विश्रुतम् महापातकम् अल्पं वा तथा यच् चोपपातकम् तत् सर्वं नाशयेद् एतद् धौतपापं सुपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: pāpapraṇāśanaṃ nāma gālavaṃ ceti viśrutam mahāpātakam alpaṃ vā tathā yac copapātakam tat sarvaṃ nāśayed etad dhautapāpaṃ supuṇyadam
verses.translation: famed as Papapranashana and Galava. Great sin, small sin, or minor sin — this Dhautapapa destroys all, granting great merit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र दाशरथी रामः सीतया सहितो द्विज पितॄन् संतर्पयाम् आस पितृतीर्थं ततो विदुः
verses.transliteration: yatra dāśarathī rāmaḥ sītayā sahito dvija pitṝn saṃtarpayām āsa pitṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ
verses.translation: Krsna loved Rukmini and the lady of beautiful smiles loved him in return. Due to hatred, Rukmin did not give her to the discus-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna loved Rukmini and the lady of beautiful smiles loved him in return. Due to hatred, Rukmin did not give her to the discus-bearing lord.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पितॄणां तर्पणं तथा सर्वम् अक्षयताम् एति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā sarvam akṣayatām eti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Urged by Jarasandha and Rukmin together, Bhismaka of great exploit gave Rukmini to Sisupala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by Jarasandha and Rukmin together, Bhismaka of great exploit gave Rukmini to Sisupala.

verses.transliteration: yatra dāśarathī rāmo viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim pūjayām āsa rājendro munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: Then for the purpose of marriage the kings led by Jarasandha, and Sisupala went to Kundina the city of Bhismaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then for the purpose of marriage the kings led by Jarasandha, and Sisupala went to Kundina the city of Bhismaka.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रं तु तत् तीर्थम् ऋषिजुष्टं सुपुण्यदम् तत्स्वरूपं च वक्ष्यामि पठितं वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraṃ tu tat tīrtham ṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyadam tatsvarūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi paṭhitaṃ vedavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Surrounded by Balarama and other scions of the Yadu, Krsna went to Kundina to witness the marriage of Sisupala, the king of Cedi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surrounded by Balarama and other scions of the Yadu, Krsna went to Kundina to witness the marriage of Sisupala, the king of Cedi.

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्टिर् अभूत् पूर्वं प्रजानाम् अतिभीषणा विश्वामित्रो महाप्राज्ञः सशिष्यो गौतमीम् अगात्
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭir abhūt pūrvaṃ prajānām atibhīṣaṇā viśvāmitro mahāprājñaḥ saśiṣyo gautamīm agāt
verses.translation: On the sixth day after his birth, O brahmins, Kala- sambara kidnapped Pradyumna from the lying-in-chamber thinking—"O this one will be my killer".
verses.commentary: Sense: On the sixth day after his birth, O brahmins, Kala- sambara kidnapped Pradyumna from the lying-in-chamber thinking—"O this one will be my killer".

verses.transliteration: śiṣyān putrāṃś ca jāyāṃ ca kṛśān dṛṣṭvā kṣudhāturān vyathitaḥ kauśikaḥ śrīmāñ śiṣyān idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: Taking the boy with him he hurled him into the briny sea, infested with crocodiles, the awful abode of sparks that abounded in eddies and whirlpools generated by billows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking the boy with him he hurled him into the briny sea, infested with crocodiles, the awful abode of sparks that abounded in eddies and whirlpools generated by billows.

verses.sanskrit: यथा कथंचिद् यत् किंचिद् यत्र क्वापि यथा तथा आनीयतां किंतु भक्ष्यं भोज्यं वा मा विलम्ब्यताम् इदानीम् एव गन्तव्यम् आनेतव्यं क्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: yathā kathaṃcid yat kiṃcid yatra kvāpi yathā tathā ānīyatāṃ kiṃtu bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vā mā vilambyatām idānīm eva gantavyam ānetavyaṃ kṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: As the boy fell down there a fish caught hold of him. Though burned by its gastric fire the boy did not die.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the boy fell down there a fish caught hold of him. Though burned by its gastric fire the boy did not die.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषेस् तद् वचनाच् छिष्याः क्षुधितास् त्वरया ययुः अटमाना इतश् चेतो मृतं ददृशिरे शुनम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣes tad vacanāc chiṣyāḥ kṣudhitās tvarayā yayuḥ aṭamānā itaś ceto mṛtaṃ dadṛśire śunam
verses.translation: O brahmins, this fish alongwith other fishes was caught by fishermen and offered to Sambara the most excellent one among the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, this fish alongwith other fishes was caught by fishermen and offered to Sambara the most excellent one among the Asuras.
