verses.transliteration: gacchatāṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ lokatritayapāvanīm snānaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ tasyāṃ kurutāṃ śraddhayānvitau
verses.translation: O Krsna, O Krsna, O lord of the universe, I know (hat you are Purusottama the great lord, the great Atman the greatest being without beginning or without end. Be pleased, O lord, fearlessness (freedom from fear) has been offered to Bana by me. The words uttered by me should not be falsified by you.
verses.wordMeaning: O Krsna, O Krsna, O lord of the universe, I know (hat you are Purusottama the great lord, the great Atman the greatest being without beginning or without end. Be pleased, O lord, fearlessness (freedom from fear) has been offered to Bana by me.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टावनामिता ध्याता गौतमी सर्वकामदा न देशकालजात्यादिनियमो ऽत्रावगाहने ज्येष्ठो ऽनृणस् ततो भूयात् परिवित्तिर् न चेतरः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāvanāmitā dhyātā gautamī sarvakāmadā na deśakālajātyādiniyamo 'trāvagāhane jyeṣṭho 'nṛṇas tato bhūyāt parivittir na cetaraḥ
verses.translation: He has grown old in serving me and having my support. O unchanging one, it is not your fault. (?) Boons have been granted to this Daitya by me. Hence, I request fo. your forbearance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has grown old in serving me and having my support. O unchanging one, it is not your fault. (?) Boons have been granted to this Daitya by me. Hence, I request fo. your forbearance.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ pṛthuśravā jyeṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā snānaṃ satarpaṇam trayāṇām api lokānāṃ kākṣīvato 'nṛṇo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Thus requested, Krsna became delighted as evidenced by his bright face. His anger towards the Asura disappeared. He spoke to the Trident-bearing lord of Uma. O Sankara, may Bana live (since) he has been grant¬ ed boons by you. The discus has been withdrawn by me out of ' deference for your words.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ṛṇamocanam ucyate śrautasmārta-ṛṇebhyaś ca itarebhyaś ca nārada tatra snānena dānena ṛṇī muktaḥ sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: After saying this Krsna went to that place where the son of Pradyumna had been imprisoned. When dried up by the winds of Garuda the serpents that fettered him perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Krsna went to that place where the son of Pradyumna had been imprisoned. When dried up by the winds of Garuda the serpents that fettered him perished.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णासंगमं नाम काद्रवासंगमं तथा महेश्वरो यत्र देवो गङ्गापुलिनम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: suparṇāsaṃgamaṃ nāma kādravāsaṃgamaṃ tathā maheśvaro yatra devo gaṅgāpulinam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, even as I narrate, let this be listened to with great attention how Varanasi was burned by Krsna during his incarnation as a human being.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, even as I narrate, let this be listened to with great attention how Varanasi was burned by Krsna during his incarnation as a human being.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकुण्डं च तत्रैव रौद्रं वैष्णवम् एव च सौरं सौम्यं तथा ब्राह्मं कौमारं वारुणं तथा
verses.transliteration: agnikuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva raudraṃ vaiṣṇavam eva ca sauraṃ saumyaṃ tathā brāhmaṃ kaumāraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: (Defective) Paundraka, king of Varanasi was told by the people deluded by ignorance—"Vasudeva has taken in¬ carnation on the Earth. You are that incarnation."
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Paundraka, king of Varanasi was told by the people deluded by ignorance—"Vasudeva has taken in¬ carnation on the Earth. You are that incarnation."

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरा च नदी यत्र संगता गङ्गया तथा तत्तीर्थस्मरणाद् एव कृतकृत्यो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: apsarā ca nadī yatra saṃgatā gaṅgayā tathā tattīrthasmaraṇād eva kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: When the messenger who had been instructed thus,
verses.commentary: Sense: When the messenger who had been instructed thus,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापप्रशमनं शृणु यत्नेन नारद इन्द्रेण हिंसिताः पूर्वं वालखिल्या महर्षयः दत्तार्धतपसः सर्वे प्रोचुस् ते काश्यपं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada indreṇa hiṃsitāḥ pūrvaṃ vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ dattārdhatapasaḥ sarve procus te kāśyapaṃ munim
verses.translation: On hearing about the endeavour of Krsna and that of his (Paundraka's), the lord of Kasi came as his supporting ally, with all his armies surrounding him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the endeavour of Krsna and that of his (Paundraka's), the lord of Kasi came as his supporting ally, with all his armies surrounding him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रम् उत्पादयानेन इन्द्रदर्पहरं शुभम् तपसो ऽर्धं तु दास्यामस् तथेत्य् आह मुनिस् तु तान्
verses.transliteration: putram utpādayānena indradarpaharaṃ śubham tapaso 'rdhaṃ tu dāsyāmas tathety āha munis tu tān
verses.translation: With a great army (of his own) and that of the king of Kasi, Paundraka Vasudeva marched against Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: With a great army (of his own) and that of the king of Kasi, Paundraka Vasudeva marched against Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णायां ततो गर्भम् आदधे स प्रजापतिः कद्र्वां चैव शनैर् ब्रह्मन् सर्पाणां सर्पमातरि
verses.transliteration: suparṇāyāṃ tato garbham ādadhe sa prajāpatiḥ kadrvāṃ caiva śanair brahman sarpāṇāṃ sarpamātari
verses.translation: Instantaneously he slew the army by means of arrows discharged from his bow and blazing like fires, and by means of hits and blows with the iron clubs and discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Instantaneously he slew the army by means of arrows discharged from his bow and blazing like fires, and by means of hits and blows with the iron clubs and discus.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते गर्भिण्याव् उभे आह गन्तुकामः प्रजापतिः अपराधो न च क्वापि कार्यो गमनम् एव च
verses.transliteration: te garbhiṇyāv ubhe āha gantukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ aparādho na ca kvāpi kāryo gamanam eva ca
verses.translation: After destroying the army of the king of Kasi also, Krsna spoke to Paundraka who was deluded and who bore his own characteristic marks.
verses.commentary: Sense: After destroying the army of the king of Kasi also, Krsna spoke to Paundraka who was deluded and who bore his own characteristic marks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र गमनाच् छापो भविष्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anyatra gamanāc chāpo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O Paundraka, through the messenger you had told me <f Leave the symbols." I shall now accomplish it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Paundraka, through the messenger you had told me <f Leave the symbols." I shall now accomplish it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sa yayau patnyau gate bhartari te ubhe tadaiva jagmatuḥ sattram ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: After saying this, he discharged his discus by which Paundraka was torn asunder. He was then threshed with his iron club. Garuda of Paundraka was smashed by his own Garuda.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, he discharged his discus by which Paundraka was torn asunder. He was then threshed with his iron club. Garuda of Paundraka was smashed by his own Garuda.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मवृन्दसमाकीर्णं गङ्गातीरसमाश्रितम् उन्मत्ते ते उभे नित्यं वयःसंपत्तिगर्विते
verses.transliteration: brahmavṛndasamākīrṇaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam unmatte te ubhe nityaṃ vayaḥsaṃpattigarvite
verses.translation: On seeing the head of the king of Kasi fallen in his city the wonder-struck people said—'"What is this? By whom is this heinous crime committed?
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the head of the king of Kasi fallen in his city the wonder-struck people said—'"What is this? By whom is this heinous crime committed?

verses.sanskrit: निवार्यमाणे बहुशो मुनिभिस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिः विकुर्वत्यौ तत्र सत्त्रे समानि च हवींषि च
verses.transliteration: nivāryamāṇe bahuśo munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ vikurvatyau tatra sattre samāni ca havīṃṣi ca
verses.translation: He chose thus—"O lord, O Mahcsvara, by your favour, may a Krtya (female deity of destruction) rise up for destroying Krsna who slew my lather."
verses.commentary: Sense: He chose thus—"O lord, O Mahcsvara, by your favour, may a Krtya (female deity of destruction) rise up for destroying Krsna who slew my lather."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: योषितां दुर्विलसितं कः संवरितुम् ईश्वरः ते दृष्ट्वा चुक्षुभुर् विप्रा अपमार्गरते उभे
verses.transliteration: yoṣitāṃ durvilasitaṃ kaḥ saṃvaritum īśvaraḥ te dṛṣṭvā cukṣubhur viprā apamārgarate ubhe
verses.translation: It had an awful face blazing terrible with flames of fire. The tresses were dishevelled and blazing. Angrily shouting 'Krsna Krsna' it went to Dvaravatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had an awful face blazing terrible with flames of fire. The tresses were dishevelled and blazing. Angrily shouting 'Krsna Krsna' it went to Dvaravatl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपमार्गस्थिते यस्माद् आपगे हि भविष्यथः सुपर्णा चैव कद्रूश् च नद्यौ ते संबभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: apamārgasthite yasmād āpage hi bhaviṣyathaḥ suparṇā caiva kadrūś ca nadyau te saṃbabhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the terrible Krtya with hideous eyes, the people of Dvaraka sought refuge in Sri Krsna who is worthy of being the refuge to the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the terrible Krtya with hideous eyes, the people of Dvaraka sought refuge in Sri Krsna who is worthy of being the refuge to the worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिद् गृहं प्रायात् कश्यपो ऽथ प्रजापतिः ऋषिभ्यस् तत्र वृत्तान्तं शापं ताभ्यां सविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sa kadācid gṛhaṃ prāyāt kaśyapo 'tha prajāpatiḥ ṛṣibhyas tatra vṛttāntaṃ śāpaṃ tābhyāṃ savistaram
verses.translation: After propitiating the bull-emblemed deity this great Krtya lias been created by the son of the king of Kasi for killing you, the discus-bearing lord. Kill this terrible Krtya having a confused mess of matted hair blazing like flame of fire.

verses.translation: Pleased, Prajapati performed the parting-of-the-hair rite for them, and honoured the brahmins by the prescribed rite.

verses.translation: When the brahmins had eaten in Kashyapa's house, Kadru, seated near her husband, looking at the brahmins,

verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadrūr ṛṣīn akṣṇā prāhasat te ca cukṣubhuḥ yenākṣṇā hasitā pāpe bhajyatāṃ te 'kṣi pāpavat
verses.translation: laughed at the sages with her eye, and they were angered: "Wicked one, since you laughed with your eye, let your eye be broken, sinner."

verses.transliteration: kāṇābhavat tataḥ kadrūḥ sarpamāteti yocyate tataḥ prasādayām āsa kaśyapo bhagavān ṛṣīn
verses.translation: Kadru then became one-eyed — she who is called the mother of serpents. Then the Lord Kashyapa appeased the sages.

verses.translation: Then, pleased, they said, "The Gautami, best of rivers, will protect from thousands of offences through resort to her."

verses.sanskrit: भार्यान्वितस् तथा चक्रे कश्यपो मुनिसत्तमः ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् उभयोः संगमं विदुः सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryānvitas tathā cakre kaśyapo munisattamaḥ tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ubhayoḥ saṃgamaṃ viduḥ sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: Kashyapa, best of sages, did so with his wives. From then on that holy place is known as the confluence of the two, allaying all sins and granting the fruit of all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवसम् आख्यातं तीर्थं वेदविदो विदुः स्मरणाद् एव पापानां नाशनं किं तु दर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: purūravasam ākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ smaraṇād eva pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ kiṃ tu darśanāt
verses.translation: O sage, we wish to hear again about the exploits of the intelligent Balarama. It behoves you to recount his heroism unto us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरूरवा ब्रह्मसदः प्राप्य तत्र सरस्वतीम् यदृच्छया देवनदीं हसन्तीं ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तिके तां दृष्ट्वा रूपसंपन्नाम् उर्वशीं प्राह भूपतिः
verses.transliteration: purūravā brahmasadaḥ prāpya tatra sarasvatīm yadṛcchayā devanadīṃ hasantīṃ brahmaṇo 'ntike tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannām urvaśīṃ prāha bhūpatiḥ
verses.translation: His exploits, such as dragging Yamuna have already been heard by us here. Hence, O blessed one, kindly recount anything else which Bala performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: His exploits, such as dragging Yamuna have already been heard by us here. Hence, O blessed one, kindly recount anything else which Bala performed.

verses.transliteration: keyaṃ rūpavatī sādhvī sthiteyaṃ brahmaṇo 'ntike sarvāsām uttamā yoṣid dīpayantī sabhām imām
verses.translation: O sages, listen to the activities carried out by Rama the infinite one, the unmeasurable one, the incarnation ofSesa, the holder of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, listen to the activities carried out by Rama the infinite one, the unmeasurable one, the incarnation ofSesa, the holder of the Earth.

verses.transliteration: urvaśī prāha rājānam iyaṃ devanadī śubhā sarasvatī brahmasutā nityam eti ca yāti ca tac chrutvā vismito rājā ānayemāṃ mamāntikam
verses.translation: Samba the heroic son of Jambavatl forcefully abducted Duryodhana's daughter whose Svayamvara was awaited.

verses.transliteration: urvaśī punar apy āha rājānaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Then the infuriated Karna, Duryodhana and others including Bhlsma and Drona of great prowess bound him after conquering him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the infuriated Karna, Duryodhana and others including Bhlsma and Drona of great prowess bound him after conquering him.

verses.transliteration: ānīyate mahārāja tasyāḥ sarvaṃ nivedya ca
verses.translation: On hearing about it, O sages, the Yadavas became
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about it, O sages, the Yadavas became

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तां प्राहिणोत् तत्र राजा प्रीत्या तदोर्वशीम् सा गत्वा राजवचनं न्यवेदयद् अथोर्वशी
verses.transliteration: tatas tāṃ prāhiṇot tatra rājā prītyā tadorvaśīm sā gatvā rājavacanaṃ nyavedayad athorvaśī
verses.translation: Bala stopped them and spoke to them although his words were indistinct through inebriation:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Bala stopped them and spoke to them although his words were indistinct through inebriation:—

verses.transliteration: sarasvaty api tan mene urvaśyā yan niveditam sā tatheti pratijñāya prāyād yatra purūravāḥ
verses.translation: Then Balarama went to Hastinapura. He camped in the middle of a park at the outskirts of the city. He did not enter it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Balarama went to Hastinapura. He camped in the middle of a park at the outskirts of the city. He did not enter it.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यास् ततस् तीरे स रेमे बहुलाः समाः सरस्वान् अभवत् पुत्रो यस्य पुत्रो बृहद्रथः
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyās tatas tīre sa reme bahulāḥ samāḥ sarasvān abhavat putro yasya putro bṛhadrathaḥ
verses.translation: On coming to know that Balarama had arrived, Duryodhana and others brought unto him by way of presents, greetings, along with Arghya and water for drinking.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know that Balarama had arrived, Duryodhana and others brought unto him by way of presents, greetings, along with Arghya and water for drinking.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तां गच्छन्तीं नृपगृहं नित्यम् एव सरस्वतीम् सरस्वन्तं ततो लक्ष्म ज्ञात्वान्येषु तथा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ gacchantīṃ nṛpagṛhaṃ nityam eva sarasvatīm sarasvantaṃ tato lakṣma jñātvānyeṣu tathā kṛtam
verses.translation: After duly accepting those things he said to the Kauravas—"It is Ugrasena's order—Release Samba quickly".
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly accepting those things he said to the Kauravas—"It is Ugrasena's order—Release Samba quickly".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यै ददाव् अहं शापं भूया इति महानदी मच्छापभीता वागीशा प्रागाद् देवीं च गौतमीम्
verses.transliteration: tasyai dadāv ahaṃ śāpaṃ bhūyā iti mahānadī macchāpabhītā vāgīśā prāgād devīṃ ca gautamīm
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on hearing his words, Bhlsma, Drona, Karna, Duryodhana and others became angry.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, on hearing his words, Bhlsma, Drona, Karna, Duryodhana and others became angry.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कमण्डलुभवां पूतां मातरं लोकपावनीम् तापत्रयोपशमनीम् ऐहिकामुष्मिकप्रदाम्
verses.transliteration: kamaṇḍalubhavāṃ pūtāṃ mātaraṃ lokapāvanīm tāpatrayopaśamanīm aihikāmuṣmikapradām
verses.translation: Bahllka and all other kings too, were angry on seeing Balarama who had the threshing rod for his weapon and realizing that the race of Yadu did not deserve a kingdom, they said:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahllka and all other kings too, were angry on seeing Balarama who had the threshing rod for his weapon and realizing that the race of Yadu did not deserve a kingdom, they said:—
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा गत्वा गौतमीं देवीं प्राह मच्छापम् आदितः गङ्गापि माम् उवाचेदं विशापां कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: sā gatvā gautamīṃ devīṃ prāha macchāpam āditaḥ gaṅgāpi mām uvācedaṃ viśāpāṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: If even Ugrasena can pass orders on Kauravas, enough of the white umbrellas and ornaments befitting kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: If even Ugrasena can pass orders on Kauravas, enough of the white umbrellas and ornaments befitting kings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न युक्तं यत् सरस्वत्याः शापं त्वं दत्तवान् असि स्त्रीणाम् एष स्वभावो वै पुंस्कामा योषितो यतः
verses.transliteration: na yuktaṃ yat sarasvatyāḥ śāpaṃ tvaṃ dattavān asi strīṇām eṣa svabhāvo vai puṃskāmā yoṣito yataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, go back, O Balarama. Neither at your bidding will we release Samba whose activities are unjust.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, go back, O Balarama. Neither at your bidding will we release Samba whose activities are unjust.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावचपला ब्रह्मन् योषितः सकला अपि त्वं कथं तु न जानीषे जगत्स्रष्टाम्बुजासन
verses.transliteration: svabhāvacapalā brahman yoṣitaḥ sakalā api tvaṃ kathaṃ tu na jānīṣe jagatsraṣṭāmbujāsana
verses.translation: Formerly, Kukuras and Andhakas used to bow unto us, for we are worthy of that honour. Now-a-days that usual obeisance is not made. What is this commanding attitude of a servant towards a master?
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Kukuras and Andhakas used to bow unto us, for we are worthy of that honour. Now-a-days that usual obeisance is not made. What is this commanding attitude of a servant towards a master?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विडम्बयति कं वा न कामो वापि स्वभावतः ततो विशापम् अवदं दृश्यापि स्यात् सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: viḍambayati kaṃ vā na kāmo vāpi svabhāvataḥ tato viśāpam avadaṃ dṛśyāpi syāt sarasvatī
verses.translation: After saying this the Kauravas remained adamant. They did not release Krsna's son. After making this unanimous decision they entered Hastinapura.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the Kauravas remained adamant. They did not release Krsna's son. After making this unanimous decision they entered Hastinapura.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच् छापान् नदी मर्त्ये दृश्यादृश्या सरस्वती यत्रैषा संगता देवी गङ्गायां शापविह्वला
verses.transliteration: tasmāc chāpān nadī martye dṛśyādṛśyā sarasvatī yatraiṣā saṃgatā devī gaṅgāyāṃ śāpavihvalā
verses.translation: Maddened by the anger originating from the insult, Balarama lifted up his rugged ploughshare and rolled it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maddened by the anger originating from the insult, Balarama lifted up his rugged ploughshare and rolled it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र प्रायान् नृपवरो धार्मिकः स पुरूरवाः तपस् तप्त्वा समाराध्य देवं सिद्धेश्वरं हरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra prāyān nṛpavaro dhārmikaḥ sa purūravāḥ tapas taptvā samārādhya devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ haram
verses.translation: Alas, the insignificant wicked haughty Kauravas wish to rule over us. It is brought abput by adverse time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Alas, the insignificant wicked haughty Kauravas wish to rule over us. It is brought abput by adverse time.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् अथावाप गङ्गायाश् च प्रसादतः ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पुरूरवसम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān athāvāpa gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ purūravasam ucyate
verses.translation: The womenfolk of the servants of Ugrasena wear bun¬ ches of flower, of Parijata tree, still he is not a king for these people.
verses.commentary: Sense: The womenfolk of the servants of Ugrasena wear bun¬ ches of flower, of Parijata tree, still he is not a king for these people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वतीसंगमं च ब्रह्मतीर्थं तद् उच्यते सिद्धेश्वरो यत्र देवः सर्वकामप्रदं तु तत्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīsaṃgamaṃ ca brahmatīrthaṃ tad ucyate siddheśvaro yatra devaḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ tu tat
verses.translation: Let Ugrasena, the lord of kings stay by. I shall go to that city after making the Earth devoid of Kauravas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Ugrasena, the lord of kings stay by. I shall go to that city after making the Earth devoid of Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्री चैव गायत्री श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती एतानि पञ्च तीर्थानि पुण्यानि मुनयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī etāni pañca tīrthāni puṇyāni munayo viduḥ
verses.translation: O holy sage, explain the number of Parardha as it has been mentioned before, and by doubling which the natural re¬ absorption has to be realized. Fifteen Kalas make a Nadika. In the calculation of time by means of the measurement of water it is equivalent to half of thirteen Palas (6£ Palas of water trickling down through a hole may take a Nadika of time i.e. 24 minutes to flow out completely).

verses.wordMeaning: O holy sage, explain the number of Parardha as it has been mentioned before, and by doubling which the natural re¬ absorption has to be realized. Fifteen Kalas make a Nadika.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु पीत्वा तु मुच्यते सर्वकल्मषात् सावित्री चैव गायत्री श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu pītvā tu mucyate sarvakalmaṣāt sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, two Nadikas make one Muhurta (48 minutes). A day of twentyfour hours consists of thirty Muhurtas and thirty days make a month. Twelve months make a year and this constitutes a peiiod of a day and a night in the heaven. Three hundred and sixty human years make one divine year.

verses.transliteration: etā mama sutā jyeṣṭhā dharmasaṃsthānahetavaḥ sarvāsām uttamāṃ kāṃcin nirmame lokasundarīm
verses.translation: Twelve thousand divine years make a set of four Yugas. A thousand sets of four Yugas are considered to be one day of Brahma. Then, O excellent sages, almost all of those earthly

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विकृता बुद्धिर् ममासीन् मुनिसत्तम गृह्यमाणा मया बाला सा मां दृष्ट्वा पलायिता
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtā buddhir mamāsīn munisattama gṛhyamāṇā mayā bālā sā māṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyitā
verses.translation: Then the imperishable lord Krsna assumes the form of Rudra and endeavours to keep the subjects within himself for the purpose of annihilation. After drinking up the water present in the elements and living beings, O brahmins, he makes the entire surface of the Earth dried up and withered.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the imperishable lord Krsna assumes the form of Rudra and endeavours to keep the subjects within himself for the purpose of annihilation. After drinking up the water present in the elements and living beings, O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the imperishable lord Krsna assumes the form of Rudra and endeavours to keep the subjects within himself for the purpose of annihilation. After drinking up the water present in the elements and living beings, O brahmins,…
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृगीभूता तु सा बाला मृगो ऽहम् अभवं तदा मृगव्याधो ऽभवच् छंभुर् धर्मसंरक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: mṛgībhūtā tu sā bālā mṛgo 'ham abhavaṃ tadā mṛgavyādho 'bhavac chaṃbhur dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca
verses.translation: He dries up oceans, rivers, mountains and mountain springs. He sucks up the water that is present in the nether worlds too. As every particle of water vanishes there will be seven suns, each of a thousand rays and they become increased in size due to their watery diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: He dries up oceans, rivers, mountains and mountain springs. He sucks up the water that is present in the nether worlds too. As every particle of water vanishes there will be seven suns, each of a thousand rays and they become increased in size due to their watery diet.

verses.sanskrit: ता मद्भीताः पञ्च सुता गङ्गाम् ईयुर् महानदीम् ततो महेश्वरः प्रायाद् धर्मसंरक्षणाय सः
verses.transliteration: tā madbhītāḥ pañca sutā gaṅgām īyur mahānadīm tato maheśvaraḥ prāyād dharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya saḥ
verses.translation: Blazing from beneath and above, O brahmins, those seven suns burn up the three worlds along with the nether worlds. On being burnt by those blazing suns, the three worlds, along with the extensive area of mountains, trees and oceans, become devoid of viscidity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blazing from beneath and above, O brahmins, those seven suns burn up the three worlds along with the nether worlds. On being burnt by those blazing suns, the three worlds, along with the extensive area of mountains, trees and oceans, become devoid of viscidity.

verses.sanskrit: धनुर् गृहीत्वा सशरम् ईशो ऽपि मृगरूपिणम् माम् उवाच वधिष्ये त्वां मृगव्याधस् तदा हरः
verses.transliteration: dhanur gṛhītvā saśaram īśo 'pi mṛgarūpiṇam mām uvāca vadhiṣye tvāṃ mṛgavyādhas tadā haraḥ
verses.translation: Then the entire area of the three worlds, O brahmins, has all the trees and watery parts dried up. The Earth attains the shape of the back of a tortoise. Thereafter lord Hara, the annihilator of all created be¬ ings, terrible like black fire, burns the nether worlds from below by means of the hot breath of the serpent Sesa.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the entire area of the three worlds, O brahmins, has all the trees and watery parts dried up. The Earth attains the shape of the back of a tortoise. Thereafter lord Hara, the annihilator of all created be¬ ings, terrible like black fire,…

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मणो निवृत्तो ऽहं प्रादां कन्यां विवस्वते सावित्र्याद्याः पञ्च सुता नदीरूपेण संगताः
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaṇo nivṛtto 'haṃ prādāṃ kanyāṃ vivasvate sāvitryādyāḥ pañca sutā nadīrūpeṇa saṃgatāḥ
verses.translation: From there also people proceed ahead to Janaloka on being scorched by the great sunshine ten times more power¬ ful. They are desirous of a supreme abode. After burning the entire universe, O excellent sages, the lord in the guise of Rudra, produces clouds by means* of breath expelled from his mouth.
verses.wordMeaning: From there also people proceed ahead to Janaloka on being scorched by the great sunshine ten times more power¬ ful. They are desirous of a supreme abode. After burning the entire universe, O excellent sages, the lord in the guise of Rudra,…

verses.sanskrit: ता आगताः पुनश् चापि स्वर्गं लोकं ममान्तिकम् यत्र ताः संगता देव्या पञ्च तीर्थानि नारद
verses.transliteration: tā āgatāḥ punaś cāpi svargaṃ lokaṃ mamāntikam yatra tāḥ saṃgatā devyā pañca tīrthāni nārada
verses.translation: Thereafter, rise up in the sky the Samvartaka clouds Some of these clouds are like a collyrium mountain; some are like the elephant Kumuda. Some are smoky in colour! Some are yellow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, rise up in the sky the Samvartaka clouds Some of these clouds are like a collyrium mountain; some are like the elephant Kumuda. Some are smoky in colour! Some are yellow.

verses.sanskrit: संगतानि च पुण्यानि पञ्च नद्यः सरस्वती तेषु स्नानं तथा दानं यत् किंचित् कुरुते नरः
verses.transliteration: saṃgatāni ca puṇyāni pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatī teṣu snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ yat kiṃcit kurute naraḥ
verses.translation: Some are turmeric; some resemble the exudation of lac juice; some appear like lapis lazuli; and some are like sapphire. Some resemble a conch shell and others the turner's lathe; some are like Jati flower (white jasmine) and some are like Kunda. Some are scarlet coloured like the tiny insect Indragopa (glow-worm) and some are like Manahs'ita (?)
verses.wordMeaning: Some are turmeric; some resemble the exudation of lac juice; some appear like lapis lazuli; and some are like sapphire. Some resemble a conch shell and others the turner's lathe; some are like Jati flower (white jasmine) and some are like Kunda.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामप्रदं तत् स्यान् नैष्कर्म्यान् मुक्तिदं स्मृतम् तत्राभवन् मृगव्याधं तीर्थं सर्वार्थदं नृणाम् स्वर्गमोक्षफलं चान्यद् ब्रह्मतीर्थफलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmapradaṃ tat syān naiṣkarmyān muktidaṃ smṛtam tatrābhavan mṛgavyādhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ nṛṇām svargamokṣaphalaṃ cānyad brahmatīrthaphalaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Some of the terrible clouds rise up like the petals of a Others resemble the apartments on the tops of houses; some are like the dry tracts of ground. They are huge in body and loud In their sound; they cover the sky completely.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of the terrible clouds rise up like the petals of a Others resemble the apartments on the tops of houses; some are like the dry tracts of ground. They are huge in body and loud In their sound; they cover the sky completely.

verses.sanskrit: शमीतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वपापोपशान्तिदम् तस्याख्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन नारद
verses.transliteration: śamītīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntidam tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada
verses.translation: How did Krsna exterminate his family under the pre¬ text of the curse of brahmins? How did he give up his human form? O messenger, I know fully well what you say. But the destruction of Yadavas is only just started by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसीत् प्रियव्रतो नाम क्षत्रियो जयतां वरः गौतम्या दक्षिणे तीरे दीक्षां चक्रे पुरोधसा
verses.transliteration: āsīt priyavrato nāma kṣatriyo jayatāṃ varaḥ gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre dīkṣāṃ cakre purodhasā
verses.translation: If they remain uncxlerminated, they will constitute a great burden unto the Earth. Hence I shall hurriedly bring that down within seven nights. In the same manner as it had been taken from the ocean I shall replace Dvaraka in the ocean, exterminate Yada¬ vas and then return to heaven.
verses.wordMeaning: If they remain uncxlerminated, they will constitute a great burden unto the Earth. Hence I shall hurriedly bring that down within seven nights. In the same manner as it had been taken from the ocean I shall replace Dvaraka in the ocean,…

verses.sanskrit: हयमेध उपक्रान्ते ऋत्विग्भिर् ऋषिभिर् वृते तस्य राज्ञो महाबाहोर् वसिष्ठस् तु पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: hayamedha upakrānte ṛtvigbhir ṛṣibhir vṛte tasya rājño mahābāhor vasiṣṭhas tu purohitaḥ
verses.translation: I shall cast off my human body too, assisted by Sam- karsana. It should be considered by the leader of Devas that I have come there. Thus informed by Vasudcva O sages, the divine messenger bowed to him and went to heaven near the king of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall cast off my human body too, assisted by Sam- karsana. It should be considered by the leader of Devas that I have come there. Thus informed by Vasudcva O sages, the divine messenger bowed to him and went to heaven near the king of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तद्यज्ञवाटम् अगमद् दानवो ऽथ हिरण्यकः तं दानवम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य देवास् त्व् इन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: tadyajñavāṭam agamad dānavo 'tha hiraṇyakaḥ taṃ dānavam abhiprekṣya devās tv indrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: Day and night the lord witnessed evil omens in hea¬ ven, on Earth and in the sky as well, indicating the destruction of Dvaraka. On seeing them he said to Yadavas—"See the extre¬ mely terrible evil omens. In order to subdue these, we shall go to Prabhasa. Do not delay".
verses.commentary: Sense: Day and night the lord witnessed evil omens in hea¬ ven, on Earth and in the sky as well, indicating the destruction of Dvaraka. On seeing them he said to Yadavas—"See the extre¬ mely terrible evil omens. In order to subdue these, we shall go to Prabhasa. Do not delay".

verses.transliteration: bhītāḥ kecid divaṃ jagmur havyavāṭ śamim āviśat aśvatthaṃ viṣṇur agamad bhānur arkaṃ vaṭaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: After finishing this family I shall go to Heaven. T e sea will engulf Dvaraka in its flood when it has been abandon¬ ed by me. Thus advised and urged by Krsna, Uddhava bowed to liim and went to the abode of Nara and Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After finishing this family I shall go to Heaven. T e sea will engulf Dvaraka in its flood when it has been abandon¬ ed by me. Thus advised and urged by Krsna, Uddhava bowed to liim and went to the abode of Nara and Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पलाशम् अगमद् गङ्गाम्भो हव्यवाहनः अश्विनौ तु हयं गृह्य वायसो ऽभूद् यमः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: somaḥ palāśam agamad gaṅgāmbho havyavāhanaḥ aśvinau tu hayaṃ gṛhya vāyaso 'bhūd yamaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Then Yadavas, O brahmins, got into fast moving chariots and went to Prabhasa alongwith Krsna, Balarama and
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Yadavas, O brahmins, got into fast moving chariots and went to Prabhasa alongwith Krsna, Balarama and
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः यष्टिम् आदाय दैतेयान् न्यवारयद् अथाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ yaṣṭim ādāya daiteyān nyavārayad athājñayā
verses.translation: Krsna restrained them. They thought that he was one who had come to assist them. They bit and struck one another. The infuriated Krsna seized a fistful of Eraka from them. Thus the iron club became the fistful of iron for their destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna restrained them. They thought that he was one who had come to assist them. They bit and struck one another. The infuriated Krsna seized a fistful of Eraka from them. Thus the iron club became the fistful of iron for their destruction.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रवृत्तः पुनर् एव यज्ञो दैत्यो गतः स्वेन बलेन युक्तः इमानि तीर्थानि ततः शुभानि दशाश्वमेधस्य फलानि दद्युः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravṛttaḥ punar eva yajño daityo gataḥ svena balena yuktaḥ imāni tīrthāni tataḥ śubhāni daśāśvamedhasya phalāni dadyuḥ
verses.translation: As an Assailant he killed all Yadavas. Suddenly they too approached him and hit one another. Others also did like¬ wise.
verses.commentary: Sense: As an Assailant he killed all Yadavas. Suddenly they too approached him and hit one another. Others also did like¬ wise.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं तु शमीतीर्थं द्वितीयं वैष्णवं विदुः आर्कं शैवं च सौम्यं च वासिष्ठं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ tu śamītīrthaṃ dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ ārkaṃ śaivaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: Then O excellent brahmins, even as Daruka went on watching, observing, Jaitra, the chariot of the discus-bearing lord was dragged by the horses through the middle of the ocean. The discus Sarnga, quivers, conch and the sword circumambulated him and went away along the solar path.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then O excellent brahmins, even as Daruka went on watching, observing, Jaitra, the chariot of the discus-bearing lord was dragged by the horses through the middle of the ocean. The discus Sarnga, quivers, conch and the sword circumambulated him and went away along the solar path.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च ऋषयः सर्वे निवृत्ते मखविस्तरे तुष्टाः प्रोचुर् वसिष्ठं तं यजमानं प्रियव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: devāś ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve nivṛtte makhavistare tuṣṭāḥ procur vasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ yajamānaṃ priyavratam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, within a moment Yadavas were destroyed except the mighty-armed Krsna and Daruka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, within a moment Yadavas were destroyed except the mighty-armed Krsna and Daruka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तांश् च वृक्षांस् तां च गङ्गां मुदा युक्ताः पुनः पुनः हयमेधस्य निष्पत्त्यै एते याता इतस् ततः
verses.transliteration: tāṃś ca vṛkṣāṃs tāṃ ca gaṅgāṃ mudā yuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ hayamedhasya niṣpattyai ete yātā itas tataḥ
verses.translation: While taking their rounds both of them saw Balarama seated at the root of a tree. A great serpent was coming out of his mouth. After wriggling out of his mouth that serpent of huge dimension went towards the ocean. It was worshipped by Siddhas as well as Nagas.
verses.commentary: Sense: While taking their rounds both of them saw Balarama seated at the root of a tree. A great serpent was coming out of his mouth. After wriggling out of his mouth that serpent of huge dimension went towards the ocean. It was worshipped by Siddhas as well as Nagas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हयमेधफलं दद्युस् तीर्थानीत्य् अवदन् सुराः तस्मात् स्नानेन दानेन तेषु तीर्थेषु नारद हयमेधफलं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति न मृषा वचः
verses.transliteration: hayamedhaphalaṃ dadyus tīrthānīty avadan surāḥ tasmāt snānena dānena teṣu tīrtheṣu nārada hayamedhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti na mṛṣā vacaḥ
verses.translation: Taking Arghya with him the ocean came face to face with Balarama. Worshipped by the excellent Nagas he entered
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking Arghya with him the ocean came face to face with Balarama. Worshipped by the excellent Nagas he entered
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रं हरिश्चन्द्रं शुनःशेपं च रोहितम् वारुणं ब्राह्मम् आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्रम् ऐन्दवम् ऐश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraṃ hariścandraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ ca rohitam vāruṇaṃ brāhmam āgneyam aindram aindavam aiśvaram
verses.translation: Thus directed, Daruka bowed to and circumambulated Krsna and went away as instructed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मैत्रं च वैष्णवं चैव याम्यम् आश्विनम् औशनम् एतेषां पुण्यतीर्थानां नामधेयं शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: maitraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva yāmyam āśvinam auśanam eteṣāṃ puṇyatīrthānāṃ nāmadheyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: Lord Krsna reinstated the greatest Brahman of the nature ofVasudcva into the Atman and held it in all living
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Krsna reinstated the greatest Brahman of the nature ofVasudcva into the Atman and held it in all living
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्र इति त्व् आसीद् इक्ष्वाकुप्रभवो नृपः तस्य गृहे मुनी प्राप्तौ नारदः पर्वतस् तथा कृत्वातिथ्यं तयोः सम्यग् घरिश्चन्द्रो ऽब्रवीद् ऋषी
verses.transliteration: hariścandra iti tv āsīd ikṣvākuprabhavo nṛpaḥ tasya gṛhe munī prāptau nāradaḥ parvatas tathā kṛtvātithyaṃ tayoḥ samyag ghariścandro 'bravīd ṛṣī
verses.translation: O excellent ones, honouring the words of brahmins and Durvasas, the lord remained in the yogic posture keeping one of his feet over the other knee.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones, honouring the words of brahmins and Durvasas, the lord remained in the yogic posture keeping one of his feet over the other knee.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं क्लिश्यते लोकः किं पुत्रेण भविष्यति ज्ञानी वाप्य् अथवाज्ञानी उत्तमो मध्यमो ऽथवा एतं मे संशयं नित्यं ब्रूताम् ऋषिवराव् उभौ
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ kliśyate lokaḥ kiṃ putreṇa bhaviṣyati jñānī vāpy athavājñānī uttamo madhyamo 'thavā etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ nityaṃ brūtām ṛṣivarāv ubhau
verses.translation: The hunter Jara came there, holding a great arrow fitted with the last remnant bit of the iron club.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hunter Jara came there, holding a great arrow fitted with the last remnant bit of the iron club.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ताव् ऊचतुर् हरिश्चन्द्रं पर्वतो नारदस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tāv ūcatur hariścandraṃ parvato nāradas tathā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing the foot of the lord having the shape of a deer the hunter stopped. With the same remnant of the iron club he hit the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: ekadhā daśadhā rājañ śatadhā ca sahasradhā uttaraṃ vidyate samyak tathāpy etad udīryate
verses.translation: Onefold, tenfold, a hundredfold and a thousandfold, O king, there is a proper answer; yet this is said:

verses.transliteration: nāputrasya paro loko vidyate nṛpasattama jāte putre pitā snānaṃ yaḥ karoti janādhipa
verses.translation: "For the sonless there is no higher world, O best of kings. The father who bathes when a son is born, O lord of people,

verses.sanskrit: दशानाम् अश्वमेधानाम् अभिषेकफलं लभेत् आत्मप्रतिष्ठा पुत्रात् स्याज् जायते चामरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: daśānām aśvamedhānām abhiṣekaphalaṃ labhet ātmapratiṣṭhā putrāt syāj jāyate cāmarottamaḥ
verses.translation: obtains the fruit of the consecration bath of ten horse sacrifices; one's standing comes from a son, and one becomes excellent among immortals.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेनामरा देवाः पुत्रेण ब्राह्मणादयः त्रिऋणान् मोचयेत् पुत्रः पितरं च पितामहान्
verses.transliteration: amṛtenāmarā devāḥ putreṇa brāhmaṇādayaḥ triṛṇān mocayet putraḥ pitaraṃ ca pitāmahān
verses.translation: The gods are immortal through nectar, brahmins and others through a son; a son frees his father and grandfathers from the three debts.

verses.sanskrit: किं तु मूलं किम् उ जलं किं तु श्मश्रूणि किं तपः विना पुत्रेण राजेन्द्र स्वर्गो मुक्तिः सुतात् स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu mūlaṃ kim u jalaṃ kiṃ tu śmaśrūṇi kiṃ tapaḥ vinā putreṇa rājendra svargo muktiḥ sutāt smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: What use is the root, what use water, what use beards, what use austerity? Without a son, O king of kings — heaven and liberation are remembered as coming from a son.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र एव परो लोको धर्मः कामो ऽर्थ एव च पुत्रो मुक्तिः परं ज्योतिस् तारकः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: putra eva paro loko dharmaḥ kāmo 'rtha eva ca putro muktiḥ paraṃ jyotis tārakaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: A son is the highest world, dharma, desire and wealth; a son is liberation, the supreme light, the saviour of all embodied beings.

verses.transliteration: vinā putreṇa rājendra svargamokṣau sudurlabhau putra eva paro loke dharmakāmārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: Without a son, O king of kings, heaven and liberation are very hard to attain; a son alone is supreme in the world for accomplishing dharma, desire and wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना पुत्रेण यद् दत्तं विना पुत्रेण यद् धुतम् विना पुत्रेण यज् जन्म व्यर्थं तद् अवभाति मे
verses.transliteration: vinā putreṇa yad dattaṃ vinā putreṇa yad dhutam vinā putreṇa yaj janma vyarthaṃ tad avabhāti me
verses.translation: What is given without a son, what is offered without a son, a birth without a son — it seems to me in vain.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् पुत्रसमं किंचित् काम्यं नास्ति जगत्त्रये तच् छ्रुत्वा विस्मयवांस् ताव् उवाच नृपः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt putrasamaṃ kiṃcit kāmyaṃ nāsti jagattraye tac chrutvā vismayavāṃs tāv uvāca nṛpaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore in the three worlds nothing is as desirable as a son." Hearing that, the king, filled with wonder, spoke to the two again:

verses.sanskrit: कथं मे स्यात् सुतो ब्रूतां यत्र क्वापि यथातथम् येन केनाप्य् उपायेन कृत्वा किंचित् तु पौरुषम् मन्त्रेण यागदानाभ्याम् उत्पाद्यो ऽसौ सुतो मया
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ me syāt suto brūtāṃ yatra kvāpi yathātatham yena kenāpy upāyena kṛtvā kiṃcit tu pauruṣam mantreṇa yāgadānābhyām utpādyo 'sau suto mayā
verses.translation: "Tell me truly how I may have a son, wherever it may be — by whatever means, having made some effort, by mantra, sacrifice or gifts, this son is to be begotten by me."

verses.transliteration: tāv ūcatur nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ hariścandraṃ sutārthinam dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tathā samyag gautamīṃ yāhi mānada
verses.translation: The two, having meditated a moment, said to Harishchandra, best of kings, who sought a son: "Go to the Gautami, O giver of honour.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापांपतिर् उत्कृष्टं ददाति मनसीप्सितम् वरुणः सर्वदाता वै मुनिभिः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpāṃpatir utkṛṣṭaṃ dadāti manasīpsitam varuṇaḥ sarvadātā vai munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: There the lord of waters grants the best wish of the mind; Varuna is declared by the sages to be the giver of all.

verses.transliteration: sa tu prītaḥ śanaiḥ kāle tava putraṃ pradāsyati etac chrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭho munivākyaṃ tathākarot
verses.translation: Pleased, he will in time give you a son." Hearing this, the best of kings followed the sages' words.

verses.transliteration: toṣayām āsa varuṇaṃ gautamītīram āśritaḥ tataś ca tuṣṭo varuṇo hariścandram uvāca ha
verses.translation: Resorting to the bank of the Gautami, he pleased Varuna; then Varuna, pleased, said to Harishchandra:

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं दास्यामि ते राजंल् लोकत्रयविभूषणम् यदि यक्ष्यसि तेनैव तव पुत्रो भवेद् ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: putraṃ dāsyāmi te rājaṃl lokatrayavibhūṣaṇam yadi yakṣyasi tenaiva tava putro bhaved dhruvam
verses.translation: "I will give you a son, O king, an ornament of the three worlds, if you will sacrifice with him; then you will surely have a son."

verses.transliteration: adyaiva putro yaṣṭavyaḥ smarase vacanaṃ purā
verses.translation: "Your son is to be sacrificed today; do you remember your promise?"

verses.transliteration: nirdaśo medhyatāṃ yāti paśur yakṣye tato hy aham
verses.translation: "An animal becomes fit for sacrifice after ten days; then I will sacrifice."

verses.translation: Hearing the king's words, Varuna went to his abode; after ten days he came again and said to the king, "Sacrifice."

verses.translation: "When a kshatriya is the victim in a sacrifice, lord of waters, when he knows the science of arms, then he is an excellent victim."

verses.translation: and that subduer of foes became learned in all the Vedas and scriptures, when Rohita at sixteen had attained the rank of crown prince,

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिमान् अगमत् तत्र यत्र राजा सरोहितः आगत्य वरुणः प्राह यजस्वाद्य सुतं स्वकम्
verses.transliteration: prītimān agamat tatra yatra rājā sarohitaḥ āgatya varuṇaḥ prāha yajasvādya sutaṃ svakam
verses.translation: he came, pleased, to where the king was with Rohita; Varuna came and said, "Sacrifice your own son today."

verses.sanskrit: ओम् इत्य् उक्त्वा नृपवर ऋत्विजः प्राह भूपतिः रोहितं च सुतं ज्येष्ठं शृण्वतो वरुणस्य च
verses.transliteration: om ity uktvā nṛpavara ṛtvijaḥ prāha bhūpatiḥ rohitaṃ ca sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca
verses.translation: Saying "Om," the best of kings spoke to the priests and to Rohita, his eldest son, while Varuna listened:

verses.sanskrit: एहि पुत्र महावीर यक्ष्ये त्वां वरुणाय हि
verses.transliteration: ehi putra mahāvīra yakṣye tvāṃ varuṇāya hi
verses.translation: "Come, my son, great hero; I will sacrifice you to Varuna."

verses.sanskrit: किम् एतद् इत्य् अथोवाच रोहितः पितरं प्रति पितापि तद् यथावृत्तम् आचचक्षे सविस्तरम् रोहितः पितरं प्राह शृण्वतो वरुणस्य च
verses.transliteration: kim etad ity athovāca rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prati pitāpi tad yathāvṛttam ācacakṣe savistaram rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prāha śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca

verses.sanskrit: अहं पूर्वं महाराज ऋत्विग्भिः सपुरोहितः विष्णवे लोकनाथाय यक्ष्ये ऽहं त्वरितं शुचिः पशुना वरुणेनाथ तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ pūrvaṃ mahārāja ṛtvigbhiḥ sapurohitaḥ viṣṇave lokanāthāya yakṣye 'haṃ tvaritaṃ śuciḥ paśunā varuṇenātha tad anujñātum arhasi
verses.translation: "Great king, I will first, pure and quickly, with the priests and the family priest, sacrifice to Vishnu, lord of the worlds, with an animal, and then to Varuna; please permit this."

verses.transliteration: rohitasya tu tad vākyaṃ śrutvā vārīśvaras tadā kopena mahatāviṣṭo jalodaram athākarot
verses.translation: Hearing Rohita's words, the lord of waters, filled with great anger, then afflicted King Harishchandra with dropsy.

verses.transliteration: hariścandrasya nṛpate rohitaḥ sa vanaṃ yayau gṛhītvā sa dhanur divyaṃ rathārūḍho gatavyathaḥ
verses.translation: Rohita went to the forest, taking his divine bow, mounted on his chariot, free from distress.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र चाराध्य वरुणं हरिश्चन्द्रो जनेश्वरः गङ्गायां प्राप्तवान् पुत्रं तत्रागात् सो ऽपि रोहितः
verses.transliteration: yatra cārādhya varuṇaṃ hariścandro janeśvaraḥ gaṅgāyāṃ prāptavān putraṃ tatrāgāt so 'pi rohitaḥ
verses.translation: Where King Harishchandra had worshipped Varuna and obtained a son at the Ganga, there Rohita too went.

verses.sanskrit: व्यतीतान्य् अथ वर्षाणि पञ्च षष्ठे प्रवर्तति तत्र स्थित्वा नृपसुतः शुश्राव नृपते रुजम्
verses.transliteration: vyatītāny atha varṣāṇi pañca ṣaṣṭhe pravartati tatra sthitvā nṛpasutaḥ śuśrāva nṛpate rujam
verses.translation: Five years passed, and in the sixth, staying there, the prince heard of the king's illness.

verses.transliteration: mayā putreṇa jātena pitur vai kleśakāriṇā kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ nu kṛtyaṃ syād ity evaṃ paryacintayat
verses.translation: "What use is it that I was born a son who causes suffering to my father? What should I do?" — thus he reflected.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तीरे ऋषीन् पुण्यान् अपश्यन् नृपतेः सुतः गङ्गातीरे वर्तमानम् अपश्यद् ऋषिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasyās tīre ṛṣīn puṇyān apaśyan nṛpateḥ sutaḥ gaṅgātīre vartamānam apaśyad ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: On its bank the prince saw holy sages; he saw a best of sages living on the bank of the Ganga,

verses.translation: known as Ajigarta, son of the sage Vayas, surrounded by three sons and his wife, his livelihood exhausted. Seeing him, the prince bowed and said:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: kṣīṇavṛttiḥ kṛśaḥ kasmād durmanā iva lakṣyase
verses.translation: "Why do you appear with your livelihood exhausted, lean and as if dejected?"

verses.translation: And Ajigarta said to Rohita, the prince:

verses.sanskrit: वर्तनं नास्ति देहस्य भोक्तारो बहवश् च मे विनान्नेन मरिष्यामो ब्रूहि किं करवामहे
verses.transliteration: vartanaṃ nāsti dehasya bhoktāro bahavaś ca me vinānnena mariṣyāmo brūhi kiṃ karavāmahe
verses.translation: "There is no means of sustaining the body, and I have many to feed; without food we shall die. Tell me, what shall we do?"

verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā punar apy āha nṛpaputra ṛṣiṃ tadā
verses.translation: Hearing that, the prince spoke again to the sage:

verses.transliteration: tava kiṃ vartate citte tad brūhi vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: "What is in your mind? Tell me that, best of speakers."

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यं रजतं गावो धान्यं वस्त्रादिकं न मे विद्यते नृपशार्दूल वर्तनं नास्ति मे ततः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ vastrādikaṃ na me vidyate nṛpaśārdūla vartanaṃ nāsti me tataḥ
verses.translation: "I have no gold, silver, cows, grain, clothes or the like, O tiger among kings; so I have no livelihood.

verses.sanskrit: सुता मे सन्ति भार्या च अहं वै पञ्चमस् तथा नैतेषां कतमस्यापि क्रेतान्नेन नृपोत्तम
verses.transliteration: sutā me santi bhāryā ca ahaṃ vai pañcamas tathā naiteṣāṃ katamasyāpi kretānnena nṛpottama
verses.translation: I have sons and a wife, and I am the fifth; will you buy any of them with food, best of kings?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं क्रीणासि महाबुद्धे ऽजीगर्त सत्यम् एव मे वद नान्यच् च वक्तव्यं विप्रा वै सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ krīṇāsi mahābuddhe 'jīgarta satyam eva me vada nānyac ca vaktavyaṃ viprā vai satyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: "What do you sell, wise Ajigarta? Tell me the truth and say nothing else; brahmins speak the truth."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि पुत्राणाम् एकं वा मां तथैव च भार्यां वापि गृहाणेमां क्रीत्वा जीवामहे वयम्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām api putrāṇām ekaṃ vā māṃ tathaiva ca bhāryāṃ vāpi gṛhāṇemāṃ krītvā jīvāmahe vayam
verses.translation: "Buy one of my three sons, or me, or my wife, and we will live."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं भार्यया महाबुद्धे किं त्वया वृद्धरूपिणा युवानं देहि पुत्रं मे पुत्राणां यं त्वम् इच्छसि
verses.transliteration: kiṃ bhāryayā mahābuddhe kiṃ tvayā vṛddharūpiṇā yuvānaṃ dehi putraṃ me putrāṇāṃ yaṃ tvam icchasi
verses.translation: "What use is your wife, wise one, or you in your old age? Give me a young son, whichever of your sons you wish."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठपुत्रं शुनःपुच्छं नाहं क्रीणामि रोहित माता कनीयसं चापि न क्रीणाति ततो ऽनयोः मध्यमं तु शुनःशेपं क्रीणामि वद तद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaputraṃ śunaḥpucchaṃ nāhaṃ krīṇāmi rohita mātā kanīyasaṃ cāpi na krīṇāti tato 'nayoḥ madhyamaṃ tu śunaḥśepaṃ krīṇāmi vada taddhanam
verses.translation: "I will not sell my eldest son Shunahpuchchha, Rohita, and the mother will not sell the youngest; of these, I will sell the middle one, Shunahshepa; name the price."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वरुणाय पशुः कल्प्यः पुरुषो गुणवत्तरः यदि क्रीणासि मूल्यं त्वं वद सत्यं महामुने

verses.translation: "Sacrifice to Varuna with this victim, and be free of disease."

verses.translation: Harishchandra spoke thus after his son's words:

verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā rājñā pālyā iti śrutiḥ viśeṣatas tu varṇānāṃ guravo hi dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: "Brahmins, kshatriyas and vaishyas are to be protected by the king — so says the scripture; and especially the best of brahmins are the teachers of the classes.

verses.transliteration: varaṃ hi jātu maraṇaṃ na kathaṃcid dvijaṃ paśum karomi tasmāt putra tvaṃ brāhmaṇena sukhaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Better to die than ever make a brahmin a victim; therefore, my son, go happily with the brahmin."

verses.translation: Meanwhile a bodiless voice spoke there:

verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ śīghraṃ gaṅgām agān nṛpottamaḥ viśvāmitreṇa ṛṣiṇā vasiṣṭhena purodhasā
verses.translation: Hearing those words, the best of kings quickly went to the Ganga, with the sage Vishvamitra and the family priest Vasishtha,

verses.transliteration: vāmadevena ṛṣiṇā tathānyair munibhiḥ saha prāpya gaṅgāṃ gautamīṃ tāṃ naramedhāya dīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: with the sage Vamadeva and other sages; reaching that Gautami Ganga, he was consecrated for the human sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: vedimaṇḍapakuṇḍādi yūpapaśvādi cākarot kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ tasmin yajñe pravartite
verses.translation: He made the altar, pavilion, fire-pits and the rest, the sacrificial post, the victim and so on; having done everything properly, when the sacrifice began,

verses.sanskrit: शुनःशेपं पशुं यूपे निबध्याथ समन्त्रकम् वारिभिः प्रोक्षितं दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रो ऽब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: śunaḥśepaṃ paśuṃ yūpe nibadhyātha samantrakam vāribhiḥ prokṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitro 'bravīd idam
verses.translation: seeing Shunahshepa, the victim, tied to the post with mantras and sprinkled with water, Vishvamitra said this:

verses.transliteration: devān ṛṣīn hariścandraṃ rohitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ anujānantv imaṃ sarve śunaḥśepaṃ dvijottamam
verses.translation: "Let the gods, the sages, Harishchandra and especially Rohita, all give leave concerning this Shunahshepa, best of brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: येभ्यस् त्व् अयं हविर् देयो देवेभ्यो ऽयं पृथक् पृथक् अनुजानन्तु ते सर्वे शुनःशेपं विशेषतः

verses.translation: The gods to whom this oblation is to be given, each separately — let them all especially give leave concerning Shunahshepa.

verses.sanskrit: वसाभिर् लोमभिस् त्वग्भिर् मांसैः सन्मन्त्रितैर् मखे अग्नौ होष्यः पशुश् चायं शुनःशेपो द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: vasābhir lomabhis tvagbhir māṃsaiḥ sanmantritair makhe agnau hoṣyaḥ paśuś cāyaṃ śunaḥśepo dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: With fat, hair, skins and flesh consecrated with good mantras in the sacrifice, this victim, Shunahshepa, best of brahmins, is to be offered in the fire.

verses.translation: Let all the best of brahmins be honoured and agree with me; let the best of brahmins go to the Gautami and, having bathed, praise the gods separately

verses.translation: with mantras and hymns and rejoice, devoted to Shiva; let the sages and the gods who eat the oblation protect him."

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् ऊचुश् च मुनयो मेने च नृपसत्तमः ततो गत्वा शुनःशेपो गङ्गां त्रैलोक्यपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: tathety ūcuś ca munayo mene ca nṛpasattamaḥ tato gatvā śunaḥśepo gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm
verses.translation: The sages said "So be it," and the best of kings agreed. Then Shunahshepa went to the Ganga, purifier of the three worlds,

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तुष्टाव तान् देवान् ये तत्र हविषो भुजः ततस् तुष्टाः सुरगणाः शुनःशेपं च ते मुने अवदन्त सुराः सर्वे विश्वामित्रस्य शृण्वतः
verses.transliteration: snātvā tuṣṭāva tān devān ye tatra haviṣo bhujaḥ tatas tuṣṭāḥ suragaṇāḥ śunaḥśepaṃ ca te mune avadanta surāḥ sarve viśvāmitrasya śṛṇvataḥ
verses.translation: bathed and praised the gods who eat the oblations there. Then the hosts of gods were pleased with Shunahshepa, O sage, and all the gods said, while Vishvamitra listened:

verses.transliteration: kratuḥ pūrṇo bhavatv eṣa śunaḥśepavadhaṃ vinā
verses.translation: "Let this rite be complete without the killing of Shunahshepa."

verses.transliteration: viśeṣeṇātha varuṇaś cāvadan nṛpasattamam tataḥ pūrṇo 'bhavad rājño nṛmedho lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: And especially Varuna spoke to the best of kings; then the king's human sacrifice, famed in the world, was completed.

verses.translation: Vishvamitra honoured Shunahshepa in the assembly and, having honoured him in the presence of the gods, made him his own son.

verses.translation: Shunahshepa's seniority Kaushika cursed; the sons who accepted his seniority he honoured

verses.translation: with a boon, O tiger among sages — this I have told you. All this happened on the southern bank of the Gautami.

verses.translation: Bathing and giving at them grant the fruit of a human sacrifice. The greatness of this holy place has been told, O best of sages;

verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayed vāpi śṛṇuyād vāpi bhaktitaḥ aputraḥ putram āpnoti yac cānyan manasaḥ priyam
verses.translation: whoever reads it, causes it to be read or hears it with devotion — the sonless obtains a son, and whatever else the mind holds dear.

verses.transliteration: somatīrtham iti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam tatra vṛttaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada
verses.translation: Arjuna found out the cast off physical bodies of Krsna and Balarama and performed the requisite consecratory rites. He did the same for others too.

verses.translation: Revati the excellent lady, embraced the body of Bala¬ rama and entered the blazing fire which cooled and delighted her by the mere touch of her body.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वाग् विबुधान् आह गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीषु कामुकाः तेभ्यो दत्त्वाथ मां देवाः सोमम् आहर्तुम् अर्हथ
verses.transliteration: tatra vāg vibudhān āha gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ tebhyo dattvātha māṃ devāḥ somam āhartum arhatha
verses.translation: On hearing about this, Ugrasena, Anakadundubhi, DevakI and RohinI entered fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about this, Ugrasena, Anakadundubhi, DevakI and RohinI entered fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वाचं प्रत्यूचुर् अमरास् त्वां दातुं न क्षमा वयम् विना तेनापि न स्थातुं शक्यं नैव त्वया विना
verses.transliteration: vācaṃ pratyūcur amarās tvāṃ dātuṃ na kṣamā vayam vinā tenāpi na sthātuṃ śakyaṃ naiva tvayā vinā
verses.translation: Arjuna performed their funeral rites in accordance with the injunctions. Taking all the people and Vajra with him he left Dvaraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arjuna performed their funeral rites in accordance with the injunctions. Taking all the people and Vajra with him he left Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् वाग् अब्रवीद् देवान् पुनर् एष्याम्य् अहं त्व् इह अत्र बुद्धिर् विधातव्या क्रियतां क्रतुर् उत्तमः
verses.transliteration: punar vāg abravīd devān punar eṣyāmy ahaṃ tv iha atra buddhir vidhātavyā kriyatāṃ kratur uttamaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of wives of Krsna went out of Dvaravatl. Looking after Vajra and the people, the son of Kunti went ahead slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of wives of Krsna went out of Dvaravatl. Looking after Vajra and the people, the son of Kunti went ahead slowly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या दक्षिणे तीरे भवेद् देवागमो यदि मखं तु विषयं कृत्वा आयान्तु सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre bhaved devāgamo yadi makhaṃ tu viṣayaṃ kṛtvā āyāntu surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, the assembly chamber Sudharma, that had been brought to the mortal world by Kisnawent back to heaven. So also the Parijata tree..
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the assembly chamber Sudharma, that had been brought to the mortal world by Kisnawent back to heaven. So also the Parijata tree..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीप्रिया नित्यं पणध्वं तं मया सह तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः सरस्वत्या वचःस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāḥ strīpriyā nityaṃ paṇadhvaṃ taṃ mayā saha tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ sarasvatyā vacaḥsthitāḥ
verses.translation: The great ocean flooded Dvaraka. The sea did not engulf the house of the most excellent one among the descendants of Yadu. This was the only thing it did not envelop in its waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great ocean flooded Dvaraka. The sea did not engulf the house of the most excellent one among the descendants of Yadu. This was the only thing it did not envelop in its waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवदूतैः पृथग् देवान् यक्षान् गन्धर्वपन्नगान् आह्वानं चक्रिरे तत्र पुण्ये देवगिरौ तदा
verses.transliteration: devadūtaiḥ pṛthag devān yakṣān gandharvapannagān āhvānaṃ cakrire tatra puṇye devagirau tadā
verses.translation: O excellent sages, in the land ofPancanada (watered by five rivers), equipped with much of wealth and foodgrains, Arjuna made arrangements for the residence of all the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, in the land ofPancanada (watered by five rivers), equipped with much of wealth and foodgrains, Arjuna made arrangements for the residence of all the people.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगिरिर् नाम पर्वतस्याभवन् मुने तत्रागमन् सुरगणा गन्धर्वा यक्षकिंनराः
verses.transliteration: tato devagirir nāma parvatasyābhavan mune tatrāgaman suragaṇā gandharvā yakṣakiṃnarāḥ
verses.translation: Tnereafter Dasyus who hurled lumps of clay and who struck with their staffs rushed at those womenfolk whose hus¬ bands had been killed. They attacked them in their thousands. Turning back, the son of Kunti spoke to the Abhiras laughingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tnereafter Dasyus who hurled lumps of clay and who struck with their staffs rushed at those womenfolk whose hus¬ bands had been killed. They attacked them in their thousands. Turning back, the son of Kunti spoke to the Abhiras laughingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सिद्धाश् च ऋषयस् तथाष्टौ देवयोनयः ऋषिभिर् गौतमीतीरे क्रियमाणे महाध्वरे
verses.transliteration: devāḥ siddhāś ca ṛṣayas tathāṣṭau devayonayaḥ ṛṣibhir gautamītīre kriyamāṇe mahādhvare
verses.translation: When the arrows were exhausted Arjuna struck them with the tip of his bow. O brahmins, at the blow the Dasyus laughed derisively.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the arrows were exhausted Arjuna struck them with the tip of his bow. O brahmins, at the blow the Dasyus laughed derisively.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवैः परिवृतः सहस्राक्षो ऽभ्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tatra devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo 'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Arjuna became dejected saying—"Alas; Alas, I have been abandoned by that lord." He lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arjuna became dejected saying—"Alas; Alas, I have been abandoned by that lord." He lamented.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वान् अथ संपूज्य सरस्वत्याः समीपतः सरस्वत्या पणध्वं नो युष्माकम् अमृतात्मना
verses.transliteration: gandharvān atha saṃpūjya sarasvatyāḥ samīpataḥ sarasvatyā paṇadhvaṃ no yuṣmākam amṛtātmanā
verses.translation: That bow, those miraculous missiles, that chariot and those horses—all these are destroyed at one'stroke like the chari¬ table gift to one who is not learned in the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That bow, those miraculous missiles, that chariot and those horses—all these are destroyed at one'stroke like the chari¬ table gift to one who is not learned in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तच् छक्रवचनात् ते वै गन्धर्वाः स्त्रीषु कामुकाः सोमं दत्त्वा सुरेभ्यस् तु जगृहुस् तां सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: tac chakravacanāt te vai gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ somaṃ dattvā surebhyas tu jagṛhus tāṃ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: My superior powers and those of Bhimawere certainly effected by Lord Kjrsna. Without him, I have been conquered by the cowherds. How can it happen otherwise?
verses.commentary: Sense: My superior powers and those of Bhimawere certainly effected by Lord Kjrsna. Without him, I have been conquered by the cowherds. How can it happen otherwise?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सोमो ऽभवच् चामराणां गन्धर्वाणां सरस्वती अवसत् तत्र वागीशा तथापि च सुरान्तिके
verses.transliteration: somo 'bhavac cāmarāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sarasvatī avasat tatra vāgīśā tathāpi ca surāntike
verses.translation: Saying thus, Arjuna went to Indraprastha. There he crowned as king, the Yadava scion Vajra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying thus, Arjuna went to Indraprastha. There he crowned as king, the Yadava scion Vajra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आयाति च रहो नित्यम् उपांशु क्रियताम् इति अत एव हि सोमस्य क्रयो भवति नारद
verses.transliteration: āyāti ca raho nityam upāṃśu kriyatām iti ata eva hi somasya krayo bhavati nārada
verses.translation: Arjuna saw there the highly blessed sage Vyasa with his abode in the forest. He approached him humbly and saluted the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arjuna saw there the highly blessed sage Vyasa with his abode in the forest. He approached him humbly and saluted the sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपांशुना वर्तितव्यं सोमक्रयण एव हि ततो ऽभवद् देवतानां सोमश् चापि सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: upāṃśunā vartitavyaṃ somakrayaṇa eva hi tato 'bhavad devatānāṃ somaś cāpi sarasvatī
verses.translation: He who had been our strength, our splendour, our prowess, our exploit, our glory, our lustre—lord Kna—has left us.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who had been our strength, our splendour, our prowess, our exploit, our glory, our lustre—lord Kna—has left us.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाणां नैव सोमो नैवासीच् च सरस्वती तत्रागमन् सर्व एव सोमार्थं गौतमीतटम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāṇāṃ naiva somo naivāsīc ca sarasvatī tatrāgaman sarva eva somārthaṃ gautamītaṭam
verses.translation: To me the Earth appears like a lady who has lost her blooming youth, whose splendour is destroyed and whose lustre has vanished. O dear one, I am not the only one to suffer from the bereavement of the discus-bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: To me the Earth appears like a lady who has lost her blooming youth, whose splendour is destroyed and whose lustre has vanished. O dear one, I am not the only one to suffer from the bereavement of the discus-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गावो देवाः पर्वता यक्षरक्षाः सिद्धाः साध्या मुनयो गुह्यकाश् गन्धर्वास् ते मरुतः पन्नगाश् सर्वौषध्यो मातरो लोकपालाः
verses.transliteration: gāvo devāḥ parvatā yakṣarakṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyā munayo guhyakāś gandharvās te marutaḥ pannagāś sarvauṣadhyo mātaro lokapālāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the power and magnificence of Krsna I was able to kill Bhlsma and others. I was like fire and they were like moths. But today, without lord Krsna, I have been defeated by cowherds. O great sage, thousands of helpless ladies have been carried off, in spite of my endeavour, by the Dasyus who had batons for their weapons.

verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिनद्यस् तु गङ्गायां संगता मुने पूर्णाहुतिर् यत्र दत्ता पूर्णाख्यानं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatinadyas tu gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatā mune pūrṇāhutir yatra dattā pūrṇākhyānaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: All the womenfolk of Krsna, while being brought over here by me, have been carried away by the cowherds who carried sticks as their weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the womenfolk of Krsna, while being brought over here by me, have been carried away by the cowherds who carried sticks as their weapons.

verses.transliteration: gautamyāṃ saṃgatā yās tu sarvāś cāpi yathoditāḥ tannāmadheyatīrthāni saṃkṣepāc chṛṇu nārada
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the noble-minded Arjuna, who Enough of your being ashamed, O Arjuna, it does not behove you to bewail. Understand that the working of time in all living beings is like this.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the noble-minded Arjuna, who Enough of your being ashamed, O Arjuna, it does not behove you to bewail. Understand that the working of time in all living beings is like this.

verses.transliteration: somatīrthaṃ ca gāndharvaṃ devatīrtham ataḥ param pūrṇātīrthaṃ tataḥ śālaṃ śrīparṇāsaṃgamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Formerly, the Earth that had been afflicted by burden had gone to Devas. It was for that purpose that Visnu who could assume any form that he desired had taken up incarnation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the Earth that had been afflicted by burden had gone to Devas. It was for that purpose that Visnu who could assume any form that he desired had taken up incarnation.

verses.sanskrit: स्वागतासंगमं पुण्यं कुसुमायाश् च संगमम् पुष्टिसंगमम् आख्यातं कर्णिकासंगमं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: svāgatāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ kusumāyāś ca saṃgamam puṣṭisaṃgamam ākhyātaṃ karṇikāsaṃgamaṃ śubham
verses.translation: That task has been achieved, the kings have been killed. The family of Vrsnis and Andhakas has been duly finished. This lord of Devas performs creation at the beginning and sustains during its maintenance. He is competent to annihi¬ late as well, as has been done now.
verses.commentary: Sense: That task has been achieved, the kings have been killed. The family of Vrsnis and Andhakas has been duly finished. This lord of Devas performs creation at the beginning and sustains during its maintenance. He is competent to annihi¬ late as well, as has been done now.

verses.sanskrit: वैणवीसंगमश् चैव कृशरासंगमस् तथा वासवीसंगमश् चैव शिवशर्या तथा शिखी
verses.transliteration: vaiṇavīsaṃgamaś caiva kṛśarāsaṃgamas tathā vāsavīsaṃgamaś caiva śivaśaryā tathā śikhī
verses.translation: Hence, O Arjuna, you must not feel aggrieved due to this discomfiture. At the moment of creative activity men will have exploits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Arjuna, you must not feel aggrieved due to this discomfiture. At the moment of creative activity men will have exploits.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुम्भिका उपारथ्या शान्तिजा देवजा तदा अजो वृद्धः सुरो भद्रो गौतम्या सह संगताः
verses.transliteration: kusumbhikā upārathyā śāntijā devajā tadā ajo vṛddhaḥ suro bhadro gautamyā saha saṃgatāḥ
verses.translation: That lord, the lord of the universe, permeates other bodies and performs the task of dissolving all living beings in the end. During the origin of this creative process the lord was your ally, O son of Kuntl. At the close of created beings those who are viewed with sympathy by the lord had been your adversaries.
verses.wordMeaning: That lord, the lord of the universe, permeates other bodies and performs the task of dissolving all living beings in the end. During the origin of this creative process the lord was your ally, O son of Kuntl.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord, the lord of the universe, permeates other bodies and performs the task of dissolving all living beings in the end. During the origin of this creative process the lord was your ally, O son of Kuntl.…

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो नदीनदसहायगाः पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि ह्य् अगमन् देवपर्वते
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo nadīnadasahāyagāḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hy agaman devaparvate
verses.translation: Who could have believed at the beginning that you could kill Kauravas including Bhisma? Who could have believ¬ ed your discomfiture at the hands of cowherds?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who could have believed at the beginning that you could kill Kauravas including Bhisma? Who could have believ¬ ed your discomfiture at the hands of cowherds?

verses.sanskrit: सोमार्थं वै तथा चान्ये ऽप्य् आगमन् मखमण्डपम् तानि तीर्थानि गङ्गायां संगतानि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: somārthaṃ vai tathā cānye 'py āgaman makhamaṇḍapam tāni tīrthāni gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatāni yathākramam
verses.translation: O Arjuna, Rambha, Tilottama and hundreds and thou¬ sands of other ladies eulogised and praised that great soul. They praised the sage who wore weighty matted hair and who was standing immersed in water up to his neck. With humility they bent down their heads. They were eager in repeating the hymns.
verses.wordMeaning: O Arjuna, Rambha, Tilottama and hundreds and thou¬ sands of other ladies eulogised and praised that great soul. They praised the sage who wore weighty matted hair and who was standing immersed in water up to his neck. With humility they bent down their heads.…

verses.sanskrit: नदीरूपेण कान्य् एव नदरूपेण कानिचित् सरोरूपेण कान्य् अत्र स्तवरूपेण कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: nadīrūpeṇa kāny eva nadarūpeṇa kānicit sarorūpeṇa kāny atra stavarūpeṇa kānicit
verses.translation: They eulogised him so much that he became pleased with them. O most excellent among the descendants of Kuru, they eulogised that most excellent brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: They eulogised him so much that he became pleased with them. O most excellent among the descendants of Kuru, they eulogised that most excellent brahmin.
