verses.sanskrit: तान्य् एव सर्वतीर्थानि विख्यातानि पृथक् पृथक् तेषु स्नानं जपो होमः पितृतर्पणम् एव च
verses.transliteration: tāny eva sarvatīrthāni vikhyātāni pṛthak pṛthak teṣu snānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam eva ca
verses.translation: O highly blessed ladies, I am delighted. Whatever is wished for by you, may be requested for from me. I shall grant it even if it.is very difficult to grant. Hence, O Arjuna, even the least bit of sorrow need not be felt by you. Everything has already been ordained by the lord of all.
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed ladies, I am delighted. Whatever is wished for by you, may be requested for from me. I shall grant it even if it.is very difficult to grant. Hence, O Arjuna, even the least bit of sorrow need not be felt by you.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामप्रदं पुंसां भुक्तिदं मुक्तिभाजनम् एतेषां पठनं चापि स्मरणं वा करोति यः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो याति विष्णुपुरं जनः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ bhuktidaṃ muktibhājanam eteṣāṃ paṭhanaṃ cāpi smaraṇaṃ vā karoti yaḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇupuraṃ janaḥ
verses.translation: Your strength, splendour, prowess and greatness have been condensed by the lord desirous of annihilating you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your strength, splendour, prowess and greatness have been condensed by the lord desirous of annihilating you all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रवरासंगमो नाम श्रेष्ठा चैव महानदी यत्र सिद्धेश्वरो देवः सर्वलोकोपकारकृत्
verses.transliteration: pravarāsaṃgamo nāma śreṣṭhā caiva mahānadī yatra siddheśvaro devaḥ sarvalokopakārakṛt
verses.translation: O excellent sage, the rare manifestation and the diverse activities of lord Krsna as well as Balarama in the world have been mentioned by you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, the rare manifestation and the diverse activities of lord Krsna as well as Balarama in the world have been mentioned by you.

verses.sanskrit: देवानां दानवानां च संगमो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः तेषां परस्परं वापि प्रीतिश् चाभून् महामुने
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgamo 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ teṣāṃ parasparaṃ vāpi prītiś cābhūn mahāmune
verses.translation: Listening to the story of the lord we are not contented. We wish to hear about the other manifestations of the lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listening to the story of the lord we are not contented. We wish to hear about the other manifestations of the lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽप्य् एवं मन्त्रयाम् आसुर् देवा वै दानवा मिथः मेरुपर्वतम् आसाद्य परस्परहितैषिणः
verses.transliteration: te 'py evaṃ mantrayām āsur devā vai dānavā mithaḥ meruparvatam āsādya parasparahitaiṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: We do not know his full conduct nor the details of the process whereby the incarnation took place. We do not know the extent of the existence of Gunas and Karmans in him. We do not know the extent of his will in the causation thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: We do not know his full conduct nor the details of the process whereby the incarnation took place. We do not know the extent of the existence of Gunas and Karmans in him. We do not know the extent of his will in the causation thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेनामरत्वं स्याद् उत्पाद्यामृतम् उत्तमम् पिबामः सर्व एवैते भवामश् चामरा वयम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtenāmaratvaṃ syād utpādyāmṛtam uttamam pibāmaḥ sarva evaite bhavāmaś cāmarā vayam
verses.translation: I shall mention the greatness of Vasudeva, the con¬ duct of life of the highly intelligent one, for the welfare of Devas and mortal beings as well as the origin of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the greatness of Vasudeva, the con¬ duct of life of the highly intelligent one, for the welfare of Devas and mortal beings as well as the origin of the worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकीभूत्वा वयं लोकान् पालयामः सुखानि च प्राप्स्यामः संगरं हित्वा संगरो दुःखकारणम्
verses.transliteration: ekībhūtvā vayaṃ lokān pālayāmaḥ sukhāni ca prāpsyāmaḥ saṃgaraṃ hitvā saṃgaro duḥkhakāraṇam
verses.translation: The supreme Atman manifests himself on many occa¬ sions. I shall recount the manifestations that are divine, sacred and endowed with good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The supreme Atman manifests himself on many occa¬ sions. I shall recount the manifestations that are divine, sacred and endowed with good qualities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्या चैवार्जितान् अर्थान् भोक्ष्यामो गतमत्सराः यतः स्नेहेन वृत्तिर् या सास्माकं सुखदा सदा
verses.transliteration: prītyā caivārjitān arthān bhokṣyāmo gatamatsarāḥ yataḥ snehena vṛttir yā sāsmākaṃ sukhadā sadā
verses.translation: The lord of Devas, the lord of universe, who sleeps for the period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, manifests himself against some (specific) task after the thousand sets of four Yugas are completed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of Devas, the lord of universe, who sleeps for the period of a thousand sets of four Yugas, manifests himself against some (specific) task after the thousand sets of four Yugas are completed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैपरीत्यं तु यद् वृत्तं न स्मर्तव्यं कदाचन न च त्रैलोक्यराज्ये ऽपि कैवल्ये वा सुखं मनाक् तद् ऊर्ध्वम् अपि वा यत् तु निर्वैरत्वाद् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: vaiparītyaṃ tu yad vṛttaṃ na smartavyaṃ kadācana na ca trailokyarājye 'pi kaivalye vā sukhaṃ manāk tad ūrdhvam api vā yat tu nirvairatvād avāpyate
verses.translation: O you of good holy rites, I am pleased wtih your penance. Welfare unto you. Choose a boon. Obtain your cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: O you of good holy rites, I am pleased wtih your penance. Welfare unto you. Choose a boon. Obtain your cherished desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं परस्परं प्रीताः सन्तो देवाश् च दानवाः एकीभूताश् च सुप्रीता विमथ्य वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ parasparaṃ prītāḥ santo devāś ca dānavāḥ ekībhūtāś ca suprītā vimathya varuṇālayam
verses.translation: O dear one, all these divine and wonderful boons have been granted to you by me. O dear one, you will attain all these desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, all these divine and wonderful boons have been granted to you by me. O dear one, you will attain all these desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा रज्जुं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् देवाश् च दानवाः सर्वे ममन्थुर् वरुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā rajjuṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim devāś ca dānavāḥ sarve mamanthur varuṇālayam
verses.translation: After saying this, lord Brahma immediately went to his abode frequented by the brahminical sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, lord Brahma immediately went to his abode frequented by the brahminical sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नं च ततः पुण्यम् अमृतं सुरवल्लभम् निष्पन्ने चामृते पुण्ये ते च प्रोचुः परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: utpannaṃ ca tataḥ puṇyam amṛtaṃ suravallabham niṣpanne cāmṛte puṇye te ca procuḥ parasparam
verses.translation: On hearing about the granting of boon, Devas, Nagas, Gandharvas and sages approached him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the granting of boon, Devas, Nagas, Gandharvas and sages approached him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यामः स्वं स्वम् अधिष्ठानं कृतकार्याः श्रमं गताः सर्वे समं च सर्वेभ्यो यथायोग्यं विभज्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yāmaḥ svaṃ svam adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtakāryāḥ śramaṃ gatāḥ sarve samaṃ ca sarvebhyo yathāyogyaṃ vibhajyatām
verses.translation: O lord, with this boon, that Asura will harass us. Hence, O lord, be pleased, let the manner of his destruction be also thought of.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, with this boon, that Asura will harass us. Hence, O lord, be pleased, let the manner of his destruction be also thought of.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा सर्वागमो यत्र यस्मिंल् लग्ने शुभावहे विभज्यताम् इदं पुण्यम् अमृतं सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yadā sarvāgamo yatra yasmiṃl lagne śubhāvahe vibhajyatām idaṃ puṇyam amṛtaṃ surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you are the self-born lord, you are the cause of all living beings, you are the creator of Havyas and Kavyas. You Are the unmanifest being. You are certainly Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are the self-born lord, you are the cause of all living beings, you are the creator of Havyas and Kavyas. You Are the unmanifest being. You are certainly Prakrti.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा ते ययुः सर्वे दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः गतेषु दैत्यसंघेषु देवाः सर्वे ऽन्वमन्त्रयन्
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā te yayuḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ gateṣu daityasaṃgheṣu devāḥ sarve 'nvamantrayan
verses.translation: O Devas, the fruit of penance must of course be obtain- ed by him. But as the benefits of penance are exhausted lord Visnu will slay him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas, the fruit of penance must of course be obtain- ed by him. But as the benefits of penance are exhausted lord Visnu will slay him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गतास् ते रिपवो ऽस्माकं दैवयोगाद् अरिंदमाः रिपूणाम् अमृतं नैव देयं भवति सर्वथा
verses.transliteration: gatās te ripavo 'smākaṃ daivayogād ariṃdamāḥ ripūṇām amṛtaṃ naiva deyaṃ bhavati sarvathā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the lotus-born Brahma Devas felt joyous. They returned to their divine abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the lotus-born Brahma Devas felt joyous. They returned to their divine abodes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिस् तथेत्य् आह पुनर् आह सुरान् इदम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspatis tathety āha punar āha surān idam
verses.translation: Immediately after he had obtained the boon, the asura Hiranyakasipu became haughty and he harassed his subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately after he had obtained the boon, the asura Hiranyakasipu became haughty and he harassed his subjects.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न जानन्ति यथा पापा पिबध्वं च तथामृतम् अयम् एवोचितो मन्त्रो यच् छत्रूणां पराभवः
verses.transliteration: na jānanti yathā pāpā pibadhvaṃ ca tathāmṛtam ayam evocito mantro yac chatrūṇāṃ parābhavaḥ
verses.translation: He overpowered and insulted the highly blessed sages of holy rites, interested in truthfulness and piety and of subdued sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: He overpowered and insulted the highly blessed sages of holy rites, interested in truthfulness and piety and of subdued sense-organs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्वेष्याः सर्वात्मना द्वेष्या इति नीतिविदो विदुः न विश्वास्या न चाख्येया नैव मन्त्र्याश् च शत्रवः
verses.transliteration: dveṣyāḥ sarvātmanā dveṣyā iti nītivido viduḥ na viśvāsyā na cākhyeyā naiva mantryāś ca śatravaḥ
verses.translation: That great Asura defeated Devas stationed in heaven. He kept the three worlds under his control and lived in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great Asura defeated Devas stationed in heaven. He kept the three worlds under his control and lived in heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो न देयम् अमृतं भवेयुर् अमरास् ततः अमरेषु च जातेषु तेषु दैत्येषु शत्रुषु ताञ् जेतुं नैव शक्ष्यामो न देयम् अमृतं ततः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo na deyam amṛtaṃ bhaveyur amarās tataḥ amareṣu ca jāteṣu teṣu daityeṣu śatruṣu tāñ jetuṃ naiva śakṣyāmo na deyam amṛtaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Whenever that asura became haughty due to his obtaining the boon he roamed over the Earth. He made asuras worthy of shares in the Yajnas and Devas, unworthy of shares in the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whenever that asura became haughty due to his obtaining the boon he roamed over the Earth. He made asuras worthy of shares in the Yajnas and Devas, unworthy of shares in the same.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति संमन्त्र्य ते देवा वाचस्पतिम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: iti saṃmantrya te devā vācaspatim athābruvan
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, save us today from the fear of Hiran- yakasipu. Indeed you are our greatest lord. You are our greatest preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, save us today from the fear of Hiran- yakasipu. Indeed you are our greatest lord. You are our greatest preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: क्व यामः कुत्र मन्त्रः स्यात् क्व पिबामः क्व संस्थितिः कुर्मस् तद् एव प्रथमं वद वाचस्पते तथा
verses.transliteration: kva yāmaḥ kutra mantraḥ syāt kva pibāmaḥ kva saṃsthitiḥ kurmas tad eva prathamaṃ vada vācaspate tathā
verses.translation: O most excellent one among Devas, you are indeed the supreme creator of all of us, Brahma and others. O lord, with the eyes resembling thepetals of a full blown lotus devoid of impurities, O lord, the destroyer of the enemy hosts, be our refuge for the destruction of the race of Diti.
verses.wordMeaning: O most excellent one among Devas, you are indeed the supreme creator of all of us, Brahma and others. O lord, with the eyes resembling thepetals of a full blown lotus devoid of impurities, O lord, the destroyer of the enemy hosts,…

verses.sanskrit: यान्तु ब्रह्माणम् अमराः पृच्छन्त्व् अत्र गतिं पराम् स तु ज्ञाता च वक्ता च दाता चैव पितामहः
verses.transliteration: yāntu brahmāṇam amarāḥ pṛcchantv atra gatiṃ parām sa tu jñātā ca vaktā ca dātā caiva pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: O immortal ones, cast off your fear. I grant you all, fearlessness. O Devas, you will regain heaven as before without delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: O immortal ones, cast off your fear. I grant you all, fearlessness. O Devas, you will regain heaven as before without delay.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेर् वचः श्रुत्वा मदन्तिकम् अथागमन् नमस्य मां सुराः सर्वे यद् वृत्तं तन् न्यवेदयन्
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspater vacaḥ śrutvā madantikam athāgaman namasya māṃ surāḥ sarve yad vṛttaṃ tan nyavedayan
verses.translation: I shall kill this asura along with his attendants. I shall kill this leading Danava haughty on account of his acquiring the boon that he cannot be killed by the leading immortal
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall kill this asura along with his attendants. I shall kill this leading Danava haughty on account of his acquiring the boon that he cannot be killed by the leading immortal
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् देववचनात् पुत्र तैः सुरैर् अगमं हरिम् विष्णवे कथितं सर्वं शंभवे विषहारिणे
verses.transliteration: tad devavacanāt putra taiḥ surair agamaṃ harim viṣṇave kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃbhave viṣahāriṇe
verses.translation: After saying this to the chiefs of Devas and bidding
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to the chiefs of Devas and bidding
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं विष्णुश् च शंभुश् च देवगन्धर्वकिंनरैः मेरुकन्दरम् आगत्य न जानन्ति यथासुराः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ viṣṇuś ca śaṃbhuś ca devagandharvakiṃnaraiḥ merukandaram āgatya na jānanti yathāsurāḥ
verses.translation: A further manifestation of Visnu the great Atman, in the nature of a living being, is well known as Dattatreya. He was equipped with great forbearance.
verses.commentary: Sense: A further manifestation of Visnu the great Atman, in the nature of a living being, is well known as Dattatreya. He was equipped with great forbearance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्षकं च हरिं कृत्वा सोमपानाय तस्थिरे आदित्यस् तत्र विज्ञाता सोमभोज्यान् अथेतरान्
verses.transliteration: rakṣakaṃ ca hariṃ kṛtvā somapānāya tasthire ādityas tatra vijñātā somabhojyān athetarān
verses.translation: O lord of the Earth, you will protect the entire Earth. Engaged in battle you become so dazzling that you will not be stared at by the enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Earth, you will protect the entire Earth. Engaged in battle you become so dazzling that you will not be stared at by the enemy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमो दातामृतं भागं चक्रधृग् रक्षकस् तथा नैव जानन्ति तद् दैत्या दनुजा राक्षसास् तथा
verses.transliteration: somo dātāmṛtaṃ bhāgaṃ cakradhṛg rakṣakas tathā naiva jānanti tad daityā danujā rākṣasās tathā
verses.translation: This glorious and auspicious manifestation of Visnu has been recounted to you. There is another manifestation of the great Atman namely Jamadagnya Parasurama.
verses.commentary: Sense: This glorious and auspicious manifestation of Visnu has been recounted to you. There is another manifestation of the great Atman namely Jamadagnya Parasurama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विना राहुं महाप्राज्ञं सैंहिकेयं च सोमपम् कामरूपधरो राहुर् मरुतां मध्यम् आविशत्
verses.transliteration: vinā rāhuṃ mahāprājñaṃ saiṃhikeyaṃ ca somapam kāmarūpadharo rāhur marutāṃ madhyam āviśat
verses.translation: In the course of this manifestation the lord Parasurama killed king Sahasrarjuna in battle. Previously he had been invincible to the enemies in battle by the prowess of his thousand arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of this manifestation the lord Parasurama killed king Sahasrarjuna in battle. Previously he had been invincible to the enemies in battle by the prowess of his thousand arms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मरुद्रूपं समास्थाय पानपात्रधरस् तथा ज्ञात्वा दिवाकरो दैत्यं तं सोमाय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: marudrūpaṃ samāsthāya pānapātradharas tathā jñātvā divākaro daityaṃ taṃ somāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: The Earth where crores of Ksatriyas remained scatte¬ red about, the Earth that is adorned by the mountains Meru and Mandara was rid of Ksatriyas twentyone* times by the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Earth where crores of Ksatriyas remained scatte¬ red about, the Earth that is adorned by the mountains Meru and Mandara was rid of Ksatriyas twentyone* times by the lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदा तद् अमृतं तस्मै दैत्यायादैत्यरूपिणे दत्त्वा सोमं तदा सोमो विष्णवे तन् न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: tadā tad amṛtaṃ tasmai daityāyādaityarūpiṇe dattvā somaṃ tadā somo viṣṇave tan nyavedayat
verses.translation: After making the Earth devoid of Ksatriyas, Para¬ surama of great fame performed a horse sacrifice in order to dispel his sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the Earth devoid of Ksatriyas, Para¬ surama of great fame performed a horse sacrifice in order to dispel his sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुः पीतामृतं दैत्यं चक्रेणोद्यम्य तच्छिरः चिच्छेद तरसा वत्स तच्छिरस् त्व् अमरं त्व् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuḥ pītāmṛtaṃ daityaṃ cakreṇodyamya tacchiraḥ ciccheda tarasā vatsa tacchiras tv amaraṃ tv abhūt
verses.translation: Rama the lord of the living beings killed Ravana who had a huge body, who was very powerful and who resembled a mass of clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama the lord of the living beings killed Ravana who had a huge body, who was very powerful and who resembled a mass of clouds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रविहीनं यद् देहं तद् अपतद् भुवि देहं तद् अमृतस्पृष्टं पतितं दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: śiromātravihīnaṃ yad dehaṃ tad apatad bhuvi dehaṃ tad amṛtaspṛṣṭaṃ patitaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: For the sake of Sugrlva, Bali the powerful lord of monkeys was killed in battle and Sugrlva was crowned in his place.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of Sugrlva, Bali the powerful lord of monkeys was killed in battle and Sugrlva was crowned in his place.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्या मुनिशार्दूल कम्पयद् वसुधातलम् देहं चाप्य् अमरं पुत्र तद् अद्भुतम् इवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: gautamyā muniśārdūla kampayad vasudhātalam dehaṃ cāpy amaraṃ putra tad adbhutam ivābhavat
verses.translation: Janasthana: A part of DaijiJaka forest which lies in the basin of Godavari. Rama had lived in this forest with Sita and Laksmana for a long time during the period of his exile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Janasthana: A part of DaijiJaka forest which lies in the basin of Godavari. Rama had lived in this forest with Sita and Laksmana for a long time during the period of his exile.

verses.sanskrit: देहं च शिरसो ऽपेक्षि शिरो देहम् अपेक्षते उभयं चामरं जातं दैत्यश् चायं महाबलः
verses.transliteration: dehaṃ ca śiraso 'pekṣi śiro deham apekṣate ubhayaṃ cāmaraṃ jātaṃ daityaś cāyaṃ mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरः काये समाविष्टं सर्वान् भक्षयते सुरान् तस्माद् देहम् इदं पूर्वं नाशयामो महीगतम् ततस् ते शंकरं प्राहुर् देवाः सर्वे ससंभ्रमाः
verses.transliteration: śiraḥ kāye samāviṣṭaṃ sarvān bhakṣayate surān tasmād deham idaṃ pūrvaṃ nāśayāmo mahīgatam tatas te śaṃkaraṃ prāhur devāḥ sarve sasaṃbhramāḥ
verses.translation: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महीगतं दैत्यदेहं नाशयस्व सुरोत्तम त्वं देव करुणासिन्धुः शरणागतरक्षकः
verses.transliteration: mahīgataṃ daityadehaṃ nāśayasva surottama tvaṃ deva karuṇāsindhuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ
verses.translation: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit: शिरसा नैव युज्येत दैत्यदेहं तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: śirasā naiva yujyeta daityadehaṃ tathā kuru
verses.translation: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयाम् आस चेशो ऽपि श्रेष्ठां शक्तिं तदात्मनः मातृभिः सहितां देवीं मातरं लोकपालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: preṣayām āsa ceśo 'pi śreṣṭhāṃ śaktiṃ tadātmanaḥ mātṛbhiḥ sahitāṃ devīṃ mātaraṃ lokapālinīm
verses.translation: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.

verses.sanskrit: ईशायुधधरा देवी ईशशक्तिसमन्विता महीगतं यत्र देहं तत्रागाद् भक्ष्यकाङ्क्षिणी
verses.transliteration: īśāyudhadharā devī īśaśaktisamanvitā mahīgataṃ yatra dehaṃ tatrāgād bhakṣyakāṅkṣiṇī
verses.translation: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रं सुराः सर्वे मेरौ तत्रैव सान्त्वयन् देहो देव्या पुनस् तत्र युयुधे बहवः समाः
verses.transliteration: śiromātraṃ surāḥ sarve merau tatraiva sāntvayan deho devyā punas tatra yuyudhe bahavaḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राहुस् तत्र सुरान् आह भित्त्वा देहं पुरा मम अत्रास्ते रसम् उत्कृष्टं तद् आकृष्य शरीरतः
verses.transliteration: rāhus tatra surān āha bhittvā dehaṃ purā mama atrāste rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ tad ākṛṣya śarīrataḥ
verses.translation: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.commentary: Sense: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्भूते रसे देहं प्रवरे ऽमृतम् उत्तमम् भस्मीभूयात् क्षणेनैव तस्मात् कुर्वन्तु तत् पुरा
verses.transliteration: pṛthakbhūte rase dehaṃ pravare 'mṛtam uttamam bhasmībhūyāt kṣaṇenaiva tasmāt kurvantu tat purā
verses.translation: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् राहुवचः श्रुत्वा प्रीताः सर्वे ऽसुरारयः अभ्यषिञ्चन् ग्रहाणां त्वं ग्रहो भूया मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: etad rāhuvacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve 'surārayaḥ abhyaṣiñcan grahāṇāṃ tvaṃ graho bhūyā mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्देववचनाच् छक्तिर् ईश्वरी या निगद्यते देहं भित्त्वा दैत्यपतेः सुरशक्तिसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: taddevavacanāc chaktir īśvarī yā nigadyate dehaṃ bhittvā daityapateḥ suraśaktisamanvitā
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आकृष्य शीघ्रम् उत्कृष्टं प्रवरं चामृतं बहिः स्थापयित्वा तु तद् देहं भक्षयाम् आस चाम्बिका
verses.transliteration: ākṛṣya śīghram utkṛṣṭaṃ pravaraṃ cāmṛtaṃ bahiḥ sthāpayitvā tu tad dehaṃ bhakṣayām āsa cāmbikā
verses.translation: All the jewels of the kings were taken away by him
verses.commentary: Sense: All the jewels of the kings were taken away by him
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिर् भद्रकाली प्रोच्यते या महाबला स्थापितं रसम् उत्कृष्टं रसानां प्रवरं रसम्
verses.transliteration: kālarātrir bhadrakālī procyate yā mahābalā sthāpitaṃ rasam utkṛṣṭaṃ rasānāṃ pravaraṃ rasam
verses.translation: The following manifestation of the great Atman is conducive to the welfare of the world. It is the manifestation of Kalki named Visnuyasas also. It will occur in the village of Sambhala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following manifestation of the great Atman is conducive to the welfare of the world. It is the manifestation of Kalki named Visnuyasas also. It will occur in the village of Sambhala.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: व्यस्रवत् स्थापितं तत् तु प्रवरा साभवन् नदी आकृष्टम् अमृतं चैव स्थापितं साप्य् अभक्षयत्
verses.transliteration: vyasravat sthāpitaṃ tat tu pravarā sābhavan nadī ākṛṣṭam amṛtaṃ caiva sthāpitaṃ sāpy abhakṣayat
verses.translation: The Puranais on a par with the Vedas and Srutis (?) The enumeration of manifestation is but indicatory, not exhaus¬ tive.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रेष्ठा नदी जाता प्रवरा चामृता शुभा राहुदेहसमुद्भूता रुद्रशक्तिसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śreṣṭhā nadī jātā pravarā cāmṛtā śubhā rāhudehasamudbhūtā rudraśaktisamanvitā
verses.translation: Then arose the excellent river Pravara, auspicious and nectar-like, born of Rahu's body and endowed with the power of Rudra.

verses.transliteration: gautamo vṛddha ity ukto munir āsīn mahātapāḥ yadā purābhavad bālo gautamasya suto dvijaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, you know everything, origin and dissolution of living beings and the goal reached through actions. Hence, we ask you, O great sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, you know everything, origin and dissolution of living beings and the goal reached through actions. Hence, we ask you, O great sage.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनासः स पुरोत्पन्नस् तस्माद् विकृतरूपधृक् स वैराग्याज् जगामाथ देशं तीर्थम् इतस् ततः
verses.transliteration: anāsaḥ sa purotpannas tasmād vikṛtarūpadhṛk sa vairāgyāj jagāmātha deśaṃ tīrtham itas tataḥ
verses.translation: How do men go to the abode of Yama through that path? O foremost among eloquent persons, tell us the magni¬ tude and extent of the path.
verses.commentary: Sense: How do men go to the abode of Yama through that path? O foremost among eloquent persons, tell us the magni¬ tude and extent of the path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपाध्यायेन नैवासील् लज्जितस्य समागमः शिष्यैर् अन्यैः सहाध्यायो लज्जितस्य च नाभवत्
verses.transliteration: upādhyāyena naivāsīl lajjitasya samāgamaḥ śiṣyair anyaiḥ sahādhyāyo lajjitasya ca nābhavat
verses.translation: O omniscient sage, we earnesdy ask you to tell us entirely. O sage, how do men avert the miseries of hell?
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient sage, we earnesdy ask you to tell us entirely. O sage, how do men avert the miseries of hell?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उपनीतः कथंचिच् च पित्रा वै गौतमेन सः एतावता गौतमो ऽपि व्यगमच् चरितुं बहिः
verses.transliteration: upanītaḥ kathaṃcic ca pitrā vai gautamena saḥ etāvatā gautamo 'pi vyagamac carituṃ bahiḥ
verses.translation: By what means do they prevent the hellish tortures? By charitable gifts, holy rites and observances?
verses.commentary: Sense: By what means do they prevent the hellish tortures? By charitable gifts, holy rites and observances?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुतिथे काले ब्रह्ममात्रा धृते द्विजे नैव चाध्ययनं तस्य संजातं गौतमस्य हि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahutithe kāle brahmamātrā dhṛte dvije naiva cādhyayanaṃ tasya saṃjātaṃ gautamasya hi
verses.translation: How do people attain the heavenly goal? By what deeds do they go to hell? How many are the abodes in heaven? How many are the hellish abodes?
verses.commentary: Sense: How do people attain the heavenly goal? By what deeds do they go to hell? How many are the abodes in heaven? How many are the hellish abodes?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नैव शास्त्रस्य चाभ्यासो गौतमस्याभवत् तदा अग्निकार्यं ततश् चक्रे नित्यम् एव यतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: naiva śāstrasya cābhyāso gautamasyābhavat tadā agnikāryaṃ tataś cakre nityam eva yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: How do men of good deeds go? How do men of evil deeds go? What is the form and what is the magnitude? What is the caste of the two? Even as an individual soul is being led to Yama's abode what is its form, shape and extent?
verses.commentary: Sense: How do men of good deeds go? How do men of evil deeds go? What is the form and what is the magnitude? What is the caste of the two? Even as an individual soul is being led to Yama's abode what is its form, shape and extent?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गायत्र्यभ्यासमात्रेण ब्राह्मणो नामधारकः अग्न्युपासनमात्रं च गायत्र्यभ्यसनं तथा
verses.transliteration: gāyatryabhyāsamātreṇa brāhmaṇo nāmadhārakaḥ agnyupāsanamātraṃ ca gāyatryabhyasanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O leading sages, listen, even as I recount. O sages of good holy rites, the cycle of worldly existence is unageing. It has no permanent existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, listen, even as I recount. O sages of good holy rites, the cycle of worldly existence is unageing. It has no permanent existence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतावता ब्राह्मणत्वं गौतमस्याभवन् मुने उपासतो ऽग्निं विधिवद् गायत्रीं च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: etāvatā brāhmaṇatvaṃ gautamasyābhavan mune upāsato 'gniṃ vidhivad gāyatrīṃ ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall decisively mention the path of Yama entirely. I shall recount everything in detail beginning from the time of departure. I shall recount it in a manner that no one else will be able to recount.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall decisively mention the path of Yama entirely. I shall recount everything in detail beginning from the time of departure. I shall recount it in a manner that no one else will be able to recount.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यायुर् ववृधे पुत्र गौतमस्य चिरायुषः न दारसंग्रहं लेभे नैव दातास्ति कन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāyur vavṛdhe putra gautamasya cirāyuṣaḥ na dārasaṃgrahaṃ lebhe naiva dātāsti kanyakām
verses.translation: O excellent ones, I shall mention the form and nature of the path about which you have asked me and also the dis¬ tance between the world of Yama and the mortal world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones, I shall mention the form and nature of the path about which you have asked me and also the dis¬ tance between the world of Yama and the mortal world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथा चरंस् तीर्थदेशे वनेषु विविधेषु च आश्रमेषु च पुण्येषु अटन्न् आस्ते स गौतमः
verses.transliteration: tathā caraṃs tīrthadeśe vaneṣu vividheṣu ca āśrameṣu ca puṇyeṣu aṭann āste sa gautamaḥ
verses.translation: That pathway should of necessity be traversed by all living beings called individual souls. Meritorious men go to the meritorious sections and the sinful go to the sinful.
verses.commentary: Sense: That pathway should of necessity be traversed by all living beings called individual souls. Meritorious men go to the meritorious sections and the sinful go to the sinful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं भ्रमञ् शीतगिरिम् आश्रित्यास्ते स गौतमः तत्रापश्यद् गुहां रम्यां वल्लीविटपमालिनीम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhramañ śītagirim āśrityāste sa gautamaḥ tatrāpaśyad guhāṃ ramyāṃ vallīviṭapamālinīm
verses.translation: Those who make charitable gifts of water and cooked rice do not undergo any forture there along with their wives, sons and kins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make charitable gifts of water and cooked rice do not undergo any forture there along with their wives, sons and kins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपविश्य विप्रेन्द्रो वस्तुं समकरोन् मतिम् चिन्तयंस् तु प्रविष्टो ऽसाव् अपश्यत् स्त्रियम् उत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: tatropaviśya viprendro vastuṃ samakaron matim cintayaṃs tu praviṣṭo 'sāv apaśyat striyam uttamām
verses.translation: He who makes a charitable gift of cooked rice with the mind sanctified by faith derives satisfaction there even without (the presence of) cooked rice then.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes a charitable gift of cooked rice with the mind sanctified by faith derives satisfaction there even without (the presence of) cooked rice then.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिथिलाङ्गीम् अथ कृशां वृद्धां च तपसि स्थिताम् ब्रह्मचर्येण वर्तन्तीं विरागां रहसि स्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: śithilāṅgīm atha kṛśāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca tapasi sthitām brahmacaryeṇa vartantīṃ virāgāṃ rahasi sthitām
verses.translation: The tlieist who lias faith in God or holy scriptures, utters no falsehood and by whom severance of affection has not been effected, attains a happy death.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tlieist who lias faith in God or holy scriptures, utters no falsehood and by whom severance of affection has not been effected, attains a happy death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स तां दृष्ट्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो नमस्काराय तस्थिवान् नमस्यन्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं तं गौतमम् अवारयत्
verses.transliteration: sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśreṣṭho namaskārāya tasthivān namasyantaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ taṃ gautamam avārayat
verses.translation: These men face a happy death:—those who are devot¬ ed to the worship of Devas and brahmins, those who are not jealous, those who have spotless character, those who are liberal in gifts and those who possess the attribute of modesty.
verses.commentary: Sense: These men face a happy death:—those who are devot¬ ed to the worship of Devas and brahmins, those who are not jealous, those who have spotless character, those who are liberal in gifts and those who possess the attribute of modesty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुस् त्वं भविता मह्यं न मां वन्दितुम् अर्हसि आयुर् विद्या धनं कीर्तिर् धर्मः स्वर्गादिकं च यत् तस्य नश्यति वै सर्वं यं नमस्यति वै गुरुः
verses.transliteration: gurus tvaṃ bhavitā mahyaṃ na māṃ vanditum arhasi āyur vidyā dhanaṃ kīrtir dharmaḥ svargādikaṃ ca yat tasya naśyati vai sarvaṃ yaṃ namasyati vai guruḥ
verses.translation: He who does not eschew virtue either due to lust or due to fury or out of hatred; he who carries out what is men¬ tioned by elders and he who is gentle meets with a comfortable death.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not eschew virtue either due to lust or due to fury or out of hatred; he who carries out what is men¬ tioned by elders and he who is gentle meets with a comfortable death.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटस् तां वै गौतमः प्राह विस्मितः
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭas tāṃ vai gautamaḥ prāha vismitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who offer water to the thirsty, give food to the hungry, meet with timely death with ease and happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who offer water to the thirsty, give food to the hungry, meet with timely death with ease and happiness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tapasvinī tvaṃ vṛddhā ca guṇajyeṣṭhā ca bhāminī alpavidyas tv alpavayā ahaṃ tava guruḥ katham
verses.translation: He attains another body having the same shape as the previous one. It is for experiencing the tortures caused by his bad Karman. This body does not originate from the parents.
verses.commentary: Sense: He attains another body having the same shape as the previous one. It is for experiencing the tortures caused by his bad Karman. This body does not originate from the parents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आर्ष्टिषेणप्रियपुत्र ऋतध्वज इति श्रुतः गुणवान् मतिमाञ् शूरः क्षत्रधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: ārṣṭiṣeṇapriyaputra ṛtadhvaja iti śrutaḥ guṇavān matimāñ śūraḥ kṣatradharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Watched by those people in distress, with their eyes full of tears he casts off his body, attains a gaseous form and goes ahead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Watched by those people in distress, with their eyes full of tears he casts off his body, attains a gaseous form and goes ahead.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिद् वनं प्रायान् मृगयाकृष्टचेतनः विश्रामम् अकरोद् अस्यां गुहायां स ऋतध्वजः
verses.transliteration: sa kadācid vanaṃ prāyān mṛgayākṛṣṭacetanaḥ viśrāmam akarod asyāṃ guhāyāṃ sa ṛtadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the living creature with the span of life extinct, the terrible emissaries of Yama come there desirous of taking him aw&y.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the living creature with the span of life extinct, the terrible emissaries of Yama come there desirous of taking him aw&y.

verses.sanskrit: युवा स मतिमान् दक्षो बलेन महता वृतः तं विश्रान्तं नृपवरम् अप्सरा ददृशे ततः
verses.transliteration: yuvā sa matimān dakṣo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ taṃ viśrāntaṃ nṛpavaram apsarā dadṛśe tataḥ
verses.translation: The emissaries of Yama are excessively terrible and competent to frighten all living beings. They assume different forms and their faces resembl.e those of bears, buffaloes, vampires.
verses.commentary: Sense: The emissaries of Yama are excessively terrible and competent to frighten all living beings. They assume different forms and their faces resembl.e those of bears, buffaloes, vampires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वराजस्य सुता सुश्यामा इति विश्रुता तां दृष्ट्वा चकमे राजा राजानं चकमे च सा
verses.transliteration: gandharvarājasya sutā suśyāmā iti viśrutā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame rājā rājānaṃ cakame ca sā
verses.translation: Some have long faces; some are hideous-faced; some have crooked nooses; some have three eyes. They have massive jaw bones, cheeks and faces. Some have hanging lips.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some have long faces; some are hideous-faced; some have crooked nooses; some have three eyes. They have massive jaw bones, cheeks and faces. Some have hanging lips.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति क्रीडा समभवत् तया राज्ञो महामते निवृत्तकामो राजेन्द्रस् ताम् आपृच्छ्यागमद् गृहम्
verses.transliteration: iti krīḍā samabhavat tayā rājño mahāmate nivṛttakāmo rājendras tām āpṛcchyāgamad gṛham
verses.translation: The limbs of some are smeared with blood and flesh. Their teeth come out of their mouths resembling spouts of shooting plants. They arc very hideous in their shape. Their curved fangs are very fierce.
verses.commentary: Sense: The limbs of some are smeared with blood and flesh. Their teeth come out of their mouths resembling spouts of shooting plants. They arc very hideous in their shape. Their curved fangs are very fierce.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाहं ततस् तस्यां सुश्यामायां महामते गच्छन्ती मां तदा माता इदम् आह तपोधन
verses.transliteration: utpannāhaṃ tatas tasyāṃ suśyāmāyāṃ mahāmate gacchantī māṃ tadā mātā idam āha tapodhana
verses.translation: Their mouths resemble the nether worlds with blazing terrible tongues. The eyes are awful in their shape and size. They are shining, roving and tawny-coloured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their mouths resemble the nether worlds with blazing terrible tongues. The eyes are awful in their shape and size. They are shining, roving and tawny-coloured.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् अस्यां प्रविशेद् भद्रे स ते भर्ता भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yas tv asyāṃ praviśed bhadre sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The eyes of some resemble fire or the eyes of the cat or owl. Some eyes are protruded like the eyes of the beetle. Some resemble the glowworm. Their hair are dishevelled and stand erect.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eyes of some resemble fire or the eyes of the cat or owl. Some eyes are protruded like the eyes of the beetle. Some resemble the glowworm. Their hair are dishevelled and stand erect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा सा जगमाथ माता मम महामते तस्माद् अत्र प्रविष्टस् त्वं पुमान् नान्यः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā sā jagamātha mātā mama mahāmate tasmād atra praviṣṭas tvaṃ pumān nānyaḥ kadācana
verses.translation: They are bedecked in garlands and skulls. Their limbs drip with blood (?). Their ornaments resemble terrible ser¬ pents tied up round their heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are bedecked in garlands and skulls. Their limbs drip with blood (?). Their ornaments resemble terrible ser¬ pents tied up round their heads.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि तथाशीतिं कृत्वा राज्यं पिता मम अत्रैव च तपस् तप्त्वा ततः स्वर्गम् उपेयिवान्
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi tathāśītiṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ pitā mama atraiva ca tapas taptvā tataḥ svargam upeyivān
verses.translation: There are black serpents round their necks. They are very terrible due to their kissing sounds. Their tresses are coarse and stiff. They arc terrible and they resemble fiery flames.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are black serpents round their necks. They are very terrible due to their kissing sounds. Their tresses are coarse and stiff. They arc terrible and they resemble fiery flames.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गं याते ऽपि पितरि सहस्राणि तथा दश वर्षाणि मुनिशार्दूल राज्यं कृत्वा तथा परः
verses.transliteration: svargaṃ yāte 'pi pitari sahasrāṇi tathā daśa varṣāṇi muniśārdūla rājyaṃ kṛtvā tathā paraḥ
verses.translation: Some of them have only two arms; others have four arms, still others have ten, sixteen or twenty arms. •
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them have only two arms; others have four arms, still others have ten, sixteen or twenty arms. •
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे यातो मम भ्राता अहम् अत्रैव संस्थिता अहं ब्रह्मन् नान्यवृत्ता न माता न पिता मम
verses.transliteration: svarge yāto mama bhrātā aham atraiva saṃsthitā ahaṃ brahman nānyavṛttā na mātā na pitā mama
verses.translation: There are still others with innumrable hands. Some of them have thousand arms. Terrible weapons of various forms shine in their hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are still others with innumrable hands. Some of them have thousand arms. Terrible weapons of various forms shine in their hands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहम् आत्मेश्वरी ब्रह्मन् निविष्टा क्षत्रकन्यका तस्माद् भजस्व मां ब्रह्मन् व्रतस्थां पुरुषार्थिनीम्
verses.transliteration: aham ātmeśvarī brahman niviṣṭā kṣatrakanyakā tasmād bhajasva māṃ brahman vratasthāṃ puruṣārthinīm
verses.translation: These emissaries of great strength threaten the aying men with different brilliant weapons such as javelin, iron club, discus etc. or nooses, fetters and batons.
verses.commentary: Sense: These emissaries of great strength threaten the aying men with different brilliant weapons such as javelin, iron club, discus etc. or nooses, fetters and batons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रायुर् अहं भद्रे मत्तस् त्वं वयसाधिका अहं बालस् त्वं तु वृद्धा नैवायं घटते मिथः
verses.transliteration: sahasrāyur ahaṃ bhadre mattas tvaṃ vayasādhikā ahaṃ bālas tvaṃ tu vṛddhā naivāyaṃ ghaṭate mithaḥ
verses.translation: When the span of life of the men comes to an end these extremely terrible emissaries come to take away the creatures. All of them carry out the orders of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the span of life of the men comes to an end these extremely terrible emissaries come to take away the creatures. All of them carry out the orders of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं भर्ता मे पुरा दिष्टो नान्यो भर्ता मतो मम धात्रा दत्तस् ततस् त्वं मां न निराकर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ bhartā me purā diṣṭo nānyo bhartā mato mama dhātrā dattas tatas tvaṃ māṃ na nirākartum arhasi
verses.translation: The creature assumes a physical body befitting tortures in the hell and originating from its own actions. It is this body of the creature that is taken away towards the abode of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creature assumes a physical body befitting tortures in the hell and originating from its own actions. It is this body of the creature that is taken away towards the abode of Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अथवा नेच्छसि मां त्वम् अप्रदुष्टाम् अनुव्रताम् ततस् त्यक्ष्यामि जीवं मे इदानीं तव पश्यतः
verses.transliteration: athavā necchasi māṃ tvam apraduṣṭām anuvratām tatas tyakṣyāmi jīvaṃ me idānīṃ tava paśyataḥ
verses.translation: With the nooses, adamantine fetters andiron chains, the creature is bound by the infuriated servants of Yama. He is beaten and taken over to the abode of Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the nooses, adamantine fetters andiron chains, the creature is bound by the infuriated servants of Yama. He is beaten and taken over to the abode of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: अपेक्षिताप्राप्तितो हि देहिनां मरणं वरम् अनुरक्तजनत्यागे पातकान्तो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: apekṣitāprāptito hi dehināṃ maraṇaṃ varam anuraktajanatyāge pātakānto na vidyate
verses.translation: That great path has to be traversed by these sinful per¬ sons frightened in some places, terrified in some places and faltering here and there. They are shouting and lamenting due to misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great path has to be traversed by these sinful per¬ sons frightened in some places, terrified in some places and faltering here and there. They are shouting and lamenting due to misery.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धायास् तद् वचः श्रुत्वा गौतमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāyās tad vacaḥ śrutvā gautamo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: The living beings have to traverse the path even as they are rebuked and burnt in their bodies, They are agitated due to terror. They run about in great dejection and agitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The living beings have to traverse the path even as they are rebuked and burnt in their bodies, They are agitated due to terror. They run about in great dejection and agitation.

verses.sanskrit: अहं तपोविरहितो विद्याहीनो ह्य् अकिंचनः नाहं वरो हि योग्यस् ते कुरूपो भोगवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tapovirahito vidyāhīno hy akiṃcanaḥ nāhaṃ varo hi yogyas te kurūpo bhogavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Men who are devoid of charitable gifts are scorched and burnt by the heated sand. They have to go along the path strewn with thorns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who are devoid of charitable gifts are scorched and burnt by the heated sand. They have to go along the path strewn with thorns.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अनासो ऽहं किं करोमि अतपोविद्य एव च तस्मात् सुरूपं सुविद्याम् आपाद्य प्रथमं शुभे पश्चात् ते वचनं कार्यं ततो वृद्धाब्रवीद् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: anāso 'haṃ kiṃ karomi atapovidya eva ca tasmāt surūpaṃ suvidyām āpādya prathamaṃ śubhe paścāt te vacanaṃ kāryaṃ tato vṛddhābravīd dvijam
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings have to traverse the path with their bodies emitting putrescent odour of
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings have to traverse the path with their bodies emitting putrescent odour of

verses.sanskrit: मया सरस्वती देवी तोषिता तपसा द्विज तथैवापो रूपवत्यो रूपदाताग्निर् एव च
verses.transliteration: mayā sarasvatī devī toṣitā tapasā dvija tathaivāpo rūpavatyo rūpadātāgnir eva ca
verses.translation: The destroyers of living beings must of necessity go along the path shouting and lamenting, cooing and chirping out of tune. They shall be in agony due to their pain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The destroyers of living beings must of necessity go along the path shouting and lamenting, cooing and chirping out of tune. They shall be in agony due to their pain.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् वागीश्वरी देवी सा ते विद्यां प्रदास्यति अग्निश् च रूपवान् देवस् तव रूपं प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmād vāgīśvarī devī sā te vidyāṃ pradāsyati agniś ca rūpavān devas tava rūpaṃ pradāsyati
verses.translation: Those who are guilty of slaying living beings must of necessity go along the path even as they arc being pierced and smashed by javelins, iron clubs, swords, maces and arrows or by the sharp pointed tridents.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā gautamaṃ taṃ vṛddhovāca vibhāvasum prārthayitvā suvidyaṃ taṃ surūpaṃ cākaron munim
verses.translation: Having said this to Gautama, the old woman prayed to Fire and made that sage learned and handsome.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुविद्यः सुभगः सुकान्तो वृद्धां स पत्नीम् अकरोत् प्रीतियुक्तः तया स रेमे बहुला मनोज्ञया समाः सुखं प्रीतमना गुहायाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suvidyaḥ subhagaḥ sukānto vṛddhāṃ sa patnīm akarot prītiyuktaḥ tayā sa reme bahulā manojñayā samāḥ sukhaṃ prītamanā guhāyām
verses.translation: Then, learned, fortunate and lovely, he, full of affection, made the old woman his wife, and joyful at heart he delighted with that charming one in the cave for many years.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् तत्र वसतोर् दंपत्योर् मुदतोर् गिरौ गुहायां मुनिशार्दूल आजग्मुर् मुनयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: kadācit tatra vasator daṃpatyor mudator girau guhāyāṃ muniśārdūla ājagmur munayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: Once, while the couple were living joyfully in the cave on the mountain, O tiger among sages, spotless sages came there,

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठवामदेवाद्या ये चान्ये च महर्षयः भ्रमन्तः पुण्यतीर्थानि प्राप्नुवंस् तस्य तां गुहाम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhavāmadevādyā ye cānye ca maharṣayaḥ bhramantaḥ puṇyatīrthāni prāpnuvaṃs tasya tāṃ guhām
verses.translation: Vasishtha, Vamadeva and other great sages; wandering through holy places they reached his cave.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आगतांस् तान् ऋषीञ् ज्ञात्वा गौतमः सह भार्यया सत्कारम् अकरोत् तेषां जहसुस् तं च केचन
verses.transliteration: āgatāṃs tān ṛṣīñ jñātvā gautamaḥ saha bhāryayā satkāram akarot teṣāṃ jahasus taṃ ca kecana
verses.translation: Knowing the sages had come, Gautama with his wife showed them hospitality; some of them laughed at him.

verses.sanskrit: ये बाला यौवनोन्मत्ता वयसा ये च मध्यमाः वृद्धां च गौतमं प्रेक्ष्य जहसुस् तत्र केचन
verses.transliteration: ye bālā yauvanonmattā vayasā ye ca madhyamāḥ vṛddhāṃ ca gautamaṃ prekṣya jahasus tatra kecana
verses.translation: Those who were young, intoxicated with youth, and those of middle age, seeing the old woman and Gautama, some laughed there:

verses.transliteration: putro 'yaṃ tava pautro vā vṛddhe ko gautamo 'bhavat satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi ity evaṃ jahasur dvijāḥ
verses.translation: "Is this your son or grandson, old woman? Who has become Gautama? Tell the truth, auspicious one" — so the brahmins laughed.

verses.transliteration: viṣaṃ vṛddhasya yuvatī vṛddhāyā amṛtaṃ yuvā iṣṭāniṣṭasamāyogo dṛṣṭo 'smābhir aho cirāt
verses.translation: "A young woman is poison to an old man; a young man is nectar to an old woman. Ah, after a long time we have seen a union of the desired and the undesired!"

verses.transliteration: ity evam ūcire kecid daṃpatyoḥ śṛṇvatos tadā evam uktvā kṛtātithyā yayuḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: So some said as the couple listened; having said this and received hospitality, all the great sages left.

verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ubhāv api suduḥkhitau lajjitau ca mahāprājñau gautamo bhāryayā saha papraccha muniśārdūlam agastyam ṛṣisattamam
verses.translation: Hearing the sages' words, both were deeply grieved and ashamed; the very wise Gautama with his wife asked Agastya, tiger among sages, best of seers:

verses.sanskrit: को देशः किम् उ तीर्थं वा यत्र श्रेयः समाप्यते शीघ्रम् एव महाप्राज्ञ भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: ko deśaḥ kim u tīrthaṃ vā yatra śreyaḥ samāpyate śīghram eva mahāprājña bhuktimuktipradāyakam
verses.translation: "What land or holy place is there where good is quickly attained, O very wise one, granting enjoyment and liberation?"

verses.sanskrit: वदद्भिर् मुनिभिर् ब्रह्मन् मया श्रुतम् इदं वचः सर्वे कामास् तत्र पूर्णा गौतम्यां नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vadadbhir munibhir brahman mayā śrutam idaṃ vacaḥ sarve kāmās tatra pūrṇā gautamyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "O Brahman, I have heard these words from sages speaking: all desires are fulfilled there at the Gautami, without doubt.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् गच्छ महाबुद्धे गौतमीं पापनाशिनीम् अहं त्वाम् अनुयास्यामि यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.transliteration: tasmād gaccha mahābuddhe gautamīṃ pāpanāśinīm ahaṃ tvām anuyāsyāmi yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.translation: Therefore go, O wise one, to the Gautami, destroyer of sin; I will follow you; do as you wish."

verses.transliteration: etac chrutvāgastyavākyaṃ vṛddhayā gautamo 'bhyagāt tatra tepe tapas tīvraṃ patnyā sa bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Hearing Agastya's words, Gautama went with the old woman; there the Lord sage performed fierce austerity with his wife.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिं चकार देवस्य शंभोर् विष्णोस् तथैव च गङ्गां च तोषयाम् आस भार्यार्थं भगवान् ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: stutiṃ cakāra devasya śaṃbhor viṣṇos tathaiva ca gaṅgāṃ ca toṣayām āsa bhāryārthaṃ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: The Lord sage praised the god Shambhu and likewise Vishnu, and propitiated the Ganga for his wife's sake:

verses.sanskrit: खिन्नात्मनाम् अत्र भवे त्वम् एव शरणं शिवः मरुभूमाव् अध्वगानां विटपीव प्रियायुतः
verses.transliteration: khinnātmanām atra bhave tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ marubhūmāv adhvagānāṃ viṭapīva priyāyutaḥ
verses.translation: "For the weary in this existence you alone are the auspicious refuge, like a tree with its shade for travellers in the desert.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानां भूतानां सर्वथा पापनोदनः सस्यानां घनवत् कृष्ण त्वम् अवग्रहशोषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: uccāvacānāṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvathā pāpanodanaḥ sasyānāṃ ghanavat kṛṣṇa tvam avagrahaśoṣiṇām
verses.translation: In every way you remove the sins of beings high and low, as a cloud does for crops withering in drought, O dark one.

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठदुर्गनिःश्रेणिस् त्वं पीयूषतरंगिणी अधोगतानां तप्तानां शरणं भव गौतमि
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhadurganiḥśreṇis tvaṃ pīyūṣataraṃgiṇī adhogatānāṃ taptānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava gautami
verses.translation: You are the ladder to the fortress of Vaikuntha, a river of nectar; be the refuge, O Gautami, of those who have fallen and are tormented."

verses.translation: Saying "So be it" at the Ganga's words, the two did as instructed, and both obtained beauty by the grace of the Gautami.

verses.translation: The water of that sprinkling became a river, famed by the name of the old woman, O best of sages.

verses.translation: increasing beauty, good fortune, wealth, sons and grandsons, long life, health and well-being, victory and affection, and by bathing, giving and fire offerings supremely purifying the ancestors."

verses.translation: "So be it," said the Ganga to that old woman, beloved of Gautama. The linga installed by Gautama is praised by the name Vriddha.

verses.translation: There the best of sages found joy with the old woman; bathing and giving there grant every wish.

verses.translation: From then on that holy place is called the confluence of Vriddha.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इलातीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां पावनं सर्वकामदम्
verses.transliteration: ilātīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pāvanaṃ sarvakāmadam
verses.translation: O ascetic, how do the sinners go to that city by the southern path? We wish to hear. Recount it in detail.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O ascetic, how do the sinners go to that city by the southern path? We wish to hear. Recount it in detail.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्वये जात इलो नाम जनेश्वरः महत्या सेनया सार्धं जगाम मृगयावनम्
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatānvaye jāta ilo nāma janeśvaraḥ mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ jagāma mṛgayāvanam
verses.translation: On seeing such a terrible doorway, those who have committed sins faint and lose consciousness suddenly. They begin to babble and prattle due to fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing such a terrible doorway, those who have committed sins faint and lose consciousness suddenly. They begin to babble and prattle due to fear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिबभ्राम गहनं बहुव्यालसमाकुलम् नानाकारद्विजयुतं विटपैः परिशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: paribabhrāma gahanaṃ bahuvyālasamākulam nānākāradvijayutaṃ viṭapaiḥ pariśobhitam
verses.translation: Then the servants of Yama bind them with chains and nooses and drag them ruthlessly. They beat them with sticks and threaten them again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the servants of Yama bind them with chains and nooses and drag them ruthlessly. They beat them with sticks and threaten them again and again.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वनेचरं नृपश्रेष्ठो मृगयागतमानसः तत्रैव मतिम् आधत्त इलो ऽमात्यान् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vanecaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho mṛgayāgatamānasaḥ tatraiva matim ādhatta ilo 'mātyān athābravīt
verses.translation: After regaining consciousness they go towards the southern door faltering at every step. They are smeared with blood.
verses.commentary: Sense: After regaining consciousness they go towards the southern door faltering at every step. They are smeared with blood.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु नगरं सर्वे मम पुत्रेण पालितम् देशं कोशं बलं राज्यं पालयन्तु पुनश् च तम्
verses.transliteration: gacchantu nagaraṃ sarve mama putreṇa pālitam deśaṃ kośaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ pālayantu punaś ca tam
verses.translation: When the extremely rough, coarse and chill wind blows against them they shrink, shrivel and become frozen.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the extremely rough, coarse and chill wind blows against them they shrink, shrivel and become frozen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठो ऽपि तथा यातु आदायाग्नीन् पितेव नः पत्नीभिः सहितो धीमान् अरण्ये ऽहं वसाम्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho 'pi tathā yātu ādāyāgnīn piteva naḥ patnībhiḥ sahito dhīmān araṇye 'haṃ vasāmy atha
verses.translation: On hearing the words ofYama's servants they lose their taste therein. They are afflicted by hunger and thirst (all the more). Thereafter they are tortured by the servants of Yama with terrible weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words ofYama's servants they lose their taste therein. They are afflicted by hunger and thirst (all the more). Thereafter they are tortured by the servants of Yama with terrible weapons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अरण्यभोगभुग्भिश् च वाजिवारणमानुषैः मृगयाशीलिभिः कैश्चिद् यान्तु सर्व इतः पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: araṇyabhogabhugbhiś ca vājivāraṇamānuṣaiḥ mṛgayāśīlibhiḥ kaiścid yāntu sarva itaḥ purīm
verses.translation: They do not get the opportunity of either getting in or coming out. They are in a highly wretched state. Those sinners are overwhelmed by their own actions. They lament piteously.
verses.commentary: Sense: They do not get the opportunity of either getting in or coming out. They are in a highly wretched state. Those sinners are overwhelmed by their own actions. They lament piteously.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा ययुस् ते ऽपि स्वयं प्रायाच् छनैर् गिरिम् हिमवन्तं रत्नमयं वसंस् तत्र इलो नृपः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā yayus te 'pi svayaṃ prāyāc chanair girim himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ vasaṃs tatra ilo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: After restraining and afflicting them much the sinners are taken by the servants of Yama to that place where Yama himself is present.
verses.commentary: Sense: After restraining and afflicting them much the sinners are taken by the servants of Yama to that place where Yama himself is present.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श कन्दरं तत्र नानारत्नविचित्रितम् तत्र यक्षेश्वरः कश्चित् समन्युर् इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: dadarśa kandaraṃ tatra nānāratnavicitritam tatra yakṣeśvaraḥ kaścit samanyur iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Now, when you are being afflicted by your own ac¬ tions, why do you repent and bewail? Experience your own miseries. It is not the fault of anyone else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, when you are being afflicted by your own ac¬ tions, why do you repent and bewail? Experience your own miseries. It is not the fault of anyone else.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या समानाम्नी भर्तृव्रतपरायणा तस्मिन् वसत्य् असौ यक्षो रमणीये नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā samānāmnī bhartṛvrataparāyaṇā tasmin vasaty asau yakṣo ramaṇīye nagottame
verses.translation: Due to your greed for the kingdom, due to delusion
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to your greed for the kingdom, due to delusion
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मृगरूपेण व्यचरद् भार्यया स महामतिः स्वेच्छया स्ववने यक्षः क्रीडते नृत्यगीतकैः
verses.transliteration: mṛgarūpeṇa vyacarad bhāryayā sa mahāmatiḥ svecchayā svavane yakṣaḥ krīḍate nṛtyagītakaiḥ
verses.translation: We do not see all that strength of yours whereby the subjects have been destroyed. You are being hit and pierced by the emissaries of Yama now. Now see, what have you gained?
verses.commentary: Sense: We do not see all that strength of yours whereby the subjects have been destroyed. You are being hit and pierced by the emissaries of Yama now. Now see, what have you gained?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स यक्षो जानाति मृगरूपधरो ऽपि च इलस् तु तं न जानाति कन्दरं यक्षपालितम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa yakṣo jānāti mṛgarūpadharo 'pi ca ilas tu taṃ na jānāti kandaraṃ yakṣapālitam
verses.translation: Touched by the wind he slowly regains life. Then they throw the man into the ocean of hellish life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Touched by the wind he slowly regains life. Then they throw the man into the ocean of hellish life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यक्षस्य गेहं विपुलं नानारत्नविचित्रितम् तत्रोपविष्टो नृपतिर् महत्या सेनया वृतः
verses.transliteration: yakṣasya gehaṃ vipulaṃ nānāratnavicitritam tatropaviṣṭo nṛpatir mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the emissaries intimate to Yama about the people engaged in sinful activities who are now extremely miserable.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, the emissaries intimate to Yama about the people engaged in sinful activities who are now extremely miserable.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वासं चक्रे स तत्रैव गेहे यक्षस्य धीमतः स यक्षो ऽधर्मकोपेन भार्यया मृगरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: vāsaṃ cakre sa tatraiva gehe yakṣasya dhīmataḥ sa yakṣo 'dharmakopena bhāryayā mṛgarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: This man has had sexual intercourse with forbidden women. He is a wicked man. He is a person who stole away other men's wealth. He has sold his daughter. He is a perjuror. He is ungrateful. He has deceived friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: This man has had sexual intercourse with forbidden women. He is a wicked man. He is a person who stole away other men's wealth. He has sold his daughter. He is a perjuror. He is ungrateful. He has deceived friends.

verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इलं जेतुं न शक्नोमि याचितो न ददाति च हृतं गेहं ममानेन किं करोमीत्य् अचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: ilaṃ jetuṃ na śaknomi yācito na dadāti ca hṛtaṃ gehaṃ mamānena kiṃ karomīty acintayat
verses.translation: Virtue and piety has always been censured by this pioud follow. A sinful deed has been committed by this wicked man in the mortal world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virtue and piety has always been censured by this pioud follow. A sinful deed has been committed by this wicked man in the mortal world.

verses.translation: Now, O lord of Devas, mention the modes of restrain¬ ing or blessing this fellow. Our lord must be competent to lay down action against him. We will be only hindering if we do anything ourselves.

verses.translation: The tongues of those who take false pledges and speak words that wound the sensitive spots in others are plucked by the servants of Yama, who are the members of the assembly.

verses.translation: Those who carnally approach the daughters-in-law are hurled over the heaps of burning coal and burnt by the ser¬ vants of Yama.

verses.translation: "If you do not fall from battle, where will you go if you flee?" At the Yaksha's words the king of kings fought in anger.

verses.translation: Having conquered Yakshas of many kinds, he stayed ten nights; the lord of the Yakshas, becoming a deer, lived in the forest with his wife.

verses.translation: His house taken, his servants taken, he had gone to the forest; anxious, he said to his beloved Yaksha wife, who had taken the form of a doe:

verses.translation: "This king is ill-intentioned, beloved, his mind given to vice; how may he come to misfortune? Think of a means for that.

verses.translation: The kingdoms of all rulers end in sinful pursuits and vices. Lure him to Uma's forest, fair-browed one, becoming a charming doe.

verses.translation: If this king enters there, he will become a woman without doubt. You must do it, dear one; it is not fitting for me, for I am a man, while you are a woman and a Yakshi."

verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tvayā na gantavyam umāvanam anuttamam gate 'pi tvayi ko doṣas tan me kathaya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: "Why should you not go to the unsurpassed forest of Uma? What fault would there be if you went? Tell me truly."

verses.translation: 'It is the nature of women that love-play should be kept hidden; therefore give me a secure place protected by your command.
