verses.translation: whoever enters here, Lord, let him become a woman.'

verses.translation: Thus was the command given concerning Uma's forest by the pleased moon-crested god. What can I do, being a man, beloved, pressed by your love? Therefore I must not go to Uma's excellent forest."

verses.translation: The Yaksha stayed there; Ila then saw the doe, and his mind, attached to hunting, was especially drawn by the doe.

verses.translation: Alone, mounted on his horse, he went out after that doe; slowly she drew on the king, eager for the hunt.

verses.translation: her hand resting on its branch, anointed with divine perfume, bearing a divine form, slender, her task accomplished.

verses.transliteration: kupito darśayām āsa trailokyavijayī dhanuḥ punaḥ sā prāha nṛpatiṃ mahātmānam ile svayam

verses.translation: You, the king, sat in his very cool cave, whose Yakshas you slew in delusion without a proper battle.

verses.transliteration: strītvaṃ jātaṃ jātam eva na puṃstvaṃ kartum arhasi gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ strīyogyāṃ nṛtyaṃ gītam alaṃkṛtim strīlālityaṃ strīvilāsaṃ strīkṛtyaṃ sarvam eva tat
verses.translation: "Womanhood has come and is here; you cannot make it manhood. Take the knowledge fit for a woman — dance, song, adornment, feminine grace, feminine charm and all a woman's ways."

verses.transliteration: ilā sarvam athāvāpya yakṣiṇīṃ vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Ila, having obtained all of it, said to the Yakshi:

verses.sanskrit: को वा भर्ता किं तु कृत्यं पुनः पुंस्त्वं कथं भवेत् एतद् वदस्व कल्याणी दुःखार्ताया विशेषतः आर्तानाम् आर्तिशमनाच् छ्रेयो नाभ्यधिकं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: ko vā bhartā kiṃ tu kṛtyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet etad vadasva kalyāṇī duḥkhārtāyā viśeṣataḥ ārtānām ārtiśamanāc chreyo nābhyadhikaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: "Who will be my husband, what must I do, and how may manhood come again? Tell me this, auspicious one, for I am especially distressed; nothing is better than relieving the distress of the distressed."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधः सोमसुतो नाम वनाद् अस्माच् च पूर्वतः आश्रमस् तस्य सुभगे पितरं नित्यम् एष्यति
verses.transliteration: budhaḥ somasuto nāma vanād asmāc ca pūrvataḥ āśramas tasya subhage pitaraṃ nityam eṣyati
verses.translation: "Budha, son of Soma, has his hermitage east of this forest, fair one; he goes daily to his father.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव पथा सोमं पितरं स बुधो ग्रहः द्रष्टुं याति ततो नित्यं नमस्कर्तुं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: anenaiva pathā somaṃ pitaraṃ sa budho grahaḥ draṣṭuṃ yāti tato nityaṃ namaskartuṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: By this very path the planet Budha goes daily to see and to bow to his father Soma.

verses.sanskrit: यदा याति बुधः शान्तस् तदात्मानं च दर्शय तं दृष्ट्वा त्वं तु सुभगे सर्वकामान् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: yadā yāti budhaḥ śāntas tadātmānaṃ ca darśaya taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu subhage sarvakāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: When the tranquil Budha comes, show yourself; seeing him, fair one, you will obtain all desires."

verses.sanskrit: ताम् आश्वास्य ततः सुभ्रूर् यक्षिण्य् अन्तरधीयत यक्षिणी सा तम् आचष्ट यक्षो ऽपि सुखम् आप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tām āśvāsya tataḥ subhrūr yakṣiṇy antaradhīyata yakṣiṇī sā tam ācaṣṭa yakṣo 'pi sukham āptavān
verses.translation: Having comforted her, the fair-browed Yakshi vanished; the Yakshi told her husband, and the Yaksha too was happy.

verses.transliteration: ilasainyaṃ ca tatrāsīt tad gataṃ ca yathāsukham umāvanasthitā celā gāyantī nṛtyatī punaḥ
verses.translation: Ila's army that was there went away as it pleased. Staying in Uma's forest, Ila sang and danced again and again,

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीभावम् अनुचेष्टन्ती स्मरन्ती कर्मणो गतिम् कदाचित् क्रियमाणे तु इलया नृत्यकर्मणि
verses.transliteration: strībhāvam anuceṣṭantī smarantī karmaṇo gatim kadācit kriyamāṇe tu ilayā nṛtyakarmaṇi
verses.translation: acting in a woman's ways, remembering the course of karma. Once, while Ila was dancing,

verses.transliteration: tām apaśyad budho dhīmān pitaraṃ gantum udyataḥ ilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatiṃ tyaktvā tām āgatyābravīd budhaḥ
verses.translation: the wise Budha, setting out to go to his father, saw her. Seeing Ila, abandoning his journey, Budha came to her and said:

verses.sanskrit: भार्या भव मम स्वस्था सर्वाभ्यस् त्वं प्रिया भव
verses.transliteration: bhāryā bhava mama svasthā sarvābhyas tvaṃ priyā bhava
verses.translation: "Be my wife, at ease; be dearest to me of all."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बुधवाक्यम् इला भक्त्या त्व् अभिनन्द्य तथाकरोत् स्मृत्वा च यक्षिणीवाक्यं ततस् तुष्टाभवन् मुने
verses.transliteration: budhavākyam ilā bhaktyā tv abhinandya tathākarot smṛtvā ca yakṣiṇīvākyaṃ tatas tuṣṭābhavan mune
verses.translation: Ila devotedly welcomed Budha's words and did so; remembering the Yakshi's words, she was then pleased, O sage.

verses.transliteration: kiṃ te deyaṃ mayā bhadre priyaṃ yan manasi sthitam
verses.translation: "What shall I give you, dear one, that is dear and in your mind?"

verses.transliteration: tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu putraṃ dehīty abhāṣata ilā budhaṃ somasutaṃ prītimantaṃ priyaṃ tathā
verses.translation: At the very moment of his words, Ila said to Budha, son of Soma, loving and dear, "Give me a son."

verses.translation: "This seed of mine is unfailing and born of love; therefore you will have a son, a kshatriya famed in the world,

verses.translation: founder of the lunar line, glorious, like the sun in splendour, equal to Brihaspati in intellect and to the earth in forbearance,

verses.transliteration: vīryeṇājau harir iva kopena hutabhug yathā
verses.translation: like Hari in valour in battle and like fire in anger."

verses.translation: When that great-souled son of Budha was being born, cries of victory arose everywhere, even in the abode of the gods.

verses.translation: When Budha's son was born, the lords of the gods came there; I too came there joyfully, O wise one.

verses.translation: As soon as he was born the son made a loud cry; at that all the assembled sages and gods said:

verses.transliteration: yasmāt purū ravo 'syeti tasmād eṣa purūravāḥ syād ity evaṃ nāma cakruḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ
verses.translation: "Since his cry (rava) is loud (puru), let him be Pururavas" — so all, content in mind, gave him the name.

verses.translation: Budha taught his son the auspicious science of the kshatriya; Budha gave his son the science of archery with its practice.

verses.translation: "Tell me that first, Mother."

verses.translation: And Ila said to him, "How can I tell a secret? Yet I tell you, my son, since a son is the refuge of his parents; for those sunk in the ocean of sorrow, a son is the best boat."

verses.translation: "Go to the Gautami, my son; there Shiva always dwells with Uma, glorious, remover of curses, giver of boons."

verses.transliteration: gacchantam anvagāt putram ilā somasutas tathā te sarve gautamīṃ prāptā himavatparvatottamāt
verses.translation: As the son went, Ila and Soma's son followed; they all reached the Gautami from the Himalaya, best of mountains.

verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tapaḥ kiṃcit kṛtvā cakruḥ stutiṃ parām bhavasya devadevasya stutikramam imaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Having bathed there and performed some austerity, they offered supreme praise to Bhava, god of gods; hear this order of praise:

verses.transliteration: budhas tuṣṭāva prathamam ilā ca tadanantaram tataḥ purūravāḥ putro gaurīṃ devīṃ ca śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Budha praised first, then Ila, then the son Pururavas praised the goddess Gauri and Shankara:

verses.sanskrit: यौ कुङ्कुमेन स्वशरीरजेन स्वभावहेमप्रतिमौ सरूपौ याव् अर्चितौ स्कन्दगणेश्वराभ्यां तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yau kuṅkumena svaśarīrajena svabhāvahemapratimau sarūpau yāv arcitau skandagaṇeśvarābhyāṃ tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: "Those two who with saffron from their own bodies are naturally like golden images, alike in form, worshipped by Skanda and the lord of the Ganas — may they, the refuges, be my refuge.

verses.sanskrit: संसारतापत्रयदावदग्धाः शरीरिणो यौ परिचिन्तयन्तः सद्यः परां निर्वृतिम् आप्नुवन्ति तौ शंकरौ मे शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsāratāpatrayadāvadagdhāḥ śarīriṇo yau paricintayantaḥ sadyaḥ parāṃ nirvṛtim āpnuvanti tau śaṃkarau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those two by thinking of whom embodied beings burned by the forest fire of the threefold suffering of worldly existence at once attain supreme bliss — may those auspicious ones be my refuge.

verses.sanskrit: आर्ता ह्य् अहं पीडितमानसा ते क्लेशादिगोप्ता न परो ऽस्ति कश्चित् देव त्वदीयौ चरणौ सुपुण्यौ तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: ārtā hy ahaṃ pīḍitamānasā te kleśādigoptā na paro 'sti kaścit deva tvadīyau caraṇau supuṇyau tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: I am distressed, my mind oppressed; there is no other protector from affliction; O god, your most holy feet — may they, the refuges, be my refuge.

verses.sanskrit: ययोः सकाशाद् इदम् अभ्युदैति प्रयाति चान्ते लयम् एव सर्वम् जगच्छरण्यौ जगदात्मकौ तु गौरीहरौ मे शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yayoḥ sakāśād idam abhyudaiti prayāti cānte layam eva sarvam jagaccharaṇyau jagadātmakau tu gaurīharau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: From whom all this arises and into whom at the end it dissolves — the refuges of the world whose self is the world, Gauri and Hara, may they be my refuge.

verses.sanskrit: यौ देववृन्देषु महोत्सवे तु पादौ गृहाणेश गिरीशपुत्र्याः प्रोक्तं धृतौ प्रीतिवशाच् छिवेन तौ मे शरण्यौ शरणं भवेताम्
verses.transliteration: yau devavṛndeṣu mahotsave tu pādau gṛhāṇeśa girīśaputryāḥ proktaṃ dhṛtau prītivaśāc chivena tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām
verses.translation: Those feet of the mountain's daughter which Shiva out of love held at the great festival among the hosts of gods, saying 'Take them, O Lord' — may they, the refuges, be my refuge."

verses.sanskrit: किम् अभीष्टं प्रदास्यामि युष्मभ्यं तद् वदन्तु मे कृतकृत्याः स्थ भद्रं वो देवानाम् अपि दुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: kim abhīṣṭaṃ pradāsyāmi yuṣmabhyaṃ tad vadantu me kṛtakṛtyāḥ stha bhadraṃ vo devānām api duṣkaram
verses.translation: "What wish shall I grant you? Tell me; you are fulfilled; blessings on you, even what is hard for the gods."

verses.transliteration: ilo rājā tavājñātvā vanaṃ prāviśad ambike tat kṣamasva sureśāni puṃstvaṃ dātuṃ tvam arhasi
verses.translation: "King Ila entered the forest without knowing your command, Mother; forgive that, queen of the gods; you should grant manhood."

verses.transliteration: tathety uvāca tān sarvān bhavasya tu mate sthitā tataḥ sa bhagavān āha devīvākyarataḥ sadā
verses.translation: "So be it," she said to them all, abiding by Bhava's will; then the Lord, ever delighting in the Goddess's words, said:

verses.sanskrit: अत्राभिषेकमात्रेण पुंस्त्वं प्राप्नोत्व् अयं नृपः
verses.transliteration: atrābhiṣekamātreṇa puṃstvaṃ prāpnotv ayaṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: "By merely being sprinkled here, let this king obtain manhood."

verses.transliteration: snātāyā budhabhāryāyāḥ śarīrād vāri susruve nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ yakṣiṇyā yad upārjitam
verses.translation: When Budha's wife bathed, water flowed from her body; the dance, song and beauty that had been acquired from the Yakshi

verses.transliteration: tat sarvaṃ vāridhārābhir gaṅgāmbhasi samāviśat nṛtyā gītā ca saubhāgyā imā nadyo babhūvire
verses.translation: all entered the Ganga's water in streams; these became the rivers Nritya, Gita and Saubhagya.

verses.sanskrit: ताश् चापि संगता गङ्गां ते पुण्याः संगमास् त्रयः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सुरराज्यफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tāś cāpi saṃgatā gaṅgāṃ te puṇyāḥ saṃgamās trayaḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca surarājyaphalapradam
verses.translation: They too joined the Ganga — those three holy confluences; bathing and giving at them grant the fruit of kingship among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: इला पुंस्त्वम् अवाप्याथ गौरीशंभोः प्रसादतः महाभ्युदयसिद्ध्यर्थं वाजिमेधम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: ilā puṃstvam avāpyātha gaurīśaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ mahābhyudayasiddhyarthaṃ vājimedham athākarot
verses.translation: Ila, having obtained manhood by the grace of Gauri and Shambhu, then performed a horse sacrifice for the attainment of great prosperity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसं वसिष्ठं च भार्यां पुत्रांस् तथैव च अमात्यांश् च बलं कोशम् आनीय स नृपोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhāryāṃ putrāṃs tathaiva ca amātyāṃś ca balaṃ kośam ānīya sa nṛpottamaḥ
verses.translation: Bringing the family priest Vasishtha, his wife and sons, ministers, army and treasury, that best of kings

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गं बलं राज्यं दण्डके ऽस्थापयत् तदा इलस्य नाम्ना विख्यातं तत्र तत् पुरम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ daṇḍake 'sthāpayat tadā ilasya nāmnā vikhyātaṃ tatra tat puram ucyate
verses.translation: established the fourfold army and kingdom in Dandaka; that city is famed there by the name of Ila.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजातान् अथो पुत्रान् सूर्यवंशक्रमागते राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य पश्चात् तम् ऐलं स्नेहाद् असिञ्चयत्
verses.transliteration: pūrvajātān atho putrān sūryavaṃśakramāgate rājye 'bhiṣicya paścāt tam ailaṃ snehād asiñcayat
verses.translation: Having consecrated the sons born before in the kingdom descending in the solar line, he afterwards, out of love, consecrated the son of Ila,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमवंशकरः श्रीमान् अयं राजा भवेद् इति सर्वेभ्यो मतिमानेभ्यो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठो ऽभवन् मुने
verses.transliteration: somavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmān ayaṃ rājā bhaved iti sarvebhyo matimānebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho 'bhavan mune
verses.translation: "Let this glorious one be king, founder of the lunar line"; of all those wise ones he became the eldest and best, O sage.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र च क्रतवो वृत्ता इलस्य नृपतेः शुभाः यत्र पुंस्त्वम् अवाप्याथ यत्र पुत्राः समागताः
verses.transliteration: yatra ca kratavo vṛttā ilasya nṛpateḥ śubhāḥ yatra puṃstvam avāpyātha yatra putrāḥ samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Where King Ila's auspicious sacrifices took place, where he obtained manhood, where the sons gathered,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यक्षिणीदत्तनृत्यादिगीतसौभाग्यमङ्गलाः नद्यो भूत्वा यत्र गङ्गां संगतास् तानि नारद
verses.transliteration: yakṣiṇīdattanṛtyādigītasaubhāgyamaṅgalāḥ nadyo bhūtvā yatra gaṅgāṃ saṃgatās tāni nārada
verses.translation: where dance, song, good fortune and blessings given by the Yakshi became rivers and joined the Ganga — those, O Narada,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानि शुभदान्य् आसन् सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश उभयोस् तीरयोस् तात तत्र शंभुर् इलेश्वरः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthāni śubhadāny āsan sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa ubhayos tīrayos tāta tatra śaṃbhur ileśvaraḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: became sixteen thousand auspicious holy places on both banks, my child; there Shambhu is Ileshvara; bathing and giving at them grant the fruit of all sacrifices.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं ब्रह्महत्यादिनाशनम् यत्र चक्रेश्वरो देवश् चक्रम् आप यतो हरिः
verses.transliteration: cakratīrtham iti khyātaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam yatra cakreśvaro devaś cakram āpa yato hariḥ
verses.translation: Served by heavenly damsels they go the city of Dhamia- raja travelling by different divine aerial chariots rendered splendid by diamonds and gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Served by heavenly damsels they go the city of Dhamia- raja travelling by different divine aerial chariots rendered splendid by diamonds and gold.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र विष्णुः स्वयं स्थित्वा चक्रार्थं शंकरं प्रभुः पूजयाम् आस तत् तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prabhuḥ pūjayām āsa tat tīrthaṃ cakratīrtham udāhṛtam
verses.translation: Those who devoutly give the brahmins gifts of various forms go comfortably along that great path.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who devoutly give the brahmins gifts of various forms go comfortably along that great path.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते दक्षक्रतौ प्रवृत्ते तु देवानां च समागमे
verses.transliteration: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate dakṣakratau pravṛtte tu devānāṃ ca samāgame
verses.translation: Those who speak truth, those who are devoid of impuri¬ ties inwardly and outwardly, go to the abode of Yama by serial chariots. They resemble the immortal beings in lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who speak truth, those who are devoid of impuri¬ ties inwardly and outwardly, go to the abode of Yama by serial chariots. They resemble the immortal beings in lustre.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दक्षेण दूषिते देवे शिवे शर्वे महेश्वरे अनाह्वाने सुरेशस्य दक्षचित्ते मलीमसे
verses.transliteration: dakṣeṇa dūṣite deve śive śarve maheśvare anāhvāne sureśasya dakṣacitte malīmase
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of gold, silver, corals or pearls, travel in aerial chariots shining like furnished gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make gifts of gold, silver, corals or pearls, travel in aerial chariots shining like furnished gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायण्या श्रुते वाक्ये अनाह्वानस्य कारणे अहल्यायां चोक्तवत्यां कुपिताभूत् सुरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇyā śrute vākye anāhvānasya kāraṇe ahalyāyāṃ coktavatyāṃ kupitābhūt sureśvarī
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of houses and residences go to the abode of Dharmaraja (making use of) rest houses embel¬ lished in gold and resembling the rising sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make gifts of houses and residences go to the abode of Dharmaraja (making use of) rest houses embel¬ lished in gold and resembling the rising sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितरं नाशये पापं क्षमेयं न कथंचन शृण्वती दोषवाक्यानि पित्रा चोक्तानि भर्तरि
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ nāśaye pāpaṃ kṣameyaṃ na kathaṃcana śṛṇvatī doṣavākyāni pitrā coktāni bhartari
verses.translation: Those who make gifts of water pots, different types of vessels such as Kundika, Karaka etc. go (along the path) by means of lordly elephants. They are honoured by celestial damsels too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who make gifts of water pots, different types of vessels such as Kundika, Karaka etc. go (along the path) by means of lordly elephants. They are honoured by celestial damsels too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पत्युः शृण्वन्ति या निन्दां तासां पापावधिः कुतः यादृशस् तादृशो वापि पतिः स्त्रीणां परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: patyuḥ śṛṇvanti yā nindāṃ tāsāṃ pāpāvadhiḥ kutaḥ yādṛśas tādṛśo vāpi patiḥ strīṇāṃ parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Those who give to brahmins oil for applying over the feet or on the head, those who give water for bath and drink unto the brahmins, go to the abode of Yama by riding on horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who give to brahmins oil for applying over the feet or on the head, those who give water for bath and drink unto the brahmins, go to the abode of Yama by riding on horses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनः सकलाधीशो महादेवो जगद्गुरुः श्रुतं तन्निन्दनं तर्हि धारयामि न देहकम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punaḥ sakalādhīśo mahādevo jagadguruḥ śrutaṃ tannindanaṃ tarhi dhārayāmi na dehakam
verses.translation: Those who accord rest to brahmins who are travel- worn and emaciated go comfortably along the path in a vehicle drawn by ruddy geese.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who accord rest to brahmins who are travel- worn and emaciated go comfortably along the path in a vehicle drawn by ruddy geese.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्यक्ष्य इमं देहम् इत्य् उक्त्वा सा महासती कोपेन महताविष्टा प्रजज्वाल सुरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tyakṣya imaṃ deham ity uktvā sā mahāsatī kopena mahatāviṣṭā prajajvāla sureśvarī
verses.translation: He who greets and honours a brahmin offering him welcome and befitting seat goes along that path comfortably. He becomes excessively delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who greets and honours a brahmin offering him welcome and befitting seat goes along that path comfortably. He becomes excessively delighted.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शिवैकचेतना देहं बलाद् योगाच् च तत्यजे महेश्वरो ऽपि सकलं वृत्तम् आकर्ण्य नारदात्
verses.transliteration: śivaikacetanā dehaṃ balād yogāc ca tatyaje maheśvaro 'pi sakalaṃ vṛttam ākarṇya nāradāt
verses.translation: He who salutes Hari saying cc obeisance, O lord, favour¬ ably disposed to the brahmins 75 and he who salutes a cow saying "O dispeller of sins 55, goes along that path comfortably.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who salutes Hari saying cc obeisance, O lord, favour¬ ably disposed to the brahmins 75 and he who salutes a cow saying "O dispeller of sins 55, goes along that path comfortably.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चुकोप पप्रच्छ जयां च विजयां तथा ते ऊचतुर् उभे देवं दक्षक्रतुविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā cukopa papraccha jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ tathā te ūcatur ubhe devaṃ dakṣakratuvināśanam
verses.translation: Those who take meals after the guests have taken and those who are devoid of arrogance and untruthfulness, go along that path by means of vehicles drawn by Sarasas (waterfowls).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who take meals after the guests have taken and those who are devoid of arrogance and untruthfulness, go along that path by means of vehicles drawn by Sarasas (waterfowls).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायण्या इति श्रुत्वा मखं प्रायान् महेश्वरः भीमैर् गणैः परिवृतो भूतनाथैः समं ययौ
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇyā iti śrutvā makhaṃ prāyān maheśvaraḥ bhīmair gaṇaiḥ parivṛto bhūtanāthaiḥ samaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Those who take only a morsel of food (each day) and are devoid of obstinacy and arrogance go to the abode of Yama comfortably by means of aerial chariots drawn by swans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who take only a morsel of food (each day) and are devoid of obstinacy and arrogance go to the abode of Yama comfortably by means of aerial chariots drawn by swans.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मखस् तैर् वेष्टितः सर्वो देवब्रह्मपुरस्कृतः दक्षेण यजमानेन शुद्धभावेन रक्षितः
verses.transliteration: makhas tair veṣṭitaḥ sarvo devabrahmapuraskṛtaḥ dakṣeṇa yajamānena śuddhabhāvena rakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have conquered the sense-organs and sustain themselves on a single morsel of food once in four days, go to the city of Dharma in vehicles drawn by peacock.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered the sense-organs and sustain themselves on a single morsel of food once in four days, go to the city of Dharma in vehicles drawn by peacock.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठादिभिर् अत्युग्रैर् मुनिभिः परिवारितः इन्द्रादित्याद्यैर् वसुभिः सर्वतःपरिपालितः
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhādibhir atyugrair munibhiḥ parivāritaḥ indrādityādyair vasubhiḥ sarvataḥparipālitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who regularly do virtuous deeds and take food once in three days go to that region by means of vehicles and divine chariots fitted with elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who regularly do virtuous deeds and take food once in three days go to that region by means of vehicles and divine chariots fitted with elephants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामवेदैश् च स्वाहाशब्दैर् अलंकृतः श्रद्धा पुष्टिस् तथा तुष्टिः शान्तिर् लज्जा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmavedaiś ca svāhāśabdair alaṃkṛtaḥ śraddhā puṣṭis tathā tuṣṭiḥ śāntir lajjā sarasvatī
verses.translation: He who takes cooked rice once in six days, has conquer¬ ed the sense-organs, and always maintains cleanliness, goes like the consort of SacI seated on an elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who takes cooked rice once in six days, has conquer¬ ed the sense-organs, and always maintains cleanliness, goes like the consort of SacI seated on an elephant.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूमिर् द्यौः शर्वरी क्षान्तिर् उषा आशा जया मतिः एताभिश् च तथान्याभिः सर्वतः समलंकृतः
verses.transliteration: bhūmir dyauḥ śarvarī kṣāntir uṣā āśā jayā matiḥ etābhiś ca tathānyābhiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: (He goes to) the beautiful city of Dharmaraja em¬ bellished with jewels, resonant with different notes and voices as well as the shouts of victory.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He goes to) the beautiful city of Dharmaraja em¬ bellished with jewels, resonant with different notes and voices as well as the shouts of victory.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tvaṣṭrā mahātmanā cāpi kārito viśvakarmaṇā surabhir nandinī dhenuḥ kāmadhuk kāmadohinī
verses.translation: Those who observe fasts for a forthnight go to the city of Dharmaraja in vehicles drawn by tigers and attended by Devas and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who observe fasts for a forthnight go to the city of Dharmaraja in vehicles drawn by tigers and attended by Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एताभिः कामवर्षाभिः सर्वकामसमृद्धिमान् कल्पवृक्षः पारिजातो लताः कल्पलतादिकाः
verses.transliteration: etābhiḥ kāmavarṣābhiḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhimān kalpavṛkṣaḥ pārijāto latāḥ kalpalatādikāḥ
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sense-organs and observe fasts for a month go to the abode of Yama in vehicles as refulgent as the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sense-organs and observe fasts for a month go to the abode of Yama in vehicles as refulgent as the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यद् यद् इष्टतमं किंचित् तत्र तस्मिन् मखे स्थितम् स्वयं मघवता पूष्णा हरिणा परिरक्षितः
verses.transliteration: yad yad iṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcit tatra tasmin makhe sthitam svayaṃ maghavatā pūṣṇā hariṇā parirakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: He who sanctifies the body with the inner soul devoted to Visnu goes to heaven in a chariot as refulgent as fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sanctifies the body with the inner soul devoted to Visnu goes to heaven in a chariot as refulgent as fire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दीयतां भुज्यतां वापि क्रियतां स्थीयतां सुखम् एतैश् च सर्वतो वाक्यैर् दक्षस्य पूजितं मखम्
verses.transliteration: dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ vāpi kriyatāṃ sthīyatāṃ sukham etaiś ca sarvato vākyair dakṣasya pūjitaṃ makham
verses.translation: He who remembers Visnu and casts off his vital airs without resorting to destructive weapons goes to the city of Dharma by means of a vehicle that has the refulgence of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who remembers Visnu and casts off his vital airs without resorting to destructive weapons goes to the city of Dharma by means of a vehicle that has the refulgence of the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदौ तु वीरभद्रो ऽसौ भद्रकाल्या युतो ययौ शोककोपपरीतात्मा पश्चाच् छूलपिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: ādau tu vīrabhadro 'sau bhadrakālyā yuto yayau śokakopaparītātmā paścāc chūlapinākadhṛk
verses.translation: He who enters water and casts off his vital airs, goes comfortably in a vehicle resembling the lunar disc.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who enters water and casts off his vital airs, goes comfortably in a vehicle resembling the lunar disc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अभ्याययौ महादेवो महाभूतैर् अलंकृतः तानि भूतानि परितो मखे वेष्ट्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: abhyāyayau mahādevo mahābhūtair alaṃkṛtaḥ tāni bhūtāni parito makhe veṣṭya maheśvaram
verses.translation: The devotee of Visnu who gives up his body to the vultures, goes to the abode of Yama in a splendid chariot made of gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee of Visnu who gives up his body to the vultures, goes to the abode of Yama in a splendid chariot made of gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुं विध्वंसयाम् आसुस् तत्र क्षोभो महान् अभूत् पलायन्त ततः केचित् केचिद् गत्वा ततः शिवम्
verses.transliteration: kratuṃ vidhvaṃsayām āsus tatra kṣobho mahān abhūt palāyanta tataḥ kecit kecid gatvā tataḥ śivam
verses.translation: He who meets death in a battle ensuing upon his at¬ tempt to resist the abduction of a woman or capture of cows goes along shining like the sun and attended upon by celestial girls.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who meets death in a battle ensuing upon his at¬ tempt to resist the abduction of a woman or capture of cows goes along shining like the sun and attended upon by celestial girls.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: केचित् स्तुवन्ति देवेशं केचित् कुप्यन्ति शंकरम् एवं विध्वंसितं यज्ञं दृष्ट्वा पूषा समभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: kecit stuvanti deveśaṃ kecit kupyanti śaṃkaram evaṃ vidhvaṃsitaṃ yajñaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūṣā samabhyagāt
verses.translation: Those devotees of Visnu who have conquered their sense-organs and undertake pilgrimages to holy centres go along that terrible path by comfortable vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees of Visnu who have conquered their sense-organs and undertake pilgrimages to holy centres go along that terrible path by comfortable vehicles.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पूष्णो दन्तान् अथोत्पाट्य इन्द्रं व्यद्रावयत् क्षणात् भगस्य चक्षुषी विप्र वीरभद्रो व्यपाटयत्
verses.transliteration: pūṣṇo dantān athotpāṭya indraṃ vyadrāvayat kṣaṇāt bhagasya cakṣuṣī vipra vīrabhadro vyapāṭayat
verses.translation: The excellent brahmins who worship, performing sacri¬ fices wherein monetary gifts are generously distributed go com¬ fortably by means of aerial chariots resembling molten gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent brahmins who worship, performing sacri¬ fices wherein monetary gifts are generously distributed go com¬ fortably by means of aerial chariots resembling molten gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दिवाकरं पुनर् दोर्भ्यां परिभ्राम्य समाक्षिपत् ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे विष्णुं ते शरणं ययुः
verses.transliteration: divākaraṃ punar dorbhyāṃ paribhrāmya samākṣipat tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve viṣṇuṃ te śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: Those who refrain from inflicting pain on others and those who sustain their servants, go comfortably in aerial chariots shining like gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who refrain from inflicting pain on others and those who sustain their servants, go comfortably in aerial chariots shining like gold.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्राहि त्राहि गदापाणे भूतनाथकृताद् भयात् महेश्वरगणः कश्चित् प्रमथानां तु नायकः तेन दग्धो मखः सर्वो वैष्णवः पश्यतो हरेः
verses.transliteration: trāhi trāhi gadāpāṇe bhūtanāthakṛtād bhayāt maheśvaragaṇaḥ kaścit pramathānāṃ tu nāyakaḥ tena dagdho makhaḥ sarvo vaiṣṇavaḥ paśyato hareḥ
verses.translation: Those who worship Visnu, Brahma, the three-eyed lord Siva and the sun with the same emotional fervour go there immediately with a pure mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who worship Visnu, Brahma, the three-eyed lord Siva and the sun with the same emotional fervour go there immediately with a pure mind.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हरिणा चक्रम् उत्सृष्टं भूतनाथवधं प्रति भूतनाथो ऽपि तच् चक्रम् आपतच् च तदाग्रसत्
verses.transliteration: hariṇā cakram utsṛṣṭaṃ bhūtanāthavadhaṃ prati bhūtanātho 'pi tac cakram āpatac ca tadāgrasat
verses.translation: Those who arc devoted to truth, cleanliness and mercy and do not eat flesh go to the city of Dharmaraja comfortably.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who arc devoted to truth, cleanliness and mercy and do not eat flesh go to the city of Dharmaraja comfortably.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ग्रस्ते चक्रे ततो विष्णोर् लोकपाला भयाद् ययुः तथा स्थितान् अवेक्ष्याथ दक्षो यज्ञं सुरान् अपि तुष्टाव शंकरं देवं दक्षो भक्त्या प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: graste cakre tato viṣṇor lokapālā bhayād yayuḥ tathā sthitān avekṣyātha dakṣo yajñaṃ surān api tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ dakṣo bhaktyā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, Brahma, the most excellent one among the knowers of the Vedas, said thus He who makes a gift of a thousand cows and he who abstains from eating meat—these two are on a par with each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Brahma, the most excellent one among the knowers of the Vedas, said thus He who makes a gift of a thousand cows and he who abstains from eating meat—these two are on a par with each other.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जय शंकर सोमेश जय सर्वज्ञ शंभवे जय कल्याणभृच् छंभो जय कालात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: jaya śaṃkara someśa jaya sarvajña śaṃbhave jaya kalyāṇabhṛc chaṃbho jaya kālātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, the benefit resulting from the avoidance of meat-eating is the same as that of the pilgrimage to all holy centres and of the performance of all Yaj'nas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the benefit resulting from the avoidance of meat-eating is the same as that of the pilgrimage to all holy centres and of the performance of all Yaj'nas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आदिकर्तर् नमस् ते ऽस्तु नीलकण्ठ नमो ऽस्तु ते ब्रह्मप्रिय नमस् ते ऽस्तु ब्रह्मरूप नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: ādikartar namas te 'stu nīlakaṇṭha namo 'stu te brahmapriya namas te 'stu brahmarūpa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Thus the virtuous ones engaged in charitable gifts and religious vows go comfortably in vehicles to the world of Yama the lord who is the son of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the virtuous ones engaged in charitable gifts and religious vows go comfortably in vehicles to the world of Yama the lord who is the son of the sun.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमूर्तये नमो देव त्रिधाम परमेश्वर सर्वमूर्ते नमस् ते ऽस्तु त्रैलोक्याधार कामद
verses.transliteration: trimūrtaye namo deva tridhāma parameśvara sarvamūrte namas te 'stu trailokyādhāra kāmada
verses.translation: On seeing those virtuous persons lord Yama will hon¬ our them by offering them greetings of welcome, seats and pleasing water for washing feet and materials of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those virtuous persons lord Yama will hon¬ our them by offering them greetings of welcome, seats and pleasing water for washing feet and materials of worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: नमो वेदान्तवेद्याय नमस् ते परमात्मने यज्ञरूप नमस् ते ऽस्तु यज्ञधाम नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namo vedāntavedyāya namas te paramātmane yajñarūpa namas te 'stu yajñadhāma namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Men who have magnificence of meritorious deeds find armaraja very gentle, as though he is their father himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who have magnificence of meritorious deeds find armaraja very gentle, as though he is their father himself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञदान नमस् ते ऽस्तु हव्यवाह नमो ऽस्तु ते यज्ञहर्त्रे नमस् ते ऽस्तु फलदाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: yajñadāna namas te 'stu havyavāha namo 'stu te yajñahartre namas te 'stu phaladāya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: O brahmins, if one resorts to it, virtue saves one from great dangers. One shall undoubtedly attain divinity and brahminhood by means of virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if one resorts to it, virtue saves one from great dangers. One shall undoubtedly attain divinity and brahminhood by means of virtue.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्राहि त्राहि जगन्नाथ शरणागतवत्सल भक्तानाम् अप्य् अभक्तानां त्वम् एव शरणं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: trāhi trāhi jagannātha śaraṇāgatavatsala bhaktānām apy abhaktānāṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ prabho
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, when the previously accumulated demerit of men dwindles, their mind turns to virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, when the previously accumulated demerit of men dwindles, their mind turns to virtue.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं तु स्तुवतस् तस्य प्रसन्नो ऽभून् महेश्वरः किं ददामीति तं प्राह क्रतुः पूर्णो ऽस्तु मे प्रभो
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu stuvatas tasya prasanno 'bhūn maheśvaraḥ kiṃ dadāmīti taṃ prāha kratuḥ pūrṇo 'stu me prabho
verses.translation: If, after thousands of births in the other species one attains the rare birth as a human being, but still one does not practice virtue, he is a deceived persons indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: If, after thousands of births in the other species one attains the rare birth as a human being, but still one does not practice virtue, he is a deceived persons indeed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उवाच भगवान् देवदेवो महेश्वरः शंकरः सर्वभूतात्मा करुणावरुणालयः
verses.transliteration: tathety uvāca bhagavān devadevo maheśvaraḥ śaṃkaraḥ sarvabhūtātmā karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ
verses.translation: The following should be known as persons devoid of virtue—Despicable persons, ugly ones, impoverished men, sick men, foolish ones and those who serve others.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following should be known as persons devoid of virtue—Despicable persons, ugly ones, impoverished men, sick men, foolish ones and those who serve others.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुं कृत्वा ततः पूर्णं तस्य दक्षस्य वै मुने एवम् उक्त्वा स भगवान् भूतैर् अन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: kratuṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tasya dakṣasya vai mune evam uktvā sa bhagavān bhūtair antaradhīyata
verses.translation: Virtue has been practised previously by the following persons those who live long, the heroic ones, scholars, those who have wealth, those who are free from ailments and those who are beautiful and handsome.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virtue has been practised previously by the following persons those who live long, the heroic ones, scholars, those who have wealth, those who are free from ailments and those who are beautiful and handsome.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यथागतं सुरा जग्मुः स्वम् एव सदनं प्रति ततः कदाचिद् देवानां दैत्यानां विग्रहो महान्
verses.transliteration: yathāgataṃ surā jagmuḥ svam eva sadanaṃ prati tataḥ kadācid devānāṃ daityānāṃ vigraho mahān
verses.translation: O brahmins, those who are engaged in righteous acti¬ vities attain the highest state. Those who resort to sin and evil are born as animals and low creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, those who are engaged in righteous acti¬ vities attain the highest state. Those who resort to sin and evil are born as animals and low creatures.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बभूव तत्र दैत्येभ्यो भीता देवाः श्रियः पतिम् तुष्टुवुः सर्वभावेन वचोभिस् तं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: babhūva tatra daityebhyo bhītā devāḥ śriyaḥ patim tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvabhāvena vacobhis taṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: Those who always bow to the lord who has neither birth nor death and who slays Daityas and Danavas, do not see Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who always bow to the lord who has neither birth nor death and who slays Daityas and Danavas, do not see Yama.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शक्रादयो ऽपि त्रिदशाः कटाक्षम् अवेक्ष्य यस्यास् तप आचरन्ति सा चापि यत्पादरता च लक्ष्मीस् तं ब्रह्मभूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: śakrādayo 'pi tridaśāḥ kaṭākṣam avekṣya yasyās tapa ācaranti sā cāpi yatpādaratā ca lakṣmīs taṃ brahmabhūtaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Those who have sought refuge in Visnu in their thoughts, words and deeds get the benefit of salvation. Yama is not able to harm them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have sought refuge in Visnu in their thoughts, words and deeds get the benefit of salvation. Yama is not able to harm them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् त्रिलोक्यां न परः समानो न चाधिकस् तार्क्ष्यरथान् नृसिंहात् स देवदेवो ऽवतु नः समस्तान् महाभयेभ्यः कृपया प्रपन्नान्
verses.transliteration: yasmāt trilokyāṃ na paraḥ samāno na cādhikas tārkṣyarathān nṛsiṃhāt sa devadevo 'vatu naḥ samastān mahābhayebhyaḥ kṛpayā prapannān
verses.translation: O brahmins, those people who continuously bow to Narayana, the lord of worlds, do not go anywhere else other than the abode of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, those people who continuously bow to Narayana, the lord of worlds, do not go anywhere else other than the abode of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवाञ् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः किमर्थम् आगताः सर्वे तत्कर्तास्मीत्य् उवाच तान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavāñ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ kimartham āgatāḥ sarve tatkartāsmīty uvāca tān
verses.translation: By bowing to Visnu, (the devotees) do not see those emissaries, Yama, that city or. that path. They never see hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: By bowing to Visnu, (the devotees) do not see those emissaries, Yama, that city or. that path. They never see hells.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भयं च तीव्रं दैत्येभ्यो देवानां मधुसूदन ततस् त्राणाय देवानां मतिं कुरु जनार्दन
verses.transliteration: bhayaṃ ca tīvraṃ daityebhyo devānāṃ madhusūdana tatas trāṇāya devānāṃ matiṃ kuru janārdana
verses.translation: Although those who are deluded may commit sins, still if they are devoted to Hari, the destroyer of sins, they do not go to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although those who are deluded may commit sins, still if they are devoted to Hari, the destroyer of sins, they do not go to hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तान् आगतान् हरिः प्राह ग्रस्तं चक्रं हरेण मे किं करोमि गतं चक्रं भवन्तश् चार्तिम् आगताः यान्तु सर्वे देवगणा रक्षा वः क्रियते मया
verses.transliteration: tān āgatān hariḥ prāha grastaṃ cakraṃ hareṇa me kiṃ karomi gataṃ cakraṃ bhavantaś cārtim āgatāḥ yāntu sarve devagaṇā rakṣā vaḥ kriyate mayā
verses.translation: Those who remember the lord even roguishly, go to the world of Visnu, free from ailments, after casting off this mortal body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो गतेषु देवेषु विष्णुश् चक्रार्थम् उद्यतः गोदावरीं ततो गत्वा शंभोः पूजां प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tato gateṣu deveṣu viṣṇuś cakrārtham udyataḥ godāvarīṃ tato gatvā śaṃbhoḥ pūjāṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: Then, when the gods had gone, Vishnu, eager for the discus, went to the Godavari and began to worship Shambhu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: suvarṇakamalair divyaiḥ sugandhair daśabhiḥ śataiḥ bhaktito nityavat pūjāṃ cakre viṣṇur umāpateḥ
verses.translation: With a thousand divine, fragrant golden lotuses Vishnu devotedly performed his daily worship of the husband of Uma.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्यमाने तु तयोस् तत्त्वम् इदं शृणु कमलानां सहस्रे तु यदैकं नैव पूर्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjyamāne tu tayos tattvam idaṃ śṛṇu kamalānāṃ sahasre tu yadaikaṃ naiva pūryate
verses.translation: As he worshipped thus, hear the truth of the two: when one of the thousand lotuses was missing,

verses.sanskrit: तदासुरारिः स्वं नेत्रम् उत्पाट्यार्घ्यम् अकल्पयत् अर्घ्यपात्रं करे गृह्य सहस्रकमलान्वितम् ध्यात्वा शंभुं ददाव् अर्घ्यम् अनन्यशरणो हरिः
verses.transliteration: tadāsurāriḥ svaṃ netram utpāṭyārghyam akalpayat arghyapātraṃ kare gṛhya sahasrakamalānvitam dhyātvā śaṃbhuṃ dadāv arghyam ananyaśaraṇo hariḥ
verses.translation: the enemy of the Asuras plucked out his own eye and prepared it as the offering; taking the offering-vessel with the thousand lotuses in hand and meditating on Shambhu, Hari, having no other refuge, gave the offering:

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् एव देव जानीषे भावम् अन्तर्गतं नृणाम् त्वम् एव शरणो ऽधीशो ऽत्र का भवेद् विचारणा
verses.transliteration: tvam eva deva jānīṣe bhāvam antargataṃ nṛṇām tvam eva śaraṇo 'dhīśo 'tra kā bhaved vicāraṇā
verses.translation: "You alone, O god, know the feeling within men; you alone are the refuge and the Lord; what deliberation can there be here?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदन्न् उदश्रुनयनो निलिल्ये ऽसाव् इतीश्वरे भवानीसहितः शंभुः पुरस्ताद् अभवत् तदा
verses.transliteration: vadann udaśrunayano nililye 'sāv itīśvare bhavānīsahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ purastād abhavat tadā
verses.translation: Saying this, with tears in his eyes, he became absorbed in the Lord; then Shambhu with Bhavani appeared before him.

verses.sanskrit: गाढम् आलिङ्ग्य विविधैर् वरैर् आपूरयद् धरिम् तद् एव चक्रम् अभवन् नेत्रं चापि यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: gāḍham āliṅgya vividhair varair āpūrayad dharim tad eva cakram abhavan netraṃ cāpi yathā purā
verses.translation: Embracing Hari tightly, he filled him with various boons; that very eye became the discus, and the eye too was as before.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे तुष्टुवुर् हरिशंकरौ गङ्गां चापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठां देवं च वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvur hariśaṃkarau gaṅgāṃ cāpi saricchreṣṭhāṃ devaṃ ca vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Then all the hosts of gods praised Hari and Shankara, the Ganga, best of rivers, and the bull-bannered god.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् इति स्मृतम् यस्यानुश्रवणेनैव मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ cakratīrtham iti smṛtam yasyānuśravaṇenaiva mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: From then on that holy place is remembered as Chakratirtha, by merely hearing of which one is freed from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नानं च दानं च यः कुर्यात् पितृतर्पणम् सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पितृभिः स्वर्गभाग् भवेत् तत् तु चक्राङ्कितं तीर्थम् अद्यापि परिदृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt pitṛtarpaṇam sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ svargabhāg bhavet tat tu cakrāṅkitaṃ tīrtham adyāpi paridṛśyate
verses.translation: Whoever bathes, gives and offers libations to the ancestors there is freed from all sins and shares heaven with the ancestors; that holy place marked with the discus is seen even today.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलं तीर्थम् आख्यातं चक्रतीर्थाद् अनन्तरम् यत्र चक्रेश्वरो देवश् चक्रम् आप यतो हरिः
verses.transliteration: pippalaṃ tīrtham ākhyātaṃ cakratīrthād anantaram yatra cakreśvaro devaś cakram āpa yato hariḥ
verses.translation: After hearing about the path of Yama and the tortures in the hells the excellent sages asked Vyasa again to clear their doubts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र विष्णुः स्वयं स्थित्वा चक्रार्थं शंकरं विभुम् पूजयाम् आस तत् तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थम् उदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vibhum pūjayām āsa tat tīrthaṃ cakratīrtham udāhṛtam
verses.translation: A creature equipped with Dharma will attain the greatest heavenly goal. Similarly, one defiled by sins attains hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: A creature equipped with Dharma will attain the greatest heavenly goal. Similarly, one defiled by sins attains hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र प्रीतो ऽभवद् विष्णोः शंभुस् तत् पिप्पलं विदुः महिमानं यस्य वक्तुं न क्षमो ऽप्य् अहिनायकः
verses.transliteration: yatra prīto 'bhavad viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhus tat pippalaṃ viduḥ mahimānaṃ yasya vaktuṃ na kṣamo 'py ahināyakaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, the wise one should not be delighted by riches
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the wise one should not be delighted by riches
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: चक्रेश्वरो पिप्पलेशो नामधेयस्य कारणम् शृणु नारद तद् भक्त्या साक्षाद् वेदोदितं मया
verses.transliteration: cakreśvaro pippaleśo nāmadheyasya kāraṇam śṛṇu nārada tad bhaktyā sākṣād vedoditaṃ mayā
verses.translation: Even a well-read man commits unworthy acts on being deluded by covetousness for wealth of others. He may commit sins due to greed, delusion, sympathy or fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a well-read man commits unworthy acts on being deluded by covetousness for wealth of others. He may commit sins due to greed, delusion, sympathy or fear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दधीचिर् इति विख्यातो मुनिर् आसीद् गुणान्वितः तस्य भार्या महाप्राज्ञा कुलीना च पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: dadhīcir iti vikhyāto munir āsīd guṇānvitaḥ tasya bhāryā mahāprājñā kulīnā ca pativratā
verses.translation: Virtue, wealth and sensual pleasure are the three ob¬ jectives that a living man strives after. These three should be acquired after avoiding sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virtue, wealth and sensual pleasure are the three ob¬ jectives that a living man strives after. These three should be acquired after avoiding sins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: लोपामुद्रेति या ख्याता स्वसा तस्या गभस्तिनी इति नाम्ना च विख्याता वडवेति प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: lopāmudreti yā khyātā svasā tasyā gabhastinī iti nāmnā ca vikhyātā vaḍaveti prakīrtitā
verses.translation: The virtuous words of Your Holiness have been listened to. They are greatly conducive to our welfare. Now we are inclined to know about this assemblage (of parts) called body.
verses.commentary: Sense: The virtuous words of Your Holiness have been listened to. They are greatly conducive to our welfare. Now we are inclined to know about this assemblage (of parts) called body.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दधीचेः सा प्रिया नित्यं तपस् तेपे तया महत् दधीचिर् अग्निमान् नित्यं गृहधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: dadhīceḥ sā priyā nityaṃ tapas tepe tayā mahat dadhīcir agnimān nityaṃ gṛhadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The dead body of men becomes subtle. It passes into an unmanifest state. It reaches a state where it cannot be seen. How does Dharma follow it?
verses.commentary: Sense: The dead body of men becomes subtle. It passes into an unmanifest state. It reaches a state where it cannot be seen. How does Dharma follow it?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भागीरथीं समाश्रित्य देवातिथिपरायणः स्वकलत्ररतः शान्तः कुम्भयोनिर् इवापरः
verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathīṃ samāśritya devātithiparāyaṇaḥ svakalatrarataḥ śāntaḥ kumbhayonir ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: The earth, wind, ether, water, fire, mind, intellect, soul—all these collectively see Dharma always.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth, wind, ether, water, fire, mind, intellect, soul—all these collectively see Dharma always.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभावात् तं देशं नारयो दैत्यदानवाः आजग्मुर् मुनिशार्दूल यत्रागस्त्यस्य चाश्रमः
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāvāt taṃ deśaṃ nārayo daityadānavāḥ ājagmur muniśārdūla yatrāgastyasya cāśramaḥ
verses.translation: They are the witnesses unto all living beings by day or by night. Along with these, Dharma follows the individual soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are the witnesses unto all living beings by day or by night. Along with these, Dharma follows the individual soul.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः समाजग्मू रुद्रादित्यास् तथाश्विनौ इन्द्रो विष्णुर् यमो ऽग्निश् च जित्वा दैत्यान् उपागतान्
verses.transliteration: tatra devāḥ samājagmū rudrādityās tathāśvinau indro viṣṇur yamo 'gniś ca jitvā daityān upāgatān
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the skin, bone, flesh, semen and blood all these leave off the body bereft of living soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the skin, bone, flesh, semen and blood all these leave off the body bereft of living soul.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जयेन जातसंहर्षाः स्तुताश् चैव मरुद्गणैः दधीचिं मुनिशार्दूलं दृष्ट्वा नेमुः सुरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: jayena jātasaṃharṣāḥ stutāś caiva marudgaṇaiḥ dadhīciṃ muniśārdūlaṃ dṛṣṭvā nemuḥ sureśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Then the individual soul equipped with Dharma attains happiness, both in this world and in the other world. What else shall I tell you?
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the individual soul equipped with Dharma attains happiness, both in this world and in the other world. What else shall I tell you?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दधीचिर् जातसंहर्षः सुरान् पूज्य पृथक् पृथक् गृहकृत्यं ततश् चक्रे सुरेभ्यो भार्यया सह
verses.transliteration: dadhīcir jātasaṃharṣaḥ surān pūjya pṛthak pṛthak gṛhakṛtyaṃ tataś cakre surebhyo bhāryayā saha
verses.translation: How Dharma follows (the soul) has been indicated by Your Holiness. We wish to know how semen begins to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: How Dharma follows (the soul) has been indicated by Your Holiness. We wish to know how semen begins to function.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टाश् च कुशलं तेन कथाश् चक्रुः सुरा अपि दधीचिम् अब्रुवन् देवा भार्यया सुखितं पुनः
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭāś ca kuśalaṃ tena kathāś cakruḥ surā api dadhīcim abruvan devā bhāryayā sukhitaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Now, listen, in which particular life or existence a deluded person is born and for what action of his.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, listen, in which particular life or existence a deluded person is born and for what action of his.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसीनं हृष्टमनस ऋषिं नत्वा पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: āsīnaṃ hṛṣṭamanasa ṛṣiṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, there are spots as holy as celestial regions. These are progressive and specially designed for the mortals.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, there are spots as holy as celestial regions. These are progressive and specially designed for the mortals.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किम् अद्य दुर्लभं लोके ऋषे ऽस्माकं भविष्यति त्वादृशः सकृपो येषु मुनिर् भूकल्पपादपः
verses.transliteration: kim adya durlabhaṃ loke ṛṣe 'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati tvādṛśaḥ sakṛpo yeṣu munir bhūkalpapādapaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, in the world of Yama which equals the world of Brahma, the jiva, bound by the fast chains of his actions reaps the fruits thereof.'
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, in the world of Yama which equals the world of Brahma, the jiva, bound by the fast chains of his actions reaps the fruits thereof.'
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एव फलं पुंसां जीवतां मुनिसत्तम तीर्थाप्लुतिर् भूतदया दर्शनं च भवादृशाम्
verses.transliteration: etad eva phalaṃ puṃsāṃ jīvatāṃ munisattama tīrthāplutir bhūtadayā darśanaṃ ca bhavādṛśām
verses.translation: I shall, now, tell you about those actions which cause a person to assume an ugly form.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall, now, tell you about those actions which cause a person to assume an ugly form.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत् स्नेहाद् उच्यते ऽस्माभिर् अवधारय तन् मुने जित्वा दैत्यान् इह प्राप्ता हत्वा राक्षसपुंगवान्
verses.transliteration: yat snehād ucyate 'smābhir avadhāraya tan mune jitvā daityān iha prāptā hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavān
verses.translation: A Brahmana though well versed in the Vedas is born as an ass if he receives charity from a fallen person.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana though well versed in the Vedas is born as an ass if he receives charity from a fallen person.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वयं च सुखिनो ब्रह्मंस् त्वयि दृष्टे विशेषतः नायुधैः फलम् अस्माकं वोढुं नैव क्षमा वयम्
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ ca sukhino brahmaṃs tvayi dṛṣṭe viśeṣataḥ nāyudhaiḥ phalam asmākaṃ voḍhuṃ naiva kṣamā vayam
verses.translation: If he officiates at a sacrifice performed by alow person, he is born a worm and in the form of a worm he lives for fifteen years.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he officiates at a sacrifice performed by alow person, he is born a worm and in the form of a worm he lives for fifteen years.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थाप्यदेशं न पश्याम आयुधानां मुनीश्वर स्वर्गे सुरद्विषो ज्ञात्वा स्थापितानि हरन्ति च
verses.transliteration: sthāpyadeśaṃ na paśyāma āyudhānāṃ munīśvara svarge suradviṣo jñātvā sthāpitāni haranti ca
verses.translation: He remains in that form for eight years. Then he is born a fawn, O Brahmanas. He remains in that form for four months. Then he is born a goat.
verses.commentary: Sense: He remains in that form for eight years. Then he is born a fawn, O Brahmanas. He remains in that form for four months. Then he is born a goat.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: nayeyur āyudhānīti tathaiva ca rasātale tasmāt tavāśrame puṇye sthāpyante 'strāṇi mānada
verses.translation: He remains in that form for one year. Then he is borri as an insect, then a man.
verses.commentary: Sense: He remains in that form for one year. Then he is borri as an insect, then a man.

verses.sanskrit: नैवात्र किंचिद् भयम् अस्ति विप्र न दानवेभ्यो राक्षसेभ्यश् च घोरम् त्वदाज्ञया रक्षितपुण्यदेशो न विद्यते तपसा ते समानः
verses.transliteration: naivātra kiṃcid bhayam asti vipra na dānavebhyo rākṣasebhyaś ca ghoram tvadājñayā rakṣitapuṇyadeśo na vidyate tapasā te samānaḥ
verses.translation: He who out of delusion, with a guilty mind, seduces the wife of his brother is born a male cuckoo and remains in that form for a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who out of delusion, with a guilty mind, seduces the wife of his brother is born a male cuckoo and remains in that form for a year.

verses.sanskrit: जितारयो ब्रह्मविदां वरिष्ठं वयं च पूर्वं निहता दैत्यसंघाः अस्त्रैर् अलं भारभूतैः कृतार्थैः स्थाप्यं स्थानं ते समीपे मुनीश
verses.transliteration: jitārayo brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaṃ vayaṃ ca pūrvaṃ nihatā daityasaṃghāḥ astrair alaṃ bhārabhūtaiḥ kṛtārthaiḥ sthāpyaṃ sthānaṃ te samīpe munīśa
verses.translation: He with whom his parents are angry or he who is not attentive to the instructions of his teacher is born an ass.
verses.commentary: Sense: He with whom his parents are angry or he who is not attentive to the instructions of his teacher is born an ass.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यान् भोगान् कामिनीभिः समेतान् देवोद्याने नन्दने संभजामः ततो यामः कृतकार्याः सहेन्द्राः स्वं स्वं स्थानं चायुधानां च रक्षा
verses.transliteration: divyān bhogān kāminībhiḥ sametān devodyāne nandane saṃbhajāmaḥ tato yāmaḥ kṛtakāryāḥ sahendrāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ cāyudhānāṃ ca rakṣā
verses.translation: As an ass he lives for two years. As a cat he lives for
verses.commentary: Sense: As an ass he lives for two years. As a cat he lives for

verses.transliteration: tvayā kṛtā jāyatāṃ tat praśādhi samarthas tvaṃ rakṣaṇe dhāraṇe ca
verses.translation: He suffers from various sorts of pains in hell, coming in contact with.leaves as sharp as swords, or in hell full of hot sands, or in hell where the wicked are tortured with sharp s.words.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यम् आकर्ण्य दधीचिर् एवं वाक्यं जगौ विबुधान् एवम् अस्तु निवार्यमाणः प्रियशीलया स्त्रिया किं देवकार्येण विरुद्धकारिणा
verses.transliteration: tadvākyam ākarṇya dadhīcir evaṃ vākyaṃ jagau vibudhān evam astu nivāryamāṇaḥ priyaśīlayā striyā kiṃ devakāryeṇa viruddhakāriṇā
verses.translation: Even women in association with the sinful men incur sins.

verses.sanskrit: ये ज्ञातशास्त्राः परमार्थनिष्ठाः संसारचेष्टासु गतानुरागाः तेषां परार्थव्यसनेन किं मुने येनात्र वामुत्र सुखं न किंचित्
verses.transliteration: ye jñātaśāstrāḥ paramārthaniṣṭhāḥ saṃsāraceṣṭāsu gatānurāgāḥ teṣāṃ parārthavyasanena kiṃ mune yenātra vāmutra sukhaṃ na kiṃcit
verses.translation: "For those who know the scriptures, who are established in the highest truth and have lost attachment to worldly activity, what use is devotion to another's affairs, O sage, by which there is no happiness here or hereafter?

verses.transliteration: devadviṣo dveṣam anuprayānti datte sthāne vipravarya śṛṇuṣva naṣṭe hṛte cāyudhānāṃ munīśa kupyanti devā ripavas te bhavanti
verses.translation: The enemies of the gods will turn their hatred on the place where they are kept, O best of brahmins; listen. If the weapons are lost or stolen, O lord of sages, the gods will become angry and become your enemies.

verses.transliteration: tasmān nedaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭha yuktaṃ dravye parakīye mamatvam tāvac ca maitrī dravyabhāvaś ca tāvan naṣṭe hṛte ripavas te bhavanti
verses.translation: Therefore, best of Veda-knowers, it is not fitting to claim another's property as one's own; friendship lasts only as long as the property; when it is lost or stolen, they become enemies.

verses.sanskrit: चेद् अस्ति शक्तिर् द्रव्यदाने ततस् ते दातव्यम् एवार्थिने किं विचार्यम् नो चेत् सन्तः परकार्याणि कुर्युर् वाग्भिर् मनोभिः कृतिभिस् तथैव
verses.transliteration: ced asti śaktir dravyadāne tatas te dātavyam evārthine kiṃ vicāryam no cet santaḥ parakāryāṇi kuryur vāgbhir manobhiḥ kṛtibhis tathaiva
verses.translation: If one has the power to give wealth, it should simply be given to the one who asks — what is there to consider? Otherwise the good should do others' tasks by words, thoughts and deeds.

verses.transliteration: parasvasaṃdhāraṇam etad eva sadbhir nirastaṃ tyaja kānta sadyaḥ
verses.translation: Holding another's property is rejected by the good; give it up at once, beloved."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ priyāyā vacanaṃ sa vipro niśamya bhāryām idam āha subhrūm
verses.translation: Hearing his beloved's words, the brahmin said to his fair-browed wife:

verses.transliteration: purā surāṇām anumānya bhadre netīti vāṇī na sukhaṃ mamaiti
verses.translation: "Having formerly agreed with the gods, dear one, saying 'no' does not please me."

verses.transliteration: tā devavākyāc ca tathaiva cakruḥ saṃlihya cāsthīni daduḥ surāṇām surās tvarā jagmur adīnasattvāḥ svam ālayaṃ cāpi tathaiva gāvaḥ
verses.translation: At the gods' words they did so; licking the flesh away, they gave the bones to the gods; the gods of undaunted spirit went quickly to their abode, and so did the cows.

verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tathāstrāṇi ca devatānāṃ tvaṣṭā jagāmātha surājñayā tadā tataś cirāc chīlavatī subhadrā bhartuḥ priyā bālagarbhā tvarantī

verses.transliteration: kare gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ vāripūrṇam umāṃ natvā phalapuṣpaiḥ sametya agniṃ ca bhartāram athāśramaṃ ca saṃdraṣṭukāmā hy ājagāmātha śīghram
verses.translation: with a pitcher full of water in her hand, having bowed to Uma and come with fruits and flowers, wishing to see the fire, her husband and the hermitage, came back quickly.

verses.transliteration: āgacchantīṃ tāṃ prātitheyīṃ tadānīṃ nivārayām āsa tadolkapātaḥ sā saṃbhramād āgatā cāśramaṃ svaṃ naivāpaśyat tatra bhartāram agre
verses.translation: As Pratitheyi was coming, a falling meteor warned her; she came in agitation to her own hermitage and did not see her husband before her.

verses.transliteration: kva vā gataś ceti savismayā sā papraccha cāgniṃ prātitheyī tadānīm agnis tadovāca savistaraṃ tāṃ devāgamaṃ yācanaṃ vai śarīre
verses.translation: "Where has he gone?" In astonishment Pratitheyi asked the fire; then the fire told her in detail of the gods' coming and their request for his body,

verses.transliteration: asthnām upādānam atha prayāṇaṃ śrutvā sarvaṃ duḥkhitā sā babhūva duḥkhodvegāt sā papātātha pṛthvyāṃ mandaṃ mandaṃ vahnināśvāsitā ca
verses.translation: the taking of the bones and his departure; hearing all, she was grief-stricken, and from the shock of sorrow she fell to the ground, and was slowly comforted by the fire.

verses.transliteration: śāpe 'marāṇāṃ tu nāhaṃ samarthā agniṃ prāpsye kiṃ nu kāryaṃ bhaven me
verses.translation: "I am not able to curse the immortals; I will enter the fire; what else is there for me to do?"

verses.transliteration: kopaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca niyamya sādhvī tadāvādīd dharmayuktaṃ ca bhartuḥ
verses.translation: Restraining her anger and grief, the virtuous woman then spoke the righteous words of her husband:

verses.transliteration: utpadyate yat tu vināśi sarvaṃ na śocyam astīti manuṣyaloke govipradevārtham iha tyajanti prāṇān priyān puṇyabhājo manuṣyāḥ
verses.translation: "Whatever is born is perishable; in the human world there is nothing to grieve over. Meritorious people give up their dear lives here for the sake of cows, brahmins and gods.

verses.sanskrit: संसारचक्रे परिवर्तमाने देहं समर्थं धर्मयुक्तं त्व् अवाप्य प्रियान् प्राणान् देवविप्रार्थहेतोस् ते वै धन्याः प्राणिनो ये त्यजन्ति
verses.transliteration: saṃsāracakre parivartamāne dehaṃ samarthaṃ dharmayuktaṃ tv avāpya priyān prāṇān devaviprārthahetos te vai dhanyāḥ prāṇino ye tyajanti
verses.translation: As the wheel of worldly existence turns, having obtained a capable, righteous body, blessed are those living beings who give up their dear lives for the sake of gods and brahmins.

verses.transliteration: prāṇāḥ sarve 'syāpi dehānvitasya yātāro vai nātra saṃdehaleśaḥ evaṃ jñātvā vipragodevadīnādy arthaṃ cainān utsṛjantīśvarās te
verses.translation: All the life-breaths of anyone who has a body will depart; there is not the slightest doubt. Knowing this, the lordly ones give them up for the sake of brahmins, cows, gods, the poor and others.

verses.transliteration: nivāryamāṇo 'pi mayā prapannayā cakāra devāstraparigrahaṃ saḥ manogataṃ vetty athavā vidhātuḥ ko martyalokātigaceṣṭitasya
verses.translation: Though I, devoted to him, would have prevented him, he accepted the gods' weapons. Who knows the mind of the Creator, or of one whose deeds surpass the mortal world?"

verses.translation: having bowed to the Ganga, the earth, the hermitage, and the trees and plants of the hermitage, said:

verses.transliteration: pitrā hīno bandhubhir gotrajaiś ca mātrā hīno bālakaḥ sarva eva rakṣantu sarve 'pi ca bhūtasaṃghās tathauṣadhyo bālakaṃ lokapālāḥ
verses.translation: "This child is bereft of father, of kinsmen of his lineage, and of mother; let all the hosts of beings, the plants and the guardians of the worlds protect this child.

verses.transliteration: ye bālakaṃ mātṛpitṛprahīṇaṃ sanirviśeṣaṃ svatanuprarūḍhaiḥ paśyanti rakṣanti ta eva nūnaṃ brahmādikānām api vandanīyāḥ
verses.translation: Those who look upon and protect a child bereft of mother and father as no different from one grown from their own body are surely to be revered even by Brahma and the others."

verses.transliteration: ity uktvā cātyajad bālaṃ bhartṛcittaparāyaṇā pippalānāṃ samīpe tu nyasya bālaṃ namasya ca
verses.translation: Having said this, devoted to her husband's mind, she left the child; placing the child near the pippala trees and bowing,

verses.translation: circumambulating the fire, with the sacrificial vessels, Pratitheyi entered the fire and went to heaven with her husband.

verses.translation: Those dwelling in the hermitage and the forest trees wept — those who had been nourished like sons by the sage Dadhichi:

verses.translation: "Without him we will not live, nor without that mother." The deer, all the birds and the trees said to one another:

verses.transliteration: svargam āseduṣoḥ pitros tadapatyeṣv akṛtrimam ye kurvanty aniśaṃ snehaṃ ta eva kṛtino narāḥ
verses.translation: "Those who show unfailing, genuine love to the children of parents who have gone to heaven are indeed the accomplished ones.

verses.translation: As Dadhichi and Pratitheyi looked after us before, so neither father nor mother does now; shame on us, we are sinners.

verses.transliteration: asmākam api sarveṣām ataḥ prabhṛti niścitam bālo dadhīciḥ prātitheyī bālo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: From now on this is settled for all of us: the child is Dadhichi, the child is Pratitheyi, the child is eternal dharma."

verses.translation: Having said this, the plants together with the trees went to King Soma and asked for the excellent nectar.

verses.transliteration: sa cāpi dattavāṃs tebhyaḥ somo 'mṛtam anuttamam dadur bālāya te cāpi amṛtaṃ suravallabham
verses.translation: Soma gave them the unsurpassed nectar, and they gave the child the nectar dear to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन तृप्तो ववृधे शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी पिप्पलैः पालितो यस्मात् पिप्पलादः स बालकः प्रवृद्धः पिप्पलान् एवम् उवाच त्व् अतिविस्मितः
verses.transliteration: sa tena tṛpto vavṛdhe śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī pippalaiḥ pālito yasmāt pippalādaḥ sa bālakaḥ pravṛddhaḥ pippalān evam uvāca tv ativismitaḥ
verses.translation: Satisfied by it, he grew like the moon in the bright fortnight; since he was protected by the pippalas, the child was Pippalada. Grown up, he said to the pippalas, greatly astonished:

verses.sanskrit: मानुषेभ्यो मानुषास् तु जायन्ते पक्षिभिः खगाः बीजेभ्यो वीरुधो लोके वैषम्यं नैव दृश्यते वार्क्षस् त्व् अहं कथं जातो हस्तपादादिजीववान्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣebhyo mānuṣās tu jāyante pakṣibhiḥ khagāḥ bījebhyo vīrudho loke vaiṣamyaṃ naiva dṛśyate vārkṣas tv ahaṃ kathaṃ jāto hastapādādijīvavān
verses.translation: "Humans are born from humans, birds from birds, plants from seeds; no irregularity is seen in the world. How was I born of a tree, alive with hands, feet and so on?"

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षास् तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वम् ऊचुर् यथाक्रमम् दधीचेर् मरणं साध्व्यास् तथा चाग्निप्रवेशनम्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣās tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvam ūcur yathākramam dadhīcer maraṇaṃ sādhvyās tathā cāgnipraveśanam
verses.translation: The trees, hearing his words, told him everything in order: Dadhichi's death, the virtuous wife's entering the fire,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: asthnāṃ saṃharaṇaṃ devair etat sarvaṃ savistaram śrutvā duḥkhasamāviṣṭo nipapāta tadā bhuvi
verses.translation: the gods' taking of the bones — all this in detail. Hearing it, overcome with grief, he fell to the ground.

verses.transliteration: āśvāsitaḥ punar vṛkṣair vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ āśvastaḥ sa punaḥ prāha tadauṣadhivanaspatīn
verses.translation: Comforted again by the trees with words full of dharma and meaning, recovered, he spoke again to the plants and trees:

verses.sanskrit: पितृहन्तॄन् हनिष्ये ऽहं नान्यथा जीवितुं क्षमः पितुर् मित्राणि शत्रूंश् च तथा पुत्रो ऽनुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: pitṛhantṝn haniṣye 'haṃ nānyathā jīvituṃ kṣamaḥ pitur mitrāṇi śatrūṃś ca tathā putro 'nuvartate
verses.translation: "I will kill my father's killers; I cannot live otherwise. A son follows his father's friends and enemies alike.

verses.sanskrit: स एव पुत्रो यो ऽन्यस् तु पुत्ररूपो रिपुः स्मृतः वदन्ति पितृमित्राणि तारयन्त्य् अहितान् अपि
verses.transliteration: sa eva putro yo 'nyas tu putrarūpo ripuḥ smṛtaḥ vadanti pitṛmitrāṇi tārayanty ahitān api
verses.translation: He alone is a son; another is remembered as an enemy in a son's form. Friends of one's father, they say, save even the hostile."

verses.transliteration: vṛkṣās taṃ bālam ādāya somāntikam athāyayuḥ bālavākyaṃ tu te vṛkṣāḥ somāyātha nyavedayan śrutvā somo 'pi taṃ bālaṃ pippalādam abhāṣata
verses.translation: The trees took the child and went to Soma; the trees told Soma the child's words; hearing them, Soma spoke to the child Pippalada:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
