verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ vidhivat samagrāṃ tapaḥsamṛddhiṃ ca śubhāṃ ca vācam śauryaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca balaṃ ca buddhiṃ saṃprāpsyase putra madājñayā tvam
verses.translation: "Take all knowledge duly, the wealth of austerity and auspicious speech; you will obtain valour, beauty, strength and intellect, my son, by my command."

verses.transliteration: pippalādas tam apy āha oṣadhīśaṃ vinītavat
verses.translation: Pippalada humbly said to the lord of plants:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: sarvam etad vṛthā manye pitṛhantṛviniṣkṛtim na karomy atra yāvac ca tasmāt tat prathamaṃ vada
verses.translation: "I consider all this vain until I bring retribution on my father's killers; therefore tell me that first:

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् देशे यत्र काले यस्मिन् देवे च मन्त्रके यत्र तीर्थे च सिध्येत मत्संकल्पः सुरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yasmin deśe yatra kāle yasmin deve ca mantrake yatra tīrthe ca sidhyeta matsaṃkalpaḥ surottama
verses.translation: in what land, at what time, with what deity and mantra, at what holy place my resolve may be accomplished, O best of gods."

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रः प्राह चिरं ध्यात्वा भुक्तिर् वा मुक्तिर् एव वा सर्वं महेश्वराद् देवाज् जायते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: candraḥ prāha ciraṃ dhyātvā bhuktir vā muktir eva vā sarvaṃ maheśvarād devāj jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Moon, after meditating long, said: "Whether enjoyment or liberation, all comes from the god Maheshvara; there is no doubt."

verses.sanskrit: स सोमं पुनर् अप्य् आह कथं द्रक्ष्ये महेश्वरम् बालो ऽहं बालबुद्धिश् च न सामर्थ्यं तपस् तथा
verses.transliteration: sa somaṃ punar apy āha kathaṃ drakṣye maheśvaram bālo 'haṃ bālabuddhiś ca na sāmarthyaṃ tapas tathā
verses.translation: He said to Soma again: "How shall I see Maheshvara? I am a child with a child's mind; I have no power or austerity."

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं गच्छ भद्र त्वं स्तुहि चक्रेश्वरं हरम् प्रसन्नस् तु तवेशानो ह्य् अल्पायासेन वत्सक
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ gaccha bhadra tvaṃ stuhi cakreśvaraṃ haram prasannas tu taveśāno hy alpāyāsena vatsaka
verses.translation: "Go to the Gautami, dear one, and praise Hara, lord of the discus; the Lord will be pleased with you with little effort, my child.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो भवेन् महादेवः साक्षात् कारुणिकः शिवः आस्ते साक्षात्कृतः शंभुर् विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना
verses.transliteration: prīto bhaven mahādevaḥ sākṣāt kāruṇikaḥ śivaḥ āste sākṣātkṛtaḥ śaṃbhur viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
verses.translation: Mahadeva, compassionate Shiva himself, will be pleased; Shambhu stays there, seen face to face by the mighty Vishnu,

verses.sanskrit: वरं च दत्तवान् विष्णोश् चक्रं च त्रिदशार्चितम् गच्छ तत्र महाबुद्धे दण्डके गौतमीं नदीम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ ca dattavān viṣṇoś cakraṃ ca tridaśārcitam gaccha tatra mahābuddhe daṇḍake gautamīṃ nadīm
verses.translation: and he gave Vishnu a boon and the discus worshipped by the gods. Go there, wise one, to the river Gautami in Dandaka.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रेश्वरं नाम तीर्थं जानन्त्य् ओषधयस् तु तत् तं गत्वा स्तुहि देवेशं सर्वभावेन शंकरम् स ते प्रीतमनास् तात सर्वान् कामान् प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: cakreśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ jānanty oṣadhayas tu tat taṃ gatvā stuhi deveśaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṃkaram sa te prītamanās tāta sarvān kāmān pradāsyati
verses.translation: The plants know the holy place called Chakreshvara; go there and praise Shankara, lord of the gods, with all your heart; pleased with you, my child, he will grant all your desires."

verses.transliteration: tad rājavacanād brahman pippalādo mahāmuniḥ ājagāma jagannātho yatra rudraḥ sa cakradaḥ
verses.translation: At the king's words, O Brahman, the great sage Pippalada came to where Rudra, lord of the world, the giver of the discus, was.

verses.sanskrit: तं बालं कृपयाविष्टाः पिप्पलाः स्वाश्रमान् ययुः गोदावर्यां ततः स्नात्वा नत्वा त्रिभुवनेश्वरम् तुष्टाव सर्वभावेन पिप्पलादः शिवं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ bālaṃ kṛpayāviṣṭāḥ pippalāḥ svāśramān yayuḥ godāvaryāṃ tataḥ snātvā natvā tribhuvaneśvaram tuṣṭāva sarvabhāvena pippalādaḥ śivaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: The pippalas, full of compassion for the child, went to their own hermitages. Then, having bathed in the Godavari and bowed to the lord of the three worlds, the pure Pippalada praised Shiva with all his heart:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाणि कर्माणि विहाय धीरास् त्यक्तैषणा निर्जितचित्तवाताः यं यान्ति मुक्त्यै शरणं प्रयत्नात् तम् आदिदेवं प्रणमामि शंभुम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāṇi karmāṇi vihāya dhīrās tyaktaiṣaṇā nirjitacittavātāḥ yaṃ yānti muktyai śaraṇaṃ prayatnāt tam ādidevaṃ praṇamāmi śaṃbhum
verses.translation: "I bow to Shambhu, the primal god, to whom the steadfast, abandoning all actions and desires, having conquered the winds of the mind, go with effort for refuge to obtain liberation.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वसाक्षी सकलान्तरात्मा सर्वेश्वरः सर्वकलानिधानम् विज्ञाय मच्चित्तगतं समस्तं स मे स्मरारिः करुणां करोतु
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvasākṣī sakalāntarātmā sarveśvaraḥ sarvakalānidhānam vijñāya maccittagataṃ samastaṃ sa me smarāriḥ karuṇāṃ karotu
verses.translation: May he who is witness of all, the inner self of all, lord of all, treasury of all arts, knowing all that is in my mind, the enemy of Love, show me compassion.

verses.transliteration: digīśvarāñ jitya surārcitasya kailāsam āndolayataḥ purāreḥ aṅguṣṭhakṛtyaiva rasātalād adho gatasya tasyaiva daśānanasya
verses.translation: When the ten-headed one, having conquered the lords of the quarters, shook Kailasa of the enemy of the cities worshipped by the gods, he was sent down below Rasatala merely by the pressure of his toe;

verses.sanskrit: आलूनकायस्य गिरं निशम्य विहस्य देव्या सह दत्तम् इष्टम् तस्मै प्रसन्नः कुपितो ऽपि तद्वद् अयुक्तदातासि महेश्वर त्वम्
verses.transliteration: ālūnakāyasya giraṃ niśamya vihasya devyā saha dattam iṣṭam tasmai prasannaḥ kupito 'pi tadvad ayuktadātāsi maheśvara tvam
verses.translation: hearing the words of that one whose body was crushed, you laughed with the Goddess and gave him what he wished; pleased, and even when angry, you are thus a giver even to the unworthy, O Maheshvara.

verses.sanskrit: सौत्रामणीम् ऋद्धिम् अधः स चक्रे यो ऽर्चां हरौ नित्यम् अतीव कृत्वा बाणः प्रशस्यः कृतवान् उच्चपूजां रम्यां मनोज्ञां शशिखण्डमौलेः
verses.transliteration: sautrāmaṇīm ṛddhim adhaḥ sa cakre yo 'rcāṃ harau nityam atīva kṛtvā bāṇaḥ praśasyaḥ kṛtavān uccapūjāṃ ramyāṃ manojñāṃ śaśikhaṇḍamauleḥ
verses.translation: He who always worshipped Hara exceedingly obtained the prosperity of the Sautramani; Bana, praiseworthy, performed a lofty, delightful and charming worship of the one crowned with the crescent moon.

verses.sanskrit: जित्वा रिपून् देवगणान् प्रपूज्य गुरुं नमस्कर्तुम् अगाद् विशाखः चुकोप दृष्ट्वा गणनाथम् ऊढम् अङ्के तम् आरोप्य जहास सोमः
verses.transliteration: jitvā ripūn devagaṇān prapūjya guruṃ namaskartum agād viśākhaḥ cukopa dṛṣṭvā gaṇanātham ūḍham aṅke tam āropya jahāsa somaḥ
verses.translation: Having conquered his enemies and honoured the hosts of gods, Vishakha went to bow to his father; he became angry seeing the lord of the Ganas carried on his lap, and Soma, placing him on his lap, laughed.

verses.sanskrit: ईशाङ्करूढो ऽपि शिशुस्वभावान् न मातुर् अङ्कं प्रमुमोच बालः क्रुद्धं सुतं बोधितुम् अप्य् अशक्तस् ततो ऽर्धनारित्वम् अवाप सोमः
verses.transliteration: īśāṅkarūḍho 'pi śiśusvabhāvān na mātur aṅkaṃ pramumoca bālaḥ kruddhaṃ sutaṃ bodhitum apy aśaktas tato 'rdhanāritvam avāpa somaḥ
verses.translation: Though seated on the Lord's lap, the child by a child's nature did not leave his mother's lap; unable to pacify his angry son, Soma then took the half-woman form."

verses.transliteration: tataḥ svayaṃbhūḥ suprītaḥ pippalādam abhāṣata
verses.translation: Then the Self-born, well pleased, said to Pippalada:

verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te pippalāda yathepsitam
verses.translation: "Choose a boon as you wish, Pippalada; blessings on you."

verses.transliteration: hato devair mahādeva pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ adāmbhikaḥ satyavādī tathā mātā pativratā
verses.translation: "O Mahadeva, my illustrious father was slain by the gods — without pretence and truthful — and likewise my mother, faithful to her husband.

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यश् च तयोर् नाशं श्रुत्वा नाथ सविस्तरम् दुःखकोपसमाविष्टो नाहं जीवितुम् उत्सहे
verses.transliteration: devebhyaś ca tayor nāśaṃ śrutvā nātha savistaram duḥkhakopasamāviṣṭo nāhaṃ jīvitum utsahe
verses.translation: Having heard in detail of their death at the hands of the gods, Lord, overcome with grief and anger, I cannot bear to live.

verses.transliteration: tasmān me dehi sāmarthyaṃ nāśayeyaṃ surān yathā avadhyasevyas trailokye tvam eva śaśiśekhara
verses.translation: Therefore give me the power to destroy the gods; you alone in the three worlds are to be served and cannot be slain, O moon-crested one."

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं नयनं द्रष्टुं यदि शक्नोषि मे ऽनघ ततः समर्थो भविता देवांश् छेदयितुं भवान्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ nayanaṃ draṣṭuṃ yadi śaknoṣi me 'nagha tataḥ samartho bhavitā devāṃś chedayituṃ bhavān
verses.translation: "If you are able to look at my third eye, sinless one, then you will be able to cut down the gods."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रष्टुं मनश् चक्रे तृतीयं लोचनं विभोः न शशाक तदोवाच न शक्तो ऽस्मीति शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: tato draṣṭuṃ manaś cakre tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ vibhoḥ na śaśāka tadovāca na śakto 'smīti śaṃkaram
verses.translation: Then he set his mind to looking at the Lord's third eye; he could not, and then said to Shankara, "I am not able."

verses.translation: Men devoted to harming others, forgetting their own good, their minds wandering here and there, fall into the pit of hell."

verses.translation: Hearing these words of his mothers, Pippalada became angry; when pride burns within, good counsel is useless.

verses.translation: The lord of the world said to them: "The Kritya does not harm those who dwell within a yojana; therefore, immortals, stay here day and night, and you will have no fear of her."

verses.translation: let that Sun alone always stay here in visible form; all of you will abide in his form."

verses.translation: "Stay right here, lord of the world, and protect these gods yourself; we too will stay here with our portions near Shambhu."

verses.transliteration: aṅgulyardhārdhamātraṃ tu gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritāḥ tisraḥ koṭyas tathā pañca śatāni munisattama tīrthānāṃ tatra vyuṣṭiṃ ca kaḥ śṛṇoti bravīti vā

verses.transliteration: nāśiteṣv api deveṣu pitā te nāgamiṣyati dattāḥ pitrā tava prāṇā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye

verses.transliteration: dīnārtakaruṇābandhuḥ ko hi tādṛgbhave bhavet tathā yātā divaṃ tāta tava mātā pativratā
verses.translation: Who in existence could be such a kinsman of compassion to the wretched and distressed? Likewise your mother, faithful to her husband, has gone to heaven, my child.

verses.transliteration: samā kāpy atra matayā lopāmudrāpy arundhatī yad asthibhiḥ surāḥ sarve jayinaḥ sukhinaḥ sadā
verses.translation: In my view neither Lopamudra nor Arundhati equals her. By his bones all the gods are ever victorious and happy;

verses.transliteration: tenāvāptaṃ yaśaḥ sphītaṃ tava mātrākṣayaṃ kṛtam tvayā putreṇa sarvatra nātaḥ parataraṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: he has gained abundant fame, and your mother has made it imperishable; by you, their son, it has been done everywhere — nothing higher has been done.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्प्रतापभयात् स्वर्गाच् च्युतांस् त्वं पातुम् अर्हसि कांदिशीकांस् तव भयाद् अमरांस् त्रातुम् अर्हसि नार्तत्राणाद् अभ्यधिकं सुकृतं क्वापि विद्यते
verses.transliteration: tvatpratāpabhayāt svargāc cyutāṃs tvaṃ pātum arhasi kāṃdiśīkāṃs tava bhayād amarāṃs trātum arhasi nārtatrāṇād abhyadhikaṃ sukṛtaṃ kvāpi vidyate
verses.translation: You should protect those fallen from heaven in fear of your might; you should save the immortals who are bewildered by fear of you. There is no merit anywhere greater than saving the distressed.

verses.sanskrit: यावद् यशः स्फुरति चारु मनुष्यलोके अहानि तावन्ति दिवं गतस्य दिने दिने वर्षसंख्या परस्मिंल् लोके वासो जायते निर्विकारः
verses.transliteration: yāvad yaśaḥ sphurati cāru manuṣyaloke ahāni tāvanti divaṃ gatasya dine dine varṣasaṃkhyā parasmiṃl loke vāso jāyate nirvikāraḥ
verses.translation: As long as one's fame shines beautifully in the human world, for so many days one who has gone to heaven dwells in the other world unchanged, each day counting as years.

verses.sanskrit: मृतास् त एवात्र यशो न येषाम् अन्धास् त एव श्रुतवर्जिता ये ये दानशीला न नपुंसकास् ते ये धर्मशीला न त एव शोच्याः
verses.transliteration: mṛtās ta evātra yaśo na yeṣām andhās ta eva śrutavarjitā ye ye dānaśīlā na napuṃsakās te ye dharmaśīlā na ta eva śocyāḥ
verses.translation: They alone are dead here who have no fame; they alone are blind who lack learning; those given to generosity are not eunuchs; those given to dharma are not to be pitied."

verses.transliteration: bhāṣitaṃ devadevasya śrutvā śānto 'bhavan muniḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā natvā nātham athābravīt
verses.translation: Hearing the words of the god of gods, the sage became calm; with joined palms, bowing to the Lord, he said:

verses.transliteration: vāgbhir manobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye tebhyo hitārthaṃ tv iha cāpareṣāṃ somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam
verses.translation: "To those who, devoted to my good, sometimes help me by words, thoughts and deeds — for their good and for others here, I bow to Soma, worshipped by the gods and others.

verses.sanskrit: संरक्षितो यैर् अभिवर्धितश् च समानगोत्रश् च समानधर्मा तेषाम् अभीष्टानि शिवः करोतु बालेन्दुमौलिं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: saṃrakṣito yair abhivardhitaś ca samānagotraś ca samānadharmā teṣām abhīṣṭāni śivaḥ karotu bālendumauliṃ praṇato 'smi nityam
verses.translation: May Shiva fulfil the wishes of those by whom I was protected and raised, of the same lineage and the same dharma; I ever bow to the one crowned with the young moon.

verses.sanskrit: यैर् अहं वर्धितो नित्यं मातृवत् पितृवत् प्रभो तन्नाम्ना जायतां तीर्थं देवदेव जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: yair ahaṃ vardhito nityaṃ mātṛvat pitṛvat prabho tannāmnā jāyatāṃ tīrthaṃ devadeva jagattraye
verses.translation: Those by whom I was always raised like a mother and father, O Lord — let a holy place arise in the three worlds by their name, O god of gods.

verses.transliteration: yaśas tu teṣāṃ bhavitā tebhyo 'ham anṛṇas tataḥ yāni kṣetrāṇi devānāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūtale
verses.translation: Then their fame will arise and I will be free of debt to them. Whatever regions of the gods and holy places there are on earth,

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो यद् इदम् अधिकम् अनुमन्यन्तु देवताः ततः क्षमे ऽहं देवानाम् अपराधं निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo yad idam adhikam anumanyantu devatāḥ tataḥ kṣame 'haṃ devānām aparādhaṃ nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: let the deities agree that this is greater than them; then I, stainless, will forgive the gods' offence."

verses.transliteration: tataḥ samakṣaṃ surasākṣarāṃ giraṃ sahasracakṣuḥpramukhāṃs tathāgrataḥ uvāca devā api menire vaco dadhīciputroditam ādareṇa
verses.translation: Then, in the presence of the gods, he spoke words heard by the gods before the thousand-eyed and the rest; the gods too accepted with respect the words spoken by the son of Dadhichi.

verses.transliteration: bālasya buddhiṃ vinayaṃ ca vidyāṃ śauryaṃ balaṃ sāhasaṃ satyavācam pitror bhaktiṃ bhāvaśuddhiṃ viditvā tadāvādīc chaṃkaraḥ pippalādam
verses.translation: Knowing the child's intellect, humility, learning, valour, strength, daring, truthful speech, devotion to his parents and purity of feeling, Shankara then spoke to Pippalada:

verses.sanskrit: वत्स यद् वै प्रियं कामं यच् चापि सुरवल्लभम् प्राप्स्यसे वद कल्याणं नान्यथा त्वं मनः कृथाः
verses.transliteration: vatsa yad vai priyaṃ kāmaṃ yac cāpi suravallabham prāpsyase vada kalyāṇaṃ nānyathā tvaṃ manaḥ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: "Child, whatever dear desire you have, even what is dear to the gods, you will obtain; speak what is auspicious and set your mind on nothing else."

verses.sanskrit: ये गङ्गायाम् आप्लुता धर्मनिष्ठाः संपश्यन्ति त्वत्पदाब्जं महेश सर्वान् कामान् आप्नुवन्तु प्रसह्य देहान्ते ते पदम् आयान्तु शैवम्
verses.transliteration: ye gaṅgāyām āplutā dharmaniṣṭhāḥ saṃpaśyanti tvatpadābjaṃ maheśa sarvān kāmān āpnuvantu prasahya dehānte te padam āyāntu śaivam
verses.translation: "May those steadfast in dharma who bathe in the Ganga and behold your lotus feet, O great Lord, obtain all desires fully, and at the end of their bodies come to Shiva's state.

verses.sanskrit: तातः प्राप्तस् त्वत्पदं चाम्बिका मे नाथ प्राप्ता पिप्पलश् चामराश् च सुखं प्राप्ता नाथनाथं विलोक्य त्वां पश्येयुस् त्वत्पदं ते प्रयान्तु
verses.transliteration: tātaḥ prāptas tvatpadaṃ cāmbikā me nātha prāptā pippalaś cāmarāś ca sukhaṃ prāptā nāthanāthaṃ vilokya tvāṃ paśyeyus tvatpadaṃ te prayāntu
verses.translation: My father has reached your state, and my mother, Lord; the pippalas and the immortals have found happiness seeing you, lord of lords; may they see you and go to your state."

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा पिप्पलादं देवदेवो महेश्वरः अभिनन्द्य च तं देवैः सार्धं वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā pippalādaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ abhinandya ca taṃ devaiḥ sārdhaṃ vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: Saying "So be it" to Pippalada, the god of gods Maheshvara, welcoming him, spoke together with the gods.

verses.transliteration: devā api mudā yuktā nirbhayās tatkṛtād bhayāt idam ūcuḥ sarva eva dādhīcaṃ śivasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: The gods too, joyful and freed from the fear he had caused, all said this to the son of Dadhichi in Shiva's presence:

verses.transliteration: surāṇāṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ ca tvayā kṛtam asaṃśayam pālitā devadevasya ājñā trailokyamaṇḍanī
verses.translation: "What the gods wished has surely been done by you; the command of the god of gods, the ornament of the three worlds, has been kept.

verses.transliteration: yācitaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ parārthaṃ nātmane dvija tasmād anyatamaṃ brūhi kiṃcid dāsyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: You asked before for others and not for yourself, O brahmin; therefore name something else and we will give it."

verses.transliteration: punaḥ punas tad evocuḥ surasaṃghā dvijottamam kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ pūrvaṃ natvā śaṃbhusurān idam uvāca pippalādaś ca umāṃ natvā ca pippalān
verses.translation: The hosts of gods said this again and again to the best of brahmins; Pippalada, with joined palms, first bowing to Shambhu and the gods, to Uma and the pippalas, said:

verses.transliteration: pitarau draṣṭukāmo 'smi sadā me śabdagocarau te dhanyāḥ prāṇino loke mātāpitror vaśe sthitāḥ
verses.translation: "I wish to see my parents, who have always been only words to me. Blessed are those living beings in the world who remain under the care of mother and father,

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषणपरा नित्यं तत्पादाज्ञाप्रतीक्षकाः इन्द्रियाणि शरीरं च कुलं शक्तिं धियं वपुः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ tatpādājñāpratīkṣakāḥ indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca kulaṃ śaktiṃ dhiyaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: ever devoted to serving them, awaiting the command of their feet; having obtained senses, body, family, strength, intellect and form,

verses.translation: one becomes fulfilled in their service. For beasts and birds too the sight of a mother is easy;

verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ mama tac cāpi pṛcche pāpaphalaṃ nu kim durlabhaṃ ca tathā cet syāt sarveṣāṃ yasya kasyacit
verses.translation: it is hard for me — what is the fruit of this sin, I ask? If it were hard for all and everyone,

verses.transliteration: nopapadyeta sulabhaṃ matto nānyo 'sti pāpakṛt tayor darśanamātraṃ ca yadi prāpsye surottamāḥ
verses.translation: it would not be easy; there is no other sinner than me. If I obtain merely the sight of them, O best of gods,

verses.transliteration: manovākkāyakarmabhyaḥ phalaṃ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati pitarau ye na paśyanti samutpannā na saṃsṛtau teṣāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ kaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartum īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: the fruit of deeds of mind, speech and body will be obtained. Those who do not see their parents are not born into existence; who can count their great sins?"

verses.translation: longing to see you, your parents, the auspicious couple, fanned by the women of the gods and praised by Kinnaras.

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sa mātāpitarau nanāma śivasaṃnidhau harṣabāṣpāśrunayanau sa kathaṃcid uvāca tau
verses.translation: Seeing his mother and father, he bowed in Shiva's presence; his eyes full of tears of joy, he somehow said to them:

verses.sanskrit: तारयन्त्य् एव पितराव् अन्ये पुत्राः कुलोद्वहाः अहं तु मातुर् उदरे केवलं भेदकारणम् एवंभूतो ऽपि तौ मोहात् पश्येयम् अतिदुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: tārayanty eva pitarāv anye putrāḥ kulodvahāḥ ahaṃ tu mātur udare kevalaṃ bhedakāraṇam evaṃbhūto 'pi tau mohāt paśyeyam atidurmatiḥ
verses.translation: "Other sons, upholders of their families, save their parents; but I was merely the cause of splitting my mother's womb; even so, out of delusion, I, most wicked, wished to see them."

verses.transliteration: tāv ālokya tato duḥkhād vaktuṃ naiva śaśāka saḥ devāś ca mātāpitarau pippalādam athābruvan
verses.translation: Looking at them, he could not speak for sorrow; the gods and the mother and father said to Pippalada:

verses.transliteration: bhavatām icchayā sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ me surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: "By your wish, O best of gods, everything is to be my food."

verses.sanskrit: वडवा सा नदी जाता गङ्गया संगता मुने तद्भवस् तु महान् अग्निर् य आसीद् अतिभीषणः तम् आहुर् अमरा वह्निं भूतानाम् आदितो विदुः
verses.transliteration: vaḍavā sā nadī jātā gaṅgayā saṃgatā mune tadbhavas tu mahān agnir ya āsīd atibhīṣaṇaḥ tam āhur amarā vahniṃ bhūtānām ādito viduḥ

verses.transliteration: āpo jyeṣṭhatamā jñeyās tathaiva prathamaṃ bhavān tatrāpy apāṃpatiṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ samudram aśanaṃ kuru yathaiva tu vayaṃ brūmo gaccha bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham
verses.translation: "The waters should be known as the eldest, and you likewise as the first; among them make the eldest, the lord of waters, the ocean, your food; go as we say and eat as you please."

verses.sanskrit: अनलस् त्व् अमरान् आह आपस् तत्र कथं त्व् अहम् व्रजेयं यदि मां तत्र प्रापयन्त्य् उदकं महत्
verses.transliteration: analas tv amarān āha āpas tatra kathaṃ tv aham vrajeyaṃ yadi māṃ tatra prāpayanty udakaṃ mahat
verses.translation: The fire said to the immortals, "How can I go there to the waters, unless someone takes me there to that great water?"

verses.sanskrit: भवन्त एव ते ऽप्य् आहुः कथं ते ऽग्ने गतिर् भवेत् अग्निर् अप्य् आह तान् देवान् कन्या मां गुणशालिनी

verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakalaśe sthāpya nayed yatra gatir mama tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kanyām ūcuḥ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: placing me in a golden pitcher, should carry me to where my course lies." Hearing his words, they said to the maiden Sarasvati:

verses.translation: "Carry this fire quickly on your head to the abode of Varuna."

verses.translation: Sarasvati said to the gods, "I alone cannot bear it; together with four others I could quickly carry it to the abode of Varuna."

verses.transliteration: sarasvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā narmadāṃ tapatīṃ caiva surāḥ procuḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Hearing Sarasvati's words, the gods spoke separately to the Ganga, the Yamuna, the Narmada and the Tapati.

verses.translation: to where the lord of gods, Somanatha, lord of the world, adorned with the moon, dwells at Prabhasa with the gods.

verses.transliteration: prāpayām āsur analaṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatī adhyāste ca mahān agniḥ piban vāri śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: The five rivers with Sarasvati brought the fire there, and the great fire dwells there, drinking the water slowly.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve śivam ūcuḥ surottamam
verses.translation: Then all the hosts of gods said to Shiva, best of gods:

verses.transliteration: asthnāṃ ca pāvanaṃ brūhi asmākaṃ ca gavāṃ tathā
verses.translation: "Tell us the purification for the bones, for us and for the cows."

verses.sanskrit: शिवः प्राह तदा सर्वान् गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य यत्नतः देवाश् च गावस् तत्पापान् मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ prāha tadā sarvān gaṅgām āplutya yatnataḥ devāś ca gāvas tatpāpān mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Shiva then said to all, "By carefully bathing in the Ganga, the gods and cows are freed from that sin; there is no doubt."

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षालितानि चास्थीनि ऋषिदेहभवान्य् अथ तानि प्रक्षालनाद् एव तत्र प्राप्तानि पूतताम्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālitāni cāsthīni ṛṣidehabhavāny atha tāni prakṣālanād eva tatra prāptāni pūtatām
verses.translation: And the bones from the sage's body were washed; by that very washing they attained purity there.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवा मुक्तपापास् तत् तीर्थं पापनाशनम् तत्र स्नानं च दानं च ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra devā muktapāpās tat tīrthaṃ pāpanāśanam tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca brahmahatyāvināśanam
verses.translation: Where the gods were freed from sin, that holy place is Papanashana; bathing and giving there destroy the sin of brahmin-slaying.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गवां च पावनं यत्र गोतीर्थं तद् उदाहृतम् तत्र स्नानान् महाबुद्धिर् गोमेधफलम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ ca pāvanaṃ yatra gotīrthaṃ tad udāhṛtam tatra snānān mahābuddhir gomedhaphalam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Where the cows were purified is called Gotirtha; by bathing there the wise one obtains the fruit of a cow sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तद्ब्राह्मणास्थीनि आसन् पुण्यानि नारद पितृतीर्थं तु वै ज्ञेयं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra tadbrāhmaṇāsthīni āsan puṇyāni nārada pitṛtīrthaṃ tu vai jñeyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: Where the holy bones of that brahmin were, O Narada, should be known as Pitritirtha, increasing the pleasure of the ancestors.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मास्थिनखरोमाणि प्राणिनो यस्य कस्यचित् तत्र तीर्थे संक्रमेरन् यावच् चन्द्रार्कतारकम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmāsthinakharomāṇi prāṇino yasya kasyacit tatra tīrthe saṃkrameran yāvac candrārkatārakam
verses.translation: If ashes, bones, nails or hair of any living being pass into that holy place, as long as moon, sun and stars endure,

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गे वासो भवेत् तस्य अपि दुष्कृतकर्मणः तथा चक्रेश्वरात् तीर्थात् त्रीणि तीर्थानि नारद ततः पूताः सुरगणा गावः शंभुम् अथाब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: svarge vāso bhavet tasya api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ tathā cakreśvarāt tīrthāt trīṇi tīrthāni nārada tataḥ pūtāḥ suragaṇā gāvaḥ śaṃbhum athābruvan
verses.translation: he dwells in heaven, even if he did evil deeds. So from the Chakreshvara holy place there are three holy places, O Narada. Then the hosts of gods and the cows, purified, said to Shambhu:

verses.sanskrit: यामः स्वं स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् अत्र सूर्यः प्रतिष्ठितः अस्मिन् स्थिते दिनकरे सुराः सर्वे प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: yāmaḥ svaṃ svam adhiṣṭhānam atra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ asmin sthite dinakare surāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: "We go each to our own abode; the Sun is established here. While the sun stays here, all the gods are established.

verses.sanskrit: भवेयुर् जगताम् ईश तद् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि सूर्यो ह्य् आत्मास्य जगतस् तस्थुषश् च सनातनः
verses.transliteration: bhaveyur jagatām īśa tad anujñātum arhasi sūryo hy ātmāsya jagatas tasthuṣaś ca sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of the worlds, please grant permission. The Sun is the eternal self of this world, moving and unmoving.

verses.transliteration: divākaro devamayas tatrāsmābhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ yatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī yatra vai tryambakaḥ svayam suravāsaṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhaved yatra ca tryambakam
verses.translation: The Sun, full of the gods, has been established here by us, where the Ganga, sustainer of the world, is and where Tryambaka himself is; the dwelling of the gods would be Pratishthana, where Tryambaka is."

verses.transliteration: āpṛcchya pippalādaṃ taṃ surāḥ svaṃ sadanaṃ yayuḥ pippalāḥ kālaparyāye svargaṃ jagmur athākṣayam
verses.translation: Taking leave of Pippalada, the gods went to their own abodes; the pippalas in course of time went to imperishable heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पादपानां पदं विप्रः पिप्पलादः प्रतापवान् क्षेत्राधिपत्ये संस्थाप्य पूजयाम् आस शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: pādapānāṃ padaṃ vipraḥ pippalādaḥ pratāpavān kṣetrādhipatye saṃsthāpya pūjayām āsa śaṃkaram
verses.translation: The mighty brahmin Pippalada, establishing the place of the trees in lordship of the region, worshipped Shankara.

verses.sanskrit: दधीचिसूनुर् मुनिर् उग्रतेजा अवाप्य भार्यां गौतमस्यात्मजां च पुत्रान् अथावाप्य श्रियं यशश् च सुहृज्जनैः स्वर्गम् अवाप धीरः
verses.transliteration: dadhīcisūnur munir ugratejā avāpya bhāryāṃ gautamasyātmajāṃ ca putrān athāvāpya śriyaṃ yaśaś ca suhṛjjanaiḥ svargam avāpa dhīraḥ
verses.translation: The sage of fierce splendour, son of Dadhichi, having obtained a wife, the daughter of Gautama, and sons, fortune and fame, the steadfast one attained heaven with his friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पिप्पलेश्वरम् उच्यते सर्वक्रतुफलं पुण्यं स्मरणाद् अघनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ pippaleśvaram ucyate sarvakratuphalaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇād aghanāśanam
verses.translation: From then on that holy place is called Pippaleshvara, holy, bringing the fruit of all sacrifices, destroying sin by remembrance —

verses.sanskrit: किं पुनः स्नानदानाभ्याम् आदित्यस्य तु दर्शनात् चक्रेश्वरः पिप्पलेशो देवदेवस्य नामनी
verses.transliteration: kiṃ punaḥ snānadānābhyām ādityasya tu darśanāt cakreśvaraḥ pippaleśo devadevasya nāmanī
verses.translation: how much more by bathing and giving and by seeing the Sun! Chakreshvara and Pippalesha are the names of the god of gods;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सरहस्यं विदित्वा तु सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात् सूर्यस्य च प्रतिष्ठानात् सुरवासे प्रतिष्ठिते प्रतिष्ठानं तु तत् क्षेत्रं सुराणाम् अपि वल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: sarahasyaṃ viditvā tu sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt sūryasya ca pratiṣṭhānāt suravāse pratiṣṭhite pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ surāṇām api vallabham
verses.translation: knowing this with its secret one obtains all desires. Since the Sun was established where the gods dwell, that region is Pratishthana, dear even to the gods.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इतीदम् आख्यानम् अतीव पुण्यं पठेत वा यः शृणुयात् स्मरेद् वा स दीर्घजीवी धनवान् धर्मयुक्तश् चान्ते स्मरञ् शंभुम् उपैति नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: itīdam ākhyānam atīva puṇyaṃ paṭheta vā yaḥ śṛṇuyāt smared vā sa dīrghajīvī dhanavān dharmayuktaś cānte smarañ śaṃbhum upaiti nityam
verses.translation: Whoever reads, hears or remembers this very holy account becomes long-lived, wealthy and righteous, and at the end, remembering Shambhu, reaches him forever.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नागतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् यत्र नागेश्वरो देवः शृणु तस्यापि विस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: nāgatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham yatra nāgeśvaro devaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi vistaram
verses.translation: O lord, you have addressed us on the course of adharma. now let us know about the course of dharma too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठानपुरे राजा शूरसेन इति श्रुतः सोमवंशभवः श्रीमान् मतिमान् गुणसागरः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhānapure rājā śūrasena iti śrutaḥ somavaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān matimān guṇasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: Having done sinful deeds, how do people meet with disaster? By what righteous activities do the people attain prosperity?
verses.commentary: Sense: Having done sinful deeds, how do people meet with disaster? By what righteous activities do the people attain prosperity?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं स महायत्नम् अकरोत् प्रियया सह तस्य पुत्रश् चिराद् आसीत् सर्पो वै भीषणाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ sa mahāyatnam akarot priyayā saha tasya putraś cirād āsīt sarpo vai bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Having performed evil actions, having come under the control of adharma, with his mind averse to dharma, man goes
verses.commentary: Sense: Having performed evil actions, having come under the control of adharma, with his mind averse to dharma, man goes
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं तं गोपयाम् आस शूरसेनो महीपतिः राज्ञः पुत्रः सर्प इति न कश्चिद् विन्दते जनः
verses.transliteration: putraṃ taṃ gopayām āsa śūraseno mahīpatiḥ rājñaḥ putraḥ sarpa iti na kaścid vindate janaḥ
verses.translation: He who out of ignorance performs acts of impiety but repents afterwards with his mind concentrated on his self never comes to grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who out of ignorance performs acts of impiety but repents afterwards with his mind concentrated on his self never comes to grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्वर्ती परो वापि मातरं पितरं विना धात्रेय्य् अपि न जानाति नामात्यो न पुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: antarvartī paro vāpi mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vinā dhātreyy api na jānāti nāmātyo na purohitaḥ
verses.translation: Inasmuch as his mind dislikes performing evil deeds, in the same proportion is his body released from the control o adharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inasmuch as his mind dislikes performing evil deeds, in the same proportion is his body released from the control o adharma.

verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ sabhāryo nṛpasattamaḥ saṃtāpaṃ nityam āpnoti sarpād varam aputratā
verses.translation: Thus the food not attained by unlawful activities should be gifted. He should, first of all, pour offerings of food into the fire with the formula Pranaya Svaha and then eat food.

verses.transliteration: etad asti mahāsarpo vakti nityaṃ manuṣyavat sa sarpaḥ pitaraṃ prāha kuru cūḍām api kriyām
verses.translation: He attains the fulfilment of all desires and then after death he gets happiness. Thus performing good actions and devoid of fever he enjoys life. He is blessed with beauty, fame and wealth.

verses.transliteration: tathopanayanaṃ cāpi vedādhyayanam eva ca yāvad vedaṃ na cādhīte tāvac chūdrasamo dvijaḥ
verses.translation: "Likewise the investiture with the sacred thread and the study of the Veda; until a twice-born studies the Veda, he is like a shudra."

verses.translation: Hearing these words of his son, Shurasena was greatly grieved; bringing some brahmin, he had the rites and the rest performed; the serpent, having studied the Veda, said to his father:

verses.sanskrit: विवाहं कुरु मे राजन् स्त्रीकामो ऽहं नृपोत्तम अन्यथापि च कृत्यं ते न सिध्येद् इति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration: vivāhaṃ kuru me rājan strīkāmo 'haṃ nṛpottama anyathāpi ca kṛtyaṃ te na sidhyed iti me matiḥ
verses.translation: "Arrange my marriage, O king; I desire a wife, best of kings; otherwise your duty will not be fulfilled — that is my view.

verses.sanskrit: जनयित्वात्मजान् वेदविधिनाखिलसंस्कृतीः न कुर्याद् यः पिता तस्य नरकान् नास्ति निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: janayitvātmajān vedavidhinākhilasaṃskṛtīḥ na kuryād yaḥ pitā tasya narakān nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: A father who begets sons and does not perform all the rites according to Vedic rule has no escape from hell."

verses.transliteration: vismitaḥ sa pitā prāha sutaṃ tam uragākṛtim
verses.translation: Astonished, the father said to his son of serpent form:

verses.transliteration: yasya śabdād api trāsaṃ yānti śūrāś ca pūruṣāḥ tasmai kanyāṃ tu ko dadyād vada putra karomi kim
verses.translation: "Who would give a maiden to one at whose very sound even brave men are terrified? Tell me, son, what shall I do?"

verses.transliteration: tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā sarpaḥ prāha vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing his father's words, the clever serpent said:

verses.sanskrit: विवाहा बहवो राजन् राज्ञां सन्ति जनेश्वर प्रसह्याहरणं चापि शस्त्रैर् वैवाह एव च
verses.transliteration: vivāhā bahavo rājan rājñāṃ santi janeśvara prasahyāharaṇaṃ cāpi śastrair vaivāha eva ca
verses.translation: "There are many kinds of marriage for kings, O lord of people: abduction by force, and marriage by weapons too.

verses.sanskrit: जाते विवाहे पुत्रस्य पितासौ कृतकृद् भवेत् नो चेद् अत्रैव गङ्गायां मरिष्ये नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: jāte vivāhe putrasya pitāsau kṛtakṛd bhavet no ced atraiva gaṅgāyāṃ mariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: When his son is married, the father has done his duty; otherwise I will die here in the Ganga; there is no doubt."

verses.transliteration: tat putraniścayaṃ jñātvā aputro nṛpasattamaḥ vivāhārtham amātyāṃs tān āhūyedaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: Knowing his son's resolve, the best of kings, who had no other son, summoned his ministers for the marriage and said:

verses.sanskrit: नागेश्वरो मम सुतो युवराजो गुणाकरः गुणवान् मतिमाञ् शूरो दुर्जयः शत्रुतापनः

verses.translation: "How may his daughter become this son's wife? Tell me that."

verses.sanskrit: लक्षितो ऽसि महाराज यत् ते मनसि वर्तते यच् छूरसेन कृत्यं स्याद् अनुजानीहि मां ततः
verses.transliteration: lakṣito 'si mahārāja yat te manasi vartate yac chūrasena kṛtyaṃ syād anujānīhi māṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: "I have perceived what is in your mind, great king; permit me to do whatever is to be done for Shurasena."

verses.translation: Hearing the old minister's words, he honoured him with ornaments, garments and words, and sent him with a great army.

verses.transliteration: sa pūrvadeśam āgatya mahārājaṃ sametya ca saṃpūjya vividhair vākyair upāyair nītisaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: He came to the eastern land, met the great king and honoured him with various words and means born of policy;

verses.sanskrit: महाराजसुतायाश् च भोगवत्या महामतिः शूरसेनस्य नृपतेः सूनोर् नागस्य धीमतः

verses.translation: the very wise one, for the great king's daughter Bhogavati and the wise Naga, son of King Shurasena,

verses.sanskrit: विवाहायाकरोत् संधिं मिथ्यामिथ्यावचोउक्तिभिः पूजयाम् आस नृपतिं भूषणाच्छादनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: vivāhāyākarot saṃdhiṃ mithyāmithyāvacouktibhiḥ pūjayām āsa nṛpatiṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ

verses.translation: and told Shurasena the matter of the marriage. Then after many days the very wise old minister,

verses.transliteration: punar balena mahatā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ jagāma tarasā sarvair anyaiś ca sacivair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: adorned with garments and ornaments, went again quickly with a great army, accompanied by all the other counsellors,

verses.transliteration: atrāgantuṃ na cāyāti śūrasenasya bhūpateḥ putro nāga iti khyāto buddhimān guṇasāgaraḥ
verses.translation: "The son of King Shurasena, known as Naga, wise and an ocean of virtues, does not come here.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणां विवाहाश् च भवेयुर् बहुधा नृप तस्माच् छस्त्रैर् अलंकारैर् विवाहः स्यान् महामते
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyāṇāṃ vivāhāś ca bhaveyur bahudhā nṛpa tasmāc chastrair alaṃkārair vivāhaḥ syān mahāmate
verses.translation: The marriages of kshatriyas can be of many kinds, O king; therefore let the marriage be with weapons and ornaments, O wise one.

verses.translation: Hearing the old minister's words, Vijaya, best of kings, accepted the words as true and the minister and the king.

verses.translation: giving his own ministers, cows, gold, horses and much else; Vijaya was filled with great joy.

verses.translation: Vijaya's young daughter, rich in beauty and youth, slender-waisted, constantly served her mother-in-law and father-in-law.

verses.transliteration: bhogavatyāś ca yo bhartā mahāsarpo 'tibhīṣaṇaḥ ekāntadeśe vijane gṛhe ratnasuśobhite

verses.translation: "Why does my wife, the princess, not come to me?" Hearing her son's words, the serpent's mother said:

verses.transliteration: dhātrike gaccha subhage śīghraṃ bhogavatīṃ vada tava bhartā sarpa iti tataḥ sā kiṃ vadiṣyati
verses.translation: "Nurse, go quickly, good woman, and tell Bhogavati, 'Your husband is a serpent'; what will she say then?"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धात्रिका च तथेत्य् उक्त्वा गत्वा भोगवतीं तदा रहोगता उवाचेदं विनीतवद् अपूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: dhātrikā ca tathety uktvā gatvā bhogavatīṃ tadā rahogatā uvācedaṃ vinītavad apūrvavat
verses.translation: The nurse said "So be it," went to Bhogavati and, alone with her, said humbly, as never before:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जाने ऽहं सुभगे भद्रे भर्तारं तव दैवतम् न चाख्येयं त्वया क्वापि सर्पो न पुरुषो ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: jāne 'haṃ subhage bhadre bhartāraṃ tava daivatam na cākhyeyaṃ tvayā kvāpi sarpo na puruṣo dhruvam
verses.translation: "I know, fortunate and gentle one, that your husband is divine; you must tell no one: he is surely a serpent, not a man."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भोगवत्य् अब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bhogavaty abravīd idam
verses.translation: Hearing her words, Bhogavati said this:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मानुषीणां मनुष्यो हि भर्ता सामान्यतो भवेत् किं पुनर् देवजातिस् तु भर्ता पुण्येन लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: mānuṣīṇāṃ manuṣyo hi bhartā sāmānyato bhavet kiṃ punar devajātis tu bhartā puṇyena labhyate
verses.translation: "For human women a husband is ordinarily a man; how much more is a husband of divine race obtained by merit!"
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भोगवत्यास् तु तद् वाक्यं सा च सर्वं न्यवेदयत् सर्पाय सर्पमात्रे च राज्ञे चैव यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: bhogavatyās tu tad vākyaṃ sā ca sarvaṃ nyavedayat sarpāya sarpamātre ca rājñe caiva yathākramam
verses.translation: She reported Bhogavati's words in turn to the serpent, the serpent's mother and the king.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद राजा तद्वाक्यात् स्मृत्वा तां कर्मणो गतिम् भोगवत्य् अपि तां प्राह उक्तपूर्वां पुनः सखीम्
verses.transliteration: ruroda rājā tadvākyāt smṛtvā tāṃ karmaṇo gatim bhogavaty api tāṃ prāha uktapūrvāṃ punaḥ sakhīm
verses.translation: The king wept at her words, remembering the course of karma. Bhogavati too said again to that friend who had spoken before:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्तं दर्शय भद्रं ते वृथा याति वयो मम
verses.transliteration: kāntaṃ darśaya bhadraṃ te vṛthā yāti vayo mama
verses.translation: "Show me my beloved, blessings on you; my youth is passing in vain."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा दर्शयाम् आस सर्पं तम् अतिभीषणम् सुगन्धकुसुमाकीर्णे शयने सा रहोगता
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā darśayām āsa sarpaṃ tam atibhīṣaṇam sugandhakusumākīrṇe śayane sā rahogatā
verses.translation: Then she showed her that very terrible serpent, alone with her, on a bed strewn with fragrant flowers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा भीषणं सर्पं भर्तारं रत्नभूषितम् कृताञ्जलिपुटा वाक्यम् अवदत् कान्तम् अञ्जसा
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ bhartāraṃ ratnabhūṣitam kṛtāñjalipuṭā vākyam avadat kāntam añjasā
verses.translation: Seeing that terrible serpent, her husband adorned with jewels, with joined palms she at once spoke to her beloved:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्म्य् अनुगृहीतास्मि यस्या मे दैवतं पतिः
verses.transliteration: dhanyāsmy anugṛhītāsmi yasyā me daivataṃ patiḥ
verses.translation: "I am blessed and favoured, whose husband is divine."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा शयने स्थित्वा तं सर्पं सर्पभावनैः खेलयाम् आस तन्वङ्गी गीतैश् चैवाङ्गसंगमैः
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā śayane sthitvā taṃ sarpaṃ sarpabhāvanaiḥ khelayām āsa tanvaṅgī gītaiś caivāṅgasaṃgamaiḥ
verses.translation: Saying this, seated on the bed, the slender one played with that serpent with serpent-like ways, with songs and embraces,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धकुसुमैः पानैस् तोषयाम् आस तं पतिम् तस्याश् चैव प्रसादेन सर्पस्याभूत् स्मृतिर् मुने स्मृत्वा सर्वं दैवकृतं रात्रौ सर्पो ऽब्रवीत् प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: sugandhakusumaiḥ pānais toṣayām āsa taṃ patim tasyāś caiva prasādena sarpasyābhūt smṛtir mune smṛtvā sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ rātrau sarpo 'bravīt priyām
verses.translation: and pleased that husband with fragrant flowers and drinks. By her grace the serpent's memory returned, O sage; remembering all that fate had done, the serpent said to his beloved at night:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: राजकन्यापि मां दृष्ट्वा न भीतासि कथं प्रिये सोवाच दैवविहितं को ऽतिक्रमितुम् ईश्वरः पतिर् एव गतिः स्त्रीणां सर्वदैव विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: rājakanyāpi māṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhītāsi kathaṃ priye sovāca daivavihitaṃ ko 'tikramitum īśvaraḥ patir eva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ sarvadaiva viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "Though a princess, how is it that you are not afraid of me, beloved?" She said, "Who can overcome what fate has ordained? The husband alone is always the refuge of women above all."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: śrutveti hṛṣṭas tām āha nāgaḥ prahasitānanaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing this, delighted, the Naga said to her with a smiling face:

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽस्मि तव भक्त्याहं किं ददामि तवेप्सितम् तव प्रसादाच् चार्वङ्गि सर्वस्मृतिर् अभूद् इयम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'smi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kiṃ dadāmi tavepsitam tava prasādāc cārvaṅgi sarvasmṛtir abhūd iyam
verses.translation: "I am pleased with your devotion; what shall I give you that you desire? By your grace, lovely one, all this memory has returned.

verses.sanskrit: शप्तो ऽहं देवदेवेन कुपितेन पिनाकिना महेश्वरकरे नागः शेषपुत्रो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: śapto 'haṃ devadevena kupitena pinākinā maheśvarakare nāgaḥ śeṣaputro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: I was cursed by the angry god of gods, the bearer of Pinaka — the mighty Naga on Maheshvara's arm, son of Shesha.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पतिस् त्वं च भार्या नाम्ना भोगवती पुरा उमावाक्याज् जहासोच्चैः शंभुः प्रीतो रहोगतः
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ patis tvaṃ ca bhāryā nāmnā bhogavatī purā umāvākyāj jahāsoccaiḥ śaṃbhuḥ prīto rahogataḥ
verses.translation: I was the husband and you the wife, named Bhogavati, long ago. At Uma's words Shambhu, pleased, laughed loudly in private;

verses.transliteration: mamāpi cāgataṃ bhadre hāsyaṃ taddevasaṃnidhau tatas tu kupitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ prādāc chāpaṃ mamedṛśam
verses.translation: and laughter came to me too, dear one, in the god's presence; then Shambhu in anger gave me this curse:

verses.transliteration: manuṣyayonau tvaṃ sarpo bhavitā jñānavān iti
verses.translation: 'You will be a serpent in a human womb, yet possessed of knowledge.'

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasāditaḥ śaṃbhus tvayā bhadre mayā saha tataś coktaṃ tena bhadre gautamyāṃ mama pūjanam
verses.translation: Then Shambhu was appeased by you with me, dear one; then he said, 'While you worship me at the Gautami,

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वतो ज्ञानम् आधास्ये यदा सर्पाकृतेस् तव तदा विशापो भविता भोगवत्याः प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: kurvato jñānam ādhāsye yadā sarpākṛtes tava tadā viśāpo bhavitā bhogavatyāḥ prasādataḥ
verses.translation: I will grant knowledge to you in serpent form; then, by the grace of Bhogavati, you will be freed from the curse.'

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् इदं ममापन्नं तव चापि शुभानने तस्मान् नीत्वा गौतमीं मां पूजां कुरु मया सह
verses.transliteration: tasmād idaṃ mamāpannaṃ tava cāpi śubhānane tasmān nītvā gautamīṃ māṃ pūjāṃ kuru mayā saha
verses.translation: So this has come upon me and on you too, fair-faced one; therefore take me to the Gautami and worship with me.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विशापो भविता आवां यावः शिवं पुनः सर्वेषां सर्वदार्तानां शिव एव परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: tato viśāpo bhavitā āvāṃ yāvaḥ śivaṃ punaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvadārtānāṃ śiva eva parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Then the curse will be removed and we shall go to Shiva again; for all who are ever distressed, Shiva alone is the highest refuge."

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा भर्तृवचनं सा भर्त्रा गौतमीं ययौ ततः स्नात्वा तु गौतम्यां पूजां चक्रे शिवस्य तु
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā bhartṛvacanaṃ sā bhartrā gautamīṃ yayau tataḥ snātvā tu gautamyāṃ pūjāṃ cakre śivasya tu
verses.translation: Hearing her husband's words, she went with her husband to the Gautami; having bathed in the Gautami, she worshipped Shiva.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān divyarūpaṃ dadau mune āpṛcchya pitarau sarpo bhāryayā gantum udyataḥ śivalokaṃ tato jñātvā pitā prāha mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Then the Lord, pleased, gave him a divine form, O sage; taking leave of his parents, the serpent was ready to go with his wife to Shiva's world. Knowing this, his wise father said:

verses.transliteration: yuvarājyadharo jyeṣṭhaḥ putra eko bhavān iti tasmād rājyam aśeṣeṇa kṛtvotpādya sutān bahūn yāte mayi paraṃ dhāma tato yāhi śivaṃ puram
verses.translation: "You are the eldest and only son, heir to the kingdom; therefore rule the whole kingdom, beget many sons, and when I have gone to the supreme abode, then go to Shiva's city."

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा पितृवचस् तथेत्य् आह स नागराट् कामरूपम् अवाप्याथ भार्यया सह सुव्रतः
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā pitṛvacas tathety āha sa nāgarāṭ kāmarūpam avāpyātha bhāryayā saha suvrataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing his father's words, the king of Nagas said "So be it"; obtaining the ability to take any form, he, of good vows, with his wife,

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा मात्रा तथा पुत्रै राज्यं कृत्वा सुविस्तरम् याते पितरि स्वर्लोकं पुत्रान् स्थाप्य स्वके पदे
verses.transliteration: pitrā mātrā tathā putrai rājyaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram yāte pitari svarlokaṃ putrān sthāpya svake pade
verses.translation: ruled the kingdom extensively with his father, mother and sons; when his father had gone to heaven, he placed his sons in his own position

verses.sanskrit: भार्यामात्यादिसहितस् ततः शिवपुरं ययौ ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं नागतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: bhāryāmātyādisahitas tataḥ śivapuraṃ yayau tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ nāgatīrtham iti śrutam
verses.translation: and with his wife, ministers and others went to Shiva's city. From then on that holy place is famed as Nagatirtha,

verses.sanskrit: यत्र नागेश्वरो देवो भोगवत्या प्रतिष्ठितः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yatra nāgeśvaro devo bhogavatyā pratiṣṭhitaḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam
verses.translation: where the god Nageshvara was installed by Bhogavati; bathing and giving there grant the fruit of all sacrifices.

verses.transliteration: mātṛtīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām ādhibhir mucyate jantus tattīrthasmaraṇād api
verses.translation: How should sons and relatives perform Sraddha for the manes who have departed to the other world and who are abiding in the region assigned to them according to their actions? I bow to Varaha, lord of the universe, creator of the people. Listen, I shall tell you all about Sraddha, as was recorded afore.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानाम् असुराणां च संगरो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः नाशक्नुवंस् तदा जेतुं देवा दानवसंगरम्
verses.transliteration: devānām asurāṇāṃ ca saṃgaro 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ nāśaknuvaṃs tadā jetuṃ devā dānavasaṃgaram
verses.translation: In days of yore, the lord uplifted the manes who were drowned in the waters of Koka river, by performing Sraddha for their sake, O best ofBrahmanas. In the intervening period of Treta and Dvapara Yugas, the diverse human beings—the manes, stood in the company of Visvedevas at the top of Meru mountain.
verses.wordMeaning: In days of yore, the lord uplifted the manes who were drowned in the waters of Koka river, by performing Sraddha for their sake, O best ofBrahmanas. In the intervening period of Treta and Dvapara Yugas, the diverse human beings—the manes,…

verses.sanskrit: तदाहम् अगमं देवैस् तिष्ठन्तं शूलपाणिनम् अस्तवं विविधैर् वाक्यैः कृताञ्जलिपुटः शनैः
verses.transliteration: tadāham agamaṃ devais tiṣṭhantaṃ śūlapāṇinam astavaṃ vividhair vākyaiḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Once, they were sitting (as usual) there (at the top of Meru). A beautiful divine girl born of Soma appeared before them with hands joined in reverence. Among the manes who had assembled there, those shining with refulgence spoke to her. She said to the refulgent manes. I am Kala, born of the Moon, You are my lords whom I can choose, if you so desire.
verses.wordMeaning: Once, they were sitting (as usual) there (at the top of Meru). A beautiful divine girl born of Soma appeared before them with hands joined in reverence. Among the manes who had assembled there, those shining with refulgence spoke to her. She said to the refulgent manes.…

verses.sanskrit: संमन्त्र्य देवैर् असुरैश् च सर्वैर् यदाहृतं संमथितुं समुद्रम् यत् कालकूटं समभून् महेश तत् त्वां विना को ग्रसितुं समर्थः
verses.transliteration: saṃmantrya devair asuraiś ca sarvair yadāhṛtaṃ saṃmathituṃ samudram yat kālakūṭaṃ samabhūn maheśa tat tvāṃ vinā ko grasituṃ samarthaḥ
verses.translation: When Visvcdevas saw that they were gazing at the face of the girl and had fallen off Yoga, they left their company and went to heaven. When the holy god Moon did not see his daughter Urja, he was upset. Where she may have gone? He thought to himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Visvcdevas saw that they were gazing at the face of the girl and had fallen off Yoga, they left their company and went to heaven. When the holy god Moon did not see his daughter Urja, he was upset. Where she may have gone? He thought to himself.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पप्रहारेण जगत्त्रयं यः स्वाधीनम् आपादयितुं समर्थः मारो हरे ऽप्य् अन्यसुरादिवन्द्यो वितायमानो विलयं प्रयातः
verses.transliteration: puṣpaprahāreṇa jagattrayaṃ yaḥ svādhīnam āpādayituṃ samarthaḥ māro hare 'py anyasurādivandyo vitāyamāno vilayaṃ prayātaḥ
verses.translation: Thus cursed by the Moon, the manes, the divine men were deprived of yoga and fell off at Mount Himavat. O best of sages, the manes living on that sustenance passed ten thousand years as it were a single day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus cursed by the Moon, the manes, the divine men were deprived of yoga and fell off at Mount Himavat. O best of sages, the manes living on that sustenance passed ten thousand years as it were a single day.

verses.sanskrit: विमथ्य वारीशम् अनङ्गशत्रो यद् उत्तमं तत् तु दिवौकसेभ्यः दत्त्वा विषं संहरन् नीलकण्ठ को वा धर्तुं त्वाम् ऋते वै समर्थः
verses.transliteration: vimathya vārīśam anaṅgaśatro yad uttamaṃ tat tu divaukasebhyaḥ dattvā viṣaṃ saṃharan nīlakaṇṭha ko vā dhartuṃ tvām ṛte vai samarthaḥ
verses.translation: Then the asuras, yatudhanas and raksasas found that the manes were estranged from Devas anci they fell upon them. The Brahmins stationed on the bank of Koka (who were formerly manes) saw asuras and yatudhanas pouncing upon them. The infuriated brahmins caught hold of a lofty slab.
verses.wordMeaning: Then the asuras, yatudhanas and raksasas found that the manes were estranged from Devas anci they fell upon them. The Brahmins stationed on the bank of Koka (who were formerly manes) saw asuras and yatudhanas pouncing upon them.…

verses.transliteration: tataś ca tuṣṭo bhagavān ādikartā trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: The fast-flowing Koka saw them holding the slab. She concealed the manes in her waters which overflowed Himalaya. Victory to Govinda: O the abode of the universe, O Kesava, be pleased to favour us with Victory. O Janardana of pure and spotless impression, uplift us from the cavity of waters.

verses.transliteration: dāsye 'haṃ yad abhīṣṭaṃ vo bruvantu surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: O lord, Visnu, O Boar, Vaikuntha, Narayana, lord of lords, lotus-navelled, worthy of praise, we are afraid of asuras, of dreadful sight; protect us, O lord, and grant us victory. O Visnu, the younger brother of lord Indra, O Yogin, the slayer of Madhu and Kaitabha demons, O Endless, of steady disposition, Vasudeva, holding bow, discus, lotus and conch in your hands, O lord of Devas, protect us from raksasas.

verses.transliteration: dānavebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ tatraihi vṛṣabhadhvaja jahi śatrūn surān pāhi nāthavantas tvayā prabho
verses.translation: O Sambhu, you are the father of universe, the dreadful asuras are unable to assail you. Hence, we come to your shel¬ ter. Thus praised by the manes, the lord in the divine form of a boar, the sustainer of this Earth saw the manes, merged in the waters of Koka carrying slabs over their head.

verses.transliteration: niṣkāraṇaḥ suhṛc chaṃbho nābhaviṣyad bhavān yadi tadākariṣyan kim iva duḥkhārtāḥ sarvadehinaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, in the form of a boar, saw the manes hid¬ den in the waters of Koka out of fear from the asuras and thou¬ ght of uplifting them to the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu, in the form of a boar, saw the manes hid¬ den in the waters of Koka out of fear from the asuras and thou¬ ght of uplifting them to the Earth.

verses.transliteration: ity uktas tatkṣaṇāt prāyād yatra te devaśatravaḥ tatra tad yuddham abhavac chaṃkareṇa suradviṣām
verses.translation: The boar cast away the slab with the tip of his tusks and brought up the manes to the Earth. They said: "You may" The Lord then invoked all <mds and on their arrival gave them seats.

verses.transliteration: tatas trilocanaḥ śrāntas tamorūpadharaḥ śivaḥ lalāṭād vyapataṃs tasya yudhyataḥ svedabindavaḥ
verses.translation: Adorned with discus and mace, he planned out their protection with the unbroken rice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adorned with discus and mace, he planned out their protection with the unbroken rice.

verses.transliteration: sa saṃharan daityagaṇāṃs tāmasīṃ mūrtim āśritaḥ tāṃ mūrtim asurā dṛṣṭvā merupṛṣṭhād bhuvaṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: The unbroken rice and the barley seeds are born of parts of all-gods. These ward off calamities from all sites- they are produced for the sake of protection. "I invoke the manes, both divine and mortals." When they agreed to be invoked, he invoked them.

verses.translation: Similarly, he put his right hand on the right knee and the sacred thread on the right side and invited them with the mantra 'ayantu nah\ Varaha recited the mantra 'apahata' and warded off the asuras from the site. He then transferred his saci ed thi cad to the right. Uttering the names and gotras he invoked the pitrs by the personal and gotra names.

verses.translation: Varaha then uttered the mantras 'apyayayantu' and 'samvatsaraih* and poured arghya to the Pitrs who as a result of the curse had assumed the form of Brahmins.

verses.transliteration: procur maheśvaraṃ sarvāḥ khādāmas tv asurān iti tataḥ provāca bhagavān sarvaiḥ suragaṇair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Varaha (incarnate of Visnu) repeated the same proce¬ dure for the maternal grandfather. He propitiated them again with incense etc. and offered them perfume with devotion. The residue of the sacrificial material he offered thrice to each of the Pitrs, by their personal and gotra names.

verses.translation: The residue of the material such as "food" he put into the vessel wherein the rice-ball was kept. Then, he gave the tasty food together with the rice boiled in milk.

verses.transliteration: tāś ca jagmur bhuvaṃ bhittvā yatra te daityadānavāḥ tān hatvā mātaraḥ sarvān devārīn atibhīṣaṇān
verses.translation: Having pleased them thus, he should move aside, repeat aghamarsana thrice. Withdrawing himself, he should repeat 'yanme'.

verses.transliteration: punar devān upājagmuḥ pathā tenaiva mātaraḥ gatāś ca mātaro yāvad yāvac ca punar āgatāḥ
verses.translation: Then sprinkling the massive heap of hair with the collected waters of holy rivers he begged blessings of Brahmanas. O lord Boar, by your favour, we shall go to heaven. Let Soma (the Moon-god), the observer of Yoga be our guar¬ dian.

verses.transliteration: tāvad devāḥ sthitā āsan gautamītīram āśritāḥ prasthānāt tatra mātṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pratiṣṭhiteḥ
verses.translation: Let Yama be your deity; Moon the preceptor; Fire the priest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let Yama be your deity; Moon the preceptor; Fire the priest.

verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tat kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ vijayavardhanam mātṝṇāṃ yatra cotpattir mātṛtīrthaṃ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Let Fire, wind and Sun be your abodes; Brahma, \ isnu and Rudra be your guardians. Let Aditiyas, Vasus and Rudras be your forms. Let \ ogis, embodying \ oga make yoga as your basis and observe

verses.transliteration: tatra tatra bilāny āsan rasātalagatāni ca surās tābhyo varān procur loke pūjāṃ yathā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Known as Koka, she will resort to Himalaya. She will be as efficacious as the crores of holy places all together.
verses.commentary: Sense: Known as Koka, she will resort to Himalaya. She will be as efficacious as the crores of holy places all together.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नोति तद्वन् मातृभ्यः पूजा भवतु सर्वदा इत्य् उक्त्वान्तर्दधुर् देवा आसंस् तत्रैव मातरः
verses.transliteration: prāpnoti tadvan mātṛbhyaḥ pūjā bhavatu sarvadā ity uktvāntardadhur devā āsaṃs tatraiva mātaraḥ
verses.translation: I shall stay in Koka from this very day, smashing sins of all mankind. The sight of lord Boar is holy. His worship grants worldly pleasures and salvation. Drinking the water of Koka destroys sins. The plunge yields merit. The fast leads to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall stay in Koka from this very day, smashing sins of all mankind. The sight of lord Boar is holy. His worship grants worldly pleasures and salvation. Drinking the water of Koka destroys sins. The plunge yields merit. The fast leads to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र यत्र स्थिता देव्यो मातृतीर्थं ततो विदुः सुराणाम् अपि सेव्यानि किं पुनर् मानुषादिभिः
verses.transliteration: yatra yatra sthitā devyo mātṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ surāṇām api sevyāni kiṃ punar mānuṣādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Charity gives imperishable fruit; it destroys sins of birth, death and old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Charity gives imperishable fruit; it destroys sins of birth, death and old age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानम् अथो दानं पितॄणां चैव तर्पणम् सर्वं तद् अक्षयं ज्ञेयं शिवस्य वचनं यथा
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānam atho dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā
verses.translation: He who fasts here reaps the fruit thereof as mentioned previously. O blessed ones, you are now free to go to your places at your will. "I too shall rest here", saying this lord Boar disappear¬ ed. When lord Boar had gone, the pitrs took leave of Koka and went away.

verses.sanskrit: यस् त्व् इदं शृणुयान् नित्यं स्मरेद् अपि पठेत् तथा आख्यानं मातृतीर्थानाम् आयुष्मान् स सुखी भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yas tv idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ smared api paṭhet tathā ākhyānaṃ mātṛtīrthānām āyuṣmān sa sukhī bhavet
verses.translation: Thus have I described at Kokamukha the Boar incar¬ nate ofVisnu who confers boons to the people. On hearing this description, a man is purified from dirt, becomes devoid of sins, and obtains the merit of performing Asvamedha Sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: idam apy aparaṃ tīrthaṃ devānām api durlabham brahmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: Women and Sudras too should perform the same under the direction of Brahmanas. But there should be no recitation of mantras or ritual of sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: sthiteṣu devasainyeṣu praviṣṭeṣu rasātalam daityeṣu ca muniśreṣṭha tathā mātṛṣu tān anu
verses.translation: When the sun enters zodiac Kanya, there are fifteen days exclusively meant for Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun enters zodiac Kanya, there are fifteen days exclusively meant for Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: मदीयं पञ्चमं वक्त्रं गर्दभाकृति भीषणम् तद् वक्त्रं देवसैन्येषु मयि तिष्ठत्य् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: madīyaṃ pañcamaṃ vaktraṃ gardabhākṛti bhīṣaṇam tad vaktraṃ devasainyeṣu mayi tiṣṭhaty uvāca ha
verses.translation: When the sun has entered the Kanya Zodiac, the per¬ former of Sraddha in that period obtains whatever desire lie • has in his mind. Nandlmukha should be performed during the same period. It should be done in Purnima as stated in Varaha Purana.

verses.sanskrit: हे दैत्याः किं पलायन्ते न भयं वो ऽस्तु सत्वरम् आगच्छन्तु सुरान् सर्वान् भक्षयिष्ये क्षणाद् इति
verses.transliteration: he daityāḥ kiṃ palāyante na bhayaṃ vo 'stu satvaram āgacchantu surān sarvān bhakṣayiṣye kṣaṇād iti
verses.translation: When a Brahmin versed in the Vedas and the firc- lituals comes to the house, he alone should be considered as worthy of Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a Brahmin versed in the Vedas and the firc- lituals comes to the house, he alone should be considered as worthy of Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: निवारयन्तं माम् एवं भक्षणायोद्यतं तथा तं दृष्ट्वा विबुधाः सर्वे वित्रस्ता विष्णुम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: nivārayantaṃ mām evaṃ bhakṣaṇāyodyataṃ tathā taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve vitrastā viṣṇum abruvan
verses.translation: When the material for Sraddha approved by the experts is available, he should perform Parvana Sraddha with the help of Brahmins well versed in the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the material for Sraddha approved by the experts is available, he should perform Parvana Sraddha with the help of Brahmins well versed in the Sraddha.

verses.transliteration: trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha brahmaṇo 'sya mukhaṃ luna cakradhṛg vibudhān āha cchedmi cakreṇa vai śiraḥ
verses.translation: One should celebrate the anniversary of one's departed parents, also of the uncle and elder brother if they died sonless.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should celebrate the anniversary of one's departed parents, also of the uncle and elder brother if they died sonless.

verses.transliteration: kiṃ tu tac chinnam evedaṃ saṃharet sacarācaram mantraṃ brūmo 'tra vibudhāḥ śrūyatāṃ sarvam eva hi
verses.translation: After purification, they enjoin Ekoddista, on the twelfth day, or after the expiry of a month or at the end of three fort¬ nights.

verses.transliteration: trinetraḥ kaśiraś chettā sa ca dhatte na saṃśayaḥ mayā ca śaṃbhuḥ sarvaiś ca stutaḥ proktas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O Brahmins, Sraddha should be performed every month, for a year. Then he should perform sapindlkarana rite after a year. When that is done, he should perform Parvana. The de¬ ceased then change their states as Preta to thatofPitrs.

verses.transliteration: yāgaḥ kṣaṇī dṛṣṭaphale 'samarthaḥ sa naiva kartuḥ phalatīti matvā phalasya dāne pratibhūr jaṭīti niścitya lokaḥ pratikarma yātaḥ
verses.translation: Pitrs are twofold: murta and -amurta. NandTmukhas are amurta and Parvanas arc murta. Prctas receive Ekoddista, Pitrs receive Parvana Sraddha.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ sureśaḥ saṃtuṣṭo devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye lokānām upakārārthaṃ tathety āha surān prati
verses.translation: Then the lord of the gods, pleased, for the accomplishment of the gods' task and for the benefit of the worlds, said "So be it" to the gods.

verses.transliteration: tadvaktraṃ pāparūpaṃ yad bhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam nikṛtya nakhaśastraiś ca kva sthāpyaṃ cety athābravīt
verses.translation: "That face which is sinful, terrible and hair-raising — having cut it off with the weapons of my nails, where shall it be placed?" he asked.

verses.translation: Then Ila said to the gods, "I cannot bear the head; I will go to Rasatala." And the ocean said,

verses.transliteration: śoṣaṃ yāsye kṣaṇād eva punaś cocuḥ śivaṃ surāḥ tvayaivaitad brahmaśiro dhāryaṃ lokānukampayā
verses.translation: "I would dry up in a moment." Again the gods said to Shiva, "This head of Brahma must be borne by you alone, out of compassion for the worlds.

verses.transliteration: acchede jagatāṃ nāśaś chede doṣaś ca tādṛśaḥ evaṃ vimṛśya someśo dadhāra kaśiras tadā
verses.translation: If not cut off, the worlds are destroyed; if cut off, there is such a fault." Having considered thus, Somesha then bore the head of Brahma.

verses.translation: Seeing that difficult deed, the gods reached the purifying Gautami and praised the lord of the worlds with love and devotion:

verses.transliteration: deveṣv amitraṃ kaśiro 'tibhīmaṃ tān bhakṣaṇāyopagataṃ nikṛtya nakhāgrasūcyā śakalendumaulis tyāge 'pi doṣāt kṛpayānudhatte
verses.translation: "Having cut off with the needle of his nail-tip Brahma's very terrible head, enemy to the gods, which came to devour them, the one crowned with the crescent moon, out of compassion, bears it despite the fault of casting it away."

verses.transliteration: tatra te vibudhāḥ sarve sthitā ye brahmaṇo 'ntike tuṣṭuvur vibudheśānaṃ karma dṛṣṭvātidaivatam
verses.translation: All the gods who were there near Brahma praised the lord of the gods, seeing that more-than-divine deed.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं ब्रह्मतीर्थम् इति श्रुतम् अद्यापि ब्रह्मणो रूपं चतुर्मुखम् अवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ brahmatīrtham iti śrutam adyāpi brahmaṇo rūpaṃ caturmukham avasthitam
verses.translation: From then on that holy place is famed as Brahmatirtha; even today the four-faced form of Brahma stands there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.explanation: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: शिरोमात्रं तु यः पश्येत् स गच्छेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम् यत्र स्थित्वा स्वयं रुद्रो लूनवान् ब्रह्मणः शिरः
verses.transliteration: śiromātraṃ tu yaḥ paśyet sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam yatra sthitvā svayaṃ rudro lūnavān brahmaṇaḥ śiraḥ
verses.translation: Whoever sees just the head goes to the state of Brahma. Where Rudra himself stood and cut off Brahma's head,

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रतीर्थं तद् एव स्यात् तत्र साक्षाद् दिवाकरः देवानां च स्वरूपेण स्थितो यस्मात् तद् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rudratīrthaṃ tad eva syāt tatra sākṣād divākaraḥ devānāṃ ca svarūpeṇa sthito yasmāt tad uttamam
verses.translation: that is Rudratirtha; there the Sun stands visibly in the form of the gods, and therefore it is excellent;

verses.sanskrit: सौर्यं तीर्थं तद् आख्यातं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम् तत्र स्नात्वा रविं दृष्ट्वा पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sauryaṃ tīrthaṃ tad ākhyātaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam tatra snātvā raviṃ dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate
verses.translation: that is called the solar holy place, granting the fruit of all sacrifices; having bathed there and seen the Sun, there is no rebirth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महादेवेन यच् छिन्नं ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः क्षेत्रे ऽविमुक्ते संस्थाप्य देवतानां हितं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevena yac chinnaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ kṣetre 'vimukte saṃsthāpya devatānāṃ hitaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: The fifth head of Brahma that was cut off by Mahadeva was placed in the region of Avimukta, doing good to the gods.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मतीर्थे शिरोमात्रं यो दृष्ट्वा गौतमीतटे क्षेत्रे ऽविमुक्ते तस्यैव स्थापितं यो ऽनुपश्यति कपालं ब्रह्मणः पुण्यं ब्रह्महा पूततां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmatīrthe śiromātraṃ yo dṛṣṭvā gautamītaṭe kṣetre 'vimukte tasyaiva sthāpitaṃ yo 'nupaśyati kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puṇyaṃ brahmahā pūtatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Whoever sees just the head at Brahmatirtha on the Gautami's bank, and also sees Brahma's holy skull placed at Avimukta — even the slayer of a brahmin becomes pure.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अविघ्नं तीर्थम् आख्यातं सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् तत्रापि वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये शृणु नारद भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: avighnaṃ tīrtham ākhyātaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam tatrāpi vṛttam ākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: There should be four vessels, three for the Pitrs, mixed with sesamum seeds, incense and water and one for the Preta.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: There should be four vessels, three for the Pitrs, mixed with sesamum seeds, incense and water and one for the Preta.

verses.transliteration: devasattre pravṛtte tu gautamyāś cottare taṭe samāptir naiva sattrasya saṃjātā vighnadoṣataḥ
verses.translation: In each of the three vessels some water from the Preta patra should be poured. In each case, he should recite the mantra "Ye samana".
verses.commentary: Sense: In each of the three vessels some water from the Preta patra should be poured. In each case, he should recite the mantra "Ye samana".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः सर्वे माम् अवोचन् हरिं तदा ततो ध्यानगतो ऽहं तान् अवोचं वीक्ष्य कारणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve mām avocan hariṃ tadā tato dhyānagato 'haṃ tān avocaṃ vīkṣya kāraṇam
verses.translation: In regard to women also, the same procedure should be adopted. But sapindikarana need not be performed if the deceas¬ ed woman had no sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: In regard to women also, the same procedure should be adopted. But sapindikarana need not be performed if the deceas¬ ed woman had no sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनायककृतैर् विघ्नैर् नैतत् सत्त्रं समाप्यते तस्मात् स्तुवन्तु ते सर्वे आदिदेवं विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: vināyakakṛtair vighnair naitat sattraṃ samāpyate tasmāt stuvantu te sarve ādidevaṃ vināyakam
verses.translation: In case of women sapindikarana should be done every year by men. The rite should be performed on their death anni¬ versary, as enjoined by the sastras.
verses.commentary: Sense: In case of women sapindikarana should be done every year by men. The rite should be performed on their death anni¬ versary, as enjoined by the sastras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सुरगणाः स्नात्वा ते गौतमीतटे अस्तुवन् भक्तितो देवा आदिदेवं गणेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā suragaṇāḥ snātvā te gautamītaṭe astuvan bhaktito devā ādidevaṃ gaṇeśvaram
verses.translation: If there be no son, this should be performed by the rela¬ tives connected by the offering of rice balls. If there be no such relatives, brothers should do the same. If there be no brothers, grandsons or great-grandsons should perform the sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: If there be no son, this should be performed by the rela¬ tives connected by the offering of rice balls. If there be no such relatives, brothers should do the same. If there be no brothers, grandsons or great-grandsons should perform the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वकार्येषु सदा सुराणाम् अपीशविष्ण्वम्बुजसंभवानाम् पूज्यो नमस्यः परिचिन्तनीयस् तं विघ्नराजं शरणं व्रजामः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvakāryeṣu sadā surāṇām apīśaviṣṇvambujasaṃbhavānām pūjyo namasyaḥ paricintanīyas taṃ vighnarājaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: The daughter's son should perform the rite for hfa maternal groud-fa,her. They are named dvyamusyayana (fo
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter's son should perform the rite for hfa maternal groud-fa,her. They are named dvyamusyayana (fo

verses.sanskrit: न विघ्नराजेन समो ऽस्ति कश्चिद् देवो मनोवाञ्छितसंप्रदाता निश्चित्य चैतत् त्रिपुरान्तको ऽपि तं पूजयाम् आस वधे पुराणाम्
verses.transliteration: na vighnarājena samo 'sti kaścid devo manovāñchitasaṃpradātā niścitya caitat tripurāntako 'pi taṃ pūjayām āsa vadhe purāṇām
verses.translation: The list of Brahmins as mentioned above should be invited a day before Sraddha. Whether the rite pertains to gods or manes, he should appoint them accordingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The list of Brahmins as mentioned above should be invited a day before Sraddha. Whether the rite pertains to gods or manes, he should appoint them accordingly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: करोतु सो ऽस्माकम् अविघ्नम् अस्मिन् महाक्रतौ सत्वरम् आम्बिकेयः ध्यातेन येनाखिलदेहभाजां पूर्णा भविष्यन्ति मनोभिलाषाः
verses.transliteration: karotu so 'smākam avighnam asmin mahākratau satvaram āmbikeyaḥ dhyātena yenākhiladehabhājāṃ pūrṇā bhaviṣyanti manobhilāṣāḥ
verses.translation: He who gives fresh garments, made of silk or cotton, obtains the fulfilment of his desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives fresh garments, made of silk or cotton, obtains the fulfilment of his desire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: महोत्सवो ऽभूद् अखिलस्य देव्या जातः सुतश् चिन्तितमात्र एव अतो ऽवदन् सुरसंघाः कृतार्थाः सद्योजातं विघ्नराजं नमन्तः
verses.transliteration: mahotsavo 'bhūd akhilasya devyā jātaḥ sutaś cintitamātra eva ato 'vadan surasaṃghāḥ kṛtārthāḥ sadyojātaṃ vighnarājaṃ namantaḥ
verses.translation: The Pitrs receive food offered to the brahmins who utter the Pitr's name, gotra and mantras. Although they are not present in physical forms they get satiated thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs receive food offered to the brahmins who utter the Pitr's name, gotra and mantras. Although they are not present in physical forms they get satiated thereby.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो मातुर् उत्सङ्गगतो ऽथ मात्रा निवार्यमाणो ऽपि बलाच् च चन्द्रम् संगोपयाम् आस पितुर् जटासु गणाधिनाथस्य विनोद एषः
verses.transliteration: yo mātur utsaṅgagato 'tha mātrā nivāryamāṇo 'pi balāc ca candram saṃgopayām āsa pitur jaṭāsu gaṇādhināthasya vinoda eṣaḥ
verses.translation: Homage to Deities, Pitrs and Yogins. Homage to Svaha, Svadha for ever and for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homage to Deities, Pitrs and Yogins. Homage to Svaha, Svadha for ever and for ever.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
