verses.sanskrit: पपौ स्तनं मातुर् अथापि तृप्तो यो भ्रातृमात्सर्यकषायबुद्धिः लम्बोदरस् त्वं भव विघ्नराजो लम्बोदरं नाम चकार शंभुः
verses.transliteration: papau stanaṃ mātur athāpi tṛpto yo bhrātṛmātsaryakaṣāyabuddhiḥ lambodaras tvaṃ bhava vighnarājo lambodaraṃ nāma cakāra śaṃbhuḥ
verses.translation: At the beginning and the end of Sraddha, he should repeat the same thrice. At the offering of the rice-ball as well, he should recite this attentively.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning and the end of Sraddha, he should repeat the same thrice. At the offering of the rice-ball as well, he should recite this attentively.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संवेष्टितो देवगणैर् महेशः प्रवर्ततां नृत्यम् इतीत्य् उवाच संतोषितो नूपुररावमात्राद् गणेश्वरत्वे ऽभिषिषेच पुत्रम्
verses.transliteration: saṃveṣṭito devagaṇair maheśaḥ pravartatāṃ nṛtyam itīty uvāca saṃtoṣito nūpurarāvamātrād gaṇeśvaratve 'bhiṣiṣeca putram
verses.translation: Pitrs come very soon. Raksasas fly away. They get propitiated in the three worlds. This mantra, indeed uplifts them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pitrs come very soon. Raksasas fly away. They get propitiated in the three worlds. This mantra, indeed uplifts them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो विघ्नपाशं च करेण बिभ्रत् स्कन्धे कुठारं च तथा परेण अपूजितो विघ्नम् अथो ऽपि मातुः करोति को विघ्नपतेः समो ऽन्यः
verses.transliteration: yo vighnapāśaṃ ca kareṇa bibhrat skandhe kuṭhāraṃ ca tathā pareṇa apūjito vighnam atho 'pi mātuḥ karoti ko vighnapateḥ samo 'nyaḥ
verses.translation: He should gift a fresh thread, silken, hempen, cotton, one made of patrorna, patka or kauseya. Variety should be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should gift a fresh thread, silken, hempen, cotton, one made of patrorna, patka or kauseya. Variety should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामादिषु पूर्वपूज्यो देवासुरैः पूज्यत एव नित्यम् यस्यार्चनं नैव विनाशम् अस्ति तं पूर्वपूज्यं प्रथमं नमामि
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmādiṣu pūrvapūjyo devāsuraiḥ pūjyata eva nityam yasyārcanaṃ naiva vināśam asti taṃ pūrvapūjyaṃ prathamaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: The wise man should avoid that piece of cloth which in spite of its being full has no fringe. The aforesaid variety docs not propitiate the Pitrs and the donor too comes to grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wise man should avoid that piece of cloth which in spite of its being full has no fringe. The aforesaid variety docs not propitiate the Pitrs and the donor too comes to grief.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्यार्चनात् प्रार्थनयानुरूपां दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वस्य फलस्य सिद्धिम् स्वतन्त्रसामर्थ्यकृतातिगर्वं भ्रातृप्रियं त्व् आखुरथं तम् ईडे
verses.transliteration: yasyārcanāt prārthanayānurūpāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu sarvasya phalasya siddhim svatantrasāmarthyakṛtātigarvaṃ bhrātṛpriyaṃ tv ākhurathaṃ tam īḍe
verses.translation: With faith and devotion he should offer ball into the fire. If he is in need of progeny, he should give it to his wife, reciting the mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: With faith and devotion he should offer ball into the fire. If he is in need of progeny, he should give it to his wife, reciting the mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो मातरं सरसैर् नृत्यगीतैस् तथाभिलाषैर् अखिलैर् विनोदैः संतोषयाम् आस तदातितुष्टं तं श्रीगणेशं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: yo mātaraṃ sarasair nṛtyagītais tathābhilāṣair akhilair vinodaiḥ saṃtoṣayām āsa tadātituṣṭaṃ taṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: If he wishes for brilliant splendour, he should offer it to the cows. If he wishes for wisdom, fame and renown he should offer the same into waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he wishes for brilliant splendour, he should offer it to the cows. If he wishes for wisdom, fame and renown he should offer the same into waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरोपकारैर् असुरैश् च युद्धैः स्तोत्रैर् नमस्कारपरैश् च मन्त्रैः पितृप्रसादेन सदा समृद्धं तं श्रीगणेशं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: suropakārair asuraiś ca yuddhaiḥ stotrair namaskāraparaiś ca mantraiḥ pitṛprasādena sadā samṛddhaṃ taṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: If he wishes for longevity he should give it to the
verses.commentary: Sense: If he wishes for longevity he should give it to the

verses.sanskrit: जये पुराणाम् अकरोत् प्रतीपं पित्रापि हर्षात् प्रतिपूजितो यः निर्विघ्नतां चापि पुनश् चकार तस्मै गणेशाय नमस्करोमि
verses.transliteration: jaye purāṇām akarot pratīpaṃ pitrāpi harṣāt pratipūjito yaḥ nirvighnatāṃ cāpi punaś cakāra tasmai gaṇeśāya namaskaromi
verses.translation: Again, some brahmins opine that Pinda should be lifted by the front. He should do so when the Brahmins have said: "Now, lift it up please".
verses.commentary: Sense: Again, some brahmins opine that Pinda should be lifted by the front. He should do so when the Brahmins have said: "Now, lift it up please".

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तुतः सुरगणैर् विघ्नेशः प्राह तान् पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti stutaḥ suragaṇair vighneśaḥ prāha tān punaḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, Sraddha should be performed as the sages of yore have stated. Otherwise, he incurs sin, and the Pitrs do not receive the essence thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, Sraddha should be performed as the sages of yore have stated. Otherwise, he incurs sin, and the Pitrs do not receive the essence thereof.

verses.sanskrit: इतो निर्विघ्नता सत्त्रे मत्तः स्याद् असुरारिणः
verses.transliteration: ito nirvighnatā sattre mattaḥ syād asurāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Guggulu, sandal paste, Srivasa, Aguru, and such other instances as are available.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guggulu, sandal paste, Srivasa, Aguru, and such other instances as are available.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवसत्त्रे निवृत्ते तु गणेशः प्राह तान् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: devasattre nivṛtte tu gaṇeśaḥ prāha tān surān
verses.translation: Beans, Canakas, Masuras, Koradusakas, Viprusas, Markatas, Kodravas should be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beans, Canakas, Masuras, Koradusakas, Viprusas, Markatas, Kodravas should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्त्या मां स्तोष्यन्ति यतव्रताः तेषां दारिद्र्यदुःखानि न भवेयुः कदाचन
verses.transliteration: stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā māṃ stoṣyanti yatavratāḥ teṣāṃ dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyuḥ kadācana
verses.translation: He should avoid milk, curd, ghee produced from Ma-. C amara > Mrga, Avika, Ekasapha (an animal whose hoof is not cloven) (as ahorse, ass etc.), the breasts of women, camel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid milk, curd, ghee produced from Ma-. C amara > Mrga, Avika, Ekasapha (an animal whose hoof is not cloven) (as ahorse, ass etc.), the breasts of women, camel.

verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र ये भक्तितः स्नानं दानं कुर्युर् अतन्द्रिताः तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि भवेयुर् इति मन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: atra ye bhaktitaḥ snānaṃ dānaṃ kuryur atandritāḥ teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyur iti manyatām
verses.translation: Tala, Varuna, Kakola, Bahupatra, Arjuniphala, Ja- mblra, red Bilva, and the fruit of Sala should be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tala, Varuna, Kakola, Bahupatra, Arjuniphala, Ja- mblra, red Bilva, and the fruit of Sala should be avoided.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु तथेत्य् ऊचुः सुरा अपि निवृत्ते तु मखे तस्मिन् सुरा जग्मुः स्वम् आलयम्
verses.transliteration: tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu tathety ūcuḥ surā api nivṛtte tu makhe tasmin surā jagmuḥ svam ālayam
verses.translation: He who recites this section on Pitrmedha at the time of Sraddha, O Brahmins, his Pitrs feed upon his food for a number of years lasting for three yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites this section on Pitrmedha at the time of Sraddha, O Brahmins, his Pitrs feed upon his food for a number of years lasting for three yugas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अविघ्नम् इति गद्यते सर्वकामप्रदं पुंसां सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham avighnam iti gadyate sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvavighnavināśanam
verses.translation: Thus I have told you the section on Pitrmedha which destroys sins and increases merit. Men with controlled mind should hear it attentively and recite the same during the period when the Sraddha is being performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I have told you the section on Pitrmedha which destroys sins and increases merit. Men with controlled mind should hear it attentively and recite the same during the period when the Sraddha is being performed.

verses.sanskrit: शेषतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदायकम् तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यन् मया परिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: śeṣatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yan mayā paribhāṣitam
verses.translation: Thus the Deities and Manes are to be duly worshipped by the householder by means of the Havya and Xavya offer¬ ings. The guests and kinsmen should be honoured with cooked rice. The living beings, the servants, animals, birds and even ants; the mendicants who beg for alms and all other travellers who come to the house are to be received hospitably. Brahmins observing the disciplined conduct of life of the good should be honoured by the good householder.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शेषो नाम महानागो रसातलपतिः प्रभुः सर्वनागैः परिवृतो रसातलम् अथाभ्यगात्
verses.transliteration: śeṣo nāma mahānāgo rasātalapatiḥ prabhuḥ sarvanāgaiḥ parivṛto rasātalam athābhyagāt
verses.translation: Good conduct should always be preserved by a house¬ holder. There is no welfare here or hereafter to one who is devoid of good conduct. Sacrifices, charitable gifts and austerities are not condu- • cive to the prosperity of the person who transgresses the rules A person who maintains good conduct attains the longe¬ vity of Brahma (?) Virtue and good conduct should always be maintained. Virtue is the symbol of good conduct.
verses.wordMeaning: Good conduct should always be preserved by a house¬ holder. There is no welfare here or hereafter to one who is devoid of good conduct. Sacrifices,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Good conduct should always be preserved by a house¬ holder. There is no welfare here or hereafter to one who is devoid of good conduct. Sacrifices,…
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसा दैत्यदनुजाः प्रविष्टा ये रसातलम् तैर् निरस्तो भोगिपतिर् माम् उवाचाथ विह्वलः
verses.transliteration: rākṣasā daityadanujāḥ praviṣṭā ye rasātalam tair nirasto bhogipatir mām uvācātha vihvalaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall avoid evil utterances, falsehoods and harsh words. He shall eschew ignoble scriptures, evil argu¬ ments and service of ignoble persons. One shall perform Homa both in the evening and in the morning, with perfect restraint over the self. He shall not see sunrise and sunset directly. The following activities should be performed in the forenoon Washing the teeth, applying collyrium, embellish¬ ing the hair, looking into the mirror and the Tarpana rite to the deities.
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, one shall avoid evil utterances, falsehoods and harsh words. He shall eschew ignoble scriptures, evil argu¬ ments and service of ignoble persons. One shall perform Homa both in the evening and in the morning, with perfect restraint over the self.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, one shall avoid evil utterances, falsehoods and harsh words. He shall eschew ignoble scriptures, evil argu¬ ments and service of ignoble persons. One shall perform Homa both in the evening and in the morning, with perfect restraint over the self.…

verses.sanskrit: रसातलं त्वया दत्तं राक्षसानां ममापि च ते मे स्थानं न दास्यन्ति तस्मात् त्वां शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ tvayā dattaṃ rākṣasānāṃ mamāpi ca te me sthānaṃ na dāsyanti tasmāt tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Faeces should not be discharged on the path leading to the ruial residences, holy centres and fields, nor in a ploughed field, nor in a cowpen. One shall not look at the naked wife of another man; one shall not look at one's own ordure. (One shall avoid) see- ing, touching and talking to a women in her menses. One shall not discharge urine or faeces into the waters (of a tank etc.). Nor should one indulge in sexual intercourse under water. One shall not stand on faeces and urine nor on hairs or ashes. One shall not stand over the sharp edge of any cutting instrument.
verses.wordMeaning: Faeces should not be discharged on the path leading to the ruial residences, holy centres and fields, nor in a ploughed field, nor in a cowpen. One shall not look at the naked wife of another man; one shall not look at one's own ordure. (One shall avoid) see- ing,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Faeces should not be discharged on the path leading to the ruial residences, holy centres and fields, nor in a ploughed field, nor in a cowpen. One shall not look at the naked wife of another man; one shall not look at one's own ordure. (One shall avoid) see- ing,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽहम् अब्रवं नागं गौतमीं याहि पन्नग तत्र स्तुत्वा महादेवं लप्स्यसे त्वं मनोरथम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'ham abravaṃ nāgaṃ gautamīṃ yāhi pannaga tatra stutvā mahādevaṃ lapsyase tvaṃ manoratham
verses.translation: An intelligent man shall not stand on scattered husk, burning coal, bits of ropes, clothes etc. on the road or in a ground. After performing the rite of worship of the Pitfs, Devas, human beings and other living beings, the householder deserves to take food in accordance with his affluence. After performing the Acamana rite, after restricting unnecessary talk, the man shall remain pure. He shall sit fac¬ ing the East or the North and take food with the mind therein. He shall keep the hands between the knees.
verses.wordMeaning: An intelligent man shall not stand on scattered husk, burning coal, bits of ropes, clothes etc. on the road or in a ground. After performing the rite of worship of the Pitfs, Devas, human beings and other living beings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: An intelligent man shall not stand on scattered husk, burning coal, bits of ropes, clothes etc. on the road or in a ground. After performing the rite of worship of the Pitfs, Devas, human beings and other living beings,…

verses.sanskrit: नान्यो ऽस्ति लोकत्रितये मनोरथसमर्पकः मद्वाक्यप्रेरितो नागो गङ्गाम् आप्लुत्य यत्नतः कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा तुष्टाव त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nānyo 'sti lokatritaye manorathasamarpakaḥ madvākyaprerito nāgo gaṅgām āplutya yatnataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā tuṣṭāva tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: Except in the case of utter destruction of food, the wise man shall not complain about the defects of food at the time of taking it. One shall avoid taking salt directly (i.e. salt should be mixed with food and then taken in). He shall avoid the leavings of food also. An intelligent man shall talk in a way favourable to them (i.e. elderly persons). He shall follow them. He shall not act against them. One shall avoid studying the Vedas during the holi¬ days. One shall never disregard or insult brahmins, fires, cows and the sun.
verses.wordMeaning: Except in the case of utter destruction of food, the wise man shall not complain about the defects of food at the time of taking it. One shall avoid taking salt directly (i.e. salt should be mixed with food and then taken in). He shall avoid the leavings of food also.…

verses.sanskrit: नमस् त्रैलोक्यनाथाय दक्षयज्ञविभेदिने आदिकर्त्रे नमस् तुभ्यं नमस् त्रैलोक्यरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: namas trailokyanāthāya dakṣayajñavibhedine ādikartre namas tubhyaṃ namas trailokyarūpiṇe
verses.translation: One shall discharge faeces and urine facing the north during the day and facing the south during the night. During distress he shall discharge them as he pleases. One shall not speak out the misdeeds of the precep¬ tor. If he is angry, one shall propitiate him. One shall not listen to others who slander him.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall discharge faeces and urine facing the north during the day and facing the south during the night. During distress he shall discharge them as he pleases. One shall not speak out the misdeeds of the precep¬ tor. If he is angry, one shall propitiate him.…

verses.sanskrit: नमः सहस्रशिरसे नमः संहारकारिणे सोमसूर्याग्निरूपाय जलरूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sahasraśirase namaḥ saṃhārakāriṇe somasūryāgnirūpāya jalarūpāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: One shall avoid taking oil bath or indulging j„ scxua, intercourse with women on the eighth, fourteenth and Bftecnth lunations as well as on Parvan days. No wise man shall ever stand with arms and upper leg A wise man should not drag a seat with his leg and sit thereon. One shall not prepare a cake of wheat flour or a dish of rice and peas mixed together or meat solely for oneself.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid taking oil bath or indulging j„ scxua, intercourse with women on the eighth, fourteenth and Bftecnth lunations as well as on Parvan days. No wise man shall ever stand with arms and upper leg A wise man should not drag a seat with his leg and sit thereon.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वरूपाय कालरूपाय ते नमः पाहि शंकर सर्वेश पाहि सोमेश सर्वग जगन्नाथ नमस् तुभ्यं देहि मे मनसेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvadā sarvarūpāya kālarūpāya te namaḥ pāhi śaṃkara sarveśa pāhi someśa sarvaga jagannātha namas tubhyaṃ dehi me manasepsitam
verses.translation: One shall never wear a red, or a black cloth nor one of variegated colour. No one shall exchange clothes or orna¬ ments (with others). A man shall never take in salt directly. O brahmins, a foodstuff that has been left over for a long time, that has be¬ come dry or that has become stale should be eschewed.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall never wear a red, or a black cloth nor one of variegated colour. No one shall exchange clothes or orna¬ ments (with others). A man shall never take in salt directly. O brahmins, a foodstuff that has been left over for a long time,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो महेश्वरः प्रीतः प्रादान् नागेप्सितान् वरान् विनाशाय सुरारीणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: tato maheśvaraḥ prītaḥ prādān nāgepsitān varān vināśāya surārīṇāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām
verses.translation: One shall not grind one's teeth, nor beat one's own body. While sleeping, meditating or taking food, one shall eschew the self-study of the Vedas. One shall protect one's wife. One shall avoid jealousy as well as sleeping and indulgence in sexual intercourse during the day. One shall eschew infliction of pain on animals, and all other activities that cause distress and sorrow to others. In the case of the people of all castes, a woman in her monthly course should be avoided for the first four nights. To prevent the birth of a female child, one shall avoid the fifth night also.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not grind one's teeth, nor beat one's own body. While sleeping, meditating or taking food, one shall eschew the self-study of the Vedas. One shall protect one's wife. One shall avoid jealousy as well as sleeping and indulgence in sexual intercourse during the day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not grind one's teeth, nor beat one's own body. While sleeping, meditating or taking food, one shall eschew the self-study of the Vedas. One shall protect one's wife. One shall avoid jealousy as well as sleeping and indulgence in sexual intercourse during the day.…

verses.transliteration: śeṣāya pradadau śūlaṃ jahy anenāripuṃgavān tataḥ proktaḥ śivenāsau śeṣaḥ śūlena bhogibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he shall carnally approach her on the sixth night or other excellent nights even in number. Boys will be Unrighteous persons indulge in sexual intercourse on Parvan and other days and impotent persons during dusk time. A clever man shall avoid Rikta days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he shall carnally approach her on the sixth night or other excellent nights even in number. Boys will be Unrighteous persons indulge in sexual intercourse on Parvan and other days and impotent persons during dusk time. A clever man shall avoid Rikta days.

verses.sanskrit: रसातलम् अथो गत्वा निजघान रिपून् रणे निहत्य नागः शूलेन दैत्यदानवराक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: rasātalam atho gatvā nijaghāna ripūn raṇe nihatya nāgaḥ śūlena daityadānavarākṣasān
verses.translation: Even if rude people speak a lot, one shall never lisen to them. After shaving, vomitting or sexual intercourse with a woman an intelligent person shall take bath along with the clothe worn. He shall take bath also after going to the cremation ground. One shall stand up while meeting friends, persons who are initiated, kings, religious students who have finished studies and become householders and the father-in-law. When they come to one's house one shall greet them in accordance with one's affluences.
verses.wordMeaning: Even if rude people speak a lot, one shall never lisen to them. After shaving, vomitting or sexual intercourse with a woman an intelligent person shall take bath along with the clothe worn. He shall take bath also after going to the cremation ground.…

verses.sanskrit: न्यवर्तत पुनर् देवो यत्र शेषेश्वरो हरः पथा येन समायातो देवं द्रष्टुं स नागराट्
verses.transliteration: nyavartata punar devo yatra śeṣeśvaro haraḥ pathā yena samāyāto devaṃ draṣṭuṃ sa nāgarāṭ
verses.translation: O brahmins, after honouring and worshipping them in accordance with his capacity he shall bid them farewell to their respective places, after they had stayed for a year. No shrewd man shall hold water and fire together. One shall not stretch one's legs in front of one's preceptors, Devas, Pitrs and brahmins.
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, after honouring and worshipping them in accordance with his capacity he shall bid them farewell to their respective places, after they had stayed for a year. No shrewd man shall hold water and fire together.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, after honouring and worshipping them in accordance with his capacity he shall bid them farewell to their respective places, after they had stayed for a year. No shrewd man shall hold water and fire together.…

verses.sanskrit: रसातलाद् यत्र देवो बिलं तत्र व्यजायत तस्माद् बिलतलाद् यातं गाङ्गं वार्य् अतिपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: rasātalād yatra devo bilaṃ tatra vyajāyata tasmād bilatalād yātaṃ gāṅgaṃ vāry atipuṇyadam
verses.translation: One should not look at a cow suckling her calf; one should not drink water with the palms joined together to form a cup; an intelligent man shall not cause delay in the short and long periods of cleaning. One shall not blow fire with the mouth. O brahmins, one should not stay in a place where the following four are not present, viz. one who offers debt; a physician, a brahmin well-versed in the Vedas and a river abound¬ ing in water. An intelligent man shall always stay there where the king is strong, interested in virtue and has conquered his ser¬ vants. Whence can one have happiness if the king is bad.
verses.wordMeaning: One should not look at a cow suckling her calf; one should not drink water with the palms joined together to form a cup; an intelligent man shall not cause delay in the short and long periods of cleaning. One shall not blow fire with the mouth. O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not look at a cow suckling her calf; one should not drink water with the palms joined together to form a cup; an intelligent man shall not cause delay in the short and long periods of cleaning. One shall not blow fire with the mouth. O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: तद् वारि गङ्गाम् अगमद् गङ्गायाः संगमस् ततः देवस्य पुरतश् चापि कुण्डं तत्र सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tad vāri gaṅgām agamad gaṅgāyāḥ saṃgamas tataḥ devasya purataś cāpi kuṇḍaṃ tatra suvistaram
verses.translation: A shrewd man shall live in that country where the husbandmen are generally not very arrogant* and where all medi¬ cines are available. O brahmins, one shall not stay in that place where the following three exist together: one who is eager to conquer; a previous enemy and people who continuously celebrate the festivals.
verses.wordMeaning: A shrewd man shall live in that country where the husbandmen are generally not very arrogant* and where all medi¬ cines are available. O brahmins, one shall not stay in that place where the following three exist together: one who is eager to conquer;…
verses.commentary: Sense: A shrewd man shall live in that country where the husbandmen are generally not very arrogant* and where all medi¬ cines are available. O brahmins, one shall not stay in that place where the following three exist together: one who is eager to conquer;…

verses.sanskrit: नागस् तत्राकरोद् धोमं यत्र चाग्निः सदा स्थितः सोष्णं तद् अभवद् वारि गङ्गायास् तत्र संगमः
verses.transliteration: nāgas tatrākarod dhomaṃ yatra cāgniḥ sadā sthitaḥ soṣṇaṃ tad abhavad vāri gaṅgāyās tatra saṃgamaḥ
verses.translation: A learned man shall stay among his fellow travellers of very good conduct. One shall always stay at a place where the king cannot be thwarted and where the earth yields plenty of vegetables. Thus, O brahmins, everything has been mentioned by me for the welfare of you all. Henceforth I shall state the rules of procedure regarding the food-intake. Cooked rice, though stale, can be taken in if it is soak¬ ed in oil. It can be kept thus for a long time. Wheat products, barley products and milk products, kept for a long time can be eaten even if they are devoid of oiliness.
verses.wordMeaning: A learned man shall stay among his fellow travellers of very good conduct. One shall always stay at a place where the king cannot be thwarted and where the earth yields plenty of vegetables. Thus, O brahmins, everything has been mentioned by me for the welfare of you all.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man shall stay among his fellow travellers of very good conduct. One shall always stay at a place where the king cannot be thwarted and where the earth yields plenty of vegetables. Thus, O brahmins, everything has been mentioned by me for the welfare of you all.…

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवं समाराध्य नागः प्रीतो महायशाः रसातलं ततो ऽभीष्टं शिवात् प्राप्य तलं ययौ
verses.transliteration: devadevaṃ samārādhya nāgaḥ prīto mahāyaśāḥ rasātalaṃ tato 'bhīṣṭaṃ śivāt prāpya talaṃ yayau
verses.translation: The following can be eaten: hare, tortoise, alliga¬ tor, porcupine and the fish with darts (?) The village boar and the cock should be avoided. In the following circumstances, even if one eats meat, one is not defiled: if it is the remnant/ of offerings unto the Pitrs, Devas etc. or if it is cooked in Sraddha at the request of the brahmins and is sprinkled with holy water or if it is taken as a medicine.
verses.wordMeaning: The following can be eaten: hare, tortoise, alliga¬ tor, porcupine and the fish with darts (?) The village boar and the cock should be avoided. In the following circumstances, even if one eats meat, one is not defiled: if it is the remnant/ of offerings unto the Pitrs,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं नागतीर्थम् उदाहृतम् सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं रोगदारिद्र्यनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ nāgatīrtham udāhṛtam sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ rogadāridryanāśanam
verses.translation: The cleansing of stony vessels may be with water or by scrubbing with a stone. The cleansing of oily vessels is by means of hot water. The flowing waters devoid of odour are pure. A plot of land becomes pure by the efflux of time, by being burnt, by being swept or when herds of cows pass over it. One shall take bath in natural water reservoirs (lite¬ rally, those dug by gods), in eddies and Ganga (and other) rivers.
verses.wordMeaning: The cleansing of stony vessels may be with water or by scrubbing with a stone. The cleansing of oily vessels is by means of hot water. The flowing waters devoid of odour are pure. A plot of land becomes pure by the efflux of time, by being burnt,…

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्लक्ष्मीकरं पुण्यं स्नानदानाच् च मुक्तिदम् शृणुयाद् वा पठेद् भक्त्या यो वापि स्मरते तु तत्
verses.transliteration: āyurlakṣmīkaraṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānāc ca muktidam śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed bhaktyā yo vāpi smarate tu tat
verses.translation: (In similar circumstances) a Ksatriya shall remain without performing the Nitya rites for twelve days, a Vaisyafor half a month and a Sudra for a month. After the rite of Sancayana (collection of bones after cremation) the touch of their limbs is laid down in the Sastras. The rites should be performed by the members of the Gotra, after the rite of Sancayana.
verses.wordMeaning: (In similar circumstances) a Ksatriya shall remain without performing the Nitya rites for twelve days, a Vaisyafor half a month and a Sudra for a month. After the rite of Sancayana (collection of bones after cremation) the touch of their limbs is laid down in the Sastras.…

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं शेषेश्वरो यत्र यत्र शक्तिप्रदः शिवः एकविंशतितीर्थानाम् उभयोस् तत्र तीरयोः शतानि मुनिशार्दूल सर्वसंपत्प्रदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ śeṣeśvaro yatra yatra śaktipradaḥ śivaḥ ekaviṃśatitīrthānām ubhayos tatra tīrayoḥ śatāni muniśārdūla sarvasaṃpatpradāyinām
verses.translation: Thereafter the rite of Ekoddista Sraddha should be performed by learned men in regard to the dead man and gifts should be given to the brahmins. When the days are completed the people shall touch water by their vehicles and weapons. After giving water liba¬ tions and Pindas to the dead men people of all castes would have fulfilled all their due rites. They shall perform all rites maintaining purity for prosperity here and hereafter. The Vedas should be studied everyday. One should try to be a learned scholar.
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the rite of Ekoddista Sraddha should be performed by learned men in regard to the dead man and gifts should be given to the brahmins. When the days are completed the people shall touch water by their vehicles and weapons.…

verses.sanskrit: महानलम् इति ख्यातं वडवानलम् उच्यते महानलो यत्र देवो वडवा यत्र सा नदी
verses.transliteration: mahānalam iti khyātaṃ vaḍavānalam ucyate mahānalo yatra devo vaḍavā yatra sā nadī
verses.translation: O holy one, we wish to hear about the special duties of different castes. O excellent brahmin, recount the duties of four Asramas also.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy one, we wish to hear about the special duties of different castes. O excellent brahmin, recount the duties of four Asramas also.

verses.sanskrit: तत् तीर्थं पुत्र वक्ष्यामि मृत्युदोषजरापहम् पुरासन् नैमिषारण्ये ऋषयः सत्त्रकारिणः
verses.transliteration: tat tīrthaṃ putra vakṣyāmi mṛtyudoṣajarāpaham purāsan naimiṣāraṇye ṛṣayaḥ sattrakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Listen with restraint to the duties of different castes, Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras in due order as they are being recounted by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen with restraint to the duties of different castes, Brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras in due order as they are being recounted by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शमितारं च ऋषयो मृत्युं चक्रुस् तपस्विनः वर्तमाने सत्त्रयागे मृत्यौ शमितरि स्थिते
verses.transliteration: śamitāraṃ ca ṛṣayo mṛtyuṃ cakrus tapasvinaḥ vartamāne sattrayāge mṛtyau śamitari sthite
verses.translation: A Brahmin shall be devoted to (the practice of) sympathy, charitable gift, austerities, sacrifice unto the gods and study of his own branch of the Vedas. He shall regularly perform water libations. He shall maintain sacrificial fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmin shall be devoted to (the practice of) sympathy, charitable gift, austerities, sacrifice unto the gods and study of his own branch of the Vedas. He shall regularly perform water libations. He shall maintain sacrificial fires.

verses.sanskrit: न ममार तदा कश्चिद् उभयं स्थास्नु जङ्गमम् विना पशून् मुनिश्रेष्ठ मर्त्यं चामर्त्यतां गतम्
verses.transliteration: na mamāra tadā kaścid ubhayaṃ sthāsnu jaṅgamam vinā paśūn muniśreṣṭha martyaṃ cāmartyatāṃ gatam
verses.translation: For his livelihood he shall perform sacrifices on behalf of others. He shall teach Vedic lore to the twice-born. O brahmins, for performing sacrifices he shall accept monetary gifts with discretion.
verses.commentary: Sense: For his livelihood he shall perform sacrifices on behalf of others. He shall teach Vedic lore to the twice-born. O brahmins, for performing sacrifices he shall accept monetary gifts with discretion.

verses.sanskrit: ततस् त्रिविष्टपे शून्ये मर्त्ये चैवातिसंभृते मृत्युनोपेक्षिते देवा राक्षसान् ऊचिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: tatas triviṣṭape śūnye martye caivātisaṃbhṛte mṛtyunopekṣite devā rākṣasān ūcire tadā
verses.translation: O brahmins, he shall do everything beneficial to the world. He shall not perform what is detrimental to anyone. Friendliness to all living beings is the excellent asset of a Brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he shall do everything beneficial to the world. He shall not perform what is detrimental to anyone. Friendliness to all living beings is the excellent asset of a Brahmin.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वम् ऋषिसत्त्रं तन् नाशयध्वं महाध्वरम् इति देववचः श्रुत्वा प्रोचुस् ते राक्षसाः सुरान्
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvam ṛṣisattraṃ tan nāśayadhvaṃ mahādhvaram iti devavacaḥ śrutvā procus te rākṣasāḥ surān
verses.translation: O brahmins, he shall view a cow and another man's precious gem as equal. O brahmins, his carnal approach to his wife during the permissible period after the days of mens¬ truation, is commended.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he shall view a cow and another man's precious gem as equal. O brahmins, his carnal approach to his wife during the permissible period after the days of mens¬ truation, is commended.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विध्वंसयामस् तं यज्ञम् अस्माकं किं फलं ततः प्रवर्तते विना हेतुं न कोपि क्वापि जातुचित्
verses.transliteration: vidhvaṃsayāmas taṃ yajñam asmākaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tataḥ pravartate vinā hetuṃ na kopi kvāpi jātucit
verses.translation: A Ksatnya shall give charitable gifts to the brahmins as much as they wish. O brahmins, he should perform different sacrifices and read the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Ksatnya shall give charitable gifts to the brahmins as much as they wish. O brahmins, he should perform different sacrifices and read the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवा अप्य् असुरान् ऊचुर् यज्ञार्धं भवताम् अपि भवेद् एव ततो यान्तु ऋषीणां सत्त्रम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: devā apy asurān ūcur yajñārdhaṃ bhavatām api bhaved eva tato yāntu ṛṣīṇāṃ sattram uttamam
verses.translation: He shall maintain himself through his weapons. Protec¬ tion of Earth is his excellent means of livelihood. Sustenance of Earth is his primary duty.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall maintain himself through his weapons. Protec¬ tion of Earth is his excellent means of livelihood. Sustenance of Earth is his primary duty.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ते श्रुत्वा त्वरिताः सर्वे यत्र यज्ञः प्रवर्तते जग्मुस् तत्र विनाशाय देववाक्याद् विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: te śrutvā tvaritāḥ sarve yatra yajñaḥ pravartate jagmus tatra vināśāya devavākyād viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Rulers of men (kings) are content only by due sus¬ tenance of the Earth, since the protection of the king himself is accomplished by such holy rites as sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rulers of men (kings) are content only by due sus¬ tenance of the Earth, since the protection of the king himself is accomplished by such holy rites as sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तज् ज्ञात्वा ऋषयो मृत्युम् आहुः किं कुर्महे वयम् आगता देववचनाद् राक्षसा यज्ञनाशिनः
verses.transliteration: taj jñātvā ṛṣayo mṛtyum āhuḥ kiṃ kurmahe vayam āgatā devavacanād rākṣasā yajñanāśinaḥ
verses.translation: For him the following activities tnn..
verses.commentary: Sense: For him the following activities tnn..
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युना सह संमन्त्र्य नैमिषारण्यवासिनः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा स्वाश्रमं तं शमित्रा सह नारद
verses.transliteration: mṛtyunā saha saṃmantrya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ sarve tyaktvā svāśramaṃ taṃ śamitrā saha nārada
verses.translation: In times of adversity the vocation of a Ksatriya or a Vaisya is recommended for a Brahmin; the vocation of a Vais'ya to a Ksatriya and the jobs of a Sudra to both Ksatriyas and Vaisya s.
verses.commentary: Sense: In times of adversity the vocation of a Ksatriya or a Vaisya is recommended for a Brahmin; the vocation of a Vais'ya to a Ksatriya and the jobs of a Sudra to both Ksatriyas and Vaisya s.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमात्रम् उपादाय त्यक्त्वा पात्रादिकं तु यत् क्रतुनिष्पत्तये जग्मुर् गौतमीं प्रति सत्वराः
verses.transliteration: agnimātram upādāya tyaktvā pātrādikaṃ tu yat kratuniṣpattaye jagmur gautamīṃ prati satvarāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, in case of incompetence that shall be avoided. That alone shall be pursued during adversity, but chaotic mixing up of jobs shall not be effected.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in case of incompetence that shall be avoided. That alone shall be pursued during adversity, but chaotic mixing up of jobs shall not be effected.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महेशानं रक्षणायोपतस्थिरे कृताञ्जलिपुटास् ते तु तुष्टुवुस् त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā maheśānaṃ rakṣaṇāyopatasthire kṛtāñjalipuṭās te tu tuṣṭuvus tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: Thus, O brahmins, the duties of a Brahmin have been mentioned by me. Understand now the respective duties of the people of various stages of life even as I explain them well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O brahmins, the duties of a Brahmin have been mentioned by me. Understand now the respective duties of the people of various stages of life even as I explain them well.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो लीलया विश्वम् इदं चकार धाता विधाता भुवनत्रयस्य यो विश्वरूपः सदसत्परो यः सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामः
verses.transliteration: yo līlayā viśvam idaṃ cakāra dhātā vidhātā bhuvanatrayasya yo viśvarūpaḥ sadasatparo yaḥ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, with concentration and purity of mind lie shall make obeisance to the sun-god and fire-god at dawn as well as at dusk. He shall salute the preceptor too.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, with concentration and purity of mind lie shall make obeisance to the sun-god and fire-god at dawn as well as at dusk. He shall salute the preceptor too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इच्छामात्रेण यः सर्वं हन्ति पाति करोति च तम् अहं त्रिदशेशानं शरणं यामि शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: icchāmātreṇa yaḥ sarvaṃ hanti pāti karoti ca tam ahaṃ tridaśeśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he shall stand when the pre¬ ceptor remains standing. He shall follow when the preceptor goes ahead. When the teacher is seated he shall be seated on a lower level. He shall avoid what is contrary to the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, he shall stand when the pre¬ ceptor remains standing. He shall follow when the preceptor goes ahead. When the teacher is seated he shall be seated on a lower level. He shall avoid what is contrary to the preceptor.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महानलं महाकायं महानागविभूषणम् महामूर्तिधरं देवं शरणं यामि शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: mahānalaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahānāgavibhūṣaṇam mahāmūrtidharaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram
verses.translation: He shall sit in front of him. Without his mind dwelling on anything else he shall repeat the Vedic text recited by the preceptor. Thereafter, on being permitted by him, he shall partake of the cooked food received as alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall sit in front of him. Without his mind dwelling on anything else he shall repeat the Vedic text recited by the preceptor. Thereafter, on being permitted by him, he shall partake of the cooked food received as alms.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् मृत्यो का प्रीतिर् अस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca bhagavān mṛtyo kā prītir astu te
verses.translation: He shall take bath in the water wherein the preceptor has taken bath. Early in the morning everyday he shall fetch water for libation and sacrificial twigs for the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall take bath in the water wherein the preceptor has taken bath. Early in the morning everyday he shall fetch water for libation and sacrificial twigs for the preceptor.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसेभ्यो भयं घोरम् आपन्नं त्रिदशेश्वर यज्ञम् अस्मांश् च रक्षस्व यावत् सत्त्रं समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: rākṣasebhyo bhayaṃ ghoram āpannaṃ tridaśeśvara yajñam asmāṃś ca rakṣasva yāvat sattraṃ samāpyate
verses.translation: Having learnt the requisite Vedic texts he shall pay fees to his preceptor. On getting his permission he shall enter the stage of a householder. He shall duly acquire a wife. O brahmins, after earning wealth by his own work he shall perform the duties of a householder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having learnt the requisite Vedic texts he shall pay fees to his preceptor. On getting his permission he shall enter the stage of a householder. He shall duly acquire a wife. O brahmins, after earning wealth by his own work he shall perform the duties of a householder.

verses.sanskrit: तथा चकार भगवांस् त्रिनेत्रो वृषभध्वजः शमित्रा मृत्युना सत्त्रम् ऋषीणां पूर्णतां ययौ
verses.transliteration: tathā cakāra bhagavāṃs trinetro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ śamitrā mṛtyunā sattram ṛṣīṇāṃ pūrṇatāṃ yayau
verses.translation: The recluses and religious students who sustain them- selves by cooked food received as alms depend on the householder. Hence the stage of householder is the noblest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The recluses and religious students who sustain them- selves by cooked food received as alms depend on the householder. Hence the stage of householder is the noblest.

verses.sanskrit: हविषां भागधेयाय आजग्मुर् अमराः क्रमात् तान् अवोचन् मुनिगणाः संक्षुब्धा मृत्युना सह
verses.transliteration: haviṣāṃ bhāgadheyāya ājagmur amarāḥ kramāt tān avocan munigaṇāḥ saṃkṣubdhā mṛtyunā saha
verses.translation: For a householder the following arc despicable: Dishonouring (others), egotism, arrogance, slandering, attacking and speaking harsh words to others. At a ripe old age, O brahmins, the householder who has duly fulfilled his duties shall entrust his sons with the duty of looking after his wife and himself retire and go to the forest. Or he can allow his wife to accompany him.
verses.wordMeaning: For a householder the following arc despicable: Dishonouring (others), egotism, arrogance, slandering, attacking and speaking harsh words to others. At a ripe old age, O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For a householder the following arc despicable: Dishonouring (others), egotism, arrogance, slandering, attacking and speaking harsh words to others. At a ripe old age, O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्मन्मखविनाशाय राक्षसाः प्रेषिता यतः तस्माद् भवद्भ्यः पापिष्ठा राक्षसाः सन्तु शत्रवः
verses.transliteration: asmanmakhavināśāya rākṣasāḥ preṣitā yataḥ tasmād bhavadbhyaḥ pāpiṣṭhā rākṣasāḥ santu śatravaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, his wearing apparel and upper garment shall consist of leather, Darbha grass or Kasa plants. Taking head bath thrice a day (in rivers or lakes) is recommen¬ ded for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, his wearing apparel and upper garment shall consist of leather, Darbha grass or Kasa plants. Taking head bath thrice a day (in rivers or lakes) is recommen¬ ded for him.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवानां राक्षसा वैरिणो ऽभवन् कृत्यां च वडवां तत्र देवाश् च ऋषयो ऽमलाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti devānāṃ rākṣasā vairiṇo 'bhavan kṛtyāṃ ca vaḍavāṃ tatra devāś ca ṛṣayo 'malāḥ
verses.translation: The following are highly recommended in his case: Worship of the deities, offering ghee into the fire, greeting and honouring visitors and guests, begging alms and offering oblations. Massaging his limbs by means of oil obtained from forest products is also commended. O leading brahmins, ability to bear the extremes of chilliness and heat is a form of penance unto him.
verses.wordMeaning: The following are highly recommended in his case: Worship of the deities, offering ghee into the fire, greeting and honouring visitors and guests, begging alms and offering oblations. Massaging his limbs by means of oil obtained from forest products is also commended.…

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योर् भार्या भव त्वं ताम् इत्य् उक्त्वा ते ऽभ्यषेचयन् अभिषेकोदकं यत् तु सा नदी वडवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyor bhāryā bhava tvaṃ tām ity uktvā te 'bhyaṣecayan abhiṣekodakaṃ yat tu sā nadī vaḍavābhavat
verses.translation: The forest-dwelling recluse who ■ regularly preforms
verses.commentary: Sense: The forest-dwelling recluse who ■ regularly preforms

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युना स्थापितं लिङ्गं महानलम् इति श्रुतम् ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं वडवासंगमं विदुः
verses.transliteration: mṛtyunā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ mahānalam iti śrutam tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ vaḍavāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: O excellent ones, follow me even as I O excellent brahmins, a mendicant shall., affection and attacliment unto his sons wife mri * eschew

verses.transliteration: mahānalo yatra devas tat tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktidam sahasraṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinām ubhayos tīrayos tatra smaraṇād aghaghātinām
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he shall leave off th~.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं नृणाम् तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि यत्र ज्ञानेश्वरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: ātmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi yatra jñāneśvaraḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmins fall off from their status by performing evil deeds. For the same reason one is forced down again even after attaining the most excellent of castes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: datta ity api vikhyātaḥ so 'triputro harapriyaḥ durvāsasaḥ priyo bhrātā sarvajñānaviśāradaḥ sa gatvā pitaraṃ prāha vinayena praṇamya ca
verses.translation: One who adheres to the characteristics of a Brahmin, whether a Ksatriya or a Vaisya, attains Brahminhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who adheres to the characteristics of a Brahmin, whether a Ksatriya or a Vaisya, attains Brahminhood.

verses.transliteration: brahmajñānaṃ kathaṃ me syāt kaṃ pṛcchāmi kva yāmi ca
verses.translation: He who forsakes brahminhood and resorts to the acti¬ vities and features of a Ksatriya incurs a downfall from the status of a Brahmin and is bom of a Ksatriya womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who forsakes brahminhood and resorts to the acti¬ vities and features of a Ksatriya incurs a downfall from the status of a Brahmin and is bom of a Ksatriya womb.

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वात्रिः पुत्रवाक्यं ध्यात्वा वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvātriḥ putravākyaṃ dhyātvā vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: O goddess, this too, another thing pertaining to the Atman has been cited by Brahma. Eternal achievement is re¬ sorted to by those who are desirous of righteous activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, this too, another thing pertaining to the Atman has been cited by Brahma. Eternal achievement is re¬ sorted to by those who are desirous of righteous activities.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं पुत्र गच्छ त्वं तत्र स्तुहि महेश्वरम् स तु प्रीतो यदैव स्यात् तदा ज्ञानम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ putra gaccha tvaṃ tatra stuhi maheśvaram sa tu prīto yadaiva syāt tadā jñānam avāpsyasi
verses.translation: O goddess, the food cooked by the mixed caste Ugra is despicable. The food collectively cooked, the food pertaining to Sraddha, the food defiled by pollution due to the birth or death of someone in the family and the food that is loudly proclaim¬ ed should not be eaten. The food cooked by a Sfidra should never be eaten.

verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, the food cooked by the mixed caste Ugra is despicable. The food collectively cooked, the food pertaining to Sraddha, the food defiled by pollution due to the birth or death of someone in the family and the food that is loudly proclaim¬ ed should not be eaten.…

verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā tadātreyo gaṅgāṃ gatvā śucir yataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram
verses.translation: he food cooked by a Sudra is despised by gods and noble men, O goddess. That which is uttered by Brahma is authoritative.
verses.commentary: Sense: he food cooked by a Sudra is despised by gods and noble men, O goddess. That which is uttered by Brahma is authoritative.

verses.sanskrit: संसारकूपे पतितो ऽस्मि दैवान् मोहेन गुप्तो भवदुःखपङ्के अज्ञाननाम्ना तमसावृतो ऽहं परं न विन्दामि सुराधिनाथ
verses.transliteration: saṃsārakūpe patito 'smi daivān mohena gupto bhavaduḥkhapaṅke ajñānanāmnā tamasāvṛto 'haṃ paraṃ na vindāmi surādhinātha
verses.translation: A Brahmin, a person who maintains sacrificial fires and one who performs sacrifice attain the goal of Sudras if they were to die with the remnants of the food cooked by a Sudra within the stomach.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmin, a person who maintains sacrificial fires and one who performs sacrifice attain the goal of Sudras if they were to die with the remnants of the food cooked by a Sudra within the stomach.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नस् त्रिशूलेन बलीयसाहं पापेन चिन्ताक्षुरपाटितश् च तप्तो ऽस्मि पञ्चेन्द्रियतीव्रतापैः श्रान्तो ऽस्मि संतारय सोमनाथ
verses.transliteration: bhinnas triśūlena balīyasāhaṃ pāpena cintākṣurapāṭitaś ca tapto 'smi pañcendriyatīvratāpaiḥ śrānto 'smi saṃtāraya somanātha
verses.translation: A Brahmin, who has been ousted from Brahma's abode by the remnants of food cooked by a Sudra attains the state of a Sudra. This is certain.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmin, who has been ousted from Brahma's abode by the remnants of food cooked by a Sudra attains the state of a Sudra. This is certain.

verses.sanskrit: बद्धो ऽस्मि दारिद्र्यमयैश् च बन्धैर् हतो ऽस्मि रोगानलतीव्रतापैः क्रान्तो ऽस्म्य् अहं मृत्युभुजंगमेन भीतो भृशं किं करवाणि शंभो
verses.transliteration: baddho 'smi dāridryamayaiś ca bandhair hato 'smi rogānalatīvratāpaiḥ krānto 'smy ahaṃ mṛtyubhujaṃgamena bhīto bhṛśaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi śaṃbho
verses.translation: A Brahmin takes birth in the womb of a lady of the same caste as the person whose food he uses for sustenance or the remnants of whose food remain undigested in his stomach at the time of his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmin takes birth in the womb of a lady of the same caste as the person whose food he uses for sustenance or the remnants of whose food remain undigested in his stomach at the time of his death.

verses.sanskrit: भवाभवाभ्याम् अतिपीडितो ऽहं तृष्णाक्षुधाभ्यां च रजस्तमोभ्याम् ईदृक्षया जरया चाभिभूतः पश्यावस्थां कृपया मे ऽद्य नाथ
verses.transliteration: bhavābhavābhyām atipīḍito 'haṃ tṛṣṇākṣudhābhyāṃ ca rajastamobhyām īdṛkṣayā jarayā cābhibhūtaḥ paśyāvasthāṃ kṛpayā me 'dya nātha
verses.translation: After happily attaining the rare privilege of being born as a Brahmin, if anyone slights it or if he partakes of forbidden food, he falls off from the status of a Brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: After happily attaining the rare privilege of being born as a Brahmin, if anyone slights it or if he partakes of forbidden food, he falls off from the status of a Brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: कामेन कोपेन च मत्सरेण दम्भेन दर्पादिभिर् अप्य् अनेकैः एकैकशः कष्टगतो ऽस्मि विद्धस् त्वं नाथवद् वारय नाथ शत्रून्
verses.transliteration: kāmena kopena ca matsareṇa dambhena darpādibhir apy anekaiḥ ekaikaśaḥ kaṣṭagato 'smi viddhas tvaṃ nāthavad vāraya nātha śatrūn
verses.translation: A Brahmin who defiles the bed of his preceptor, who hates his preceptor, who delights in despising his preceptor or who is hostile to Brahmins, falls from Brahminical birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmin who defiles the bed of his preceptor, who hates his preceptor, who delights in despising his preceptor or who is hostile to Brahmins, falls from Brahminical birth.

verses.sanskrit: कस्यापि कश्चित् पतितस्य पुंसो दुःखप्रणोदी भवतीति सत्यम् विना भवन्तं मम सोमनाथ कुत्रापि कारुण्यवचो ऽपि नास्ति
verses.transliteration: kasyāpi kaścit patitasya puṃso duḥkhapraṇodī bhavatīti satyam vinā bhavantaṃ mama somanātha kutrāpi kāruṇyavaco 'pi nāsti
verses.translation: O goddess, by preforming these splendid holy rites a Sudra attains Brahminhood and a Vaisya the status of a Ksatriya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, by preforming these splendid holy rites a Sudra attains Brahminhood and a Vaisya the status of a Ksatriya.

verses.sanskrit: तावत् स कोपो भयमोहदुःखान्य् अज्ञानदारिद्र्यरुजस् तथैव कामादयो मृत्युर् अपीह यावन् नमः शिवायेति न वच्मि वाक्यम्
verses.transliteration: tāvat sa kopo bhayamohaduḥkhāny ajñānadāridryarujas tathaiva kāmādayo mṛtyur apīha yāvan namaḥ śivāyeti na vacmi vākyam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, a virtuous Vaisya shall become a Ksa¬ triya by performing his own duties. By the fruits of these acti¬ vities of a lower birth he can become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मे ऽस्ति धर्मो न च मे ऽस्ति भक्तिर् नाहं विवेकी करुणा कुतो मे दातासि तेनाशु शरण्य चित्ते निधेहि सोमेति पदं मदीये
verses.transliteration: na me 'sti dharmo na ca me 'sti bhaktir nāhaṃ vivekī karuṇā kuto me dātāsi tenāśu śaraṇya citte nidhehi someti padaṃ madīye
verses.translation: "I have no dharma, no devotion, no discrimination — whence compassion in me? You are the giver; therefore, O refuge, quickly place the word 'Soma' in my mind.

verses.sanskrit: याचे न चाहं सुरभूपतित्वं हृत्पद्ममध्ये मम सोमनाथ श्रीसोमपादाम्बुजसंनिधानं याचे विचार्यैव च तत् कुरुष्व
verses.transliteration: yāce na cāhaṃ surabhūpatitvaṃ hṛtpadmamadhye mama somanātha śrīsomapādāmbujasaṃnidhānaṃ yāce vicāryaiva ca tat kuruṣva
verses.translation: I do not ask to be king of the gods; I ask, O Somanatha, for the presence of Shri Soma's lotus feet in the midst of my heart-lotus; consider it and do so.

verses.sanskrit: यथा तवाहं विदितो ऽस्मि पापस् तथापि विज्ञापनम् आशृणुष्व संश्रूयते यत्र वचः शिवेति तत्र स्थितिः स्यान् मम सोमनाथ
verses.transliteration: yathā tavāhaṃ vidito 'smi pāpas tathāpi vijñāpanam āśṛṇuṣva saṃśrūyate yatra vacaḥ śiveti tatra sthitiḥ syān mama somanātha
verses.translation: You know how sinful I am, yet hear my request: where the word 'Shiva' is heard, there may my dwelling be, O Somanatha.

verses.sanskrit: गौरीपते शंकर सोमनाथ विश्वेश कारुण्यनिधे ऽखिलात्मन् संस्तूयते यत्र सदेति तत्र केषाम् अपि स्यात् कृतिनां निवासः
verses.transliteration: gaurīpate śaṃkara somanātha viśveśa kāruṇyanidhe 'khilātman saṃstūyate yatra sadeti tatra keṣām api syāt kṛtināṃ nivāsaḥ
verses.translation: O husband of Gauri, Shankara, Somanatha, lord of the universe, treasury of compassion, self of all — where you are always praised, there may some accomplished ones dwell."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् आत्रेयस्तुतिं श्रुत्वा तुतोष भगवान् हरः वरदो ऽस्मीति तं प्राह योगिनं विश्वकृद् भवः
verses.transliteration: ity ātreyastutiṃ śrutvā tutoṣa bhagavān haraḥ varado 'smīti taṃ prāha yoginaṃ viśvakṛd bhavaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing this hymn of Atreya, the Lord Hara was pleased; Bhava, maker of the universe, said to the yogin, "I am the giver of boons."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: ātmajñānaṃ ca muktiṃ ca bhuktiṃ ca vipulāṃ tvayi tīrthasyāpi ca māhātmyaṃ varo 'yaṃ tridaśārcita
verses.translation: "Knowledge of the self, liberation and abundant enjoyment in you, and the greatness of the holy place too — this is the boon, O one worshipped by the gods."

verses.transliteration: evam astv iti taṃ śaṃbhur uktvā cāntaradhīyata tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham ātmatīrthaṃ vidur budhāḥ tatra snānena dānena muktiḥ syād iha nārada
verses.translation: Saying "So be it" to him, Shambhu vanished. From then on the wise know that holy place as Atmatirtha; by bathing and giving there, liberation comes here, O Narada.

verses.translation: O lord of all living beings, O lord saluted by Devas and

verses.transliteration: purā tv agastyo bhagavān dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ prabhuḥ devais tu preritaḥ pūrvaṃ vindhyasya prārthanaṃ prati
verses.translation: All embodied beings are bound by three kinds of bonds, viz. thought, speech and physical action. How are they released therefrom?
verses.commentary: Sense: All embodied beings are bound by three kinds of bonds, viz. thought, speech and physical action. How are they released therefrom?

verses.transliteration: sa śanair vindhyam abhyāgāt sahasramunibhir vṛtaḥ tam āgatya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ bahuvṛkṣasamākulam
verses.translation: O lord, by what habitual practice, by what holy rite, by what sort of conduct and good quality do men go to heaven? MaheSvara said:

verses.sanskrit: स्पर्धिनं मेरुभानुभ्यां विन्ध्यं शृङ्गशतैर् वृतम् अत्युन्नतं नगं धीरो लोपामुद्रापतिर् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: spardhinaṃ merubhānubhyāṃ vindhyaṃ śṛṅgaśatair vṛtam atyunnataṃ nagaṃ dhīro lopāmudrāpatir muniḥ
verses.translation: O goddess Uma of perfect v knowledge of the principles of piety, O gentle lady of permanent adherence to virtue, your question is conducive to welfare and wisdom of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess Uma of perfect v knowledge of the principles of piety, O gentle lady of permanent adherence to virtue, your question is conducive to welfare and wisdom of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: कृतातिथ्यो द्विजैः सार्धं प्रशस्य च नगं पुनः इदम् आह मुनिश्रेष्ठो देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: kṛtātithyo dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ praśasya ca nagaṃ punaḥ idam āha muniśreṣṭho devakāryārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: Persons of tranquillity, engaged in truth and piety and devoid of all external symbols are free from doubts. They are fettered neither by piety nor by blasphemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons of tranquillity, engaged in truth and piety and devoid of all external symbols are free from doubts. They are fettered neither by piety nor by blasphemy.

verses.sanskrit: अहं यामि नगश्रेष्ठ मुनिभिस् तत्त्वदर्शिभिः तीर्थयात्रां करोमीति दक्षिणाशां व्रजाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ yāmi nagaśreṣṭha munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ tīrthayātrāṃ karomīti dakṣiṇāśāṃ vrajāmy aham
verses.translation: Those persons who are omniscient, who are conversant with the principles of creation and annihilation, who see every¬ thing and who are devoid of passionate attachment are released from the bonds of Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those persons who are omniscient, who are conversant with the principles of creation and annihilation, who see every¬ thing and who are devoid of passionate attachment are released from the bonds of Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: देहि मार्गं नगपते आतिथ्यं देहि याचते यावद् आगमनं मे स्यात् स्थातव्यं तावद् एव हि
verses.transliteration: dehi mārgaṃ nagapate ātithyaṃ dehi yācate yāvad āgamanaṃ me syāt sthātavyaṃ tāvad eva hi
verses.translation: Those who do not injure anything whatsoever, men¬ tally, verbally or physically, those who are not involved in any¬ thing, are not bound by Karmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not injure anything whatsoever, men¬ tally, verbally or physically, those who are not involved in any¬ thing, are not bound by Karmans.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यथा भवितव्यं ते तथेत्य् आह नगोत्तमः आक्रामन् दक्षिणाम् आशां तैर् वृतो मुनिभिर् मुनिः
verses.transliteration: nānyathā bhavitavyaṃ te tathety āha nagottamaḥ ākrāman dakṣiṇām āśāṃ tair vṛto munibhir muniḥ
verses.translation: Those who refrain from violence to lives, who possess good conduct and mercifulness, and who are equally amiable to others' hatred and love are released from the bondage of Karmans. They have self-control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who refrain from violence to lives, who possess good conduct and mercifulness, and who are equally amiable to others' hatred and love are released from the bondage of Karmans. They have self-control.

verses.sanskrit: शनैः स गौतमीम् आगात् सत्त्रयागाय दीक्षितः यावत् संवत्सरं सत्त्रम् अकरोद् ऋषिभिर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: śanaiḥ sa gautamīm āgāt sattrayāgāya dīkṣitaḥ yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ sattram akarod ṛṣibhir vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are merciful toliving beings, who are worthy of being trusted by living creatures and who have eschewed violent activities go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are merciful toliving beings, who are worthy of being trusted by living creatures and who have eschewed violent activities go to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कैटभस्य सुतौ पापौ राक्षसौ धर्मकण्टकौ अश्वत्थः पिप्पलश् चेति विख्यातौ त्रिदशालये
verses.transliteration: kaiṭabhasya sutau pāpau rākṣasau dharmakaṇṭakau aśvatthaḥ pippalaś ceti vikhyātau tridaśālaye
verses.translation: Those who are indifferent to others' assets, who always avoid other men's wives and who enjoy the riches virtuously acquired by themselves go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are indifferent to others' assets, who always avoid other men's wives and who enjoy the riches virtuously acquired by themselves go to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थो ऽश्वत्थरूपेण पिप्पलो ब्रह्मरूपधृक् ताव् उभाव् अन्तरं प्रेप्सू यज्ञविध्वंसनाय तु
verses.transliteration: aśvattho 'śvattharūpeṇa pippalo brahmarūpadhṛk tāv ubhāv antaraṃ prepsū yajñavidhvaṃsanāya tu
verses.translation: Those men who always associate with other men's wives as though they were their own mothers, sisters and daughters, go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those men who always associate with other men's wives as though they were their own mothers, sisters and daughters, go to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुतां काङ्क्षितं रूपं दानवौ पापचेतसौ अश्वत्थो वृक्षरूपेण पिप्पलो ब्राह्मणाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: kurutāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ rūpaṃ dānavau pāpacetasau aśvattho vṛkṣarūpeṇa pippalo brāhmaṇākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Those who cling to their own wives, who carnally approach them only during the prescribed period after the days of menstruation and who never indulge themselves in vulgar lechery, go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who cling to their own wives, who carnally approach them only during the prescribed period after the days of menstruation and who never indulge themselves in vulgar lechery, go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: pippalaḥ sāmago bhūtvā śiṣyān aśnāti rākṣasaḥ tasmād adyāpi vipreṣu sāmago 'tīva niṣkṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Those who view other men's wives with eyes enveloped by chastity, who have conquered their sense organs and who value good conduct very much, go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who view other men's wives with eyes enveloped by chastity, who have conquered their sense organs and who value good conduct very much, go to heaven.

verses.translation: Those who welcome others speaking sweet, sinless and polished words with clearly pronounced syllables, go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who welcome others speaking sweet, sinless and polished words with clearly pronounced syllables, go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: punaḥ procur munigaṇā dāsyāmas te tapo mahat ity ukto brāhmaṇaiḥ sauriḥ kṛtam ity āha tān api
verses.translation: O gentle lady, this act of piety relating to speech, should

verses.transliteration: saurir brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa prāyād aśvattharūpiṇam rākṣasaṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā pradakṣiṇam athākarot
verses.translation: O highly blessed lord of gods, O Pinaka-wielding lord, tell me those mental-acts whereby a man is held in bondage. O lady of weal, those who possess virtues of thought do always go to heaven. Listen, even as I narrate them.

verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvāṇaṃ mene brāhmaṇam eva tam nityavad rākṣasaḥ pāpo bhakṣayām āsa māyayā
verses.translation: Good men do not become overjoyed on seeing other men's property left in a lonely place whether in the village or in the house (nor do they think of appropriating it). They go to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good men do not become overjoyed on seeing other men's property left in a lonely place whether in the village or in the house (nor do they think of appropriating it). They go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: tasya kāyaṃ samāviśya cakṣuṣāntrāṇy apaśyata dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ pāpo mandena ravisūnunā
verses.translation: Similarly, good men do not even think of molesting lcchcrouslv the wives of others (on meeting them) in lonely spots. They go to heaven. Good men mentally view friends and enemies alike. They have a friendly attitude towards them. They go to heaven.

verses.translation: Good men are learned, merciful, pure and truthful; they arc contented with their own riches. They go to heaven.

verses.translation: Good men are devoid of enmity. They do not over¬ strain themselves (?) They always maintain a friendly attitude. They are merciful towards all living beings. They go to heaven. They possess knowledge. They perform holy rites. They are fond of their friends. They understand piety and sin. They go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: pippalaḥ pūrvavac cāpi bhakṣayām āsa bhānujam sa bhakṣitaḥ pūrvavac ca kukṣāv antrāṇy avaikṣata
verses.translation: Good men, O gentle lady, arc indifferent to the accumu¬ lating fruits of auspicious and inauspicious deeds. They go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: munayo jātasaṃharṣāḥ sarva eva tapasvinaḥ tataḥ prasannā hy abhavann ṛṣayo 'gastyapūrvakāḥ
verses.translation: O great lord, I have a certain doubt concerning mortals Hence it behoves you to explain it fully.

verses.sanskrit: वरान् ददुर् यथाकामं सौरये मन्दगामिने स प्रीतो ब्राह्मणान् आह शनिः सूर्यसुतो बली
verses.transliteration: varān dadur yathākāmaṃ sauraye mandagāmine sa prīto brāhmaṇān āha śaniḥ sūryasuto balī
verses.translation: O lord, by means of what holy rite does a man attain a long life? By what type of penance, O lord of gods, does he obtain a great span of life? By means of what activity does man on Earth get long¬ evity reduced? O uncensured lord, it beloves you to narrate the consequences of actions.

verses.sanskrit: मद्द्वारे नियता ये च कुर्वन्त्य् अश्वत्थलम्भनम् तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि स्युः पीडा मद्भवा न च
verses.transliteration: maddvāre niyatā ye ca kurvanty aśvatthalambhanam teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi syuḥ pīḍā madbhavā na ca
verses.translation: Differences are observed in men. Some are highly for¬ tunate. Others are less fortunate. Some are born noble and others are ignoble.
verses.commentary: Sense: Differences are observed in men. Some are highly for¬ tunate. Others are less fortunate. Some are born noble and others are ignoble.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थे चाश्वत्थसंज्ञे वै स्नानं कुर्वन्ति ये नराः तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि भवेयुर् अपरो वरः
verses.transliteration: tīrthe cāśvatthasaṃjñe vai snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyur aparo varaḥ
verses.translation: Some are very odious in appearance as if they are made of wood. Others are very pleasing to behold. Some appear to be evil-minded. Some appear to be highly learned. Others have highly developed intellect with pure wisdom and prescience.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are very odious in appearance as if they are made of wood. Others are very pleasing to behold. Some appear to be evil-minded. Some appear to be highly learned. Others have highly developed intellect with pure wisdom and prescience.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दवारे तु ये ऽश्वत्थं प्रातर् उत्थाय मानवाः आलभन्ते च तेषां वै ग्रहपीडा व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: mandavāre tu ye 'śvatthaṃ prātar utthāya mānavāḥ ālabhante ca teṣāṃ vai grahapīḍā vyapohatu
verses.translation: O lord, some are men of few words. Others are highly eloquent. Hence it behoves you to explain this diversity.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, some are men of few words. Others are highly eloquent. Hence it behoves you to explain this diversity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् अश्वत्थं पिप्पलं विदुः तीर्थं शनैश्चरं तत्र तत्रागस्त्यं च सात्त्रिकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham aśvatthaṃ pippalaṃ viduḥ tīrthaṃ śanaiścaraṃ tatra tatrāgastyaṃ ca sāttrikam
verses.translation: A man of violent nature goes to hell a „„„ •, man goes to!,«,«„ mi, 8 ro neu ' A nonviolent If anyone, by any means, survives and comes out of hell and attains human birth, lie becomes short-lived.

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञिकं चापि तत् तीर्थं सामगं तीर्थम् एव च इत्याद्यष्टोत्तराण्य् आसन् सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सत्त्रयागफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yājñikaṃ cāpi tat tīrthaṃ sāmagaṃ tīrtham eva ca ityādyaṣṭottarāṇy āsan sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sattrayāgaphalapradam
verses.translation: O gentle lady, one who commits sinful actions, violence etc. is inimical to all living beings and becomes short¬ lived.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, one who commits sinful actions, violence etc. is inimical to all living beings and becomes short¬ lived.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तद् अप्य् उक्तं महात्मभिः तत्र स्नानेन दानेन सोमपानफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: somatīrtham iti khyātaṃ tad apy uktaṃ mahātmabhiḥ tatra snānena dānena somapānaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: What are those things which a man should regularly do in order to attain heaven? What should be his conduct and what holy rites should he perform? What should he give in charity?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: What are those things which a man should regularly do in order to attain heaven? What should be his conduct and what holy rites should he perform? What should he give in charity?

verses.sanskrit: जगतां मातरः पूर्वम् ओषध्यो जीवसंमताः ममापि मातरो देव्यः पूर्वासां पूर्ववत्तराः
verses.transliteration: jagatāṃ mātaraḥ pūrvam oṣadhyo jīvasaṃmatāḥ mamāpi mātaro devyaḥ pūrvāsāṃ pūrvavattarāḥ
verses.translation: There, he will be possessed of desirable qualities. He will be joyous. The man becomes rich. He enjoys great plea¬ sures and accomplishes great deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, he will be possessed of desirable qualities. He will be joyous. The man becomes rich. He enjoys great plea¬ sures and accomplishes great deeds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आसु प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मः स्वाध्यायो यज्ञकर्म च आभिर् एव धृतं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: āsu pratiṣṭhito dharmaḥ svādhyāyo yajñakarma ca ābhir eva dhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: These highly blessed living beings of charitable disposi¬ tion are those spoken of formerly by Brahma as men of pleas¬ ing appearance liked by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: These highly blessed living beings of charitable disposi¬ tion are those spoken of formerly by Brahma as men of pleas¬ ing appearance liked by all.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अशेषरोगोपशमो भवत्य् आभिर् असंशयम् अन्नम् एताभिर् एव स्याद् अशेषप्राणरक्षणम् अत्रौषध्यो जगद्वन्द्या माम् ऊचुर् अनहंकृताः
verses.transliteration: aśeṣarogopaśamo bhavaty ābhir asaṃśayam annam etābhir eva syād aśeṣaprāṇarakṣaṇam atrauṣadhyo jagadvandyā mām ūcur anahaṃkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Other men, O gentle lady, arc the twice-born ones of miserly nature who do not give anything to anyone. Those tho¬ ughtless ones do not give foodstuffs even when they have them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other men, O gentle lady, arc the twice-born ones of miserly nature who do not give anything to anyone. Those tho¬ ughtless ones do not give foodstuffs even when they have them.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वं पतिं देहि राजानं सुरसत्तम
verses.transliteration: asmākaṃ tvaṃ patiṃ dehi rājānaṃ surasattama
verses.translation: Even after seeing the poor, the blind and the wretched mendicants, even on being requested by them, they turn away because they are gluttonous and so covetous of palatable things.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after seeing the poor, the blind and the wretched mendicants, even on being requested by them, they turn away because they are gluttonous and so covetous of palatable things.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तच् छ्रुत्वा वचनं तासां मयोक्ता ओषधीर् इदम् पतिं प्राप्स्यथ सर्वाश् च राजानं प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃ mayoktā oṣadhīr idam patiṃ prāpsyatha sarvāś ca rājānaṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: They never give away money, garments, means of enjoyment, gold, cows or items of cooked food.
verses.commentary: Sense: They never give away money, garments, means of enjoyment, gold, cows or items of cooked food.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: राजानम् इति तच् छ्रुत्वा ता माम् ऊचुः पुनर् मुने गन्तव्यं क्व पुनश् चोक्ता गौतमीं यान्तु मातरः
verses.transliteration: rājānam iti tac chrutvā tā mām ūcuḥ punar mune gantavyaṃ kva punaś coktā gautamīṃ yāntu mātaraḥ
verses.translation: They are highly greedy and covetous, atheists, devoid of liberal-mindedness. Men of this nature, O gentle lady, are the thoughtless ones who go to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are highly greedy and covetous, atheists, devoid of liberal-mindedness. Men of this nature, O gentle lady, are the thoughtless ones who go to hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टायाम् अथ तस्यां वो राजा स्याल् लोकपूजितः ताश् च गत्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ तुष्टुवुर् गौतमीं नदीम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāyām atha tasyāṃ vo rājā syāl lokapūjitaḥ tāś ca gatvā muniśreṣṭha tuṣṭuvur gautamīṃ nadīm
verses.translation: After the lapse of some time when they take human birth those men of deficient intellect are born in some family devoid of wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the lapse of some time when they take human birth those men of deficient intellect are born in some family devoid of wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं वाकरिष्यन् भववर्तिनो जना नानाघसंघाभिभवाच् च दुःखिताः न चागमिष्यद् भवती भुवं चेत् पुण्योदके गौतमि शंभुकान्ते
verses.transliteration: kiṃ vākariṣyan bhavavartino janā nānāghasaṃghābhibhavāc ca duḥkhitāḥ na cāgamiṣyad bhavatī bhuvaṃ cet puṇyodake gautami śaṃbhukānte
verses.translation: They are tormented by hunger and thirst. They are boycotted by the world. Devoid of any hope for the enjoyment oi pleasure they keep on living their evil lives.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are tormented by hunger and thirst. They are boycotted by the world. Devoid of any hope for the enjoyment oi pleasure they keep on living their evil lives.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: को वेत्ति भाग्यं नरदेहभाजां महीगतानां सरिताम् अधीशे एषां महापातकसंघहन्त्री त्वम् अम्ब गङ्गे सुलभा सदैव
verses.transliteration: ko vetti bhāgyaṃ naradehabhājāṃ mahīgatānāṃ saritām adhīśe eṣāṃ mahāpātakasaṃghahantrī tvam amba gaṅge sulabhā sadaiva
verses.translation: They aie born of families of inferior worldly pleasures. Those men are engrossed in spurious pleasures. O gentle lady, it is oy these activities that men become devoid of wealth.
verses.commentary: Sense: They aie born of families of inferior worldly pleasures. Those men are engrossed in spurious pleasures. O gentle lady, it is oy these activities that men become devoid of wealth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न ते विभूतिं ननु वेत्ति को ऽपि त्रैलोक्यवन्द्ये जगदम्ब गङ्गे गौरीसमालिङ्गितविग्रहो ऽपि धत्ते स्मरारिः शिरसापि यत् त्वाम्
verses.transliteration: na te vibhūtiṃ nanu vetti ko 'pi trailokyavandye jagadamba gaṅge gaurīsamāliṅgitavigraho 'pi dhatte smarāriḥ śirasāpi yat tvām
verses.translation: Those who cast their evil eye on other men's wives are born blind due to that evil conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who cast their evil eye on other men's wives are born blind due to that evil conduct.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते मातर् अभीष्टदायिनि नमो ऽस्तु ते ब्रह्ममये ऽघनाशिनि नमो ऽस्तु ते विष्णुपदाब्जनिःसृते नमो ऽस्तु ते शंभुजटाविनिःसृते
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te mātar abhīṣṭadāyini namo 'stu te brahmamaye 'ghanāśini namo 'stu te viṣṇupadābjaniḥsṛte namo 'stu te śaṃbhujaṭāviniḥsṛte
verses.translation: Men of sinful actions who look at a naked woman with a defiled mind become distressed due to sickness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of sinful actions who look at a naked woman with a defiled mind become distressed due to sickness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं स्तुवताम् ईशा किं ददामीत्य् अवोचत
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ stuvatām īśā kiṃ dadāmīty avocata
verses.translation: Foolish men of evil conduct who indulge in the sexual act with beasts become deficient and defiled in wisdom as well as impotent. They become eunuchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Foolish men of evil conduct who indulge in the sexual act with beasts become deficient and defiled in wisdom as well as impotent. They become eunuchs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
