verses.sanskrit: पतिं देहि जगन्माता राजानम् अतितेजसम्
verses.transliteration: patiṃ dehi jaganmātā rājānam atitejasam
verses.translation: Men who bind animals or embrace them closely, men who defile their preceptor's bed and men who scatter their seminal discharge are born as eunuchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who bind animals or embrace them closely, men who defile their preceptor's bed and men who scatter their seminal discharge are born as eunuchs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदोवाच नदी गङ्गा ओषधीस् ता इदं वचः
verses.transliteration: tadovāca nadī gaṅgā oṣadhīs tā idaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: O the most excellent one among the gods, what is a despicable action? What is it that is not despicable, by doing which a man attains prosperity and renown?
verses.commentary: Sense: O the most excellent one among the gods, what is a despicable action? What is it that is not despicable, by doing which a man attains prosperity and renown?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं चामृतरूपास्मि ओषध्यो मातरो ऽमृताः तादृशं चामृतात्मानं पतिं सोमं ददामि वः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ cāmṛtarūpāsmi oṣadhyo mātaro 'mṛtāḥ tādṛśaṃ cāmṛtātmānaṃ patiṃ somaṃ dadāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: He who seeks the path of prosperity and asks brah¬ mins about it, he who seeks virtue and he who yearns for good qualities attains heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who seeks the path of prosperity and asks brah¬ mins about it, he who seeks virtue and he who yearns for good qualities attains heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च ऋषयो वाक्यं मेनिरे सोम एव च ओषध्यश् चापि तद् वाक्यं ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आलयम्
verses.transliteration: devāś ca ṛṣayo vākyaṃ menire soma eva ca oṣadhyaś cāpi tad vākyaṃ tato jagmuḥ svam ālayam
verses.translation: If at any time he takes up human birth, O gentle lady, he is born highly intelligent, wise and endowed with memory.
verses.commentary: Sense: If at any time he takes up human birth, O gentle lady, he is born highly intelligent, wise and endowed with memory.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्र चापुर् महौषध्यो राजानम् अमृतात्मकम् सोमं समस्तसंतापपापसंघनिवारकम्
verses.transliteration: yatra cāpur mahauṣadhyo rājānam amṛtātmakam somaṃ samastasaṃtāpapāpasaṃghanivārakam
verses.translation: There are other men of deficient wisdom who hate virtue. They do not wish to approach brahmins well-versed in the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other men of deficient wisdom who hate virtue. They do not wish to approach brahmins well-versed in the Vedas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थं तु तत् ख्यातं सोमपानफलप्रदम् तत्र स्नानेन दानेन पितरः स्वर्गम् आप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: somatīrthaṃ tu tat khyātaṃ somapānaphalapradam tatra snānena dānena pitaraḥ svargam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: Some men observe holy rites. They have faith and they
verses.commentary: Sense: Some men observe holy rites. They have faith and they
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयान् नित्यं पठेद् वा भक्तितः स्मरेत् दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्नोति स पुत्री धनवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ paṭhed vā bhaktitaḥ smaret dīrgham āyur avāpnoti sa putrī dhanavān bhavet
verses.translation: Still others are regular performers of holy sacrifices. There are others devoid of delusion. Tell me how they become so. What is that action as a result of which they become so.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still others are regular performers of holy sacrifices. There are others devoid of delusion. Tell me how they become so. What is that action as a result of which they become so.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धान्यतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् सुभिक्षं क्षेमदं पुंसां सर्वापद्विनिवारणम्
verses.transliteration: dhānyatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām subhikṣaṃ kṣemadaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam
verses.translation: O Brahmins, I do not see any means other than the son of Vasudeva for the liberation of men bound by the noose of action (and reactions) who undergo misery.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmins, I do not see any means other than the son of Vasudeva for the liberation of men bound by the noose of action (and reactions) who undergo misery.

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यः सोमराजानं पतिं प्राप्य मुदान्विताः ऊचुः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गङ्गायाश् चेप्सितं वचः
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaḥ somarājānaṃ patiṃ prāpya mudānvitāḥ ūcuḥ sarvasya lokasya gaṅgāyāś cepsitaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Those who worship well that lord who wields conch, discus and club, byword, deeds and thoughts attain the highest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who worship well that lord who wields conch, discus and club, byword, deeds and thoughts attain the highest region.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वैदिकी पुण्यगाथास्ति यां वै वेदविदो विदुः भूमिं सस्यवतीं कश्चिन् मातरं मातृसंमिताम्
verses.transliteration: vaidikī puṇyagāthāsti yāṃ vai vedavido viduḥ bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ kaścin mātaraṃ mātṛsaṃmitām
verses.translation: O Pinaka-bearing Sankara, O destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, O lord adored by the worlds, wc wish to hear the great¬ ness of Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Pinaka-bearing Sankara, O destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, O lord adored by the worlds, wc wish to hear the great¬ ness of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गासमीपे यो दद्यात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात् भूमिं सस्यवतीं गाश् च ओषधीश् च मुदान्वितः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāsamīpe yo dadyāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ gāś ca oṣadhīś ca mudānvitaḥ
verses.translation: He has ten arms. He has great splendour. He is the destroyer of the enemies of gods. He is Hrslkes'a marked by the scar Srivatsa. He is the leader of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has ten arms. He has great splendour. He is the destroyer of the enemies of gods. He is Hrslkes'a marked by the scar Srivatsa. He is the leader of gods.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुब्रह्मेशरूपाय यो दद्याद् भक्तिमान् नरः सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇubrahmeśarūpāya yo dadyād bhaktimān naraḥ sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The sages and the eternal worlds are born of his body. He is the abode of Brahma himself and of Devas too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages and the eternal worlds are born of his body. He is the abode of Brahma himself and of Devas too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यः सोमराजन्याः सोमश् चाप्य् ओषधीपतिः इति ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मविद ओषधीर् यः प्रदास्यति
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaḥ somarājanyāḥ somaś cāpy oṣadhīpatiḥ iti jñātvā brahmavida oṣadhīr yaḥ pradāsyati
verses.translation: For the fulfilment of the task of gods he takes up human form. He bestows honour on others. He will be killing all kings in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the fulfilment of the task of gods he takes up human form. He bestows honour on others. He will be killing all kings in battle.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ता एव सोमराजन्याः प्रीताः प्रोचुः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān avāpnoti brahmaloke mahīyate tā eva somarājanyāḥ prītāḥ procuḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Without the help of Trivikrama, the hosts of Devas will be leaderless and they will be incapable of performing their divine functions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without the help of Trivikrama, the hosts of Devas will be leaderless and they will be incapable of performing their divine functions.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽस्मान् ददाति गङ्गायां तं राजन् पारयामसि त्वम् उत्तमश् चौषधीश त्वदधीनं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'smān dadāti gaṅgāyāṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi tvam uttamaś cauṣadhīśa tvadadhīnaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: The gods are comfortably stationed in his body. That lotus-eyed lord has goddess LaksmI in his belly. He stays in the company of Sri.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods are comfortably stationed in his body. That lotus-eyed lord has goddess LaksmI in his belly. He stays in the company of Sri.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ओषधयः संवदन्ते सोमेन सह राज्ञा यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: oṣadhayaḥ saṃvadante somena saha rājñā yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: That lord has ample forbearance. He does not boast of himself. He bestows (the power to realise) Brahman. He removes the fear of those who are distressed by fear. He increases the delight of his friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord has ample forbearance. He does not boast of himself. He bestows (the power to realise) Brahman. He removes the fear of those who are distressed by fear. He increases the delight of his friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वयं च ब्रह्मरूपिण्यः प्राणरूपिण्य एव च यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ ca brahmarūpiṇyaḥ prāṇarūpiṇya eva ca yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: He helps those who resort to him. He causes fear in the minds of his enemies. He is conversant with polity. He is richly
verses.commentary: Sense: He helps those who resort to him. He causes fear in the minds of his enemies. He is conversant with polity. He is richly
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान् ददाति यो नित्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो जितव्रतः उपास्तिर् अस्ति सास्माकं तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: asmān dadāti yo nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo jitavrataḥ upāstir asti sāsmākaṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: Acyuta, that lord of Devas, should be worshipped by a person conversant with virtue. When this lord is worshipped he will always possess virtue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Acyuta, that lord of Devas, should be worshipped by a person conversant with virtue. When this lord is worshipped he will always possess virtue.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरं जङ्गमं किंचिद् अस्माभिर् व्यापृतं जगत् यो ऽस्मान् ददाति विप्रेभ्यस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ kiṃcid asmābhir vyāpṛtaṃ jagat yo 'smān dadāti viprebhyas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: They, beginning with Sanatkumara, duly created by him, stay on the Gandhamadana mountain, performing austeri¬ ties.
verses.commentary: Sense: They, beginning with Sanatkumara, duly created by him, stay on the Gandhamadana mountain, performing austeri¬ ties.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हव्यं कव्यं यद् अमृतं यत् किंचिद् उपभुज्यते तद्गरीयश् च यो दद्यात् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: havyaṃ kavyaṃ yad amṛtaṃ yat kiṃcid upabhujyate tadgarīyaś ca yo dadyāt taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: Hence, O leading twice-born, that eloquent lord con¬ versant with Dharma should be bowed to. He shall salute on being saluted; he shall honour, on being honoured.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O leading twice-born, that eloquent lord con¬ versant with Dharma should be bowed to. He shall salute on being saluted; he shall honour, on being honoured.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतां वैदिकीं गाथां यः शृणोति स्मरेत वा पठते भक्तिम् आपन्नस् तं राजन् पारयामसि
verses.transliteration: ity etāṃ vaidikīṃ gāthāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti smareta vā paṭhate bhaktim āpannas taṃ rājan pārayāmasi
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, that lord shall see on being seen; he shall offer refuge everyday, on being sought refuge in; On being worshipped regularly he shall accept worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, that lord shall see on being seen; he shall offer refuge everyday, on being sought refuge in; On being worshipped regularly he shall accept worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यत्रैषा पठिता गाथा सोमेन सह राज्ञा गङ्गातीरे चौषधीभिर् धान्यतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yatraiṣā paṭhitā gāthā somena saha rājñā gaṅgātīre cauṣadhībhir dhānyatīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: That son of Devaki should always be bowed to, by thought, by speech and by deeds by brahmins exerting them¬ selves. He should necessarily be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son of Devaki should always be bowed to, by thought, by speech and by deeds by brahmins exerting them¬ selves. He should necessarily be seen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् औषध्यं सौम्यम् एव च अमृतं वेदगाथं च मातृतीर्थं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham auṣadhyaṃ saumyam eva ca amṛtaṃ vedagāthaṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: I too always worship and bow to that lord, the grand¬ father of the worlds, the great Boar, lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: I too always worship and bow to that lord, the grand¬ father of the worlds, the great Boar, lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एषु स्नानं जपो होमो दानं च पितृतर्पणम् अन्नदानं तु यः कुर्यात् तद् आनन्त्याय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: eṣu snānaṃ japo homo dānaṃ ca pitṛtarpaṇam annadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tad ānantyāya kalpate
verses.translation: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.commentary: Sense: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: षट्शताधिकसाहस्रं तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः सर्वपापनिहन्तॄणां सर्वसंपद्विवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭśatādhikasāhasraṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ sarvapāpanihantṝṇāṃ sarvasaṃpadvivardhanam
verses.translation: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.commentary: Sense: The ploughshare-wielding lord, well-known as Bala,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विदर्भासंगमं पुण्यं रेवतीसंगमं तथा तत्र यद् वृत्तम् आख्यास्ये यत् पुराणविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: vidarbhāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ revatīsaṃgamaṃ tathā tatra yad vṛttam ākhyāsye yat purāṇavido viduḥ
verses.translation: Oh, the wonderful greatness of Krsna has been heard by us. It is holy. It dispels sins. It is conducive to wealth. It des¬ troys the round of births and deaths.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Oh, the wonderful greatness of Krsna has been heard by us. It is holy. It dispels sins. It is conducive to wealth. It des¬ troys the round of births and deaths.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाज इति ख्यात ऋषिर् आसीत् तपोधिकः तस्य स्वसा रेवतीति कुरूपा विकृतस्वरा
verses.transliteration: bharadvāja iti khyāta ṛṣir āsīt tapodhikaḥ tasya svasā revatīti kurūpā vikṛtasvarā
verses.translation: O great sage, after worshipping Vasudeva, duly and with devotion what goal do the men who are engaged in the worship of Vasudeva attain?
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, after worshipping Vasudeva, duly and with devotion what goal do the men who are engaged in the worship of Vasudeva attain?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा विकृतां भ्राता भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् चिन्तया परया युक्तो गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ bhrātā bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān cintayā parayā yukto gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Do they attain liberation or heaven, O great sage? Or, O excellent sage, do they obtain both the fruits?
verses.commentary: Sense: Do they attain liberation or heaven, O great sage? Or, O excellent sage, do they obtain both the fruits?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कस्मै दद्याम् इमां कन्यां स्वसारं भीषणाकृतिम् न कश्चित् प्रतिगृह्णाति दातव्या च स्वसा तथा
verses.transliteration: kasmai dadyām imāṃ kanyāṃ svasāraṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim na kaścit pratigṛhṇāti dātavyā ca svasā tathā
verses.translation: O omniscient one, it behoves you to dispel this doubt lurking in our hearts. O excellent sage, excepting you there is noone else in this world who can dispel it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O omniscient one, it behoves you to dispel this doubt lurking in our hearts. O excellent sage, excepting you there is noone else in this world who can dispel it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहो भूयान् न कस्यापि कन्या दुःखैककारणम् मरणं जीवतो ऽप्य् अस्य प्राणिनस् तु पदे पदे
verses.transliteration: aho bhūyān na kasyāpi kanyā duḥkhaikakāraṇam maraṇaṃ jīvato 'py asya prāṇinas tu pade pade
verses.translation: Well done, well-done, O excellent sages! What has been uttered by you is quite pertinent. Now listen to all those things
verses.commentary: Sense: Well done, well-done, O excellent sages! What has been uttered by you is quite pertinent. Now listen to all those things
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विमृशतस् तस्य स्वाश्रमे चातिशोभने द्रष्टुं मुनिवरः प्रायाद् भरद्वाजं यतव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vimṛśatas tasya svāśrame cātiśobhane draṣṭuṃ munivaraḥ prāyād bharadvājaṃ yatavratam
verses.translation: By the mere initiation (into the fold) of Krsna, men attain salvation. What then, in regard to those who devotedly worship Visnu always!
verses.commentary: Sense: By the mere initiation (into the fold) of Krsna, men attain salvation. What then, in regard to those who devotedly worship Visnu always!
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्व्यष्टवर्षः शुभवपुः शान्तो दान्तो गुणाकरः नाम्ना कठ इति ख्यातो भरद्वाजं ननाम सः
verses.transliteration: dvyaṣṭavarṣaḥ śubhavapuḥ śānto dānto guṇākaraḥ nāmnā kaṭha iti khyāto bharadvājaṃ nanāma saḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, neither heaven nor salvation is inac¬ cessible to them. Devotees of Visnu obtain even the rarest things, would they desire them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, neither heaven nor salvation is inac¬ cessible to them. Devotees of Visnu obtain even the rarest things, would they desire them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विधिवत् पूज्य तं विप्रं भरद्वाजः कठं तदा तस्यागमनकार्यं च पप्रच्छ पुरतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vidhivat pūjya taṃ vipraṃ bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ tadā tasyāgamanakāryaṃ ca papraccha purataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Just as after climbing the mountain of jewels one can take away any number as one pleases, so also O leading sages, one can obtain the cherished things from Kr$na.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as after climbing the mountain of jewels one can take away any number as one pleases, so also O leading sages, one can obtain the cherished things from Kr$na.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कठो ऽप्य् आह भरद्वाजं विद्यार्थ्य् अहम् उपागतः तथा च दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी यद् युक्तं तद् विधीयताम्
verses.transliteration: kaṭho 'py āha bharadvājaṃ vidyārthy aham upāgataḥ tathā ca darśanākāṅkṣī yad yuktaṃ tad vidhīyatām
verses.translation: Just as, after reaching the wish-yielding Kalpa tree, O brahmins, a person plucks the fruits as he pleases, so also one can take one's cherished things from Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as, after reaching the wish-yielding Kalpa tree, O brahmins, a person plucks the fruits as he pleases, so also one can take one's cherished things from Krsna.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजः कठं प्राह अधीष्व यद् अभीप्सितम् पुराणं स्मृतयो वेदा धर्मस्थानान्य् अनेकशः
verses.transliteration: bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ prāha adhīṣva yad abhīpsitam purāṇaṃ smṛtayo vedā dharmasthānāny anekaśaḥ
verses.translation: By duly and faithfully worshipping Vasudcva, the pre¬ ceptor of the universe, men attain the fruit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: By duly and faithfully worshipping Vasudcva, the pre¬ ceptor of the universe, men attain the fruit of virtue, wealth, love and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं वेद्मि महाप्राज्ञ रुचिरं वद मा चिरम् कुलीनो धर्मनिरतो गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतः अभिमानी श्रुतधरः शिष्यः पुण्यैर् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ vedmi mahāprājña ruciraṃ vada mā ciram kulīno dharmanirato guruśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ abhimānī śrutadharaḥ śiṣyaḥ puṇyair avāpyate
verses.translation: By propitiating that lord of the universe with a puri¬ fied inner soul men obtain desirable things difficult of access even unto Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: By propitiating that lord of the universe with a puri¬ fied inner soul men obtain desirable things difficult of access even unto Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापयस्व भो ब्रह्मञ् शिष्यं मां वीतकल्मषम् शुश्रूषणरतं भक्तं कुलीनं सत्यवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: adhyāpayasva bho brahmañ śiṣyaṃ māṃ vītakalmaṣam śuśrūṣaṇarataṃ bhaktaṃ kulīnaṃ satyavādinam
verses.translation: To those who devotedly worship the Imperishable lord Vasudcva there is nothing inaccessible in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To those who devotedly worship the Imperishable lord Vasudcva there is nothing inaccessible in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा भरद्वाजः प्रादाद् विद्याम् अशेषतः प्राप्तविद्यः कठः प्रीतो भरद्वाजम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā bharadvājaḥ prādād vidyām aśeṣataḥ prāptavidyaḥ kaṭhaḥ prīto bharadvājam athābravīt
verses.translation: Blessed are those persons in the world who worship Lord Hari who dispels all sins and who bestows the desired benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Blessed are those persons in the world who worship Lord Hari who dispels all sins and who bestows the desired benefits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इच्छेयं दक्षिणां दातुं गुरो तव मनःप्रियाम् वदस्व दुर्लभं वापि गुरो तुभ्यं नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: iccheyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ guro tava manaḥpriyām vadasva durlabhaṃ vāpi guro tubhyaṃ namo 'stu te
verses.translation: By worshipping the most excellent lord of Devas, brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, women, Sudras and men of low castes attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshipping the most excellent lord of Devas, brahmins, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, women, Sudras and men of low castes attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विद्यां प्राप्यापि ये मोहात् स्वगुरोः पारितोषिकम् न प्रयच्छन्ति निरयं ते यान्त्य् आचन्द्रतारकम्
verses.transliteration: vidyāṃ prāpyāpi ye mohāt svaguroḥ pāritoṣikam na prayacchanti nirayaṃ te yānty ācandratārakam
verses.translation: Hence, O sinless sages, listen. I shall expound what you ask. I shall succinctly narrate the goal of those noble souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O sinless sages, listen. I shall expound what you ask. I shall succinctly narrate the goal of those noble souls.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहाण कन्यां विधिवद् भार्यां कुरु मम स्वसाम् अस्यां प्रीत्या वर्तितव्यं याचेयं दक्षिणाम् इमाम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa kanyāṃ vidhivad bhāryāṃ kuru mama svasām asyāṃ prītyā vartitavyaṃ yāceyaṃ dakṣiṇām imām
verses.translation: They take up divine bodies of great strength bedecked by earrings. Huge bodies, O excellent brahmins, they assume with a four-armed form, and sport there.
verses.commentary: Sense: They take up divine bodies of great strength bedecked by earrings. Huge bodies, O excellent brahmins, they assume with a four-armed form, and sport there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: bhrātṛvat putravac cāpi śiṣyaḥ syāt tu guroḥ sadā guruś ca pitṛvac ca syāt saṃbandho 'tra kathaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, in their eternal state they re¬ main for ten thousand crores of years and are bowed to by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, in their eternal state they re¬ main for ten thousand crores of years and are bowed to by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मद्वाक्यं कुरु सत्यं त्वं ममाज्ञा तव दक्षिणा सर्वं स्मृत्वा कठाद्य त्वं रेवतीं भर तन्मनाः
verses.transliteration: madvākyaṃ kuru satyaṃ tvaṃ mamājñā tava dakṣiṇā sarvaṃ smṛtvā kaṭhādya tvaṃ revatīṃ bhara tanmanāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, O brahmins, those magnificent self-posses¬ sed men go to the abode of Narasimha. There they rejoice and sport for about ten thousand crores of years
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, O brahmins, those magnificent self-posses¬ sed men go to the abode of Narasimha. There they rejoice and sport for about ten thousand crores of years

verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā guror vākyāt kaṭho jagrāha pāṇinā revatīṃ vidhivad dattāṃ tāṃ samīkṣya kaṭhas tv atha
verses.translation: At the end of that period they go to the abode of
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of that period they go to the abode of

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव पूजयाम् आस देवेशं शंकरं तदा रेवत्या रूपसंपत्त्यै शिवप्रीत्यै च रेवती
verses.transliteration: tatraiva pūjayām āsa deveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā revatyā rūpasaṃpattyai śivaprītyai ca revatī
verses.translation: Thereafter they go to the city of Pradyumna. Free of
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter they go to the city of Pradyumna. Free of

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपा चारुसर्वाङ्गी न रूपेणोपमीयते अभिषेकोदकं तत्र रेवत्या यद् विनिःसृतम्
verses.transliteration: surūpā cārusarvāṅgī na rūpeṇopamīyate abhiṣekodakaṃ tatra revatyā yad viniḥsṛtam
verses.translation: They are delighted. They are endowed with strength and power. They can go anywhere as they please. Thereafter those Yogins go to the place where lord Sankarsana rules.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: साभवत् तत्र गङ्गायां तस्मात् तन्नामतो नदी रेवतीति समाख्याता रूपसौभाग्यदायिनी
verses.transliteration: sābhavat tatra gaṅgāyāṃ tasmāt tannāmato nadī revatīti samākhyātā rūpasaubhāgyadāyinī
verses.translation: She became a river there in the Ganga; therefore that river is known by her name, Revati, bestowing beauty and good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् दर्भैश् च विविधैर् अभिषेकं चकार सः पुण्यरूपत्वसंसिद्ध्यै विदर्भा तद् अभून् नदी
verses.transliteration: punar darbhaiś ca vividhair abhiṣekaṃ cakāra saḥ puṇyarūpatvasaṃsiddhyai vidarbhā tad abhūn nadī
verses.translation: Again he performed an anointing with various kinds of darbha grass for the attainment of a holy form; that became the river Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया संगमे स्नात्वा रेवतीगङ्गयोर् नरः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā saṃgame snātvā revatīgaṅgayor naraḥ sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: A man who bathes with faith at the confluence of the Revati and the Ganga is freed from all sins and honoured in Vishnu's world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा विदर्भागौतम्योः संगमे श्रद्धया मुने स्नानं करोत्य् असौ याति भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tathā vidarbhāgautamyoḥ saṃgame śraddhayā mune snānaṃ karoty asau yāti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Likewise, whoever bathes with faith at the confluence of the Vidarbha and the Gautami, O sage, at once attains enjoyment and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: ubhayos tīrayos tatra tīrthānāṃ śatam uttamam sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
verses.translation: On both banks there are a hundred excellent holy places, destroying all sins and granting all perfections.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं गङ्गाया उत्तरे तटे तत्र स्नात्वा नरो ऽज्ञानात् तथापि शुभम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatīrtham iti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe tatra snātvā naro 'jñānāt tathāpi śubham āpnuyāt
verses.translation: O great sage, describe to us the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake. Great is our eagerness to hear the same.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, describe to us the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake. Great is our eagerness to hear the same.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं वर्ण्यते केन जन्तुना स्वयं संस्थीयते यत्र चक्रिणा च पिनाकिना
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate kena jantunā svayaṃ saṃsthīyate yatra cakriṇā ca pinākinā
verses.translation: Listen, O excellent sages. I shall describe duly the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake, as mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O excellent sages. I shall describe duly the benefit of the chorus song of Visnu while keeping awake, as mentioned before.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: purā dhanvantarir nāma kalpādāv āyuṣaḥ sutaḥ iṣṭvā bahuvidhair yajñair aśvamedhapuraḥsaraiḥ
verses.translation: His songs in praise of Visnu were sung in various notes such as Gandhara, Sadja, Nisada, Pancama, Dhaivata etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: His songs in praise of Visnu were sung in various notes such as Gandhara, Sadja, Nisada, Pancama, Dhaivata etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा दानान्य् अनेकानि भुक्त्वा भोगांश् च पुष्कलान् विज्ञाय भोगवैषम्यं परं वैराग्यम् आश्रितः
verses.transliteration: dattvā dānāny anekāni bhuktvā bhogāṃś ca puṣkalān vijñāya bhogavaiṣamyaṃ paraṃ vairāgyam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: Many years of his life were thus spent by him in propitiating Visnu by means of different types of songs (of prayer).
verses.commentary: Sense: Many years of his life were thus spent by him in propitiating Visnu by means of different types of songs (of prayer).

verses.translation: The achievement of virtue, wealth and love and the rare acquisition of liberation becomes possible due to the truth of men. Hence one shall never forsake truth.

verses.translation: Saying this, the Canqlala ignored that excellent man and went to the place where the Rrahmaraksasa, the slayer of living beings, was waiting.

verses.transliteration: kiṃ karomi kathaṃ brahmaṃs tapasaḥ pāram āpnuyām
verses.translation: Tell me. How long have you been observing this rite of keeping awake devotedly in the abode ofVisnu?

verses.transliteration: sa hy aśeṣajagatsraṣṭā vedavedyaḥ purātanaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ puṃsāṃ nānyo 'sti bhuvanatraye
verses.translation: It behoves you to carry out what I am going to tell
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to carry out what I am going to tell

verses.translation: In that case I shall set you free. I shall not leave you otherwise, O highly blessed one. I have vowed thrice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that case I shall set you free. I shall not leave you otherwise, O highly blessed one. I have vowed thrice.

verses.translation: The Candala said to him: "O night-prowler, my own self has been surrendered to you. What is the use of talking much? Eat me up as you please".

verses.translation: The Raksasa said to him again: "Give me (the benefit of) keeping awake for two yamas (six hours) along with the songs sung by you. It behoves you to take pity on me."

verses.transliteration: jaya viśvabhuje deva jaya viśvadhṛte namaḥ jayeśa sadasat tvaṃ vai jaya mādhava dharmiṇe
verses.translation: Why this irrelevant talk? Eat me up as you please. I will not give you the benefit of keeping awake.
verses.commentary: Sense: Why this irrelevant talk? Eat me up as you please. I will not give you the benefit of keeping awake.

verses.translation: She said: "O gentle Sir, the observance undertaken by you refers to the wooden one. This is not made of wood. You have been extremely afflicted by hunger. Eat this".

verses.translation: The brahmin replied to her: "O gentle lady, the statement had not been qualified by me. A general vow had been undertaken by me."

verses.translation: That lady then said again: "O brahmin, if you do not want to eat take this home. Your family shall partake of it."

verses.transliteration: bhagavan kena doṣeṇa śacībhartā udāradhīḥ rājyāt prabhraśyate nātha saṃśayaṃ chettum arhasi
verses.translation: O brahmins, after saying this UrvasI flew up to heaven. That brahmin of truthful austerity went to Rupatlrtha.

verses.transliteration: tadāham abravaṃ brahmaṃś ciraṃ dhyātvā bṛhaspatim khaṇḍadharmākhyadoṣeṇa tena rājyapadāc cyutaḥ
verses.translation: For a period of one hundred Manvantaras he ex¬ perienced all pleasures and then was born as a king in an ex¬ cellent dynasty. He was eager in delighting and encouraging his subjects.

verses.translation: He performed various sacrifices, concluding them with excellent monetary gifts. After entrusting his sons with the work of ruling the realm he went again to Saukarava.

verses.translation: He died in the holy spot Rupatlrtha and again went to the region of Indra. After enjoying pleasures there for a period of hundred Manvantaras he came off.

verses.translation: and does not accomplish its purpose; therefore it is for the untroubled. When one's own dharma is incomplete, what harm does not arise?

verses.translation: What happened to the two before I have also told you, sinless one. The glorious son of Ayus was the noble-minded Dhanvantari;

verses.transliteration: tamasā ca kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ viṣṇunā tac ca nāśitam pūrvajanmasu vṛttāntam ityādi parikīrtitam
verses.translation: an obstacle was made by Tamas, and Vishnu destroyed it — such is the account of former births that has been told.

verses.translation: Hearing that, both were astonished and spoke to me again:

verses.transliteration: sarveṣu sattveṣu samatvabuddhyā saṃvīkṣya ṣaṭsūrmiṣu śāntabhāvāḥ jñānena te karmaphalāni hitvā dhyānena te tvāṃ praviśanti śaṃbho
verses.translation: Seeing all beings with an equal mind, calm amid the six waves, casting off the fruits of action through knowledge, they enter you through meditation, O Shambhu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: na jātidharmāṇi na vedaśāstraṃ na dhyānayogo na samādhidharmaḥ rudraṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śānticittaṃ bhaktyā devaṃ somam ahaṃ namasye
verses.translation: Not caste duties, not the Vedas and scriptures, not the yoga of meditation, not the discipline of samadhi — with devotion I bow to Rudra, Shiva, Shankara of tranquil mind, the god Soma.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्खो ऽपि शंभो तव पादभक्त्या समाप्नुयान् मुक्तिमयीं तनुं ते ज्ञानेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव ध्यानेषु होमेषु महाफलेषु
verses.transliteration: mūrkho 'pi śaṃbho tava pādabhaktyā samāpnuyān muktimayīṃ tanuṃ te jñāneṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dhyāneṣu homeṣu mahāphaleṣu
verses.translation: Even a fool, O Shambhu, by devotion to your feet attains your body made of liberation; in knowledge, sacrifices, austerities, meditations and fire offerings of great fruit —

verses.sanskrit: संपन्नम् एतत् फलम् उत्तमं यत् सोमेश्वरे भक्तिर् अहर्निशं यत् सर्वस्य जीवस्य सदा प्रियस्य फलस्य दृष्टस्य तथा श्रुतस्य
verses.transliteration: saṃpannam etat phalam uttamaṃ yat someśvare bhaktir aharniśaṃ yat sarvasya jīvasya sadā priyasya phalasya dṛṣṭasya tathā śrutasya
verses.translation: this is the highest fruit attained: devotion day and night to Someshvara; the fruit dear to every living being, seen and heard,

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गस्य मोक्षस्य जगन्निवास सोपानपङ्क्तिस् तव भक्तिर् एषा त्वत्पादसंप्राप्तिफलाप्तये तु सोपानपङ्क्तिं न वदन्ति धीराः
verses.transliteration: svargasya mokṣasya jagannivāsa sopānapaṅktis tava bhaktir eṣā tvatpādasaṃprāptiphalāptaye tu sopānapaṅktiṃ na vadanti dhīrāḥ
verses.translation: of heaven and liberation, O dwelling of the world — this devotion to you is the stairway; for attaining your feet, the wise do not speak of a stairway.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् दयालो मम भक्तिर् अस्तु नैवास्त्य् उपायस् तव रूपसेवा आत्मीयम् आलोक्य महत्त्वम् ईश पापेषु चास्मासु कुरु प्रसादम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād dayālo mama bhaktir astu naivāsty upāyas tava rūpasevā ātmīyam ālokya mahattvam īśa pāpeṣu cāsmāsu kuru prasādam
verses.translation: Therefore, compassionate one, let me have devotion; there is no other means than service of your form. Seeing your own greatness, O Lord, show grace to us sinners.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलं च सूक्ष्मं त्वम् अनादि नित्यं पिता च माता यद् असच् च सच् च एवं स्तुतो यः श्रुतिभिः पुराणैर् नमामि सोमेश्वरम् ईशितारम्
verses.transliteration: sthūlaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ tvam anādi nityaṃ pitā ca mātā yad asac ca sac ca evaṃ stuto yaḥ śrutibhiḥ purāṇair namāmi someśvaram īśitāram
verses.translation: You are gross and subtle, beginningless and eternal, father and mother, non-being and being; I bow to Someshvara, the ruler, praised thus by the Shrutis and Puranas."

verses.translation: Then Hari and Hara, lords of the thirty gods, pleased, said:

verses.transliteration: vriyatāṃ yan manobhīṣṭaṃ yad varaṃ cātidurlabham
verses.translation: "Choose whatever your mind desires, a boon even very rare."

verses.transliteration: indraḥ prāha sureśānaṃ madrājyaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ jāyate bhraśyate caiva tat pāpam upaśāmyatām
verses.translation: Indra said to the lord of the gods, "My kingdom again and again arises and falls; let that sin be removed,

verses.sanskrit: यथा स्थिरो ऽहं राज्ये स्यां सर्वं स्यान् निश्चलं मम सुप्रीतौ यदि देवेशौ सर्वं स्यान् निश्चलं सदा
verses.transliteration: yathā sthiro 'haṃ rājye syāṃ sarvaṃ syān niścalaṃ mama suprītau yadi deveśau sarvaṃ syān niścalaṃ sadā
verses.translation: so that I may be firm in my kingdom and everything of mine be steady; if the two lords of gods are well pleased, let everything be ever steady."

verses.transliteration: tatheti harivākyaṃ tāv abhinandyedam ūcatuḥ paraṃ prasādam āpannau tāv ālokya smitānanau
verses.translation: Welcoming Hari's words, "So be it," the two said this, gracious, smiling, looking at them:

verses.sanskrit: निरपायनिराधारनिर्विकारस्वरूपिणौ शरण्यौ सर्वलोकानां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदाव् उभौ
verses.transliteration: nirapāyanirādhāranirvikārasvarūpiṇau śaraṇyau sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāv ubhau
verses.translation: "We two, whose nature is free from decline, without support and changeless, are the refuges of all worlds, granting enjoyment and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदैवत्यं महातीर्थं गौतमी वाञ्छितप्रदा तस्याम् अनेन मन्त्रेण कुरुतां स्नानम् आदरात्
verses.transliteration: tridaivatyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ gautamī vāñchitapradā tasyām anena mantreṇa kurutāṃ snānam ādarāt
verses.translation: The Gautami, great holy place of the three deities, grants what is desired; let bathing be done in her with this mantra, respectfully.

verses.transliteration: abhiṣekaṃ mahendrasya maṅgalāya bṛhaspatiḥ karotu saṃsmarann āvāṃ saṃpadāṃ sthairyasiddhaye
verses.translation: Let Brihaspati perform the anointing of great Indra for auspiciousness, remembering us, for the steadiness of fortune:

verses.sanskrit: इह जन्मनि पूर्वस्मिन् यत् किंचित् सुकृतं कृतम् तत् सर्वं पूर्णताम् एतु गोदावरि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: iha janmani pūrvasmin yat kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam tat sarvaṃ pūrṇatām etu godāvari namo 'stu te
verses.translation: 'Whatever good deed was done in this birth or a former one, may it all become complete; O Godavari, salutation to you.'

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्मृत्वा तु यः कश्चिद् गौतम्यां स्नानम् आचरेत् आवाभ्यां तु प्रसादेन धर्मः संपूर्णताम् इयात् पूर्वजन्मकृताद् दोषात् स मुक्तः पुण्यवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ smṛtvā tu yaḥ kaścid gautamyāṃ snānam ācaret āvābhyāṃ tu prasādena dharmaḥ saṃpūrṇatām iyāt pūrvajanmakṛtād doṣāt sa muktaḥ puṇyavān bhavet
verses.translation: Whoever, remembering thus, bathes in the Gautami — by the grace of us two his dharma will become complete; freed from faults committed in former births, he will become meritorious."

verses.transliteration: tatheti cakratuḥ prītau surendradhiṣaṇau tataḥ mahābhiṣekam indrasya cakāra dyusadāṃ guruḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," the lord of the gods and Dhishana were pleased; then the teacher of the dwellers of heaven performed the great anointing of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाभूद् या नदी पुण्या मङ्गलेत्य् उदिता तु सा तया च संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गायाः शुभदस् त्व् असौ
verses.transliteration: tenābhūd yā nadī puṇyā maṅgalety uditā tu sā tayā ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāḥ śubhadas tv asau
verses.translation: From it arose a holy river called Mangala; its confluence with the Ganga is holy and auspicious.

verses.transliteration: indreṇa saṃstuto viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣo 'bhūj jaganmayaḥ trilokasaṃmitāṃ śakro bhūmiṃ lebhe jagatpateḥ
verses.translation: Praised by Indra, Vishnu, who is the world, appeared visibly; Shakra obtained from the lord of the world the earth equal to the three worlds.

verses.transliteration: tannāmnā cāpi vikhyāto govinda iti tatra ca trilokasaṃmitā labdhā tena gaur vajradhāriṇā
verses.translation: He is famed there by that name, Govinda; the earth (go) equal to the three worlds was obtained by the wielder of the thunderbolt,

verses.transliteration: dattā ca hariṇā tatra govindas tad abhūd dhariḥ trailokyarājyaṃ yat prāptaṃ hariṇā ca harer mune
verses.translation: and given there by Hari; so Hari became Govinda. The kingship of the three worlds that Hari (Indra) obtained from Hari, O sage,

verses.transliteration: niścalaṃ yena saṃjātaṃ devadevān maheśvarāt bṛhaspatir devagurur yatrāstauṣīn maheśvaram
verses.translation: became steady through the god of gods Maheshvara. Where Brihaspati, teacher of the gods, praised Maheshvara

verses.transliteration: rājyasya sthirabhāvāya devendrasya mahātmanaḥ siddheśvaras tatra devo liṅgaṃ tu tridaśārcitam
verses.translation: for the stability of the kingdom of the great-souled lord of the gods, the god there is Siddheshvara, a linga worshipped by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं गोविन्दम् इति विश्रुतम् मङ्गलासंगमं चैव पूर्णतीर्थं ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ govindam iti viśrutam maṅgalāsaṃgamaṃ caiva pūrṇatīrthaṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: From then on that holy place is famed as Govinda, the confluence of the Mangala, and after that Purnatirtha,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca viśrutam yatra siddheśvaro devo viṣṇur govinda eva ca
verses.translation: famed as Indratirtha and known as Barhaspatya, where the god Siddheshvara and Vishnu Govinda are.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानं च दानं च यत् किंचित् सुकृतार्जनम् सर्वं तद् अक्षयं विद्यात् पितॄणाम् अतिवल्लभम्
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yat kiṃcit sukṛtārjanam sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ vidyāt pitṝṇām ativallabham
verses.translation: Whatever bathing, giving and acquisition of merit is done at them — know all of it to be imperishable and very dear to the ancestors.

verses.sanskrit: शृणोति यश् चापि पठेद् यश् च स्मरति नित्यशः तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं भ्रष्टराज्यप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: śṛṇoti yaś cāpi paṭhed yaś ca smarati nityaśaḥ tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam
verses.translation: Whoever hears, reads or daily remembers the greatness of that holy place is restored to a lost kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तत्रिंशत् सहस्राणि तीर्थानां तीरयोर् द्वयोः उभयोर् मुनिशार्दूल सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनाम्
verses.transliteration: saptatriṃśat sahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ ubhayor muniśārdūla sarvasiddhipradāyinām
verses.translation: There are thirty-seven thousand holy places on the two banks, O tiger among sages, granting all perfections.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न पूर्णतीर्थसदृशं तीर्थम् अस्ति महाफलम् निष्फलं तस्य जन्मादि यो न सेवेत तन् नरः
verses.transliteration: na pūrṇatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrtham asti mahāphalam niṣphalaṃ tasya janmādi yo na seveta tan naraḥ
verses.translation: There is no holy place of great fruit like Purnatirtha; fruitless is the birth of the man who does not resort to it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रामतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं भ्रूणहत्याविनाशनम् तस्य श्रवणमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: rāmatīrtham iti khyātaṃ bhrūṇahatyāvināśanam tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages. I shall mention in due order how a person shall attain devotion to Visnu with great benefit.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O leading sages. I shall mention in due order how a person shall attain devotion to Visnu with great benefit.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवः क्षत्रियो लोकविश्रुतः बलवान् मतिमाञ् शूरो यथा शक्रः पुरंदरः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavaḥ kṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ balavān matimāñ śūro yathā śakraḥ puraṃdaraḥ
verses.translation: After human birth he attains brahminhood, power of discrimination, sense of piety and happiness in successive births.
verses.commentary: Sense: After human birth he attains brahminhood, power of discrimination, sense of piety and happiness in successive births.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कुर्वन्न् आस्ते यथा बलिः तस्य तिस्रो महिष्यः स्यू राज्ञो दशरथस्य हि
verses.transliteration: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ kurvann āste yathā baliḥ tasya tisro mahiṣyaḥ syū rājño daśarathasya hi
verses.translation: Until the ultimate destruction of all sins of men accumu¬ lated in different births, devotion to Vasudeva identical with the universe, is not possible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Until the ultimate destruction of all sins of men accumu¬ lated in different births, devotion to Vasudeva identical with the universe, is not possible.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कौशल्या च सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च महामते एताः कुलीनाः सुभगा रूपलक्षणसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: kauśalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca mahāmate etāḥ kulīnāḥ subhagā rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, with great concentration and purity of mind be begins to love the fire-god. When the fire-god is pro¬ pitiated he becomes a devotee of sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O brahmins, with great concentration and purity of mind be begins to love the fire-god. When the fire-god is pro¬ pitiated he becomes a devotee of sun.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् राजनि राज्ये तु स्थिते ऽयोध्यापतौ मुने वसिष्ठे ब्रह्मविच्छ्रेष्ठे पुरोधसि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasmin rājani rājye tu sthite 'yodhyāpatau mune vasiṣṭhe brahmavicchreṣṭhe purodhasi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, he worships sun-god regularly. When that god is pleased he becomes devoted to Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he worships sun-god regularly. When that god is pleased he becomes devoted to Sankara.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न च व्याधिर् न दुर्भिक्षं न चावृष्टिर् न चाधयः ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां नित्यं शूद्राणां च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: na ca vyādhir na durbhikṣaṃ na cāvṛṣṭir na cādhayaḥ brahmakṣatraviśāṃ nityaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He performs the worship of Sambhu duly and strenuo¬ usly. When the three-eyed god is satisfied he becomes devoted to Kesava.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performs the worship of Sambhu duly and strenuo¬ usly. When the three-eyed god is satisfied he becomes devoted to Kesava.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमाणां तु सर्वेषाम् आनन्दो ऽभूत् पृथक् पृथक् तस्मिञ् शासति राजेन्द्र इक्ष्वाकूणां कुलोद्वहे
verses.transliteration: āśramāṇāṃ tu sarveṣām ānando 'bhūt pṛthak pṛthak tasmiñ śāsati rājendra ikṣvākūṇāṃ kulodvahe
verses.translation: By worshipping the imperishable lord of the universe named Vasudeva, O excellent brahmins, he attains worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshipping the imperishable lord of the universe named Vasudeva, O excellent brahmins, he attains worldly pleasures and salvation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवानां दानवानां तु राज्यार्थे विग्रहो ऽभवत् क्वापि तत्र जयं प्रापुर् देवाः क्वापि तथेतरे
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ dānavānāṃ tu rājyārthe vigraho 'bhavat kvāpi tatra jayaṃ prāpur devāḥ kvāpi tathetare
verses.translation: O great sage, some men are averse to devotion of Visnu. O brahmin, tell us why they do not worship Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, some men are averse to devotion of Visnu. O brahmin, tell us why they do not worship Visnu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रवर्तमाने तु त्रैलोक्यम् अतिपीडितम् अभून् नारद तत्राहम् अवदं दैत्यदानवान्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pravartamāne tu trailokyam atipīḍitam abhūn nārada tatrāham avadaṃ daityadānavān
verses.translation: In this world, O excellent sages, two types of created be¬ ings are well-known, viz. Asura (demonic) and Daiva (di¬ vine). They are created formerly by the self-born lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world, O excellent sages, two types of created be¬ ings are well-known, viz. Asura (demonic) and Daiva (di¬ vine). They are created formerly by the self-born lord.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवांश् चापि विशेषेण न कृतं तैर् मदीरितम् पुनश् च संगरस् तेषां बभूव सुमहान् मिथः
verses.transliteration: devāṃś cāpi viśeṣeṇa na kṛtaṃ tair madīritam punaś ca saṃgaras teṣāṃ babhūva sumahān mithaḥ
verses.translation: By attaining the divine nature men worship Acyuta. Those who have attained the demonic nature slander Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: By attaining the divine nature men worship Acyuta. Those who have attained the demonic nature slander Hari.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं गत्वा सुराः प्रोचुस् तथेशानं जगन्मयम् ताव् ऊचतुर् उभौ देवान् असुरान् दैत्यदानवान्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ gatvā surāḥ procus tatheśānaṃ jaganmayam tāv ūcatur ubhau devān asurān daityadānavān
verses.translation: We all wish to comprehend that insurmountable Maya of Visnu. Osage conversant with details of virtue, it behoves you to narrate. Our eagerness is great.
verses.commentary: Sense: We all wish to comprehend that insurmountable Maya of Visnu. Osage conversant with details of virtue, it behoves you to narrate. Our eagerness is great.

verses.transliteration: tapasā balino yāntu punaḥ kurvantu saṃgaram tathety āhur yayuḥ sarve tapase niyatavratāḥ
verses.translation: The father endeavoured to cclehmt P u.v
verses.commentary: Sense: The father endeavoured to cclehmt P u.v

verses.sanskrit: ययुस् तु राक्षसान् देवाः पुनस् ते मत्सरान्विताः देवानां दानवानां च संगरो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: yayus tu rākṣasān devāḥ punas te matsarānvitāḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgaro 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even after hearing the words of h;. r, tained silence with solemnity Oku- h f her he mam " him frequently. rahmins, the father urged

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र देवा जेतारो नैव दैत्याश् च दानवाः संयुगे वर्तमाने तु वाग् उवाचाशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: na tatra devā jetāro naiva daityāś ca dānavāḥ saṃyuge vartamāne tu vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
verses.translation: On hearing the behest of his father the son of perfect self-control was reminded of the old strange ways of the world He said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the behest of his father the son of perfect self-control was reminded of the old strange ways of the world He said:

verses.sanskrit: येषां दशरथो राजा ते जेतारो न चेतरे
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ daśaratho rājā te jetāro na cetare
verses.translation: I have acquired thousands of births, hundreds of deaths and old age and acquisitions of and separation from wives in all of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have acquired thousands of births, hundreds of deaths and old age and acquisitions of and separation from wives in all of them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा जयायोभौ जग्मतुर् देवदानवौ तत्र वायुस् त्वरन् प्राप्तो राजानम् अवदत् तदा
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā jayāyobhau jagmatur devadānavau tatra vāyus tvaran prāpto rājānam avadat tadā
verses.translation: Hundreds of different states have been attained by me —like those of grass, shrubs, creepers, winding plants, reptiles, animals, birds, beasts, women, men etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds of different states have been attained by me —like those of grass, shrubs, creepers, winding plants, reptiles, animals, birds, beasts, women, men etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आगन्तव्यं त्वया राजन् देवदानवसंगरे यत्र राजा दशरथो जयस् तत्रेति विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: āgantavyaṃ tvayā rājan devadānavasaṃgare yatra rājā daśaratho jayas tatreti viśrutam
verses.translation: In view of my being united with a wife I had been
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of my being united with a wife I had been
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं देवपक्षे स्या भवेयुर् जयिनः सुराः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvaṃ devapakṣe syā bhaveyur jayinaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: After passing through many births as man, god, Gan-
verses.commentary: Sense: After passing through many births as man, god, Gan-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वायुवचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दशरथो नृपः आगम्यते मया सत्यं गच्छ वायो यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tad vāyuvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā daśaratho nṛpaḥ āgamyate mayā satyaṃ gaccha vāyo yathāsukham
verses.translation: Then my devotion to Visnu, the slayer of Madhu and the lord of worlds, was very steady. By means of devotion and different holy rites and fasts, the wielder of discus, club and other miraculous weapons was propitiated by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then my devotion to Visnu, the slayer of Madhu and the lord of worlds, was very steady. By means of devotion and different holy rites and fasts, the wielder of discus, club and other miraculous weapons was propitiated by me.

verses.sanskrit: गते वायौ तदा दैत्या आजग्मुर् भूपतिं प्रति ते ऽप्य् ऊचुर् भगवन्न् अस्मत्साहाय्यं कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: gate vāyau tadā daityā ājagmur bhūpatiṃ prati te 'py ūcur bhagavann asmatsāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: The delighted noble Visnu came there riding on the lord of birds (Garuda) (with the intention of) granting me boons. He said in a loud voice: Cf O twice-born one, let any boon be prayed for. I shall give you whatever you desire."
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted noble Visnu came there riding on the lord of birds (Garuda) (with the intention of) granting me boons. He said in a loud voice: Cf O twice-born one, let any boon be prayed for. I shall give you whatever you desire."

verses.sanskrit: राजन् दशरथ श्रीमन् विजयस् त्वयि संस्थितः तस्मात् त्वं वै दैत्यपतेः साहाय्यं कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.transliteration: rājan daśaratha śrīman vijayas tvayi saṃsthitaḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vai daityapateḥ sāhāyyaṃ kartum arhasi
verses.translation: Then I said to lord Hari: "O Kes'ava, if you are pleased I shall choose a boon. O Janardana, I wish to know that great Maya belonging to you".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I said to lord Hari: "O Kes'ava, if you are pleased I shall choose a boon. O Janardana, I wish to know that great Maya belonging to you".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रोवाच नृपतिर् वायुना प्रार्थितः पुरा प्रतिज्ञातं मया तच् च यान्तु दैत्याश् च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ provāca nṛpatir vāyunā prārthitaḥ purā pratijñātaṃ mayā tac ca yāntu daityāś ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: The enemy of Madhu and Kaitabha then said to me: "O brahmin, of what avail is that Maya to you? I shall give unto you virtue, wealth and love, prominent sons and freedom from sickness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The enemy of Madhu and Kaitabha then said to me: "O brahmin, of what avail is that Maya to you? I shall give unto you virtue, wealth and love, prominent sons and freedom from sickness.

verses.sanskrit: स तु राजा तथा चक्रे गत्वा चैव त्रिविष्टपम् युद्धं चक्रे तथा दैत्यैर् दानवैः सह राक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: sa tu rājā tathā cakre gatvā caiva triviṣṭapam yuddhaṃ cakre tathā daityair dānavaiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: Then I said again to the enemy of Mura: "This is my desire to conquer wealth and virtue. I wish to know your Maya, O Puskaraksa (Lotus-eyed one). Show that unto me 55.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then I said again to the enemy of Mura: "This is my desire to conquer wealth and virtue. I wish to know your Maya, O Puskaraksa (Lotus-eyed one). Show that unto me 55.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यत्सु देवसंघेषु नमुचेर् भ्रातरस् तदा विविधुर् निशितैर् बाणैर् अथाक्षं नृपतेस् तथा
verses.transliteration: paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu namucer bhrātaras tadā vividhur niśitair bāṇair athākṣaṃ nṛpates tathā
verses.translation: Then lord Visnu, the prominent Man-Lion, the lord of goddess of wealth said these words to me: "No one knows my Maya nor will any one ever know it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Visnu, the prominent Man-Lion, the lord of goddess of wealth said these words to me: "No one knows my Maya nor will any one ever know it.

verses.commentary: Sense: Then the two blind sons and the deaf daughter came there. They too were distressed and on perceiving their crying father they wept bitterly.

verses.sanskrit: तावत् पुंभिर् जीवितव्यं यावल् लक्ष्मीर् दृढं वपुः यावद् आज्ञाप्रतिहता तीर्थादाव् अन्यथा मृतिः
verses.transliteration: tāvat puṃbhir jīvitavyaṃ yāval lakṣmīr dṛḍhaṃ vapuḥ yāvad ājñāpratihatā tīrthādāv anyathā mṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him cry along with his daughter and sons I too became distressed. Grief reminded me, O King, that I was myself the Canclala maiden.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him cry along with his daughter and sons I too became distressed. Grief reminded me, O King, that I was myself the Canclala maiden.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा वृद्धयोर् गुरुवत्सलः पुत्रः प्रोवाच तद् दुःखं गिरा मधुरया हरन्
verses.transliteration: ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhayor guruvatsalaḥ putraḥ provāca tad duḥkhaṃ girā madhurayā haran
verses.translation: Then, O King, I said to that Candala: "Why do you cry in distress? You are not going to get her back by your foolish cries. It is in vain. Of what avail to you is this lamen¬ tation?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O King, I said to that Candala: "Why do you cry in distress? You are not going to get her back by your foolish cries. It is in vain. Of what avail to you is this lamen¬ tation?"

verses.sanskrit: मयि जीवति किं नाम युवयोर् दुःखम् ईदृशम् न हरत्य् आत्मजः पित्रोर् यश् चरित्रैर् मनोरुजम्
verses.transliteration: mayi jīvati kiṃ nāma yuvayor duḥkham īdṛśam na haraty ātmajaḥ pitror yaś caritrair manorujam
verses.translation: He said to me: "Both these sons are blind. The only girl is deaf. How can I, O brahmin, console these and biing them up?"
verses.commentary: Sense: He said to me: "Both these sons are blind. The only girl is deaf. How can I, O brahmin, console these and biing them up?"

verses.sanskrit: तेन किं तनुजेनेह कुलोद्वेगविधायिना
verses.transliteration: tena kiṃ tanujeneha kulodvegavidhāyinā
verses.translation: After saying this he cried all the more loudly along with his children. The longer I watched the Candala crying the more I pitied him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this he cried all the more loudly along with his children. The longer I watched the Candala crying the more I pitied him.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा पितरौ नत्वा ताव् आश्वास्य महामनाः तरुस्कन्धे समारोप्य वृद्धौ च पितरौ तदा
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā pitarau natvā tāv āśvāsya mahāmanāḥ taruskandhe samāropya vṛddhau ca pitarau tadā
verses.translation: Preventing him frpm crying further in his grief, I nari'ated to him the incidents of my life. Thereupon the dis¬ tressed man entered the waters of Kokamukha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Preventing him frpm crying further in his grief, I nari'ated to him the incidents of my life. Thereupon the dis¬ tressed man entered the waters of Kokamukha.

verses.sanskrit: हस्ते गृहीत्वा कलशं जगाम ऋषिपुत्रकः स ऋषिर् न तु राजानं जानाति नृपतिर् द्विजम्
verses.transliteration: haste gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ jagāma ṛṣiputrakaḥ sa ṛṣir na tu rājānaṃ jānāti nṛpatir dvijam
verses.translation: Immediately after his entry into the water the Can¬ dala became free from sins by the efficacy of the Tlrtha. Even
verses.commentary: Sense: Immediately after his entry into the water the Can¬ dala became free from sins by the efficacy of the Tlrtha. Even
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उभौ सरभसौ तत्र द्विजो वारि समाविशत् सत्वरं कलशे न्युब्जे वारि गृह्णन्तम् आशुगैः
verses.transliteration: ubhau sarabhasau tatra dvijo vāri samāviśat satvaraṃ kalaśe nyubje vāri gṛhṇantam āśugaiḥ
verses.translation: After his entering the water and passing away my grief increased causing me great delusion. Then, O excellent king, I dived into the sacred waters of the Koka and went to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: After his entering the water and passing away my grief increased causing me great delusion. Then, O excellent king, I dived into the sacred waters of the Koka and went to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: द्विजं राजा द्विपं मत्वा विव्याध निशितैः शरैः वनद्विपो ऽपि भूपानाम् अवध्यस् तद् विदन्न् अपि
verses.transliteration: dvijaṃ rājā dvipaṃ matvā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ vanadvipo 'pi bhūpānām avadhyas tad vidann api
verses.translation: I observed holy rites and'made my body emaciated. Then I went to heaven. Coming down therefrom I am now born in your, abode. O father, I can remember my previous births by the grace of Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: I observed holy rites and'made my body emaciated. Then I went to heaven. Coming down therefrom I am now born in your, abode. O father, I can remember my previous births by the grace of Hari.

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध तं नृपः कुर्यान् न किं किं विधिवञ्चितः स विद्धो मर्मदेशे तु दुःखितो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vivyādha taṃ nṛpaḥ kuryān na kiṃ kiṃ vidhivañcitaḥ sa viddho marmadeśe tu duḥkhito vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus O brahmins, the Maya of the great lord, has been described by me. Even Devas are not able to think about it. It is like a dream or the jugglery of a conjuror. The whole universe is deluded by it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: kenedaṃ duḥkhadaṃ karma kṛtaṃ sadbrāhmaṇasya me maitro brāhmaṇa ity ukto nāparādho 'sti kaścana
verses.translation: "Who has done this painful deed to me, a good brahmin? I am called the friendly brahmin; I have committed no offence."

verses.transliteration: tad etad vacanaṃ śrutvā muner ārtasya bhūpatiḥ niśceṣṭaś ca nirutsāho śanais taṃ deśam abhyagāt
verses.translation: Hearing these words of the distressed sage, the king, motionless and dispirited, slowly approached the place.

verses.sanskrit: तं तु दृष्ट्वा द्विजवरं ज्वलन्तम् इव तेजसा असाव् अप्य् अभवत् तत्र सशल्य इव मूर्च्छितः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvijavaraṃ jvalantam iva tejasā asāv apy abhavat tatra saśalya iva mūrcchitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that excellent brahmin, as if blazing with splendour, he too swooned there as if pierced by a dart.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानम् आत्मना कृत्वा स्थिरं राजाब्रवीद् इदम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānam ātmanā kṛtvā sthiraṃ rājābravīd idam
verses.translation: Steadying himself by himself, the king said this:

verses.sanskrit: को भवान् द्विजशार्दूल किमर्थम् इह चागतः वद पापकृते मह्यं वद मे निष्कृतिं पराम्
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān dvijaśārdūla kimartham iha cāgataḥ vada pāpakṛte mahyaṃ vada me niṣkṛtiṃ parām
verses.translation: "Who are you, tiger among brahmins, and why have you come here? Tell me, a sinner; tell me the supreme expiation.

verses.translation: Hearing the king's words, the sage's son said:

verses.translation: "My life-breaths will depart, so I will say something: know that in the ignorance of acting at will there is a ripening of deeds.

verses.transliteration: ātmārthaṃ tu na śocāmi vṛddhau tu pitarau mama tayoḥ śuśrūṣakaḥ kaḥ syād andhayor ekaputrayoḥ
verses.translation: I do not grieve for myself; but my parents are old — who will serve them, blind, with an only son?

verses.transliteration: vinā mayā mahāraṇye kathaṃ tau jīvayiṣyataḥ mamābhāgyam aho kīdṛk pitṛśuśrūṣaṇe kṣatiḥ
verses.translation: Without me, how will they live in the great forest? Ah, what is my misfortune — a failure in serving my parents

verses.transliteration: jātā me 'dya vinā prāṇair hā vidhe kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā tathāpi gaccha tatra tvaṃ gṛhītakalaśas tvaran

verses.translation: and give them water so that they do not die."

verses.translation: As he spoke thus, his life departed in the great forest; laying aside his bow and arrow and taking the pitcher, the king

verses.translation: "Is he troubled or angry, or has he been devoured? Our staff has not come; what shall we do, what will become of us?

verses.translation: There is no other son like him in all creation, who never disobeys his parents' words even when reproached.

verses.translation: As the old couple spoke many such words in the forest, King Dasharatha slowly approached that place.

verses.translation: By the sound of his footsteps they thought their son had come:

verses.sanskrit: कुतो वत्स चिरात् प्राप्तस् त्वं दृष्टिस् त्वं परायणम् न ब्रूषे किंतु रुष्टो ऽसि वृद्धयोर् अन्धयोः सुतः
verses.transliteration: kuto vatsa cirāt prāptas tvaṃ dṛṣṭis tvaṃ parāyaṇam na brūṣe kiṃtu ruṣṭo 'si vṛddhayor andhayoḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: "Where have you come from so late, child? You are our sight and refuge. Why do you not speak — are you angry, son of the old blind couple?"

verses.sanskrit: सशल्य इव दुःखार्तः शोचन् दुष्कृतम् आत्मनः स भीत इव राजेन्द्रस् ताव् उवाचाथ नारद
verses.transliteration: saśalya iva duḥkhārtaḥ śocan duṣkṛtam ātmanaḥ sa bhīta iva rājendras tāv uvācātha nārada
verses.translation: Grief-stricken as if pierced by a dart, lamenting his evil deed, the king of kings, as if afraid, said to them, O Narada:

verses.sanskrit: उदपानं च कुरुतां तच् छ्रुत्वा नृपभाषितम् नायं वक्ता सुतो ऽस्माकं को भवांस् तत् पुरा वद
verses.transliteration: udapānaṃ ca kurutāṃ tac chrutvā nṛpabhāṣitam nāyaṃ vaktā suto 'smākaṃ ko bhavāṃs tat purā vada
verses.translation: "Drink water." Hearing the king's words, they said, "This speaker is not our son; tell us first who you are;

verses.transliteration: paścāt pibāvaḥ pānīyaṃ tato rājābravīc ca tau
verses.translation: then we will drink the water." Then the king said to them:

verses.transliteration: tatra tiṣṭhati vāṃ putro yatra vārisamāśrayaḥ
verses.translation: "Your son lies where the water is."

verses.translation: Hearing that, the distressed pair said, "Tell the truth, not otherwise." Then the king told everything as it was.

verses.transliteration: tatas tu patitau vṛddhau tatrāvāṃ naya mā spṛśa brahmaghnasparśanaṃ pāpaṃ na kadācid vinaśyati
verses.translation: Then the old couple fell down: "Take us there; do not touch us; the sin of touching the slayer of a brahmin never perishes."

verses.transliteration: ninye vai śravaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ sabhāryaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ yatrāsau patitaḥ putras taṃ spṛṣṭvā tau vilepatuḥ
verses.translation: The best of kings led the old Shravana's father with his wife to where their son had fallen; touching him, they lamented:

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुत्रवियोगेन मृत्युर् नौ विहितस् तथा त्वं चापि पाप पुत्रस्य वियोगान् मृत्युम् आप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: yathā putraviyogena mṛtyur nau vihitas tathā tvaṃ cāpi pāpa putrasya viyogān mṛtyum āpsyasi
verses.translation: "As our death has been brought about by separation from our son, so you too, sinner, will meet death through separation from your son."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu jalpator brahman gatāḥ prāṇās tato nṛpaḥ agninā yojayām āsa vṛddhau ca ṛṣiputrakam
verses.translation: As they spoke thus, O Brahman, their life-breaths departed; then the king placed the old couple and the sage's son in the fire.

verses.sanskrit: ततो जगाम नगरं दुःखितो नृपतिर् मुने वसिष्ठाय च तत् सर्वं न्यवेदयद् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tato jagāma nagaraṃ duḥkhito nṛpatir mune vasiṣṭhāya ca tat sarvaṃ nyavedayad aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then the grieving king went to the city, O sage, and told Vasishtha everything completely.

verses.translation: and sacrifice with many horse sacrifices with abundant fees."

verses.transliteration: pūtaṃ śarīram abhavad rājño daśarathasya hi vyavahāryaś ca bhavitā bhaviṣyanti tathā sutāḥ jyeṣṭhaputraprasādena rājāpāpo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "King Dasharatha's body has become pure; he will be fit for social dealings and will have sons; by the grace of his eldest son the king will become sinless."

verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhena tadā prokto rājā daśarathas tv iti
verses.translation: Then Vasishtha said to King Dasharatha:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: raghavaḥ prārthanābhaṅgaṃ na rājan kvāpi śikṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "The Raghus have never been taught to refuse a request, O king."

verses.transliteration: rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva kathaṃcid avadan nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: With difficulty the king said to Rama and Lakshmana:

verses.transliteration: viśvāmitrasya brahmarṣeḥ kurutāṃ yajñarakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "Protect the sacrifice of the brahmin sage Vishvamitra."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वदन्न् इति सुतौ सोष्णं निश्वसन् ग्लपिताधरः पुत्रौ समर्पयाम् आस विश्वामित्रस्य शास्त्रकृत्
verses.transliteration: vadann iti sutau soṣṇaṃ niśvasan glapitādharaḥ putrau samarpayām āsa viśvāmitrasya śāstrakṛt
verses.translation: Saying this, sighing hotly, his lips parched, the upholder of scripture handed his two sons to Vishvamitra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा दशरथं नमस्य च पुनः पुनः जग्मतू रक्षणार्थाय विश्वामित्रेण तौ मुदा
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā daśarathaṃ namasya ca punaḥ punaḥ jagmatū rakṣaṇārthāya viśvāmitreṇa tau mudā
verses.translation: Saying "So be it" to Dasharatha and bowing again and again, the two joyfully went with Vishvamitra to protect the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टः स मुनिर् मुदा प्रादात् तदोभयोः माहेश्वरीं महाविद्यां धनुर्विद्यापुरःसराम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sa munir mudā prādāt tadobhayoḥ māheśvarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ dhanurvidyāpuraḥsarām
verses.translation: Then the sage, delighted, joyfully gave both of them the great knowledge of Maheshvara, headed by the science of archery,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रीम् आस्त्रीं लौकिकीं च रथविद्यां गजोद्भवाम् अश्वविद्यां गदाविद्यां मन्त्राह्वानविसर्जने
verses.transliteration: śāstrīm āstrīṃ laukikīṃ ca rathavidyāṃ gajodbhavām aśvavidyāṃ gadāvidyāṃ mantrāhvānavisarjane
verses.translation: the scriptural, the missile and the worldly sciences, the science of chariots, of elephants, of horses, of the mace, and the invoking and releasing of mantras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वविद्याम् अथावाप्य उभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ वनौकसां हितार्थाय जघ्नतुस् ताटकां वने
verses.transliteration: sarvavidyām athāvāpya ubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau vanaukasāṃ hitārthāya jaghnatus tāṭakāṃ vane
verses.translation: Having obtained all knowledge, Rama and Lakshmana killed Tataka in the forest for the good of the forest-dwellers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहल्यां शापनिर्मुक्तां पादस्पर्शाच् च चक्रतुः यज्ञविध्वंसनायाताञ् जघ्नतुस् तत्र राक्षसान्
verses.transliteration: ahalyāṃ śāpanirmuktāṃ pādasparśāc ca cakratuḥ yajñavidhvaṃsanāyātāñ jaghnatus tatra rākṣasān
verses.translation: They freed Ahalya from her curse by the touch of a foot, and killed the Rakshasas who came to destroy the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतविद्यौ धनुष्पाणी चक्रतुर् यज्ञरक्षणम् ततो महामखे वृत्ते विश्वामित्रो मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kṛtavidyau dhanuṣpāṇī cakratur yajñarakṣaṇam tato mahāmakhe vṛtte viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Skilled in knowledge, bows in hand, they protected the sacrifice. When the great sacrifice was over, Vishvamitra, lord of sages,

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राभ्यां सहितो राज्ञो जनकं द्रष्टुम् अभ्यगात् चित्राम् अदर्शयत् तत्र राजमध्ये नृपात्मजः
verses.transliteration: putrābhyāṃ sahito rājño janakaṃ draṣṭum abhyagāt citrām adarśayat tatra rājamadhye nṛpātmajaḥ
verses.translation: went with the king's two sons to see Janaka. There among the kings the prince displayed a wonder:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
