verses.sanskrit: रामः सौमित्रिसहितो धनुर्विद्यां गुरोर् मताम् तत्प्रीतो जनकः प्रादात् सीतां लक्ष्मीम् अयोनिजाम्
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ saumitrisahito dhanurvidyāṃ guror matām tatprīto janakaḥ prādāt sītāṃ lakṣmīm ayonijām
verses.translation: Rama with Saumitri showed the archery approved by his teacher; pleased, Janaka gave Sita, Lakshmi not born of a womb.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tathaiva lakṣmaṇasyāpi bharatasyānujasya ca śatrughnabharatādīnāṃ vasiṣṭhādimate sthitaḥ

verses.transliteration: rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmān vivāham akaron mune tato bahutithe kāle rājyaṃ tasya prayacchati
verses.translation: the glorious King Dasharatha performed the marriages, O sage. Then after many days, when he was giving the kingdom to him

verses.translation: with the consent of all the people and the teacher, Kaikeyi, impelled by the ill fate in the form of Manthara and filled with jealousy,

verses.transliteration: kaikeyī vighnam ātasthe vanapravrājanaṃ tathā bharatasya ca tad rājyaṃ rājā naiva ca dattavān
verses.translation: set up an obstacle and the banishment to the forest; and the king did not give that kingdom to Bharata.

verses.translation: Keeping his father's word true, Rama entered the great forest with Sita and with Saumitri,

verses.transliteration: satāṃ ca mānasaṃ śuddhaṃ sa viveśa svakair guṇaiḥ tasmin vinirgate rāme vanavāsāya dīkṣite
verses.translation: and by his own virtues he entered the pure minds of the good. When Rama had gone out, consecrated for dwelling in the forest,

verses.translation: with Lakshmana and Sita, free from thirst for the kingdom, overcome with great grief for Rama, Saumitri and the virtuous Sita,

verses.translation: and remembering the brahmin's curse, King Dasharatha, grief-stricken, gave up his life.

verses.transliteration: kṛtakarmavipākena rājā nīto yamānugaiḥ tasmai rājñe mahāprājña yāvat sthāvarajaṅgame
verses.translation: By the ripening of his deeds the king was taken by Yama's servants; for that king, O wise one, among the unmoving and moving,

verses.transliteration: yamasadmany anekāni tāmisrādīni nārada narakāṇy atha ghorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni bahūni ca
verses.translation: in Yama's abode there were many hells beginning with Tamisra, O Narada, terrible, fearsome and many.

verses.translation: Cast into those hells one after another, the king was cooked, cut, ground and crushed,

verses.translation: dried, bitten, burned again and submerged; the king was tormented in such terrible hells.

verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi gacchann adhvānaṃ citrakūṭam athāgamat tatraiva trīṇi varṣāṇi vyatītāni mahāmate
verses.translation: Rama too, going along the road, came to Chitrakuta; there three years passed, O wise one.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः स दक्षिणाम् आशाम् आक्रामद् दण्डकं वनम् विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु देशानां तद् धि पुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: punaḥ sa dakṣiṇām āśām ākrāmad daṇḍakaṃ vanam vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu deśānāṃ tad dhi puṇyadam
verses.translation: Again he went south into the Dandaka forest, famed in the three worlds, the most meritorious of lands.

verses.transliteration: prāviśat tan mahāraṇyaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ daityasevitam tadbhayād ṛṣibhis tyaktaṃ hatvā daityāṃs tu rākṣasān
verses.translation: He entered that great forest, terrible and frequented by Daityas, abandoned by the sages out of fear of them; killing the Daityas and Rakshasas,

verses.transliteration: vicaran daṇḍakāraṇye ṛṣisevyam athākarot tatredaṃ vṛttam ākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ
verses.translation: wandering in the Dandaka forest, he made it fit for the sages to frequent. There I shall tell this story; hear it carefully, O Narada.

verses.transliteration: tāvac chanais tv agād rāmo yāvad yojanapañcakam gautamīṃ samanuprāpto rājāpi narake sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Slowly Rama went up to five yojanas and reached the Gautami, while the king was in hell.

verses.transliteration: yamaḥ svakiṃkarān āha rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ gautamīm abhito yāti pitaraṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Yama said to his servants: "Rama, son of Dasharatha, is going toward the Gautami; his wise father —

verses.translation: draw the king out of hell without doubt. As long as Rama goes across the Gautami for five yojanas,

verses.transliteration: rāmas tāvat tasya pitā narake naiva pacyatām yad etan madvacaḥ puṇyaṃ na kuryur yadi dūtakāḥ
verses.translation: so long his father must not be cooked in hell. If the messengers do not carry out this holy word of mine,

verses.transliteration: tataś ca narake ghore yūyaṃ sarve nimajjatha yā kāpy uktā parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī
verses.translation: then all of you will sink in terrible hell. Whatever supreme power of Shiva is said to be inseparable from him,

verses.sanskrit: ताम् एव गौतमीं सन्तो वदन्त्य् अम्भःस्वरूपिणीम् हरिब्रह्ममहेशानां मान्या वन्द्या च सैव यत्
verses.transliteration: tām eva gautamīṃ santo vadanty ambhaḥsvarūpiṇīm haribrahmamaheśānāṃ mānyā vandyā ca saiva yat
verses.translation: the good call that very Gautami, in the form of water; she is honoured and worshipped by Hari, Brahma and Mahesha.

verses.transliteration: nistīryate na kenāpi tad atikramajaṃ tv agham pāpino 'py ātmajaḥ kaścid yaś ca gaṅgām anusmaret
verses.translation: The sin of transgressing her cannot be crossed by anyone. Even the son of a sinner who remembers the Ganga

verses.transliteration: so 'nekadurganirayān nirgato muktatāṃ vrajet kiṃ punas tādṛśaḥ putro gautamīnikaṭe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: comes out of many hellish fortresses and attains liberation — how much more such a son staying near the Gautami,

verses.transliteration: tat putravacanaṃ śrutvā śanair āhūya vācayā uvācādhomukho bhūtvā snuṣāṃ putrau kṛtāñjaliḥ muhur antar vinidhyāyan gatiṃ duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ

verses.sanskrit: अहं दशरथो राजा पुत्रौ मे शृणुतं वचः तिसृभिर् ब्रह्महत्याभिर् वृतो ऽहं दुःखम् आगतः छिन्नं पश्यत मे देहं नरकेषु च पातितम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ daśaratho rājā putrau me śṛṇutaṃ vacaḥ tisṛbhir brahmahatyābhir vṛto 'haṃ duḥkham āgataḥ chinnaṃ paśyata me dehaṃ narakeṣu ca pātitam
verses.translation: "I am King Dasharatha; my sons, hear my words. Beset by three brahmin-slayings, I have come to sorrow; see my body cut and cast into hells."

verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rāmaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca bhūmau praṇemus te sarve vacanaṃ caitad abruvan
verses.translation: Then Rama with joined palms, with Sita and Lakshmana, all bowed to the ground and said these words:

verses.sanskrit: कस्येदं कर्मणस् तात फलं नृपतिसत्तम
verses.transliteration: kasyedaṃ karmaṇas tāta phalaṃ nṛpatisattama
verses.translation: "Of what deed is this the fruit, father, best of kings?"

verses.transliteration: sa ca prāha yathāvṛttaṃ brahmahatyātrayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: And he told as it happened the three brahmin-slayings:

verses.transliteration: niṣkṛtir brahmahantṝṇāṃ putrau kvāpi na vidyate
verses.translation: "There is no expiation anywhere, my sons, for the slayers of brahmins."

verses.transliteration: tato duḥkhena mahatāvṛtāḥ sarve bhuvaṃ gatāḥ rājānaṃ vanavāsaṃ ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: Then, overcome with great grief, all fell to the ground; remembering the king, the forest-dwelling, their mothers and father,

verses.sanskrit: दुःखागमं कर्मगतिं नरके पातनं तथा एवमाद्य् अथ संस्मृत्य मुमोह नृपतेः सुतः विसंज्ञं नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा सीता वाक्यम् अथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhāgamaṃ karmagatiṃ narake pātanaṃ tathā evamādy atha saṃsmṛtya mumoha nṛpateḥ sutaḥ visaṃjñaṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā sītā vākyam athābravīt
verses.translation: the coming of sorrow, the course of karma and the fall into hell, the prince swooned; seeing the prince unconscious, Sita said:

verses.sanskrit: न शोचन्ति महात्मानस् त्वादृशा व्यसनागमे चिन्तयन्ति प्रतीकारं दैव्यम् अप्य् अथ मानुषम्
verses.transliteration: na śocanti mahātmānas tvādṛśā vyasanāgame cintayanti pratīkāraṃ daivyam apy atha mānuṣam
verses.translation: "Great souls like you do not grieve when misfortune comes; they think of a remedy, divine or human.

verses.sanskrit: शोचद्भिर् युगसाहस्रं विपत्तिर् नैव तीर्यते व्यामोहम् आप्नुवन्तीह न कदाचिद् विचक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: śocadbhir yugasāhasraṃ vipattir naiva tīryate vyāmoham āpnuvantīha na kadācid vicakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: By those who grieve for a thousand ages calamity is not crossed; the discerning never fall into bewilderment here.

verses.transliteration: kim anenātra duḥkhena niṣphalena janeśvara dehi hatyāṃ prathamato yā jātā hy atibhīṣaṇā
verses.translation: What use is this fruitless grief here, O lord of people? Give me the first slaying, which was very terrible —

verses.transliteration: pitṛbhaktaḥ puṇyaśīlo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ anāgā yo hato vipras tatpāpasyātra niṣkṛtim
verses.translation: for the brahmin who was killed though innocent, devoted to his parents, of holy conduct, master of the Vedas and their limbs — I will perform the expiation for that sin

verses.sanskrit: महापातकसंघातविघातकृद् अनुस्मृतिः तत्रागच्छंल् लोकपाला रुद्रादित्यास् तथाश्विनौ
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakasaṃghātavighātakṛd anusmṛtiḥ tatrāgacchaṃl lokapālā rudrādityās tathāśvinau
verses.translation: whose very remembrance destroys the mass of great sins. There came the guardians of the worlds, the Rudras, the Adityas and the two Ashvins,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्वं स्वं विमानम् आरूढास् तेषां मध्ये ऽतिदीप्तिमान् विमानवरम् आरूढः स्तूयमानश् च किंनरैः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ svaṃ vimānam ārūḍhās teṣāṃ madhye 'tidīptimān vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ stūyamānaś ca kiṃnaraiḥ
verses.translation: each mounted on his own celestial car; among them, on the finest car, exceedingly radiant and praised by the Kinnaras,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यसदृशाकारस् तेषां मध्ये बभौ पिता तम् अदृष्ट्वा स्वपितरं देवान् दृष्ट्वा विमानिनः
verses.transliteration: ādityasadṛśākāras teṣāṃ madhye babhau pitā tam adṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ devān dṛṣṭvā vimāninaḥ
verses.translation: his father shone in their midst with a form like the sun. Not seeing his own father, but seeing the gods in their cars,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो रामः पिता मे क्वेत्य् अभाषत इति दिव्याभवद् वाणी रामं संबोध्य सीतया
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmaḥ pitā me kvety abhāṣata iti divyābhavad vāṇī rāmaṃ saṃbodhya sītayā
verses.translation: Rama, with joined palms, said, "Where is my father?" Then a divine voice spoke, addressing Rama and Sita:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तिसृभिर् ब्रह्महत्याभिर् मुक्तो दशरथो नृपः वृतं पश्य सुरैस् तात देवा अप्य् ऊचिरे च तम्
verses.transliteration: tisṛbhir brahmahatyābhir mukto daśaratho nṛpaḥ vṛtaṃ paśya surais tāta devā apy ūcire ca tam
verses.translation: "King Dasharatha is freed from the three brahmin-slayings; see him, dear one, surrounded by the gods." And the gods too said to him:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'si kṛtakṛtyo 'si rāma svargaṃ gataḥ pitā nānānirayasaṃghātāt pūrvajān uddharet tu yaḥ
verses.translation: "You are blessed, you have done your duty, O Rama; your father has gone to heaven. He who lifts his forefathers out of the host of hells

verses.sanskrit: स धन्यो ऽलंकृतं तेन कृतिना भुवनत्रयम् एनं पश्य महाबाहो मुक्तपापं रविप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sa dhanyo 'laṃkṛtaṃ tena kṛtinā bhuvanatrayam enaṃ paśya mahābāho muktapāpaṃ raviprabham
verses.translation: is blessed, and by that accomplished one the three worlds are adorned. See him, O mighty-armed one, freed from sin and radiant as the sun.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंपत्तियुक्तो ऽपि पापी दग्धद्रुमोपमः निष्किंचनो ऽपि सुकृती दृश्यते चन्द्रमौलिवत्
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃpattiyukto 'pi pāpī dagdhadrumopamaḥ niṣkiṃcano 'pi sukṛtī dṛśyate candramaulivat
verses.translation: Even with every kind of wealth, a sinner is like a burnt tree; even without possessions, a virtuous man shines like the moon-crested Shiva."

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाब्रवीत् सुतं राजा आशीर्भिर् अभिनन्द्य च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvābravīt sutaṃ rājā āśīrbhir abhinandya ca
verses.translation: Seeing his son, the king spoke, greeting him with blessings:

verses.sanskrit: कृतकृत्यो ऽसि भद्रं ते तारितो ऽहं त्वयानघ धन्यः स पुत्रो लोके ऽस्मिन् पितॄणां यस् तु तारकः
verses.transliteration: kṛtakṛtyo 'si bhadraṃ te tārito 'haṃ tvayānagha dhanyaḥ sa putro loke 'smin pitṝṇāṃ yas tu tārakaḥ
verses.translation: "You have done your duty; blessings on you. I have been delivered by you, O sinless one. Blessed in this world is the son who delivers his ancestors."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुरगणाः प्रोचुर् देवानां कार्यसिद्धये रामं च पुरुषश्रेष्ठं गच्छ तात यथासुखम् ततस् तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस् तान् अब्रवीत् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suragaṇāḥ procur devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye rāmaṃ ca puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ gaccha tāta yathāsukham tatas tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmas tān abravīt surān
verses.translation: Then the hosts of gods, to accomplish the gods' purpose, said to Rama, best of men, "Go, dear one, as you please." Hearing their words, Rama said to the gods:

verses.transliteration: gurau pitari me devāḥ kiṃ kṛtyam avaśiṣyate
verses.translation: "O gods, what duty remains for me toward my elder, my father?"

verses.sanskrit: नदी न गङ्गया तुल्या न त्वया सदृशः सुतः न शिवेन समो देवो न तारेण समो मनुः
verses.transliteration: nadī na gaṅgayā tulyā na tvayā sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ na śivena samo devo na tāreṇa samo manuḥ
verses.translation: "No river equals the Ganga, no son is like you, no god is equal to Shiva, and no mantra equals the pranava.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया राम गुरूणां च कार्यं सर्वम् अनुष्ठितम् तारिताः पितरो राम त्वया पुत्रेण मानद गच्छन्तु सर्वे स्वस्थानं त्वं च गच्छ यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā rāma gurūṇāṃ ca kāryaṃ sarvam anuṣṭhitam tāritāḥ pitaro rāma tvayā putreṇa mānada gacchantu sarve svasthānaṃ tvaṃ ca gaccha yathāsukham
verses.translation: By you, O Rama, every duty to your elders has been fulfilled; your ancestors have been delivered by you, their son, O giver of honour. Let all go to their own abodes, and you too go as you please."

verses.sanskrit: तद् देववचनाद् धृष्टः सीतया लक्ष्मणाग्रजः तद् दृष्ट्वा गङ्गामाहात्म्यं विस्मितो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tad devavacanād dhṛṣṭaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ tad dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vismito vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Delighted by the gods' words, Lakshmana's elder brother, with Sita, having seen the greatness of the Ganga, spoke in wonder:

verses.sanskrit: अहो गङ्गाप्रभावो ऽयं त्रैलोक्ये नोपमीयते वयं धन्या यतो गङ्गा दृष्टास्माभिस् त्रिपावनी
verses.transliteration: aho gaṅgāprabhāvo 'yaṃ trailokye nopamīyate vayaṃ dhanyā yato gaṅgā dṛṣṭāsmābhis tripāvanī
verses.translation: "Ah, this power of the Ganga has no equal in the three worlds. We are blessed, for we have seen the Ganga, purifier of the three worlds."

verses.sanskrit: हर्षेण महता युक्तो देवं स्थाप्य महेश्वरम् तं षोडशभिर् ईशानम् उपचारैः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yukto devaṃ sthāpya maheśvaram taṃ ṣoḍaśabhir īśānam upacāraiḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Filled with great joy, he installed the god Maheshvara and carefully worshipped that Lord with the sixteen offerings,

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्यावरणैर् युक्तं षट्त्रिंशत्कलम् ईश्वरम् कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा रामस् तुष्टाव शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjyāvaraṇair yuktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkalam īśvaram kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rāmas tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram
verses.translation: worshipping the Lord of thirty-six kalas together with his attendant deities; then, with joined palms, Rama praised Shankara:

verses.sanskrit: नमामि शंभुं पुरुषं पुराणं नमामि सर्वज्ञम् अपारभावम् नमामि रुद्रं प्रभुम् अक्षयं तं नमामि शर्वं शिरसा नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi śaṃbhuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ namāmi sarvajñam apārabhāvam namāmi rudraṃ prabhum akṣayaṃ taṃ namāmi śarvaṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: "I bow to Shambhu, the ancient Person; I bow to the all-knowing one of boundless being; I bow to Rudra, the imperishable Lord; I bow to Sharva, I bow with my head.

verses.sanskrit: नमामि देवं परम् अव्ययं तम् उमापतिं लोकगुरुं नमामि नमामि दारिद्र्यविदारणं तं नमामि रोगापहरं नमामि
verses.transliteration: namāmi devaṃ param avyayaṃ tam umāpatiṃ lokaguruṃ namāmi namāmi dāridryavidāraṇaṃ taṃ namāmi rogāpaharaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to the supreme, imperishable God; I bow to Uma's lord, teacher of the worlds; I bow to him who tears away poverty; I bow to the remover of disease.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: namāmi kalyāṇam acintyarūpaṃ namāmi viśvodbhavabījarūpam namāmi viśvasthitikāraṇaṃ taṃ namāmi saṃhārakaraṃ namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to the auspicious one of inconceivable form; I bow to him who is the seed of the universe's origin; I bow to the cause of its preservation; I bow to its destroyer.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: namāmi gaurīpriyam avyayaṃ taṃ namāmi nityaṃ kṣaram akṣaraṃ tam namāmi cidrūpam ameyabhāvaṃ trilocanaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to the imperishable beloved of Gauri; I bow to him who is ever the perishable and the imperishable; I bow to him whose form is consciousness and whose being is immeasurable; I bow with my head to the three-eyed one.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमामि कारुण्यकरं भवस्य भयंकरं वापि सदा नमामि नमामि दातारम् अभीप्सितानां नमामि सोमेशम् उमेशम् आदौ
verses.transliteration: namāmi kāruṇyakaraṃ bhavasya bhayaṃkaraṃ vāpi sadā namāmi namāmi dātāram abhīpsitānāṃ namāmi someśam umeśam ādau
verses.translation: I bow always to him who is compassionate to beings, and also terrifying; I bow to the giver of all that is desired; I bow first to Someshvara, lord of Uma.

verses.translation: I bow to him whose eyes are the three Vedas; I bow to him who is beyond the three forms; I bow to the holy one beyond being and non-being; I bow to the remover of sin.

verses.transliteration: namāmi viśvasya hite rataṃ taṃ namāmi rūpāṇi bahūni dhatte yo viśvagoptā sadasatpraṇetā namāmi taṃ viśvapatiṃ namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to him devoted to the welfare of the universe, who bears many forms; he who is the protector of the universe and the director of being and non-being — I bow to that Lord of the universe.

verses.transliteration: yajñeśvaraṃ saṃprati havyakavyaṃ tathā gatiṃ lokasadāśivo yaḥ ārādhito yaś ca dadāti sarvaṃ namāmi dānapriyam iṣṭadevam
verses.translation: The lord of sacrifice, who is now the offering to gods and ancestors, the goal of the worlds, the eternal Shiva who when worshipped gives everything — I bow to that chosen deity who delights in giving.

verses.transliteration: namāmi someśvaram asvatantram umāpatiṃ taṃ vijayaṃ namāmi namāmi vighneśvaranandināthaṃ putrapriyaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to Someshvara, who is bound to his devotees; I bow to that lord of Uma, the victorious; I bow with my head to the lord of Vighneshvara and Nandi, who loves his sons.

verses.transliteration: namāmi devaṃ bhavaduḥkhaśoka vināśanaṃ candradharaṃ namāmi namāmi gaṅgādharam īśam īḍyam umādhavaṃ devavaraṃ namāmi
verses.translation: I bow to the god who destroys the grief and sorrow of worldly existence; I bow to the bearer of the moon; I bow to the praiseworthy Lord who holds the Ganga; I bow to Uma's consort, best of gods.

verses.transliteration: namāmy ajādīśapuraṃdarādi surāsurair arcitapādapadmam namāmi devīmukhavādanānām īkṣārtham akṣitritayaṃ ya aicchat
verses.translation: I bow to him whose lotus feet are worshipped by gods and demons led by Brahma, Vishnu and Indra; I bow to him who wished for three eyes to behold the Goddess's face.

verses.transliteration: pañcāmṛtair gandhasudhūpadīpair vicitrapuṣpair vividhaiś ca mantraiḥ annaprakāraiḥ sakalopacāraiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ somam ahaṃ namāmi
verses.translation: Worshipped with the five nectars, perfume, fine incense and lamps, with various flowers and many mantras, with kinds of food and every offering — to that Lord with Uma I bow."

verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān āha rāmaṃ śaṃbhuḥ salakṣmaṇam varān vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te rāmaḥ prāha vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: Then the blessed Shambhu said to Rama and Lakshmana, "Choose boons; blessings on you." Rama said to the bull-bannered god:

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रेणानेन ये भक्त्या तोष्यन्ति त्वां सुरोत्तम तेषां सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्धिं यान्तु महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā toṣyanti tvāṃ surottama teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ yāntu maheśvara
verses.translation: "O best of gods, may every undertaking of those who devotedly please you with this hymn succeed, O Maheshvara.

verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ ca pitaraḥ śaṃbho patitā narakārṇave teṣāṃ piṇḍādidānena pūtā yāntu triviṣṭapam
verses.translation: And those whose ancestors, O Shambhu, have fallen into the ocean of hell — purified by the offering of rice-balls and the like here, may they go to heaven.

verses.transliteration: janmaprabhṛti pāpāni manovākkāyikaṃ tv agham atra tu snānamātreṇa tat sadyo nāśam āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Sins committed since birth, and wrongs of mind, speech and body — may they be destroyed at once merely by bathing here.

verses.transliteration: dayālor apatat tatra lakṣmaṇasya karāc charaḥ tad bāṇatīrtham abhavat sarvāpadvinivāraṇam
verses.translation: An arrow fell there from the hand of the compassionate Lakshmana; that became Banatirtha, which wards off all calamities.

verses.transliteration: nānāvidhāśeṣapāpasaṃghanirmūlanakṣamam yad aṅghrisaṃgād abhavad gaṅgā trailokyapāvanī
verses.translation: able to uproot the whole mass of sins of every kind. He by contact with whose feet the Ganga became the purifier of the three worlds —

verses.translation: where he bathed, what can be said of its excellence? No tirtha anywhere is like that Ramatirtha.

verses.transliteration: putratīrtham iti khyātaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ tad ucyate sarvān kāmān avāpnoti yanmahimnaḥ śruter api
verses.translation: From you, O great sage, we wish process of annihilation at the end of a pralaya.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन नारद दितेः पुत्राश् च दनुजाः परिक्षीणा यदाभवन् अदितेस् तु सुता ज्येष्ठाः सर्वभावेन नारद
verses.transliteration: tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada diteḥ putrāś ca danujāḥ parikṣīṇā yadābhavan adites tu sutā jyeṣṭhāḥ sarvabhāvena nārada
verses.translation: Let it be heard precisely, O excellent sages, how the process of annihilation takes place at the end of a Kaloa as well as at the time of Prakrta Pralaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let it be heard precisely, O excellent sages, how the process of annihilation takes place at the end of a Kaloa as well as at the time of Prakrta Pralaya.

verses.transliteration: tadā ditiḥ putraviyogaduḥkhāt saṃspardhamānā danum ājagāma
verses.translation: Ki ta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali constitute a set of four Yugas containing twelve thousand Divine years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ki ta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali constitute a set of four Yugas containing twelve thousand Divine years.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणाः सुता आवयोर् एव भद्रे किं कुर्महे कर्म लोके गरीयः पश्यादितेर् वंशम् अभिन्नम् उत्तमं सौराज्ययुक्तं यशसा जयश्रिया
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇāḥ sutā āvayor eva bhadre kiṃ kurmahe karma loke garīyaḥ paśyāditer vaṃśam abhinnam uttamaṃ saurājyayuktaṃ yaśasā jayaśriyā
verses.translation: The four Yugas are similar in form. K r ta is the Yua first. O sages, Kaliyuga is the last.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four Yugas are similar in form. K r ta is the Yua first. O sages, Kaliyuga is the last.

verses.transliteration: jitārim abhyunnatakīrtidharmaṃ maccittasaṃharṣavināśadakṣam samānabhartṛtvasamānadharme samānagotre 'pi samānarūpe
verses.translation: O holy Sir, it beloves you to describe in detail the nature of Kaliyuga when the four-footed sacred Dharma undergoes deficiency.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy Sir, it beloves you to describe in detail the nature of Kaliyuga when the four-footed sacred Dharma undergoes deficiency.

verses.translation: Understand the form of Kali, O sinless brahmins, about
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the form of Kali, O sinless brahmins, about

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणाम् अतिदीनवक्त्रां विनिश्वसन्तीं परमेष्ठिपुत्रः कृताभिपूजो विगतश्रमस् तां स सान्त्वयन्न् आह मनोभिरामाम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇām atidīnavaktrāṃ viniśvasantīṃ parameṣṭhiputraḥ kṛtābhipūjo vigataśramas tāṃ sa sāntvayann āha manobhirāmām
verses.translation: In the age of Kali the actions of men are not based on the conduct prescribed for Varnas and Asramas. Nor do they follow the specific injunctions of the Sama, Rk and Yajus Vedas as their guide.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the age of Kali the actions of men are not based on the conduct prescribed for Varnas and Asramas. Nor do they follow the specific injunctions of the Sama, Rk and Yajus Vedas as their guide.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: खेदो न कार्यः समभीप्सितं यत् तत् प्राप्यते पुण्यत एव भद्रे तत्साधनं वेत्ति महानुभावः प्रजापतिस् ते स तु वक्ष्यतीति
verses.transliteration: khedo na kāryaḥ samabhīpsitaṃ yat tat prāpyate puṇyata eva bhadre tatsādhanaṃ vetti mahānubhāvaḥ prajāpatis te sa tu vakṣyatīti
verses.translation: In Kaliyuga the strongest man, whoever he may be and in whichever family he is born, becomes the lord of all. Man maintains himself through girls taken from all the castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kaliyuga the strongest man, whoever he may be and in whichever family he is born, becomes the lord of all. Man maintains himself through girls taken from all the castes.

verses.sanskrit: साध्व्य् एतत् सर्वभावेन प्रश्रयावनता सती
verses.transliteration: sādhvy etat sarvabhāvena praśrayāvanatā satī
verses.translation: Fast, exertion and charity constitute pious activities in Kali age and rites are performed as one pleases.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fast, exertion and charity constitute pious activities in Kali age and rites are performed as one pleases.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणां च दितिं दनुः प्रोवाच नारद
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ ca ditiṃ danuḥ provāca nārada
verses.translation: In Kali age men become haughty and arrogant even with a little wealth. Pride of beauty in women will be on the basis of their tresses of hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age men become haughty and arrogant even with a little wealth. Pride of beauty in women will be on the basis of their tresses of hair.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं कश्यपं भद्रे तोषयस्व निजैर् गुणैः तुष्टो यदि भवेद् भर्ता ततः कामान् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ kaśyapaṃ bhadre toṣayasva nijair guṇaiḥ tuṣṭo yadi bhaved bhartā tataḥ kāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: As gold, jewels, diamonds as well as garments dwindle in the Kali age, women will be embellished by their tresses.
verses.commentary: Sense: As gold, jewels, diamonds as well as garments dwindle in the Kali age, women will be embellished by their tresses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा सर्वभावैस् तोषयाम् आस कश्यपम् दितिं प्रोवाच भगवान् कश्यपो ऽथ प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā sarvabhāvais toṣayām āsa kaśyapam ditiṃ provāca bhagavān kaśyapo 'tha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Women will forsake their husbands having no wealth. In Kali age it is the moneyed man who becomes the lord of damsels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women will forsake their husbands having no wealth. In Kali age it is the moneyed man who becomes the lord of damsels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: किं ददामि वदाभीष्टं दिते वरय सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: kiṃ dadāmi vadābhīṣṭaṃ dite varaya suvrate
verses.translation: Women in Kali age will be harlots desirous of luxury. They covet men who have earned much by illegal means.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women in Kali age will be harlots desirous of luxury. They covet men who have earned much by illegal means.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दितिर् अप्य् आह भर्तारं पुत्रं बहुगुणान्वितम् जेतारं सर्वलोकानां सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ditir apy āha bhartāraṃ putraṃ bahuguṇānvitam jetāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: At that time, O brahmins, no man will brook a loss to his vested interest even to the extent of a fourth of a Pana (the smallest coin) even when he is entreated by his own friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, O brahmins, no man will brook a loss to his vested interest even to the extent of a fourth of a Pana (the smallest coin) even when he is entreated by his own friend.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: येन जातेन लोके ऽस्मिन् भवेयं वीरपुत्रिणी तं वरेयं सुरपितर् इत्य् आह विनयान्विता
verses.transliteration: yena jātena loke 'smin bhaveyaṃ vīraputriṇī taṃ vareyaṃ surapitar ity āha vinayānvitā
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the Kali age, the mind will always be manly and courageous. Cows will be solemnly honoured as long as they yield milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the Kali age, the mind will always be manly and courageous. Cows will be solemnly honoured as long as they yield milk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपदेक्ष्ये व्रतं श्रेष्ठं द्वादशाब्दफलप्रदम् तत आगत्य ते गर्भम् आधास्ये यन् मनोगतम् निष्पापतायां जातायां सिध्यन्ति हि मनोरथाः
verses.transliteration: upadekṣye vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dvādaśābdaphalapradam tata āgatya te garbham ādhāsye yan manogatam niṣpāpatāyāṃ jātāyāṃ sidhyanti hi manorathāḥ
verses.translation: Fearing a drought the subjects will be afraid of hunger. They will then have their eyes riveted to the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fearing a drought the subjects will be afraid of hunger. They will then have their eyes riveted to the sky.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्तृवाक्याद् दितिः प्रीता तं नमस्यायतेक्षणा उपदिष्टं व्रतं चक्रे भर्त्रादिष्टं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: bhartṛvākyād ditiḥ prītā taṃ namasyāyatekṣaṇā upadiṣṭaṃ vrataṃ cakre bhartrādiṣṭaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Like the sages of yore men will have roots, leaves and fruits for their food. They will think of killing themselves in their misery due to the absence of rain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the sages of yore men will have roots, leaves and fruits for their food. They will think of killing themselves in their misery due to the absence of rain.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थसेवापात्रदानव्रतचर्यादिवर्जिताः कथम् आसादयिष्यन्ति प्राणिनो ऽत्र मनोरथान्
verses.transliteration: tīrthasevāpātradānavratacaryādivarjitāḥ katham āsādayiṣyanti prāṇino 'tra manorathān
verses.translation: They will have perpetual famine and pain. They will be incapable of mastering things. By virtue of their lapses their happiness will be spoiled.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will have perpetual famine and pain. They will be incapable of mastering things. By virtue of their lapses their happiness will be spoiled.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततश् चीर्णे व्रते तस्यां दित्यां गर्भम् अधारयत् पुनः कान्ताम् अथोवाच कश्यपस् तां दितिं रहः
verses.transliteration: tataś cīrṇe vrate tasyāṃ dityāṃ garbham adhārayat punaḥ kāntām athovāca kaśyapas tāṃ ditiṃ rahaḥ
verses.translation: In Kali age women will be greedy and lecherous. Thev will have puny bodies but they will be gluttonous. They will have little good fortune but plenty of offsprings
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age women will be greedy and lecherous. Thev will have puny bodies but they will be gluttonous. They will have little good fortune but plenty of offsprings
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न प्राप्नुवन्ति यत्कामान् मुनयो ऽपि तपस्स्थिताः यथाविहितकर्माङ्गअवज्ञया तच् छुचिस्मिते
verses.transliteration: na prāpnuvanti yatkāmān munayo 'pi tapassthitāḥ yathāvihitakarmāṅgaavajñayā tac chucismite
verses.translation: Women will be furious. They will be more ' interested m sustaining themselves; they will be wanting in the puritv of bodies. They will habitually speak harsh and untruthful words
verses.commentary: Sense: Women will be furious. They will be more ' interested m sustaining themselves; they will be wanting in the puritv of bodies. They will habitually speak harsh and untruthful words
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: निन्दितं च न कर्तव्यं संध्ययोर् उभयोर् अपि न स्वप्तव्यं न गन्तव्यं मुक्तकेशी च नो भव
verses.transliteration: ninditaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ saṃdhyayor ubhayor api na svaptavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ muktakeśī ca no bhava
verses.translation: Even the women of noble families will be ill-behaved. They will yearn for men of bad conduct. They will be unchaste and disloyal to their husbands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the women of noble families will be ill-behaved. They will yearn for men of bad conduct. They will be unchaste and disloyal to their husbands.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: भोक्तव्यं सुभगे नैव क्षुतं वा जृम्भणं तथा संध्याकाले न कर्तव्यं भूतसंघसमाकुले
verses.transliteration: bhoktavyaṃ subhage naiva kṣutaṃ vā jṛmbhaṇaṃ tathā saṃdhyākāle na kartavyaṃ bhūtasaṃghasamākule
verses.translation: Men of no holy rites will study the Vedas. Householders will not perform homas nor will they give appropriate things in charity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of no holy rites will study the Vedas. Householders will not perform homas nor will they give appropriate things in charity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सान्तर्धानं सदा कार्यं हसितं तु विशेषतः गृहान्तदेशे संध्यासु न स्थातव्यं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sāntardhānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ hasitaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ gṛhāntadeśe saṃdhyāsu na sthātavyaṃ kadācana
verses.translation: Foi est-dwellers will take to the diet pertaining to.the villagers. Mendicants will be influenced by filial affection and other contacts towards sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Foi est-dwellers will take to the diet pertaining to.the villagers. Mendicants will be influenced by filial affection and other contacts towards sons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मुशलोलूखलादीनि शूर्पपीठपिधानकम् नैवातिक्रमणीयानि दिवा रात्रौ सदा प्रिये
verses.transliteration: muśalolūkhalādīni śūrpapīṭhapidhānakam naivātikramaṇīyāni divā rātrau sadā priye
verses.translation: At the advent of Kali age kings will no longer protect their subjects. They will take the wealth of common man under the pretext of taxes and fees.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the advent of Kali age kings will no longer protect their subjects. They will take the wealth of common man under the pretext of taxes and fees.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदक्शीर्षं तु शयनं न संध्यासु विशेषतः वक्तव्यं नानृतं किंचिन् नान्यगेहाटनं तथा
verses.transliteration: udakśīrṣaṃ tu śayanaṃ na saṃdhyāsu viśeṣataḥ vaktavyaṃ nānṛtaṃ kiṃcin nānyagehāṭanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Whoever happens to possess horses, chariots and ele¬ phants will become the king. In the Kali age, those who happen to be weak will be servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whoever happens to possess horses, chariots and ele¬ phants will become the king. In the Kali age, those who happen to be weak will be servants.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कान्ताद् अन्यो न वीक्ष्यस् तु प्रयत्नेन नरः क्वचित् इत्यादिनियमैर् युक्ता यदि त्वम् अनुवर्तसे ततस् ते भविता पुत्रस् त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: kāntād anyo na vīkṣyas tu prayatnena naraḥ kvacit ityādiniyamair yuktā yadi tvam anuvartase tatas te bhavitā putras trailokyaiśvaryabhājanam
verses.translation: Harassed by the burden of taxes and famine, people w'll become miserable. They will migrate to those lands where wheat and barley abound.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harassed by the burden of taxes and famine, people w'll become miserable. They will migrate to those lands where wheat and barley abound.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेति प्रतिजज्ञे सा भर्तारं लोकपूजितम् गतश् च कश्यपो ब्रह्मन्न् इतश् चेतः सुरान् प्रति
verses.transliteration: tatheti pratijajñe sā bhartāraṃ lokapūjitam gataś ca kaśyapo brahmann itaś cetaḥ surān prati
verses.translation: As the Vedic path falls into disuse, as the people become more and more heretic, sins will increase and the span of life of the people will shrink.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Vedic path falls into disuse, as the people become more and more heretic, sins will increase and the span of life of the people will shrink.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितेर् गर्भो ऽपि ववृधे बलवान् पुण्यसंभवः एतत् सर्वं मयो दैत्यो मायया वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: diter garbho 'pi vavṛdhe balavān puṇyasaṃbhavaḥ etat sarvaṃ mayo daityo māyayā vetti tattvataḥ
verses.translation: When men begin to undertake austerities not prescribed by sacred texts there will be infantile mortalily due to the fault of kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: When men begin to undertake austerities not prescribed by sacred texts there will be infantile mortalily due to the fault of kings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सख्यम् अभवन् मयेन प्रीतिपूर्वकम् मयो गत्वा रहः प्राह इन्द्रं स विनयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: indrasya sakhyam abhavan mayena prītipūrvakam mayo gatvā rahaḥ prāha indraṃ sa vinayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Girls will give birth to children at the ages of five, six and seven years begotten by men of the ages ol eight, nine and ten.
verses.commentary: Sense: Girls will give birth to children at the ages of five, six and seven years begotten by men of the ages ol eight, nine and ten.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दितेर् दनोर् अभिप्रायं व्रतं गर्भस्य वर्धनम् तस्य वीर्यं च विविधं प्रीत्येन्द्राय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: diter danor abhiprāyaṃ vrataṃ garbhasya vardhanam tasya vīryaṃ ca vividhaṃ prītyendrāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: Hairs will begin to turn grey at the twelfth year. No one will live upto the twentieth year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hairs will begin to turn grey at the twelfth year. No one will live upto the twentieth year.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्वासैकगृहं मित्रम् अपायत्रासवर्जितम् अर्जितं सुकृतं नानाविधं चेत् तद् अवाप्यते
verses.transliteration: viśvāsaikagṛhaṃ mitram apāyatrāsavarjitam arjitaṃ sukṛtaṃ nānāvidhaṃ cet tad avāpyate
verses.translation: Men will be destroyed in a short time because their wisdom and intelligence will be mediocre and their kings will be wicked. They will wear false marks.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will be destroyed in a short time because their wisdom and intelligence will be mediocre and their kings will be wicked. They will wear false marks.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमुचेश् च प्रियो भ्राता मयो दैत्यो महाबलः भ्रातृहन्त्रा कथं मैत्र्यं मयस्यासीत् सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: namuceś ca priyo bhrātā mayo daityo mahābalaḥ bhrātṛhantrā kathaṃ maitryaṃ mayasyāsīt sureśvara
verses.translation: The increase in the severity of the Kali age should be inferred by wise persons as the heretic activities are observed more and more.
verses.commentary: Sense: The increase in the severity of the Kali age should be inferred by wise persons as the heretic activities are observed more and more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानाम् अधिपश् चासीद् बलवान् नमुचिः पुरा इन्द्रेण वैरम् अभवद् भीषणं लोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: daityānām adhipaś cāsīd balavān namuciḥ purā indreṇa vairam abhavad bhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: When the undertakings of men of virtuous activities do not flourish, O brahmins, the prominence of Kali age should be inferred by wise persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the undertakings of men of virtuous activities do not flourish, O brahmins, the prominence of Kali age should be inferred by wise persons.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युद्धं हित्वा कदाचिद् भो गच्छन्तं तु शतक्रतुम् दृष्ट्वा दैत्यपतिः शूरो नमुचिः पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात्
verses.transliteration: yuddhaṃ hitvā kadācid bho gacchantaṃ tu śatakratum dṛṣṭvā daityapatiḥ śūro namuciḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt
verses.translation: When persons cease to perform sacrifices in the worship of Purusottama, lord of sacrifices, the influence of Kali age should be inferred.
verses.commentary: Sense: When persons cease to perform sacrifices in the worship of Purusottama, lord of sacrifices, the influence of Kali age should be inferred.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तम् आयान्तम् अभिप्रेक्ष्य शचीभर्ता भयातुरः ऐरावतं गजं त्यक्त्वा इन्द्रः फेनम् अथाविशत्
verses.transliteration: tam āyāntam abhiprekṣya śacībhartā bhayāturaḥ airāvataṃ gajaṃ tyaktvā indraḥ phenam athāviśat
verses.translation: The increasein the severity of Kali should be inferred by wise and intelligent persons when there is no interest in Vedic discussions and heretical doctrines are entertained.
verses.commentary: Sense: The increasein the severity of Kali should be inferred by wise and intelligent persons when there is no interest in Vedic discussions and heretical doctrines are entertained.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स वज्रपाणिस् तरसा फेनेनैवाहनद् रिपुम् नमुचिर् नाशम् अगमत् तस्य भ्राता मयो ऽनुजः
verses.transliteration: sa vajrapāṇis tarasā phenenaivāhanad ripum namucir nāśam agamat tasya bhrātā mayo 'nujaḥ
verses.translation: In the Kali age, O brahmins, men overpowered by heresy will never worship Visnu, the lord of the Universe, the Supreme lord, the Creator of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali age, O brahmins, men overpowered by heresy will never worship Visnu, the lord of the Universe, the Supreme lord, the Creator of everything.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृहन्तृविनाशाय तपस् तेपे मयो महत् मायां च विविधाम् आप देवानाम् अतिभीषणाम्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛhantṛvināśāya tapas tepe mayo mahat māyāṃ ca vividhām āpa devānām atibhīṣaṇām
verses.translation: Men influenced by heresy will prattle thus of what avail are Devas? Of what use are the brahmins and the Vedas? Of what avail is the purificatory wash with water?".
verses.commentary: Sense: Men influenced by heresy will prattle thus of what avail are Devas? Of what use are the brahmins and the Vedas? Of what avail is the purificatory wash with water?".
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वरांश् चावाप्य तपसा विष्णोर् लोकपरायणात् दानशौण्डः प्रियालापी तदाभवद् असौ मयः
verses.transliteration: varāṃś cāvāpya tapasā viṣṇor lokaparāyaṇāt dānaśauṇḍaḥ priyālāpī tadābhavad asau mayaḥ
verses.translation: At the advent of Kali age, O brahmins, clouds will shower less rain, plants will produce less, and fruits will have less nutritional value.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the advent of Kali age, O brahmins, clouds will shower less rain, plants will produce less, and fruits will have less nutritional value.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्नींश् च ब्राह्मणान् पूज्य जेतुम् इन्द्रं कृतक्षणः दातारं च तदार्थिभ्यः स्तूयमानं च बन्दिभिः
verses.transliteration: agnīṃś ca brāhmaṇān pūjya jetum indraṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ dātāraṃ ca tadārthibhyaḥ stūyamānaṃ ca bandibhiḥ
verses.translation: In Kali age clothes will come down only upto the knees, the trees will be like the Sami tree, the castes will exhibit the characteristics of Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age clothes will come down only upto the knees, the trees will be like the Sami tree, the castes will exhibit the characteristics of Sudras.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विदित्वा मघवा वायोर् मयं मायाविनं रिपुम् उपक्रान्तं सुयुद्धाय विप्रो भूत्वा तम् अभ्यगात् शचीभर्ता मयं दैत्यं प्रोवाचेदं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: viditvā maghavā vāyor mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ ripum upakrāntaṃ suyuddhāya vipro bhūtvā tam abhyagāt śacībhartā mayaṃ daityaṃ provācedaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: In the Kali age, O excellent sages, mothers- and fathers- in-law will be mainly considered elders. Men and women shall take food m open buildings (Eating Houses) along with their friends (?).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali age, O excellent sages, mothers- and fathers- in-law will be mainly considered elders. Men and women shall take food m open buildings (Eating Houses) along with their friends (?).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहि दैत्यपते मह्यम् अर्थिने ऽपेक्षितं वरम् त्वां श्रुत्वा दातृतिलकम् आगतो ऽहं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: dehi daityapate mahyam arthine 'pekṣitaṃ varam tvāṃ śrutvā dātṛtilakam āgato 'haṃ dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Men following their fathers-in-law will say • "Whose mother? Whose father? A man is the product of his own Karman."
verses.commentary: Sense: Men following their fathers-in-law will say • "Whose mother? Whose father? A man is the product of his own Karman."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मयो ऽपि ब्राह्मणं मत्वा ऽवदद् दत्तं मया तव विचारयन्ति कृतिनो बह्व् अल्पं वा पुरो ऽर्थिनि
verses.transliteration: mayo 'pi brāhmaṇaṃ matvā 'vadad dattaṃ mayā tava vicārayanti kṛtino bahv alpaṃ vā puro 'rthini
verses.translation: Men of insignificant intellect will be afflicted again and again by verbal, mental and physical faults and they will commit sins everyday.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men of insignificant intellect will be afflicted again and again by verbal, mental and physical faults and they will commit sins everyday.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्ते तु हरिः प्राह सख्यम् इच्छे ह्य् अहं त्वया इन्द्रं मयः पुनः प्राह किम् अनेन द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ity ukte tu hariḥ prāha sakhyam icche hy ahaṃ tvayā indraṃ mayaḥ punaḥ prāha kim anena dvijottama
verses.translation: In a short time he will perform an excellent meritorious lite which in the Krta yuga is done by hard penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: In a short time he will perform an excellent meritorious lite which in the Krta yuga is done by hard penance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न त्वया मम वैरं भोः स्वस्तीत्य् आह हरिर् मयम् तत्त्वं वदेति स हरिर् दैत्येनोक्तः स्वकं वपुः
verses.transliteration: na tvayā mama vairaṃ bhoḥ svastīty āha harir mayam tattvaṃ vadeti sa harir daityenoktaḥ svakaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: At what time does a simple act of piety yield a great benefit? It behoves you to mention it entirely. We have a keen desire to hear.
verses.commentary: Sense: At what time does a simple act of piety yield a great benefit? It behoves you to mention it entirely. We have a keen desire to hear.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयाम् आस दैत्याय सहस्राक्षं यद् उच्यते ततः सविस्मयो दैत्यो मयो हरिम् उवाच ह
verses.transliteration: darśayām āsa daityāya sahasrākṣaṃ yad ucyate tataḥ savismayo daityo mayo harim uvāca ha
verses.translation: In the blessed Kali age, O brahmins, there shall be a great benefit through less strain. Women and Sudras shall be¬ come blessed. Understand one thing more.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the blessed Kali age, O brahmins, there shall be a great benefit through less strain. Women and Sudras shall be¬ come blessed. Understand one thing more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: किम् इदं वज्रपाणिस् त्वं तवायोग्या कृतिः सखे
verses.transliteration: kim idaṃ vajrapāṇis tvaṃ tavāyogyā kṛtiḥ sakhe
verses.translation: By singing songs in praise of Kesava in the Kali age one obtains what one obtains in the Krta yuga by meditation, in the Treta yuga by performing sacrifices and in the Dvapara by conducting worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: By singing songs in praise of Kesava in the Kali age one obtains what one obtains in the Krta yuga by meditation, in the Treta yuga by performing sacrifices and in the Dvapara by conducting worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परिष्वज्य विहस्याथ वृत्तम् इत्य् अब्रवीद् धरिः केनापि साधयन्त्य् अत्र पण्डिताश् च समीहितम्
verses.transliteration: pariṣvajya vihasyātha vṛttam ity abravīd dhariḥ kenāpi sādhayanty atra paṇḍitāś ca samīhitam
verses.translation: In the Kali age, a person attains increased virtue by means of a simple effort. People become well-versed in piety with a little strain. Hence I am pleased with Kali age.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali age, a person attains increased virtue by means of a simple effort. People become well-versed in piety with a little strain. Hence I am pleased with Kali age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति शक्रस्य मयेन महती ह्य् अभूत् सुप्रीतिर् मुनिशार्दूल मयो हरिहितः सदा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti śakrasya mayena mahatī hy abhūt suprītir muniśārdūla mayo harihitaḥ sadā
verses.translation: But a Sudra achieves salvation merely by serving the twice-born. He is authorized in Pakayajna (mere cooking of his food is no less than a Yajna). Hence a Sudra is more blessed.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a Sudra achieves salvation merely by serving the twice-born. He is authorized in Pakayajna (mere cooking of his food is no less than a Yajna). Hence a Sudra is more blessed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य भवनं गत्वा तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत् किं मे कृत्यम् इति प्राह मयं मायाविनं हरिः
verses.transliteration: indrasya bhavanaṃ gatvā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat kiṃ me kṛtyam iti prāha mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: Wealth should be acquired by men without a conflict with their duties; wealth should be distributed among deserving persons; sacrifices should be duly performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wealth should be acquired by men without a conflict with their duties; wealth should be distributed among deserving persons; sacrifices should be duly performed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हरये च मयो मायां प्रादात् प्रीत्या तथा हरिः प्राप्तः संप्रीतिमान् आह किं कृत्यं मय तद् वद
verses.transliteration: haraye ca mayo māyāṃ prādāt prītyā tathā hariḥ prāptaḥ saṃprītimān āha kiṃ kṛtyaṃ maya tad vada
verses.translation: By means of these and other strenuous efforts, O excel¬ lent brahmins, people attain Prajapatya and other worlds in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of these and other strenuous efforts, O excel¬ lent brahmins, people attain Prajapatya and other worlds in due order.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यस्याश्रमं गच्छ तत्रास्ते गर्भिणी दितिः तस्याः शुश्रूषणं कुर्वन्न् आस्स्व तत्र कियन्ति च
verses.transliteration: agastyasyāśramaṃ gaccha tatrāste garbhiṇī ditiḥ tasyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kurvann āssva tatra kiyanti ca
verses.translation: A women attains other worlds by duly serving her hus¬ band by thoughts, words and deeds. That is because, O brahmins, she attains the same world as lie.
verses.commentary: Sense: A women attains other worlds by duly serving her hus¬ band by thoughts, words and deeds. That is because, O brahmins, she attains the same world as lie.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अहानि मघवंस् तस्या गर्भम् आविश्य वज्रधृक् वर्धमानं च तं छिन्धि यावद् वश्यो ऽथवा मृतिम् प्राप्नोति तावद् वज्रेण ततो न भविता रिपुः
verses.transliteration: ahāni maghavaṃs tasyā garbham āviśya vajradhṛk vardhamānaṃ ca taṃ chindhi yāvad vaśyo 'thavā mṛtim prāpnoti tāvad vajreṇa tato na bhavitā ripuḥ
verses.translation: Thus she attains those worlds without much effort like the man.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus she attains those worlds without much effort like the man.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा मयं पूज्य मघवान् एक एव हि विनीतवत् तदा प्रायाद् दितिं मातरम् अञ्जसा शुश्रूषमाणस् तां देवीं शक्रो दैतेयमातरम् सा न जानाति तच् चित्तं शक्रस्य द्विषतो दितिः
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā mayaṃ pūjya maghavān eka eva hi vinītavat tadā prāyād ditiṃ mātaram añjasā śuśrūṣamāṇas tāṃ devīṃ śakro daiteyamātaram sā na jānāti tac cittaṃ śakrasya dviṣato ditiḥ
verses.translation: Tlius has been mentioned, O brahmins, what you have come hei c foi. Hence, ask as you please. I shall explain every¬ thing clearly to you.

verses.transliteration: garbhe sthitaṃ tu yad bhūtaṃ devendrasya viceṣṭitam amoghaṃ tan munes tejaḥ kaśyapasya durāsadam
verses.translation: Whatever the king of the gods attempted against the being in the womb, the energy of the sage Kashyapa was unfailing and hard to overcome.

verses.transliteration: tataḥ pragṛhya kuliśaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ antaḥpraveśakāmo 'sau bahukālaṃ samāvasan
verses.translation: Then thousand-eyed Purandara took up his thunderbolt and, wishing to enter within, waited there a long time.

verses.sanskrit: संध्योदक्शीर्षनिद्रां ताम् अवेक्ष्य कुलिशायुधः इदम् अन्तरम् इत्य् उक्त्वा दित्याः कुक्षिं समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyodakśīrṣanidrāṃ tām avekṣya kuliśāyudhaḥ idam antaram ity uktvā dityāḥ kukṣiṃ samāviśat
verses.translation: Seeing her asleep at twilight with her head to the north, the wielder of the thunderbolt said, "This is the opening," and entered Diti's womb.

verses.transliteration: antarvarti ca yad bhūtam indraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtāyudham hantukāmaṃ tadovāca punaḥ punar abhītavat
verses.translation: The being within, seeing Indra with weapon raised and bent on killing it, spoke again and again without fear:

verses.sanskrit: किं मां न रक्षसे वज्रिन् भ्रातरं त्वं जिघांससि नारणे मारणाद् अन्यत् पातकं विद्यते महत्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ māṃ na rakṣase vajrin bhrātaraṃ tvaṃ jighāṃsasi nāraṇe māraṇād anyat pātakaṃ vidyate mahat
verses.translation: "Why do you not protect me, O wielder of the thunderbolt? You wish to kill your brother. Outside battle there is no greater sin than killing.

verses.transliteration: ṛte yuddhān mahābāho śakra yudhyasva nirgate mayi tasmān naitad evaṃ tava yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Only in battle, O mighty-armed Shakra — fight me when I have come out. This is not fitting for you.

verses.sanskrit: शतक्रतुः सहस्राक्षः शचीभर्ता पुरंदरः वज्रपाणिः सुरेन्द्रस् त्वं ते न युक्तं भवेत् प्रभो
verses.transliteration: śatakratuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ śacībhartā puraṃdaraḥ vajrapāṇiḥ surendras tvaṃ te na yuktaṃ bhavet prabho
verses.translation: You are Shatakratu, the thousand-eyed, husband of Shachi, Purandara, thunderbolt in hand, king of the gods; this does not befit you, O lord.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा युद्धकामस् त्वं मम निष्क्रमणं यथा तथा कुरु महाबाहो मार्गाद् अस्माद् अपासर
verses.transliteration: athavā yuddhakāmas tvaṃ mama niṣkramaṇaṃ yathā tathā kuru mahābāho mārgād asmād apāsara
verses.translation: Or if you wish to fight, act so that I may come out, O mighty-armed one; step aside from this path.

verses.transliteration: kumārge na pravartante mahānto 'pi vipadgatāḥ avidyaś cāpy aśastraś ca naiva cāyudhasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: The great do not take a wrong path even in distress. I am unlearned, unarmed, and have no store of weapons;

verses.transliteration: tvaṃ vidyāvān vajrapāṇe māṃ nighnan kiṃ na lajjase kurvanti garhitaṃ karma na kulīnāḥ kadācana
verses.translation: you are learned, O wielder of the thunderbolt — are you not ashamed to kill me? The nobly born never do a blameworthy deed.

verses.translation: What would come of killing me — fame, or merit? Brothers in the womb are killed out of desire — what manliness is that?

verses.transliteration: yadi vā yuddhabhaktis te mayi bhrātar asaṃśayam tato muṣṭiṃ puraskṛtya vajriṇe 'sau vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Or if you truly have a craving to fight me, brother..." Then he stood ready before the thunderbolt-wielder with his fist raised.

verses.translation: "The slayer of a child, the slayer of a brahmin, and the betrayer of trust — such is the fruit, Shakra; why are you set on killing me?

verses.translation: He at whose command this whole world, moving and unmoving, goes on — if he kills me, a child, what fame is that, what manliness?"

verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvantaṃ taṃ garbhaṃ ciccheda kuliśena saḥ krodhāndhānāṃ lobhināṃ ca na ghṛṇā kvāpi vidyate
verses.translation: As it spoke thus, he cut the embryo with his thunderbolt. Those blinded by anger and greed have no pity anywhere.

verses.transliteration: na mamāra tato duḥkhād āhus te bhrātaro vayam punaś ciccheda tān khaṇḍān mā vadhīr iti cābruvan
verses.translation: It did not die; then in pain they said, "We are your brothers." Again he cut the pieces, and they cried, "Do not kill us!"

verses.transliteration: viśvastān mātṛgarbhasthān nijabhrātṝñ śatakrato dveṣavidhvastabuddhīnāṃ na citte karuṇākaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Your own trusting brothers in their mother's womb, O Shatakratu! In minds whose judgment hatred has destroyed there is not a particle of compassion.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu khaṇḍitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ hastapādādijīvavat nirvikāraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā saptasapta suvismitaḥ
verses.translation: Each piece so cut was alive, with hands, feet and the rest; seeing them unharmed, seven times seven, he was greatly astonished.

verses.transliteration: ekavad bahurūpāṇi garbhasthāni śubhāni ca rudanti bahurūpāṇi mā rutety abravīd dhariḥ
verses.translation: Many beautiful forms, as if one, lay in the womb; the many forms wept, and Hari said, "Do not weep."

verses.transliteration: tatas te maruto jātā balavanto mahaujasaḥ garbhasthā eva te 'nyonyam ūcuḥ śakraṃ gatabhramāḥ
verses.translation: Thus they became the Maruts, strong and of great vigour. Still in the womb, their confusion gone, they spoke to one another and to Shakra,

verses.transliteration: agastyaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ mātā yasyāśrame sthitā asmatpitā tava bhrātā sakhyaṃ te bahu manyate
verses.translation: and called on Agastya, tiger among sages, in whose hermitage their mother was staying: "Our father is like a brother to you and greatly values your friendship.

verses.transliteration: asmān upari sasnehaṃ manas te vidmahe mune na yat karoti śvapacaḥ pravṛttas tatra vajradhṛk
verses.translation: We know your mind is affectionate toward us, O sage. The thunderbolt-wielder has set about what not even an outcaste would do."

verses.transliteration: ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā agastyo 'gāt sasaṃbhramaḥ ditiṃ saṃbodhayām āsa vyathitāṃ garbhavedanāt
verses.translation: Hearing these words, Agastya went in haste and comforted Diti, who was in anguish from the pain of her womb.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रागस्त्यः शचीकान्तम् अशपत् कुपितो भृशम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāgastyaḥ śacīkāntam aśapat kupito bhṛśam
verses.translation: There Agastya, greatly enraged, cursed the lord of Shachi:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: संग्रामे रिपवः पृष्ठं पश्येयुस् ते सदा हरे जीवताम् एव मरणम् एतद् एव हि मानिनाम् पृष्ठं पलायमानानां यत् पश्यन्त्य् अहिता रणे
verses.transliteration: saṃgrāme ripavaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśyeyus te sadā hare jīvatām eva maraṇam etad eva hi māninām pṛṣṭhaṃ palāyamānānāṃ yat paśyanty ahitā raṇe
verses.translation: "In battle, O Hari, may your enemies always see your back. For the proud this alone is death while still alive: that foes in battle see their backs as they flee."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सापि तं गर्भसंस्थं च शशापेन्द्रं रुषा दितिः
verses.transliteration: sāpi taṃ garbhasaṃsthaṃ ca śaśāpendraṃ ruṣā ditiḥ
verses.translation: Diti too, in anger, cursed Indra while he was still inside her womb:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न पौरुषं कृतं तस्माच् छापो ऽयं भविता तव स्त्रीभिः परिभवं प्राप्य राज्यात् प्रभ्रश्यसे हरे
verses.transliteration: na pauruṣaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmāc chāpo 'yaṃ bhavitā tava strībhiḥ paribhavaṃ prāpya rājyāt prabhraśyase hare
verses.translation: "You have not acted with manliness, so this shall be your curse: humiliated by women, you will fall from your kingdom, O Hari."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र कश्यपो वै प्रजापतिः प्रायाच् च व्यथितो ऽगस्त्याच् छ्रुत्वा शक्रविचेष्टितम् गर्भान्तरगतः शक्रः पितरं प्राह भीतवत्
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra kaśyapo vai prajāpatiḥ prāyāc ca vyathito 'gastyāc chrutvā śakraviceṣṭitam garbhāntaragataḥ śakraḥ pitaraṃ prāha bhītavat
verses.translation: Meanwhile Kashyapa the Prajapati came there, distressed, having heard from Agastya what Shakra had done. Shakra, inside the womb, spoke fearfully to his father:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्याच् च दितेश् चैव बिभेमि क्रमितुं बहिः
verses.transliteration: agastyāc ca diteś caiva bibhemi kramituṃ bahiḥ
verses.translation: "I fear Agastya and Diti, and dare not step outside."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: etasminn antare prāpya kaśyapo 'pi prajāpatiḥ putrakarma ca tad dṛṣṭvā garbhāntaḥsthitim eva ca ditiśāpam agastyasya śrutvāsau duḥkhito 'bhavat
verses.translation: Meanwhile Kashyapa the Prajapati, arriving and seeing his son's deed and that he was still within the womb, and hearing the curses of Diti and Agastya, was grieved.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गच्छ शक्र पुत्रैतत् पापं किं कृतवान् असि न निर्मलकुलोत्पन्ना मनः कुर्वन्ति पातके
verses.transliteration: nirgaccha śakra putraitat pāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtavān asi na nirmalakulotpannā manaḥ kurvanti pātake
verses.translation: "Come out, Shakra, my son. What sin is this you have done? Those born of a pure family do not set their minds on sin."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स निर्गतो वज्रपाणिः सव्रीडो ऽधोमुखो ऽब्रवीत् तन्मूर्तिर् एव वदति सदसच्चेष्टितं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: sa nirgato vajrapāṇiḥ savrīḍo 'dhomukho 'bravīt tanmūrtir eva vadati sadasacceṣṭitaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: The thunderbolt-wielder came out, ashamed, with face cast down, and said, "A man's very bearing declares whether his conduct is good or bad.

verses.transliteration: yad uktam atra śreyaḥ syāt tatkartāham asaṃśayam
verses.translation: Whatever is declared best here, that I will certainly do."

verses.transliteration: tato mamāntikaṃ prāyāl lokapālaiḥ sa kaśyapaḥ sarvaṃ vṛttam athovāca punaḥ papraccha māṃ suraiḥ
verses.translation: Then Kashyapa came to me with the guardians of the worlds, told the whole story, and with the gods asked me again

verses.sanskrit: दितिगर्भस्य वै शान्तिं सहस्राक्षविशापताम् गर्भस्थानां च सर्वेषाम् इन्द्रेण सह मित्रताम्
verses.transliteration: ditigarbhasya vai śāntiṃ sahasrākṣaviśāpatām garbhasthānāṃ ca sarveṣām indreṇa saha mitratām
verses.translation: about the pacifying of Diti's embryo, the thousand-eyed one's release from the curse, and friendship between all those in the womb and Indra,

verses.transliteration: tataḥ śivaprasādena sarvaṃ śreyo bhaved iti tathety uktvā jagāmāsau kaśyapo gautamīṃ tadā
verses.translation: Then by Shiva's grace all will be well." Saying "So be it," Kashyapa went to the Gautami.

verses.translation: Having bathed, he praised the Lord of gods with these very words: "Two alone are proclaimed to remove all sorrow — the holy river Gautami, or Shiva, the mine of compassion.

verses.translation: Protect us, O Shankara, lord of gods; protect us, you who are saluted by the worlds; protect us, O purifier, lord of speech; protect us, you who are adorned with serpents.

verses.translation: Protect us, O lord, slayer of Tripura; protect us, you who are adorned with the half-moon; protect us, O lord of sacrifice, Someshvara; protect us, O giver of what is desired.

verses.translation: Protect us, O abode of compassion; protect us, O giver of blessings; protect us, O origin of all; protect us, O protector, O Vasava.

verses.translation: Protect us, O Sun, lord of wealth; protect us, you who are saluted by Brahma; protect us, O lord of the universe, lord of the Siddhas; protect us, O perfect one; salutations to you.

verses.translation: For embodied beings whose minds are troubled by wandering in the dreadful wilderness of worldly existence, you alone are the refuge, O Shiva, ocean of compassion."

verses.translation: As he praised thus, the bull-bannered god appeared before him and offered a boon to Kashyapa the Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: शापं नाशं च पुत्राणां परस्परम् अमित्रताम् पापप्राप्तिं तु शक्रस्य शापप्राप्तिं तथैव च ततो वृषाकपिः प्राह दितिं चागस्त्यम् एव च
verses.transliteration: śāpaṃ nāśaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ parasparam amitratām pāpaprāptiṃ tu śakrasya śāpaprāptiṃ tathaiva ca tato vṛṣākapiḥ prāha ditiṃ cāgastyam eva ca
verses.translation: the curse, the harm to the sons, their mutual enmity, Shakra's incurring of sin, and his being cursed as well. Then Vrishakapi spoke to Diti and to Agastya:

verses.sanskrit: मरुतो ये भवत्पुत्राः पञ्चाशच् चैकवर्जिताः सर्वे भवेयुः सुभगा भवेयुर् यज्ञभागिनः
verses.transliteration: maruto ye bhavatputrāḥ pañcāśac caikavarjitāḥ sarve bhaveyuḥ subhagā bhaveyur yajñabhāginaḥ
verses.translation: "Your sons, the Maruts, forty-nine in number, shall all be fortunate and shall have a share in sacrifices.

verses.transliteration: indreṇa sahitā nityaṃ vartayeyur mudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: They shall always live joyfully together with Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य तु हविर्भागो यत्र यत्र मखे भवेत् आदौ तु मरुतस् तत्र भवेयुर् नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: indrasya tu havirbhāgo yatra yatra makhe bhavet ādau tu marutas tatra bhaveyur nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Wherever Indra has a share of oblation in a sacrifice, there the Maruts shall be first; of this there is no doubt.

verses.sanskrit: मरुद्भिः सहितं शक्रं न जयेयुः कदाचन जेता भवेत् सर्वदैव सुखं तिष्ठ प्रजापते
verses.transliteration: marudbhiḥ sahitaṃ śakraṃ na jayeyuḥ kadācana jetā bhavet sarvadaiva sukhaṃ tiṣṭha prajāpate
verses.translation: None shall ever conquer Shakra when he is with the Maruts; he shall always be victorious. Dwell in happiness, O Prajapati.

verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti ye kuryur anayād bhrātṛghātanam vaṃśacchedo vipattiś ca nityaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: From today, those who wrongfully kill their brothers shall always suffer the ruin of their line and misfortune."

verses.transliteration: agastyam ṛṣiśārdūlaṃ śaṃbhur apy āha yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Shambhu also spoke earnestly to Agastya, tiger among sages:

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्यास् त्वं च कोपं च शचीभर्तरि वै मुने शमं व्रज महाप्राज्ञ मरुतस् त्व् अमरा भवन्
verses.transliteration: na kuryās tvaṃ ca kopaṃ ca śacībhartari vai mune śamaṃ vraja mahāprājña marutas tv amarā bhavan
verses.translation: "Do not be angry with Shachi's husband, O sage. Be at peace, O wise one; the Maruts have become immortal."

verses.transliteration: ditiṃ cāpi śivaḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Shiva, the bull-bannered god, graciously spoke to Diti as well:

verses.transliteration: eko bhūyān mama sutas trailokyaiśvaryamaṇḍitaḥ ity evaṃ cintayantī tvaṃ tapase niyatābhavaḥ
verses.translation: "Thinking, 'May I have one son adorned with lordship over the three worlds,' you devoted yourself to austerity.

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतत् सफलं ते ऽद्य पुत्रा बहुगुणाः शुभाः अभवन् बलिनः शूरास् तस्माज् जहि मनोरुजम् अन्यान् अपि वरान् सुभ्रूर् याचस्व गतसंभ्रमा
verses.transliteration: tad etat saphalaṃ te 'dya putrā bahuguṇāḥ śubhāḥ abhavan balinaḥ śūrās tasmāj jahi manorujam anyān api varān subhrūr yācasva gatasaṃbhramā
verses.translation: Today that has borne fruit for you: your sons are many-virtued and auspicious, strong and heroic, so cast off the pain in your heart. Ask for other boons too, fair-browed one, without fear."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं पुत्रतीर्थम् उदाहृतम् तत्र तु स्नानदानाद्यैः सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ putratīrtham udāhṛtam tatra tu snānadānādyaiḥ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: From then on that tirtha has been called Putratirtha; by bathing, giving and the like there one obtains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: मरुद्भिः सह मैत्र्येण मित्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते निष्पापत्वेन चेन्द्रस्य शक्रतीर्थं तद् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: marudbhiḥ saha maitryeṇa mitratīrthaṃ tad ucyate niṣpāpatvena cendrasya śakratīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: Because of the friendship with the Maruts it is called Mitratirtha; because of Indra's freedom from sin it is called Shakratirtha.

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रीं श्रियं यत्र लेभे तत् तीर्थं कमलाभिधम् एतानि सर्वतीर्थानि सर्वाभीष्टप्रदानि हि
verses.transliteration: aindrīṃ śriyaṃ yatra lebhe tat tīrthaṃ kamalābhidham etāni sarvatīrthāni sarvābhīṣṭapradāni hi
verses.translation: The tirtha where he regained Indra's glory is called Kamala. All these tirthas grant every wish.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं भविष्यतीत्य् उक्त्वा शिवश् चान्तरधीयत कृतकृत्याश् च ते जग्मुः सर्व एव यथागतम् तीर्थानां पुण्यदं तत्र लक्षम् एकं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatīty uktvā śivaś cāntaradhīyata kṛtakṛtyāś ca te jagmuḥ sarva eva yathāgatam tīrthānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tatra lakṣam ekaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Saying, "All this will come to pass," Shiva vanished, and they all, their purpose accomplished, went back as they had come. One hundred thousand merit-giving tirthas are proclaimed there.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् दृष्टादृष्टेष्टदं सर्वदेवर्षिगणसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: yamatīrtham iti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣṭadaṃ sarvadevarṣigaṇasevitam
verses.translation: In the final Yuga will come up those kings who will cease to be protectors and take away the portion of oblations. They will be interested only in saving themselves.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: In the final Yuga will come up those kings who will cease to be protectors and take away the portion of oblations. They will be interested only in saving themselves.
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् अनुह्राद इति ख्यातः कपोतो बलवान् अभूत्
verses.transliteration: tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam anuhrāda iti khyātaḥ kapoto balavān abhūt
verses.translation: In the final Yuga, non-Ksatriyas will become kings, brahmins will resort to Sudras for sustenance and Siidras will maintain the conduct and way of life of the brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the final Yuga, non-Ksatriyas will become kings, brahmins will resort to Sudras for sustenance and Siidras will maintain the conduct and way of life of the brahmins.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या हेतिनाम्नी पक्षिणी कामरूपिणी मृत्योः पौत्रो ह्य् अनुह्रादो दौहित्री हेतिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā hetināmnī pakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī mṛtyoḥ pautro hy anuhrādo dauhitrī hetir eva ca
verses.translation: Men will become ill-mannered. They will be devoted to the hoarding of wealth. They will be fond of liquor and meat. Base men will carnally approach the wives of their friends.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will become ill-mannered. They will be devoted to the hoarding of wealth. They will be fond of liquor and meat. Base men will carnally approach the wives of their friends.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कालेनाथ तयोः पुत्राः पौत्राश् चैव बभूविरे तस्य शत्रुश् च बलवान् उलूको नाम पक्षिराट्
verses.transliteration: kālenātha tayoḥ putrāḥ pautrāś caiva babhūvire tasya śatruś ca balavān ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ
verses.translation: In the final Yuga, wealth and assets will become impor¬ tant. The conduct and activities of the good will not be honoured. The fallen ones will not be rebuked and treated with contempt.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the final Yuga, wealth and assets will become impor¬ tant. The conduct and activities of the good will not be honoured. The fallen ones will not be rebuked and treated with contempt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्राश् च पौत्राश् च आग्नेयास् ते बलोत्कटाः तयोश् च वैरम् अभवद् बहुकालं द्विजन्मनोः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrāś ca pautrāś ca āgneyās te balotkaṭāḥ tayoś ca vairam abhavad bahukālaṃ dvijanmanoḥ
verses.translation: Men will be ugly with the noses missing and the hairs in disarray. Girls less than sixteen in age will give birth to children.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will be ugly with the noses missing and the hairs in disarray. Girls less than sixteen in age will give birth to children.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
