verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाया उत्तरे तीरे कपोतस्याश्रमो ऽभवत् तस्याश् च दक्षिणे कूल उलूको नाम पक्षिराट्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyā uttare tīre kapotasyāśramo 'bhavat tasyāś ca dakṣiṇe kūla ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ
verses.translation: In the final yuga, cooked food will be sold in the open
verses.commentary: Sense: In the final yuga, cooked food will be sold in the open
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वासं चक्रे तत्र पुत्रैः पौत्रैश् च द्विजसत्तम तयोश् च युद्धम् अभवद् बहुकालं विरुद्धयोः
verses.transliteration: vāsaṃ cakre tatra putraiḥ pautraiś ca dvijasattama tayoś ca yuddham abhavad bahukālaṃ viruddhayoḥ
verses.translation: Sudras will begin to expound Dharma. Their teeth 'vi be white. They will conquer their sense-organs. They will wear ocher robes They will sustain themselves with knavishness and crooked intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudras will begin to expound Dharma. Their teeth 'vi be white. They will conquer their sense-organs. They will wear ocher robes They will sustain themselves with knavishness and crooked intellect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैः पौत्रैश् च वृतयोर् बलिनोर् बलिभिः सह उलूको वा कपोतो वा नैवाप्नोति जयाजयौ
verses.transliteration: putraiḥ pautraiś ca vṛtayor balinor balibhiḥ saha ulūko vā kapoto vā naivāpnoti jayājayau
verses.translation: The base ones will stay in the end. The subjects will lose bashfulncss. They are doomed in that final age.
verses.commentary: Sense: The base ones will stay in the end. The subjects will lose bashfulncss. They are doomed in that final age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कपोतो यमम् आराध्य मृत्युं पैतामहं तथा याम्यम् अस्त्रम् अवाप्याथ सर्वेभ्यो ऽप्य् अधिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kapoto yamam ārādhya mṛtyuṃ paitāmahaṃ tathā yāmyam astram avāpyātha sarvebhyo 'py adhiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: Even the excellent brahmins sell fruits of their austeri¬ ties and sacrifices. The seasons will become adverse during that ultimate age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the excellent brahmins sell fruits of their austeri¬ ties and sacrifices. The seasons will become adverse during that ultimate age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तथोलूको ऽग्निम् आराध्य बलवान् अभवद् भृशम् वरैर् उन्मत्तयोर् युद्धम् अभवच् चातिभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: tatholūko 'gnim ārādhya balavān abhavad bhṛśam varair unmattayor yuddham abhavac cātibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: Similarly, steers under training will be yoked to the plough even when they are two years old. When the yuga comes to a close, the clouds will begin to shower in a quaint way
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, steers under training will be yoked to the plough even when they are two years old. When the yuga comes to a close, the clouds will begin to shower in a quaint way
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्राग्नेयम् उलूको ऽपि कपोतायास्त्रम् आक्षिपत् कपोतो ऽप्य् अथ पाशान् वै याम्यान् आक्षिप्य शत्रवे
verses.transliteration: tatrāgneyam ulūko 'pi kapotāyāstram ākṣipat kapoto 'py atha pāśān vai yāmyān ākṣipya śatrave
verses.translation: Those who arc born in the family of heroes will become kings as the lower subjects become baser and baser at the close of the age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who arc born in the family of heroes will become kings as the lower subjects become baser and baser at the close of the age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: उलूकायाथ दण्डं च मृत्युपाशान् अवासृजत् पुनस् तद् अभवद् युद्धं पुराडिबकयोर् यथा
verses.transliteration: ulūkāyātha daṇḍaṃ ca mṛtyupāśān avāsṛjat punas tad abhavad yuddhaṃ purāḍibakayor yathā
verses.translation: Charitable gifts will be obligatory on the parts of parents while the sons will never perform sacred rites as the age comes to a close.
verses.commentary: Sense: Charitable gifts will be obligatory on the parts of parents while the sons will never perform sacred rites as the age comes to a close.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हेतिः कपोतकी दृष्ट्वा ज्वलनं प्राप्तम् अन्तिके पतिव्रता महायुद्धे भर्तुः सा दुःखविह्वला
verses.transliteration: hetiḥ kapotakī dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ prāptam antike pativratā mahāyuddhe bhartuḥ sā duḥkhavihvalā
verses.translation: Sons will eagerly share the hereditary assets and charitable gifts. Urged by greed and other bad qualities they will be antagonistic to one another and will even attempt to take away other's shares.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sons will eagerly share the hereditary assets and charitable gifts. Urged by greed and other bad qualities they will be antagonistic to one another and will even attempt to take away other's shares.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना वेष्ट्यमानांश् च पुत्रान् दृष्ट्वा विशेषतः सा गत्वा ज्वलनं हेतिस् तुष्टाव विविधोक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: agninā veṣṭyamānāṃś ca putrān dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ sā gatvā jvalanaṃ hetis tuṣṭāva vividhoktibhiḥ
verses.translation: At the close ot the \uga when tenderness, beauty and jewellery cease to exist women will be decked by means of their tresses.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close ot the \uga when tenderness, beauty and jewellery cease to exist women will be decked by means of their tresses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: रूपं न दानं न परोक्षम् अस्ति यस्यात्मभूतं च पदार्थजातम् अश्नन्ति हव्यानि च येन देवाः स्वाहापतिं यज्ञभुजं नमस्ये
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ na dānaṃ na parokṣam asti yasyātmabhūtaṃ ca padārthajātam aśnanti havyāni ca yena devāḥ svāhāpatiṃ yajñabhujaṃ namasye
verses.translation: A householder devoid of stamina and virility will attempt to have sexual pleasure. When the Yuga comes to a close no sexual indulgence will be on a par with that with one's own wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: A householder devoid of stamina and virility will attempt to have sexual pleasure. When the Yuga comes to a close no sexual indulgence will be on a par with that with one's own wife.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखभूतं च देवानां देवानां हव्यवाहनम् होतारं चापि देवानां देवानां दूतम् एव च
verses.transliteration: mukhabhūtaṃ ca devānāṃ devānāṃ havyavāhanam hotāraṃ cāpi devānāṃ devānāṃ dūtam eva ca
verses.translation: Population will consist mostly of beggars; people will never give anything to one another. They will perish on being harassed by kings and robbers or destroyed by fire or fighting.
verses.commentary: Sense: Population will consist mostly of beggars; people will never give anything to one another. They will perish on being harassed by kings and robbers or destroyed by fire or fighting.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तं देवं शरणं यामि आदिदेवं विभावसुम् अन्तः स्थितः प्राणरूपो बहिश् चान्नप्रदो हि यः यो यज्ञसाधनं यामि शरणं तं धनंजयम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi ādidevaṃ vibhāvasum antaḥ sthitaḥ prāṇarūpo bahiś cānnaprado hi yaḥ yo yajñasādhanaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ taṃ dhanaṃjayam
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close, plants will cease to bear fruits; young men will exhibit the characteristics of old men and men of no good conduct will be happy in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Yuga comes to a close, plants will cease to bear fruits; young men will exhibit the characteristics of old men and men of no good conduct will be happy in the world.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अमोघम् एतद् अस्त्रं मे न्यस्तं युद्धे कपोतकि यत्र विश्रमयेद् अस्त्रं तन् मे ब्रूहि पतिव्रते
verses.transliteration: amogham etad astraṃ me nyastaṃ yuddhe kapotaki yatra viśramayed astraṃ tan me brūhi pativrate
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close rough and low winds showering hailstone will begin to blow in the rainy seasons; the other world will become of doubtful existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Yuga comes to a close rough and low winds showering hailstone will begin to blow in the rainy seasons; the other world will become of doubtful existence.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मयि विश्रम्यताम् अस्त्रं न पुत्रे न च भर्तरि सत्यवाग् भव हव्येश जातवेदो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: mayi viśramyatām astraṃ na putre na ca bhartari satyavāg bhava havyeśa jātavedo namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Kings like the Vais'yas will maintain themselves with wealth and foodgrains. When the Yuga passes off, no one will behave like kinsman to anyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings like the Vais'yas will maintain themselves with wealth and foodgrains. When the Yuga passes off, no one will behave like kinsman to anyone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽस्मि तव वाक्येन भर्तृभक्त्या पतिव्रते तवापि भर्तृपुत्राणां हेति क्षेमं ददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'smi tava vākyena bhartṛbhaktyā pativrate tavāpi bhartṛputrāṇāṃ heti kṣemaṃ dadāmy aham
verses.translation: Agreements and promises will cease to function. When the Yuga comes to a close a debt will lose itself along with a sense of propriety and decorum.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agreements and promises will cease to function. When the Yuga comes to a close a debt will lose itself along with a sense of propriety and decorum.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आग्नेयम् एतद् अस्त्रं मे न भर्तारं सुतान् अपि न त्वां दहेत् ततो याहि सुखेन त्वं कपोतकि
verses.transliteration: āgneyam etad astraṃ me na bhartāraṃ sutān api na tvāṃ dahet tato yāhi sukhena tvaṃ kapotaki
verses.translation: Delight of men will be fruitless and the anger of men will be fruitful. When the Yuga comes to a close people will begin to rear goats for getting milk.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delight of men will be fruitless and the anger of men will be fruitful. When the Yuga comes to a close people will begin to rear goats for getting milk.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे तत्र उलूकी ददृशे पतिम् वेष्ट्यमानं याम्यपाशैर् यमदण्डेन ताडितम् उलूकी दुःखिता भूत्वा यमं प्रायाद् भयातुरा
verses.transliteration: etasminn antare tatra ulūkī dadṛśe patim veṣṭyamānaṃ yāmyapāśair yamadaṇḍena tāḍitam ulūkī duḥkhitā bhūtvā yamaṃ prāyād bhayāturā
verses.translation: Similarly, sacrifices will be performed not in accordance with the sacred texts. Men who profess to be scholars will be acting in an unauthorized manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, sacrifices will be performed not in accordance with the sacred texts. Men who profess to be scholars will be acting in an unauthorized manner.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्भीता अनुद्रवन्ते जनास् त्वद्भीता ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति त्वद्भीताः साधु चरन्ति धीरास् त्वद्भीताः कर्मनिष्ठा भवन्ति
verses.transliteration: tvadbhītā anudravante janās tvadbhītā brahmacaryaṃ caranti tvadbhītāḥ sādhu caranti dhīrās tvadbhītāḥ karmaniṣṭhā bhavanti
verses.translation: Without offering alms and oblations men will partake of their meals. Deceiving their husbands who are asleep women will go elsewhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without offering alms and oblations men will partake of their meals. Deceiving their husbands who are asleep women will go elsewhere.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्भीता अनाशकम् आचरन्ति ग्रामाद् अरण्यम् अभि यच् चरन्ति त्वद्भीताः सौम्यताम् आश्रयन्ते त्वद्भीताः सोमपानं भजन्ते
verses.transliteration: tvadbhītā anāśakam ācaranti grāmād araṇyam abhi yac caranti tvadbhītāḥ saumyatām āśrayante tvadbhītāḥ somapānaṃ bhajante
verses.translation: After this, when the virtue falls down the subjects will become devoid of good qualities. After attaining loss of good conduct they will attain deficiency in their longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After this, when the virtue falls down the subjects will become devoid of good qualities. After attaining loss of good conduct they will attain deficiency in their longevity.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवत्यां तस्यां ताम् आह दक्षिणदिक्पतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvatyāṃ tasyāṃ tām āha dakṣiṇadikpatiḥ
verses.translation: They will incur decline in strength due to defi¬ ciency in longevity; pallor and discolouration due to decline in strength, sickness and pain due to pallor; and despondency due to pain of sickness.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will incur decline in strength due to defi¬ ciency in longevity; pallor and discolouration due to decline in strength, sickness and pain due to pallor; and despondency due to pain of sickness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वरं वरय भद्रं ते दास्ये ऽहं मनसः प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dāsye 'haṃ manasaḥ priyam
verses.translation: Due to despondency self-knowledge will be aroused in them; due to self-knowledge inclination towards piety (will be acquired by them). By attaining the highest point thus they will reach the Krta Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to despondency self-knowledge will be aroused in them; due to self-knowledge inclination towards piety (will be acquired by them). By attaining the highest point thus they will reach the Krta Yuga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यमस्येति वचः श्रुत्वा सा तम् आह पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: yamasyeti vacaḥ śrutvā sā tam āha pativratā
verses.translation: Some will be practising piety to a certain extent; some will attain a neutral state; some will follow misconceived piety; some will attain jolly temperament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some will be practising piety to a certain extent; some will attain a neutral state; some will follow misconceived piety; some will attain jolly temperament.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भर्ता मे वेष्टितः पाशैर् दण्डेनाभिहतस् तव तस्माद् रक्ष सुरश्रेष्ठ पुत्रान् भर्तारम् एव च
verses.transliteration: bhartā me veṣṭitaḥ pāśair daṇḍenābhihatas tava tasmād rakṣa suraśreṣṭha putrān bhartāram eva ca
verses.translation: Some will come to the conclusion that only perception and inference constitute true testimony; others will say that no¬ thing can be true testimony.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some will come to the conclusion that only perception and inference constitute true testimony; others will say that no¬ thing can be true testimony.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यात् कृपया युक्तो यमः प्राह पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tadvākyāt kṛpayā yukto yamaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Some will be addicted to atheism and ruin piety; some will become deluded. Brahmins will profess to be great scholars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some will be addicted to atheism and ruin piety; some will become deluded. Brahmins will profess to be great scholars.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पाशानां चापि दण्डस्य स्थानं वद शुभानने
verses.transliteration: pāśānāṃ cāpi daṇḍasya sthānaṃ vada śubhānane
verses.translation: People will be excluded from the knowledge of scrip¬ tures. They will retain faith only in what is current for the nonce. Men devoid of knowledge will become arrogant.
verses.commentary: Sense: People will be excluded from the knowledge of scrip¬ tures. They will retain faith only in what is current for the nonce. Men devoid of knowledge will become arrogant.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सा प्रोवाच यमं देवं मयि पाशास् त्वयेरिताः आविशन्तु जगन्नाथ दण्डो मय्य् एव संविशेत् ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् यमस् तां कृपया पुनः
verses.transliteration: sā provāca yamaṃ devaṃ mayi pāśās tvayeritāḥ āviśantu jagannātha daṇḍo mayy eva saṃviśet tataḥ provāca bhagavān yamas tāṃ kṛpayā punaḥ
verses.translation: When piety becomes unsteady and disarranged, there will still be people honoured by the noble ones who will prac¬ tise auspicious rites and resort to charitable deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: When piety becomes unsteady and disarranged, there will still be people honoured by the noble ones who will prac¬ tise auspicious rites and resort to charitable deeds.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तव भर्ता च पुत्राश् च सर्वे जीवन्तु विज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tava bhartā ca putrāś ca sarve jīvantu vijvarāḥ
verses.translation: When people begin to cat indiscriminately, when they think that they arc protected by themselves, when they conceal themselves, when they become devoid of mercy, when they are shameless in their character, these are the signs of Kali age.
verses.commentary: Sense: When people begin to cat indiscriminately, when they think that they arc protected by themselves, when they conceal themselves, when they become devoid of mercy, when they are shameless in their character, these are the signs of Kali age.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: न्यवारयद् यमः पाशान् आग्नेयास्त्रं तु हव्यवाट् कपोतोलूकयोश् चापि प्रीतिं वै चक्रतुः सुरौ आहतुश् च द्विजन्मानौ व्रियतां वर ईप्सितः
verses.transliteration: nyavārayad yamaḥ pāśān āgneyāstraṃ tu havyavāṭ kapotolūkayoś cāpi prītiṃ vai cakratuḥ surau āhatuś ca dvijanmānau vriyatāṃ vara īpsitaḥ
verses.translation: During the period of the onslaught of Kali that des¬ troys strict adherence to wisdom, even unprepared persons will attain Siddhi in a short while.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the period of the onslaught of Kali that des¬ troys strict adherence to wisdom, even unprepared persons will attain Siddhi in a short while.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भवतोर् दर्शनं लब्धं वैरव्याजेन दुष्करम् वयं च पक्षिणः पापाः किं वरेण सुरोत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: bhavator darśanaṃ labdhaṃ vairavyājena duṣkaram vayaṃ ca pakṣiṇaḥ pāpāḥ kiṃ vareṇa surottamau
verses.translation: O brahmins, if the people of lower castes resort to the
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if the people of lower castes resort to the

verses.sanskrit: अथ देयो वरो ऽस्माकं भवद्भ्यां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् नात्मार्थम् अनुयाचावो दीयमानं वरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: atha deyo varo 'smākaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ prītipūrvakam nātmārtham anuyācāvo dīyamānaṃ varaṃ śubham
verses.translation: When the Yuga comes to a close there will be great wars, heavy downpour, strong gusts of wind and scorching heat. It is the characteristic feature of Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Yuga comes to a close there will be great wars, heavy downpour, strong gusts of wind and scorching heat. It is the characteristic feature of Kali.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थं यस् तु याचेत स शोच्यो हि सुरेश्वरौ जीवितं सफलं तस्य यः परार्थोद्यतः सदा
verses.transliteration: ātmārthaṃ yas tu yāceta sa śocyo hi sureśvarau jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ tasya yaḥ parārthodyataḥ sadā
verses.translation: When a time characterized by worthlessness and full of disturbances comes and there arc no holy rites, men who are afflicted by the burden of taxes, will resort to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a time characterized by worthlessness and full of disturbances comes and there arc no holy rites, men who are afflicted by the burden of taxes, will resort to the forest.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् आपो रविः पृथ्वी धान्यानि विविधानि च परार्थं वर्तनं तेषां सतां चापि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: agnir āpo raviḥ pṛthvī dhānyāni vividhāni ca parārthaṃ vartanaṃ teṣāṃ satāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: When the holy rites of sacrifices cease to be performed, demons, beasts of prey, worms, mice and serpents will attack men.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the holy rites of sacrifices cease to be performed, demons, beasts of prey, worms, mice and serpents will attack men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादयो ऽपि हि यतो युज्यन्ते मृत्युना सह एवं ज्ञात्वा तु देवेशौ वृथा स्वार्थपरिश्रमः
verses.transliteration: brahmādayo 'pi hi yato yujyante mṛtyunā saha evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśau vṛthā svārthapariśramaḥ
verses.translation: At the close of the Age some excellent men in certain places will enjoy prosperity, abundance of food, of good healt and self-sufficiency in the kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the Age some excellent men in certain places will enjoy prosperity, abundance of food, of good healt and self-sufficiency in the kinsmen.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: जन्मना सह यत् पुंसां विहितं परमेष्ठिना कदाचिन् नान्यथा तद् वै वृथा क्लिश्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.transliteration: janmanā saha yat puṃsāṃ vihitaṃ parameṣṭhinā kadācin nānyathā tad vai vṛthā kliśyanti jantavaḥ
verses.translation: In the different regions there will be separate groups of persons equipped with rafts and requisites. They will be protected by themselves as well as robbed by themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the different regions there will be separate groups of persons equipped with rafts and requisites. They will be protected by themselves as well as robbed by themselves.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् याचावहे किंचिद् धिताय जगतां शुभम् गुणदायि तु सर्वेषां तद् युवाम् अनुमन्यताम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād yācāvahe kiṃcid dhitāya jagatāṃ śubham guṇadāyi tu sarveṣāṃ tad yuvām anumanyatām
verses.translation: As time passes on, men will be dislodged from their countries; they will lose valuable things along with their kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: As time passes on, men will be dislodged from their countries; they will lose valuable things along with their kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: ताव् आहतुर् उभौ देवौ पक्षिणौ लोकविश्रुतौ धर्मस्य यशसो ऽवाप्त्ये लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tāv āhatur ubhau devau pakṣiṇau lokaviśrutau dharmasya yaśaso 'vāptye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: They will be afflicted by starvation and they will run away in great fright taking their children' with them. They will cross the river Kausikl.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be afflicted by starvation and they will run away in great fright taking their children' with them. They will cross the river Kausikl.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आवाभ्याम् आश्रमौ तीर्थे गङ्गाया उभये तटे भवेतां जगतां नाथाव् एष एव परो वरः
verses.transliteration: āvābhyām āśramau tīrthe gaṅgāyā ubhaye taṭe bhavetāṃ jagatāṃ nāthāv eṣa eva paro varaḥ
verses.translation: They will resort to the lands of Aiiga, Vahga, Kalinga, Kasmlra and Kosala. They will occupy valleys and chasms between the mountains abounding in sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will resort to the lands of Aiiga, Vahga, Kalinga, Kasmlra and Kosala. They will occupy valleys and chasms between the mountains abounding in sages.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपो होमः पितॄणां चापि पूजनम् सुकृती दुष्कृती वापि यः करोति यथा तथा सर्वं तद् अक्षयं पुण्यं स्याद् इत्य् एष परो वरः
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi pūjanam sukṛtī duṣkṛtī vāpi yaḥ karoti yathā tathā sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ syād ity eṣa paro varaḥ
verses.translation: The Earth will be neither void nor full of forests. Kings will be both protectors and non-protectors.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Earth will be neither void nor full of forests. Kings will be both protectors and non-protectors.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अस्तु तथा चान्यत् सुप्रीतौ तु ब्रवावहै
verses.transliteration: evam astu tathā cānyat suprītau tu bravāvahai
verses.translation: Men will sustain themselves by means of deer, fish, birds, beasts of prey, serpents, insects, worms, honey, vegetables, green fruits and roots.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will sustain themselves by means of deer, fish, birds, beasts of prey, serpents, insects, worms, honey, vegetables, green fruits and roots.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे गौतमीतीरे यमस्तोत्रं पठन्ति ये तेषां सप्तसु वंशेषु नाकाले मृत्युम् आप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: uttare gautamītīre yamastotraṃ paṭhanti ye teṣāṃ saptasu vaṃśeṣu nākāle mṛtyum āpnuyāt
verses.translation: Like sages men will use barks of trees, skins of deer and will have for their food the rotting and decaying leaves and fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like sages men will use barks of trees, skins of deer and will have for their food the rotting and decaying leaves and fruits.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषो भाजनं च स्यात् सर्वदा सर्वसंपदाम् यस् त्व् इदं पठते नित्यं मृत्युस्तोत्रं जितात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: puruṣo bhājanaṃ ca syāt sarvadā sarvasaṃpadām yas tv idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ mṛtyustotraṃ jitātmavān
verses.translation: The people will not be able to extract oil from seeds. They will be assailed and struck by darts fixed to wooden pieces. They will always rear goats, sheep, asses, mules and camels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people will not be able to extract oil from seeds. They will be assailed and struck by darts fixed to wooden pieces. They will always rear goats, sheep, asses, mules and camels.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाशीतिसहस्रैश् च व्याधिभिर् न स बाध्यते अस्मिंस् तीर्थे द्विजश्रेष्ठौ त्रिमासाद् गुर्विणी सती
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśītisahasraiś ca vyādhibhir na sa bādhyate asmiṃs tīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhau trimāsād gurviṇī satī
verses.translation: They will resort to the banks, of rivers and for the sake of diverting the course of water they will restrain the flow of currents. They will be engaged in mutual petty trade and deal in cooked food.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will resort to the banks, of rivers and for the sake of diverting the course of water they will restrain the flow of currents. They will be engaged in mutual petty trade and deal in cooked food.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाग्वन्ध्या च षण्मासात् सप्ताहं स्नानम् आचरेत् वीरसूः सा भवेन् नारी शतायुः स सुतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: arvāgvandhyā ca ṣaṇmāsāt saptāhaṃ snānam ācaret vīrasūḥ sā bhaven nārī śatāyuḥ sa suto bhavet
verses.translation: Due to the non-fulfilment of their desires thev will be pious m their conduct. Themselves afflicted by destruction they will perform coasccratory rites.

verses.transliteration: lakṣmīvān matimāñ śūraḥ putrapautravivardhanaḥ tatra piṇḍādidānena pitaro muktim āpnuyuḥ manovākkāyajāt pāpāt snānān mukto bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: He becomes prosperous, wise and heroic, flourishing with sons and grandsons. By offering rice-balls and the like there the ancestors attain liberation, and by bathing a man is freed from sin born of mind, speech and body.

verses.sanskrit: यमवाक्याद् अनु तथा हव्यवाड् आह पक्षिणौ
verses.transliteration: yamavākyād anu tathā havyavāḍ āha pakṣiṇau
verses.translation: After Yama's words, the Bearer of oblations likewise spoke to the two birds:

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्तोत्रं दक्षिणे तीरे ये पठन्ति यतव्रताः तेषाम् आरोग्यम् ऐश्वर्यं लक्ष्मीं रूपं ददाम्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: matstotraṃ dakṣiṇe tīre ye paṭhanti yatavratāḥ teṣām ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ lakṣmīṃ rūpaṃ dadāmy aham
verses.translation: "Those who, keeping their vows, recite my hymn on the southern bank — to them I give health, lordship, prosperity and beauty.

verses.transliteration: idaṃ stotraṃ tu yaḥ kaścid yatra kvāpi paṭhen naraḥ naivāgnito bhayaṃ tasya likhite 'pi gṛhe sthite
verses.translation: Whoever recites this hymn anywhere has no fear of fire, even if it is only kept written in his house.

verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād agnitīrthe śucir naraḥ agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya bhaved eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The pure man who bathes and gives at Agnitirtha surely gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma sacrifice; there is no doubt."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं याम्यम् आग्नेयम् एव च कपोतं च तथोलूकं हेत्युलूकं विदुर् बुधाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ yāmyam āgneyam eva ca kapotaṃ ca tatholūkaṃ hetyulūkaṃ vidur budhāḥ
verses.translation: From then on the wise know that tirtha as Yamya and Agneya, and also as Kapota and Uluka, called Hetyuluka.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्रीणि सहस्राणि तावन्त्य् एव शतानि च पुनर् नवतितीर्थानि प्रत्येकं मुक्तिभाजनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tāvanty eva śatāni ca punar navatitīrthāni pratyekaṃ muktibhājanam
verses.translation: There are three thousand tirthas there, as many hundreds, and ninety more, each a vessel of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्नानेन दानेन प्रेतीभूताश् च ये नराः पूतास् ते पुत्रवित्ताढ्या आक्रमेयुर् दिवं शुभाः
verses.transliteration: teṣu snānena dānena pretībhūtāś ca ye narāḥ pūtās te putravittāḍhyā ākrameyur divaṃ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: By bathing and giving at them even men who have become ghosts are purified and, rich in sons and wealth, ascend to the auspicious heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तपोवृद्धिकरं महत् सर्वकामप्रदं पुण्यं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: tapastīrtham iti khyātaṃ tapovṛddhikaraṃ mahat sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: Janasthana: A part of DaijiJaka forest which lies in the basin of Godavari. Rama had lived in this forest with Sita and Laksmana for a long time during the period of his exile.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस् तीर्थे तु यद् वृत्तं शृणु पापप्रणाशनम् अपाम् अग्नेश् च संवादम् ऋषीणां च परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yad vṛttaṃ śṛṇu pāpapraṇāśanam apām agneś ca saṃvādam ṛṣīṇāṃ ca parasparam
verses.translation: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Asura, the haughty son of Madhu, the Danava named Lavana, the heroic demon, proud of his boons was killed in the forest (named) Madhuvana.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपो ज्येष्ठतमाः केचिन् मेनिरे ऽग्निं तथापरे एवं ब्रुवन्तो मुनयः संवादं चाग्निवारिणोः
verses.transliteration: apo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ kecin menire 'gniṃ tathāpare evaṃ bruvanto munayaḥ saṃvādaṃ cāgnivāriṇoḥ
verses.translation: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tiger among men killed Viradha and Kabandha, the Raksasas of terrible exploits who had been formerly two Gandharvas deluded by imprecation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विनाग्निं जीवनं क्व स्याज् जीवभूतो यतो ऽनलः आत्मभूतो हव्यभूतश् चाग्निना जायते ऽखिलम्
verses.transliteration: vināgniṃ jīvanaṃ kva syāj jīvabhūto yato 'nalaḥ ātmabhūto havyabhūtaś cāgninā jāyate 'khilam
verses.translation: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the battle Rama killed his enemies by means of arrows, that had the lustre of fire, sun-rays and lightning streaks, that had the tail ends fitted with feathers of various kinds made of molten gold and the strength of which was like that of the thunderbolt of Mahendra.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना ध्रियते लोको ह्य् अग्निर् ज्योतिर्मयं जगत् तस्माद् अग्नेः परं नास्ति पावनं दैवतं महत्
verses.transliteration: agninā dhriyate loko hy agnir jyotirmayaṃ jagat tasmād agneḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ daivataṃ mahat
verses.translation: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Weapons were given to him by Visvaraitra the intelli¬ gent sage for slaying the enemies who could not be assailed even by Devas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्ज्योतिः स एवोक्तः परं ज्योतिः स एव हि विनाग्निना किंचिद् अस्ति यस्य धाम जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: antarjyotiḥ sa evoktaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sa eva hi vināgninā kiṃcid asti yasya dhāma jagattrayam
verses.translation: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, when a certain sacrifice yvas performed by Janaka the great Atman, the great bow belonging to Mahesvara was broken by him even as he playfully and sportingly touched it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् अग्नेः परं नास्ति भूतानां ज्यैष्ठ्यभाजनम् योषित्क्षेत्रे ऽर्पितं बीजं पुरुषेण यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmād agneḥ paraṃ nāsti bhūtānāṃ jyaiṣṭhyabhājanam yoṣitkṣetre 'rpitaṃ bījaṃ puruṣeṇa yathā tathā
verses.translation: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing these tasks Rama the most excellent among the virtuous performed ten horse-sacrifices where flesh was offered to the deities.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देहादिका शक्तिः कृशानोर् एव नान्यथा देवानां हि मुखं वह्निस् तस्मान् नातः परं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tasya dehādikā śaktiḥ kṛśānor eva nānyathā devānāṃ hi mukhaṃ vahnis tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: No widow lamented. There were no calamities. Every¬ thing was auspicious when Rama was ruling over the earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अपरे तु ह्य् अपां ज्यैष्ठ्यं मेनिरे वेदवादिनः अद्भिः संपत्स्यते ह्य् अन्नं शुचिर् अद्भिः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: apare tu hy apāṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ menire vedavādinaḥ adbhiḥ saṃpatsyate hy annaṃ śucir adbhiḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.commentary: Sense: No living being had any fear from water, fire, wind or blows (of any sort). Old men never performed the funeral rites of boys (i.e. boys never died before old men).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर् एव धृतं सर्वम् आपो वै मातरः स्मृताः त्रैलोक्यजीवनं वारि वदन्तीति पुराविदः
verses.transliteration: adbhir eva dhṛtaṃ sarvam āpo vai mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ trailokyajīvanaṃ vāri vadantīti purāvidaḥ
verses.translation: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Ksatriyas were devoted to the Brahmins. The Vaisyas were devoted to the Ksatriyas. The Sudras served the three castes without any pride or egotism.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नम् अमृतं ह्य् अद्भ्यस् ताभ्यश् चौषधिसंभवः अग्निर् ज्येष्ठ इति प्राहुर् आपो ज्येष्ठतमाः परे
verses.transliteration: utpannam amṛtaṃ hy adbhyas tābhyaś cauṣadhisaṃbhavaḥ agnir jyeṣṭha iti prāhur āpo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ pare
verses.translation: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women did not stray from their husbands; the hus¬ band did not stray from his wife. The entire universe was restrained and subdued. The earth was rid of robbers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं मीमांसमानास् ते ऋषयो वेदवादिनः विरुद्धवादिनो मां च समभ्येत्येदम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mīmāṃsamānās te ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ viruddhavādino māṃ ca samabhyetyedam abruvan
verses.translation: Thousands ofarmsofBana of miraculous activities were cut off. Naraka was killed in the war. So also Yavana of great strength.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: agner apāṃ vada jyaiṣṭhyaṃ trailokyasya bhavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "Tell us whether fire or water is the elder; you are the lord of the three worlds."

verses.sanskrit: अहम् अप्य् अब्रवं प्राप्तान् ऋषीन् सर्वान् यतव्रतान् उभौ पूज्यतमौ लोक उभाभ्यां जायते जगत्
verses.transliteration: aham apy abravaṃ prāptān ṛṣīn sarvān yatavratān ubhau pūjyatamau loka ubhābhyāṃ jāyate jagat
verses.translation: I said to all the sages who had come, keeping their vows: "Both are most worthy of worship in the world; from both the world is born.

verses.sanskrit: उभाभ्यां जायते हव्यं कव्यं चामृतम् एव च उभाभ्यां जीवनं लोके शरीरस्य च धारणम्
verses.transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ jāyate havyaṃ kavyaṃ cāmṛtam eva ca ubhābhyāṃ jīvanaṃ loke śarīrasya ca dhāraṇam
verses.translation: From both come offerings to the gods and ancestors, and nectar too; from both come life in the world and the sustaining of the body.

verses.sanskrit: नानयोश् च विशेषो ऽस्ति ततो ज्यैष्ठ्यं समं मतम् ततो मद्वचनाज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् उभयोर् नैव कस्यचित्
verses.transliteration: nānayoś ca viśeṣo 'sti tato jyaiṣṭhyaṃ samaṃ matam tato madvacanāj jyaiṣṭhyam ubhayor naiva kasyacit
verses.translation: There is no difference between them, so their seniority is held to be equal." So by my word neither of the two was the elder.

verses.sanskrit: ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अन्यतरस्येति मेनिरे ऋषिसत्तमाः न तृप्ता मम वाक्येन जग्मुर् वायुं तपस्विनः
verses.transliteration: jyaiṣṭhyam anyatarasyeti menire ṛṣisattamāḥ na tṛptā mama vākyena jagmur vāyuṃ tapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: The best of sages held that one of the two must be the elder; not satisfied with my words, the ascetics went to Vayu:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: kasya jyaiṣṭhyaṃ bhavān prāṇo vāyo satyaṃ tvayi sthitam
verses.translation: "Whose is the seniority? You are the life-breath, O Vayu; truth rests in you."

verses.translation: Vayu said, "Fire is the elder; everything is established in fire." Saying "No" to one another, the sages then went to the Earth:

verses.transliteration: satyaṃ bhūme vada jyaiṣṭhyam ādhārāsi carācare
verses.translation: "O Earth, tell truly which is the elder; you are the support of all that moves and does not move."

verses.transliteration: bhūmir apy āha vinayād āgatāṃs tān ṛṣīn idam
verses.translation: The Earth too humbly said this to the sages who had come:

verses.transliteration: mamāpy ādhārabhūtāḥ syur āpo devyaḥ sanātanāḥ adbhyas tu jāyate sarvaṃ jyaiṣṭhyam apsu pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: "The eternal divine Waters are my own support; from the waters everything is born, and seniority rests in the waters."

verses.transliteration: nety uktvānyonyam ṛṣayo jagmuḥ kṣīrodaśāyinam tuṣṭuvur vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: Saying "No" to one another, the sages went to him who lies on the ocean of milk and praised the bearer of conch, discus and mace with various hymns:

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद सर्वं भुवनं भविष्यद् यज् जायमानं च गुहानिविष्टम् लोकत्रयं चित्रविचित्ररूपम् अन्ते समस्तं च यम् आविवेश
verses.transliteration: yo veda sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyad yaj jāyamānaṃ ca guhāniviṣṭam lokatrayaṃ citravicitrarūpam ante samastaṃ ca yam āviveśa
verses.translation: "He who knows the whole world, what will be and what is being born, hidden in the cave of the heart; the three worlds of wondrous varied form, all of which enter into him at the end;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: yad akṣaraṃ śāśvatam aprameyaṃ yaṃ vedavedyam ṛṣayo vadanti yam āśritāḥ svepsitam āpnuvanti tad vastu satyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ
verses.translation: that which is imperishable, eternal and immeasurable, which the sages call knowable through the Vedas, resorting to which men gain what they desire — to that Reality, the Truth, we go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भूतं महाभूतजगत्प्रधानं न विन्दते योगिनो विष्णुरूपम् तद् वक्तुम् एते ऋषयो ऽत्र याताः सत्यं वदस्वेह जगन्निवास
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ mahābhūtajagatpradhānaṃ na vindate yogino viṣṇurūpam tad vaktum ete ṛṣayo 'tra yātāḥ satyaṃ vadasveha jagannivāsa
verses.translation: The yogis cannot find Vishnu's form, which is the elements, the great elements and the chief principle of the world. These sages have come here to ask; speak the truth here, O abode of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: त्वम् अन्तरात्माखिलदेहभाजां त्वम् एव सर्वं त्वयि सर्वम् ईश तथापि जानन्ति न केअपि कुत्रापि अहो भवन्तं प्रकृतिप्रभावात्
verses.transliteration: tvam antarātmākhiladehabhājāṃ tvam eva sarvaṃ tvayi sarvam īśa tathāpi jānanti na keapi kutrāpi aho bhavantaṃ prakṛtiprabhāvāt
verses.translation: You are the inner Self of all embodied beings; you alone are everything, and everything is in you, O Lord. Yet, alas, no one anywhere knows you, because of the power of Prakriti."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्राह जगद्धात्री दैवी वाग् अशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prāha jagaddhātrī daivī vāg aśarīriṇī
verses.translation: Then a bodiless divine voice, the Upholder of the world, said:

verses.sanskrit: उभाव् आराध्य तपसा भक्त्या च नियमेन च यस्य स्यात् प्रथमं सिद्धिस् तद् भूतं ज्येष्ठम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ubhāv ārādhya tapasā bhaktyā ca niyamena ca yasya syāt prathamaṃ siddhis tad bhūtaṃ jyeṣṭham ucyate
verses.translation: "Worship both with austerity, devotion and discipline; whichever grants perfection first, that element is called the elder."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् तथा ययुः सर्वे ऋषयो लोकपूजिताः श्रान्ताः खिन्नान्तरात्मानः परं वैराग्यम् आश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: tathety tathā yayuḥ sarve ṛṣayo lokapūjitāḥ śrāntāḥ khinnāntarātmānaḥ paraṃ vairāgyam āśritāḥ
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," all the sages revered by the world went away, weary and dejected at heart, resorting to supreme detachment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकैकजननीं भुवनत्रयपावनीम् गौतमीम् अगमन् सर्वे तपस् तप्तुं यतव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sarvalokaikajananīṃ bhuvanatrayapāvanīm gautamīm agaman sarve tapas taptuṃ yatavratāḥ
verses.translation: All of them, keeping their vows, went to the Gautami, sole mother of all worlds and purifier of the three worlds, to perform austerities.

verses.sanskrit: अब्दैवतं तथाग्निं च पूजनायोद्यतास् तदा अग्नेश् च पूजका ये च अपां वै पूजने स्थिताः तत्र वाग् अब्रवीद् दैवी वेदमाता सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: abdaivataṃ tathāgniṃ ca pūjanāyodyatās tadā agneś ca pūjakā ye ca apāṃ vai pūjane sthitāḥ tatra vāg abravīd daivī vedamātā sarasvatī
verses.translation: They then set about worshipping the deity of the waters and Fire. To those who worshipped Fire and those who worshipped the Waters, the divine voice spoke there — Sarasvati, mother of the Vedas:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर् आपस् तथा योनिर् अद्भिः शौचम् अवाप्यते अग्नेश् च पूजका ये च विनाद्भिः पूजनं कथम्
verses.transliteration: agner āpas tathā yonir adbhiḥ śaucam avāpyate agneś ca pūjakā ye ca vinādbhiḥ pūjanaṃ katham
verses.translation: "The Waters are the source of Fire, and purity is gained through water. How can those who worship Fire worship without water?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु जातासु सर्वत्र कर्मण्य् अधिकृतो भवेत् तावत् कर्मण्य् अनर्हो ऽयम् अशुचिर् मलिनो नरः
verses.transliteration: apsu jātāsu sarvatra karmaṇy adhikṛto bhavet tāvat karmaṇy anarho 'yam aśucir malino naraḥ
verses.translation: Through the waters one becomes entitled to rites everywhere; until then a man is unfit for rites, impure and soiled,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न मग्नः श्रद्धया यावद् अप्सु शीतासु वेदवित् तस्माद् आपो वरिष्ठाः स्युर् मातृभूता यतः स्मृताः तस्माज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अपाम् एव जनन्यो ऽग्नेर् विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: na magnaḥ śraddhayā yāvad apsu śītāsu vedavit tasmād āpo variṣṭhāḥ syur mātṛbhūtā yataḥ smṛtāḥ tasmāj jyaiṣṭhyam apām eva jananyo 'gner viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: so long as that knower of the Veda has not plunged with faith into the cool waters. Therefore the Waters are the foremost, since they are remembered as mothers; seniority belongs to the Waters, who are above all the mothers of Fire."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वचः शुश्रुवुस् ते ऋषयो वेदवादिनः निश्चयं च ततश् चक्रुर् भवेज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अपाम् इति
verses.transliteration: etad vacaḥ śuśruvus te ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ niścayaṃ ca tataś cakrur bhavej jyaiṣṭhyam apām iti
verses.translation: The sages who expound the Veda heard these words and then concluded that seniority belongs to the Waters.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: yatra tīrthe vṛttam idam ṛṣisattre ca nārada tapastīrthaṃ tu tat proktaṃ sattratīrthaṃ tad ucyate
verses.translation: The tirtha where this took place at the sages' sacrificial session, O Narada, is called Tapastirtha and also Sattratirtha.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नितीर्थं च तत् प्रोक्तं तथा सारस्वतं विदुः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: agnitīrthaṃ ca tat proktaṃ tathā sārasvataṃ viduḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: It is also called Agnitirtha, and known as Sarasvata; bathing and giving at them is auspicious and grants all desires.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश शतान्य् अत्र तीर्थानां पुण्यदायिनाम् तेषु स्नानं च दानं च स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa śatāny atra tīrthānāṃ puṇyadāyinām teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca svargamokṣapradāyakam
verses.translation: There are fourteen hundred merit-giving tirthas here; bathing and giving at them grants heaven and liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृतं संदेहहरणम् ऋषीणां यत्र भाषया सरस्वत्य् अभवत् तत्र गङ्गया संगता नदी माहात्म्यं तस्य को वक्तुं संगमस्य क्षमो नरः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ saṃdehaharaṇam ṛṣīṇāṃ yatra bhāṣayā sarasvaty abhavat tatra gaṅgayā saṃgatā nadī māhātmyaṃ tasya ko vaktuṃ saṃgamasya kṣamo naraḥ
verses.translation: Where the sages' doubt was removed by her speech, Sarasvati became a river there, joined with the Ganga. What man could describe the greatness of that confluence?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं गङ्गाया उत्तरे तटे तस्य प्रभावं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: devatīrtham iti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, when the water encroaches upon the abode of seven sages (Great Bear) the entire area of the three worlds becomes a vast sheet of water.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, when the water encroaches upon the abode of seven sages (Great Bear) the entire area of the three worlds becomes a vast sheet of water.

verses.sanskrit: आर्ष्टिषेण इति ख्यातो राजा सर्वगुणान्वितः तस्य भार्या जया नाम साक्षाल् लक्ष्मीर् इवापरा
verses.transliteration: ārṣṭiṣeṇa iti khyāto rājā sarvaguṇānvitaḥ tasya bhāryā jayā nāma sākṣāl lakṣmīr ivāparā
verses.translation: Then, O brahmins, the wind arising out of the expiration of Visnu destroys those clouds in the course of hundred years and more.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, O brahmins, the wind arising out of the expiration of Visnu destroys those clouds in the course of hundred years and more.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो भरो नाम मतिमान् पितृवत्सलः धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च निष्णातो दक्ष एव च
verses.transliteration: tasya putro bharo nāma matimān pitṛvatsalaḥ dhanurvede ca vede ca niṣṇāto dakṣa eva ca
verses.translation: He then employs the divine Yoganidra (yogic slumber) consisting of Maya of the Atman (soul). He is the Supreme lord pondering over himself with the appellation of Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He then employs the divine Yoganidra (yogic slumber) consisting of Maya of the Atman (soul). He is the Supreme lord pondering over himself with the appellation of Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या रूपवती सुप्रभेत्य् अभिविश्रुता आर्ष्टिषेणस् ततो राजा पुत्रे राज्यं निवेश्य सः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā rūpavatī suprabhety abhiviśrutā ārṣṭiṣeṇas tato rājā putre rājyaṃ niveśya saḥ
verses.translation: A thousand sets of four Yugas constitute a day of the lotus-born Brahma. When the whole universe becomes a vast sheet of water, a period of as much duration is said to be his night.
verses.commentary: Sense: A thousand sets of four Yugas constitute a day of the lotus-born Brahma. When the whole universe becomes a vast sheet of water, a period of as much duration is said to be his night.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोधसा च मुख्येन दीक्षां चक्रे नरेश्वरः सरस्वत्यास् ततस् तीरे हयमेधाय यत्नवान्
verses.transliteration: purodhasā ca mukhyena dīkṣāṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ sarasvatyās tatas tīre hayamedhāya yatnavān
verses.translation: Waking up at the close of the night, Brahma continues the work of creation. As mentioned to you before, it is Visnu who assumes this form of'Brahma and continues the work of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waking up at the close of the night, Brahma continues the work of creation. As mentioned to you before, it is Visnu who assumes this form of'Brahma and continues the work of creation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विग्भिर् ऋषिमुख्यैश् च वेदशास्त्रपरायणैः दीक्षितं तं नृपश्रेष्ठं ब्राह्मणाग्निसमीपतः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvigbhir ṛṣimukhyaiś ca vedaśāstraparāyaṇaiḥ dīkṣitaṃ taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇāgnisamīpataḥ
verses.translation: The (special) quality of the waters (i.e. taste) is drunk (consumed and destroyed) by the Fire element. When the Rasatanmatra (the subtle primary element of taste) is destroyed, the heated waters perish.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (special) quality of the waters (i.e. taste) is drunk (consumed and destroyed) by the Fire element. When the Rasatanmatra (the subtle primary element of taste) is destroyed, the heated waters perish.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मिथुर् दानवराट् शूरः पापबुद्धिः प्रतापवान् मखं विध्वस्य नृपतिं सभार्यं सपुरोहितम्
verses.transliteration: mithur dānavarāṭ śūraḥ pāpabuddhiḥ pratāpavān makhaṃ vidhvasya nṛpatiṃ sabhāryaṃ sapurohitam
verses.translation: It spreads everywhere, at the sides, above and below along with its rays. The fire-element has its great quality, rupa (colour), that causes lustre, that is destroyed by Vayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: It spreads everywhere, at the sides, above and below along with its rays. The fire-element has its great quality, rupa (colour), that causes lustre, that is destroyed by Vayu.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आदाय वेगात् स प्रागाद् रसातलतलं मुने नीते तस्मिन् नृपवरे यज्ञे नष्टे ततो ऽमराः
verses.transliteration: ādāya vegāt sa prāgād rasātalatalaṃ mune nīte tasmin nṛpavare yajñe naṣṭe tato 'marāḥ
verses.translation: (The cosmic egg) consisting of seven worlds along with the mountains, the seven continents and oceans is enveloped by water and it is drunk (i.e. destroyed) by the fiery element.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विजश् च ययुः सर्वे स्वं स्वं स्थानं मखात् ततः पुरोहितसुतो राज्ञो देवापिर् इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: ṛtvijaś ca yayuḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ makhāt tataḥ purohitasuto rājño devāpir iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Then all the priests went from the sacrifice to their own places. The son of the king's priest was known as Devapi.

verses.transliteration: siddhiṃ kuru sukhaṃ yāhi mā cintām alpikāṃ bhaja
verses.translation: "Accomplish your aim and go happily; do not entertain the least worry."

verses.translation: Then Devapi, intent on meditating on the feet of the king of the immortals, diligently sought out the priests and bowed to each of them; and the boy Devapi, with joined palms, said:

verses.sanskrit: भवद्भिश् च मखो रक्ष्यो यजमानश् च दीक्षितः पुरोधाश् च तथा रक्ष्यः पत्नी या दीक्षितस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiś ca makho rakṣyo yajamānaś ca dīkṣitaḥ purodhāś ca tathā rakṣyaḥ patnī yā dīkṣitasya tu
verses.translation: "You were to protect the sacrifice and the consecrated sacrificer, and the priest likewise, and the consecrated one's wife.

verses.transliteration: bhavatsu tatra paśyatsu yajñaṃ vidhvasya daityarāṭ rājādayas tena nītās tan na yuktatamaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: While you looked on, the demon king destroyed the sacrifice and carried off the king and the others; that was not at all proper.

verses.transliteration: athāpy etad ahaṃ manye bhavantas tān arogiṇaḥ dātum arhanti tān sarvān anyathā śāpam arhatha
verses.translation: Still, I think you ought to give them all back unharmed; otherwise you deserve a curse."

verses.sanskrit: मखे ऽग्निः प्रथमं पूज्यो ह्य् अग्निर् एवात्र दैवतम् तस्माद् वयं न जानीमो ह्य् अग्नीनां परिचारकाः
verses.transliteration: makhe 'gniḥ prathamaṃ pūjyo hy agnir evātra daivatam tasmād vayaṃ na jānīmo hy agnīnāṃ paricārakāḥ
verses.translation: "In a sacrifice Fire is worshipped first; Fire alone is the deity here. So we do not know; we are only servants of the fires.

verses.transliteration: sa eva dātā bhoktā ca hartā kartā ca havyavāṭ
verses.translation: He, the bearer of oblations, is the giver and the enjoyer, the taker and the doer."

verses.translation: Leaving the priests behind, Devapi duly worshipped Jatavedas and laid the matter before Fire.

verses.transliteration: yathartvijas tathā cāhaṃ devānāṃ paricārakaḥ havyaṃ vahāmi devānāṃ bhoktāro rakṣakāś ca te
verses.translation: "As the priests are, so am I — a servant of the gods. I carry the offerings to the gods; they are the enjoyers and the protectors.

verses.transliteration: devān āhūya yatnena havirbhāgān pṛthak pṛthak dāsye 'ham eṣa doṣo me tasmād yāhi surān prati
verses.translation: Summoning the gods carefully, I give each his share of the oblation; this is no fault of mine. So go to the gods."

verses.sanskrit: देवापिः स सुरान् प्राप्य नत्वा तेभ्यः पृथक् पृथक् ऋत्विग्वाक्यं चाग्निवाक्यं शापं चापि न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: devāpiḥ sa surān prāpya natvā tebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ṛtvigvākyaṃ cāgnivākyaṃ śāpaṃ cāpi nyavedayat
verses.translation: Devapi went to the gods, bowed to each of them, and reported the priests' words, Fire's words, and his threat of a curse.

verses.sanskrit: आहूता वैदिकैर् मन्त्रैर् ऋत्विग्भिश् च यथाक्रमम् भोक्ष्यामहे हविर्भागान् न स्वतन्त्रा द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: āhūtā vaidikair mantrair ṛtvigbhiś ca yathākramam bhokṣyāmahe havirbhāgān na svatantrā dvijottama
verses.translation: "Summoned by Vedic mantras and by the priests in due order, we enjoy our shares of the oblation; we are not independent, O best of brahmins.

verses.translation: Bowing to the Vedas again and again, Devapi told them the words of the priests, of Fire, and of the gods.

verses.translation: We also know your capacity, and whom you must worship and where, so that you will have them before you again."

verses.transliteration: pitā tavāpy upamanyus tale tiṣṭhanty arogiṇaḥ varadānān maheśasya mithuṃ hatvā ca rākṣasam yaśaḥ prāpsyasi dharmaṃ ca etac chakyaṃ na cetarat
verses.translation: and your father Upamanyu, remain unharmed in the netherworld. By Mahesha's boon you will slay the demon Mithu and gain fame and merit; this can be done, and nothing else."

verses.translation: At the Vedas' word the boy Devapi went to the Gautami; having bathed and completed his rites, the brahmin praised Maheshvara:

verses.sanskrit: बालो ऽहं देवदेवेश गुरूणां त्वं गुरुर् मम न मे शक्तिस् त्वत्स्तवने तुभ्यं शंभो नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: bālo 'haṃ devadeveśa gurūṇāṃ tvaṃ gurur mama na me śaktis tvatstavane tubhyaṃ śaṃbho namo 'stu te
verses.translation: "I am a child, O Lord of lords, and you are my teacher of teachers. I have no power to praise you; O Shambhu, salutations to you.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वां जानन्ति निगमा न देवा मुनयो न च न ब्रह्मा नापि वैकुण्ठो यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: na tvāṃ jānanti nigamā na devā munayo na ca na brahmā nāpi vaikuṇṭho yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te
verses.translation: The scriptures do not know you, nor the gods, nor the sages, nor Brahma, nor even Vishnu; whatever you are, that you are — salutations to you.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽनाथा ये च कृपणा ये दरिद्राश् च रोगिणः पापात्मानो ये च लोके तांस् त्वं पासि महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: ye 'nāthā ye ca kṛpaṇā ye daridrāś ca rogiṇaḥ pāpātmāno ye ca loke tāṃs tvaṃ pāsi maheśvara
verses.translation: Those who are helpless, wretched, poor and sick, and those in the world who are sinful — you protect them, O Maheshvara.

verses.transliteration: tapasā niyamair mantraiḥ pūjitās tridivaukasaḥ tvayā dattaṃ phalaṃ tebhyo dāsyanti jagatāṃ pate
verses.translation: The heaven-dwellers, worshipped with austerity, disciplines and mantras, give their worshippers the fruit that you have given them, O Lord of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: yācitāraś ca dātāras tebhyo yad yan manīṣitam bhavatīti na citraṃ syāt tvaṃ viparyayakārakaḥ
verses.translation: That seekers and givers obtain whatever they desire is no wonder; you are the one who reverses fortunes.

verses.transliteration: ye 'jñānino ye ca pāpā ye magnā narakārṇave śiveti vacanān nātha tān pāsi tvaṃ jagadguro
verses.translation: Those who are ignorant, who are sinful, who are sunk in the ocean of hell — at the word 'Shiva' you protect them, O Lord, teacher of the world."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ tu stuvatas tasya puraḥ prāha trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: As he praised thus, the three-eyed god appeared before him and said:

verses.transliteration: varaṃ brūhy atha devāpe alaṃ dainyena bālaka
verses.translation: "Name a boon, Devapi; enough of this dejection, child."

verses.transliteration: rājānaṃ rājapatnīṃ ca pitaraṃ ca guruṃ mama prāptum icche jagannātha nidhanaṃ ca ripor mama
verses.translation: "I wish to recover the king, the queen, and my father and teacher, O Lord of the world, and the death of my enemy."

verses.translation: Hearing Devapi's words, the Lord of all said, "So be it," and by Shankara's command everything came to pass for Devapi.

verses.transliteration: punar apy āha taṃ śaṃbhur devāpikaruṇākaraḥ nandinaṃ preṣayām āsa śaṃbhuḥ śūlena nārada
verses.translation: Then Shambhu, compassionate to Devapi, spoke again and sent Nandi with his trident, O Narada.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: rasātalaṃ mithuṃ nandī hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān tatpitrādīn samānīya tasmai tān sa nyavedayat
verses.translation: Nandi went to Rasatala, slew Mithu and the chief demons, brought back his father and the others, and handed them over to him.

verses.transliteration: hayamedhaś ca tatrāsīd ārṣṭiṣeṇasya dhīmataḥ agniś ca ṛtvijo devā vedāś ca ṛṣayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: Then the wise Arshtishena's horse-sacrifice took place there. Fire, the priests, the gods, the Vedas and the sages said:

verses.sanskrit: यत्र साक्षाद् अभूच् छंभुर् देवापे भक्तवत्सलः देवदेवो जगन्नाथो देवतीर्थम् अभूच् च तत्
verses.transliteration: yatra sākṣād abhūc chaṃbhur devāpe bhaktavatsalaḥ devadevo jagannātho devatīrtham abhūc ca tat
verses.translation: "Where Shambhu, God of gods and Lord of the world, fond of his devotees, appeared in person to Devapi, that became Devatirtha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापक्षयकरं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम् पुण्यदं तीर्थम् एतत् स्यात् तव कीर्तिश् च शाश्वती
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām puṇyadaṃ tīrtham etat syāt tava kīrtiś ca śāśvatī
verses.translation: This tirtha will destroy all sins, grant men every success and bestow merit; and your fame will be everlasting."

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधे निवृत्ते तु सुरास् तेभ्यो वरान् ददुः स्नात्वा कृतार्था गङ्गायां ततस् ते दिवम् आक्रमन्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhe nivṛtte tu surās tebhyo varān daduḥ snātvā kṛtārthā gaṅgāyāṃ tatas te divam ākraman
verses.translation: When the horse-sacrifice was complete, the gods gave them boons; having bathed in the Ganga, their aims fulfilled, they ascended to heaven.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत्रासंस् तीर्थानि दश पञ्च च सहस्राणि शतान्य् अष्टाव् उभयोर् अपि तीरयोः तेषु स्नानं च दानं च ह्य् अतीव फलदं विदुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tatrāsaṃs tīrthāni daśa pañca ca sahasrāṇi śatāny aṣṭāv ubhayor api tīrayoḥ teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca hy atīva phaladaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: From then on there have been fifteen thousand eight hundred tirthas there on both banks; bathing and giving at them is known to be most fruitful.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तपोवनम् इति ख्यातं नन्दिनीसंगमं तथा सिद्धेश्वरं तत्र तीर्थं गौतम्या दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: tapovanam iti khyātaṃ nandinīsaṃgamaṃ tathā siddheśvaraṃ tatra tīrthaṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: After understanding the three types of suffering, O brahmins, beginning with the Adhyatmika (i.e. the organic), a learned man realises perfect knowledge and has Vairagya (detachment). He then attains the ultimate re-absorption.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलं चेति विख्यातं तेषां वृत्तम् इदं शृणु यस्याकर्णनमात्रेण सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śārdūlaṃ ceti vikhyātaṃ teṣāṃ vṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu yasyākarṇanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) suffering occurs to men from animals, birds, men, evil spirits, serpents, ogres, reptiles and other beings..
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) suffering occurs to men from animals, birds, men, evil spirits, serpents, ogres, reptiles and other beings..

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर् होता पुरा त्व् आसीद् देवानां हव्यवाहनः भार्यां प्राप्तो दक्षसुतां स्वाहानाम्नीं सुरूपिणीम्
verses.transliteration: agnir hotā purā tv āsīd devānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ bhāryāṃ prāpto dakṣasutāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ surūpiṇīm
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the suffering arising from cold¬ ness, heat, winds, rains, water, lightning etc. is called Adhi- daivika.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the suffering arising from cold¬ ness, heat, winds, rains, water, lightning etc. is called Adhi- daivika.

verses.sanskrit: सानपत्या पुरा चासीत् पुत्रार्थं तप आविशत् तपश् चरन्तीं विपुलं तोषयन्तीं हुताशनम् स भर्ता हुतभुक् प्राह भार्यां स्वाहाम् अनिन्दिताम्
verses.transliteration: sānapatyā purā cāsīt putrārthaṃ tapa āviśat tapaś carantīṃ vipulaṃ toṣayantīṃ hutāśanam sa bhartā hutabhuk prāha bhāryāṃ svāhām aninditām
verses.translation: On being touched by the external wind he attains an extremely senseless state. On being born, O excellent sages, he attains the loss of special knowledge (of the previous births).
verses.commentary: Sense: On being touched by the external wind he attains an extremely senseless state. On being born, O excellent sages, he attains the loss of special knowledge (of the previous births).

verses.sanskrit: अपत्यानि भविष्यन्ति मा तपः कुरु शोभने
verses.transliteration: apatyāni bhaviṣyanti mā tapaḥ kuru śobhane
verses.translation: His limbs are afflicted as it were by thorns. I~Ie is pierced and split as it were by saws. He is just like a worm that has fallen on the ground from a pus-discharging foul ulcer.
verses.commentary: Sense: His limbs are afflicted as it were by thorns. I~Ie is pierced and split as it were by saws. He is just like a worm that has fallen on the ground from a pus-discharging foul ulcer.

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा भर्तृवाक्यं निवृत्ता तपसो ऽभवत् स्त्रीणाम् अभीष्टदं नान्यद् भर्तृवाक्यं विना क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā bhartṛvākyaṃ nivṛttā tapaso 'bhavat strīṇām abhīṣṭadaṃ nānyad bhartṛvākyaṃ vinā kvacit
verses.translation: (Thus) the miseries at the time of birth are many. Similarly those Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) mise¬ ries too that he undergoes after his birth in the course of his childhood, are many.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Thus) the miseries at the time of birth are many. Similarly those Adhibhautika (extraneous and material) mise¬ ries too that he undergoes after his birth in the course of his childhood, are many.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कतिपये काले तारकाद् भय आगते अनुत्पन्ने कार्त्तिकेये चिरकालरहोगते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ katipaye kāle tārakād bhaya āgate anutpanne kārttikeye cirakālarahogate
verses.translation: "What is good?" "What is evil?" "In what does it consist and how?" "What is our duty?" "What is it that we should refrain from?" "What is it that is meritorious?" "What is it that is faulty?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is good?" "What is evil?" "In what does it consist and how?" "What is our duty?" "What is it that we should refrain from?" "What is it that is meritorious?" "What is it that is faulty?"

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरे भवान्या च त्रस्ता देवाः समागताः देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् अग्निं प्रोचुर् दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: maheśvare bhavānyā ca trastā devāḥ samāgatāḥ devānāṃ kāryasiddhyartham agniṃ procur divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus foolish men who like animals are given to sex and eating suffer great pain resulting from ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus foolish men who like animals are given to sex and eating suffer great pain resulting from ignorance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देव गच्छ महाभाग शंभुं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् तारकाद् भयम् उत्पन्नं शंभवे त्वं निवेदय
verses.transliteration: deva gaccha mahābhāga śaṃbhuṃ trailokyapūjitam tārakād bhayam utpannaṃ śaṃbhave tvaṃ nivedaya
verses.translation: Sages say that the result of omission of duty is (fall¬ ing into) hell. Hence ignorant people experience excessive misery both here and hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages say that the result of omission of duty is (fall¬ ing into) hell. Hence ignorant people experience excessive misery both here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न गन्तव्यं तत्र देशे दंपत्योः स्थितयो रहः सामान्यमात्रतो न्यायः किं पुनः शूलपाणिनि
verses.transliteration: na gantavyaṃ tatra deśe daṃpatyoḥ sthitayo rahaḥ sāmānyamātrato nyāyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śūlapāṇini
verses.translation: Then, during old age man undergoes many miseries as follows: His body is shattered by old age. His limbs are en¬ feebled and flaccid. His teeth are broken and loose. He is covered by wrinkles and protruding sinews and neves and veins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, during old age man undergoes many miseries as follows: His body is shattered by old age. His limbs are en¬ feebled and flaccid. His teeth are broken and loose. He is covered by wrinkles and protruding sinews and neves and veins.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तस्थितयोः स्वैरं जल्पतोर् यः सरागयोः दंपत्योः शृणुयाद् वाक्यं निरयात् तस्य नोद्धृतिः
verses.transliteration: ekāntasthitayoḥ svairaṃ jalpator yaḥ sarāgayoḥ daṃpatyoḥ śṛṇuyād vākyaṃ nirayāt tasya noddhṛtiḥ
verses.translation: His eyes are incapable of seeing far off. His pupils are fixed to the sky. Clusters of hair come out of his nostrils. The whole of his body shakes and shivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: His eyes are incapable of seeing far off. His pupils are fixed to the sky. Clusters of hair come out of his nostrils. The whole of his body shakes and shivers.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स स्वाम्य् अखिललोकानां महाकालस् त्रिशूलवान् निरीक्षणीयः केन स्याद् भवान्या रहसि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa svāmy akhilalokānāṃ mahākālas triśūlavān nirīkṣaṇīyaḥ kena syād bhavānyā rahasi sthitaḥ
verses.translation: His bones are laid bare. The bones at his back are bent. Since his gastric fire does not function, he takes but little food. He is capable of only a few movements.
verses.commentary: Sense: His bones are laid bare. The bones at his back are bent. Since his gastric fire does not function, he takes but little food. He is capable of only a few movements.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाभये चानुगते न्यायः को ऽन्व् अत्र वर्ण्यते तारकाद् भय उत्पन्ने गच्छ त्वं तारको भवान्
verses.transliteration: mahābhaye cānugate nyāyaḥ ko 'nv atra varṇyate tārakād bhaya utpanne gaccha tvaṃ tārako bhavān
verses.translation: He experiences difficulties in rising up, in moving about, in lying down, in sitting and in his movements. His eyes and ears become less keen. Saliva exudes from his mouth and defiles his face.
verses.commentary: Sense: He experiences difficulties in rising up, in moving about, in lying down, in sitting and in his movements. His eyes and ears become less keen. Saliva exudes from his mouth and defiles his face.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाभयाब्धौ साधूनां यत् परार्थाय जीवितम् रूपेणान्येन वा गच्छ वाचं वद यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: mahābhayābdhau sādhūnāṃ yat parārthāya jīvitam rūpeṇānyena vā gaccha vācaṃ vada yathā tathā
verses.translation: With his sense organs intractable he looks up to his early death. He is not capable of remembering anything experienced at the very same moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his sense organs intractable he looks up to his early death. He is not capable of remembering anything experienced at the very same moment.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विश्राव्य देववचनं शंभुम् आगच्छ सत्वरः ततो दास्यामहे पूजाम् उभयोर् लोकयोः कवे
verses.transliteration: viśrāvya devavacanaṃ śaṃbhum āgaccha satvaraḥ tato dāsyāmahe pūjām ubhayor lokayoḥ kave
verses.translation: In uttering a sentence even once he has to put in great effort. He spends sleepless nights due to the strain of ail¬ ments such as asthma, bronchitis (cough) etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: In uttering a sentence even once he has to put in great effort. He spends sleepless nights due to the strain of ail¬ ments such as asthma, bronchitis (cough) etc.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शुको भूत्वा जगामाशु देववाक्याद् धुताशनः यत्रासीज् जगतां नाथो रममाणस् तदोमया
verses.transliteration: śuko bhūtvā jagāmāśu devavākyād dhutāśanaḥ yatrāsīj jagatāṃ nātho ramamāṇas tadomayā
verses.translation: The old man has to be lifted up or laid to rest with the help of another man. He is disdained and insulted by his ser¬ vants, sons and wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: The old man has to be lifted up or laid to rest with the help of another man. He is disdained and insulted by his ser¬ vants, sons and wife.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: स भीतवद् अथ प्रायाच् छुको भूत्वा तदानलः नाशकद् द्वारदेशे तु प्रवेष्टुं हव्यवाहनः
verses.transliteration: sa bhītavad atha prāyāc chuko bhūtvā tadānalaḥ nāśakad dvāradeśe tu praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: Remembering the activities of his own youth as though they were experienced in another birth he is all the more dis¬ tressed. He then heaves deep sighs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering the activities of his own youth as though they were experienced in another birth he is all the more dis¬ tressed. He then heaves deep sighs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो गवाक्षदेशे तु तस्थौ धुन्वन्न् अधोमुखः तं दृष्ट्वा प्रहसञ् शंभुर् उमां प्राह रहोगतः
verses.transliteration: tato gavākṣadeśe tu tasthau dhunvann adhomukhaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā prahasañ śaṃbhur umāṃ prāha rahogataḥ
verses.translation: These and similar ones are the miseries he experiences in the old age. Now listen to those miseries which he experiences at the time of death.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and similar ones are the miseries he experiences in the old age. Now listen to those miseries which he experiences at the time of death.
