verses.sanskrit: पश्य देवि शुकं प्राप्तं देववाक्याद् धुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: paśya devi śukaṃ prāptaṃ devavākyād dhutāśanam
verses.translation: His bones and joints are torn and shorn as it were by great and terrible ailments like the saws that appear to be the arrows of the god of death. They pierce the vulnerable spots of his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: His bones and joints are torn and shorn as it were by great and terrible ailments like the saws that appear to be the arrows of the god of death. They pierce the vulnerable spots of his body.

verses.sanskrit: लज्जिता चावदद् देवम् अलं देवेति पार्वती पुरश्चरन्तं देवेशो ह्य् अग्निं तं द्विजरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: lajjitā cāvadad devam alaṃ deveti pārvatī puraścarantaṃ deveśo hy agniṃ taṃ dvijarūpiṇam
verses.translation: The puplis of his eyes roll. He begins to beat and kick with his hands and feet. His palate, lips and throat become parched and he begins to snort and grumble.
verses.commentary: Sense: The puplis of his eyes roll. He begins to beat and kick with his hands and feet. His palate, lips and throat become parched and he begins to snort and grumble.

verses.sanskrit: आहूय बहुशश् चापि ज्ञातो ऽस्य् अग्ने ऽत्र मा वद विदारयस्व स्वमुखं गृहाणेदं नयस्व तत्
verses.transliteration: āhūya bahuśaś cāpi jñāto 'sy agne 'tra mā vada vidārayasva svamukhaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ nayasva tat
verses.translation: The organic Udana wind afflicts him by choking his throat. An excessive heat spreads over him. He becomes dis¬ tressed due to thirst and hunger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The organic Udana wind afflicts him by choking his throat. An excessive heat spreads over him. He becomes dis¬ tressed due to thirst and hunger.

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् उक्त्वा तस्य चास्ये ऽग्ने रेतः स प्राक्षिपद् बहु रेतोगर्भस् तदा चाग्निर् गन्तुं नैव च शक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: ity uktvā tasya cāsye 'gne retaḥ sa prākṣipad bahu retogarbhas tadā cāgnir gantuṃ naiva ca śaktavān
verses.translation: These and other similar ones are the miseries of men at the time of death. Now listen to those miseries which are experienced in hell by the persons who die.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and other similar ones are the miseries of men at the time of death. Now listen to those miseries which are experienced in hell by the persons who die.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: सुरनद्यास् ततस् तीरं श्रान्तो ऽग्निर् उपतस्थिवान् कृत्तिकासु च तद् रेतः प्रक्षेपात् कार्त्तिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: suranadyās tatas tīraṃ śrānto 'gnir upatasthivān kṛttikāsu ca tad retaḥ prakṣepāt kārttiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: The dead undergoes tortures in various ways. The servants of Yama catch him by means of noose etc. They strike him with sticks. The very sight of Yama is terrible. It is terrible to behold even the path (leading to Yama's place).
verses.commentary: Sense: The dead undergoes tortures in various ways. The servants of Yama catch him by means of noose etc. They strike him with sticks. The very sight of Yama is terrible. It is terrible to behold even the path (leading to Yama's place).

verses.sanskrit: अवशिष्टं च यत् किंचिद् अग्नेर् देहे च शांभवम् तद् एव रेतो वह्निस् तु स्वभार्यायां द्विधाक्षिपत्
verses.transliteration: avaśiṣṭaṃ ca yat kiṃcid agner dehe ca śāṃbhavam tad eva reto vahnis tu svabhāryāyāṃ dvidhākṣipat
verses.translation: O exellecnt brahmins, the tortures in different hells are different. They are terrible and the means employed are mud, sand, fire, mechanical devices, weapons etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: O exellecnt brahmins, the tortures in different hells are different. They are terrible and the means employed are mud, sand, fire, mechanical devices, weapons etc.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहायां प्रियभूतायां पुत्रार्थिन्यां विशेषतः पुरा साश्वासिता तेन संततिस् ते भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: svāhāyāṃ priyabhūtāyāṃ putrārthinyāṃ viśeṣataḥ purā sāśvāsitā tena saṃtatis te bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Again he becomes a foetus in the womb. The man is born again. Again he gets merged into the womb on being born. He then perishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again he becomes a foetus in the womb. The man is born again. Again he gets merged into the womb on being born. He then perishes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तद् वह्निनाथ संस्मृत्य तत् क्षिप्तं शांभवं महः तद् अग्ने रेतसस् तस्यां जज्ञे मिथुनम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tad vahninātha saṃsmṛtya tat kṣiptaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ mahaḥ tad agne retasas tasyāṃ jajñe mithunam uttamam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the means of attaining the same is said to be knowledge as well as holy rites. Knowledge is mentioned as twofold: 1) arising from scriptural texts and 2) arising from discrimination.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the means of attaining the same is said to be knowledge as well as holy rites. Knowledge is mentioned as twofold: 1) arising from scriptural texts and 2) arising from discrimination.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णश् च सुवर्णा च रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि अग्नेः प्रीतिकरं नित्यं लोकानां प्रीतिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇaś ca suvarṇā ca rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi agneḥ prītikaraṃ nityaṃ lokānāṃ prītivardhanam
verses.translation: HeisSaguna (having attributes) and transcends all beings, Prakrti, Gunas and Dosas (merits and demerits). Since the entire inside of the universe is enveloped by him, he is Akhilatman (soul of all). He transcends all other coverings.
verses.commentary: Sense: HeisSaguna (having attributes) and transcends all beings, Prakrti, Gunas and Dosas (merits and demerits). Since the entire inside of the universe is enveloped by him, he is Akhilatman (soul of all). He transcends all other coverings.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रीत्या सुवर्णां तां प्रादाद् धर्माय धीमते सुवर्णस्याथ पुत्रस्य संकल्पाम् अकरोत् प्रियाम् एवं पुत्रस्य पुत्र्याश् च विवाहम् अकरोत् कविः
verses.transliteration: agniḥ prītyā suvarṇāṃ tāṃ prādād dharmāya dhīmate suvarṇasyātha putrasya saṃkalpām akarot priyām evaṃ putrasya putryāś ca vivāham akarot kaviḥ
verses.translation: That whereby this pure, supreme single form (that is free from impurity and devoid of all defects) is comprehended, perceived or attained is Jhana (knowledge). That which is other than this is Ajnana (ignorance).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यरेतोव्यतिषङ्गदोषाद् अग्नेर् अपत्यम् उभयं तथैव पुत्रः सुवर्णो बहुरूपरूपी रूपाणि कृत्वा सुरसत्तमानाम्
verses.transliteration: anyonyaretovyatiṣaṅgadoṣād agner apatyam ubhayaṃ tathaiva putraḥ suvarṇo bahurūparūpī rūpāṇi kṛtvā surasattamānām
verses.translation: Through the fault of their mingling seed with each other, both of Agni's offspring were so: the son Suvarna, taking many forms, assumed the forms of the best of the gods
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वायोर् धनदस्य भार्यां जलेश्वरस्यापि मुनीश्वराणाम् भार्यास् तु गच्छत्य् अनिशं सुवर्णो यस्याः प्रियं यच् च वपुः स कृत्वा
verses.transliteration: indrasya vāyor dhanadasya bhāryāṃ jaleśvarasyāpi munīśvarāṇām bhāryās tu gacchaty aniśaṃ suvarṇo yasyāḥ priyaṃ yac ca vapuḥ sa kṛtvā
verses.translation: and continually visited the wives of Indra, Vayu, Kubera, Varuna and the great sages, taking on the form each one loved.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याति क्वचिच् चापि कवेस् तनूजस् तद्भर्तृरूपं च पतिव्रतासु कृत्वानिशं ताभिर् उदारभावः कुर्वन् कृतार्थं मदनं स रेमे
verses.transliteration: yāti kvacic cāpi kaves tanūjas tadbhartṛrūpaṃ ca pativratāsu kṛtvāniśaṃ tābhir udārabhāvaḥ kurvan kṛtārthaṃ madanaṃ sa reme
verses.translation: At times that son of the Seer went to faithful wives in the form of their husbands, and, generous-hearted, sported with them constantly, fulfilling desire.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा गता क्वापि चैवं सुवर्णा धर्मस्य भार्यापि सुवर्णनाम्नी स्वाहासुता स्वैरिणी सा बभूव यस्यापि यस्यापि मनोगता या
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā gatā kvāpi caivaṃ suvarṇā dharmasya bhāryāpi suvarṇanāmnī svāhāsutā svairiṇī sā babhūva yasyāpi yasyāpi manogatā yā
verses.translation: Having done so he would go elsewhere. And Dharma's wife too, named Suvarna, daughter of Svaha, became wanton; whoever's mind she entered,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भार्यास्वरूपा सैव भूत्वा सुवर्णा रेमे पतीन् मानुषान् आसुरांश् च देवान् ऋषीन् पितृरूपांस् तथान्यान् रूपौदार्यस्थैर्यगाम्भीर्ययुक्तान्
verses.transliteration: bhāryāsvarūpā saiva bhūtvā suvarṇā reme patīn mānuṣān āsurāṃś ca devān ṛṣīn pitṛrūpāṃs tathānyān rūpaudāryasthairyagāmbhīryayuktān
verses.translation: that same Suvarna, taking the form of his wife, enjoyed husbands — men, asuras, gods, sages, ancestors and others endowed with beauty, generosity, steadiness and depth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: याभिप्रेता यस्य देवस्य भार्या तद्रूपा सा रमते तेन सार्धम् नानाभेदैः करणैश् चाप्य् अनेकैर् आकर्षन्ती तन्मनः कामसिद्धिम्
verses.transliteration: yābhipretā yasya devasya bhāryā tadrūpā sā ramate tena sārdham nānābhedaiḥ karaṇaiś cāpy anekair ākarṣantī tanmanaḥ kāmasiddhim
verses.translation: Whichever god's wife he desired, she took her form and enjoyed him, drawing his mind to the fulfilment of desire with many and varied arts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: evaṃ suvarṇasya nirīkṣya ceṣṭām agneḥ sūnoḥ putrikāyās tathāgneḥ sarve ca śepuḥ kupitās tadāgneḥ putraṃ ca putrīṃ ca surāsurās te
verses.translation: Seeing this conduct of Suvarna, the son of Agni, and likewise of Agni's daughter, all the gods and asuras in anger cursed Agni's son and daughter:

verses.sanskrit: कृतं यद् एतद् व्यभिचाररूपं यच् छद्मना वर्तनं पापरूपम् तस्मात् सुतस् ते व्यभिचारवांश् च सर्वत्र गामी जायतां हव्यवाह
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ yad etad vyabhicārarūpaṃ yac chadmanā vartanaṃ pāparūpam tasmāt sutas te vyabhicāravāṃś ca sarvatra gāmī jāyatāṃ havyavāha
verses.translation: "Since this adulterous behaviour has been committed, this sinful conduct by deceit, O Bearer of oblations, let your son be adulterous and go everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सुवर्णापि न चैकनिष्ठा भूयाद् अग्ने नैकतृप्ता बहूंश् च नानाजातीन् निन्दितान् देहभाजो भजित्री स्याद् एष दोषश् च पुत्र्याः
verses.transliteration: tathā suvarṇāpi na caikaniṣṭhā bhūyād agne naikatṛptā bahūṃś ca nānājātīn ninditān dehabhājo bhajitrī syād eṣa doṣaś ca putryāḥ
verses.translation: Likewise, O Agni, let Suvarna not be devoted to one nor satisfied with one, but consort with many embodied beings of various despised kinds; this shall be your daughter's fault."

verses.transliteration: ity etac chāpavacanaṃ śrutvāgnir atibhītavat mām abhyetya tadovāca niṣkṛtiṃ vada putrayoḥ
verses.translation: Hearing these words of the curse, Agni, greatly frightened, came to me and said, "Tell me the remedy for my children."

verses.sanskrit: तदाहम् अब्रवं वह्ने गौतमीं गच्छ शंकरम् स्तुत्वा तत्र महाबाहो निवेदय जगत्पतेः
verses.transliteration: tadāham abravaṃ vahne gautamīṃ gaccha śaṃkaram stutvā tatra mahābāho nivedaya jagatpateḥ
verses.translation: Then I said, "O Fire, go to the Gautami, O mighty-armed one, praise Shankara there, and make this known to the Lord of the world:

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरेण वीर्येण तव देहस्थितेन च एवंविधं त्व् अपत्यं ते जातं वह्ने ततो भवान्
verses.transliteration: māheśvareṇa vīryeṇa tava dehasthitena ca evaṃvidhaṃ tv apatyaṃ te jātaṃ vahne tato bhavān
verses.translation: 'Through Maheshvara's seed lodged in my body such offspring was born to me.' Then, O Fire,

verses.transliteration: nivedayasva devāya devānāṃ śāpam īdṛśam svāpatyarakṣaṇāyāsau śaṃbhuḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati
verses.translation: report this curse of the gods to the God. To protect his own offspring, Shambhu will bring about their welfare.

verses.transliteration: stuhi devaṃ ca devīṃ ca bhaktyā prīto bhavec chivaḥ tatas tv apatyaviṣaye priyān kāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Praise the God and the Goddess with devotion; Shiva will be pleased, and then you will obtain your wishes concerning your children."

verses.transliteration: tato madvacanād agnir gaṅgāṃ gatvā maheśvaram tuṣṭāva niyato vākyaiḥ stutibhir vedasaṃmitaiḥ
verses.translation: Then at my word Agni went to the Ganga and, with self-restraint, praised Maheshvara with words and hymns consonant with the Veda:

verses.transliteration: viśvasya jagato dhātā viśvamūrtir nirañjanaḥ ādikartā svayaṃbhūś ca taṃ namāmi jagatpatim
verses.translation: "The ordainer of the whole universe, whose form is the universe, stainless, the first creator and self-born — I bow to that Lord of the world.

verses.transliteration: yo 'gnir bhūtvā saṃharati sraṣṭā vai jalarūpataḥ sūryarūpeṇa yaḥ pāti taṃ namāmi ca tryambakam
verses.translation: He who, becoming fire, destroys; who creates in the form of water; who protects in the form of the sun — I bow to that three-eyed one."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् अनन्तः शंभुर् अव्ययः वरेण च्छन्दयाम् आस पावकं सुरपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān anantaḥ śaṃbhur avyayaḥ vareṇa cchandayām āsa pāvakaṃ surapūjitam
verses.translation: Then the blessed Shambhu, infinite and imperishable, well pleased, offered a boon to Pavaka, worshipped by the gods.

verses.transliteration: tathā suvarṇā putrī ca tasmād eva jagatprabho anyonyavīryasaṅgāc ca taddoṣād ubhayaṃ tv idam
verses.translation: and likewise a daughter, Suvarna, from it, O Lord of the world. Through the mingling of their seed with each other, and from that fault, both of them

verses.transliteration: vyabhicārāt sadoṣaṃ ca apatyam abhavac chiva śāpaṃ daduḥ surāḥ sarve tayoḥ śāntiṃ kuru prabho
verses.translation: became offspring tainted by adultery, O Shiva. All the gods have cursed them; grant them relief, O Lord."

verses.transliteration: tadagnivacanāc chaṃbhuḥ provācedaṃ śubhodayam
verses.translation: At Agni's words Shambhu spoke these auspicious words:

verses.transliteration: madvīryād abhavat tvattaḥ suvarṇo bhūrivikramaḥ samagrā ṛddhayaḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇe 'smin samāhitāḥ
verses.translation: "From my seed, through you, was born Suvarna of great valour; all prosperities are gathered in this Suvarna — gold.

verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti na saṃdeho vahne śṛṇu vaco mama trayāṇām api lokānāṃ pāvanaḥ sa bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: So they will be, no doubt; O Fire, hear my word: he will be the purifier of all three worlds.

verses.transliteration: sa eva cāmṛtaṃ loke sa eva suravallabhaḥ sa eva bhuktimuktī ca sa eva makhadakṣiṇā
verses.translation: He alone will be nectar in the world, he the favourite of the gods, he both enjoyment and liberation, he the fee of the sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: sa eva rūpaṃ sarvasya gurūṇām apy asau guruḥ vīryaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ vidyād vīryaṃ matto yad uttamam
verses.translation: He will be the beauty of all things, the teacher even of teachers. Know seed to be most excellent, and the seed that comes from me is the highest.

verses.transliteration: viśeṣatas tvayi kṣiptaṃ tasya kā syād vicāraṇā hīnaṃ tena vinā sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇās tena saṃpadaḥ
verses.translation: Since it was placed especially in you, what question can there be? Without it everything is lacking; with it all riches are complete.

verses.transliteration: jīvanto 'pi mṛtāḥ sarve suvarṇena vinā narāḥ nirguṇo 'pi dhanī mānyaḥ saguṇo 'py adhano nahi
verses.translation: All men without gold are dead though living; a rich man is honoured even without virtues, but a virtuous man without wealth is not.

verses.transliteration: tasmān nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcit suvarṇād dhi bhaviṣyati tathā caiṣā suvarṇāpi syād utkṛṣṭāpi cañcalā
verses.translation: Therefore nothing will be higher than gold. And this Suvarna too, though excellent, will be fickle.

verses.sanskrit: अनया वीक्षितं सर्वं न्यूनं पूर्णं भविष्यति तपसा जपहोमैश् च येयं प्राप्या जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: anayā vīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati tapasā japahomaiś ca yeyaṃ prāpyā jagattraye
verses.translation: All that she looks upon, though lacking, will become full — she who is to be won in the three worlds by austerity, japa and oblations.

verses.translation: Something of her power and excellence is told, O Agni: she who dwells everywhere will come and go as she wanders.

verses.translation: Suvarna will be Kamala herself, and pure. From today, though your two children act as they please,

verses.transliteration: tathāpi caitayoḥ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: still there has never been and never will be merit like theirs."

verses.translation: Having said this, Shambhu, Shiva himself, manifested there in the form of a linga, desiring the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.translation: and Fire's son too lived happily as he wished. Meanwhile, O sage, Agni's daughter Svarna —

verses.translation: the demon lord Shardula, overpowering Dharma, carried off by deceit that abode of fortune, good luck and charm.

verses.translation: The world-famed Suvarna was taken by him to Rasatala. Agni's son-in-law Dharma and Agni, the bearer of oblations,

verses.translation: praised Vishnu, lord of the world, again and again, and together made their purpose known to the mighty one.

verses.transliteration: tataś cakreṇa ciccheda śārdūlasya śiro hariḥ sānītā viṣṇunā devī suvarṇā lokasundarī
verses.translation: Then Hari cut off Shardula's head with his discus; the goddess Suvarna, most beautiful in the world, was brought back by Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: maheśvarasutā caiva agneś caiva tathā priyā maheśvarāya tāṃ viṣṇur darśayām āsa nārada
verses.translation: Vishnu showed her, Maheshvara's daughter and Agni's beloved, to Maheshvara, O Narada.

verses.transliteration: prīto 'bhavan maheśo 'pi sasvaje tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra śārdūlacchedi dīptimat
verses.translation: Mahesha too was delighted and embraced her again and again. The place where the shining discus that had severed Shardula was washed

verses.sanskrit: तत् तीर्थं शांकरं ज्ञेयं वैष्णवं सिद्धम् एव तु यत्रानन्दम् अनुप्राप्तो ह्य् अग्निर् धर्मश् च शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: tat tīrthaṃ śāṃkaraṃ jñeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ siddham eva tu yatrānandam anuprāpto hy agnir dharmaś ca śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: that tirtha should be known as Shankara, as Vaishnava, and as Siddha. Where Agni and the eternal Dharma attained bliss,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दाश्रूणि न्यपतन् यत्राग्नेर् मुनिसत्तम आनन्देति नदी जाता तथा वै नन्दिनीति च
verses.transliteration: ānandāśrūṇi nyapatan yatrāgner munisattama ānandeti nadī jātā tathā vai nandinīti ca
verses.translation: where tears of joy fell from Agni, O best of sages, a river arose called Ananda, and also Nandini.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश् च संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गायां तत्र वै शिवः तत्रैव संगमे साक्षात् सुवर्णाद्यापि संस्थिता
verses.transliteration: tasyāś ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāṃ tatra vai śivaḥ tatraiva saṃgame sākṣāt suvarṇādyāpi saṃsthitā
verses.translation: Its confluence with the Ganga is holy, and Shiva is there; at that very confluence Suvarna still dwells in person today —
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायणी सैव शिवा आग्नेयी चेति विश्रुता अम्बिका जगदाधारा शिवा कात्यायनीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇī saiva śivā āgneyī ceti viśrutā ambikā jagadādhārā śivā kātyāyanīśvarī
verses.translation: she who is known as Dakshayani, Shiva and Agneyi; Ambika, support of the world, Shiva, Katyayani, the Queen,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भक्ताभीष्टप्रदा नित्यम् अलंकृत्योभयं तटम् तपस् तेपे यत्र चाग्निस् तत् तीर्थं तु तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktābhīṣṭapradā nityam alaṃkṛtyobhayaṃ taṭam tapas tepe yatra cāgnis tat tīrthaṃ tu tapovanam
verses.translation: ever granting her devotees' wishes, adorning both banks. Where Agni performed austerities, that tirtha is Tapovana.

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि तीर्थानि तीरयोर् उभयोर् मुने तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: evamādīni tīrthāni tīrayor ubhayor mune teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Such are the tirthas on both banks, O sage; bathing and giving at them is auspicious and grants all desires.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे चैव पारे च सहस्राणि चतुर्दश दक्षिणे च तथा पारे सहस्राण्य् अथ षोडश
verses.transliteration: uttare caiva pāre ca sahasrāṇi caturdaśa dakṣiṇe ca tathā pāre sahasrāṇy atha ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: On the northern bank there are fourteen thousand, and on the southern bank sixteen thousand.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र च तीर्थानि साभिज्ञानानि सन्ति वै नामानि च पृथक् सन्ति संक्षेपात् तन् मयोच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra ca tīrthāni sābhijñānāni santi vai nāmāni ca pṛthak santi saṃkṣepāt tan mayocyate
verses.translation: Here and there are tirthas with their distinguishing marks and their separate names; I tell them to you in brief.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि यश् च शृणुयाद् यश् च वा पठति स्मरेत् सर्वेषु तत्र काम्येषु परिपूर्णो भवेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: etāni yaś ca śṛṇuyād yaś ca vā paṭhati smaret sarveṣu tatra kāmyeṣu paripūrṇo bhaven naraḥ
verses.translation: Whoever hears these, or recites or remembers them, becomes fulfilled in all his desires there.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वृत्तं तु यो ज्ञात्वा तत्र स्नानादिकं चरेत् लक्ष्मीवाञ् जायते नित्यं धर्मवांश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: etad vṛttaṃ tu yo jñātvā tatra snānādikaṃ caret lakṣmīvāñ jāyate nityaṃ dharmavāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Whoever knows this story and bathes and so on there always becomes prosperous, and especially righteous.

verses.sanskrit: अब्जकात् पश्चिमे तीर्थं तच् छार्दूलम् उदाहृतम् वाराणस्यादितीर्थेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् अधिकं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: abjakāt paścime tīrthaṃ tac chārdūlam udāhṛtam vārāṇasyāditīrthebhyaḥ sarvebhyo hy adhikaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: West of Abjaka is the tirtha called Shardula; it surpasses all the tirthas beginning with Varanasi.

verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā pitṝn devān vandate tarpayaty api sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: One who bathes there and salutes and offers libations to the ancestors and gods is freed from all sins and honoured in Vishnu's world.

verses.transliteration: tapovanāc ca śārdūlān madhye tīrthāny aśeṣataḥ tasyaikaikasya māhātmyaṃ na kenāpy atra varṇyate
verses.translation: Between Tapovana and Shardula lie countless tirthas; the greatness of each one of them cannot be described here by anyone.

verses.transliteration: indratīrtham iti khyātaṃ tatraiva ca vṛṣākapam phenāyāḥ saṃgamo yatra hanūmataṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On hearing their words, the highly delighted Krsna- Dvaipayana, the Yogin, the most excellent among those who understand Yoga, said thus:

verses.sanskrit: अब्जकं चापि यत् प्रोक्तं यत्र देवस् त्रिविक्रमः तत्र स्नानं च दानं च पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: abjakaṃ cāpi yat proktaṃ yatra devas trivikramaḥ tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca punarāvṛttidurlabham
verses.translation: O brahmins, listen. I shall recount Yoga that destroys worldly existence. By practising it, a Yogin shall attain liberation which is extremely difficult of access.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, listen. I shall recount Yoga that destroys worldly existence. By practising it, a Yogin shall attain liberation which is extremely difficult of access.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वृत्तान्य् अथाख्यास्ये गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे इन्द्रेश्वरं चोत्तरे च शृणु भक्त्या यतव्रतः
verses.transliteration: tatra vṛttāny athākhyāsye gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe indreśvaraṃ cottare ca śṛṇu bhaktyā yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: If out, of foolishness, anyone were to practise Yoga without taking into consideration these restrictions as to places, cei tain defects are produced and they cause obstacles. I shall describe them.
verses.commentary: Sense: If out, of foolishness, anyone were to practise Yoga without taking into consideration these restrictions as to places, cei tain defects are produced and they cause obstacles. I shall describe them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नमुचिर् बलवान् आसीद् इन्द्रशत्रुर् मदोत्कटः तस्येन्द्रेणाभवद् युद्धं फेनेनेन्द्रो ऽहरच् छिरः
verses.transliteration: namucir balavān āsīd indraśatrur madotkaṭaḥ tasyendreṇābhavad yuddhaṃ phenenendro 'harac chiraḥ
verses.translation: Deafness, sluggishness, loss of memory, dumbness, blindness and fever are produced immediately. Similarly ignor- ance is caused.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deafness, sluggishness, loss of memory, dumbness, blindness and fever are produced immediately. Similarly ignor- ance is caused.

verses.sanskrit: अपां च नमुचेः शत्रोस् तत्फेनवज्ररूपधृक् शिरश् छित्त्वा तच् च फेनं गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: apāṃ ca namuceḥ śatros tatphenavajrarūpadhṛk śiraś chittvā tac ca phenaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Hence (arrangement for) safety should always be made
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence (arrangement for) safety should always be made
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न्यपतद् भूमिं भित्त्वा तु रसातलम् अथाविशत् रसातलभवं गाङ्गं वारि यद् विश्वपावनम्
verses.transliteration: nyapatad bhūmiṃ bhittvā tu rasātalam athāviśat rasātalabhavaṃ gāṅgaṃ vāri yad viśvapāvanam
verses.translation: At the outset he shall fix the sense organs, the organs of action and the elements in his soul. He should unite his soul
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset he shall fix the sense organs, the organs of action and the elements in his soul. He should unite his soul

verses.sanskrit: वज्रादिष्टेन मार्गेण व्यगमद् भूमिमण्डलम् तज् जलं फेननाम्ना तु नदी फेनेति गद्यते
verses.transliteration: vajrādiṣṭena mārgeṇa vyagamad bhūmimaṇḍalam taj jalaṃ phenanāmnā tu nadī pheneti gadyate
verses.translation: By the power of Yoga the Yogin attains the pure Purusottama who is termed the "fourth" and who transcends the three states (viz. wakeful, dreaming and slumbering). There is no doubt in this that he is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the power of Yoga the Yogin attains the pure Purusottama who is termed the "fourth" and who transcends the three states (viz. wakeful, dreaming and slumbering). There is no doubt in this that he is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास् तु संगमः पुण्यो गङ्गया लोकविश्रुतः सर्वपापक्षयकरो गङ्गायमुनयोर् इव
verses.transliteration: tasyās tu saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgayā lokaviśrutaḥ sarvapāpakṣayakaro gaṅgāyamunayor iva
verses.translation: On hearing his words they said: "Well done, Well done". After praising and honouring Vyasa they began to ask him once again.

verses.sanskrit: हनूमदुपमाता वै यत्राप्लवनमात्रतः मार्जारत्वाद् अभून् मुक्ता विष्णुगङ्गाप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: hanūmadupamātā vai yatrāplavanamātrataḥ mārjāratvād abhūn muktā viṣṇugaṅgāprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Where Hanuman's foster mother, merely by plunging in, was freed from the form of a cat by the grace of Vishnu and the Ganga —

verses.sanskrit: मार्जारं चेति तत् तीर्थं पुरा प्रोक्तं मया तव हनूमतं च तत् प्रोक्तं तत्राख्यानं पुरोदितम्
verses.transliteration: mārjāraṃ ceti tat tīrthaṃ purā proktaṃ mayā tava hanūmataṃ ca tat proktaṃ tatrākhyānaṃ puroditam
verses.translation: that tirtha I described to you earlier as Marjara; it is also called Hanumata, and its story was told before.

verses.transliteration: vṛṣākapaṃ cābjakaṃ ca tatredaṃ prayataḥ śṛṇu hiraṇya iti vikhyāto daityānāṃ pūrvajo balī
verses.translation: Now listen attentively to the story of Vrishakapa and Abjaka. There was one known as Hiranya, a mighty forefather of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: तपस् तप्त्वा सुरैः सर्वैर् अजेयो ऽभूत् सुदारुणः तस्यापि बलवान् पुत्रो देवानां दुर्जयः सदा
verses.transliteration: tapas taptvā suraiḥ sarvair ajeyo 'bhūt sudāruṇaḥ tasyāpi balavān putro devānāṃ durjayaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Having performed austerities, he became very fierce and invincible to all the gods. His son too was mighty and ever hard for the gods to conquer,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् इति ख्यातस् तस्य भार्या पराजिता तेनेन्द्रस्याभवद् युद्धं बहुकालं निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir iti khyātas tasya bhāryā parājitā tenendrasyābhavad yuddhaṃ bahukālaṃ nirantaram
verses.translation: famed as Mahashani; his wife was Parajita. Indra fought a war with him continuously for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् महावीर्यः सततं रणमूर्धनि जित्वा नागेन सहितं शक्रं पित्रे न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir mahāvīryaḥ satataṃ raṇamūrdhani jitvā nāgena sahitaṃ śakraṃ pitre nyavedayat
verses.translation: Mahashani of great valour, ever at the forefront of battle, conquered Shakra along with his elephant and presented him to his father.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वा हस्तिसमायुक्तं स्वसारं वीक्ष्य तां तदा विहाय क्रूरतां दैत्यो हिरण्याय न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: baddhvā hastisamāyuktaṃ svasāraṃ vīkṣya tāṃ tadā vihāya krūratāṃ daityo hiraṇyāya nyavedayat
verses.translation: Having bound him together with his elephant, and then seeing that sister of his, the Daitya set aside his cruelty and handed him over to Hiranya.

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिपिता दैत्यः पूर्वेषां पूर्ववत्तरः शचीकान्तं तले स्थाप्य तस्य रक्षाम् अथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: mahāśanipitā daityaḥ pūrveṣāṃ pūrvavattaraḥ śacīkāntaṃ tale sthāpya tasya rakṣām athākarot
verses.translation: The Daitya Hiranya, Mahashani's father, more ancient than the ancients, placed Shachi's husband in the netherworld and kept him under guard.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: महाशनिर् हरिं जित्वा जेतुं वरुणम् अभ्यगात् वरुणो ऽपि महाबुद्धिः प्रादात् कन्यां महाशनेः
verses.transliteration: mahāśanir hariṃ jitvā jetuṃ varuṇam abhyagāt varuṇo 'pi mahābuddhiḥ prādāt kanyāṃ mahāśaneḥ
verses.translation: Having conquered Hari, Mahashani went to conquer Varuna; but Varuna, of great wisdom, gave his daughter to Mahashani.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उदधिं स्वालयं प्रादाद् वरुणस् तु महाशनेः तयोश् च सख्यम् अभवद् वरुणस्य महाशनेः
verses.transliteration: udadhiṃ svālayaṃ prādād varuṇas tu mahāśaneḥ tayoś ca sakhyam abhavad varuṇasya mahāśaneḥ
verses.translation: Varuna also gave the ocean, his own abode, to Mahashani, and friendship arose between Varuna and Mahashani.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वारुणी चापि या कन्या सा प्रियाभून् महाशनेः वीर्येण यशसा चापि शौर्येण च बलेन च
verses.transliteration: vāruṇī cāpi yā kanyā sā priyābhūn mahāśaneḥ vīryeṇa yaśasā cāpi śauryeṇa ca balena ca
verses.translation: Varuni, Varuna's daughter, became dear to Mahashani. In valour, fame, heroism and strength

verses.transliteration: mahāśanir mahādaityas trailokye nopamīyate nirindratvaṃ gate loke devāḥ sarve nyamantrayan
verses.translation: the great Daitya Mahashani had no equal in the three worlds. When the world was left without an Indra, all the gods took counsel:

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर् एवेन्द्रदाता स्याद् दैत्यहन्ता स एव च मन्त्रदृग् वा स एव स्याद् इन्द्रं चान्यं करिष्यति
verses.transliteration: viṣṇur evendradātā syād daityahantā sa eva ca mantradṛg vā sa eva syād indraṃ cānyaṃ kariṣyati
verses.translation: "Vishnu alone can give us an Indra; he alone is the slayer of Daityas. He is the seer of counsel; he will make another Indra."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एवं संमन्त्र्य ते देवा विष्णोर् मन्त्रं न्यवेदयन् ममावध्यो महादैत्यो महाशनिर् इति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃmantrya te devā viṣṇor mantraṃ nyavedayan mamāvadhyo mahādaityo mahāśanir iti bruvan
verses.translation: Having taken counsel thus, the gods laid their plan before Vishnu; he said, "The great Daitya Mahashani cannot be slain by me."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रायाद् वारीश्वरं विष्णुः श्वशुरं वरुणं तदा केशवो वरुणं गत्वा प्राहेन्द्रस्य पराभवम्
verses.transliteration: prāyād vārīśvaraṃ viṣṇuḥ śvaśuraṃ varuṇaṃ tadā keśavo varuṇaṃ gatvā prāhendrasya parābhavam
verses.translation: Then Vishnu went to Varuna, lord of the waters, Mahashani's father-in-law; reaching Varuna, Keshava told him of Indra's defeat:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तथा त्वयैतत् कर्तव्यं यथायाति पुरंदरः तद्विष्णुवचनाच् छीघ्रं ययौ जलपतिर् मुने
verses.transliteration: tathā tvayaitat kartavyaṃ yathāyāti puraṃdaraḥ tadviṣṇuvacanāc chīghraṃ yayau jalapatir mune
verses.translation: "You must act so that Purandara comes back." At Vishnu's word the lord of the waters quickly went, O sage,

verses.translation: to valiant Mahashani, son of Hiranya and his daughter's husband; the lord Varuna was greatly honoured by his son-in-law.

verses.transliteration: papracchāgamanaṃ daityo vinayāc chvaśuraṃ tadā varuṇaḥ prāha taṃ daityaṃ yad āgamanakāraṇam
verses.translation: The Daitya then humbly asked his father-in-law why he had come, and Varuna told the Daitya the reason for his coming:

verses.transliteration: indraṃ dehi mahābāho yas tvayā nirjitaḥ purā baddhaṃ rasātalasthaṃ taṃ devānām adhipaṃ sakhe
verses.translation: "Give me Indra, O mighty-armed one, whom you conquered long ago — the lord of the gods, bound and kept in Rasatala, my friend.

verses.transliteration: asmākaṃ sarvadā mānyaṃ dehi tvaṃ mama śatruhan baddhvā vimokṣaṇaṃ śatror mahate yaśase satām
verses.translation: He is always to be honoured by us; give him to me, O slayer of foes. To release an enemy after binding him brings great fame among the good."

verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā kathaṃcit sa daityeśo varuṇāya tam prādād indraṃ śacīkāntaṃ vāraṇena samanvitam
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," the lord of the Daityas reluctantly gave Indra, Shachi's husband, together with his elephant, to Varuna.

verses.transliteration: sa daityamadhye 'tivirājamāno hariṃ tadovāca jaleśasaṃnidhau saṃpūjya caivātha mahopacārair mahāśanir maghavantaṃ babhāṣe
verses.translation: Shining brilliantly amid the Daityas, in the presence of the lord of the waters, Mahashani honoured Maghavan with great ceremony and then said to him:

verses.transliteration: kena tvam indro 'dya kṛto 'si kena vīryaṃ tavedṛg bahu bhāṣase ca tvaṃ saṃgare śatrubhir bādhyase ca tathāpi cendro bhavasīti citram
verses.translation: "Who has made you Indra today? Who gave you such valour, that you boast so much? You are harassed by enemies in battle, and still you are Indra — how strange!

verses.sanskrit: अथापि बद्धा पुरुषेण काचित् तस्याः पतिस् तां मोचयतीति युक्तम् स्त्रियो ऽस्वतन्त्राः पुरुषप्रधानास् त्वं वै पुमान् भविता शक्र साधो
verses.transliteration: athāpi baddhā puruṣeṇa kācit tasyāḥ patis tāṃ mocayatīti yuktam striyo 'svatantrāḥ puruṣapradhānās tvaṃ vai pumān bhavitā śakra sādho
verses.translation: When some woman is held captive by a man, it is fitting that her husband sets her free; women are dependent and ruled by men — and you, good Shakra, are supposed to be a man!

verses.sanskrit: बद्धो मया संगरे वाहनेन क्वाप्य् अस्त्रं ते वज्रम् उद्दामशक्ति चिन्तारत्नं नन्दनं योषितस् ता यशो बलं देवराजोपभोग्यम्
verses.transliteration: baddho mayā saṃgare vāhanena kvāpy astraṃ te vajram uddāmaśakti cintāratnaṃ nandanaṃ yoṣitas tā yaśo balaṃ devarājopabhogyam
verses.translation: I bound you in battle along with your mount. Where was your weapon then, the thunderbolt of unbounded power? The wish-granting jewel, the Nandana grove, those women, fame and strength — the enjoyments of the king of the gods —

verses.sanskrit: तज् जीवनं यत् तु यशोनिधानं स एव मृत्युर् यशसो यद् विरोधि एवं जानञ् शक्र कथं जलेशान् मुक्तिं प्राप्तो नैव लज्जां भजेथाः
verses.transliteration: taj jīvanaṃ yat tu yaśonidhānaṃ sa eva mṛtyur yaśaso yad virodhi evaṃ jānañ śakra kathaṃ jaleśān muktiṃ prāpto naiva lajjāṃ bhajethāḥ
verses.translation: that alone is life which is a treasury of fame, and that alone is death which is opposed to fame. Knowing this, Shakra, how is it that, having won release through the lord of the waters, you feel no shame?

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविष्टपस्थः परिवेष्टितः सन् सर्वैः सुरैः कान्तया वीज्यमानः संस्तूयमानश् च तथाप्सरोभिर् नूनं लज्जा ते बिभेतीति मन्ये
verses.transliteration: triviṣṭapasthaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ san sarvaiḥ suraiḥ kāntayā vījyamānaḥ saṃstūyamānaś ca tathāpsarobhir nūnaṃ lajjā te bibhetīti manye
verses.translation: Dwelling in heaven, surrounded by all the gods, fanned by your beloved and praised by the Apsaras — surely shame itself is afraid of you, I think.

verses.transliteration: tvaṃ vṛtrahā namuceś cāpi hantā purāṃ bhettā gotrabhid vajrabāhuḥ evaṃ surās tvāṃ paripūjayantīty ato jiṣṇo sarvam etat tyajasva
verses.translation: 'You are the slayer of Vritra and of Namuchi, breaker of cities, splitter of mountains, thunderbolt-armed' — so the gods worship you; therefore, O Jishnu, give all this up.

verses.transliteration: vikāram āpyāpy ahitodbhavaṃ ye jīvanti lokān anusaṃviśanti bhavādṛśāṃ duścyavanābjajanmā kathaṃ na hṛdbhedam avāpa kartā
verses.translation: Those who go on living and mixing with people even after suffering disgrace at the hands of enemies — how did the lotus-born creator of such as you not have his heart break?"

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu daityeśo varuṇāya mahātmane prādād indraṃ punaś cedaṃ vacanaṃ tad abhāṣata
verses.translation: Having said this, the lord of the Daityas handed Indra over to the great-souled Varuna and spoke these words again:

verses.transliteration: adya prabhṛty asau śiṣya indraḥ syād varuṇo guruḥ śvaśuro mama yena tvaṃ muktim āpto 'si vāsava
verses.translation: "From today let this Indra be the disciple, and Varuna, my father-in-law, through whom you have gained release, be the teacher, O Vasava.

verses.transliteration: tathā tvaṃ bhṛtyabhāvena vartethā varuṇaṃ prati no ced baddhvā punas tvāṃ vai kṣepsye caiva rasātalam
verses.translation: You must behave as a servant toward Varuna; otherwise I will bind you again and throw you into Rasatala."

verses.transliteration: evaṃ nirbhartsya taṃ śakraṃ hasaṃś cāpi punaḥ punaḥ abravīd gaccha gaccheti varuṇaṃ cānumanya tu
verses.translation: Having rebuked Shakra thus, laughing again and again, he said, "Go, go," and took leave of Varuna.

verses.transliteration: sa tu prāptaḥ svanilayaṃ lajjayā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ paulomyāṃ prāha tat sarvaṃ yat tac chatruparābhavam
verses.translation: Reaching his own abode, stained with shame, Indra told Pauloma's daughter everything about his defeat by the enemy.

verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ kṛtaś caiva śatruṇāhaṃ varānane nirvāpayāmi yena svam ātmānaṃ subhage vada
verses.translation: "Thus was I spoken to and treated by the enemy, fair-faced one; tell me, fortunate one, how I may find relief."

verses.transliteration: dānavānām athodbhūtiṃ śakra māyāṃ parābhavam varadānaṃ tathā mṛtyuṃ jāne 'haṃ balasūdana
verses.translation: "I know the origin of the Danavas, Shakra, their magic, their defeat, their boons and their death, O slayer of Bala.

verses.transliteration: tasmād yasmāt tasya mṛtyur athavāpi parābhavaḥ jāyeta śṛṇu tat sarvaṃ vakṣye 'haṃ prītaye tava
verses.translation: So listen: I will tell you everything by which his death or defeat may come about, for your satisfaction.

verses.transliteration: hiraṇyasya suto vīraḥ pitṛvyasya suto balī tasmān mama syāt sa bhrātā varadānāc ca darpitaḥ
verses.translation: The heroic son of Hiranya is the mighty son of my paternal uncle, so he is my brother, and he is proud from a boon.

verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ toṣayām āsa tapasā niyamena ca īdṛśaṃ balam āpannaṃ tapasā kiṃ na sidhyati
verses.translation: He pleased Brahma with austerity and discipline and gained such strength; what is not achieved by austerity?

verses.translation: So you should feel neither distress nor wonder at all. Listen to what must be done here, as it has come down in due order."

verses.translation: Having said this, Pauloma's daughter humbly spoke to Indra:

verses.translation: And I have heard this excellent saying, beloved: only women truly know the nature of women, O lord of the gods.

verses.translation: Likewise nothing is impossible for the earth and the waters, O lord, since austerity and sacrifice and the like come about through them alone.

verses.transliteration: tatrāpi tīrthabhūtā tu yā bhūmis tāṃ vrajed bhavān tatra viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ pūjya sarvān kāmān avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Even among these, you should go to the land that is a tirtha; worshipping Vishnu and Shiva there, you will obtain all your desires.

verses.translation: I have also heard this: women who are faithful to their husbands know everything, and by them the moving and unmoving world is upheld.

verses.translation: The essence of the earth is the Dandaka forest in its midst; there flows the Ganga, upholder of the world. Worship the Lord there, O lord,

verses.translation: or Vishnu, lord of the worlds, the all-pervading one who removes the pain of the wretched and afflicted. For helpless men here, sinking in the ocean of sorrow,

verses.transliteration: haro harir vā gaṅgā vā kvāpy anyac charaṇaṃ nahi tasmāt sarvaprayatnena toṣayaitān samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: there is no other refuge anywhere but Hara, Hari or the Ganga. So with every effort, and with a collected mind, please them

verses.transliteration: bhaktyā stotraiś ca tapasā kuru caiva mayā saha tataḥ prāpsyasi kalyāṇam īśaviṣṇuprasādajam
verses.translation: with devotion, hymns and austerity; do this together with me. Then you will obtain the welfare that comes from the grace of Isha and Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: ajñātvaikaguṇaṃ karma phalaṃ dāsyati karmiṇaḥ jñātvā śataguṇaṃ tat syād bhāryayā ca tad akṣayam
verses.translation: A rite done without understanding gives the doer a single measure of fruit; done with understanding it becomes a hundredfold, and done with one's wife it is imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: पुंसः सर्वेषु कार्येषु भार्यैवेह सहायिनी स्वल्पानाम् अपि कार्याणां नहि सिद्धिस् तया विना
verses.transliteration: puṃsaḥ sarveṣu kāryeṣu bhāryaiveha sahāyinī svalpānām api kāryāṇāṃ nahi siddhis tayā vinā
verses.translation: In all a man's undertakings the wife alone is his helper here; without her even small tasks do not succeed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एकेन यत् कृतं कर्म तस्माद् अर्धफलं भवेत् जायया तु कृतं नाथ पुष्कलं पुरुषो लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ekena yat kṛtaṃ karma tasmād ardhaphalaṃ bhavet jāyayā tu kṛtaṃ nātha puṣkalaṃ puruṣo labhet
verses.translation: A rite performed by one person alone yields half the fruit; performed with his wife, O lord, a man gains the full.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एतत् सुविदितम् अर्धो जाया इति श्रुतेः श्रूयते दण्डकारण्ये सरिच्छ्रेष्ठास्ति गौतमी
verses.transliteration: tasmād etat suviditam ardho jāyā iti śruteḥ śrūyate daṇḍakāraṇye saricchreṣṭhāsti gautamī
verses.translation: So it is well known from the Veda that 'the wife is half.' It is heard that in the Dandaka forest flows the Gautami, best of rivers,

verses.sanskrit: अशेषाघप्रशमनी सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनी तस्माद् गच्छ मया तत्र कुरु पुण्यं महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: aśeṣāghapraśamanī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī tasmād gaccha mayā tatra kuru puṇyaṃ mahāphalam
verses.translation: which quells all sin and grants every wish. So go there with me and perform merit of great fruit.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शत्रून् निहत्याजौ महत् सुखम् अवाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śatrūn nihatyājau mahat sukham avāpsyasi
verses.translation: Then, having slain your enemies in battle, you will attain great happiness."

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्य् उक्त्वा स गुरुणा भार्यया च शतक्रतुः ययौ गङ्गां जगद्धात्रीं गौतमीं चेति विश्रुताम्
verses.transliteration: tathety uktvā sa guruṇā bhāryayā ca śatakratuḥ yayau gaṅgāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ gautamīṃ ceti viśrutām
verses.translation: Saying "So be it," Shatakratu, with his teacher and his wife, went to the Ganga, upholder of the world, famed as the Gautami.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डकारण्यमध्यस्थां ययौ स प्रीतिमान् हरिः तपः कर्तुं मनश् चक्रे देवदेवाय शंभवे
verses.transliteration: daṇḍakāraṇyamadhyasthāṃ yayau sa prītimān hariḥ tapaḥ kartuṃ manaś cakre devadevāya śaṃbhave
verses.translation: Hari went gladly to her in the midst of the Dandaka forest and resolved to perform austerity for Shambhu, the God of gods.

verses.transliteration: gaṅgāṃ natvā tu prathamaṃ snātvā ca sa kṛtāñjaliḥ śivaikaśaraṇo bhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato 'bravīt
verses.translation: First bowing to the Ganga and bathing, with joined palms and taking Shiva as his sole refuge, he then spoke this hymn:

verses.sanskrit: स्वमायया यो ह्य् अखिलं चराचरं सृजत्य् अवत्य् अत्ति न सज्जते ऽस्मिन् एकः स्वतन्त्रो ऽद्वयचित् सुखात्मकः स नः प्रसन्नो ऽस्तु पिनाकपाणिः
verses.transliteration: svamāyayā yo hy akhilaṃ carācaraṃ sṛjaty avaty atti na sajjate 'smin ekaḥ svatantro 'dvayacit sukhātmakaḥ sa naḥ prasanno 'stu pinākapāṇiḥ
verses.translation: "He who by his own maya creates, sustains and devours this whole world of moving and unmoving things yet is not attached to it — the one, independent, non-dual consciousness whose nature is bliss — may that Pinaka-bearer be gracious to us.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य तत्त्वं सनकादयो ऽपि जानन्ति वेदान्तरहस्यविज्ञाः स पार्वतीशः सकलाभिलाष दाता प्रसन्नो ऽस्तु ममान्धकारिः
verses.transliteration: na yasya tattvaṃ sanakādayo 'pi jānanti vedāntarahasyavijñāḥ sa pārvatīśaḥ sakalābhilāṣa dātā prasanno 'stu mamāndhakāriḥ
verses.translation: He whose truth not even Sanaka and the others, knowers of the secret of Vedanta, can know — may that lord of Parvati, giver of all desires, enemy of Andhaka, be gracious to me.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वा स्वयंभूर् भगवान् विरिञ्चिं भयंकरं चास्य शिरो ऽन्वपश्यत् छित्त्वा नखाग्रैर् नखसक्तम् एतच् चिक्षेप तस्माद् अभवत् त्रिवर्गः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭvā svayaṃbhūr bhagavān viriñciṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ cāsya śiro 'nvapaśyat chittvā nakhāgrair nakhasaktam etac cikṣepa tasmād abhavat trivargaḥ
verses.translation: The self-born Lord, having created Brahma, saw that his head was fearsome; he cut it off with his fingernails and flung it away as it clung to his nail, and from it arose the triad of ills:

verses.sanskrit: पापं दरिद्रं त्व् अथ लोभयाच्ञे मोहो विपच् चेति ततो ऽप्य् अनन्तम् जातप्रभावं भवदुःखरूपं बभूव तैर् व्याप्तम् इदं समस्तम्
verses.transliteration: pāpaṃ daridraṃ tv atha lobhayācñe moho vipac ceti tato 'py anantam jātaprabhāvaṃ bhavaduḥkharūpaṃ babhūva tair vyāptam idaṃ samastam
verses.translation: sin and poverty, then greed and begging, delusion and calamity, and from these endless others, powerful, the very form of worldly sorrow; this whole world became pervaded by them.

verses.sanskrit: अवेक्ष्य सर्वं चकितः सुरेशो देवीम् अवोचज् जगद् अस्तम् एति त्वं पाहि लोकेश्वरि लोकमातर् उमे शरण्ये सुभगे सुभद्रे
verses.transliteration: avekṣya sarvaṃ cakitaḥ sureśo devīm avocaj jagad astam eti tvaṃ pāhi lokeśvari lokamātar ume śaraṇye subhage subhadre
verses.translation: Seeing all this, the lord of the gods, alarmed, said to the Goddess: 'The world is going to ruin; protect it, O Queen of the worlds, Mother of the worlds, Uma, giver of refuge, fortunate and most auspicious one.

verses.transliteration: jagatpratiṣṭhe varade jaya tvaṃ bhuktiḥ samādhiḥ paramā ca muktiḥ svāhā svadhā svastir anādisiddhir gīr buddhir āsīr ajarāmare tvam
verses.translation: Foundation of the world, giver of boons, victory to you! You are enjoyment, samadhi and supreme liberation; Svaha, Svadha, well-being, beginningless perfection, speech, intellect and blessing — you are unageing and immortal.

verses.transliteration: vidyādirūpeṇa jagattraye tvaṃ rakṣāṃ karoṣy eva madājñayā ca tvayaiva sṛṣṭaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ syād yataḥ prakṛtyaiva tathaiva citram
verses.translation: In the form of knowledge and the rest you protect the three worlds at my command; by you alone the three worlds are created, for this manifold wonder arises from Prakriti alone.'

verses.transliteration: ity evam uktā dayitā hareṇa saṃśleṣasaṃlāpaparā babhūva śrāntā bhavasyārdhatanau sulagnā cikṣepa ca svedajalaṃ karāgraiḥ
verses.translation: Addressed thus by Hara, his beloved became absorbed in embraces and tender talk; weary, closely joined in half of Bhava's body, she flicked drops of sweat from her fingertips.

verses.transliteration: tasmād babhūva prathamaṃ sa dharmo lakṣmīr atho dānam atho suvṛṣṭiḥ sattvaṃ susaṃpannadharaṃ sarāṃsi dhānyāni puṣpāṇi phalāni caiva
verses.translation: From that there arose first Dharma, then Lakshmi, then charity, then good rain, goodness, the fertile earth, lakes, grains, flowers and fruits,

verses.translation: things of good fortune, beauty, fine dress, adornments, great medicines, dances, songs, nectar, the Puranas, Shruti and Smriti, statecraft, food and drink,

verses.transliteration: śastrāṇi śāstrāṇi gṛhopayogyāny astrāṇi tīrthāni ca kānanāni iṣṭāni pūrtāni ca maṅgalāni yānāni śubhrābharaṇāsanāni
verses.translation: weapons, sciences, household goods, missiles, tirthas and forests, sacrifices and works of public merit, auspicious things, vehicles, bright ornaments and seats.

verses.translation: From contact with Bhava's body, from laughter, sweat, tender talk and the ways of intimacy, the whole world of moving and unmoving beings arose, free from sin, O Goddess;

verses.transliteration: sukhaṃ prabhūtaṃ ca śubhaṃ ca nityaṃ virāji caitat tava devi bhāvāt tasmāt tu māṃ rakṣa jagajjanitri bhītaṃ bhayebhyo jagatāṃ pradhāne
verses.translation: and abundant happiness and good ever shine forth from your being, O Goddess. So protect me, Mother of the world, foremost of the worlds, for I am afraid of dangers.

verses.transliteration: eke tarkair vimuhyanti līyante tatra cāpare śivaśaktyos tadādvaitaṃ sundaraṃ naumi vigraham
verses.translation: Some are bewildered by reasonings, others are absorbed in it; I praise that beautiful form, the non-duality of Shiva and Shakti."

verses.translation: As he praised thus, Shiva appeared before him:

verses.translation: "What wish do you choose, Hari? Tell me your aim."

verses.translation: Then Vishnu was pleased and said, "What shall I give?" Lord Hari (Indra) said, "Give me a slayer of my enemy."

verses.translation: a man was born from the water, bearing the form of both Shiva and Vishnu, holding discus and trident; he went to Rasatala

verses.translation: and slew the Daitya Mahashani, Indra's enemy. That water-born Abjaka, who is Vrishakapi, became Indra's friend.

verses.sanskrit: नाहम् इन्द्राणि शरणम् ऋते सख्युर् वृषाकपेः वारि वापि हविर् यस्य अग्नेः प्रियकरं सदा
verses.transliteration: nāham indrāṇi śaraṇam ṛte sakhyur vṛṣākapeḥ vāri vāpi havir yasya agneḥ priyakaraṃ sadā
verses.translation: "O Indrani, I have no refuge except my friend Vrishakapi, whose water and oblation are always dear to Agni.

verses.transliteration: nāham anyatra gantāsmi priye cāṅgena te śape tasmān nārhasi māṃ vaktuṃ śaṅkayānyatra bhāmini
verses.translation: I will not go elsewhere, my love; I swear by your body. So you should not speak to me with suspicion of another, passionate one.

verses.transliteration: pativratā priyā me tvaṃ dharme mantre sahāyinī sāpatyā ca kulīnā ca tvatto 'nyā kā priyā mama
verses.translation: You are my beloved, faithful to your husband, my helper in dharma and counsel, a mother, of noble family; who else but you is dear to me?

verses.translation: On your advice I came to the Ganga, the great river, and by the grace of Vishnu, God of gods, wielder of the discus,

verses.transliteration: tathā śivasya devasya prasādāc ca vṛṣākapeḥ jalodbhavāc ca me mitrād abjakāl lokaviśrutāt
verses.translation: and by the grace of the god Shiva, and through my water-born friend Vrishakapi, the world-famed Abjaka,

verses.transliteration: uttīrṇaduḥkhaḥ subhage ita indro 'ham acyutaḥ kiṃ na sādhyaṃ yatra bhāryā bhartṛcittānugāminī
verses.translation: I have crossed beyond sorrow, fortunate one; from now on I am Indra, unshaken. What cannot be achieved where the wife follows her husband's mind?

verses.sanskrit: दुष्करा तत्र नो मुक्तिः किंत्व् अर्थादित्रयं शुभे जायैव परमं मित्रं लोकद्वयहितैषिणी
verses.transliteration: duṣkarā tatra no muktiḥ kiṃtv arthāditrayaṃ śubhe jāyaiva paramaṃ mitraṃ lokadvayahitaiṣiṇī
verses.translation: Even liberation is not hard to gain there, let alone wealth and the other two aims, auspicious one. The wife alone is the supreme friend, seeking one's good in both worlds.

verses.transliteration: sā cet kulīnā priyabhāṣiṇī ca pativratā rūpavatī guṇāḍhyā saṃpatsu cāpatsu samānarūpā tayā hy asādhyaṃ kim iha trilokyām
verses.translation: If she is of good family, sweet-spoken, faithful, beautiful, rich in virtues, and the same in prosperity and adversity, what in the three worlds is impossible with her?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tasmāt tava dhiyā kānte mamedaṃ śubham āgatam itas tavoditaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ nānyad asti me
verses.translation: So through your wisdom, beloved, this good has come to me; from now on what you say shall be done — I have no other course.

verses.sanskrit: परलोके च धर्मे च सत्पुत्रसदृशं न च आर्तस्य पुरुषस्येह भार्यावद् भेषजं नहि
verses.transliteration: paraloke ca dharme ca satputrasadṛśaṃ na ca ārtasya puruṣasyeha bhāryāvad bheṣajaṃ nahi
verses.translation: For the next world and for dharma there is nothing like a good son; and for a man in distress here there is no medicine like a wife.

verses.sanskrit: निःश्रेयसपदप्राप्त्यै तथा पापस्य मुक्तये गङ्गया सदृशं नास्ति शृणु चान्यद् वरानने
verses.transliteration: niḥśreyasapadaprāptyai tathā pāpasya muktaye gaṅgayā sadṛśaṃ nāsti śṛṇu cānyad varānane
verses.translation: For reaching the highest good and for release from sin there is nothing like the Ganga; hear something more, fair-faced one:

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां प्राप्तये पापमुक्तये शिवविष्ण्वोर् अनन्यत्वज्ञानान् नास्त्य् अत्र मुक्तये
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāptaye pāpamuktaye śivaviṣṇvor ananyatvajñānān nāsty atra muktaye
verses.translation: for gaining dharma, wealth, pleasure and liberation and for release from sin, there is nothing here that liberates like knowing that Shiva and Vishnu are not different.

verses.transliteration: tasmāt tava dhiyā sādhvi sarvam etan manogatam avāptaṃ ca śivād viṣṇor gaṅgāyāś ca prasādataḥ
verses.translation: So through your wisdom, virtuous one, all that was in my mind has been attained by the grace of Shiva, Vishnu and the Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रत्वं मे स्थिरं चेतो मन्ये मित्रबलात् पुनः वृषाकपिर् मम सखा यो जातस् त्व् अप्सु भामिनि
verses.transliteration: indratvaṃ me sthiraṃ ceto manye mitrabalāt punaḥ vṛṣākapir mama sakhā yo jātas tv apsu bhāmini
verses.translation: I think my Indra-hood is secure again through the strength of my friend: Vrishakapi, who was born in the waters, is my companion, passionate one,
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: त्वं च प्रियसखी नित्यं नान्यत् प्रियतरं मम तीर्थानां गौतमी गङ्गा देवानां हरिशंकरौ
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ ca priyasakhī nityaṃ nānyat priyataraṃ mama tīrthānāṃ gautamī gaṅgā devānāṃ hariśaṃkarau
verses.translation: and you are ever my dear friend; nothing is dearer to me. Among tirthas the Gautami Ganga, among gods Hari and Shankara —
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एभ्यः प्रसादेन सर्वं चेप्सितम् आप्तवान् मम प्रीतिकरं चेदं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād ebhyaḥ prasādena sarvaṃ cepsitam āptavān mama prītikaraṃ cedaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
verses.translation: by their grace I have obtained all I wished; and this tirtha, famed in the three worlds, gives me joy.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् एतद् धि याचिष्ये देवान् सर्वान् अनुक्रमात् अनुमन्यन्तु ऋषयो गङ्गा च हरिशंकरौ
verses.transliteration: tasmād etad dhi yāciṣye devān sarvān anukramāt anumanyantu ṛṣayo gaṅgā ca hariśaṃkarau
verses.translation: So I shall ask this of all the gods in turn; let the sages, the Ganga, and Hari and Shankara consent:
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: indreśvare cābjake ca ubhayos tīrayoḥ surāḥ ekatra śaṃkaro devo hy aparatra janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: at Indreshvara and Abjaka on the two banks, O gods, let the god Shankara stand on one side and Janardana on the other —

verses.sanskrit: पावयन् दण्डकारण्यं साक्षाद् विष्णुस् त्रिविक्रमः अन्तरे यानि तीर्थानि सर्वपुण्यप्रदानि च
verses.transliteration: pāvayan daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ sākṣād viṣṇus trivikramaḥ antare yāni tīrthāni sarvapuṇyapradāni ca
verses.translation: Vishnu Trivikrama himself, purifying the Dandaka forest. And the tirthas that lie between, granting all merit —
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: atra tu snānamātreṇa sarve te muktim āpnuyuḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpato muktim āpnuyur ye ca dharmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: by merely bathing here may all attain liberation; may the most sinful be freed from sin, and may the righteous

verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu paramā muktiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ atra kiṃcic ca ye dadyur arthibhyas tilamātrakam
verses.translation: attain supreme liberation along with five generations of ancestors on each side. Whatever those here give to supplicants, even the size of a sesame seed,

verses.sanskrit: दातृभ्यो ह्य् अक्षयं तत् स्यात् कामदं मोक्षदं तथा धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् आरोग्यं पुण्यवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: dātṛbhyo hy akṣayaṃ tat syāt kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ārogyaṃ puṇyavardhanam
verses.translation: may it be imperishable for the givers, granting desires and liberation. This story of Vishnu and Shambhu brings blessing, fame, long life, health and increase of merit,

verses.transliteration: ākhyānaṃ viṣṇuśaṃbhvoś ca jñātvā snānāc ca muktidam asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca
verses.translation: and, when known, liberation through bathing. Those who hear and recite the greatness of this tirtha

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यभाजो भवेयुस् ते तेभ्यो ऽत्रैव स्मृतिर् भवेत् शिवविष्ण्वोर् अशेषाघसंघविच्छेदकारिणी यां प्रार्थयन्ति मुनयो विजितेन्द्रियमानसाः
verses.transliteration: puṇyabhājo bhaveyus te tebhyo 'traiva smṛtir bhavet śivaviṣṇvor aśeṣāghasaṃghavicchedakāriṇī yāṃ prārthayanti munayo vijitendriyamānasāḥ
verses.translation: shall share in merit, and here itself shall gain the remembrance of Shiva and Vishnu that cuts away the whole mass of sin, which sages who have mastered their senses and minds pray for."

verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyaty evam eveti taṃ devā ṛṣayo 'bruvan gautamyā uttare pāre tīrthānāṃ mokṣadāyinām
verses.translation: "So it shall be," the gods and sages told him. On the northern bank of the Gautami there are tirthas that grant liberation,

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षिसिद्धसेव्यानां सहस्राण्य् अथ सप्त वै तथैव दक्षिणे तीरे तीर्थान्य् एकादशैव तु
verses.transliteration: devarṣisiddhasevyānāṃ sahasrāṇy atha sapta vai tathaiva dakṣiṇe tīre tīrthāny ekādaśaiva tu
verses.translation: served by gods, sages and Siddhas, seven thousand in number; and on the southern bank likewise there are eleven thousand tirthas.

verses.sanskrit: अब्जकं हृदयं प्रोक्तं गोदावर्या मुनीश्वरैः विश्रामस्थानम् ईशस्य विष्णोर् ब्रह्मण एव च
verses.transliteration: abjakaṃ hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ godāvaryā munīśvaraiḥ viśrāmasthānam īśasya viṣṇor brahmaṇa eva ca
verses.translation: The great sages call Abjaka the heart of the Godavari, the resting place of Isha, Vishnu and Brahma.

verses.transliteration: āpastambam iti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam smaraṇād apy aśeṣāghasaṃghavidhvaṃsanakṣamam
verses.translation: Hence, O sage, describe in detail the; Yoga that bestows salvation. O most excellent one among the bipeds, we wish to hear about Samkhya too.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्बो महाप्राज्ञो मुनिर् आसीन् महायशाः तस्य भार्याक्षसूत्रेति पतिधर्मपरायणा
verses.transliteration: āpastambo mahāprājño munir āsīn mahāyaśāḥ tasya bhāryākṣasūtreti patidharmaparāyaṇā
verses.translation: O brahmin, how does an intelligent brahmin, well versed in the Vedas, one who is the performer of sacrifices, an intelligent devotee devoid of jealousy, one whose mind dwells on truth and virtue, attain Brahman?
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, how does an intelligent brahmin, well versed in the Vedas, one who is the performer of sacrifices, an intelligent devotee devoid of jealousy, one whose mind dwells on truth and virtue, attain Brahman?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो महाप्राज्ञः कर्किनामाथ तत्त्ववित् तस्याश्रमम् अनुप्राप्तो ह्य् अगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro mahāprājñaḥ karkināmātha tattvavit tasyāśramam anuprāpto hy agastyo munisattamaḥ
verses.translation: Does he attain it by performing austerities, or by living a celibate life, or by renouncing everything, or by means of his intellect, or by resorting to thought propounded by Samkhya or Yoga? On being asked this, please tell us.

verses.sanskrit: तम् अगस्त्यं पूजयित्वा आपस्तम्बो मुनीश्वरः शिष्यैर् अनुगतो धीमांस् तं प्रष्टुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tam agastyaṃ pūjayitvā āpastambo munīśvaraḥ śiṣyair anugato dhīmāṃs taṃ praṣṭum upacakrame
verses.translation: By what means does a man attain concentration of mind and control over senses? It behoves you to explain this.
verses.commentary: Sense: By what means does a man attain concentration of mind and control over senses? It behoves you to explain this.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणां को नु पूज्यः स्याद् देवानां मुनिसत्तम भुक्तिर् मुक्तिश् च कस्माद् वा स्याद् अनादिश् च को भवेत्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāṃ ko nu pūjyaḥ syād devānāṃ munisattama bhuktir muktiś ca kasmād vā syād anādiś ca ko bhavet
verses.translation: No one achieves (spiritual attainment) without know¬ ledge and austerity, without subduing the sense organs or with¬ out renouncing everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one achieves (spiritual attainment) without know¬ ledge and austerity, without subduing the sense organs or with¬ out renouncing everything.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तश् चापि को विप्र देवानाम् अपि दैवतम् यज्ञैः क इज्यते देवः को वेदेष्व् अनुगीयते एतं मे संशयं छेत्तुं वदागस्त्य महामुने
verses.transliteration: anantaś cāpi ko vipra devānām api daivatam yajñaiḥ ka ijyate devaḥ ko vedeṣv anugīyate etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chettuṃ vadāgastya mahāmune
verses.translation: All the major elements are the earlier creation of the self-born lord. They are fixed into the bodies of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the major elements are the earlier creation of the self-born lord. They are fixed into the bodies of all living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां प्रमाणं शब्द उच्यते तत्रापि वैदिकः शब्दः प्रमाणं परमं मतः
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ śabda ucyate tatrāpi vaidikaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ mataḥ
verses.translation: The deities presiding over the various parts of the body are: Visnu at the time of departure, Indra over the physical strength, the Fire-god in the bowels, the interstices of quarters over the ears, Sarasvati, goddess of speech, over the ears and the tongue.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities presiding over the various parts of the body are: Visnu at the time of departure, Indra over the physical strength, the Fire-god in the bowels, the interstices of quarters over the ears, Sarasvati, goddess of speech, over the ears and the tongue.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदेन गीयते यस् तु पुरुषः स परात् परः मृतो ऽपरः स विज्ञेयो ह्य् अमृतः पर उच्यते
verses.transliteration: vedena gīyate yas tu puruṣaḥ sa parāt paraḥ mṛto 'paraḥ sa vijñeyo hy amṛtaḥ para ucyate
verses.translation: The following are eternally present in the physical bodies of the embodied beings: sense-organs, objects of senses, intrinsic nature, consciousness, mind, vital airs namely Prana and Apana and Jiva (the individual soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are eternally present in the physical bodies of the embodied beings: sense-organs, objects of senses, intrinsic nature, consciousness, mind, vital airs namely Prana and Apana and Jiva (the individual soul).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽमूर्तः स परो ज्ञेयो ह्य् अपरो मूर्त उच्यते गुणाभिव्याप्तिभेदेन मूर्तो ऽसौ त्रिविधो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yo 'mūrtaḥ sa paro jñeyo hy aparo mūrta ucyate guṇābhivyāptibhedena mūrto 'sau trividho bhavet
verses.translation: (?) There is no support unto the Sattva; what is term¬ ed by the word Guna is not the conscious ones. The splendour creates Sattva and by no means the Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (?) There is no support unto the Sattva; what is term¬ ed by the word Guna is not the conscious ones. The splendour creates Sattva and by no means the Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुः शिवश् चेति एक एव त्रिधोच्यते त्रयाणाम् अपि देवानां वेद्यम् एकं परं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaś ceti eka eva tridhocyate trayāṇām api devānāṃ vedyam ekaṃ paraṃ hi tat
verses.translation: It cannot be perceived by the eye nor by the sense- organs. It is by means of the illuminated mind that the higher soul is revealed.
verses.commentary: Sense: It cannot be perceived by the eye nor by the sense- organs. It is by means of the illuminated mind that the higher soul is revealed.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एकस्य बहुधा व्याप्तिर् गुणकर्मविभेदतः लोकानाम् उपकारार्थम् आकृतित्रितयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ekasya bahudhā vyāptir guṇakarmavibhedataḥ lokānām upakārārtham ākṛtitritayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: The soul has no region. Even Devas seeking the region of the soul that is the inner soul of all living beings and is devoted to the welfare of all living beings, become deluded on the way.
verses.commentary: Sense: The soul has no region. Even Devas seeking the region of the soul that is the inner soul of all living beings and is devoted to the welfare of all living beings, become deluded on the way.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस् तत्त्वं वेत्ति परमं स च विद्वान् न चेतरः तत्र यो भेदम् आचष्टे लिङ्गभेदी स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yas tattvaṃ vetti paramaṃ sa ca vidvān na cetaraḥ tatra yo bhedam ācaṣṭe liṅgabhedī sa ucyate
verses.translation: Just as the movement of birds in the sky or that of the fishes in the water is imperceptible, so also the movement of those who have achieved knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the movement of birds in the sky or that of the fishes in the water is imperceptible, so also the movement of those who have achieved knowledge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्यास्ति यश् चैषां व्याहरेद् भिदम् त्रयाणाम् अपि देवानां मूर्तिभेदः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti yaś caiṣāṃ vyāhared bhidam trayāṇām api devānāṃ mūrtibhedaḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: Kala (Time, God of Death) cooks all living beings in the soul by means of the soul. But nobody knows that wherein Kala itself is cooked.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala (Time, God of Death) cooks all living beings in the soul by means of the soul. But nobody knows that wherein Kala itself is cooked.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: वेदाः प्रमाणं सर्वत्र साकारेषु पृथक् पृथक् निराकारं च यत् त्व् एकं तत् तेभ्यः परमं मतम्
verses.transliteration: vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvatra sākāreṣu pṛthak pṛthak nirākāraṃ ca yat tv ekaṃ tat tebhyaḥ paramaṃ matam
verses.translation: It has hands and feet all around; it has eyes, head and face all around; it has ears all around; it stands up enveloping everything in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has hands and feet all around; it has eyes, head and face all around; it has ears all around; it stands up enveloping everything in the world.

verses.sanskrit: नानेन निर्णयः कश्चिन् मयात्र विदितो भवेत् तत्राप्य् अत्र रहस्यं यत् तद् विमृश्याशु कीर्त्यताम् निःसंशयं निर्विकल्पं भाजनं सर्वसंपदाम्
verses.transliteration: nānena nirṇayaḥ kaścin mayātra vidito bhavet tatrāpy atra rahasyaṃ yat tad vimṛśyāśu kīrtyatām niḥsaṃśayaṃ nirvikalpaṃ bhājanaṃ sarvasaṃpadām
verses.translation: There are two states of the Atman, viz. the im¬ perishable and the perishable. The perishable one is in all liv¬ ing beings; the imperishable is divine and immortal.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are two states of the Atman, viz. the im¬ perishable and the perishable. The perishable one is in all liv¬ ing beings; the imperishable is divine and immortal.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: एतद् आकर्ण्य भगवान् अगस्त्यो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: etad ākarṇya bhagavān agastyo vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: The Hamsa(swan, here the soul) builds for itself a city with nine gates (i.e, the body with nine doors, viz. eye$ etc.). He controls it invariably. He is like this in regard to all living beings, whether mobile or immobile.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Hamsa(swan, here the soul) builds for itself a city with nine gates (i.e, the body with nine doors, viz. eye$ etc.). He controls it invariably. He is like this in regard to all living beings, whether mobile or immobile.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यप्य् एषां न भेदो ऽस्ति देवानां तु परस्परम् तथापि सर्वसिद्धिः स्याच् छिवाद् एव सुखात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yadyapy eṣāṃ na bhedo 'sti devānāṃ tu parasparam tathāpi sarvasiddhiḥ syāc chivād eva sukhātmanaḥ
verses.translation: You had' asked me, O brahmins, and so Samkhya which is combined with perfect knowledge has been duly and truthfully recounted by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: You had' asked me, O brahmins, and so Samkhya which is combined with perfect knowledge has been duly and truthfully recounted by me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: प्रपञ्चस्य निमित्तं यत् तज् ज्योतिश् च परं शिवः तम् एव साधय हरं भक्त्या परमया मुने गौतम्यां सकलाघौघसंहर्ता दण्डके वने
verses.transliteration: prapañcasya nimittaṃ yat taj jyotiś ca paraṃ śivaḥ tam eva sādhaya haraṃ bhaktyā paramayā mune gautamyāṃ sakalāghaughasaṃhartā daṇḍake vane
verses.translation: He shall not be too delighted for a gain nor be worried for a loss. He shall be impartial to all living beings. He shall thus be one having properties similar to those of the
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not be too delighted for a gain nor be worried for a loss. He shall be impartial to all living beings. He shall thus be one having properties similar to those of the

verses.sanskrit: एतच् छ्रुत्वा मुनेर् वाक्यं परां प्रीतिम् उपागतः भुक्तिदो मुक्तिदः पुंसां साकारो ऽथ निराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: etac chrutvā muner vākyaṃ parāṃ prītim upāgataḥ bhuktido muktidaḥ puṃsāṃ sākāro 'tha nirākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Within six months, Brahman approaches that devotee whose soul has become healthy and normal, who views every¬ thing impartially, who has become virtuous and perfect and who is perpetually engaged in Yogic practice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within six months, Brahman approaches that devotee whose soul has become healthy and normal, who views every¬ thing impartially, who has become virtuous and perfect and who is perpetually engaged in Yogic practice.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्याकारस् ततः शक्तः पालनाकार एव च दाता च हन्ति सर्वं यो यस्माद् एतत् समाप्यते
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭyākāras tataḥ śaktaḥ pālanākāra eva ca dātā ca hanti sarvaṃ yo yasmād etat samāpyate
verses.translation: (Thus) the Yogin is in a position to view a clod of earth, a piece of rock and an ingot of gold impartially. On seeing others distressed due to pain he shall not be deluded nor shall he swerve from his path.

verses.transliteration: brahmākṛtiḥ kartṛrūpā vaiṣṇavī pālanī tathā rudrākṛtir nihantrī sā sarvavedeṣu paṭhyate
verses.translation: Even a man of very low caste or a woman desirous of

verses.sanskrit: आपस्तम्बस् तदा गङ्गां गत्वा स्नात्वा यतव्रतः तुष्टाव शंकरं देवं स्तोत्रेणानेन नारद
verses.transliteration: āpastambas tadā gaṅgāṃ gatvā snātvā yatavrataḥ tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ stotreṇānena nārada
verses.translation: On seeing this unborn, ancient, unageing, eternal

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठेषु वह्निः कुसुमेषु गन्धो बीजेषु वृक्षादि दृषत्सु हेम भूतेषु सर्वेषु तथास्ति यो वै तं सोमनाथं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭheṣu vahniḥ kusumeṣu gandho bījeṣu vṛkṣādi dṛṣatsu hema bhūteṣu sarveṣu tathāsti yo vai taṃ somanāthaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: "He who is present as fire in wood, fragrance in flowers, the tree in its seed, gold in stone, and likewise in all beings — to that Somanatha I go for refuge.

verses.sanskrit: यो लीलया विश्वम् इदं चकार धाता विधाता भुवनत्रयस्य यो विश्वरूपः सदसत्परो यः सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yo līlayā viśvam idaṃ cakāra dhātā vidhātā bhuvanatrayasya yo viśvarūpaḥ sadasatparo yaḥ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: He who in play made this universe, the creator and ordainer of the three worlds, whose form is the universe and who is beyond being and non-being — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यं स्मृत्य दारिद्र्यमहाभिशाप रोगादिभिर् न स्पृश्यते शरीरी यम् आश्रिताश् चेप्सितम् आप्नुवन्ति सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yaṃ smṛtya dāridryamahābhiśāpa rogādibhir na spṛśyate śarīrī yam āśritāś cepsitam āpnuvanti someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: Remembering whom an embodied being is untouched by poverty, great curses, disease and the like, and resorting to whom people gain what they desire — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.

verses.sanskrit: येन त्रयीधर्मम् अवेक्ष्य पूर्वं ब्रह्मादयस् तत्र समीहिताश् च एवं द्विधा येन कृतं शरीरं सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yena trayīdharmam avekṣya pūrvaṃ brahmādayas tatra samīhitāś ca evaṃ dvidhā yena kṛtaṃ śarīraṃ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: He who in the beginning, considering the dharma of the three Vedas, set Brahma and the others to their tasks, and who thus made his body twofold — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मै नमो गच्छति मन्त्रपूतं हुतं हविर् या च कृता च पूजा दत्तं हविर् येन सुरा भजन्ते सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yasmai namo gacchati mantrapūtaṃ hutaṃ havir yā ca kṛtā ca pūjā dattaṃ havir yena surā bhajante someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: To whom goes every salutation, every oblation purified by mantras and every act of worship; by whom the gods receive the offerings given — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् परं नान्यद् अस्ति प्रशस्तं यस्मात् परं नैव सुसूक्ष्मम् अन्यत् यस्मात् परं नो महतां महच् च सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yasmāt paraṃ nānyad asti praśastaṃ yasmāt paraṃ naiva susūkṣmam anyat yasmāt paraṃ no mahatāṃ mahac ca someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: Beyond whom there is nothing more excellent, beyond whom there is nothing subtler, beyond whom there is nothing greater than the great — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्याज्ञया विश्वम् इदं विचित्रम् अचिन्त्यरूपं विविधं महच् च एकक्रियं यद्वद् अनुप्रयाति सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yasyājñayā viśvam idaṃ vicitram acintyarūpaṃ vividhaṃ mahac ca ekakriyaṃ yadvad anuprayāti someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: By whose command this wondrous universe, of inconceivable form, manifold and vast, moves as if by a single act — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् विभूतिः सकलाधिपत्यं कर्तृत्वदातृत्वमहत्त्वम् एव प्रीतिर् यशः सौख्यम् अनादिधर्मः सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: yasmin vibhūtiḥ sakalādhipatyaṃ kartṛtvadātṛtvamahattvam eva prītir yaśaḥ saukhyam anādidharmaḥ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: In whom are glory, lordship over all, the greatness of creator and giver, love, fame, happiness and beginningless dharma — to that Someshvara I go for refuge.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं शरण्यः सकलस्य पूज्यो नित्यं प्रियो यः शरणागतस्य नित्यं शिवो यः सकलस्य रूपं सोमेश्वरं तं शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ śaraṇyaḥ sakalasya pūjyo nityaṃ priyo yaḥ śaraṇāgatasya nityaṃ śivo yaḥ sakalasya rūpaṃ someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: Who is ever the refuge of all and worthy of worship, ever dear to those who seek refuge, ever auspicious, the form of all — to that Someshvara I go for refuge."
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān āha nārada taṃ munim ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca āpastambo 'bravīc chivam
verses.translation: Then the Lord, pleased, spoke to that sage, O Narada; and Apastamba spoke to Shiva for his own sake and for others':

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् आप्नुयुस् ते ये स्नात्वा देवम् ईश्वरम् पश्येयुर् जगताम् ईशम् अस्त्व् इत्य् आह शिवो मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān āpnuyus te ye snātvā devam īśvaram paśyeyur jagatām īśam astv ity āha śivo munim
verses.translation: "May those who bathe and behold the god, the Lord of the worlds, obtain all their desires." "So be it," Shiva told the sage.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थम् आपस्तम्बम् उदाहृतम् अनाद्य् अविद्यातिमिरव्रातनिर्मूलनक्षमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrtham āpastambam udāhṛtam anādy avidyātimiravrātanirmūlanakṣamam
verses.translation: From then on that tirtha has been called Apastamba, able to uproot the dense darkness of beginningless ignorance.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
