verses.sanskrit: यमतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं पितॄणां प्रीतिवर्धनम् अशेषपापशमनं तत्र वृत्तम् इदं शृणु
verses.transliteration: yamatīrtham iti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam aśeṣapāpaśamanaṃ tatra vṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: Should the Vedic injunction be "Perform rites and renounce them"? Whither do they go by means of Vidya(learn¬ ing), and what do they attain by means of holy rites?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.commentary: Sense: Should the Vedic injunction be "Perform rites and renounce them"? Whither do they go by means of Vidya(learn¬ ing), and what do they attain by means of holy rites?

verses.sanskrit: तत्राख्यानम् इदं त्व् आसीद् इतिहासं पुरातनम् सरमेति प्रसिद्धास्ति नाम्ना देवशुनी मुने
verses.transliteration: tatrākhyānam idaṃ tv āsīd itihāsaṃ purātanam sarameti prasiddhāsti nāmnā devaśunī mune
verses.translation: We wish to hear this. Your Holiness may be pleased to explain it to us. There is a mutual inconsistency in this (in¬ junction) because both are opposed to each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: We wish to hear this. Your Holiness may be pleased to explain it to us. There is a mutual inconsistency in this (in¬ junction) because both are opposed to each other.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुत्रौ महाश्रेष्ठौ श्वानौ नित्यं जनान् अनु गामिनौ पवनाहारौ चतुरक्षौ यमप्रियौ
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ putrau mahāśreṣṭhau śvānau nityaṃ janān anu gāminau pavanāhārau caturakṣau yamapriyau
verses.translation: Listen, O leading sages, I shall briefly explain the Ksara (perishable) and Aksara (imperishable) in the form of holy rites and (knowledge) about which you have asked me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O leading sages, I shall briefly explain the Ksara (perishable) and Aksara (imperishable) in the form of holy rites and (knowledge) about which you have asked me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गा रक्षति स्म देवानां यज्ञार्थं कल्पितान् पशून् रक्षन्तीम् अनुजग्मुस् ते राक्षसा दैत्यदानवाः
verses.transliteration: gā rakṣati sma devānāṃ yajñārthaṃ kalpitān paśūn rakṣantīm anujagmus te rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ
verses.translation: Listen now, O brahmins, to the quarter whither they go by means of learning and what they attain by means of holy rites. The reply to this (question) is intricate and complex.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen now, O brahmins, to the quarter whither they go by means of learning and what they attain by means of holy rites. The reply to this (question) is intricate and complex.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन्तीं तां महाप्राज्ञाः श्वानयोर् मातरं शुनीम् प्रलोभयित्वा विविधैर् वाक्यैर् दानैश् च यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: rakṣantīṃ tāṃ mahāprājñāḥ śvānayor mātaraṃ śunīm pralobhayitvā vividhair vākyair dānaiś ca yatnataḥ
verses.translation: There are the two paths wherein the Vedas are well- founded. Dharma is characterised by Pravrtti (Activity, taking active part in worldly life). The other alternative is Nivjrtti (cessation of active participation).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are the two paths wherein the Vedas are well- founded. Dharma is characterised by Pravrtti (Activity, taking active part in worldly life). The other alternative is Nivjrtti (cessation of active participation).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: हृता गा राक्षसैः पापैः पश्वर्थे कल्पिताः शुभाः तत आगत्य सा देवान् इदम् आह क्रमाच् छुनी
verses.transliteration: hṛtā gā rākṣasaiḥ pāpaiḥ paśvarthe kalpitāḥ śubhāḥ tata āgatya sā devān idam āha kramāc chunī
verses.translation: On account of activity (i.e. by performing various rites) one is reborn after death into an embodied form consist-
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of activity (i.e. by performing various rites) one is reborn after death into an embodied form consist-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: मां बद्ध्वा राक्षसैः पाशैस् ताडयित्वा प्रहारकैः नीता गा यज्ञसिद्ध्यर्थं कल्पिताः पशवः सुराः
verses.transliteration: māṃ baddhvā rākṣasaiḥ pāśais tāḍayitvā prahārakaiḥ nītā gā yajñasiddhyarthaṃ kalpitāḥ paśavaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Those.possessed of inferior intellect praise Karman (performance of holy rites). Thereby they attain a series of bodies to indulge themselves in. They then perform worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those.possessed of inferior intellect praise Karman (performance of holy rites). Thereby they attain a series of bodies to indulge themselves in. They then perform worship.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तस्या वाचं निशम्याशु सुरान् प्राह बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: tasyā vācaṃ niśamyāśu surān prāha bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: Those who have acquired the highest intellect, those who perceive the efficiency of Dharma do not praise Karman, like one who drinks the river water and so does not praise the well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have acquired the highest intellect, those who perceive the efficiency of Dharma do not praise Karman, like one who drinks the river water and so does not praise the well.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: इयं विकृतरूपास्ते अस्याः पापं च लक्षये अस्या मतेन ता गावो नीता नान्येन हेतुना पापेयं सुकृतीवेति लक्ष्यते देहचेष्टितैः
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ vikṛtarūpāste asyāḥ pāpaṃ ca lakṣaye asyā matena tā gāvo nītā nānyena hetunā pāpeyaṃ sukṛtīveti lakṣyate dehaceṣṭitaiḥ
verses.translation: One attains happiness and misery, birth and non-birth as a result of Karmans. By learning one attains that after reaching which one never feels sorry.
verses.commentary: Sense: One attains happiness and misery, birth and non-birth as a result of Karmans. By learning one attains that after reaching which one never feels sorry.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तद् गुरोर् वचनाच् छक्रः पदा तां प्राहरच् छुनीम् पदाघातात् तदा तस्या मुखात् क्षीरं प्रसुस्रुवे
verses.transliteration: tad guror vacanāc chakraḥ padā tāṃ prāharac chunīm padāghātāt tadā tasyā mukhāt kṣīraṃ prasusruve
verses.translation: After going there one does not die; after going there
verses.commentary: Sense: After going there one does not die; after going there
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनः प्राह शचीभर्ता क्षीरं पीतं त्वया शुनि राक्षसैश् च तदा दत्तं तस्मान् नीतास् तु गा मम
verses.transliteration: punaḥ prāha śacībhartā kṣīraṃ pītaṃ tvayā śuni rākṣasaiś ca tadā dattaṃ tasmān nītās tu gā mama
verses.translation: Those who are impartial to all, those who are friendly
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are impartial to all, those who are friendly
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: नापराधो ऽस्ति मे नाथ न चान्यस्यापि कस्यचित् नापराधो न चोपेक्षा ममास्ति त्रिदशेश्वर तस्माद् रुष्टो ऽसि किं नाथ रिपवो बलिनस् तु ते
verses.transliteration: nāparādho 'sti me nātha na cānyasyāpi kasyacit nāparādho na copekṣā mamāsti tridaśeśvara tasmād ruṣṭo 'si kiṃ nātha ripavo balinas tu te
verses.translation: The creatures of Prakrti are known as (individual soul). They do not comprehend him nor does he know them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creatures of Prakrti are known as (individual soul). They do not comprehend him nor does he know them.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यात्वा देवगुरुर् ज्ञात्वा तस्या विचेष्टितम् सत्यं शक्र त्व् इयं दुष्टा रिपूणां पक्षकारिणी
verses.transliteration: tato dhyātvā devagurur jñātvā tasyā viceṣṭitam satyaṃ śakra tv iyaṃ duṣṭā ripūṇāṃ pakṣakāriṇī
verses.translation: The individual soul performs his activities through the sense organs, with the mind as the sixth among them, just as the sober charioteer manages his chariot by means of superb well- controlled horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The individual soul performs his activities through the sense organs, with the mind as the sixth among them, just as the sober charioteer manages his chariot by means of superb well- controlled horses.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः शशाप तां शक्रः पापिष्ठे त्वं शुनी भव मर्त्यलोके पापभूता अज्ञानात् पापकारिणी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaśāpa tāṃ śakraḥ pāpiṣṭhe tvaṃ śunī bhava martyaloke pāpabhūtā ajñānāt pāpakāriṇī
verses.translation: By means of clearness of his mind the ascetic eschews the auspicious and inauspicious. One whose soul is pleased abides in the Atman and attains everlasting bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of clearness of his mind the ascetic eschews the auspicious and inauspicious. One whose soul is pleased abides in the Atman and attains everlasting bliss.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदेन्द्रस्य तु शापेन मानुषे सा व्यजायत यथा शप्ता मघवता पापात् सा ह्य् अतिभीषणा
verses.transliteration: tadendrasya tu śāpena mānuṣe sā vyajāyata yathā śaptā maghavatā pāpāt sā hy atibhīṣaṇā
verses.translation: Even if the whole of the earth filled with all jewels were offered against this, a man who knows reality shall con¬ sider this (knowledge) better than that.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if the whole of the earth filled with all jewels were offered against this, a man who knows reality shall con¬ sider this (knowledge) better than that.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गावो या राक्षसैर् नीतास् तासाम् आनयनाय च यत्नं कुर्वन् सुरपतिर् विष्णवे तन् न्यवेदयत्
verses.transliteration: gāvo yā rākṣasair nītās tāsām ānayanāya ca yatnaṃ kurvan surapatir viṣṇave tan nyavedayat
verses.translation: Describe once detail, O holy one, the can fully understand it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Describe once detail, O holy one, the can fully understand it.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुर् दैत्यांश् च दनुजान् गोहर्तॄंश् चैव राक्षसान् हन्तुं प्रयत्नम् अकरोज् जगृहे च महद् धनुः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇur daityāṃś ca danujān gohartṝṃś caiva rākṣasān hantuṃ prayatnam akaroj jagṛhe ca mahad dhanuḥ
verses.translation: The great elements are the Earth, Water, Fire (light) Air and Ether. He who is the creator of these elements is with- in all the living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great elements are the Earth, Water, Fire (light) Air and Ether. He who is the creator of these elements is with- in all the living beings.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शार्ङ्गं यल् लोकविख्यातं दैत्यनाशनम् एव च जितारिः पूजितो देवैः स्वयं स्थित्वा जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: śārṅgaṃ yal lokavikhyātaṃ daityanāśanam eva ca jitāriḥ pūjito devaiḥ svayaṃ sthitvā janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Sound, ear, void space—these there are the traits of Ether. Vital airs, movement and touch are the qualities of Vayu (Air).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound, ear, void space—these there are the traits of Ether. Vital airs, movement and touch are the qualities of Vayu (Air).
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वै दण्डकारण्ये शार्ङ्गपाणिर् जगत्प्रभुः तत्रस्थान् दैत्यदनुजान् राक्षसांश् च बलीयसः
verses.transliteration: yatra vai daṇḍakāraṇye śārṅgapāṇir jagatprabhuḥ tatrasthān daityadanujān rākṣasāṃś ca balīyasaḥ
verses.translation: Colour, eye and gastric action (digestion)—the fiery element is threefold thus. Taste, tongue, sweet—are the quali¬ ties of Water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Colour, eye and gastric action (digestion)—the fiery element is threefold thus. Taste, tongue, sweet—are the quali¬ ties of Water.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् जघ्ने स वै विष्णुर् गा यैर् नीताश् च राक्षसैः तत्र वै दण्डकारण्ये शार्ङ्गपाणिर् इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: punar jaghne sa vai viṣṇur gā yair nītāś ca rākṣasaiḥ tatra vai daṇḍakāraṇye śārṅgapāṇir iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: The quality of touch belongs to the Wind; the quality of taste to Water; the quality of colour to Fiery element; the quality of sound to Ether and the quality of smell is that of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The quality of touch belongs to the Wind; the quality of taste to Water; the quality of colour to Fiery element; the quality of sound to Ether and the quality of smell is that of the Earth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: युध्यमानस् ततो विष्णुर् दितिजै राक्षसैः सह ते जग्मुर् दक्षिणाम् आशां विष्णोस् त्रासान् महामुने
verses.transliteration: yudhyamānas tato viṣṇur ditijai rākṣasaiḥ saha te jagmur dakṣiṇām āśāṃ viṣṇos trāsān mahāmune
verses.translation: The mind, intellect and intrinsic nature—are born of their origins. They transcend Gunas; they are greater than Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind, intellect and intrinsic nature—are born of their origins. They transcend Gunas; they are greater than Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अन्वगच्छत् ततो विष्णुस् तान् एव परमेश्वरः गरुत्मता तान् अवाप्य शार्ङ्गमुक्तैर् मनोजवैः
verses.transliteration: anvagacchat tato viṣṇus tān eva parameśvaraḥ garutmatā tān avāpya śārṅgamuktair manojavaiḥ
verses.translation: Just as the turtle stretches and withdraws the limbs, so also he who has excellent intellect controls his set of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the turtle stretches and withdraws the limbs, so also he who has excellent intellect controls his set of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: बाणैस् तान् व्याहनद् विष्णुर् गङ्गाया उत्तरे तटे देवारयः क्षयं नीता विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना
verses.transliteration: bāṇais tān vyāhanad viṣṇur gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe devārayaḥ kṣayaṃ nītā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
verses.translation: The fact that one sees upwards, sideways as well as below the soles of feet indicates that the excellent intellect abides by this duty alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fact that one sees upwards, sideways as well as below the soles of feet indicates that the excellent intellect abides by this duty alone.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: शार्ङ्गमुक्तैर् महावेगैः सुस्वनैश् च सुमन्त्रितैः क्षयं प्राप्ता विष्णुबाणैस् ततस् ते देवशत्रवः
verses.transliteration: śārṅgamuktair mahāvegaiḥ susvanaiś ca sumantritaiḥ kṣayaṃ prāptā viṣṇubāṇais tatas te devaśatravaḥ
verses.translation: There are five sense-organs in man; the sixth is mind; the seventh is intellect; the soul is the eighth.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are five sense-organs in man; the sixth is mind; the seventh is intellect; the soul is the eighth.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: गावो लब्धा यत्र देवैर् बाणतीर्थं तद् उच्यते वैष्णवं लोकविदितं गोतीर्थं चेति विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: gāvo labdhā yatra devair bāṇatīrthaṃ tad ucyate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaviditaṃ gotīrthaṃ ceti viśrutam
verses.translation: The eye perceives; the mind entertains doubt; the in¬ tellect determines; the soul is the witness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eye perceives; the mind entertains doubt; the in¬ tellect determines; the soul is the witness.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पश्वर्थे कल्पिता गावो गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे प्रद्रुतास् ते सुराः सर्वे गङ्गायां संन्यवेशयन्
verses.transliteration: paśvarthe kalpitā gāvo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe pradrutās te surāḥ sarve gaṅgāyāṃ saṃnyaveśayan
verses.translation: Rajas, Tamas and Sattva are born of their respective causes. They are common to all beings. They are Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rajas, Tamas and Sattva are born of their respective causes. They are common to all beings. They are Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये कारयाम् आसुर् द्वीपं चैवाश्रयं गवाम् तैर् गोभिस् तत्र गङ्गायां सुरयज्ञो व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye kārayām āsur dvīpaṃ caivāśrayaṃ gavām tair gobhis tatra gaṅgāyāṃ surayajño vyajāyata
verses.translation: That which one sees within the soul—something which is pleasant and delightful is Sattva. It is something quiescent and calm.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which one sees within the soul—something which is pleasant and delightful is Sattva. It is something quiescent and calm.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञतीर्थं तु तत् प्रोक्तं गोद्वीपं गाङ्गमध्यतः देवानां यजनं तच् च सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: yajñatīrthaṃ tu tat proktaṃ godvīpaṃ gāṅgamadhyataḥ devānāṃ yajanaṃ tac ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: They call the followingSattvika qualities: Extreme de¬ light, pleasure, bliss, mastery over oneself, and normal restful nature of the mind, with or without reasons thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call the followingSattvika qualities: Extreme de¬ light, pleasure, bliss, mastery over oneself, and normal restful nature of the mind, with or without reasons thereof.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं मूर्तिमती भूत्वा गङ्गाशक्तिर् महाद्युते असारापारसंसारसागरोत्तरणे तरिः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ mūrtimatī bhūtvā gaṅgāśaktir mahādyute asārāpārasaṃsārasāgarottaraṇe tariḥ
verses.translation: The following are the symptoms of Rajas: conceit, un¬ truthfulness, covetousness, delusion and impatience.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the symptoms of Rajas: conceit, un¬ truthfulness, covetousness, delusion and impatience.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेश्वरी योगमाया सद्भक्ताभयदायिनी गोरक्षं तु ततस् तीर्थं गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: viśveśvarī yogamāyā sadbhaktābhayadāyinī gorakṣaṃ tu tatas tīrthaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: Similarly, the following are Tamasa qualities: Deluded state, blunders, languor, slumber, inability to be awake. (The people under their influence) live somehow. They do not live a full useful life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the following are Tamasa qualities: Deluded state, blunders, languor, slumber, inability to be awake. (The people under their influence) live somehow. They do not live a full useful life.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तौ श्वानौ सरमापुत्रौ चतुरक्षौ यमप्रियौ मातुः शापं चापराधं सर्वं चापि सविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tau śvānau saramāputrau caturakṣau yamapriyau mātuḥ śāpaṃ cāparādhaṃ sarvaṃ cāpi savistaram
verses.translation: The objects are indeed greater than the sense-organs-
verses.commentary: Sense: The objects are indeed greater than the sense-organs-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य तु यथान्यायं कार्यं चापि सुखप्रदम् विशापकरणं चापि पप्रच्छतुर् उभौ यमम्
verses.transliteration: nivedya tu yathānyāyaṃ kāryaṃ cāpi sukhapradam viśāpakaraṇaṃ cāpi papracchatur ubhau yamam
verses.translation: Inasmuch as the sense-organs are separate it is the in¬ tellect that undergoes aberration. In the act of hearing it be¬ comes the ear and as the organ that touches it is called the sense of touch.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inasmuch as the sense-organs are separate it is the in¬ tellect that undergoes aberration. In the act of hearing it be¬ comes the ear and as the organ that touches it is called the sense of touch.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स ताभ्यां सहितः सौरिः पित्रे सूर्याय चाब्रवीत् श्रुत्वा सूर्यः सुतं प्राह गङ्गायां सुरसत्तम
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṃ sahitaḥ sauriḥ pitre sūryāya cābravīt śrutvā sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāha gaṅgāyāṃ surasattama
verses.translation: In the act of seeing it shall be the eye and in the act of tasting, the tongue, in the act of smelling the nose; the intellect undergoes changes.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the act of seeing it shall be the eye and in the act of tasting, the tongue, in the act of smelling the nose; the intellect undergoes changes.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोकत्रयैकपावन्यां गौतम्यां दण्डके वने श्रद्धया परया वत्स सुस्नातः सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: lokatrayaikapāvanyāṃ gautamyāṃ daṇḍake vane śraddhayā parayā vatsa susnātaḥ susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: They call them the sense-organs. The intellect becomes diffused in those forms. Remaining steady in the state of intellect in a man it is called intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call them the sense-organs. The intellect becomes diffused in those forms. Remaining steady in the state of intellect in a man it is called intellect.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं चैव विष्णुं च माम् ईशं च यथाक्रमम् स्तुहि त्वं सर्वभावेन भृत्यौ प्रीतिम् अवाप्स्यतः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ caiva viṣṇuṃ ca mām īśaṃ ca yathākramam stuhi tvaṃ sarvabhāvena bhṛtyau prītim avāpsyataḥ
verses.translation: When the intellect yearns for and seeks something it becomes the mind. One shall sec them intellectually as separate in their basis.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the intellect yearns for and seeks something it becomes the mind. One shall sec them intellectually as separate in their basis.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत् पितुर् वचनं श्रुत्वा यमः प्रीतमनास् तदा तयोश् च प्रीतये प्रायाद् देवतर्पणयोर् यमः
verses.transliteration: tat pitur vacanaṃ śrutvā yamaḥ prītamanās tadā tayoś ca prītaye prāyād devatarpaṇayor yamaḥ
verses.translation: The sense-organs are based on the intellect. They must be collected entirely (?) in the order in which each is evolved.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sense-organs are based on the intellect. They must be collected entirely (?) in the order in which each is evolved.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: गौतम्याम् अघहारिण्यां सुसमाहितमानसः तथैव तोषयाम् आस गङ्गायां सुरसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: gautamyām aghahāriṇyāṃ susamāhitamānasaḥ tathaiva toṣayām āsa gaṅgāyāṃ surasattamān
verses.translation: Those that abide emotionally in all these three, func¬ tion after the objects like the spokes in regard to the rim.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those that abide emotionally in all these three, func¬ tion after the objects like the spokes in regard to the rim.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वभ्यां च सहितः श्रीमान् दक्षिणाशापतिः प्रभुः ब्रह्माणं तोषयाम् आस भानुं वै दक्षिणे तटे
verses.transliteration: śvabhyāṃ ca sahitaḥ śrīmān dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ prabhuḥ brahmāṇaṃ toṣayām āsa bhānuṃ vai dakṣiṇe taṭe
verses.translation: (?)One shall make use of the mind for the purpose of illumination even N; as the sense-organs are perfected by the intellect (either) moving befittingly or remaining indiffernt.
verses.commentary: Sense: (?)One shall make use of the mind for the purpose of illumination even N; as the sense-organs are perfected by the intellect (either) moving befittingly or remaining indiffernt.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ईशानम् उत्तरे विष्णुं स्वयं धर्मः प्रतापवान् दत्तवन्तो वरं श्रेष्ठं सरमाया विशापकम् वरान् अयाचत बहूंल् लोकानाम् उपकारकान्
verses.transliteration: īśānam uttare viṣṇuṃ svayaṃ dharmaḥ pratāpavān dattavanto varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saramāyā viśāpakam varān ayācata bahūṃl lokānām upakārakān
verses.translation: If only one understands this as natural one does not become deluded. He does not bewail and he is delighted. He is always free from hostility.
verses.commentary: Sense: If only one understands this as natural one does not become deluded. He does not bewail and he is delighted. He is always free from hostility.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: एषु स्नानं तु ये कुर्युर् ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः आत्मार्थं च परार्थं च ते कामान् आप्नुयुः शुभान्
verses.transliteration: eṣu snānaṃ tu ye kuryur brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca te kāmān āpnuyuḥ śubhān
verses.translation: Indeed the soul cannot be perceived by the sense-organs that are subject to lust, that function in diverse ways, that cannot be controlled and that are ignorant and foolish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed the soul cannot be perceived by the sense-organs that are subject to lust, that function in diverse ways, that cannot be controlled and that are ignorant and foolish.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: बाणतीर्थे तु ये स्नात्वा शार्ङ्गपाणिं स्मरन्ति वै तेभ्यो दारिद्र्यदुःखानि न भवेयुर् युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: bāṇatīrthe tu ye snātvā śārṅgapāṇiṃ smaranti vai tebhyo dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyur yuge yuge
verses.translation: When one holds their reins firmly by means of the mind and controls them, the soul reveals itself like a figure illuminated by a lamp.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: gotīrthe brahmatīrthe vā yas tu snātvā yatavrataḥ brahmāṇaṃ taṃ namasyātha dvīpasyāpi pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: Whoever, keeping his vows, bathes at Gotirtha or Brahmatirtha, bows to Brahma there and also circumambulates the island,

verses.transliteration: yaḥ kuryāt tena pṛthivī saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tatra kiṃcid dattvā vasu dvijam
verses.translation: has by that circumambulated the whole earth with its seven continents. Giving a little wealth there to a brahmin,

verses.transliteration: tad devayajanaṃ prāpya kiṃcid dhutvā hutāśane aśvamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam
verses.translation: and reaching that place of divine sacrifice and offering a little into the fire, he obtains in full the fruit of sacrifices such as the horse-sacrifice.

verses.transliteration: yaḥ sakṛt tatra paṭhati gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram adhītās tena vedā vai niṣkāmo muktibhājanam
verses.translation: Whoever recites there even once the Gayatri, mother of the Vedas, has by that studied the Vedas; free from desire, he becomes a vessel of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तु दक्षिणे कूले शक्तिं देवीं तु भक्तितः पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tu dakṣiṇe kūle śaktiṃ devīṃ tu bhaktitaḥ pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Bathing on the southern bank and duly worshipping the goddess Shakti with devotion, one obtains all desires.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां शक्तिर् माता त्रयीमयी सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नोति पुत्रवान् धनवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ śaktir mātā trayīmayī sarvān kāmān avāpnoti putravān dhanavān bhavet
verses.translation: Worshipping Shakti, mother of Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesha, who consists of the three Vedas, one obtains all desires and becomes rich in sons and wealth.

verses.transliteration: ādityaṃ bhaktito yas tu dakṣiṇe niyato naraḥ snātvā paśyeta teneṣṭā yajñā vividhadakṣiṇāḥ
verses.translation: The disciplined man who bathes and devotedly beholds the Sun on the southern bank has thereby performed sacrifices with manifold fees.

verses.transliteration: kūle yaś cottare caiva gaṅgāyā daityasūdanam snātvā paśyeta taṃ natvā tasya viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: And whoever bathes on the northern bank of the Ganga, beholds the slayer of Daityas and bows to him, attains the supreme abode of Vishnu.

verses.transliteration: yameśvaraṃ tato yas tu yamatīrthe tu pūjitam snātaḥ paśyati yuktātmā sa karoty acireṇa hi
verses.translation: Whoever, bathed and self-controlled, then beholds Yameshvara worshipped at Yamatirtha soon brings about

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणाम् अक्षयं पुण्यं फलदं कीर्तिवर्धनम् तत्र स्नानेन दानेन जपेन स्तवनेन च अपि दुष्कृतकर्माणः पितरो मोक्षम् आप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇām akṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ phaladaṃ kīrtivardhanam tatra snānena dānena japena stavanena ca api duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ pitaro mokṣam āpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: imperishable merit for his ancestors, fruitful and increasing fame. By bathing, giving, japa and praise there, even ancestors of wicked deeds attain liberation.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: इत्याद्य् अष्ट सहस्राणि तीर्थानि त्रीणि नारद तेषु स्नानं च दानं च सर्वम् अक्षयपुण्यदम्
verses.transliteration: ityādy aṣṭa sahasrāṇi tīrthāni trīṇi nārada teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvam akṣayapuṇyadam
verses.translation: Thus, O Narada, there are eight thousand and three tirthas; bathing and giving at them all bestows imperishable merit.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां स्मरणं पुण्यं नानाजन्माघनाशनम् श्रवणात् पितृभिः सार्धं पठनात् स्वकुलैः सह
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ smaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nānājanmāghanāśanam śravaṇāt pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ paṭhanāt svakulaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Remembering them is meritorious and destroys the sins of many births; hearing of them purifies one along with one's ancestors, and reciting them along with one's whole family;
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.transliteration: teṣām apy atipāpāni nāśaṃ yānti mamājñayā tatra snānādi yaḥ kṛtvā kiṃcid dattvā yatātmavān
verses.translation: even their great sins are destroyed at my command. Whoever, self-controlled, bathes there, gives a little,

verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi kṛtvā natvā surān imān dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśo vīryam āyur ārogyasaṃpadaḥ
verses.translation: offers rice-balls and the like to the ancestors and bows to these gods, gains wealth, grain, fame, vigour, long life, health and prosperity,

verses.transliteration: putrān pautrān priyāṃ bhāryāṃ labdhvā cānyan manīṣitam aviyuktaḥ prītamanā bandhubhiś cātimānitaḥ
verses.translation: sons, grandsons, a beloved wife and whatever else he desires; never separated from them, glad of heart and greatly honoured by his kin,

verses.transliteration: narakasthān api pitṝṃs tārayitvā kulāni ca pāvayitvā priyair yukto hy ante viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ smaret tato muktipadaṃ gacched devānāṃ vacanaṃ yathā
verses.translation: having delivered even ancestors dwelling in hell and purified his families, he, surrounded by loved ones, remembers Vishnu and Shiva at the end and then goes to the state of liberation, as the gods declared.

verses.transliteration: yakṣiṇīsaṃgamaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sarvaphalapradam tatra snānena dānena sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Sattva creates Gunas and the Ksetrajna presides over them. As though indifferent, the lord presides over them. Some are of this firm opinion: Those who have started functioning do not stop the same; (the fact is) the

verses.transliteration: yatra yakṣeśvaro devo darśanād bhuktimuktidaḥ tatra ca snānamātreṇa sattrayāgaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: One should ponder over these two and come to a deci- sion in accordance with one's intellect. Of course, in this manner a great doubt may occur. Indeed the Atman has neither birth nor death. A man shall sport about after realizing it. He should never be angry nor too delighted. He shall be free from enmity and jealousy.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वावसोः स्वसा नाम्ना पिप्पला गुरुहासिनी ऋषीणां सत्त्रम् अगमद् गौतमीतीरवर्तिनाम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāvasoḥ svasā nāmnā pippalā guruhāsinī ṛṣīṇāṃ sattram agamad gautamītīravartinām
verses.translation: The enlightened ones do not have to face the great fear that the unenlightened ones have to after death in the other world. No one has a greater status than the eternal one which the enlightened one has. If one performs Karmans without yearning for benefit, it burns away sins. If actions are performed with pleasure or hatred as motives the same is the result of his actions. May Your Holiness be pleased to tell us that most excellent virtue than which there is no greater virtue and that which is greater than all valuable things.
verses.wordMeaning: The enlightened ones do not have to face the great fear that the unenlightened ones have to after death in the other world. No one has a greater status than the eternal one which the enlightened one has. If one performs Karmans without yearning for benefit, it burns away sins.…

verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tatra ṛṣīn kṣāmān sā jahāsātigarvitā yā gatvāśrāvaya vauṣaḍ astu śrauṣaḍ iti sthiram
verses.translation: I shall recount the ancient virtue eulogised bv the sages, which is the most excellent of all virtues. Listen to it O ° ne sees Atman by Atman through the mind that is illuminated by perfect knowledge. O brahmins, you all shall be free from passionate attachment on seeing Atman.

verses.sanskrit: विस्वरेण ब्रुवती तां ते शेपुः स्राविणी भव ततो नद्य् अभवत् तत्र यक्षिणीति सुविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: visvareṇa bruvatī tāṃ te śepuḥ srāviṇī bhava tato nady abhavat tatra yakṣiṇīti suviśrutā
verses.translation: Even in this world you will attain great intellect and. become liberated from all sins like serpents that shed off their slough. You will be devoid of anxieties and free from ailments. Thereafter, you will see the birth and annihilation of all living beings. Wise men have considered this as the most excellent of all virtues. O most excellent ones, among personsupholding virtue, the wise sages of truthful speech consider this as the most ex¬ cellent virtue. O Brahmins, the souls are all-pervading. This principle should be imparted to one's sons.
verses.wordMeaning: Even in this world you will attain great intellect and. become liberated from all sins like serpents that shed off their slough. You will be devoid of anxieties and free from ailments. Thereafter, you will see the birth and annihilation of all living beings.…

verses.transliteration: tato viśvāvasuḥ pūjya ṛṣīn devaṃ trilocanam saṃgamya caiva gautamyā tāṃ viśāpām athākarot
verses.translation: All these facts have been described, O brahmins, by (Defective) A person of delighted mind, whose son possesses good qualities and who is compassionate towards good sons will think about the welfare of those sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these facts have been described, O brahmins, by (Defective) A person of delighted mind, whose son possesses good qualities and who is compassionate towards good sons will think about the welfare of those sons.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति तत् तीर्थं यक्षिणीसंगमं स्मृतम् तत्र स्नानादिदानेन सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ yakṣiṇīsaṃgamaṃ smṛtam tatra snānādidānena sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: It has been said by Brahma that liberation is to be acquired through a certain means and not without means. O sage, we wish to hear that means. In regard to this, O extremely intelligent ones, a close scrutiny is proper. O sinless ones, always seek all objects through that means. The path that leads to the eastern sea does not go to t e western s. Indeed there is only one path unto liberation. U sinless ones, listen to that.
verses.wordMeaning: It has been said by Brahma that liberation is to be acquired through a certain means and not without means. O sage, we wish to hear that means. In regard to this, O extremely intelligent ones, a close scrutiny is proper. O sinless ones,…

verses.transliteration: viśvāvasoḥ prasanno 'bhūd yatra śaṃbhuḥ śivānvitaḥ śaivaṃ tat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ durgātīrthaṃ ca viśrutam
verses.translation: One shall conquer greed and delusion by content¬ ment; sensual object by means of the vision of reality; the evil by tenderness and compassion; and virtue by indifference (?) The learned man shall conquer hope and ambition by restraining his mind; competence (?) by avoiding close contact. He shall conquer affection by the thought of (?) non- eternity and hunger by Yogic practice.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापौघहरणं सर्वदुर्गतिनाशनम् सर्वेषां तीर्थमुख्यानां तद् धि सारं महामुने तीर्थं मुनिवरैः ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaughaharaṇaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam sarveṣāṃ tīrthamukhyānāṃ tad dhi sāraṃ mahāmune tīrthaṃ munivaraiḥ khyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: One shall conquer self by means of self by merciful compassion; excessive greed by means of contentment; languor by early rise. One shall conquer fanciful doubt by means of decision. One shall conquer variety of languages by means of silence, fcai by heroism. One shall control speech and mind by his intellect. One shall conquer intellect by the eye of knowledge. The great Atman shall control knowledge. The tran¬ quillity of the Atman shall control the Atman. These things shall be understood by a tranquil person of pure activities.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall conquer self by means of self by merciful compassion; excessive greed by means of contentment; languor by early rise. One shall conquer fanciful doubt by means of decision. One shall conquer variety of languages by means of silence, fcai by heroism.…

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिकरं नृणाम् यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण सर्वकामान् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrtham iti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O brahmin, O excellent sage, it behoves you to relate to us the respective peculiarity of Samkhya and Yoga, O sage, conversant with virtue, everything is known to you.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाज इति ख्यातो मुनिः परमधार्मिकः तस्य पैठीनसी नाम भार्या सुकलभूषणा
verses.transliteration: bharadvāja iti khyāto muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ tasya paiṭhīnasī nāma bhāryā sukalabhūṣaṇā
verses.translation: The followers of Samkhya praise Samkhya. The followers of Yoga praise Yoga. In order to exalt one's side they give cogent reasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The followers of Samkhya praise Samkhya. The followers of Yoga praise Yoga. In order to exalt one's side they give cogent reasons.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीतीरम् अध्यास्ते पतिव्रतपरायणा अग्नीषोमीयम् ऐन्द्राग्नं पुरोडाशम् अकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: gautamītīram adhyāste pativrataparāyaṇā agnīṣomīyam aindrāgnaṃ puroḍāśam akalpayat
verses.translation: A reason competent to justify one's own side, words con¬ ducive to one's welfare, should be accepted. The opinion of ex¬ cellent persons should be accepted by you all who are honoured by good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: A reason competent to justify one's own side, words con¬ ducive to one's welfare, should be accepted. The opinion of ex¬ cellent persons should be accepted by you all who are honoured by good men.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: पुरोडाशे श्रप्यमाणे धूमात् कश्चिद् अजायत पुरोडाशं भक्षयित्वा लोकत्रितयभीषणः
verses.transliteration: puroḍāśe śrapyamāṇe dhūmāt kaścid ajāyata puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayitvā lokatritayabhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O sinless ones, proper means of clealiness has been mentioned in both of them equally. Compassionate mercy to all living beings is also mentioned. The observance of holy rites is also similar, but spiritual vision is not the same in both (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: O sinless ones, proper means of clealiness has been mentioned in both of them equally. Compassionate mercy to all living beings is also mentioned. The observance of holy rites is also similar, but spiritual vision is not the same in both (?)

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञं मे ह्य् अत्र को हंसि कोपात् त्वम् इति तं मुनिः प्रोवाच सत्वरं क्रुद्धो भरद्वाजो द्विजोत्तमः तद् ऋषेर् वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसः प्रत्युवाच तम्
verses.transliteration: yajñaṃ me hy atra ko haṃsi kopāt tvam iti taṃ muniḥ provāca satvaraṃ kruddho bharadvājo dvijottamaḥ tad ṛṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasaḥ pratyuvāca tam
verses.translation: If the observance of holy rites, purity, and merciful-
verses.commentary: Sense: If the observance of holy rites, purity, and merciful-
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: हव्यघ्न इति विख्यातं भरद्वाज निबोध माम् संध्यासुतो ऽहं ज्येष्ठश् च सुतः प्राचीनबर्हिषः
verses.transliteration: havyaghna iti vikhyātaṃ bharadvāja nibodha mām saṃdhyāsuto 'haṃ jyeṣṭhaś ca sutaḥ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ
verses.translation: Defaulters in Yogic practice attain the following five defects mentioned in the Yogic path: passion, delusion, affection, lust and anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Defaulters in Yogic practice attain the following five defects mentioned in the Yogic path: passion, delusion, affection, lust and anger.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा मे वरो दत्तो यज्ञान् खाद यथासुखम् ममानुजः कलिश् चापि बलवान् अतिभीषणः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā me varo datto yajñān khāda yathāsukham mamānujaḥ kaliś cāpi balavān atibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Just as the big fish cut off the net and escape into the water once again, so also the persons devoid of sins attain that region by taking recourse to Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the big fish cut off the net and escape into the water once again, so also the persons devoid of sins attain that region by taking recourse to Yoga.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अहं कृष्णः पिता कृष्णो माता कृष्णा तथानुजः अहं मखं हनिष्यामि यूपं छेद्मि कृतान्तकः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pitā kṛṣṇo mātā kṛṣṇā tathānujaḥ ahaṃ makhaṃ haniṣyāmi yūpaṃ chedmi kṛtāntakaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, the fire of very little magnitude is very weak and it calms down on being overwhelmed by huge (quantities of) fuel. The Yogic power too is similar.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the fire of very little magnitude is very weak and it calms down on being overwhelmed by huge (quantities of) fuel. The Yogic power too is similar.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: रक्ष्यतां मे त्वया यज्ञः प्रियो धर्मः सनातनः जाने त्वां यज्ञहन्तारं सद्द्विजं रक्ष मे क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣyatāṃ me tvayā yajñaḥ priyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ jāne tvāṃ yajñahantāraṃ saddvijaṃ rakṣa me kratum
verses.translation: The same fire, O brahmins, becomes stronger once again on being accompanied by the wind. It may then burn the entire earth instantly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same fire, O brahmins, becomes stronger once again on being accompanied by the wind. It may then burn the entire earth instantly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाज निबोधेदं वाक्यं मम समासतः ब्रह्मणाहं पुरा शप्तो देवदानवसंनिधौ
verses.transliteration: bharadvāja nibodhedaṃ vākyaṃ mama samāsataḥ brahmaṇāhaṃ purā śapto devadānavasaṃnidhau
verses.translation: The extremely powerful Yogin whose strength is the perfect knowledge of reality and whose splendour is illuminated, is capable of drying up the entire universe like the sun at the time of dissolution.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extremely powerful Yogin whose strength is the perfect knowledge of reality and whose splendour is illuminated, is capable of drying up the entire universe like the sun at the time of dissolution.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसादितो देवो मया लोकपितामहः अमृतैः प्रोक्षयिष्यन्ति यदा त्वां मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasādito devo mayā lokapitāmahaḥ amṛtaiḥ prokṣayiṣyanti yadā tvāṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Those who are endowed with the power of Yoga, be¬ come masters of everything and enter the region of Prajapatis, Manus and Bhutas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are endowed with the power of Yoga, be¬ come masters of everything and enter the region of Prajapatis, Manus and Bhutas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तदा विशापो भविता हव्यघ्न त्वं न चान्यथा एवं करिष्यसि यदा ततः सर्वं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tadā viśāpo bhavitā havyaghna tvaṃ na cānyathā evaṃ kariṣyasi yadā tataḥ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Neither Yama, nor the infuriated Antaka (The annihi- lator), nor Mftyu (i.e. god of Death) of terrible exploits enter, O brahmins, the path of Yoga of unlimited splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Yama, nor the infuriated Antaka (The annihi- lator), nor Mftyu (i.e. god of Death) of terrible exploits enter, O brahmins, the path of Yoga of unlimited splendour.

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाजः पुनः प्राह सखा मे ऽसि महामते मखसंरक्षणं येन स्यान् मे वद करोमि तत्
verses.transliteration: bharadvājaḥ punaḥ prāha sakhā me 'si mahāmate makhasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ yena syān me vada karomi tat
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, there are thousands of Atmans (souls). By means of them one shall practice Yoga and after attaining the Yogic power, wander over the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, there are thousands of Atmans (souls). By means of them one shall practice Yoga and after attaining the Yogic power, wander over the earth.

verses.translation: One may indulge in enjoying worldly pleasures and do severe penance thereafter. Again, O brahmins, he shall subdue them like the sun that subdues the qualities of brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: One may indulge in enjoying worldly pleasures and do severe penance thereafter. Again, O brahmins, he shall subdue them like the sun that subdues the qualities of brilliance.

verses.translation: Listen to the illustration, O excellent sages, in regard to meditation upon the soul or in regard to concentration of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the illustration, O excellent sages, in regard to meditation upon the soul or in regard to concentration of mind.

verses.translation: Just as an archer who does not err and who has full

verses.sanskrit: तेनाकरोद् ऋषी रक्षो ह्य् अभिषिक्तं तदा मखे पुनश् च यूपे च पशाव् ऋत्विक्षु मखमण्डले
verses.transliteration: tenākarod ṛṣī rakṣo hy abhiṣiktaṃ tadā makhe punaś ca yūpe ca paśāv ṛtvikṣu makhamaṇḍale
verses.translation: It behoves you, O excellent one, to explain this. What is the diet of the Yogin? What things does he conquer and subdue? How does he gain in strength?
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you, O excellent one, to explain this. What is the diet of the Yogin? What things does he conquer and subdue? How does he gain in strength?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वम् एवाभवच् छुक्लम् अभिषेकान् महात्मनः तद् रक्षो ऽपि तदा शुक्लो भूत्वोत्पन्नो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: sarvam evābhavac chuklam abhiṣekān mahātmanaḥ tad rakṣo 'pi tadā śuklo bhūtvotpanno mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The Yogin who consumes coarse barley for a long time, O excellent brahmins, becomes a purified soul. With this single diet the Yogin attains great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yogin who consumes coarse barley for a long time, O excellent brahmins, becomes a purified soul. With this single diet the Yogin attains great strength.

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरा कृष्णरूपो ऽभूत् स तु शुक्लो ऽभवत् क्षणात् यज्ञं सर्वं समाप्याथ भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ purā kṛṣṇarūpo 'bhūt sa tu śuklo 'bhavat kṣaṇāt yajñaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyātha bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Wandering through (and residing) in the caves for many fortnights, months and seasons of diverse incidents, and drinking water with milk added (now and then), the Yogin shall attain great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wandering through (and residing) in the caves for many fortnights, months and seasons of diverse incidents, and drinking water with milk added (now and then), the Yogin shall attain great strength.

verses.transliteration: ṛtvijo 'pi visṛjyātha yūpaṃ gaṅgodake 'kṣipat gaṅgāmadhye tad dhi yūpam adyāpy āste mahāmate
verses.translation: After fasting incessantly for an unbroken period of a month, the Yogin becomes purified in soul and attains great strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fasting incessantly for an unbroken period of a month, the Yogin becomes purified in soul and attains great strength.

verses.transliteration: abhiṣiktaṃ cāmṛtena abhijñānaṃ tu tan mahat tatra tīrthe punā rakṣo bharadvājam uvāca ha
verses.translation: One should closely adhere to the path of Yoga as though that were as keen as the edge of a razor. This close adherence is the Dharana. It is difficult for persons devoid of self-possession to tread this path.

verses.transliteration: ahaṃ yāmi bharadvāja kṛtaḥ śuklas tvayā punaḥ tasmāt tavātra tīrthe ye snānadānādipūjanam
verses.translation: He who practises Yoga by adhering to Dharana duly, conquers death and the misery of frequent births. He excels others in happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who practises Yoga by adhering to Dharana duly, conquers death and the misery of frequent births. He excels others in happiness.

verses.transliteration: kuryus teṣām abhīṣṭāni bhaveyur yat phalaṃ makhe smaraṇād api pāpāni nāśaṃ yāntu sadā mune
verses.translation: This great path of Yoga has been resorted to by a number of sages. This has been precisely (explained) in various scriptures. This is decisively (nurtured) by the twice-born people.
verses.commentary: Sense: This great path of Yoga has been resorted to by a number of sages. This has been precisely (explained) in various scriptures. This is decisively (nurtured) by the twice-born people.

verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ sapta vikhyātā vasiṣṭhapramukhā mune gautamyās tīram āśritya sattrayajñam upāsate
verses.translation: In that system, O excellcn g, defects, The objects of pleasure of Nagas, Gandharvas, Pitrs and lower creatures are known. The objects of pleasure of Suparna (Garutfa), Maruts, sages and royal sages are known.

verses.transliteration: tatra vighna upakrānte rakṣobhir atibhīṣaṇe mām abhyetyātha munayo rakṣaḥkṛtyaṃ nyavedayan
verses.translation: The objects of pleasure of Asuras, Visvedevas and divine sages are known. The great objects of Yogas are also understood. The misery, O brahmins, of those souls that take birth among low creatures or fall into hell, is understood. The merits and demerits of heaven, O brahmins, are entirely under¬ stood. The Karman of the persons indulging in worldly pleasures, O leading brahmins, should be known as sinful; sense-organs and the objects of senses should be known as stationed in the Atman.
verses.wordMeaning: The objects of pleasure of Asuras, Visvedevas and divine sages are known. The great objects of Yogas are also understood. The misery, O brahmins, of those souls that take birth among low creatures or fall into hell, is understood. The merits and demerits of heaven, O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: तदाहं प्रमदारूपं माययासृज्य नारद यस्याश् च दर्शनाद् एव नाशं यान्त्य् अथ राक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: tadāhaṃ pramadārūpaṃ māyayāsṛjya nārada yasyāś ca darśanād eva nāśaṃ yānty atha rākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: The rarity of salvation should be known by means of the Vedic literature. The (vital airs such as) Prana, Apana, Samana, Vyana and Udana should be known duly. The primordial wind element should be known and then the resultant wind also should be known. They should be known as divided into seven. The remaining ones should also be known as sevenfold. The destruction of the groups of elements, O brah¬ mins, should be heard. The splendid movement of the words should be known. Those who deserve the worship of persons of sinful actions should be seen.
verses.wordMeaning: The rarity of salvation should be known by means of the Vedic literature. The (vital airs such as) Prana, Apana, Samana, Vyana and Udana should be known duly. The primordial wind element should be known and then the resultant wind also should be known.…

verses.transliteration: evam uktvā tu tāṃ prādām ṛṣibhyaḥ pramadāṃ mune madvākyād ṛṣayo māyām ādāya punar āgaman
verses.translation: The misery of those who have fallen into the abode of Yama (in the river) Vaitarani should be realised. The inauspi¬ cious movements of creatures in the variegated wombs should be observed. Respect for things not yet received, neutrality in regard

verses.transliteration: ajaikā yā samākhyātā kṛṣṇalohitarūpiṇī muktakeśīty abhidhayā sāste 'dyāpi svarūpiṇī
verses.translation: One shall comprehend residence in the families of creatures intending death as well as the emergence of creatures that arc dead after breaking the splendid bodies (?) The misery of even the Sattvika creatures, O brahmins, must be comprehended. The fate of the persons who had killed biahmins and hence had a downfall, must be comprehended. . The evil fate of vicious brahmins addicted to the drink¬ ing of liquoi, as well as those who indulge in illegitimate union with the wife of the preceptor shall be comprehended.
verses.wordMeaning: One shall comprehend residence in the families of creatures intending death as well as the emergence of creatures that arc dead after breaking the splendid bodies (?) The misery of even the Sattvika creatures, O brahmins, must be comprehended.…

verses.transliteration: lokatritayasaṃmohadāyinī kāmarūpiṇī tadbalāt svasthamanasaḥ sarve ca munipuṃgavaḥ
verses.translation: What defects arising out of Utpatas (dangerous por¬ tents) do you see, O most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman? It behoves you to clarify this doubt of ours comp¬ letely. O brahmins, intelligent scholars speak of five defects in the body, the scholars who are the followers of Kapila and

verses.sanskrit: गौतमीं सरितां श्रेष्ठां पुनर् यज्ञाय दीक्षिताः पुनस् तन्मखनाशाय राक्षसाः समुपागमन्
verses.transliteration: gautamīṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ punar yajñāya dīkṣitāḥ punas tanmakhanāśāya rākṣasāḥ samupāgaman
verses.translation: Lust, anger, fear, slumber and breath—these defects are seen in the bodies of all embodied beings. By means of patience they cut off anger; by avoiding close intimacy they remove lust; by resorting to Sattvika sub¬ stances they remove slumber; and they remove fear by means of avoidance of errors. They cut off and remove breath, O brahmins, by means of reduced diet. Good qualities are known by means of hundreds of good qualities and defects by means of hundreds of defects.
verses.wordMeaning: Lust, anger, fear, slumber and breath—these defects are seen in the bodies of all embodied beings. By means of patience they cut off anger; by avoiding close intimacy they remove lust; by resorting to Sattvika sub¬ stances they remove slumber;…

verses.transliteration: yakṣavāṭāntike māyāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ tato nṛtyanti gāyanti hasanti ca rudanti ca
verses.translation: Reasons must be known by means of hundreds of reasons; wonderful things should be known by means of wonder¬ ful things. It resembles the wall painted in a picture. It has as much strength as grass (i.e. it is flimsy and feeble). It is con¬ ducive to great harm. It wanders about in darkness. It must be seen as one resembling bubbles (of water) during rain,

verses.sanskrit: माहेश्वरी महामाया प्रभावेणातिदर्पिता तेषां मध्ये दैत्यपतिः शम्बरो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: māheśvarī mahāmāyā prabhāveṇātidarpitā teṣāṃ madhye daityapatiḥ śambaro nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: After crossing (the ocean of) births which is difficult to cross they enter the pure sky and thereafter on seeing them come, the sun carries them with its rays. The rays enter them like fibres of lotus, O brahmins, as it blows over the territories. O sinless ones, the wind Pravaha takes them up there. O brahmins, the subtle, sweet smelling, cool wind Pra¬ vaha with gentle touch receives those ascetics who are devoid of passion and the Siddhas whose asset is penance and who are endowed with virility.

verses.transliteration: māyārūpāṃ tu pramadāṃ bhakṣayām āsa nārada tad adbhutam atīvāsīt tanmāyābaladarśinām
verses.translation: The firmament carries the lords of the worlds to the After attaining the most excellent region of the lord, do those persons of steady holy rites sport about there, till their death and rebirth?
verses.commentary: Sense: The firmament carries the lords of the worlds to the After attaining the most excellent region of the lord, do those persons of steady holy rites sport about there, till their death and rebirth?

verses.sanskrit: मखे विध्वंस्यमाने तु ते विष्णुं शरणं ययुः प्रादाद् विष्णुश् चक्रम् अथो मुनीनां रक्षणाय तु
verses.transliteration: makhe vidhvaṃsyamāne tu te viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ prādād viṣṇuś cakram atho munīnāṃ rakṣaṇāya tu
verses.translation: It behoves you to describe accurately what exactly is the reality therein. Excepting you we cannot, O excellent one, afford to ask any other mortal. The question has been put most relevantly, O excellent sages. Your dilemma has been enunciated. O excellent sages, there is confusion and delusion even amongst scholars in regard to this problem. Even here listen to my words in regard to the perfect truth where the great intellect of those noble souls, the followers ofKapila, finds a place.

verses.translation: In this connection I shall recount unto you the legend of yore, the dialogue between Vasistha and Karala-Janaka.

verses.transliteration: tatra snānena dānena brahmahatyādināśanam brahmaviṣṇvoś ca saṃvāde mahattve ca parasparam
verses.translation: Vasistha, the most excellent one among the sages, having the features of the sun, was sitting in his hermitage when king Janaka asked him about the perfect knowledge loading to salvation.

verses.transliteration: tayor madhye mahādevo jyotirmūrtir abhūt kila tatraiva vāg uvācedaṃ daivī putra tayoḥ śubhā
verses.translation: Let it be heard, O ruler of the Earth, how this universe dissolves and perishes, where it dissolves at first, and how long does it take.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let it be heard, O ruler of the Earth, how this universe dissolves and perishes, where it dissolves at first, and how long does it take.

verses.transliteration: aham asmi mahāṃs tatra aham asmīti vai mithaḥ daivī vāk tāv ubhau prāha yas tv asyāntaṃ tu paśyati
verses.translation: A Yuga consists of twelve thousand years. Know that a Kalpa is made up of four Yugas. A cycle of four hundred Kalpas is called a day of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Yuga consists of twelve thousand years. Know that a Kalpa is made up of four Yugas. A cycle of four hundred Kalpas is called a day of Brahma.

verses.transliteration: tato viṣṇuḥ śīghram etya jyotiḥpārśva upāviśat aprāpyāntam ahaṃ prāyāṃ dūrād dūrataraṃ mune
verses.translation: It alone abides in the heart of all forms. It is equipped with soul (?). It is conscious and it instils consciousness in all objects. It has no form but it identifies itself with all forms.

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रान्तो निवृत्तो ऽहं द्रष्टुम् ईशं तु तं प्रभुम् तदैवं मम धीर् आसीद् दृष्टश् चान्तो मया भृशम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrānto nivṛtto 'haṃ draṣṭum īśaṃ tu taṃ prabhum tadaivaṃ mama dhīr āsīd dṛṣṭaś cānto mayā bhṛśam
verses.translation: It assumes forms of creation and annihilation through the peculiar characteristics of creation and annihilation. Al¬ though it is devoid of attributes it remains within the view.
verses.commentary: Sense: It assumes forms of creation and annihilation through the peculiar characteristics of creation and annihilation. Al¬ though it is devoid of attributes it remains within the view.

verses.transliteration: asya devasya tad viṣṇor mama jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sphuṭaṃ bhavet punaś cāpi mama tv evaṃ matir āsīn mahāmate
verses.translation: Although this great soul undergoes certain changes due to millions of creations and annihilations it does not absolutely identify itself with them all (?)

verses.sanskrit: सत्यैर् वक्त्रैः कथं वक्ष्ये पीडितो ऽप्य् अनृतं वचः नानाविधेषु पापेषु नानृतात् पातकं परम्
verses.transliteration: satyair vaktraiḥ kathaṃ vakṣye pīḍito 'py anṛtaṃ vacaḥ nānāvidheṣu pāpeṣu nānṛtāt pātakaṃ param
verses.translation: Not being enlightened itself and due to the resorting of unenlightened persons it becomes enveloped with Tamas, Sattva and Rajas and is born in different wombs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not being enlightened itself and due to the resorting of unenlightened persons it becomes enveloped with Tamas, Sattva and Rajas and is born in different wombs.

verses.translation: and then beholding Vagishvara, one attains liberation by that alone. Whoever performs there some charity, oblation and the like, or rites such as fasting,

verses.transliteration: yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame puṇye saṃsāre na bhavet punaḥ ekonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayor dvayoḥ nānājanmārjitāśeṣapāpakṣayavidhāyinām
verses.translation: at that holy confluence is not born again in worldly existence. There are nineteen hundred tirthas on the two banks, which destroy all the sins accumulated over many births.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुतीर्थम् इति ख्यातं तत्र वृत्तम् इदं शृणु मौद्गल्य इति विख्यातो मुद्गलस्य सुतो ऋषिः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇutīrtham iti khyātaṃ tatra vṛttam idaṃ śṛṇu maudgalya iti vikhyāto mudgalasya suto ṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: On account of its acquisition of penance or decrease of good qualities the soul sometimes takes up bodies among gods or among lower creatures.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या तु जाबाला नाम्ना ख्याता सुपुत्रिणी पिता ऋषिस् तथा वृद्धो मुद्गलो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tu jābālā nāmnā khyātā suputriṇī pitā ṛṣis tathā vṛddho mudgalo lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: From human birth it proceeds to heaven and from god it becomes a human being. From the state of man it proceeds to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: From human birth it proceeds to heaven and from god it becomes a human being. From the state of man it proceeds to hell.

verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā tathā khyātā nāmnā bhāgīrathī śubhā sa maudgalyaḥ prātar eva gaṅgāṃ snāti yatavrataḥ
verses.translation: Just as the silk worm wraps itself by its thread-like fibres so also this soul though devoid of Gunas wraps itself by means of Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the silk worm wraps itself by its thread-like fibres so also this soul though devoid of Gunas wraps itself by means of Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यम् एव त्व् इदं कर्म तस्यासीन् मुनिसत्तम गङ्गातीरे कुशैर् मृद्भिः शमीपुष्पैर् अहर्निशम्
verses.transliteration: nityam eva tv idaṃ karma tasyāsīn munisattama gaṅgātīre kuśair mṛdbhiḥ śamīpuṣpair aharniśam
verses.translation: Though the soul is devoid of mutually opposed pairs it is affected by them in different births. At the time when a person suffers from ailments such as headache, eye-pain, tooth¬ ache, sore throat, dropsy, diarrhoea, Gandamala, Vicarcika, leukoderma, burns, scalds, epileptic fils etc., the characteristic symptoms of diverse types appear in the bodies of these souls. The soul identifies itself with the bodies. As in the case of identification so also in regard to meritorious deeds.

verses.translation: He may wear lion hide or silken garment. Plank may

verses.translation: Mat alone may be his garment or he may be wearing bark garment. We may take pride in wearing other types of clothes.

verses.transliteration: pūjitas tena ṛṣiṇā sa maudgalyena yatnataḥ prabrūte ca kathāś citrā maudgalyāya jagatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: He may have diverse types of food and different kinds of jewels. He may take food once a day or on different nights with intervals of a night in between.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽपराह्णसमये विष्णुः प्राह स मौद्गलिम् याहि वत्स स्वभवनं श्रान्तो ऽसीति पुनः पुनः

verses.translation: Some may take in cow's urine; some the Kasa flower.

verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ sa devena viṣṇunā yāti sa dvijaḥ jagatprabhus tato yāti devair yuktaḥ svamandiram
verses.translation: He may rkort to lonely river bank, diffcn, foreslr

verses.translation: He may adopt different types of holy rites and obeer vancea and var.ou, kmda of austerities, sacrifices of varioa types and different kinds of scholarly arts.

verses.translation: Divine Prakrti causes fear and annihilation. At the end of the day, he passes beyond Gunas and remains single.

verses.transliteration: tato 'pratihatajñāno jīvanmuktas tato bhavet sarveṣāṃ sulabhā muktir madbhaktyā ceha pūrtataḥ
verses.translation: then, with unobstructed knowledge, he becomes liberated while living. Liberation is easy for all through devotion to me here, in full;

verses.transliteration: bhuktir dānādinā sarvabhūtaduḥkhanibarhaṇāt athavā lapsyase muktiṃ bhaktyā bhuktiṃ na lapsyase
verses.translation: enjoyment comes through giving and the like, and through relieving the suffering of all beings. Otherwise you will gain liberation through devotion, but you will not gain enjoyment."

verses.transliteration: bhaktyā muktiḥ kathaṃ bhūyād bhukter muktiḥ sudurlabhā jātā ced dehināṃ muktiḥ kim anyena prayojanam
verses.translation: "How can liberation come through devotion? For one bent on enjoyment liberation is very hard. If embodied beings do attain liberation, what need is there of anything else?

verses.translation: Liberation through devotion is honoured by all; that is what I would wish for, O you who pervade the world."

verses.translation: "This is the difference, O brahmin: whatever is given to a brahmin or to supplicants while remembering me becomes imperishable.

verses.translation: What one gives without meditating on me yields only its own measure of fruit; it is merely given here and does not serve for enjoyment hereafter.

verses.translation: So, O wise one, you must give me some food, or give it to a chief brahmin while dwelling on the bank of the Gautami."

verses.translation: Maudgalya said to Vishnu, "I have nothing to give — nothing else, not even my body, for that has already been offered to you."

verses.translation: Then Vishnu, Lord of the world, quickly said to Garuda, "Bring an ear of grain here; he will offer it to me,

verses.translation: and then he will obtain fitting enjoyments dear to his heart." Hearing his master's command, the king of birds did so.

verses.translation: "Ah, the power of giving! Ah, the remembrance of Vishnu! Ah, the power of the Ganga! Who can fathom this greatness?"

verses.translation: Maudgalya, with his wife, sons, grandsons, kinsmen and parents, enjoyed pleasures, and obtained both enjoyment and liberation.

verses.translation: Without a man no woman conceives. Without a woman no man is able to evolve a form.

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रया च सा प्रोक्ता सर्वेभ्यो ह्य् अधिका ह्य् अहम् मुक्तिर् मदाश्रिता नित्यं दरिद्रैवं वचो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: daridrayā ca sā proktā sarvebhyo hy adhikā hy aham muktir madāśritā nityaṃ daridraivaṃ vaco 'bravīt
verses.translation: The texts of both, viz. the Vedas and other scriptures are held by you, O king. Be the person who understands the essence of the texts correctly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The texts of both, viz. the Vedas and other scriptures are held by you, O king. Be the person who understands the essence of the texts correctly.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
verses.science: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधश् च लोभश् च मदो मात्सर्यम् एव च यत्राहम् अस्मि तत्रैते न तिष्ठन्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca mado mātsaryam eva ca yatrāham asmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana
verses.translation: He who docs not understand the meaning of those texts is merely a carrier of a burden. The acquisition of the texts is not in vain in regard to a person who is conversant with the meaning and principles of the texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who docs not understand the meaning of those texts is merely a carrier of a burden. The acquisition of the texts is not in vain in regard to a person who is conversant with the meaning and principles of the texts.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: न भयोद्भूतिर् उन्माद ईर्ष्या उद्धतवृत्तिता यत्राहम् अस्मि तत्रैते न तिष्ठन्ति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na bhayodbhūtir unmāda īrṣyā uddhatavṛttitā yatrāham asmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana
verses.translation: If a person who has not understood the basic prin¬ ciples of a scriptural text begins to explain it out of greed or arrogance, he is a sinner and he will fall into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person who has not understood the basic prin¬ ciples of a scriptural text begins to explain it out of greed or arrogance, he is a sinner and he will fall into hell.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्राया वचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मीस् तां प्रत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: daridrāyā vacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīs tāṃ pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: A person of loopholes (i.e. imperfect knowledge) will never explain the text truthfully and confidently since he is neither self-possessed nor conversant with the meaning and basic principles of the text.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person of loopholes (i.e. imperfect knowledge) will never explain the text truthfully and confidently since he is neither self-possessed nor conversant with the meaning and basic principles of the text.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: अलंकृतो मया जन्तुः सर्वो भवति पूजितः निर्धनः शिवतुल्यो ऽपि सर्वैर् अप्य् अभिभूयते
verses.transliteration: alaṃkṛto mayā jantuḥ sarvo bhavati pūjitaḥ nirdhanaḥ śivatulyo 'pi sarvair apy abhibhūyate
verses.translation: Whatever the followers of the Yoga system see (and understand), the Samkhyas too follow. He who sees the iden¬ tity of the Samkhya and Yoga systems is wise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever the followers of the Yoga system see (and understand), the Samkhyas too follow. He who sees the iden¬ tity of the Samkhya and Yoga systems is wise.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: देहीति वचनद्वारा देहस्थाः पञ्च देवताः सद्यो निर्गत्य गच्छन्ति धीश्रीह्रीशान्तिकीर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dehīti vacanadvārā dehasthāḥ pañca devatāḥ sadyo nirgatya gacchanti dhīśrīhrīśāntikīrtayaḥ
verses.translation: Skin, flesh, blood, bile, marrow, bone and sinew— O dear one, these can be perceived by the sense-organs, as Your Highness has already told me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Skin, flesh, blood, bile, marrow, bone and sinew— O dear one, these can be perceived by the sense-organs, as Your Highness has already told me.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावद् गुणा गुरुत्वं च यावन् नार्थयते परम् अर्थी चेत् पुरुषो जातः क्व गुणाः क्व च गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: tāvad guṇā gurutvaṃ ca yāvan nārthayate param arthī cet puruṣo jātaḥ kva guṇāḥ kva ca gauravam
verses.translation: How will there be Gunas in the great Atman because it is devoid of Gunas? How can this embodied soul devoid of sense-organs have the Gunas? How can there be Guna in a seed that is not solid?
verses.commentary: Sense: How will there be Gunas in the great Atman because it is devoid of Gunas? How can this embodied soul devoid of sense-organs have the Gunas? How can there be Guna in a seed that is not solid?
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तावत् सर्वोत्तमो जन्तुस् तावत् सर्वगुणालयः नमस्यः सर्वलोकानां यावन् नार्थयते परम्
verses.transliteration: tāvat sarvottamo jantus tāvat sarvaguṇālayaḥ namasyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yāvan nārthayate param
verses.translation: Gunas are produced from Gunas and they cease to exist there itself. In the same manner the Gunas arising out of Prakfti are produced from Prakrti but they end therein itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gunas are produced from Gunas and they cease to exist there itself. In the same manner the Gunas arising out of Prakfti are produced from Prakrti but they end therein itself.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: कष्टम् एतन् महापापं निर्धनत्वं शरीरिणाम् न मानयति नो वक्ति न स्पृशत्य् अधनं जनः
verses.transliteration: kaṣṭam etan mahāpāpaṃ nirdhanatvaṃ śarīriṇām na mānayati no vakti na spṛśaty adhanaṃ janaḥ
verses.translation: The Gunas exist in one with Guna. Plow can there be Gunas in one without Gunas? Hence those people who look at Gunas know thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gunas exist in one with Guna. Plow can there be Gunas in one without Gunas? Hence those people who look at Gunas know thus.

verses.sanskrit: अहम् एव ततः श्रेष्ठा दरिद्रे शृणु मे वचः
verses.transliteration: aham eva tataḥ śreṣṭhā daridre śṛṇu me vacaḥ
verses.translation: When this soul identifies itself with the Gunas belong¬ ing to Prakrti it is one with Gunas and it observes the different Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When this soul identifies itself with the Gunas belong¬ ing to Prakrti it is one with Gunas and it observes the different Gunas.
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये

verses.sanskrit: तल् लक्ष्मीवचनं श्रुत्वा दरिद्रा वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tal lakṣmīvacanaṃ śrutvā daridrā vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: This principle of perishable and Imperishahlp h n<! been mentioned to you. Thev call p tn. /, le has
verses.commentary: Sense: This principle of perishable and Imperishahlp h n<! been mentioned to you. Thev call p tn. /, le has

verses.sanskrit: वक्तुं न लक्ष्मीर् ज्येष्ठाहम् इति वै लज्जसे मुहुः पापेषु रमसे नित्यं विहाय पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vaktuṃ na lakṣmīr jyeṣṭhāham iti vai lajjase muhuḥ pāpeṣu ramase nityaṃ vihāya puruṣottamam
verses.translation: The learned men state that the twenty-fifth princmle is
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned men state that the twenty-fifth princmle is
verses.hindi: गौतम बोले भोगकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले जीवोंको मनोवाञ्छित भोग प्रदान करनेके लिये
