verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ती च भवेद् दृष्टी रसन्ती रसना भवेत् जिघ्रन्ती भवति घ्राणं बुद्धिर् विकुरुते पृथक्
verses.transliteration: paśyantī ca bhaved dṛṣṭī rasantī rasanā bhavet jighrantī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ buddhir vikurute pṛthak
verses.translation: seeing, it becomes sight; tasting, it becomes the tongue; smelling, it becomes the nose — so the intellect transforms itself distinctly.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि तु तान्य् आहुस् तेषां वृत्त्या वितिष्ठति तिष्ठति पुरुषे बुद्धिर् बुद्धिभावव्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi tu tāny āhus teṣāṃ vṛttyā vitiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati puruṣe buddhir buddhibhāvavyavasthitā
verses.translation: These they call the senses; through their activity it abides. The intellect abides in the Person, established in the state of intellect.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिल् लभते प्रीतिं कदाचिद् अपि शोचति न सुखेन च दुःखेन कदाचिद् इह मुह्यते
verses.transliteration: kadācil labhate prītiṃ kadācid api śocati na sukhena ca duḥkhena kadācid iha muhyate
verses.translation: Sometimes it finds joy, sometimes it grieves, and sometimes here it is neither happy nor sad but bewildered.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं भावात्मिका भावांस् त्रीन् एतान् अतिवर्तते सरितां सागरो भर्ता महावेलाम् इवोर्मिमान्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃs trīn etān ativartate saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelām ivormimān
verses.translation: Itself made of states, it passes beyond these three states, as the ocean, lord of rivers, with its waves passes beyond its great shore.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रार्थयते किंचित् तदा भवति सा मनः अधिष्ठाने च वै बुद्ध्या पृथग् एतानि संस्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: yadā prārthayate kiṃcit tadā bhavati sā manaḥ adhiṣṭhāne ca vai buddhyā pṛthag etāni saṃsmaret
verses.translation: When it longs for something, it becomes mind. With the intellect one should consider these separately in their seats,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि च मेध्यानि विचेतव्यानि कृत्स्नशः सर्वाण्य् एवानुपूर्वेण यद् यदा च विधीयते
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi ca medhyāni vicetavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ sarvāṇy evānupūrveṇa yad yadā ca vidhīyate
verses.translation: and the senses, which are pure, should be examined completely, all of them in order, as each is prescribed.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अविभागमना बुद्धिर् भावो मनसि वर्तते प्रवर्तमानस् तु रजः सत्त्वम् अप्य् अतिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: avibhāgamanā buddhir bhāvo manasi vartate pravartamānas tu rajaḥ sattvam apy ativartate
verses.translation: The intellect with undivided mind is a state that abides in the mind; when it is active it is rajas, and it also goes beyond sattva.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ये वै भावेन वर्तन्ते सर्वेष्व् एतेषु ते त्रिषु अन्व् अर्थान् संप्रवर्तन्ते रथनेमिम् अरा इव
verses.transliteration: ye vai bhāvena vartante sarveṣv eteṣu te triṣu anv arthān saṃpravartante rathanemim arā iva
verses.translation: Those who operate through these states, in all these three, move along after objects like spokes around the rim of a chariot wheel.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीपार्थं मनः कुर्याद् इन्द्रियैर् बुद्धिसत्तमैः निश्चरद्भिर् यथायोगम् उदासीनैर् यदृच्छया
verses.transliteration: pradīpārthaṃ manaḥ kuryād indriyair buddhisattamaiḥ niścaradbhir yathāyogam udāsīnair yadṛcchayā
verses.translation: One should make the mind a lamp, with the senses led by the intellect going forth as fits, indifferent and at ease.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवंस्वभावम् एवेदम् इति बुद्ध्वा न मुह्यति अशोचन् संप्रहृष्यंश् च नित्यं विगतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃsvabhāvam evedam iti buddhvā na muhyati aśocan saṃprahṛṣyaṃś ca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Knowing 'Such is the nature of this,' one is not deluded; neither grieving nor exulting, always free from envy.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न ह्य् आत्मा शक्यते द्रष्टुम् इन्द्रियैः कामगोचरैः प्रवर्तमानैर् अनेकैर् दुर्धरैर् अकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: na hy ātmā śakyate draṣṭum indriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ pravartamānair anekair durdharair akṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: The Self cannot be seen by the senses that range among desires, many, active, hard to hold, belonging to the undisciplined.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु मनसा रश्मीन् यदा सम्यङ् नियच्छति तदा प्रकाशते श्यात्मा दीपदीप्ता यथाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīn yadā samyaṅ niyacchati tadā prakāśate śyātmā dīpadīptā yathākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: But when one rightly restrains their reins with the mind, then the Self shines forth, as a shape lit by a lamp.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एव भूतानां तमस्य् उपगते यथा प्रकाशं भवते सर्वं तथैवम् उपधार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ tamasy upagate yathā prakāśaṃ bhavate sarvaṃ tathaivam upadhāryatām
verses.translation: As, when darkness departs, everything becomes visible to all beings, so should this be understood.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा वारिचरः पक्षी न लिप्यति जले चरन् विमुक्तात्मा तथा योगी गुणदोषैर् न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran vimuktātmā tathā yogī guṇadoṣair na lipyate
verses.translation: As a water bird moving in the water is not wetted by it, so the yogi whose self is freed is not stained by the faults of the qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एव कृतप्रज्ञो न दोषैर् विषयांश् चरन् असज्जमानः सर्वेषु न कथंचित् प्रलिप्यते
verses.transliteration: evam eva kṛtaprajño na doṣair viṣayāṃś caran asajjamānaḥ sarveṣu na kathaṃcit pralipyate
verses.translation: So too one of perfected wisdom, moving among sense objects without faults and unattached to all, is in no way stained.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा पूर्वकृतं कर्म रतिर् यस्य सदात्मनि सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्य गुणसङ्गेन सज्जतः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma ratir yasya sadātmani sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya guṇasaṅgena sajjataḥ
verses.translation: He who has abandoned the karma done before and ever delights in the Self, who has become the Self of all beings, though associated with the qualities,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयम् आत्मा प्रसवति गुणेष्व् अपि कदाचन न गुणा विदुर् आत्मानं गुणान् वेद स सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: svayam ātmā prasavati guṇeṣv api kadācana na guṇā vidur ātmānaṃ guṇān veda sa sarvadā
verses.translation: the Self itself never gives birth to the qualities. The qualities do not know the Self; the Self always knows the qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परिदध्याद् गुणानां स द्रष्टा चैव यथातथम् सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोर् एवम् अन्तरं लक्षयेन् नरः
verses.transliteration: paridadhyād guṇānāṃ sa draṣṭā caiva yathātatham sattvakṣetrajñayor evam antaraṃ lakṣayen naraḥ
verses.translation: He is the overseer and true seer of the qualities. Thus a man should discern the difference between sattva and the knower of the field.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सृजते तु गुणान् एक एको न सृजते गुणान् पृथग्भूतौ प्रकृत्यैतौ संप्रयुक्तौ च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: sṛjate tu guṇān eka eko na sṛjate guṇān pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyaitau saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā
verses.translation: One creates the qualities, the other does not create them; by nature these two are separate, yet always joined —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथाश्मना हिरण्यस्य संप्रयुक्तौ तथैव तौ मशकोदुम्बरौ वापि संप्रयुक्तौ यथा सह
verses.transliteration: yathāśmanā hiraṇyasya saṃprayuktau tathaiva tau maśakodumbarau vāpi saṃprayuktau yathā saha
verses.translation: as gold is joined with stone, or as the gnat and the fig are joined together,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इषिका वा यथा मुञ्जे पृथक् च सह चैव ह तथैव सहिताव् एतौ अन्योन्यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितौ
verses.transliteration: iṣikā vā yathā muñje pṛthak ca saha caiva ha tathaiva sahitāv etau anyonyasmin pratiṣṭhitau
verses.translation: or as the reed within the munja grass is both separate and together — so these two are united, each established in the other.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सृजते तु गुणान् सत्त्वं क्षेत्रज्ञस् त्व् अधितिष्ठति गुणान् विक्रियतः सर्वान् उदासीनवद् ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sṛjate tu guṇān sattvaṃ kṣetrajñas tv adhitiṣṭhati guṇān vikriyataḥ sarvān udāsīnavad īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Just like the Rtviks I too am a servant of Devas. I carry Havya to Devas. They are the enjoyers (and therefore) they are the saviours too.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.commentary: Sense: Just like the Rtviks I too am a servant of Devas. I carry Havya to Devas. They are the enjoyers (and therefore) they are the saviours too.
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावयुक्तं तत् सर्वं यद् इमान् सृजते गुणान् ऊर्णनाभिर् यथा सूत्रं सृजते तद् गुणांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: svabhāvayuktaṃ tat sarvaṃ yad imān sṛjate guṇān ūrṇanābhir yathā sūtraṃ sṛjate tad guṇāṃs tathā
verses.translation: I shall call Devas and carefully distribute their shares in the Havis to each. Hence, you go hurriedly towards them.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall call Devas and carefully distribute their shares in the Havis to each. Hence, you go hurriedly towards them.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्ता न निवर्तन्ते प्रवृत्तिर् नोपलभ्यते एवम् एके व्यवस्यन्ति निवृत्तिम् इति चापरे
verses.transliteration: pravṛttā na nivartante pravṛttir nopalabhyate evam eke vyavasyanti nivṛttim iti cāpare
verses.translation: Devapi approached Devas and bowed to each of them. He then intimated to them the statement of Rtviks, of the Fire-god and (his own threat of) curse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devapi approached Devas and bowed to each of them. He then intimated to them the statement of Rtviks, of the Fire-god and (his own threat of) curse.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: उभयं संप्रधार्यैतद् अध्यवस्येद् यथामति अनेनैव विधानेन भवेद् वै संशयो महान्
verses.transliteration: ubhayaṃ saṃpradhāryaitad adhyavasyed yathāmati anenaiva vidhānena bhaved vai saṃśayo mahān
verses.translation: When we are invoked by the Vedic Mantras by the Rtviks in the proper order we partake of our shares in the Havis. We are not otherwise free, O excellent brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: When we are invoked by the Vedic Mantras by the Rtviks in the proper order we partake of our shares in the Havis. We are not otherwise free, O excellent brahmin.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधनो ह्य् आत्मा तं बुद्ध्वा विहरेन् नरः अक्रुध्यन्न् अप्रहृष्यंश् च नित्यं विगतमत्सरः
verses.transliteration: anādinidhano hy ātmā taṃ buddhvā viharen naraḥ akrudhyann aprahṛṣyaṃś ca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, we are the perpetual followers of the Vedas. We are induced by the Vedas. O brahmin, we are dependent. Therefore, intimate this to the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, we are the perpetual followers of the Vedas. We are induced by the Vedas. O brahmin, we are dependent. Therefore, intimate this to the Vedas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इत्य् एवं हृदये सर्वो बुद्धिचिन्तामयं दृढम् अनित्यं सुखम् आसीनम् अशोच्यं छिन्नसंशयः
verses.transliteration: ity evaṃ hṛdaye sarvo buddhicintāmayaṃ dṛḍham anityaṃ sukham āsīnam aśocyaṃ chinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: At the instance of the Vedas the boy Devapi went to Gautami. The brahmin took his bath and having got the proper opportunity eulogized Mahelvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of the Vedas the boy Devapi went to Gautami. The brahmin took his bath and having got the proper opportunity eulogized Mahelvara.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तरयेत् प्रच्युतां पृथ्वीं यथा पूर्णां नदीं नराः अवगाह्य च विद्वांसो विप्रा लोलम् इमं तथा
verses.transliteration: tarayet pracyutāṃ pṛthvīṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ avagāhya ca vidvāṃso viprā lolam imaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O lord of the chiefs of Devas, I am a mere boy. You are the preceptor of preceptors. I have no power to eulogize you befittingly. Obeisance be to you, O Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the chiefs of Devas, I am a mere boy. You are the preceptor of preceptors. I have no power to eulogize you befittingly. Obeisance be to you, O Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: न तु तप्यति वै विद्वान् स्थले चरति तत्त्ववित् एवं विचिन्त्य चात्मानं केवलं ज्ञानम् आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: na tu tapyati vai vidvān sthale carati tattvavit evaṃ vicintya cātmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñānam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas do not know you. Neither Devas nor sages. Neither Brahma nor Visnu. As you are so you are. Obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas do not know you. Neither Devas nor sages. Neither Brahma nor Visnu. As you are so you are. Obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तां तु बुद्ध्वा नरः सर्गं भूतानाम् आगतिं गतिम् समचेष्टश् च वै सम्यग् लभते शमम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tu buddhvā naraḥ sargaṃ bhūtānām āgatiṃ gatim samaceṣṭaś ca vai samyag labhate śamam uttamam
verses.translation: You protect, O Mahegvara, those who are sinning souls, who are helpless, who are miserable, who are poor and who are sickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You protect, O Mahegvara, those who are sinning souls, who are helpless, who are miserable, who are poor and who are sickly.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतद् द्विजन्मसामग्र्यं ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः आत्मज्ञानसमस्नेहपर्याप्तं तत्परायणम्
verses.transliteration: etad dvijanmasāmagryaṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ātmajñānasamasnehaparyāptaṃ tatparāyaṇam
verses.translation: The heaven-dwellers who are worshipped by penance, holy rites and Mantras will give them the benefit ordained by you, O lord of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heaven-dwellers who are worshipped by penance, holy rites and Mantras will give them the benefit ordained by you, O lord of the worlds.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वं बुद्ध्वा भवेद् बुद्धः किम् अन्यद् बुद्धलक्षणम् विज्ञायैतद् विमुच्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: tattvaṃ buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kim anyad buddhalakṣaṇam vijñāyaitad vimucyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: (Even) beggars will turn out to be donors. Whatever they desire is not wanting at your door. You are the cause of this unique situation.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Even) beggars will turn out to be donors. Whatever they desire is not wanting at your door. You are the cause of this unique situation.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न भवति विदुषां महद् भयं यद् अविदुषां सुमहद् भयं परत्र नहि गतिर् अधिकास्ति कस्यचिद् भवति हि या विदुषः सनातनी
verses.transliteration: na bhavati viduṣāṃ mahad bhayaṃ yad aviduṣāṃ sumahad bhayaṃ paratra nahi gatir adhikāsti kasyacid bhavati hi yā viduṣaḥ sanātanī
verses.translation: O preceptor of the universe, O lord, at the mere utter¬ ance of the word Siva, you protect ignorant persons, sinners and those who are immersed in the ocean of hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor of the universe, O lord, at the mere utter¬ ance of the word Siva, you protect ignorant persons, sinners and those who are immersed in the ocean of hell.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: लोके मातरम् असूयते नरस् तत्र देवम् अनिरीक्ष्य शोचते तत्र चेत् कुशलो न शोचते ये विदुस् तद् उभयं कृताकृतम्
verses.transliteration: loke mātaram asūyate naras tatra devam anirīkṣya śocate tatra cet kuśalo na śocate ye vidus tad ubhayaṃ kṛtākṛtam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Devapi the lord of the uni¬ verse said "So be it". At the behest of Sankara, Devapi got everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Devapi the lord of the uni¬ verse said "So be it". At the behest of Sankara, Devapi got everything.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यत् करोत्य् अनभिसंधिपूर्वकं तच् च निन्दयति यत् पुरा कृतम् यत् प्रियं तद् उभयं न वाप्रियं तस्य तज् जनयतीह कुर्वतः
verses.transliteration: yat karoty anabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ tac ca nindayati yat purā kṛtam yat priyaṃ tad ubhayaṃ na vāpriyaṃ tasya taj janayatīha kurvataḥ
verses.translation: Calling Nandin, one of his Ganas, the merciful lord Sambhu sent him with his Spear, O Narada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Calling Nandin, one of his Ganas, the merciful lord Sambhu sent him with his Spear, O Narada.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् धर्मात् परो धर्मो विद्यते नेह कश्चन यो विशिष्टश् च भूतेभ्यस् तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु नः
verses.transliteration: yasmād dharmāt paro dharmo vidyate neha kaścana yo viśiṣṭaś ca bhūtebhyas tad bhavān prabravītu naḥ
verses.translation: Nandin went to the nether worlds and killed Mithu and the leading Asuras. Bringing his father and others he handed them over to them (Devapi).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nandin went to the nether worlds and killed Mithu and the leading Asuras. Bringing his father and others he handed them over to them (Devapi).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं च संप्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणम् ऋषिभिः स्तुतम् विशिष्टं सर्वधर्मेभ्यः शृणुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi purāṇam ṛṣibhiḥ stutam viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadharmebhyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The horse sacrifice of the self-possessed Ar§i§ena was performed there. The Fire-god, Rtviks, Devas, Vedas and sages said:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि बुद्ध्या संयम्य तत्त्वतः सर्वतः प्रसृतानीह पिता बालान् इवात्मजान्
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi pramāthīni buddhyā saṃyamya tattvataḥ sarvataḥ prasṛtānīha pitā bālān ivātmajān
verses.translation: Restraining with the intellect, in truth, the tormenting senses that have spread out in every direction, as a father restrains his young children —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मनसश् चेन्द्रियाणां चाप्य् ऐकाग्र्यं परमं तपः विज्ञेयः सर्वधर्मेभ्यः स धर्मः पर उच्यते
verses.transliteration: manasaś cendriyāṇāṃ cāpy aikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate
verses.translation: one-pointedness of mind and senses is the highest austerity; it is to be known as higher than all dharmas and is called the supreme dharma.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तानि सर्वाणि संधाय मनःषष्ठानि मेधया आत्मतृप्तः स एवासीद् बहुचिन्त्यम् अचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi saṃdhāya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā ātmatṛptaḥ sa evāsīd bahucintyam acintayan
verses.translation: Gathering all of them, with the mind as sixth, through wisdom, he remained content in the Self, not thinking of the many things to be thought of.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: गोचरेभ्यो निवृत्तानि यदा स्थास्यन्ति वेश्मनि तदा चैवात्मनात्मानं परं द्रक्ष्यथ शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: gocarebhyo nivṛttāni yadā sthāsyanti veśmani tadā caivātmanātmānaṃ paraṃ drakṣyatha śāśvatam
verses.translation: When the senses, turned back from their objects, remain in their abode, then by yourself you will see the supreme, eternal Self.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं विधूमम् इव पावकम् प्रपश्यन्ति महात्मानं ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ vidhūmam iva pāvakam prapaśyanti mahātmānaṃ brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The wise brahmins behold the great Self, the Self of all, like a fire without smoke.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुष्पफलोपेतो बहुशाखो महाद्रुमः आत्मनो नाभिजानीते क्व मे पुष्पं क्व मे फलम्
verses.transliteration: yathā puṣpaphalopeto bahuśākho mahādrumaḥ ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṃ kva me phalam
verses.translation: As a great tree with many branches, laden with flowers and fruits, does not itself know where its flowers are or where its fruits,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् आत्मा न जानीते क्व गमिष्ये कुतो ऽन्व् अहम् अन्यो ह्य् अस्यान्तरात्मास्ति यः सर्वम् अनुपश्यति
verses.transliteration: evam ātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kuto 'nv aham anyo hy asyāntarātmāsti yaḥ sarvam anupaśyati
verses.translation: so the individual self does not know where it will go or where it came from; there is another, its inner Self, who sees all.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानदीपेन दीप्तेन पश्यत्य् आत्मानम् आत्मना दृष्ट्वात्मानं तथा यूयं विरागा भवत द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: jñānadīpena dīptena paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ tathā yūyaṃ virāgā bhavata dvijāḥ
verses.translation: With the blazing lamp of knowledge one sees the Self by the self. Having seen the Self, O brahmins, become free of passion,

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्ताः सर्वपापेभ्यो मुक्तत्वच इवोरगाः परां बुद्धिम् अवाप्येहाप्य् अचिन्ता विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktatvaca ivoragāḥ parāṃ buddhim avāpyehāpy acintā vigatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: released from all sins like snakes that have cast their skins; attaining supreme understanding here, be free of anxiety and fever.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतःस्रोतसं घोरां नदीं लोकप्रवाहिणीम् पञ्चेन्द्रियग्राहवतीं मनःसंकल्परोधसम्
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥsrotasaṃ ghorāṃ nadīṃ lokapravāhiṇīm pañcendriyagrāhavatīṃ manaḥsaṃkalparodhasam
verses.translation: The terrible river that flows through the world, with currents on every side, with the five senses as its crocodiles and the mind's intentions as its banks,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: लोभमोहतृणच्छन्नां कामक्रोधसरीसृपाम् सत्यतीर्थानृतक्षोभां क्रोधपङ्कां सरिद्वराम्
verses.transliteration: lobhamohatṛṇacchannāṃ kāmakrodhasarīsṛpām satyatīrthānṛtakṣobhāṃ krodhapaṅkāṃ saridvarām
verses.translation: covered with the grass of greed and delusion, with desire and anger as its serpents, truth as its landing place and falsehood as its turbulence, anger as its mud — that best of rivers,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तप्रभवां शीघ्रां कामक्रोधसमाकुलाम् प्रतरध्वं नदीं बुद्ध्या दुस्तराम् अकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaprabhavāṃ śīghrāṃ kāmakrodhasamākulām prataradhvaṃ nadīṃ buddhyā dustarām akṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: rising from the unmanifest, swift, full of desire and anger — cross that river by the intellect, hard for the undisciplined to cross,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: संसारसागरगमां योनिपातालदुस्तराम् आत्मजन्मोद्भवां तां तु जिह्वावर्तदुरासदाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsārasāgaragamāṃ yonipātāladustarām ātmajanmodbhavāṃ tāṃ tu jihvāvartadurāsadām
verses.translation: flowing to the ocean of worldly existence, with the netherworld of births hard to pass, arising from one's own birth, hard to approach with the whirlpool of the tongue.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यां तरन्ति कृतप्रज्ञा धृतिमन्तो मनीषिणः तां तीर्णः सर्वतो मुक्तो विधूतात्मात्मवाञ् शुचिः
verses.transliteration: yāṃ taranti kṛtaprajñā dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ tāṃ tīrṇaḥ sarvato mukto vidhūtātmātmavāñ śuciḥ
verses.translation: The wise, of perfected understanding and steadfast, cross it; having crossed it, one is free on every side, cleansed, self-possessed and pure,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमां बुद्धिम् आस्थाय ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते उत्तीर्णः सर्वसंक्लेशान् प्रसन्नात्मा विकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: uttamāṃ buddhim āsthāya brahmabhūyāya kalpate uttīrṇaḥ sarvasaṃkleśān prasannātmā vikalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: and resting in the highest understanding becomes fit for union with Brahman; having crossed beyond all afflictions, serene and stainless,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: भूयिष्ठानीव भूतानि सर्वस्थानान् निरीक्ष्य च अक्रुध्यन्न् अप्रसीदंश् च ननृशंसमतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūyiṣṭhānīva bhūtāni sarvasthānān nirīkṣya ca akrudhyann aprasīdaṃś ca nanṛśaṃsamatis tathā
verses.translation: looking on beings of every place as if from a height, neither angry nor elated, and without cruelty of mind,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रक्ष्यथ सर्वेषां भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययम् एतद् धि सर्वधर्मेभ्यो विशिष्टं मेनिरे बुधाः
verses.transliteration: tato drakṣyatha sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam etad dhi sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ
verses.translation: then you will see the origin and dissolution of all beings. This the wise have held to be superior to all dharmas —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठा मुनयः सत्यदर्शिनः आत्मानो व्यापिनो विप्रा इति पुत्रानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhā munayaḥ satyadarśinaḥ ātmāno vyāpino viprā iti putrānuśāsanam
verses.translation: this dharma, O best of those who uphold dharma, sages who see the truth, of the all-pervading Self, O brahmins; such is the teaching for sons.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रयताय प्रवक्तव्यं हितायानुगताय च आत्मज्ञानम् इदं गुह्यं सर्वगुह्यतमं महत्
verses.transliteration: prayatāya pravaktavyaṃ hitāyānugatāya ca ātmajñānam idaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaguhyatamaṃ mahat
verses.translation: It should be told to one who is restrained, well-meaning and devoted. This knowledge of the Self is secret, the greatest and most secret of all.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवं यद् अहं विप्रा आत्मसाक्षिकम् अञ्जसा नैव स्त्री न पुमान् एवं न चैवेदं नपुंसकम्
verses.transliteration: abravaṃ yad ahaṃ viprā ātmasākṣikam añjasā naiva strī na pumān evaṃ na caivedaṃ napuṃsakam
verses.translation: What I have told you, O brahmins, is plainly witnessed by the Self itself. Brahman is neither woman nor man, nor is it neuter;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अदुःखम् असुखं ब्रह्म भूतभव्यभवात्मकम् नैतज् ज्ञात्वा पुमान् स्त्री वा पुनर्भवम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: aduḥkham asukhaṃ brahma bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam naitaj jñātvā pumān strī vā punarbhavam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Brahman is without sorrow and without pleasure, the essence of past, future and present. Knowing it, neither man nor woman comes to birth again.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा मतानि सर्वाणि तथैतानि यथा तथा कथितानि मया विप्रा भवन्ति न भवन्ति च
verses.transliteration: yathā matāni sarvāṇi tathaitāni yathā tathā kathitāni mayā viprā bhavanti na bhavanti ca
verses.translation: As all the doctrines are, so have I told these as they are, O brahmins; they are and they are not.

verses.sanskrit: तत्प्रीतियुक्तेन गुणान्वितेन पुत्रेण सत्पुत्रदयान्वितेन दृष्ट्वा हितं प्रीतमना यदर्थं ब्रूयात् सुतस्येह यद् उक्तम् एतत्
verses.transliteration: tatprītiyuktena guṇānvitena putreṇa satputradayānvitena dṛṣṭvā hitaṃ prītamanā yadarthaṃ brūyāt sutasyeha yad uktam etat
verses.translation: This is what a father, glad at heart, would tell his son, seeing his good — a son full of love, endowed with virtues, and with the kindness of a good son.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षः पितामहेनोक्त उपायान् नानुपायतः तम् उपायं यथान्यायं श्रोतुम् इच्छामहे मुने
verses.transliteration: mokṣaḥ pitāmahenokta upāyān nānupāyataḥ tam upāyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotum icchāmahe mune
verses.translation: "The Grandsire declared that liberation comes through a means, not without one; we wish to hear that means duly, O sage."

verses.sanskrit: अस्मासु तन् महाप्राज्ञा युक्तं निपुणदर्शनम् यदुपायेन सर्वार्थान् मृगयध्वं सदानघाः
verses.transliteration: asmāsu tan mahāprājñā yuktaṃ nipuṇadarśanam yadupāyena sarvārthān mṛgayadhvaṃ sadānaghāḥ
verses.translation: "That is fitting in you, O wise ones — a subtle insight, that you always seek all aims through a means, sinless ones.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: घटोपकरणे बुद्धिर् घटोत्पत्तौ न सा मता एवं धर्माद्युपायार्थे नान्यधर्मेषु कारणम्
verses.transliteration: ghaṭopakaraṇe buddhir ghaṭotpattau na sā matā evaṃ dharmādyupāyārthe nānyadharmeṣu kāraṇam
verses.translation: The intention to make a pot's tools is not held to be the making of the pot; so the means to dharma and the rest is not the cause in other dharmas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे समुद्रे यः पन्था न स गच्छति पश्चिमम् एकः पन्था हि मोक्षस्य तच् छृणुध्वं ममानघाः
verses.transliteration: pūrve samudre yaḥ panthā na sa gacchati paścimam ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tac chṛṇudhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ
verses.translation: The path to the eastern sea does not lead to the western; there is one path to liberation — hear it from me, sinless ones.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: क्षमया क्रोधम् उच्छिन्द्यात् कामं संकल्पवर्जनात् सत्त्वसंसेवनाद् धीरो निद्राम् उच्छेत्तुम् अर्हति
verses.transliteration: kṣamayā krodham ucchindyāt kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt sattvasaṃsevanād dhīro nidrām ucchettum arhati
verses.translation: By forbearance one should cut off anger, and desire by giving up intentions; the steadfast should cut off sleep by cultivating sattva.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमादाद् भयं रक्षेद् रक्षेत् क्षेत्रं च संविदम् इच्छां द्वेषं च कामं च धैर्येण विनिवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: apramādād bhayaṃ rakṣed rakṣet kṣetraṃ ca saṃvidam icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet
verses.translation: By heedfulness one should guard against fear, and guard the field and awareness; by firmness one should turn back longing, aversion and desire.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निद्रां च प्रतिभां चैव ज्ञानाभ्यासेन तत्त्ववित् उपद्रवांस् तथा योगी हितजीर्णमिताशनात्
verses.transliteration: nidrāṃ ca pratibhāṃ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit upadravāṃs tathā yogī hitajīrṇamitāśanāt
verses.translation: The knower of truth should overcome sleep and wandering fancy by the practice of knowledge, and the yogi should overcome disturbances by wholesome, digestible and measured food;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: लोभं मोहं च संतोषाद् विषयांस् तत्त्वदर्शनात् अनुक्रोशाद् अधर्मं च जयेद् धर्मम् उपेक्षया
verses.transliteration: lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca saṃtoṣād viṣayāṃs tattvadarśanāt anukrośād adharmaṃ ca jayed dharmam upekṣayā
verses.translation: greed and delusion by contentment, sense objects by seeing the truth; he should conquer adharma by compassion, and dharma by indifference;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आयत्या च जयेद् आशां सामर्थ्यं सङ्गवर्जनात् अनित्यत्वेन च स्नेहं क्षुधां योगेन पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: āyatyā ca jayed āśāṃ sāmarthyaṃ saṅgavarjanāt anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhāṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: hope by thought for the future, power by giving up attachment, affection by seeing impermanence, and hunger by yoga — so the wise one should;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कारुण्येनात्मनात्मानं तृष्णां च परितोषतः उत्थानेन जयेत् तन्द्रां वितर्कं निश्चयाज् जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kāruṇyenātmanātmānaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca paritoṣataḥ utthānena jayet tandrāṃ vitarkaṃ niścayāj jayet
verses.translation: the self by compassion, craving by contentment; he should conquer lethargy by exertion and doubt by resolution;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मौनेन बहुभाषां च शौर्येण च भयं जयेत् यच्छेद् वाङ्मनसी बुद्ध्या तां यच्छेज् ज्ञानचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: maunena bahubhāṣāṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet yacched vāṅmanasī buddhyā tāṃ yacchej jñānacakṣuṣā
verses.translation: much talk by silence, and fear by courage. He should restrain speech and mind by the intellect, and that by the eye of knowledge;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.transliteration: jñānam ātmā mahān yacchet taṃ yacchec chāntir ātmanaḥ tad etad upaśāntena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā
verses.translation: the great self should restrain knowledge, and the peace of the Self should restrain that. This is to be understood by one who is calm and pure in deeds,

verses.transliteration: yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam
verses.translation: having cut away the five faults of yoga known to the wise — desire, anger, greed, fear and sleep as the fifth.

verses.transliteration: parityajya niṣeveta yathāvad yogasādhanāt dhyānam adhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīr ārjavaṃ kṣamā
verses.translation: Having abandoned these, one should practise the means of yoga duly: meditation, study, giving, truth, modesty, straightforwardness, forbearance,

verses.transliteration: śaucam ācārataḥ śuddhir indriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ etair vivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānam upahanti ca
verses.translation: cleanliness in conduct, purity and restraint of the senses — by these radiance grows and sin is struck down.

verses.sanskrit: सिध्यन्ति चास्य संकल्पा विज्ञानं च प्रवर्तते धूतपापः स तेजस्वी लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: sidhyanti cāsya saṃkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate dhūtapāpaḥ sa tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: His intentions are fulfilled and understanding arises; with sin shaken off, radiant, eating lightly and with senses conquered,

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधौ वशे कृत्वा निर्विशेद् ब्रह्मणः पदम् अमूढत्वम् असङ्गित्वं कामक्रोधविवर्जनम्
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā nirviśed brahmaṇaḥ padam amūḍhatvam asaṅgitvaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam
verses.translation: bringing desire and anger under control, he should enter the state of Brahman. Freedom from delusion, freedom from attachment, the giving up of desire and anger,

verses.sanskrit: अदैन्यम् अनुदीर्णत्वम् अनुद्वेगो ह्य् अवस्थितिः एष मार्गो हि मोक्षस्य प्रसन्नो विमलः शुचिः तथा वाक्कायमनसां नियमाः कामतो ऽव्ययाः
verses.transliteration: adainyam anudīrṇatvam anudvego hy avasthitiḥ eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ tathā vākkāyamanasāṃ niyamāḥ kāmato 'vyayāḥ
verses.translation: freedom from dejection and from excitement, freedom from agitation, and steadiness — this is the path of liberation, serene, stainless and pure; and so too are the disciplines of speech, body and mind, undecaying when kept willingly."

verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyaṃ yogasya no vipra viśeṣaṃ vaktum arhasi tava dharmajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ munisattama
verses.translation: Where Sambhu, the lord of Devas, the lord of the uni¬ verse, favourably disposed towards his devotees appeared per¬ sonally, O Devapi, that place has become the holy centre Deva- tlrtha.

verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ praśaṃsanti yogān yogaviduttamāḥ vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ svapakṣodbhavanāya vai
verses.translation: O highly fortunate one, go to lord Sambhu worshipped by the three worlds. Inform Siva that there is danger from Taraka. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly fortunate one, go to lord Sambhu worshipped by the three worlds. Inform Siva that there is danger from Taraka. 1

verses.transliteration: anīśvaraḥ kathaṃ mucyed ity evaṃ munisattamāḥ vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ yogaṃ samyaṅ manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: A powerful demon who by the performance of severe penance had secured a boon from Siva and had later became a great terror to gods; killed by Skanda who as a result of a divine planning was bom to Siva and Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: A powerful demon who by the performance of severe penance had secured a boon from Siva and had later became a great terror to gods; killed by Skanda who as a result of a divine planning was bom to Siva and Parvati.

verses.transliteration: vadanti kāraṇaṃ vedaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ samyag dvijātayaḥ vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ
verses.translation: One should not go to that place where a couple remain in secret communion. This is a general rule. What then with regard to the trident bearing lord?
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not go to that place where a couple remain in secret communion. This is a general rule. What then with regard to the trident bearing lord?

verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ sa dehāt suvyaktaṃ vimucyed iti nānyathā etad āhur mahāprājñāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ vai mokṣadarśanam
verses.translation: After intimating to Sambhu the words of Devas come back quickly. Then, Fire-god, we shall offer you worship (on behalf) of the two worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After intimating to Sambhu the words of Devas come back quickly. Then, Fire-god, we shall offer you worship (on behalf) of the two worlds.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपक्षे कारणं ग्राह्यं समर्थं वचनं हितम् शिष्टानां हि मतं ग्राह्यं भवद्भिः शिष्टसंमतैः
verses.transliteration: svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataiḥ
verses.translation: Out of love Agni gave Suvarna (in marriage) to the intelligent Dharma. He made Samkalpa the beloved wife of his son Suvarna. Thus Fire-god performed the marriages of his son and daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of love Agni gave Suvarna (in marriage) to the intelligent Dharma. He made Samkalpa the beloved wife of his son Suvarna. Thus Fire-god performed the marriages of his son and daughter.

verses.transliteration: pratyakṣaṃ hetavo yogāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śāstraviniścayāḥ ubhe caite mate tattve samavete dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing these (amorous) activities of Suvarna and Suvarna, the son of Agni as well as the daughter of Agni, Devas and Asuras became angry and they cursed the son and daughter of Agni at that time.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing these (amorous) activities of Suvarna and Suvarna, the son of Agni as well as the daughter of Agni, Devas and Asuras became angry and they cursed the son and daughter of Agni at that time.

verses.sanskrit: उभे चैते मते ज्ञाते मुनीन्द्राः शिष्टसंमते अनुष्ठिते यथाशास्त्रं नयेतां परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ubhe caite mate jñāte munīndrāḥ śiṣṭasaṃmate anuṣṭhite yathāśāstraṃ nayetāṃ paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On hearing these words of imprecation Agni approach¬ ed me with great fright and spoke, "Tell me the mode of ex¬ piation for the children'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of imprecation Agni approach¬ ed me with great fright and spoke, "Tell me the mode of ex¬ piation for the children'*.

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यं शौचं तयोर् युक्तं दया भूतेषु चानघाः व्रतानां धारणं तुल्यं दर्शनं त्व् असमं तयोः
verses.transliteration: tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayor yuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānaghāḥ vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ tv asamaṃ tayoḥ
verses.translation: Eulogize the lord and the goddess. Siva will be pleased with your devotion. Then you will get the fulfilment of cherish¬ ed desires in regard to your children.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogize the lord and the goddess. Siva will be pleased with your devotion. Then you will get the fulfilment of cherish¬ ed desires in regard to your children.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यदि तुल्यं व्रतं शौचं दया चात्र महामुने तुल्यं तद्दर्शनं कस्मात् तन् नो ब्रूहि द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra mahāmune tulyaṃ taddarśanaṃ kasmāt tan no brūhi dvijottama
verses.translation: Then at my instance, Agni went to Ganga and eulogized Mahesvara by means of laudatory statements equal to the Vedas in importance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at my instance, Agni went to Ganga and eulogized Mahesvara by means of laudatory statements equal to the Vedas in importance.

verses.sanskrit: रागं मोहं तथा स्नेहं कामं क्रोधं च केवलम् योगास्थिरोदितान् दोषान् पञ्चैतान् प्राप्नुवन्ति तान्
verses.transliteration: rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam yogāsthiroditān doṣān pañcaitān prāpnuvanti tān
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord Siva, the unchanging and the endless, asked Agni, worshipped by Devas to choose any boon he liked.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord Siva, the unchanging and the endless, asked Agni, worshipped by Devas to choose any boon he liked.

verses.sanskrit: यथा वानिमिषाः स्थूलं जालं छित्त्वा पुनर् जलम् प्राप्नुवन्ति तथा योगात् तत् पदं वीतकल्मषाः
verses.transliteration: yathā vānimiṣāḥ sthūlaṃ jālaṃ chittvā punar jalam prāpnuvanti tathā yogāt tat padaṃ vītakalmaṣāḥ
verses.translation: Men without Suvarna are dead though (physically) alive. A rich man though devoid of good qualities is worthy of being honoured, but not so a poor man though endowed with good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men without Suvarna are dead though (physically) alive. A rich man though devoid of good qualities is worthy of being honoured, but not so a poor man though endowed with good qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव वागुरां छित्त्वा बलवन्तो यथा मृगाः प्राप्नुयुर् विमलं मार्गं विमुक्ताः सर्वबन्धनैः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ prāpnuyur vimalaṃ mārgaṃ vimuktāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ
verses.translation: There are fourteen thousand holy centres on the northern bank and sixteen thousand holy centres on the southern bank.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are fourteen thousand holy centres on the northern bank and sixteen thousand holy centres on the southern bank.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: लोभजानि तथा विप्रा बन्धनानि बलान्वितः छित्त्वा योगात् परं मार्गं गच्छन्ति विमलं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: lobhajāni tathā viprā bandhanāni balānvitaḥ chittvā yogāt paraṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalaṃ śubham
verses.translation: In different places, the holy centres have special marks of recognition. They have separate names as well. It has been briefly mentioned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: In different places, the holy centres have special marks of recognition. They have separate names as well. It has been briefly mentioned by me.

verses.sanskrit: अचलास् त्व् आविला विप्रा वागुरासु तथापरे विनश्यन्ति न संदेहस् तद्वद् योगबलाद् ऋते
verses.transliteration: acalās tv āvilā viprā vāgurāsu tathāpare vinaśyanti na saṃdehas tadvad yogabalād ṛte
verses.translation: Whoever listens to this, reads or remembers this, will be perfect in all desirable respects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whoever listens to this, reads or remembers this, will be perfect in all desirable respects.

verses.sanskrit: बलहीनाश् च विप्रेन्द्रा यथा जालं गता द्विजाः बन्धं न गच्छन्त्य् अनघा योगास् ते तु सुदुर्लभाः
verses.transliteration: balahīnāś ca viprendrā yathā jālaṃ gatā dvijāḥ bandhaṃ na gacchanty anaghā yogās te tu sudurlabhāḥ
verses.translation: If a man knows this and performs holy dip etc. there, he remains rich always and particularly righteous.

verses.sanskrit: यथा च शकुनाः सूक्ष्मं प्राप्य जालम् अरिंदमाः तत्राशक्ता विपद्यन्ते मुच्यन्ते तु बलान्विताः
verses.transliteration: yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmaṃ prāpya jālam ariṃdamāḥ tatrāśaktā vipadyante mucyante tu balānvitāḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention what has transpired on the southern bank of Ganga. On the northern bank there is the holy centre named Indresvara. Listen with devotion observing holy rites with controlled senses.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention what has transpired on the southern bank of Ganga. On the northern bank there is the holy centre named Indresvara. Listen with devotion observing holy rites with controlled senses.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मजैर् बन्धनैर् बद्धास् तद्वद् योगपरा द्विजाः अबला न विमुच्यन्ते मुच्यन्ते च बलान्विताः
verses.transliteration: karmajair bandhanair baddhās tadvad yogaparā dvijāḥ abalā na vimucyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ
verses.translation: The excessively arrogant enemy of Indra named Namuci was very strong. He fought with Indra Indra removed his head with Phena (watery foam).

verses.sanskrit: अल्पकश् च यथा विप्रा वह्निः शाम्यति दुर्बलः आक्रान्त इन्धनैः स्थूलैस् तद्वद् योगबलः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: alpakaś ca yathā viprā vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ ākrānta indhanaiḥ sthūlais tadvad yogabalaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: As a small, weak fire is put out, O brahmins, when smothered by heavy fuel, so is the power of yoga said to be when weak.

verses.sanskrit: स एव च तदा विप्रा वह्निर् जातबलः पुनः समीरणगतः कृत्स्नां दहेत् क्षिप्रं महीम् इमाम्
verses.transliteration: sa eva ca tadā viprā vahnir jātabalaḥ punaḥ samīraṇagataḥ kṛtsnāṃ dahet kṣipraṃ mahīm imām
verses.translation: That same fire, O brahmins, when it gains strength again and is fanned by the wind, may quickly burn this whole earth.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वज्ञानबलो योगी दीप्ततेजा महाबलः अन्तकाल इवादित्यः कृत्स्नं संशोषयेज् जगत्
verses.transliteration: tattvajñānabalo yogī dīptatejā mahābalaḥ antakāla ivādityaḥ kṛtsnaṃ saṃśoṣayej jagat
verses.translation: The yogi strong in knowledge of truth, blazing with radiance and of great strength, could dry up the whole world like the sun at the end of time.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बलश् च यथा विप्राः स्रोतसा ह्रियते नरः बलहीनस् तथा योगी विषयैर् ह्रियते च सः
verses.transliteration: durbalaś ca yathā viprāḥ srotasā hriyate naraḥ balahīnas tathā yogī viṣayair hriyate ca saḥ
verses.translation: As a weak man is carried away by a current, O brahmins, so a yogi without strength is carried away by sense objects.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तद् एव तु यथा स्रोतो विष्कम्भयति वारणः तद्वद् योगबलं लब्ध्वा न भवेद् विषयैर् हृतः
verses.transliteration: tad eva tu yathā sroto viṣkambhayati vāraṇaḥ tadvad yogabalaṃ labdhvā na bhaved viṣayair hṛtaḥ
verses.translation: But as an elephant stems that same current, so, having gained the strength of yoga, one is not carried away by sense objects.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विशन्ति वा वशाद् वाथ योगाद् योगबलान्विताः प्रजापतीन् मनून् सर्वान् महाभूतानि चेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: viśanti vā vaśād vātha yogād yogabalānvitāḥ prajāpatīn manūn sarvān mahābhūtāni ceśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Endowed with the power of yoga, through their mastery the lords of yoga enter at will all the Prajapatis, the Manus and the great elements.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न यमो नान्तकः क्रुद्धो न मृत्युर् भीमविक्रमः विशन्ते तद् द्विजाः सर्वे योगस्यामिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mṛtyur bhīmavikramaḥ viśante tad dvijāḥ sarve yogasyāmitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: Neither Yama, nor wrathful Death the Ender, nor Mrityu of terrible prowess can overcome the yogi of boundless radiance, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनां च सहस्राणि बहूनि द्विजसत्तमाः योगं कुर्याद् बलं प्राप्य तैश् च सर्वैर् महीं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: ātmanāṃ ca sahasrāṇi bahūni dvijasattamāḥ yogaṃ kuryād balaṃ prāpya taiś ca sarvair mahīṃ caret
verses.translation: Having gained power, O best of brahmins, the yogi may create many thousands of selves and roam the earth with all of them;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुयाद् विषयान् कश्चित् पुनश् चोग्रं तपश् चरेत् संक्षिप्येच् च पुनर् विप्राः सूर्यस् तेजोगुणान् इव
verses.transliteration: prāpnuyād viṣayān kaścit punaś cograṃ tapaś caret saṃkṣipyec ca punar viprāḥ sūryas tejoguṇān iva
verses.translation: with some he may enjoy sense objects, and with others perform fierce austerity, and then withdraw them again, O brahmins, as the sun withdraws its rays.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बलस्थस्य हि योगस्य बलार्थं मुनिसत्तमाः विमोक्षप्रभवं विष्णुम् उपपन्नम् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: balasthasya hi yogasya balārthaṃ munisattamāḥ vimokṣaprabhavaṃ viṣṇum upapannam asaṃśayam
verses.translation: For one established in the power of yoga, O best of sages, Vishnu, the source of liberation, is surely attained.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बलानि योगप्रोक्तानि मयैतानि द्विजोत्तमाः निदर्शनार्थं सूक्ष्माणि वक्ष्यामि च पुनर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: balāni yogaproktāni mayaitāni dvijottamāḥ nidarśanārthaṃ sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punar dvijāḥ
verses.translation: These powers taught in yoga I have told you, O best of brahmins, as examples; now I will speak again of subtle ones, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनश् च समाधाने धारणां प्रति वा द्विजाः निदर्शनानि सूक्ष्माणि शृणुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ātmanaś ca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati vā dvijāḥ nidarśanāni sūkṣmāṇi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Hear, O best of sages, the subtle illustrations concerning the concentration of the self and the practice of fixation.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमत्तो यथा धन्वी लक्ष्यं हन्ति समाहितः युक्तः सम्यक् तथा योगी मोक्षं प्राप्नोत्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ yuktaḥ samyak tathā yogī mokṣaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: As an archer, heedful and collected, hits his target, so the yogi rightly yoked attains liberation, without doubt.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहपात्रे यथा पूर्णे मन आधाय निश्चलम् पुरुषो युक्त आरोहेत् सोपानं युक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: snehapātre yathā pūrṇe mana ādhāya niścalam puruṣo yukta ārohet sopānaṃ yuktamānasaḥ
verses.translation: As a man carrying a full vessel of oil, his mind fixed and unwavering, climbs a stair with attentive mind,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तस् तथायम् आत्मानं योगं तद्वत् सुनिश्चलम् करोत्य् अमलम् आत्मानं भास्करोपमदर्शने
verses.transliteration: muktas tathāyam ātmānaṃ yogaṃ tadvat suniścalam karoty amalam ātmānaṃ bhāskaropamadarśane
verses.translation: so the liberated one makes the self and his yoga perfectly steady, and makes the self stainless, like the sun to behold.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा च नावं विप्रेन्द्राः कर्णधारः समाहितः महार्णवगतां शीघ्रं नयेद् विप्रांस् तु पत्तनम्
verses.transliteration: yathā ca nāvaṃ viprendrāḥ karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ mahārṇavagatāṃ śīghraṃ nayed viprāṃs tu pattanam
verses.translation: As a steersman, attentive, O best of brahmins, quickly brings a ship on the great ocean to port with its passengers,

verses.sanskrit: तद्वद् आत्मसमाधानं युक्तो योगेन योगवित् दुर्गमं स्थानम् आप्नोति हित्वा देहम् इमं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tadvad ātmasamādhānaṃ yukto yogena yogavit durgamaṃ sthānam āpnoti hitvā deham imaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: so the knower of yoga, joined in yoga through concentration of the self, reaches a place hard to attain on leaving this body, O brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिश् च यथा युक्तः सदश्वान् सुसमाहितः देशम् इष्टं नयत्य् आशु धन्विनं पुरुषर्षभम्
verses.transliteration: sārathiś ca yathā yuktaḥ sadaśvān susamāhitaḥ deśam iṣṭaṃ nayaty āśu dhanvinaṃ puruṣarṣabham
verses.translation: As a charioteer, attentive and well collected, quickly brings a bowman, a bull among men, with good horses to the desired place,

verses.sanskrit: तथैव च द्विजा योगी धारणासु समाहितः प्राप्नोत्य् आशु परं स्थानं लक्ष्यमुक्त इवाशुगः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva ca dvijā yogī dhāraṇāsu samāhitaḥ prāpnoty āśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣyamukta ivāśugaḥ
verses.translation: so, O brahmins, the yogi collected in fixations quickly reaches the supreme place, like an arrow loosed at its mark.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आविश्यात्मनि चात्मानं यो ऽवतिष्ठति सो ऽचलः पाशं हत्वेव मीनानां पदम् आप्नोति सो ऽजरम्
verses.transliteration: āviśyātmani cātmānaṃ yo 'vatiṣṭhati so 'calaḥ pāśaṃ hatveva mīnānāṃ padam āpnoti so 'jaram
verses.translation: He who, entering the Self with the self, remains unmoving, reaches the unageing state, as a fish breaks free of the net.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नाभ्यां शीर्षे च कुक्षौ च हृदि वक्षसि पार्श्वयोः दर्शने श्रवणे वापि घ्राणे चामितविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: nābhyāṃ śīrṣe ca kukṣau ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ darśane śravaṇe vāpi ghrāṇe cāmitavikramaḥ
verses.translation: At the navel, the head, the belly, the heart, the chest, the sides, in sight, hearing or smell, he of boundless power —

verses.sanskrit: स्थानेष्व् एतेषु यो योगी महाव्रतसमाहितः आत्मना सूक्ष्मम् आत्मानं युङ्क्ते सम्यग् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sthāneṣv eteṣu yo yogī mahāvratasamāhitaḥ ātmanā sūkṣmam ātmānaṃ yuṅkte samyag dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: the yogi who, collected in great vows, rightly joins the subtle Self with the self in these places, O best of brahmins,

verses.sanskrit: सुशीघ्रम् अचलप्रख्यं कर्म दग्ध्वा शुभाशुभम् उत्तमं योगम् आस्थाय यदीच्छति विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: suśīghram acalaprakhyaṃ karma dagdhvā śubhāśubham uttamaṃ yogam āsthāya yadīcchati vimucyate
verses.translation: very quickly burns up karma, good and bad, massive as a mountain, and resting in the highest yoga is released whenever he wishes."

verses.sanskrit: आहारान् कीदृशान् कृत्वा कानि जित्वा च सत्तम योगी बलम् अवाप्नोति तद् भवान् वक्तुम् अर्हति
verses.transliteration: āhārān kīdṛśān kṛtvā kāni jitvā ca sattama yogī balam avāpnoti tad bhavān vaktum arhati
verses.translation: "By taking what kinds of food and conquering what, O good one, does the yogi gain power? Please tell us that."

verses.sanskrit: कणानां भक्षणे युक्तः पिण्याकस्य च भो द्विजाः स्नेहानां वर्जने युक्तो योगी बलम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bho dvijāḥ snehānāṃ varjane yukto yogī balam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "Given to eating broken grains and oil-cake, O brahmins, and avoiding oily foods, the yogi gains power.

verses.sanskrit: भुञ्जानो यावकं रूक्षं दीर्घकालं द्विजोत्तमाः एकाहारी विशुद्धात्मा योगी बलम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: bhuñjāno yāvakaṃ rūkṣaṃ dīrghakālaṃ dvijottamāḥ ekāhārī viśuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Eating dry barley gruel for a long time, O best of brahmins, taking one meal a day, pure of self, the yogi gains power.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पक्षान् मासान् ऋतूंश् चित्रान् संचरंश् च गुहास् तथा अपः पीत्वा पयोमिश्रा योगी बलम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pakṣān māsān ṛtūṃś citrān saṃcaraṃś ca guhās tathā apaḥ pītvā payomiśrā yogī balam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: For fortnights, months and varied seasons, wandering in caves and drinking water mixed with milk, the yogi gains power.

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डम् अपि वा मासं सततं मुनिसत्तमाः उपोष्य सम्यक् शुद्धात्मा योगी बलम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: akhaṇḍam api vā māsaṃ satataṃ munisattamāḥ upoṣya samyak śuddhātmā yogī balam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Fasting properly for an entire month without break, O best of sages, pure of self, the yogi gains power.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कामं जित्वा तथा क्रोधं शीतोष्णं वर्षम् एव च भयं शोकं तथा स्वापं पौरुषान् विषयांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇaṃ varṣam eva ca bhayaṃ śokaṃ tathā svāpaṃ pauruṣān viṣayāṃs tathā
verses.translation: Having conquered desire and anger, cold and heat and rain, fear, grief and sleep, and the objects of men,

verses.sanskrit: अरतिं दुर्जयां चैव घोरां दृष्ट्वा च भो द्विजाः स्पर्शं निद्रां तथा तन्द्रां दुर्जयां मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bho dvijāḥ sparśaṃ nidrāṃ tathā tandrāṃ durjayāṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: and having faced dreadful discontent, so hard to conquer, O brahmins, and touch, sleep and lethargy, so hard to conquer, O best of sages,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दीपयन्ति महात्मानं सूक्ष्मम् आत्मानम् आत्मना वीतरागा महाप्राज्ञा ध्यानाध्ययनसंपदा
verses.transliteration: dīpayanti mahātmānaṃ sūkṣmam ātmānam ātmanā vītarāgā mahāprājñā dhyānādhyayanasaṃpadā
verses.translation: the great-souled ones, free of passion and deeply wise, illumine the subtle Self by the self through the wealth of meditation and study.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गस् त्व् एष मतः पन्था ब्राह्मणानां विपश्चिताम् यः कश्चिद् व्रजति क्षिप्रं क्षेमेण मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.transliteration: durgas tv eṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām yaḥ kaścid vrajati kṣipraṃ kṣemeṇa munipuṃgavāḥ
verses.translation: This path of wise brahmins is held to be hard to travel; few go on it quickly and safely, O bulls among sages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथा कश्चिद् वनं घोरं बहुसर्पसरीसृपम् श्वभ्रवत् तोयहीनं च दुर्गमं बहुकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: yathā kaścid vanaṃ ghoraṃ bahusarpasarīsṛpam śvabhravat toyahīnaṃ ca durgamaṃ bahukaṇṭakam
verses.translation: As one might pass safely through a dreadful forest full of snakes and reptiles, full of pits, waterless, hard to cross and full of thorns,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अभक्तम् अटवीप्रायं दावदग्धमहीरुहम् पन्थानं तस्कराकीर्णं क्षेमेणाभिपतेत् तथा
verses.transliteration: abhaktam aṭavīprāyaṃ dāvadagdhamahīruham panthānaṃ taskarākīrṇaṃ kṣemeṇābhipatet tathā
verses.translation: without food, mostly wilderness, its trees burnt by forest fires, a road infested with robbers —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योगमार्गं समासाद्य यः कश्चिद् व्रजते द्विजः क्षेमेणोपरमेन् मार्गाद् बहुदोषो ऽपि संमतः
verses.transliteration: yogamārgaṃ samāsādya yaḥ kaścid vrajate dvijaḥ kṣemeṇoparamen mārgād bahudoṣo 'pi saṃmataḥ
verses.translation: so a brahmin who takes up the path of yoga and travels on it may safely come to rest, though the path is held to have many dangers.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आस्थेयं क्षुरधारासु निशितासु द्विजोत्तमाः धारणा सा तु योगस्य दुर्गेयम् अकृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: āstheyaṃ kṣuradhārāsu niśitāsu dvijottamāḥ dhāraṇā sā tu yogasya durgeyam akṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: One must stand on sharpened razor edges, O best of brahmins; such is the fixation of yoga, hard to endure for the undisciplined.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषमा धारणा विप्रा यान्ति वै न शुभां गतिम् नेतृहीना यथा नावः पुरुषाणां तु वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣamā dhāraṇā viprā yānti vai na śubhāṃ gatim netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Uneven fixations do not lead to a good goal, O brahmins, just as ships without a pilot do not bring men to safety.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यस् तु तिष्ठति योगाधौ धारणासु यथाविधि मरणं जन्मदुःखित्वं सुखित्वं स विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: yas tu tiṣṭhati yogādhau dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi maraṇaṃ janmaduḥkhitvaṃ sukhitvaṃ sa viśiṣyate
verses.translation: But he who stands firm in the fixations as prescribed in the practice of yoga rises above death, the sorrow of birth, and happiness.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नानाशास्त्रेषु नियतं नानामुनिनिषेवितम् परं योगस्य पन्थानं निश्चितं तं द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: nānāśāstreṣu niyataṃ nānāmuniniṣevitam paraṃ yogasya panthānaṃ niścitaṃ taṃ dvijātiṣu
verses.translation: Laid down in various scriptures and practised by various sages, this supreme path of yoga is certain among the twice-born.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परं हि तद् ब्रह्ममयं मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्माणम् ईशं वरदं च विष्णुम् भवं च धर्मं च महानुभावं यद् ब्रह्मपुत्रान् सुमहानुभावान्
verses.transliteration: paraṃ hi tad brahmamayaṃ munīndrā brahmāṇam īśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca mahānubhāvaṃ yad brahmaputrān sumahānubhāvān
verses.translation: For that supreme state is made of Brahman, O lords of sages; Brahma, the boon-giving Lord Vishnu, Bhava, Dharma of great power, and the mighty sons of Brahma,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तमश् च कष्टं सुमहद् रजश् च सत्त्वं च शुद्धं प्रकृतिं परां च सिद्धिं च देवीं वरुणस्य पत्नीं तेजश् च कृत्स्नं सुमहच् च धैर्यम्
verses.transliteration: tamaś ca kaṣṭaṃ sumahad rajaś ca sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ tejaś ca kṛtsnaṃ sumahac ca dhairyam
verses.translation: the harsh and vast tamas and rajas, pure sattva and supreme Prakriti, the goddess Siddhi, wife of Varuna, all radiance and vast steadfastness,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ताराधिपं खे विमलं सुतारं विश्वांश् च देवान् उरगान् पितॄंश् च शैलांश् च कृत्स्नान् उदधींश् च वाचलान् नदीश् च सर्वाः सनगांश् च नागान्
verses.transliteration: tārādhipaṃ khe vimalaṃ sutāraṃ viśvāṃś ca devān uragān pitṝṃś ca śailāṃś ca kṛtsnān udadhīṃś ca vācalān nadīś ca sarvāḥ sanagāṃś ca nāgān
verses.translation: the stainless lord of stars with his bright stars in the sky, the Vishvedevas, serpents and ancestors, all the mountains and the roaring oceans, all the rivers with their forests, and the Nagas,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: साध्यांस् तथा यक्षगणान् दिशश् च गन्धर्वसिद्धान् पुरुषान् स्त्रियश् च परस्परं प्राप्य महान् महात्मा विशेत योगी नचिराद् विमुक्तः
verses.transliteration: sādhyāṃs tathā yakṣagaṇān diśaś ca gandharvasiddhān puruṣān striyaś ca parasparaṃ prāpya mahān mahātmā viśeta yogī nacirād vimuktaḥ
verses.translation: the Sadhyas, the hosts of Yakshas, the directions, the Gandharvas and Siddhas, men and women — reaching them one after another, the great-souled yogi soon enters them and is freed.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कथा च या विप्रवराः प्रसक्ता दैवे महावीर्यमतौ शुभेयम् योगान् स सर्वान् अनुभूय मर्त्या नारायणं तं द्रुतम् आप्नुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: kathā ca yā vipravarāḥ prasaktā daive mahāvīryamatau śubheyam yogān sa sarvān anubhūya martyā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ drutam āpnuvanti
verses.translation: This auspicious story, O best of brahmins, bound up with the gods and with minds of great power — mortals who experience all these yogas swiftly attain Narayana.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सम्यक् क्रियेयं विप्रेन्द्र वर्णिता शिष्टसंमता योगमार्गो यथान्यायं शिष्यायेह हितैषिणा
verses.transliteration: samyak kriyeyaṃ viprendra varṇitā śiṣṭasaṃmatā yogamārgo yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyāyeha hitaiṣiṇā
verses.translation: By performing penance he became invincible to all Devas. He became very terrible. His son also was very power¬ ful, difficult to be conquered by Devas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ये त्व् इदानीं धर्मस्य विधिं प्रब्रूहि तत्त्वतः त्रिषु लोकेषु यज् ज्ञानं सर्वं तद् विदितं हि ते
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhye tv idānīṃ dharmasya vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaj jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ hi te
verses.translation: After conquering Indra Mahasani marched against Varuna in order to conquer him. Varuna of great intellect offered his daughter to Mahaiani.
verses.commentary: Sense: After conquering Indra Mahasani marched against Varuna in order to conquer him. Varuna of great intellect offered his daughter to Mahaiani.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं मुनयः सर्वम् आख्यानं विदितात्मनाम् विहितं यतिभिर् वृद्धैः कपिलादिभिर् ईश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarvam ākhyānaṃ viditātmanām vihitaṃ yatibhir vṛddhaiḥ kapilādibhir īśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Varuna gave his own abode in ocean to Mahasani. Friendship was generated between Varuna and Mahasani in this way.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna gave his own abode in ocean to Mahasani. Friendship was generated between Varuna and Mahasani in this way.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् सुविभ्रमाः केचिद् दृश्यन्ते मुनिसत्तमाः गुणाश् च यस्मिन् बहवो दोषहानिश् च केवला
verses.transliteration: yasmin suvibhramāḥ kecid dṛśyante munisattamāḥ guṇāś ca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniś ca kevalā
verses.translation: Visnu alone shall be the person to restore Indra. He alone is the slayer of Daityas. He alone shall be the seer of Mantras. He will create another Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu alone shall be the person to restore Indra. He alone is the slayer of Daityas. He alone shall be the seer of Mantras. He will create another Indra.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन परिसंख्याय सदोषान् विषयान् द्विजाः मानुषान् दुर्जयान् कृत्स्नान् पैशाचान् विषयांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: jñānena parisaṃkhyāya sadoṣān viṣayān dvijāḥ mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃs tathā
verses.translation: By whom have you been created, O Indra? Your valour is useless. Wherefore do you boast so much? You are being tormented by enemies in the battlefield. Still you continue to be Indra. This is ridiculous.
verses.commentary: Sense: By whom have you been created, O Indra? Your valour is useless. Wherefore do you boast so much? You are being tormented by enemies in the battlefield. Still you continue to be Indra. This is ridiculous.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषयान् औरगाञ् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वविषयांस् तथा पितॄणां विषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा तिर्यक्त्वं चरतां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣayān auragāñ jñātvā gandharvaviṣayāṃs tathā pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñ jñātvā tiryaktvaṃ caratāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: You have been caught and imprisoned by me in the battle along with your vehicle. Your miraculous weapon (Thunderbolt) of uncontrollable power has been (cast off) some¬ where. Fie upon your life! After being set free through the intercession of the lord of waters you still wish to live despite
verses.wordMeaning: You have been caught and imprisoned by me in the battle along with your vehicle. Your miraculous weapon (Thunderbolt) of uncontrollable power has been (cast off) some¬ where.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You have been caught and imprisoned by me in the battle along with your vehicle. Your miraculous weapon (Thunderbolt) of uncontrollable power has been (cast off) some¬ where.…
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णविषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा मरुतां विषयांस् तथा महर्षिविषयांश् चैव राजर्षिविषयांस् तथा
verses.transliteration: suparṇaviṣayāñ jñātvā marutāṃ viṣayāṃs tathā maharṣiviṣayāṃś caiva rājarṣiviṣayāṃs tathā
verses.translation: "That which is the storehouse of fame is life, that which is antagonistic to fame is death"—even after knowing this, O Indra, how did you get yourself released through the intercession of the lord of Waters? Why don't you feel ashamed?
verses.commentary: Sense: "That which is the storehouse of fame is life, that which is antagonistic to fame is death"—even after knowing this, O Indra, how did you get yourself released through the intercession of the lord of Waters? Why don't you feel ashamed?

verses.sanskrit: आसुरान् विषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा वैश्वदेवांस् तथैव च देवर्षिविषयाञ् ज्ञात्वा योगानाम् अपि वै परान्
verses.transliteration: āsurān viṣayāñ jñātvā vaiśvadevāṃs tathaiva ca devarṣiviṣayāñ jñātvā yogānām api vai parān
verses.translation: You were staying in heaven surrounded by Devas fanned by your beloved wife and eulogized by the celestial damsels. I think, indeed, bashfulness is afraid of you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You were staying in heaven surrounded by Devas fanned by your beloved wife and eulogized by the celestial damsels. I think, indeed, bashfulness is afraid of you.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विषयांश् च प्रमाणस्य ब्रह्मणो विषयांस् तथा आयुषश् च परं कालं लोकैर् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: viṣayāṃś ca pramāṇasya brahmaṇo viṣayāṃs tathā āyuṣaś ca paraṃ kālaṃ lokair vijñāya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: "You are the slayer of Vj-tra, killer ofNamuci, breaker of cities; with the thunderbolt in your hand you have split the mountains". Thus Devas honour you. Hence, O victorious one I abandon all these.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You are the slayer of Vj-tra, killer ofNamuci, breaker of cities; with the thunderbolt in your hand you have split the mountains". Thus Devas honour you. Hence, O victorious one I abandon all these.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुखस्य च परं कालं विज्ञाय मुनिसत्तमाः प्राप्तकाले च यद् दुःखं पततां विषयैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: sukhasya ca paraṃ kālaṃ vijñāya munisattamāḥ prāptakāle ca yad duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord of Daityas gave Indra to the noble-souled Varuna. Thereafter, he said these words again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lord of Daityas gave Indra to the noble-souled Varuna. Thereafter, he said these words again.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यक्त्वे पततां विप्रास् तथैव नरकेषु यत् स्वर्गस्य च गुणाञ् ज्ञात्वा दोषान् सर्वांश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tiryaktve patatāṃ viprās tathaiva narakeṣu yat svargasya ca guṇāñ jñātvā doṣān sarvāṃś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: From now onwards Indra shall be the disciple and Varuna the preceptor—Varuna who is my father-in-law and through whom, O Indra, you have attained freedom.
verses.commentary: Sense: From now onwards Indra shall be the disciple and Varuna the preceptor—Varuna who is my father-in-law and through whom, O Indra, you have attained freedom.

verses.sanskrit: वेदवादे च ये दोषा गुणा ये चापि वैदिकाः ज्ञानयोगे च ये दोषा ज्ञानयोगे च ये गुणाः
verses.transliteration: vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ jñānayoge ca ye doṣā jñānayoge ca ye guṇāḥ
verses.translation: In the same manner you shall behave like a servant unto Varuna. Otherwise, I will be obliged to imprison you and hurl you into the nether worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the same manner you shall behave like a servant unto Varuna. Otherwise, I will be obliged to imprison you and hurl you into the nether worlds.

verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāṃs tathaiva ca guṇā dvijāḥ sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: After rebuking Indra thus and laughing again and again he took leave of Varuna and said (to Indra) "Go, go".
verses.commentary: Sense: After rebuking Indra thus and laughing again and again he took leave of Varuna and said (to Indra) "Go, go".

verses.sanskrit: तमश् चाष्टगुणं ज्ञात्वा बुद्धिं सप्तगुणां तथा षड्गुणं च नभो ज्ञात्वा तमश् च त्रिगुणं महत्
verses.transliteration: tamaś cāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā tamaś ca triguṇaṃ mahat
verses.translation: Indra then reached his abode completely overwhelmed by shame. He told his wife the details of his defeat and discomfi¬ ture at the hands of the enemy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra then reached his abode completely overwhelmed by shame. He told his wife the details of his defeat and discomfi¬ ture at the hands of the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणं च रजो ज्ञात्वा सत्त्वं चैकगुणं पुनः मार्गं विज्ञाय तत्त्वेन प्रलयप्रेक्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvaṃ caikaguṇaṃ punaḥ mārgaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralayaprekṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: I have been told thus and treated thus, O lady of splen-
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been told thus and treated thus, O lady of splen-

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानसंपन्नाः कारणैर् भावितात्मभिः प्राप्नुवन्ति शुभं मोक्षं सूक्ष्मा इव नभः परम्
verses.transliteration: jñānavijñānasaṃpannāḥ kāraṇair bhāvitātmabhiḥ prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param
verses.translation: O Indra, the slayer of Bala, I know the origin of Danavas, their Maya, mortification, grant of boons as well as their death.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Indra, the slayer of Bala, I know the origin of Danavas, their Maya, mortification, grant of boons as well as their death.
