verses.sanskrit: रूपेण दृष्टिं संयुक्तां घ्राणं गन्धगुणेन च शब्दग्राह्यं तथा श्रोत्रं जिह्वां रसगुणेन च
verses.transliteration: rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca śabdagrāhyaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇena ca
verses.translation: Hence, I shall say for your satisfaction everything necessary for the death or defeat of that demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, I shall say for your satisfaction everything necessary for the death or defeat of that demon.

verses.sanskrit: त्वचं स्पर्शं तथा शक्यं वायुं चैव तदाश्रितम् मोहं तमसि संयुक्तं लोभं मोहेषु संश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: tvacaṃ sparśaṃ tathā śakyaṃ vāyuṃ caiva tadāśritam mohaṃ tamasi saṃyuktaṃ lobhaṃ moheṣu saṃśritam
verses.translation: He propitiated Brahma by means of penance and obser¬ vances. He acquired a great power like this. What is it that cannot be achieved by means of penance?
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiated Brahma by means of penance and obser¬ vances. He acquired a great power like this. What is it that cannot be achieved by means of penance?

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं क्रान्ते बले शक्रं कोष्ठे सक्तं तथानलम् अप्सु देवीं समायुक्ताम् आपस् तेजसि संश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam apsu devīṃ samāyuktām āpas tejasi saṃśritāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, no undue worry or wonder should be entertained by you. Listen. This must be pursued as it is overdue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, no undue worry or wonder should be entertained by you. Listen. This must be pursued as it is overdue.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो वायौ तु संयुक्तं वायुं नभसि चाश्रितम् नभो महति संयुक्तं तमो महसि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tejo vāyau tu saṃyuktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ tamo mahasi saṃsthitam
verses.translation: There too you shall go to that land which has become a holy centre. There you will attain all cherished desires by worshipping Visnu and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: There too you shall go to that land which has become a holy centre. There you will attain all cherished desires by worshipping Visnu and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: रजः सत्त्वं तथा सक्तं सत्त्वं सक्तं तथात्मनि सक्तम् आत्मानम् ईशे च देवे नारायणे तथा
verses.transliteration: rajaḥ sattvaṃ tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani saktam ātmānam īśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā
verses.translation: Again this has been heard by me. Only those women who are chaste ladies know everything. The world consisting of the mobile and immobile is sustained by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again this has been heard by me. Only those women who are chaste ladies know everything. The world consisting of the mobile and immobile is sustained by them.

verses.sanskrit: देवं मोक्षे च संयुक्तं ततो मोक्षं च न क्वचित् ज्ञात्वा सत्त्वगुणं देहं वृतं षोडशभिर् गुणैः
verses.transliteration: devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃyuktaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca na kvacit jñātvā sattvaguṇaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: By means of devotion, penance or prayer perform the rite of propitiation along with me. Then you will attain welfare by the favour of lord Siva and lord Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of devotion, penance or prayer perform the rite of propitiation along with me. Then you will attain welfare by the favour of lord Siva and lord Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: स्वभावं भावनां चैव ज्ञात्वा देहसमाश्रिताम् मध्यस्थम् इव चात्मानं पापं यस्मिन् न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: svabhāvaṃ bhāvanāṃ caiva jñātvā dehasamāśritām madhyastham iva cātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasmin na vidyate
verses.translation: If a man performs a good rite unknowingly the lord gives him as much benefit as he deserves; but if he performs it knowingly it shall be hundred times more beneficial. If a man performs a holy rite along with his wife it has everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man performs a good rite unknowingly the lord gives him as much benefit as he deserves; but if he performs it knowingly it shall be hundred times more beneficial. If a man performs a holy rite along with his wife it has everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयं कर्म वै ज्ञात्वा विप्रेन्द्रा विषयैषिणाम् इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थांश् च सर्वान् आत्मनि संश्रितान्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṃ karma vai jñātvā viprendrā viṣayaiṣiṇām indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃś ca sarvān ātmani saṃśritān
verses.translation: If a man does any thing alone he gets only half the benefit, but if he does it along with his wife, O lord, the man gets abundant benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man does any thing alone he gets only half the benefit, but if he does it along with his wife, O lord, the man gets abundant benefit.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभत्वं च मोक्षस्य विज्ञाय श्रुतिपूर्वकम् प्राणापानौ समानं च व्यानोदानौ च तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñāya śrutipūrvakam prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ
verses.translation: This idea occurs in the Vedas too, which say that one who has understood holy rites very well takes the help of his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: This idea occurs in the Vedas too, which say that one who has understood holy rites very well takes the help of his wife.

verses.transliteration: ādyaṃ caivānilaṃ jñātvā prabhavaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ saptadhā tāṃs tathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivat punaḥ
verses.translation: It subdues sins entirely. It bestows all cherished desires. Hence, go there along with me. Perform meritorious rites yield¬ ing great benefit.

verses.transliteration: prajāpatīn ṛṣīṃś caiva sargāṃś ca subahūn varān saptarṣīṃś ca bahūñ jñātvā rājarṣīṃś ca paraṃtapān
verses.translation: At the outset he bowed down to Gahga. After taking the holy bath he joined his palms in reverence. Seeking sole refuge in Siva he recited the following prayer:

verses.transliteration: surarṣīn marutaś cānyān brahmarṣīn sūryasaṃnibhān aiśvaryāc cyāvitān dṛṣṭvā kālena mahatā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: May that Pinaka-bearing lord be pleased with us— the lord who creates, protects and devours the entire universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings through his own Maya but does not get entangled in it; who is single, who is independent and who is of the nature of non-dual knowledge and happiness.

verses.transliteration: mahatāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ gatiṃ vācāṃ śubhāṃ jñātvā arcārhāḥ pāpakarmaṇām
verses.translation: May that consort of Parvati be pleased with me, the lord whose reality even Sanaka and others conversant with the esoteric doctrine of Vedanta, do not know; who is the bestower of all cherished desires and who is the enemy of Demon Andhaka. 1

verses.transliteration: vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yad duḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye yoniṣu ca vicitrāsu saṃcārān aśubhāṃs tathā
verses.translation: The self-born lord created Brahma and saw his terrible head. He plucked it off with the tips of his nails. He hurled it when it stuck to his nails and from it the three objects 2 of worldly existence, viz., virtue, love and wealth, originated.

verses.transliteration: jaṭhare cāśubhe vāsaṃ śoṇitodakabhājane śleṣmamūtrapurīṣe ca tīvragandhasamanvite
verses.translation: Sin, poverty, greed, begging, delusion and adversity were born therefrom. Many other endless things also took shape from them. They became influential. They had the features of worldly misery. This entire visible world is pervaded by them.

verses.translation: On seeing everything, the lord of Devas became bewil¬ dered and said to the goddess: "The whole universe is crumbling down. O goddess of the worlds, protect it. O mother of the worlds, the sole refuge, O gentle lady, O fortunate one.

verses.translation: Understanding the Self as their good, and the various yogas, O brahmins; understanding that what is delightful to tamasic beings of false nature

verses.translation: is contemptible to sattvic beings, O best of sages, and blamed by great Sankhyas who know the Self;

verses.translation: seeing the terrible eclipses of the moon and of the sun, the falling of stars and the changes of the constellations;

verses.translation: knowing the pitiful separation of pairs, O brahmins, and seeing beings devour one another, which is inauspicious;

verses.transliteration: bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya pakṣadehasya cāśubham rāgaṃ mohaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ kvacit sattvaṃ samāśritam
verses.translation: knowing the delusion of childhood and the impurity of the body's parts, and that passion and delusion arise and only sometimes is sattva resorted to;

verses.transliteration: sahasreṣu naraḥ kaścin mokṣabuddhiṃ samāśritaḥ durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñānaṃ śrutipūrvakam
verses.translation: that among thousands of men one resorts to the thought of liberation; knowing, from scripture, how rare liberation is;

verses.sanskrit: बहुमानम् अलब्धेषु लब्धे मध्यस्थतां पुनः विषयाणां च दौरात्म्यं विज्ञाय च पुनर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: bahumānam alabdheṣu labdhe madhyasthatāṃ punaḥ viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya ca punar dvijāḥ
verses.translation: knowing the high regard for what is not gained and indifference once it is gained, and the wickedness of sense objects, O brahmins;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: गतासूनां च सत्त्वानां देहान् भित्त्वा तथा शुभान् वासं कुलेषु जन्तूनां मरणाय धृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: gatāsūnāṃ ca sattvānāṃ dehān bhittvā tathā śubhān vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ maraṇāya dhṛtātmanām
verses.translation: knowing the bodies of departed beings as they break apart, and the dwelling of creatures in families, doomed to die;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकानां च जन्तूनां दुःखं विज्ञाय भो द्विजाः ब्रह्मघ्नानां गतिं ज्ञात्वा पतितानां सुदारुणाम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bho dvijāḥ brahmaghnānāṃ gatiṃ jñātvā patitānāṃ sudāruṇām
verses.translation: knowing the sorrow even of sattvic beings, O brahmins; knowing the terrible fate of brahmin-slayers and the fallen,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सुरापाने च सक्तानां ब्राह्मणानां दुरात्मनाम् गुरुदारप्रसक्तानां गतिं विज्ञाय चाशुभाम्
verses.transliteration: surāpāne ca saktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ durātmanām gurudāraprasaktānāṃ gatiṃ vijñāya cāśubhām
verses.translation: and of wicked brahmins addicted to drink, and knowing the evil fate of those attached to their teacher's wife;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जननीषु च वर्तन्ते येन सम्यग् द्विजोत्तमाः सदेवकेषु लोकेषु येन वर्तन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: jananīṣu ca vartante yena samyag dvijottamāḥ sadevakeṣu lokeṣu yena vartanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: knowing that by which men behave properly toward mothers, O best of brahmins, and by which men live in the worlds together with the gods;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेन ज्ञानेन विज्ञाय गतिं चाशुभकर्मणाम् तिर्यग्योनिगतानां च विज्ञाय च गतीः पृथक्
verses.transliteration: tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya ca gatīḥ pṛthak
verses.translation: knowing by that knowledge the fate of those of evil deeds, and knowing separately the fates of those born as animals;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वेदवादांस् तथा चित्रान् ऋतूनां पर्ययांस् तथा क्षयं संवत्सराणां च मासानां च क्षयं तथा
verses.transliteration: vedavādāṃs tathā citrān ṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃs tathā kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: knowing the varied doctrines of the Veda, the turning of the seasons, the passing of years and the passing of months,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पक्षक्षयं तथा दृष्ट्वा दिवसानां च संक्षयम् क्षयं वृद्धिं च चन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यक्षतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatas tathā
verses.translation: seeing the passing of fortnights and the passing of days, and seeing directly the waning and waxing of the moon,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिं दृष्ट्वा समुद्राणां क्षयं तेषां तथा पुनः क्षयं धनानां दृष्ट्वा च पुनर् वृद्धिं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punar vṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: seeing the rise of the oceans and their fall again, seeing the loss of wealth and its growth again,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: संयोगानां तथा दृष्ट्वा युगानां च विशेषतः देहवैक्लव्यतां चैव सम्यग् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: saṃyogānāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ dehavaiklavyatāṃ caiva samyag vijñāya tattvataḥ
verses.translation: seeing the unions and especially the ages, and knowing rightly and truly the frailty of the body,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मदोषांश् च विज्ञाय सर्वान् आत्मनि संस्थितान् स्वदेहाद् उत्थितान् गन्धांस् तथा विज्ञाय चाशुभान्
verses.transliteration: ātmadoṣāṃś ca vijñāya sarvān ātmani saṃsthitān svadehād utthitān gandhāṃs tathā vijñāya cāśubhān
verses.translation: knowing all one's own faults residing in oneself, and knowing the foul smells that arise from one's own body —"
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कान् उत्पातभवान् दोषान् पश्यसि ब्रह्मवित्तम एतं नः संशयं कृत्स्नं वक्तुम् अर्हस्य् अशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kān utpātabhavān doṣān paśyasi brahmavittama etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktum arhasy aśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "What faults arising from calamity do you see, O best of the knowers of Brahman? Please resolve this whole doubt of ours completely."
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च दोषान् द्विजा देहे प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः मार्गज्ञाः कापिलाः सांख्याः शृणुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pañca doṣān dvijā dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ mārgajñāḥ kāpilāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: "The wise, O brahmins — the Kapila Sankhyas who know the path — speak of five faults in the body; hear them, O best of sages:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधौ भयं निद्रा पञ्चमः श्वास उच्यते एते दोषाः शरीरेषु दृश्यन्ते सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarvadehinām
verses.translation: desire, anger, fear, sleep, and the fifth is called breath. These faults are seen in the bodies of all embodied beings.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्दन्ति क्षमया क्रोधं कामं संकल्पवर्जनात् सत्त्वसंसेवनान् निद्राम् अप्रमादाद् भयं तथा
verses.transliteration: chindanti kṣamayā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt sattvasaṃsevanān nidrām apramādād bhayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: They cut off anger by forbearance, desire by giving up intentions, sleep by cultivating sattva, and fear by heedfulness;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: छिन्दन्ति पञ्चमं श्वासम् अल्पाहारतया द्विजाः गुणान् गुणशतैर् ज्ञात्वा दोषान् दोषशतैर् अपि
verses.transliteration: chindanti pañcamaṃ śvāsam alpāhāratayā dvijāḥ guṇān guṇaśatair jñātvā doṣān doṣaśatair api
verses.translation: they cut off the fifth, breath, by eating little, O brahmins. Knowing the qualities by hundreds of qualities and the faults by hundreds of faults,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हेतून् हेतुशतैश् चित्रैश् चित्रान् विज्ञाय तत्त्वतः अपां फेनोपमं लोकं विष्णोर् मायाशतैः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: hetūn hetuśataiś citraiś citrān vijñāya tattvataḥ apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇor māyāśataiḥ kṛtam
verses.translation: and the varied causes truly by hundreds of varied causes; seeing the world as like foam on water, made by Vishnu's hundreds of illusions,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: चित्रभित्तिप्रतीकाशं नलसारम् अनर्थकम् तमःसंभ्रमितं दृष्ट्वा वर्षबुद्बुदसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: citrabhittipratīkāśaṃ nalasāram anarthakam tamaḥsaṃbhramitaṃ dṛṣṭvā varṣabudbudasaṃnibham
verses.translation: like a painted wall, hollow as a reed and meaningless, whirled about by darkness, like a bubble in the rain,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नाशप्रायं सुखाधानं नाशोत्तरमहाभयम् रजस् तमसि संमग्नं पङ्के द्विपम् इवावशम्
verses.transliteration: nāśaprāyaṃ sukhādhānaṃ nāśottaramahābhayam rajas tamasi saṃmagnaṃ paṅke dvipam ivāvaśam
verses.translation: nearly perishing, a storehouse of pleasure followed by the great fear of destruction, sunk in rajas and tamas like a helpless elephant in mud —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्या विप्रा महाप्राज्ञास् त्यक्त्वा स्नेहं प्रजाकृतम् ज्ञानज्ञेयेन सांख्येन व्यापिना महता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñās tyaktvā snehaṃ prajākṛtam jñānajñeyena sāṃkhyena vyāpinā mahatā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: the Sankhya brahmins, deeply wise, having given up affection for offspring, by the great, all-pervading Sankhya of knowledge and the knowable, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: राजसान् अशुभान् गन्धांस् तामसांश् च तथाविधान् पुण्यांश् च सात्त्विकान् गन्धान् स्पर्शजान् देहसंश्रितान्
verses.transliteration: rājasān aśubhān gandhāṃs tāmasāṃś ca tathāvidhān puṇyāṃś ca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān
verses.translation: cutting away the rajasic and inauspicious smells, the tamasic ones likewise, and the holy sattvic smells arising from touch and residing in the body,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वात्मज्ञानशस्त्रेण तपोदण्डेन सत्तमाः ततो दुःखादिकं घोरं चिन्ताशोकमहाह्रदम्
verses.transliteration: chittvātmajñānaśastreṇa tapodaṇḍena sattamāḥ tato duḥkhādikaṃ ghoraṃ cintāśokamahāhradam
verses.translation: with the sword of Self-knowledge and the staff of austerity, O good ones, then cross by wisdom the terrible ocean of sorrow, whose great lake is anxiety and grief,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: व्याधिमृत्युमहाघोरं महाभयमहोरगम् तमःकूर्मं रजोमीनं प्रज्ञया संतरन्त्य् उत
verses.transliteration: vyādhimṛtyumahāghoraṃ mahābhayamahoragam tamaḥkūrmaṃ rajomīnaṃ prajñayā saṃtaranty uta
verses.translation: most dreadful with disease and death, whose great serpent is great fear, whose tortoise is tamas and whose fish is rajas;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहपङ्कं जरादुर्गं स्पर्शद्वीपं द्विजोत्तमाः कर्मागाधं सत्यतीरं स्थितं व्रतमनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: snehapaṅkaṃ jarādurgaṃ sparśadvīpaṃ dvijottamāḥ karmāgādhaṃ satyatīraṃ sthitaṃ vratamanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: whose mud is affection, whose fortress is old age, whose island is touch, O best of brahmins, whose depth is karma and whose shore is truth, steadied by the wise in vows,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हर्षसंघमहावेगं नानारससमाकुलम् नानाप्रीतिमहारत्नं दुःखज्वरसमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: harṣasaṃghamahāvegaṃ nānārasasamākulam nānāprītimahāratnaṃ duḥkhajvarasamīritam
verses.translation: with great surges of joy, full of many flavours, whose great jewels are many delights, stirred by the fever of sorrow,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शोकतृष्णामहावर्तं तीक्ष्णव्याधिमहारुजम् अस्थिसंघातसंघट्टं श्लेष्मयोगं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śokatṛṣṇāmahāvartaṃ tīkṣṇavyādhimahārujam asthisaṃghātasaṃghaṭṭaṃ śleṣmayogaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: with great whirlpools of grief and craving, great pains of sharp disease, the clashing of heaps of bones, and joinings of phlegm, O best of brahmins,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दानमुक्ताकरं घोरं शोणितोद्गारविद्रुमम् हसितोत्क्रुष्टनिर्घोषं नानाज्ञानसुदुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: dānamuktākaraṃ ghoraṃ śoṇitodgāravidrumam hasitotkruṣṭanirghoṣaṃ nānājñānasuduṣkaram
verses.translation: terrible, a mine of pearls of giving, its coral the spurting of blood, echoing with laughter and cries, hard to cross by varied knowledge,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रोदनाश्रुमलक्षारं सङ्गयोगपरायणम् प्रलब्ध्वा जन्मलोको यं पुत्रबान्धवपत्तनम्
verses.transliteration: rodanāśrumalakṣāraṃ saṅgayogaparāyaṇam pralabdhvā janmaloko yaṃ putrabāndhavapattanam
verses.translation: its salt the tears of weeping, given to attachment and union — having gained this world of birth, the port of sons and kin,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसासत्यमर्यादं प्राणयोगमयोर्मिलम् वृन्दानुगामिनं क्षीरं सर्वभूतपयोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsāsatyamaryādaṃ prāṇayogamayormilam vṛndānugāminaṃ kṣīraṃ sarvabhūtapayodadhim
verses.translation: bounded by non-violence and truth, its waves made of the play of breath, its milk following the herds, the ocean of all beings,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदुर्लभविषयं वाडवासुखसागरम् तरन्ति यतयः सिद्धा ज्ञानयोगेन चानघाः
verses.transliteration: mokṣadurlabhaviṣayaṃ vāḍavāsukhasāgaram taranti yatayaḥ siddhā jñānayogena cānaghāḥ
verses.translation: where liberation is hard to reach, the ocean with the mare's-mouth fire — this the sinless ascetics who are perfected cross by the yoga of knowledge.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तीर्त्वा च दुस्तरं जन्म विशन्ति विमलं नभः ततस् तान् सुकृतीञ् ज्ञात्वा सूर्यो वहति रश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ tatas tān sukṛtīñ jñātvā sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: Having crossed the hard-to-cross birth, they enter the stainless sky; then the sun, knowing them to be doers of good, carries them with its rays.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पद्मतन्तुवद् आविश्य प्रवहन् विषयान् द्विजाः तत्र तान् प्रवहो वायुः प्रतिगृह्णाति चानघाः
verses.transliteration: padmatantuvad āviśya pravahan viṣayān dvijāḥ tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti cānaghāḥ
verses.translation: Entering like lotus fibres and conveying them beyond sense objects, O brahmins, the wind called Pravaha there receives them, O sinless ones.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागान् यतीन् सिद्धान् वीर्ययुक्तांस् तपोधनान् सूक्ष्मः शीतः सुगन्धश् च सुखस्पर्शश् च भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgān yatīn siddhān vīryayuktāṃs tapodhanān sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaś ca sukhasparśaś ca bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: those passionless, perfected ascetics, full of vigour and rich in austerity. Subtle, cool, fragrant and pleasant to the touch, O brahmins,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सप्तानां मरुतां श्रेष्ठो लोकान् गच्छति यः शुभान् स तान् वहति विप्रेन्द्रा नभसः परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān sa tān vahati viprendrā nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: the best of the seven winds, which goes to the auspicious worlds, carries them, O best of brahmins, to the highest goal of the sky.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नभो वहति लोकेशान् रजसः परमां गतिम् रजो वहति विप्रेन्द्राः सत्त्वस्य परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: nabho vahati lokeśān rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim rajo vahati viprendrāḥ sattvasya paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The sky carries these lords of the world to the highest goal of rajas; rajas carries them, O best of brahmins, to the highest goal of sattva;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं वहति शुद्धात्मा परं नारायणं प्रभुम् प्रभुर् वहति शुद्धात्मा परमात्मानम् आत्मना
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātmā paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum prabhur vahati śuddhātmā paramātmānam ātmanā
verses.translation: sattva, pure in nature, carries them to the supreme lord Narayana; and the Lord, pure in nature, of himself carries them to the Supreme Self.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परमात्मानम् आसाद्य तद्भूता यतयो ऽमलाः अमृतत्वाय कल्पन्ते न निवर्तन्ति च द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: paramātmānam āsādya tadbhūtā yatayo 'malāḥ amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Reaching the Supreme Self and becoming one with it, the stainless ascetics become fit for immortality and do not return, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परमा सा गतिर् विप्रा निर्द्वंद्वानां महात्मनाम् सत्यार्जवरतानां वै सर्वभूतदयावताम्
verses.transliteration: paramā sā gatir viprā nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām satyārjavaratānāṃ vai sarvabhūtadayāvatām
verses.translation: That is the highest goal, O brahmins, of the great-souled ones free from the pairs of opposites, devoted to truth and straightforwardness and compassionate to all beings.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्थानम् उत्तमम् आसाद्य भगवन्तं स्थिरव्रताः आजन्ममरणं वा ते रमन्ते तत्र वा न वा
verses.transliteration: sthānam uttamam āsādya bhagavantaṃ sthiravratāḥ ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te ramante tatra vā na vā
verses.translation: "Reaching that highest state, the Blessed One, those firm in their vows — do they delight there until the end of birth and death, or not?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: यद् अत्र तथ्यं तत्त्वं नो यथावद् वक्तुम् अर्हसि त्वदृते मानवं नान्यं प्रष्टुम् अर्हाम सत्तम
verses.transliteration: yad atra tathyaṃ tattvaṃ no yathāvad vaktum arhasi tvadṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭum arhāma sattama
verses.translation: Please tell us truly what the fact is here; there is no other man but you whom we may ask, O good one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षदोषो महान् एष प्राप्य सिद्धिं गतान् ऋषीन् यदि तत्रैव विज्ञाने वर्तन्ते यतयः परे
verses.transliteration: mokṣadoṣo mahān eṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatān ṛṣīn yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare
verses.translation: This is a great flaw in liberation, if the ascetics who have attained perfection remain in that very knowledge.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणं धर्मं पश्याम परमं द्विज मग्नस्य हि परे ज्ञाने किंतु दुःखान्तरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāma paramaṃ dvija magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃtu duḥkhāntaraṃ bhavet
verses.translation: We see the dharma marked by activity as supreme, O brahmin; for one sunk in the highest knowledge, might there not be yet another sorrow?"
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यथान्यायं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रश्नः पृष्टश् च संकटः बुधानाम् अपि संमोहः प्रश्ने ऽस्मिन् मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yathānyāyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaś ca saṃkaṭaḥ budhānām api saṃmohaḥ praśne 'smin munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: "Fittingly, best of sages, have you asked a difficult question; even the wise are bewildered by this question, O best of sages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रापि तत्त्वं परमं शृणुध्वं वचनं मम बुद्धिश् च परमा यत्र कपिलानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama buddhiś ca paramā yatra kapilānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Hear my words on this too, the supreme truth, where the highest understanding of the great-souled followers of Kapila lies.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाण्य् अपि बुध्यन्ते स्वदेहं देहिनां द्विजाः करणान्य् आत्मनस् तानि सूक्ष्मं पश्यन्ति तैस् तु सः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇy api budhyante svadehaṃ dehināṃ dvijāḥ karaṇāny ātmanas tāni sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti tais tu saḥ
verses.translation: The senses of embodied beings perceive their own body, O brahmins; they are the instruments of the Self, and through them he sees what is subtle.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मना विप्रहीणानि काष्ठकुड्यसमानि तु विनश्यन्ति न संदेहो वेला इव महार्णवे
verses.transliteration: ātmanā viprahīṇāni kāṣṭhakuḍyasamāni tu vinaśyanti na saṃdeho velā iva mahārṇave
verses.translation: Deprived of the Self, they are like wood or a wall, and perish without doubt, like waves on the great ocean.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियैः सह सुप्तस्य देहिनो द्विजसत्तमाः सूक्ष्मश् चरति सर्वत्र नभसीव समीरणः
verses.transliteration: indriyaiḥ saha suptasya dehino dvijasattamāḥ sūkṣmaś carati sarvatra nabhasīva samīraṇaḥ
verses.translation: When the embodied one sleeps with his senses, O best of brahmins, the subtle one moves everywhere, like wind in the sky.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स पश्यति यथान्यायं स्मृत्वा स्पृशति चानघाः बुध्यमानो यथापूर्वम् अखिलेनेह भो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ smṛtvā spṛśati cānaghāḥ budhyamāno yathāpūrvam akhileneha bho dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He sees fittingly, remembers and touches, sinless ones, understanding everything here as before, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि ह सर्वाणि स्वे स्वे स्थाने यथाविधि अनीशत्वात् प्रलीयन्ते सर्पा विषहता इव
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi ha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi anīśatvāt pralīyante sarpā viṣahatā iva
verses.translation: All the senses, each in its own place as ordained, dissolve for lack of mastery, like snakes whose poison is spent.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां तु सर्वेषां स्वस्थानेष्व् एव सर्वशः आक्रम्य गतयः सूक्ष्मा वरत्य् आत्मा न संशयः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣv eva sarvaśaḥ ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmā varaty ātmā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Overpowering the subtle movements of all the senses in their own places, the Self moves on, without doubt.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वस्य च गुणान् कृत्स्नान् रजसश् च गुणान् पुनः गुणांश् च तमसः सर्वान् गुणान् बुद्धेश् च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaś ca guṇān punaḥ guṇāṃś ca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheś ca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: All the qualities of sattva, the qualities of rajas, all the qualities of tamas and the qualities of the intellect, O good ones,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: गुणांश् च मनसश् चापि नभसश् च गुणांस् तथा गुणान् वायोश् च सर्वज्ञाः स्नेहजांश् च गुणान् पुनः
verses.transliteration: guṇāṃś ca manasaś cāpi nabhasaś ca guṇāṃs tathā guṇān vāyoś ca sarvajñāḥ snehajāṃś ca guṇān punaḥ
verses.translation: the qualities of the mind and of space, the qualities of wind, O all-knowing ones, and the qualities born of moisture,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: अपां गुणास् तथा विप्राः पार्थिवांश् च गुणान् अपि सर्वान् एव गुणैर् व्याप्य क्षेत्रज्ञेषु द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: apāṃ guṇās tathā viprāḥ pārthivāṃś ca guṇān api sarvān eva guṇair vyāpya kṣetrajñeṣu dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: the qualities of water, O brahmins, and the qualities of earth — pervading all with these qualities in the knowers of the field, O best of brahmins,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा चरति क्षेत्रज्ञः कर्मणा च शुभाशुभे शिष्या इव महात्मानम् इन्द्रियाणि च तं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ātmā carati kṣetrajñaḥ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubhe śiṣyā iva mahātmānam indriyāṇi ca taṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: the Self, the knower of the field, moves through good and bad by karma; and the senses follow that great Self like disciples, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं चाप्य् अतिक्रम्य शुद्धं सूक्ष्मं परात् परम् नारायणं महात्मानं निर्विकारं परात् परम्
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ cāpy atikramya śuddhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parāt param nārāyaṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ nirvikāraṃ parāt param
verses.translation: Passing beyond Prakriti, he reaches the pure, subtle, higher than the high — Narayana, the great Self, changeless, higher than the high,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तं सर्वपापेभ्यः प्रविष्टं च ह्य् अनामयम् परमात्मानम् अगुणं निर्वृतं तं च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ ca hy anāmayam paramātmānam aguṇaṃ nirvṛtaṃ taṃ ca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: freed from all sins, entering the one free from ill, the Supreme Self without qualities, at rest, O good ones.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं तत्र मनो विप्रा इन्द्रियाणि च भो द्विजाः आगच्छन्ति यथाकालं गुरोः संदेशकारिणः
verses.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ tatra mano viprā indriyāṇi ca bho dvijāḥ āgacchanti yathākālaṃ guroḥ saṃdeśakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: There the best mind and the senses, O brahmins, come in due time, carrying out the teacher's command.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शक्यं वाल्पेन कालेन शान्तिं प्राप्तुं गुणांस् तथा एवम् उक्तेन विप्रेन्द्राः सांख्ययोगेन मोक्षिणीम्
verses.transliteration: śakyaṃ vālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇāṃs tathā evam uktena viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyayogena mokṣiṇīm
verses.translation: It is possible in a short time to attain peace and those qualities; so by this Sankhya-yoga that has been described, O best of brahmins, one reaches liberation.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्या विप्रा महाप्राज्ञा गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम् ज्ञानेनानेन विप्रेन्द्रास् तुल्यं ज्ञानं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim jñānenānena viprendrās tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: The Sankhya brahmins, deeply wise, reach the highest goal by this knowledge, O best of brahmins; there is no knowledge equal to it.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र वः संशयो मा भूज् ज्ञानं सांख्यं परं मतम् अक्षरं ध्रुवम् एवोक्तं पूर्वं ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: atra vaḥ saṃśayo mā bhūj jñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam akṣaraṃ dhruvam evoktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam
verses.translation: Have no doubt here: Sankhya knowledge is held to be supreme. The imperishable and constant, the eternal Brahman, was spoken of before —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यनिधनं निर्द्वंद्वं कर्तृ शाश्वतम् कूटस्थं चैव नित्यं च यद् वदन्ति शमात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: anādimadhyanidhanaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ kartṛ śāśvatam kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yad vadanti śamātmakāḥ
verses.translation: without beginning, middle or end, beyond the pairs, the agent, everlasting, unchanging and eternal, as the tranquil ones describe it,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यतः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः एवं शंसन्ति शास्त्रेषु प्रवक्तारो महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ evaṃ śaṃsanti śāstreṣu pravaktāro maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: from which all the changes of creation and dissolution proceed. So do the great sages who teach declare in the scriptures.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे विप्राश् च वेदाश् च तथा सामविदो जनाः ब्रह्मण्यं परमं देवम् अनन्तं परमाच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: sarve viprāś ca vedāś ca tathā sāmavido janāḥ brahmaṇyaṃ paramaṃ devam anantaṃ paramācyutam
verses.translation: All brahmins and the Vedas, and those who know the Sama, the supreme god devoted to Brahman, the infinite and supremely imperishable one,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयन्तश् च तं विप्रा वदन्ति गुणबुद्धयः सम्यग् उक्तास् तथा योगाः सांख्याश् चामितदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: prārthayantaś ca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ samyag uktās tathā yogāḥ sāṃkhyāś cāmitadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: seeking him, O brahmins, speak of him with minds bound to qualities. The yogas have been rightly taught, and the Sankhyas of boundless insight.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अमूर्तिस् तस्य विप्रेन्द्राः सांख्यं मूर्तिर् इति श्रुतिः अभिज्ञानानि तस्याहुर् महान्ति मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: amūrtis tasya viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ mūrtir iti śrutiḥ abhijñānāni tasyāhur mahānti munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: His formless aspect, O best of brahmins, is Sankhya, and his form, says scripture; the great ones call these his signs, O best of sages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधानि हि भूतानि पृथिव्यां द्विजसत्तमाः अगम्यगम्यसंज्ञानि गम्यं तत्र विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: dvividhāni hi bhūtāni pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ agamyagamyasaṃjñāni gamyaṃ tatra viśiṣyate
verses.translation: Beings on earth are of two kinds, O best of brahmins, called the unreachable and the reachable, and of these the reachable is superior.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं महद् वै महतश् च विप्रा वेदेषु सांख्येषु तथैव योगे यच् चापि दृष्टं विधिवत् पुराणे सांख्यागतं तन् निखिलं मुनीन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ mahad vai mahataś ca viprā vedeṣu sāṃkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge yac cāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vidhivat purāṇe sāṃkhyāgataṃ tan nikhilaṃ munīndrāḥ
verses.translation: The great knowledge of the great one, O brahmins, found in the Vedas, in Sankhya and in yoga, and what is duly seen in the Puranas — all that has come from Sankhya, O lords of sages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यच् चेतिहासेषु महत्सु दृष्टं यथार्थशास्त्रेषु विशिष्टदृष्टम् ज्ञानं च लोके यद् इहास्ति किंचित् सांख्यागतं तच् च महामुनीन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: yac cetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ yathārthaśāstreṣu viśiṣṭadṛṣṭam jñānaṃ ca loke yad ihāsti kiṃcit sāṃkhyāgataṃ tac ca mahāmunīndrāḥ
verses.translation: What is seen in the great histories, what is specially seen in the true treatises, and whatever knowledge there is in the world here — that too has come from Sankhya, O great lords of sages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: समस्तदृष्टं परमं बलं च ज्ञानं च मोक्षश् च यथावद् उक्तम् तपांसि सूक्ष्माणि च यानि चैव सांख्ये यथावद् विहितानि विप्राः
verses.transliteration: samastadṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca mokṣaś ca yathāvad uktam tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi ca yāni caiva sāṃkhye yathāvad vihitāni viprāḥ
verses.translation: The supreme power seen by all, knowledge and liberation have been duly declared, and the subtle austerities too have been duly set out in Sankhya, O brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययं तस्य हितं सदैव गच्छन्ति सांख्याः सततं सुखेन तांश् चापि संधार्य ततः कृतार्थाः पतन्ति विप्रायतनेषु भूयः
verses.transliteration: viparyayaṃ tasya hitaṃ sadaiva gacchanti sāṃkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena tāṃś cāpi saṃdhārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ patanti viprāyataneṣu bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: The Sankhyas always reach the reverse of that, which is their good, constantly and with ease; and having held on to these, their purpose accomplished, they come down again into the homes of brahmins.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हित्वा च देहं प्रविशन्ति मोक्षं दिवौकसश् चापि च योगसांख्याः अतो ऽधिकं ते ऽभिरता महार्हे सांख्ये द्विजा भो इह शिष्टजुष्टे
verses.transliteration: hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ divaukasaś cāpi ca yogasāṃkhyāḥ ato 'dhikaṃ te 'bhiratā mahārhe sāṃkhye dvijā bho iha śiṣṭajuṣṭe
verses.translation: Abandoning the body, the yogis and Sankhyas enter liberation, and some become dwellers of heaven; so all the more should you delight here, O brahmins, in the precious Sankhya cherished by the good.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु तिर्यग्गमनं हि दृष्टं नाधो गतिः पापकृतां निवासः न वा प्रधाना अपि ते द्विजातयो ये ज्ञानम् एतन् मुनयो न सक्ताः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ nādho gatiḥ pāpakṛtāṃ nivāsaḥ na vā pradhānā api te dvijātayo ye jñānam etan munayo na saktāḥ
verses.translation: For them no going among animals is seen, no downward course, no abode of evildoers; nor are those twice-born who are not attached to this knowledge, O sages, truly foremost.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यं विशालं परमं पुराणं महार्णवं विमलम् उदारकान्तम् कृत्स्नं हि सांख्या मुनयो महात्म नारायणे धारयताप्रमेयम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ mahārṇavaṃ vimalam udārakāntam kṛtsnaṃ hi sāṃkhyā munayo mahātma nārāyaṇe dhārayatāprameyam
verses.translation: Sankhya is vast, supreme and ancient, a great ocean, stainless and nobly beautiful; the Sankhya sages, O great one, place it wholly and immeasurably in Narayana.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतन् मयोक्तं परमं हि तत्त्वं नारायणाद् विश्वम् इदं पुराणम् स सर्गकाले च करोति सर्गं संहारकाले च हरेत भूयः
verses.transliteration: etan mayoktaṃ paramaṃ hi tattvaṃ nārāyaṇād viśvam idaṃ purāṇam sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ saṃhārakāle ca hareta bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: This I have told as the supreme truth: from Narayana comes this ancient universe; at the time of creation he makes creation, and at the time of dissolution he withdraws it again.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: किं तद् अक्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं यस्मान् नावर्तते पुनः किंस्वित् तत् क्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं यस्माद् आवर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ tad akṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmān nāvartate punaḥ kiṃsvit tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ yasmād āvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: A demon with a thousand arms and heads, two thousands eyes and feet, so called because he walked like a blind man; killed by Siva when he attem¬ pted to carry off the Purijata tree from Svarga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षराक्षरयोर् व्यक्तिं पृच्छामस् त्वां महामुने उपलब्धुं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वेन मुनिपुंगव
verses.transliteration: akṣarākṣarayor vyaktiṃ pṛcchāmas tvāṃ mahāmune upalabdhuṃ muniśreṣṭha tattvena munipuṃgava
verses.translation: Trivarga, i.e. the three supreme objects desired by worldly persons, vu., Dharma, Artha and Kama. The fourth is Moksa or ultimate deliverance from the world of transmigration. All the four together are know as caturvarga i.e. four kinds of highest objects or Purufdrthacatu}taya i.e. four supreme objects of human endeavour.

verses.transliteration: mahān iti ca yogeṣu viriñcir iti cāpy atha sāṃkhye ca paṭhyate śāstre nāmabhir bahudhātmakaḥ
verses.translation: Mahat in the yoga texts and Viranchi as well, and in the Sankhya scripture he is recited by many names, manifold in nature.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विचित्ररूपो विश्वात्मा एकाक्षर इति स्मृतः धृतम् एकात्मकं येन कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यम् आत्मना
verses.transliteration: vicitrarūpo viśvātmā ekākṣara iti smṛtaḥ dhṛtam ekātmakaṃ yena kṛtsnaṃ trailokyam ātmanā
verses.translation: Of varied form, the Self of the universe, he is known as the One Imperishable, by whom the whole three worlds, one in nature, are upheld by himself.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव बहुरूपत्वाद् विश्वरूप इति श्रुतः एष वै विक्रियापन्नः सृजत्य् आत्मानम् आत्मना
verses.transliteration: tathaiva bahurūpatvād viśvarūpa iti śrutaḥ eṣa vai vikriyāpannaḥ sṛjaty ātmānam ātmanā
verses.translation: Likewise, because of his many forms he is known as Vishvarupa. Undergoing change, he creates himself by himself.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं तस्य संयोगाद् उत्पन्नं सुमहत् पुरम् अहंकारं महातेजाः प्रजापतिनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ tasya saṃyogād utpannaṃ sumahat puram ahaṃkāraṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatinamaskṛtam
verses.translation: From his union with Pradhana the vast city arises; the greatly radiant one produces ahamkara, saluted by Prajapati.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तिम् आपन्नं विद्यासर्गं वदन्ति तम् महान्तं चाप्य् अहंकारम् अविद्यासर्ग एव च
verses.transliteration: avyaktād vyaktim āpannaṃ vidyāsargaṃ vadanti tam mahāntaṃ cāpy ahaṃkāram avidyāsarga eva ca
verses.translation: What passes from the unmanifest to the manifest they call the creation of knowledge; and Mahat and ahamkara are the creation of ignorance.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अचरश् च चरश् चैव समुत्पन्नौ तथैकतः विद्याविद्येति विख्याते श्रुतिशास्त्रानुचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: acaraś ca caraś caiva samutpannau tathaikataḥ vidyāvidyeti vikhyāte śrutiśāstrānucintakaiḥ
verses.translation: The unmoving and the moving arose likewise from one source; those who reflect on scripture know them as knowledge and ignorance.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: भूतसर्गम् अहंकारात् तृतीयं विद्धि पार्थिव अहंकारेषु नृपते चतुर्थं विद्धि वैकृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtasargam ahaṃkārāt tṛtīyaṃ viddhi pārthiva ahaṃkāreṣu nṛpate caturthaṃ viddhi vaikṛtam
verses.translation: Know the creation of the elements from ahamkara as the third, O king; and in the ahamkaras, O lord of men, know the fourth, the modified creation:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: वायुर् ज्योतिर् अथाकाशम् आपो ऽथ पृथिवी तथा शब्दस्पर्शौ च रूपं च रसो गन्धस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vāyur jyotir athākāśam āpo 'tha pṛthivī tathā śabdasparśau ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhas tathaiva ca
verses.translation: wind, fire, space, water and earth, and sound, touch, form, taste and smell.

verses.transliteration: evaṃ yugapad utpannaṃ daśavargam asaṃśayam pañcamaṃ viddhi rājendra bhautikaṃ sargam arthakṛt
verses.translation: Thus the group of ten arose at once, without doubt. Know the fifth, O king of kings, as the elemental creation that serves purposes:

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणम् एव च पञ्चमम् वाग् हस्तौ चैव पादौ च पायुर् मेढ्रं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇam eva ca pañcamam vāg hastau caiva pādau ca pāyur meḍhraṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: ear, skin, eyes, tongue and nose as the fifth, speech, hands, feet, anus and generative organ —

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि चैतानि तथा कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च संभूतानीह युगपन् मनसा सह पार्थिव
verses.transliteration: buddhīndriyāṇi caitāni tathā karmendriyāṇi ca saṃbhūtānīha yugapan manasā saha pārthiva
verses.translation: these senses of knowledge and senses of action arose here together with the mind, O king.

verses.sanskrit: एषा तत्त्वचतुर्विंशा सर्वाकृतिः प्रवर्तते यां ज्ञात्वा नाभिशोचन्ति ब्राह्मणास् तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: eṣā tattvacaturviṃśā sarvākṛtiḥ pravartate yāṃ jñātvā nābhiśocanti brāhmaṇās tattvadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: This is the set of twenty-four principles, from which all forms proceed; knowing it, brahmins who see the truth do not grieve.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एतत् समुत्पन्नं त्रैलोक्यम् इदम् उत्तमम् वेदितव्यं नरश्रेष्ठ सदैव नरकार्णवे
verses.transliteration: evam etat samutpannaṃ trailokyam idam uttamam veditavyaṃ naraśreṣṭha sadaiva narakārṇave
verses.translation: Thus has this excellent threefold world arisen; it should always be known, O best of men, in the ocean of hell,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सयक्षभूतगन्धर्वे सकिंनरमहोरगे सचारणपिशाचे वै सदेवर्षिनिशाचरे
verses.transliteration: sayakṣabhūtagandharve sakiṃnaramahorage sacāraṇapiśāce vai sadevarṣiniśācare
verses.translation: with Yakshas, ghosts and Gandharvas, with Kinnaras and great serpents, with Charanas and Pishachas, with divine sages and night-roamers,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सदंशकीटमशके सपूतिकृमिमूषके शुनि श्वपाके चैणेये सचाण्डाले सपुल्कसे
verses.transliteration: sadaṃśakīṭamaśake sapūtikṛmimūṣake śuni śvapāke caiṇeye sacāṇḍāle sapulkase
verses.translation: with gadflies, worms and mosquitoes, with putrid maggots and rats, in the dog, the dog-cooker, the antelope, the Chandala and the Pulkasa,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वखरशार्दूले सवृके गवि चैव ह या च मूर्तिश् च यत् किंचित् सर्वत्रैतन् निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvakharaśārdūle savṛke gavi caiva ha yā ca mūrtiś ca yat kiṃcit sarvatraitan nidarśanam
verses.translation: in the elephant, horse, donkey, tiger, wolf and cow — whatever form there is, anything at all, everywhere this is the illustration.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जले भुवि तथाकाशे नान्यत्रेति विनिश्चयः स्थानं देहवताम् आसीद् इत्य् एवम् अनुशुश्रुम
verses.transliteration: jale bhuvi tathākāśe nānyatreti viniścayaḥ sthānaṃ dehavatām āsīd ity evam anuśuśruma
verses.translation: In water, on land and in the sky, and nowhere else — this is certain — was the dwelling of embodied beings; so we have heard.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नम् एतावतस् तात क्षरते व्यक्तसंज्ञकः अहन्य् अहनि भूतात्मा यच् चाक्षर इति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnam etāvatas tāta kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñakaḥ ahany ahani bhūtātmā yac cākṣara iti smṛtam
verses.translation: All of this, dear one, what is called manifest, wastes away day after day; the Self of beings is what is called the imperishable.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तत् क्षरम् इत्य् उक्तं क्षरतीदं यथा जगत् जगन् मोहात्मकं चाहुर् अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तसंज्ञकम्
verses.transliteration: tatas tat kṣaram ity uktaṃ kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat jagan mohātmakaṃ cāhur avyaktād vyaktasaṃjñakam
verses.translation: Therefore that is called perishable (kshara), since this world wastes away; and they call the world, which springs from the unmanifest and is called manifest, deluding in nature.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: महांश् चैवाक्षरो नित्यम् एतत् क्षरविवर्जनम् कथितं ते महाराज यस्मान् नावर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration: mahāṃś caivākṣaro nityam etat kṣaravivarjanam kathitaṃ te mahārāja yasmān nāvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: Mahat and the imperishable are eternal; this is free from perishing. I have told you, great king, that from which there is no return.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिको ऽमूर्तः स नित्यस् तत्त्वसंज्ञकः सत्त्वसंश्रयणात् तत्त्वं सत्त्वम् आहुर् मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatiko 'mūrtaḥ sa nityas tattvasaṃjñakaḥ sattvasaṃśrayaṇāt tattvaṃ sattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The twenty-fifth is formless, eternal, called the Principle; because it rests in sattva, the wise call the principle sattva.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यद् अमूर्तिः सृजद् व्यक्तं तन् मूर्तिम् अधितिष्ठति चतुर्विंशतिमो व्यक्तो ह्य् अमूर्तिः पञ्चविंशकः
verses.transliteration: yad amūrtiḥ sṛjad vyaktaṃ tan mūrtim adhitiṣṭhati caturviṃśatimo vyakto hy amūrtiḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: That which, formless, created the manifest, presides over form; the manifest is the twenty-fourth, and the formless is the twenty-fifth.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स एव हृदि सर्वासु मूर्तिष्व् आतिष्ठतात्मवान् चेतयंश् चेतनो नित्यं सर्वमूर्तिर् अमूर्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣv ātiṣṭhatātmavān cetayaṃś cetano nityaṃ sarvamūrtir amūrtimān
verses.translation: He, self-possessed, dwells in the heart of all forms, conscious and making conscious, eternal, of every form yet formless.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्गप्रलयधर्मेण स सर्गप्रलयात्मकः गोचरे वर्तते नित्यं निर्गुणो गुणसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: sargapralayadharmeṇa sa sargapralayātmakaḥ gocare vartate nityaṃ nirguṇo guṇasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: By the law of creation and dissolution he is of the nature of creation and dissolution; he always abides in the realm of the senses, without qualities yet called by qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एष महात्मा च सर्गप्रलयकोटिशः विकुर्वाणः प्रकृतिमान् नाभिमन्येत बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: evam eṣa mahātmā ca sargapralayakoṭiśaḥ vikurvāṇaḥ prakṛtimān nābhimanyeta buddhimān
verses.translation: Thus this great Self, undergoing change through countless creations and dissolutions and joined with Prakriti, should not, if wise, identify with it.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तमःसत्त्वरजोयुक्तस् तासु तास्व् इह योनिषु लीयते प्रतिबुद्धत्वाद् अबुद्धजनसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: tamaḥsattvarajoyuktas tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu līyate pratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt
verses.translation: Joined with tamas, sattva and rajas, he is absorbed in those various wombs here, through lack of awakening and through keeping company with the unawakened.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सहवासनिवासत्वाद् बालो ऽहम् इति मन्यते यो ऽहं न सो ऽहम् इत्य् उक्तो गुणान् एवानुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sahavāsanivāsatvād bālo 'ham iti manyate yo 'haṃ na so 'ham ity ukto guṇān evānuvartate
verses.translation: Through living together he thinks, "I am a child"; told "What I am, I am not," he simply follows the qualities.

verses.sanskrit: तमसा तामसान् भावान् विविधान् प्रतिपद्यते रजसा राजसांश् चैव सात्त्विकान् सत्त्वसंश्रयात्
verses.transliteration: tamasā tāmasān bhāvān vividhān pratipadyate rajasā rājasāṃś caiva sāttvikān sattvasaṃśrayāt
verses.translation: Through tamas he comes to various tamasic states, through rajas to rajasic ones, and to sattvic ones through resorting to sattva.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: शुक्ललोहितकृष्णानि रूपाण्य् एतानि त्रीणि तु सर्वाण्य् एतानि रूपाणि जानीहि प्राकृतानि तु
verses.transliteration: śuklalohitakṛṣṇāni rūpāṇy etāni trīṇi tu sarvāṇy etāni rūpāṇi jānīhi prākṛtāni tu
verses.translation: White, red and black are these three forms; know all these forms to be of Prakriti.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तामसा निरयं यान्ति राजसा मानुषान् अथ सात्त्विका देवलोकाय गच्छन्ति सुखभागिनः
verses.transliteration: tāmasā nirayaṃ yānti rājasā mānuṣān atha sāttvikā devalokāya gacchanti sukhabhāginaḥ
verses.translation: The tamasic go to hell, the rajasic to human birth, and the sattvic, sharing in happiness, go to the world of the gods.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निष्केवलेन पापेन तिर्यग्योनिम् अवाप्नुयात् पुण्यपापेषु मानुष्यं पुण्यमात्रेण देवताः
verses.transliteration: niṣkevalena pāpena tiryagyonim avāpnuyāt puṇyapāpeṣu mānuṣyaṃ puṇyamātreṇa devatāḥ
verses.translation: By sin alone one is born among animals; by merit and sin mixed, as a human; and by merit alone, among the gods.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अव्यक्तविषयं मोक्षम् आहुर् मनीषिणः पञ्चविंशतिमो यो ऽयं ज्ञानाद् एव प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: evam avyaktaviṣayaṃ mokṣam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ pañcaviṃśatimo yo 'yaṃ jñānād eva pravartate
verses.translation: Thus the wise say that liberation lies beyond the unmanifest; it comes about for the twenty-fifth through knowledge alone.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् अप्रतिबुद्धत्वाद् अबुद्धम् अनुवर्तते देहाद् देहसहस्राणि तथा च न स भिद्यते
verses.transliteration: evam apratibuddhatvād abuddham anuvartate dehād dehasahasrāṇi tathā ca na sa bhidyate
verses.translation: Hence, I will request Devas for only this: Let them in due order permit this. Let the sages, Ganga, Devas, Hari and Sankara permit this.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनिसहस्रेषु कदाचिद् देवतास्व् अपि उत्पद्यति तपोयोगाद् गुणैः सह गुणक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: tiryagyonisahasreṣu kadācid devatāsv api utpadyati tapoyogād guṇaiḥ saha guṇakṣayāt
verses.translation: O Devas, on either bank of the river, there is Sankara in Ijidresvara and lord Janardana in Abjaka on the other side.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas, on either bank of the river, there is Sankara in Ijidresvara and lord Janardana in Abjaka on the other side.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यत्वाद् दिवं याति देवो मानुष्यम् एति च मानुष्यान् निरयस्थानम् आलयं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: manuṣyatvād divaṃ yāti devo mānuṣyam eti ca mānuṣyān nirayasthānam ālayaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: Visnu, Trivikrama, directly sanctifies the Dandaka forest. Whatever holy centres are in between are the bestowers of everything meritorious.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, Trivikrama, directly sanctifies the Dandaka forest. Whatever holy centres are in between are the bestowers of everything meritorious.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कोषकारो यथात्मानं कीटः समभिरुन्धति सूत्रतन्तुगुणैर् नित्यं तथायम् अगुणो गुणैः
verses.transliteration: koṣakāro yathātmānaṃ kīṭaḥ samabhirundhati sūtratantuguṇair nityaṃ tathāyam aguṇo guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping Agastya the wise great sage followed by his disciples began to ask.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Agastya the wise great sage followed by his disciples began to ask.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: द्वंद्वम् एति च निर्द्वंद्वस् तासु तास्व् इह योनिषु शीर्षरोगे ऽक्षिरोगे च दन्तशूले गलग्रहे
verses.transliteration: dvaṃdvam eti ca nirdvaṃdvas tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu śīrṣaroge 'kṣiroge ca dantaśūle galagrahe
verses.translation: In the matters of virtue, wealth, love and liberation scriptures are said to be the authority. And among scriptures Vedas are considered to be the greatest authority.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the matters of virtue, wealth, love and liberation scriptures are said to be the authority. And among scriptures Vedas are considered to be the greatest authority.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जलोदरे ऽतिसारे च गण्डमालाविचर्चिके श्वित्रकुष्ठे ऽग्निदग्धे च सिध्मापस्मारयोर् अपि
verses.transliteration: jalodare 'tisāre ca gaṇḍamālāvicarcike śvitrakuṣṭhe 'gnidagdhe ca sidhmāpasmārayor api
verses.translation: Only he who knows the highest truth (or principle) is the learned one and not the other. He who speaks of difference (in the three forms) is called Lingabhedin (the splitter of Linga).
verses.commentary: Sense: Only he who knows the highest truth (or principle) is the learned one and not the other. He who speaks of difference (in the three forms) is called Lingabhedin (the splitter of Linga).
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यानि चान्यानि द्वंद्वानि प्राकृतानि शरीरिणाम् उत्पद्यन्ते विचित्राणि तान्य् एवात्माभिमन्यते
verses.transliteration: yāni cānyāni dvaṃdvāni prākṛtāni śarīriṇām utpadyante vicitrāṇi tāny evātmābhimanyate
verses.translation: The Vedas are our authority in respect of the separate physical forms. The one that is formless is superior to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas are our authority in respect of the separate physical forms. The one that is formless is superior to them.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अभिमानातिमानानां तथैव सुकृतान्य् अपि एकवासाश् चतुर्वासाः शायी नित्यम् अधस् तथा
verses.transliteration: abhimānātimānānāṃ tathaiva sukṛtāny api ekavāsāś caturvāsāḥ śāyī nityam adhas tathā
verses.translation: By this (statement) I have not come to any fixed con¬ clusion. In this respect too, let the secret doctrine be elaborated upon and explained quickly. That secret doctrine should be free from doubts and alternatives and it should be (important enough so as) deserving all riches.
verses.commentary: Sense: By this (statement) I have not come to any fixed con¬ clusion. In this respect too, let the secret doctrine be elaborated upon and explained quickly. verses.transliteration: niyamān vividhāṃś cāpi vividhāni tapāṃsi ca yajñāṃś ca vividhākārān vidyāś ca vividhās tathā
verses.translation: various disciplines and austerities, sacrifices of many kinds and various branches of learning,

verses.sanskrit: वणिक्पथं द्विजक्षत्रवैश्यशूद्रांस् तथैव च दानं च विविधाकारं दीनान्धकृपणादिषु
verses.transliteration: vaṇikpathaṃ dvijakṣatravaiśyaśūdrāṃs tathaiva ca dānaṃ ca vividhākāraṃ dīnāndhakṛpaṇādiṣu
verses.translation: the path of trade, brahmins, kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras, and gifts of many kinds to the poor, the blind, the wretched and others —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्येत संधातुं तथैव विविधान् गुणान् सत्त्वं रजस् तमश् चैव धर्मार्थौ काम एव च
verses.transliteration: abhimanyeta saṃdhātuṃ tathaiva vividhān guṇān sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca
verses.translation: he imagines he is taking these up, and likewise the various qualities, sattva, rajas and tamas, dharma, wealth and pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्यात्मानम् एवात्मा एवं प्रविभजत्य् उत स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ स्वधाकारनमस्क्रिये
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyātmānam evātmā evaṃ pravibhajaty uta svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau svadhākāranamaskriye
verses.translation: Thus the Self divides itself as Prakriti. The cries of svaha and vashat, the cry of svadha and the act of salutation,

verses.sanskrit: यजनाध्ययने दानं तथैवाहुः प्रतिग्रहम् याजनाध्यापने चैव तथान्यद् अपि किंचन
verses.transliteration: yajanādhyayane dānaṃ tathaivāhuḥ pratigraham yājanādhyāpane caiva tathānyad api kiṃcana
verses.translation: sacrificing and studying, giving and likewise receiving, officiating at sacrifices and teaching, and whatever else there is,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: जन्ममृत्युविधानेन तथा विशसनेन च शुभाशुभभयं सर्वम् एतद् आहुः सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: janmamṛtyuvidhānena tathā viśasanena ca śubhāśubhabhayaṃ sarvam etad āhuḥ sanātanam
verses.translation: through the ordering of birth and death, and through slaughter — all this fear of good and bad they call eternal.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिः कुरुते देवी भयं प्रलयम् एव च दिवसान्ते गुणान् एतान् अतीत्यैको ऽवतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiḥ kurute devī bhayaṃ pralayam eva ca divasānte guṇān etān atītyaiko 'vatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: The goddess Prakriti creates fear and dissolution; at the end of the day he alone remains, having passed beyond these qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.transliteration: raśmijālam ivādityas tatkālaṃ saṃniyacchati evam evaiṣa tat sarvaṃ krīḍārtham abhimanyate
verses.translation: As the sun draws in its net of rays at that time, so he regards all this as play —

verses.sanskrit: आत्मरूपगुणान् एतान् विविधान् हृदयप्रियान् एवम् एतां प्रकुर्वाणः सर्गप्रलयधर्मिणीम्
verses.transliteration: ātmarūpaguṇān etān vividhān hṛdayapriyān evam etāṃ prakurvāṇaḥ sargapralayadharmiṇīm
verses.translation: these various qualities of his own form, dear to the heart. Thus producing this activity whose nature is creation and dissolution,

verses.sanskrit: क्रियां क्रियापथे रक्तस् त्रिगुणस् त्रिगुणाधिपः क्रियाक्रियापथोपेतस् तथा तद् इति मन्यते
verses.transliteration: kriyāṃ kriyāpathe raktas triguṇas triguṇādhipaḥ kriyākriyāpathopetas tathā tad iti manyate
verses.translation: attached to the path of action, of three qualities and lord of the three qualities, following the path of action and inaction, he thinks, 'That is so.'
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्या सर्वम् एवेदं जगद् अन्धीकृतं विभो रजसा तमसा चैव व्याप्तं सर्वम् अनेकधा
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyā sarvam evedaṃ jagad andhīkṛtaṃ vibho rajasā tamasā caiva vyāptaṃ sarvam anekadhā
verses.translation: By Prakriti this whole world has been made blind, O lord, pervaded in many ways by rajas and tamas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवं द्वंद्वान्य् अतीतानि मम वर्तन्ति नित्यशः मत्त एतानि जायन्ते प्रलये यान्ति माम् अपि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dvaṃdvāny atītāni mama vartanti nityaśaḥ matta etāni jāyante pralaye yānti mām api
verses.translation: 'So the pairs of opposites that have passed always turn upon me; from me they arise and in dissolution they go back to me.

verses.transliteration: nistartavyāṇy athaitāni sarvāṇīti narādhipa manyate pakṣabuddhitvāt tathaiva sukṛtāny api
verses.translation: All these must be crossed,' O king, so he thinks, out of partial understanding; and so too of his good deeds:

verses.sanskrit: भोक्तव्यानि ममैतानि देवलोकगतेन वै इहैव चैनं भोक्ष्यामि शुभाशुभफलोदयम्
verses.transliteration: bhoktavyāni mamaitāni devalokagatena vai ihaiva cainaṃ bhokṣyāmi śubhāśubhaphalodayam
verses.translation: 'These are to be enjoyed by me when I have gone to the world of the gods; and here too I shall enjoy the rising fruit of good and bad.

verses.sanskrit: सुखम् एवं तु कर्तव्यं सकृत् कृत्वा सुखं मम यावद् एव तु मे सौख्यं जात्यां जात्यां भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: sukham evaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sakṛt kṛtvā sukhaṃ mama yāvad eva tu me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Happiness must be made thus; having once made my happiness, my happiness will last birth after birth;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति न मे दुःखं कृतेनेहाप्य् अनन्तकम् सुखदुःखं हि मानुष्यं निरये चापि मज्जनम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyati na me duḥkhaṃ kṛtenehāpy anantakam sukhaduḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam
verses.translation: and by what I have done here there will be endless freedom from sorrow for me.' Human life is pleasure and pain, and there is sinking into hell as well.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निरयाच् चापि मानुष्यं कालेनैष्याम्य् अहं पुनः मनुष्यत्वाच् च देवत्वं देवत्वात् पौरुषं पुनः
verses.transliteration: nirayāc cāpi mānuṣyaṃ kālenaiṣyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ manuṣyatvāc ca devatvaṃ devatvāt pauruṣaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: 'From hell I shall come again in time to human birth, from human birth to godhood, and from godhood again to manhood;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यत्वाच् च निरयं पर्यायेणोपगच्छति एष एवं द्विजातीनाम् आत्मा वै स गुणैर् वृतः
verses.transliteration: manuṣyatvāc ca nirayaṃ paryāyeṇopagacchati eṣa evaṃ dvijātīnām ātmā vai sa guṇair vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: and from manhood he goes to hell in turn.' Such is the self of the twice-born, enveloped by the qualities;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तेन देवमनुष्येषु निरयं चोपपद्यते ममत्वेनावृतो नित्यं तत्रैव परिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: tena devamanuṣyeṣu nirayaṃ copapadyate mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate
verses.translation: by it he comes to gods, men and hell; always wrapped in the sense of 'mine,' he turns about right there
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्गकोटिसहस्राणि मरणान्तासु मूर्तिषु य एवं कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: sargakoṭisahasrāṇi maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu ya evaṃ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam
verses.translation: through thousands of crores of creations, in forms that end in death. He who performs karma that bears good and bad fruit in this way
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स एवं फलम् आप्नोति त्रिषु लोकेषु मूर्तिमान् प्रकृतिः कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: sa evaṃ phalam āpnoti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān prakṛtiḥ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam
verses.translation: obtains the fruit thus, embodied in the three worlds. Prakriti performs the karma bearing good and bad fruit,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिश् च तथाप्नोति त्रिषु लोकेषु कामगा तिर्यग्योनिमनुष्यत्वे देवलोके तथैव च
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiś ca tathāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu kāmagā tiryagyonimanuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca
verses.translation: and Prakriti, going where it will, likewise obtains it in the three worlds — in animal birth, in human birth and in the world of the gods.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि स्थानानि चैतानि जानीयात् प्राकृतानि ह अलिङ्गप्रकृतित्वाच् च लिङ्गैर् अप्य् अनुमीयते
verses.transliteration: trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyāt prākṛtāni ha aliṅgaprakṛtitvāc ca liṅgair apy anumīyate
verses.translation: These three states should be known as belonging to Prakriti. Because Prakriti is without marks, it is inferred through its marks;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.transliteration: tathaiva pauruṣaṃ liṅgam anumānād dhi manyate sa liṅgāntaram āsādya prākṛtaṃ liṅgam avraṇam
verses.translation: and likewise the mark of the Purusha is known by inference. Entering another body, the flawless body of Prakriti,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.transliteration: vraṇadvārāṇy adhiṣṭhāya karmāṇy ātmani manyate śrotrādīni tu sarvāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇy atha
verses.translation: and occupying the openings of its wounds, he thinks of actions as belonging to himself. The ear and the rest, and the five senses of action,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: रागादीनि प्रवर्तन्ते गुणेष्व् इह गुणैः सह अहम् एतानि वै कुर्वन् ममैतानीन्द्रियाणि ह
verses.transliteration: rāgādīni pravartante guṇeṣv iha guṇaiḥ saha aham etāni vai kurvan mamaitānīndriyāṇi ha
verses.translation: and passion and the like operate here among the qualities along with the qualities. 'I am doing these; these senses are mine' —

verses.translation: so, though without senses, he thinks; though without wounds, he thinks 'I am wounded'; though without marks, he thinks himself marked; though beyond time, he thinks himself subject to time;

verses.sanskrit: असत्त्वं सत्त्वम् आत्मानम् अमृतं मृतम् आत्मनः अमृत्युं मृत्युम् आत्मानम् अचरं चरम् आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: asattvaṃ sattvam ātmānam amṛtaṃ mṛtam ātmanaḥ amṛtyuṃ mṛtyum ātmānam acaraṃ caram ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: though without sattva, he thinks himself sattva; though immortal, he thinks himself dead; though deathless, he thinks himself death; though unmoving, he thinks himself moving;

verses.sanskrit: अक्षेत्रं क्षेत्रम् आत्मानम् असङ्गं सङ्गम् आत्मनः अतत्त्वं तत्त्वम् आत्मानम् अभवं भवम् आत्मनः
verses.transliteration: akṣetraṃ kṣetram ātmānam asaṅgaṃ saṅgam ātmanaḥ atattvaṃ tattvam ātmānam abhavaṃ bhavam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: though without a field, he thinks himself the field; though unattached, attached; though not a principle, a principle; though unborn, born;
