verses.sanskrit: अक्षरं क्षरम् आत्मानम् अबुद्धत्वाद् धि मन्यते एवम् अप्रतिबुद्धत्वाद् अबुद्धजनसेवनात्
verses.transliteration: akṣaraṃ kṣaram ātmānam abuddhatvād dhi manyate evam apratibuddhatvād abuddhajanasevanāt
verses.translation: though imperishable, he thinks himself perishable, through lack of understanding. Thus through lack of awakening and keeping company with the unawakened,

verses.sanskrit: सर्गकोटिसहस्राणि पतनान्तानि गच्छति जन्मान्तरसहस्राणि मरणान्तानि गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati janmāntarasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni gacchati
verses.translation: he goes through thousands of crores of creations ending in a fall, and through thousands of births ending in death,

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्योनिमनुष्यत्वे देवलोके तथैव च चन्द्रमा इव कोशानां पुनस् तत्र सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tiryagyonimanuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca candramā iva kośānāṃ punas tatra sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: in animal birth, human birth and the world of the gods, like the moon through its phases, again there by the thousand.

verses.sanskrit: नीयते ऽप्रतिबुद्धत्वाद् एवम् एव कुबुद्धिमान् कला पञ्चदशी योनिस् तद् धाम इति पठ्यते
verses.transliteration: nīyate 'pratibuddhatvād evam eva kubuddhimān kalā pañcadaśī yonis tad dhāma iti paṭhyate
verses.translation: So the ill-minded one is led on through lack of awakening. The fifteenth digit is the source; that is said to be its abode.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यम् एव विजानीहि सोमं वै षोडशांशकैः कलया जायते ऽजस्रं पुनः पुनर् अबुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: nityam eva vijānīhi somaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ kalayā jāyate 'jasraṃ punaḥ punar abuddhimān
verses.translation: Know that the moon always has sixteen parts; through a digit the unwise one is born again and again continually.

verses.sanskrit: धीमांश् चायं न भवति नृप एवं हि जायते षोडशी तु कला सूक्ष्मा स सोम उपधार्यताम्
verses.transliteration: dhīmāṃś cāyaṃ na bhavati nṛpa evaṃ hi jāyate ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām
verses.translation: The wise one is not born thus, O king. The sixteenth digit is subtle; understand that to be the true Soma.

verses.sanskrit: न तूपयुज्यते देवैर् देवान् अपि युनक्ति सः ममत्वं क्षपयित्वा तु जायते नृपसत्तम प्रकृतेस् त्रिगुणायास् तु स एव त्रिगुणो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: na tūpayujyate devair devān api yunakti saḥ mamatvaṃ kṣapayitvā tu jāyate nṛpasattama prakṛtes triguṇāyās tu sa eva triguṇo bhavet
verses.translation: It is not consumed by the gods, but it nourishes the gods. Having destroyed the sense of 'mine,' O best of kings, he is born; for Prakriti has three qualities, and he becomes of three qualities too.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरक्षरयोर् एष द्वयोः संबन्ध इष्यते स्त्रीपुंसयोर् वा संबन्धः स वै पुरुष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: akṣarakṣarayor eṣa dvayoḥ saṃbandha iṣyate strīpuṃsayor vā saṃbandhaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate
verses.translation: Those who take their holy bath in the Banatlrtha and remember Sarngapani Visnu will never experience the miseries of proverty for ages.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.transliteration: ṛte tu puruṣaṃ neha strī garbhān dhārayaty uta ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartate tathā
verses.translation: If a man recites but once Gayatri, the mother of Vedas,
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man recites but once Gayatri, the mother of Vedas,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यस्याभिसंबन्धाद् अन्योन्यगुणसंश्रयात् रूपं निर्वर्तयेद् एतद् एवं सर्वासु योनिषु
verses.transliteration: anyonyasyābhisaṃbandhād anyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt rūpaṃ nirvartayed etad evaṃ sarvāsu yoniṣu
verses.translation: By taking holy bath in the southern bank and by worshipping goddess Sakti devoutly and duly one shall attain all cherished desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking holy bath in the southern bank and by worshipping goddess Sakti devoutly and duly one shall attain all cherished desires.

verses.translation: Siva well known by the name Brahmeivara has been installed by me for helping all people and for my own reasons.

verses.transliteration: yad eva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṃkhyaṃ tad anugamyate ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān
verses.translation: (3rd Mantra, 114thSukta of the IX Mamjala) (Tr. According to Sayana) "O Soma, protect us with all these, viz. the seven Diks (quarters) (excluding that of which Soma is the lord, i.e. north) presided over by different suns, the seven Hotfs (Vasatkartrs), the seven Rtviks, the seven dazzling sons of Aditi (excepting Martamja who was thrown up, according to RV X. 72-8). O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.translation: (4th Mantra, 114th Sukta, IX Manala) "O Rajan (Lord as the person making them work) Soma, protect us by means of the Havis cooked for your sake. Let not the inimical assailant kill us nor destroy anything (wealth etc.) belonging to us. O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.transliteration: nirindriyasya bījasya nirdravyasyāpi dehinaḥ kathaṃ guṇā bhaviṣyanti nirguṇatvān mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: (3rd Mantra, IX-112) "I am the composer of the Suktas. Hence I am the father and son. I am the physician, Brahma of the Yajfia. This lady who makes the groats, gruel etc. is the mother or daughter. All of us of diverse mental pre¬ dilections and activities are desirous of wealth and like cows we serve the world. O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.transliteration: guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva viramanti ca evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtijā jāyante na ca yānti ca
verses.translation: By saying thus (i.e. by eulogizing Soma thus) the Soma was obtained for the Vajra-wielding Indra. By giving (the same Soma) to them Indra got his hundred sacrifices complete.

verses.translation: He comes in some other guise at midday in order to see me, Sankara and Hari. There, at midday, all people should be bowed to always.

verses.sanskrit: पुमांश् चैवापुमांश् चैव स्त्रीलिङ्गं प्राकृतं स्मृतम् वायुर् एष पुमांश् चैव रस इत्य् अभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: pumāṃś caivāpumāṃś caiva strīliṅgaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam vāyur eṣa pumāṃś caiva rasa ity abhidhīyate
verses.translation: Merely by remembering that Tirtha, propitiation of (malignant) planets can be achieved. Another Tirtha is on the excellent mountain Indragopa.

verses.sanskrit: अलिङ्गा प्रकृतिर् लिङ्गैर् उपलभ्यति सात्मजैः यथा पुष्पफलैर् नित्यं मूर्तं चामूर्तयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: aliṅgā prakṛtir liṅgair upalabhyati sātmajaiḥ yathā puṣpaphalair nityaṃ mūrtaṃ cāmūrtayas tathā
verses.translation: Prakriti, without marks, is perceived through the marks born of itself, as the embodied and the formless are always perceived through flowers and fruits.

verses.transliteration: evam apy anumānena sa liṅgam upalabhyate pañcaviṃśatikas tāta liṅgeṣu niyatātmakaḥ
verses.translation: So too by inference the mark is perceived; the twenty-fifth, dear one, is fixed in nature among the marks,

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधनो ऽनन्तः सर्वदर्शनकेवलः केवलं त्व् अभिमानित्वाद् गुणेषु गुण उच्यते
verses.transliteration: anādinidhano 'nantaḥ sarvadarśanakevalaḥ kevalaṃ tv abhimānitvād guṇeṣu guṇa ucyate
verses.translation: without beginning or end, infinite, the sole seer of all; only because of identification is it called a quality among the qualities.

verses.sanskrit: गुणा गुणवतः सन्ति निर्गुणस्य कुतो गुणाः तस्माद् एवं विजानन्ति ये जना गुणदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ tasmād evaṃ vijānanti ye janā guṇadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: Qualities belong to what has qualities; how can what is without qualities have them? So those who see the qualities understand.

verses.sanskrit: यदा त्व् एष गुणान् एतान् प्राकृतान् अभिमन्यते तदा स गुणवान् एव गुणभेदान् प्रपश्यति
verses.transliteration: yadā tv eṣa guṇān etān prākṛtān abhimanyate tadā sa guṇavān eva guṇabhedān prapaśyati
verses.translation: But when he identifies with these qualities of Prakriti, then he becomes possessed of qualities and sees the distinctions of qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत् तद् बुद्धेः परं प्राहुः सांख्ययोगं च सर्वशः बुध्यमानं महाप्राज्ञाः प्रबुद्धपरिवर्जनात्
verses.transliteration: yat tad buddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṃkhyayogaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ budhyamānaṃ mahāprājñāḥ prabuddhaparivarjanāt
verses.translation: That which they call beyond the intellect, and Sankhya-yoga in every way, the deeply wise call the awakening one, through setting aside the awakened.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रबुद्धं यथा व्यक्तं स्वगुणैः प्राहुर् ईश्वरम् निर्गुणं चेश्वरं नित्यम् अधिष्ठातारम् एव च
verses.transliteration: aprabuddhaṃ yathā vyaktaṃ svaguṇaiḥ prāhur īśvaram nirguṇaṃ ceśvaraṃ nityam adhiṣṭhātāram eva ca
verses.translation: They call the Lord unawakened as manifested by his own qualities, and the Lord without qualities eternal, the presiding one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतेश् च गुणानां च पञ्चविंशतिकं बुधाः सांख्ययोगे च कुशला बुध्यन्ते परमैषिणः
verses.transliteration: prakṛteś ca guṇānāṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṃ budhāḥ sāṃkhyayoge ca kuśalā budhyante paramaiṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The twenty-fifth, beyond Prakriti and the qualities, the wise who are skilled in Sankhya-yoga and seek the supreme understand.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रबुद्धम् अव्यक्तम् अवस्थातननीरवः बुध्यमानं न बुध्यन्ते ऽवगच्छन्ति समं तदा
verses.transliteration: yadā prabuddham avyaktam avasthātananīravaḥ budhyamānaṃ na budhyante 'vagacchanti samaṃ tadā
verses.translation: When the unmanifest is awakened, and the states are silent, they do not know the awakening one; then they understand it as the same.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतन् निदर्शनं सम्यङ् न सम्यग् अनुदर्शनम् बुध्यमानं प्रबुध्यन्ते द्वाभ्यां पृथग् अरिंदम
verses.transliteration: etan nidarśanaṃ samyaṅ na samyag anudarśanam budhyamānaṃ prabudhyante dvābhyāṃ pṛthag ariṃdama
verses.translation: This is a proper illustration, not a proper vision; they understand the awakening one as distinct from the two, O subduer of foes.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: परस्परेणैतद् उक्तं क्षराक्षरनिदर्शनम् एकत्वम् अक्षरं प्राहुर् नानात्वं क्षरम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: paraspareṇaitad uktaṃ kṣarākṣaranidarśanam ekatvam akṣaraṃ prāhur nānātvaṃ kṣaram ucyate
verses.translation: This illustration of the perishable and imperishable has been stated in relation to each other: oneness they call the imperishable, and multiplicity is called the perishable.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिनिष्ठो ऽयं तदा सम्यक् प्रचक्षते एकत्वदर्शनं चास्य नानात्वं चास्य दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭho 'yaṃ tadā samyak pracakṣate ekatvadarśanaṃ cāsya nānātvaṃ cāsya darśanam
verses.translation: When he is established in the twenty-fifth, then they speak rightly; his vision of oneness and his vision of multiplicity —
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्ववित् तत्त्वयोर् एव पृथग् एतन् निदर्शनम् पञ्चविंशतिभिस् तत्त्वं तत्त्वम् आहुर् मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: tattvavit tattvayor eva pṛthag etan nidarśanam pañcaviṃśatibhis tattvaṃ tattvam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: the knower of principles sees this illustration of the two principles as distinct. The wise call the principle with the twenty-five principles 'the principle';
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निस्तत्त्वं पञ्चविंशस्य परम् आहुर् मनीषिणः वर्ज्यस्य वर्ज्यम् आचारं तत्त्वं तत्त्वात् सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: nistattvaṃ pañcaviṃśasya param āhur manīṣiṇaḥ varjyasya varjyam ācāraṃ tattvaṃ tattvāt sanātanam
verses.translation: the wise call what is beyond the twenty-fifth free of principles. The conduct to be avoided is the avoidance of what is to be avoided; the eternal principle is beyond the principle."
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: नानात्वैकत्वम् इत्य् उक्तं त्वयैतद् द्विजसत्तम पश्यतस् तद् धि संदिग्धम् एतयोर् वै निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: nānātvaikatvam ity uktaṃ tvayaitad dvijasattama paśyatas tad dhi saṃdigdham etayor vai nidarśanam
verses.translation: "You have spoken of multiplicity and oneness, O best of brahmins, but to one who looks, the illustration of these two remains doubtful.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तथा बुद्धप्रबुद्धाभ्यां बुध्यमानस्य चानघ स्थूलबुद्ध्या न पश्यामि तत्त्वम् एतन् न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tathā buddhaprabuddhābhyāṃ budhyamānasya cānagha sthūlabuddhyā na paśyāmi tattvam etan na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Likewise, sinless one, with my gross understanding I cannot see the truth of the awakened, the unawakened and the awakening one; there is no doubt of this.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरक्षरयोर् उक्तं त्वया यद् अपि कारणम् तद् अप्य् अस्थिरबुद्धित्वात् प्रनष्टम् इव मे ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: akṣarakṣarayor uktaṃ tvayā yad api kāraṇam tad apy asthirabuddhitvāt pranaṣṭam iva me 'nagha
verses.translation: And the reason you gave for the imperishable and the perishable seems lost to me, sinless one, because my understanding is unsteady.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तद् एतच् छ्रोतुम् इच्छामि नानात्वैकत्वदर्शनम् द्वंद्वं चैवानिरुद्धं च बुध्यमानं च तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tad etac chrotum icchāmi nānātvaikatvadarśanam dvaṃdvaṃ caivāniruddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ
verses.translation: So I wish to hear this: the vision of multiplicity and oneness, the pair and the unobstructed, and the awakening one, in truth;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याविद्ये च भगवन्न् अक्षरं क्षरम् एव च सांख्ययोगं च कृत्स्नेन बुद्धाबुद्धिं पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: vidyāvidye ca bhagavann akṣaraṃ kṣaram eva ca sāṃkhyayogaṃ ca kṛtsnena buddhābuddhiṃ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: knowledge and ignorance, blessed one, the imperishable and the perishable, and Sankhya-yoga fully, the awakened and the unawakened, each separately."

verses.sanskrit: हन्त ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि यद् एतद् अनुपृच्छसि योगकृत्यं महाराज पृथग् एव शृणुष्व मे
verses.transliteration: hanta te saṃpravakṣyāmi yad etad anupṛcchasi yogakṛtyaṃ mahārāja pṛthag eva śṛṇuṣva me
verses.translation: "Well then, I will tell you what you ask. Hear from me separately, great king, the practice of yoga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योगकृत्यं तु योगानां ध्यानम् एव परं बलम् तच् चापि द्विविधं ध्यानम् आहुर् विद्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānam eva paraṃ balam tac cāpi dvividhaṃ dhyānam āhur vidyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: The practice of the yogas is meditation, which is their supreme strength; and that meditation, those who know say, is twofold:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एकाग्रता च मनसः प्राणायामस् तथैव च प्राणायामस् तु सगुणो निर्गुणो मानसस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmas tathaiva ca prāṇāyāmas tu saguṇo nirguṇo mānasas tathā
verses.translation: one-pointedness of mind and breath control; and breath control is with qualities, while the mental one is without qualities.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मूत्रोत्सर्गे पुरीषे च भोजने च नराधिप द्विकालं नोपभुञ्जीत शेषं भुञ्जीत तत्परः
verses.transliteration: mūtrotsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa dvikālaṃ nopabhuñjīta śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta tatparaḥ
verses.translation: At the times of passing urine and stool and of eating, O king, one should not practise; at the other times one should practise intently.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यो निवर्त्य मनसा मुनिः दशद्वादशभिर् वापि चतुर्विंशात् परं यतः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo nivartya manasā muniḥ daśadvādaśabhir vāpi caturviṃśāt paraṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: The sage, withdrawing the senses from their objects with the mind, with ten or twelve (breath-controls), for he is beyond the twenty-four,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स चोदनाभिर् मतिमान् नात्मानं चोदयेद् अथ तिष्ठन्तम् अजरं तं तु यत् तद् उक्तं मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: sa codanābhir matimān nātmānaṃ codayed atha tiṣṭhantam ajaraṃ taṃ tu yat tad uktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: and the wise one should not urge himself with urgings; that unageing one who abides is what the wise have spoken of.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वात्मा सततं ज्ञेय इत्य् एवम् अनुशुश्रुम द्रव्यं ह्य् अहीनमनसो नान्यथेति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: viśvātmā satataṃ jñeya ity evam anuśuśruma dravyaṃ hy ahīnamanaso nānyatheti viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: The Self of the universe is always to be known — so we have heard. It is the object for one whose mind is not deficient; not otherwise — this is certain.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वसङ्गेभ्यो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः पूर्वरात्रे परार्धे च धारयीत मनो हृदि
verses.transliteration: vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ pūrvarātre parārdhe ca dhārayīta mano hṛdi
verses.translation: Freed from all attachments, eating lightly, with senses conquered, in the early part of the night and the latter one should hold the mind in the heart.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरीकृत्येन्द्रियग्रामं मनसा मिथिलेश्वर मनो बुद्ध्या स्थिरं कृत्वा पाषाण इव निश्चलः
verses.transliteration: sthirīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manasā mithileśvara mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ
verses.translation: Making the group of senses steady by the mind, O lord of Mithila, and the mind steady by the intellect, motionless as a stone,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: स्थाणुवच् चाप्य् अकम्प्यः स्याद् दारुवच् चापि निश्चलः बुद्ध्या विधिविधानज्ञस् ततो युक्तं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: sthāṇuvac cāpy akampyaḥ syād dāruvac cāpi niścalaḥ buddhyā vidhividhānajñas tato yuktaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: one should be unshakable as a post and motionless as a log. The one who knows the rules of practice through the intellect is then called 'yoked.'
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न शृणोति न चाघ्राति न च पश्यति किंचन न च स्पर्शं विजानाति न च संकल्पते मनः
verses.transliteration: na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na ca paśyati kiṃcana na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na ca saṃkalpate manaḥ
verses.translation: He does not hear, smell or see anything; he does not perceive touch, and his mind forms no intentions;
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न चापि मन्यते किंचिन् न च बुध्येत काष्ठवत् तदा प्रकृतिम् आपन्नं युक्तम् आहुर् मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: na cāpi manyate kiṃcin na ca budhyeta kāṣṭhavat tadā prakṛtim āpannaṃ yuktam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: he does not think of anything and is not aware, like a log; then the wise call him yoked, having reached his true nature.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: न भाति हि यथा दीपो दीप्तिस् तद्वच् च दृश्यते निलिङ्गश् चाधश् चोर्ध्वं च तिर्यग्गतिम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: na bhāti hi yathā dīpo dīptis tadvac ca dṛśyate niliṅgaś cādhaś cordhvaṃ ca tiryaggatim avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: As a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so his radiance is seen; free from marks, he may move below, above and across.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तदा तदुपपन्नश् च यस्मिन् दृष्टे च कथ्यते हृदयस्थो ऽन्तरात्मेति ज्ञेयो ज्ञस् तात मद्विधैः
verses.transliteration: tadā tadupapannaś ca yasmin dṛṣṭe ca kathyate hṛdayastho 'ntarātmeti jñeyo jñas tāta madvidhaiḥ
verses.translation: Then, having attained that, he is said to be the one in whom it is seen: the inner Self dwelling in the heart is to be known as the knower by such as me, dear one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निर्धूम इव सप्तार्चिर् आदित्य इव रश्मिवान् वैद्युतो ऽग्निर् इवाकाशे पश्यत्य् आत्मानम् आत्मनि
verses.transliteration: nirdhūma iva saptārcir āditya iva raśmivān vaidyuto 'gnir ivākāśe paśyaty ātmānam ātmani
verses.translation: Like a smokeless fire, like the sun with its rays, like lightning's fire in the sky, he sees the Self in the self.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यं पश्यन्ति महात्मानो धृतिमन्तो मनीषिणः ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिस्था ह्य् अयोनिम् अमृतात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: yaṃ paśyanti mahātmāno dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ brāhmaṇā brahmayonisthā hy ayonim amṛtātmakam
verses.translation: Great-souled, steadfast and wise brahmins, established in the source of Brahman, behold him, the sourceless and immortal.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तद् एवाहुर् अणुभ्यो ऽणु तन् महद्भ्यो महत्तरम् सर्वत्र सर्वभूतेषु ध्रुवं तिष्ठन् न दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tad evāhur aṇubhyo 'ṇu tan mahadbhyo mahattaram sarvatra sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhan na dṛśyate
verses.translation: They call it subtler than the subtlest and greater than the greatest; everywhere in all beings it abides unmoving, yet is not seen.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिद्रव्येण दृश्येन मनोदीपेन लोककृत् महतस् तमसस् तात पारे तिष्ठन् न तामसः
verses.transliteration: buddhidravyeṇa dṛśyena manodīpena lokakṛt mahatas tamasas tāta pāre tiṣṭhan na tāmasaḥ
verses.translation: By the visible substance of the intellect and the lamp of the mind the maker of the world is seen; standing beyond the great darkness, dear one, he is not of darkness.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तमसो दूर इत्य् उक्तस् तत्त्वज्ञैर् वेदपारगैः विमलो विमतश् चैव निर्लिङ्गो ऽलिङ्गसंज्ञकः
verses.transliteration: tamaso dūra ity uktas tattvajñair vedapāragaiḥ vimalo vimataś caiva nirliṅgo 'liṅgasaṃjñakaḥ
verses.translation: Those who know the truth and have mastered the Vedas call him 'far from darkness,' stainless, beyond opinion, without marks, called the markless.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योग एष हि लोकानां किम् अन्यद् योगलक्षणम् एवं पश्यन् प्रपश्येत आत्मानम् अजरं परम्
verses.transliteration: yoga eṣa hi lokānāṃ kim anyad yogalakṣaṇam evaṃ paśyan prapaśyeta ātmānam ajaraṃ param
verses.translation: This is the yoga of the worlds; what other mark of yoga is there? Seeing thus, one beholds the unageing, supreme Self.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योगदर्शनम् एतावद् उक्तं ते तत्त्वतो मया सांख्यज्ञानं प्रवक्ष्यामि परिसंख्यानिदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: yogadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te tattvato mayā sāṃkhyajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi parisaṃkhyānidarśanam
verses.translation: This much I have told you truly of the vision of yoga; now I will tell of Sankhya knowledge, the illustration of enumeration.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तम् आहुः प्रख्यानं परां प्रकृतिम् आत्मनः तस्मान् महत् समुत्पन्नं द्वितीयं राजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: avyaktam āhuḥ prakhyānaṃ parāṃ prakṛtim ātmanaḥ tasmān mahat samutpannaṃ dvitīyaṃ rājasattama
verses.translation: The unmanifest they call the first, the supreme Prakriti of the Self; from it Mahat arose as the second, O best of kings.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अहंकारस् तु महतस् तृतीय इति नः श्रुतम् पञ्चभूतान्य् अहंकाराद् आहुः सांख्यात्मदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃkāras tu mahatas tṛtīya iti naḥ śrutam pañcabhūtāny ahaṃkārād āhuḥ sāṃkhyātmadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: Ahamkara from Mahat is the third, so we have heard; from ahamkara come the five elements, say those who see the Self through Sankhya.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एताः प्रकृतयस् त्व् अष्टौ विकाराश् चापि षोडश पञ्च चैव विशेषाश् च तथा पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: etāḥ prakṛtayas tv aṣṭau vikārāś cāpi ṣoḍaśa pañca caiva viśeṣāś ca tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: These are the eight Prakritis, and the modifications are sixteen: the five particulars and the five senses, and so on.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतावद् एव तत्त्वानां सांख्यम् आहुर् मनीषिणः सांख्ये सांख्यविधानज्ञा नित्यं सांख्यपथे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: etāvad eva tattvānāṃ sāṃkhyam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ sāṃkhye sāṃkhyavidhānajñā nityaṃ sāṃkhyapathe sthitāḥ
verses.translation: This much the wise call the Sankhya of the principles; those who know the Sankhya rules abide ever on the Sankhya path.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.explanation: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। इस पंक्ति का बल इसी प्रसंग के नियम पर है, किसी अलग प्रसंग से लाई हुई सामान्य उक्ति पर नहीं।
verses.science: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् यद् अभिजायेत तत् तत्रैव प्रलीयते लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमानि गृह्यन्ते चान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: yasmād yad abhijāyeta tat tatraiva pralīyate līyante pratilomāni gṛhyante cāntarātmanā
verses.translation: Whatever arises from something dissolves back into it; they dissolve in reverse order and are taken up by the inner Self.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आनुलोम्येन जायन्ते लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमतः गुणा गुणेषु सततं सागरस्योर्मयो यथा
verses.transliteration: ānulomyena jāyante līyante pratilomataḥ guṇā guṇeṣu satataṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā
verses.translation: They arise in forward order and dissolve in reverse order — qualities into qualities, continually, like the waves of the ocean.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सर्गप्रलय एतावान् प्रकृतेर् नृपसत्तम एकत्वं प्रलये चास्य बहुत्वं च तथा सृजि
verses.transliteration: sargapralaya etāvān prakṛter nṛpasattama ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca tathā sṛji
verses.translation: Such is the creation and dissolution of Prakriti, O best of kings: oneness in dissolution and multiplicity in creation.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एव च राजेन्द्र विज्ञेयं ज्ञानकोविदैः अधिष्ठातारम् अव्यक्तम् अस्याप्य् एतन् निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: evam eva ca rājendra vijñeyaṃ jñānakovidaiḥ adhiṣṭhātāram avyaktam asyāpy etan nidarśanam
verses.translation: So it should be understood by those skilled in knowledge, O king of kings; and this is also the illustration of its presiding unmanifest one.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एकत्वं च बहुत्वं च प्रकृतेर् अनु तत्त्ववान् एकत्वं प्रलये चास्य बहुत्वं च प्रवर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛter anu tattvavān ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt
verses.translation: The knower of principles follows the oneness and multiplicity of Prakriti: its oneness in dissolution and its multiplicity from its unfolding.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बहुधात्मा प्रकुर्वीत प्रकृतिं प्रसवात्मिकाम् तच् च क्षेत्रं महान् आत्मा पञ्चविंशो ऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: bahudhātmā prakurvīta prakṛtiṃ prasavātmikām tac ca kṣetraṃ mahān ātmā pañcaviṃśo 'dhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The manifold Self produces Prakriti, whose nature is to bring forth, and the great Self, the twenty-fifth, presides over that field.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठातेति राजेन्द्र प्रोच्यते यतिसत्तमैः अधिष्ठानाद् अधिष्ठाता क्षेत्राणाम् इति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhāteti rājendra procyate yatisattamaiḥ adhiṣṭhānād adhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇām iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: He is called the presiding one by the best of ascetics, O king of kings; the presider over the fields because of his presiding, so we have heard.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रं जानाति चाव्यक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञ इति चोच्यते अव्यक्तिके पुरे शेते पुरुषश् चेति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate avyaktike pure śete puruṣaś ceti kathyate
verses.translation: He knows the field, the unmanifest, and so is called the knower of the field; he lies in the unmanifest city and so is called Purusha.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यद् एव च क्षेत्रं स्याद् अन्यः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते क्षेत्रम् अव्यक्त इत्य् उक्तं ज्ञातारं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: anyad eva ca kṣetraṃ syād anyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate kṣetram avyakta ity uktaṃ jñātāraṃ pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: The field is one thing and the knower of the field is said to be another; the field is called the unmanifest, and the knower is the twenty-fifth.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यद् एव च ज्ञानं स्याद् अन्यज् ज्ञेयं तद् उच्यते ज्ञानम् अव्यक्तम् इत्य् उक्तं ज्ञेयो वै पञ्चविंशकः
verses.transliteration: anyad eva ca jñānaṃ syād anyaj jñeyaṃ tad ucyate jñānam avyaktam ity uktaṃ jñeyo vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: Knowledge is one thing and the knowable is said to be another; knowledge is called the unmanifest, and the knowable is the twenty-fifth.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रम् इत्य् उक्तं तथा सत्त्वं तथेश्वरम् अनीश्वरम् अतत्त्वं च तत्त्वं तत् पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ kṣetram ity uktaṃ tathā sattvaṃ tatheśvaram anīśvaram atattvaṃ ca tattvaṃ tat pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: The unmanifest is called the field, and likewise sattva and the lord; the twenty-fifth is not a lord and not a principle, yet it is the principle.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यदर्शनम् एतावत् परिसंख्या न विद्यते संख्या प्रकुरुते चैव प्रकृतिं च प्रवक्ष्यते
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvat parisaṃkhyā na vidyate saṃkhyā prakurute caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pravakṣyate
verses.translation: Such is the vision of Sankhya; beyond this there is no enumeration. Enumeration produces, and Prakriti will be described.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशच् चतुर्विंशत् प्रतिसंख्याय तत्त्वतः संख्या सहस्रकृत्या तु निस्तत्त्वः पञ्चविंशकः
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśac caturviṃśat pratisaṃkhyāya tattvataḥ saṃkhyā sahasrakṛtyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: Enumerating truly the twenty-four and the forty, and counting a thousand times, the twenty-fifth is free of principles.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशत् प्रबुद्धात्मा बुध्यमान इति श्रुतः यदा बुध्यति आत्मानं तदा भवति केवलः
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśat prabuddhātmā budhyamāna iti śrutaḥ yadā budhyati ātmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ
verses.translation: The twenty-fifth, whose self is awakened, is known as the awakening one; when he awakens to the Self, then he becomes alone (kevala).

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्दर्शनम् एतावद् भाषितं तव तत्त्वतः एवम् एतद् विजानन्तः साम्यतां प्रतियान्त्य् उत
verses.transliteration: samyagdarśanam etāvad bhāṣitaṃ tava tattvataḥ evam etad vijānantaḥ sāmyatāṃ pratiyānty uta
verses.translation: This much I have told you truly of right vision; those who understand it thus attain sameness.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यङ्निदर्शनं नाम प्रत्यक्षं प्रकृतेस् तथा गुणवत्त्वाद् यथैतानि निर्गुणेभ्यस् तथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samyaṅnidarśanaṃ nāma pratyakṣaṃ prakṛtes tathā guṇavattvād yathaitāni nirguṇebhyas tathā bhavet
verses.translation: Right illustration is direct perception of Prakriti; just as these arise from what has qualities, so it would be from the qualityless.

verses.sanskrit: न त्व् एवं वर्तमानानाम् आवृत्तिर् वर्तते पुनः विद्यते क्षरभावश् च न परस्परम् अव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: na tv evaṃ vartamānānām āvṛttir vartate punaḥ vidyate kṣarabhāvaś ca na parasparam avyayam
verses.translation: For those who abide thus there is no returning again; the perishable state exists, but not the mutual imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्त्य् अमतयो ये न सम्यक् तेषु च दर्शनम् ते व्यक्तिं प्रतिपद्यन्ते पुनः पुनर् अरिंदम
verses.transliteration: paśyanty amatayo ye na samyak teṣu ca darśanam te vyaktiṃ pratipadyante punaḥ punar ariṃdama
verses.translation: Those of poor understanding who do not see rightly, and whose vision rests on these, come to manifestation again and again, O subduer of foes.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वम् एतद् विजानन्तो न सर्वस्य प्रबोधनात् व्यक्तिभूता भविष्यन्ति व्यक्तस्यैवानुवर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: sarvam etad vijānanto na sarvasya prabodhanāt vyaktibhūtā bhaviṣyanti vyaktasyaivānuvartanāt
verses.translation: Those who know all this, but not through awakening to the whole, will become manifest beings because they follow only the manifest.

verses.transliteration: sarvam avyaktam ity uktam asarvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ ya evam abhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate
verses.translation: All is said to be unmanifest, and the twenty-fifth is not all; those who understand this have no fear.

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यदर्शनम् एतावद् उक्तं ते नृपसत्तम विद्याविद्ये त्व् इदानीं मे त्वं निबोधानुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyadarśanam etāvad uktaṃ te nṛpasattama vidyāvidye tv idānīṃ me tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The immortal ones began the eulogy of the two lords, the dispellers of the distress of everyone, while they were being (respectfully) watched by the Manes.

verses.translation: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Maruts, the Guardians of the

verses.transliteration: parasparasya vidyā vai tan nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ yathoktam ṛṣibhis tāta sāṃkhyasyātinidarśanam
verses.translation: O Narada, these two lords are ever established in the seven well known confluences as well as the meeting place of the ocean and the Ganga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narada, these two lords are ever established in the seven well known confluences as well as the meeting place of the ocean and the Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मेन्द्रियाणां सर्वेषां विद्या बुद्धीन्द्रियं स्मृतम् बुद्धीन्द्रियाणां च तथा विशेषा इति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: karmendriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidyā buddhīndriyaṃ smṛtam buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: Siva well known by the name Brahmeivara has been installed by me for helping all people and for my own reasons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva well known by the name Brahmeivara has been installed by me for helping all people and for my own reasons.

verses.sanskrit: विषयाणां मनस् तेषां विद्याम् आहुर् मनीषिणः मनसः पञ्च भूतानि विद्या इत्य् अभिचक्षते
verses.transliteration: viṣayāṇāṃ manas teṣāṃ vidyām āhur manīṣiṇaḥ manasaḥ pañca bhūtāni vidyā ity abhicakṣate
verses.translation: (3rd Mantra, 114thSukta of the IX Mamjala) (Tr. According to Sayana) "O Soma, protect us with all these, viz. the seven Diks (quarters) (excluding that of which Soma is the lord, i.e. north) presided over by different suns, the seven Hotfs (Vasatkartrs), the seven Rtviks, the seven dazzling sons of Aditi (excepting Martamja who was thrown up, according to RV X. 72-8). O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.sanskrit: अहंकारस् तु भूतानां पञ्चानां नात्र संशयः अहंकारस् तथा विद्या बुद्धिर् विद्या नरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: ahaṃkāras tu bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ahaṃkāras tathā vidyā buddhir vidyā nareśvara
verses.translation: (4th Mantra, 114th Sukta, IX Manala) "O Rajan (Lord as the person making them work) Soma, protect us by means of the Havis cooked for your sake. Let not the inimical assailant kill us nor destroy anything (wealth etc.) belonging to us. O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तम् अपरं प्राहुर् विद्या वै पञ्चविंशकः सर्वस्य सर्वम् इत्य् उक्तं ज्ञेयज्ञानस्य पारगः
verses.transliteration: avyaktam aparaṃ prāhur vidyā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ sarvasya sarvam ity uktaṃ jñeyajñānasya pāragaḥ
verses.translation: (3rd Mantra, IX-112) "I am the composer of the Suktas. Hence I am the father and son. I am the physician, Brahma of the Yajfia. This lady who makes the groats, gruel etc. is the mother or daughter. All of us of diverse mental pre¬ dilections and activities are desirous of wealth and like cows we serve the world. O Indu, flow out everywhere for the sake of Indra."

verses.transliteration: jñānam avyaktam ity uktaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam tathaiva jñānam avyaktaṃ vijñātā pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: By saying thus (i.e. by eulogizing Soma thus) the Soma was obtained for the Vajra-wielding Indra. By giving (the same Soma) to them Indra got his hundred sacrifices complete.

verses.sanskrit: विद्याविद्ये तु तत्त्वेन मयोक्ते वै विशेषतः अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव यद् उक्तं तन् निबोध मे
verses.transliteration: vidyāvidye tu tattvena mayokte vai viśeṣataḥ akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yad uktaṃ tan nibodha me
verses.translation: He comes in some other guise at midday in order to see me, Sankara and Hari. There, at midday, all people should be bowed to always.
verses.commentary: Sense: He comes in some other guise at midday in order to see me, Sankara and Hari. There, at midday, all people should be bowed to always.

verses.sanskrit: उभाव् एतौ क्षराव् उक्तौ उभाव् एताव् अनक्षरौ कारणं तु प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाज्ञानं तु ज्ञानतः
verses.transliteration: ubhāv etau kṣarāv uktau ubhāv etāv anakṣarau kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathājñānaṃ tu jñānataḥ
verses.translation: Merely by remembering that Tirtha, propitiation of (malignant) planets can be achieved. Another Tirtha is on the excellent mountain Indragopa.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधनाव् एतौ उभाव् एवेश्वरौ मतौ तत्त्वसंज्ञाव् उभाव् एव प्रोच्येते ज्ञानचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: anādinidhanāv etau ubhāv eveśvarau matau tattvasaṃjñāv ubhāv eva procyete jñānacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, who has the power to narrate in full that

verses.sanskrit: सर्गप्रलयधर्मित्वाद् अव्यक्तं प्राहुर् अव्ययम् तद् एतद् गुणसर्गाय विकुर्वाणं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sargapralayadharmitvād avyaktaṃ prāhur avyayam tad etad guṇasargāya vikurvāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: There can be no offence if the description by one prom¬ pted by devotion is inadequate. There is no doubt about it. For the sake of the benefit of the world certain features of that river have been indicated with very great difficulty.

verses.transliteration: guṇānāṃ mahadādīnām utpadyati parasparam adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṣetram āhur etad vai pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: The qualities beginning with Mahat arise from one another; the presiding field they call this twenty-fifth.

verses.sanskrit: यद् अन्तर्गुणजालं तु तद् व्यक्तात्मनि संक्षिपेत् तद् अहं तद् गुणैस् तैस् तु पञ्चविंशे विलीयते
verses.transliteration: yad antarguṇajālaṃ tu tad vyaktātmani saṃkṣipet tad ahaṃ tad guṇais tais tu pañcaviṃśe vilīyate
verses.translation: The net of qualities within should be drawn into the manifest self; then that 'I' with those qualities dissolves into the twenty-fifth.

verses.sanskrit: गुणा गुणेषु लीयन्ते तद् एका प्रकृतिर् भवेत् क्षेत्रज्ञो ऽपि तदा तावत् क्षेत्रज्ञः संप्रणीयते
verses.transliteration: guṇā guṇeṣu līyante tad ekā prakṛtir bhavet kṣetrajño 'pi tadā tāvat kṣetrajñaḥ saṃpraṇīyate
verses.translation: Qualities dissolve into qualities, and then Prakriti becomes one; then the knower of the field too is led to the knower of the field.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यदाक्षरं प्रकृतिर् यं गच्छते गुणसंज्ञिता निर्गुणत्वं च वै देहे गुणेषु परिवर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: yadākṣaraṃ prakṛtir yaṃ gacchate guṇasaṃjñitā nirguṇatvaṃ ca vai dehe guṇeṣu parivartanāt
verses.translation: When Prakriti, called qualities, goes to the imperishable, and qualitylessness comes about in the body through the turning of the qualities,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एवम् एव च क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रज्ञानपरिक्षयात् प्रकृत्या निर्गुणस् त्व् एष इत्य् एवम् अनुशुश्रुम
verses.transliteration: evam eva ca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrajñānaparikṣayāt prakṛtyā nirguṇas tv eṣa ity evam anuśuśruma
verses.translation: so the knower of the field, through the wearing away of the knowledge of the field, is without qualities by nature — so we have heard.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: क्षरो भवत्य् एष यदा गुणवती गुणेष्व् अथ प्रकृतिं त्व् अथ जानाति निर्गुणत्वं तथात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kṣaro bhavaty eṣa yadā guṇavatī guṇeṣv atha prakṛtiṃ tv atha jānāti nirguṇatvaṃ tathātmanaḥ
verses.translation: He becomes perishable when Prakriti with qualities is among the qualities; but then he knows Prakriti, and likewise his own qualitylessness.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तथा विशुद्धो भवति प्रकृतेः परिवर्जनात् अन्यो ऽहम् अन्येयम् इति यदा बुध्यति बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: tathā viśuddho bhavati prakṛteḥ parivarjanāt anyo 'ham anyeyam iti yadā budhyati buddhimān
verses.translation: So he becomes pure by giving up Prakriti; when the wise one understands, 'I am one thing and she is another,'

verses.sanskrit: तदैषो ऽव्यथताम् एति न च मिश्रत्वम् आव्रजेत् प्रकृत्या चैष राजेन्द्र मिश्रो ऽन्यो ऽन्यस्य दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tadaiṣo 'vyathatām eti na ca miśratvam āvrajet prakṛtyā caiṣa rājendra miśro 'nyo 'nyasya dṛśyate
verses.translation: then he becomes free from affliction and does not fall into mixture; with Prakriti, O king of kings, he is seen as mixed, each with the other.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु गुणजालं तत् प्राकृतं विजुगुप्सते पश्यते च परं पश्यंस् तदा पश्यन् नु संसृजेत्
verses.transliteration: yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tat prākṛtaṃ vijugupsate paśyate ca paraṃ paśyaṃs tadā paśyan nu saṃsṛjet
verses.translation: But when he feels disgust for that net of qualities of Prakriti and sees the Supreme, then, seeing, how could he unite with it again?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: किं मया कृतम् एतावद् यो ऽहं कालनिमज्जनः यथा मत्स्यो ह्य् अभिज्ञानाद् अनुवर्तितवाञ् जलम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ mayā kṛtam etāvad yo 'haṃ kālanimajjanaḥ yathā matsyo hy abhijñānād anuvartitavāñ jalam
verses.translation: 'What have I done all this time, sinking in time? Like a fish that, through knowing nothing else, followed the water,

verses.sanskrit: अहम् एव हि संमोहाद् अन्यम् अन्यं जनाज् जनम् मत्स्यो यथोदकज्ञानाद् अनुवर्तितवान् इह
verses.transliteration: aham eva hi saṃmohād anyam anyaṃ janāj janam matsyo yathodakajñānād anuvartitavān iha
verses.translation: I myself, out of delusion, went from one person to another, from birth to birth, as a fish followed the water here through its knowledge of water.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यो ऽन्यत्वम् अथाज्ञानाद् उदकान् नाभिमन्यते आत्मानं तद् अवज्ञानाद् अन्यं चैव न वेद्म्य् अहम्
verses.transliteration: matsyo 'nyatvam athājñānād udakān nābhimanyate ātmānaṃ tad avajñānād anyaṃ caiva na vedmy aham
verses.translation: The fish, out of ignorance, does not think itself other than the water; and I, through disregard, do not know the Self as other.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ममास्तु धिक् कुबुद्धस्य यो ऽहं मग्न इमं पुनः अनुवर्तितवान् मोहाद् अन्यम् अन्यं जनाज् जनम्
verses.transliteration: mamāstu dhik kubuddhasya yo 'haṃ magna imaṃ punaḥ anuvartitavān mohād anyam anyaṃ janāj janam
verses.translation: Fie on me, ill-minded one, who, sunk in this, followed again out of delusion from one person to another, from birth to birth.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अयम् अनुभवेद् बन्धुर् अनेन सह मे क्षयम् साम्यम् एकत्वतां यातो यादृशस् तादृशस् त्व् अहम्
verses.transliteration: ayam anubhaved bandhur anena saha me kṣayam sāmyam ekatvatāṃ yāto yādṛśas tādṛśas tv aham
verses.translation: This one may be my kinsman; with him I meet decline. I have reached sameness and oneness: as he is, so am I.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यताम् इह पश्यामि सदृशो ऽहम् अनेन वै अयं हि विमलो व्यक्तम् अहम् ईदृशकस् तदा
verses.transliteration: tulyatām iha paśyāmi sadṛśo 'ham anena vai ayaṃ hi vimalo vyaktam aham īdṛśakas tadā
verses.translation: I see equality here; I am truly like him. He is plainly stainless, and I am such as he.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽहम् अज्ञानसंमोहाद् अज्ञया संप्रवृत्तवान् संसर्गाद् अतिसंसर्गात् स्थितः कालम् इमं त्व् अहम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'ham ajñānasaṃmohād ajñayā saṃpravṛttavān saṃsargād atisaṃsargāt sthitaḥ kālam imaṃ tv aham
verses.translation: I, who out of the delusion of ignorance acted with the ignorant one, through association and excessive association, have stayed all this time.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहम् एवं वशीभूतः कालम् एतं न बुद्धवान् उत्तमाधममध्यानां ताम् अहं कथम् आवसे
verses.transliteration: so 'ham evaṃ vaśībhūtaḥ kālam etaṃ na buddhavān uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ tām ahaṃ katham āvase
verses.translation: I, so subjugated, did not recognize this time. How shall I dwell with her who is of high, low and middle kinds?
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: समानमायया चेह सहवासम् अहं कथम् गच्छाम्य् अबुद्धभावत्वाद् इहेदानीं स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: samānamāyayā ceha sahavāsam ahaṃ katham gacchāmy abuddhabhāvatvād ihedānīṃ sthiro bhava
verses.translation: How can I live with one of like illusion here? Out of lack of understanding I went; now be steady here.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सहवासं न यास्यामि कालम् एतं विवञ्चनात् वञ्चितो ह्य् अनया यद् धि निर्विकारो विकारया
verses.transliteration: sahavāsaṃ na yāsyāmi kālam etaṃ vivañcanāt vañcito hy anayā yad dhi nirvikāro vikārayā
verses.translation: I will not live with her any longer, having been deceived all this time; for I, changeless, was deceived by her who is change.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: न तत् तदपराद्धं स्याद् अपराधो ह्य् अयं मम यो ऽहम् अत्राभवं सक्तः पराङ्मुखम् उपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: na tat tadaparāddhaṃ syād aparādho hy ayaṃ mama yo 'ham atrābhavaṃ saktaḥ parāṅmukham upasthitaḥ
verses.translation: That was not her fault; the fault is mine, for I became attached here, having turned my face away.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्मिन् बहुरूपो ऽथ स्थितो मूर्तिर् अमूर्तिमान् अमूर्तिश् चाप्य् अमूर्तात्मा ममत्वेन प्रधर्षितः
verses.transliteration: tato 'smin bahurūpo 'tha sthito mūrtir amūrtimān amūrtiś cāpy amūrtātmā mamatvena pradharṣitaḥ
verses.translation: So I stayed in this of many forms, embodied though formless; and the formless, of formless nature, was overpowered by the sense of 'mine.'
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृत्या च तया तेन तासु तास्व् इह योनिषु निर्ममस्य ममत्वेन विकृतं तासु तासु च
verses.transliteration: prakṛtyā ca tayā tena tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu nirmamasya mamatvena vikṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca
verses.translation: By that Prakriti, in those various wombs here, I who am without 'mine' was altered by the sense of 'mine' in each of them,
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: योनिषु वर्तमानेन नष्टसंज्ञेन चेतसा समता न मया काचिद् अहंकारे कृता मया
verses.transliteration: yoniṣu vartamānena naṣṭasaṃjñena cetasā samatā na mayā kācid ahaṃkāre kṛtā mayā
verses.translation: dwelling in wombs with a mind whose awareness was lost. I made no equality with her in the ego.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं बहुधा कृत्वा सो ऽयं भूयो युनक्ति माम् इदानीम् अवबुद्धो ऽस्मि निर्ममो निरहंकृतः
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā so 'yaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām idānīm avabuddho 'smi nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Having made the self manifold, she joins me again; now I am awakened, free of 'mine' and free of ego.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: ममत्वं मनसा नित्यम् अहंकारकृतात्मकम् अपलग्नाम् इमां हित्वा संश्रयिष्ये निरामयम्
verses.transliteration: mamatvaṃ manasā nityam ahaṃkārakṛtātmakam apalagnām imāṃ hitvā saṃśrayiṣye nirāmayam
verses.translation: Abandoning the sense of 'mine,' always made by the mind and shaped by ego, and abandoning her who clung to me, I will resort to the one free from ill.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अनेन साम्यं यास्यामि नानयाहम् अचेतसा क्षेमं मम सहानेन नैवैकम् अनया सह
verses.transliteration: anena sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi nānayāham acetasā kṣemaṃ mama sahānena naivaikam anayā saha
verses.translation: With him I will attain sameness, not with this unconscious one; my welfare lies with him, not in oneness with her.'

verses.sanskrit: एवं परमसंबोधात् पञ्चविंशो ऽनुबुद्धवान् अक्षरत्वं निगच्छति त्यक्त्वा क्षरम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ paramasaṃbodhāt pañcaviṃśo 'nubuddhavān akṣaratvaṃ nigacchati tyaktvā kṣaram anāmayam
verses.translation: Thus through supreme awakening the twenty-fifth is awakened; abandoning the perishable, he attains the imperishable, free from ill.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं व्यक्तधर्माणं सगुणं निर्गुणं तथा निर्गुणं प्रथमं दृष्ट्वा तादृग् भवति मैथिल
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ vyaktadharmāṇaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā nirguṇaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛg bhavati maithila
verses.translation: The unmanifest with the qualities of the manifest, with qualities and without — having first seen the qualityless, one becomes like it, O king of Mithila.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षरक्षरयोर् एतद् उक्तं तव निदर्शनम् मयेह ज्ञानसंपन्नं यथा श्रुतिनिदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: akṣarakṣarayor etad uktaṃ tava nidarśanam mayeha jñānasaṃpannaṃ yathā śrutinidarśanāt
verses.translation: This illustration of the imperishable and the perishable I have given you here, full of knowledge, as shown by scripture.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: निःसंदिग्धं च सूक्ष्मं च विशुद्धं विमलं तथा प्रवक्ष्यामि तु ते भूयस् तन् निबोध यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca viśuddhaṃ vimalaṃ tathā pravakṣyāmi tu te bhūyas tan nibodha yathāśrutam
verses.translation: Free from doubt, subtle, pure and stainless — I will tell it to you again; learn it as it has been heard.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ययोगो मया प्रोक्तः शास्त्रद्वयनिदर्शनात् यद् एव सांख्यशास्त्रोक्तं योगदर्शनम् एव तत्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyayogo mayā proktaḥ śāstradvayanidarśanāt yad eva sāṃkhyaśāstroktaṃ yogadarśanam eva tat
verses.translation: I have taught Sankhya-yoga through the illustration of the two scriptures; what is taught in the Sankhya scripture is itself the vision of yoga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: प्रबोधनपरं ज्ञानं सांख्यानाम् अवनीपते विस्पष्टं प्रोच्यते तत्र शिष्याणां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: prabodhanaparaṃ jñānaṃ sāṃkhyānām avanīpate vispaṣṭaṃ procyate tatra śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: The knowledge of the Sankhyas aimed at awakening, O lord of the earth, is set out clearly there for the good of disciples.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बृहच् चैवम् इदं शास्त्रम् इत्य् आहुर् विदुषो जनाः अस्मिंश् च शास्त्रे योगानां पुनर्भवपुरःसरम्
verses.transliteration: bṛhac caivam idaṃ śāstram ity āhur viduṣo janāḥ asmiṃś ca śāstre yogānāṃ punarbhavapuraḥsaram
verses.translation: The learned call this scripture vast; and in this scripture, for the yogas, with rebirth in view,

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशात् परं तत्त्वं पठ्यते च नराधिप सांख्यानां तु परं तत्त्वं यथावद् अनुवर्णितम्
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśāt paraṃ tattvaṃ paṭhyate ca narādhipa sāṃkhyānāṃ tu paraṃ tattvaṃ yathāvad anuvarṇitam
verses.translation: a principle beyond the twenty-fifth is recited, O king; but for the Sankhyas the supreme principle has been described as it is.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धम् अप्रतिबुद्धं च बुध्यमानं च तत्त्वतः बुध्यमानं च बुद्धत्वं प्राहुर् योगनिदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: buddham apratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ budhyamānaṃ ca buddhatvaṃ prāhur yoganidarśanam
verses.translation: The awakened, the unawakened and the awakening one in truth; the awakening one and awakenedness they call the vision of yoga.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अप्रबुद्धम् अथाव्यक्तम् इमं गुणनिधिं सदा गुणानां धार्यतां तत्त्वं सृजत्य् आक्षिपते तथा
verses.transliteration: aprabuddham athāvyaktam imaṃ guṇanidhiṃ sadā guṇānāṃ dhāryatāṃ tattvaṃ sṛjaty ākṣipate tathā
verses.translation: Proceeding thus the divine river joined the sea. She has all the Tirthas (on her banks) and fulfils all the desires of men. Her power is unique.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।
verses.commentary: Sense: Proceeding thus the divine river joined the sea. She has all the Tirthas (on her banks) and fulfils all the desires of men. Her power is unique.

verses.sanskrit: अजो हि क्रीडया भूप विक्रियां प्राप्त इत्य् उत आत्मानं बहुधा कृत्वा नानेव प्रतिचक्षते
verses.transliteration: ajo hi krīḍayā bhūpa vikriyāṃ prāpta ity uta ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā nāneva praticakṣate
verses.translation: Wherefore has the intellect of everyone not been rendered completely calm even after hearing the eulogy of the Ganga through the nectar-like statements of mine? O sage, this appears to be the most mysterious thing in all the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherefore has the intellect of everyone not been rendered completely calm even after hearing the eulogy of the Ganga through the nectar-like statements of mine? O sage, this appears to be the most mysterious thing in all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतद् एवं विकुर्वाणो बुध्यमानो न बुध्यते गुणान् आचरते ह्य् एष सृजत्य् आक्षिपते तथा
verses.transliteration: etad evaṃ vikurvāṇo budhyamāno na budhyate guṇān ācarate hy eṣa sṛjaty ākṣipate tathā
verses.translation: O Brahman, it behoves you to dispel this doubt of mine.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahman, it behoves you to dispel this doubt of mine.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तबोधनाच् चैव बुध्यमानं वदन्त्य् अपि न त्व् एवं बुध्यते ऽव्यक्तं सगुणं तात निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktabodhanāc caiva budhyamānaṃ vadanty api na tv evaṃ budhyate 'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ tāta nirguṇam
verses.translation: Listen, O Narada. I shall tell you the secret of the excellent Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen, O Narada. I shall tell you the secret of the excellent Dharma.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् त्व् एव खल्व् एतत् तद् आहुः प्रतिबुद्धकम् बुध्यते यदि चाव्यक्तम् एतद् वै पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: kadācit tv eva khalv etat tad āhuḥ pratibuddhakam budhyate yadi cāvyaktam etad vai pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: The Gunas are three, the Purusas are three and the eternal deities are three. The Vedas in combination with the Smrtis are enumereted as four.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gunas are three, the Purusas are three and the eternal deities are three. The Vedas in combination with the Smrtis are enumereted as four.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: बुध्यमानो भवत्य् एष ममात्मक इति श्रुतः अन्योन्यप्रतिबुद्धेन वदन्त्य् अव्यक्तम् अच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: budhyamāno bhavaty eṣa mamātmaka iti śrutaḥ anyonyapratibuddhena vadanty avyaktam acyutam
verses.translation: In accordance with the Yugas it wanes quarter by quarter, O highly intelligent one. Dharma stands in need of Desa (Place) in both respects.
verses.commentary: Sense: In accordance with the Yugas it wanes quarter by quarter, O highly intelligent one. Dharma stands in need of Desa (Place) in both respects.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तबोधनाच् चैव बुध्यमानं वदन्त्य् उत पञ्चविंशं महात्मानं न चासाव् अपि बुध्यते
verses.transliteration: avyaktabodhanāc caiva budhyamānaṃ vadanty uta pañcaviṃśaṃ mahātmānaṃ na cāsāv api budhyate
verses.translation: If it were to be wanting in both Dharma would have been totally non-existent. Hence Dharma based on De£a has the full complement of the four quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: If it were to be wanting in both Dharma would have been totally non-existent. Hence Dharma based on De£a has the full complement of the four quarters.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशं विमलं बुद्धम् अप्रमेयं सनातनम् सततं पञ्चविंशं तु चतुर्विंशं विबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśaṃ vimalaṃ buddham aprameyaṃ sanātanam satataṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ tu caturviṃśaṃ vibudhyate
verses.translation: That Dharma abides in the Desas in the form of TIrthas. In the Kfta Yuga Dharma leans on the prop of De£a and Kala and settles down.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Dharma abides in the Desas in the form of TIrthas. In the Kfta Yuga Dharma leans on the prop of De£a and Kala and settles down.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यादृश्ये ह्य् अनुगततत्स्वभावे महाद्युते अव्यक्तं चैव तद् ब्रह्म बुध्यते तात केवलम्
verses.transliteration: dṛśyādṛśye hy anugatatatsvabhāve mahādyute avyaktaṃ caiva tad brahma budhyate tāta kevalam
verses.translation: In the Kaliyuga Dharma moves about unsteadily on one leg (having only a quater of itself). But it does not wane for one who comprehends Dharma in this way.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kaliyuga Dharma moves about unsteadily on one leg (having only a quater of itself). But it does not wane for one who comprehends Dharma in this way.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशं चतुर्विंशम् आत्मानम् अनुपश्यति बुध्यमानो यदात्मानम् अन्यो ऽहम् इति मन्यते
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśaṃ caturviṃśam ātmānam anupaśyati budhyamāno yadātmānam anyo 'ham iti manyate
verses.translation: The differences in castes are maintained in accordance with the power of the Yugas. Dharma is of diverse nature as it follows Gunas and those who work according to Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The differences in castes are maintained in accordance with the power of the Yugas. Dharma is of diverse nature as it follows Gunas and those who work according to Gunas.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रकृतिमान् एष भवत्य् अव्यक्तलोचनः बुध्यते च परां बुद्धिं विशुद्धाम् अमलां यथा
verses.transliteration: tadā prakṛtimān eṣa bhavaty avyaktalocanaḥ budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ viśuddhām amalāṃ yathā
verses.translation: By virtue of such a form and activity Dharma be¬ comes unique. Kala is said to be Abhivyafijaka (that which makes something manifest) and Deia is said to be Abhivyarigya (that which is manifested).

verses.translation: Whenever Kala assumes Abhivyakti (manifestation) that itself, O Brahman, is its token. Hence there is no doubt in this respect.

verses.transliteration: nirguṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ veda guṇayuktām acetanām tataḥ kevaladharmāsau bhavaty avyaktadarśanāt
verses.translation: The form of the Devas and the Vedas shall be in accordance with the Yugas. Those ofKarmans (rites), TIrthas, castfes and stages of life too (are in accordance with the Yugas).
verses.commentary: Sense: The form of the Devas and the Vedas shall be in accordance with the Yugas. Those ofKarmans (rites), TIrthas, castfes and stages of life too (are in accordance with the Yugas).

verses.sanskrit: केवलेन समागम्य विमुक्तात्मानम् आप्नुयात् एतत् तु तत्त्वम् इत्य् आहुर् निस्तत्त्वम् अजरामरम्
verses.transliteration: kevalena samāgamya vimuktātmānam āpnuyāt etat tu tattvam ity āhur nistattvam ajarāmaram
verses.translation: On hearing those words of his mother the elephant¬ faced one spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of his mother the elephant¬ faced one spoke:

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वसंश्रवणाद् एव तत्त्वज्ञो जायते नृप पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: tattvasaṃśravaṇād eva tattvajño jāyate nṛpa pañcaviṃśatitattvāni pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The sages too stay there itself, so also all the men and the Manes. Hence make liana, Mahelvara the lord of the Devas, leave the place.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages too stay there itself, so also all the men and the Manes. Hence make liana, Mahelvara the lord of the Devas, leave the place.

verses.sanskrit: न चैव तत्त्ववांस् तात संसारेषु निमज्जति एषाम् उपैति तत्त्वं हि क्षिप्रं बुध्यस्व लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: na caiva tattvavāṃs tāta saṃsāreṣu nimajjati eṣām upaiti tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ budhyasva lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: On hearing those words of his mother, Ganesvara said once again:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of his mother, Ganesvara said once again:

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशो ऽयम् इति प्राज्ञो गृह्यमाणो ऽजरामरः केवलेन बलेनैव समतां यात्य् असंशयम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśo 'yam iti prājño gṛhyamāṇo 'jarāmaraḥ kevalena balenaiva samatāṃ yāty asaṃśayam
verses.translation: O highly intelligent one, choose as boons all good and pleasing things that you cherish in your heart. I shall grant you everything that you may desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent one, choose as boons all good and pleasing things that you cherish in your heart. I shall grant you everything that you may desire.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: षड्विंशेन प्रबुद्धेन बुध्यमानो ऽप्य् अबुद्धिमान् एतन् नानात्वम् इत्य् उक्तं सांख्यश्रुतिनिदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍviṃśena prabuddhena budhyamāno 'py abuddhimān etan nānātvam ity uktaṃ sāṃkhyaśrutinidarśanāt
verses.translation: Sambhu, the benefactor of all the worlds, said to him once again:
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhu, the benefactor of all the worlds, said to him once again:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: चेतनेन समेतस्य पञ्चविंशतिकस्य ह एकत्वं वै भवेत् तस्य यदा बुद्ध्यानुबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: cetanena sametasya pañcaviṃśatikasya ha ekatvaṃ vai bhavet tasya yadā buddhyānubudhyate
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence Gautama said to Bhava with his spirit undepressed:
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence Gautama said to Bhava with his spirit undepressed:

verses.sanskrit: बुध्यमानेन बुद्धेन समतां याति मैथिल सङ्गधर्मा भवत्य् एष निःसङ्गात्मा नराधिप
verses.transliteration: budhyamānena buddhena samatāṃ yāti maithila saṅgadharmā bhavaty eṣa niḥsaṅgātmā narādhipa
verses.translation: Inasmuch as the divine river extending up to the ocean has been released from Brahma's mountain, O bull-bannered one, it is incumbent upon thee to stay thereon everywhere and always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inasmuch as the divine river extending up to the ocean has been released from Brahma's mountain, O bull-bannered one, it is incumbent upon thee to stay thereon everywhere and always.

verses.sanskrit: निःसङ्गात्मानम् आसाद्य षड्विंशं कर्मजं विदुः विभुस् त्यजति चाव्यक्तं यदा त्व् एतद् विबुध्यते
verses.transliteration: niḥsaṅgātmānam āsādya ṣaḍviṃśaṃ karmajaṃ viduḥ vibhus tyajati cāvyaktaṃ yadā tv etad vibudhyate
verses.translation: O lord of the worlds, thou alone art the giver of the fruit unto those who desire benefits. O lord of the Devas, other Tirthas are auspicious only in certain places.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the worlds, thou alone art the giver of the fruit unto those who desire benefits. O lord of the Devas, other Tirthas are auspicious only in certain places.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशम् अगाधं च षड्विंशस्य प्रबोधनात् एष ह्य् अप्रतिबुद्धश् च बुध्यमानस् तु ते ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśam agādhaṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśasya prabodhanāt eṣa hy apratibuddhaś ca budhyamānas tu te 'nagha
verses.translation: They know that place alone to be the yielder of aus¬ piciousness where thy presence is constant. It is the place where Ganga stationed in the crown of thy matted hair has been handed ever. O Sankara, thou being present everywhere there are Tirthas (everywhere).
verses.commentary: Sense: They know that place alone to be the yielder of aus¬ piciousness where thy presence is constant. It is the place where Ganga stationed in the crown of thy matted hair has been handed ever. O Sankara, thou being present everywhere there are Tirthas (everywhere).

verses.sanskrit: उक्तो बुद्धश् च तत्त्वेन यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात् मशकोदुम्बरे यद्वद् अन्यत्वं तद्वद् एतयोः
verses.transliteration: ukto buddhaś ca tattvena yathāśrutinidarśanāt maśakodumbare yadvad anyatvaṃ tadvad etayoḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Gautama, Siva said again with delight:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of Gautama, Siva said again with delight:
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्योदके यथा तद्वद् अन्यत्वम् उपलभ्यते एवम् एव च गन्तव्यं नानात्वैकत्वम् एतयोः
verses.transliteration: matsyodake yathā tadvad anyatvam upalabhyate evam eva ca gantavyaṃ nānātvaikatvam etayoḥ
verses.translation: Hence the Gahga Godavari led by you shall become the destroyer of all sins and the bestower of everything desired.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the Gahga Godavari led by you shall become the destroyer of all sins and the bestower of everything desired.
verses.hindi: इदं मयोक्तं प्रवरं पुराणं पापापहं धर्मविवर्धनं च। श्रुतं भवद्भिः परमं रहस्यमाज्ञापयध्वं मुनयो व्रजामि ।

verses.sanskrit: एतावन् मोक्ष इत्य् उक्तो ज्ञानविज्ञानसंज्ञितः पञ्चविंशतिकस्याशु यो ऽयं देहे प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: etāvan mokṣa ity ukto jñānavijñānasaṃjñitaḥ pañcaviṃśatikasyāśu yo 'yaṃ dehe pravartate
verses.translation: O mother, this has been heard by me directly from Siva who was speaking to Gautama. For this reason Sambhu is invariably present in the Ganga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, this has been heard by me directly from Siva who was speaking to Gautama. For this reason Sambhu is invariably present in the Ganga.

verses.sanskrit: एष मोक्षयितव्यैति प्राहुर् अव्यक्तगोचरात् सो ऽयम् एवं विमुच्येत नान्यथेति विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: eṣa mokṣayitavyaiti prāhur avyaktagocarāt so 'yam evaṃ vimucyeta nānyatheti viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: To the base man many obstacles do occur even as he desires to set off from his house. If he goes to the Ganga after setting his foot firmly over it does he not obtain any benefit from it?
verses.commentary: Sense: To the base man many obstacles do occur even as he desires to set off from his house. If he goes to the Ganga after setting his foot firmly over it does he not obtain any benefit from it?

verses.sanskrit: परश् च परधर्मा च भवत्य् एव समेत्य वै विशुद्धधर्मा शुद्धेन नाशुद्धेन च बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: paraś ca paradharmā ca bhavaty eva sametya vai viśuddhadharmā śuddhena nāśuddhena ca buddhimān
verses.translation: Who can describe its power (completely) should he be even Sadasiva himself? Everything has been succinctly narrated by me closely following the tradition and mythology.
verses.commentary: Sense: Who can describe its power (completely) should he be even Sadasiva himself? Everything has been succinctly narrated by me closely following the tradition and mythology.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तधर्मा बुद्धेन समेत्य पुरुषर्षभ वियोगधर्मिणा चैव विमुक्तात्मा भवत्य् अथ
verses.transliteration: vimuktadharmā buddhena sametya puruṣarṣabha viyogadharmiṇā caiva vimuktātmā bhavaty atha
verses.translation: In the extensive mythological legends there is every¬ thing conducive to the attainment of piety, wealth, love and liberation in the entire world consisting of mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the extensive mythological legends there is every¬ thing conducive to the attainment of piety, wealth, love and liberation in the entire world consisting of mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: विमोक्षिणा विमोक्षश् च समेत्येह तथा भवेत् शुचिकर्मा शुचिश् चैव भवत्य् अमितबुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: vimokṣiṇā vimokṣaś ca sametyeha tathā bhavet śucikarmā śuciś caiva bhavaty amitabuddhimān
verses.translation: The Purana has been narrated for the benefit of all the worlds. It consists of many pious rites. If perused carefully it contributes to the good of the worlds. It contains everything mentioned in the Vedas. It consists of all the secret doctrines of the Srutis. The very name (Purana) indicates that it is the cause of everything excellent.

verses.transliteration: vimalātmā ca bhavati sametya vimalātmanā kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai svatantraś ca svatantreṇa svatantratvam avāpyate
verses.translation: If anyone devoutly listens to or recites one verse or one word out of this or utters 'Ganga 5, 'Ganga 5, he shall obtain the spiritual benefit thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone devoutly listens to or recites one verse or one word out of this or utters 'Ganga 5, 'Ganga 5, he shall obtain the spiritual benefit thereby.

verses.sanskrit: एतावद् एतत् कथितं मया ते तथ्यं महाराज यथार्थतत्त्वम् अमत्सरस् त्वं प्रतिगृह्य बुद्ध्या सनातनं ब्रह्म विशुद्धम् आद्यम्
verses.transliteration: etāvad etat kathitaṃ mayā te tathyaṃ mahārāja yathārthatattvam amatsaras tvaṃ pratigṛhya buddhyā sanātanaṃ brahma viśuddham ādyam
verses.translation: The word Ganga uttered or the water of the Ganga imbibed becomes excellent. It is cabable of destroying the stigma of Kali age. It is auspicious. It gives splendour and all Siddhis (super-natural powers). It is worthy of veneration in the world. It grants desired things.
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Ganga uttered or the water of the Ganga imbibed becomes excellent. It is cabable of destroying the stigma of Kali age. It is auspicious. It gives splendour and all Siddhis (super-natural powers). It is worthy of veneration in the world. It grants desired things.

verses.sanskrit: तद् वेदनिष्ठस्य जनस्य राजन् प्रदेयम् एतत् परमं त्वया भवेत् विधित्समानाय निबोधकारकं प्रबोधहेतोः प्रणतस्य शासनम्
verses.transliteration: tad vedaniṣṭhasya janasya rājan pradeyam etat paramaṃ tvayā bhavet vidhitsamānāya nibodhakārakaṃ prabodhahetoḥ praṇatasya śāsanam
verses.translation: Well done, O Gautama! Welfare unto you. Who else is equal to you? It is you who eagerly brought this Ganga to the Dandaka forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Well done, O Gautama! Welfare unto you. Who else is equal to you? It is you who eagerly brought this Ganga to the Dandaka forest.

verses.sanskrit: न देयम् एतच् च यथानृतात्मने शठाय क्लीबाय न जिह्मबुद्धये न पण्डितज्ञानपरोपतापिने देयं तथा शिष्यविबोधनाय
verses.transliteration: na deyam etac ca yathānṛtātmane śaṭhāya klībāya na jihmabuddhaye na paṇḍitajñānaparopatāpine deyaṃ tathā śiṣyavibodhanāya
verses.translation: He who utters 'Ganga Ganga* even from hundreds of Yojanas away becomes rid of all sins; He goes to the world of Vi§nu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who utters 'Ganga Ganga* even from hundreds of Yojanas away becomes rid of all sins; He goes to the world of Vi§nu.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धान्वितायाथ गुणान्विताय परापवादाद् विरताय नित्यम् विशुद्धयोगाय बुधाय चैव कृपावते ऽथ क्षमिणे हिताय
verses.transliteration: śraddhānvitāyātha guṇānvitāya parāpavādād viratāya nityam viśuddhayogāya budhāya caiva kṛpāvate 'tha kṣamiṇe hitāya
verses.translation: In all the three worlds there are thirtyfive millions of Tirthas. When Jupiter is in the sign of Leo, all these Tirthas come to the Ganga for a bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the three worlds there are thirtyfive millions of Tirthas. When Jupiter is in the sign of Leo, all these Tirthas come to the Ganga for a bath.

verses.sanskrit: विविक्तशीलाय विधिप्रियाय विवादहीनाय बहुश्रुताय विनीतवेशाय नहैतुकात्मने सदैव गुह्यं त्व् इदम् एव देयम्
verses.transliteration: viviktaśīlāya vidhipriyāya vivādahīnāya bahuśrutāya vinītaveśāya nahaitukātmane sadaiva guhyaṃ tv idam eva deyam
verses.translation: Holy ablution in the Bhagirathi for sixty-thousand years is equal to a single bath in the Godavari when Brhaspati (Ju¬ piter) is in Simha (Leo).
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy ablution in the Bhagirathi for sixty-thousand years is equal to a single bath in the Godavari when Brhaspati (Ju¬ piter) is in Simha (Leo).

verses.sanskrit: एतैर् गुणैर् हीनतमे न देयम् एतत् परं ब्रह्म विशुद्धम् आहुः न श्रेयसे योक्ष्यति तादृशे कृतं धर्मप्रवक्तारम् अपात्रदानात्
verses.transliteration: etair guṇair hīnatame na deyam etat paraṃ brahma viśuddham āhuḥ na śreyase yokṣyati tādṛśe kṛtaṃ dharmapravaktāram apātradānāt
verses.translation: O son, this Gautami grants salvation unto all men who bathe therein anywhere at any time. That is due to Siva's bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, this Gautami grants salvation unto all men who bathe therein anywhere at any time. That is due to Siva's bidding.

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीम् इमां वा यदि रत्नपूर्णां दद्याद् अदेयं त्व् इदम् अव्रताय जितेन्द्रियाय प्रयताय देयं देयं परं तत्त्वविदे नरेन्द्र
verses.transliteration: pṛthvīm imāṃ vā yadi ratnapūrṇāṃ dadyād adeyaṃ tv idam avratāya jitendriyāya prayatāya deyaṃ deyaṃ paraṃ tattvavide narendra
verses.translation: Merely by listening to it one gets that benefit which is obtained by performing thousands of ASvamedhas (Horse-sacri¬ fices) or hundred of Vajapeya sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Merely by listening to it one gets that benefit which is obtained by performing thousands of ASvamedhas (Horse-sacri¬ fices) or hundred of Vajapeya sacrifices.
